english_meaning: to have sex in a public or outdoor location; to engage in sexual activity in a public place
explanation_mandarin: 指在户外或者公共场所进行性行为。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in sexual activity outdoors or in a public place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋後生仔女，成日都諗住去郊外打野戰，真係好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hau6 saang1 zai2 neoi5, sing4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 daa2 je5 zin3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这些年轻人，总是想着去郊外野战，真的很危险啊！
examples.english_sentence: These young people always think about having sex outdoors, it's really dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔明點解有人鍾意打野戰，又污糟又容易俾人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ming4 dim2 gaai2 jau5 jan4 zung1 ji3 daa2 je5 zin3, jau6 wu1 zou1 jau6 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不明白为什么有人喜欢野战，又脏又容易被人抓住。
examples.english_sentence: I don't understand why some people like having sex outdoors, it's dirty and easy to get caught.

english_meaning: to size up; to look (sb.) up and down; to take measure of
explanation_mandarin: 仔细地看、观察、估量。
explanation_english: To observe or scrutinize someone or something carefully, often to evaluate or assess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路行一路打量周圍嘅環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 haang4 jat1 lou6 daa2 loeng4 zau1 wai4 ge3 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一路走一路打量周围的环境。
examples.english_sentence: He was walking along and sizing up the surrounding environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾佢打量咗一陣，覺得好唔自在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 keoi5 daa2 loeng4 zo2 jat1 zan6, gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 zi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被他打量了一阵，觉得很不自在。
examples.english_sentence: I was sized up by him for a while and felt very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣打量人哋，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 daa2 loeng4 jan4 dei6, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样打量别人，很没有礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't size people up like that, it's very rude.

english_meaning: to give or receive an injection; to get a shot
explanation_mandarin: 给予或接受注射。通常指医疗行为，例如预防疫苗或治疗疾病。
explanation_english: To administer or receive an injection. Typically refers to a medical procedure such as getting a vaccination or treatment for an illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去診所打針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 can2 so2 daa2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去诊所打针。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the clinic for an injection tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路仔最驚打針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 geng1 daa2 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们最怕打针。
examples.english_sentence: Children are most afraid of getting shots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我定期返嚟打針，控制病情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 ding6 kei4 faan1 lai4 daa2 zam1, hung3 zai3 beng6 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我定期回来打针，控制病情。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to come back regularly for injections to control the illness.

mandarin_meaning: 注射过激素的鸡，比喻过分追求成绩或虚假强大的人
english_meaning: Literally: injected chicken. Figuratively: a person artificially boosted to perform better, often through unfair means or external help; someone who appears stronger or better than they actually are because of artificial enhancement.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是注射了激素的鸡。比喻通过不正当手段或外部帮助来提高表现的人；指那些因为人为强化而显得比实际更强或更好的人。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a chicken injected with hormones to make it grow bigger and faster. Figuratively, it describes someone who has been artificially enhanced or boosted to appear more capable or successful than they truly are. This often implies the use of unfair means or external assistance to achieve a desired outcome. The implication is that the person's skills or abilities are not genuine or earned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞到咁高分，我覺得佢好似打針雞咁，一定係補習補得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 lo2 dou3 gam3 gou1 fan1, ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 daa2 zam1 gai1 gam2, jat1 ding6 hai6 bou2 zaap6 bou2 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了这么高的分数，我觉得他好像是打了激素的鸡一样，一定是补习补得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He got such a high score on the exam. I think he's like an injected chicken; he must have been cramming really hard with tutoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做打針雞啦，靠自己嘅努力先至係真材實料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 daa2 zam1 gai1 laa1, kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zan1 caai4 sat6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做打针鸡了，靠自己的努力才是真材实料。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be an injected chicken. Relying on your own efforts is what truly counts.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻打了兴奋剂或强心剂的人或事物，暂时充满活力，但状态不稳定。
english_meaning: Figurative: Someone or something that has been given a 'shot in the arm' or boost; temporarily energized or invigorated but the state is unsustainable; comparable to a steroid user.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻接受刺激或帮助后，短时间内表现出异常活跃或强劲的状态，但这种状态并非自然，且难以持久。类似于打了兴奋剂的鸡，看起来很有活力，但这种活力是暂时的，并且之后会变得虚弱。
explanation_english: A figurative term that refers to someone or something that has received a boost or stimulus, exhibiting a temporarily heightened or energetic state. This state is unnatural and unsustainable, much like a chicken given an injection (usually implying a stimulant). The initial vigor is followed by a decline or return to a weaker state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司最近賺咗好多錢，但係我覺得佢哋好似打針鷄咁，唔會維持得耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 daa2 zam1 gai1 gam2, m4 wui5 wai4 ci4 dak1 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司最近赚了很多钱，但是我觉得他们好像打了兴奋剂一样，不会维持很久。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has made a lot of money recently, but I think they're like a 'shot in the arm' situation; it won't last long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅宣傳活動好似打針鷄咁，開始嘅時候好勁，但係之後就冇人理喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 syun1 cyun4 wut6 dung6 hou2 ci5 daa2 zam1 gai1 gam2, hoi1 ci2 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 ging6, daan6 hai6 zi1 hau6 zau6 mou5 jan4 lei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的宣传活动好像打了兴奋剂一样，开始的时候很厉害，但是之后就没人理了。
examples.english_sentence: This promotional campaign was like a 'shot in the arm'; it was great at the beginning, but no one paid attention afterwards.

english_meaning: to dial the wrong number; to make a mistake; to be wrong
explanation_mandarin: 拨错电话号码；做错事；搞错。
explanation_english: To dial the wrong number; to make a mistake; to be wrong. It can refer to dialing the wrong phone number or making a general mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我打錯咗電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 daa2 co3 zo2 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我打错电话了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I dialed the wrong number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做打錯晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 daa2 co3 saai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做全错的。
examples.english_sentence: You're doing it all wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗我哋可能打錯咗啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 daa2 co3 zo2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想我们可能搞错了一些事情。
examples.english_sentence: I think we may have gotten something wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 从事体力劳动；比喻努力工作
english_meaning: To work hard physically; to toil; to work hard (generally)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指打造铁器的工作，现在常用来比喻努力工作，付出辛勤的劳动。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the work of forging ironware, but now it is often used as a metaphor for working hard and putting in diligent labor. It implies a physical effort in getting something done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都要打鐵，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 daa2 tit3, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都要辛苦地工作，真的很累。
examples.english_sentence: Having to work hard every day is really tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搵食，唔打鐵點得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wan2 sik6, m4 daa2 tit3 dim2 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚钱糊口，不努力工作怎么行呢？
examples.english_sentence: In order to make a living, how can we not work hard?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日夜夜都喺度打鐵，就係為咗養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 je6 je6 dou1 hai2 dou6 daa2 tit3, zau6 hai6 wai6 zo2 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他日日夜夜都在努力工作，就是为了养家糊口。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard day and night just to support his family.

english_meaning: Strike while the iron is hot
explanation_mandarin: 比喻抓住时机，及时行动。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to seize the opportune moment to act decisively. To take advantage of a situation when it's most favorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱傾掂數，打鐵趁熱，即刻簽咗份合約佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 king1 ding6 sou3, daa2 tit3 can3 jit6, zik1 hak1 cim1 zo2 fan6 hap6 joek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚刚谈好价钱，趁热打铁，立刻签了合同。
examples.english_sentence: We just agreed on the price, so striking while the iron is hot, we immediately signed the contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考得咁好，打鐵趁熱，不如報多啲興趣班俾佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 gam3 hou2, daa2 tit3 can3 jit6, bat1 jyu4 bou3 do1 di1 hing3 ceoi3 baan1 bei2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考得这么好，趁热打铁，不如给他报多一些兴趣班吧。
examples.english_sentence: He did so well in the exam, striking while the iron is hot, why not sign him up for more interest classes?

mandarin_meaning: 暴打, 痛打, 狠狠地教训一顿
english_meaning: To give someone a good beating; to severely punish or scold someone
explanation_mandarin: 指狠狠地打一顿，或者严厉地训斥、惩罚某人。
explanation_english: Refers to giving someone a severe beating or severely scolding/punishing them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽話，我一定要打鑊佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 waa6, ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 wok6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听话，我一定要狠狠地教训他一顿。
examples.english_sentence: He's not listening, I must give him a good beating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細尋日因為我哋搞砸咗個project而打鑊我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 cam4 jat6 jan1 wai6 ngo5 dei6 gaau2 zaap6 zo2 go3 project ji4 daa2 wok6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板昨天因为我们搞砸了那个项目而狠狠地骂了我们一顿。
examples.english_sentence: The boss gave us a good dressing down yesterday because we messed up the project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我肥佬，阿媽返嚟實打鑊我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 fei4 lou2, aa3 maa1 faan1 lei4 sat1 daa2 wok6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我没及格，妈妈回来肯定要狠狠地骂我一顿。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam, my mom will definitely give me a good scolding when she gets back.

english_meaning: to give someone a severe beating; to beat someone up badly
explanation_mandarin: 指狠狠地打某人一顿，程度较重，带有教训或惩罚的意味。
explanation_english: To give someone a severe beating, often implying a lesson or punishment. The beating is quite harsh and significant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢俾人捉到，俾人打鑊甘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2, bei2 jan4 daa2 wok6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷东西被人抓到了，被人狠狠地打了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught stealing and got a severe beating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就打鑊甘你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 daa2 wok6 gam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就狠狠地揍你一顿。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I'll give you a good beating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚啲古惑仔喺街邊打鑊甘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 di1 gu2 waak6 zai2 hai2 gaai1 bin1 daa2 wok6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上那些小混混在街边打了一架，打得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Last night, those gangsters had a brawl on the street and beat each other badly.

mandarin_meaning: 大赚一笔; 狠狠地赚一笔
english_meaning: To make a killing; to make a big profit; to hit the jackpot
explanation_mandarin: 形容通过某种手段或机会，迅速且大量地赚取金钱。
explanation_english: Describes earning a large sum of money quickly through some means or opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋炒樓炒到打鑊金，真係羨慕死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 caau2 lau2 caau2 dou3 daa2 wok6 gam1, zan1 hai6 sin6 mou6 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们炒房赚了一大笔钱，真是羡慕死人。
examples.english_sentence: They made a killing from speculating on real estate; I'm so jealous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次股市升浪，好多人都打咗鑊金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 gu2 si5 sing1 long6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 daa2 zo2 wok6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次股市上涨，很多人都大赚了一笔。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of people made a big profit in this stock market rally.

english_meaning: to beat a gong; to publicize; to make a fuss about; to announce loudly
explanation_mandarin: 敲锣，通常用于吸引注意或宣告。也指大肆宣传或张扬某事。
explanation_english: Literally, to beat a gong. Figuratively, it means to publicize something widely, to make a fuss about something, or to announce something loudly, often to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁打鑼啦，大家都知你升咗職嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daa2 lo4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 sing1 zo2 zik1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么张扬了，大家都知道你升职了。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to publicize it so much, everyone knows you've been promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺度打鑼，話自己有幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 dou6 daa2 lo4, waa6 zi6 gei2 jau5 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在那里吹嘘，说自己有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's making a fuss about himself every day, saying how great he is.

english_meaning: To search high and low (with great fanfare); to make a very public and thorough search
explanation_mandarin: 形容声势浩大地寻找某物或某人，类似于敲锣打鼓地寻找，强调寻找的范围广且公开。
explanation_english: Describes searching for something or someone in a high-profile and thorough manner, similar to searching with gongs and drums. Emphasizes the breadth and public nature of the search.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打鑼咁揾隻走失咗嘅狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 lo4 gam2 wan2 zek3 zau2 sat1 zo2 ge3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们大张旗鼓地寻找那只走失的狗。
examples.english_sentence: They are searching high and low for the lost dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打鑼咁揾都揾唔到我嘅銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 lo4 gam2 wan2 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 ngo5 ge3 ngan2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我到处找也找不到我的钱包。
examples.english_sentence: I've searched high and low, but I still can't find my wallet.

english_meaning: To search high and low (making a lot of noise)
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常卖力、大张旗鼓地寻找某人或某物，就像敲锣打鼓一样引人注目。
explanation_english: Describes a very energetic and high-profile search for someone or something, making a lot of noise and drawing attention, similar to beating a gong and drum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗隻戒指，要打鑼咁搵先得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 zek3 gaai3 zi2, jiu3 daa2 lo4 gam2 wan2 sin1 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不见了戒指，得大张旗鼓地找才行了。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my ring, I have to search high and low for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司打鑼咁搵緊個IT專才呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 daa2 lo4 gam2 wan2 gan2 go3 IT zyun1 coi4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司正在四处寻找IT人才啊。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is searching high and low for an IT specialist.

english_meaning: to beat gongs and drums; to celebrate boisterously; to make a big fuss
explanation_mandarin: 形容热闹地庆祝，大肆宣传。
explanation_english: Describes a lively celebration, often involving the beating of gongs and drums, or making a big fuss about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職，成家人打鑼打鼓咁慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1, sing4 gaa1 jan4 daa2 lo4 daa2 gu2 gam2 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，全家人敲锣打鼓地庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, and the whole family celebrated with a big fuss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁打鑼打鼓嘅，小事啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daa2 lo4 daa2 gu2 ge3, siu2 si6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么敲锣打鼓的，小事而已。
examples.english_sentence: No need to make such a big fuss, it's just a small matter.

synonyms: 大肆宣揚 (daai6 si3 syun1 joeng4)
大事宣傳 (daai6 si6 syun1 cyun4)

jyutping: daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2
english_meaning: Can't find even if you beat a gong looking for it; extremely difficult to find; virtually impossible to find.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常难以找到某人或某物，即使大张旗鼓地寻找也找不到。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is extremely difficult or impossible to find, even with a lot of effort and publicity. The image is of someone beating a gong to attract attention and help in the search, but still failing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲口罩咁搶手，打鑼都揾唔倒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 hau2 zaau3 gam3 coeng2 sau2, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近口罩这么抢手，简直遍寻不着了。
examples.english_sentence: Face masks are so sought after these days, you practically can't find them anywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失咗蹤咁耐，打鑼都揾唔倒佢，真係擔心死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 zo2 zung1 gam3 noi6, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 daam1 sam1 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失踪这么久，到处都找不到他，真是担心死了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been missing for so long, we can't find him anywhere, even if we beat a gong to look for him. I'm so worried.

synonyms: 冇影冇蹤 (mou5 jeng2 mou5 zung1)

jyutping: daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2
mandarin_meaning: 遍寻不着; 怎么也找不到
english_meaning: Impossible to find, even if you beat a gong to search; absolutely cannot be found; extremely rare
explanation_mandarin: 即使敲锣打鼓地四处寻找也找不到。形容非常稀有或者难以找到。
explanation_english: Even if you beat a gong while searching everywhere, you still cannot find it. It describes something that is extremely rare or difficult to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生仔咁有上進心，真係打鑼都揾唔到幾個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 gam3 jau5 soeng5 zeon3 sam1, zan1 hai6 daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 gei2 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在像这样有上进心的年轻人，真是很难找到几个。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, it's really hard to find many young people who are this ambitious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅為人咁差，想揾個肯幫佢嘅人，打鑼都揾唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wai4 jan4 gam3 caa1, soeng2 wan2 go3 hang2 bong1 keoi5 ge3 jan4, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人这么差，想找一个肯帮助他的人，根本找不到。
examples.english_sentence: His character is so bad that he won't be able to find anyone willing to help him, no matter how hard he tries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款絕版嘅玩具，而家打鑼都揾唔到㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 kwan2 zyut6 baan2 ge3 waan2 geoi6, ji4 gaa1 daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款绝版的玩具，现在根本找不到了。
examples.english_sentence: This limited edition toy is impossible to find now.

jyutping: daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2
english_meaning: Nowhere to be found; impossible to find even if you searched everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容很难找到某人或某物，即使敲锣打鼓大范围寻找也找不到。
explanation_english: This idiom describes something or someone extremely difficult to find. It suggests even a thorough search accompanied by the loud announcement of a gong wouldn't be enough to locate it/them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好古惑，打鑼都搵唔倒佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gu2 waak6, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很狡猾，到处都找不到他的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very cunning person; you wouldn't be able to find him anywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約唔見咗，打鑼都搵唔倒，真係大鑊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 m4 gin3 zo2, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2, zan1 hai6 daai6 wok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合同不见了，到处都找不到，真是糟糕！
examples.english_sentence: The contract is missing, nowhere to be found! This is really bad!

jyutping: daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2
english_meaning: impossible to find; can't be found no matter how hard you look; you could search high and low and still not find it
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常稀少或隐藏得很深，难以找到。即使敲锣打鼓地寻找，也无法找到。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very rare, hidden very well, or simply unattainable. It implies that even if you were to search with a loud and thorough method (like beating a gong), you still wouldn't be able to find it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好古怪，打鑼都搵唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gu2 gwaai3, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很古怪，很难找到他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very strange person, you can never find him no matter how hard you try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲筍盤，打鑼都搵唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 seon2 pun2, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的好房产，根本找不到了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, good property deals are impossible to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多年都冇見，佢都打鑼都搵唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 nin4 dou1 mou5 gin3, keoi5 dou1 daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么多年都没见，他现在也很难找到了。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so many years since I last saw him, he's probably impossible to find now.

synonyms: 海底撈針 (hoi2 dai2 laau1 zam1)

jyutping: daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2
mandarin_meaning: 很难找到；无论如何都找不到
english_meaning: cannot be found anywhere, even with a gong; extremely difficult to find
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常难找到某人或某物，即使敲锣打鼓地寻找也找不到，表示其非常罕见或藏匿极深。
explanation_english: This idiom describes something or someone extremely difficult or impossible to find, even with a thorough search (implied by using a gong to announce the search). It suggests that the thing/person is either very rare or well hidden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲良心醫生，真係打鑼都搵唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 loeng4 sam1 yi1 sang1, zan1 hai6 daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的好医生，真是很难找到了。
examples.english_sentence: Good doctors nowadays are really hard to find.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人咁孤僻，打鑼都搵唔到佢去邊㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gam3 gu1 pik1, daa2 lo4 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5 heoi3 bin1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人这么孤僻，无论如何都找不到他去了哪里。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a loner, you'll never find him no matter how hard you search.

english_meaning: to open; to switch on; to turn on
explanation_mandarin: 表示打开或开启某个东西，如打开门、打开灯、打开电视等。
explanation_english: To open something physically (e.g., a door, a book) or to switch on/turn on something electrical (e.g., a light, a TV).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打開度門啦，好焗呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 hoi1 dou6 mun4 laa1, hou2 guk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把门打开吧，太闷了。
examples.english_sentence: Open the door, it's too stuffy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打開咗電視睇新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 hoi1 zo2 din6 si6 tai2 san1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打开电视看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He turned on the TV to watch the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打開個app，就見到你想睇嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 hoi1 go3 app1, zau6 gin3 dou2 nei5 soeng2 tai2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打开这个app，就能看到你想看的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Open this app and you'll see what you want to see.

mandarin_meaning: 摊牌; 说实话; 亮底牌
english_meaning: to lay one's cards on the table; to show one's hand; to be frank; to come clean
explanation_mandarin: 比喻公开说明真相或意图，不再隐瞒。
explanation_english: To reveal one's true intentions or position; to be honest and open about something that was previously hidden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然大家咁熟，不如打開口牌講清楚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 daai6 gaa1 gam3 suk6, bat1 jyu4 daa2 hoi1 hau2 paai2 gong2 cing1 co2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然大家都这么熟了，不如摊牌说清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since we all know each other so well, why don't we just lay our cards on the table and clarify everything?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於打開口牌，承認自己偷咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 daa2 hoi1 hau2 paai2, sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 tau1 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于摊牌，承认自己偷了钱。
examples.english_sentence: He finally came clean and admitted that he stole the money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺談判嘅時候，我哋要睇吓對方幾時會打開口牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 taam4 pun3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 haa5 deoi3 fong1 gei2 si4 wui2 daa2 hoi1 hau2 paai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在谈判的时候，我们要看看对方什么时候会亮出底牌。
examples.english_sentence: During the negotiation, we need to see when the other party will show their hand.

jyutping: daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa6
english_meaning: to speak frankly; to speak plainly; to be upfront about something
explanation_mandarin: 比喻说话或行事不拐弯抹角，直接坦率。
explanation_english: It means to speak or act directly and frankly without beating around the bush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打開天窗說亮話啦，你到底想點啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa6 laa1, nei5 dou3 dai2 soeng2 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 咱们打开天窗说亮话吧，你到底想怎样？
examples.english_sentence: Let's be frank, what do you really want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好估估吓啦，打開天窗說亮話啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gu2 gu2 haa5 laa1, daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别猜来猜去了，打开天窗说亮话吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop guessing, let's speak frankly.

jyutping: daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa2
english_meaning: to speak frankly; to be open and honest
explanation_mandarin: 比喻说话做事开诚布公，不拐弯抹角，直接坦率。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to speak openly and honestly without beating around the bush; to be straightforward and candid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋打開天窗説亮話啦，你究竟想點？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa2 laa1, nei5 gau3 ging2 soeng2 dim2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们开天窗说亮话吧，你到底想怎样？
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we speak frankly? What exactly do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩唔滿意咪打開天窗説亮話囉，唔使收收埋埋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 mai5 daa2 hoi1 tin1 coeng1 syut3 loeng6 waa2 lo1, m4 sai2 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么不满意就开天窗说亮话啊，不用藏着掖着。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any dissatisfaction, just speak frankly. There's no need to hide it.

synonyms: 直話直説 (zik6 waa6 zik6 syut3)
有話直說 (jau5 waa6 zik6 syut3)

english_meaning: to open one's heart; to unburden oneself; to confide
explanation_mandarin: 比喻打开自己的内心，坦诚地表达自己的想法和感受。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to open one's heart, to express one's thoughts and feelings sincerely and honestly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望你可以同我打開心扉，講下你嘅煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 daa2 hoi1 sam1 fei1, gong2 haa5 nei5 ge3 faan4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望你可以向我敞开心扉，说说你的烦恼。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you can open your heart to me and talk about your worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要建立真正嘅友誼，就要互相打開心扉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gin3 lap6 zan1 zeng3 ge3 jau5 ji5, zau6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 daa2 hoi1 sam1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要建立真正的友谊，就要互相敞开心扉。
examples.english_sentence: To build a true friendship, you must open your hearts to each other.

english_meaning: To somersault; to tumble; to fall head over heels; to suffer a setback (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指身体前后翻转，做翻跟头的动作。2. 比喻遇到挫折，遭受失败。
explanation_english: 1. Literally, to perform a somersault or tumbling motion. 2. Figuratively, to suffer a setback, to experience a failure, or to have plans go awry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路喺草地上面打關斗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 hai2 cou2 dei6 soeng6 min6 daa2 gwaan1 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩在草地上翻跟头。
examples.english_sentence: That child is somersaulting on the grass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意失敗，打咗個關斗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 sat1 baai6, daa2 zo2 go3 gwaan1 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意失败了，摔了个跟头。
examples.english_sentence: He failed in his business and suffered a setback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我打咗個關斗，下次要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 daa2 zo2 go3 gwaan1 dau2, haa6 ci3 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考砸了，下次要努力一些。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up this exam; I need to work harder next time.

english_meaning: to play mahjong
explanation_mandarin: 指玩麻将。麻将是一种四人参与的棋牌游戏。
explanation_english: Refers to playing mahjong. Mahjong is a tile-based game played by four people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去打雀啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daa2 zoek3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去打麻将吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's play mahjong tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打雀，唔做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 zoek3, m4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天打麻将，不做事。
examples.english_sentence: He plays mahjong all day and doesn't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打雀要量力而为，唔好赌得太大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zoek3 jiu3 loeng4 lik6 ji4 wai4, m4 hou2 dou2 dak1 taai3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打麻将要量力而行，不要赌太大。
examples.english_sentence: When playing mahjong, you should play within your means, don't gamble too much.

english_meaning: to squint (like a sparrow)
explanation_mandarin: 形容眼睛眯成一条线，像麻雀的眼睛一样。通常用于形容人困倦、不悦，或者看不清楚东西时的状态。
explanation_english: Describes the eyes being narrowed into slits, resembling the eyes of a sparrow. Typically used to describe someone who is sleepy, unhappy, or unable to see things clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢眼瞓到打雀咁眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaan5 fan3 dou3 daa2 zoek3 gam2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他困得眼睛都眯成一条线了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so sleepy that his eyes are squinting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我無戴眼鏡，睇嘢睇到打雀咁眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 mou5 daai3 ngaan5 geng3, tai2 je5 tai2 dou3 daa2 zoek3 gam2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我没戴眼镜，看东西都眯着眼睛。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm not wearing my glasses, so I'm squinting to see things.

english_meaning: To squint like a sparrow; to have small, squinty eyes; to be narrow-eyed
explanation_mandarin: 形容眼睛很小，像麻雀的眼睛一样眯着。带有一点贬义。
explanation_english: Describes having small, squinty eyes, resembling the eyes of a sparrow. Carries a slightly derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對眼打雀噉眼咁，好難睇到佢嘅表情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngaan5 daa2 zoek3 gam2 ngaan5 gam2, hou2 naan4 tai2 dou3 keoi5 ge3 biu2 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼睛眯成一条线，很难看清他的表情。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes are so squinty that it's hard to read his expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋，話人哋打雀噉眼唔係咁好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 yan4 dei6, waa6 yan4 dei6 daa2 zoek3 gam2 ngaan5 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说别人，说别人眯眯眼不太好听。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about people like that; calling someone 'squinty-eyed' isn't very nice.

english_meaning: to do odd jobs; to be a handyman; to do menial tasks
explanation_mandarin: 做各种零碎的、不重要的工作。
explanation_english: To perform various small, unimportant tasks; to be a general helper or odd-job person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺餐廳打雜，咩都要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 caan1 teng1 daa2 zaap6, me1 dou1 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在餐厅打杂，什么都要做。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing odd jobs in the restaurant, he has to do everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱入職，咪住打雜先囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 jap6 zik1, mai6 zyu6 daa2 zaap6 sin1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚入职，先做打杂的活吧。
examples.english_sentence: I just joined the company, so I'll start by doing odd jobs.

english_meaning: to thunder
explanation_mandarin: 天空云层放电时发出的巨大声音。
explanation_english: To produce a loud crashing or rumbling sound caused by atmospheric electrical discharges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日夜晚打雷打得好勁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 je6 maan5 daa2 leoi4 daa2 dak1 hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上打雷打得很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: It was thundering really badly last night!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一打雷就落狗屎咁落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 daa2 leoi4 zau6 lok6 gau2 si2 gam2 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一打雷就下倾盆大雨。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as it thunders, it starts to rain cats and dogs.

english_meaning: to send a telegram
explanation_mandarin: 指通过电报局发送电报，一种早期的远程通信方式。
explanation_english: To send a telegram; an early form of long-distance communication via a telegraph office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人有急事，就會去郵局打電報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 jau5 gap1 si6, zau6 wui5 heoi3 jau4 guk6 daa2 din6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们有急事，就会去邮局发电报。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people would go to the post office to send a telegram when they had urgent matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家都好少人打電報啦，都用電話或者短訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 dou1 hou2 siu2 jan4 daa2 din6 bou3 laa1, dou1 yung6 din6 waa2 waak6 ze2 dyun2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少人发电报了，都用电话或者短信。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few people send telegrams; they use telephones or text messages instead.

english_meaning: To use a computer / To play on the computer
explanation_mandarin: 指操作电脑，可以是工作学习，也可以是娱乐。
explanation_english: Refers to operating a computer, which can be for work and study, or for entertainment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要打電腦做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 daa2 din6 nou5 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天需要用电脑做功课。
examples.english_sentence: I need to use the computer to do my homework today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路成日打電腦，都唔溫書嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 daa2 din6 nou5, dou1 m4 wan1 syu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些孩子们整天玩电脑，都不复习功课的。
examples.english_sentence: Those kids are always playing on the computer, they don't even study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返工成日都要打電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 gung1 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 daa2 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上班总是要用电脑。
examples.english_sentence: He always has to use the computer at work.

english_meaning: to make a phone call, to call
explanation_mandarin: 指拨打电话。
explanation_english: To make a phone call, to dial a number and speak to someone using a telephone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會打電話俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会打电话给你。
examples.english_sentence: I will call you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以打電話問下佢幾點嚟呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daa2 din6 waa2 man6 haa5 keoi5 gei2 dim2 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以打电话问一下他几点来吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you call and ask him what time he is coming?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我借你電話打個電話得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 je3 nei5 din6 waa2 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我可以借你的电话打个电话吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, can I borrow your phone to make a call?

english_meaning: to shiver; to tremble; to shake
explanation_mandarin: 指身体因寒冷、恐惧、激动等原因而不由自主地抖动。
explanation_english: To shake or tremble involuntarily, typically due to cold, fear, excitement, or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍到我成身打震呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dou3 ngo5 sing4 san1 daa2 zan3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我冻得全身发抖。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so cold that my whole body is shivering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到腳都打震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 goek3 dou1 daa2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得腿都发抖。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that his legs were trembling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 知道考試肥佬，佢驚到打震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 dou3 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, keoi5 geng1 dou3 daa2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 知道考试不及格，他害怕得发抖。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing he failed the exam, he was trembling with fear.

mandarin_meaning: 蒙混, 掩饰, 混淆视听
english_meaning: to obscure, to obfuscate, to confuse, to play dumb, to feign ignorance
explanation_mandarin: 指用含糊不清的言语或行动来掩盖真相，使人难以理解或分辨。
explanation_english: To obscure or confuse something with vague or misleading statements or actions; to play dumb or pretend not to know something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度打霧啦，講清楚件事嘅來龍去脈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daa2 mou6 laa1, gong2 cing1 chu2 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里含糊其辞了，把事情的来龙去脉讲清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb here, explain the whole story clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明喺度打霧，唔想負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai2 dou6 daa2 mou6, m4 soeng2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明显在装糊涂，不想负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He's obviously trying to play dumb, he doesn't want to take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想打霧呃人，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 daa2 mou6 aak1 jan4, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想混淆视听骗人，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's trying to trick people by being evasive, don't trust him.

english_meaning: To waste effort; to be in vain; fruitless; a wild goose chase.
explanation_mandarin: 指做事情白费力气，没有结果，最终落空。形容做了无用功。
explanation_english: Refers to putting in effort that is ultimately wasted and leads to no result. Describes doing futile work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住今次一定得，點知都係打霧水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 dak1, dim2 zi1 dou1 hai6 daa2 mou6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这次肯定行，没想到还是白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: I thought I would definitely succeed this time, but it was all in vain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你噉樣做，只會打霧水㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, zi2 wui5 daa2 mou6 seoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，只会白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: If you do it this way, you'll only be wasting your effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗咁耐，都係打霧水，佢根本唔聽我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 hai6 daa2 mou6 seoi2, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他说了这么久，都是白费力气，他根本不听我说话。
examples.english_sentence: I've been talking to him for so long, but it's all been in vain. He doesn't listen to me at all.

synonyms: 徒勞無功 (tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1)

english_meaning: to be executed by firing squad; to shoot at a target
explanation_mandarin: 最初指枪决犯人，现在也可指射击靶子。前者用法比较负面，后者则中性。
explanation_english: Originally referred to execution by firing squad. Now, it can also mean to shoot at a target. The former usage is negative, while the latter is neutral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個殺人犯判咗打靶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saat3 jan4 faan6 pun3 zo2 daa2 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个杀人犯被判处枪毙。
examples.english_sentence: That murderer was sentenced to be executed by firing squad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗射擊場打靶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 se6 gik1 coeng4 daa2 baa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了射击场射击。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the shooting range to shoot at targets.

mandarin_meaning: 小兔崽子; 混蛋; 枪靶子
english_meaning: Little bastard; son of a gun; target for shooting (literal)
explanation_mandarin: 指责对方为小兔崽子或混蛋，属于骂人的话。字面意思是枪靶子，引申为可以随意欺负或辱骂的人。语气强烈，含有贬义。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to call someone a "little bastard" or "son of a gun". The literal meaning is "target for shooting", which is used figuratively to mean someone who can be easily bullied or insulted. It is a strong and offensive term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，真係打靶仔嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, zan1 hai6 daa2 baa2 zai2 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，真是个混蛋！
examples.english_sentence: The way you did that, you're really a bastard!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬲啦，佢都係細路仔，唔識嘢啫，唔使鬧佢打靶仔嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 sai3 lou6 zai2, m4 sik1 je5 ze1, m4 sai2 nau6 keoi5 daa2 baa2 zai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么生气了，他还是个孩子，不懂事，不用骂他是小兔崽子。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, he's still a child, doesn't know better, no need to call him a little bastard.

english_meaning: Damn you; You deserve to be shot
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常强烈的厌恶、愤怒或诅咒。 “打靶”指枪毙， “鬼”指可憎的人。 指该枪毙的鬼，比喻非常厌恶的人。
explanation_english: A very strong expression of dislike, anger or a curse. "打靶 (daa2 baa2)" refers to being executed by firing squad, and "鬼 (gwai2)" refers to a detestable person. Refers to a 'ghost' who deserves to be shot, implying extreme dislike of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日搞搞震，真係打靶鬼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, zan1 hai6 daa2 baa2 gwai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一天到晚搞事情，真是个该死的家伙！
examples.english_sentence: You're always causing trouble, damn you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個衰仔咁唔生性，簡直係打靶鬼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 seoi1 zai2 gam3 m4 sang1 sing3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 daa2 baa2 gwai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个坏小子这么不争气，简直是个该死的家伙！
examples.english_sentence: That useless son is so hopeless, he's just a damn fool!

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to lick someone's boots
explanation_mandarin: 比喻奉承、讨好别人，尤指向上级或有权势的人献媚。
explanation_english: A metaphor for flattering or pleasing someone, especially currying favor with superiors or those in power. It suggests excessively praising someone to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前打鞋碼，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 daa2 haai4 maa5, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在老板面前拍马屁，想升职呗。
examples.english_sentence: He's always sucking up to the boss, trying to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣打鞋碼啦，好肉酸㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 daa2 haai4 maa5 laa1, hou2 juk6 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样拍马屁了，很丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flatter like that, it's embarrassing.

english_meaning: to get off to a flying start, to make a successful start, to achieve a great initial success
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一开始就取得显著的成功，为后续奠定良好的基础。
explanation_english: It means to achieve significant success at the very beginning, laying a good foundation for the future. It's often used to describe a successful launch of a project, campaign, or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新產品嘅推出，公司想打響頭炮，所以做咗好多宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 caan2 pan2 ge3 tui1 ceot1, gung1 si1 soeng2 daa2 hoeng2 tau4 paau3, so2 ji5 zou6 zo2 ho2 do1 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次新产品的推出，公司想打响第一炮，所以做了很多宣传。
examples.english_sentence: For the launch of this new product, the company wanted to get off to a flying start, so they did a lot of promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽入面打響頭炮，攞咗個冠軍，真係好叻！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 daa2 hoeng2 tau4 paau3, lo2 zo2 go3 gun1 gwan3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中打响第一炮，拿了冠军，真的很棒！
examples.english_sentence: He got off to a flying start in the competition and won the championship, he's really great!

synonyms: 旗開得勝 (kei4 hoi1 dak1 sing3)
先聲奪人 (sin1 seng1 dyut6 jan4)

mandarin_meaning: 预先通知, 提前打招呼
english_meaning: to inform in advance, to give prior notice
explanation_mandarin: 事先通知对方，让对方有所准备。
explanation_english: To inform someone in advance, allowing them to prepare or be aware of something beforehand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得打預我，我好安排時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daa2 jyu6 ngo5, ngo5 hou2 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得提前告诉我，我好安排时间。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to let me know in advance, so I can arrange my time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都冇打預聲就嚟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 mou5 daa2 jyu6 seng1 zau6 lai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都没提前打招呼就来了。
examples.english_sentence: He came without giving any prior notice.

english_meaning: to take the lead; to be the first to do something; to lead the way; to initiate
explanation_mandarin: 比喻带头做某事，首先开始。最初指戏曲表演时第一个敲锣，引申为第一个做某事的人或行动。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to take the lead in doing something, to start something first. Originally refers to the first gong being struck at the beginning of a Cantonese opera performance, now extended to mean the first person or action in doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次打頭鑼，搞咗個新嘅市場推廣策略，反應好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 daa2 tau4 lo4, gaau2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4 teoi1 gwong2 caak3 loek6, faan2 jing3 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他带头，搞了一个新的市场推广策略，反响很好。
examples.english_sentence: This time, he took the lead and launched a new marketing strategy, which had a great response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司要打頭鑼，率先推出呢款新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jiu3 daa2 tau4 lo4, leot6 sin1 teoi1 ceot1 ni1 kwan2 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司要带头，率先推出这款新产品。
examples.english_sentence: Our company needs to take the lead and launch this new product first.

english_meaning: to lead the way; to spearhead; to be the first to take action
explanation_mandarin: 在队伍或行动中担任先锋，第一个行动或尝试。
explanation_english: To take the lead in a group or action; to be the first to act or try something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個Project好重要，你打頭陣，我哋支持你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 Project hou2 zung6 jiu3, nei5 daa2 tau4 zan6, ngo5 dei6 zi1 chi4 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划很重要，你打头阵，我们支持你！
examples.english_sentence: This project is very important, you take the lead, we'll support you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個比賽入面打頭陣，表現好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 daa2 tau4 zan6, biu2 hin3 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中打头阵，表现很好。
examples.english_sentence: He spearheaded the competition and performed very well.

english_meaning: to have a typhoon; typhoon
explanation_mandarin: 指刮台风。既可以作动词，表示“刮台风”，也可以作名词，表示“台风”。
explanation_english: Refers to a typhoon happening. It can be used as a verb, meaning 'to have a typhoon,' or as a noun, meaning 'typhoon'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會打風，唔好出街啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1, m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会刮台风，不要出门啦。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a typhoon tomorrow, don't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文台話今次個打風好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 gam1 ci3 go3 daa2 fung1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文台说这次的台风很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The observatory says this typhoon is very strong.

jyutping: daa2 fung1 m4 sing4 saam1 jat6 jyu5
english_meaning: A storm doesn't result in three days of rain; to start strong but fade quickly; a flash in the pan; all bark and no bite.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻开始时声势很大，但很快就消失或无结果。形容事情雷声大雨点小，持续时间很短。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where something starts with a lot of momentum or promise but quickly fades away or amounts to nothing. It's like a storm that doesn't lead to lasting rain, implying a lack of follow-through or substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要減肥，點知打風唔成三日雨，一個禮拜都唔夠就放棄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, dim2 zi1 daa2 fung1 m4 sing4 saam1 jat6 jyu5, jat1 go3 lai5 baai1 dou1 m4 gau3 zau6 fong3 hei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要减肥，结果虎头蛇尾，一个星期都不到就放弃了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he was going to lose weight, but it was a flash in the pan; he gave up in less than a week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司開頭話要大展拳腳，點知打風唔成三日雨，做咗幾個月就摺埋咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hoi1 tau4 waa6 jiu3 daai6 zin2 kyun4 goek3, dim2 zi1 daa2 fung1 m4 sing4 saam1 jat6 jyu5, zou6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 zip3 maai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司一开始说要大展宏图，结果虎头蛇尾，做了几个月就倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company initially said they would expand ambitiously, but it was all bark and no bite; they closed down after a few months.

english_meaning: unshakeable, unshakable even in a typhoon, very stable, reliable, solid (relationship/object)
explanation_mandarin: 即使台风来也吹不掉，比喻非常牢固、稳固，形容关系或事物非常稳定可靠。
explanation_english: Literally means 'unshakeable even in a typhoon'. It describes something that is very stable, reliable and strong, be it a relationship, an object, or a conviction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個感情打風都打唔甩㗎，一齊咗十幾年都咁恩愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam2 cing4 daa2 fung1 dou1 daa2 m4 lat1 gaa3, jat1 cai4 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4 dou1 gam3 jan1 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的感情非常牢固，即使台风也吹不散，在一起十几年仍然这么恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship is unshakeable, they've been together for over ten years and are still so loving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅信譽打風都打唔甩，咁多年嚟都無出過事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 seon3 jyu6 daa2 fung1 dou1 daa2 m4 lat1, gam3 do1 nin4 lai4 dou1 mou5 ceot1 gwo3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的信誉非常稳固，这么多年来都没有出过事。
examples.english_sentence: This company's reputation is rock solid, it hasn't had any problems for so many years.

english_meaning: To hoist a typhoon signal; to display a typhoon signal; typhoon signal is raised
explanation_mandarin: 香港和澳门在台风来临时，天文台会悬挂风球（台风信号），表示台风的强度和位置，以便市民做好防风准备。“打風球”就是指天文台悬挂风球。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong and Macau, when a typhoon approaches, the observatory will hoist typhoon signals (typhoon flags) to indicate the typhoon's intensity and location, allowing citizens to prepare for it. "打風球" refers to the observatory hoisting these signals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日天文台會唔會打風球㗎？我想去游水呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 tin1 man4 toi4 wui5 m4 wui5 daa2 fung1 kiu4 gaa3? ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 jau4 seoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天天文台会挂风球吗？我想去游泳啊。
examples.english_sentence: Will the observatory hoist a typhoon signal tomorrow? I want to go swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果打八號風球，所有學校都會停課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 daa2 baat3 hou6 fung1 kiu4, so2 jau5 hok6 haau6 dou1 wui5 ting4 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果挂八号风球，所有学校都会停课。
examples.english_sentence: If the No. 8 typhoon signal is hoisted, all schools will be suspended.

english_meaning: windy and rainy
explanation_mandarin: 指刮风和下雨的天气状况。
explanation_english: Refers to the weather condition of having wind and rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日打風落雨，唔好出去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 daa2 fung1 lok6 jyu5, m4 hou2 cheut1 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天刮风下雨，不要出去了。
examples.english_sentence: It's windy and rainy today, don't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風落雨嘅日子，最啱喺屋企睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 lok6 jyu5 ge3 jat6 zi2, zeoi3 aam1 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刮风下雨的日子，最适合在家里看电影。
examples.english_sentence: Windy and rainy days are the best for watching movies at home.

jyutping: daa2 fung1 dou1 daa2 m4 lat1
english_meaning: Extremely firm; unshakable; impossible to break off (even by a typhoon)
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系、感情或承诺非常牢固，即使遇到很大的困难或挑战（例如台风），也无法动摇或打破。
explanation_english: Describes a relationship, feeling, or promise that is extremely strong and firm, and cannot be shaken or broken even by a great difficulty or challenge (like a typhoon). It implies a deep and unwavering commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆感情好到打風都打唔甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 gam2 cing4 hou2 dou3 daa2 fung1 dou1 daa2 m4 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩感情好到牢不可破。
examples.english_sentence: The couple's relationship is so good that it's unbreakable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢嘅友誼，打風都打唔甩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 jau5 ji5, daa2 fung1 dou1 daa2 m4 lat1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他的友谊坚如磐石。
examples.english_sentence: My friendship with him is unshakable.

mandarin_meaning: 没事找事；无聊生事；闲得慌
english_meaning: To stir up trouble for fun; to be bored and cause problems; to have nothing better to do.
explanation_mandarin: 指因为闲着没事，故意挑起事端或制造麻烦。通常带有负面含义，表示这个人游手好闲，喜欢惹事。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately stirring up trouble or creating problems out of boredom. It usually carries a negative connotation, indicating that someone is idle and likes to cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺度打飯炮，搞到成間公司都烏煙瘴氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 daa2 faan6 paau3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 wu1 jin1 zong3 hei3.

examples.english_sentence: He's always stirring up trouble every day, causing chaos in the whole company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁得閒打飯炮啦，不如做啲有意義嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 dak1 haan4 daa2 faan6 paau3 laa1, bat1 jyu4 zou6 di1 jau5 ji3 yi6 ge3 je5.

explanation_english: Refers to belching after eating a full meal. It is a natural bodily function indicating satisfaction and fullness.

english_meaning: to pretend to be ignorant; to play dumb; to feign ignorance; to act oblivious

explanation_english: To deliberately pretend not to know or understand something, typically to avoid responsibility or accountability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再喺度打餐懵啦，件事明明就係你搞出嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 daa2 caan1 mung1 laa1, gin6 si6 ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 nei5 gaau2 chut1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里装糊涂了，这件事明明就是你搞出来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb anymore. It's clear that you caused this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日打餐懵，唔肯認自己做錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 caan1 mung1, m4 hang2 ying6 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 je5.

examples.english_sentence: He clearly knows what happened, but he's still playing dumb.

english_meaning: to scold; to berate; to reprimand

english_meaning: to be in charge, to have the final say, to make the decision

examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project bin1 go3 daa2 sik1 gaa3?

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gin3 dou2 bou6 lik6 tung4 daa2 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想看到暴力和打斗。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to see violence and fighting.

english_meaning: to fish, to go fishing

explanation_english: To catch fish; the act of fishing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今日出海打魚。

explanation_english: Refers to a state of being mentally absent, having wandering thoughts, daydreaming, or spacing out. Similar to 'woolgathering' or 'not paying attention'.

english_meaning: to wink, to flirt with one's eyes, to make eyes at someone
explanation_mandarin: 用眼睛向人示意，尤指含有挑逗或调情的意味。

english_meaning: to play mahjong

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要打點吓行李，聽日就出發啦。

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 daa2 dim2 uk1 kei2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会料理家里的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at managing household affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我打點吓聽日個會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 daa2 dim2 haa5 ting1 jat6 go3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我安排一下明天的会议。

english_meaning: Ta Ku Ling (a place name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 打鼓岭是香港新界北区的一个地方，靠近中国大陆边境，以农业和乡村风貌著称。
explanation_english: Ta Ku Ling is a place in the North District of the New Territories, Hong Kong, near the border with mainland China, known for its agriculture and rural landscape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時成日同屋企人去打鼓嶺嘅農場摘士多啤梨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 sing4 jat6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 heoi3 daa2 gu2 ling5 ge3 nung4 coeng4 zaak6 si6 do1 be1 lei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常和家人去打鼓岭的农场摘草莓。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to the farms in Ta Ku Ling with my family to pick strawberries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打鼓嶺仲保留住好多傳統嘅農村風貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 gu2 ling5 zung6 bou2 lau4 zyu6 hou2 do1 tyun2 tung2 ge3 nung4 cyun1 fung1 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打鼓岭还保留着许多传统的农村风貌。
examples.english_sentence: Ta Ku Ling still retains many traditional rural landscapes.

english_meaning: to strike while the iron is hot; to do something when the mood is right; to seize the opportunity when it presents itself
explanation_mandarin: 趁着兴致高的时候做某事。比喻抓紧时机。
explanation_english: To do something while the mood or interest is high. Figuratively, it means to seize the opportunity when it arises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家大家咁開心，不如打鼓趁興，一齊唱K啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 daai6 gaa1 gam3 hoi1 sam1, bat1 jyu4 daa2 gu2 can3 hing3, jat1 cai4 coeng3 kei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在大家这么开心，不如乘兴，一起唱K吧！
examples.english_sentence: Now that everyone is so happy, why don't we strike while the iron is hot and sing karaoke together!

examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 dei6 hou2 ci5 deoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, bat1 jyu4 daa2 gu2 can3 hing3, zik1 hak1 king1 maai4 keoi5.

examples.english_sentence: Seeing that they seem very interested in this project, why don't we strike while the iron is hot and finalize it with them right away.

explanation_english: To make a loud, harsh noise while sleeping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺嗰陣時打鼻鼾打到好大聲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 si4 daa2 bei6 hon1 daa2 dou3 hou2 daai6 seng1 gaa3.
