examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 maan1 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 fong4 ge3 jan4 daa2 bei6 hon1, cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上我隔壁房间的人打呼噜，吵得我睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: Last night the person in the room next to mine was snoring, and it was so noisy that I couldn't sleep.

english_meaning: to hold a Taoist or Buddhist ritual to transfer merit to the deceased
explanation_mandarin: 举行道教或佛教的仪式，为已故的人积功德，超度亡灵。通常包括诵经、拜忏等活动。
explanation_english: To conduct a Taoist or Buddhist ritual in order to accumulate merit for the deceased and help them pass on to the next life. The ritual usually includes chanting scriptures and repentance ceremonies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆過咗身，我哋要幫佢打齋超渡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gwo3 zo2 san1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 daa2 zai1 ciu1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶去世了，我们要帮她做道场超度。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma passed away, we need to hold a ritual for her to help her pass on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺殯儀館打咗幾日齋，希望先人可以安息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ban3 ji4 gun2 daa2 zo2 gei2 jat6 zai1, hei1 mong6 sin1 jan4 ho2 ji5 on1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在殡仪馆做了好几天的道场，希望先人可以安息。
examples.english_sentence: They held the ritual for several days in the funeral home, hoping the deceased can rest in peace.

english_meaning: To feign piety, to act hypocritically, to put on a show of virtue
explanation_mandarin: 指表面上做出虔诚的样子，实际上内心并不诚实，带有讽刺意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who outwardly appears pious and virtuous, but is not sincere at heart. It carries a sarcastic connotation, implying hypocrisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前扮勤力，根本就係打齋鶴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 baan6 kan4 lik6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daa2 zaai1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前装作很勤奋，根本就是装模作样。
examples.english_sentence: He always pretends to be hardworking in front of the boss; he's just feigning piety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢個人好打齋鶴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 ge3 jan4 hou2 daa2 zaai1 hok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他这个人很虚情假意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says; he's a very hypocritical person.

jyutping: daa2 zaai1 hok6 -- dou6 nei5 sing1 sin1
english_meaning: Conducting a religious service for the dead in order to help you ascend to heaven (said sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 打斋鹤是道教仪式中超度亡灵的一种方式。度你升仙，意思是帮你成仙，通常带有讽刺意味，指假惺惺地帮助别人，实际上是希望别人早点死。
explanation_english: "打齋鶴 (daa2 zaai1 hok6)" refers to a Taoist ritual conducted to help the deceased ascend to heaven. "度你升仙 (dou6 nei5 sing1 sin1)" literally means "to help you ascend to heaven." The phrase is used sarcastically to imply that someone is insincerely helping you, but actually wishes you were dead or gone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺度笑騎騎咁問我幾時退休，真係打齋鶴，度我升仙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 siu3 ke4 ke4 gam2 man6 ngo5 gei2 si4 teoi3 jau1, zan1 hai6 daa2 zaai1 hok6, dou6 ngo5 sing1 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都笑嘻嘻地问我什么时候退休，真是假惺惺地，巴不得我早点退休！
examples.english_sentence: He asks me with a smirking face every day when I'm going to retire. What a hypocrite, wishing I'd hurry up and retire!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣幫佢，根本就係打齋鶴，度佢升仙啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 bong1 keoi5, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daa2 zaai1 hok6, dou6 keoi5 sing1 sin1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样帮他，根本就是假惺惺的，希望他早点完蛋。
examples.english_sentence: The way you're helping him is just for show. You actually hope he fails.

english_meaning: to tip someone off, to conspire, to act as an informer, to pass on information secretly
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中传递消息，互相串通，或者通风报信。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly passing information, conspiring with each other, or tipping someone off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一定係打龍通，先咁容易知道我哋嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 hai6 daa2 lung4 tung1, sin1 gam3 jung4 ji6 zi1 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一定是在通风报信，才能这么容易知道我们的计划。
examples.english_sentence: They must be tipping each other off, that's how they knew our plan so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢打龍通啊，佢靠唔住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 daa2 lung4 tung1 aa3, keoi5 kaau3 m4 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别和他串通，他靠不住的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't conspire with him, he is unreliable.

mandarin_meaning: 空手而归; 没有收获
english_meaning: To catch nothing; to fail to achieve a result; to come back empty-handed; to be shutout (in fishing or gambling)
explanation_mandarin: 指没有捕到鱼，或者没有赢钱，空手而归。也泛指没有取得任何成果。
explanation_english: Refers to not catching any fish, not winning any money, and returning empty-handed. It can also generally refer to not achieving any results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日去釣魚，點知打龜，乜都冇釣到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 diu3 yu2, dim2 zi1 daa2 gwai1, mat1 dou1 mou5 diu3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天去钓鱼，结果空手而归，什么都没钓到。
examples.english_sentence: He went fishing today, but he caught nothing; he came back empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去賭錢，打龜收場，輸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 heoi3 dou2 cin2, daa2 gwai1 sau1 coeng4, syu1晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去赌钱，结果一无所获，输光了。
examples.english_sentence: I went gambling tonight, but I lost everything and came back empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋努力咗咁耐，如果今次打龜就慘喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nu5 lik6 zo2 gam3 noi6, jyu4 gwo2 gam1 ci3 daa2 gwai1 zau6 caam2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们努力了这么久，如果这次没有成果就惨了。
examples.english_sentence: We've worked so hard for so long, it would be terrible if we failed this time.

english_meaning: to throw; to toss; to discard; to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 指抛掷、丢弃某物。
explanation_english: To throw, toss, or discard something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁扔垃圾呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 wing1 laap6 saap3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔垃圾啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't litter carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到將本書扔咗落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 wing1 zo2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地把书扔到地上。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he threw the book on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將啲舊嘢扔走佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 gau6 je5 wing1 zau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把那些旧东西扔掉。
examples.english_sentence: We need to throw away those old things.

english_meaning: to throw away, to discard, to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 丢弃不要的东西。
explanation_english: To get rid of something by throwing it away; to discard or abandon something considered useless or unwanted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔要嘅嘢就扔掉佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jiu3 ge3 je5 zau6 wing1 diu6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不要的东西就扔掉它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's throw away the things we don't need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲垃圾要扔掉佢先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 laap1 saap3 jiu3 wing1 diu6 keoi5 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 垃圾要扔掉才行。
examples.english_sentence: The rubbish needs to be thrown away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將舊衫扔掉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gau6 saam1 wing1 diu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把旧衣服扔掉了。
examples.english_sentence: He threw away his old clothes.

mandarin_meaning: 支撑, 依托, 拜托, 衬托, 帮助
english_meaning: support, rely on, entrust, support, help, thanks to
explanation_mandarin: 1. 用手或其他工具向上推举或抬起。2. 依靠，依托。3. 拜托，委托。4. 衬托，烘托。5. 在背后支持、帮助。
explanation_english: 1. To support with the hand or other tools. 2. To rely on, depend on. 3. To entrust, ask for a favor. 4. To set off, enhance. 5. To support or help from behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托住個枱唔好俾佢跌啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 zyu6 go3 toi2 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dit3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托住桌子，别让它掉下来！
examples.english_sentence: Hold up the table, don't let it fall!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你托我買包煙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 tok3 ngo5 maai5 baau1 jin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我买包烟吧。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please buy me a pack of cigarettes?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後面有人托住，所以先咁順利嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 min6 jau5 jan4 tok3 zyu6, so2 ji5 sin1 gam3 seon6 lei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背后有人支持，所以才这么顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He has someone supporting him behind the scenes, that's why he's so successful.

english_meaning: shill, plant, someone paid to promote something by pretending to be a genuine customer
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇或安排，假扮顾客或支持者，以营造良好气氛或促成交易的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is hired or arranged to pretend to be a customer or supporter in order to create a good atmosphere or facilitate a transaction. A shill; someone used to deceptively promote something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳咁多人排隊，我諗好多都係托兒嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 gam3 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2, ngo5 lam2 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 tok3 ji4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅这么多人排队，我猜很多都是托儿。
examples.english_sentence: There are so many people queuing at this restaurant, I think many of them are shills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘢，佢咪係個托兒嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5, keoi5 mai1 hai6 go3 tok3 ji4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他就是个托儿。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's just a shill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭請咗好多托兒嚟谷人氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 tok3 ji4 lai4 guk1 jan4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺请了很多托儿来炒人气。
examples.english_sentence: This store hired many shills to boost popularity.

english_meaning: nursery, day-care center
explanation_mandarin: 一种照料幼儿的机构，通常接收2-6岁的儿童。
explanation_english: An institution that provides care for young children, typically between the ages of 2 and 6.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔喺托兒所返學，佢哋教好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 hai2 tok3 ji4 so2 faan1 hok6, keoi5 dei6 gaau3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子在托儿所上学，他们教很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: My son goes to nursery, they teach a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵間好嘅托兒所好緊要，可以幫手照顧細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 gaan1 hou2 ge3 tok3 ji4 so2 hou2 gan2 jiu3, ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找一家好的托儿所很重要，可以帮忙照顾小孩。
examples.english_sentence: Finding a good nursery is very important, it can help take care of the children.

english_meaning: Please, I beg you; as if pleading or begging someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种恳求、哀求或者撒娇的语气，希望对方能够满足自己的请求。
explanation_english: Expresses a pleading, begging, or coaxing tone, hoping the other person will fulfill one's request. It often implies a sense of urgency or importance from the speaker's perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托呀，俾多粒糖我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 aa1, bei2 do1 lap1 tong2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜托，再给我一颗糖吧！
examples.english_sentence: Please, give me one more candy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托呀，幫下手啦，我搞唔掂呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 aa1, bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1, ngo5 gaau2 m4 dim6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜托，帮个忙吧，我搞不定啊。
examples.english_sentence: Please, give me a hand, I can't handle this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托呀，唔好話俾佢知呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 aa1, m4 hou2 waa6 bei2 keoi5 ji1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 求你，不要告诉他啊！
examples.english_sentence: Please, don't tell him!

synonyms: 求下你 (kau4 haa5 nei5) - I beg you

english_meaning: What's it to you? What's it your business?
explanation_mandarin: 表示不关对方事，带有不耐烦或不客气的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is none of the other person's business, often with an impatient or impolite tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我點樣做嘢托咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dim2 joeng2 zou6 je5 tok3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怎么做事关你什么事？
examples.english_sentence: How I do things is none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意買乜嘢托咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 maai5 mat1 je5 tok3 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢买什么关你什么事？
examples.english_sentence: What I like to buy is none of your business.

synonyms: 關你鬼事 (gwaan1 nei5 gwai2 si6)

jyutping: tok3 taap3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3
english_meaning: Rigid, inflexible, unable to adapt; unable to think outside the box
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“托着塔却不懂得转动肩膀”，比喻人死脑筋，不懂得随机应变，做事不够灵活。
explanation_english: Literally, "holding up a pagoda but not knowing how to turn the shoulder". It's a metaphor for someone who is rigid, inflexible, and unable to adapt to changing circumstances. They lack the ability to think creatively or find alternative solutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁托塔唔識轉膊啦，要識得執生啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 tok3 taap3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3 laa1, jiu3 sik1 dak1 zap1 sang1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么死脑筋，要懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inflexible in your work, you need to know how to adapt to the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人就係咁托塔唔識轉膊㗎，你同佢講都嘥氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 yan4 zau6 hai6 gam2 tok3 taap3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3 gaa3, nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou1 saai1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是这么死脑筋的人，你跟他讲也是白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: He's just that kind of inflexible person, it's a waste of time talking to him.

jyutping: tok3 taap3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3
english_meaning: Inflexible; unable to adapt; lacking common sense even when faced with obvious alternatives
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，死脑筋，即使情况已经很明显需要改变，仍然不肯改变或想不出变通的方法。托塔指托塔李天王，就算托着塔这么重的东西，也应该懂得利用肩膀来减轻负担，但有些人连这么简单的道理都不懂，比喻人死脑筋。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is very stubborn and inflexible. Even when faced with a situation where change is obviously necessary, they are unable to adapt or think of alternative solutions. The phrase references Li Tianwang, who holds a pagoda; even with such a heavy burden, he should know to shift it onto his shoulder to ease the weight. Someone who doesn't even understand this basic principle is considered to be very rigid and lacking common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁堅持啦，托塔都唔識轉膊，轉下諗法咪解決到問題囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam3 gin1 chi4 laa1, tok3 taap3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3, zyun3 haa5 nim2 faat3 mai5 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 man6 tai4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也不要这么坚持了，死脑筋，换个想法不就解决问题了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so persistent. Don't be so inflexible. If you change your approach, you can solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係托塔都唔識轉膊，都話咗唔得，仲係要試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 tok3 taap3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3, dou1 waa6 zo2 m4 dak1, zung6 hai6 jiu3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是死脑筋，都说了不行，还要试。
examples.english_sentence: He's really inflexible; even though we told him it wouldn't work, he still insisted on trying.

synonyms: 死牛一面頸 (sei2 ngau4 jat1 min6 geng2)

english_meaning: To agree to anything, even to supporting a pagoda; To promise anything and everything; To be extremely agreeable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人非常顺从，无论什么要求都答应，即使是难以做到的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely agreeable and will promise to do anything, even difficult or absurd tasks, just to please someone else or achieve a goal. The phrase alludes to someone being willing to shoulder the burden of supporting a pagoda (a heavy and monumental task).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗追到條女，佢托塔都應承。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 zeoi1 dou2 tiu4 neoi2, keoi5 tok3 taap3 dou1 jing1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了追到那个女孩，他什么都答应。
examples.english_sentence: In order to woo that girl, he's promising everything and anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆一講要加班，佢就托塔都應承，真係好擦鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jat1 gong2 jiu3 gaa1 baan1, keoi5 zau6 tok3 taap3 dou1 jing1 sing4, zan1 hai6 hou2 caat3 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板一说要加班，他就什么都答应，真是会拍马屁。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the boss said there was overtime, he agreed to everything, he's such a bootlicker.

english_meaning: To help someone out, to give someone a leg up, to promote someone.
explanation_mandarin: 指给予他人帮助，提供机会，使他人获得成功或进步。含有提携、支持的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to giving someone help, providing opportunities, and enabling them to succeed or progress. It implies support and promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好彩遇到個好老細，成日托佢大腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 coi2 jyu6 dou2 go3 hou2 lou5 sai3, sing4 jat6 tok3 keoi5 daai6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很幸运遇到一个好老板，总是帮助他。
examples.english_sentence: He was lucky to meet a good boss who always helps him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有能力，應該托下啲後生仔大腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 nang4 lik6, ying1 goi1 tok3 haa5 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 daai6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有能力，应该提携一下年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: If you have the ability, you should help out the younger generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為靠自己就得，有時都需要人托大腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 kaau3 zi6 gei2 zau6 dak1, jau5 si4 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 tok3 daai6 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为靠自己就行了，有时候也需要别人帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can rely on yourself alone; sometimes you need someone to give you a leg up.

english_meaning: to prop up the market; market intervention
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或机构通过购买股票或其他金融资产来支撑市场价格，防止市场崩溃。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a government or institution intervening in the market, typically by buying stocks or other financial assets, to artificially inflate prices and prevent a market crash or severe decline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府出手托市，希望可以穩住個股市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ceot1 sau2 tok3 si5, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 wan2 zyu6 go3 gu2 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府出手支撑市场，希望可以稳定股市。
examples.english_sentence: The government is intervening to prop up the market, hoping to stabilize the stock market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇人托市，樓價可能會跌得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 mou5 jan4 tok3 si5, lau4 gaa3 ho2 nang4 wui5 dit3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有人支撑市场，房价可能会跌得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: If no one props up the market, housing prices might fall drastically.

english_meaning: to stand aside; to sit idly by; to be a bystander; to wash one's hands of something
explanation_mandarin: 指不介入某事，置身事外，不承担责任。
explanation_english: Refers to not getting involved in something, standing aside, and not taking responsibility; to be a passive observer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好托手㬹啦，一齊幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tok3 sau2 zaang2 laa1, jat1 cai4 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要袖手旁观了，一起帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just stand aside, help out together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次有咩事都托手㬹，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 jau5 me1 si6 dou1 tok3 sau2 zaang2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次有什么事都袖手旁观，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always stands aside whenever something happens, which is really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁重要，你唔可以托手㬹㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 zung6 jiu3, nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 tok3 sau2 zaang2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么重要，你不能袖手旁观啊。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so important, you can't just stand aside.

english_meaning: To shirk responsibility, to pass the buck, to push the responsibility onto someone else
explanation_mandarin: 比喻将责任推给别人，自己不负责任。
explanation_english: A metaphor for shifting responsibility to someone else and not taking responsibility yourself. It describes the action of using one's elbow to deflect something onto another person, implying the deflection of responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好乜嘢都托手踭俾我啦，呢啲係你嘅責任嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mat1 je5 dou1 tok3 sau2 zaang1 bei2 ngo5 laa1, ni1 di1 hai6 nei5 ge3 zaak3 jam3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要什么都推卸责任给我，这些是你的责任。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push all the responsibility onto me, this is your responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢就托手踭，真係好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 zau6 tok3 sau2 zaang1, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事就推卸责任，真的很不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He shirks responsibility when he makes mistakes, he's really irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住托手踭，要做個有承擔嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nim2 zyu6 tok3 sau2 zaang1, jiu3 zou6 go3 jau5 sing4 daam1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着推卸责任，要做一个有担当的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about shirking responsibility, be a responsible person.

english_meaning: To nudge someone with one's elbow; to elbow someone
explanation_mandarin: 用手肘轻轻地推或撞某人，通常为了引起他们的注意或者提醒他们。
explanation_english: To gently push or bump someone with one's elbow, typically to get their attention or to remind them of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路講嘢一路托收踭我，示意我唔好再出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 gong2 je5 jat1 lou6 tok3 sau1 zaang1 ngo5, si3 ji3 ngo5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一边说话一边用胳膊肘顶我，示意我不要再出声。
examples.english_sentence: He kept elbowing me as he was talking, signaling me to stop talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽見到我恰眼瞓，就托收踭我叫我醒醒定定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 hap1 ngaan5 fan3, zau6 tok3 sau1 zaang1 ngo5 giu3 ngo5 sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈看到我打瞌睡，就用胳膊肘碰我，叫我清醒一点。
examples.english_sentence: My mother saw me dozing off and nudged me with her elbow to wake me up.

english_meaning: to set off; to bring out; to highlight; to show off
explanation_mandarin: 意思是衬托，使某事物更显突出、出色。
explanation_english: To set off, highlight, or bring out the beauty or characteristics of something else. It suggests a supportive or complementary role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條裙托杉到佢身材好好啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 tok3 sam1 dou3 keoi5 san1 coi4 hou2 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子把她的身材衬托得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This dress really shows off her figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個燈光托杉到幅畫好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 dang1 gwong1 tok3 sam1 dou3 fuk1 waa2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灯光把这幅画衬托得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The lighting really highlights the beauty of the painting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容托杉到佢對眼更加明亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 tok3 sam1 dou3 keoi5 deoi3 ngaan5 gang3 gaa1 ming4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的笑容衬托得她的眼睛更加明亮。
examples.english_sentence: Her smile made her eyes even brighter.

jyutping: tok3 caam3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3
mandarin_meaning: 死脑筋，不灵活，不识变通
english_meaning: Inflexible; unable to adapt; thickheaded; doesn't know how to turn the shoulder pole
explanation_mandarin: 原指挑东西时不知道如何调整肩上的扁担来减轻负担。比喻人死脑筋，不灵活，不懂得变通，遇到问题不知道如何解决。
explanation_english: Literally: "Doesn't know how to turn the shoulder pole." Refers to someone who is inflexible, stubborn, and unable to adapt to changing situations. Like someone carrying a load on a shoulder pole and not knowing how to shift the weight by turning the pole on their shoulder to relieve pressure points. Metaphorically, it describes someone who is not resourceful and cannot find solutions to problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁托杉唔識轉膊啦，方法有好多種㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tok3 caam3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3 laa1, fong1 faat3 jau5 hou2 do1 zung2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么死脑筋，方法有很多种的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inflexible, there are many different ways to do it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明真係托杉唔識轉膊，叫佢做咩佢都唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 zan1 hai6 tok3 caam3 m4 sik1 zyun2 bok3, giu3 keoi5 zou6 me1 keoi5 dou1 m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明真是死脑筋，让他做什么他都不会变通。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is really inflexible; he can't adapt to anything you ask him to do.

jyutping: tok3 caam3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3
english_meaning: So inflexible that even when carrying poles, they don't know how to shift them to ease the load; inflexible; lacking adaptability; rigid in thinking.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一个人非常死板，不懂得灵活变通，即使是最简单的事情也做不好。托杉指扛木头，转膊指将木头从一个肩膀换到另一个肩膀，减轻负担。连这么简单的减轻负担的方法都不知道，形容人非常笨拙，不会随机应变。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is extremely inflexible and lacks the ability to adapt to situations.  '托杉' (tok3 caam3) refers to carrying wooden poles, and '轉膊' (zyun3 bok3) refers to shifting the pole from one shoulder to the other to ease the burden. The idiom suggests that even with such a simple task as shifting the load to make it easier, the person is incapable of understanding or executing it, highlighting their inflexibility and lack of common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你叫佢諗下計仔，佢托杉都唔識轉膊，點幫到你啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 giu3 keoi5 lam2 haa5 gai2 zai2, keoi5 tok3 caam3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3, dim2 bong1 dou2 nei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你让他想想办法，他死脑筋，不会变通，怎么能帮到你啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're asking him to come up with ideas? He's so inflexible, he can't even think of the simplest solutions. How can he help you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁死板啦，托杉都唔識轉膊，咁樣做嘢好難成功㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sei2 baan2 laa1, tok3 caam3 dou1 m4 sik1 zyun3 bok3, gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5 hou2 naan4 sing4 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么死板了，要懂得变通，这样工作很难成功的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid. You need to be more adaptable; otherwise, it'll be difficult to succeed in your work.

english_meaning: stupid, foolish, incompetent, clumsy
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常笨拙，愚蠢，或者办事能力很差。带有贬义色彩，语气较重。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely clumsy, foolish, or has very poor ability to handle things. It has a derogatory connotation and a strong tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁托柒㗎，咁簡單嘅嘢都做唔好！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 tok3 cat1 gaa3, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 zou6 m4 hou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨，这么简单的事情都做不好！
examples.english_sentence: You are so stupid, you can't even do such a simple thing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁托柒啦，幫唔到手就唔好搞搞震啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tok3 cat1 laa1, bong1 m4 dou2 sau2 zau6 m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨手笨脚的了，帮不上忙就不要捣乱了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, if you can't help, then don't make things worse.

jyutping: tok3 cat1 m4 sik1 zyun2 bo3
english_meaning: Stupid, inflexible, unable to adapt; literally: "holding a penis and not knowing how to turn the shoulder"
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常笨拙，不灵活，遇到问题不懂得变通。字面意思是拿着阳具却不知道如何转动肩膀。 这是一种粗俗的比喻，形容人非常笨拙，不知如何是好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely clumsy, inflexible, and unable to adapt to problems. The literal meaning is "holding a penis and not knowing how to turn the shoulder." It is a vulgar metaphor describing someone who is very awkward and doesn't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做嘢，真係托柒唔識轉膊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 tok3 cat1 m4 sik1 zyun2 bo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样工作，真是太笨了！
examples.english_sentence: The way you work is really stupid!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係咁，托柒唔識轉膊，諗嘢都唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2, tok3 cat1 m4 sik1 zyun2 bo3, nam2 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这样，死脑筋，想事情都不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He's always like this, inflexible and doesn't know how to be adaptable when thinking about things.

mandarin_meaning: 串通作弊；内外勾结抬高价格
english_meaning: To rig the market; to collude to inflate prices; to engage in price fixing
explanation_mandarin: 指通过内外勾结，人为抬高价格或制造虚假交易，从而从中获利的行为。常见于股票、房地产等市场。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of artificially inflating prices or creating false transactions through internal and external collusion, thereby profiting from it. It is commonly seen in markets such as stocks and real estate.  Literally, it means 'lifting water dragon'. The 'water dragon' is a metaphor for the inflated price or value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋托水龍，夾埋啲地產佬抬高個樓價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tok3 seoi2 lung4, gaap3 maai4 di1 dei6 caan2 lou2 taai2 gou1 go3 lau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们串通地产商抬高房价。
examples.english_sentence: They colluded with the real estate developers to inflate the property prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住托水龍就可以呃到人，我唔會上當㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 tok3 seoi2 lung4 zau6 ho2 ji5 aak1 dou2 jan4, ngo5 m4 wui5 soeng5 dong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想搞串通作弊来骗人，我是不会上当的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can deceive people by rigging the market; I won't fall for it.

english_meaning: Trotskyist; Trotskyite
explanation_mandarin: 指信奉托洛茨基主义的人或派别。在政治语境中，有时带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a follower or adherent of Trotskyism. In a political context, it can sometimes carry a pejorative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前俾人話係托派，不過後來就唔再講呢啲嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 tok3 paai3, bat1 gwo3 hau6 lai4 zau6 m4 zoi3 gong2 ni1 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前被人说是托派，不过后来就不再提这些事了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be called a Trotskyist, but he doesn't talk about these things anymore.

english_meaning: To take the blame for someone else; to be a scapegoat; to cover for someone
explanation_mandarin: 比喻替他人承担责任或承受压力，通常指替人受过或充当挡箭牌。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking responsibility or pressure for someone else, usually referring to being a scapegoat or a shield.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，成日都要我托炮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 ngo5 tok3 paau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事，总是要我替他背锅。
examples.english_sentence: He makes mistakes and always makes me take the blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁傻啦，唔好幫佢托炮呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 so2 laa1, m4 hou2 bong1 keoi5 tok3 paau3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么傻了，别帮他当挡箭牌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, don't be a scapegoat for him.

english_meaning: to feign illness, to pretend to be sick
explanation_mandarin: 为了某种目的而假装自己生病。
explanation_english: To pretend to be sick, usually in order to avoid work, school, or some other obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日托病唔返工，老闆都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tok3 beng6 m4 faan1 gung1, lou5 baan2 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装病不来上班，老板都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always feigns illness to avoid work, the boss doesn't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日托病喇，有咩嘢講出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tok3 beng6 laa3, jau5 me1 je5 gong2 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是装病了，有什么事说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pretend to be sick, just say what's on your mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢托病避開咗個無聊嘅聚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tok3 beng6 bei6 hoi1 zo2 go3 mou4 liu1 ge3 zeoi6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他装病避开了那个无聊的聚会。
examples.english_sentence: He feigned illness to avoid that boring gathering.

english_meaning: tray
explanation_mandarin: 用于端放物品的扁平容器。
explanation_english: A flat container used for carrying objects, typically food and drinks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞住個托盤，上面放咗好多杯嘢飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zyu6 go3 tok3 pun4, soeng6 min6 fong3 zo2 hou2 do1 bui1 je5 yam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着一个托盘，上面放了很多杯饮料。
examples.english_sentence: He was holding a tray with many drinks on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 侍應生用托盤將啲菜送到客人嘅枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 ying3 sang1 yung6 tok3 pun4 zoeng1 di1 coi3 sung3 dou3 haak3 yan4 ge3 toi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 服务员用托盘将菜送到客人的桌子。
examples.english_sentence: The waiter used a tray to deliver the dishes to the customer's table.

english_meaning: Thanks to; owing to; to benefit from (someone's good fortune); by your grace; be lucky (because of someone else)
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为别人的好运或能力而使自己也获得了好处或便利。也用于客套话，感谢别人的帮助或付出。
explanation_english: Expressing that one has benefited or gained convenience due to someone else's good fortune or ability. Also used as a polite expression to thank someone for their help or contribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托你嘅福，我今次考試先咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 nei5 ge3 fuk1, ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 sin1 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托你的福，我这次考试才这么顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to you, I passed the exam so smoothly this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次可以升職，真係要托你嘅福呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 tok3 nei5 ge3 fuk1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次可以升职，真的要托你的福啊！
examples.english_sentence: I could get promoted this time, it's really thanks to you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托賴！總算搞掂晒啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 laai6! zung2 syun3 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托福！总算把所有事情都搞定了。
examples.english_sentence: Thank goodness! Finally got everything sorted out.

english_meaning: Thanks to; By virtue of; To owe to; To get by because of; To rely on someone's favour/blessing.
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为得到了某种帮助或恩惠而得以顺利进行或取得成功。通常带有一种客气或谦虚的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses gratitude or acknowledgment that success or smooth progress is due to someone's help, blessing, or good fortune. Often used with a sense of politeness or humility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得幾好，都係托賴你幫我補習啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gei2 hou2, dou1 hai6 tok3 laai6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bou2 sik1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得不错，都是多亏你帮我补习。
examples.english_sentence: I did quite well in this exam, all thanks to you for tutoring me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司呢幾年都幾順利，托賴各位同事嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ni1 gei2 nin4 dou1 gei2 seon6 lei6, tok3 laai6 gok3 wai2 tung4 si6 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司这几年都挺顺利的，多亏各位同事的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has been quite successful these past few years, thanks to the hard work of all my colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 托賴嫲嫲照顧，啲小朋友先咁生性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tok3 laai6 maa4 maa2 ziu3 gu3, di1 siu2 peng4 jau5 sin1 gam3 sang1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多亏奶奶照顾，小朋友们才这么乖巧。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to grandma's care, the children are so well-behaved.

english_meaning: excuse, pretext
explanation_mandarin: 用虚假的理由来推脱或辩解。
explanation_english: A false reason given to avoid doing something or to explain why something has not been done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都用好多托辭嚟唔返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 ho2 do1 tok3 ci4 lai4 m4 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是用很多借口来不来上班。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses a lot of excuses to not come to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再用托辭，直接講原因啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 yung6 tok3 ci4, zik6 zip3 gong2 jyun4 yan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再找借口了，直接说原因吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses and just tell me the reason.

english_meaning: to check (luggage); to consign for shipment
explanation_mandarin: 将行李或货物委托运输。
explanation_english: To hand over luggage or goods to be transported; to check in (luggage); to consign for shipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺邊度托運行李呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 bin1 dou6 tok3 wan6 hang4 lei5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在哪里托运行李啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where do we need to check in our luggage?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲貨托運去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 fo3 tok3 wan6 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把那些货物托运去美国。
examples.english_sentence: I'm shipping those goods to the US.

english_meaning: to brown-nose; to flatter; to suck up to someone
explanation_mandarin: 指为了讨好或获得好处而向他人奉承、谄媚的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of flattering someone to gain favor or benefits. It implies insincere praise and ingratiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日托騷啦，做好自己份工先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tok3 sou1 laa1, zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 fan6 gung1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是拍马屁了，先做好自己的工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to brown-nose, focus on doing your own job first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前托騷，所以升得咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 tok3 sou1, so2 ji5 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前拍马屁，所以升得这么快。
examples.english_sentence: He's always flattering the boss, that's why he got promoted so quickly.

english_meaning: to tug, to pull, to snatch
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具快速地拉或扯。
explanation_english: To pull or tug sharply and quickly with the hand or a tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好扚我條辮呀，好痛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dik1 ngo5 tiu4 bin1 aa3, hou2 tung3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别拽我的辫子呀，很痛的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pull my braid, it hurts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扚咗我枝筆去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dik1 zo2 ngo5 zi1 bat1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把我的笔拽走了。
examples.english_sentence: He snatched my pen.

english_meaning: To cheat; to try to get away with something by being sneaky; to cut corners
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当手段或投机取巧的方式来达到目的，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving a goal by using unfair means or taking shortcuts, often with negative connotations. It implies dishonesty or a lack of integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住扚波，正正經經做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 dik1 bo1, zing3 zing3 ging1 ging1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是想着投机取巧，认真工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about cheating; just work properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課咁高分，唔係自己做嘅，一定係扚波嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gam3 gou1 fan1, m4 hai6 zi6 gei2 zou6 ge3, jat1 ding6 hai6 dik1 bo1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这份作业这么高分，不是自己做的，一定是投机取巧的。
examples.english_sentence: He got such a high score on his homework; he didn't do it himself, he must have cheated.

english_meaning: To pluck up courage; to steel oneself; to make up one's mind (to do something difficult or unpleasant)
explanation_mandarin: 表示下定决心，鼓起勇气去做一件困难或者不愿意做的事情。
explanation_english: To make a firm decision, often requiring courage or determination, to undertake a task that is challenging or undesirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我扚起心肝，聽日一定要早起身返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dik1 hei2 sam1 gon1, ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou2 hei2 san1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下定决心，明天一定要早起去上班。
examples.english_sentence: I'm steeling myself to wake up early for work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扚起心肝，決定戒煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dik1 hei2 sam1 gon1, kyut3 ding6 gaai3 yin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下定决心，决定戒烟。
examples.english_sentence: He plucked up the courage and decided to quit smoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁耐，佢終於扚起心肝去面對問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 noi6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dik1 hei2 sam1 gon1 heoi3 min6 deoi3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过了这么久，他终于下定决心去面对问题。
examples.english_sentence: After so long, he finally steeled himself to face the problem.

english_meaning: to carry on the shoulder; to shoulder; to bear; to take on (responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 用肩膀承担，承受责任。
explanation_english: To carry something on the shoulder; also means to bear or take on responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一定要扛起呢個責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 kong1 hei2 ni1 go3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要承担起这个责任。
examples.english_sentence: You must shoulder this responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人扛起嗮成個家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 kong1 hei2 saai3 sing4 go3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人承担了整个家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He carries the whole family on his shoulders.

english_meaning: to fork; to separate; to straddle; to spread legs apart
explanation_mandarin: 分開雙腿; 岔開，張開。
explanation_english: To spread one's legs apart; to fork; to spread open.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣扠開對腳呀，好樣衰嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 caa1 hoi1 deoi3 goek3 aa3, hou2 joeng2 seoi1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那样岔开你的腿，很难看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spread your legs apart like that, it's unsightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扠開雙腿坐喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa1 hoi1 soeng1 teoi2 co5 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他叉开双腿坐在地上。
examples.english_sentence: He sat on the ground with his legs spread apart.

english_meaning: Really? / No way! / Is that so?
explanation_mandarin: 表示怀疑、惊讶或反问的语气。通常用于对对方所说的话表示不相信或惊讶。
explanation_english: Expresses doubt, surprise, or a rhetorical question. Typically used to express disbelief or surprise at what the other person has said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢中咗六合彩頭獎，扠喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 tau4 zoeng2, caa1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他中了六合彩头奖，真的吗？
examples.english_sentence: You said he won the first prize in the Mark Six lottery, really?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話聽日會落雪，扠喎，香港好少落雪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 syut3, caa1 wo3, hoeng1 gong2 hou2 siu2 lok6 syut3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说明天会下雪，不是吧，香港很少下雪的。
examples.english_sentence: He said it will snow tomorrow, no way, it rarely snows in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to cause trouble; to stir up trouble; to get into trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指引起麻烦或灾祸。多指无意中或因不谨慎而导致不良后果。
explanation_english: Refers to causing trouble or disaster, often unintentionally or due to carelessness, leading to negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再扠禍啦，我哋已經夠晒煩喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 caa1 wo6 laa1, ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 gau3 saai3 faan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹祸了，我们已经够烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause any more trouble, we're already annoyed enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扠禍，搞到阿爸阿媽好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 caa1 wo6, gaau2 dou3 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa4 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是闯祸，弄得爸爸妈妈很担心。
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble, making his parents very worried.

english_meaning: To stand with hands on hips; hands on hips
explanation_mandarin: 指双手叉在腰部，呈现一种姿势。多表示不耐烦，生气，或者骄傲等情绪。
explanation_english: To stand with hands on hips. Often indicates impatience, anger, or arrogance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都扠𢰸，唔覺攰嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 caa1 cam1, m4 gok3 gwai3 gui6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整天都叉着腰，不觉得累吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're standing with your hands on your hips all day long, aren't you tired?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嬲就鍾意扠𢰸，好似好巴閉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nau1 zau6 zung1 ji3 caa1 cam1, hou2 ci5 hou2 baa1 bai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一生气就喜欢叉腰，好像很了不起一样。
examples.english_sentence: She likes to stand with her hands on her hips whenever she's angry, as if she's a big deal.

mandarin_meaning: 扣除, 减少, 抓紧, 关押
english_meaning: to deduct, to reduce, to fasten, to detain, button, discount
explanation_mandarin: 动词：减少；扣除。名词：纽扣；折扣。
explanation_english: Verb: To deduct, reduce. Noun: Button; discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細話我遲到要扣人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 waa6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 jiu3 kau3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说我迟到要扣工资。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said I'll have my salary deducted because I was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有鈕扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 nau2 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有纽扣。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has buttons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家做緊大減價，好多嘢都有得扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jau5 dak1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在正在打折，很多东西都有折扣。
examples.english_sentence: There is a big sale now, many things have discounts.

english_meaning: gripping; heart-stirring; deeply moving; captivating
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常激动人心，强烈地吸引人。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely exciting and deeply moving, strongly attracting people's attention and emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好扣人心弦，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 kau3 jan4 sam1 jyun4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情非常扣人心弦，看得我都眼眶湿润了。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is so gripping, it made my eyes watery.

english_meaning: to deduct commission
explanation_mandarin: 从总金额中扣除应付的佣金部分。
explanation_english: To deduct a portion of a total amount as commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果達唔到目標，老闆就會扣佣㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 daat6 m4 dou2 muk6 biu1, lou5 baan2 zau6 wui5 kau3 jung2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果达不到目标，老板就会扣佣金的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't reach the target, the boss will deduct commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲交貨俾公司扣咗好多佣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ci4 gaau1 fo3 bei2 gung1 si1 kau3 zo2 hou2 do1 jung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟交货被公司扣了很多佣金。
examples.english_sentence: He had a lot of commission deducted by the company because he delivered the goods late.

english_meaning: to induce vomiting, to make oneself throw up
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或其他工具刺激咽喉，引起呕吐。
explanation_english: To stimulate the throat, usually with fingers, in order to induce vomiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食得太多，頂唔順，唯有扣喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 dak1 taai3 do1, ding2 m4 seon6, wai4 jau5 kau3 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃得太多，受不了了，只好催吐。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too much and couldn't handle it, so I had to induce vomiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗減肥，成日扣喉，好傷身㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gaam2 fei4, seng4 jat6 kau3 hau4, hou2 soeng1 san1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了减肥，她总是催吐，很伤身体的。
examples.english_sentence: She often induces vomiting to lose weight, which is very harmful to her health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁扣喉，分分鐘會整傷條脷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 kau3 hau4, fan1 fan1 cung1 wui2 zing2 soeng1 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱催吐，很可能会弄伤舌头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't induce vomiting randomly, you might injure your tongue.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常小气，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好扣布㗎，一蚊都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 kau3 bou3 gaa3, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很吝啬，一分钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stingy person, unwilling to spend even a penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁扣布啦，請大家飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kau3 bou3 laa1, ceng2 daai6 gaa1 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么吝啬了，请大家喝一杯东西嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just treat everyone to a drink.

english_meaning: Debit card
explanation_mandarin: 一种银行卡，消费时直接从银行账户扣款。
explanation_english: A type of bank card that allows you to make purchases by directly debiting funds from your bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想申請張扣帳卡，方便啲喺網上買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 zoeng1 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1, fong1 bin6 di1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想申请一张借记卡，方便在网上买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I want to apply for a debit card to make it easier to buy things online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用扣帳卡畀錢，唔使帶咁多現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 bei2 cin2, m4 sai2 daai3 gam3 do1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用借记卡付款，不用带那么多现金。
examples.english_sentence: I pay with a debit card, so I don't need to carry so much cash.

english_meaning: Debit card
explanation_mandarin: 一种银行卡，消费时直接从账户扣款。
explanation_english: A type of bank card that directly deducts funds from a user's checking account when a purchase is made.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用扣帳咭多過信用卡，因為唔會使多咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 do1 gwo3 seon3 yung6 kaat1, jan1 wai6 m4 wui5 sai2 do1 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用借记卡多过信用卡，因为不会花太多钱。
examples.english_sentence: I prefer using debit cards over credit cards because I won't spend more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度收唔收扣帳咭㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 sau1 m4 sau1 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里收借记卡吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you accept debit cards here?

synonyms: 銀行咭 (ngan4 hong4 kaat1) - bank card (general term, can include debit card)

mandarin_meaning: 保留底牌; 隐藏实力; 暗藏; (俚语) 偷偷摸摸地搞不正当的事情
english_meaning: Keep your cards close to your chest; Hold back; Conceal one's true intentions or capabilities; (Slang) To engage in illicit or underhanded activities secretly
explanation_mandarin: 原指打麻将时，将一些好牌藏在牌底，不轻易出示。引申为隐藏实力，不轻易显露。也指暗中做一些不光彩的事情。
explanation_english: Originally refers to hiding good tiles at the bottom during Mahjong, not easily showing them. It's extended to mean concealing one's capabilities or intentions, not revealing them easily. It can also refer to secretly engaging in dishonorable or illicit activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都扣底，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 kau3 dai2, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是藏着掖着，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always keeps his cards close to his chest, I don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好扣底啦，有乜嘢就直接講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 kau3 dai2 laa1, jau5 mat1 je5 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再藏着掖着了，有什么就直接说出来。
examples.english_sentence: Stop holding back, just say what's on your mind directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢扣底搞咗好多嘢，不過冇人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 kau3 dai2 gaau2 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, bat1 gwo3 mou5 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他暗地里搞了很多事情，但是没人知道。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he's been doing a lot of things under the table, but no one knows about it.

english_meaning: detain, impound, seize, hold in custody
explanation_mandarin: 暂时拘留或没收（人或财物）。
explanation_english: To detain or impound (a person or property) temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察扣押咗佢嘅車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 kau3 aap3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察扣押了他的车。
examples.english_sentence: The police impounded his car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關扣押咗啲走私貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 kau3 aap3 zo2 di1 zau2 si1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关扣押了那些走私货物。
examples.english_sentence: Customs seized the smuggled goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為涉嫌盜竊俾警方扣押。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sip3 him4 dou6 sip3 bei2 ging2 fong1 kau3 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为涉嫌盗窃被警方扣押。
examples.english_sentence: He was detained by the police on suspicion of theft.

english_meaning: to deduct from an account, to deduct an amount, to offset
explanation_mandarin: 从账目中扣除一定金额。通常指在应付金额中减去已经支付或应收的款项。
explanation_english: To deduct an amount from an account. It usually refers to subtracting an amount that has already been paid or is owed from the payable amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會喺你人工度扣數，因為你遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 hai2 nei5 jan4 gung1 dou6 kau3 sou3, jan1 wai6 nei5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会从你工资里扣钱，因为你迟到。
examples.english_sentence: The company will deduct from your salary because you were late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之前講好咗，要扣數嚟抵返上次嘅欠款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 gong2 hou2 zo2, jiu3 kau3 sou3 lai4 dai2 faan1 soeng6 ci3 ge3 him3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之前说好了，要扣账来抵还上次的欠款。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed before that we would deduct from the account to offset the previous debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你計清楚啲，唔好扣錯數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gai3 cing1 co2 di1, m4 hou2 kau3 co3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你算清楚一点，不要扣错账。
examples.english_sentence: Calculate more clearly, don't deduct the wrong amount.

english_meaning: to detain for investigation; to hold for questioning
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或相关执法部门将某人暂时拘留，以便进行调查。
explanation_english: Refers to the temporary detention of a person by the police or relevant law enforcement agencies for investigation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺機場俾人扣查咗幾個鐘頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 bei2 jan4 kau3 caa4 zo2 gei2 go3 zung1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在机场被扣留调查了几个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He was detained for questioning at the airport for several hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方扣查咗疑犯嘅電話，想搵到更多證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 kau3 caa4 zo2 ji4 faan6 ge3 din6 waa2, soeng2 wan2 dou3 gang3 do1 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方扣留了嫌疑犯的电话，想找到更多证据。
examples.english_sentence: The police detained the suspect's phone, hoping to find more evidence.

english_meaning: to smash (in sports, especially volleyball or badminton); spike
explanation_mandarin: （体育运动中）指排球、羽毛球等运动中，用力将球从高处向下打向对方场地。
explanation_english: To powerfully strike a ball downward in a sports game, typically volleyball or badminton, making it difficult for the opponent to return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅扣殺好有威力，對方好難接得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kau3 saat3 hou2 jau5 wai1 lik6, deoi3 fong1 hou2 naan4 zip3 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的扣球很有威力，对方很难接住。
examples.english_sentence: His smash is very powerful, it's difficult for the opponent to receive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日練習扣殺，希望比賽嘅時候可以攞到更多分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 lin6 zaap6 kau3 saat3, hei1 mong6 bei2 coi3 ge3 si4 hau6 ho2 ji5 lo2 dou2 gang3 do1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天练习扣球，希望比赛的时候可以拿到更多分。
examples.english_sentence: They practice smashing all day, hoping to score more points during the competition.

english_meaning: to deduct, to subtract, to reduce, deduction
explanation_mandarin: 从总数中减去一部分。
explanation_english: To take away or subtract a certain amount from a total.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人工畀公司扣減咗一千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yan4 gung1 bei2 gung1 si1 kau3 gaam2 zo2 jat1 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资被公司扣除了1000块。
examples.english_sentence: His salary was deducted by 1000 dollars by the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果遲到，會扣減勤工獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ci4 dou3, wui5 kau3 gaam2 kan4 gung1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果迟到，会扣除全勤奖。
examples.english_sentence: If you are late, your attendance bonus will be deducted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為表現唔好，所以佢嘅績效分被扣減咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 biu2 hin3 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 keoi5 ge3 zik1 haau6 fan1 bei2 kau3 gaam2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为表现不好，所以他的绩效分被扣除了。
examples.english_sentence: Because his performance was not good, his performance score was deducted.

english_meaning: to detain; to hold in custody; detention
explanation_mandarin: 暂时拘禁，限制人身自由。
explanation_english: To detain someone temporarily, restricting their freedom of movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為涉嫌犯法，畀警察扣留咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sip3 jim4 faan6 faat3, bei2 ging2 chaat3 kau3 lau4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为涉嫌违法，被警察拘留了。
examples.english_sentence: He was detained by the police for suspected illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關人員扣留咗佢嘅行李，因為發現有違禁品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 yan4 yun4 kau3 lau4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 hang4 lei5, jan1 wai6 faat3 hin3 jau5 wai4 gam3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关人员扣留了他的行李，因为发现有违禁品。
examples.english_sentence: Customs officials detained his luggage because they found contraband.

english_meaning: to cover (with a cup, bowl, etc.); to place something over something else (usually with the intention of hiding or protecting it)
explanation_mandarin: 用杯子、碗等器皿盖住东西。通常是为了遮盖或保护东西。
explanation_english: To cover something with a cup, bowl, or similar vessel. Usually done to conceal or protect something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆驚啲塵埃落入碗飯度，所以用個碗扣盅住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 geng1 di1 can4 ai1 lok6 jap6 wun2 faan6 dou6, so2 ji5 yung6 go3 wun2 kau3 zung1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶怕灰尘掉进饭碗里，所以用碗盖住了。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma was afraid that dust would fall into the rice bowl, so she covered it with another bowl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎個玻璃盅扣盅住啲蛋糕，防止啲蟲飛埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 go3 bo1 lei1 zung1 kau3 zung1 zyu6 di1 daan6 gou1, fong4 zi2 di1 cung4 fei1 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿一个玻璃罩盖住蛋糕，防止虫子飞过去。
examples.english_sentence: He covered the cakes with a glass dome to prevent insects from flying onto them.

english_meaning: deduct taxes
explanation_mandarin: 从收入中扣除税款。
explanation_english: To deduct taxes from income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份糧要扣稅㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 loeng4 jiu3 kau3 seoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的工资要扣税的。
examples.english_sentence: Your salary will be taxed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年扣咗幾多稅啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 kau3 zo2 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年扣了多少税啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much tax was deducted this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想交咁多稅，諗住搵啲嘢嚟扣稅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 gaau1 gam3 do1 seoi3, nam2 zyu2 wan2 di1 je5 lai4 kau3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想交这么多税，打算找一些东西来抵扣税款。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to pay so much tax, I'm planning to find some things to use as tax deductions.

english_meaning: deduct tax, withhold tax
explanation_mandarin: 从工资、收入或其他款项中扣除税款。
explanation_english: To deduct tax from wages, income, or other payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每個月都會幫我哋扣税。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 kau3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每个月都会帮我们扣税。
examples.english_sentence: The company deducts tax for us every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年政府扣税政策有變，你要留意吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 zing3 fu2 kau3 seoi3 zing3 caak3 jau5 bin3, nei5 jiu3 lau4 yi3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年政府扣税政策有变，你要留意一下。
examples.english_sentence: The government's tax deduction policy has changed this year, you need to pay attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份糧扣咗税之後仲有幾多?
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 leong4 kau3 zo2 seoi3 zi1 hau6 zung6 jau5 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这份工资扣了税之后还有多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much do you have left in your salary after tax deductions?

english_meaning: Debit card
explanation_mandarin: 一种银行卡，直接从持卡人的银行账户中扣除消费金额。
explanation_english: A bank card that directly deducts the spending amount from the cardholder's bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我經常用扣賬卡買嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ging1 soeng4 yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 maai5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常用借记卡买东西。
examples.english_sentence: I often use a debit card to buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用扣賬卡要小心啲，因為直接扣你銀行戶口嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, jan1 wai6 zik6 zip3 kau3 nei5 ngan4 hang4 wu6 hau2 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用借记卡要小心一些，因为它直接扣你银行账户的钱。
examples.english_sentence: You have to be careful when using a debit card because it directly deducts money from your bank account.

english_meaning: Debit card
explanation_mandarin: 一种银行卡，消费时直接从用户的银行账户扣款。
explanation_english: A type of bank card where purchases are directly debited from the user's bank account.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我平時都係用扣賬咭俾錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ping4 si4 dou1 hai6 yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 bei2 chin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我平时都是用借记卡付款的。
examples.english_sentence: I usually pay with a debit card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用扣賬咭嘅好處係可以控制消費，唔使怕使多咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yung6 kau3 zoeng3 kaat1 ge3 hou2 chu3 hai6 ho2 yi5 hung3 zai3 siu1 fai3, m4 sai2 paa3 sai2 do1 zo2 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用借记卡的好处是可以控制消费，不用怕花多了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The advantage of using a debit card is that you can control your spending and not worry about overspending.

english_meaning: to withhold; to deduct; to keep back
explanation_mandarin: 从整体中拿出一部分，或暂时保留。
explanation_english: To withhold a portion from the whole, or to temporarily keep something back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老細扣起咗佢一部分人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 sai3 kau3 hei2 zo2 keoi5 jat1 bou6 fan6 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的老板扣留了他一部分工资。
examples.english_sentence: His boss withheld a portion of his salary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關扣起咗佢啲行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 kau3 hei2 zo2 keoi5 di1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关扣留了他的行李。
examples.english_sentence: The customs withheld his luggage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司扣起晒啲獎金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kau3 hei2 saai3 di1 zoeng2 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司把所有的奖金都扣留了。
examples.english_sentence: The company withheld all the bonuses.

english_meaning: to fine someone to drink (alcohol as a penalty); to make someone drink as a penalty
explanation_mandarin: 在饮酒场合，因为某人犯错或者为了活跃气氛而强迫或劝诱其喝酒，作为一种惩罚或者玩笑。
explanation_english: In a drinking setting, to force or encourage someone to drink alcohol as a penalty for a mistake or to liven up the atmosphere. It's usually done playfully or as a light-hearted punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔記得咗老闆嘅名，俾人扣酒三杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 lou5 baan2 ge3 ming4, bei2 jan4 kau3 zau2 saam1 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忘记了老板的名字，被罚酒三杯。
examples.english_sentence: He forgot the boss's name, so he was fined three glasses of alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁耐都唔飲，梗係要扣酒啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 yam2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 kau3 zau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么久都不喝，当然要罚酒了！
examples.english_sentence: You haven't drunk for so long, of course you'll be fined!

english_meaning: Safety pin; brooch; clasp
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来固定衣物或其他物品的金属小针，通常带有一个可以防止刺伤的保护装置。也指用于装饰的别针。
explanation_english: A small metal pin with a protective clasp, used for fastening clothing or other items. Also refers to a decorative brooch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我條裙爛咗，用個扣針扣住先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tiu4 kwan4 laan6 zo2, yung6 go3 kau3 zam1 kau3 zyu6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的裙子破了，先用个别针别住吧。
examples.english_sentence: My skirt is torn, I'll use a safety pin to hold it together for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫上面有個好靚嘅扣針。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 kau3 zam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的衣服上有一个很漂亮的胸针。
examples.english_sentence: She has a very beautiful brooch on her shirt.

english_meaning: to button up, to fasten a button
explanation_mandarin: 把纽扣扣上。
explanation_english: To fasten or button up a piece of clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 凍凍地，扣返粒鈕先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung3 dung3 dei2, kau3 faan1 lap1 nau2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有点冷，先扣上一个纽扣吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's a little cold, let's button up first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件衫啲鈕扣甩晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 saam1 di1 nau2 kau3 lat1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这件衣服的纽扣都掉了。
examples.english_sentence: All the buttons on your shirt have come off.

english_meaning: to knock on a door
explanation_mandarin: 用手或物体敲击门，发出声音以引起注意。
explanation_english: To knock on a door to attract attention or seek entry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度扣門，但係冇人應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 kau3 mun4, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这里敲门，但是没有人回应。
examples.english_sentence: I'm knocking on the door, but no one is answering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大聲扣門，會嘈醒隔離鄰舍㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 kau3 mun4, wui5 cou4 sing2 gaak3 lei4 lin4 se5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么大声地敲门，会吵醒隔壁邻居的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't knock so loudly, you'll wake up the neighbours!

english_meaning: deduct; subtract; deduct from
explanation_mandarin: 从总数中减去。
explanation_english: To take away or deduct from a total amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份糧會扣除強積金㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 loeng4 wui5 kau3 ceoi4 koeng4 jik1 gan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的工资会扣除强积金的。
examples.english_sentence: Your salary will have the Mandatory Provident Fund deducted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 扣除咗啲開支，我哋仲有幾多錢剩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau3 ceoi4 zo2 di1 hoi1 zi1, ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 gei2 do1 cin2 sing6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 扣除了那些开支，我们还剩多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: After deducting the expenses, how much money do we still have left?

mandarin_meaning: 占人便宜; 揩油; 敲诈
english_meaning: To mooch; to freeload; to take advantage of someone; to sponge off someone; to get a free ride; to rip someone off (in a small way)
explanation_mandarin: 指占别人便宜，通常是不花钱或少花钱就得到好处。多指行为不大光明，但金额较小，程度较轻的占便宜行为。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of someone, usually by getting benefits without spending or spending very little money. It often refers to taking advantage in a way that isn't entirely honest, but the amount of money involved is small and the degree of exploitation is light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想扣我雞，次次食飯都唔畀錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 kau3 ngo5 gai1, ci3 ci3 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占我便宜，每次吃饭都不给钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to mooch off me, never paying when we eat out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁cheap啦，唔好扣人哋雞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cip1 laa1, m4 hou2 kau3 jan4 dei6 gai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气啦，不要占别人便宜啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cheap, don't sponge off other people.

english_meaning: to kowtow; to knock one's head on the ground as a sign of respect or obeisance
explanation_mandarin: 一种表示尊敬、服从或道歉的礼节，通过弯腰并使头触地来完成。
explanation_english: A traditional act of showing respect, submission, or apology by kneeling and touching one's head to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺祖先面前扣頭，祈求保佑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zou2 sin1 min6 cin4 kau3 tau4, kei4 kau4 bou2 yau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在祖先面前磕头，祈求保佑。
examples.english_sentence: They kowtowed before their ancestors, praying for blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅人要向皇帝扣頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 jan4 jiu3 hoeng3 wong4 dai3 kau3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过去的人要向皇帝磕头。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, people had to kowtow to the emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知錯，即刻跪低扣頭認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 co3, zik1 hak1 gwai6 dai1 kau3 tau4 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道错了，立刻跪下磕头认错。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he was wrong and immediately knelt down and kowtowed to admit his mistake.

english_meaning: to stick to the topic, to be relevant to the topic, to be on-topic
explanation_mandarin: 围绕主题，符合题目要求。
explanation_english: To keep to the main point; to be relevant to the topic under discussion; to be on-topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢唔扣題喎，講咗咁耐都唔知你想講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 m4 kau3 tai4 wo3, gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话不切题啊，说了这么久都不知道你想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: You're not sticking to the topic. I don't know what you're trying to say after talking for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文寫得幾好，夠晒扣題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 se2 dak1 gei2 hou2, gau3 saai3 kau3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章写得很好，很切题。
examples.english_sentence: This article is well-written and stays on topic.

english_meaning: Stingy; Miserly; Cheapskate
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常小气，不愿意花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有錢，但係對自己都好扣鷄，真係唔明點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 cin2, daan6 hai6 deoi3 zi6 gei2 dou1 hou2 kau3 gai1, zan1 hai6 m4 ming4 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么有钱，但是对自己都很小气，真是不明白为什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's so rich, but he's so stingy even with himself. I really don't understand why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁扣鷄啦，請我飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kau3 gai1 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气啦，请我喝一杯东西而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just buy me a drink.

mandarin_meaning: 摇动; 挪动; 调整
english_meaning: to shake; to wiggle; to jiggle; to adjust by wiggling or shaking
explanation_mandarin: 指通过小幅度的摇动、晃动或扭动来移动、调整或固定某物。
explanation_english: Refers to moving, adjusting, or fixing something by shaking, wiggling, or jiggling it slightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張凳唔穩陣，扤一扤佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang3 m4 wan2 zan6, ngat1 jat1 ngat1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这凳子不稳，晃动一下它。
examples.english_sentence: This stool is not stable, wiggle it a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條鎖匙好難開，要扤幾下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 so2 si4 hou2 naan4 hoi1, jiu3 ngat1 gei2 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把钥匙很难开，要摇晃几下才能开。
examples.english_sentence: This key is hard to open, you need to wiggle it a few times to make it work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個窗簾遮住咗少少，扤返正佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 coeng1 lim4 ze1 zyu6 zo2 siu2 siu2, ngat1 faan1 zeng3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 窗帘遮住了一点，把它调整好。
examples.english_sentence: The curtain is blocking a bit, adjust it back into place.

english_meaning: to lose (something), to misplace
explanation_mandarin: 指不小心弄丢东西。
explanation_english: Refers to accidentally losing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都扤失嘢嘅，唔記得擺咗喺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 ngat1 sat1 je5 ge3, m4 gei3 dak1 baai2 zo2 hai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是丢东西，不记得放在哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: I always lose things; I can't remember where I put them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁唔小心，又扤失咗銀包？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 m4 siu2 sam1, jau6 ngat1 sat1 zo2 ngan4 baau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么不小心，又丢了钱包？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless; did you lose your wallet again?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺巴士上面扤失咗把遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6 ngat1 sat1 zo2 baa2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在巴士上丢了一把伞。
examples.english_sentence: I lost an umbrella on the bus.

english_meaning: To fidget one's leg, to bounce one's leg, to jiggle one's leg
explanation_mandarin: 指由于紧张、无聊或其他原因而不停地抖动腿。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of involuntarily or habitually bouncing or jiggling one's leg, often due to nervousness, boredom, or restlessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嘅時候好緊張，一路扤扤腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, jat1 lou6 ngat1 ngat1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候很紧张，一直抖腿。
examples.english_sentence: He was very nervous during the exam, and he kept bouncing his leg.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度扤扤腳啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 ngat1 ngat1 goek3 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里抖腿啦，很吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't jiggle your leg here, it's noisy!

english_meaning: (of babies) to teethe; teething
explanation_mandarin: 形容幼儿在长牙期间，牙齿顶破牙龈，导致幼儿感觉不舒服，经常啃咬东西以减轻不适感。
explanation_english: Describes the process of a baby's teeth erupting through the gums, causing discomfort and a need to gnaw on things to relieve the irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB仔扤牙嗰陣成日都扭計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 zai2 ngat6 ngaa4 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 dou1 nau2 gai2.
