jyutping: pai1 go3 tau4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 让你把我的头当凳子坐
english_meaning: I'll let you use my head as a stool to sit on (exaggerated expression of subservience or apology)
explanation_mandarin: 一种夸张的说法，表示对某人非常恭敬顺从，甚至愿意牺牲自己的尊严。通常用于表示真诚的道歉或极度的谦卑。
explanation_english: An exaggerated expression meaning to be extremely subservient or apologetic to someone. It suggests a willingness to sacrifice one's own dignity to please or appease the other person. It's often used when offering a sincere apology or expressing extreme humility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係我錯曬，批個頭畀你當櫈坐都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 ngo5 co3 saai3, pai1 go3 tau4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的是我全错了，让你把我的头当凳子坐都可以。
examples.english_sentence: I was completely wrong this time. I'll even let you use my head as a stool to sit on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬲啦，批個頭畀你當櫈坐啦，原諒我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 laa1, pai1 go3 tau4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 laa1, jyun4 loeng6 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么生气了，让你把我的头当凳子坐啦，原谅我吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, I'll even let you use my head as a stool! Please forgive me.

cantonese: 批個頭落嚟俾你當凳坐
jyutping: pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 把脑袋砍下来给你当凳子坐
english_meaning: I'd cut off my head and let you use it as a stool.
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某人非常顺从、迁就，甚至不惜牺牲自己来满足对方的要求。表示极端的忍让和服从。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely subservient and accommodating to another person, even to the point of sacrificing themselves to meet their demands. It indicates extreme tolerance and obedience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁過份啦，唔通要我批個頭落嚟俾你當凳坐咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam3 gwo3 fan6 laa1, m4 tung1 jiu3 ngo5 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要太过分了，难道要我把头砍下来给你当凳子坐吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so excessive. Do you want me to cut off my head and let you use it as a stool?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明成日都聽晒阿美話，真係批個頭落嚟俾佢當凳坐都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 seng4 jat6 dou1 teng1晒 aa3 mei5 waa6, zan1 hai6 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 keoi5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明总是听阿美的话，真是把头砍下来给她当凳子坐都可以。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming always listens to Ah Mei. He really would cut off his head and let her use it as a stool.

synonyms: 任你鱼肉 (jam6 nei5 jyu4 juk6)
千依百顺 (chin1 yi1 baak3 seun6)

cantonese: 批個頭落嚟俾你當櫈坐
jyutping: pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 把头砍下来给你当凳子坐
english_meaning: To offer one's head for you to sit on as a stool/chair (an exaggerated expression of extreme deference or willingness to please)
explanation_mandarin: 极端夸张的说法，表示对某人极度顺从或愿意付出一切来讨好对方。
explanation_english: An extremely exaggerated expression to indicate absolute subservience or a willingness to do anything, even the most absurd things, to please someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭，你講乜我都照做，就算批個頭落嚟俾你當櫈坐都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4, nei5 gong2 mat1 ngo5 dou1 ziu3 zou6, zau6 syun3 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老大，你说的我都照做，就算把头砍下来给你当凳子坐也没问题。
examples.english_sentence: Boss, I'll do whatever you say, even if it means offering my head for you to sit on as a stool, no problem.

cantonese: 批個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐
jyutping: pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lei4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 把头砍下来给你当凳子坐
english_meaning: I'd give you the shirt off my back (literally: I'd chop off my head and let you use it as a stool)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常慷慨，愿意为另一个人付出很多甚至牺牲自己。 虽然字面意思是砍下头颅给人当凳子，但实际上表达的是一种极度的慷慨和愿意为他人牺牲奉献的精神。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely generous and willing to sacrifice a lot, even their own well-being, for another person. While the literal meaning is to chop off one's head for someone to use as a stool, it actually expresses a spirit of extreme generosity and willingness to sacrifice for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁好人，批個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐都得呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hou2 jan4, pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lei4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 dou1 dak1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你人那么好，我愿意为你牺牲一切！ (你人那么好，把头砍下来给你当凳子坐都可以啊！)
examples.english_sentence: You're such a good person, I'd give you the shirt off my back! (You're such a good person, I'd even chop off my head and let you use it as a stool!)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對朋友真係好好，簡直係批個頭落嚟畀你當凳坐咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lei4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对朋友真的很好，简直就是愿意为朋友牺牲一切。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good to his friends, he's practically willing to give them the shirt off his back.

synonyms: 兩肋插刀 (leong5 lak6 caap3 dou1)

cantonese: 批個頭落嚟畀你當櫈坐
jyutping: pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5
mandarin_meaning: 把头砍下来给你当凳子坐
english_meaning: To be extremely subservient and willing to do anything for someone; to literally offer one's head to be used as a stool.
explanation_mandarin: 形容极度卑微顺从，愿意为对方做任何事情，甚至牺牲自己。比喻为了讨好对方，什么都可以做。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is extremely subservient and willing to do absolutely anything for another person, even to the point of self-sacrifice. It implies a willingness to debase oneself in order to please someone else. It's a very strong expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔好咁樣批個頭落嚟畀佢當櫈坐啦，做人要有啲尊嚴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 keoi5 dong3 dang3 co5 laa1, zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 di1 zyun1 jim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要这样对他百依百顺，做人要有点尊严。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't be so subservient to him. You need to have some dignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會批個頭落嚟畀你當櫈坐嘅，我唔係你嘅奴隸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 pai1 go3 tau4 lok6 lai4 bei2 nei5 dong3 dang3 co5 ge3, ngo5 m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 nou4 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会对你百依百顺的，我不是你的奴隶。
examples.english_sentence: I won't be so subservient to you; I am not your slave.

english_meaning: to approve, to ratify
explanation_mandarin: 同意；允许。
explanation_english: To officially agree to something; to give permission for something to happen or be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細批准咗我嘅請假申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 pai1 zeon2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ceng2 gaa3 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板批准了我的请假申请。
examples.english_sentence: The boss approved my leave application.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府批准咗起呢個新嘅購物中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 pai1 zeon2 zo2 hei2 ni1 go3 san1 ge3 gau3 mat6 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府批准了建这个新的购物中心。
examples.english_sentence: The government approved the construction of this new shopping mall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅婚姻申請已經獲得批准。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fan1 yan1 san1 ceng2 ji5 ging1 wok6 dak1 pai1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的婚姻申请已经获得批准。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage application has been approved.

english_meaning: criticize, criticism
explanation_mandarin: 评论，评判，指责缺点。
explanation_english: To criticize; to judge or evaluate critically, often negatively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋批判緊政府嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 pai1 pun3 gan2 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在批判政府的政策。
examples.english_sentence: They are criticizing the government's policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我接受你嘅批判，但係我唔會改變我嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zip3 sau6 nei5 ge3 pai1 pun3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 ngo5 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我接受你的批判，但是我不会改变我的想法。
examples.english_sentence: I accept your criticism, but I won't change my mind.

english_meaning: Critical thinking
explanation_mandarin: 一种通过质疑、分析、评估和解释信息，从而形成合理的判断的思维方式。
explanation_english: The ability to think clearly and rationally about what to do or what to believe. It includes the ability to engage in reflective and independent thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要有批判性思考，唔好人哋講咩就信咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jiu3 pai1 pun3 sing3 si1 hau1, m4 hou2 jan4 dei6 gong2 me1 zau6 seon3 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要有批判性思维，不要别人说什么就信什么。
examples.english_sentence: You need to have critical thinking; don't believe everything people tell you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要培養學生嘅批判性思考能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 pui4 joeng5 hok6 sang1 ge3 pai1 pun3 sing3 si1 hau1 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要培养学生的批判性思维能力。
examples.english_sentence: We need to cultivate students' critical thinking skills.

english_meaning: To grant land; to allocate land (usually for development); land grant; land allocation
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或相关机构批准土地的使用权，通常用于房地产开发或公共事业。
explanation_english: Refers to the granting of land use rights by the government or relevant authorities, usually for real estate development or public works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府批咗塊地俾發展商起樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 pai1 zo2 faai3 dei6 bei2 faat3 zin2 soeng1 hei2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府批准了一块地给发展商盖楼。
examples.english_sentence: The government has granted a piece of land to the developer to build a building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地盤係政府批地發展嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 pun2 hai6 zing3 fu2 pai1 dei6 faat3 zin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块工地是政府批地开发的。
examples.english_sentence: This construction site is being developed on land granted by the government.

english_meaning: to mark (homework, exams, etc.); to correct
explanation_mandarin: 评阅并改正（作业、试卷等）。
explanation_english: To read through and correct (assignments, exams, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir今日要批改一百份試卷，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 gam1 jat6 jiu3 pai1 goi2 jat1 baak3 fan6 si3 gyun2, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师今天要批改一百份试卷，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher has to mark one hundred exam papers today, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你批改咗啲功課喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 pai1 goi2 zo2 di1 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你批改了一些作业了。
examples.english_sentence: I've marked some of your homework for you.

english_meaning: official approval document; written approval; permit
explanation_mandarin: 政府或上级机关对下级机关的请示所作的批示，以文件形式下达。
explanation_english: A written document containing official approval or instructions from a government agency or higher authority to a subordinate body, typically in response to a formal request.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司攞到政府嘅批文，可以開始起新樓喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 lo2 dou2 zing3 fu2 ge3 pai1 man4, ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 hei2 san1 lau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司拿到了政府的批准文件，可以开始盖新楼了。
examples.english_sentence: That company has received the government's approval document and can start building the new building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇批文就開工，到時俾人捉就麻煩喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 pai1 man4 zau6 hoi1 gung1, dou3 si4 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有批准文件就开工，到时候被人抓住就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Starting work without the official approval is troublesome if you get caught.

english_meaning: to approve, to sanction, approval
explanation_mandarin: 批准，审核通过。 指上级机关或主管人员对下级机关或部门呈报的文件、方案等进行审查后，同意并批示执行。
explanation_english: To approve, sanction, or endorse. Refers to the process where a higher authority or supervisor reviews a document, proposal, or plan submitted by a lower-level department or individual and, after examination, grants approval and instructs its implementation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋份貸款申請已經批核咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 fan6 taai3 fun1 san1 cing2 ji5 ging1 pai1 hat6 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的贷款申请已经被批准了。
examples.english_sentence: Our loan application has already been approved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅預算仲未批核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 zung6 mei6 pai1 hat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的预算还没有批准。
examples.english_sentence: The budget for this project has not been approved yet.

english_meaning: wholesale
explanation_mandarin: 成批地发售货物；大批量的销售。
explanation_english: to wholesale; to sell in bulk; wholesale trade

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司做批發㗎，價錢會平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zou6 pai1 faat3 gaa3, gaa3 cin4 wui5 peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司是做批发的，价格会便宜一些。
examples.english_sentence: Our company does wholesale, so the prices will be cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺果欄做批發，成日都要好早起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gwo2 laan2 zou6 pai1 faat3, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hou2 zou2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在果栏做批发，总是要很早起床。
examples.english_sentence: He works in the fruit market doing wholesale, so he always has to get up very early.

english_meaning: to criticize severely; to flay; to rip to shreds
explanation_mandarin: 指严厉地批评别人，通常带有一种批判得体无完肤，不留情面的意味。 也可形容因长期日晒导致皮肤脱落。
explanation_english: To criticize someone severely and harshly, often to the point of leaving them with no defense. It can also describe peeling skin due to prolonged sun exposure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日喺會議室批皮批到佢哋狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 hai2 wui5 ji5 sat1 pai1 pei4 pai1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天在会议室把他们批评得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: The boss ripped them to shreds in the meeting room today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢曬到成身批皮，睇見都覺得痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saai3 dou3 seng4 san1 pai1 pei4, tai2 gin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他晒得全身脱皮，看着都觉得疼。
examples.english_sentence: His whole body is peeling from sunburn; it looks painful.

english_meaning: to plaster, to render (a wall); plastering
explanation_mandarin: 指用水泥、石灰等材料涂抹墙面，使其平整光滑。也指这种涂抹的动作或涂抹后的墙面。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of applying plaster, cement or similar material to a wall surface to make it smooth and even. It can also refer to the plastered surface itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅今日嚟咗批盪個廚房啲牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 gam1 jat6 lai4 zo2 pai1 tong3 go3 cyu4 fong2 di1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅今天来抹灰厨房的墙壁。
examples.english_sentence: The craftsman came today to plaster the kitchen walls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲牆批盪得唔夠平滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 coeng4 pai1 tong3 dak1 m4 gau3 ping4 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的墙面抹灰不够平滑。
examples.english_sentence: The plastering on these walls isn't smooth enough.

mandarin_meaning: 批评得一无是处；彻底批评
english_meaning: To criticize severely; to tear someone apart; to give a thorough dressing down
explanation_mandarin: 形容批评得非常严厉，就像用石米（一种粗糙的建筑材料）打在人身上一样，比喻彻底否定和批评某人。
explanation_english: Describes a severe and comprehensive criticism, as if striking someone with stucco (a rough building material). It implies a complete rejection and criticism of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細批石米，搞到唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 pai1 sek6 mai5, gaau2 dou3 m4 gam2 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板狠狠地批评了一顿，搞得不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: He was severely criticized by his boss, so he didn't dare to say a word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得咁差，實俾阿頭批石米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 gam3 chaa1, sat6 bei2 aa3 tau4 pai1 sek6 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得这么差，肯定会被领导狠狠批评一顿。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written so badly, the boss is definitely going to tear it apart.

english_meaning: to approve and issue instructions; official instruction; endorsement
explanation_mandarin: 指上级对下级的报告、请示等作出指示或批示。
explanation_english: An instruction or comment given by a superior in response to a report or request from a subordinate. Also refers to the act of giving such instructions or comments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細喺份文件上面批示咗「批准」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 hai2 fan6 man4 gin2 soeng6 min6 pai1 si6 zo2 「pai1 zeon2」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板在文件上批示了“批准”。
examples.english_sentence: The boss endorsed "approved" on the document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要按照上頭嘅批示嚟做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 on3 ziu3 soeng6 tau4 ge3 pai1 si6 lai4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要按照上级的批示来工作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work according to the instructions from the superiors.

english_meaning: to plaster (a wall); to render; plastering
explanation_mandarin: 用石灰、水泥等涂抹墙壁表面，使之平整光滑。
explanation_english: To apply plaster or similar material to a wall or surface to make it smooth and even.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 師傅今日要嚟批蕩個客廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fu2 gam1 jat6 jiu3 lai4 pai1 dong6 go3 hak3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 师傅今天会来粉刷客厅。
examples.english_sentence: The plasterer will come today to plaster the living room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲牆好粗糙，要批蕩先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cheung4 hou2 cou1 cou3, jiu3 pai1 dong6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些墙壁很粗糙，需要先粉刷。
examples.english_sentence: The walls are very rough, they need to be plastered first.

english_meaning: to criticize, criticism
explanation_mandarin: 指出缺点或错误，发表意见。
explanation_english: To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults or mistakes; the expression of disapproval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日批評人哋做嘢做得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 pai1 ping4 jan4 dei6 zou6 je5 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是批评别人工作做得不好。
examples.english_sentence: He always criticizes others for not doing a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我接受你嘅批評，下次會做得更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zip3 sau6 nei5 ge3 pai1 ping4, haa6 ci3 wui5 zou6 dak1 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我接受你的批评，下次会做得更好。
examples.english_sentence: I accept your criticism, and I will do better next time.

english_meaning: To elbow; to jostle (with elbows); to elbow someone out; to push someone aside unfairly to gain an advantage.
explanation_mandarin: 指用手肘推撞别人，通常是为了抢占位置或排挤他人，带有负面含义。
explanation_english: To use one's elbow to push or jostle others, often to gain an advantage or push someone aside unfairly. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度批踭啦，好迫呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 pai1 zaang1 laa1, hou2 bik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里用肘推挤了，很挤啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't elbow here, it's very crowded!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，成日批踭啲同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 sing1 zik1, seng4 jat6 pai1 zaang1 di1 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了升职，他经常排挤同事。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get promoted, he often elbows out his colleagues.

english_meaning: to mark (papers, assignments); to grade; to examine and approve
explanation_mandarin: 指老师或上级审核修改作业、文件等。
explanation_english: To mark, correct, or assess papers, assignments, or documents; to review and approve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: Miss Chan成日都要批閱功課，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Miss Chan seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 pai1 yut6 gung1 fo3, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 陈老师每天都要批改作业，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Miss Chan has to mark homework every day, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆要批閱呢份合約先可以簽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Laau5 baan2 jiu3 pai1 yut6 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 sin1 ho2 ji5 cim1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板要审阅这份合同才可以签的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss needs to review this contract before signing it.

english_meaning: to read and approve; to peruse and approve; to review and approve
explanation_mandarin: 审核并批准；查阅并认可。
explanation_english: To read through and approve (documents, papers, etc.); to review and give approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師日日都要批閲好多功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 pai1 jyut6 hou2 do1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师每天都要批阅很多作业。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher has to review and mark a lot of homework every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆批閲咗份報告先肯簽名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laau5 baan2 pai1 jyut6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3 sin1 hang2 cim1 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板批阅了这份报告才肯签名。
examples.english_sentence: The boss would only sign after reviewing the report.

english_meaning: to criticize; to scold; to reprimand
explanation_mandarin: 批评，责备。指指出错误或缺点并进行指责。
explanation_english: To criticize or scold someone, often for making a mistake or having a flaw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都批頭我做得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 pai1 tau4 ngo5 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是批评我做得不好。
examples.english_sentence: He always criticizes me for not doing well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日批頭咗佢，因為佢交唔到份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 pai1 tau4 zo2 keoi5, jan1 wai6 keoi5 gaau1 m4 dou2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天批评了他，因为他交不了报告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss scolded him today because he couldn't submit the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係識得批頭人，試下幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 pai1 tau4 jan4, si3 haa5 bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只会批评人，试着帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just know how to criticize others, try to lend a hand.

english_meaning: to denounce and struggle against (someone); to subject to public criticism and humiliation; struggle session
explanation_mandarin: 指在政治运动中，对某人进行公开的批判和斗争，通常伴随着羞辱和人身攻击。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice of publicly criticizing and attacking someone, often involving humiliation and personal attacks, during political movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 文化大革命嗰陣，好多人俾人批鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man4 faa3 daai6 gaak3 ming6 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 bei2 jan4 pai1 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文化大革命的时候，很多人被人批斗。
examples.english_sentence: During the Cultural Revolution, many people were subjected to struggle sessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便批鬥人，要講證據㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 pai1 dau3 jan4, jiu3 gong2 zing3 geoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便批判斗争别人，要讲证据。
examples.english_sentence: Don't arbitrarily denounce people; you need to present evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為寫咗啲有爭議嘅文章，俾人批鬥到體無完膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 se2 zo2 di1 jau5 zang1 yi5 ge3 man4 zoeng1, bei2 jan4 pai1 dau3 dou3 tai2 mou4 jyun4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为写了一些有争议的文章，被人批斗得体无完肤。
examples.english_sentence: He was denounced mercilessly for writing some controversial articles.

english_meaning: An area/location designated for public criticism and denouncement (similar to a struggle session)
explanation_mandarin: 批斗座是指在批斗大会上，被批斗的人所站立或跪的地方。也指一种公共场合，用来进行集体批判和指责。
explanation_english: "批鬥座" refers to the area or location where the person being criticized during a public criticism session (like a struggle session) stands or kneels. It can also refer more broadly to a public space where collective criticism and denunciation take place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司開咗個「投訴信箱」，根本就係一個新嘅批鬥座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hoi1 zo2 go3 "tau4 sou3 seon3 haam1", gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 pai1 dau3 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司开设了一个“投诉信箱”，根本就是一个新的批斗场所。
examples.english_sentence: The company set up a "complaint box," but it's basically a new arena for public criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上討論區好多時都變成批鬥座，大家互相攻擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 to2 leon6 keoi1 hou2 do1 si4 dou1 bin3 sing4 pai1 dau3 zo6, daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 gung1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上论坛很多时候都变成批斗场所，大家互相攻击。
examples.english_sentence: Online forums often become arenas for public criticism, where everyone attacks each other.

english_meaning: to fall, to bump, to knock, to collide
explanation_mandarin: 粤语，指跌倒，撞击或碰撞。
explanation_english: Cantonese: to fall down, to bump into, to collide with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心扻親咗落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 ham2 can1 zo2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心摔倒在地了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally fell to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔睇路，扻到埋牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 tai2 lou6, ham2 dou3 maai4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不看路，撞到墙上。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't watching where he was going and bumped into the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車扻到正，花曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ham2 dou3 zeng3, faa1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞得很厉害，全花了。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed badly, it's all scratched.

english_meaning: to bang one's head against the wall (in frustration or despair)
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常沮丧或绝望，以至于想用头撞墙。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of extreme frustration, despair, or hopelessness, to the point where one feels like banging their head against the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考到咁嘅成績，真係想扻頭埋牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 dou3 gam3 ge3 sing1 zik1, zan1 hai6 soeng2 ham2 tau4 maai4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考到这样的成绩，真想碰头撞墙。
examples.english_sentence: Getting such grades, I really feel like banging my head against the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份project搞成咁，俾老細鬧到我好想扻頭埋牆呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 project gaau2 seng4 gam2, bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 dou3 ngo5 hou2 soeng2 ham2 tau4 maai4 coeng4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份项目搞成这样，被老板骂得我好想碰头撞墙啊。
examples.english_sentence: The project turned out like this, my boss scolded me so badly I feel like banging my head against the wall.

english_meaning: to strangle, to grip, to control, to suppress
explanation_mandarin: 表示用力握住或掐住，也表示控制、扼杀等含义。
explanation_english: Indicates forcefully gripping or strangling. Also means to control, suppress, or stifle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人扼住條頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zyu6 tiu4 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人掐住脖子。
examples.english_sentence: He was being strangled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好扼殺小朋友嘅創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 aak1 saat3 siu2 peng4 jau5 ge3 chong3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要扼杀小朋友的创意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stifle children's creativity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要扼住經濟命脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 aak1 zyu6 ging1 zai3 ming6 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要控制经济命脉。
examples.english_sentence: To control the economic lifeline.

english_meaning: to guard, to defend, to hold (a strategic position)
explanation_mandarin: 指控制或防守重要的地点，使其不受侵犯。
explanation_english: To guard or defend a vital location, preventing it from being invaded or taken over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條村口扼守，唔俾任何人入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 tiu4 cyun1 hau2 ak1 sau2, m4 bei2 jam6 ho2 jan4 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在村口把守，不让任何人进去。
examples.english_sentence: They are guarding the entrance of the village, not allowing anyone to enter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個關口對成個戰局好重要，所以一定要扼守住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwaan1 hau2 deoi3 sing4 go3 zin3 guk6 hou2 zung6 jiu3, so2 ji5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ak1 sau2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个关口对整个战局很重要，所以一定要守住。
examples.english_sentence: This pass is very important to the entire war situation, so it must be defended.

english_meaning: to strangle, to stifle, to suppress, to nip in the bud
explanation_mandarin: 比喻压制、摧残使不能发展。通常指用强力压制、扼制生长或发展。
explanation_english: To suppress or stifle something, preventing it from developing or growing. Usually refers to the use of force to suppress growth or development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好扼殺小朋友嘅創意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 aak1 saat3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 chong3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要扼杀小朋友的创意。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stifle children's creativity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅政策扼殺咗好多中小企嘅生存空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 chaak3 aak1 saat3 zo2 hou2 do1 zung1 siu2 kei5 je5 ge3 sang1 chyun4 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的政策扼杀了许多中小企业的生存空间。
examples.english_sentence: The government's policies have stifled the survival space of many SMEs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想俾屋企人扼殺咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 bei2 uk1 kei2 yan4 aak1 saat3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想被家人扼杀了。
examples.english_sentence: His dream was stifled by his family.

english_meaning: concise; brief; to the point
explanation_mandarin: 简单扼要，抓住重点。
explanation_english: Concise and to the point; grasping the key points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以扼要咁講下呢件事嘅經過嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 aak1 jiu3 gam2 gong2 haa5 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 ging1 gwo3 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以扼要地讲一下这件事的经过吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you briefly explain what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細要我哋寫份扼要嘅報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 se2 fan6 aak1 jiu3 ge3 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板要我们写一份扼要的报告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants us to write a concise report.

english_meaning: to tug, to jerk, to yank, to shake slightly
explanation_mandarin: 用力拉或抖动。
explanation_english: To pull or jerk something with a sudden, sharp movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力扽我件衫呀，會爛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 dan3 ngo5 gin6 saam1 aa3, wui2 laan6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么用力拽我的衣服，会烂的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't tug my shirt so hard, it will tear!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扽咗幾下條繩，睇下實唔實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dan3 zo2 gei2 haa5 tiu4 sing4, tai2 haa5 sat6 m4 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拉了几下绳子，看看是否牢固。
examples.english_sentence: He jerked the rope a few times to see if it was secure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣壞咗，你扽下佢個電線睇下掂唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 waai6 zo2, nei5 dan3 haa5 keoi5 go3 din6 sin3 tai2 haa5 dim6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 空调坏了，你抖动一下它的电线看看行不行。
examples.english_sentence: The air conditioner is broken, try wiggling its power cord to see if it works.

mandarin_meaning: 抖出来；弄出来；展现出来
english_meaning: To shake out; to bring out; to reveal; to bring into view
explanation_mandarin: 指通过抖动或拉扯等动作将某物弄出来，或者将某事某物展现出来。也可指经过努力或操作，最终得到或呈现出某种结果。
explanation_english: Refers to bringing something out by shaking or pulling, or revealing something. It can also mean achieving or presenting a certain result through effort or operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺個袋度扽出嚟啲銀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 go3 doi2 dou6 dan6 ceot1 lai4 di1 ngan4 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我从袋子里抖出一些硬币。
examples.english_sentence: I shook some coins out of my bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想扽出嚟啲真相，但係冇人肯講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 dan6 ceot1 lai4 di1 zan1 soeng3, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 hang2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想弄出真相，但是没有人肯说。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to bring out the truth, but no one is willing to tell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅努力，佢終於扽出嚟啲成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dan6 ceot1 lai4 di1 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的努力，他终于取得了成绩。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of effort, he finally produced some results.

english_meaning: to sulk, to throw a tantrum, to act up, to show resentment
explanation_mandarin: 指因为不满或不愉快而表现出不高兴或生气的样子，通常带有一些孩子气或不成熟的行为。
explanation_english: To express displeasure or anger, often in a childish or immature way, typically due to dissatisfaction or unhappiness. It often involves being sullen, moody, or difficult to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日扽氣啦，有咩事咪講出嚟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dan6 hei3 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 mai6 gong2 chut1 lai4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别老是耍性子了，有什么事就说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop sulking all the time, if there's something wrong just say it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今朝俾老細鬧完，返到屋企一路扽氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ziu1 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6 jyun4, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 jat1 lou6 dan6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天早上被老板骂完，回到家一直闷闷不乐。
examples.english_sentence: He was scolded by the boss this morning and has been sulking since he got home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扽氣嘅樣真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dan6 hei3 ge3 joeng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他耍性子的样子真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: The way he throws a tantrum is really annoying.

english_meaning: To dip into one's wallet; to spend money; to fork out money
explanation_mandarin: 从自己的钱包里拿钱出来，通常指被迫花钱或大出血。
explanation_english: To take money out of one's wallet, usually referring to spending money, often reluctantly or a large sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次去歐洲旅行，真係扽咗我唔少荷包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 dan3 zo2 ngo5 m4 siu2 ho4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次去欧洲旅行，真让我掏了不少腰包。
examples.english_sentence: This trip to Europe really made me dip into my wallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個仔結婚，阿爸阿媽梗係要扽荷包幫手俾首期啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zai2 git3 fan1, aa3 baa1 aa3 maa1 gang2 hai6 jiu3 dan3 ho4 baau1 bong1 sau2 bei2 sau2 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子结婚，爸爸妈妈肯定要掏腰包帮忙给首付啊。
examples.english_sentence: When their son gets married, the parents definitely have to fork out money to help with the down payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買樓真係要扽大荷包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 lau2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 dan3 daai6 ho4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买房子真是要掏大腰包。
examples.english_sentence: Buying a house really requires spending a lot of money.

english_meaning: To fish in troubled waters; to exploit a chaotic situation for personal gain
explanation_mandarin: 趁着混乱或危机的时候捞取好处。 形容趁机取利的行为。
explanation_english: To take advantage of a chaotic or turbulent situation to gain something, often unfairly or opportunistically. It implies exploiting a situation for personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市咁波動，有啲人就想扽蝦籠，趁低吸納。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 gam3 bo1 dung6, jau5 di1 jan4 zau6 soeng2 dan6 haa1 lung4, can3 dai1 kap1 naap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市这么波动，有些人就想浑水摸鱼，趁低吸纳。
examples.english_sentence: With the stock market being so volatile, some people want to fish in troubled waters and buy when prices are low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅人事鬥爭入面，成日都諗住扽蝦籠，攞盡著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 si6 dau3 zang1 jap6 min6, seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dan6 haa1 lung4, lo2 zeon6 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的人事斗争中，总是想着浑水摸鱼，占尽便宜。
examples.english_sentence: In the company's internal struggles, he always tries to fish in troubled waters and get all the advantages he can.

english_meaning: to look for; to find; to seek; to give change (money)
explanation_mandarin: 寻找；给予零钱。
explanation_english: To look for something; to try to find someone or something; to seek. Also, to give change (money) after a transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度搵緊我部電話呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 wan2 gan2 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在找我的电话。
examples.english_sentence: I'm looking for my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我搵啲資料啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 wan2 di1 zi1 liu2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我找一些资料吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me find some information?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，搵返兩蚊俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, wan2 faan1 loeng5 man1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢，找回我两块钱。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you, give me back two dollars change.

english_meaning: to find; to locate; to discover
explanation_mandarin: 表示寻觅后发现或获得。
explanation_english: Indicates the act of finding or locating something after searching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵咗好耐先搵到部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 zaau2 dou3 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找了很久才找到这部电话。
examples.english_sentence: I searched for a long time before I found this phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搵唔搵到條鎖匙呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wan2 m4 wan2 dou3 tiu4 so2 si4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你找没找到钥匙啊？
examples.english_sentence: Have you found the key?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於搵到份好工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou3 fan6 hou2 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于找到一份好工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He finally found a good job.

english_meaning: to seek; to look for; to search for
explanation_mandarin: 寻求；寻找。
explanation_english: To try to find something; to look for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵出真相，繼續努力去搵嘢，唔可以放棄任何線索，努力去搵尋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 ceot1 zan1 soeng2, gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6 heoi3 wan2 je5, m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 hei3 jam6 ho4 sin3 sok3, nou5 lik6 heoi3 zaau2 cam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找出真相，继续努力去找东西，不可以放弃任何线索，努力去寻找。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find out the truth, continue to work hard to find things, don't give up any clues, and work hard to search.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度四圍找尋失蹤嘅寵物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 sei3 wai4 zaau2 cam4 sat1 zung1 ge3 cung2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处寻找失踪的宠物。
examples.english_sentence: He is searching everywhere for his missing pet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察正在找尋證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zing3 zoi6 zaau2 cam4 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察正在寻找证据。
examples.english_sentence: The police are looking for evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 自找麻烦; 自讨苦吃
english_meaning: to look for trouble; to ask for it; to court disaster
explanation_mandarin: 指自己主动去做一些不明智的事情，结果给自己带来麻烦或不好的后果。形容自作自受。
explanation_english: Refers to someone deliberately doing something unwise or foolish that leads to trouble or negative consequences for themselves. It implies that they are responsible for their own misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明知佢心情唔好，仲走去激佢，咪即係找悔氣囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 zi1 keoi5 sam1 cing4 m4 hou2, zung6 zau2 heoi3 gik1 keoi5, mai1 zik1 hai6 zaau2 fui3 hei3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明知道他心情不好，还去刺激他，那不是自找麻烦吗？
examples.english_sentence: You knew he was in a bad mood and still went to provoke him, isn't that just asking for trouble?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞咁多嘢啦，再搞落去就真係找悔氣㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1, zoi3 gaau2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 zan1 hai6 zaau2 fui3 hei3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别搞这么多事了，再搞下去就真是自找麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause so much trouble, if you keep doing that, you'll really be asking for it.

english_meaning: to exchange (money); currency exchange
explanation_mandarin: 指将一种货币兑换成另一种货币。
explanation_english: To exchange one currency for another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想喺銀行找換啲美金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hai2 ngan4 hong4 zaau2 wun6 di1 mei5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想在银行兑换一些美元。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange some US dollars at the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有冇地方可以找換日圓？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 mou5 dei6 fong1 ho2 ji5 zaau2 wun6 jat6 jyun4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有没有地方可以兑换日元？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anywhere here I can exchange Japanese Yen?

english_meaning: Money exchange shop; currency exchange
explanation_mandarin: 提供外币兑换服务的店铺。
explanation_english: A shop or business that provides currency exchange services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去 搵 間 找換店 換啲美金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 wan2 gaan1 zaau2 wun6 dim3 wun6 di1 mei5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去找一家兑换店换一些美元。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go find a money exchange shop to exchange some US dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間 找換店 嘅 匯率 好唔好㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zaau2 wun6 dim3 ge3 wui6 leot2 hou2 m4 hou2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家兑换店的汇率好不好啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is the exchange rate good at this money exchange shop?

english_meaning: to pay up, to honour a debt/promise, to settle accounts
explanation_mandarin: 原指结算账目，付清欠款。现在也指兑现承诺或诺言。
explanation_english: Originally refers to settling accounts and paying off debts. Now it also refers to fulfilling a promise or pledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗請我食飯，記得找數啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 sing4 zo2 ching2 ngo5 sik6 faan6, gei3 dak1 zaau2 sou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应请我吃饭了，记得兑现啊！
examples.english_sentence: You promised to treat me to a meal, remember to pay up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗錢唔肯找數，真係冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 cin2 m4 hang2 zaau2 sou3, zan1 hai6 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了钱不肯付账，真是没品。
examples.english_sentence: He lost money and refused to pay up, that's really bad character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵佢找數！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 keoi5 zaau2 sou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要找他算账！
examples.english_sentence: We need to make him pay!

english_meaning: to ask for trouble, to invite bad luck, to look for a fight
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦，故意激怒别人或主动招惹不好的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately seeking trouble, intentionally provoking others, or actively inviting bad things to happen.  Implies that the person is bringing misfortune upon themselves or is looking for conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好去搵佢哋啦，擺明搵晦氣啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3 wan2 keoi5 dei6 laa1, baai2 ming4 wan2 hui3 hei3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好别去找他们了，摆明是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better not go look for them, it's clearly asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再講落去，小心我搵你晦氣啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3, siu2 sam1 ngo5 wan2 nei5 hui3 hei3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再说下去，小心我找你麻烦！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep talking, be careful I'll make trouble for you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知唔得，重要去做，真係搵晦氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 m4 dak1, zung6 jiu3 heoi3 zou6, zan1 hai6 wan2 hui3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道不行，还要去做，真是自找倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knows it won't work, but still does it, he's really asking for trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 找零 (zhǎo líng), 找錢 (zhǎo qián)
english_meaning: To give change, to return change (after a purchase)
explanation_mandarin: 在購物或交易後，將多餘的錢退還給顧客。
explanation_english: To give back the difference between the amount paid and the price of the item purchased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買嘢要睇清楚佢有冇搵續俾你呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 je5 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 keoi5 jau5 mou5 wan2 zuk6 bei2 nei5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买东西要看清楚他有没有找零给你啊。
examples.english_sentence: When buying things, you need to check carefully whether he gives you the change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，搵續五十蚊俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, wan2 zuk6 ng5 sap6 man1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦，找零五十块钱给我。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, please give me fifty dollars in change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使搵續喇，當係貼士啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 wan2 zuk6 laa3, dong3 hai6 tip1 si2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用找零了，就当是小费吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to give me change, consider it a tip.

mandarin_meaning: 找回面子；挽回損失；找補
english_meaning: to save face; to redeem oneself; to make amends; to get one's own back
explanation_mandarin: 比喻通过某种行为或方式来挽回失去的尊严、利益或面子。
explanation_english: Figuratively, it means to redeem oneself, save face, or recoup losses through some action or means. It implies an attempt to regain lost dignity, benefits, or face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗咁多錢，梗係要搵機會找贖返啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 wan2 gei1 wui2 zaau2 suk6 faan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了这么多钱，肯定要找机会找补回来。
examples.english_sentence: He lost so much money, he definitely needs to find an opportunity to get his own back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次俾佢擺咗一道，今次我一定要找贖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 bei2 keoi5 baai2 zo2 jat1 dou6, gam1 ci3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zaau2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次被他摆了一道，这次我一定要找回面子。
examples.english_sentence: I was tricked by him last time, this time I must get even.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知自己做錯咗，想盡辦法找贖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 zo2, soeng2 zeon6 baan6 faat3 zaau2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己做错了，想尽办法弥补。
examples.english_sentence: He knows he made a mistake and is trying everything he can to make amends.

english_meaning: to give change (money)
explanation_mandarin: 指在交易中，卖家收到大于商品价格的金额时，将多余的部分退还给买家。
explanation_english: To give back the difference between the amount paid and the cost of an item in a transaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你找錢俾我呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 zaau2 cin2 bei2 ngo5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你找零给我。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me the change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾咗一百蚊，佢要找幾多錢俾我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 zo2 jat1 baak3 man1, keoi5 jiu3 zaau2 gei2 do1 cin2 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我给了一百块，他要找多少钱给我？
examples.english_sentence: I gave one hundred dollars, how much change should he give me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使找錢啦，當俾貼士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zaau2 cin2 laa1, dong3 bei2 tip1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用找钱了，当做小费。
examples.english_sentence: Keep the change, consider it a tip.

english_meaning: to give change, change (money)
explanation_mandarin: 动词：指在交易中，当支付的金额大于应付的金额时，找回多余的钱。名词：指找回的零钱。
explanation_english: Verb: To give back the remaining money when the amount paid is more than the amount due in a transaction. Noun: The change (money) received back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，可唔可以找零畀我？我冇散紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zaau2 ling4 bei2 ngo5? ngo5 mou5 saan2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问，可以找零给我吗？我没有零钱。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, can you give me change? I don't have any small change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾咗一百蚊，應該找零五十蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 zo2 jat1 baak3 man1, ying1 goi1 zaau2 ling4 ng5 sap6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你给了一百块钱，应该找零五十块钱。
examples.english_sentence: You gave a hundred dollars, you should receive fifty dollars in change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我睇吓有冇得找零。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 yau5 mou5 dak1 zaau2 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我看看有没有零钱可以找。
examples.english_sentence: Please check if you have any change to give.

mandarin_meaning: 继承; 承担; 蒙受
english_meaning: to bear; to undertake; to inherit; to receive; to get
explanation_mandarin: 接受，接續；擔當，負責；承受，蒙受。
explanation_english: To receive, inherit, or accept; to bear or undertake responsibility; to endure or be subjected to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 承你貴言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 nei5 gwai3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 承蒙您这么说。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your kind words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我承擔晒啲責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 daam1 saai3 di1 zaak3 jam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我承担所有的责任。
examples.english_sentence: I will take all the responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 承傳文化
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 cyun4 man4 faa3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传承文化
examples.english_sentence: To inherit culture

mandarin_meaning: 承上启下 (chéng shàng qǐ xià)
english_meaning: To connect the preceding with the following; to serve as a link between the past and the future; to form a bridge between what has come before and what is yet to come.
explanation_mandarin: 指承接上面的，引起下面的。多用于文章、讲话等的前后连接。
explanation_english: Refers to connecting what comes before and leading to what comes after. Often used to describe the transition and connection in writing, speeches, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個項目入面扮演住承上啓下嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6 baan1 jin2 zoek6 sing4 soeng5 kai2 haa6 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个项目中扮演着承上启下的角色。
examples.english_sentence: He plays a pivotal role in this project, connecting the past with the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個章節喺成篇報告入面係承上啓下嘅關鍵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zoeng1 zit3 hai2 sing4 pin1 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 hai6 sing4 soeng5 kai2 haa6 ge3 gwaan1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这一章节在整篇报告中是承上启下的关键。
examples.english_sentence: This chapter is crucial in the entire report, serving as a bridge between sections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講做得好好，能夠承上啓下，將唔同嘅觀點整合埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2, nang4 gau3 sing4 soeng5 kai2 haa6, zoeng1 m4 tung4 ge3 gun1 dim2 zing2 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲做得很好，能够承上启下，将不同的观点整合在一起。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was very well done, able to connect the preceding and following points, integrating different viewpoints together.

english_meaning: to connect the preceding with the following; to serve as a link between what comes before and what comes after; transitional
explanation_mandarin: 指在文章或讲话中，连接上下文，使前后内容贯通，起过渡作用。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to connect the preceding with the following, serving as a transition between the past and the future or previous and subsequent parts (of a speech, writing, etc.). It highlights a connecting or transitional role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇嘢嘅第二段就係承上啟下嘅作用，解釋返上一段嘅重點，跟住引導落下一段嘅新論點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 je5 ge3 dai6 ji6 dyun6 zau6 hai6 sing4 soeng5 kai2 haa6 ge3 zok3 jung6, gaai2 sik1 faan1 soeng5 jat1 dyun6 ge3 zung2 dim2, gan1 zyu6 jan5 dou6 lok6 haa6 jat1 dyun6 ge3 san1 leon6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章的第二段起着承上启下的作用，解释了上一段的重点，然后引导到下一段的新论点。
examples.english_sentence: The second paragraph of this article serves as a transition, explaining the key points of the previous paragraph and then leading into the new argument in the next paragraph.

english_meaning: Thank you for your kind words; I appreciate your well wishes; I hope you're right.
explanation_mandarin: 客套话，承蒙对方的美好祝愿或期许，表示感谢和希望对方说的是对的。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to thank someone for their good wishes, hopeful words, or optimistic predictions. It also implies a hope that what the person said will come true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望佢考試順利啦，承你貴言！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 keoi5 haau2 si3 seon6 lei6 laa1, sing4 nei5 gwai3 jin4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望他考试顺利，承蒙您的吉言！
examples.english_sentence: I hope he does well on the exam, thank you for your kind words/well wishes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話我會升職㗎，承你貴言啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ngo5 wui5 sing1 zik1 gaa3, sing4 nei5 gwai3 jin4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说我会升职的，承蒙您的吉言！
examples.english_sentence: He said I would get promoted, I hope you're right (about what he said)!

english_meaning: to underwrite (insurance)
explanation_mandarin: 保险公司承诺对投保人承担保险责任。
explanation_english: When an insurance company agrees to accept the risk and provide insurance coverage to a policyholder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間保險公司承保咗我嘅醫療保險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 bou2 him2 gung1 si1 sing4 bou2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ji1 liu4 bou2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家保险公司承保了我的医疗保险。
examples.english_sentence: The insurance company underwrote my health insurance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔肯承保高風險嘅行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 hang2 sing4 bou2 gou1 fung1 him2 ge3 hang4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不肯承保高风险的行业。
examples.english_sentence: They are unwilling to underwrite high-risk industries.

english_meaning: to inherit; to carry on; to pass down; to transmit
explanation_mandarin: 指继承并传扬下去，将文化、知识、技能等传给后代。
explanation_english: To inherit and pass on, transmitting culture, knowledge, skills, etc. to future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要承傳中國嘅傳統文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sing4 cyun4 zung1 gwok3 ge3 tyun4 tung2 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要传承中国的传统文化。
examples.english_sentence: We need to carry on China's traditional culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺將佢嘅手藝承傳俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 sau2 ngai6 sing4 cyun4 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷把他的手艺传承给他。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather passed down his craft to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間老字號一直努力承傳傳統嘅味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 jat1 zik6 nu5 lik6 sing4 cyun4 tyun4 tung2 ge3 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号一直努力传承传统的味道。
examples.english_sentence: This established brand has been working hard to preserve the traditional flavor.

english_meaning: to inherit the past and usher in the future; to carry on the heritage and open up new horizons
explanation_mandarin: 继承前人的事业，为后人开辟道路。形容一个人在某方面取得成就，既继承了前人的优秀传统，又为后人开创了新的局面。
explanation_english: To inherit the legacy of predecessors and pave the way for future generations. Describes someone who has achieved success in a certain field, both inheriting the excellent traditions of their predecessors and creating new prospects for those who follow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺科學界嘅貢獻，可以話係承先啓後，影響深遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fo1 hok6 gaai3 ge3 gung3 hin3, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, ying2 heong2 sam1 yuen5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在科学界的贡献，可以说是承前启后，影响深远。
examples.english_sentence: His contribution to the scientific community can be said to have inherited the past and opened up the future, with a far-reaching impact.

english_meaning: to carry on the heritage and forge ahead; to inherit the past and usher in the future
explanation_mandarin: 继承前人的事业，为后人开辟道路。形容事业的延续和发展。
explanation_english: To inherit the achievements of the past and pave the way for the future. Describes the continuity and development of a cause or enterprise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅發展一路都係承先啟後，越做越好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2 jat1 lou6 dou1 hai6 sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, yuet6 zou6 yuet6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的发展一直都是承前启后，越做越好。
examples.english_sentence: The development of this company has always been about carrying on the heritage and forging ahead, becoming better and better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅研究承先啟後，喺學術界影響深遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin4 gau3 sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, hai2 hok6 seot6 gaai3 ying2 heong2 sam1 yuen5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的研究承前启后，在学术界影响深远。
examples.english_sentence: His research inherited the past and ushered in the future, having a profound impact in academia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學習上一代嘅經驗，承先啟後，將呢個文化傳承落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 hok6 zaap6 soeng6 jat1 dai6 ge3 ging1 yim6, sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, zoeng1 ni1 go3 man4 faa3 cyun4 sing3 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习上一代的经验，承前启后，将这个文化传承下去。
examples.english_sentence: We must learn from the experiences of the previous generation, carry on the heritage and forge ahead, and pass on this culture.

english_meaning: to inherit from the past and pave the way for the future; to carry on the heritage and open a new era
explanation_mandarin: 繼承前人的事業，並為後人開闢道路。形容繼往開來，具有承上啟下的作用。
explanation_english: To inherit the legacy of predecessors and pave the way for future generations. It describes a role of linking the past and the future, carrying forward heritage and creating a new era.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅作品承先啟後，喺粵劇界有重要嘅地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zok3 ban2 sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, hai2 jyut6 kek6 gaai3 jau5 zung6 jiu3 ge3 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作品承前啟後，在粤剧界有重要的地位。
examples.english_sentence: His works inherit from the past and pave the way for the future, holding an important position in the Cantonese opera scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新一代嘅科學家要承先啟後，繼續探索宇宙嘅奧秘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jat1 daai6 ge3 fo1 hok6 gaa1 jiu3 sing4 sin1 kai2 hau6, gai3 zuk6 taam3 sok3 jyu5 zau6 ge3 ou3 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新一代的科学家要承前启后，继续探索宇宙的奥秘。
examples.english_sentence: The new generation of scientists must inherit from the past and pave the way for the future, continuing to explore the mysteries of the universe.

english_meaning: to contract; to undertake; to take on a contract; to farm out
explanation_mandarin: 接受合同，承担任务。
explanation_english: To accept a contract and undertake the task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋承包咗呢個建築項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 baau1 zo2 ni1 go3 gin3 zuk1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们承包了这个建筑项目。
examples.english_sentence: They contracted to undertake this construction project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司承包咗政府嘅清潔服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 baau1 zo2 zing3 fu2 ge3 cing1 git3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司承包了政府的清洁服务。
examples.english_sentence: This company contracted to provide cleaning services for the government.

english_meaning: to print; to undertake printing work; printing
explanation_mandarin: 指承担印刷工作，也指印刷出来的成品。
explanation_english: Refers to undertaking printing work or the printed product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份嘢要攞去邊間公司承印好呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 je5 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jan3 hou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件要拿到哪家公司印刷好呢？
examples.english_sentence: Which company should we take this document to for printing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書嘅承印商係邊間啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ge3 sing4 jan3 soeng1 hai6 bin1 gaan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的印刷商是哪家啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which company is the printer of this book?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司承印好多唔同類型嘅刊物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 sing4 jan3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 hon1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司承印很多不同类型的刊物。
examples.english_sentence: Our company undertakes the printing of many different types of publications.

english_meaning: to bear; to endure; to withstand; to inherit
explanation_mandarin: 接受或担当（压力、负担、痛苦等）；继承。
explanation_english: To bear or endure (pressure, burden, pain, etc.); to inherit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工壓力好大，唔係個個人都承受得到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6, m4 hai6 go3 go3 jan4 dou1 sing4 sau6 dak1 dou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作压力很大，不是每个人都能承受得了的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very stressful; not everyone can handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢承受咗好多家庭嘅期望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 ge3 kei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他承受了很多家庭的期望。
examples.english_sentence: He bears a lot of family expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋承受咗好多苦難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 sau6 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2 naan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们承受了很多苦难。
examples.english_sentence: They have endured a lot of suffering.

english_meaning: to contract to build; to undertake construction
explanation_mandarin: 承担建筑工程的建设。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇你畫得咁靚，我都技癢想畫返幾幅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 nei5 waak6 dak1 gam3 leng3, ngo5 dou1 gei6 joeng5 soeng2 waak6 faan1 gei2 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看你画得这么漂亮，我也手痒想画几幅。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how beautifully you paint, I'm itching to paint a few myself.

english_meaning: to exhaust one's bag of tricks; to have run out of ideas; to be at one's wits' end
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用尽了所有的方法，再也没有办法了。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone has exhausted all their abilities and strategies, leaving them with no further recourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗極都諗唔到計仔，真係技窮啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 gik1 dou1 nam2 m4 dou2 gai3 zai2, zan1 hai6 gei6 kung4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了很久都想不出办法，真是黔驴技穷了！
examples.english_sentence: I've thought about it for ages and can't come up with any solutions, I'm really at my wit's end!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司已經技窮，再冇新產品推出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 gei6 kung4, zoi3 mou5 san1 caan2 ban2 tui1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经黔驴技穷，再没有新产品推出了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has exhausted its bag of tricks and has no new products to launch.

english_meaning: skill; technical ability
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握和运用专门技术的能力。
explanation_english: The ability to master and apply specialized technical knowledge and abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅電腦技能好叻，可以幫我哋解決好多問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 din6 nou5 gei6 nang4 hou2 lek1, ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 gaai2 kyut3 hou2 do1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的电脑技能很厉害，可以帮我们解决很多问题。
examples.english_sentence: His computer skills are excellent; he can help us solve many problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學一門新嘅技能需要時間同埋耐心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jat1 mun4 san1 ge3 gei6 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 tung4 mai4 noi6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习一门新的技能需要时间和耐心。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a new skill requires time and patience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺職場上面，有啲技能係好搶手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6 min6, jau5 di1 gei6 nang4 hai6 hou2 coeng2 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在职场上面，有些技能是很抢手的。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace, some skills are highly sought after.

english_meaning: skill; art; craft; technique
explanation_mandarin: 指技术和艺术，尤指需要特殊训练或才能的技能。
explanation_english: Refers to skill and art, especially skills that require special training or talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅烹飪技藝好精湛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 paang1 jam3 gei6 ngai6 hou2 zing1 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的烹饪技艺非常精湛。
examples.english_sentence: His culinary skills are very exquisite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個魔術師嘅技藝令人嘆為觀止。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mo1 seot6 si1 ge3 gei6 ngai6 ling6 jan4 taan3 wai4 gun1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个魔术师的技艺令人叹为观止。
examples.english_sentence: The magician's skill is amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習一門技藝需要時間同埋耐心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jat1 mun4 gei6 ngai6 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 tung4 maai4 noi6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习一门技艺需要时间和耐心。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a skill takes time and patience.

english_meaning: skill; technique; technology
explanation_mandarin: 指在生产斗争、科学实验或社会生活中积累的经验和创造的工艺，以及在一定生产部门中所掌握的知识和技能。
explanation_english: Refers to the skill, technique, or technology acquired through experience and creation in production, scientific experiments, or social life, as well as the knowledge and skills mastered in a specific production sector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅電腦技術好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 din6 nou5 gei6 seot6 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的电脑技术很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: His computer skills are very impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要提升香港嘅競爭力，我哋要大力發展高新技術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 tai4 sing1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging6 zang1 lik6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daai6 lik6 faat3 zin2 gou1 san1 gei6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要提升香港的竞争力，我们要大力发展高新技术。
examples.english_sentence: To enhance Hong Kong's competitiveness, we need to vigorously develop high technology.

english_meaning: Technical content; technological sophistication
explanation_mandarin: 指产品或项目所包含的技术水平或科技含量。
explanation_english: Refers to the level of technology or technological content included in a product or project.  Describes how sophisticated or advanced something is from a technical perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅技術含量好高，功能好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 gei6 seot6 haam4 loeng6 hou2 gou1, gung1 nang4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话的技术含量很高，功能很多。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has a high technical content, with many features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅產品係市場上技術含量最高嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2 hai6 si5 cheung4 soeng6 gei6 seot6 haam4 loeng6 zeoi3 gou1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的产品是市场上技术含量最高的。
examples.english_sentence: Their products have the highest technical content in the market.

english_meaning: skilled immigration; immigration based on skills
explanation_mandarin: 指依靠个人的技术能力，通过审核获得移民资格的一种移民方式。
explanation_english: Refers to an immigration pathway where individuals qualify for immigration based on their skills and qualifications, typically assessed through a points-based system or other criteria.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打算申請技術移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 syun3 san1 ching2 gei6 seot6 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打算申请技术移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: He plans to apply for skilled immigration to Canada.

english_meaning: Skillful performance that astounds everyone present; to amaze the audience with one's skill.
explanation_mandarin: 形容技艺表演精湛，使在场的人都感到震惊。
explanation_english: Describes a performance or skill that is so outstanding and impressive that it amazes everyone present.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅鋼琴演奏技驚四座，贏得全場熱烈嘅掌聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gong3 kam4 jin2 zau3 gei6 ging1 sei3 zo6, wing4 dak1 cyun4 coeng4 jit6 lit6 ge3 zoeng2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的钢琴演奏技惊四座，赢得了全场热烈的掌声。
examples.english_sentence: His piano performance was so amazing that it stunned the audience, and he won a warm round of applause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺功夫比賽入面嘅表現技驚四座，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 fu1 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 ge3 biu2 hin3 gei6 ging1 sei3 zo6, lo2 zo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在功夫比赛中的表现技惊四座，获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: His performance in the Kung Fu competition was astonishing, and he won the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 魔術師嘅表演技驚四座，啲觀眾個個都睇到目瞪口呆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mo1 seot6 si1 ge3 biu2 jin2 gei6 ging1 sei3 zo6, di1 gun1 zung3 go3 go3 dou1 tai2 dou3 muk6 dang6 hau2 daai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 魔术师的表演技惊四座，观众们个个都看得目瞪口呆。
examples.english_sentence: The magician's performance was amazing, leaving the audience in awe.

mandarin_meaning: 抄写; 复制; 查抄
english_meaning: to copy; to transcribe; to plagiarize; to search and confiscate; stir-fry
explanation_mandarin: 1. 照原文或样本写或画：抄写、抄录。2. 复制：抄本、抄袭。3. 搜查没收：抄家。
explanation_english: 1. To copy or transcribe: to write or draw according to the original text or sample. 2. To duplicate: a copy, to plagiarize. 3. To search and confiscate: to confiscate property (raid a house).  It can also mean 'to stir-fry' in the context of cooking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣抄人哋嘅答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 go2 zan6 caau3 jan4 dei6 ge3 daap3 aan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候抄别人的答案。
examples.english_sentence: He copied other people's answers during the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嚟抄低呢個電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lai4 caau3 dai2 ni1 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们来记下这个电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: Let's copy down this phone number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學下點樣抄雜菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 caau3 zaap6 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想学一下怎么炒什锦蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn how to stir-fry mixed vegetables.

english_meaning: to write down, to copy down, to take notes
explanation_mandarin: 用笔记录下来信息。
explanation_english: To write down information, to copy something that is said or written.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師講嘅嘢，你要抄低呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gong2 ge3 je5, nei5 jiu3 caau1 dai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师讲的东西，你要记下来啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to write down what the teacher says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會抄低你電話號碼，到時打俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 caau1 dai1 nei5 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5, dou3 si4 daa2 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会记下你的电话号码，到时候打给你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll write down your phone number, and I'll call you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抄低咗成篇報道嘅重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau1 dai1 zo2 seng4 pin1 bou3 dou6 ge3 zung2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抄下了整篇报道的重点。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote down the main points of the entire report.

english_meaning: to confiscate a family's property, to ransack a household (usually due to political reasons)
explanation_mandarin: 古代一种政治惩罚，指查抄没收犯罪或政治异己者的家产。
explanation_english: Historically, a form of political punishment involving the confiscation of a criminal's or political opponent's family assets and ransacking their home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲皇帝成日都抄人哋嘅家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 wong4 dai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 caau1 jan4 dei6 ge3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的皇帝经常抄别人的家。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, emperors often confiscated people's properties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為參與叛亂，成個家族都被抄家滅族。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 caam1 jyu5 bun6 lyun6, sing4 go3 gaa1 zuk6 dou1 bei2 caau1 gaa1 mit6 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为参与叛乱，整个家族都被抄家灭族。
examples.english_sentence: Because he participated in the rebellion, his whole family was confiscated and exterminated.

english_meaning: to copy; to transcribe; to write out
explanation_mandarin: 照着原文写下来。
explanation_english: To write something out verbatim; to copy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我哋抄寫課文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 caau1 se2 fo3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师叫我们抄写课文。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked us to copy the text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抄寫得好快手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau1 se2 dak1 hou2 faai3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抄写得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He copies very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好偷睇人哋嘅答案嚟抄寫呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tau1 tai2 yan4 dei6 ge3 daap3 aan3 lai4 caau1 se2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要偷看别人的答案来抄写啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't peek at other people's answers to copy!

english_meaning: Bottom fishing / Buy at the bottom / Buy the dip
explanation_mandarin: 在股市或其它投资市场中，当价格跌至低谷时买入，希望在价格反弹时获利。
explanation_english: In the stock market or other investment markets, it refers to buying when the price drops to a low point, hoping to profit when the price rebounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市跌到咁低，依家係抄底嘅好時機啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 dit3 dou3 gam3 dai1, ji1 gaa1 hai6 caau1 dai2 ge3 hou2 si4 gei1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市跌到这么低，现在是抄底的好时机啊！
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has fallen so low; now is a good time to buy the dip!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住抄底，但係成日都俾人捉到正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 caau1 dai2, daan6 hai6 seng4 jat6 dou1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着抄底，但是总是被人抓住。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about bottom fishing, but he keeps getting caught.

mandarin_meaning: 副本; 抄本; 抄袭的文本
english_meaning: copy; transcript; manuscript copy; to copy (a text)
explanation_mandarin: 指复制的文本，可以是手抄本或复印件。也指抄袭的文本。
explanation_english: Refers to a copied text, which can be a handwritten copy or a photocopy. It can also refer to a plagiarized text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件係我哋嘅抄本，你睇吓啱唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 caau1 bun2, nei5 tai2 haa5 ngaam1 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件是我们的副本，你看看对不对。
examples.english_sentence: This document is our copy, please check if it's correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住抄本人哋嘅功課，要自己做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 caau1 bun2 jan4 dei6 ge3 gung1 fo3, jiu3 zi6 gei2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着抄袭别人的作业，要自己做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about copying other people's homework, you have to do it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢嘅論文全部都係抄本，所以被取消資格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 ge3 leon6 man4 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 caau1 bun2, so2 ji5 bei2 ceoi2 siu1 zi1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他的论文全部都是抄袭的，所以被取消资格。
examples.english_sentence: He said his entire thesis was plagiarized, so he was disqualified.

mandarin_meaning: 抄袭创意; 剽窃点子
english_meaning: To copy ideas; to plagiarize a concept; to steal someone's idea
explanation_mandarin: 指抄袭或剽窃他人的创意、想法或计划。
explanation_english: Refers to copying or plagiarizing someone else's creativity, ideas, or plans. It typically implies taking credit for an idea that is not one's own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日抄人哋條橋啦，自己諗下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 caau1 jan4 dei6 tiu4 kiu2 laa1, zi6 gei2 nim2 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是抄袭别人的想法，自己想想吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always copy other people's ideas, think for yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份project好多嘢都係抄橋，好無恥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 project hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 caau1 kiu2, hou2 mou4 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的项目很多东西都是抄袭的，很无耻。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of things in his project are plagiarized, so shameless.

english_meaning: To copy/plagiarize, to hype/promote something (by rehashing old information), to rummage/search
explanation_mandarin: “抄” 指抄袭；“炒”指翻炒， 引申为炒作，重复利用旧信息宣传；“摷” 指翻找，搜寻。
explanation_english: "抄 (caau1)" means to copy/plagiarize; "炒 (caau2)" means to rehash, often in the sense of hyping something up by rehashing old news/information; "摷 (caau2)" means to rummage through, to search.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日抄人哋嘅嘢啦，自己諗下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 caau1 jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 laa1, zi6 gei2 lam2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是抄袭别人的东西，自己想一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always copy other people's stuff, think for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新聞成日炒埋啲舊聞，都唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 man4 sing4 jat6 caau2 maai4 di1 gau6 man4, dou1 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些新闻总是炒作一些旧闻，都不知道在干什么。
examples.english_sentence: The news is always rehashing old stories, I don't know what they're doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺個櫃桶度摷咗好耐都搵唔到把鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 go3 gwai6 tung2 dou6 caau2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 baa2 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在抽屉里翻找了很久都找不到钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: I rummaged through the drawer for a long time and couldn't find the key.

synonyms: 翻箱倒櫃 (faan1 soeng1 dou2 gwai6)

english_meaning: To issue a traffic ticket; to note down a license plate number
explanation_mandarin: 警察或相关人员记录违规车辆的车牌号码，以便开罚单。 也泛指记录号码牌。
explanation_english: For the police or relevant personnel to note down the license plate number of a vehicle that has violated traffic regulations, usually in order to issue a ticket. Can also generally refer to recording any kind of numbered plate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢亂咁泊車，俾人抄牌都抵死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lyun6 gam2 paak3 ce1, bei2 jan4 caau1 paai4 dou1 dai2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他乱停车，被人开罚单也是活该。
examples.english_sentence: He parked randomly, it serves him right that he got a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到可疑人物，最好抄低佢哋嘅車牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 ho2 yi4 jan4 mat6, zeoi3 hou2 caau1 dai1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ce1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 见到可疑人物，最好记下他们的车牌号。
examples.english_sentence: If you see suspicious people, it's best to note down their license plate numbers.

english_meaning: to copy, to plagiarize, to imitate
explanation_mandarin: 从别人的作品或行为中照搬或模仿。多指不正当的模仿。
explanation_english: To copy or imitate someone else's work or behavior. Often refers to illegitimate imitation or plagiarism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嗰陣抄考隔離個同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 go2 zan6 caau1 haau2 gaak3 lei4 go3 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候抄袭了旁边同学的。
examples.english_sentence: He copied from the student next to him during the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日抄考人哋嘅橋啦，自己諗吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 caau1 haau2 yan4 dei6 ge3 kiu2 laa1, zi6 gei2 lam2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是抄袭别人的点子，自己想想吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always copy other people's ideas, think for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅論文俾人發現抄考咗好多內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 leon6 man4 bei2 yan4 faat3 yin6 caau1 haau2 zo2 hou2 do1 noi6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的论文被人发现抄袭了很多内容。
examples.english_sentence: His thesis was discovered to have plagiarized a lot of content.

english_meaning: plagiarize, copy, plagiarism
explanation_mandarin: 指未经授权或未注明出处地复制或模仿他人的作品、思想、或创意。
explanation_english: To take someone else's work or ideas and pass them off as one's own; plagiarism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課抄襲人哋嘅論文，俾老師發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 caau1 zaap6 jan4 dei6 ge3 leon6 man4, bei2 lou5 si1 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作业抄袭了别人的论文，被老师发现了。
examples.english_sentence: His homework plagiarized someone else's thesis, and the teacher found out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抄襲係一種唔誠實嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caau1 zaap6 hai6 jat1 zung2 m4 sing4 sat6 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抄袭是一种不诚实的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Plagiarism is a form of dishonesty.

english_meaning: to wipe; to dab
explanation_mandarin: 用手或布等擦去污垢或液体。
explanation_english: To wipe off dirt or liquid with a hand, cloth, or other material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抆下你塊面啦，污糟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man1 haa5 nei5 faai3 min6 laa1, wu1 zou1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 擦一下你的脸吧，脏死了。
examples.english_sentence: Wipe your face, it's filthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用紙巾抆咗下鼻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 ji2 gan1 man1 zo2 haa5 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用纸巾擦了一下鼻子。
examples.english_sentence: He wiped his nose with a tissue.

english_meaning: To wipe one's bottom; to clean up after oneself; to tidy up a mess (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是擦屁股，引申为处理残局，收拾烂摊子。
explanation_english: Literally means to wipe one's bottom. Figuratively, it means to clean up after oneself or to tidy up a mess, often implying taking responsibility for someone else's mistakes or resolving a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥成日搞搞震，都要我幫佢抆尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, dou1 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 man5 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥整天惹麻烦，都要我帮他收拾残局。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother always makes trouble, and I always have to clean up after him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁大鑊，睇嚟要搵人抆尾喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, tai2 lai4 jiu3 wan2 jan4 man5 mei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么严重，看来要找人来收拾残局了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious; it looks like someone needs to clean up the mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，都要自己抆尾㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 man5 mei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错了事，都要自己收拾残局的。
examples.english_sentence: If he does something wrong, he needs to clean up his own mess.

english_meaning: to wipe one's bottom (after defecating); to clean up someone else's mess; to deal with a problem caused by someone else
explanation_mandarin: 本义是擦屁股。引申为替别人收拾烂摊子，处理别人造成的问题。
explanation_english: Literally means to wipe one's bottom after defecating. Figuratively, it means to clean up someone else's mess, to deal with a problem caused by someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都要幫佢哋抆屎，好辛苦啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 dei6 man5 si2, hou2 san1 fu2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是要帮他们擦屁股，好辛苦啊！
examples.english_sentence: I always have to clean up their mess, it's so tiring!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你闖咗咁大嘅禍，要我幫你抆屎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 chong2 zo2 gam3 daai6 ge3 wo6, jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 man5 si2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你闯了这么大的祸，要我帮你擦屁股？
examples.english_sentence: You've created such a big problem, you want me to clean up your mess?

english_meaning: to wipe away tears; to force out tears (fake crying)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或纸巾擦拭眼泪。也指假装哭泣，故意挤出眼泪。
explanation_english: To wipe away tears with one's hand or tissue. It can also refer to fake crying; deliberately forcing out tears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知衰就即刻抆水博同情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 seoi1 zau6 zik1 hak1 man1 seoi2 bok3 tung4 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己错了就立刻擦眼泪博取同情。
