examples.english_sentence: Knowing he was in the wrong, he immediately wiped away tears to gain sympathy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再抆水啦，我都唔信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 man1 seoi2 laa1, ngo5 dou1 m4 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再假哭了，我都不相信你了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force out tears anymore, I don't believe you.

english_meaning: to wipe one's bottom (after defecation)
explanation_mandarin: 指擦拭屁股，通常是在大便之后。
explanation_english: To wipe one's bottom, usually after defecation. A more direct and less euphemistic term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲紙巾喺度，你去廁所可以攞嚟抆灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ji2 gan1 hai2 dou6, nei5 heoi3 ci3 so2 ho2 ji5 lo2 lai4 man1 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 纸巾在这里，你去厕所可以拿来擦屁股。
examples.english_sentence: The tissues are here, you can take them to the toilet to wipe your bottom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，阿媽會幫我抆灰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, aa3 maa1 wui5 bong1 ngo5 man1 fui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，妈妈会帮我擦屁股。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom would help me wipe my bottom.

english_meaning: to pick, to dig, to excavate; to choose, to select
explanation_mandarin: 本意是挖或掘，也指选择，挑选。
explanation_english: Originally means to dig or excavate. It also means to choose or select.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要抉擇一個正確嘅方向好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 kyut3 zaak6 jat1 go3 jing1 kok3 ge3 fong1 hoeng3 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选择一个正确的方向很难。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to choose the right direction.

english_meaning: to choose, to decide, to make a choice; decision
explanation_mandarin: 指在几个可供选择的方案中进行选择、决定。
explanation_english: To make a choice or decision between different options or alternatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要去到抉擇嘅時候喇，究竟揀A定係揀B呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 heoi3 dou3 kyut3 zaak6 ge3 si4 hau6 laa3, gau3 ging2 gaan2 A ding6 hai6 gaan2 B ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在到了需要抉择的时候了，究竟选A还是选B呢？
examples.english_sentence: We've reached the point where we need to make a decision. Do we choose A or B?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係一個好難嘅抉擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 naan4 ge3 kyut3 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一个很难的选择。
examples.english_sentence: This is a very difficult decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面臨一個重要嘅人生抉擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 lam4 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jan4 sang1 kyut3 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他面临一个重要的人生抉择。
examples.english_sentence: He is facing an important life decision.

english_meaning: a measure word; to hold; handle
explanation_mandarin: 量詞，用於有柄的器物或一手可握的東西；動詞，拿、握。
explanation_english: Measure word for objects with a handle or things that can be held in one hand; Verb: to hold, to grasp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把遮幾靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 ze1 gei2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把伞真漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This umbrella is so pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我把遮擺咗喺門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baa2 ze1 baai2 zo2 hai2 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把伞放在门口了。
examples.english_sentence: I put the umbrella at the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把刀好利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 dou1 hou2 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的刀很锋利。
examples.english_sentence: His knife is very sharp.

english_meaning: Mouth; Ability to speak; Way of speaking
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“口”，引申指说话的能力、方式，或者直接指嘴巴。
explanation_english: Literally means "mouth." It can refer to the ability to speak, the way someone speaks, or simply the mouth itself. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把口咁臭，梗係成日講大話啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 hau2 gam3 cau3, gang2 hai6 seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的嘴这么臭，肯定总是说谎！
examples.english_sentence: Your mouth is so foul; you must be lying all the time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把口好叻，成日氹到人好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 hau2 hou2 lek1, seng4 jat6 tam5 dou3 jan4 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的口才很好，总是哄得别人很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good with his words; he always makes people happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁用把口食人嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 jung6 baa2 hau2 sik6 jan4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱用嘴吃别人的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just use your mouth to eat other people's things.

english_meaning: to be foul-mouthed, to be tactless, to speak without restraint, to say whatever comes to mind
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话不注意，想说什么就说什么，不考虑场合或听者的感受，有时会冒犯他人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who doesn't watch what they say, speaking whatever comes to mind without considering the situation or the listener's feelings, sometimes offending others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係把口唔修，成日得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 baa2 hau2 m4 sau1, seng4 jat6 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是口无遮拦，老是得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: He's really foul-mouthed, always offending people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把口唔修就唔好怪人唔鍾意你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 hau2 m4 sau1 zau6 m4 hou2 gwaai3 jan4 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你口无遮拦就不要怪别人不喜欢你。
examples.english_sentence: If you are tactless, don't blame people for not liking you.

english_meaning: unable to keep one's mouth shut; to be talkative; to be unable to stop talking
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喋喋不休，管不住自己的嘴巴，经常说个不停。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very talkative and unable to keep their mouth shut, constantly talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講起佢啲仔女就把口唔收，講足幾個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 hei2 keoi5 di1 zai2 neoi5 zau6 baa2 hau2 m4 sau1, gong2 zuk1 gei2 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一提起他的孩子们就滔滔不绝，讲了几个小时。
examples.english_sentence: Once he starts talking about his children, he can't stop talking and goes on for hours.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以把口收下呀？好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 baa2 hau2 sau1 haa5 aa3? hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以闭上嘴吗？好吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Can you please keep your mouth shut? It's so noisy!

english_meaning: to be glib, to be eloquent but insincere, to have a silver tongue, smooth-talking
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话非常流畅，口才很好，但常常带有夸张或不真诚的意味，给人一种油嘴滑舌的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes a person who speaks fluently and eloquently, but often with exaggeration or insincerity, giving the impression of being smooth-talking and potentially untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友把口啷過油，乜嘢都講得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 baa2 hau2 long1 gwo3 jau4, mat1 je5 dou1 gong2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人能说会道，什么话都说得出来。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is so glib; he can say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢，佢把口啷過油，專登氹你開心咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5, keoi5 baa2 hau2 long1 gwo3 jau4, zyun1 dang3 tam5 nei5 hoi1 sam1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别相信他，他能说会道，专门哄你开心罢了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him; he's smooth-talking, just trying to please you.

english_meaning: glib-tongued; smooth-talking; having a silver tongue
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话非常圆滑，很会说好听的话，但可能不诚实或不可靠。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely smooth and persuasive with their words, often to the point of being insincere or untrustworthy. It implies they are very skilled at flattery and convincing others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把口瑯過油，講嘢唔可以盡信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 hau2 long4 gwo3 jau4, gong2 je5 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon6 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他油嘴滑舌的，说话不能完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: He's very glib-tongued, you can't completely trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易俾佢把口瑯過油氹到啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 bei2 keoi5 baa2 hau2 long4 gwo3 jau4 tam5 dou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易被他甜言蜜语哄骗到啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easily tricked by his smooth-talking.

english_meaning: Having a glib tongue; slick talker; smooth-tongued
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话非常油滑，不诚实，喜欢说好听的话来讨好别人。
explanation_english: Describes a person who speaks very glibly and insincerely, often using flattering words to please others. Implies a lack of sincerity and a focus on superficial charm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁把口𠺘過油，千祈唔好信佢講嘅嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 baa2 hau2 ling4 gwo3 jau4, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么油嘴滑舌，千万不要相信他说的话啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a smooth talker, don't ever trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個地產經紀把口𠺘過油，氹到啲阿婆買貴樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 dei6 caan2 ging1 gei2 baa2 hau2 ling4 gwo3 jau4, tam5 dou3 di1 aa3 po4 maai5 gwai3 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个房地产经纪油嘴滑舌的，哄骗那些老奶奶买了贵的房子。
examples.english_sentence: That real estate agent is so slick, he tricked the old ladies into buying expensive apartments.

english_meaning: to guard; to defend; to garrison
explanation_mandarin: 指守卫、看守某个地方，防止敌人或其他人进入。
explanation_english: To guard, defend, or garrison a place to prevent enemies or others from entering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲士兵喺邊境把守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 si1 bing1 hai2 bin1 ging2 baa2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 士兵们在边境把守。
examples.english_sentence: The soldiers are guarding the border.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要嚴格把守呢個關口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jim4 gaak3 baa2 sau2 ni1 go3 gwaan1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要严格把守这个关口。
examples.english_sentence: We must strictly guard this checkpoint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責把守個門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 baa2 sau2 go3 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责把守门口。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for guarding the entrance.

english_meaning: Matriarch; a mother-in-law who is the head of the household
explanation_mandarin: 指在家庭中拥有绝对权威，能够掌管一切事务的婆婆。 通常用来形容强势、专制的婆婆。
explanation_english: Refers to a mother-in-law who wields absolute authority in the family and manages all affairs. Usually used to describe a strong-willed, authoritarian mother-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我奶奶係一個典型嘅把家姑婆，屋企大大小小嘅事都係佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 naai5 naai2 hai6 jat1 go3 din2 jing4 ge3 baa2 gaa1 gu1 po4, uk1 kei2 daai6 daai6 siu2 siu2 ge3 si6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的奶奶是一个典型的当家作主的婆婆，家里大大小小的事情都是她说了算。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother is a typical matriarch. She decides everything in the family, big or small.

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to suck up to
explanation_mandarin: 指奉承、谄媚他人，以获得好处。
explanation_english: To flatter or brown-nose someone, usually to gain an advantage or favor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺老細面前把屁，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 baa2 pei3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在老板面前拍马屁，想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He flatters the boss every day, hoping to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁把屁啦，咁樣好核突㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baa2 pei3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 hat6 dat1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么拍马屁了，这样很恶心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flatter so much, it's disgusting.

mandarin_meaning: 稍微有点生气; 一点点火气
english_meaning: A little bit angry; slightly irritated
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有点生气，但程度不深。表示稍微有点火气，心里不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slightly angry or irritated, but not intensely so. It suggests a mild level of annoyance or discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再搞搞震，我就真係把幾火㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ngo5 zau6 zan1 hai6 baa2 gei2 fo2 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再捣乱，我就真的有点生气了！
examples.english_sentence: If you mess around again, I'll really get a little angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要返工，諗起都把幾火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, nam2 hei2 dou1 baa2 gei2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上班，一想起就有点烦躁。
examples.english_sentence: Having to go back to work tomorrow makes me a little annoyed.

english_meaning: to steel oneself; to make up one's mind with determination; to take the plunge
explanation_mandarin: 下定决心，不顾一切地去做某事。
explanation_english: To steel oneself and make a firm decision to do something, often involving risk or overcoming hesitation. It implies a sense of resolution after some deliberation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我把心一橫，決定辭職去創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baa2 sam1 jat1 waang4, kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1 heoi3 cong3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一狠心，决定辞职去创业。
examples.english_sentence: I steeled myself and decided to quit my job to start my own business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把心一橫，同個男朋友分手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 sam1 jat1 waang4, tung4 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5 fan1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一狠心，和男朋友分手了。
examples.english_sentence: She steeled herself and broke up with her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把心一橫，買咗間貴樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 sam1 jat1 waang4, maai5 zo2 gaan1 gwai3 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一狠心，买了间贵的房子。
examples.english_sentence: He took the plunge and bought an expensive apartment.

english_meaning: indecisive; vacillating; unable to make up one's mind
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人犹豫不决，拿不定主意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is indecisive and unable to make a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都把心唔定，搞到我哋唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 baa2 sam1 m4 ding6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是三心二意，搞得我们不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so indecisive, it makes us not know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁把心唔定啦，快啲決定去唔去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baa2 sam1 m4 ding6 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么三心二意了，快点决定去不去吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so indecisive, quickly decide whether to go or not.

mandarin_meaning: 戏法, 花招, 小技巧
english_meaning: trick, gimmick, cheap trick, ploy, sleight of hand
explanation_mandarin: 指一些不值得一提的技巧、手段，或用于蒙骗人的小花招。也可指简单的表演或技艺。
explanation_english: Refers to unimpressive skills, tricks, or petty gimmicks used to deceive people. Can also refer to simple performances or skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲把戲呃唔到人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 baa2 hei3 ngaak1 m4 dou2 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那些花招骗不了人的。
examples.english_sentence: His tricks can't fool anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係啲小把戲嚟啫，唔好咁認真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 di1 siu2 baa2 hei3 lei4 ze1, m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是些小花招而已，别太认真了。
examples.english_sentence: These are just little tricks, don't take it so seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度表演緊啲簡單嘅把戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 biu2 jin2 gan2 di1 gaan2 daan1 ge3 baa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在表演一些简单的技艺。
examples.english_sentence: He's performing some simple tricks.

english_meaning: handle; trick; skill; way of handling something
explanation_mandarin: 原指握持的地方，也引申为处理事情的技巧、方法或可被利用的弱点。
explanation_english: Literally means a handle for holding, but also refers to the skill or method of handling things, or a weakness that can be exploited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有把手㗎，乜嘢搞唔掂？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 baa2 sau2 gaa3, mat1 je5 gaau2 m4 dim6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有办法的，什么搞不定？
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable; what can't he handle?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要小心啲，唔好畀佢哋攞到把手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 lo2 dou3 baa2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要小心点，不要让他们抓住把柄。
examples.english_sentence: We have to be careful not to let them find a weakness to exploit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔係咁容易搞掂，要啲把手先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 gam3 jung4 ji6 gaau2 dim6, jiu3 di1 baa2 sau2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事没那么容易解决，需要一些技巧才行。
examples.english_sentence: This matter isn't that easy to solve; it needs some skill.

english_meaning: to protect; to shield; to cover up for someone
explanation_mandarin: 指袒护、包庇某人或某事，使其免受惩罚或批评。
explanation_english: To protect or shield someone or something from punishment or criticism; to cover up for someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁把托佢啦，佢錯就係錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baa2 tok3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 co3 zau6 hai6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么包庇他了，他错就是错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't protect him so much; he's wrong and that's that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸成日把托佢個仔，所以佢個仔先咁曳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 sing4 jat6 baa2 tok3 keoi5 go3 zai2, so2 ji5 keoi5 go3 zai2 sin1 gam3 jai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸总是包庇他的儿子，所以他的儿子才那么调皮。
examples.english_sentence: The father always covers up for his son, which is why his son is so naughty.

english_meaning: to control, to dominate, to monopolize
explanation_mandarin: 控制，掌握。多用于贬义，指不正当地控制或垄断权力、资源等。
explanation_english: To control or dominate something, often in a negative way, implying unfair control or monopolization of power, resources, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把持住成間公司嘅決策權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 ci4 zyu6 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 caak3 kuen4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把持着整个公司的决策权。
examples.english_sentence: He monopolizes the decision-making power of the entire company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢哋把持住啲資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 baa2 ci4 zyu6 di1 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他们把持住这些资源。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let them monopolize these resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想把持呢個位好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 baa2 ci4 ni1 go3 wai2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把持这个位置很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has wanted to control this position for a long time.

english_meaning: to grasp; to seize; to hold; assurance; certainty; to be confident of (success)
explanation_mandarin: 抓住机会或要领; 对某事有信心。
explanation_english: To seize an opportunity or key point; to have confidence in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一定要把握呢次機會啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 baa2 ak1 ni1 ci3 gei1 wui2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要把握这次机会啊！
examples.english_sentence: You must seize this opportunity!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇乜把握可以贏到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 mat1 baa2 ak1 ho2 ji5 jeng4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有太大把握能赢。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very confident that I can win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有把握今次考試一定合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 baa2 ak1 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 jat1 ding6 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有把握这次考试一定及格。
examples.english_sentence: He is very confident that he will pass the exam this time.

mandarin_meaning: 无聊，烦人，多事，没事找事
english_meaning: Boring; annoying; bothersome; meddlesome; to be a nuisance
explanation_mandarin: 形容人很无聊，没事找事，喜欢打扰别人，令人讨厌。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being boring, meddlesome, a nuisance, and generally annoying. It suggests someone who is doing something pointless or being bothersome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁把撚啦，得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 baa2 lan2 laa1, dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么无聊好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Can you please not be so annoying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好把撚，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 baa2 lan2, sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很烦人，整天搞事。
examples.english_sentence: He's really annoying, always stirring things up.

mandarin_meaning: 卖弄风骚；卖弄姿色；发情
english_meaning: To flirt; to show off one's sexuality; to be in heat (animal)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性（或动物）卖弄风骚，试图引起异性的注意；也指动物发情。
explanation_english: Refers to a female (or animal) acting flirtatiously, trying to attract the attention of the opposite sex; also refers to animals being in heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺啲男同事面前把春，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 di1 naam4 tung4 si6 min6 cin4 baa2 ceon1, zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天在男同事面前卖弄风骚，真是受不了。
examples.english_sentence: She's always flirting in front of her male colleagues, it's really unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貓開始把春，就知春天到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 maau1 hoi1 chi2 baa2 ceon1, zau6 zi1 cheun1 tin1 dou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫开始发情了，就知道春天到了。
examples.english_sentence: When the cats start being in heat, you know spring has arrived.

english_meaning: handle; something someone can be held accountable for; weak point; leverage
explanation_mandarin: 可以用来要挟别人的弱点或过失。
explanation_english: Something a person can be held accountable for; a flaw or mistake that can be used to blackmail or control someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有我嘅把柄喺手，所以我唔敢唔聽佢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ngo5 ge3 baa2 bing3 hai2 sau2, so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 gam2 m4 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他手里有我的把柄，所以我不敢不听他的话。
examples.english_sentence: He has something on me, so I don't dare to disobey him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你千祈唔好俾人捉到把柄呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 baa2 bing3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你千万不要被人抓住把柄啊。
examples.english_sentence: You must never let anyone find something to use against you.

english_meaning: anger, rage, temper
explanation_mandarin: 指心中的怒火，生气时的情绪状态。
explanation_english: Refers to anger, rage, or temper; the emotional state of being angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撩我，我就嚟谷住把火啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 liu1 ngo5, ngo5 zau6 lai4 guk1 zyu6 baa2 fo2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再惹我了，我快要忍不住了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke me anymore, I'm about to explode with anger!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講起呢件事，我就嚟把火！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hei2 ni1 gin6 si6, ngo5 zau6 lai4 baa2 fo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说到这件事，我就来气！
examples.english_sentence: Speaking of this matter, I get so angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撳住把火，無即刻發爛渣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam6 zyu6 baa2 fo2, mou5 zik1 hak1 faat3 laan6 zaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他强压住怒火，没有立刻发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: He suppressed his anger and didn't throw a tantrum immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 厉害; 擅长; 精通
english_meaning: skilled; expert; proficient; to have a flair for something
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人在某方面非常厉害，很擅长，精通。多用于口语。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very skilled, proficient, or an expert in a particular field. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機好把炮㗎，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 hou2 baa2 paau3 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打游戏很厉害，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good at playing video games, he wins every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺電腦方面好把炮，乜嘢問題都識解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 din6 nou5 fong1 min6 hou2 baa2 paau3, mat1 je5 man6 tai4 dou1 sik1 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在电脑方面很厉害，什么问题都懂得解决。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is very skilled in computers, he knows how to solve any problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁把炮，不如你嚟教我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 baa2 paau3, bat1 jyu4 nei5 lai4 gaau3 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么厉害，不如你来教我吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since you're so good, why don't you teach me?

english_meaning: to take someone's pulse; (figurative) to size up a situation
explanation_mandarin: 中医通过切脉诊断病情。比喻了解情况，摸清底细。
explanation_english: Literally, in traditional Chinese medicine, to take someone's pulse for diagnosis. Figuratively, to assess a situation; to get to the bottom of things; to take the measure of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生幫我把脈，話我壓力太大，要放鬆啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 bong1 ngo5 baa2 mak6, waa6 ngo5 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6, yiu3 fong3 sung1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生帮我诊脉，说我压力太大，要放松些。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor took my pulse and said I was too stressed and needed to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好把脈，先可以知道公司嘅問題喺邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 hou2 hou2 baa2 mak6, sin1 ho2 ji5 zi1 dou3 gung1 si1 ge3 man6 tai4 hai2 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得好好摸清情况，才可以知道公司的问题在哪里。
examples.english_sentence: We need to thoroughly assess the situation before we can find out where the company's problems lie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識把脈，一眼就睇穿咗佢嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 baa2 mak6, yat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 chyun1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会摸清情况，一眼就看穿了他的想法。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at reading people; he saw right through his thoughts at a glance.

english_meaning: to take the helm; to steer; to be in control; to call the shots
explanation_mandarin: 比喻掌握控制权或主导权。
explanation_english: Figuratively, it means to be in control, to have the power to steer things in a certain direction, to be in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家由佢把舦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jau4 keoi5 baa2 taai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在这家公司由他掌舵。
examples.english_sentence: He's in control of the company now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁有經驗，不如你嚟把舦啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jau5 ging1 jim6, bat1 jyu4 nei5 lai4 baa2 taai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么有经验，不如你来掌舵吧。
examples.english_sentence: You're so experienced, why don't you take the helm?

mandarin_meaning: 掌握方向盘；掌舵；掌握控制权
english_meaning: To take the wheel; to steer; to take control; to be in charge
explanation_mandarin: 原指掌握方向盘来控制车辆，引申为掌握控制权，主导局势。
explanation_english: Literally means to hold the steering wheel and control a vehicle. Figuratively, it means to take control of a situation or to be in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢間公司把軚好耐㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 baa2 taai5 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司掌舵很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in charge of this company for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅計劃由你把軚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 gai3 waak6 jau4 nei5 baa2 taai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划由你来掌控。
examples.english_sentence: You are in control of this plan this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽唔喺屋企，今日由我把軚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 m4 hai2 uk1 kei2, gam1 jat6 jau4 ngo5 baa2 taai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈不在家，今天由我来当家。
examples.english_sentence: Mum's not at home, I'm in charge today.

english_meaning: to drink and make merry; to enjoy oneself with drinking and conversation
explanation_mandarin: 端着酒杯，谈笑风生，尽情欢乐。
explanation_english: To drink wine and chat merrily; to enjoy a happy and convivial gathering with drinks and conversation. It implies a joyful atmosphere and pleasant interaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊同學聚會，我哋把酒言歡，傾咗好多以前嘅趣事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 tung4 hok6 zeoi6 wui2, ngo5 dei6 baa2 zau2 jin4 fun1, king1 zo2 ho2 do1 ji5 cin4 ge3 ceoi3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老同学聚会，我们把酒言欢，聊了很多以前的趣事。
examples.english_sentence: At the alumni reunion, we drank and made merry, chatting about many interesting things from the past.

english_meaning: to check; to control; to guard a pass; quality control; gatekeeping
explanation_mandarin: 负责检查、控制，确保质量或安全。
explanation_english: To check and control something in order to ensure quality or safety; to act as a gatekeeper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要嚴格把關，確保產品嘅品質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jim4 gaak3 baa2 gwaan1, kok3 bou2 caan2 ban2 ge3 ban2 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要严格把关，确保产品的质量。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strictly check and control the process to ensure the quality of the products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個項目嘅負責人，負責把關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 fu6 zaak3 yan4, fu6 zaak3 baa2 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个项目的负责人，负责把关。
examples.english_sentence: He is in charge of this project and is responsible for quality control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工作係幫公司把關，防止資料洩露。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 hai6 bong1 gung1 si1 baa2 gwaan1, fong2 zi2 zi1 liu2 sit3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作是帮公司把关，防止资料泄露。
examples.english_sentence: His job is to protect the company by preventing information leaks.

english_meaning: to keep watch; to act as a lookout
explanation_mandarin: 指在进行非法或不被允许的活动时，负责观察周围情况，防止被发现或干扰。
explanation_english: To keep watch or act as a lookout, typically during an illegal or unauthorized activity, to prevent detection or interference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋爆格，我喺樓下幫佢哋把風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baau3 gaak3, ngo5 hai2 lau4 haa6 bong1 keoi5 dei6 baa2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们入室盗窃，我在楼下帮他们放哨。
examples.english_sentence: They're burglarizing a house, I'm keeping watch for them downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我把風啫，唔關我事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 baa2 fung1 ze1, m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我只是放哨而已，不关我的事。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm just acting as lookout, it's not my responsibility.

english_meaning: impossible; unbelievable; no way; to fool someone
explanation_mandarin: 表示不相信或认为不可能，也有欺骗的意思。
explanation_english: Expresses disbelief or impossibility; also used to mean 'to fool someone' or 'to be unbelievable'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢考到第一，把鬼啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 haau2 dou2 dai6 jat1, baa2 gwai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他考了第一，不可能吧！
examples.english_sentence: He said he got first place, no way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同佢講咁多都冇用，佢擺明係想把鬼你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 gam3 do1 dou1 mou5 jung6, keoi5 baai2 ming4 hai6 soeng2 baa2 gwai2 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你跟他讲这么多也没用，他摆明是想骗你罢了。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use talking to him so much; he clearly just wants to fool you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁平，把鬼咩，肯定有問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 peng4, baa2 gwai2 me1, hang2 ding6 jau5 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么便宜，不可能吧，肯定有问题。
examples.english_sentence: So cheap, no way, there must be something wrong.

english_meaning: to get angry; to be furious; to be enraged
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常生气、愤怒。程度较深，是一种比较口语化的表达方式。
explanation_english: Expresses extreme anger or fury. A colloquial way of saying someone is very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就真係把鬼火喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 zan1 hai6 baa2 gwai2 fo2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就真的要发火了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I'm really going to get angry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞搞震，唔係阿婆會把鬼火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, m4 hai6 aa3 po4 wui5 baa2 gwai2 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要捣乱，不然奶奶会生气的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around, or Grandma will get angry.

english_meaning: to throw, to fling, to dump
explanation_mandarin: 指用手用力扔东西，或比喻丢弃、放弃。
explanation_english: To throw something forcefully with the hand; metaphorically, to discard or abandon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁抌嘢呀，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 dam2 je5 aa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔东西啊，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things around randomly, it's dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，將啲舊嘅相抌晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, zoeng1 di1 gau6 ge3 soeng2 dam2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，把旧的照片都扔了。
examples.english_sentence: After breaking up, he threw away all the old photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司抌咗好多舊嘅機器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 dam2 zo2 hou2 do1 gau6 ge3 gei1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司扔掉了许多旧的机器。
examples.english_sentence: Their company discarded a lot of old machines.

mandarin_meaning: 盖章; 作准; 确定
english_meaning: To stamp; To seal; To confirm; To finalize; To give the go-ahead
explanation_mandarin: 用印章盖印，比喻作出决定或保证。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to stamp a seal'. Figuratively means to make a decision, confirm something, or give something the go-ahead.  Often used in business or official contexts, but can also be used casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細抌咗印，我哋就可以開始做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dam2 zo2 jan3, ngo5 dei6 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板盖章了，我们就可以开始做了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has stamped it, we can start working now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你confirm晒啲資料未？要抌印㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 confirm saai3 di1 zi1 liu2 mei6? jiu3 dam2 jan3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你确认所有资料了吗？需要盖章的。
examples.english_sentence: Have you confirmed all the information? It needs to be stamped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約已經抌咗印，正式生效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 ji5 ging1 dam2 zo2 jan3, zeng3 sik1 sang1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合同已经盖章，正式生效。
examples.english_sentence: The contract has been stamped and is officially in effect.

synonyms: 通過 (tung1 gwo3) - to pass (a motion, etc.)

english_meaning: to throw away garbage, to dump trash
explanation_mandarin: 把垃圾扔掉。是一个常用的口语表达。
explanation_english: To throw away garbage or trash. A common colloquial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱抌咗垃圾，你唔使抌啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 dam2 zo2 laap1 saap3, nei5 m4 sai2 dam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚扔了垃圾，你不用扔了。
examples.english_sentence: I just threw away the garbage, you don't need to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住聽日朝早要抌垃圾呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 jiu3 dam2 laap1 saap3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记住明天早上要扔垃圾啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take out the trash tomorrow morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個咁冇公德心，周圍抌垃圾？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 gam3 mou5 gung1 dak1 sam1, zau1 wai4 dam2 laap1 saap3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谁这么没公德心，到处扔垃圾？
examples.english_sentence: Who is so inconsiderate, throwing garbage everywhere?

english_meaning: to worry, to be anxious
explanation_mandarin: 表示担忧、担心。
explanation_english: To feel worried or anxious about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好抌心啦，佢咁大個人識得照顧自己嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dam2 sam1 laa1, keoi5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要担心了，他这么大的人懂得照顾自己的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, he's old enough to take care of himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，我好抌心考得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, ngo5 hou2 dam2 sam1 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，我很担心考不好。
examples.english_sentence: I'm worried about not doing well on the exam tomorrow.

english_meaning: to pat one's chest (to guarantee something); to vouch for something; to pledge with confidence
explanation_mandarin: 表示保证，担保某事一定会发生或一定能做到。通过拍打自己的胸口来强调自己的承诺。
explanation_english: To pat one's chest is a gesture used to emphasize a guarantee or assurance that something will happen or be done. It implies a strong commitment and confidence in fulfilling the promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我抌心口保證，今次一定幫你搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 dam2 sam1 hau2 bou2 zeng3, gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，我拍胸脯保证，这次一定帮你搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee it, I'll definitely help you sort it out this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我抌心口，絕對唔會有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dam2 sam1 hau2, zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我拍胸脯保证，绝对不会有问题。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee there won't be any problem with this.

english_meaning: Wholeheartedly; To be completely honest and sincere; To pour one's heart out
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常诚恳，真心实意，毫无保留地表达自己的想法或感受。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely sincere and expresses their thoughts and feelings wholeheartedly and without reservation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對你真係抌心抌肺，你唔好辜負佢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 nei5 zan1 hai6 dam2 sam1 dam2 fai3, nei5 m4 hou2 gu1 fu6 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对你真是掏心掏肺，你不要辜负他啊。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly being wholeheartedly sincere with you, don't let him down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我抌心抌肺噉同佢講晒我嘅煩惱，希望佢可以幫到我啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dam2 sam1 dam2 fai3 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2晒 ngo5 ge3 faan4 nou5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 ngo5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我掏心掏肺地跟他说完了我的烦恼，希望他可以帮到我。
examples.english_sentence: I poured my heart out to him about all my worries, hopefully he can help me.

synonyms: 真心真意 (zan1 sam1 zan1 ji3)

english_meaning: to splurge, to squander, to waste money lavishly
explanation_mandarin: 指大手大脚地花钱，无节制地浪费。
explanation_english: Refers to spending money extravagantly and wastefully, without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日抌春，所以永遠都儲唔到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dam2 ceon1, so2 ji5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 chu5 m4 dou2 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是挥霍浪费，所以永远都存不了钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always splurges, so he can never save any money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁抌春啦，慳啲使啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 dam2 ceon1 laa1, haan1 di1 sai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么挥霍浪费了，省着点花吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wasteful, save some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢唔係咁易賺，唔好咁抌春啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 chin2 m4 hai6 gam3 ji6 gaan2, m4 hou2 gam3 dam2 ceon1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不是那么容易赚的，不要这么挥霍啊。
examples.english_sentence: Money isn't easy to earn, don't be so wasteful.

synonyms: 洗腳唔抹腳 (sai2 goek3 m4 mut3 goek3)

english_meaning: to kill time, to while away the time
explanation_mandarin: 指为了打发无聊而做一些事情。
explanation_english: To spend time doing something, often to relieve boredom or because there is nothing else to do; to kill time, to while away the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺機場抌時間，睇吓雜誌咁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gei1 cheung4 dam2 si4 gaan3, tai2 haa5 zaap6 ji3 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在机场消磨时间，看看杂志什么的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm killing time at the airport, just reading some magazines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨冇嘢做，唯有喺屋企抌時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 yu5 mou5 je5 zou6, wai4 yau5 hai2 uk1 kei2 dam2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨没事做，只好在家里消磨时间。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining and there's nothing to do, so I can only kill time at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去飲杯嘢，抌陣時間先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heui3 yam2 bui1 ye5, dam2 zan6 si4 gaan3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去喝一杯，先消磨一下时间吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for a drink and kill some time first.

english_meaning: to invest heavily, to throw money at something, to go all out (financially)
explanation_mandarin: 指投入大量资金，不惜成本，希望获得丰厚回报。
explanation_english: Refers to investing a large amount of money, sparing no expense, in the hope of receiving a substantial return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今次真係抌本落去做宣傳，希望可以打響名堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 dam2 bun2 lok6 heoi3 zou6 syun1 cyun4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 daa2 hoeng2 ming4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司这次真的是下血本做宣传，希望可以打响名声。
examples.english_sentence: This company is really throwing money at promotion this time, hoping to make a name for itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗追到個女仔，抌本買咗部跑車俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zeoi1 dou2 go3 neoi5 zai2, dam2 bun2 maai5 zo2 bou6 paau2 ce1 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了追到那个女孩，他砸钱买了辆跑车给她。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win over that girl, he splurged and bought her a sports car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搞好呢個項目，一定要抌本投資先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaau2 hou2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 dam2 bun2 tau4 zi1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要做好这个项目，一定要投入大量的资金才行。
examples.english_sentence: To do this project well, you must invest heavily.

english_meaning: to throw down; to drop; to put in
explanation_mandarin: 表示将某物用力扔下或放下，也指投入（资金、精力等）。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of throwing down or putting down something forcefully, or investing (funds, effort, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到將個電話抌落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zoeng1 go3 din6 waa2 dam2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地把电话扔到地上。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he threw his phone on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細抌咗好多錢落去呢個項目度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dam2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 lok6 heoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板在这个项目投入了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: The boss invested a lot of money in this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你抌啲冰落杯嘢飲度啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dam2 di1 bing1 lok6 bui1 je5 yam2 dou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你往饮料里放些冰块吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put some ice in the drink.

mandarin_meaning: 乱花钱, 花钱如流水
english_meaning: To spend money lavishly, to throw money around, to be extravagant
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱大手大脚，不在乎花费，把钱像丢进袋子一样随意挥霍。
explanation_english: Describes someone who spends money lavishly, without caring about the expense, and throws money around as if throwing it into a bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩之後，就開始抌袋，買好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 ci2 dam2 doi2, maai5 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票之后，就开始乱花钱，买很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: After winning the lottery, he started spending money lavishly, buying a lot of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁抌袋啦，儲啲錢嚟傍身好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 dam2 doi2 laa1, cou5 di1 cin2 lai4 bong6 san1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么乱花钱了，存点钱来傍身比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spend money so lavishly, it's better to save some for a rainy day.

english_meaning: or; either
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择关系的连词，相当于“或者”。
explanation_english: A conjunction indicating an alternative, equivalent to "or" or "either". It is less common in spoken Cantonese compared to "定係 (ding6 hai6)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想飲茶抑咖啡呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jam2 caa4 jik1 gaa3 fe1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想喝茶或者咖啡？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to drink tea or coffee?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係想去香港抑澳門？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 soeng2 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 jik1 ou3 mun4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想去香港或者澳门？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to go to Hong Kong or Macau?

english_meaning: to restrain, to control, to suppress
explanation_mandarin: 控制、压制某种情绪、欲望或发展趋势，使其不发展或减缓发展。
explanation_english: To restrain, control, or suppress a feeling, desire, or developing trend, preventing it from developing further or slowing its progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府想抑制樓價上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 soeng2 jik1 zai3 lau4 gaa3 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府想抑制房价上涨。
examples.english_sentence: The government wants to curb the rise in property prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢盡力抑制住自己嘅怒氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeon6 lik6 jik1 zai3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他尽力抑制住自己的怒气。
examples.english_sentence: He tried his best to suppress his anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥可以抑制癌細胞嘅生長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ho2 ji5 jik1 zai3 ngaam4 sai3 baau1 ge3 sang1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药可以抑制癌细胞的生长。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine can inhibit the growth of cancer cells.

english_meaning: inhibitor
explanation_mandarin: 阻止或减慢某种过程或反应进行的物质或因素。
explanation_english: A substance or factor that inhibits or slows down a process or reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥係一種酵素抑制劑，可以減慢癌細胞嘅生長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 hai6 jat1 zung2 faan2 so3 jip3 jik1 zai1, ho2 ji5 gaam2 maan6 ngaam4 sai3 baau1 ge3 sang1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药是一种酶抑制剂，可以减缓癌细胞的生长。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine is an enzyme inhibitor that can slow down the growth of cancer cells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋研究緊一啲可以抑制病毒複製嘅抑制劑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jin4 gau3 gan2 jat1 di1 ho2 ji5 jip3 jik1 beng6 duk6 fuk1 zai3 ge3 jip3 jik1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在研究一些可以抑制病毒复制的抑制剂。
examples.english_sentence: They are researching some inhibitors that can suppress virus replication.

english_meaning: to suppress; to repress; to restrain
explanation_mandarin: 控制或压制（感情、想法等），使其不能自由表达或发展。
explanation_english: To hold back or restrain (a feeling, impulse, or idea).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘗試抑壓自己嘅怒氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 soeng4 jik1 aat3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他尝试压抑自己的怒气。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to suppress his anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期抑壓情緒對健康唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 jik1 aat3 cing4 seoi5 deoi3 gin6 hong1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期压抑情绪对健康不好。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term emotional suppression is bad for your health.

english_meaning: or; either...or
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择关系，相当于“或者”、“还是”。
explanation_english: Indicates a choice or alternative, equivalent to "or" or "either...or".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚想食飯抑或食麵啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 faan6 jik1 waak6 sik6 min6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚想吃饭还是吃面啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to eat rice or noodles tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知應該去香港抑或去台灣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 jing1 goi1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 jik1 waak6 heoi3 toi4 waan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道应该去香港还是去台湾。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know whether I should go to Hong Kong or Taiwan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲未決定到買紅色抑或藍色嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 mei6 kyut3 ding6 dou3 maai5 hung4 sik1 jik1 waak6 laam4 sik1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还没决定买红色还是蓝色的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't decided whether to buy a red or blue shirt.

english_meaning: modulation; cadence; inflection; rising and falling tones (in speech or music)
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音高低起伏、节奏分明，富于变化和情感。常用来形容说话、朗读、演唱等声音的表现形式富有感染力。
explanation_english: Describes the rising and falling tones, distinct rhythm, rich variations, and emotional expressiveness of sound, especially in speech, reading, or singing. It implies a captivating and expressive delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有抑揚頓挫，好吸引人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 jik1 joeng4 deon6 co3, hou2 kap1 jan4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很有抑扬顿挫，很吸引人听。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks with great modulation, making it very captivating to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌嘅時候，會運用抑揚頓挫嚟表達歌詞嘅情感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 ge3 si4 hau6, wui5 wan6 jung6 jik1 joeng4 deon6 co3 lai4 biu2 daat6 go1 ci4 ge3 ching4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌的时候，会运用抑扬顿挫来表达歌词的情感。
examples.english_sentence: When he sings, he uses modulation to express the emotions of the lyrics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇演講稿如果加上啲抑揚頓挫，就會更加生動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 jin2 gong2 gou2 jyu4 gwo2 ga1 soeng5 di1 jik1 joeng4 deon6 co3, zau6 wui5 gang3 ga1 sang1 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这篇演讲稿加上一些抑扬顿挫，就会更加生动。
examples.english_sentence: If we add some modulation to this speech, it will be more vivid.

english_meaning: to restrain, to suppress, to inhibit, to check
explanation_mandarin: 控制或阻止某种行为、情绪或发展。
explanation_english: To control or prevent something from happening, developing, or being expressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我忍唔住笑，點都抑止唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3, dim2 dou1 jik1 zi2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忍不住笑，怎么也抑制不住。
examples.english_sentence: I couldn't help but laugh; I couldn't suppress it no matter what.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該抑止樓價嘅升勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 jik1 zi2 lau4 gaa3 ge3 sing1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该抑制房价的上涨趋势。
examples.english_sentence: The government should restrain the rising trend of property prices.

english_meaning: depressed, depression
explanation_mandarin: 形容情绪低落、意志消沉的状态; 精神医学上的抑郁症。
explanation_english: Describing a state of low mood and depression; in psychiatry, it refers to clinical depression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似有啲抑鬱，成日都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 jik1 wat1, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近好像有点抑郁，整天都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He seems a bit depressed lately, and is unhappy all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇咗醫生，醫生話佢有抑鬱症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 zo2 ji1 sang1, ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 jik1 wat1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看了医生，医生说他有抑郁症。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a doctor, and the doctor said he has depression.

english_meaning: depression
explanation_mandarin: 一种精神疾病，特征是持续的悲伤、失去兴趣或快乐、以及各种身体症状。
explanation_english: A mental disorder characterized by persistent sadness, loss of interest or pleasure, and various physical symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇咗醫生，發現自己有抑鬱症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 zo2 ji1 sang1, faat3 hin1 zi6 gei2 jau5 jik1 wat1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看了医生，发现自己有抑郁症。
examples.english_sentence: He saw a doctor and found out he has depression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現代社會生活壓力大，好多人都會有抑鬱症嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 doi6 se5 wui2 sang1 wut6 aat3 lik6 daai6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 jau5 jik1 wat1 zing3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现代社会生活压力大，很多人都会有抑郁症的问题。
examples.english_sentence: Life in modern society is stressful, and many people have problems with depression.

english_meaning: to express; to give vent to; to relieve
explanation_mandarin: 表达或发泄（感情、想法等）。
explanation_english: To express or give vent to (feelings, thoughts, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抒發吓情緒對身體好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 faat3 haa5 ching4 sui5 deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抒发一下情绪对身体好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Expressing your emotions is better for your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想寫歌嚟抒發佢嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seung2 se2 go1 lai4 syu1 faat3 keoi5 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想写歌来抒发他的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to write songs to express his feelings.

english_meaning: to express one's emotions; lyrical
explanation_mandarin: 表达个人情感；富于抒情色彩的。
explanation_english: To express one's feelings and emotions, often in a poetic or artistic way; lyrical, characterized by the expression of emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌好抒情啊，聽完覺得好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hou2 syu1 cing4 aa3, teng1 jyun4 gok3 dak1 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌很抒情啊，听完觉得很感动。
examples.english_sentence: This song is very lyrical, I feel very moved after listening to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫風好抒情，充滿詩意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waa2 fung1 hou2 syu1 cing4, cung1 mun5 si1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画风很抒情，充满诗意。
examples.english_sentence: His painting style is very lyrical, full of poetic feeling.

english_meaning: to express; to give vent to
explanation_mandarin: 表达、发泄（感情、想法等）。
explanation_english: To express or give vent to (emotions, thoughts, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搵個地方抒發吓啲壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wan2 go3 dei6 fong1 syu1 faat3 haa5 di1 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想找个地方抒发一下压力。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to find a place to vent some of his stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫日記可以抒發情感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 jat6 gei3 ho2 ji5 syu1 faat3 ching4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写日记可以抒发情感。
examples.english_sentence: Writing a diary can help express emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢透過音樂抒發自己嘅情緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau3 gwo3 jam1 ngok6 syu1 faat3 zi6 gei2 ge3 ching4 seoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通过音乐抒发自己的情绪。
examples.english_sentence: He expresses his emotions through music.

english_meaning: to grab; to scratch; to arrest; to seize
explanation_mandarin: 用手或爪取或挠。
explanation_english: To seize, catch, or scratch with the hand or claws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾隻貓抓損咗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zek3 maau1 zaa1 syun2 zo2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手被猫抓伤了。
examples.english_sentence: His hand was scratched by the cat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察抓咗個賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zaa1 zo2 go3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓住了小偷。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested the thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲抓緊條繩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 zaa1 gan2 tiu4 sing2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点抓住绳子！
examples.english_sentence: Hold onto the rope quickly!

english_meaning: Rock-paper-scissors
explanation_mandarin: 一种用手势猜拳的游戏，粤语地区称之为“抓子”。
explanation_english: A hand game where players make gestures representing rock, paper, or scissors. In Cantonese-speaking regions, it's called "zaau2 zi2".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如玩抓子嚟決定邊個先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 waan2 zaau2 zi2 lai4 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们玩石头剪刀布来决定谁先吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we play rock-paper-scissors to decide who goes first?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日同啲朋友玩抓子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 pang4 jau5 waan2 zaau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常和朋友们玩石头剪刀布。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often played rock-paper-scissors with my friends.

mandarin_meaning: 找茬儿, 挑剔, 吹毛求疵
english_meaning: To nitpick, to find fault, to pick on someone, to be fussy or overly critical
explanation_mandarin: 指故意找别人的缺点或错误，进行批评或指责，带有挑剔的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately finding faults or mistakes in others to criticize or blame them, often with a picky attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日抓毛啦，咁樣好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zaau1 mou1 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是挑剔，这样很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always nitpick, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老細好鍾意抓毛，啲嘢做得幾好佢都總搵到啲嘢嚟鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 hou2 zung1 ji3 zaau1 mou1, di1 je5 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2 keoi5 dou1 zung2 wan2 dou2 di1 je5 lai4 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板很喜欢挑剔，东西做得再好他总能找到东西来骂。
examples.english_sentence: That boss really likes to nitpick, no matter how well things are done, he can always find something to scold about.

synonyms: 雞蛋裏挑骨頭 (gai1 daan2 lei5 tiu1 gwat1 tau4)

english_meaning: to arrest; to capture; to apprehend
explanation_mandarin: 指捉住罪犯或者逃犯等。
explanation_english: Refers to capturing a criminal or fugitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方尋日喺旺角抓獲咗幾個毒販。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 cam4 jat6 hai2 wong6 gok3 zaau2 wok6 zo2 gei2 go3 duk6 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方昨天在旺角逮捕了几名毒贩。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested several drug dealers in Mong Kok yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋終於將個賊抓獲歸案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 zoeng1 go3 caak6 zaau2 wok6 gwai1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们终于将那个贼抓获归案。
examples.english_sentence: They finally captured the thief and brought him to justice.

mandarin_meaning: 抓住; 抓牢; 把握
english_meaning: to grasp firmly; to hold on tight; to seize; to take hold of; to pay close attention to; to make the most of (time, opportunity)
explanation_mandarin: 表示紧紧抓住，不放松；也指把握机会或时间。
explanation_english: Indicates to hold on tightly, not to let go. It can also refer to seizing an opportunity or making the most of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你抓緊啲扶手呀，架車轉彎好快㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaau2 gan2 di1 fu4 sau2 aa3, gaa3 ce1 zyun2 waan1 hou2 faai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你抓紧扶手，车转弯很快的。
examples.english_sentence: Hold on tight to the handrail, the car turns very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要抓緊機會，唔係下次唔知幾時先有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zaau2 gan2 gei1 wui6, m4 hai6 haa6 ci3 m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要抓住机会，不然下次不知道什么时候才有了。
examples.english_sentence: You have to seize the opportunity, otherwise you don't know when the next one will come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要抓緊時間溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaau2 gan2 si4 gaan3 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要抓紧时间复习。
examples.english_sentence: We need to make the most of our time to revise.

english_meaning: snatch (weightlifting)
explanation_mandarin: 举重比赛中的一个项目，运动员用一次动作将杠铃从地面举过头顶。
explanation_english: A weightlifting event where the athlete lifts the barbell from the ground to overhead in one continuous movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺奧運會嘅抓舉項目攞咗金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 ge3 zaau2 geoi2 hong6 muk6 lo2 zo2 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在奥运会的抓举项目上拿了金牌。
examples.english_sentence: He won a gold medal in the snatch event at the Olympics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抓舉係舉重比賽中最難嘅項目之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaau2 geoi2 hai6 geoi2 cung5 bei2 coi3 zui3 naan4 ge3 hong6 muk6 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抓举是举重比赛中最难的项目之一。
examples.english_sentence: The snatch is one of the most difficult events in weightlifting.

english_meaning: to throw; to cast; to fling; to vote; to invest
explanation_mandarin: 用手臂的挥动使东西离开自己，向一定方向移动；投入（资金）；投票。
explanation_english: To throw, cast, or fling something; to invest (funds); to vote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投咗個籃球入個籃度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zo2 go3 laam4 kau4 jap6 go3 laam4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把篮球投进了篮筐里。
examples.english_sentence: He threw the basketball into the basket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要投票選出新嘅班長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tau4 piu3 syun2 ceot1 san1 ge3 baan1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要投票选出新的班长。
examples.english_sentence: We need to vote to elect a new class monitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投咗好多錢落去呢間公司度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 lok6 heoi3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司投入了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He invested a lot of money in this company.

english_meaning: to take out insurance; to insure
explanation_mandarin: 购买保险，使自己或某物获得保险保障。
explanation_english: To take out an insurance policy; to arrange for insurance coverage for oneself or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋最好投保埋醫療保險，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 tau4 bou2 maai4 ji1 liu4 bou2 him2, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们最好也投保医疗保险，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: We should also take out medical insurance, just in case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你架車有冇投保呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaa3 ce1 jau5 mou5 tau4 bou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的车有没有投保啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is your car insured?

english_meaning: to throw into; to put into; to plunge into; to invest; to be absorbed in; to be engrossed in
explanation_mandarin: （一）扔进去，放进去。（二） 资金、力量等加入到某项事业中。（三） 专心致志，全身心地投入。
explanation_english: (1) To throw into; to put into. (2) To invest capital, effort, etc., into a project. (3) To be absorbed in; to be engrossed in; to devote oneself wholeheartedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好投入咁做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tau4 jap6 gam2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很投入地工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is very engrossed in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我投入咗好多錢落去呢個項目度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 jap6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 lok6 heoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我投入了很多钱到这个项目里。
examples.english_sentence: I invested a lot of money in this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇戲嘅時候，佢好投入，喊到收唔到聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hei3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 hou2 tau4 jap6, haam3 dou3 sau1 m4 dou2 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看电影的时候，他很投入，哭得停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: When watching the movie, he was so engrossed that he couldn't stop crying.

english_meaning: sense of immersion, feeling of being involved
explanation_mandarin: 指完全沉浸于某种活动或情境中，全身心投入的感觉。
explanation_english: Refers to the feeling of being completely immersed in an activity or situation, wholeheartedly involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲嘅劇情好吸引，令觀眾好有投入感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 kap1 yan5, ling6 gun1 zung3 hou2 jau5 tau4 jap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很吸引人，让观众很有投入感。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very engaging, giving the audience a strong sense of immersion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講故仔講得好生動，令人好有投入感，好似身歷其境咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 gu3 zai2 gong2 dak1 hou2 sang1 dung6, ling6 yan4 hou2 jau5 tau4 jap6 gam2, hou2 chi5 san1 lik6 kei4 ging2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲故事讲得很生动，让人很有投入感，好像身临其境一样。
examples.english_sentence: He tells stories so vividly, giving people a strong sense of immersion, like they are experiencing it themselves.

english_meaning: to cater to someone's tastes; to appeal to someone's liking; to pander to someone
explanation_mandarin: 指迎合别人的爱好，使其高兴。
explanation_english: To do or say things that someone else likes in order to please them, often to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日投其所好，想氹掂個老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tau4 kei4 so2 hou3, soeng2 tam5 dim6 go3 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是投其所好，想讨好老板。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to cater to the boss's tastes, hoping to please him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想同人建立關係，投其所好都係一個方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 tung4 jan4 gin3 lap6 gwaan1 hai6, tau4 kei4 so2 hou3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想和别人建立关系，投其所好也是一个方法。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to build relationships with people, catering to their tastes is one way to do it.

english_meaning: pledge of allegiance; a point of no return; an act that irreversibly commits someone to a group or cause, often involving wrongdoing.
explanation_mandarin: 原指水浒传中梁山好汉入伙前必须做的一件表示决心的事情，往往是杀人，以断绝后路。现在比喻为了表示忠诚而做的一件不光彩的事情，表示彻底加入某个阵营，没有回头路可走。
explanation_english: Originally from the classic novel Water Margin (Shui Hu Zhuan), 'tou ming zhuang' refers to the act that Liangshan heroes had to do before joining the group, often involving murder to cut off any possibility of retreat. Now, it is a metaphor for doing something dishonorable to show loyalty, signifying a complete commitment to a certain group with no turning back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗上位，幫老細做咗好多衰嘢，簡直係交咗投名狀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 soeng5 wai2, bong1 lou5 sai3 zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 seoi1 je5, gaan2 zik1 hai6 gaau1 zo2 tau4 ming4 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了上位，他帮老板做了很多坏事，简直是交了投名状。
examples.english_sentence: To get promoted, he did many bad things for his boss. He practically offered a pledge of allegiance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加入黑社會就等於簽咗投名狀，想走都走唔甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaap3 jap6 hak1 se5 wui2 zau6 dang2 jyu1 cim1 zo2 tau4 ming4 zong3, soeng2 zau2 dou1 zau2 m4 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加入黑社会就等于签了投名状，想走也走不掉。
examples.english_sentence: Joining the triad is like signing a pledge of allegiance. You can't escape even if you want to.

english_meaning: to get along well, to be congenial, to hit it off
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人性格、兴趣等方面很相投，容易相处。
explanation_english: Describes two people who are compatible in personality, interests, etc., and easy to get along with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋两个好投契，成日一齐玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 tau4 kai3, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩很投缘，经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Those two get along very well, they always play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好投契，乜嘢都可以倾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 tau4 kai3, mat1 je5 dou1 ho2 ji5 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很合得来，什么都可以聊。
examples.english_sentence: I get along with him very well, we can talk about anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 第一次见面就觉得佢好投契，好似识咗好耐噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 zau6 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 tau4 kai3, hou2 ci5 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 第一次见面就觉得他很投缘，好像认识了很久一样。
examples.english_sentence: I felt like I hit it off with him the first time we met, as if we had known each other for a long time.

english_meaning: to seek refuge with; to go to and depend on; to throw oneself on (someone's mercy)
explanation_mandarin: 前往并依靠某人或某机构寻求帮助或庇护。
explanation_english: To go to and depend on someone or an organization for help or shelter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鄉下發生咗災難，逼住要投奔喺香港嘅親戚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng1 haa5 faat3 sang1 zo2 zoi1 naan6, bik1 zyu6 jiu3 tau4 ban1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 can1 cik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家乡发生了灾难，不得已要投奔在香港的亲戚。
examples.english_sentence: A disaster happened in his hometown, forcing him to seek refuge with relatives in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人投奔內地發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 tau4 ban1 noi6 dei6 faat3 zin2.
