examples.english_sentence: Due to the poor economy, many people are moving to the mainland for development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明冇錢，唯有投奔佢個有錢嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 mou5 cin2, wai4 jau5 tau4 ban1 keoi5 go3 jau5 cin2 ge3 pang1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明没钱，只好投奔他那个有钱的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming has no money, so he has no choice but to seek help from his wealthy friend.

english_meaning: projection (psychology); to project (an image, feeling, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 心理学上的概念，指个体将自己的情感、态度或想法归于他人或事物。也可以指将光或影像投向某个表面。
explanation_english: In psychology, projection is a defense mechanism in which a person attributes their own feelings, thoughts, or impulses to another person. It can also refer to projecting light or an image onto a surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都將自己嘅焦慮投射落其他人身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 jiu1 leoi6 tau4 se6 lok6 kei4 taa1 jan4 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是把他自己的焦虑投射到别人身上。
examples.english_sentence: He always projects his own anxiety onto other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部投影機可以將個畫面投射去牆上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 tau4 jing2 gei1 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 waak6 min6 tau4 se6 heoi3 cheung4 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台投影机可以将画面投射到墙上。
examples.english_sentence: This projector can project the screen onto the wall.

english_meaning: to drop a bombshell, to leak information, to reveal inside stories, to expose
explanation_mandarin: 指突然揭露或公布令人震惊的消息或内幕，通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Refers to suddenly revealing or announcing shocking news or inside stories, usually with negative connotations. Often implies the leaking of sensitive or damaging information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺記者會度投咗粒大炸彈，話公司內部有貪污！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 dou6 tau4 zo2 lap1 daai6 zaa3 daan2, waa6 gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 jau5 taam1 wu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在记者会上投了一颗炸弹，说公司内部有贪污！
examples.english_sentence: He dropped a bombshell at the press conference, saying there was corruption within the company!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁投彈，小心惹禍上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 tau4 daan2, siu2 sam1 jek6 wo6 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱投炸弹，小心惹祸上身。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go around dropping bombshells carelessly, be careful you don't get yourself into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明又投彈喇，話老闆下個月會炒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 jau6 tau4 daan2 laa3, waa6 lou5 baan2 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 caau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明又爆料了，说老板下个月会裁员。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming dropped another bombshell, saying the boss will be laying people off next month.

english_meaning: Projector
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以将图像或视频投影到屏幕或平面上的设备。
explanation_english: A device that projects an image or video onto a screen or flat surface.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋用投影機睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 yung6 tau4 jing2 gei1 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们用投影机看电影。
examples.english_sentence: We're watching a movie with the projector tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司開會要用投影機嚟做簡報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hoi1 wui2 jiu3 yung6 tau4 jing2 gei1 lai4 zou6 gaan2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司开会要用投影机来做简报。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to use a projector to do the presentation at the meeting.

english_meaning: to throw oneself into someone's arms; to offer oneself willingly (esp. in a romantic context)
explanation_mandarin: 主动投入别人的怀抱，多指女子主动示爱。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone, often a woman, intentionally and enthusiastically embraces or seeks physical intimacy with someone else. It often implies a deliberate act of affection or romantic pursuit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個偶像即刻投懷送抱，真係好熱情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 au2 zoeng6 zik1 hak1 tau4 waai4 sung3 pou5, zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看到偶像立刻投怀送抱，真是很热情。
examples.english_sentence: She threw herself into her idol's arms as soon as she saw him, she's really enthusiastic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁易對人投懷送抱啦，要保護自己啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 dui3 yan4 tau4 waai4 sung3 pou5 laa1, jiu3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易对人投怀送抱，要保护自己啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw yourself into people's arms so easily, you need to protect yourself.

english_meaning: to throw, to hurl
explanation_mandarin: 用力扔东西。
explanation_english: To throw something with force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度投擲石頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 tau4 zaak6 sek6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在投掷石头。
examples.english_sentence: They are throwing stones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便投擲垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 tau4 zaak6 laap6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便乱扔垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: Don't litter.

english_meaning: to cast; to put in; to throw; to launch; to invest; to allocate
explanation_mandarin: 投入，放置，发射。
explanation_english: To put in, to cast, to throw, to launch (a product, an investment, etc.), to allocate resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司投放咗好多資源去發展新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tau4 fong3 zo2 ho2 do1 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 faat3 zin2 san1 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司投入了很多资源去发展新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company has invested a lot of resources to develop new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府投放資金改善醫療服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tau4 fong3 zi1 gam1 goi2 sin6 yi1 liu4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府投入资金改善医疗服务。
examples.english_sentence: The government allocates funds to improve medical services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投放咗大量嘅時間喺呢個項目上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 fong3 zo2 daai6 loeng6 ge3 si4 gaan3 hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投入了大量的时间在这个项目上。
examples.english_sentence: He invested a lot of time in this project.

english_meaning: to surrender oneself to the authorities, to turn oneself in
explanation_mandarin: 指向公安机关或司法机关自首，承认自己的罪行并接受法律的制裁。
explanation_english: To surrender to the police or judicial authorities, confess one's crime and accept legal punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知道自己衰咗，決定去警署投案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 seoi1 zo2, kyut3 ding6 heoi3 ging2 syu2 tau4 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己犯错了，决定去警察局投案自首。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he had done wrong and decided to surrender himself to the police station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一番掙扎，佢終於決定去投案，希望可以得到寬大處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 faan1 zaang1 zaat3, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 tau4 on3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 fun1 daai6 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一番挣扎，他终于决定去投案，希望可以得到宽大处理。
examples.english_sentence: After struggling for a while, he finally decided to surrender himself, hoping for leniency.

english_meaning: to bid (on a contract, project, etc.); to submit a tender
explanation_mandarin: 指为获得某种合同或工程项目而提交报价的行为。
explanation_english: The act of submitting a formal offer to undertake a contract or project, often involving a detailed cost estimate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司決定投標呢個政府項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 tau4 biu1 ni1 go3 zing3 fu2 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司决定投标这个政府项目。
examples.english_sentence: Our company decided to bid on this government project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投標競爭好激烈啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 biu1 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投标竞争很激烈啊。
examples.english_sentence: The competition for this bid is very fierce.

english_meaning: to speculate, to seize an opportunity, opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 指利用机会获取利益，也指不付出努力，只想靠运气或钻空子来获得成功。也可形容一个人善于抓住机会。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of opportunities to gain profit. It can also mean wanting to achieve success by luck or exploiting loopholes without putting in effort. It can also describe someone who is good at seizing opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想投機取巧，唔肯腳踏實地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 tau4 gei1 ceoi2 haau2, m4 hang2 goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想投机取巧，不肯脚踏实地。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to take shortcuts and doesn't want to work hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市咁波動，唔好亂咁投機呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 gam3 bo1 dung6, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 tau4 gei1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市这么波动，不要乱投机啊。
examples.english_sentence: The housing market is so volatile, don't speculate blindly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好投機，一見有機會就衝上前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 tau4 gei1, jat1 gin3 jau5 gei1 wui2 zau6 cung1 soeng5 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很投机，一见到机会就冲上前。
examples.english_sentence: He is very opportunistic, jumping at every opportunity he sees.

english_meaning: To drown oneself; to commit suicide by drowning
explanation_mandarin: 指跳入水中自杀。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of jumping into water to commit suicide; to drown oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為生意失敗，一時諗唔開就去投水自殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai4 seng1 ji3 si1 baai6, jat1 si4 lam2 m4 hoi1 zau6 heoi3 tau4 seoi2 zi6 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为生意失败，一时想不开就去投水自杀了。
examples.english_sentence: Because his business failed, he was unable to think straight and went to drown himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁傻，有咩解決唔到要投水啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 so4, jau5 me1 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 jiu3 tau4 seoi2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么傻，有什么解决不了要投水啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so foolish, what can't be solved that requires you to drown yourself?

english_meaning: to invest; to bet; to stake; to put in (effort, resources)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 投入（资金、精力等）。2. 赌博时下赌注。
explanation_english: 1. To invest (capital, energy, etc.). 2. To place a bet in gambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅錢都投注喺呢隻馬度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 cin2 dou1 tau3 zyu3 hai2 ni1 zek3 maa5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的钱都投注在这匹马上了。
examples.english_sentence: He bet all his money on this horse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司投注咗好多資源喺研發新產品方面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 tau3 zyu3 zo2 hou2 do1 zi1 jyun4 hai2 jin4 faat3 san1 caan2 ban2 fong1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司在研发新产品方面投入了很多资源。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has invested a lot of resources in researching and developing new products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將太多時間投注喺無謂嘅爭拗上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 taai3 do1 si4 gaan3 tau3 zyu3 hai2 mou4 wai6 ge3 zaang1 aau3 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把太多时间投入在无谓的争论上面。
examples.english_sentence: Don't invest too much time in pointless arguments.

english_meaning: betting station, off-course betting branch
explanation_mandarin: 提供投注服务的场所，通常指香港赛马会或其他博彩公司的投注点。
explanation_english: A place that provides betting services, usually referring to a Hong Kong Jockey Club or other gambling company's betting outlet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去投注站買六合彩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 tau4 jyu3 zaam6 maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去投注站买六合彩吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the betting station to buy Mark Six tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都蒲喺投注站度，希望中頭獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 pou4 hai2 tau4 jyu3 zaam6 dou6, hei1 mong6 zung3 tau4 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天泡在投注站里，希望中头奖。
examples.english_sentence: He hangs around the betting station all day, hoping to win the first prize.

english_meaning: to put into production; to start production; to go into operation
explanation_mandarin: 指开始进行生产活动，通常指工厂或生产线开始运作。
explanation_english: Refers to the commencement of production activities, usually indicating that a factory or production line has begun operating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間新工廠聽日正式投產啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 san1 gung1 cong2 ting1 jat6 zeng3 sik1 tau4 caan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家新工厂明天正式投入生产了。
examples.english_sentence: This new factory will officially go into production tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條新生產線下個月會投產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 san1 sang1 caan2 sin3 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 tau4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条新生产线下个月会投入生产。
examples.english_sentence: This new production line will start production next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司投產之後，生意好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 tau4 caan2 zi1 hau6, sang1 ji3 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司投入生产之后，生意好多了。
examples.english_sentence: After the company started production, business improved a lot.

synonyms: 開始生產 (hoi1 ci2 sang1 caan2)

english_meaning: To test the waters; to throw a stone to test the depth of the water; to make a tentative inquiry; to feel out the situation.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先做一些试探性的工作，以便了解情况，为下一步行动做准备。也指用不重要的东西引出重要的东西。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the act of taking preliminary steps to gauge a situation before proceeding with a larger plan. It can also refer to using something unimportant as bait to elicit something important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如投石問路，先試吓問佢肯唔肯合作啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 tau4 sek6 man6 lou6, sin1 si3 haa5 man6 keoi5 hang2 m4 hang2 hap6 jok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如先试探一下，先问问他肯不肯合作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we test the waters and ask him if he's willing to cooperate first?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司諗住投石問路，搞個小型嘅試驗計劃睇吓市場反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 lam2 zyu6 tau4 sek6 man6 lou6, gaau2 go3 siu2 jing4 ge3 si3 jim6 gai3 waak6 tai2 haa5 si5 coeng4 faan2 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算试探一下，搞个小型的试验计划看看市场反应。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to test the waters by launching a small pilot program to see the market response.

english_meaning: catapult, trebuchet
explanation_mandarin: 一种古代的攻城武器，利用杠杆原理或扭力将石块等抛射出去。
explanation_english: An ancient siege engine that launches projectiles, such as stones, using leverage or torsion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲戰爭成日用投石機攻打城市嘅城牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi5 cin4 di1 zin3 zang1 sing4 jat6 yung6 tau4 sek6 gei1 gung1 daa2 sing4 si5 ge3 seng4 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的战争经常用投石机攻击城市的城墙。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, wars often used catapults to attack the city walls.

english_meaning: to vote; cast a ballot
explanation_mandarin: 指在选举或表决中，通过书面或电子方式表达自己的选择。
explanation_english: To cast a vote, typically in an election or referendum, expressing a choice or preference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要去投票選議員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tau4 piu3 syun2 ji5 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天要去投票选议员。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to vote for council members today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇登記做選民，可以投票㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 dang1 gei3 zou6 syun2 man4, ho2 ji5 tau4 piu3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有登记成为选民，可以投票吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you registered as a voter so you can vote?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次選舉嘅投票率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ge3 tau4 piu3 leot2 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次选举的投票率很低。
examples.english_sentence: The voter turnout for the last election was very low.

english_meaning: voter turnout, voting rate
explanation_mandarin: 指参与投票的选民人数占有资格投票的选民总数的百分比。
explanation_english: The percentage of eligible voters who cast a ballot in an election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今屆區議會選舉嘅投票率比上屆高好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 gaai3 khu1 yi5 wui2 syun2 ge3 tau4 piu3 leut6 bei2 soeng6 gaai3 gou1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这届区议会选举的投票率比上届高很多。
examples.english_sentence: The voter turnout in this district council election is much higher than the last one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提高年輕人嘅投票率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 gou1 nin4 hing1 yan4 ge3 tau4 piu3 leut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要提高年轻人的投票率。
examples.english_sentence: We need to increase the voter turnout among young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 低投票率可能反映市民對政府嘅不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dai1 tau4 piu3 leut6 ho2 nang4 faan2 ying2 si5 man4 deoi3 zing3 fu2 ge3 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 低投票率可能反映市民对政府的不满。
examples.english_sentence: A low voter turnout may reflect citizens' dissatisfaction with the government.

english_meaning: to submit (an article, story, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指向报刊、杂志等媒体寄送稿件，希望被采用刊登。
explanation_english: To submit a manuscript (article, story, etc.) to a publication (newspaper, magazine, etc.) for consideration and potential publication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫咗篇小說，諗住投稿去文學雜誌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 zo2 pin1 siu2 syut3, lam2 zyu6 tau4 gong2 heoi3 man4 hok6 zaap6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我写了一篇小说，打算投稿去文学杂志。
examples.english_sentence: I wrote a novel and I plan to submit it to a literary magazine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經常投稿，希望可以成為作家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 seong4 tau4 gong2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing4 wai4 zok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常投稿，希望可以成为作家。
examples.english_sentence: He often submits articles, hoping to become a writer.

english_meaning: to shoot a basketball
explanation_mandarin: 在篮球运动中，将球投入篮筐。
explanation_english: In basketball, the act of throwing the ball into the basket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意去公園投籃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 tau4 laam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢去公园投篮。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to go to the park to shoot hoops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落雨，我哋冇得去投籃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 mou5 dak1 heoi3 tau4 laam4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下雨，我们不能去投篮了。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining today, we can't go shoot hoops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅投籃姿勢好標準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 laam4 zi1 sai3 hou2 biu1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的投篮姿势很标准。
examples.english_sentence: His basketball shooting form is very standard.

english_meaning: to be congenial, to hit it off, to click with someone
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间性格相合，彼此喜欢，容易相处。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling when two people's personalities are compatible, they like each other, and it's easy to get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢好投緣，一見如故咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 tau4 jyun4, jat1 gin3 jyu4 gu3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他很投缘，一见如故一样。
examples.english_sentence: I really clicked with him, it was like we were old friends from the moment we met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好投緣，成日一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 tau4 jyun4, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个很投缘，总是玩在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Those two hit it off really well, they're always playing together.

english_meaning: to apply for an examination; to take an entrance exam
explanation_mandarin: 参加考试，报名应考。
explanation_english: To apply to take an exam, especially an entrance exam for a school, university, or job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年準備投考大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zyun2 bei6 tau4 haau2 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年准备报考大学。
examples.english_sentence: He is preparing to apply for university this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都投考政府工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 tau4 haau2 zing3 fu2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都报考政府工作。
examples.english_sentence: Many people apply for government jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住投考邊間學校呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 zyu6 tau4 haau2 bin1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算报考哪间学校啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which school are you planning to apply to?

english_meaning: Reincarnation; to be reborn
explanation_mandarin: 指人或动物死亡后，灵魂重新转生到新的生命形态。
explanation_english: Refers to the belief that after death, a person or animal's soul is reborn into a new life form. It implies reincarnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁好人，下世一定可以投胎做有錢人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hou2 jan4, haa6 sai3 jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 tau4 toi1 zou6 jau5 cin2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么好的人，下辈子一定可以投胎做有钱人。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a good person, he'll definitely be reborn as a rich person in the next life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人相信人死咗之後會投胎變做另一種生物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 soeng1 seon3 jan4 sei2 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui5 tau4 toi1 bin3 zou6 ling6 jat1 zung2 sang1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人相信人死后会投胎变成另一种生物。
examples.english_sentence: Some people believe that after death, people will be reborn as another type of creature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果可以投胎，我想做一隻自由自在嘅雀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 tau4 toi1, ngo5 soeng2 zou6 jat1 zek3 zi6 jau4 zi6 zoi6 ge3 zoek3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果可以投胎，我想做一只自由自在的小鸟。
examples.english_sentence: If I could be reincarnated, I'd like to be a free and unrestrained bird.

english_meaning: investment bank
explanation_mandarin: 指专门从事投资银行业务的金融机构，主要业务包括证券承销、并购重组、财务顾问等。
explanation_english: Refers to a financial institution specializing in investment banking activities. Its main business includes securities underwriting, mergers and acquisitions, financial advisory services, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢目標係畢業之後入投行做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 muk6 biu1 hai6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 jap6 tau4 hong4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的目标是毕业之后去投资银行工作。
examples.english_sentence: His goal is to work in an investment bank after graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投行嘅工壓力好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 hong4 ge3 gung1 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资银行的工作压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: The work in investment banks is very stressful.

english_meaning: to complain; complaint
explanation_mandarin: 指向有关部门或上级反映情况，提出不满或要求；也可以指提出的不满或要求。
explanation_english: To make a formal complaint; to express dissatisfaction to an authority or superior; can also refer to the complaint itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日投訴公司嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tau4 sou3 gung1 si1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抱怨公司的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He always complains about things at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到好多顧客嘅投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou2 hou2 do1 gu3 hak3 ge3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到很多顾客的投诉。
examples.english_sentence: We received a lot of customer complaints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔滿意，可以向經理投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 mun5 yi3, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 ging1 lei5 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不满意，可以向经理投诉。
examples.english_sentence: If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the manager.

english_meaning: Nowhere to complain; no avenue for complaint; no one to turn to for redress.
explanation_mandarin: 指没有地方可以投诉，申诉无门，没有解决问题的途径。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where there is no place to lodge a complaint, no avenue for redress, and no means to resolve the issue. It implies a lack of access to channels for grievance and justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲嘢咁差，投訴都投訴無門，真係激死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 je5 gam3 caa1, tau4 sou3 dou1 tau4 sou3 mou4 mun4, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的东西这么差，投诉都投诉无门，真是气死人。
examples.english_sentence: The products from this company are so bad. There's nowhere to complain. It's really infuriating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅服務態度咁差，我哋真係投訴無門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fuk6 mou6 taai3 dou6 gam3 caa1, ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 tau4 sou3 mou4 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的服务态度这么差，我们真是投诉无门。
examples.english_sentence: Their service attitude is so bad. We really have nowhere to complain.

english_meaning: investment; to invest
explanation_mandarin: 投入资金或资源以期望获得回报的行为。
explanation_english: The act of allocating money or resources with the expectation of receiving a future benefit or profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該投資邊隻股票好呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 tau4 zi1 bin1 zek3 gu2 piu3 hou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该投资哪个股票好呢？
examples.english_sentence: Which stock should we invest in?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房地產方面嘅投資好成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong4 dei6 saan2 fong1 min6 ge3 tau4 zi1 hou2 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房地产方面的投资很成功。
examples.english_sentence: His investment in real estate has been very successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資有風險，入市前要諗清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 jau5 fung2 him2, jap6 si5 cin4 jiu3 lam2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资有风险，入市前要考虑清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Investment involves risks, think carefully before entering the market.

english_meaning: Investment immigration, immigrant investor program
explanation_mandarin: 指通过在目标国家或地区进行投资，以获得永久居留权或公民身份的移民方式。
explanation_english: A method of immigration where individuals invest capital in a target country or region in exchange for permanent residency or citizenship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人諗住通過投資移民去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 lam2 zyu6 tung1 gwo3 tau4 zi1 ji4 man4 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人打算通过投资移民去加拿大。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is planning to immigrate to Canada through investment immigration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好多國家都有投資移民嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jau5 tau4 zi1 ji4 man4 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多国家都有投资移民的计划。
examples.english_sentence: Many countries now have investment immigration programs.

english_meaning: Investment portfolio
explanation_mandarin: 指投资者持有的不同资产的集合，例如股票、债券、房地产等，旨在分散风险并获得收益。
explanation_english: A collection of investments owned by an individual or organization. Portfolios are designed to balance risk and return based on the investor's goals and risk tolerance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅投資組合包括股票、債券同埋房地產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tau4 zi1 zou2 hap6 baau1 kut3 guk1 piu3, zaai3 hyun3 tung4 maai4 fong2 dei6 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的投资组合包括股票、债券和房地产。
examples.english_sentence: His investment portfolio includes stocks, bonds, and real estate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分散投資係管理投資組合風險嘅重要策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 saan2 tau4 zi1 hai6 gun2 lei5 tau4 zi1 zou2 hap6 fung1 him2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分散投资是管理投资组合风险的重要策略。
examples.english_sentence: Diversification is an important strategy for managing the risk of an investment portfolio.

english_meaning: investor
explanation_mandarin: 指投入资金或资源以期望获得回报的个人或机构。
explanation_english: A person or organization that invests money or capital with the expectation of receiving a financial return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司吸引咗好多本地同埋外國嘅投資者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 bun2 dei6 tung4 mai4 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 tau4 zi1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司吸引了很多本地和外国的投资者。
examples.english_sentence: This company has attracted many local and foreign investors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個投資者，你要了解市場嘅風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 tau4 zi1 ze2, nei5 jiu3 liu2 gaai2 si5 coeng4 ge3 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个投资者，你需要了解市场的风险。
examples.english_sentence: As an investor, you need to understand the risks of the market.

english_meaning: Investment bank
explanation_mandarin: 指主要从事证券承销、并购顾问、资产管理等业务的金融机构。
explanation_english: A financial institution that provides services such as underwriting, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory, and asset management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間好大嘅投資銀行做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 hou2 daai6 ge3 tau4 zi1 ngan4 hong4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家很大的投资银行工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works at a large investment bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資銀行嘅花紅通常都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 ngan4 hong4 ge3 faa1 hung4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资银行的奖金通常都很高。
examples.english_sentence: Bonuses at investment banks are usually very high.

english_meaning: to dedicate oneself to; to plunge into; to throw oneself into
explanation_mandarin: 全身心地投入到某项事业或活动中。
explanation_english: To devote oneself wholeheartedly to a cause or activity; to dedicate one's time, energy, and resources to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定投身教育界，培育下一代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 tau4 san1 gaau3 yuk6 gaai3, pui4 yuk6 haa6 jat1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定投身教育界，培育下一代。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to dedicate himself to the education sector to nurture the next generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投身咗義工服務，幫好多有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 san1 zo2 ji6 gung1 fuk6 mou6, bong1 hou2 do1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投身了义工服务，帮助了很多有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated himself to volunteer services, helping many people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後，投身咗金融行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, tau4 san1 zo2 gam1 jung4 hong4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业之后，投身了金融行业。
examples.english_sentence: After graduation, he dedicated himself to the financial industry.

mandarin_meaning: 闲置；安排不重要的工作
english_meaning: To put someone on the shelf; to give someone insignificant work to do; to sideline someone
explanation_mandarin: 指安排某人做不重要的、清闲的工作，通常是因为这个人不受重视或已经失去价值。
explanation_english: Refers to assigning someone unimportant or idle work, usually because the person is not valued or has lost their value. It implies being sidelined or marginalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得唔開心，俾公司投閒置散咗，根本冇嘢俾佢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 m4 hoi1 sam1, bei2 gung1 si1 tau4 haan4 zi3 saan2 zo2, gan1 bun2 mou5 je5 bei2 keoi5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作不开心，被公司投闲置散了，根本没什么事给他做。
examples.english_sentence: He's unhappy at work. The company has sidelined him, there's basically nothing for him to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢得罪咗老細之後，就俾人投閒置散，好慘呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 dak1 zeoi6 zo2 lou5 sai3 zi1 hau6, zau6 bei2 jan4 tau4 haan4 zi3 saan2, hou2 caam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他得罪了老板之后，就被投闲置散，好可怜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he offended the boss, he's been sidelined, it's awful.

english_meaning: to surrender, to give in, to capitulate
explanation_mandarin: 停止抵抗，放弃战斗；认输。
explanation_english: To cease resistance to an enemy or opponent and submit to their authority; to give in or admit defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我認輸啦，我投降！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing6 syu1 laa1, ngo5 tau4 hong4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认输了，我投降！
examples.english_sentence: I admit defeat, I surrender!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最終都係要投降。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 hai6 jiu3 tau4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最终还是要投降。
examples.english_sentence: They will have to surrender eventually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快投降，試多幾次先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 tau4 hong4, si3 do1 gei2 chi3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快投降，多尝试几次吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly, try a few more times first.

english_meaning: To surrender and lose half (of the stake/original goal)
explanation_mandarin: 表示遇到困难时，及时认输止损，可以减少损失。相当于承认失败，但避免全部损失。
explanation_english: This idiom means to surrender and accept a partial loss rather than continue fighting and potentially losing everything. It suggests cutting your losses and minimizing damage when facing unfavorable odds. It's about recognizing when to concede and avoid a complete defeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋投降輸一半，唔好再揼錢落去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 tau4 hong2 syu1 jat1 bun3, m4 hou2 zoi3 dam3 cin2 lok6 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们投降输一半，不要再砸钱进去了。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe we should just surrender and lose half, let's not keep pouring money into it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資失敗，唯有投降輸一半，賣咗啲股票算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6, wai4 jau5 tau4 hong2 syu1 jat1 bun3, maai6 zo2 di1 gu2 piu3 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资失败了，只好认输输一半，卖掉一些股票算了。
examples.english_sentence: This investment failed, so we have no choice but to surrender and lose half, and just sell some stocks.

english_meaning: to seek refuge with; to rely on; to depend on for support
explanation_mandarin: 指寻求依靠，依靠他人来获得庇护或支持。
explanation_english: To seek refuge or support by relying on someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企破產之後，佢哋就去投靠啲親戚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 po3 saan2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 tau4 kaau3 di1 can1 cik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家破产之后，他们就去投靠亲戚了。
examples.english_sentence: After their family went bankrupt, they went to seek refuge with their relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業之後，唯有投靠佢個大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, wai4 jau5 tau4 kaau3 keoi5 go3 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业之后，只能投靠他的哥哥。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he had no choice but to depend on his elder brother.

english_meaning: to hesitate to injure something for fear of harming something else; to be restrained by fear of the consequences
explanation_mandarin: 比喻想打击坏人，但又有所顾忌，不敢放手行事。
explanation_english: A metaphor for wanting to strike at a bad person but hesitating because of concern for the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事真係好麻煩，想搞掂佢，但係又投鼠忌器，怕影響到其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4, soeng2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, daan6 hai6 jau6 tau4 syu2 gei6 hei3, paa3 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的很麻烦，想解决它，但是又投鼠忌器，怕影响到其他人。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really troublesome. I want to solve it, but I'm hesitant because of the consequences and am afraid of affecting other people.

english_meaning: to rest, to take a break, to relax
explanation_mandarin: 休息，放松。
explanation_english: To rest, relax, or take a break from work or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋抖下先啦，行咗咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dau2 haa5 sin1 laa1, hang4 zo2 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们休息一下吧，走了这么久。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a break, we've been walking for so long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工返屋企想抖下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 soeng2 dau2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班回家想休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: After work, I want to relax at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫佢要多啲抖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 keoi5 jiu3 do1 di1 dau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫他要多休息。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told him to rest more.

english_meaning: to take a deep breath (usually to relax or relieve stress); to breathe a sigh of relief
explanation_mandarin: 深吸一口气，通常表示放松、缓解压力或者松了一口气。
explanation_english: To take a deep breath, usually indicating relaxation, relief of stress, or a sigh of relief after a tense situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，我終於可以抖大氣喇。

examples.english_sentence: It is difficult for small companies to compete with large corporations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力抗衡外來嘅文化入侵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 kong3 hang4 ngoi6 loi4 ge3 man4 faa3 jap6 chim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力抗衡外来的文化入侵。
examples.english_sentence: We must strive to resist foreign cultural invasion.

english_meaning: protest, object, remonstrate
explanation_mandarin: 表示反对或不满，提出强烈的意见。
explanation_english: To express disapproval or objection to something, often publicly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要上街抗議政府嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 soeng5 gaai1 kong3 ngi5 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要上街抗议政府的政策。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to protest the government's policy on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋舉牌抗議加租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 geoi2 paai4 kong3 ngi5 gaa1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们举牌抗议涨租。
examples.english_sentence: They are holding signs to protest the rent increase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋向公司提出咗正式嘅抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoeng3 gung1 si1 tai4 ceot1 zo2 zeng3 sik1 ge3 kong3 ngi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们向公司提出了正式的抗议。
examples.english_sentence: They have lodged a formal protest with the company.

english_meaning: to argue against; to defend oneself; to plead; to contest (a charge); to refute
explanation_mandarin: 在法庭上或辩论中，对指控或论点进行辩解、反驳或提出异议。
explanation_english: To argue against an accusation or argument, to defend oneself, or to raise objections in a court of law or during a debate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺法庭上面極力抗辯，話自己係無辜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 min6 gik1 lik6 kong3 bin6, waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 mou4 gu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在法庭上极力抗辩，说自己是无辜的。
examples.english_sentence: He strongly pleaded his case in court, claiming he was innocent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對所有指控都作出抗辯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 so2 jau5 zi2 gung3 dou1 zok3 ceot1 kong3 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对所有的指控都做出了抗辩。
examples.english_sentence: He refuted all the charges against him.

english_meaning: earthquake resistant; seismic resistance; anti-seismic
explanation_mandarin: 形容建筑或结构能够抵抗地震的破坏。动词表示采取措施以防止或减轻地震造成的损害。
explanation_english: Describing a building or structure that is resistant to damage from earthquakes. As a verb, it means to take measures to prevent or mitigate damage caused by earthquakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟樓起嗰陣有特別做過抗震措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung3 lau2 hei2 go2 zan6 jau5 dak6 bit6 zou6 gwo3 kong3 zan3 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼建造的时候特别做了抗震措施。
examples.english_sentence: This building had special anti-seismic measures taken during its construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，政府要加強建築物嘅抗震能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, zing3 fu2 jiu3 ga1 koeng4 gin3 zuk1 mat6 ge3 kong3 zan3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，政府要加强建筑物的抗震能力。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, the government needs to strengthen the seismic resistance of buildings.

english_meaning: antibody
explanation_mandarin: 免疫系统中产生的，能与特定抗原结合的蛋白质。
explanation_english: A protein produced by the body's immune system when it detects harmful substances, called antigens. Antibodies bind to antigens and neutralize them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打咗疫苗之後，身體就會產生抗體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 zo2 jik6 miu4 zi1 hau6, san1 tai2 zau6 wui5 caan2 sang1 kong3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打了疫苗之后，身体就会产生抗体。
examples.english_sentence: After getting vaccinated, your body will produce antibodies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅抗體水平好高，應該唔會容易感染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kong3 tai2 seoi2 ping4 hou2 gou1, jing1 goi1 m4 wui5 jung4 ji6 gam2 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的抗体水平很高，应该不容易感染。
examples.english_sentence: His antibody levels are high, so he probably won't get infected easily.

english_meaning: discount; to fold; to break
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示弯曲或断裂。作为名词，表示折扣。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to bend, fold, or break. As a noun, it means a discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做緊七折優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 cat1 zit3 jau1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在正在做七折优惠。
examples.english_sentence: There's a 30% discount now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張紙太長，折埋佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi2 taai3 coeng4, zit3 maai4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张纸太长了，把它折起来吧。
examples.english_sentence: This paper is too long, fold it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心跌親，整折咗隻腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 can1, zing2 zit3 zo2 zek3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心摔倒了，把脚摔折了。
examples.english_sentence: He fell down accidentally and broke his leg.

english_meaning: to convert to, to amount to, to translate into
explanation_mandarin: 将一种单位或货币换算成另一种。通常用于计算不同货币、重量、容量等之间的等值关系。
explanation_english: To convert from one unit or currency to another. Usually used to calculate the equivalent value between different currencies, weights, volumes, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲美金折合做港幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 mei5 gam1 zit3 hap6 zou6 gong2 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那些美元折算成港币。
examples.english_sentence: He converted those US dollars into Hong Kong dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個價錢折合返人民幣大約幾多錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 zit3 hap6 faan1 jan4 man4 bai6 daai6 joek3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个价格折算成人民币大约多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much is this price in RMB, roughly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一百克折合幾多安士呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 baak3 hak1 zit3 hap6 gei2 do1 on1 si2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一百克折合成多少盎司啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many ounces is one hundred grams?

english_meaning: To suffer misfortune; to be miserable; to be in a sorry state; to be punished (often due to bad deeds); to degrade oneself.
explanation_mandarin: 指生活困苦，境遇不佳，遭遇不幸；也指道德败坏，自甘堕落。通常带有贬义，暗示遭受报应或自我作贱。
explanation_english: Describes a state of hardship, misfortune, or a bad situation. It can also refer to moral degradation and self-abasement. It usually carries a negative connotation, implying punishment for past misdeeds or self-inflicted suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做遲早會折墮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 ci4 zou2 wui5 zit3 do6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做迟早会遭报应的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep doing things like this, you'll suffer the consequences sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭錢，搞到自己折墮埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou2 cin2, gaau2 dou3 zi6 gei2 zit3 do6 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天赌钱，搞得自己很倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: He gambles all the time and has brought misery upon himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人唔可以咁衰，唔係會折墮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 seoi1, m4 hai6 wui5 zit3 do6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人不能这么坏，不然会遭报应的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be such a bad person, or you will be punished.

english_meaning: To shorten one's lifespan (due to bad deeds or speech); to be detrimental to one's health; to wish bad luck on oneself or another.
explanation_mandarin: 迷信说法，指因做了不该做的事或说了不该说的话而导致寿命缩短。通常用于批评或劝诫他人，表示某种行为或言语会带来不好的后果。
explanation_english: A superstitious saying meaning to shorten one's lifespan, usually due to bad deeds, bad speech, or generally bringing bad luck upon oneself. It's often used to criticize or caution others about actions or words that might lead to negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日講埋啲咁嘅嘢，真係折壽㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 zit3 sau6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整天说这些话，真是折寿啊！
examples.english_sentence: You say these kinds of things all the time, it's really detrimental to your health/lifespan!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁講嘢呀，講錯嘢會折壽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 gong2 je5 aa3, gong2 co3 je5 wui5 zit3 sau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱说话呀，说错话会折寿的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense, saying the wrong thing can shorten your lifespan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咁多煎炸嘢，小心折壽啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 gam3 do1 zin1 zaa3 je5, siu2 sam1 zit3 sau6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃这么多油炸食品，小心折寿啊！
examples.english_sentence: Eating so much fried food, be careful you'll shorten your lifespan!

english_meaning: Opera excerpts; Selected scenes from a Chinese opera
explanation_mandarin: 指传统戏曲中选取精华部分单独演出的剧目或片段。
explanation_english: Refers to selected scenes or excerpts from traditional Chinese operas that are performed independently. These are usually the most dramatic or popular parts of a longer opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有折子戲睇，你想唔想去啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 zit3 zi2 hei3 tai2, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有折子戏看，你想不想去啊？
examples.english_sentence: There are opera excerpts to watch tonight, do you want to go?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最鍾意睇《帝女花》嘅折子戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 《dai3 neoi5 faa1》 ge3 zit3 zi2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最喜欢看《帝女花》的折子戏。
examples.english_sentence: She likes watching the excerpts from the opera 'Princess Chang Ping' the most.

english_meaning: net price; actual discounted price; discount applied
explanation_mandarin: 指已经将所有折扣计算在内的实际价格。
explanation_english: Refers to the actual price after all discounts have been applied. It represents the final price the customer pays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫折實幾錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zit3 sat6 gei2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服打折后实际多少钱？
examples.english_sentence: What's the net price of this shirt after the discount?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話俾我聽嘅價錢係折實價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 teng1 ge3 gaa3 cin2 hai6 zit3 sat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他告诉我的价格是实际折扣价。
examples.english_sentence: The price he told me was the actual discounted price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 折實嚟講，都幾抵買㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 sat6 lai4 gong2, dou1 gei2 dai2 maai5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算上折扣，还是很划算的！
examples.english_sentence: Considering the discount, it's quite a good deal!

english_meaning: refraction; to refract; reflection (of light or sound)
explanation_mandarin: 光或声音等从一种介质进入另一种介质时，方向发生改变的现象。也指通过曲折反映事物的情况。
explanation_english: The change in direction of a wave passing from one medium to another or from a gradual change in the medium. It can also refer to the reflection of a situation through twists and turns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 光線通過玻璃會折射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong1 sin3 tung1 gwo3 bo1 lei1 wui5 zit3 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光线通过玻璃会折射。
examples.english_sentence: Light refracts when it passes through glass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事折射咗社會嘅某啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zit3 se6 zo2 se5 wui2 ge3 mau5 dik1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事折射了社会的一些问题。
examples.english_sentence: This incident reflects some of the problems in society.

english_meaning: refractive index
explanation_mandarin: 光或其他电磁波从一种介质进入另一种介质时，发生折射现象，入射角的正弦与折射角的正弦之比，等于后一种介质的折射率与前一种介质的折射率之比。
explanation_english: The refractive index of a substance is a number that describes how light propagates through that medium. It is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in a vacuum to the speed of light in the substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊玻璃嘅折射率係幾多啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bo1 lei1 ge3 zit3 se6 leot6 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块玻璃的折射率是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What is the refractive index of this piece of glass?

english_meaning: folding fan
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以折叠的扇子。
explanation_english: A type of fan that can be folded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎住把折扇喺度撥啊撥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 zyu6 baa2 zit3 sin3 hai2 dou6 but6 aa3 but6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着一把折扇在那里扇啊扇。
examples.english_sentence: He's holding a folding fan and fanning himself.

english_meaning: discount
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或服务的价格减少，通常以百分比或具体金额表示。
explanation_english: A reduction in the usual price of something, typically expressed as a percentage or a specific amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭做緊大折扣，好多嘢都減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zou6 gan2 daai6 zit3 kau3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店正在打折，很多东西都降价了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop is having a big sale, a lot of things are discounted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用咗個會員卡，所以有額外嘅折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 zo2 go3 wui2 yun4 kaat1, so2 ji5 jau5 ngak6 ngoi6 ge3 zit3 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用了会员卡，所以有额外的折扣。
examples.english_sentence: I used the membership card, so I have an extra discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想等佢哋有折扣嘅時候先買？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 dang2 keoi5 dei6 jau5 zit3 kau3 ge3 si4 hau6 sin1 maai5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想等他们打折的时候再买？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to wait until they have a discount before buying?

english_meaning: to break, to snap
explanation_mandarin: 指物体因受力而断裂。
explanation_english: To break or snap due to force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枝樹畀風吹到折斷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 syu6 bei2 fung1 cheui1 dou3 zit3 dyun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树枝被风吹断了。
examples.english_sentence: The branch was broken by the wind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心將枝鉛筆折斷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 m4 siu2 sam1 jeung1 zi1 yun4 bat1 zit3 dyun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心把铅笔折断了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally broke the pencil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好將啲乾樹枝折斷呀，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: chin1 kei4 m4 hou2 jeung1 di1 gon1 syu6 ji1 zit3 dyun6 aa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要把那些干树枝折断啊，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't break those dry branches, it's dangerous.

english_meaning: to be convinced; to be won over; to admire; to be subjugated
explanation_mandarin: 指因对方的能力、品德等而心悦诚服，表示佩服、叹服。
explanation_english: To be sincerely convinced or impressed by someone's ability, character, or something else; to admire; to be won over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現真係令人折服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 zip3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现真是令人折服。
examples.english_sentence: His performance is truly convincing and admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾佢嘅毅力折服咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6 zip3 fuk6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被他的毅力折服了。
examples.english_sentence: I am won over by his perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個論點嘅邏輯性好強，令人折服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 leon6 dim2 ge3 lo4 gap1 sing3 hou2 koeng4, ling6 jan4 zip3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个论点的逻辑性很强，令人折服。
examples.english_sentence: The logic of this argument is very strong, it's convincing.

mandarin_meaning: 砍断树枝; 比喻夭折
english_meaning: To break off a branch; (figurative) to die young
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是折断树枝。在粤语中，常用于形容孩子夭折，过早去世，带有惋惜之意。
explanation_english: Literally means to break off a branch. In Cantonese, it is often used figuratively to describe a child dying young, implying pity and regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，咁細個就走咗，真係折枝呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, gam3 sai3 go3 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 zit3 zi1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，这么小就走了，真是夭折啊！
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, gone so young, it's such a tragedy of a young death!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔唔夠十歲就過身，實在係折枝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 m4 gau3 sap6 seoi3 zau6 gwo3 san1, sat6 zoi6 hai6 zit3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的儿子不到十岁就去世了，实在是夭折。
examples.english_sentence: His son passed away before he was even ten years old; it's such a young death.

english_meaning: to cash in; to redeem for cash; to discount (a bill)
explanation_mandarin: 将未来的收益或价值转换为现在的现金价值。通常指将支票、债券、优惠券等兑换成现金。
explanation_english: To convert a future payment or value into its present cash equivalent. Often refers to converting checks, bonds, coupons, etc., into cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將啲優惠券折現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 di1 jau1 wai6 hyun3 zit3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把这些优惠券兑换成现金。
examples.english_sentence: I want to cash in these coupons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你張支票可以去銀行折現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 zi1 piu3 ho2 ji5 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 zit3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以去银行把你的支票兑现。
examples.english_sentence: You can go to the bank to cash your check.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅紅利可以折現嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 hung4 lei6 ho2 ji5 zit3 jin6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的红利是可以兑换成现金的。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's bonus can be cashed in.

english_meaning: to fold; folding
explanation_mandarin: 将物体弯曲并使之互相重叠。也可作名词，指折叠的状态或动作。
explanation_english: To fold something, making it smaller or more compact by bending parts over each other. Can also be used as a noun, referring to the state or action of folding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱唔用嗰陣可以折疊埋佢，慳返啲位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 m4 jung6 go2 zan6 ho2 ji5 zit3 dip6 maai4 keoi5, haan1 faan1 di1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用桌子的时候可以把它折叠起来，节省一些空间。
examples.english_sentence: When not using the table, you can fold it up to save some space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部單車可以折疊，方便攜帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 daan1 ce1 ho2 ji5 zit3 dip6, fong1 bin6 kwai4 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆自行车可以折叠，方便携带。
examples.english_sentence: This bicycle can be folded, making it easy to carry.

english_meaning: to torment, to torture; torment, torture
explanation_mandarin: 使在肉体或精神上受到痛苦。
explanation_english: To cause physical or mental suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工真係折磨人，日日都要OT到凌晨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 zit3 mo4 jan4, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT dou3 ling4 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作真是折磨人，每天都要加班到凌晨。
examples.english_sentence: This job is really tormenting, I have to work overtime until dawn every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日無啦啦發脾氣，簡直係一種精神折磨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mou4 laa1 laa1 faat3 pei4 hei3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 zung2 zing1 san4 zit3 mo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是无缘无故地发脾气，简直是一种精神折磨。
examples.english_sentence: He always throws tantrums for no reason, it's simply a form of mental torture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 段感情結束之後，佢一直受到良心嘅折磨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun6 gam2 cing4 git3 suk1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 jat1 zik6 sau6 dou3 leong4 sam1 ge3 zit3 mo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那段感情结束后，他一直受到良心的折磨。
examples.english_sentence: After that relationship ended, he was constantly tormented by his conscience.

english_meaning: to diminish one's blessings, to incur bad luck due to wrongdoing or inappropriate behavior
explanation_mandarin: 指做了不好的事情，导致自己或他人减少了福气，遭受不好的运势。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of doing something bad, causing oneself or others to diminish their blessings and suffer bad luck. It implies that one's actions are reducing the amount of good fortune they or others deserve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日講大話，真係折福㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 zit3 fuk1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是说谎，真是会损福的。
examples.english_sentence: Always telling lies really diminishes your blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣對老人家，會折福嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 lou5 jan4 gaa1, wui5 zit3 fuk1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样对待老人，会损福的！
examples.english_sentence: Treating elderly people like that will bring bad luck!

english_meaning: to convert, to calculate at an exchange rate, to reckon as equivalent, to convert into
explanation_mandarin: 把一种单位或数量转换成另一种单位或数量。
explanation_english: To convert from one unit or quantity to another, often involving a calculation or exchange rate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲積分可以折算做現金㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zip1 fan1 ho2 ji5 zit3 syun3 zou6 jin6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些积分可以折算成现金的。
examples.english_sentence: These points can be converted into cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將美金折算成港幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 mei5 gam1 zit3 syun3 sing4 gong2 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把美元折算成港币。
examples.english_sentence: We need to convert US dollars into Hong Kong dollars.

english_meaning: discount; to give a discount
explanation_mandarin: 降低价格；以较低的价格出售。也可以指降低的价格或折扣。
explanation_english: To reduce the price; to sell at a lower price. Can also refer to the reduced price or the discount itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做緊推廣，全部貨品折線七折呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 tui1 gwong2, cyun4 bou6 fo3 ban2 zit3 sin3 cat1 zit3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在正在做推广活动，所有商品打七折。
examples.english_sentence: We are having a promotion now, all items are 30% off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭經常折線賣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ging1 seung4 zit3 sin3 maai6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店经常打折卖东西。
examples.english_sentence: This shop often sells things at a discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如等佢折線先買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 dang2 keoi5 zit3 sin3 sin1 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如等它打折再买吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we wait for it to go on sale before buying it?

english_meaning: To bend one's back; to stoop; to give in; to yield; to compromise; to curry favor
explanation_mandarin: 本义是弯腰，引申为屈服、逢迎权势或不得不妥协。
explanation_english: Literally means to bend one's back. Figuratively, it means to submit, to yield to power or influence, or to have to compromise against one's will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想為咗份工折腰呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 zit3 jiu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想为了这份工作折腰啊！
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to compromise my principles for this job!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗升職，成日都要喺老闆面前折腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 sing1 zik1, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 zit3 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了升职，经常都要在老板面前逢迎。
examples.english_sentence: In order to get promoted, he always has to curry favor with the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現實迫住佢折腰，接受咗呢個安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 sat6 bik1 zyu6 keoi5 zit3 jiu1, zip3 sau6 zo2 ni1 go3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现实逼迫他妥协，接受了这个安排。
examples.english_sentence: Reality forced him to yield and accept this arrangement.

english_meaning: depreciation
explanation_mandarin: 指固定资产因使用和损耗而引起的价值减少。
explanation_english: The decrease in value of an asset due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or other factors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦用咗五年，折舊都差唔多折晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 yung6 zo2 ng5 nin4, zit3 gau6 dou1 caa1 m4 do1 zit3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑用了五年，折旧差不多折完了。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been used for five years, and it's almost fully depreciated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司每年都要計折舊嘅，咁先知道實際盈利幾多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mui5 nin4 dou1 yiu3 gai3 zit3 gau6 ge3, gam2 sin1 zi1 dou3 sat6 zai3 ying4 lei6 gei2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每年都要计算折旧的，这样才能知道实际盈利多少。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to calculate depreciation every year to know the actual profit.

english_meaning: compromise; to meet halfway
explanation_mandarin: 指采取调和或中和的方式解决争端或达成共识。
explanation_english: To compromise; to meet halfway; to reconcile conflicting views or demands to find a mutually acceptable solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如折衷一下，每人退一步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 zit3 cung1 jat1 haa5, mui5 jan4 teoi3 jat1 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如折衷一下，每个人退一步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we compromise and each take a step back?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾輪談判，雙方終於達成咗一個折衷方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 leon4 taam4 pun3, soeng1 fong1 zung1 jyu1 daat6 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 zit3 cung1 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几轮谈判，双方终于达成了一个折衷方案。
examples.english_sentence: After several rounds of negotiations, both sides finally reached a compromise solution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇辦法，唯有折衷噉做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 baan6 faat3, wai4 jau5 zit3 cung1 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没办法，只能折衷着做了。
examples.english_sentence: There's no other way, we can only do it as a compromise.

english_meaning: discount, allowance
explanation_mandarin: 指在原价基础上减少一定的金额，给予优惠。
explanation_english: A reduction in the original price; an allowance given.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話如果我哋買多啲，可以俾多啲折讓我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 maai5 do1 di1, ho2 ji5 bei2 do1 di1 zit3 joeng6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说如果我们买多一点，可以给我们更多的折扣。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said if we buy more, he can give us a bigger discount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭做緊清貨大折讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zou6 gan2 cing1 fo3 daai6 zit3 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店正在做清仓大减价。
examples.english_sentence: This store is having a big clearance sale with significant discounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為貨品有啲瑕疵，所以佢哋俾咗啲折讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 fo3 pan2 jau5 di1 haa4 ci1, so2 ji5 keoi5 dei6 bei2 zo2 di1 zit3 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为货物有些瑕疵，所以他们给了一些折扣。
examples.english_sentence: Because the goods had some defects, they gave some allowance.

english_meaning: discounted price, concessionary price
explanation_mandarin: 以低于原价的价格出售的商品或服务。
explanation_english: The price of goods or services that has been reduced from the original price; a discounted or concessionary price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電視機有折讓價，抵買好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 si6 gei1 jau5 zit3 joeng6 gaa3, dai2 maai5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电视机有折扣价，划算很多。
examples.english_sentence: This TV has a discounted price, it's much more worth buying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以俾個折讓價你，但係數量要多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 zit3 joeng6 gaa3 nei5, daan6 hai6 so3 loeng6 jiu3 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以给你一个折扣价，但是数量要多一点。
examples.english_sentence: We can give you a concessionary price, but the quantity needs to be more.

english_meaning: to return; to go back; to retrace one's steps
explanation_mandarin: 指返回原来的地方。通常是因为忘记了东西，或者发现方向不对等原因。
explanation_english: To return to the place where one started, usually because something was forgotten or the direction was incorrect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗帶銀包，要折返屋企攞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 ngan4 baau1, jiu3 zit3 faan1 uk1 kei2 lo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记带钱包了，要折返回家拿。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my wallet, I need to go back home to get it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車行錯路，唯有折返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 haang4 co3 lou6, wai4 jau5 zit3 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车走错了路，只好折返。
examples.english_sentence: The car took the wrong road, so we had to turn back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行到一半，發現落雨，我哋即刻折返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 dou3 jat1 bun3, faat3 hin3 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 zit3 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走到一半，发现下雨，我们立刻折返。
examples.english_sentence: We walked halfway and discovered it was raining, so we immediately turned back.

english_meaning: To lose face, to be embarrassed, to be humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 指丢脸，出丑，名誉受损。
explanation_english: Refers to losing face, being embarrassed, or suffering damage to one's reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多人面前俾佢鬧，真係折頭死啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 keoi5 naau6, zan1 hai6 zit3 tau4 sei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前被他骂，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: Being scolded by him in front of so many people is so embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞咁多嘢啦，折頭嘅係你自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1, zit3 tau4 ge3 hai6 nei5 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别搞那么多事了，丢脸的是你自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make so much trouble, you're the one who's going to lose face.

english_meaning: to throw, to toss, to abandon, to discard
explanation_mandarin: 指用力扔或丢弃。
explanation_english: To throw forcefully or to discard, abandon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁拋垃圾呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 paau1 laap6 saap3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔垃圾啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't litter!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抛咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau1 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個波抛俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jeung1 go3 bo1 paau1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把球扔给我。
examples.english_sentence: He threw the ball to me.

english_meaning: to throw; to toss; to fling; to abandon; to give up
explanation_mandarin: 用手用力扔东西；放弃；丢弃。
explanation_english: To throw something with force using one's hand; to abandon; to give up; to discard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢将个波抛咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 bo1 paau1 zo2 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把球抛出去了。
examples.english_sentence: He threw the ball out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁轻易抛弃梦想啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji4 paau1 hei3 mung6 soeng2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易放弃梦想啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up your dreams so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒股票炒到输晒，最后抛晒啲股票走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 gu2 piu3 caau2 dou3 syu1 saai3, zeoi3 hau6 paau1 saai3 di1 gu2 piu3 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他炒股炒到亏光了，最后抛售了所有的股票走人了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost everything in stock trading and finally sold all his stocks and left.

english_meaning: to abandon; to leave behind; to dump; to give up
explanation_mandarin: 丢下，抛弃。也可以指放弃。
explanation_english: To abandon, leave behind, or give up something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抛低咗份工，去咗旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau1 dai1 zo2 fan6 gung1, heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了工作，去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned his job and went traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以就咁抛低佢哋唔理㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 zau6 gam2 jeung2 paau1 dai1 keoi5 dei6 m4 lei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能就这样把他们丢下不管！
examples.english_sentence: You can't just abandon them and not care about them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁輕易就拋低你嘅夢想啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 zau6 paau1 dai1 nei5 ge3 mung6 seung2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么轻易就放弃你的梦想啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up your dream so easily.

jyutping: paau1 go3 san1 ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5
english_meaning: To throw oneself into work, to go all out to work, to dedicate oneself to work
explanation_mandarin: 指全身心投入工作，非常卖力，不顾个人安危或利益。
explanation_english: Refers to throwing oneself wholeheartedly into work, working extremely hard, and disregarding personal safety or interests. It implies a high degree of dedication and commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗間公司，拋個身出嚟做嘢，真係好值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1, paau1 go3 san1 ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这家公司，挺身而出努力工作，真的很值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: He threw himself into his work for the company; it's really worth learning from him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使拋個身出嚟做嘢㗎，顧掂自己先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 paau1 go3 san1 ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5 gaa3, gu3 dim6 zi6 gei2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么拼命工作，先照顾好自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to throw yourself into work; take care of yourself first.

english_meaning: to polish, to buff
explanation_mandarin: 通过打磨使物体表面光滑发亮。
explanation_english: To make something smooth and shiny by rubbing it, especially with a machine or special cloth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗部機去拋光部車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 bou6 gei1 heoi3 paau1 gwong1 bou6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了机器去抛光车子。
examples.english_sentence: He took the machine to polish the car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個金屬表面要再拋光多幾次先至夠亮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gam1 suk6 biu2 min6 jiu3 zoi3 paau1 gwong1 do1 gei2 ci3 sin1 zi3 gau3 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个金属表面要再抛光几次才够亮。
examples.english_sentence: This metal surface needs to be polished a few more times to be shiny enough.

english_meaning: to dump; to sell off; to unload; to offload
explanation_mandarin: 大量出售商品、股票等，通常是为了避免更大的损失。
explanation_english: To sell off goods, stocks, etc., usually in large quantities, often to avoid further losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司財政出現問題，焗住要拋售啲資產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 coi4 zing3 ceot1 jin6 man6 tai4, guk6 zyu6 jiu3 paau1 sau6 di1 zi1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司财政出现问题，不得已要抛售一些资产。
examples.english_sentence: The company is facing financial problems and is forced to sell off some assets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市大跌，好多人驚到要拋售股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 daai6 dit3, hou2 do1 jan4 ging1 dou3 jiu3 paau1 sau6 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市大跌，很多人害怕得要抛售股票。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market crashed, and many people were so scared that they had to sell off their stocks.

english_meaning: to abandon one's wife and children, to desert one's family
explanation_mandarin: 指男子遗弃妻子和儿女，不尽家庭责任。
explanation_english: Refers to a man abandoning his wife and children, failing to fulfill his family responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爛賭成性，最後搞到要抛妻棄子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laan6 dou2 sing3 sing3, zeoi3 hau6 gaau2 dou3 jiu3 paau1 cai1 hei3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌博成性，最后导致抛妻弃子。
examples.english_sentence: He's addicted to gambling and ended up abandoning his wife and children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單止冇負起做老豆嘅責任，仲要抛妻棄子，真係好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 mou5 fu6 hei2 zou6 lou5 dau6 ge3 zaak3 yam3, zung6 jiu3 paau1 cai1 hei3 zi2, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 yam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不仅没有承担做父亲的责任，还要抛妻弃子，真是不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: Not only did he not take on the responsibilities of a father, but he also abandoned his wife and children, he's really irresponsible.

english_meaning: to show off one's knowledge; to flaunt one's learning
explanation_mandarin: 指人卖弄自己的学问，故意引用典故、生僻词语等，以显示自己博学。
explanation_english: Refers to someone showing off their knowledge, deliberately quoting allusions, obscure words, etc., to show off their erudition. It often carries a negative connotation, implying arrogance or pretentiousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人哋面前抛書包，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 paau1 syu1 baau1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在别人面前卖弄学问，很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always shows off his knowledge in front of others, which is very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為識多幾個字就拋書包，謙虛啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 sik1 do1 gei2 go3 zi6 zau6 paau1 syu1 baau1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为认识几个字就卖弄学问，谦虚一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can show off your knowledge just because you know a few more words; it's better to be humble.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to dump, to forsake, to reject
explanation_mandarin: 丢弃，放弃，不再要。
explanation_english: To abandon, to discard, to give up on, or to reject something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢男朋友抛棄咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 paau1 hei3 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友抛弃了她。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend abandoned her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁輕易抛棄你嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 hing1 ji6 paau1 hei3 nei5 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这么轻易地抛弃你的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: You can't abandon your dreams so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好抛棄啲舊嘢，可能有用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 paau1 hei3 di1 gau6 je5, ho2 nang4 jau5 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抛弃旧东西，也许有用的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw away old things, they might be useful.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to throw away
explanation_mandarin: 丢弃，放弃，不再要。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, or give up something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抛棄咗佢嘅家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau1 hei3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抛弃了他的家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好随便抛棄啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sui4 bin2 paau1 hei3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便丢弃东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things away carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司抛棄咗舊嘅技术。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 paau1 hei3 zo2 gau6 ge3 gei6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司抛弃了旧的技术。
examples.english_sentence: Their company abandoned the old technology.

english_meaning: to slack off; to not put in effort; to give up easily; to go easy (on someone); to let something slide
explanation_mandarin: 指做事敷衍了事，不认真对待，或者在某种情况下放宽标准，不严格要求。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something perfunctorily, not taking it seriously, or relaxing standards in a certain situation, not being strict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好抛水呀，今次考試好重要㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 paau1 seoi2 aa3, gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要放水啊，这次考试很重要啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off, this exam is very important!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知我哋熟，所以先至抛水俾我，俾我過關。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 ngo5 dei6 suk6, so2 ji5 sin1 zi3 paau1 seoi2 bei2 ngo5, bei2 ngo5 gwo3 gwaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道我们熟，所以才放水给我，让我过关。
examples.english_sentence: He knew we were familiar, so he went easy on me and let me pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工成日抛水，老闆遲早炒佢魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 sing4 jat6 paau1 seoi2, lou5 baan2 ci4 zou2 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作经常放水，老板迟早会炒他鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: He slacks off at work all the time, the boss will fire him sooner or later.

mandarin_meaning: 抛砖引玉; 抛出诱饵
english_meaning: To throw out a ball (idea/question/suggestion) for feedback or discussion; to test the waters; to float an idea; to prime the pump; literally: to throw a ball
explanation_mandarin: 比喻提出一个想法或问题，试探对方的反应或收集意见。就像抛出一个球，看看对方如何回应。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to throw out an idea, question, or suggestion to gauge reactions or gather feedback. It's like throwing a ball to see how others will respond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如抛個波出嚟，睇吓大家點睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 paau1 go3 bo1 chut1 lai4, tai2 haa5 daai6 gaa1 dim2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如提出一个想法，看看大家的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we float an idea and see what everyone thinks?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆想抛波睇吓大家接唔接受到減薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 soeng2 paau1 bo1 tai2 haa5 daai6 gaa1 zip3 m4 zip3 sau6 dou3 gaam2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板想试探一下大家是否能接受降薪。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants to test the waters to see if everyone will accept a pay cut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上面抛咗個波，問大家點樣可以增加銷售額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 paau1 zo2 go3 bo1, man6 daai6 gaa1 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 zang1 gaa1 siu1 sau3 ngak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上提出了一个问题，问大家如何增加销售额。
examples.english_sentence: He threw out a question at the meeting, asking everyone how to increase sales.

english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt; to grandstand; to seek attention
explanation_mandarin: 指故意表现自己，吸引他人注意，通常带有炫耀或卖弄的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately showing off in order to attract attention from others, usually with a sense of showing off or flaunting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺Facebook度抛浪頭，曬佢啲新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 Facebook dou6 paau1 long6 tau4, saai3 keoi5 di1 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在Facebook上炫耀，晒他的新东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often shows off on Facebook, showing off his new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁抛浪頭啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 paau1 long6 tau4 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么炫耀了，低调点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off so much, it's better to be low-key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗吸引人哋注意，咪成日喺度抛浪頭囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 kap1 jan5 dei6 zyu3 yi3, mai6 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 paau1 long6 tau4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了吸引别人注意，就经常在这里出风头。
examples.english_sentence: He always grandstands here to attract attention.

english_meaning: Parabola
explanation_mandarin: 数学术语，平面内到定点（焦点）和定直线（准线）距离相等的点的轨迹。
explanation_english: A symmetrical open plane curve formed by the intersection of a cone with a plane parallel to its side. In mathematics, it is the locus of points equidistant from a fixed point (the focus) and a fixed line (the directrix).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個籃球嘅軌跡係一條抛物線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 laam4 kau4 ge3 gwai2 jik1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 paau1 mat6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 篮球的轨迹是一条抛物线。
examples.english_sentence: The trajectory of the basketball is a parabola.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業發展好似抛物線咁，升到頂峰之後就開始下滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 faat3 zin2 hou2 ci5 paau1 mat6 sin3 gam2, sing1 dou3 ding2 fung1 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 haa1 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业发展好像抛物线一样，升到顶峰之后就开始下滑。
examples.english_sentence: His career development is like a parabola, rising to the peak and then starting to decline.

english_meaning: To flirt; to make eyes at someone; to come on to someone (often in a suggestive way)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性以不正经的方式向男性示好，带有轻浮、卖弄风骚的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman flirting with a man in a frivolous or suggestive manner. It carries a negative connotation, implying that the woman is acting improperly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個party度不斷咁抛生藕，想引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 party dou6 bat1 dyun6 gam2 paau1 sang1 ngau5, soeng2 jan5 jan4 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在派对上不停地卖弄风骚，想引起别人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: She kept flirting at the party, trying to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺街上面抛生藕啦，好核突㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 paau1 sang1 ngau5 laa1, hou2 hat6 dat6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是大街上卖弄风骚啦，很恶心的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always flirt on the street, it's disgusting!

english_meaning: To offer a humble opinion to elicit a better one; to throw a brick to attract jade; to offer a modest thing to attract something valuable in return (idiom).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先用自己不成熟的意见或作品引出别人更好的意见或作品。
explanation_english: This idiom means to offer a humble opinion or work to elicit a better one from someone else. It's a polite way of introducing one's own ideas while acknowledging their potential flaws and inviting feedback.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我拋磚引玉先，講下我嘅睇法，你哋再補充啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 paau1 zyun1 jan5 juk6 sin1, gong2 haa5 ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3, nei5 dei6 zoi3 bo2 cung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 让我先抛砖引玉，说说我的看法，你们再补充吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let me start by offering my humble opinion, then you can add to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係拋磚引玉，希望可以集思廣益，搵到解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 paau1 zyun1 jan5 juk6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zaap6 si1 gwong2 jik1, wan2 dou2 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是想抛砖引玉，希望可以集思广益，找到解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just offering my initial thoughts, hoping to get everyone's input to find a solution.

synonyms: 集思廣益 (zaap6 si1 gwong2 jik1)

english_meaning: to throw a brick to attract jade (idiom); to offer a humble opinion to elicit valuable ideas from others; to start the ball rolling (idiom)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先发表粗浅的意见或事物，引出别人高明的意见或更好的事物。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to offer a humble opinion or suggestion in order to elicit a better one from someone else; to initiate a discussion with a less than perfect idea in the hope of stimulating a better idea from the audience. It's a polite way of introducing your own (possibly less refined) idea.
