examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有时间，麻烦你抽出时间帮我看一下这份文件。
examples.english_sentence: If you have time, please find some time to help me look at this document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我盡量抽空出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeon6 loeng6 cau1 hung3 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会尽量抽出时间出席。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try my best to make time to attend.

english_meaning: cramp, muscle spasm; to act crazy, to lose it
explanation_mandarin: 1. 肌肉突然发生痉挛，疼痛。2. 形容人行为举止不正常，失去理智。
explanation_english: 1. (literal) Muscle cramp, muscle spasm. 2. (figurative, slang) To act crazy, to lose it, to go nuts, to be acting erratically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我踢波踢到抽筋啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tek1 bo1 tek1 dou3 cau1 gan1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我踢足球踢到抽筋了！
examples.english_sentence: I got a cramp from playing soccer!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔知做乜嘢抽筋，成日發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1 je5 cau1 gan1, seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天不知道怎么了，抽什么风，一直发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what's wrong with him today, he's acting crazy and throwing a tantrum all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁抽筋啦，冷靜啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cau1 gan1 laa1, laang5 zing6 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么抽风了，冷静点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so crazy, calm down!

mandarin_meaning: 笨手笨脚；做事不利索；冒失
english_meaning: Clumsy; awkward; inept; rash; careless
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人动作笨拙，做事不得要领，容易出错。也指做事冒失，考虑不周。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is clumsy, awkward, and not good at doing things, easily making mistakes. It can also refer to someone who is rash and does not consider things carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁抽筋菜啦，次次都打爛嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cau1 gan1 coi3 laa1, ci3 ci3 dou1 daa2 laan6 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨手笨脚的，每次都打烂东西！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you break things every time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好抽筋菜，做嘢成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 cau1 gan1 coi3, zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很笨手笨脚，做事总是出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very clumsy person, always making mistakes at work.

synonyms: 笨手笨腳(ban6 sau2 ban6 goek3)

english_meaning: to draw lots
explanation_mandarin: 通过抽取写有标记的竹签、纸条等来决定事情的结果或分配份额。
explanation_english: To draw lots; to pick a ticket from a collection of tickets to determine an outcome or assignment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋抽簽決定邊個先開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cau1 cim1 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们抽签决定谁先开始。
examples.english_sentence: We'll draw lots to decide who goes first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去廟抽簽問卜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 miu2 cau1 cim1 man6 buk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去庙里抽签问卜。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the temple to draw lots and seek divination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅幸運兒會喺抽簽入面產生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ge3 hang6 wan6 ji4 wui5 hai2 cau1 cim1 jap6 min6 caan2 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的幸运儿会在抽签中产生。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's lucky winner will be determined by a draw.

english_meaning: to draw lots; to draw a lot; lottery
explanation_mandarin: 通过抽取签的方式来决定结果或分配东西。
explanation_english: To determine the result or allocation of something by drawing lots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋抽籤決定邊個先開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cau1 cim1 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们抽签决定谁先开始。
examples.english_sentence: We'll draw lots to decide who goes first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廟度抽籤問卜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 miu2 dou6 cau1 cim1 man6 buk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在庙里抽签问卜。
examples.english_sentence: He drew a lot in the temple to ask about his fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樓花用抽籤形式嚟賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lau2 faa1 yung6 cau1 cim1 hang4 sik1 lai4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些楼花用抽签的形式来卖。
examples.english_sentence: These uncompleted apartments are sold by drawing lots.

english_meaning: drawn thread work, pulled thread embroidery
explanation_mandarin: 一种刺绣工艺，通过从织物中抽出纱线，然后在剩余的纱线上进行缝制，从而形成花纹或图案。
explanation_english: A type of embroidery in which threads are withdrawn from the fabric to create open spaces, which are then filled with decorative stitches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆好叻抽紗㗎，佢整嘅枱布好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po2 hou2 lek1 cau1 saa1 gaa3, keoi5 zeng2 ge3 toi2 bou3 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶很擅长刺绣，她做的桌布很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is very good at drawn thread work; the tablecloth she made is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲抽紗嘅圖案好精緻，睇得出好花心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cau1 saa1 ge3 tou4 on3 hou2 zing1 zi3, tai2 dak1 ceot1 hou2 faa1 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些刺绣图案很精致，看得出很费心思。
examples.english_sentence: These drawn thread work patterns are very delicate; you can tell a lot of effort went into them.

mandarin_meaning: 抽丝剥茧 (chōu sī bō jiǎn)
english_meaning: to unravel a complex situation; to get to the bottom of something by peeling back layers; to analyze meticulously
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从错综复杂的线索中理出头绪，逐步分析，找到真相。
explanation_english: A metaphor for unraveling a complex situation or problem by meticulously analyzing the clues and gradually uncovering the truth, similar to extracting silk from a cocoon layer by layer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單案好複雜，我哋要抽絲剝繭先可以搵到真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 on3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cau1 si1 bok1 gin2 sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案子很复杂，我们需要抽丝剥茧才能找到真相。
examples.english_sentence: This case is very complex. We need to unravel the situation layer by layer to find the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，我哋要抽絲剝繭噉樣分析每一個步驟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cau1 si1 bok1 gin2 gam2 joeng2 fan1 sik1 mui5 jat1 go3 bou6 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，我们需要像抽丝剥茧一样分析每一个步骤。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we need to analyze each step meticulously, like peeling silk from a cocoon.

synonyms: 層層剖析 (cang4 cang4 pau2 sik1)

english_meaning: liposuction, fat removal
explanation_mandarin: 一种通过手术方法将身体多余脂肪抽取出来的美容手术。
explanation_english: A cosmetic surgical procedure that removes excess fat from the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想去抽脂，減肥快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 heoi3 cau1 zi1, gaam2 fei4 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说想去做抽脂，减肥快一点。
examples.english_sentence: She said she wants to get liposuction to lose weight faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抽脂手術風險都幾高㗎，要小心考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 zi1 sau2 seot6 fung1 him2 dou1 gei2 gou1 gaa3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 haau2 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抽脂手术风险也挺高的，要小心考虑。
examples.english_sentence: Liposuction surgery has quite high risks, you need to consider it carefully.

english_meaning: to smoke (a cigarette, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指吸入香烟、雪茄等燃烧后产生的烟雾。
explanation_english: To inhale the smoke produced by burning cigarettes, cigars, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日抽菸，啲牙都黃晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cau1 jin1, di1 ngaa4 dou1 wong4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抽烟，牙齿都黄了。
examples.english_sentence: He smokes all the time, his teeth are all yellow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我唔好再抽菸喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cau1 jin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我不要再吸烟了。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me not to smoke anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺室內抽菸係犯法㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sat1 noi6 cau1 jin1 hai6 faan6 faat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在室内吸烟是犯法的。
examples.english_sentence: Smoking indoors is against the law.

english_meaning: to draw blood; blood draw; phlebotomy
explanation_mandarin: 从身体里抽取血液。通常用于医疗目的，如检查或献血。
explanation_english: To draw blood from the body, usually for medical purposes such as testing or blood donation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我聽日去抽血做檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 cau1 hyut3 zou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我明天去抽血做检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor asked me to go for a blood draw for a check-up tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好驚抽血㗎，成日驚痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 geng1 cau1 hyut3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 geng1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常害怕抽血，总是怕疼。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very scared of blood draws, I'm always afraid it will hurt.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself, to embarrass oneself, to lose face
explanation_mandarin: 指做出令人尴尬、出丑的行为，通常带有自嘲或嘲笑的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something embarrassing or foolish, often with a hint of self-deprecation or mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺巴士度唔小心踩到人，真係抽曬褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 m4 siu2 sam1 caai2 dou3 jan4, zan1 hai6 cau1 saai3 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在巴士上不小心踩到人，真丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally stepped on someone on the bus just now, it was so embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日喺老闆面前講錯嘢，抽曬褲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, cau1 saai3 fu3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天在老板面前说错话，丢死人了。
examples.english_sentence: I said the wrong thing in front of my boss yesterday, I was so embarrassed.

english_meaning: to transfer (personnel), to reassign, to second, to detach
explanation_mandarin: 从一个地方或部门抽调人员或资源到另一个地方或部门。
explanation_english: To transfer personnel or resources from one place or department to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定抽調佢去總公司幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 cau1 diu6 keoi5 heoi3 zung2 gung1 si1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定抽调他去总公司帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to transfer him to headquarters to help out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人抽調咗去前線部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 cau1 diu6 zo2 heoi3 cin4 sin3 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人抽调到前线部门了。
examples.english_sentence: He was transferred to the frontline department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情，好多醫護人員都被抽調去幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jik6 cing4, hou2 do1 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 dou1 bei2 cau1 diu6 heoi3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情，很多医护人员都被抽调去帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, many medical personnel were transferred to help.

english_meaning: abstract
explanation_mandarin: 指笼统、概括，不易理解或描述的具体事物。
explanation_english: Referring to something that is general, conceptual, and not easily understood or described in concrete terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫好抽象，我睇唔明佢想表達咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hou2 cau1 zoeng6, ngo5 tai2 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画很抽象，我看不懂它想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is very abstract, I don't understand what it's trying to express.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哲學嘅概念好抽象，要慢慢理解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zhit3 hok6 ge3 koi3 nim6 hou2 cau1 zoeng6, jiu3 maan6 maan6 lei5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哲学的概念很抽象，需要慢慢理解。
examples.english_sentence: Philosophical concepts are very abstract, you need to understand them slowly.

english_meaning: Abstract painting
explanation_mandarin: 一种不以模仿自然为目的，而是通过线条、色彩、形状等元素来表达情感或观念的绘画艺术形式。
explanation_english: A form of painting that does not attempt to represent external reality, but seeks to achieve its effect using shapes, colors, and textures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好識欣賞抽象畫，覺得睇唔明佢想表達啲咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 sik1 jan1 soeng2 cau1 zoeng6 waa2, gok3 dak1 tai2 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太会欣赏抽象画，觉得看不懂它想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really appreciate abstract paintings, I can't seem to understand what they're trying to convey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅抽象畫用咗好多鮮艷嘅顏色，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 cau1 zoeng6 waa2 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 sin1 jim6 ge3 ngaan4 sik1, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅抽象画用了许多鲜艳的颜色，很吸引眼球。
examples.english_sentence: This abstract painting uses a lot of bright colors, it's very eye-catching.

english_meaning: to take away, to withdraw, to remove
explanation_mandarin: 拿走，移走；从某个地方取走。
explanation_english: To take something away, to withdraw it, or to remove it from a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將張凳抽走咗，搞到我差啲跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zoeng1 dang3 cau1 zau2 zo2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把椅子抽走了，害得我差点摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: He took the chair away, causing me to almost fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行自動抽走咗我戶口啲錢嚟交費用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 zi6 dung6 cau1 zau2 zo2 ngo5 wu6 hau2 di1 cin2 lai4 gaau1 fai3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行自动从我的账户里扣走了钱来支付费用。
examples.english_sentence: The bank automatically withdrew money from my account to pay the fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好抽走我嘅希望呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 cau1 zau2 ngo5 ge3 hei1 mong6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要夺走我的希望啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take away my hope.

english_meaning: to detach; to withdraw; to disengage; to dissociate (oneself); detachment
explanation_mandarin: 指从某种状态或关系中脱离出来。
explanation_english: To detach oneself from a situation, relationship, or feeling; to withdraw or disengage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太投入呢套戲，好難抽離角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 tau4 jap6 ni1 tou3 hei3, hou2 naan4 cau1 lei4 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太投入这部戏了，很难从角色中抽离出来。
examples.english_sentence: He is so into this movie that it's hard for him to detach himself from the role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試吓抽離件事，客觀啲咁睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 haa5 cau1 lei4 gin6 si6, haak3 gun1 di1 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试着抽离这件事，更客观地看待它。
examples.english_sentence: I'll try to detach myself from the situation and look at it more objectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人失戀之後好難抽離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 hou2 naan4 cau1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人失恋之后很难抽离出来。
examples.english_sentence: Some people find it hard to move on after a breakup.

english_meaning: to take a cut (of profits); commission; kickback
explanation_mandarin: 指从交易或收入中提取一部分作为自己的利益或佣金。通常用于商业或不正当利益分配。
explanation_english: To take a percentage or commission from a transaction or income, often for oneself. It often carries a negative connotation, implying unfair or illicit profit-taking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做中間人，每單生意都抽頭抽唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zung1 gaan1 jan4, mui5 daan1 seng1 ji3 dou1 cau1 tau4 cau1 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做中间人，每笔生意都抽成不少。
examples.english_sentence: He's a middleman, and he takes a considerable cut from every deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔公平，成日諗住抽頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 gung1 ping4, seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 cau1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不公平，总是想着抽成。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is unfair; he's always thinking about taking a cut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程嘅利潤俾佢抽頭抽走咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 ge3 lei6 jeon6 bei2 keoi5 cau1 tau4 cau1 zou2 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程的利润被他抽走了很多。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of the profit from this project was taken by him as commission.

english_meaning: to purse (lips); to skim (cream)
explanation_mandarin: （1）合拢并收紧嘴唇：抿着嘴。 （2）轻轻地蘸取：抿一口酒。
explanation_english: (1) To purse one's lips. (2) To take a small sip; to skim (cream).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抿住嘴，好似唔想講嘢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 man5 zyu6 zeoi2, hou2 ci5 m4 soeng2 gong2 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抿着嘴，好像不想说话一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's pursing his lips, as if he doesn't want to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆抿咗一啖茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 man5 zo2 jat1 daam6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶抿了一口茶。
examples.english_sentence: The old woman took a sip of tea.

english_meaning: to purse one's lips, to press one's lips together
explanation_mandarin: 指合拢嘴唇，通常表示不悦、不同意、克制情绪等。
explanation_english: To press one's lips together, often indicating displeasure, disagreement, or restraint of emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到我嘅建議之後，抿嘴唔出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 ngo5 ge3 gin3 ji5 zi1 hau6, man5 zeoi2 m4 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到我的建议之后，抿着嘴不出声。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing my suggestion, he pursed his lips and remained silent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意我哋咁樣做，所以一路抿嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 ngo5 dei6 gam2 joeng2 zou6, so2 ji5 jat1 lou6 man5 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不喜欢我们这样做，所以一直抿着嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like us doing it this way, so he kept pursing his lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好抿嘴，有咩唔滿意就講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 man5 zeoi2, jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 zau6 gong2 chut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抿着嘴，有什么不满意的就说出来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't purse your lips, if you're dissatisfied with something, just say it.

english_meaning: stingy; miserly; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好抿屎，一蚊都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 man5 si2, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是太吝啬了，一元钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He is so stingy that he is unwilling to spend even a single dollar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁抿屎啦，請我飲杯嘢都唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 man5 si2 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么小气啦，请我喝一杯东西都不肯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, you're not even willing to buy me a drink.

mandarin_meaning: 掸, 拂拭, 轻微地擦过
english_meaning: to flick, to dust, to brush lightly, to stroke, to pass lightly over
explanation_mandarin: 用轻微的动作扫去灰尘或杂物。轻轻地擦过。
explanation_english: To remove dust or debris with a light movement. To brush or stroke lightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拂下啲灰塵先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat1 haa5 di1 fui1 can4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把灰尘掸掉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Dust off the dust first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用手輕輕噉拂過我嘅頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 sau2 hing1 hing1 gam2 fat1 gwo3 ngo5 ge3 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用手轻轻地拂过我的头发。
examples.english_sentence: He gently stroked my hair with his hand.

english_meaning: to fling one's sleeves and leave; to walk away in a huff; to leave indignantly
explanation_mandarin: 甩动衣袖离开。形容生气或不满意地离开。
explanation_english: To fling one's sleeves and leave. Describes someone leaving angrily or discontentedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到拂袖而去，咩都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 fat1 zau6 ji4 heoi3, me1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得拂袖而去，什么都不管了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he flung his sleeves and left, ignoring everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細一鬧，佢就拂袖而去，真係好冇 professional。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 jat1 naau6, keoi5 zau6 fat1 zau6 ji4 heoi3, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 professional.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板一批评，他就拂袖而去，真的很不专业。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the boss criticized him, he walked away in a huff. That's really unprofessional.

english_meaning: span (distance between the thumb and little finger when stretched out)
explanation_mandarin: 指张开大拇指和中指(或小指)两端的距离，约为20厘米。
explanation_english: Refers to the distance between the tip of the thumb and the tip of the middle finger (or little finger) when stretched out. Approximately 20 centimeters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用手拃咗拃張枱嘅闊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 sau2 zaa2 zo2 zaa2 zoeng1 toi2 ge3 fut3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用手量了一下桌子的宽度。
examples.english_sentence: He measured the width of the table with his hand span.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊布有五拃咁長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bou3 yau5 ng5 zaa2 gam3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块布有五拃那么长。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of cloth is five spans long.

english_meaning: To deliberately pick a quarrel; to nitpick; to find fault intentionally
explanation_mandarin: 形容故意找麻烦，无理取闹，鸡蛋里挑骨头。
explanation_english: Describes someone who deliberately causes trouble, is unreasonable, or nitpicks (finds fault even with minor things).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再拃亂歌柄啦，件事已經解決咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zaa2 lyun6 go1 beng3 laa1, gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再故意找茬了，事情已经解决了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep picking a quarrel; the matter has already been resolved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度拃亂歌柄，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 zaa2 lyun6 go1 beng3, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里故意找茬，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He is always deliberately finding fault, it's really annoying.

synonyms: 搵嘢嚟搞 (wan2 je5 lai4 gaau2)

english_meaning: to lean on; to prop up; to support oneself with (a stick or crutch); to stick
explanation_mandarin: 用棍子或拐杖等支撑身体；依靠其他东西支撑。
explanation_english: To support oneself with a stick, crutch, or other object; to lean on something for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路要拄住柺杖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 jiu3 zyu2住 gwaai2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路要拄着拐杖。
examples.english_sentence: He needs to use a walking stick to walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你扶我一把，畀我拄住你企起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 fu4 ngo5 jat1 baa2, bei2 ngo5 zyu2 住 nei5 kei5 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你扶我一把，让我靠着你站起来。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a hand, let me lean on you to stand up.

english_meaning: to dismantle; to demolish; to tear down; to take apart; to break up; to split
explanation_mandarin: 指把完整的东西分开、破开，或把建立起来的东西摧毁。
explanation_english: To dismantle, demolish, or tear down something whole or constructed; to break up or separate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拆咗間舊屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 caak3 zo2 gaan1 gau6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拆了一间旧房子。
examples.english_sentence: They demolished an old house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拆禮物
examples.jyutping_sentence: caak3 lai5 mat6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拆礼物
examples.english_sentence: To unwrap a gift

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拆夥喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caak3 fo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拆伙了。
examples.english_sentence: We are breaking up the partnership.

english_meaning: to dissolve a partnership; to break up a partnership
explanation_mandarin: 指合伙人之间结束合作关系，分开经营。
explanation_english: Refers to partners ending their cooperative relationship and separating to operate independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為意見不合，最後決定拆伙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai4 ji3 gin3 bat1 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 caak3 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为意见不合，最后决定散伙。
examples.english_sentence: Because of differing opinions, the two of them finally decided to dissolve the partnership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳經營唔掂，佢哋都拆伙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ging1 jing4 m4 dim6, keoi5 dei6 dou1 caak3 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间餐厅经营不善，他们都散伙了。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant wasn't doing well, so they broke up the partnership.

english_meaning: To demolish your house; I'll beat you up real bad (threat)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“拆你的房子”。实际上，这是句威胁的话，表示要把对方打得很惨，如同把他的房子拆掉一样。
explanation_english: Literally means "to demolish your house". Figuratively, it's a threatening phrase, implying that the speaker will beat the other person up so badly that it's as if their house has been demolished. It's used to express extreme anger and intent to cause serious harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再搞搞震，我就拆你屋！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, ngo5 zau6 caak3 nei5 uk1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再闹事，我就把你打得落花流水！
examples.english_sentence: If you cause any more trouble, I'll beat you to a pulp!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢激到話要拆我屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik1 dou3 waa6 jiu3 caak3 ngo5 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得说要拆我的房子。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he said he would demolish my house (beat me up badly).

synonyms: 打到你趴街 (daa2 dou3 nei5 paa1 gaai1)
打到你阿媽都唔認得 (daa2 dou3 nei5 aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 jing6 dak1)

english_meaning: to dismantle; to disassemble; to demolish; to remove
explanation_mandarin: 将物件拆开或拆除。
explanation_english: To take apart or dismantle an object or structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拆卸呢間舊屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caak3 se3 ni1 gaan1 gau6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拆卸这间旧房子。
examples.english_sentence: We need to demolish this old house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備拆卸部舊機器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 caak3 se3 bou6 gau6 gei1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备拆卸这台旧机器。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing to disassemble the old machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人開始拆卸棚架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 hoi1 chi2 caak3 se3 paang4 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人开始拆除脚手架。
examples.english_sentence: The workers started dismantling the scaffolding.

english_meaning: to sell separately; to sell in separate units; to sell off in parts
explanation_mandarin: 将整体分割成多个部分单独出售。
explanation_english: To sell something as individual components or units, instead of as a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發展商將成棟樓拆售，希望可以賺多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 zin2 soeng1 zoeng1 sing4 dung3 lau4 caak3 sau6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发商将整栋楼分拆出售，希望可以赚更多钱。
examples.english_sentence: The developer is selling the whole building as individual units, hoping to make more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司決定將業務拆售畀唔同嘅買家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 jip6 mou6 caak3 sau6 bei2 m4 tung4 ge3 maai5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定将业务分拆出售给不同的买家。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to sell off its business to different buyers.

mandarin_meaning: 揭穿西洋镜; 拆穿谎言; 砸场子
english_meaning: To expose a scam; to reveal a lie; to sabotage a situation; to disrupt a gathering (often with mischievous intent).
explanation_mandarin: 指揭穿某人的谎言或阴谋，使真相大白；也指故意破坏某项活动或场合，使其无法顺利进行。
explanation_english: Refers to exposing someone's lies or conspiracy, bringing the truth to light. It can also mean deliberately sabotaging an activity or occasion, preventing it from proceeding smoothly. Often used in situations where someone is trying to pull a fast one or where someone is being disruptive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想呃你錢㗎，好彩我拆地炮啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 aak1 nei5 cin2 gaa3, hou2 coi2 ngo5 caak3 dei6 paau3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想骗你的钱，幸好我揭穿了他。
examples.english_sentence: He was trying to cheat you out of your money, luckily I exposed him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好係人哋婚禮上面拆地炮啦，咁樣好冇品㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 jan4 dei6 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 caak3 dei6 paau3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 mou5 ban2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在别人的婚礼上砸场子啦，这样很没品。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sabotage someone else's wedding, it's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話俾我拆地炮咗，即刻唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 ngo5 caak3 dei6 paau3 zo2, zik1 hak1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说了谎被我揭穿了，立刻不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: He told a lie and I exposed him, he immediately didn't dare to speak.

english_meaning: to dissolve a partnership, to break up a business venture
explanation_mandarin: 指合伙做生意的人停止合作，解散合伙关系。
explanation_english: Refers to the termination of a business partnership or joint venture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為意見不合，最後都係要拆夥收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai4 ji3 gin3 bat1 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 caak3 fo2 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为意见不合，最后还是要拆伙收场。
examples.english_sentence: Due to disagreements, they had to dissolve their partnership in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生意唔好，佢哋傾過拆夥，各自發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, keoi5 dei6 king1 gwo3 caak3 fo2, gok3 zi6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生意不好，他们商量过拆伙，各自发展。
examples.english_sentence: The business wasn't doing well, so they discussed dissolving the partnership and developing their own ventures.

english_meaning: spendthrift; to squander family fortune; to ruin the family financially
explanation_mandarin: 指挥霍家产，导致家庭经济衰败的人，或指这种行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who squanders the family fortune, leading to financial ruin, or refers to this kind of behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賭錢，真係拆家㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou2 cin2, zan1 hai6 caak3 gaa1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天赌钱，真是个败家子。
examples.english_sentence: He gambles all day; he's really a spendthrift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣做，唔係會拆家㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 zou6, m4 hai6 wui2 caak3 gaa1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样做，不然会败家的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do it that way, or you'll ruin the family fortune!

english_meaning: to analyze a situation; to break down a complex situation; to decipher a situation; to solve a puzzle; to defuse a tense situation
explanation_mandarin: 原意为象棋术语，指分析棋局的走法。引申为分析复杂的情况、找出解决问题的方法，或化解紧张的局面。
explanation_english: Originally a chess term referring to analyzing moves in a chess game. Figuratively, it means to analyze a complex situation, find a solution to a problem, or defuse a tense situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好複雜，等我哋拆局睇下點搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, dang2 ngo5 dei6 caak3 guk6 tai2 haa5 dim2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很复杂，让我们分析一下看看怎么处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very complicated. Let us analyze the situation and see how to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識拆局，次次都可以幫公司解決難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 caak3 guk6, ci3 ci3 dou1 ho2 ji5 bong1 gung1 si1 gaai2 kyut3 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会分析局面，每次都可以帮公司解决难题。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at analyzing situations and can always help the company solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘈交，我試吓拆局，睇吓可唔可以氹返佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 cou4 gaau1, ngo5 si3 haa5 caak3 guk6, tai2 haa5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tam5 faan1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个吵架了，我试试调解一下，看看能不能哄回他们。
examples.english_sentence: They two had an argument. I'll try to mediate and see if I can appease them.

english_meaning: To demolish a house; To undermine someone; To sabotage (someone's efforts)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拆除房屋。引申义指拆别人的台，破坏别人的计划或名誉。
explanation_english: Literally means to demolish a house. Figuratively, it means to undermine someone, sabotage their plans or damage their reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日拆我屋啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 caak3 ngo5 uk1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是拆我的台！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always undermine me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想拆我屋，等我出醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 caak3 ngo5 uk1, dang2 ngo5 ceot1 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想拆我的台，让我出丑。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to undermine me, so I'll be embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊屋要拆屋重建。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 uk1 jiu3 caak3 uk1 cung4 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧房子要拆掉重建。
examples.english_sentence: The old house needs to be demolished and rebuilt.

english_meaning: to split the bill; to share expenses
explanation_mandarin: 指将账单或费用分摊给不同的人或团体。
explanation_english: To split the bill or share expenses among different people or groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食飯我哋拆帳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 faan6 ngo5 dei6 caak3 zoeng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃饭我们分账吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's split the bill for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊夾份租屋，所以每個月都要拆帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 gaap3 fan6 zou1 uk1, so2 ji5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 caak3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起合租房子，所以每个月都要分摊费用。
examples.english_sentence: We are renting a house together, so we need to share the expenses every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅收益要同股東拆帳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sau1 jik1 jiu3 tung4 gu2 dung1 caak3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的收益要和股东分账。
examples.english_sentence: The company's profits need to be split with the shareholders.

mandarin_meaning: 排雷; 排除危機; 化解矛盾
english_meaning: Defuse a bomb; defuse a crisis; resolve a conflict
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拆除炸弹。 比喻化解危机，排除困难，消除矛盾。
explanation_english: Literally means to defuse a bomb. Figuratively, it means to defuse a crisis, resolve difficulties, or eliminate conflicts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞到咁大鑊，依家要搵人拆彈至得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 gam3 daai6 wok6, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 wan2 jan4 caak3 daan6 zi3 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情闹得这么严重，现在要找人来解决危机才行了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has blown up so badly. Now we need to find someone to defuse the crisis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭成日畀啲爛攤子我哋拆彈，真係慘情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 seng4 jat6 bei2 di1 laan6 taan1 zi2 ngo5 dei6 caak3 daan6, zan1 hai6 caam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是给我们一堆烂摊子来收拾，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always gives us messes to clean up, it's really miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識拆彈，無論幾棘手嘅問題都搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 caak3 daan6, mou4 leon6 gei2 gik1 sau2 ge3 man6 tai4 dou1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会解决问题，无论多棘手的问题都能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at resolving problems, no matter how thorny they are, he can handle them.

english_meaning: HIBOR (Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate)
explanation_mandarin: 指香港银行同业市场中的短期借贷利率，反映了香港银行之间的资金供求状况。
explanation_english: Refers to the interest rate in the Hong Kong interbank market for short-term lending, reflecting the supply and demand for funds among Hong Kong banks. HIBOR is used as a benchmark for many financial products, including mortgages and loans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排拆息升得好快，按揭利息都跟住升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai1 caak3 sik1 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3, on3 gaai1 lei6 sik1 dou1 gan1 zeoi3 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近银行同业拆借利率升得很快，按揭利率也跟着上升。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the HIBOR has been rising very quickly, and mortgage rates are also rising accordingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅財務狀況唔好，借錢要畀好高嘅拆息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 mou6 zong6 fong3 m4 hou2, ze3 cin2 jiu3 bei2 hou2 gou1 ge3 caak3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的财务状况不好，借钱要付很高的银行同业拆借利率。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's financial situation is not good, they have to pay a very high HIBOR to borrow money.

english_meaning: To ruin one's reputation; to destroy a brand or image; to bring disgrace to a well-established name
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做出不好的事情，破坏了原有的好名声或声誉。
explanation_english: To ruin one's reputation by doing something bad, thereby destroying the original good name or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做咪即係拆自己招牌囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 caak3 zi6 gei2 ziu1 paai4 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是砸自己的招牌吗？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't what you're doing just ruining your own reputation?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間老字號如果再咁樣落去，遲早拆招牌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, ci4 zou2 caak3 ziu1 paai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家老字号如果再这样下去，迟早会砸招牌的。
examples.english_sentence: If this well-established brand continues like this, it will ruin its reputation sooner or later.

mandarin_meaning: 摆平, 搞定, 解决
english_meaning: to settle, to resolve, to fix (a problem), to get something done
explanation_mandarin: 指处理好某件事情，使之得到解决或完成。
explanation_english: Refers to handling a matter well, resulting in a solution or completion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一定要拆掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 caak3 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一定要搞定。
examples.english_sentence: This matter must be settled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，我會拆掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 wui5 caak3 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我会解决它的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will sort it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，乜嘢都拆掂到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, mat1 je5 dou1 caak3 dim6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能干，什么都能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable; he can fix anything.

english_meaning: to break up; to separate (people, especially a couple)
explanation_mandarin: 使原本在一起的人或事物分开。特指破坏情侣或夫妻关系。
explanation_english: To separate people or things that were originally together, especially to break up a couple or separate a married couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅父母唔鍾意佢哋拍拖，諗住拆散佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fu6 mou5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1, nam2 zyu6 caak3 saan3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的父母不喜欢他们谈恋爱，想拆散他们。
examples.english_sentence: Their parents don't like them dating and want to break them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易就放棄，唔好俾人拆散你哋嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 zau6 fong3 hei3, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 caak3 saan3 nei5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易就放弃，不要让人拆散你们的关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so easily, don't let anyone break up your relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個家庭俾一場意外拆散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gaa1 ting4 bei2 jat1 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6 caak3 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个家庭被一场意外拆散了。
examples.english_sentence: This family was torn apart by an accident.

english_meaning: To sabotage; to undermine; to ruin someone's plan or event
explanation_mandarin: 比喻破坏别人的计划或活动，使之失败。带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to sabotage someone's plans or activities, causing them to fail. It has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日拆樓啦，俾人搞搞震都唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 caak3 lau2 laa1, bei2 jan4 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 dou1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是拆台好吗？让人家搞一下也不行吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you not always sabotage things? Can't you let people just have a go?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明想拆樓，講啲嘢全部都係針對我嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 soeng2 caak3 lau2, gong2 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 zaam1 deoi3 ngo5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明了想拆台，说的话全部都是针对我的。
examples.english_sentence: It's obvious he wants to sabotage me. Everything he says is directed at me.

english_meaning: to dissolve a partnership, to close down a business (partnership)
explanation_mandarin: 指合伙人之间解除合作关系，或指店铺、摊位等结束营业。
explanation_english: Refers to the dissolution of a partnership between partners, or the closure of a shop, stall, or other business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為意見唔合，最後都係拆檔收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 ji3 gin3 m4 hap6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 caak3 dong3 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为意见不合，最后还是以解散合伙收场。
examples.english_sentence: Because of disagreements, they eventually ended their partnership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭做唔住，聽日就要拆檔喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zou6 m4 zyu6, ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 caak3 dong3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店做不下去了，明天就要关门大吉了。
examples.english_sentence: This shop can't survive anymore, it's closing down tomorrow.

english_meaning: to unpack containers (shipping); to open containers; to reveal secrets (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指打开集装箱，将里面的货物取出。引申义为揭露秘密，爆料。
explanation_english: Literally means to unpack shipping containers, taking out the goods inside. Figuratively, it refers to revealing secrets, exposing scandals, or breaking the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要喺碼頭拆櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 hai2 maa5 tau4 caak3 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天要在码头开箱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to unpack containers at the pier today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再問啦，再問我就拆你櫃喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 man6 laa1, zoi3 man6 ngo5 zau6 caak3 nei5 gwai6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再问了，再问我就揭你的底了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask anymore, if you keep asking I'll reveal your secrets!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登拆櫃爆料，想搞垮間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 dang3 caak3 gwai6 baau3 liu2, soeng2 gaau2 kwaa2 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意爆料揭秘，想搞垮那间公司。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately revealed secrets and broke the news to try and ruin the company.

english_meaning: to dismantle and break; to tear apart and destroy; to wreck
explanation_mandarin: 把东西拆开弄坏。
explanation_english: To take something apart and break it; to destroy something by tearing it apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友將啲玩具拆爛晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 zoeng1 di1 wun6 geoi6 caak3 laan6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们把玩具都拆坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The kids dismantled and broke all the toys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想拆爛間屋，然後重新裝修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 caak3 laan6 gaan1 uk1, jin4 hau6 cung4 san1 zong1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想把房子拆坏，然后重新装修。
examples.english_sentence: They want to tear down the house and then renovate it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁暴力，唔使拆爛佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bou6 lik6, m4 sai2 caak3 laan6 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么暴力，不需要拆坏它的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so violent, you don't need to break it.

english_meaning: to swindle, to con, to cheat someone out of money
explanation_mandarin: 指用欺骗的手段骗取别人的钱财。
explanation_english: To swindle or cheat someone out of their money, often through deception and false pretenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登拆白啲後生女，真係好衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 daang3 caak3 baak6 di1 hau6 saang1 neoi2, zan1 hai6 hou2 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门骗年轻女孩的钱，真是太坏了。
examples.english_sentence: He specializes in swindling young girls out of their money, he's really awful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲，唔好畀人拆白啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 caak3 baak6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心点，不要被人骗了！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't let anyone swindle you!

english_meaning: confidence tricksters who swindle money and sex, typically targeting wealthy women
explanation_mandarin: 指专门通过甜言蜜语和花言巧语来骗取女性钱财甚至感情的团伙或个人。通常以年轻英俊的男子为首，他们以恋爱为名，骗取对方的信任，最终达到骗取钱财的目的。
explanation_english: Refers to a group or individual who specializes in swindling money and even emotions from women through sweet words and flattery. Often led by young, handsome men who use romance as a pretext to gain the trust of their targets and ultimately swindle them out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋懷疑嗰個男人係拆白黨，專門呃啲有錢婆婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waai4 ji4 go2 go3 naam4 jan2 hai6 caak3 baak6 dong2, zyun1 mun4 aak1 di1 jau5 cin2 po4 po2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们怀疑那个男人是骗财骗色的，专门骗那些有钱的老太太。
examples.english_sentence: They suspect that man is a con artist who specializes in swindling wealthy old ladies.

mandarin_meaning: 破釜沉舟; 断绝后路
english_meaning: to burn one's boats; to cut off all means of retreat; to take a drastic and irreversible step
explanation_mandarin: 比喻采取非常决绝的行动，不给自己留任何退路。 祠堂在传统社会中具有重要的象征意义，拆毁祠堂意味着与过去彻底决裂。
explanation_english: An idiom that means to take a drastic and irreversible action, leaving oneself no way to retreat or return. The ancestral hall (祠堂) holds significant symbolic importance in traditional society, so destroying it represents a complete break with the past and the severing of all ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次真係拆祠堂，辭咗份工，仲賣埋間屋，決心去外國發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 caak3 ci4 tong4, ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, zung6 maai6 mai4 gaan1 uk1, kyut3 sam1 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次真是破釜沉舟了，辞掉了工作，还卖掉了房子，决心去国外发展。
examples.english_sentence: He has truly burned his boats this time, quitting his job and selling his house, determined to develop his career abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗攞到冠軍，佢哋拆祠堂，將所有嘅資源都擺晒落去訓練度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 lo2 dou3 gun3 gwan1, keoi5 dei6 caak3 ci4 tong4, zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 zi1 jyun4 dou1 baai2 saai3 lok6 heoi3 fan3 lin6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了拿到冠军，他们破釜沉舟，将所有的资源都投入到训练中。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win the championship, they burned their boats, putting all their resources into training.

english_meaning: to expose, to see through (a lie or disguise), to unmask, to reveal
explanation_mandarin: 揭露真相，使谎言或伪装显露出来。
explanation_english: To expose the truth, revealing a lie or disguise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話俾我拆穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 ngo5 caak3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说谎被我揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He lied and I exposed him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一早就睇穿佢嘅詭計，只係唔想拆穿佢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 zou2 zau6 tai2 cyun1 keoi5 ge3 gwai2 gai3, zi2 hai6 m4 soeng2 caak3 cyun1 keoi5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我早就看穿了他的诡计，只是不想揭穿他而已。
examples.english_sentence: I saw through his tricks a long time ago, I just didn't want to expose him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身份俾人拆穿咗，而家走佬喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 fan2 bei2 jan4 caak3 cyun1 zo2, ji4 gaa1 zau2 lou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身份被人揭穿了，现在跑路了。
examples.english_sentence: His identity was exposed and now he's on the run.

english_meaning: To expose the truth, to debunk, to see through a deception
explanation_mandarin: 比喻揭穿骗局，揭露真相，使本来隐藏的事情暴露出来。
explanation_english: A metaphor for revealing a scam, exposing the truth, and bringing hidden things to light. The 'peep show' or 'diorama' (西洋鏡) was a popular form of entertainment in the past, where viewers would see a scene through a peephole. '拆穿西洋鏡' refers to taking apart the box to reveal how the illusion was created.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅大話咁快就俾人拆穿西洋鏡喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daai6 waa6 gam3 faai3 zau6 bei2 jan4 caak3 cyun1 sai1 joeng4 geng3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的谎言这么快就被揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: His lie was exposed so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，我會幫你拆穿佢哋嘅西洋鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 caak3 cyun1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sai1 joeng4 geng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，我会帮你揭穿他们的谎言。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, I will help you expose their deception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔講真話，我就要拆穿你嘅西洋鏡喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 gong2 zan1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 caak3 cyun1 nei5 ge3 sai1 joeng4 geng3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不说真话，我就要揭穿你的真面目了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't tell the truth, I'm going to expose you!

english_meaning: to remove stitches; to cut ties; to break up (business relationship); to sever connection
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拆除缝合的线。引申义包括解除关系，解除合作关系等。
explanation_english: Literally means to remove stitches. Figuratively, it can mean to cut ties, end a business partnership, or sever a connection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手縫咗針，依家要拆線啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 fung4 zo2 zam1, ji1 gaa1 jiu3 caak3 sin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手缝了针，现在要拆线了。
examples.english_sentence: His hand was stitched up, and now the stitches need to be removed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為意見不合，決定拆線唔再合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai4 ji3 gin3 bat1 hap6, kyut3 ding6 caak3 sin3 m4 zoi3 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人因为意见不合，决定解除合作关系不再合作。
examples.english_sentence: Because they disagreed, the two of them decided to break up their partnership and no longer work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快放棄，唔好拆線呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3, m4 hou2 caak3 sin3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快放弃，不要断绝关系啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly, don't sever ties!

synonyms: 分手 (fan1 sau2) - to break up (romantic relationship)
解約 (gaai2 yeuk3) - to terminate a contract

mandarin_meaning: 分析透彻；彻底调查；挖出内幕
english_meaning: to analyze thoroughly; to investigate thoroughly; to get to the bottom of something; to dissect something
explanation_mandarin: 比喻彻底地分析、调查或揭露某件事的内幕。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to analyze, investigate, or expose the inside story of something thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢我一定要拆肉咁查清楚佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 caak3 juk6 gam2 caa4 cing1 co2 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情我一定要彻底调查清楚！
examples.english_sentence: I must investigate this matter thoroughly this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫得好深入，將成件事拆肉咁分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 sam1 jap6, zoeng1 sing4 gin6 si6 caak3 juk6 gam2 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告写得很深入，把整件事情分析得非常透彻。
examples.english_sentence: His report is very insightful, dissecting the whole matter thoroughly.

english_meaning: stock split
explanation_mandarin: 公司将现有股票分割成更多数量的股票，降低每股价格，使股票更易于交易。
explanation_english: A corporate action in which a company divides its existing shares into multiple shares to increase the number of shares outstanding, typically to make the shares more affordable and accessible to investors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司決定拆股，希望可以吸引多啲散戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 caak3 gu2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 kap1 yan5 do1 di1 saan2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定股票分割，希望可以吸引更多散户。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to do a stock split, hoping to attract more retail investors.

english_meaning: To break up a partnership; to dissolve a team; to go separate ways (especially in business or entertainment)
explanation_mandarin: 指团队或合作关系解散，不再继续合作。通常用于商业或演艺团体。
explanation_english: Refers to a team or partnership breaking up and no longer continuing to cooperate. Commonly used in business or entertainment groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個夾唔嚟，最後都係要拆舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gaap3 m4 lai4, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 jiu3 caak3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人合不来，最后还是要拆伙。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them didn't get along, so they ended up having to break up their partnership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個組合紅咗無耐就拆舞，真係好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 zou2 hap6 hung4 zo2 mou5 noi6 zau6 caak3 mou5, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个组合红了没多久就解散了，真是太可惜了。
examples.english_sentence: That group broke up shortly after they became famous, it's such a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果合作唔開心，不如早啲拆舞算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hap6 zok3 m4 hoi1 sam1, bat1 jyu4 zou2 di1 caak3 mou5 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果合作不开心，不如早点拆伙算了。
examples.english_sentence: If the collaboration is not happy, it's better to break up early and be done with it.

english_meaning: to dismantle a ship, shipbreaking
explanation_mandarin: 将船只拆解回收利用。
explanation_english: To dismantle a ship for scrap or recycling. It refers to the process of breaking down a vessel into its constituent parts for reuse or disposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間工廠專門拆船嘅，佢哋將啲廢鐵賣出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 cong2 zyun1 mun4 caak3 syun4 ge3, keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 fai3 tit3 maai6 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家工厂专门拆卸船只的，他们把废铁卖出去。
examples.english_sentence: That factory specializes in shipbreaking; they sell the scrap metal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拆船業喺一啲發展中國家仲好盛行。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅拆蟹專家，可以好快幫你拆好晒啲蟹肉。

explanation_mandarin: 将费用或利润按照一定比例进行分配和结算。
explanation_english: To split a bill or expenses according to a certain proportion; to settle accounts.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚分账吧，你把钱给我。
examples.english_sentence: Let's split the bill tonight, please give me the money you owe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳生意好好，所以佢哋要成日拆賬。

examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is doing very well, so they need to settle the accounts frequently.

english_meaning: to open (a package, letter, etc.); to take apart; to disassemble
explanation_mandarin: 将原本合在一起的东西分开。解开包装，或将组装好的东西分解。
explanation_english: To separate something that was originally put together. To open packaging, or to take apart something that was assembled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你拆開個禮物啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 caak3 hoi1 go3 lai5 mat6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你拆开礼物吗？
examples.english_sentence: Shall I open the gift for you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話跌咗落地，畀佢拆開咗。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個箱太重，我哋一齊拆開佢攞啲嘢出嚟啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个箱子太重，我们一起拆开它拿些东西出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: This box is too heavy, let's open it together and take some things out.

english_meaning: to dismantle; to demolish; to remove; to tear down
explanation_mandarin: 拆开并移走。指将建筑物、设备等拆卸或移除。
explanation_english: To dismantle and remove. Refers to disassembling or removing buildings, equipment, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備拆除舊樓起新樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun2 bei6 caak3 ceoi4 gau6 lau2 hei2 san1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备拆除旧楼盖新楼。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing to demolish the old building and build a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定拆除呢啲違例建築物。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定拆除这些违章建筑物。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to remove these illegal structures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拆除啲舊嘅設備，換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caak3 ceoi4 di1 gau6 ge3 sat1 bei6, wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拆除一些旧的设备，换新的。
examples.english_sentence: We need to remove some of the old equipment and replace it with new ones.

mandarin_meaning: 剔除骨头; 比喻彻底分析、剖析
english_meaning: Debone; to dissect, analyze thoroughly; to expose someone's flaws or secrets
explanation_mandarin: 原指剔除骨头。比喻彻底分析、剖析，通常带有揭露缺点的意味。
explanation_english: Originally refers to removing bones (from meat or fish). Figuratively, it means to thoroughly analyze or dissect something, often with the implication of exposing flaws or secrets. It can also mean 'to deconstruct'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將份合約拆骨咁分析，睇清楚晒啲細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 fan6 hap6 joek3 caak3 gwat1 gam2 fan1 sik1, tai2 cing1 co2晒 di1 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把合同像拆骨一样分析，把所有细节都看清楚了。
examples.english_sentence: He analyzed the contract like deboning it, examining all the details carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲傳媒成日想拆骨啲明星嘅私生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cyun4 mui4 seng4 jat6 soeng2 caak3 gwat1 di1 ming4 sing1 ge3 si1 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体总是想彻底揭露明星的私生活。
examples.english_sentence: The media always wants to expose every detail of celebrities' private lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係聽佢講，要拆骨咁諗清楚成件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 teng1 keoi5 gong2, jiu3 caak3 gwat1 gam2 nam2 cing1 co2 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.

examples.english_sentence: Don't just listen to him, you need to thoroughly analyze the whole story from beginning to end.

english_meaning: thumb
explanation_mandarin: 手指的第一节，靠外侧，通常也指大拇指。
explanation_english: The first digit of the hand, located on the outer side; commonly refers to the thumb.

english_meaning: thumb

explanation_english: The first finger of the hand, also known as the thumb.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 nim1 nim1 sim1 sim1 laa1, si6 si6 daan6 daan6 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么挑剔了，随便点就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, just settle for something average.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對食嘢好拈拈苫苫㗎，好多嘢都唔食。

english_meaning: To curve (grades); to adjust scores to a normal distribution; to raise the bar/standard
explanation_mandarin: 指在考试或评分中，为了使成绩分布更合理，或为了筛选出更优秀的人才，而对分数进行调整的行为。通常是提高整体的评分标准，使达到特定水平的要求更高。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of adjusting scores in an exam or evaluation to achieve a more reasonable distribution or to select more outstanding talents. It usually involves raising the overall grading standard, making the requirements to reach a specific level higher.

english_meaning: to procrastinate; to delay; to postpone

explanation_english: To delay or postpone doing something; to procrastinate.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 laa1 ding1 laa1, ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3 gaa3 laa3.

english_meaning: Latin dance
explanation_mandarin: 指起源于拉丁美洲的一系列舞蹈，包括伦巴、恰恰、桑巴、牛仔舞和斗牛舞。
explanation_english: Refers to a series of dances originating from Latin America, including Rumba, Cha-cha, Samba, Jive, and Paso Doble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳拉丁舞跳得好好㗎。
