examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会的时候，不要总是卖弄学问，直接讲重点吧。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, don't always flaunt your knowledge, just get to the point.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to forsake, to throw away
explanation_mandarin: 丢弃，放弃；不再要。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, or forsake something or someone; to no longer want or need something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拋棄咗佢隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paau1 hei3 zo2 keoi5 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抛弃了他的狗。
examples.english_sentence: They abandoned his dog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁容易就拋棄你嘅夢想㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 jung4 ji6 zau6 paau1 hei3 nei5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能那么容易就放弃你的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just abandon your dreams so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾佢老公拋棄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 keoi5 lou5 gung1 paau1 hei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她被她的丈夫抛弃了。
examples.english_sentence: She was abandoned by her husband.

english_meaning: to throw water; to intentionally lose (a game or competition); to give someone an easy time (especially in a competitive setting)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是扔水。引申指在比赛或竞争中故意放水，让对方容易获胜，或者给予某人优待。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to throw water'. Figuratively, it means to intentionally lose a game or competition, or to give someone an easy time, especially in a competitive setting. It implies showing leniency or deliberately underperforming to benefit another person or team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好拋水俾佢，要盡力打贏佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 paau1 seoi2 bei2 keoi5, jiu3 zeon6 lik6 daa2 wing4 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要放水给他，要尽力打赢他！
examples.english_sentence: Don't go easy on him, you have to try your best to beat him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試肯定係老師拋水俾佢，所以先咁高分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 hang2 ding6 hai6 lou5 si1 paau1 seoi2 bei2 keoi5, so2 ji5 sin1 gam3 gou1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试肯定是老师给他放水了，所以才这么高分。
examples.english_sentence: He must have been given an easy time by the teacher in this exam, that's why he got such a high score.

synonyms: 放軟手腳 (fong3 jyun5 sau2 geok3)

english_meaning: to throw out a topic; to test the waters; to float an idea
explanation_mandarin: 本意是抛球，引申义为抛出一个话题，或者试探对方的反应。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to throw a ball'. Figuratively, it means to throw out a topic of conversation to see how others react, or to test the waters and gauge someone's opinion or interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上面拋波，睇吓老闆點睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui5 yi5 soeng6 min6 paau1 bo1, tai2 haa5 lou5 baan2 dim2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上抛出了一个话题，看看老板怎么看。
examples.english_sentence: He floated an idea in the meeting to see what the boss thought.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要先拋波，睇吓佢哋接唔接受到個建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 paau1 bo1, tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 zip3 m4 zip3 sau6 dou3 go3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先试探一下，看看他们能不能接受这个建议。
examples.english_sentence: We need to test the waters first, to see if they can accept the suggestion.

english_meaning: to show off, to flaunt, to seek attention
explanation_mandarin: 指故意表现自己，引人注目，带有炫耀或卖弄的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately displaying oneself to attract attention, often with the connotation of showing off or flaunting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想拋浪頭，好煩啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 paau1 long6 tau4, hou2 faan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想出风头，真烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to show off, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺人哋面前拋浪頭啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 paau1 long6 tau4 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是在别人面前炫耀，低调一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always show off in front of others, it's better to be low-key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩之後，日日都拋浪頭，買晒名牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2 zi1 hau6, jat6 jat6 dou1 paau1 long6 tau4, maai5 saai3 ming4 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票之后，每天都炫耀，买了很多名牌。
examples.english_sentence: After he won the lottery, he showed off every day and bought a lot of brand-name goods.

english_meaning: parabola
explanation_mandarin: 数学名词，指物体在引力作用下，以一定的初速度抛射出去的轨迹。
explanation_english: A parabola is a symmetrical open plane curve formed by the intersection of a cone with a plane parallel to its side. It's the path an object takes when projected into the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個波俾佢踢咗出去，劃咗條好靚嘅拋物線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 bei2 keoi5 tek3 zo2 ceot1 heoi3, waak6 zo2 tiu4 hou2 leng3 ge3 paau1 mat6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球被他踢了出去，划出了一条很漂亮的抛物线。
examples.english_sentence: The ball was kicked out by him, drawing a beautiful parabola.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個水柱嘅噴射軌跡好似拋物線咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 seoi2 cyu5 ge3 pan3 se6 gwai2 zik1 hou2 ci5 paau1 mat6 sin3 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个水柱的喷射轨迹好像抛物线一样。
examples.english_sentence: The trajectory of this water column's spray looks like a parabola.

mandarin_meaning: 卖弄风骚；主动勾引异性
english_meaning: To flirt; to make advances; to come on to someone; to be coquettish
explanation_mandarin: 比喻女性主动以轻佻的言语或行动勾引异性。含有贬义，指卖弄风骚。
explanation_english: Metaphorically describes a woman who proactively flirts with or makes advances towards a man with flirtatious words or actions. It has a derogatory connotation, implying coquettishness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺啲男同事面前拋生藕，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 di1 naam4 tung4 si6 min6 cin4 paau1 sang1 ngau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是在男同事面前卖弄风骚，真令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: She always flirts with the male colleagues, which is really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣拋生藕啦，小心俾人話你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 paau1 sang1 ngau5 laa1, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样卖弄风骚了，小心被人说你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flirt like that, be careful people will talk about you.

mandarin_meaning: 抛砖引玉 (pāo zhuān yǐn yù)
english_meaning: to throw a brick to attract jade; to offer a humble opinion to elicit a better one; to make a preliminary offer to induce someone to make a more substantial one.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先用粗浅、不成熟的意见或事物引出别人更好的、更完美的意见或事物。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the act of offering a rudimentary or imperfect idea or action in order to draw out a better or more complete one from others. It's a self-deprecating way of inviting feedback and better suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅意見可能唔係最好，但係想拋磚引玉，睇下大家有冇更好嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 ji3 gin3 ho2 nang4 m4 hai6 zeoi3 hou2, daan6 hai6 soeng2 paau1 zyun1 jan5 juk6, tai2 haa5 daai6 gaa1 jau5 mou5 gang3 hou2 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的意见可能不是最好的，但我想抛砖引玉，看看大家有没有更好的建议。
examples.english_sentence: My opinion might not be the best, but I want to offer it as a starting point and see if anyone has better suggestions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先拋磚，講下我對呢個議題嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 paau1 zyun1, gong2 haa5 ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先抛砖引玉，说说我对这个议题的看法。
examples.english_sentence: I'll start by offering my initial thoughts on this topic, hoping to elicit better ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 抛砖引玉 (pāo zhuān yǐn yù)
english_meaning: To throw a brick to attract jade; to offer a humble opinion to induce others to contribute valuable ideas; to make a modest beginning to encourage others to improve upon it; to offer a preliminary remark in the hope of eliciting something more valuable.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻先用粗浅、不成熟的意见或事物引出别人高明的、成熟的意见或事物。是一种谦虚的说法，表示自己先发表粗浅的看法，希望引起别人更好的意见。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe the act of offering a humble or inadequate contribution in the hope of eliciting better ideas or contributions from others. It's a self-deprecating expression indicating that one is offering an initial, perhaps imperfect, idea to inspire others to share more valuable perspectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先拋磚引玉講下我嘅睇法，希望大家可以補充下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 paau1 zyun1 jan5 juk6 gong2 haa5 ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3, hei1 mong6 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 bo2 cung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先抛砖引玉谈谈我的看法，希望大家可以补充一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let me throw out a preliminary idea first, and hopefully, everyone can supplement it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係拋磚引玉，真正嘅專家仲未出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 paau1 zyun1 jan5 juk6, zan1 zeng3 ge3 zhun1 gaa1 zung6 mei6 cheut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是抛砖引玉，真正的专家还没出声。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just offering a preliminary opinion; the real experts haven't spoken up yet.

english_meaning: to stump; to embarrass someone (with a question or remark); to put someone in a difficult situation; to leave someone speechless
explanation_mandarin: 指通过提问或言语，使对方陷入尴尬、窘迫的境地，不知如何回应，也指难倒对方。
explanation_english: To put someone in an awkward or embarrassing situation, usually by asking a difficult question or making a sharp remark, leaving them unable to respond easily; to stump someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢問啲嘢咁深奧，擺明想拋窒我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 man6 di1 je5 gam3 sam1 ou3, baai2 ming4 soeng2 paau1 zat6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他问的问题那么深奥，摆明想让我们难堪。
examples.english_sentence: He asked such profound questions, obviously trying to stump us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住拋窒我，我識答㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 paau1 zat6 ngo5, ngo5 sik1 daap3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想让我难堪，我知道答案！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can stump me; I know the answer!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣講嘢，真係好容易拋窒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 paau1 zat6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那样说话，真的很容易让人尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: The way he speaks really makes it easy to embarrass people.

english_meaning: to throw to the back of one's mind; to forget completely; to put out of one's mind
explanation_mandarin: 把事情完全忘记或不再考虑。
explanation_english: To completely forget about something or stop considering it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都將啲功課拋諸腦後，所以次次考試都唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zoeng1 di1 gung1 fo3 paau1 zyu1 nou5 hau6, so2 ji5 ci3 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 m4 gap3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是把功课抛在脑后，所以每次考试都不及格。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts his homework out of his mind, so he fails every exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以將安全問題拋諸腦後，一定要小心謹慎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 on1 cyun4 man6 tai4 paau1 zyu1 nou5 hau6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gan2 san6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能将安全问题抛在脑后，一定要小心谨慎。
examples.english_sentence: We must not put safety issues out of our minds; we must be careful and cautious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將我嘅警告拋諸腦後呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 ging2 gou3 paau1 zyu1 nou5 hau6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把我的警告抛在脑后啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw my warning to the back of your mind!

english_meaning: to break down (of a vehicle); to drop anchor
explanation_mandarin: 本指船只放下锚，引申为车辆等交通工具发生故障，无法行驶。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a ship dropping anchor, it is now used to describe a vehicle breaking down and being unable to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺高速公路度拋錨，真係好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6 dou6 paau1 maau4, zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车在高速公路上抛锚，真的很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down on the highway, which is really troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架船喺海中心突然間拋錨，嚇死我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 syun4 hai2 hoi2 zung1 sam1 dat6 jin4 gaan1 paau1 maau4, haak3 sei2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船在海中央突然抛锚，吓死我了！
examples.english_sentence: The boat suddenly dropped anchor in the middle of the sea, it scared me to death!

synonyms: 死火 (si2 fo2 - to stall/break down)

english_meaning: to shirk responsibility; to abandon one's duties; to throw (the wok)
explanation_mandarin: 指放弃责任，把事情丢给别人不管，类似于“撂挑子”的意思。原指厨师将炒菜的锅扔掉，比喻不干了，不负责任了。
explanation_english: Refers to abandoning responsibility and leaving a task to others without caring. It's similar to 'passing the buck' or 'quitting'. Originally, it referred to a chef throwing away the wok, implying they're quitting and not taking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一唔鍾意份工就即刻拋鑊走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 m4 zung1 ji3 fan6 gung1 zau6 zik1 hak1 paau1 wok6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一不喜欢这份工作就立刻撂挑子走了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he didn't like the job, he immediately shirked responsibility and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁易拋鑊啦，試下解決問題先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 paau1 wok6 laa1, si3 haa5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易放弃责任，试着解决问题先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shirk responsibility so easily, try to solve the problem first.

mandarin_meaning: 抛弃, 摆脱, 忘掉
english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to throw aside, to get rid of, to leave behind, to set aside
explanation_mandarin: 放弃，摆脱，忘记（烦恼、顾虑等）。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, or forget (worries, concerns, etc.). To set aside something, whether it be physical or abstract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該拋開所有嘅憂慮，享受呢個假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 paau1 hoi1 so2 jau5 ge3 yau1 leoi6, hoeng2 sau6 ni1 go3 gaak3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该抛开所有的忧虑，享受这个假期。
examples.english_sentence: We should put aside all our worries and enjoy this vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定拋開過去嘅陰影，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 paau1 hoi1 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 yam1 ying2, cung4 san1 hoi1 chi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定抛弃过去的阴影，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to leave behind the shadows of the past and start anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗完成呢個項目，佢哋暫時拋開咗私人嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, keoi5 dei6 zaam6 si4 paau1 hoi1 zo2 si1 jan4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了完成这个项目，他们暂时抛开了私人的事。
examples.english_sentence: In order to complete this project, they temporarily put aside their personal matters.

mandarin_meaning: 甩开, 抛开, 远离
english_meaning: to leave behind, to outdistance, to shake off, to abandon, to break away from
explanation_mandarin: 指在竞争或比赛中，远远地超过对手，或者在生活中，远离某种境地或状态。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving someone or something far behind in a competition or race, or distancing oneself from a certain situation or state in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋跑得好快，將其他人拋離晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3, zoeng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 paau1 lei4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们跑得很快，把其他人都甩开了。
examples.english_sentence: They ran very fast, leaving everyone else behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想拋離過去嘅陰影，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 paau1 lei4 gwo3 heoi3 ge3 jam1 jing2, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想摆脱过去的阴影，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to shake off the shadows of the past and start anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司不斷創新，將競爭對手拋離幾條街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 bat1 dyun6 cong3 san1, zoeng1 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 paau1 lei4 gei2 tiu4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司不断创新，把竞争对手远远甩在后面。
examples.english_sentence: This company keeps innovating, leaving its competitors far behind.

english_meaning: to show one's face in public (often implying that it is inappropriate or undesirable to do so); to make a public appearance; to thrust oneself forward
explanation_mandarin: 指妇女在公共场合露面。有时含贬义，指人爱出风头，喜欢在公开场合表现自己。
explanation_english: To make a public appearance, especially referring to women. Often used with a negative connotation, implying that it is inappropriate or immodest to do so, or that someone is trying too hard to gain attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲女人唔可以隨便拋頭露面㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 neoi5 jan2 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 paau1 tau4 lou6 min6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的女人不可以随便抛头露面。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, women weren't allowed to appear in public casually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁鍾意拋頭露面，實係想紅囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 zung1 ji3 paau1 tau4 lou6 min6, sat1 hai6 soeng2 hung4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么喜欢抛头露面，肯定是想红。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to show his face so much, he must want to become famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都結咗婚啦，仲咁拋頭露面，唔怕俾人話咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 git3 zo2 fan1 laa1, zung6 gam3 paau1 tau4 lou6 min6, m4 paa3 bei2 jan4 waa6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都结婚了，还这么抛头露面，不怕被人说吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're already married, are you not afraid of people talking about you since you're making a public appearance this much?

jyutping: paau1 tau4 lou4, saaa2 jit6 hyut3
english_meaning: To sacrifice one's life and shed blood (for a cause); to lay down one's life
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了正义事业或革命理想而不惜牺牲生命。
explanation_english: Describes the act of sacrificing one's life without hesitation for a just cause or revolutionary ideal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗保衛國家，準備好拋頭顱，灑熱血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 bou2 wai6 gwok3 gaa1, zeon2 bei6 hou2 paau1 tau4 lou4, saaa2 jit6 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了保卫国家，准备好抛头颅，洒热血。
examples.english_sentence: They are prepared to sacrifice their lives and shed blood to defend the country.

english_meaning: to mix; to stir; to blend
explanation_mandarin: 指用筷子、勺子等工具将两种或多种东西混合在一起。
explanation_english: To mix or stir two or more things together using chopsticks, a spoon, or other tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食撈麵，撈麵要拌得勻至好食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 lou1 min6, lou1 min6 jiu3 bun6 dak1 wan4 zi3 hou2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃捞面，捞面要拌得均匀才好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating tossed noodles; tossed noodles taste better when mixed evenly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我拌下啲沙律吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun6 haa5 di1 saa1 lat1 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我拌一下沙拉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me mix the salad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好齋食飯，拌埋啲餸一齊食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zaai1 sik6 faan6, bun6 maai4 di1 sung3 jat1 cai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只吃饭，拌着菜一起吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just eat rice; mix it with the dishes and eat them together.

english_meaning: to pat; to clap; to take (a photo); to film
explanation_mandarin: 用手掌轻打; 拍摄; 影片拍摄
explanation_english: To gently hit with the palm of the hand; to take a photograph; to film a movie or video.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍咗我膊頭一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 zo2 ngo5 bok3 tau4 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拍了我的肩膀一下。
examples.english_sentence: He patted me on the shoulder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想拍張相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 paak3 zoeng1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想拍一张照片。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲拍得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 paak3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影拍得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is filmed very well.

english_meaning: To date (a female partner), to be in a relationship (with a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指与女性进行恋爱关系，通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Refers to dating a woman or being in a romantic relationship with a woman. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好似拍緊個新乸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 ci5 paak3 gan2 go3 san1 naa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近好像在和一个新的女朋友交往。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like she's dating a new girlfriend recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁靚仔，實好多女仔想同你拍乸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 leng3 zai2, sat1 hou2 do1 neoi5 zai2 soeng2 tung4 nei5 paak3 naa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么帅，肯定有很多女生想和你谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: You're so handsome, surely many girls want to date you.

english_meaning: to cooperate; to work together; to team up; to fight side-by-side
explanation_mandarin: 指互相配合，一起努力，共同完成某件事。通常带有并肩作战、互相支持的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to cooperating and working together to accomplish something, often with the implication of fighting side-by-side and supporting each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊拍住上，一定可以搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 paak3 zyu6 soeng5, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起合作，一定可以搞定他。
examples.english_sentence: If we work together, we can definitely handle him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project好重要，大家要拍住上啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project hou2 cung5 jiu3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 paak3 zyu6 soeng5 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目很重要，大家要合作啊！
examples.english_sentence: This project is very important, everyone needs to cooperate!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟由細到大都拍住上，感情好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 paak3 zyu6 soeng5, gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟从小到大都一起合作，感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: The two brothers have been working together since they were young, and they have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: to film a drama series; to act in a drama series
explanation_mandarin: 指拍摄电视剧，演员参与电视剧的演出。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of filming a drama series. It also implies acting in a drama series as a performer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家拍緊一套古裝劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 paak3 gan2 jat1 tou3 gu2 zong1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在正在拍一部古装电视剧。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently filming a period drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日拍劇拍到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 paak3 kek6 paak3 dou3 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常拍电视剧拍到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: They often film dramas until very late at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想做明星，所以報名參加咗個拍劇訓練班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 ming4 sing1, so2 ji5 bou3 meng2 caam1 gaa1 zo2 go3 paak3 kek6 fan3 lin6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想当明星，所以报名参加了一个电视剧拍摄训练班。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be a star, so he signed up for a drama filming training course.

english_meaning: to swipe a card; to tap a card (on a card reader)
explanation_mandarin: 使用卡片在读卡器上进行识别或记录，如上下班打卡、乘坐公共交通等。
explanation_english: To swipe or tap a card on a card reader for identification or logging purposes, such as clocking in/out at work or paying for public transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要喺公司拍卡返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 hai2 gung1 si1 paak3 kaat1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要在公司刷卡上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to swipe my card at the office to clock in every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭地鐵要用八達通拍卡先可以入閘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dei6 tit3 jiu3 yung6 baat3 daat6 tung1 paak3 kaat1 sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 zaat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乘坐地铁要用八达通刷卡才可以进站。
examples.english_sentence: You need to tap your Octopus card to enter the subway station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到咗，拍卡嘅時間都過咗九點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 zo2, paak3 kaat1 ge3 si4 gaan3 dou1 gwo3 zo2 gau2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迟到了，刷卡的时间都过了九点。
examples.english_sentence: He was late, the time he clocked in was after 9 o'clock.

english_meaning: Photography enthusiast, photography buddy
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢摄影的人，或者一起摄影的伙伴。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who enjoys photography, or a photography buddy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成班拍友星期日會去西貢影日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 baan1 paak3 jau5 sing1 kei4 jat6 wui5 heoi3 sai1 gung3 ying2 jat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一群摄影爱好者星期天会去西贡拍日落。
examples.english_sentence: Our group of photography enthusiasts will go to Sai Kung to photograph the sunset on Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅拍友，成日一齊去唔同嘅地方影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 paak3 jau5, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的摄影伙伴，经常一起去不同的地方拍照。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my photography buddy, we often go to different places to take pictures together.

english_meaning: to clock in/out (using a card or badge); to punch a time card; to check in/out
explanation_mandarin: 指使用卡片或证件在机器上记录上班或下班时间。也泛指签到、打卡。
explanation_english: Refers to using a card or badge to record the time of arrival or departure at work on a machine. It is also generally used to mean to sign in or check in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要準時拍咭返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 paak3 kaat1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要准时打卡上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to clock in on time every day for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日拍咗咭未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 paak3 zo2 kaat1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天打卡了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you clocked in today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得放工前要拍咭走呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 fong3 gung1 cin4 jiu3 paak3 kaat1 zau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得下班前要打卡离开啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to clock out before leaving work.

mandarin_meaning: 节奏; 节拍; 拍子
english_meaning: beat; rhythm; tempo; cadence
explanation_mandarin: 音乐中指有规律的强弱节奏; 比喻事情进行的节奏。
explanation_english: In music, it refers to the regular rhythm and tempo; figuratively, it refers to the pace of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跟唔上佢哋嘅拍子呀，佢哋行得太快啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 m4 soeng5佢dei6 ge3 paak3 zi2 aa3, 佢dei6 haang4 dak1 taai3 faai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跟不上他们的节奏，他们走得太快了。
examples.english_sentence: I can't keep up with their pace, they're walking too fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞嘅拍子感好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 paak3 zi2 gam2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她跳舞的节奏感很好。
examples.english_sentence: She has a good sense of rhythm when dancing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我地要跟住呢首歌嘅拍子嚟拍手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gan1 zyu6 ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 paak3 zi2 lai4 paak3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要跟着这首歌的节拍来拍手。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clap along to the beat of this song.

mandarin_meaning: 节拍器; 指做事一板一眼、缺乏变通的人
english_meaning: Metronome; (figurative) Someone who is rigid and inflexible, lacking spontaneity; someone who follows rules strictly
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是节拍器。 比喻指做事一板一眼、不懂变通，非常刻板的人。
explanation_english: Literally means a metronome. Figuratively, it refers to someone who is rigid, inflexible, and lacks spontaneity. They follow rules and procedures strictly without adapting to changing circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好似拍子機咁，一啲都唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 paak3 zi2 gei1 gam2, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事就像节拍器一样，一点都不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He works like a metronome, not knowing how to be flexible at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁拍子機啦，有時都要執生㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 paak3 zi2 gei1 laa1, jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 zap1 sang1 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么死板啦，有时候也要随机应变嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rigid, sometimes you need to improvise.

english_meaning: memo pad, roster, list of names, (slang) list of potential romantic partners
explanation_mandarin: 原指记录拍子或节拍的小本子。 现多指备忘录，记录人员名单的花名册，或者俚语中指记录潜在约会对象或追求者的名单。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a notebook for recording beats or rhythms. Now it mainly refers to a memo pad, a roster of personnel, or, in slang, a list of potential dates or people one is interested in pursuing romantically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有個拍子簿，上面寫滿晒啲女仔嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 go3 paak3 zi2 bou2, soeng6 min6 se2 mun5 saai3 di1 neoi5 zai2 ge3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一个花名册，上面写满了女孩的名字。
examples.english_sentence: He has a roster with the names of all the girls written on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞個拍子簿出嚟，記低晒啲嘢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 go3 paak3 zi2 bou2 ceot1 lai4, gei3 dai1 saai3 di1 je5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿出备忘录，先记下所有的事情。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take out my memo pad and write down everything first.

english_meaning: comparable to; on par with; to be a match for; to compete with
explanation_mandarin: 能够相比，达到或接近某个水平。表示在能力、质量等方面可以与某事物或某人相提并论。
explanation_english: To be comparable to something or someone; to be on par with; to match or compete with. It implies that the subject is able to reach a similar level of quality, ability, or achievement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅畫功已經拍得住啲名家喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waa2 gung1 ji5 ging1 paak3 dak1 zyu6 di1 ming4 gaa1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画功已经可以和那些名家相提并论了。
examples.english_sentence: His painting skills are already comparable to those of famous artists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物質素拍得住五星級酒店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 so3 paak3 dak1 zyu6 ng5 sing1 kap1 zau2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物质量可以和五星级酒店相媲美。
examples.english_sentence: The food quality in this restaurant is on par with a five-star hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係新人，但係能力已經拍得住啲老手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 san1 jan4, daan6 hai6 nang4 lik6 ji5 ging1 paak3 dak1 zyu6 di1 lou5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他是新人，但是能力已经可以和老手相提并论。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is a newcomer, his ability is already comparable to that of experienced professionals.

english_meaning: to pat one's chest (to show sincerity or confidence); to vouch for something; to guarantee
explanation_mandarin: 指拍打自己的胸膛，表示保证、承诺或很有把握。
explanation_english: Refers to patting one's chest to show sincerity, confidence, or to make a guarantee or promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我拍心口保證今次一定搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 paak3 sam1 hau2 bou2 zeng3 gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，我拍胸脯保证这次一定能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I guarantee you (by patting my chest) that I will definitely get it done this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍心口話一定會幫你，你信佢就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 sam1 hau2 waa6 jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 nei5, nei5 seon3 keoi5 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拍胸脯说一定会帮你，你相信他就行了。
examples.english_sentence: He guaranteed (by patting his chest) that he would definitely help you, you can just trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快拍心口，到時做唔到就尷尬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 paak3 sam1 hau2, dou3 si4 zou6 m4 dou2 zau6 gaam3 gaai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快拍胸脯，到时做不到就尴尬了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't guarantee so quickly, it would be embarrassing if you couldn't do it then.

english_meaning: to film a movie; to act in a movie; to put on an act (informal)
explanation_mandarin: 指拍摄电影，或者指演员表演。有时也指人装模作样，虚情假意。
explanation_english: Refers to the filming of a movie or the performance of an actor. It can also refer to someone putting on an act, being insincere or hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺橫店拍戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 waang4 dim3 paak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在横店拍戏。
examples.english_sentence: He is filming a movie in Hengdian right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度拍戲啦，我知你講緊大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 paak3 hei3 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 gong2 gan2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里演戏了，我知道你在说谎。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on an act here, I know you're lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想做明星，所以去咗參加拍戲嘅casting。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 zou6 ming4 sing1, so2 ji5 heoi3 zo2 caam1 gaa1 paak3 hei3 ge3 casting.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想当明星，所以去参加了电影拍摄的试镜。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to be a star, so he went to participate in a movie casting call.

english_meaning: to clap hands, to applaud
explanation_mandarin: 用两手相击发出声音，表示赞赏或庆祝。
explanation_english: To strike the palms of one's hands together, producing a sound, usually to express approval or appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完表演之後，大家都拍手拍得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 biu2 jin2 zi1 hau6, daai6 ga1 dou1 paak3 sau2 paak3 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完表演之后，大家都鼓掌鼓得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: After watching the performance, everyone applauded enthusiastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得咁好，梗係要拍手讚賞下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 gam3 hou2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 paak3 sau2 zaan3 soeng2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做得这么好，当然要鼓掌赞赏一下啦。
examples.english_sentence: He did so well, of course we should applaud and praise him.

english_meaning: to clap hands, to applaud
explanation_mandarin: 用手掌拍击，表示赞赏、同意或庆祝。
explanation_english: To clap one's hands, expressing approval, agreement, or celebration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表演得好好，大家都拍手掌讚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 hou2, daai6 ga1 dou1 paak3 sau2 zoeng2 zaan3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表演得很好，大家都鼓掌称赞他。
examples.english_sentence: He performed very well, everyone clapped and praised him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢嘅演講，我哋忍唔住拍手掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2, ngo5 dei6 jan2 m4 zyu6 paak3 sau2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的演讲，我们忍不住鼓掌。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to his speech, we couldn't help but applaud.

english_meaning: To be incorruptible; to have clean hands; to be free from corruption.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常廉洁，不贪污受贿，如同拍拍手，手上都没有灰尘一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely honest and incorruptible, like clapping your hands and having no dust on them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多年官都拍手無塵，真係好難得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 gun1 dou1 paak3 sau2 mou4 can4, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当了这么多年的官都两袖清风，真是很难得。
examples.english_sentence: He has been an official for so many years and remains incorruptible, it's truly remarkable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個貪污橫行嘅社會，要做到拍手無塵真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 taam1 wu1 waang4 haang4 ge3 se5 wui2, jiu3 zou6 dou3 paak3 sau2 mou4 can4 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 yi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个贪污横行的社会，要做到两袖清风真是不容易。
examples.english_sentence: In this society where corruption is rampant, it's really not easy to be incorruptible.

english_meaning: to leave without a care; to leave nonchalantly; to walk away without taking responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 指不负责任地、轻率地离开，不顾后果或不承担责任。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving irresponsibly and carelessly, without considering the consequences or taking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，拍拍屁股就走咗，真係好唔負責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, paak3 paak3 pat1 gu2 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 fu6 zaak3 yam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错了事，拍拍屁股就走了，真是很不负责任。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and just walked away without a care, he's really irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁樣，拍拍屁股就卸膊㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2, paak3 paak3 pat1 gu2 zau6 se3 bok3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这样，拍拍屁股就推卸责任！
examples.english_sentence: You can't just leave like that, walking away and shirking responsibility!

english_meaning: to dust one's butt and leave; to leave without hesitation or concern
explanation_mandarin: 形容毫不犹豫地离开，通常表示对某事或某地不再关心，或感到不满。
explanation_english: Describes leaving a place or situation without hesitation, usually indicating a lack of concern or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工咁差，我即刻拍拍籮柚走咗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 gam3 caa1, ngo5 zik1 hak1 paak3 paak3 lo4 jau2 zau2 zo2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作这么差，我立刻拍拍屁股走人了。
examples.english_sentence: The job was so bad, I dusted my butt and left immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到情況唔對路，就拍拍籮柚閃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 cing4 fong3 m4 dui3 lou6, zau6 paak3 paak3 lo4 jau2 sim2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到情况不对劲，就拍屁股走人了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the situation was not right, he dusted his butt and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁冇責任心，唔啱聽就拍拍籮柚走咗去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 zaak3 jam3 sam1, m4 ngaam1 teng1 zau6 paak3 paak3 lo4 jau2 zau2 zo2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么没有责任心，不合你意就拍拍屁股走开了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so irresponsible, just dusting your butt and leaving when you don't like what you hear.

english_meaning: to date; to be in a relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指男女双方进行恋爱活动，建立恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Refers to the activity of dating between a man and a woman, establishing a romantic relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗拖三年，就结婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 to1 saam1 nin4, zau6 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了三年恋爱，就要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for three years and are getting married soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近有冇拍拖啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 paak3 to1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近有没有谈恋爱啊？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been dating anyone recently?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋拍拖拍咗好耐㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 paak3 to1 paak3 zo2 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈恋爱谈了很久了。
examples.english_sentence: We have been dating for a long time.

english_meaning: Love Report; Dating Report; A report about one's dating life (often used humorously or sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 指恋爱经历的汇报，常用于朋友之间开玩笑，互相分享恋爱进展的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to a report or update on one's dating life. It's often used humorously among friends to share updates and details about their romantic relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你今日同條女點呀？快啲交份拍拖報嚟聽下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 gam1 jat6 tung4 tiu4 neoi2 dim2 aa3? faai3 di1 gaau1 fan6 paak3 to1 bou3 lai4 teng1 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你今天和那个女生怎么样啊？快点交一份恋爱报告来听听！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, how did things go with that girl today? Hurry up and give me a love report!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日聽你交拍拖報，幾時先有結果㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 teng1 nei5 gaau1 paak3 to1 bou3, gei2 si4 sin1 jau5 git3 gwo2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老是听你汇报恋爱情况，什么时候才会有结果呢？
examples.english_sentence: I always hear your dating reports, when will there be any results?

english_meaning: Date shift; Dating shift
explanation_mandarin: 指专门安排出来用于约会的时间或时段。
explanation_english: Refers to a dedicated time slot or shift specifically set aside for dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今個禮拜六晏晝要返工，夜晚先有拍拖更。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 luk6 aan3 zau3 jiu3 faan1 gung1, je6 maan1 sin1 jau5 paak3 to1 gaang1.

examples.english_sentence: We have to work this Saturday afternoon, so we only have a date shift in the evening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋咁忙，仲有時間排拍拖更，真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gam3 mong4, zung6 jau5 si4 gaan3 paai4 paak3 to1 gaang1, zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 yi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们这么忙，还有时间安排约会时间，真是不容易。
examples.english_sentence: You guys are so busy, it's really not easy to find the time to schedule a date shift.

english_meaning: to flirt, to chat up, to hit on someone, to woo
explanation_mandarin: 指主动接近异性，试图建立浪漫关系或进行性暗示。
explanation_english: Refers to actively approaching someone (usually of the opposite sex) with the intention of starting a romantic relationship or making sexual advances. It can also simply mean to chat someone up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒吧度拍拿條女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jyu1 baa1 dou6 paak3 naa4 tiu4 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒吧里搭讪一个女孩。
examples.english_sentence: He was chatting up a girl at the bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日淨係識得拍拿啲靚女啦，做返啲正經嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 paak3 naa4 di1 leng3 neoi2 laa1, zou6 faan1 di1 zing3 ging1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是只知道搭讪美女了，做回一些正经事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop just flirting with pretty girls all the time and do something serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻拍拿，次次都溝到女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 paak3 naa4, ci3 ci3 dou1 kau1 dou2 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会撩妹，每次都能追到女生。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at flirting, he always manages to get a girlfriend.

english_meaning: to applaud, to clap
explanation_mandarin: 用两手拍击发出声音，表示赞赏或庆祝。
explanation_english: To clap one's hands together to show approval or appreciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完表演之後，觀眾都拍掌讚好。

examples.english_sentence: After watching the performance, the audience all applauded and cheered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現好好，我哋應該拍掌鼓勵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 hou2 hou2, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 paak3 zoeng2 gu2 lai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的表现很好，我们应该鼓掌鼓励他/她。
examples.english_sentence: His/Her performance was very good, we should applaud to encourage him/her.

english_meaning: to film, to shoot (a picture/video)
explanation_mandarin: 指用照相机、摄影机等器材进行拍摄活动。
explanation_english: To film or shoot using a camera or other recording device.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去迪士尼拍攝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 dik6 si6 nei4 paak3 sip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去迪士尼拍摄。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Disneyland to film tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺香港拍攝緊一套新電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 paak3 sip3 gan2 jat1 tou3 san1 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在香港拍摄一部新电影。
examples.english_sentence: They are filming a new movie in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺博物館裏面拍攝呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 leoi5 min6 paak3 sip3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在博物馆里面拍摄啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't take pictures in the museum!

mandarin_meaning: 谈恋爱但并不认真；随便谈恋爱
english_meaning: To have a casual relationship; to date without serious commitment; to have a fling.
explanation_mandarin: 指谈恋爱，但双方都没有认真投入，关系比较随意和短暂。
explanation_english: Refers to dating or having a relationship where neither party is seriously invested or committed. The relationship is casual and often short-lived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋只係拍散拖啫，唔會結婚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 paak3 saan2 to1 ze1, m4 wui5 git3 fan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们只是随便谈谈恋爱而已，不会结婚的。
examples.english_sentence: They're just having a casual relationship; they won't get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家唔想拍長拖，拍散拖都OK嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 m4 soeng2 paak3 coeng4 to1, paak3 saan2 to1 dou1 OK ge3.

examples.english_sentence: I don't want a serious relationship right now; a casual one is okay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日拍散拖啦，搵返個真心嘅人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 paak3 saan2 to1 laa1, wan2 faan1 go3 zan1 sam1 ge3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是随便谈恋爱了，找回一个真心的人吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop having casual relationships all the time, find someone genuine.

english_meaning: to make a final decision; to finalize; to give the green light
explanation_mandarin: 指最终决定、批准或确定某事。
explanation_english: Refers to making a final decision, approving, or confirming something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細已經拍板，我哋可以開始個project喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ji5 ging1 paak3 baan2, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 chi2 go3 project laa3.

examples.english_sentence: The boss has already made the decision, we can start the project now.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 mei6 paak3 baan2, zung6 jau5 bin3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事还没定下来，还有变数。
examples.english_sentence: The matter hasn't been finalized yet, there are still uncertainties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等佢拍板先，我哋先可以confirm啲細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 keoi5 paak3 baan2 sin1, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 confirm di1 sai3 jit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等他拍板之后，我们才可以确认细节。
examples.english_sentence: We can only confirm the details after he makes the final decision.

english_meaning: to slap the table and exclaim in amazement; to applaud enthusiastically; to be highly impressed; to be breathtaking
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某事物非常赞赏，以至于拍桌子叫好，表示极高的赞叹。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely impressed by something, to the point of slapping the table and exclaiming in admiration, indicating extremely high praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個表演真係拍案叫絕，我從來未見過咁精彩嘅演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 paak3 on3 giu3 zyut6, ngo5 cung4 loi4 mei6 gin3 gwo3 gam3 zing1 coi2 ge3 jin2 ceot1.

english_meaning: partner, colleague, teammate

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我工作上嘅最佳拍檔。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 saang1 ji3 soeng6 ge3 paak3 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个是生意上的搭档。
examples.english_sentence: We are business partners.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们组了一个队，找了一个新搭档。
examples.english_sentence: They formed a team and found a new teammate.

english_meaning: to bang the table and stools; to make a scene; to create a commotion; to raise a fuss
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常生气或不满，通过敲打桌子和凳子来表达愤怒或不满的情绪，制造噪音和混乱。

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 hai2 dou6 paak3 toi2 paak3 dang3 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再在这里大吵大闹了，很吵！
examples.english_sentence: Stop banging the table and stools here, it's too noisy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得唔公平，喺會議上面拍檯拍凳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 m4 gung1 ping4, hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 min6 paak3 toi2 paak3 dang3.

explanation_english: Describes a situation where business is very bad, with few or no customers, leaving one idle and literally swatting flies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳最近生意好差，成日都喺度拍烏蠅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zeoi3 gan6 sang1 ji3 hou2 caa1, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 paak3 wu1 ying1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅最近生意很差，整天都在拍苍蝇。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's business has been very bad recently; they're swatting flies all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多公司都拍烏蠅。

english_meaning: to take a photo; to photograph

explanation_english: To take a picture using a camera.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起拍照留个纪念吧。
