examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，可唔可以幫我哋拍照啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 paak3 zaau3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，可以帮我们拍张照吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could you help us take a photo?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度唔俾拍照㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 m4 bei2 paak3 zaau3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里不允许拍照。
examples.english_sentence: Taking photos is not allowed here.

english_meaning: To applaud enthusiastically; to clap hands enthusiastically until they hurt
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常兴奋或满意地鼓掌，以至于手都拍红或拍痛。
explanation_english: Describes applauding with great enthusiasm and satisfaction, to the point where one's hands become red or sore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表演得好好，觀眾拍爛手掌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 hou2, gun1 zung3 paak3 laan6 sau2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表演得非常好，观众都热烈鼓掌。
examples.english_sentence: He performed so well that the audience applauded enthusiastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢嘅演講，大家都拍爛手掌表示讚賞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2, daai6 ga1 dou1 paak3 laan6 sau2 zoeng2 biu2 si6 zaan3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的演讲，大家都热烈鼓掌表示赞赏。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to his speech, everyone applauded enthusiastically to show their appreciation.

synonyms: 熱烈鼓掌 (jit6 lit6 gu2 zoeng2)

english_meaning: To break up a partnership; to terminate a collaboration; the partnership is ruined/broken up
explanation_mandarin: 指合作关系破裂，不再合作；也可以形容事情搞砸了。
explanation_english: Refers to the breaking up of a partnership or collaboration. It implies that the relationship or project has failed and the parties involved are no longer working together. Can also mean a situation has been completely ruined or messed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為分錢銀問題，最後拍爛檔收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan1 wai6 fan1 cin2 ngan4 man6 tai4, zeoi3 hau6 paak3 laan6 dong3 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人因为分钱的问题，最后以拆伙收场。
examples.english_sentence: Those two ended up breaking up their partnership due to disagreements over money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單project俾佢搞到拍爛檔，真係激死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 project bei2 keoi5 gaau2 dou3 paak3 laan6 dong3, zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这个项目被他搞砸了，真是气死人。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up this project so badly that the whole thing is ruined, it's infuriating.

english_meaning: to film, to shoot a video
explanation_mandarin: 指用摄影机、摄像机等设备进行影片拍摄。
explanation_english: To film or shoot a video, using a camera or video recorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去拍片，你嚟唔嚟啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 paak3 pin3, nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去拍视频，你来不来啊？
examples.english_sentence: We're going to film a video tomorrow, are you coming?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做緊YouTuber，成日都要拍片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 YouTuber, sing4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 paak3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在做YouTuber，每天都要拍视频。
examples.english_sentence: He's a YouTuber now, he has to film videos every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲啲效果好好，啲人拍片都好專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 di1 haau6 gwo2 ho2 ho2, di1 jan4 paak3 pin3 dou1 ho2 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的效果很好，人们拍视频都很专业。
examples.english_sentence: The effects of this movie are very good, and the people filming it are very professional.

mandarin_meaning: 硬撑; 硬扛; 顶上
english_meaning: to step in; to fill in for someone (usually unexpectedly or reluctantly); to cover for someone; to hold the fort; to pinch-hit
explanation_mandarin: 指在别人遇到困难或缺席时，临时顶替或支援，通常带有不情愿或紧急的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily filling in or supporting someone when they encounter difficulties or are absent, often implying reluctance or urgency. It's like stepping in to cover for someone at short notice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日病咗冇返工，我唯有拍硬檔幫佢搞掂啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 beng6 zo2 mou5 faan1 gung1, ngo5 wai4 jau5 paak3 ngaang6 dong3 bong1 keoi5 gaau2 dim6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天生病没上班，我只好硬着头皮帮他把事情处理完。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick today and didn't come to work, so I have to step in and help him finish his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日個presentation佢嚟唔到，我又要拍硬檔喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 go3 presentation keoi5 lai4 m4 dou2, ngo5 jau6 jiu3 paak3 ngaang6 dong3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天他不能来做报告，我又得硬撑了。
examples.english_sentence: He can't make the presentation tomorrow, so I have to cover for him again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇人肯做，惟有我拍硬檔頂住先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jan4 hang2 zou6, wai4 jau5 ngo5 paak3 ngaang6 dong3 ding2 zyu6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没人愿意做，只好我硬撑着先了。
examples.english_sentence: No one is willing to do it, so I have to hold the fort for now.

english_meaning: notepad
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于记录的本子，通常由多张纸用胶水或其他方式粘在一起，方便撕取。
explanation_english: A notepad, a block of paper sheets glued or bound together at one edge for easy tearing off, used for taking notes or writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺公司成日都用拍紙簿嚟記低啲重要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 paak3 zi2 bou2 lai4 gei3 dai2 di1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公司总是用便笺簿来记下一些重要的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I always use a notepad at the office to jot down important things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借我張拍紙簿吖，我想寫低個電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 ngo5 zoeng1 paak3 zi2 bou2 aa1, ngo5 soeng2 se2 dai2 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 借我一张便笺簿，我想写下电话号码。
examples.english_sentence: Lend me a notepad, I want to write down the phone number.

english_meaning: Pat on the shoulder; to use personal connections or influence; to ask for a favor or cooperation personally, often informally
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拍打肩膀。引申为通过私人关系或非正式的方式请求帮忙或合作，带有亲近和拉拢的意味。
explanation_english: Literally means 'pat on the shoulder'. Figuratively, it means to use personal connections or informal approaches to ask for help or cooperation, often implying a sense of closeness and building rapport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你拍膊頭搵佢幫手，應該冇問題嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 paak3 bok3 tau4 wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2, ying1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去找他拍拍肩膀让他帮忙，应该没问题的。
examples.english_sentence: If you go to him personally and ask for help, there shouldn't be any problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住拍膊頭，有時都要跟返規矩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nim2 zyu6 paak3 bok3 tau4, yau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 gan1 faan1 kwai1 geui2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着靠关系，有时候也要遵守规矩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on personal connections; sometimes you need to follow the rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍膊頭叫我今晚加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 bok3 tau4 giu3 ngo5 gam1 maan1 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拍拍我的肩膀叫我今晚加班。
examples.english_sentence: He patted me on the shoulder and asked me to work overtime tonight.

english_meaning: auction
explanation_mandarin: 指公开出卖货物，由买方竞相出价，最后由出价最高者购得。
explanation_english: A public sale in which goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間畫廊聽日會搞個慈善拍賣，籌錢幫助啲小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 waa2 long4 ting1 jat6 wui5 gaau2 go3 ci4 sin6 paak3 maai6, cau4 cin2 bong1 zo6 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间画廊明天会举办一场慈善拍卖，筹钱帮助一些小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: The art gallery is holding a charity auction tomorrow to raise money to help some children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件古董值錢到要用拍賣嘅方式先賣得出好價錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gu2 dung2 zik6 cin2 dou3 jiu3 yung6 paak3 maai6 ge3 fong1 sik1 sin1 maai6 dak1 ceot1 hou2 gaa3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件古董值钱到要用拍卖的方式才能卖出好价钱。
examples.english_sentence: This antique is so valuable that it needs to be sold through an auction to get a good price.

english_meaning: auction house
explanation_mandarin: 进行拍卖交易的场所或机构。
explanation_english: A company or establishment that conducts auctions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想將幅畫拎去拍賣行賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 fuk1 waa2 ling1 heoi3 paak3 mui6 hong4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想把这幅画拿到拍卖行卖。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to take this painting to the auction house to sell.

mandarin_meaning: 约会; 交往; 谈恋爱
english_meaning: To date; to go out with (someone romantically); to be in a relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间进行约会、交往，建立恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of dating, going out, or being in a romantic relationship between a man and a woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗跳幾個月就結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 tiu3 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们交往了几个月就结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They dated for a few months and then got married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近有冇同邊個拍跳啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 tung4 bin1 go3 paak3 tiu3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近有没有和谁谈恋爱啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you dating anyone recently?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍跳拍得好開心噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 tiu3 paak3 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们约会得看起来很开心。
examples.english_sentence: They seem to be having a lot of fun dating.

english_meaning: to be in a long-term relationship
explanation_mandarin: 指持续时间较长的恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a romantic relationship that lasts for a significant amount of time; to be in a long-term relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗好耐長拖，差唔多結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 hou2 noi6 coeng4 to1, caa1 m4 do1 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了很久的恋爱，差不多要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been in a long-term relationship for a long time, and they're almost getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想淨係拍散拖，想搵個可以拍長拖嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 paak3 saan2 to1, soeng2 wan2 go3 ho2 ji5 paak3 coeng4 to1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想只是谈短暂的恋爱，想找一个可以长期恋爱的人。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to just have short-term relationships; I want to find someone I can have a long-term relationship with.

english_meaning: to knock on a door
explanation_mandarin: 用手敲打门，表示请求进入或引起注意。
explanation_english: To knock on a door, typically to ask for entry or to get someone's attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日拍門記得大力啲啊，阿婆聽唔到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 paak3 mun4 gei3 dak1 daai6 lik6 di1 aa3, aa3 po4 ting1 m4 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天敲门记得用力一点啊，奶奶听不到的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to knock louder tomorrow; Grandma can't hear very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我拍門拍咗好耐都冇人應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 paak3 mun4 paak3 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 jan4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我敲了很久的门都没人回应。
examples.english_sentence: I knocked on the door for a long time, but no one answered.

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to suck up to
explanation_mandarin: 比喻奉承、谄媚别人，以求得到好处。
explanation_english: To flatter someone, especially a superior, in order to gain favor or advantage. It implies insincere praise and opportunistic behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺老細面前拍馬，真係好肉酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 paak3 maa5, zan1 hai6 hou2 juk6 saan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在老板面前拍马屁，真难看。
examples.english_sentence: He flatters the boss every day, it's really disgusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住拍馬，自己努力先至係最重要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 paak3 maa5, zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着拍马屁，自己努力才是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about flattering, your own effort is the most important.

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to suck up to someone
explanation_mandarin: 通过奉承、讨好来获取他人的好感或利益。
explanation_english: To flatter someone, often in a way that is insincere, in order to gain favor or advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺老細面前拍馬屁，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 paak3 maa5 pei3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前拍马屁，想升职啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's always brown-nosing the boss, trying to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為拍馬屁就有用，最緊要係做好自己嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 paak3 maa5 pei3 zau6 jau5 jung6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为拍马屁有用，最重要的是做好自己的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think flattering is useful; the most important thing is to do your own job well.

english_meaning: to take, to carry, to fetch, to grab
explanation_mandarin: 指用手拿起或携带物品。
explanation_english: Refers to picking up or carrying something with your hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎住啲嘢唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 zyu6 di1 je5 m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿着这些东西，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: Please hold these things, thank you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你拎埋佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 ling1 maai4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你把他也拿着吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let me help you carry him/it as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我拎個袋上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 go3 doi2 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把袋子拿上去。
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me take the bag upstairs?

english_meaning: to take away; to carry away
explanation_mandarin: 指拿取某物并带离原来所在的地方。
explanation_english: To take something away from its original location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食唔晒嘅話，我可以幫你拎走佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 m4 saai3 ge3 waa2, ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 ling1 zau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你吃不完的话，我可以帮你拿走它。
examples.english_sentence: If you can't finish it, I can help you take it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我想將個外賣拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 go3 ngoi6 maai2 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我想把外卖拿走。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I would like to take away the takeout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得拎走你啲嘢呀，唔好漏低喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 ling1 zau2 nei5 di1 je5 aa3, m4 hou2 lau6 dai1 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拿走你的东西啊，不要漏在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take your things, don't leave them here.

english_meaning: to take; to hold; to grab; to fetch
explanation_mandarin: 表示用手取东西。相当于普通话的“拿”。
explanation_english: To take something with the hand. Equivalent to "拿" in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拏住個袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa4 zyu6 go3 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿着这个袋子。
examples.english_sentence: Hold this bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拏咗本書走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naa4 zo2 bun2 syu1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一本书走了。
examples.english_sentence: He took a book and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲拏啲嘢食嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 naa4 di1 je5 sik6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点拿些东西来吃。
examples.english_sentence: Hurry up and bring some food to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 拐骗, 骗走, 拐弯
english_meaning: to kidnap, to abduct, to trick, to swindle, to turn (a corner)
explanation_mandarin: 指用欺骗的手段把人或财物骗走，或是指转弯。
explanation_english: To kidnap or abduct someone by trickery; to swindle or deceive; or to turn a corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拐咗個細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gwaai2 zo2 go3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拐走了小孩。
examples.english_sentence: They kidnapped the child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行前邊個路口就要拐彎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 cin4 bin1 go3 lou6 hau2 zau6 jiu3 gwaai2 waan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走到前面的路口就要转弯了。
examples.english_sentence: You need to turn at the intersection ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拐咗我啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwaai2 zo2 ngo5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他骗走了我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He swindled me out of my money.

english_meaning: child abductor, kidnapper of children
explanation_mandarin: 专门拐卖儿童的人。是对人贩子的称呼，带有贬义。
explanation_english: A person who specializes in abducting and trafficking children. A derogatory term for child abductors/kidnappers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔出街要小心啲，唔好跟陌生人走，費事俾拐子佬拐走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 ceot1 gaai1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 gan1 mo6 sang1 jan4 zau2, fai3 si6 bei2 gwaai2 zi2 lou2 gwaai2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子出门要小心点，不要跟陌生人走，免得被人贩子拐走。
examples.english_sentence: Children should be careful when going out and not follow strangers, to avoid being kidnapped by child abductors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時好多人驚拐子佬，所以啲細路仔都好少自己出去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2陣時好 do1 jan4 geng1 gwaai2 zi2 lou2, so2 ji5 di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 dou1 hou2 siu2 zi6 gei2 ceot1 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时候很多人害怕人贩子，所以小孩子们都很少自己出去玩。
examples.english_sentence: Back then, many people were afraid of child abductors, so children rarely went out to play by themselves.

english_meaning: to kidnap, to abduct, to traffic (people)
explanation_mandarin: 指用欺骗或强迫的手段把人（通常是儿童）带走，通常用于非法目的。
explanation_english: To kidnap or abduct someone, often a child, usually for illegal purposes such as trafficking or ransom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人會拐帶細路去乞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 gwaai2 daai3 sai3 lou2 heoi3 hat1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人会拐骗小孩去乞讨。
examples.english_sentence: Some people kidnap children to use them for begging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察捉咗個拐帶兒童嘅人販。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2 go3 gwaai2 daai3 ji4 tung4 ge3 jan4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓住了一个人贩子，这个人拐卖儿童。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested a human trafficker who abducts children.

english_meaning: to turn a corner; to make a turn; to beat around the bush; indirect; to mince words
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义是转弯，引申义是不直接表达，说话绕弯子。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to turn a corner'. Figuratively, it means to speak indirectly, to beat around the bush, or to not be straightforward in one's communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好拐彎抹角啦，有咩就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gwaai2 waan1 mut3 gok3 laa1, jau5 me1 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拐弯抹角了，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop beating around the bush, just say what you need to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面拐彎就到我屋企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 gwaai2 waan1 zau6 dou3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面转弯就到我家了。
examples.english_sentence: Turn the corner up ahead, and we'll be at my place.

synonyms: 轉彎抹角 (zyun2 waan1 mut3 gok3)

english_meaning: walking stick, crutch
explanation_mandarin: 一种用作辅助行走的工具，通常是长棍或带弯柄的棍子。
explanation_english: A stick or staff used as an aid in walking, typically used by elderly or disabled people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆行路要攞住支拐杖先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 haang4 lou6 jiu3 lo2 zyu6 zi1 gwaai2 zoeng6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶走路需要拿着拐杖才行。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma needs to use a walking stick to walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻腳受傷，要用拐杖輔助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 goek3 sau6 soeng1, jiu3 yung6 gwaai2 zoeng6 fu6 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脚受伤了，需要用拐杖辅助。
examples.english_sentence: His leg is injured, he needs to use a crutch for support.

english_meaning: to pinch; to clamp; to grip with pincers
explanation_mandarin: 用工具夹住或紧紧抓住。
explanation_english: To pinch or grip tightly with a tool or fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好拑我塊面啊，好痛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kim4 ngo5 faai3 min6 aa3, hou2 tung3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要捏我的脸啊，很痛的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pinch my face, it hurts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用鉗拑住條電線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 kim4 kim4 jyu6 tiu4 din6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用钳子夹住电线。
examples.english_sentence: He used pliers to clamp the wire.

english_meaning: to refuse, to reject, to decline
explanation_mandarin: 不接受；不答应。
explanation_english: To reject; to refuse; to decline to accept something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拒絕咗我嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 yiu1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拒绝了我的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: He refused my invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快拒人於千里之外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 geoi6 jan4 jyu1 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快拒人于千里之外。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push people away so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拒絕回應記者嘅提問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi5 zyut6 wui4 ying3 gei3 ze2 ge3 tai4 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拒绝回应记者的提问。
examples.english_sentence: He refused to answer the reporter's questions.

jyutping: geoi6 jan4 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6
english_meaning: to keep people at arm's length; to keep people at a distance; to be aloof
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度冷淡，不愿与人接近。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude that is cold and unwilling to be close to others, creating a sense of distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似成日拒人千里之外噉，都唔知佢諗緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 seng4 jat6 geoi6 jan4 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6 gam2, dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 gan2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像总是拒人千里之外，都不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always seems to keep people at arm's length; I have no idea what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格比较内向，所以容易俾人觉得佢拒人千里之外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 bei2 gaau3 noi6 hoeng3, so2 ji5 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 geoi6 jan4 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格比较内向，所以容易让人觉得他拒人千里之外。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is quite introverted, so people easily feel that he keeps them at arm's length.

jyutping: keoi5 jan4 jyu1 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6
english_meaning: to keep people at arm's length, to be aloof and distant
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度高傲，不愿与人亲近或交流。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude of being aloof and distant, unwilling to be close to or interact with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拒人於千里之外，好難同佢做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 keoi5 jan4 jyu1 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6, hou2 naan4 tung4 keoi5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拒人千里之外，很难和他做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always keeps people at arm's length, it's hard to be friends with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從升咗做經理之後，佢就好似拒人於千里之外噉，唔再同我哋傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 hou2 ci5 keoi5 jan4 jyu1 cin1 lei5 zi1 ngoi6 gam2, m4 zoi3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从升为经理之后，他好像拒人千里之外一样，不再和我们聊天了。
examples.english_sentence: Since being promoted to manager, he's become very aloof, no longer chatting with us.

synonyms: 不近人情 (bat1 gan6 jan4 ching4)

english_meaning: to refuse to act as a guarantor; to decline to be a guarantor
explanation_mandarin: 拒绝为他人提供担保。
explanation_english: To refuse to act as a guarantor for someone.  This usually refers to refusing to vouch for someone's loan or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行覺得佢信唔過，所以拒保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 seon3 m4 gwo3, so2 ji5 geoi6 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行觉得他不可靠，所以拒绝担保。
examples.english_sentence: The bank thinks he's unreliable, so they refused to act as a guarantor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔敢幫你做擔保人，萬一你走佬，我就要孭飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gam2 bong1 nei5 zou6 daam1 bou2 jan4, maan6 jat1 nei5 zau2 lou2, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 be1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不敢帮你做担保人，万一你跑路了，我就要承担责任。
examples.english_sentence: I don't dare be your guarantor, if you run away, I'll have to take responsibility.

english_meaning: to resist arrest
explanation_mandarin: 拒绝被逮捕；抗拒逮捕。
explanation_english: To refuse to be arrested; to resist arrest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為拒捕，俾警察用武力制服咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 geoi6 bou6, bei2 ging2 chaat3 yung6 mou5 lik6 zai3 fuk6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他拒捕，所以被警察用武力制服了。
examples.english_sentence: Because he resisted arrest, the police used force to subdue him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個疑犯拒捕，仲襲擊警員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji4 faan2 geoi6 bou6, zung6 zaap6 gik1 ging2 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个嫌疑犯拒捕，还袭击警员。
examples.english_sentence: The suspect resisted arrest and even attacked the police officer.

english_meaning: to refuse to accept; to reject
explanation_mandarin: 拒绝接受或收取。
explanation_english: To refuse to accept or receive something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果啲貨有問題，我哋有權拒收嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 di1 fo3 jau5 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 jau5 kyn4 geoi6 sau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果货物有问题，我们有权拒收的。
examples.english_sentence: If there are problems with the goods, we have the right to refuse acceptance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司拒收晒所有嘅投訴信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 geoi6 sau1 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 tau4 sou3 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司拒收所有的投诉信。
examples.english_sentence: Their company refused to accept all the complaint letters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳拒收信用卡，淨係收現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 geoi6 sau1 sin3 jung6 kaat1, zing6 hai6 sau1 jin6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅拒收信用卡，只收现金。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant doesn't accept credit cards, only cash.

english_meaning: to refuse, to reject
explanation_mandarin: 不接受，不答应。
explanation_english: To decline or refuse an offer, request, or proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拒絕咗我嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 yiu1 ching2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拒绝了我的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: He rejected my invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快拒絕人，聽吓佢講咩先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 keoi5 zyut6 jan4, ting1 haa5 keoi5 gong2 me1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快拒绝别人，听听他/她说什么吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't reject someone so quickly, listen to what he/she has to say first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我嘅求婚，最後都係拒絕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 kau4 fan1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 keoi5 zyut6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她对我的求婚，最后还是拒绝了。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, she rejected my marriage proposal.

english_meaning: to refuse to carry (a passenger); to refuse to pick up (a passenger)
explanation_mandarin: 拒绝载客，通常指出租车、公共汽车等拒绝乘客。
explanation_english: To refuse to carry a passenger, usually referring to taxis or buses refusing to pick up a passenger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架的士拒載我，話我太遠唔想去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 dik1 si2 geoi6 zoi3 ngo5, waa6 ngo5 taai3 jyun5 m4 soeng2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出租车拒载了我，说我太远不想去。
examples.english_sentence: The taxi refused to pick me up, saying that I was too far and he didn't want to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲巴士成日拒載，搞到好多人投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 baa1 si2 seng4 jat6 geoi6 zoi3, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的巴士经常拒载，导致很多人投诉。
examples.english_sentence: This company's buses often refuse to pick up passengers, causing many people to complain.

english_meaning: to expand, to extend, to develop; to open up
explanation_mandarin: 指扩展、开拓、开发新的领域或范围。
explanation_english: Refers to expanding, developing, or opening up new territories or scopes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力拓闊業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 tok3 fut3 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力扩展业务。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard to expand our business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想拓荒發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tok3 fong1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想开荒发展。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to pioneer and develop.

english_meaning: to make a rubbing; to take a rubbing (of an inscription etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 用纸紧贴在碑刻或其他物体上，用墨或其他有色颜料涂抹，使纸上留下与原物相同的文字或图画。
explanation_english: To make a rubbing by placing paper tightly against a stele or other object and applying ink or other colored pigment, so that the paper retains the same text or image as the original object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗廟度拓印啲經文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 miu2 dou6 tok3 jan3 di1 ging1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去庙里拓印一些经文。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the temple to make rubbings of some scriptures.

english_meaning: to expand, to extend, to develop, to broaden
explanation_mandarin: 向外发展；扩大。
explanation_english: To expand outwards; to broaden or develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司想拓展海外市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 soeng2 tok3 zin2 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司想拓展海外市场。
examples.english_sentence: Our company wants to expand into overseas markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃拓展業務去東南亞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 tok3 zin2 jip6 mou6 heoi3 dung1 naam4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划拓展业务到东南亚。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to expand their business to Southeast Asia.

english_meaning: Topology
explanation_mandarin: 数学的一个分支，研究物体在连续形变下保持不变的性质。
explanation_english: A branch of mathematics that studies the properties of geometric objects that are preserved under continuous deformations, such as stretching, twisting, crumpling, and bending, but not tearing or gluing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀拓撲學，好犀利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 tok3 pou4 hok6, hou2 sai1 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学里学拓扑学，非常厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He studies topology at university, he's very impressive.

english_meaning: rubbing (from stone inscriptions, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 从器物、碑刻等表面覆上一层薄纸，用墨或其他颜料拓印下来的图象或文字。
explanation_english: An impression taken from the surface of stone inscriptions, bronzes, or other objects by laying paper on them and rubbing it with ink or other pigment to reproduce the image or text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺博物館度睇到好多珍貴嘅拓片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 dou6 tai2 dou2 hou2 do1 zan1 gwai3 ge3 tok3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在博物馆里看到了很多珍贵的拓片。
examples.english_sentence: They saw many precious rubbings in the museum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅拓片嘅歷史好耐，保存得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 tok3 pin3 ge3 lik6 si2 hou2 noi6, bo2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅拓片的历史很久，保存得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This rubbing has a long history and is well preserved.

english_meaning: to reclaim wasteland; to open up virgin land; to pioneer; to break new ground
explanation_mandarin: 指开垦荒地，开创新的事业或领域。
explanation_english: To reclaim wasteland, to cultivate new land. Figuratively, it refers to pioneering new ventures or fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定去非洲拓荒，建立新嘅農場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 fei1 zau1 tok3 fong1, gin3 lap6 san1 ge3 nung4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定去非洲开荒，建立新的农场。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to reclaim wasteland in Africa and build a new farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人工智能呢個領域拓荒，需要好多創意同埋毅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 ni1 go3 ling5 wik6 tok3 fong1, seoi1 jiu3 hou2 do1 chong3 ji3 tung4 mai4 ngai6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在人工智能这个领域开荒，需要很多创意和毅力。
examples.english_sentence: Pioneering in the field of artificial intelligence requires a lot of creativity and perseverance.

english_meaning: to pull out, to extract
explanation_mandarin: 从里面用力拉出。
explanation_english: To pull something out with force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拔咗條雜草出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat6 zo2 tiu4 zaap6 cou2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拔了一棵杂草出来。
examples.english_sentence: He pulled out a weed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拔埋啲牙先可以箍牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat6 maai4 di1 ngaa4 sin1 ho2 ji5 ku1 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拔掉一些牙齿才可以矫正牙齿。
examples.english_sentence: We need to extract some teeth before we can get braces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拔罐可以舒緩肌肉酸痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat6 guan3 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 gei1 yuk6 syun1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拔罐可以舒缓肌肉酸痛。
examples.english_sentence: Cupping can relieve muscle soreness.

english_meaning: to draw one's sword to help; to come to someone's aid; to offer help in a righteous manner
explanation_mandarin: 形容在危急时刻，挺身而出，帮助他人。比喻见义勇为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who steps forward to help others in times of crisis. It implies acting bravely and righteously to assist those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到有人俾人恰，即刻拔刀相助，真係好有義氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 bei2 jan4 hap1, zik1 hak1 bat6 dou1 soeng1 zo6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ji6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到有人被欺负，立刻拔刀相助，真是很有义气。
examples.english_sentence: He saw someone being bullied and immediately came to their aid, he's truly righteous.

english_meaning: to excel, to stand out, to be outstanding
explanation_mandarin: 形容在人群或事物中突出、优秀。
explanation_english: To be outstanding or exceptional in a group; to excel and stand out from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀書好叻，次次考試都拔尖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 syu1 hou2 lek1, ci3 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 bat6 zim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习很厉害，每次考试都出类拔萃。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at studying and always excels in exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想喺呢個行業拔尖，一定要付出比人更多嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 hai2 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 bat6 zim1, jat1 ding6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 bei2 jan4 gang3 do1 ge3 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想在这个行业出类拔萃，一定要付出比别人更多的努力。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to excel in this industry, you must put in more effort than others.

mandarin_meaning: 照顾优秀和落后的学生；顾及尖子生和差生
english_meaning: To cater to both the top and bottom students; To take care of both the excellent and the struggling
explanation_mandarin: 指教育或管理上，既要培养优秀的人才，也要帮助基础较差的人，兼顾两头。
explanation_english: In education or management, it refers to the practice of cultivating excellent talents while also assisting those with weaker foundations, catering to both extremes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師嘅責任係要拔尖補底，唔可以淨係理叻嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 ge3 zaak3 jam6 hai6 jiu3 bat6 zim1 bou2 dai2, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 lei5 lek1 ge3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师的责任是既要照顾尖子生，也要帮助基础差的学生，不能只管聪明的那些。
examples.english_sentence: A teacher's responsibility is to cater to both the top and bottom students, not just to care for the clever ones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校應該注重拔尖補底，提供更多資源俾唔同程度嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jing1 goi1 zyu3 zung6 bat6 zim1 bou2 dai2, tai4 cung1 gang3 do1 zi1 jyun4 bei2 m4 tung1 cheng4 dou6 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校应该注重照顾尖子生和帮助基础差的学生，为不同程度的学生提供更多资源。
examples.english_sentence: Schools should focus on catering to both the top and bottom students, providing more resources for students of different levels.

english_meaning: tug-of-war
explanation_mandarin: 一种体育运动，双方拉一根绳子，看哪一方能把对方拉过中间线。
explanation_english: A sport in which two teams pull on opposite ends of a rope to try and pull the other team over a central line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校聽日有拔河比賽啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ting1 jat6 jau5 bat6 ho4 bei2 coi3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校明天有拔河比赛啊。
examples.english_sentence: Our school has a tug-of-war competition tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拔河拔到繩都斷埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bat6 ho4 bat6 dou3 sing4 dou1 tyun5 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拔河拔到绳子都断了。
examples.english_sentence: They pulled so hard in the tug-of-war that the rope broke.

english_meaning: caramelised; spun sugar
explanation_mandarin: 一种烹饪方法，将食物裹上糖浆，糖浆冷却后会拉出细丝。
explanation_english: A cooking technique where food is coated in sugar syrup, which hardens into thin strands when cooled, creating a 'spun sugar' effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食拔絲香蕉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 bat6 si1 hoeng1 ziu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃拔丝香蕉。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating caramelised bananas the most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅拔絲蘋果做得好出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 bat6 si1 ping4 gwo2 zou6 dak1 hou2 seot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的拔丝苹果做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: The caramelised apples at this restaurant are excellent.

english_meaning: cupping therapy
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统中医疗法，利用罐子产生负压，吸附在皮肤上，达到疏通经络、活血化瘀的目的。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese medicine therapy in which cups are applied to the skin to create suction, with the aim of stimulating blood flow, relieving pain, and promoting healing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我膊頭好緊，想去拔罐鬆一鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bok3 tau4 hou2 gan2, soeng2 heoi3 bat6 gun3 sung1 jat1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我肩膀很紧，想去拔罐放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: My shoulders are very tight, I want to go for cupping therapy to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話拔罐好舒服，可以驅寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 bat6 gun3 hou2 syu1 fuk6, ho2 ji5 keoi1 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说拔罐很舒服，可以驱寒。
examples.english_sentence: He always says cupping is very comfortable and can dispel cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢背脊紅晒，應該係啱啱拔完罐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 bui3 zek3 hung4 saai3, ying1 goi1 hai6 ngaam1 ngaam1 bat6 jyun4 gun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他的背红红的，应该是刚刚拔完罐。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his back all red, he should have just finished cupping.

mandarin_meaning: 揠苗助长 (yà miáo zhù zhǎng)
english_meaning: to spoil things by excessive enthusiasm; to try to help seedlings grow by pulling them up (idiom); to defeat one's purpose through excessive zeal
explanation_mandarin: 比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而把事情弄糟。
explanation_english: An idiom describing someone who spoils things by excessive enthusiasm or tries to achieve quick results by forcing things to happen prematurely, ultimately hindering rather than helping the process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣逼佢哋學嘢，咪即係拔苗助長囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 bik1 keoi5 dei6 hok6 ye5, mai1 zik1 hai6 bat6 miu4 zo6 zoeng2 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样逼他们学习，不就是揠苗助长吗！
examples.english_sentence: You're forcing them to learn like that, isn't that just spoiling things by excessive enthusiasm!

examples.english_sentence: When educating children, the most important thing to avoid is spoiling things by excessive enthusiasm; you need to proceed step by step.

english_meaning: Brandy
explanation_mandarin: 一种烈性蒸馏酒，通常由葡萄酒或其他发酵果汁蒸馏而成。
explanation_english: A distilled spirit made from wine or fermented fruit juice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯拔蘭地暖下身啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝一杯白兰地暖暖身吧。
examples.english_sentence: Have a glass of brandy to warm yourself up.

english_meaning: To run away frantically; to flee at top speed; to take to one's heels
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常慌张地快速奔跑，通常因为害怕或者紧急情况。
explanation_english: Describes running away frantically, usually due to fear or an emergency. It implies a very fast and desperate escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到隻狗咁大隻，佢即刻拔足狂奔走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 zek3 gau2 gam3 daai6 zek3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 bat6 zuk1 kwong4 ban1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到狗那么大，他立刻拔腿狂奔走了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how big the dog was, he immediately took to his heels and ran away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火燭喇！啲人嚇到拔足狂奔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 zuk1 laa3! di1 jan4 haak3 dou3 bat6 zuk1 kwong4 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 着火了！人们吓得拔腿狂奔。
examples.english_sentence: It's on fire! People were so scared that they fled at top speed.

synonyms: 逃之夭夭 (tou4 zi1 jiu1 jiu1)

mandarin_meaning: 拔除; 移除; 根除
english_meaning: to remove; to eliminate; to eradicate; to extract
explanation_mandarin: 从根源上清除掉；彻底除去。
explanation_english: To remove completely; to eradicate from the root.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拔除所有嘅障礙，先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat6 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.

examples.english_sentence: We need to remove all obstacles in order to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想拔除異己，鞏固自己嘅勢力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 bat6 ceoi4 ji6 gei2, gung2 gu3 zi6 gei2 ge3 sai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想铲除异己，巩固自己的势力。
examples.english_sentence: They want to eliminate dissidents to consolidate their own power.

english_meaning: to pull; to drag; to delay; to postpone; to hold (hands)
explanation_mandarin: 有拉，延遲，牵手等多種意思。具體意思需要根據語境判斷。
explanation_english: Has multiple meanings, including to pull/drag, to delay/postpone, and to hold hands. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拖手仔好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: to1 sau2 zai2 hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牵手好甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: Holding hands is so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再拖啦，快啲做完佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再拖延了，快点做完它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay anymore, finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拖住個行李箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 to1 zoek3 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拖着一个行李箱。
examples.english_sentence: He is dragging a suitcase.

english_meaning: to delay payment; to default on a debt; to welch on payment
explanation_mandarin: 指延迟付款，或者故意不付款、赖账的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to delaying payment, or deliberately refusing to pay or welching on a debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拖刀，搞到冇人想同佢做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 to1 dou1, gaau2 dou3 mou5 jan4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 zou6 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拖欠账款，搞得没人想跟他做生意。
examples.english_sentence: He always delays payment, which makes no one want to do business with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好拖刀呀，出糧就找返條數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 to1 dou1 aa3, ceot1 loeng4 zau6 zaau2 faan1 tiu4 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要赖账啊，发工资就还账吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't welch on the payment, pay back the debt when you get your salary.

english_meaning: to delay; to hold back progress; to drag one's feet
explanation_mandarin: 指拖延事情的进度，使事情不能按时完成。
explanation_english: Refers to delaying the progress of something, causing it not to be completed on time. It implies someone is intentionally or unintentionally slowing things down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好拖卡啦，快啲搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 to1 kaa1 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拖延了，快点搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay, finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拖卡，搞到個project遲晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 to1 kaa1, gaau2 dou3 go3 project ci4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拖延，导致整个项目都迟了。
examples.english_sentence: He always delays, causing the whole project to be late.

synonyms: 阻頭阻勢 (zo2 tau4 zo2 sai3)

english_meaning: boyfriend/girlfriend; partner
explanation_mandarin: 指恋爱中的对象，男朋友或女朋友。
explanation_english: Refers to a romantic partner, either a boyfriend or a girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有拖友未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 to1 jau2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有男朋友/女朋友了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Does she have a boyfriend/girlfriend?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥最近交咗個新拖友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 zeoi3 gan6 gaau1 zo2 go3 san1 to1 jau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥最近交了一个新的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother recently got a new girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同你個拖友幾時結婚呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 nei5 go3 to1 jau2 gei2 si4 git3 fan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和你男朋友/女朋友什么时候结婚？
examples.english_sentence: When are you and your boyfriend/girlfriend getting married?

english_meaning: to mop the floor; to mop
explanation_mandarin: 用拖把清洁地面。
explanation_english: To clean the floor with a mop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要拖地啊，好污糟呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 to1 dei6-2 aa3, hou2 wu1 zou1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天得拖地了，好脏啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have to mop the floor today, it's so dirty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你拖地嗰陣記得要用清潔劑啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 to1 dei6-2 go2 zan6 gei3 dak1 jiu3 yung6 cing1 git3 zai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拖地的时候记得要用清洁剂啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to use detergent when you mop the floor.

english_meaning: to drag down, to pull down, to ruin, to bankrupt, to cripple
explanation_mandarin: 指因受牵连或某种原因而使失败、垮台、陷入困境。
explanation_english: To cause something to fail, collapse, or be ruined due to being implicated or influenced by something negative. Can refer to financial ruin, physical deterioration, or the failure of a project/organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅管理唔好，好快就會俾佢哋拖垮㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 m4 hou2, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 to1 kwaa2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理不好，很快就会被他们拖垮的。
examples.english_sentence: The company's management is poor; it will soon be dragged down by them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再借錢畀佢喇，你咁落去遲早俾佢拖垮你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5 laa3, nei5 gam2 lok6 heoi3 ci4 zou2 bei2 keoi5 to1 kwaa2 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再借钱给他了，你这样下去迟早被他拖垮的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lend him any more money. If you continue like this, you'll be ruined by him sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗之後，成個家庭嘅經濟都差啲俾佢拖垮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 gaa1 ting4 ge3 ging1 zai3 dou1 caa1 di1 bei2 keoi5 to1 kwaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病之后，整个家庭的经济都差点被他拖垮。
examples.english_sentence: After he got sick, the economy of the whole family was almost ruined by him.

mandarin_meaning: 拖延战术, 拖延政策
english_meaning: Delaying tactic, stalling tactic, dilatory tactics
explanation_mandarin: 一种策略，指通过拖延时间来应对问题或局面，希望问题自行解决或找到更好的解决方案。
explanation_english: A tactic of delaying action or decision-making in the hope that the problem will resolve itself, or that a better solution will emerge over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用拖字訣，想等件事自己解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 to1 zi6 kyut3, soeng2 dang2 gin6 si6 zi6 gei2 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们使用拖延战术，想等这件事自己解决。
examples.english_sentence: They're using a delaying tactic, hoping the matter will resolve itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日用拖字訣，有啲嘢係要即刻處理嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 yung6 to1 zi6 kyut3, jau5 di1 je5 hai6 jik1 hak1 cyu2 lei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是用拖延战术，有些事情是要立刻处理的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always use a delaying tactic, some things need to be dealt with immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府對呢件事採取拖字訣，引起咗好多市民嘅不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 coi2 ceoi2 to1 zi6 kyut3, hing2 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 si5 man4 ge3 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府对这件事采取拖延战术，引起了很多市民的不满。
examples.english_sentence: The government's adoption of dilatory tactics in this matter has aroused dissatisfaction among many citizens.

english_meaning: to delay, to procrastinate
explanation_mandarin: 延长或延迟某事的时间。
explanation_english: To prolong or postpone something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再拖延喇，快啲做完佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 to1 jin4 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再拖延了，快点做完它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay any longer, finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都拖延時間，唔肯面對問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 to1 jin4 si4 gaan3, m4 hang2 min6 deoi3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拖延时间，不肯面对问题。
examples.english_sentence: He always procrastinates and refuses to face the problems.

english_meaning: to slow down, to delay, to drag
explanation_mandarin: 使速度变慢，使进程变慢。
explanation_english: To cause something to become slower; to delay or impede the progress of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車拖慢咗我哋嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 to1 maan6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车拖慢了我们的进度。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam slowed down our progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好拖慢成個團隊嘅速度啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 to1 maan6 sing4 go3 tyun4 deoi2 ge3 suk1 dou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拖慢整个团队的速度了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slow down the entire team's pace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策會拖慢經濟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ching3 chaak3 wui2 to1 maan6 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策会拖慢经济发展。
examples.english_sentence: This policy will slow down economic development.

english_meaning: to hold hands
explanation_mandarin: 牵着对方的手，表示亲近或感情。
explanation_english: To hold someone's hand, usually indicating affection, intimacy, or support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋行街成日拖手，好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haang4 gaai1 sing4 jat6 to1 sau2, hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们逛街总是牵着手，好甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: They always hold hands when they go shopping, so sweet!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，阿媽成日拖住我過馬路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 to1 zyu6 ngo5 gwo3 maa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，妈妈总是牵着我过马路。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom always held my hand to cross the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拖住手，一齊面對困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 to1 zyu6 sau2, jat1 cai4 min6 deoi3 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们手牵着手，一起面对困难。
examples.english_sentence: They held hands and faced the difficulties together.

english_meaning: Holding hands, holding hands (diminutive)
explanation_mandarin: 指牵着手，通常用于形容情侣、家人或朋友之间亲密的动作。 "仔" 是个后缀，有可爱的、小的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to holding hands, often used to describe the intimate action between lovers, family members, or friends. "仔" (zai2) is a suffix that adds a sense of cuteness or smallness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個行街成日都拖手仔嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 haang4 gaai1 sing4 jat6 dou1 to1 sau2 zai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩逛街总是手牵着手。
examples.english_sentence: Those two always hold hands when they go shopping.
