examples.english_sentence: Why are you so afraid? It's not a big deal even if you fail, just try and you'll know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知你好擔心，但係機會難得，拚死無大害，唔試你一定後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 nei5 hou2 daam1 sam1, daan6 hai6 gei1 wui6 naan4 dak1, pun3 sei2 mou4 daai6 hoi6, m4 si3 nei5 jat1 ding6 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你很担心，但是机会难得，拼死也没什么大不了的，不试你一定会后悔。
examples.english_sentence: I know you're worried, but the opportunity is rare. It's not a big deal even if you fail. You'll definitely regret it if you don't try.

english_meaning: To go all out; to do something desperately; to wreck something intentionally
explanation_mandarin: 形容不顾一切地去做某事，带有不顾后果或者损坏的意思。有时候也指故意破坏。
explanation_english: Describes doing something with reckless abandon, often implying disregard for the consequences or potential damage. Can also refer to intentional destruction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次要拚爛，一定要考到好成績！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 jiu3 pwaan3 laan6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我要拼了命，一定要考到好成绩！
examples.english_sentence: This time I'm going to go all out, I must get good grades!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢激到拚爛嘢，真係唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik1 dou3 pwaan3 laan6 je5, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得乱砸东西，真是不好惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he started wrecking things, it's best not to mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話要同我哋拚爛，唔好驚，我哋唔會輸嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 pwaan3 laan6, m4 hou2 geng1, ngo5 dei6 m4 wui5 syu1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说要跟我们拼个鱼死网破，别怕，我们不会输的！
examples.english_sentence: They say they want to fight us to the bitter end, don't be afraid, we won't lose!

english_meaning: to beckon, to attract, to recruit, trick, move (in martial arts)
explanation_mandarin: 招引；吸引。也指动作或方法。
explanation_english: To beckon; to attract; also refers to an action or method (especially in martial arts).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司招緊人呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ziu1 gan2 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司在招人呢。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is recruiting people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢招好掂喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ziu1 hou2 dim3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这一招很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: This move is really good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日招惹麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ziu1 je5 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He always invites trouble.

english_meaning: to incur someone's animosity; to make enemies
explanation_mandarin: 指因为言行或行为不当而引起别人的仇恨或记恨。
explanation_english: Refers to causing hatred or resentment in others due to inappropriate words, actions, or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日串串貢，梗係招人仇口㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cyun3 cyun3 gung3, gang2 hai6 ziu1 jan4 cau4 hau2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是很嚣张，当然会惹人记恨啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always arrogant, of course he's going to make enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做人唔好咁高調，費事招人仇口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 jan4 m4 hou2 gam3 gou1 diu6, fai3 si6 ziu1 jan4 cau4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做人不要那么高调，免得惹人记恨。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so high-profile, or you'll end up making enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職升得咁快，肯定招人仇口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3, hang2 ding6 ziu1 jan4 cau4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职升得这么快，肯定会惹人嫉妒。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted so quickly, he's bound to make enemies.

english_meaning: to confess; confession; to admit guilt
explanation_mandarin: 指犯人或嫌疑人承认自己的罪行。
explanation_english: To confess, specifically referring to a suspect or criminal admitting their crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾差人捉咗之後，好快就招供晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 caai1 jan2 zuk1 zo2 zi1 hau6, hou2 faai3 zau6 ziu1 gung1 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被警察抓了之后，很快就全部招认了。
examples.english_sentence: After the police arrested him, he quickly confessed everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯招供，一定有古怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 ziu1 gung1, jat1 ding6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯招认，一定有蹊跷。
examples.english_sentence: He refuses to confess; there must be something fishy.

english_meaning: to recruit troops and buy horses; to expand one's forces; to recruit talent
explanation_mandarin: 比喻扩充队伍或势力，也指大规模地招揽人才。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to expand one's team or influence, or to recruit talent on a large scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備擴充業務，要開始招兵買馬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 kwaak3 cung1 jip6 mou6, jiu3 hoi1 ci2 ziu1 bing1 maai5 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司准备扩张业务，要开始招兵买马了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is preparing to expand its business and will start recruiting talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗搞好呢個項目，四圍招兵買馬，搵咗好多勁人嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gaau2 hou2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6, sei3 wai4 ziu1 bing1 maai5 maa5, wan2 zo2 hou2 do1 ging6 jan4 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了做好这个项目，他四处招兵买马，找了很多厉害的人来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: In order to complete this project successfully, he recruited talented people from all over the place to help.

synonyms: 招賢納士 (ziu1 yin4 naap6 si6)

english_meaning: to recruit, to enlist, recruitment
explanation_mandarin: 募集人員或物資。
explanation_english: To recruit or enlist personnel or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司而家招募緊暑期工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 ziu1 muk6 gan2 syu2 kei4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司现在正在招募暑期工。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is now recruiting summer interns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府招募義工幫手派防疫物資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ziu1 muk6 ji6 gung1 bong1 sau2 paai3 fong4 jik6 mat6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府招募义工帮忙派发防疫物资。
examples.english_sentence: The government is recruiting volunteers to help distribute epidemic prevention materials.

english_meaning: To invite gossip; to cause trouble due to one's speech; to bring about arguments or criticism
explanation_mandarin: 因为说话不小心或者行为不检点而引来别人的议论，批评甚至争吵。
explanation_english: To attract gossip, criticism, or arguments due to careless speech or improper behavior. It implies that someone's words or actions have invited trouble or negative attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁大聲，好易招口舌㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 daai6 seng1, hou2 ji6 ziu1 hau2 sit6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话这么大声，很容易惹是生非的！
examples.english_sentence: You're speaking so loudly, it's easy to invite gossip!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人低調啲，唔好咁招搖，費事招口舌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 dai1 diu6 di1, m4 hou2 gam3 ziu1 jiu4, fai3 si6 ziu1 hau2 sit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人低调点，不要那么招摇，免得惹麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Be more low-key, don't be so flashy, so you won't invite trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司講是非，搞到招晒口舌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 gong2 si6 fei1, gaau2 dou3 ziu1 saai3 hau2 sit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在公司说人坏话，搞得惹了一身麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always gossiping in the company, which has caused him a lot of trouble.

english_meaning: to greet; to say hello; to take care of; to attend to; to entertain; to receive (guests)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 打招呼，问候。2. 招待，照料。
explanation_english: 1. To greet, to say hello. 2. To take care of, to entertain (guests), to attend to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日冇同我哋打招呼喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 daa2 ziu1 fu1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没有和我们打招呼呀。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't greet us yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好招呼啲客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 ziu1 fu1 di1 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要好好招待这些客人。
examples.english_sentence: We need to entertain these guests properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思， 遲咗招呼你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ci4 zo2 ziu1 fu1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，招待你晚了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I was late attending to you.

english_meaning: Unable to attend to (someone); Unable to take care of (someone properly); Not enough resources to handle
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有办法好好地招待或照顾某人，通常是因为忙碌、资源不足或其他原因。
explanation_english: Indicates an inability to properly attend to or take care of someone, usually due to being busy, insufficient resources, or other reasons. It expresses a sense of being unable to provide adequate service or care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日多人到招呼唔到你哋，唔好意思啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 do1 jan4 dou3 ziu1 fu1 m4 dou3 nei5 dei6, m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天人太多了，照顾不周，不好意思啊！
examples.english_sentence: There are too many people today, I can't attend to you all properly, I'm sorry!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳太細，人多嘅時候就招呼唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 taai3 sai3, jan4 do1 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ziu1 fu1 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅太小了，人多的时候就照顾不周。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is too small, when there are many people, we can't provide adequate service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人做咁多嘢，點招呼得咁多人啫？真係招呼唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zou6 gam3 do1 je5, dim2 ziu1 fu1 dak1 gam3 do1 jan4 ze1? zan1 hai6 ziu1 fu1 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人做这么多事，怎么照顾得了这么多人呢？ 真是照顾不周。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing so much work by himself, how can he take care of so many people? It's really impossible for him to attend to everyone.

synonyms: 忙不過來(mong4 bat1 gwo3 loi4)

english_meaning: to pacify and recruit (rebels or bandits); to offer amnesty and incorporation; to co-opt
explanation_mandarin: 原指古代朝廷对反叛势力进行安抚和收编，使其归顺。现在也用来比喻用利益或权力等手段收买、拉拢某人或某势力。
explanation_english: Originally, it referred to the ancient imperial court pacifying and incorporating rebellious forces to make them submit. Now, it is also used metaphorically to describe using benefits, power, or other means to buy over or win over someone or some force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想招安啲黑社會大佬，等佢哋幫手維持治安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 ziu1 on1啲 hak1 se5 wui2 daai6 lou2, dang2 keoi5 dei6 bong1 sau2 wai4 ci4 zi6 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想招安那些黑社会老大，让他们帮忙维持治安。
examples.english_sentence: They want to pacify and recruit those triad bosses to help maintain public order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用高薪招安咗個競爭對手嘅核心員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yung6 gou1 sam1 ziu1 on1 zo2 go3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 ge3 hat6 sam1 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间公司用高薪招安了竞争对手的核心员工。
examples.english_sentence: That company used a high salary to poach the core employees of their competitor.

mandarin_meaning: 招数, 动作, 技能
english_meaning: move, trick, technique, style (often in martial arts); maneuver; means; method
explanation_mandarin: 原指武术中的动作或技能，也泛指解决问题的方法或手段。
explanation_english: Originally refers to movements or skills in martial arts, but also generally refers to methods or means to solve problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多招式，但係都贏唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 ziu1 sik1, daan6 hai6 dou1 ying4 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了许多招数，但是都没能赢。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of moves, but he still couldn't win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好難搞，諗多啲招式先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4 gaau2, nam2 do1 di1 ziu1 sik1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很难搞，多想想办法。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is difficult to handle, let's think of more methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲招式好犀利，睇嚟練咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 ziu1 sik1 hou2 sai1 lei6, tai2 lai4 lin6 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的招数很厉害，看来练了很久。
examples.english_sentence: His moves are very impressive, it seems he has practiced for a long time.

english_meaning: to attract, to invite, to provoke, to incur
explanation_mandarin: 引起注意或产生某种后果；招惹，引来。
explanation_english: To attract attention or cause a certain consequence; to provoke, to invite, to incur something (often negative).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好唔好招引佢，佢發起脾氣好得人驚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 ziu1 jan5 keoi5, keoi5 faat3 hei2 pei4 hei3 hou2 dak1 jan4 ging1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要招惹他，他发起脾气很吓人的。
examples.english_sentence: You better not provoke him, he's scary when he loses his temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲裝修好靚，招引咗好多人嚟幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 zong1 sau1 hou2 leng3, ziu1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 bong1 caan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很漂亮，吸引了很多人来光顾。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's decoration is very beautiful, attracting a lot of people to patronize it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日講大話，好容易招引麻煩嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6, hou2 jung4 ji6 ziu1 jan5 maa4 faan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是说谎，很容易招惹麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: Always telling lies, it's easy to incur trouble.

english_meaning: to receive (guests); to entertain; to treat (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 接待；款待。
explanation_english: To receive and entertain guests; to provide hospitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要好好招待啲客人啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 ziu1 daai6 di1 haak3 jan4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要好好招待客人啊。
examples.english_sentence: We need to treat the guests well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳嘅服務好好，招待週到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 hou2, ziu1 daai6 zau1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那家餐厅的服务很好，招待周到。
examples.english_sentence: The service in his restaurant is very good, the hospitality is attentive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，招待不周。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ziu1 daai6 bat1 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，招待不周。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, the hospitality was not adequate.

english_meaning: to attract (customers), to solicit (business)
explanation_mandarin: 吸引顾客或生意。
explanation_english: To attract customers or business; to solicit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用好多方法去招徠顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 hou2 do1 fong1 faat3 heoi3 ziu1 loi4 gu3 hak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用很多方法去招揽顾客。
examples.english_sentence: They use many methods to attract customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳成日搞啲優惠嚟招徠生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing4 jat6 gaau2 di1 yau1 wai6 lei4 ziu1 loi4 sang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅经常搞一些优惠来招揽生意。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant often runs promotions to attract business.

english_meaning: to provoke, to attract trouble, to ask for it, to mess with, to invite (something unwanted)
explanation_mandarin: 引起麻烦、引来不愉快的事情或人。
explanation_english: To provoke, attract, or invite trouble, unwanted attention, or undesirable people. Often implies a sense of knowingly causing a negative situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好招惹佢啦，佢好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ziu1 je5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要招惹他，他很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him, he's very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度搞事，專登招惹人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gaau2 si6, zyun1 dang3 ziu1 je5 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在这里搞事，故意招惹别人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always making trouble here, deliberately provoking people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好去招惹啲古惑仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 heoi3 ziu1 je5 di1 gu2 waak6 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要去招惹那些小混混啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't go messing with those gangsters!

english_meaning: to wave (hand)
explanation_mandarin: 用手摇动，示意别人注意或过来。
explanation_english: To wave one's hand to attract attention or signal someone to come over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺條街度招手截的士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 ziu1 sau2 zit6 dik1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上招手拦出租车。
examples.english_sentence: I waved down a taxi on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我，即刻同我招手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 ngo5, zik1 hak1 tung4 ngo5 ziu1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我，立刻向我招手。
examples.english_sentence: He saw me and immediately waved to me.

english_meaning: to flaunt; to show off; to swagger; to boast; to parade
explanation_mandarin: 炫耀自己的才能、财富或地位，引人注意；故意惹事生非。
explanation_english: To flaunt one's talent, wealth, or status to attract attention; to deliberately cause trouble or stir up problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著到咁招搖，好似想引人注意咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 dou3 gam3 ziu1 jiu4, hou2 ci5 soeng2 jan5 jan4 zyu3 ji3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是穿得那么招摇，好像想引起别人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He always dresses so flamboyantly, as if he wants to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲人成日喺街上面招搖撞騙，大家要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 ziu1 jiu4 zong6 pin3, daai6 ga1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些人总是在街上招摇撞骗，大家要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: These people are always swindling on the streets, everyone should be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好低調，唔鍾意招搖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 dai1 diu6, m4 zung1 ji3 ziu1 jiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很低调，不喜欢招摇。
examples.english_sentence: He is a low-profile person and doesn't like to show off.

english_meaning: to bluff and swindle; to parade oneself and deceive people; to swindle by deception
explanation_mandarin: 指炫耀自己，到处行骗。
explanation_english: To flaunt oneself to deceive people and carry out fraudulent activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都招搖撞騙，呃啲老人家嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 ziu1 jiu4 zong6 pin3, aak1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是招摇撞骗，骗一些老人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always bluffs and swindles, cheating money from the elderly.

english_meaning: to parade ostentatiously through the streets; to flaunt; to show off brazenly
explanation_mandarin: 形容故意炫耀自己，引人注目。
explanation_english: Describes someone who deliberately shows off to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後日日揸住架跑車喺條街度招搖過市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6 jat1 jat1 zaa1 zyu6 gaa3 paau2 ce1 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 ziu1 jiu4 gwo3 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财之后，每天开着跑车在街上招摇过市。
examples.english_sentence: After he got rich, he drove his sports car through the streets every day, showing off ostentatiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好攞住啲名牌嘢喺公司度招搖過市啦，好多同事都唔鍾意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lo2 zyu6 di1 ming4 paai4 je5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 ziu1 jiu4 gwo3 si5 laa1, hou2 do1 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别拿着那些名牌货在公司里招摇过市了，很多同事都不喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flaunt your branded goods at the office; many colleagues don't like it.

english_meaning: to recruit, to solicit, to canvass, to attract (customers, business etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 吸引顾客或人才。即以各种方式吸引人们来。也可以指募集。
explanation_english: To attract customers or talent by various means. It can also refer to recruitment or solicitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司正積極招攬人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zing3 gik1 gik1 ziu1 laam5 jyun4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司正在积极招揽人才。
examples.english_sentence: The company is actively recruiting talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用好多方法招攬生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 hou2 do1 fong1 faat3 ziu1 laam5 saang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用了很多方法招揽生意。
examples.english_sentence: They used many methods to attract business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 餐廳門口有人招攬客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caan1 teng1 mun4 hau2 jau5 jan4 ziu1 laam5 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 餐厅门口有人招揽客人。
examples.english_sentence: There are people soliciting customers at the entrance of the restaurant.

english_meaning: to recruit, to enroll, to admit (students, members, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指机构（如学校、公司、组织等）通过一定的方式吸收人员。
explanation_english: To recruit or enroll people into an institution (e.g., schools, companies, organizations) through a specific process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間大學今年招收咗好多國際學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 daai6 hok6 gam1 nin4 ziu1 sau1 zo2 hou2 do1 gwok3 zai3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学今年招收了很多国际学生。
examples.english_sentence: This university enrolled many international students this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司依家招收緊暑期實習生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji1 gaa1 ziu1 sau1 gan2 syu2 gei1 sat6 zaap6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司现在正在招收暑期实习生。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is currently recruiting summer interns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舞蹈學校招收各個年齡層嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 mou5 dou6 hok6 haau6 ziu1 sau1 gok3 go3 nin4 ling4 cang4 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间舞蹈学校招收各个年龄层的学生。
examples.english_sentence: This dance school enrolls students of all ages.

english_meaning: move, trick, tactic, method
explanation_mandarin: 指手段、方法、策略。
explanation_english: Refers to a method, trick, tactic, or strategy to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好多招數㗎，唔好咁易信佢。

examples.english_sentence: He has many tricks up his sleeve, don't trust him so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用咗好多招數，都搞唔掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 ziu1 sou3, dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用了好多招数，都没法对付他。
examples.english_sentence: I've tried many tactics, but I still can't deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出埋啲咁嘅招數，真係卑鄙！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheut1 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 ziu1 sou3, zan1 hai6 bei1 pei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他使出这种招数，真是卑鄙！
examples.english_sentence: The tricks he's using are truly despicable!

english_meaning: to parry; to fend off; to resist; to cope with; to handle; to deal with
explanation_mandarin: 抵挡; 应付; 抵抗。
explanation_english: To defend oneself against an attack or difficulty; to ward off; to handle or cope with a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅攻勢太猛烈，我哋招架唔住啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 sai3 taai3 maang5 lit6, ngo5 dei6 ziu1 gaa3 m4 zyu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的攻势太猛烈了，我们招架不住啊！
examples.english_sentence: Their offensive is too fierce, we can't cope with it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁多投訴，佢都有啲招架唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 tau4 sou3, keoi5 dou1 jau5 di1 ziu1 gaa3 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这么多投诉，他也有点招架不住。
examples.english_sentence: Facing so many complaints, he is finding it a bit difficult to handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢口才好好，無論人哋問乜嘢，佢都招架得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau2 coi4 hou2 hou2, mou4 leon6 jan4 dei6 man6 mat1 je5, keoi5 dou1 ziu1 gaa3 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他口才很好，无论别人问什么，他都能应付。
examples.english_sentence: He has great eloquence, no matter what people ask, he can handle it.

english_meaning: to invite bids, to call for tenders, tender
explanation_mandarin: 指公开征求承包商或供应商投标。
explanation_english: To invite companies to submit bids for a project or contract; the act of inviting or submitting tenders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府而家招標起新嘅公屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ji4 gaa1 ziu1 biu1 hei2 san1 ge3 gung1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府现在招标建造新的公共房屋。
examples.english_sentence: The government is now inviting tenders for the construction of new public housing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅招標程序好嚴格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 ziu1 biu1 cing4 seoi6 hou2 yim4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的招标程序很严格。
examples.english_sentence: The tendering process for this project is very strict.

english_meaning: Fiddler crab
explanation_mandarin: 一种小型蟹，雄性有一只特别大的螯，会挥动来吸引雌性，像在招手一样。
explanation_english: A small crab, characterized by the males having one greatly enlarged claw, which they wave to attract females, resembling a beckoning gesture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去濕地公園睇招潮蟹啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sap1 dei6 gung1 yun2 tai2 ziu1 ciu4 haai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去湿地公园看招潮蟹吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the Wetland Park to see fiddler crabs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻招潮蟹嘅鉗好大呀，真係好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 ziu1 ciu4 haai5 ge3 kim4 hou2 daai6 aa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只招潮蟹的钳子好大啊，真的很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: That fiddler crab's claw is so big, it's really cute.

english_meaning: signboard, brand name, reputation
explanation_mandarin: 商店或机构挂在门口的牌子，上面写着名称等；比喻名誉、名声。
explanation_english: A signboard, often with the name of a store or organization; figuratively, reputation or brand name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅招牌好舊，但係啲嘢食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ziu1 paai4 hou2 gau6, daan6 hai6 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的招牌很旧，但是东西很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The signboard of this restaurant is old, but the food is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視自己嘅招牌，所以做嘢好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 zi6 gei2 ge3 ziu1 paai4, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重视自己的名声，所以做事很小心。
examples.english_sentence: He values his reputation a lot, so he is very careful when doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個牌子已經係信譽嘅招牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ji5 ging1 hai6 seon3 jyu6 ge3 ziu1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个牌子已经是信誉的象征。
examples.english_sentence: This brand is already a symbol of credibility.

english_meaning: signature dish; specialty (of a restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 指餐厅最出名，最能代表其特色的菜肴。
explanation_english: The most famous or signature dish of a restaurant, often considered its specialty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅招牌菜係咕嚕肉，好好食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3 hai6 gu1 lou1 juk6, hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的招牌菜是咕咾肉，很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's signature dish is sweet and sour pork, it's delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想試吓邊樣？不如試吓佢哋嘅招牌菜先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 si3 haa5 bin1 joeng6? bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ziu1 paai4 coi3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想尝尝哪个？不如先试试他们的招牌菜吧。
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to try? Why don't we try their signature dish first?

mandarin_meaning: 自我宣传的诗句；店铺里用来宣传招徕顾客的顺口溜
english_meaning: A slogan or rhyme used on a shop sign to attract customers; self-promoting verse.
explanation_mandarin: 指商家为了吸引顾客，在店铺招牌上或者店内张贴的朗朗上口的诗句或顺口溜，通常带有自我宣传的性质。
explanation_english: Refers to catchy rhymes or slogans that merchants display on their shop signs or inside their shops to attract customers. They are usually self-promotional in nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間涼茶鋪啲招牌詩幾得意，吸引咗好多人幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 loeng4 caa4 pou1 di1 ziu1 paai4 si1 gei2 dak1 ji3, kap1 yan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 bong1 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家凉茶铺的招牌诗很有意思，吸引了很多人光顾。
examples.english_sentence: The slogans on that herbal tea shop were quite interesting and attracted many customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲老店好興用招牌詩嚟做宣傳，而家就好少見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 lou5 dim3 hou2 hing1 yung6 ziu1 paai4 si1 lai4 zou6 syun1 cyun4, ji4 gaa1 zau6 hou2 siu2 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的老店铺很流行用招牌诗来做宣传，现在就很少见了。
examples.english_sentence: Old shops used to be very fond of using slogans for advertising, but it's rarely seen these days.

english_meaning: signature product; best-selling item; star item; flagship product
explanation_mandarin: 指商店或公司最有特色、最畅销的商品。也指最能代表某个商店或公司的产品。
explanation_english: Refers to the most characteristic and best-selling product of a shop or company. It also refers to the product that best represents a store or company; signature product.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ziu1 paai3 fo3 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caa1 siu1 faan6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wai6 zo2 sik6 ni1 go3 faan6 ji4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的招牌菜是他们的叉烧饭，很多人都为了吃这个饭而来。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's signature dish is their char siu rice. Many people come here just to eat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅招牌貨係手工皮革製品，好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 ge3 ziu1 paai3 fo3 hai6 sau2 gung1 pik1 go3 zai3 ban2, hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的招牌商品是手工皮革制品，很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This shop's signature product is handmade leather goods, which are very popular.

english_meaning: Signature dish (rice); House special rice dish
explanation_mandarin: 餐馆里最受欢迎或最特色的饭类菜品。
explanation_english: A rice dish that is a restaurant's most popular or signature dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想試吓你哋嘅招牌飯，有咩推薦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5 nei5 dei6 ge3 ziu1 paai4 faan6, jau5 me1 tui1 gin3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想试试你们的招牌饭，有什么推荐？
examples.english_sentence: I want to try your signature rice dish, what do you recommend?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳嘅招牌飯真係好好食，每次嚟都一定要叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ziu1 paai4 faan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 sik6, mui5 ci3 lai4 dou1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的招牌饭真的很好吃，每次来都要点。
examples.english_sentence: This cafe's signature rice dish is really delicious, I have to order it every time I come.

english_meaning: to recruit students; to enroll students; student recruitment
explanation_mandarin: 指学校或教育机构招收学生。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of schools or educational institutions recruiting students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校今年招生嘅人數多咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 ziu1 sang1 ge3 jan4 sou3 do1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校今年招收的学生人数多了。
examples.english_sentence: This school is enrolling more students this year.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zing3 hai2 dou6 ziu1 sang1, jau5 hing3 ceoi3 zau6 bou3 ming4 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: They are recruiting students, sign up if you are interested.

english_meaning: to let (property); to rent out
explanation_mandarin: 指出租房屋或店铺等，刊登广告或以其他方式寻找租户。
explanation_english: To advertise or otherwise seek tenants for a property available for rent, such as a house or shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺網上招租佢間屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 ziu1 zu1 keoi5 gaan1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在网上招租他的房子。
examples.english_sentence: He's advertising his house for rent online.

english_meaning: cocky, arrogant, smug, showy, boastful, to be smug or pleased with oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容人得意洋洋，炫耀自己的成就或优越感，态度傲慢自大。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is cocky, arrogant, and smug, showing off their achievements or perceived superiority with an attitude of arrogance and self-importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽就招積到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3 zau6 ziu1 zik1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛后得意得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: He became extremely cocky after winning the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁招積啦，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ziu1 zik1 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么得意了，谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, it's better to be more humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人哋面前招積，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 ziu1 zik1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在别人面前炫耀，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always showing off in front of others, it's very annoying.

english_meaning: leaflet; flyer; advertisement; pamphlet
explanation_mandarin: 指用于宣传、招揽顾客或告知信息的纸质印刷品，通常比较小，容易携带。
explanation_english: Refers to a printed piece of paper, typically small and easy to carry, used for promotion, advertising, or informing people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派緊招紙，宣傳新開嘅餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 gan2 ziu1 zi2, syun1 cyun4 san1 hoi1 ge3 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在发传单，宣传新开的餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: They are handing out flyers to promote the newly opened restaurant.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 lo2 zo2 zoeng1 ziu1 zi2, hai6 gaan1 mei5 yung4 yun2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上拿了一张传单，是一家美容院的。
examples.english_sentence: I picked up a flyer on the street, it's from a beauty salon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁攞啲招紙，浪費資源㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 lo2 di1 ziu1 zi2, long6 fai3 zi1 jyun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱拿传单，浪费资源的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly take flyers, it's a waste of resources.

english_meaning: to recruit through examination; recruitment exam
explanation_mandarin: 通过考试的方式招聘人员。
explanation_english: To recruit staff or students through an examination process; also refers to the recruitment examination itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府部門最近會招考公務員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 zeoi3 gan6 wui5 ziu1 haau2 gung1 mou6 yun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府部门最近会招聘公务员。
examples.english_sentence: The government departments will be recruiting civil servants recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢報咗名參加警隊嘅招考。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他报名参加了警队的招考。
examples.english_sentence: He registered for the police force recruitment exam.

english_meaning: recruit; recruitment; to hire
explanation_mandarin: 招收聘用人员。
explanation_english: To recruit or hire personnel; the act of recruitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司而家招聘緊市場推廣嘅人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 ziu1 ping3 gan2 si5 coeng4 tui1 gwong2 ge3 jyun4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司现在正在招聘市场推广的人才。
examples.english_sentence: Our company is currently recruiting talent for marketing.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份招聘启事写得很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This job advertisement is written very clearly.

examples.english_sentence: He went to a job fair to look for a job.

mandarin_meaning: 首次公开募股；发行股票

explanation_english: The process of offering shares of a private corporation to the public for the first time. It is the process by which a company can raise money by selling stock to the public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備下個月招股上市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ziu1 gu2 soeng5 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司准备下个月首次公开募股上市。
examples.english_sentence: The company is preparing to launch an IPO next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋招股嘅反應好好，好多人認購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ziu1 gu2 ge3 faan2 jing3 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 jing6 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的首次公开募股反应很好，很多人认购。
examples.english_sentence: Their IPO had a very good response, many people subscribed.

english_meaning: to incur, to invite, to bring about, to result in
explanation_mandarin: 引来，导致（多指不好的结果）。
explanation_english: To bring about, to incur, to cause (usually used for negative consequences).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為招致咗好多麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 ziu1 zi3 zo2 hou2 do1 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为招致了很多麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior caused a lot of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定可能會招致不良後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 wui5 ziu1 zi3 bat1 loeng4 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定可能会招致不良后果。
examples.english_sentence: This decision may lead to adverse consequences.

english_meaning: to find a son-in-law (to live with the bride's family); matrilocal marriage
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指没有儿子的家庭，招一个女婿来与女儿结婚，并在女方家居住，继承女方家的产业。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese society, especially when a family has no sons, it refers to finding a son-in-law to marry the daughter and live with the bride's family, inheriting the bride's family property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企冇仔，想招親啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 mou5 zai2, soeng2 ziu1 can1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家没有儿子，想招婿而已。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has no sons, they just want to find a son-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家都少人招親啦，興自己揀對象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 dou1 siu2 jan4 ziu1 can1 laa1, hing3 zi6 gei2 gaan2 deoi3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少人招婿了，流行自己选择对象。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, fewer people are looking for a son-in-law. It's more popular to choose your own partner.

english_meaning: to confess; to admit (a crime or fault)
explanation_mandarin: 承认罪行或过错。
explanation_english: To admit to having committed a crime or fault; to confess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺警局度招認咗所有嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ging2 guk6 dou6 ziu1 jing6 zo2 so2 jau5 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在警察局里招认了所有的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: He confessed to all the crimes at the police station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺證據確鑿嘅情況下，佢最終都招認咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 geoi3 kok3 zok6 ge3 ching4 kwong3 haa6, keoi5 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 ziu1 jing6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在证据确凿的情况下，他最终都招认了。
examples.english_sentence: Under overwhelming evidence, he finally confessed.

english_meaning: to recruit; to hire; to invite applications
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某个职位或任务而公开征求合适的人选。类似于普通话的“招聘”。
explanation_english: To publicly seek suitable candidates for a position or task. Similar to "recruiting" or "hiring" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司而家招請緊文員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 ziu1 cing2 gan2 man4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司现在正在招聘文员。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently recruiting clerks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋招請咗個新嘅設計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ziu1 cing2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 sai3 gai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们招聘了一个新的设计师。
examples.english_sentence: We have hired a new designer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺報紙上面登廣告招請人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bou3 zi2 soeng6 min6 dang1 gwong2 gou3 ziu1 cing2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在报纸上登广告招聘人。
examples.english_sentence: They are advertising in the newspaper to recruit people.

english_meaning: Lucky Cat, Beckoning Cat, Money Cat
explanation_mandarin: 一种日本的摆设，据说可以招来财富。通常是一个猫的形象，举起一只爪子，表示招揽客人或财富。
explanation_english: A Japanese figurine (usually ceramic) believed to bring good luck and wealth. It typically depicts a cat with one paw raised as if beckoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺鋪頭擺咗隻招財貓，希望可以多啲生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 pou3 tau2 baai2 zo2 zek3 ziu1 coi4 maau1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 do1 di1 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在店里摆了一只招财猫，希望可以多一些生意。
examples.english_sentence: I put a lucky cat in my shop, hoping it can bring more business.

english_meaning: Matrilocal marriage; to marry a man into the family; to have a son-in-law move in with the bride's family
explanation_mandarin: 指女子招夫入门，男方成为女方家庭的一员，通常男方要改姓或者孩子随母亲姓氏。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman marrying a man into her family, where the man becomes a member of the woman's family. Often, the man may change his surname or the children will take the mother's surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋得個女，所以想招郎入舍，等個女有人照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dak1 go3 neoi2, so2 ji5 soeng2 ziu1 long4 jap6 se3, dang2 go3 neoi2 jau5 jan4 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们只有一个女儿，所以想招赘，好让女儿有人照顾。
examples.english_sentence: They only have a daughter, so they want to have a matrilocal marriage so that their daughter will be taken care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅社會，招郎入舍嘅情況已經少咗好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 se5 wui2, ziu1 long4 jap6 se3 ge3 cing4 kong3 ji5 ging1 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的社会，招赘的情况已经少了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: In today's society, the practice of matrilocal marriage is much less common.

english_meaning: to offer amnesty and induce surrender; to entice into surrender
explanation_mandarin: 指劝说敌方或叛乱者投降。
explanation_english: To offer amnesty and induce enemy forces or rebels to surrender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將軍諗住招降班賊人，唔想搞到生靈塗炭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 gwan1 nam2 zyu2 ziu1 hong4 baan1 caak6 jan4, m4 soeng2 gaau2 dou3 sang1 ling4 tou4 taan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将军打算招降那些贼人，不想造成生灵涂炭。
examples.english_sentence: The general plans to offer amnesty to the bandits, not wanting to cause widespread suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘗試招降嗰個反對派嘅領導人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 si4 caang4 si3 ziu1 hong4 go2 go3 faan2 deoi3 paai3 ge3 ling5 dou6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们尝试招降那个反对派的领导人。
examples.english_sentence: They are trying to entice the leader of the opposition party to surrender.

english_meaning: To summon the spirit of the dead; to call back the soul
explanation_mandarin: 一种迷信仪式，相信可以招回死者的灵魂。
explanation_english: A superstitious ritual performed to summon the spirit or soul of the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺喪禮上面做緊招魂儀式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 song1 lai5 soeng6 min6 zou6 gan2 ziu1 wan4 ji4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在葬礼上举行招魂仪式。
examples.english_sentence: They are performing a ritual to summon the soul at the funeral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆過身之後，佢哋就請咗道士嚟招魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dei6 zau6 ceng2 zo2 dou6 si6 lai4 ziu1 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶去世后，他们就请了道士来招魂。
examples.english_sentence: After grandma passed away, they hired a Taoist priest to summon her soul.

english_meaning: to worship; to pay respects; to visit (someone out of courtesy); to request; to salute; to take leave; to say goodbye
explanation_mandarin: 表示敬意；请求；告别等。
explanation_english: Indicates respect, a request, saying goodbye, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去拜山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 baai3 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去祭拜山。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to visit the ancestral graves tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我拜託你幫我買飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baai3 tok3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拜托你帮我买票。
examples.english_sentence: I'm asking you to help me buy tickets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜拜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 baai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再见！
examples.english_sentence: Goodbye!

english_meaning: Thanks to... (often used sarcastically); Due to... (typically implying a negative consequence)
explanation_mandarin: 表示由于某人或某事的影响，通常带有一种讽刺的意味，指不好的结果。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happened due to someone or something, often with a sarcastic tone, implying a negative consequence or outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜你所賜，我今次考試肥佬喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 nei5 so2 ci3, ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托你的福，我这次考试没及格！
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to you, I failed the exam this time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜個天所賜，今日落曬雨，乜都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 go3 tin1 so2 ci3, gam1 jat6 lok6 saai3 jyu5, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 托老天的福，今天下了一整天的雨，什么都做不了。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to the weather, it's been raining all day, so we can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜你哋所賜，我哋間公司執笠都似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 nei5 dei6 so2 ci3, ngo5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1 dou1 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜你们所赐，我们公司看起来要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to you guys, our company looks like it's going to close down.

mandarin_meaning: 祭拜五脏庙 (开玩笑地指吃饭)
english_meaning: To worship the five viscera temple (humorous way of saying 'to eat')
explanation_mandarin: “五脏庙”是戏称肚子。拜五脏庙就是指吃饭，填饱肚子。是一种幽默的说法。
explanation_english: "Five viscera temple" is a humorous term for the stomach. "To worship the five viscera temple" means to eat, to fill the stomach. It's a humorous way of saying 'to eat'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋快啲搵間餐廳拜五臟廟啦，肚餓到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 wan2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 baai3 ng5 zong6 miu2 laa1, tou5 ngo6 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们快点找间餐厅吃饭吧，饿死了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's quickly find a restaurant to eat, I'm starving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掛住做嘢，記得定時拜五臟廟呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 zou6 je5, gei3 dak1 ding6 si4 baai3 ng5 zong6 miu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只顾着工作，记得定时吃饭啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't focus only on work, remember to eat regularly.

english_meaning: To eat (euphemism, especially when eating something substantial); to use the toilet (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 一种委婉的说法，表示吃东西或者上厕所。其中“五脏神”指身体内部负责消化和排泄的各个器官。
explanation_english: A euphemistic expression for eating, especially a large or satisfying meal, or for using the toilet. "Five organ gods" refers to the internal organs responsible for digestion and excretion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去食晏囉，拜下五臟神先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 aan3 lo1, baai3 haa5 ng5 zong6 san4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去吃午饭吧，先拜拜五脏神。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go for lunch, let's appease the five organ gods first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該等我陣，我去拜拜五臟神先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 dang2 ngo5 zan6, ngo5 heoi3 baai3 baai3 ng5 zong6 san4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请等我一下，我去上个厕所先。
examples.english_sentence: Please wait for me a moment, I need to use the toilet first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食咗咁多嘢，真係要拜拜五臟神喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 jiu3 baai3 baai3 ng5 zong6 san4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吃了这么多东西，真的要去上厕所了。
examples.english_sentence: He ate so much, he really needs to go to the toilet now.

mandarin_meaning: 求神拜佛; 祈求神仙
english_meaning: To worship deities; to pray to gods/immortals
explanation_mandarin: 指向神仙祈求保佑、庇护或实现愿望的行为。
explanation_english: The act of praying to deities or immortals for blessings, protection, or the fulfillment of wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，好多人都會去廟拜仙，希望新一年順順利利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 miu2 baai3 sin1, hei1 mong6 san1 jat1 nin4 seon6 seon6 lei6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人都会去庙里拜神，希望新的一年顺顺利利。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many people go to temples to worship deities, hoping for a smooth and successful new year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐都唔好，所以佢阿妈带佢去拜仙，希望神仙保佑佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 keoi5 aa3 maa1 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 baai3 sin1, hei1 mong6 sin1 sin1 bou2 jau6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久都没好，所以他妈妈带他去拜神，希望神仙保佑他。
examples.english_sentence: He has been sick for a long time without getting better, so his mother took him to worship deities, hoping that the gods would bless him.

english_meaning: to pay a visit; to greet; to send regards
explanation_mandarin: 探望、问候别人。
explanation_english: To visit or greet someone, typically out of respect or formality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋應該去拜候吓啲長輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 heoi3 baai3 hau6 haa5 di1 cheung4 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们应该去拜访一下长辈。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, we should visit our elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去拜候李先生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 baai3 hau6 Lei5 sin1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会去拜访李先生。
examples.english_sentence: I will visit Mr. Li tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你幫我拜候你屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ching2 nei5 bong1 ngo5 baai3 hau6 nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你帮我问候你的家人。
examples.english_sentence: Please send my regards to your family.

english_meaning: Byzantine Empire
explanation_mandarin: 指东罗马帝国，是罗马帝国分裂后，以君士坦丁堡为首都的帝国。
explanation_english: Refers to the Eastern Roman Empire, an empire with Constantinople as its capital after the split of the Roman Empire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜占庭帝國嘅歷史好耐，對歐洲文化影響好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 zaam1 ting4 dai3 gwok3 ge3 lik6 si2 hou2 noi6, deoi3 au1 zau1 man4 faa3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜占庭帝国的历史很悠久，对欧洲文化影响很深。
examples.english_sentence: The history of the Byzantine Empire is very long and has a profound influence on European culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋歷史堂學緊拜占庭帝國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lik6 si2 tong4 hok6 gan2 baai3 zaam1 ting4 dai3 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们历史课正在学习拜占庭帝国。
examples.english_sentence: We are learning about the Byzantine Empire in history class.

mandarin_meaning: 祭拜房屋的四个角落；安宅
english_meaning: To perform a ritual offering to the spirits of a new home (at the four corners); to pacify the spirits of a house before moving in.
explanation_mandarin: 在搬进新家之前，为了祈求平安和驱逐可能存在的邪灵，会在房屋的四个角落进行祭拜仪式。通常会准备一些供品，如水果、糖果、香烛等。
explanation_english: Before moving into a new home, it is a traditional practice to perform a ritual offering at the four corners of the house. This is done to pray for peace and to drive away any potentially malevolent spirits. Typically, offerings such as fruits, candies, incense, and candles are prepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日搬屋，今日要拜四角保平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 bun1 uk1, gam1 jat6 jiu3 baai3 sei3 gok3 bou2 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天搬家，今天要做拜四角的仪式，保佑平安。
examples.english_sentence: We are moving house tomorrow, so today we need to perform the ritual of offering to the four corners to ensure peace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人搬入新屋之前都會拜四角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 bun1 jap6 san1 uk1 zi1 cin4 dou1 wui5 baai3 sei3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港人在搬进新家之前都会做拜四角的仪式。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong people perform the ritual of offering to the four corners before moving into a new house.

english_meaning: wedding ceremony (kneeling before heaven and earth and ancestors)
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统婚礼仪式，新郎新娘在祠堂或厅堂行礼，拜天地、祖先和父母。
explanation_english: Traditional Chinese wedding ceremony where the bride and groom kneel before heaven and earth, ancestors, and parents to pay respect and acknowledge the marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日要拜堂，正式結為夫婦喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 baai3 tong4, zing3 sik1 git3 wai4 fu1 fu2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天要拜堂，正式结为夫妇了。
examples.english_sentence: They will perform the wedding ceremony tomorrow and officially become husband and wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多後生仔結婚都唔拜堂喇，直接搞西式婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hau6 sang1 zai2 git3 fan1 dou1 m4 baai3 tong4 laa3, zik6 zip3 gaau2 sai1 sik1 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多年轻人结婚都不拜堂了，直接举办西式婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people don't perform the traditional wedding ceremony anymore, they have Western-style weddings directly.

english_meaning: kneeling cushion; prayer cushion
explanation_mandarin: 通常用于跪拜时垫在膝盖下方的垫子，减轻膝盖的压力。
explanation_english: A cushion used for kneeling, typically during prayers or religious ceremonies, to provide comfort and support to the knees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺廟宇入面，我哋會見到好多拜墊俾信徒跪拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 miu6 jyu5 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 gin3 dou2 ho2 do1 baai3 zin3 bei2 seon3 tou4 gwai6 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在庙宇里面，我们会看到很多跪垫给信徒跪拜。
examples.english_sentence: In temples, we see many kneeling cushions for worshippers to kneel on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆跪喺拜墊度，好虔誠咁祈禱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gwai6 hai2 baai3 zin3 dou6, hou2 kin4 sing4 gam2 kei4 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶跪在跪垫上，很虔诚地祈祷。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is kneeling on the kneeling cushion, praying very devoutly.

english_meaning: to offer birthday congratulations (to an elder)
explanation_mandarin: 向长辈祝寿。传统习俗，通常在长辈生日时，晚辈会前往拜访并祝贺。
explanation_english: To offer birthday congratulations to an elder. A traditional custom where younger generations visit and offer their congratulations on an elder's birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要去拜壽，買咗啲嘢食去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 sau6, maai5 zo2 di1 je5 sik6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要去拜寿，买了一些东西去。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to offer birthday congratulations tomorrow and bought some things to take with us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年阿爺八十歲，要大搞，好多人嚟拜壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 aa3 je4 baat3 sap6 seoi3, jiu3 daai6 gaau2, hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 baai3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年爷爷八十岁，要大办，很多人来拜寿。
examples.english_sentence: This year is Grandpa's 80th birthday, we're going to have a big celebration, many people are coming to offer birthday congratulations.

mandarin_meaning: 祝寿，庆祝生日（特指长辈的大生日）
english_meaning: to celebrate a grand birthday (especially for elderly relatives)
explanation_mandarin: 为长辈庆祝生日，特别是重要的生日，例如六十大寿、七十大寿等。带有祝愿长辈健康长寿的含义。
explanation_english: To celebrate the birthday of an elder, especially a significant one like their 60th, 70th, etc. It carries the meaning of wishing the elder good health and longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月就係我阿嫲八十大壽，我哋要幫佢拜大壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 aa3 maa4 baat3 sap6 daai6 sau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 baai3 daai6 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月就是我奶奶八十大寿，我们要帮她祝寿。
examples.english_sentence: Next month is my grandma's 80th birthday, we need to celebrate her grand birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋決定搞個大party幫爺爺拜大壽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 gaau2 go3 daai6 paarty1 bong1 je4 je4 baai3 daai6 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们决定办个大型聚会给爷爷祝寿。
examples.english_sentence: This year we decided to throw a big party to celebrate grandpa's grand birthday.

english_meaning: To do something extremely taboo or inauspicious; to violate a major taboo; to jinx something badly.
explanation_mandarin: 指触犯了极大的禁忌，做了非常不吉利的事情。通常带有迷信色彩，认为会带来厄运。
explanation_english: Refers to violating a significant taboo or doing something extremely inauspicious. It usually carries a superstitious connotation, suggesting that it will bring bad luck or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年流流講埋啲唔吉利嘅嘢，真係拜大忌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 lau4 lau4 gong2 maai4啲 m4 gat1 lei6 ge3嘢, zan1 hai6 baai3 daai6 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间说那些不吉利的话，真是触霉头。
examples.english_sentence: Talking about unlucky things during the Chinese New Year is extremely taboo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手術前唔好講啲唔成功嘅嘢，費事拜大忌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 seot6 cin4 m4 hou2 gong2啲 m4 sing4 gung1 ge3嘢, fai3 si4 baai3 daai6 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手术前不要说一些不成功的话，免得触霉头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about failure before the surgery, lest we jinx it.

english_meaning: To kowtow to heaven and earth (a traditional wedding ritual)
explanation_mandarin: 中国传统婚礼仪式中，新人向天地叩拜，以示敬天敬地，感谢天地庇佑。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese weddings, the bride and groom kowtow to heaven and earth as a sign of respect and gratitude for their blessings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聽日結婚，到時要拜天地㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ting1 jat6 git3 fan1, dou3 si4 jiu3 baai3 tin1 dei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们明天结婚，到时候要拜天地的。
examples.english_sentence: They are getting married tomorrow, they will kowtow to heaven and earth then.

english_meaning: To visit ancestral graves; tomb sweeping
explanation_mandarin: 指在清明节或其他节日期间，到祖先的坟墓前祭拜、扫墓。
explanation_english: Refers to the practice of visiting and tidying up ancestral graves during Qingming Festival or other holidays, paying respects to ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要去拜山啊，要早啲起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 baai3 saan1 aa3, jiu3 zou2 di1 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要去扫墓啊，要早点起床。
examples.english_sentence: We're going tomb sweeping tomorrow, so we need to wake up early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節好多人都會返鄉下拜山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 baai3 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节很多人都会回乡下扫墓。
examples.english_sentence: Many people go back to their hometowns to sweep tombs during the Qingming Festival.

english_meaning: Visiting card; name card
explanation_mandarin: 旧时用于拜访时投递的卡片，上面写有姓名、职位等信息。
explanation_english: A card traditionally used for paying visits, containing information such as name and position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好少人用拜帖啦，大家都用咭片多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 jan4 yung6 baai3 tip3 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 yung6 kaat1 pin3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少人用拜帖了，大家都用名片比较多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few people use visiting cards, most people use business cards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遞咗張拜帖畀我，話想約我出嚟傾生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 zo2 zoeng1 baai3 tip3 bei2 ngo5, waa6 soeng2 joek3 ngo5 chut1 lai4 king1 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他递给我一张名片，说想约我出来谈生意。
examples.english_sentence: He handed me a visiting card, saying he wanted to meet me to discuss business.

english_meaning: to formally accept a master; to become an apprentice; apprenticeship
explanation_mandarin: 正式向师傅行礼并学习技艺。通常指学习武术、戏曲、手艺等。
explanation_english: To formally acknowledge and become a student of a master, usually in traditional arts like martial arts, opera, or crafts. It involves a formal ceremony and commitment to learn from the master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始拜師學功夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 baai3 si1 hok6 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始拜师学功夫。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning Kung Fu from a master since he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想學詠春，就應該搵個好嘅師傅嚟拜師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 hok6 wing6 cheun1, zau6 ying1 goi1 wan2 go3 hou2 ge3 si1 fu2 lai4 baai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想学咏春，就应该找个好的师傅来拜师。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to learn Wing Chun, you should find a good master to formally become their apprentice.

english_meaning: to pay a New Year visit; to wish someone a Happy New Year
explanation_mandarin: 春节期间，向亲戚朋友长辈等拜访并祝贺新年。
explanation_english: During the Chinese New Year period, to visit relatives, friends, elders, etc., and wish them a Happy New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，我哋要去親戚屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 can1 cik1 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们要去亲戚家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we need to visit our relatives' homes to wish them a Happy New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我淨係同屋企人拜年，冇去朋友度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 zing6 hai6 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 baai3 nin4, mou5 heoi3 pang4 jau5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我只是和家人拜年，没有去朋友那里。
examples.english_sentence: This year I only paid New Year visits to my family, I didn't go to my friends' place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋去阿爺阿嫲度拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 aa3 je4 aa3 maa4 dou6 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们去爷爷奶奶家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow we are going to visit Grandpa and Grandma to wish them a Happy New Year.

jyutping: baai3 dak1 san4 do1 zi6 jau5 san4 bei3 jau6
english_meaning: The more gods you worship, the more blessings you receive; It doesn't hurt to try; It's better to be safe than sorry (when seeking blessings/help)
explanation_mandarin: 指多多祈求神灵，自然能得到更多保佑。比喻多方面尝试或努力，总会有好处。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that the more you pray to gods, the more blessings you will receive. It implies that trying different approaches or putting in extra effort can only be beneficial. Similar to the idea of covering all bases or being better safe than sorry when seeking divine favor or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 是但啦，拜得神多自有神庇佑，試吓唔蝕底嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 daan6 laa1, baai3 dak1 san4 do1 zi6 jau5 san4 bei3 jau6, si3 haa5 m4 sit1 dai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便吧，多烧香多得保佑，试试又不吃亏。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever, the more gods you worship, the more blessings you receive. Trying it won't hurt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都拜，都係想拜得神多自有神庇佑啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 baai3, dou1 hai6 soeng2 baai3 dak1 san4 do1 zi6 jau5 san4 bei3 jau6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都拜，都是想多烧香多得保佑罢了。
examples.english_sentence: He worships everything, just hoping to get more blessings by worshipping more gods.

english_meaning: to repent and confess sins (through Buddhist rituals); to perform repentance rituals; to recite sutras for repentance
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，指向佛菩萨忏悔，请求宽恕过错的一种仪式。通常通过诵经、礼拜等方式进行，以求消除罪业，获得心灵的平静。
explanation_english: A Buddhist term referring to a ritual of repenting and confessing sins before Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, seeking forgiveness. It usually involves reciting sutras, prostrating, and other practices to eliminate negative karma and achieve inner peace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拜懺，希望可以消除業障。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baai3 caam3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 siu1 ceoi4 jip6 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常拜忏，希望可以消除业障。
examples.english_sentence: He often performs repentance rituals, hoping to eliminate negative karma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廟聽日會有拜懺法會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 miu2 ting1 jat6 wui5 jau5 baai3 caam3 faat3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间寺庙明天有拜忏法会。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a repentance ceremony at that temple tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人喺觀音誕嘅時候去廟度拜懺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 gun1 jam1 daan3 ge3 si4 hau6 heoi3 miu2 dou6 baai3 caam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人在观音诞的时候去庙里拜忏。
examples.english_sentence: Many people go to temples to perform repentance rituals during the Goddess of Mercy's birthday.

english_meaning: Goodbye
explanation_mandarin: 表示告别的常用语，相当于“再见”。
explanation_english: A common expression used to say goodbye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日見，拜拜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gin3, baai1 baai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天见，再见！
examples.english_sentence: See you tomorrow, goodbye!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要走啦，拜拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zau2 laa3, baai1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要走了，再见。
examples.english_sentence: I'm leaving, goodbye.

english_meaning: Goodbye, I'm ignoring you.
explanation_mandarin: 一种不礼貌的告别方式，表示不屑或轻视，隐含“我不会再理你”的意思。
explanation_english: A dismissive way of saying goodbye, implying disdain or disregard. It means 'I'm not going to bother with you anymore'. The literal translation of 'Goodbye your tail' doesn't make much sense on its own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同你拗啦，拜拜你條尾！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 aau3 laa1, baai1 baai1 nei5 tiu4 mei1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想跟你争辩了，再见，不理你了！
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to argue with you anymore, goodbye, I'm done with you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁衰格，拜拜你條尾啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, baai1 baai1 nei5 tiu4 mei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么恶劣，再见，不理你了！
examples.english_sentence: You are so awful, goodbye, I'm done with you!

synonyms: 掟你出街 (deng3 nei5 ceot1 gaai1)

english_meaning: Bingo wings; flabby upper arms
explanation_mandarin: 指女性手臂腋下至手肘上方松弛的脂肪组织，挥动手臂时会晃动。
explanation_english: Refers to the flabby or loose fat tissue on the upper arms, especially the area between the armpit and elbow. It jiggles when the arms are waved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話要操fit啲，唔想有拜拜肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 cou1 fit1 di1, m4 soeng2 jau5 baai3 baai3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说要健身，不想有蝴蝶袖。
examples.english_sentence: She always says she wants to get fitter because she doesn't want bingo wings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 著無袖衫最怕就係啲拜拜肉走晒出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 mou4 sau2 saam1 zeoi3 paa3 zau6 hai6 di1 baai3 baai3 juk6 zau2 saai3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穿无袖衫最怕的就是蝴蝶袖露出来。
examples.english_sentence: The worst thing about wearing sleeveless tops is having bingo wings showing.

english_meaning: to pay a visit, to call on
explanation_mandarin: 正式地拜访会见。
explanation_english: To pay a formal visit to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日佢哋會拜會個市長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 keoi5 dei6 wui2 baai3 wui2 go3 si5 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天他们将会拜访市长。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow they will pay a visit to the mayor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今日派咗代表去拜會客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 paai3 zo2 doi6 biu2 heoi3 baai3 wui2 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今天派了代表去拜访客户。
examples.english_sentence: Our company sent a representative to visit the client today.

english_meaning: to worship the moon; moon worship
explanation_mandarin: 在某些传统节日，如中秋节，人们祭拜月亮，祈求平安和幸福。
explanation_english: To worship the moon, usually during traditional festivals like the Mid-Autumn Festival, to pray for peace and happiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節我哋會拜月，祈求一家人平平安安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 ngo5 dei6 wui5 baai3 jyut6, kei4 kau4 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ping4 ping4 on1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋节我们会拜月，祈求一家人平平安安。
examples.english_sentence: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, we worship the moon to pray for the safety and peace of our family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話以前啲人中秋節都會喺屋企門口拜月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 zung1 cau1 zit3 dou1 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 baai3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说以前的人中秋节都会在屋门口拜月亮。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma says that people used to worship the moon at the door of their houses during the Mid-Autumn Festival.

english_meaning: to admire; to be impressed; to submit (out of admiration or respect); to be awed
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常佩服，心悦诚服，甘拜下风。
explanation_english: Expressing deep admiration, submission, and being thoroughly impressed, acknowledging someone's superiority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅才華真係令人拜服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 coi4 waa4 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 baai3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的才华真是令人佩服。
examples.english_sentence: His talent is truly admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完佢嘅表演，我真係拜服到五體投地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 baai3 fuk6 dou3 ng5 tai2 tau4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完他的表演，我真是佩服得五体投地。
examples.english_sentence: After watching his performance, I was truly impressed to the point of complete submission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，我真係拜服晒你啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 baai3 fuk6 saai3 nei5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么厉害，我真是佩服死你了！
examples.english_sentence: You are so amazing, I really admire you!

mandarin_meaning: 换桌子；（吃饭时）端着碗到处敬酒
english_meaning: To change tables (in a banquet); To go around toasting everyone at a banquet
explanation_mandarin: 在宴席中，换到不同的桌子就坐或站立，多指为了敬酒而到不同的桌子。 也指更换桌子（如餐厅里）。
explanation_english: At a banquet, to move to different tables, usually to offer toasts. Also, to change tables (e.g., in a restaurant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚擺酒，新郎哥要周圍拜枱㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 baai2 zau2, san1 long4 go1 jiu3 zau1 wai4 baai3 toi2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚办喜酒，新郎要到处敬酒的。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight is the wedding banquet, the groom needs to go around toasting everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋換過張枱啦，呢張枱太窄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wun6 gwo3 zoeng1 toi2 laa1, ni1 zoeng1 toi2 taai3 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们换张桌子吧，这张桌子太窄了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's change tables, this table is too narrow.

english_meaning: to surrender oneself to the police; to turn oneself in
explanation_mandarin: 指向警方自首，承认自己的罪行。
explanation_english: To surrender oneself to the police, confessing one's crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知道自己走唔甩，最後都係拜案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 zau2 m4 lat1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 baai3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道自己逃不掉，最后还是自首了。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he couldn't escape, and in the end, he turned himself in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方勸喻佢盡快拜案，爭取寬大處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hyun3 jyu6 keoi5 zeon6 faai3 baai3 on3, zaang1 ceoi2 fun1 daai6 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方劝他尽快自首，争取宽大处理。
examples.english_sentence: The police urged him to turn himself in as soon as possible to get a lighter sentence.

english_meaning: Appreciation banquet; teacher appreciation dinner; dinner to express gratitude.
explanation_mandarin: 指学生或其家长为了感谢老师的教导而设的宴席。
explanation_english: Refers to a banquet organized by students or their parents to thank teachers for their teaching and guidance. It is often held after graduation or at the end of the school year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋畢業，家長們夾錢搞個拜檯，多謝老師咁多年嚟嘅教導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 bat1 jip6, gaa1 cheung2 mun4 gap3 chin2 gaau2 go3 baai3 toi2, do1 je6 lou5 si1 gam3 do1 nin4 lai4 ge3 gaau3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们毕业，家长们凑钱办个谢师宴，感谢老师这么多年来的教导。
examples.english_sentence: This year we are graduating, and the parents are chipping in to organize an appreciation banquet to thank the teachers for their teaching over the years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，擺幾圍拜檯，請啲同事食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 jik1, baai2 gei2 wai4 baai3 toi2, cheng2 di1 tung4 si6 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，摆了几桌感谢宴，请同事们吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, so he's hosting a dinner to express his gratitude and treat his colleagues to a meal.

english_meaning: To suck up to; to flatter; to brown-nose; to kiss up to
explanation_mandarin: 指通过奉承、谄媚等手段来讨好别人，以获取利益或好处。
explanation_english: Refers to flattering or brown-nosing someone to gain favour, benefits, or advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拜氈老細，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 baai3 zin1 lou5 sai3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拍老板的马屁，想升职啊。

english_meaning: Losing the chicken while worshipping the gods; penny-wise and pound-foolish

explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where one loses more than they gain in trying to save money or achieve a small benefit. It is like trying to worship the gods for blessings but ending up losing the chicken used for the ritual, resulting in a net loss.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 haan1 siu2 siu2 cin2, maai5 di1 lyut3 zat1 ge3 ling4 gin2, git3 gwo2 sing4 bou6 gei1 hei3 waai6 zo2, zan1 hai6 baai3 san4 m4 gin3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了省一点钱，买了些劣质的零件，结果整部机器坏了，真是得不偿失。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to save a little money by buying low-quality parts, but the whole machine broke down. It's a classic case of losing the chicken while worshipping the gods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪埋呢啲濕碎嘢，搞到冇咗份大生意，咪拜神唔見雞囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 maai4 ni1 di1 sap1 seoi3 je5, gaau2 dou3 mou5 zo2 fan6 daai6 seng1 ji3, mai6 baai3 san4 m4 gin3 gai1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪图这些零碎的东西，导致失去了一桩大生意，这不是得不偿失吗？
examples.english_sentence: Being greedy for these small things caused him to lose a big business deal. Isn't that losing the chicken while worshipping the gods?

english_meaning: To try to profit dishonestly but end up losing out instead; to try to gain an advantage but suffer a loss
explanation_mandarin: 表面上是去拜神，却连用来祭祀的鸡都丢了。比喻想占小便宜，结果反而吃了大亏。
explanation_english: Literally, it means going to worship the gods but losing the chicken intended as an offering. It's an idiom describing a situation where someone tries to take a shortcut or gain an unfair advantage, but ends up worse off than before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住賣啲翻版嘢賺錢，點知俾人捉咗，真係拜神唔見鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 maai6 di1 faan1 baan2 je5 zaan6 cin2, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zo2, zan1 hai6 baai3 san4 m4 gin3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想靠卖盗版货赚钱，结果被人抓了，真是偷鸡不成蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could make money by selling pirated goods, but he got caught. It's a case of trying to get something for nothing and losing out in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來諗住慳啲錢，買啲平啲嘅材料裝修，點知搞到一鑊粥，又要重新嚟過，咪即係拜神唔見鷄囉。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来想省点钱，买便宜的材料装修，结果弄得一团糟，又要重新来过，这不就是偷鸡不成蚀把米吗？
examples.english_sentence: Originally, I wanted to save some money and buy cheaper materials for the renovation, but it turned into a complete mess and I had to start all over again. That's just like trying to get a bargain and losing out in the end.

english_meaning: To avoid altercations/arguments during 赤口 (Chek Hau) day
explanation_mandarin: 赤口日，农历正月初三，传统上认为是不宜拜年的日子，容易与人发生口角。因此，“拜赤口”指在这一天尽量避免外出拜年，以避免争吵或不愉快的事情。
explanation_english: "拜赤口 (baai3 cek3 hau2)" refers to the practice of avoiding visiting relatives and friends on the third day of the Lunar New Year (Chek Hau day). Traditionally, it's believed that visiting on this day is prone to arguments and disputes, so people stay home to avoid potential conflicts.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 正月初三是赤口日，待在家里睡觉更好。
examples.english_sentence: It's Chek Hau day on the third day of Lunar New Year, it's better to stay home and sleep.

examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is Chek Hau day, I won't go out to visit relatives, to avoid arguing with people.

english_meaning: to worship; to pay respect; to visit (someone); to request (someone to do something); bye; to defeat; to leave (work)

explanation_english: Originally meaning to worship or kowtow, it has evolved to include verbs indicating requests, resignation, and in Hong Kong colloquialism, 'goodbye,' derived from the English 'bye.' It can also mean 'to defeat' in specific contexts or 'to leave work'.
