examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一块布来擦桌子。
examples.english_sentence: He took a cloth to wipe the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拭乾淨佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 gon1 zing6 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把它擦干净！
examples.english_sentence: Wipe it clean!

english_meaning: to wipe away, to erase
explanation_mandarin: 用布或其他东西擦掉，抹去。
explanation_english: To remove something by wiping, such as tears, dirt, or writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拭去面上嘅淚水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 heoi3 min6 soeng6 ge3 leoi6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擦去脸上的泪水。
examples.english_sentence: He wiped away the tears from his face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用毛巾拭去枱面嘅塵埃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 mou1 gan1 sik1 heoi3 toi2 min6 ge3 can4 ai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用毛巾擦去桌子上的灰尘。
examples.english_sentence: Wipe away the dust from the table with a towel.

english_meaning: to wait and see; to wait with expectation
explanation_mandarin: 擦亮眼睛等待着。形容期待的心情。
explanation_english: To wipe one's eyes and wait; to wait and see with expectation. It describes a feeling of anticipation and eagerness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋拭目以待佢嘅表現啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik1 muk6 ji5 doi6 keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们拭目以待他的表现吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's wait and see how he performs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政策推出，大家都拭目以待佢嘅成效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 caak3 tui1 ceot1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 sik1 muk6 ji5 doi6 keoi5 ge3 sing4 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政策推出，大家都拭目以待它的成效。
examples.english_sentence: With the introduction of the new policy, everyone is waiting to see its effectiveness.

synonyms: 靜觀其變 (zing6 gun1 kei4 bin3)

english_meaning: to prick, to stab (lightly), to sting
explanation_mandarin: 用尖锐的东西刺或扎。
explanation_english: To prick or stab with a sharp object, often lightly or superficially. Can also refer to an insect sting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀蚊拮咗一啖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 man1 gat1 zo2 jat1 daam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被蚊子叮了一下。
examples.english_sentence: I got bitten by a mosquito.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枝玫瑰嘅刺拮到我隻手指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 mui4 gwai3 ge3 ci3 gat1 dou2 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玫瑰花的刺扎到我的手指了。
examples.english_sentence: The thorns of the rose pricked my finger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好拮我呀，好驚㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gat1 ngo5 aa3, hou2 geng1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要扎我呀，我很害怕的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't prick me, I'm scared!

english_meaning: Very close friend, bosom buddy, best friend
explanation_mandarin: 指关系非常亲密的朋友，通常是关系好到可以互相分享秘密，互相支持，一起经历喜怒哀乐的朋友。
explanation_english: Refers to very close friends, usually those who are so close that they share secrets, support each other, and experience joys and sorrows together.  The English word 'friend' is adopted into Cantonese and duplicated to emphasise the closeness of the relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅拮拮friend，咩秘密都同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gat1 gat1 friend, me1 bei3 mat6 dou1 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我最好的朋友，什么秘密都跟她说。
examples.english_sentence: She is my best friend, I tell her all my secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋由細到大都係拮拮friend，感情好到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hai6 gat1 gat1 friend, gam2 ching4 hou2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们从小到大都是最好的朋友，感情好到不行。
examples.english_sentence: We have been best friends since we were little, our friendship is unbelievably strong.

english_meaning: strapped for cash, short of money, hard up
explanation_mandarin: 形容经济状况不好，手头缺钱，生活比较困难。
explanation_english: Describing a difficult financial situation; being short of money and having a hard time making ends meet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多人都好拮据。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 git3 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都很拮据。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, a lot of people are short of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近失業，生活好拮据。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sat1 jip6, sang1 wut6 hou2 git3 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近失业了，生活很拮据。
examples.english_sentence: He recently lost his job and is living on a tight budget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾好多嘢要買，搞到我好拮据。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 maai5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 git3 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底很多东西要买，搞得我很拮据。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of things to buy at the end of the year, which makes me really strapped for cash.

english_meaning: to rescue, to save, to deliver
explanation_mandarin: 解救，使脱离危险或困境。
explanation_english: To rescue, to save someone from danger or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拯人一命，勝造七級浮屠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 jan4 jat1 ming6, sing3 zou6 cat1 kap1 fau4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救人一命，胜造七级浮屠。
examples.english_sentence: Saving a life is more meritorious than building a seven-story pagoda.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢奮不顧身噉去拯個細路仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan5 bat1 gu3 san1 gam2 heoi3 cing2 go3 sai3 lou6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他奋不顾身地去救那个小孩。
examples.english_sentence: He risked his own life to rescue that child.

english_meaning: to save, to rescue
explanation_mandarin: 从危险或困境中救出。
explanation_english: To save or rescue someone or something from danger or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員拯救咗困喺火場嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 cing2 gau3 zo2 kwan3 hai2 fo2 coeng4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员拯救了被困在火场里的人。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters rescued the people trapped in the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拯救地球，保護環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cing2 gau3 dei6 kau4, bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拯救地球，保护环境。
examples.english_sentence: We need to save the Earth and protect the environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅愛拯救咗我嘅靈魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 oi3 cing2 gau3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ling4 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爱拯救了我的灵魂。
examples.english_sentence: His love saved my soul.

english_meaning: to rescue someone from drowning
explanation_mandarin: 从水中救起快要淹死的人。
explanation_english: To save someone from drowning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳落去拯溺嗰個細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 lok6 heoi3 cing2 nik6 go2 go3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跳下去救那个小孩。
examples.english_sentence: He jumped in to rescue that child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救生員嘅職責就係拯溺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 sang1 jyun4 ge3 jik1 zaak3 zau6 hai6 cing2 nik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救生员的职责就是救溺。
examples.english_sentence: A lifeguard's job is to rescue people from drowning.

mandarin_meaning: 弓起, 隆起; 推动, 怂恿; 抬高
english_meaning: to arch, to push up; to instigate, to egg on; to elevate (price); to flatter
explanation_mandarin: （一）使物体弯曲成弓形；隆起。（二）推动，怂恿，怂恿人做坏事。（三）抬高，捧高，吹捧。
explanation_english: (1) To arch, to curve something into an arch shape. To bulge. (2) To instigate, to egg someone on, usually to do something bad. (3) To elevate (price, status), to flatter, to praise insincerely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拱起條腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung2 hei2 tiu4 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他弓起了腰。
examples.english_sentence: He arched his back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好拱我做啲衰嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gung2 ngo5 zou6 di1 seoi1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要怂恿我做坏事啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't instigate me to do bad things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想拱高個樓價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gung2 gou1 go3 lau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想抬高房价。
examples.english_sentence: They want to inflate the house prices.

english_meaning: arch-shaped, arched
explanation_mandarin: 一种呈弧状的形状，像拱门一样。
explanation_english: A shape that is curved like an arch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條橋嘅設計係拱形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kiu2 ge3 sai3 gai3 hai6 gung2 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座桥的设计是拱形的。
examples.english_sentence: The design of the bridge is arch-shaped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅眉毛係拱形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mei4 mou4 hai6 gung2 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的眉毛是拱形的。
examples.english_sentence: Her eyebrows are arched.

english_meaning: To cup one's fist in the opposite hand as a respectful greeting; to salute with cupped hands
explanation_mandarin: 双手合抱，表示敬意的一种礼节。 也称作揖。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese greeting where one cups one's fist in the opposite hand, signifying respect and politeness. Also known as a bow or salute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋通常會同長輩拱手拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tung4 zoeng2 bui3 gung2 sau2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们通常会向长辈拱手拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, we usually greet elders by cupping our hands in salute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到我，笑眯眯咁拱手，好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 ngo5, siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2 gung2 sau2, hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到我，笑眯眯地拱手，很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw me, he smiled and cupped his hands in greeting, very polite.

english_meaning: To offer (something) readily; to give something away without a fight; to surrender with open hands
explanation_mandarin: 指不经努力或竞争就轻易地把利益、机会、权力等让给别人。
explanation_english: To readily offer something to someone else, often without competition or resistance. It implies a lack of effort to retain something valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個機會咁好，我點會拱手相讓俾其他人啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei1 wui2 gam3 hou2, ngo5 dim2 wui5 gung2 sau2 soeng1 joeng6 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么好的机会，我怎么会拱手让给别人呢？
examples.english_sentence: This is such a good opportunity, how could I readily give it away to someone else?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想競爭，所以拱手相讓咗個職位俾佢嘅同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 ging6 zang1, so2 ji5 gung2 sau2 soeng1 joeng6 zo2 go3 zik1 wai2 bei2 keoi5 ge3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想竞争，所以拱手相让了职位给他的同事。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to compete, so he readily gave the position to his colleague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，市場就會俾對手拱手相讓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6, si5 coeng4 zau6 wui5 bei2 deoi3 sau2 gung2 sau2 soeng1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，市场就会被对手拱手相让。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, the market will be readily given to our competitors.

mandarin_meaning: 做桥梁；牵线搭桥；仰卧起坐
english_meaning: To build a bridge; to act as a matchmaker; bridge exercise (physical fitness)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 比喻为双方建立联系，促进事情成功。2. 指一种健身运动，身体仰卧，用手和脚支撑，使身体呈拱桥状。
explanation_english: 1. Metaphorically, to build a bridge or act as a go-between for two parties to facilitate a successful outcome. 2. A physical exercise where one lies on their back and supports their body with their hands and feet, forming an arch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個結婚都係靠我拱橋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 git3 fan1 dou1 hai6 kaau3 ngo5 gung2 kiu4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个结婚都是靠我牵线搭桥的。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage was all thanks to me acting as a matchmaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做拱橋可以練到腹肌同埋背肌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gung2 kiu4 ho2 ji5 lin6 dou3 fuk1 gei1 tung4 maai4 bui3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做仰卧起坐可以锻炼腹肌和背肌。
examples.english_sentence: Doing the bridge exercise can train your abdominal and back muscles.

synonyms: 穿針引線 (chuen1 zam1 yan5 sin3) - threading the needle and leading the thread (matchmaking)

english_meaning: to arch; to hump; to buckle; to rise up (as in swelling)
explanation_mandarin: 表示向上彎曲或隆起。
explanation_english: Describes something curving upwards or bulging out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢膊頭拱起，好似好驚咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bok3 tau4 gung2 hei2, hou2 ci5 hou2 geng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他肩膀弓起来了，好像很害怕的样子。
examples.english_sentence: His shoulders arched up, as if he was very scared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塊木板濕咗水，有啲拱起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 muk6 baan2 sip1 zo2 seoi2, jau5 di1 gung2 hei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那块木板湿了水，有点隆起来了。
examples.english_sentence: The wooden board got wet and has buckled a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到成條腰都拱起埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 seng4 tiu4 jiu1 dou1 gung2 hei2 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得腰都弓起来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he arched his back.

english_meaning: arch, arcade
explanation_mandarin: 一种建筑结构，呈弧形，可以支撑上方的重量。
explanation_english: An arch is a curved structure that spans a space and supports weight above it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間教堂有個好靚嘅拱門入口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaau3 tong4 jau5 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 gung2 mun4 jap6 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间教堂有一个很漂亮的拱门入口。
examples.english_sentence: That church has a very beautiful arched entrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個花園嘅拱門爬滿咗玫瑰花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 faa1 jyun2 ge3 gung2 mun4 paa4 mun5 zo2 mui4 gwai3 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花园的拱门爬满了玫瑰花。
examples.english_sentence: The arch in the garden is covered with roses.

english_meaning: fist
explanation_mandarin: 手的握紧状态，尤指用于打斗。
explanation_english: A clenched hand, especially when used for fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舉起個拳頭，好似想打人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi2 hei2 go3 kyun4 tau4, hou2 ci5 soeng2 daa2 jan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他举起拳头，好像要打人一样。
examples.english_sentence: He raised his fist, as if he wanted to hit someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打拳可以強身健體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 kyun4 ho2 ji5 koeng4 san1 gin6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打拳可以强身健体。
examples.english_sentence: Boxing can strengthen your body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋玩包、剪、揼，邊個贏？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 waan2 baau1, zin2, dam2, bin1 go3 wing4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们玩石头剪刀布，谁赢？
examples.english_sentence: Let's play rock, paper, scissors, who wins?

english_meaning: Boxer, Fighter
explanation_mandarin: 指从事拳击运动的运动员或以拳头格斗的人。
explanation_english: Refers to an athlete who engages in the sport of boxing or a person who fights with their fists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅拳手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 kyun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个很有名的拳击手。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous boxer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個拳手嘅拳頭好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyun4 sau2 ge3 kyun4 tau4 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个拳击手的拳头很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This boxer's fist is very powerful.

english_meaning: to punch and kick; to beat up
explanation_mandarin: 用拳头打，用脚踢。形容暴力殴打。
explanation_english: To punch and kick someone; to beat someone up violently using fists and feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好拳打腳踢佢呀，咁樣好暴力㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kyun4 daa2 goek3 tek3 keoi5 aa3, gam2 joeng2 hou2 bou6 lik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拳打脚踢他啊，这样做很暴力的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't punch and kick him, that's very violent!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺屋企拳打腳踢，好嘈㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 kyun4 daa2 goek3 tek3, hou2 cou4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天在家里拳打脚踢，很吵闹！
examples.english_sentence: They are always punching and kicking each other at home, it's very noisy!

english_meaning: Every punch lands directly on the flesh; every hit counts; impactful; describes something very real and impactful, leaving a lasting impression
explanation_mandarin: 形容拳击等格斗动作真实，力度大，每一拳都打在对方身上，能感受到力量。也比喻说话、表演等非常真实、有力，给人留下深刻的印象。
explanation_english: Originally used to describe boxing or other fighting actions that are realistic and powerful, where every punch lands directly and powerfully on the opponent. It is also used metaphorically to describe speech, performances, or other things that are very real, forceful, and leave a lasting impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋套戲啲打鬥場面真係拳拳到肉，睇到我好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tou3 hei3 di1 daa2 dau3 cheung4 min6 zan1 hai6 kyun4 kyun4 dou3 yuk6, tai2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gan2 cheung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这部电影的打斗场面真是拳拳到肉，看得我很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: The fight scenes in their movie are really impactful, it made me very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個演員嘅演技好正，每一句對白都拳拳到肉，好有感染力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 yin2 yun4 ge3 yan2 gei6 hou2 zeng3, mui5 jat1 geoi3 deoi3 baak6 dou1 kyun4 kyun4 dou3 yuk6, hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个演员的演技很好，每一句台词都很有力量，很有感染力。
examples.english_sentence: This actor's acting is excellent, every line is impactful and very infectious.

synonyms: 真材實料 (zan1 choi4 sat6 liu2)
針針見血 (zam1 zam1 gin3 hyut3)

english_meaning: boxing
explanation_mandarin: 一种体育运动，两人戴拳套，按规则互相攻击。
explanation_english: A combat sport in which two people wearing protective gloves throw punches at each other based on a set of rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣已經開始學拳擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 hok6 kyun4 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就已经开始学拳击了。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning boxing when he was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有場拳擊比賽，你想唔想一齊去睇？

examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有一场拳击比赛，你想不想一起去看？
examples.english_sentence: There's a boxing match tomorrow. Do you want to go watch it together?

mandarin_meaning: 拳击冠军; 拳击高手
english_meaning: Boxing champion; boxing expert
explanation_mandarin: 指在拳击比赛中获得冠军的人，或指拳击技术高超的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has won a championship in boxing, or someone who is highly skilled in boxing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢目標係成為世界拳王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 muk6 biu1 hai6 sing4 wai4 sai3 gaai3 kyun4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的目标是成为世界拳击冠军。
examples.english_sentence: His goal is to become a world boxing champion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然唔係職業拳手，但係佢啲拳法好似拳王咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seui1 jin4 m4 hai6 zik1 jip6 kyun4 sau2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 di1 kyun4 faat3 hou2 ci5 kyun4 wong4 gam3.

examples.english_sentence: Although he's not a professional boxer, his boxing skills are like those of a boxing expert.

english_meaning: the hollow/indentation/soft spot of the fist
explanation_mandarin: 指拳头握紧后，手指关节与手掌之间形成的凹陷处，或者可以理解为拳头的薄弱位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the hollow or indentation formed between the knuckles and the palm when a fist is clenched. It can also be understood as a weak spot of the fist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打交嗰陣要保護自己嘅拳眼，唔好整親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 gaau1 go2 zan6 jiu3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyun4 ngaan5, m4 hou2 zing2 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打架的时候要保护好自己的拳头的窝，不要弄伤。
examples.english_sentence: When fighting, you should protect the hollow of your fist and avoid injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出拳好快，我睇唔到佢嘅拳眼喺邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 kyun4 hou2 faai3, ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2 keoi5 ge3 kyun4 ngaan5 hai2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出拳很快，我看不清他的拳头的窝在哪里。
examples.english_sentence: He punches so fast, I can't see where the hollow of his fist is.

english_meaning: martial arts skills; fighting skills; physical combat; hands and feet
explanation_mandarin: 指武术技巧，用拳头和脚进行搏斗的能力。也泛指动手打架的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to martial arts skills, the ability to fight with fists and feet. It also broadly refers to the ability to fight physically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅拳腳好犀利，好打得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kyun4 goek3 hou2 sai1 lei6, hou2 daa2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的拳脚很厉害，很能打。
examples.english_sentence: His martial arts skills are very impressive, he's a good fighter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好郁手郁腳，有咩事好好傾啦，唔好用拳腳解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 juk1 sau2 juk1 goek3, jau5 me1 si6 hou2 hou2 king1 laa1, m4 hou2 yung6 kyun4 goek3 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要动手动脚，有什么事好好谈，不要用拳脚解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get physical, let's talk it out peacefully, don't resort to violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾年拳腳，身手敏捷咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 nin4 kyun4 goek3, san1 sau2 man5 git3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几年功夫，身手敏捷了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He has been learning martial arts for a few years, and his agility has improved a lot.

english_meaning: Fists and feet have no eyes (i.e., accidents happen during a fight)
explanation_mandarin: 形容打斗中容易发生意外，无法控制，所以可能会误伤对方。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where accidents are likely to happen during a fight because it's difficult to control movements; someone might unintentionally get hurt. It implies that one should be careful during a fight, or perhaps avoid it altogether.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔好打啦，拳腳冇眼㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 daa2 laa1, kyun4 goek3 mou5 ngaan5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们不要打了，拳脚无眼的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't fight! Fists and feet have no eyes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打起上嚟，拳腳冇眼，好容易整親人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 hei2 soeng5 lei4, kyun4 goek3 mou5 ngaan5, hou2 jung4 ji6 zing2 can1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打起来，拳脚无眼，很容易弄伤人的。
examples.english_sentence: When they start fighting, it's uncontrolled, and it's easy for someone to get hurt.

english_meaning: martial arts
explanation_mandarin: 指各种拳法的武术技艺。
explanation_english: Refers to various styles and techniques of martial arts, especially those involving fist fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始學拳術，功夫好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hok6 kyun4 seot6, gung1 fu1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学拳术，功夫很好。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning martial arts when he was young, and his kung fu is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多唔同嘅拳術門派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 kyun4 seot6 mun4 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多不同的拳术门派。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different martial arts schools in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: boxing match; boxing tournament
explanation_mandarin: 指以拳击为形式的比赛。
explanation_english: A competition involving boxing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有場好精彩嘅拳賽，你去唔去睇啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 coeng4 hou2 zing1 cai2 ge3 kyun4 coi3, nei5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 tai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有一场很精彩的拳击比赛，你去不去看啊？
examples.english_sentence: There's a great boxing match tonight, are you going to watch it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇拳賽，每個星期都會睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 kyun4 coi3, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 wui5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看拳击比赛，每个星期都会看。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes watching boxing matches, he watches them every week.

english_meaning: fist
explanation_mandarin: 手握紧后形成的状态。
explanation_english: A clenched hand, a fist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到握實拳頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 ak1 sat6 kyun4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得握紧了拳头。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he clenched his fist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔鍾意打交，成日用拳頭解決問題。

examples.english_sentence: Children like to fight and often use their fists to solve problems.

jyutping: kyun4 tau4 bat1 daa2 siu3 min6 jan4
english_meaning: One doesn't hit a smiling face (you can't hit someone who's smiling at you)
explanation_mandarin: 指面对笑脸相迎的人，即使心里不悦，也不好意思发火或采取强硬手段。
explanation_english: It means that when faced with someone who is smiling, even if you are displeased, you would be embarrassed to get angry or take harsh measures. It's hard to be angry with someone who's being friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都笑騎騎，就算有咩唔啱，你都唔好意思鬧佢啦，真係拳頭不打笑面人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 siu3 ke4 ke4, zau6 syun3 jau5 me1 m4啱, nei5 dou1 m4 hou2 ji3 si3 nau6 keoi5 laa1, zan1 hai6 kyun4 tau4 bat1 daa2 siu3 min6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是笑嘻嘻的，就算有什么不对，你都不好意思骂他，真是伸手不打笑脸人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always smiling, even if there's something wrong, you'd be embarrassed to scold him, it's really 'one doesn't hit a smiling face'.

english_meaning: To fight (with fists); a fistfight
explanation_mandarin: 指使用拳头进行打斗，通常指比较直接和原始的打架方式。
explanation_english: Refers to fighting using fists, usually implying a direct and somewhat primitive form of fighting. Literally 'fist head exchange'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為少少嘢就拳頭交，真係好無聊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 siu2 siu2 je5 zau6 kyun4 tau4 gaau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 liu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为一点小事就打架，真是很无聊。
examples.english_sentence: They started a fistfight over such a small thing; it's really boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔贊成用拳頭交嚟解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zaan3 sing4 yung6 kyun4 tau4 gaau1 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不赞成用打架来解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: I don't agree with solving problems by fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人嚟到就阻止咗佢哋拳頭交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan4 lai4 dou3 zau6 zo2 zi2 zo2 keoi5 dei6 kyun4 tau4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察来了就阻止了他们打架。

english_meaning: gang; triad; violent organization

explanation_english: Refers to a criminal group whose main mode of operation is violence, typically referring to triad organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一個惡名昭彰嘅拳頭會，專門靠收保護費同埋暴力手段嚟搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 go3 ok3 ming4 ziu1 zoeng1 ge3 kyun4 tau4 wui2, zyun1 mun4 kaau3 sau1 bou2 wu6 fai3 tung4 mai4 bou6 lik6 sau2 dyun6 lai4 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一个臭名昭著的暴力集团，专门靠收取保护费和暴力手段来谋生。
examples.english_sentence: They are a notorious gang that makes a living by collecting protection money and using violence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬今晚冚緊啲拳頭會，要小心啲。

examples.english_sentence: The police are raiding gangs tonight, so be careful.

english_meaning: boxing gym; martial arts school
explanation_mandarin: 指教授拳击或其他武术的场所。
explanation_english: A place where boxing or other martial arts are taught and practiced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都會去拳館練拳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai1 dou1 wui5 heoi3 kyun4 gun2 lin6 kyun4.

examples.english_sentence: I go to the boxing gym to train every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間拳館好多人學泰拳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 kyun4 gun2 hou2 do1 jan4 hok6 taai3 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家武术馆很多人学泰拳。
examples.english_sentence: Many people learn Muay Thai at this martial arts school.

mandarin_meaning: 拷问; 拷打; 审问

explanation_mandarin: 用刑具审问犯人，逼供。 也泛指严厉地审问。
explanation_english: To interrogate a suspect using torture to extract a confession. Also refers to a rigorous examination or questioning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人拷問佢想佢認罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 haau1 man6 keoi5 soeng2 keoi5 jing6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察拷问他想让他认罪。
examples.english_sentence: The police interrogated him, trying to get him to confess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細拷到狗血淋頭。

examples.english_sentence: He was severely interrogated/criticized by his boss.

explanation_mandarin: 用刑审问犯人；严厉地盘问。
explanation_english: To torture a prisoner during interrogation; to interrogate severely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人將佢捉返差館拷問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 jan4 zoeng1 keoi5 zuk1 faan1 caai1 gun2 haau2 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察把他抓回警局拷问。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested him and took him back to the police station to interrogate him under torture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拷問咗成晚，咩都冇講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 haau2 man6 zo2 seng4 maan1, me1 dou1 mou5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人拷问了一整晚，什么都没说。
examples.english_sentence: He was tortured all night, but didn't say anything.

explanation_mandarin: 用刑具或暴力殴打逼供。
explanation_english: To inflict torture or severe beatings, often to extract a confession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣啲差人好鍾意屈打成招，成日拷打啲疑犯。

examples.english_sentence: Back then, the police liked to force confessions through torture, always beating the suspects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人拷打咗成晚，都冇肯認罪。

explanation_english: To copy, imitate, or plagiarize. Often refers to copying files or imitating someone else's behavior or work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課係拷貝人哋㗎，所以畀老師發現咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 hai6 haau2 bui1 yan4 dei6 gaa3, so2 ji5 bei2 lou5 si1 faat3 hin1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作业是抄袭别人的，所以被老师发现了。
examples.english_sentence: His homework was copied from someone else's, so the teacher found out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日拷貝人哋嘅風格啦，要發展自己嘅特色先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 haau2 bui1 yan4 dei6 ge3 fung1 gaak3 laa1, jiu3 faat3 zin2 zi6 gei2 ge3 dak6 sik1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.

examples.english_sentence: Don't always copy other people's styles; you need to develop your own unique characteristics.

english_meaning: to strive, to fight, to risk, to gamble, to piece together, to spell
explanation_mandarin: 指努力奋斗，不顾一切地去尝试，也指冒险。
explanation_english: Refers to striving hard, trying everything regardless of the consequences, and also refers to taking risks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拼搏，先至可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ping3 bok3, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.

examples.english_sentence: We need to strive hard to be successful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗賺錢，拼埋條命都唔要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zaan6 cin2, ping3 maai4 tiu4 ming6 dou1 m4 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了赚钱，连命都不要了。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试着拼一下那些积木吧。
examples.english_sentence: Try piecing together those building blocks.

english_meaning: dedication, drive, vigour, willingness to work hard, fighting spirit
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人努力工作、奋斗的精神和力量。
explanation_english: Describes a person's spirit and strength in working hard and striving for success. It implies a high level of dedication and effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好有拼勁，乜嘢難題都肯搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 ping3 ging6, mat1 je5 naan4 tai4 dou1 hang2 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很有干劲，什么难题都肯拼搏。
examples.english_sentence: He is very dedicated in his work, willing to fight hard against any difficult problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司之所以成功，係因為員工個個都有拼勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zi1 so2 ji5 sing4 gung1, hai6 jan1 wai6 jyun4 gung1 go3 go3 dou1 jau5 ping3 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司之所以成功，是因为每个员工都有拼搏精神。
examples.english_sentence: The reason why this company is successful is because every employee has a fighting spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔夠拼勁，好難成功㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 gau3 ping3 ging6, hou2 naan4 sing4 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不够干劲，很难成功。
examples.english_sentence: You won't succeed if you don't have enough drive.

english_meaning: to piece together; to combine; to assemble; to put together
explanation_mandarin: 将零散的部分组合在一起，形成一个整体。
explanation_english: To combine separate parts to form a whole; to assemble or piece together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲爛木板拼合埋，整咗張凳仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 laan6 muk6 baan2 ping3 hap6 maai4, zeng2 zo2 zoeng1 dang3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把一些烂木板拼合起来，做了一张小凳子。
examples.english_sentence: He pieced together some rotten planks to make a small stool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要拼合所有嘅資料，先可以搵出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ping3 hap6 so2 jau5 ge3 zi1 liu2, sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 ceot1 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须拼凑所有的资料，才可以找出真相。
examples.english_sentence: We need to piece together all the information to find out the truth.

english_meaning: to exert the utmost strength; to risk one's life; to go all out; desperately
explanation_mandarin: 指尽最大的努力，不顾一切。
explanation_english: To exert maximum effort; to be desperate; to risk one's life in an effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗達成目標，拼命噉做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 daat6 sing4 muk6 biu1, ping3 ming6 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了达成目标，拼命地工作。
examples.english_sentence: He worked desperately to achieve his goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁拼命㗎，休息下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 ping3 ming6 gaa3, jau1 sik1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用这么拼命的，休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so desperate, take a break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班消防員拼命咁救火。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员们拼命地救火。
