explanation_mandarin: 中欧国家，首都为布拉格。
explanation_english: A country in Central Europe, the capital is Prague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去捷克旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 jit6 hak1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去捷克旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I will travel to the Czech Republic next month.

jyutping: zit6 hak1 si1 lo4 faat3 hak1
mandarin_meaning: 捷克斯洛伐克 (已解体国家)
english_meaning: Czechoslovakia (former country)
explanation_mandarin: 捷克斯洛伐克是曾经存在于中欧的一个国家，在1918年成立，1993年解体为捷克和斯洛伐克。
explanation_english: Czechoslovakia was a former sovereign state in Central Europe that existed from 1918 to 1993, when it peacefully dissolved into the Czech Republic and Slovakia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣，地圖上面仲有捷克斯洛伐克呢個國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 zung6 jau5 zit6 hak1 si1 lo4 faat3 hak1 ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，地图上还有捷克斯洛伐克这个国家。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, there was still a country called Czechoslovakia on the map.

english_meaning: Triumphant news, good news of victory
explanation_mandarin: 指传来胜利或成功的消息。
explanation_english: Refers to the news of victory or success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋收到奧運攞金牌嘅捷報，開心到彈起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 dou2 ou3 wan6 lo2 gam1 paai4 ge3 zit6 bou3, hoi1 sam1 dou3 taan4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们收到奥运会获得金牌的喜讯，开心得跳了起来。
examples.english_sentence: They received the triumphant news of winning the gold medal at the Olympics and were so happy they jumped up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司業績創新高，管理層即刻發捷報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jip6 zik1 cong3 san1 gou1, gun2 lei5 cang4 zik1 hak1 faat3 zit6 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司业绩创新高，管理层立刻发布喜讯。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance reached a new high, and the management immediately released the good news.

english_meaning: Frequent reports of success; a constant stream of good news.
explanation_mandarin: 指好消息接连不断地传来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where good news or reports of success are coming in frequently, one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從間公司改革咗之後，捷報頻傳，生意好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 goi2 gaak3 zo2 zi1 hau6, zit6 bou3 pan4 cyun4, saang1 yi3 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司改革之后，喜讯频传，生意好多了。
examples.english_sentence: Since the company reformed, good news has been coming in constantly, and business has improved a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋足球隊一路都訓練得好辛苦，而家終於捷報頻傳喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 kau4 deoi2 jat1 lou6 dou1 fan3 lin6 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 zit6 bou3 pan4 cyun4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的足球队一直训练得很辛苦，现在终于喜讯频传了。
examples.english_sentence: Our football team has been training very hard all along, and now finally, good news is coming in frequently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情緩和之後，各行各業捷報頻傳，經濟開始復甦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 wun6 wo2 zi1 hau6, gok3 hang4 gok3 jip6 zit6 bou3 pan4 cyun4, ging1 zai3 hoi1 chi2 fuk1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情缓和之后，各行各业喜讯频传，经济开始复苏。
examples.english_sentence: After the epidemic eased, good news came frequently from all walks of life, and the economy began to recover.

english_meaning: shortcut; easy way
explanation_mandarin: 比喻能更快达到目的的方法或途径。
explanation_english: A shortcut; a quicker or easier way to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢冇捷徑㗎，一步一步嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 mou5 zit6 ging3 gaa3, jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作没有捷径，一步一步来吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's no shortcut in working. Take it one step at a time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搵捷徑上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wan2 zit6 ging3 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想找捷径上位。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to find a shortcut to get promoted.

english_meaning: First come, first served; to get there first
explanation_mandarin: 比喻行动快的人先达到目的。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who acts quickly and achieves their goal first. It implies getting an advantage by being the first to arrive or act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個promotion咁抵，梗係要捷足先登啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 promotion gam3 dai2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 jit6 zuk1 sin1 dang1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的促销这么划算，当然要捷足先登了！
examples.english_sentence: This promotion is such a good deal, of course, we need to be first in line!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要捷足先登，搶到個靚位先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jit6 zuk1 sin1 dang1, coeng2 dou2 go3 leng3 wai2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须捷足先登，抢到个好位置才行。
examples.english_sentence: We have to get there first and grab a good spot.

english_meaning: to throw away; to discard; to fling
explanation_mandarin: 指扔掉，丢弃，比较随便地扔。
explanation_english: Refers to throwing away or discarding something casually or carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲垃圾捹咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 laap1 saap3 ban6 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把那些垃圾扔了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Throw those trash away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁捹嘢呀，要保持地方清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 ban6 je5 aa3, jiu3 bou2 chi4 dei6 fong1 ching1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔东西啊，要保持地方清洁。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things around randomly, keep the place clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到將本書捹落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zoeng1 bun2 syu1 ban6 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地把书扔到地上。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he threw the book on the ground.

english_meaning: to press down, to suppress, to endure, to control (oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用力压下去，或者控制、忍耐情绪。
explanation_english: To press down with force; to suppress or endure emotions; to control oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 捺住唔好笑，好鬼辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naat6 zyu6 m4 hou2 siu3, hou2 gwai2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忍住别笑，很难受的。
examples.english_sentence: It's really hard to hold back from laughing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經盡量捺住脾氣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon6 loeng6 naat6 zyu6 pei4 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经尽量控制我的脾气了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already tried my best to control my temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捺住個傷口止血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naat6 zyu6 go3 soeng1 hau2 zi2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他按住伤口止血。
examples.english_sentence: He pressed down on the wound to stop the bleeding.

english_meaning: to knead; to rub between the fingers; to pinch
explanation_mandarin: 用手指搓揉、捏弄。
explanation_english: To rub or knead something between the fingers; to pinch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日無聊就係度捻紙巾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 mou4 liu4 zau6 hai6 dou6 nim1 zi2 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是无聊的时候就在那儿搓纸巾。
examples.english_sentence: He always kneads tissues when he's bored.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日捻啲泥膠啦，污糟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nim1 di1 nai4 gaau1 laa1, wu1 zou1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是揉那些橡皮泥了，都脏了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep kneading that playdough, it's getting dirty.

english_meaning: to rub, to scrub, to massage
explanation_mandarin: 用手或布等在物体表面上来回摩擦。
explanation_english: To rub something repeatedly with one's hands or a cloth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 捽污糟嘢要用力啲先乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeot1 wu1 zou1 je5 jiu3 yung6 lik6 di1 sin1 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 擦脏东西要用力一点才干净。
examples.english_sentence: You need to scrub harder to clean dirty things thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捽緊眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeot1 gan2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在揉眼睛。
examples.english_sentence: He is rubbing his eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力捽塊面，會損㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 zeot1 faai3 min6, wui sun2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大力地揉脸，会伤到皮肤的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rub your face so hard, you'll hurt your skin.

english_meaning: to provoke, to irritate, to rile up; to make someone angry
explanation_mandarin: 指通过言语或行为使他人变得生气、愤怒。 通常带有故意的意味，指有意为之。
explanation_english: To provoke or irritate someone, causing them to become angry. Often implies a deliberate act intended to anger or annoy the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再捽㷫佢啦，佢就嚟爆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cyut1 hing3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zau6 lai4 baau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹他生气了，他快要爆发了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, he's about to explode.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意捽㷫人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 cyut1 hing3 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢惹别人生气。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to provoke people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同佢講嘢，費事又捽㷫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5, fai3 si6 jau6 cyut1 hing3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和他说话，免得又惹他生气。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to talk to him, in case I provoke him again.

english_meaning: To push hard for sales figures; to pressure someone to meet targets; to nag about meeting quotas
explanation_mandarin: 指向下属施加压力，催促他们完成或超过销售额或其他业绩目标。
explanation_english: To put pressure on subordinates to meet or exceed sales targets or other performance goals. It implies a forceful and sometimes unpleasant pushing for results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日捽數，真係好大壓力！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 cyut7 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是催促我们完成业绩，压力真的很大！
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always pushing us for sales figures, it's really stressful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司捽數捽得好犀利，好多人都頂唔順走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 cyut7 sou3 cyut7 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司催促业绩催得很厉害，很多人都受不了就走了。
examples.english_sentence: Their company pushes very hard for sales figures, many people couldn't stand it and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再捽我數啦，我已經盡力㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 cyut7 ngo5 sou3 laa1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 zeon6 lik6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再催我完成业绩了，我已经尽力了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push me for sales figures anymore, I've already tried my best.

english_meaning: DJing, to scratch records, to spin records
explanation_mandarin: 指唱片骑师（DJ）通过操作唱片，制造特殊音乐效果，常用于舞厅或派对。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a disc jockey (DJ) manipulating records to create special musical effects, commonly used in nightclubs or parties. Specifically, it involves scratching or mixing records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺夜總會做DJ，晚晚都要捽碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 je6 zung2 wui2 zou6 DJ, maan5 maan5 dou1 jiu3 zeot1 dip2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在夜总会做DJ，每天晚上都要打碟。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a DJ in a nightclub and has to spin records every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去睇佢捽碟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 tai2 keoi5 zeot1 dip2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去看他打碟吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go see him DJ tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢捽碟嘅技巧好純熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeot1 dip2 ge3 gei6 huk1 hou2 seon4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打碟的技巧很纯熟。
examples.english_sentence: His DJing skills are very skillful.

english_meaning: to deliberately pick a fight; to nitpick; to stir up trouble; to look for something to complain about
explanation_mandarin: 形容没事找事，故意挑剔或找麻烦的行为。字面意思是搓洗猪肠，引申为故意找不愉快的事情做。
explanation_english: Describes the act of deliberately picking a fight, nitpicking, or looking for trouble. Literally, it means "to rub pig intestines," implying deliberately seeking out unpleasant things to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都捽豬腸，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 cyut1 zyu1 coeng2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是没事找事，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always deliberately picks fights; he's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好捽豬腸啦，大家和氣生財。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cyut1 zyu1 coeng2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 wo4 hei3 sang1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别故意找茬了，大家和气生财。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stir up trouble, let's all make money in harmony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁捽豬腸啦，有咩問題直接講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cyut1 zyu1 coeng2 laa1, jau5 me1 man6 tai4 zik6 zip3 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么挑刺了，有什么问题直接说不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Stop nitpicking, if there's a problem, just say it directly.

mandarin_meaning: 掀开; 揭开; 掀起
english_meaning: to lift; to raise; to flip; to turn up; to start (a trend)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具向上掀起、揭开。
explanation_english: To lift up or turn up something with hands or tools; to uncover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掀開咗個煲蓋嚟睇下啲湯滾好未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hin1 hoi1 zo2 go3 bou1 goi3 lai4 tai2 haa5 di1 tong1 gwan2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掀开了锅盖看看汤好了没有。
examples.english_sentence: He lifted the lid to see if the soup was ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易就掀人哋嘅底牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 zau6 hin1 jan4 dei6 ge3 dai2 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易就揭别人的底牌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't reveal someone's hand so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋掀起咗一場革命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hin1 hei2 zo2 jat1 coeng4 gaak3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们掀起了一场革命。
examples.english_sentence: They started a revolution.

english_meaning: to raise; to set off; to stir up; to trigger; to lift up; to start
explanation_mandarin: 指引起、发动某种行动或事物；也指揭开、掀动等动作。
explanation_english: To initiate, start, or trigger something, often a movement, trend, or event. Can also mean to lift up or uncover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事喺社會度掀起咗好大嘅迴響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai2 se5 wui2 dou6 hin1 hei2 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 wui4 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事在社会上引起了很大的反响。
examples.english_sentence: This event stirred up a great response in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅言論喺網上掀起咗一場罵戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin4 leon6 hai2 mong5 soeng5 hin1 hei2 zo2 jat1 coeng4 maa6 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的言论在网上掀起了一场骂战。
examples.english_sentence: His remarks sparked a flame war online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想掀起張枱布睇下下面有啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hin1 hei2 zoeng1 toi2 bou3 tai2 haa5 min6 jau5 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掀起桌布看看下面有什么。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to lift the tablecloth to see what's underneath.

english_meaning: to lift; to uncover; to open (something that covers)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他方式把盖着或遮盖的东西打开。
explanation_english: To lift or uncover something that is covering something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掀開咗個煲蓋，睇下啲湯滾好未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hin1 hoi1 zo2 go3 bou1 goi3, tai2 haa5 di1 tong1 gwan2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭开了锅盖，看看汤煮好了没。
examples.english_sentence: He lifted the lid of the pot to see if the soup was cooked yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便掀開人哋嘅秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 hin1 hoi1 jan4 dei6 ge3 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便揭开别人的秘密。
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually uncover other people's secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷偷地掀開窗簾，睇下隔離鄰舍喺做乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 tau1 dei6 hin1 hoi1 coeng1 lim4, tai2 haa5 gaak3 lei4 leon4 se5 hai2 zou6 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷偷地掀开窗帘，看看隔壁邻居在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He secretly lifted the curtain to see what the neighbors were doing.

english_meaning: to yank; to jerk; to shake violently
explanation_mandarin: 用力拉或急速晃动。通常指突然而猛烈的动作。
explanation_english: To pull or shake with force and suddenness; to yank or jerk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力掁佢，會整親佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 daai6 lik6 zaang6 keoi5, wui5 zing2 can1 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么用力地拉他，会弄伤他的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't yank him so hard, you'll hurt him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掁咗我一下，搞到我差啲跌低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang6 zo2 ngo5 jat1 haa5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 dit3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他猛地拉了我一下，害得我差点摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: He jerked me, causing me to almost fall.

english_meaning: glaring, dazzling, offensive to the eye; garish, showy, ostentatious
explanation_mandarin: 形容颜色或光线过于鲜艳或强烈，使眼睛感到不舒服，或形容事物过于张扬，引人注目。
explanation_english: Describes something that is too bright or colorful, causing discomfort to the eyes; or describes something that is too ostentatious and eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫啲顏色太掁眼喇，我頂唔順啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 di1 ngaan5 sik1 taai3 zaang3 ngaan5 laa3, ngo5 ding2 m4 seon6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这件衣服的颜色太刺眼了，我受不了。
examples.english_sentence: The colours of his shirt are too glaring, I can't stand it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車噴到咁掁眼，實會俾人抄牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 pan3 dou3 gam3 zaang3 ngaan5, sat1 wui5 bei2 jan4 caau1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子喷得这么扎眼，肯定会被抄牌。
examples.english_sentence: The car is painted so garishly, it's bound to get a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭裝修到咁掁眼，實係想吸引多啲客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 zong1 sau1 dou3 gam3 zaang3 ngaan5, sat1 hai6 soeng2 kap1 jan5 do1 di1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺装修得这么扎眼，肯定是为了吸引更多顾客。
examples.english_sentence: The shop is decorated so ostentatiously, they must be trying to attract more customers.

mandarin_meaning: 耍小聪明; 小动作; 搞小动作
english_meaning: To play petty tricks; to engage in underhanded maneuvers; to be sneaky
explanation_mandarin: 指耍一些小聪明，搞一些不正当的小动作，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to playing petty tricks or engaging in underhanded maneuvers, often with a negative connotation. It implies being sneaky or trying to gain an advantage through dishonest means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺度掁雞啦，正正經經做嘢得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zaang6 gai1 laa1, zing3 zing3 ging1 ging1 zou6 je5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是在这里耍小聪明，正经工作行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always play petty tricks here, can't you just work properly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住掁雞攞著數，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 zaang6 gai1 lo2 zoek3 sou3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着耍小聪明占便宜，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking of playing petty tricks to take advantage, which is very annoying.

english_meaning: To be excited, agitated, worked up
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常激动、兴奋、坐立不安的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very excited, agitated, or restless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日去旅行呀，佢掁晒鷄，成晚都瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 aa3, keoi5 cang4 saai3 gai1, seng4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要去旅行，他兴奋得不得了，一整晚都睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: He's going on a trip tomorrow, he's so excited, he couldn't sleep all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試放榜，佢緊張到掁晒鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3 fong3 bong2, keoi5 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 cang4 saai3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试放榜，他紧张得不行。
examples.english_sentence: The exam results are coming out, he's so nervous he's all worked up.

english_meaning: OK, alright, settled, done, successful
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情已经处理妥当，没问题；或者形容某人能力强，可以胜任某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is settled, alright, or done successfully; can also describe someone as capable and able to handle a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定了！
examples.english_sentence: It's done!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢一定掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 jat1 ding6 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事他肯定能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He will definitely be able to handle this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掂唔掂啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: dim3 m4 dim3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is it okay? Will it work?

english_meaning: capable; competent; skillful; good at something; easily handled
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事干练、利索，或者形容某件事很容易处理。也指某人擅长做某事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is capable and efficient in handling tasks or refers to something that is easily managed. It can also mean that someone is good at or skillful in doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好掂手㗎，交俾佢就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 dim6 sau2 gaa3, gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很得力，交给他就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable at doing things. Just hand it over to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲簡單嘢，我掂手搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaan2 daan1 je5, ngo5 dim6 sau2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些简单的事情，我很容易就能搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: These are simple things; I can easily handle them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對電腦好掂手，有咩電腦問題問佢就啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 din6 nou5 hou2 dim6 sau2, jau5 me1 din6 nou5 man6 tai4 man6 keoi5 zau6 ngaam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长电脑，有什么电脑问题问他就对了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at computers. It is right to ask him if there are any computer problems.

mandarin_meaning: 妥当, 顺利, 完成
english_meaning: done, settled, proper, appropriate, successful, okay
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情处理妥当、顺利完成；也可以表示没问题，同意。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that has been handled properly and successfully completed. It can also mean 'no problem', 'okay', or indicate agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂晒啲嘢，就掂當喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5, zau6 dim3 dong3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把所有事情都处理完，就没问题了。
examples.english_sentence: Once all the things are settled, then it's all done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚七點喺餐廳見，掂當唔掂當啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 cat1 dim2 hai2 caan1 teng1 gin3, dim3 dong3 m4 dim3 dong3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚七点在餐厅见面，行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Meeting at the restaurant at 7pm tonight, is that okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞得掂當嘅，唔使擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 dak1 dim3 dong3 ge3, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你处理得妥当的，不用担心。
examples.english_sentence: You'll handle it properly, don't worry.

english_meaning: To rush through a task; to do something perfunctorily; to do something carelessly and hastily
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事敷衍了事，马虎随便，没有认真对待。 指处理事情或完成工作时，只是简单地应付，不求质量和效果。
explanation_english: Describes doing things perfunctorily and carelessly, without taking it seriously. It refers to handling matters or completing work by simply going through the motions, without caring about quality or results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣掂筆甩，是但畫幾筆就算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 dim6 bat1 lat1, si6 daan6 waa2 gei2 bat1 zau6 syun3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样草率了事，随便画几笔就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush through it like that, just drawing a few strokes and calling it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告唔可以掂筆甩，要認真寫㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 m4 ho2 ji5 dim6 bat1 lat1, jiu3 jing6 zan1 se2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告不能草率了事，要认真写。
examples.english_sentence: This report cannot be rushed through; it needs to be written carefully.

english_meaning: to handle something easily; to get through something smoothly; to get by
explanation_mandarin: 形容处理事情非常顺利，轻松搞定，没有遇到任何阻碍。
explanation_english: Describes handling a situation very smoothly and easily, without encountering any obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我掂行掂過，啲題目太易啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 dim3 hang4 dim3 gwo3, di1 tai4 muk6 taai3 ji6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我轻松通过，题目太容易了。
examples.english_sentence: I breezed through this exam. The questions were too easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻仔，呢份工對佢嚟講一定掂行掂過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek3 zai2, ni1 fan6 gung1 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 jat1 ding6 dim3 hang4 dim3 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么聪明，这份工作对他来说一定轻而易举。
examples.english_sentence: He's so smart. This job will definitely be a piece of cake for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放心啦，呢件事我一定幫你掂行掂過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 sam1 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 bong1 nei5 dim3 hang4 dim3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放心吧，这件事我一定帮你轻松搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will definitely help you handle this smoothly.

english_meaning: Perfect, excellent, went smoothly, handled perfectly
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情办得非常完美、顺利，或者某人处理事情非常出色。源于啃甘蔗时甘蔗的甜味令人满意。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that was handled perfectly and smoothly, or someone who has handled something exceptionally well. It originates from the satisfying sweetness when eating sugarcane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project佢哋做得掂過條蔗，冇得彈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project keoi5 dei6 zou6 dak1 dim3 gwo3 tiu4 ze3, mou5 dak1 taan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这个项目他们做得非常出色，无可挑剔。
examples.english_sentence: They did an excellent job on this project, it's flawless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅考試佢考得掂過條蔗，全部A。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 haau2 si3 keoi5 haau2 dak1 dim3 gwo3 tiu4 ze3, cyun4 bou6 ei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他考得非常好，全部是A。
examples.english_sentence: He did extremely well in this exam, all As.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅問題都處理得掂過條蔗，真係叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 man6 tai4 dou1 cyu2 lei5 dak1 dim3 gwo3 tiu4 ze3, zan1 hai6 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他连这样的问题都能处理得完美，真是厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He handled even such a problem perfectly, he's really great.

english_meaning: Smooth sailing, going smoothly, all going well
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情进行得非常顺利，像甘蔗一样一节一节地顺利通过。比喻事情进展非常顺畅，毫无阻碍。
explanation_english: Describes something going very smoothly, like peeling and eating sugar cane section by section. It's used to describe a situation that progresses very smoothly without any obstacles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅考試，我覺得掂過碌蔗呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 haau2 si3, ngo5 gok3 dak1 dim3 gwo3 luk1 ze3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，我觉得非常顺利！
examples.english_sentence: I think this exam went very smoothly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂份project真係掂過碌蔗，冇遇到咩問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 fan6 project zan1 hai6 dim3 gwo3 luk1 ze3, mou5 jyu6 dou2 me1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定这个项目真是非常顺利，没有遇到什么问题。
examples.english_sentence: Finishing this project was really smooth sailing, we didn't encounter any problems.

english_meaning: to sweep; to scan; to search
explanation_mandarin: 本义是使用扫帚清除尘土。也指快速地查看、搜索。
explanation_english: The primary meaning is to sweep away dust with a broom. It also refers to quickly viewing or searching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫手掃吓地啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 sau2 sou3 haa5 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我扫一下地吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me sweep the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要掃貨！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sou3 fo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要抢购！
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy everything up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用眼掃咗我一眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 ngaan5 sou3 zo2 ngo5 yat1 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用眼睛扫了我一眼。
examples.english_sentence: He scanned me with his eyes.

english_meaning: to strum a chord (on a guitar, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 弹奏吉他等乐器时，快速地用手指或拨片扫过琴弦，发出和弦的声音。
explanation_english: To strum a chord, usually on a guitar or other stringed instrument, by quickly sweeping your fingers or a pick across the strings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街頭掃chord唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 sou3 ko1 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街头扫弦唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He's singing and strumming chords in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我學緊點樣掃chord，但係仲未熟練。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 gan2 dim2 joeng2 sou3 ko1, daan6 hai6 zung6 mei6 suk6 lin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在学习如何扫弦，但是还不太熟练。
examples.english_sentence: I'm learning how to strum chords, but I'm not very skilled yet.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 intro hai6 sou3 ko1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的开头是扫弦的。
examples.english_sentence: The intro of this song is strumming chords.

english_meaning: to sweep the floor; to sweep
explanation_mandarin: 用扫帚清扫地面。
explanation_english: To clean the floor or ground with a broom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我掃地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 sou3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我扫地。
examples.english_sentence: My mom told me to sweep the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要掃地先可以食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sou3 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须扫地才能吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: We have to sweep the floor before we can eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，日日都掃地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, jat6 jat6 dou1 sou3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤劳，每天都扫地。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and sweeps the floor every day.

synonyms: 清潔地面 (cing1 git3 dei6 min6)

english_meaning: To sweep a venue clean, to clear the place, to clean out (e.g., of goods), to win overwhelmingly (in a competition)
explanation_mandarin: 指将场地或区域内的东西全部拿走或清除干净；也指在比赛或竞争中取得压倒性的胜利。
explanation_english: Refers to taking everything away from a venue or area, or cleaning it out completely; also refers to achieving an overwhelming victory in a competition or game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班人去掃場，買晒啲特價貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 baan1 jan4 heoi3 sou3 coeng4, maai5 saai3 di1 dak6 gaa3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一群人去扫货，把所有特价商品都买光了。
examples.english_sentence: A group of them went to sweep the venue clean, buying all the discounted items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個遊戲入面掃場，攞咗所有獎品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 sou3 coeng4, lo2 zo2 so2 jau5 zoeng2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在游戏中大获全胜，赢得了所有奖品。
examples.english_sentence: He swept the field in the game and won all the prizes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察嚟掃場，全部人都走晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 lai4 sou3 coeng4, cyun4 bou6 jan4 dou1 zau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察来清场，所有人都跑光了。
examples.english_sentence: The police came to clear the place, and everyone ran away.

english_meaning: tomb sweeping; grave sweeping; to visit and tidy up a grave
explanation_mandarin: 指清明节或其他祭祀节日时，到祖先或已故亲人的坟墓前进行祭拜、清理和修缮的活动。
explanation_english: To visit and tidy up the grave of ancestors or deceased relatives, usually during the Qingming Festival or other memorial days. This involves offering sacrifices, cleaning the grave, and making repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節我哋一家人會去掃墓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 heoi3 sou3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节我们一家人会去扫墓。
examples.english_sentence: Our family will go tomb sweeping during Qingming Festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋早啲去掃墓，避開人潮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 heoi3 sou3 mou6, bei6 hoi1 jan4 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们早点去扫墓，避开人潮。
examples.english_sentence: This year we'll go tomb sweeping earlier to avoid the crowds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掃墓嘅時候，記得帶埋鮮花同埋香燭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 mou6 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 sin1 faa1 tung4 maai4 hoeng1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 扫墓的时候，记得带上鲜花和香烛。
examples.english_sentence: When tomb sweeping, remember to bring flowers and incense.

english_meaning: to strafe; to sweep with gunfire; to spray (with bullets)
explanation_mandarin: 用机关枪或其他武器向某个区域进行密集射击。
explanation_english: To fire rapidly over an area with a machine gun or other automatic weapon.  Can also be used figuratively to describe a rapid-fire delivery of information or attacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲恐怖分子喺條街度掃射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hung2 bou3 fan2 zi2 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 sou3 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恐怖分子在街上扫射。
examples.english_sentence: The terrorists were strafing in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用機關槍喺戰壕邊緣掃射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 gei1 gwaan1 cheung1 hai2 zin3 haau1 bin1 yuen4 sou3 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用机关枪在战壕边缘扫射。
examples.english_sentence: They sprayed the edges of the trench with machine-gun fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋不停咁掃射所有反對嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bat1 ting4 gam2 sou3 se6 so2 yau5 faan2 deoi3 ge3 yi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不停地驳斥所有反对的意见。
examples.english_sentence: They relentlessly attacked all opposing viewpoints.

mandarin_meaning: 扫尾, 收尾, 善后
english_meaning: to clean up, to tidy up, to finish up, to wrap up (a task/situation), to handle the aftermath
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情的最后阶段，清理或整理，也指处理善后事宜。
explanation_english: Refers to handling the final stages of a task or situation, cleaning up or tidying up, or dealing with the aftermath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要快啲掃尾，跟住走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 sou3 mei5, gan1 zeoi6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要快点扫尾，然后走吧。
examples.english_sentence: We need to finish up quickly and then leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅掃尾工作好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 sou3 mei5 gung1 zok3 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的扫尾工作很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: The cleanup work for this matter is very troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責幫我哋掃尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu3 zaak3 bong1 ngo5 dei6 sou3 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责帮我们扫尾。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for helping us wrap things up.

english_meaning: broom
explanation_mandarin: 一种用以扫地的工具，通常由捆扎在一起的毛发或植物纤维制成，并附有手柄。
explanation_english: A cleaning implement for sweeping, typically consisting of bristles fastened to a handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我拎起掃帚嚟掃地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ling1 hei2 sou3 zau2 lai4 sou3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿起扫帚来扫地。
examples.english_sentence: I picked up the broom to sweep the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把掃帚啲毛甩晒，要換把新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 sou3 zau2 di1 mou4 lat1 saai3, jiu3 wun6 baa2 san1 ge3.

examples.english_sentence: The bristles on this broom have all fallen out, we need to get a new one.

mandarin_meaning: 扫平; 铲平; 清除
english_meaning: to clear; to level; to wipe out; to eliminate; to conquer
explanation_mandarin: 意思是清除障碍，使之变得平坦或干净。也引申为征服、消灭的意思。
explanation_english: It means to clear obstacles, making something flat or clean. It can also be extended to mean to conquer or eliminate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要掃平所有嘅障礙，先可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sou3 ping4 so2 jau5 ge3 zoeng3 ngoi6, sin1 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要扫平所有的障碍，才可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clear all obstacles to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後都掃平咗成個黑幫勢力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 sou3 ping4 zo2 seng4 go3 hak1 bong1 sai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后都扫平了整个黑帮势力。
examples.english_sentence: They finally wiped out the entire gang force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司想掃平市場上嘅競爭對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 sou3 ping4 si5 coeng4 soeng6 ge3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想扫平市场上的竞争对手。
examples.english_sentence: This company wants to eliminate its competitors in the market.

english_meaning: broom
explanation_mandarin: 用来清扫地面的工具。
explanation_english: A tool used for sweeping the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用掃把掃地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 sou3 baa2 sou3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用扫帚扫地。
examples.english_sentence: I use a broom to sweep the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把掃把嘅毛好硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 sou3 baa2 ge3 mou4 hou2 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这把扫帚的毛很硬。
examples.english_sentence: The bristles of this broom are very stiff.

english_meaning: Janitor, cleaner, sweeper
explanation_mandarin: 指负责打扫卫生，清洁工作的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is responsible for cleaning and maintenance, such as a janitor or cleaner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個掃把佬日日都好勤力咁掃地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sou3 baa2 lou2 jat6 jat6 dou1 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2 sou3 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个清洁工每天都很勤奋地扫地。
examples.english_sentence: That janitor sweeps the floor diligently every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嘈住個掃把佬做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caau4 zyu6 go3 sou3 baa2 lou2 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打扰清洁工工作了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't disturb the cleaner while he's working.

synonyms: 清潔工人 (cing1 git3 gung1 jan4)

english_meaning: Bringer of bad luck; jinx; unlucky person
explanation_mandarin: 比喻带来厄运或不幸的人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone who brings bad luck or misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係掃把星嚟㗎，一掂親你啲嘢就出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 sou3 baa2 sing1 lei4 gaa3, jat1 dim6 can1 nei5 di1 je5 zau6 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个扫把星，一碰到你的东西就出事。
examples.english_sentence: You really are a jinx, everything goes wrong when I touch your things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，邊有人係掃把星㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, bin1 jau5 jan4 hai6 sou3 baa2 sing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说别人了，哪有人是扫把星呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about people, no one is really a jinx.

english_meaning: Bow-legged, O-legs
explanation_mandarin: 指腿型弯曲，像扫把的柄一样，两腿之间有较大空隙，形成O型。
explanation_english: Refers to a leg shape that is curved, resembling the handle of a broom, with a large gap between the legs, forming an O shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有啲掃把腳，所以行路唔係咁好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 di1 sou3 baa2 goek3, so2 ji5 haang4 lou6 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有点罗圈腿，所以走路不是很好看。
examples.english_sentence: He is a bit bow-legged, so his walking doesn't look so good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，佢唔鍾意人哋話佢掃把腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 jan4 dei6 waa6 keoi5 sou3 baa2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，她不喜欢别人说她是罗圈腿。
examples.english_sentence: When she was young, she didn't like people calling her bow-legged.

english_meaning: Broom head (hairstyle); messy, unkempt hair
explanation_mandarin: 形容头发像扫帚一样乱，没有整理。
explanation_english: Describes hair that looks like a broom head, messy and unkempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個頭咁亂，成個掃把頭咁，執執佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 tau4 gam3 lyun6, seng4 go3 sou3 baa2 tau4 gam3, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的头发这么乱，像个扫帚头一样，整理一下吧！
examples.english_sentence: Your hair is so messy, it looks like a broom head, tidy it up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇梳頭，成日都係掃把頭咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 so1 tau4, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 sou3 baa2 tau4 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没梳头，每天都是扫帚头的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't comb his hair, he always looks like he has a broom head.

english_meaning: to scan
explanation_mandarin: 指利用扫描仪等设备将图像、文字等信息转换为电子信息的过程。
explanation_english: To scan refers to the process of using a scanner or similar device to convert images, text, or other information into electronic information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要掃描呢份文件，然後send email俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 sou3 miu4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2, jin4 hau6 send email bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要扫描这份文件，然后发邮件给你。
examples.english_sentence: I need to scan this document and then send you an email.

english_meaning: anti-drug operation, drug sweep, to fight drugs
explanation_mandarin: 指警察或相关部门进行打击毒品犯罪的行动。
explanation_english: Refers to an operation conducted by the police or related departments to combat drug-related crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方琴晚喺旺角掃毒，拉咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 kam4 maan1 hai2 wong6 gok3 sou3 duk6, laai1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方昨晚在旺角进行扫毒行动，逮捕了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The police conducted a drug sweep in Mong Kok last night and arrested many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日話要大力掃毒，但係效果好似唔係好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 daai6 lik6 sou3 duk6, daan6 hai6 haau6 gwo2 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 hou2 ming4 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说要大力扫毒，但是效果好像不是很明显。
examples.english_sentence: They always say they want to vigorously fight drugs, but the effect doesn't seem very obvious.

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to suck up to
explanation_mandarin: 指为了讨好别人而说好听的话，带有谄媚、奉承的意味。
explanation_english: To flatter someone, often a superior, in order to gain favor or advantage. It implies being insincere and opportunistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都掃波牙，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sou3 bo1 ngaa4, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拍马屁，想升职而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's always brown-nosing, just trying to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁掃波牙啦，好假呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sou3 bo1 ngaa4 laa1, hou2 gaa2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么拍马屁啦，好假啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't brown-nose so much, it's so fake!

english_meaning: To dampen spirits; to pour cold water on something; to discourage
explanation_mandarin: 形容打击别人的积极性，使人失去兴致或热情。
explanation_english: Describes the act of dampening someone's enthusiasm or excitement; to discourage them from pursuing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁有心機搞呢個活動，你唔好掃灰水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam3 jau5 sam1 gei1 gaau2 ni1 go3 wut6 dung6, nei5 m4 hou2 sou3 fui1 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这么用心地组织这个活动，你别泼冷水了。
examples.english_sentence: We're putting so much effort into organizing this event, please don't dampen our spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都掃灰水，搞到我冇晒動力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 sou3 fui1 seoi2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 mou5 saai3 dung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都泼冷水，搞得我都没动力了。
examples.english_sentence: He always pours cold water on things, which makes me lose all motivation.

english_meaning: to brush teeth
explanation_mandarin: 用牙刷清洁牙齿。
explanation_english: To clean teeth with a toothbrush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你朝朝早都要掃牙㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ziu1 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jiu3 sou3 ngaa4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你每天早上都要刷牙的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to brush your teeth every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱掃完牙，好乾淨呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 sou3 jyun4 ngaa4, hou2 gon1 zing6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚刷完牙，很干净啊。
examples.english_sentence: I just brushed my teeth, they are very clean.

english_meaning: To sweep; to win decisively (often in sports or competition)
explanation_mandarin: 在比赛或竞争中，以压倒性优势获胜，像扫地一样把对手扫除。
explanation_english: To win decisively in a competition or game, often referring to sweeping an opponent completely aside, like sweeping the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今次比賽真係掃晒成隊對手，贏得好勁啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 zan1 hai6 sou3 saai3 sing4 deoi2 deoi3 sau2, wing4 dak1 hou2 ging6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这次比赛真的横扫了整个对手队伍，赢得非常厉害！
examples.english_sentence: They really swept the entire opposing team in this competition, winning spectacularly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下，佢地隊波咁勁，一定會掃球攞冠軍㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5, keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 gam3 ging6, jat1 ding6 wui5 sou3 kau4 lo2 gun1 gwan3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，他们队伍那么厉害，一定会横扫千军拿到冠军的。
examples.english_sentence: Look, their team is so strong, they will definitely sweep and take the championship.

english_meaning: to eliminate illiteracy; to popularize basic knowledge; to give someone a crash course
explanation_mandarin: 指消除文盲，普及基本知识，也指给某人进行速成或简要的介绍。
explanation_english: To eliminate illiteracy; to popularize basic knowledge. Figuratively, it can also mean to give someone a quick lesson or introduction to something they don't know about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫啲老人家掃盲，教佢哋點樣用智能手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1 sou3 mang4, gaau3 keoi5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 yung6 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮助老人们扫盲，教他们怎么用智能手机。
examples.english_sentence: He's helping elderly people by giving them a crash course on how to use smartphones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對區塊鏈一竅不通，你要幫我掃盲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 khu1 faai3 lin2 jat1 hiu3 bat1 tung1, nei5 jiu3 bong1 ngo5 sou3 mang4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对区块链一窍不通，你需要先帮我扫盲才行。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know anything about blockchain; you need to give me a crash course first.

english_meaning: to scan
explanation_mandarin: 指利用设备或程序，对图像、文件等进行扫描，以便将其转化为电子格式或进行识别。
explanation_english: To scan; to examine carefully and thoroughly, often with the use of technology to create a digital copy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以幫我掃瞄呢份文件，然後email畀我嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sou3 miu4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2, jin4 hau6 email bei2 ngo5 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我扫描这份文件，然后用电子邮件发给我吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me scan this document and then email it to me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部掃瞄器壞咗，用唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sou3 miu4 hei3 waai6 zo2, yung6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 扫描仪坏了，用不了。
examples.english_sentence: The scanner is broken and cannot be used.

english_meaning: to spoil the fun; to be a killjoy; to dampen the spirits; to be disappointing
explanation_mandarin: 使人兴致低落，感到没趣。
explanation_english: To spoil someone's good mood or excitement; to ruin the enjoyment of an event or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁掃興啦，一齊去玩下吖嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sou3 hing3 laa1, jat1 cai4 heoi3 waan2 haa5 aa1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么扫兴嘛，一起去玩一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a killjoy, let's go have some fun together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨真係掃興，原本諗住去沙灘游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 zan1 hai6 sou3 hing3, jyun4 bun2 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨真是扫兴，原本想去沙滩游泳。
examples.english_sentence: The rain is such a killjoy, I was planning to go swimming at the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲負面嘢，好掃興㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 fu6 min6 je5, hou2 sou3 hing3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说一些负面的事情，很扫兴的。
examples.english_sentence: He always says negative things, which is such a mood killer.

english_meaning: to wipe out, to mop up, to clear out, to purge, to eliminate completely
explanation_mandarin: 彻底清除，肃清。
explanation_english: To eliminate completely, to wipe out, clear out, or purge something, often referring to eliminating undesirable elements or enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方展開掃蕩行動，捉咗好多黑社會成員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zin2 hoi1 sou3 dong6 hang4 dung6, zuk1 zo2 hou2 do1 hak1 se5 wui2 sing4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方展开了扫荡行动，抓了很多黑社会成员。
examples.english_sentence: The police launched a raid, arresting many triad members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要掃蕩所有嘅貪污分子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 sou3 dong6 so2 jau5 ge3 taam1 wu1 fan1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要扫荡所有的贪污分子。
examples.english_sentence: They want to eliminate all the corrupt elements.

english_meaning: to go street food hunting; to wander around eating street food
explanation_mandarin: 指在街上到处逛，品尝各种小吃。通常指在夜市或小吃街上吃东西。
explanation_english: Refers to wandering around the streets, especially a night market or street food area, trying various street food snacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去旺角掃街啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 wong6 gok3 sou3 gaai1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去旺角吃小吃吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go street food hunting in Mong Kok tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度好多嘢食，啱晒掃街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 ho2 do1 je5 sik6, ngaam1晒 sou3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里有很多吃的，非常适合逛街吃小吃。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of food there, perfect for street food hunting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺廟街掃街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 miu6 gaai1 sou3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在庙街逛街吃小吃。
examples.english_sentence: We often go street food hunting in Temple Street.

mandarin_meaning: 大量購買, 瘋狂購物
english_meaning: to go on a shopping spree; to buy up a lot of goods; to splurge
explanation_mandarin: 指大量購買商品，尤指在促銷或打折期間。
explanation_english: Refers to buying a large quantity of goods, especially during promotions or sales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁住減價，我哋去掃貨啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 zyu6 gaam2 gaa3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sou3 fo3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁着打折，我们去大量购买吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go on a shopping spree while there's a sale!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出糧就去掃貨，買咗好多衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 loeng4 zau6 heoi3 sou3 fo3, maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一发工资就去疯狂购物，买了很多衣服。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he gets paid, he goes on a shopping spree and buys a lot of clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，好多人去超市掃貨，買定啲糧食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 gei1 gaan1, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 ciu1 si5 sou3 fo3, maai5 ding6 di1 loeng4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，很多人去超市大量购买，买一些粮食备着。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, many people went to the supermarket to stock up and buy some food in advance.

english_meaning: to sweep; to clean; cleaning
explanation_mandarin: 清理垃圾、灰尘，使环境干净整洁。
explanation_english: To remove dirt, dust, and debris from a place; to clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要掃除屋企，迎接新年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sou3 cyu4 uk1 kei5, ying4 zip3 san1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要打扫屋子，迎接新年。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clean the house to welcome the New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都會掃除佢嘅辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 sou3 cyu4 keoi5 ge3 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都会打扫他的办公室。
examples.english_sentence: He cleans his office every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掃除垃圾對保持環境衛生好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 cyu4 laap6 saap3 deoi3 bou2 ci4 waan4 ging2 wai6 sang1 hou2 cung5 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清理垃圾对保持环境卫生很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Cleaning up garbage is important for maintaining environmental hygiene.

mandarin_meaning: 排雷；排除障碍；试水；避坑
english_meaning: Minesweeping; to clear obstacles; to test the waters; to avoid pitfalls/traps
explanation_mandarin: 本意是清除地雷，引申为排除障碍，试探情况，避免踩坑。在网络语境中，常指替别人试验、探路，以避免他人遇到麻烦或遭受损失。
explanation_english: Literally means 'minesweeping'. Figuratively, it means to clear obstacles, test the situation, and avoid pitfalls. In online slang, it often means testing or exploring for others to prevent them from encountering problems or suffering losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我幫你哋掃下雷先，睇下呢間餐廳好唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 dei6 sou3 haa5 leoi4 sin1, tai2 haa5 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先帮你们扫个雷，看看这家餐厅好不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Let me test the waters for you first, and see if this restaurant is good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經幫你哋掃咗雷啦，呢個課程嘅老師教得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 bong1 nei5 dei6 sou3 zo2 leoi4 laa1, ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 ge3 lou5 si1 gaau3 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经帮你们扫雷了，这个课程的老师教得不错。
examples.english_sentence: I've already tested the waters for you. The teacher of this course teaches well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買股票要小心，自己掃雷，唔好信晒人。
