examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被公司派去北京挂职一年。
examples.english_sentence: He was sent by the company to Beijing for a one-year temporary assignment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家喺政府部門掛職，學吓嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai2 zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 gwaa3 zik1, hok6 haa5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在政府部门挂职，学点东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently on a temporary posting in a government department, learning some things.

mandarin_meaning: 晾腊鸭；遭受冷落，无人理睬
english_meaning: To hang dried duck; to be ignored; to be sidelined; to be left out to dry
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是挂起腊鸭。比喻受到冷落，被搁置一边，无人理睬。类似于被晾起来的意思。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to hang dried duck.' Figuratively, it means to be ignored, sidelined, or left out to dry. Similar to being left to hang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司俾人掛臘鴨，乜嘢嘢都唔俾佢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 bei2 jan4 gwaa3 laap6 aap3, mat1 je5 je5 dou1 m4 bei2 keoi5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司被晾在一边，什么事都不让他做。
examples.english_sentence: He's being sidelined at the company, they're not letting him do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掛我臘鴨呀，我仲有好多嘢想學㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaa3 ngo5 laap6 aap3 aa3, ngo5 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 soeng2 hok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把我晾在一边呀，我还有很多东西想学呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave me out to dry, I still have a lot of things I want to learn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢講錯嘢之後，就俾老細掛咗臘鴨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 gong2 co3 je5 zi1 hau6, zau6 bei2 lou5 sai3 gwaa3 zo2 laap6 aap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他说错话之后，就被老板晾在一边了。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he said something wrong, the boss has sidelined him.

synonyms: 晾在一边 (loeng6 zoi6 jat1 bin1)
投閒置散 (tau4 haan4 zi3 saan3)

mandarin_meaning: 表示店铺出售的是劣质商品或服务；砸招牌
english_meaning: To hang a blue lantern (idiom): To indicate that a shop sells substandard goods or services; to ruin one's reputation/brand.
explanation_mandarin: 舊時的妓院會掛紅燈籠招攬生意。掛藍燈籠則表示這家店賣的是劣質商品，是一種自砸招牌的行為。
explanation_english: In the old days, brothels would hang red lanterns to attract business. Hanging a blue lantern signifies that a shop sells substandard goods or services, effectively ruining its own reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食咁難食，遲早掛藍燈籠㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gam3 naan4 sik6, ci4 zou2 gwaa3 laam4 dang1 lung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西那么难吃，迟早要砸招牌的。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so bad, it's going to ruin its reputation sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做生意，唔係掛藍燈籠係咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 seng1 ji3, m4 hai6 gwaa3 laam4 dang1 lung4 hai6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做生意，不是砸自己的招牌是什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: What else is he doing with his business if not ruining his own reputation?

english_meaning: to register (at a hospital or clinic); registration
explanation_mandarin: 在医院或诊所登记，以便就诊。
explanation_english: To register at a hospital or clinic to receive medical consultation; the act of registration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去醫院掛號睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ji1 yun2 gwaa3 hou6 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去医院挂号看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the hospital to register and see a doctor today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得掛咗號先，唔係冇得睇醫生㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 gwaa3 zo2 hou6 sin1, m4 hai6 mou5 dak1 tai2 ji1 sang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得先挂号，不然就没法看医生了。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to register first, otherwise you won't be able to see the doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上掛號方便好多，唔使排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng5 gwaa3 hou6 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1, m4 sai2 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上挂号方便多了，不用排队。
examples.english_sentence: Online registration is much more convenient, you don't need to queue.

english_meaning: registered mail, registered letter
explanation_mandarin: 一种邮件服务，寄件人可在邮局记录邮件的寄送详情，收件人签收时会留下记录，方便追踪。
explanation_english: A postal service that provides a record of mailing for the sender. A signature is obtained from the recipient upon delivery, allowing for tracking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寄咗封掛號信俾你，記得簽收啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 zo2 fung1 gwaa3 hou6 seon3 bei2 nei5, gei3 dak1 cim1 sau1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我寄了一封挂号信给你，记得签收啊。
examples.english_sentence: I sent you a registered letter, remember to sign for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好寄掛號信，咁就唔怕寄失啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 gei3 gwaa3 hou6 seon3, gam2 zau6 m4 paa3 gei3 sat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好寄挂号信，这样就不怕寄丢了。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better send it by registered mail, then you won't have to worry about it getting lost.

mandarin_meaning: 挂钩; 联系; 关联
english_meaning: to link; to connect; to associate; to be linked to; hook
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示将两个或多个事物联系起来，或表示事物之间存在联系。作为名词，可以指实际的钩子。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to link two or more things together, or to indicate a connection between things. As a noun, it can refer to an actual hook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工同表現掛鈎，做得好就加薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gung1 tung4 biu2 hin3 gwaa3 ngau1, zou6 dak1 hou2 zau6 gaa1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工资与表现挂钩，做得好就加薪。
examples.english_sentence: Salary is linked to performance. If you do well, you'll get a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策同樓價掛鈎，樓價升，佢哋就賺得多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 tung4 lau2 gaa3 gwaa3 ngau1, lau2 gaa3 sing1, keoi5 dei6 zau6 zaan6 dak1 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策和房价挂钩，房价上涨，他们就赚得多。
examples.english_sentence: This policy is linked to property prices. When property prices rise, they earn more.

english_meaning: to link up, to connect, to associate, to be linked to
explanation_mandarin: 联系在一起，发生关联。
explanation_english: To link up, connect, associate, or be linked with something else. Often implies a connection that has practical implications or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功同佢嘅努力係掛鉤嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 tung4 keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 hai6 gwaa3 ngau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功和他的努力是挂钩的。
examples.english_sentence: His success is linked to his effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策同經濟發展掛鉤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jing3 caak3 tung4 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 gwaa3 ngau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策与经济发展挂钩。
examples.english_sentence: This policy is linked to economic development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將所有嘢都同錢掛鉤啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 je5 dou1 tung4 cin2 gwaa3 ngau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把所有的事情都和钱挂钩。
examples.english_sentence: Don't associate everything with money.

english_meaning: Wall clock
explanation_mandarin: 挂在墙上的钟。
explanation_english: A clock that is hung on a wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企客廳有個掛鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 haak3 teng1 jau5 go3 gwaa3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里客厅有一个挂钟。
examples.english_sentence: There's a wall clock in the living room at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個掛鐘嘅時間唔準，要較返正先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gwaa3 zung1 ge3 si4 gaan3 m4 zeon2, jiu3 gaau3 faan1 zeng3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个挂钟的时间不准，要校正一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: The time on that wall clock is incorrect, I need to adjust it.

english_meaning: to retire (from a sport or profession)
explanation_mandarin: 原指运动员退役，不再参加比赛，把球鞋挂起来。引申为结束职业生涯，不再从事相关工作。
explanation_english: Originally refers to an athlete retiring, no longer participating in competitions, and hanging up their shoes. By extension, it means to end one's career and no longer engage in related work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢咗咁多年波，終於都決定掛靴喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 bo1, zung1 jyu1 dou1 kyut3 ding6 gwaa3 hoe1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢了这么多年的球，终于决定退役了。
examples.english_sentence: He has played football for so many years, and finally decided to retire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺年紀大，都掛靴好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 nin4 gei2 daai6, dou1 gwaa3 hoe1 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷年纪大了，都已经退休很久了。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather is old and has been retired for a long time.

english_meaning: to throw, to fling
explanation_mandarin: 指用力把东西抛出去。
explanation_english: To throw or fling something with force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掟咗個波落海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deng3 zo2 go3 bo1 lok6 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把球扔到海里了。
examples.english_sentence: He threw the ball into the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掟垃圾落街啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 deng3 laap6 saap3 lok6 gaai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把垃圾扔到街上啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw trash onto the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到掟爛咗隻杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 deng3 laan6 zo2 zek3 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气到把杯子摔烂了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he smashed the cup.

english_meaning: to pretend to be ignorant; to feign innocence; to play dumb; to act clueless
explanation_mandarin: 指明明知道事情的真相却装作不知道，或者故意装傻。
explanation_english: To pretend not to know something that you actually know; to feign ignorance or innocence; to play dumb or act clueless. Usually implies a deliberate attempt to avoid responsibility or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明撞跌咗個花樽，但係佢就扮晒嘢，喺度掟仙話唔關佢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zong6 dit3 zo2 go3 faa1 zyun1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zau6 baan6 saai3 je5, hai2 dou6 deng3 sin1 waa6 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明撞倒了花瓶，但他却装模作样，在那里装蒜说和他没关系。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knocked over the vase, but he's pretending, acting clueless, saying it wasn't him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度掟仙啦，我知你知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 deng3 sin1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里装蒜了，我知道你知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb, I know you know what happened.

synonyms: 詐傻扮懵 (zaa3 so4 baan6 mung2)

mandarin_meaning: 出乎意料的惊喜；意外之财
english_meaning: An unexpected surprise; a windfall; a lucky break.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻意想不到的好处或惊喜，就像突然收到别人送的糯米鸡一样。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to an unexpected benefit or surprise, like receiving a sticky rice package as a gift out of the blue. It often implies good luck or fortune that was not anticipated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到我買隻股票竟然賺咁多，真係掟包糯米雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou3 ngo5 maai5 zek3 gu2 piu3 ging2 jin4 zaan6 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 deng3 baau1 no6 mai5 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到我买的股票竟然赚了这么多，真是意外之财。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect to earn so much from the stock I bought. It's a real windfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中咗六合彩，簡直係掟包糯米雞啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 deng3 baau1 no6 mai5 gai1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中了彩票，简直就是意外之喜了！
examples.english_sentence: Winning the lottery is like receiving an unexpected gift!

english_meaning: To set a trap for someone, to deceive, to scam, to swindle.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻设下圈套，欺骗他人。 "糯米雞" （糯米鸡）本来是美味的食物，但是 "掟包" （扔个包）意味着是用食物做饵来引诱人上当。
explanation_english: It's a metaphor for setting a trap to deceive someone. "糯米雞" (Sticky Rice Chicken) is originally a delicious food, but "掟包" (throwing a package) implies using food as bait to lure someone into a trap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，佢擺明想掟包糯米鷄你咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 baai2 ming4 soeng2 deng3 baau1 no6 mai5 gai1 nei5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他，他明显是想设圈套骗你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he clearly wants to scam you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲投資計劃睇落好吸引，但係小心畀人掟包糯米鷄呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 tau4 zi1 gai3 waak6 tai2 lok6 hou2 hap1 yan5, daan6 hai6 siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 deng3 baau1 no6 mai5 gai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些投资计划看起来很吸引人，但是小心被人设圈套骗了。
examples.english_sentence: These investment plans look attractive, but be careful of being scammed.

english_meaning: to throw things, to hurl objects, to throw a tantrum (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意義是扔東西。引申義指發脾氣時亂扔東西，或者表示非常生氣。
explanation_english: Literally means to throw things. Figuratively, it means to throw things around in anger, or to throw a tantrum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬲啦，唔好掟嘢呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 laa1, m4 hou2 ding3 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么生气了，不要扔东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, don't throw things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路扭計，喺度掟嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 nau1 gai2, hai2 dou6 ding3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那小孩闹脾气，在这里扔东西。
examples.english_sentence: That child is throwing a tantrum, throwing things around here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就掟嘢㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 ding3 je5 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就要扔东西了！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I'm going to throw things!

english_meaning: to turn a corner (sharply); to take a turn (quickly); to swerve
explanation_mandarin: 指车辆高速行驶时，快速转向；引申为突然改变方向、策略等。
explanation_english: Refers to turning a corner sharply, especially when driving fast; by extension, it can also mean to suddenly change direction, strategy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺個彎位掟彎掟得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 go3 waan1 wai2 deng3 waan1 deng3 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车在弯道上甩尾甩得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The car was drifting very hard at the corner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然間掟彎，唔做呢個project啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 deng3 waan1, m4 zou6 ni1 go3 project laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然转变了方向，不做了这个项目了。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly changed his mind and decided not to do this project.

english_meaning: Exhausted like a dead dog; extremely tired; dog-tired
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常疲惫，筋疲力尽，就像一条死狗一样。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme exhaustion and fatigue, comparable to a dead dog. Implies a complete lack of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日返工返到我掟死狗咁呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 ngo5 deng3 sei2 gau2 gam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天上班累得我像条死狗一样！
examples.english_sentence: I was dog-tired from work today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，佢即刻掟死狗咁瞓咗喺張床度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 deng3 sei2 gau2 gam2 fan3 zo2 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试之后，他立刻像条死狗一样睡在床上。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, he immediately collapsed on the bed, exhausted like a dead dog.

synonyms: 眼瞓到死 (ngaan5 fan3 dou3 sei2)

english_meaning: to ditch someone, to flake on someone, to stand someone up (more generally, to cancel plans)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻原本约好的事情突然取消，使对方措手不及，像被人放了鸽子一样。
explanation_english: A metaphor for cancelling plans at the last minute, leaving the other person in the lurch. It's similar to being 'stood up' or 'flaked on'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都掟波，下次唔再同佢約喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 deng3 bo1, haa6 ci3 m4 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 joek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是放鸽子，下次不再和他约了。
examples.english_sentence: He always flakes, I won't make plans with him again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，我聽日有啲嘢做，可能要掟波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 di1 je5 zou6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 deng3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思啊，我明天有点事，可能要放你鸽子了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I have something to do tomorrow, I might have to cancel our plans.

english_meaning: to break up (a romantic relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣或夫妻结束恋爱关系。煲，原意为砂锅，在这里比喻恋情，掟煲即打破砂锅，形容关系破裂。
explanation_english: Describes the ending of a romantic relationship between lovers or spouses. 'Bou1' (煲) originally means a clay pot or casserole dish. Here, it is used metaphorically to represent a romantic relationship. 'Deng3 bou1' (掟煲) means to break the clay pot, hence describing the relationship breaking down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋掟煲喇，真係估唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 deng3 bou1 laa3, zan1 hai6 gu2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们分手了，真是没想到。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they broke up. I really didn't expect that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同你掟煲，我哋試下解決問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 deng3 bou1, ngo5 dei6 si3 haa5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和你分手，我们试着解决问题吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to break up with you. Let's try to solve the problems.

english_meaning: To break up without burning bridges; to break up amicably; to break up while remaining friends.
explanation_mandarin: “掟煲”指分手，“蓋”指锅盖，盖子。整句的意思是分手了，但是没有把锅盖扔掉。比喻情侣分手了，但是保持联系，并没有完全断绝关系，留有余地，将来有可能复合，或保持友好的关系。
explanation_english: "Deng bou" means to break up. "Goi" means lid. The whole phrase means breaking up but not throwing away the lid (of the pot). It's an idiom used to describe breaking up without completely severing ties, leaving room for reconciliation or remaining friends in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋雖然掟煲，但係都仲係朋友，真係掟煲唔掟蓋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seoi1 jin4 deng3 bou1, daan6 hai6 dou1 zung1 hai6 pang4 jau5, zan1 hai6 deng3 bou1 m4 deng3 goi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们虽然分手了，但是还是朋友，真是分手不绝情。
examples.english_sentence: Although they broke up, they are still friends. They really broke up without burning bridges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定和平分手，掟煲唔掟蓋，將來仲可以做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 wo4 ping4 fan1 sau2, deng3 bou1 m4 deng3 goi3, zoeng1 loi4 zung1 ho2 ji5 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定和平分手，分手不绝情，将来还可以做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We decided to break up amicably, without burning bridges, and we can still be friends in the future.

english_meaning: Breakup fee; money or gifts given to a girlfriend after a breakup to compensate for lost time and affection (often used humorously or sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 分手后，男方给女方的补偿金，通常是开玩笑的说法，带有一种戏谑的意味。
explanation_english: Compensation money or gifts that a boyfriend gives to his girlfriend after a breakup, often used humorously or sarcastically. It implies that the girlfriend deserves some form of repayment for the time and affection she invested in the relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同條女分手，佢竟然問我攞掟煲費！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 tiu4 neoi2 fan1 sau2, keoi5 ging2 jin4 man6 ngo5 lo2 deng3 bou1 fai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和女朋友分手了，她竟然问我要分手费！
examples.english_sentence: I broke up with my girlfriend, and she actually asked me for a breakup fee!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲女仔真係，拍拖都講掟煲費，當你係提款機咁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 neoi2 zai2 zan1 hai6, paak3 to1 dou1 gong2 deng3 bou1 fai3, dong3 nei5 hai6 tai4款gei1 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的女孩子真是的，谈恋爱都说分手费，把你当提款机一样！
examples.english_sentence: Girls these days are something else, even talking about breakup fees when dating, treating you like an ATM!

english_meaning: to snatch, to grab, to skim, to brush past
explanation_mandarin: 表示快速地夺取，轻轻地擦过，或掠过的动作。
explanation_english: Describes the action of quickly seizing something, brushing lightly, or skimming past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掠走咗我嘅銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loek6 zau2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抢走了我的钱包。
examples.english_sentence: He snatched my wallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雀仔低飛掠過水面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 zoek3 zai2 dai1 fei1 loek6 gwo3 seoi2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小鸟低空飞行掠过水面。
examples.english_sentence: The little bird flew low, skimming the surface of the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲風掠起啲落葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fung1 loek6 hei2 di1 lok6 yip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风吹起落叶。
examples.english_sentence: The wind swept up the fallen leaves.

english_meaning: to take away (advantageously); to steal; to swipe; to profit at someone's expense; to get a good deal
explanation_mandarin: 表示拿走别人的东西或占别人的便宜。可以指偷窃，也可以指在交易中获取比对方更大的利益。
explanation_english: To take something away, often with an element of unfair advantage or stealing. It can refer to literal theft or to gaining a profit or advantage at someone else's expense, often in a business transaction or negotiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺股市度掠低好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gu2 si5 dou6 loek6 dai1 ho2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在股市里赚了很多钱 (占了很多便宜)。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of money (took advantage) in the stock market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷咗我銀包，掠低咗我嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 zo2 ngo5 ngan4 baau1, loek6 dai1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了我的钱包，抢走了我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He stole my wallet and took my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢掠低你，簽合同前要睇清楚啲條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 loek6 dai1 nei5, cim1 hap6 tung4 cin4 jiu3 tai2 cing1 co2 di1 tiu4 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他占你的便宜，签合同前要看清楚条款。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him take advantage of you; read the terms carefully before signing the contract.

english_meaning: to plunder, to loot, to rob, to pillage
explanation_mandarin: 用武力夺取；抢夺。
explanation_english: To seize goods or property forcefully; to rob or plunder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班海盜喺條船上面掠奪咗好多財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 hoi2 dou6 hai2 tiu4 syun4 soeng6 min6 loek6 dyut6 zo2 hou2 do1 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群海盗在那艘船上掠夺了很多财物。
examples.english_sentence: The pirates plundered a lot of valuables on that ship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭令到好多無辜嘅人俾人掠奪一空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 mou4 gu1 ge3 jan4 bei2 jan4 loek6 dyut6 jat1 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争导致很多无辜的人被掠夺一空。
examples.english_sentence: The war caused many innocent people to be completely robbed.

english_meaning: To skim money; to swindle; to make a quick buck dishonestly; to rip off
explanation_mandarin: 指利用不正当手段快速获取金钱，通常带有欺骗或不诚实的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to quickly acquiring money through dishonest means, often involving deception or cheating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登開間空殼公司嚟掠水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 daang3 hoi1 gaan1 hung1 hok3 gung1 si1 lei4 loek6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意开一家空壳公司来骗钱。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately set up a shell company to skim money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾佢哋掠水啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 loek6 seoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，别让他们骗钱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't let them rip you off!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢咁貴，根本就係掠水！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 loek6 seoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西这么贵，根本就是宰人！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's food is so expensive, it's basically a rip-off!

english_meaning: to flash past; to sweep past; to skim over; to cross quickly
explanation_mandarin: 快速地经过、掠过。形容速度快，时间短。
explanation_english: To pass by quickly, to sweep past. Describes speed and brevity of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有架飛機喺我頭頂掠過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 gaa3 fei1 gei1 hai2 ngo5 tau4 ding2 loek6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有一架飞机从我的头顶掠过。
examples.english_sentence: An airplane flashed past over my head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身影好快噉掠過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 jing2 hou2 faai3 gam2 loek6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身影很快地掠过。
examples.english_sentence: His figure flashed past quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雲好快噉掠過太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wan4 hou2 faai3 gam2 loek6 gwo3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些云很快地掠过太阳。
examples.english_sentence: The clouds quickly swept across the sun.

english_meaning: to make money, to earn money (often implies quick or underhanded means)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过某种手段快速或不正当地赚钱。带有贬义，暗示手段不光明正大，或只想快速获取利益。
explanation_english: To make money, often implying quick, opportunistic, or even slightly unethical means. Carries a negative connotation suggesting less-than-honorable methods or a focus solely on rapid financial gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣可以掠到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 loek6 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在想怎么可以捞到钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how he can make a quick buck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司淨係識得掠錢，完全唔理員工嘅死活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 loek6 cin2, jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jyun4 gung1 ge3 sei2 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司只会捞钱，完全不顾员工的死活。
examples.english_sentence: This company only knows how to make money and doesn't care about the well-being of its employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲發展商淨係識得掠錢，搞到啲樓價咁貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 faat3 zin2 soeng1 jing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 loek6 cin2, gaau2 dou3 di1 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些开发商只会捞钱，搞得房价这么贵。
examples.english_sentence: Those developers only know how to make money, causing the housing prices to be so expensive.

synonyms: 搵快錢 (wan2 faai3 cin2) - make quick money

english_meaning: to pay attention to; to acknowledge; to take notice of
explanation_mandarin: 理睬，注意。在粤语中通常表示不理睬的意思，与普通话意思相近。
explanation_english: To pay attention to, to acknowledge, or to take notice of someone. In Cantonese, it's often used to mean 'to not pay attention to' or 'to ignore,' similar to its meaning in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲咗我，唔採我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 zo2 ngo5, m4 caai2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生我的气了，不理我。
examples.english_sentence: He's angry with me and is ignoring me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我講嘢佢都唔採我，真係冇癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gong2 je5 keoi5 dou1 m4 caai2 ngo5, zan1 hai6 mou5 yan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我说话他都不理我，真没意思。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't even acknowledge me when I talk, it's really boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔認錯，我就唔採你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 jing6 co3, ngo5 zau6 m4 caai2 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不认错，我就不理你了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't admit your mistake, I'm not going to talk to you anymore.

english_meaning: to adopt; to take; to use; to employ; to assume
explanation_mandarin: 选用、采取某种方法或措施。
explanation_english: To select and use a certain method or measure; to adopt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要採取更有效嘅措施嚟解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 coi2 zeoi2 gang3 jau5 haau6 ge3 cuo3 si1 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要采取更有效的措施来解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to adopt more effective measures to solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋採取咗法律行動去追討賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 coi2 zeoi2 zo2 faat3 leot6 hang4 dung6 heoi3 zeoi1 tou2 pui4 seong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们采取了法律行动去追讨赔偿。
examples.english_sentence: They took legal action to seek compensation.

english_meaning: to pick; to pluck; to gather
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具摘取果实、花朵等。
explanation_english: To pick or pluck fruits, flowers, etc. by hand or with tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去果園採摘士多啤梨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gwo2 jyun4 caai2 zaak6 si6 do1 be1 lei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去果园采摘草莓。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to the orchard to pick strawberries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺茶園採摘茶葉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 caa4 jyun4 caai2 zaak6 caa4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在茶园采摘茶叶。
examples.english_sentence: They are picking tea leaves in the tea garden.

english_meaning: to gather, to pick, to collect
explanation_mandarin: 收集、摘取。
explanation_english: To gather or pick (flowers, fruits, plants, etc.); to collect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去郊外採擷野花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 caai2 git3 je5 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去郊外采集野花。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the countryside to gather wildflowers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋採擷咗好多新鮮嘅草藥返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 caai2 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 ge3 cou2 joek6 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们采集了很多新鲜的草药回来。
examples.english_sentence: We gathered a lot of fresh herbs and brought them back.

english_meaning: to adopt, to employ, to use
explanation_mandarin: 选取并使用；采取
explanation_english: To choose and use; to adopt, employ, or use something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司決定採用新嘅管理制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 choi2 yung6 san1 ge3 gun2 lei5 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司决定采用新的管理制度。
examples.english_sentence: Our company decided to adopt a new management system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計比賽，我哋採用咗佢嘅方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat3 gai3 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 choi2 yung6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计比赛，我们采纳了他的方案。
examples.english_sentence: For this design competition, we adopted his proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋採用咗最新嘅技術嚟生產產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 choi2 yung6 zo2 zeoi3 san1 ge3 gei6 seot6 lai4 sang1 caan2 chan2 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们采用了最新的技术来生产产品。
examples.english_sentence: They have adopted the latest technology to produce their products.

english_meaning: mining
explanation_mandarin: 挖掘矿物；开采矿藏。
explanation_english: The process of extracting valuable minerals or other geological materials from the earth, usually from an ore body, lode, vein, seam, reef or placer deposit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺南非做緊採礦嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 naam4 fei1 zou6 gan2 caai2 kwong3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在南非做采矿的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is working in mining in South Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司主要業務係採礦同埋石油開採。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 jip6 mou6 hai6 caai2 kwong3 tung4 maai4 sek6 jau4 hoi1 caai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司的主要业务是采矿和石油开采。
examples.english_sentence: That company's main business is mining and oil extraction.

english_meaning: to adopt, to accept, to take up (suggestions, proposals)
explanation_mandarin: 接受并采用（建议、意见等）。
explanation_english: To accept and use (suggestions, opinions, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅建議希望可以俾公司採納啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 gin3 ji5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bei2 gung1 si1 caai2 naap6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望我的建议能被公司采纳。
examples.english_sentence: I hope my suggestions will be adopted by the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該採納市民嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 caai2 naap6 si5 man4 ge3 yi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该采纳市民的意见。
examples.english_sentence: The government should adopt the citizens' opinions.

english_meaning: ear cleaning; ear picking; the practice of professionally cleaning ears with specialized tools
explanation_mandarin: 一种专业的耳部清洁服务，使用专门的工具进行。
explanation_english: The practice of professionally cleaning ears with specialized tools. It is a form of personal care and sometimes entertainment, using tools like small picks, feathers, and vibrating devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏晝去咗旺角嘅舖頭採耳，好舒服啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 zau3 heoi3 zo2 wong6 gok3 ge3 pou3 tau2 caai2 ji5, hou2 syu1 fuk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午去了旺角的店采耳，好舒服啊！
examples.english_sentence: I went to an ear-cleaning shop in Mong Kok this afternoon, it was so comfortable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試過採耳未呀？聽講可以放鬆心情㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 gwo3 caai2 ji5 mei6 aa3? ting1 gong2 ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 sam1 ching4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试过采耳了吗？听说可以放松心情的。
examples.english_sentence: Have you ever tried ear cleaning? I heard it can relax you.

english_meaning: to interview; to gather news; to cover (an event)
explanation_mandarin: 收集信息，进行访谈，通常用于新闻报道或研究等。
explanation_english: To gather information and conduct interviews, typically for news reporting or research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者嚟緊禮拜會採訪佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 lai4 gan2 lai5 baai3 wui5 caai2 fong2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者下周会采访他。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter will interview him next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去咗北京採訪奧運會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 Bak1 ging1 caai2 fong2 Ou3 wan6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去了北京采访奥运会。
examples.english_sentence: They went to Beijing to cover the Olympic Games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要更多資料嚟支持我哋嘅採訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 zi1 liu2 lai4 zi1 chi4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 caai2 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多资料来支持我们的采访。
examples.english_sentence: We need more information to support our interview.

english_meaning: purchase; procure; buy
explanation_mandarin: 购买（通常指大量或批量购买）
explanation_english: To purchase or procure goods or services, often in bulk or on a large scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近要採購一批新嘅電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 jiu3 caai2 gau3 jat1 bat1 san1 ge3 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近要采购一批新的电脑。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to purchase a batch of new computers recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責幫公司採購辦公室用品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 bong1 gung1 si1 caai2 gau3 baan6 gung1 sat1 jung6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责帮公司采购办公室用品。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for purchasing office supplies for the company.

english_meaning: to collect; to gather; to harvest
explanation_mandarin: 收集，采集；多指收集自然界的物品。
explanation_english: To gather, collect, or harvest, especially natural objects like plants, minerals, or data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋去郊外採集標本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 heoi3 gaau1 ngoi6 caai2 zaap6 biu1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们去郊外采集标本。
examples.english_sentence: They went to the countryside to collect specimens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要採集多啲數據嚟做研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caai2 zaap6 do1 di1 sou3 geoi3 lai4 zou6 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要采集更多数据来做研究。
examples.english_sentence: We need to collect more data for the research.

english_meaning: Lion dance ritual of plucking the green; to collect good luck (usually refers to a part of a lion dance performance); to collect something green
explanation_mandarin: 采青是舞狮表演中的一个环节，寓意摘取好运和财富。通常会悬挂生菜（谐音“生财”）或其他象征吉祥的物品，舞狮者设法摘取。
explanation_english: "Caai Qing" is a segment in the lion dance performance, symbolizing the act of collecting good luck and wealth. Usually, lettuce (sounds like "generating wealth") or other auspicious items are hung up, and the lion dancers attempt to retrieve them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先睇咗場舞獅，佢哋採青採得好精彩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 tai2 zo2 coeng4 mou5 si1, keoi5 dei6 caai2 cing1 caai2 dak1 hou2 zing1 coi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才看了一场舞狮表演，他们采青采得好精彩啊！
examples.english_sentence: I just watched a lion dance performance, and their lion dance plucking the green was very impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多地方都有舞獅採青嘅表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 jau5 mou5 si1 caai2 cing1 ge3 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多地方都有舞狮采青的表演。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many places have lion dance performances including the "plucking the green" segment.

mandarin_meaning: 拜访; 探测; 侦察
english_meaning: to visit; to explore; to probe; to scout
explanation_mandarin: 看望，拜访：探亲访友。 探测，勘察：探矿。 侦察，刺探：探听消息。
explanation_english: To visit (someone); to explore or investigate (something); to scout or reconnoitre.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去醫院探我嫲嫲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ji1 yun2 taam3 ngo5 maa4 maa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去医院看望我奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the hospital tomorrow to visit my grandma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派人去探路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 jan4 heoi3 taam3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派人去探路。
examples.english_sentence: They sent people to scout the route.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想探吓佢嘅口风。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 taam3 haa5 keoi5 ge3 hau2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想探听一下他的口风。
examples.english_sentence: I want to sound him out.

english_meaning: detective, investigator
explanation_mandarin: 指进行调查和侦查的警察或专业人士。
explanation_english: Refers to a police officer or professional who conducts investigations and inquiries.
