examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要探討吓呢個問題嘅解決方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 taam3 tou2 haa5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ge3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要探讨一下这个问题的解决方法。
examples.english_sentence: We need to explore the solutions to this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度探討緊新嘅市場策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 taam3 tou2 gan2 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4 caak3 leuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在探讨新的市场策略。
examples.english_sentence: They are exploring new marketing strategies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一齊探討吓點樣可以改善公司嘅效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 taam3 tou2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 gaai2 sin6 gung1 si1 ge3 haau6 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起探讨一下怎样可以改善公司的效率。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we explore together how to improve the company's efficiency?

english_meaning: to visit; to call on
explanation_mandarin: 看望、访问。
explanation_english: To visit or call on someone (often someone who is sick, elderly, or in need of support). It implies a purpose of providing comfort or assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去醫院探訪阿婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 taam3 fong2 aa3 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去医院探望奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: We will visit Grandma in the hospital tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋每個禮拜都會去老人院探訪啲老人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 wui5 heoi3 lou5 jan4 jyun2 taam3 fong2 di1 lou5 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每个星期都会去养老院探望老人们。
examples.english_sentence: They visit the elderly at the nursing home every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，好多人唔可以親身探訪屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 kei4 gaan1, hou2 do1 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 chan1 san1 taam3 fong2 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，很多人不可以亲自探望家人。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, many people couldn't visit their family members in person.

english_meaning: to scout the road; to pave the way; to reconnoiter; to test the waters
explanation_mandarin: 探索道路；比喻为将来发展先行试探，摸清情况。
explanation_english: To explore a road or path; metaphorically, to test the waters or pave the way for future development by investigating the situation in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋派個人去探路先，睇下前面有冇危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 paai3 go3 jan4 heoi3 taam3 lou6 sin1, tai2 haa5 cin4 min6 jau5 mou5 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们派个人去探路先，看看前面有没有危险。
examples.english_sentence: Let's send someone to scout the road first to see if there are any dangers ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想喺大陸搞生意，所以咪去探路囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hai2 daai6 luk6 gaau2 saang1 ji3, so2 ji5 mai1 heoi3 taam3 lou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想在大陆做生意，所以才去探路啊。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to do business in mainland China, so he's going there to test the waters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司想進軍海外市場，所以要先探路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 zeon3 gwan1 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4, so2 ji5 jiu3 sin1 taam3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想进军海外市场，所以要先探路。
examples.english_sentence: This company wants to enter the overseas market, so they need to scout the road first.

english_meaning: Detective Inspector, Chief Detective
explanation_mandarin: 指警队中负责侦查案件的高级警官，相当于侦探长或警长。
explanation_english: Refers to a senior police officer in charge of investigating cases, equivalent to a Detective Inspector or Chief Detective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李探長係警隊嘅精英，破咗好多大案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 taam3 zoeng2 hai6 ging2 deoi6 ge3 jing1 ging1, po3 zo2 hou2 do1 daai6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李探长是警队的精英，破了很多大案。
examples.english_sentence: Detective Inspector Lee is an elite in the police force and has solved many major cases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個案件交畀探長全權負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 on3 gin2 gaau1 bei2 taam3 zoeng2 cyun4 kwan4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案件交给探长全权负责。
examples.english_sentence: This case is fully entrusted to the Detective Inspector.

english_meaning: to explore; to adventure
explanation_mandarin: 冒险去不熟悉的地方，寻找新事物。
explanation_english: To explore unfamiliar places, seeking new things or experiences; to go on an adventure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年暑假要去非洲探險呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 syu2 ga3 jiu3 heoi3 fei1 zau1 taam3 him2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年暑假要去非洲探险啊！
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Africa for an adventure this summer!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意睇關於探險嘅紀錄片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 yi3 tai2 gwaan1 jyu1 taam3 him2 ge3 gei3 luk1 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢看关于探险的纪录片。
examples.english_sentence: He likes watching documentaries about exploration.

english_meaning: to peek out; to stick one's head out; to crane one's neck
explanation_mandarin: 伸出头或身体的一部分，窥视或查看。
explanation_english: To extend one's head or part of the body to peek or check something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺窗度探頭出嚟睇下發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 coeng1 dou6 taam3 tau4 chut1 lai4 tai2 haa5 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从窗户探头出来看看发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He peeked out the window to see what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好探頭出去，危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taam3 tau4 chut1 heoi3, ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要探头出去，危险的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't stick your head out, it's dangerous!

mandarin_meaning: 打听情况, 探听消息
english_meaning: to inquire about something; to sound someone out; to probe; to get information
explanation_mandarin: 打听或调查某事或某人的情况，以便了解更多信息或为下一步行动做准备。
explanation_english: To inquire or investigate about something or someone's situation in order to get more information or prepare for the next step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要探下題，睇下佢哋嘅反應先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 taam3 haa5 tai4, tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 faan2 ying3 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要探听一下情况，看看他们的反应先。
examples.english_sentence: We need to sound them out first to see their reaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我探題，睇下個客想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 taam3 tai4, tai2 haa5 go3 haak3 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我去探听情况，看看顾客想要什么。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked me to inquire and see what the customer wants.

mandarin_meaning: 开关; 操纵杆; 控制
english_meaning: Switch; lever; to control; to operate
explanation_mandarin: 通常指控制机器或设备的开关，也可指控制行为或情绪。
explanation_english: Typically refers to a switch for controlling a machine or device, but can also refer to controlling behaviour or emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 閂咗個掣佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 zo2 go3 zai3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把开关关掉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Turn off the switch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都扭計，好難控制，真係冇晒佢符掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nau2 gai2, hou2 naan4 kong3 zai3, zan1 hai6 mou5 saai3 keoi5 fu4 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍赖，很难控制，真是拿他没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being difficult and is hard to control, I really can't handle him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機有個緊急掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 jau5 go3 gan2 gap1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器有个紧急开关。
examples.english_sentence: This machine has an emergency switch.

english_meaning: to constrain; to hamper; to hold back; to impede; to put a spoke in someone's wheel
explanation_mandarin: 原指拉住胳膊肘子，使人不能顺利活动。现在比喻牵制、阻挠，使事情不能顺利进行。
explanation_english: Originally referred to holding someone's elbow to prevent them from moving freely. Now it means to constrain, hamper, or impede someone, preventing things from proceeding smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日掣肘我哋嘅工作，搞到我哋好難做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 caak3 zau2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 zok3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 naan4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是掣肘我们的工作，搞得我们很难做事。
examples.english_sentence: They always constrain our work, making it very difficult for us to do things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個項目入面，我哋唔想受到任何掣肘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 m4 soeng2 sau6 dou3 jam6 ho4 caak3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个项目里，我们不想受到任何牵制。
examples.english_sentence: In this project, we don't want to be constrained in any way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該減少對企業嘅掣肘，等佢哋可以更加自由噉發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 gaam2 siu2 deoi3 kei5 jip6 ge3 caak3 zau2, dang2 keoi5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gang3 gaa1 zi6 jau4 gam2 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该减少对企业的牵制，让他们可以更加自由地发展。
examples.english_sentence: The government should reduce its constraints on enterprises, allowing them to develop more freely.

english_meaning: awkward, unnatural, stiff, strained
explanation_mandarin: 形容神情或表情不自然，显得尴尬，僵硬。
explanation_english: Describes an expression or demeanor that is unnatural, awkward, stiff, or strained. Often used to describe someone feeling embarrassed or uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嗰陣有啲掣面噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 jau5 di1 cai3 min6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的时候有点不自然。
examples.english_sentence: He looked a bit awkward when he was speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多人面前唱歌，佢覺得好掣面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 cai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前唱歌，他觉得很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: He felt very awkward singing in front of so many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到舊情人，個樣即刻變得好掣面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 gau6 jan4, go3 joeng2 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 hou2 cai3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见到旧情人，脸色立刻变得很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: He saw his ex and his expression immediately became awkward.

english_meaning: to straighten; to tidy up; to spruce up
explanation_mandarin: 使原本彎曲或鬆散的東西變直、變挺或整齊。
explanation_english: To straighten something bent or loose; to tidy up or spruce up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掤靚間房佢先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paang1 leng3 gaan1 fong2 keoi5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把房间整理干净。
examples.english_sentence: Tidy up the room first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掤直條腰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paang1 zik6 tiu4 jiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 挺直腰。
examples.english_sentence: Straighten your back.

mandarin_meaning: 接收, 迎接, 连接
english_meaning: to receive, to pick up, to connect, to join
explanation_mandarin: 收取，迎接，连接。
explanation_english: To receive, to pick up, to welcome, to connect, or to join something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去機場接你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zip3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去机场接你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll pick you up at the airport tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接咗個電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 zo2 go3 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接了个电话。
examples.english_sentence: He answered the phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條水管駁唔實，要接返好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 seoi2 gun2 bok3 m4 sat6, jiu3 zip3 faan1 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水管连接不紧，要把它接好。
examples.english_sentence: The water pipe is not connected tightly, it needs to be reconnected.

mandarin_meaning: 接受工作; 承接案子
english_meaning: To take on a job; to accept a project; to freelanc
explanation_mandarin: “接”是接受的意思，“Job”是英文“工作”的意思。整个词组指接受一项工作或项目，通常指自由职业者或兼职人员接受工作。
explanation_english: "接" means to accept, and "job" is the English word for "work." The whole phrase refers to accepting a job or project, usually in the context of freelancers or part-timers taking on work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近經濟唔好，我都要周圍接job搵錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zau1 wai4 zip3 job1 wan2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近经济不好，我也要到处接活儿赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: The economy hasn't been good lately, so I have to take on jobs everywhere to earn money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎，好多公司都搵佢接job。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 wan2 keoi5 zip3 job1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害，很多公司都找他接项目。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable, many companies ask him to take on projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我已經接咗其他job，冇時間幫你手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 zip3 zo2 kei4 taa1 job1, mou5 si4 gaan3 bong1 nei5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我已经接了其他项目，没时间帮你忙。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I've already taken on other projects, I don't have time to help you.

mandarin_meaning: 接连不断, 连续不断
english_meaning: one after another; in quick succession; repeatedly; successively
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物连续不断地发生。
explanation_english: Describes events occurring one after another without pause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近接二連三咁落雨，真係好鬼麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 zip3 ji6 lin4 saam1 gam2 lok6 jyu5, zan1 hai6 hou2 gwai2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近接二连三地下雨，真是很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: It's been raining one day after another recently, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接二連三咁遇到衰嘢，真係黑仔到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 ji6 lin4 saam1 gam2 jyu6 dou2 seoi1 je5, zan1 hai6 hak1 zai2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接二连三地遇到倒霉的事情，真是倒霉透顶。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps encountering bad luck one thing after another, he is really unlucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司最近接二連三咁出事，好多員工都好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 zip3 ji6 lin4 saam1 gam2 ceot1 si6, hou2 do1 wun4 gung1 dou1 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司最近接二连三地出事，很多员工都很担心。
examples.english_sentence: This company has had problems one after another recently, many employees are very worried.

english_meaning: to succeed to a post; to take over a position; to assume office; to take over
explanation_mandarin: 接替某个职位或工作。
explanation_english: To succeed to a post or position; to take over a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月會接任經理嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zip3 jam6 ging1 lei5 ge3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月会接任经理的职位。
examples.english_sentence: He will take over the position of manager next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，由佢個仔接任佢嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, jau4 keoi5 go3 zai2 zip3 jam6 keoi5 ge3 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，由他的儿子接任他的生意。
examples.english_sentence: After his retirement, his son took over his business.

english_meaning: to catch; to receive (something thrown); to follow; to continue
explanation_mandarin: 表示用手或容器等工具接住抛过来的东西；也表示继续、接着的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates catching something thrown with hands or a container; also means to continue or follow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我掟個波過嚟，你接住佢啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deng3 go3 bo1 gwo3 lai4, nei5 zip3 zyu6 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我扔个球过来，你接住它啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm throwing the ball over, catch it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講完之後，輪到你接住講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 zi1 hau6, leon4 dou3 nei5 zip3 zyu6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说完之后，轮到你接着说。
examples.english_sentence: After he finishes, it's your turn to continue speaking.

english_meaning: relay, relay race
explanation_mandarin: 指多人或多组之间轮流完成一项任务或比赛的一种形式。
explanation_english: Refers to a form of competition or task completion where multiple people or groups take turns to complete a single task or race.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日有接力賽跑呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jau5 zip3 lik6 coi3 paau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天有接力赛跑啊。
examples.english_sentence: We have a relay race tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個任務需要大家接力完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jam6 mou6 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 zip3 lik6 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个任务需要大家接力完成。
examples.english_sentence: This task requires everyone to work in relay to complete it.

english_meaning: relay race
explanation_mandarin: 一种田径比赛项目，由一组队员分段完成同一赛程。
explanation_english: A track and field event in which a team of athletes take turns running a set distance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校今年喺運動會攞咗接力賽冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 hai2 wan6 dung6 wui2 lo2 zo2 zip3 lik6 coi3 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校今年在运动会上拿了接力赛冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Our school won the relay race championship at the sports day this year.

english_meaning: to accept; to receive; to take on
explanation_mandarin: 接收、采纳、同意。表示同意或采纳某种提议、意见、礼物等。
explanation_english: To accept something offered or given; to agree to or believe something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我接受你嘅道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zip3 sau6 nei5 ge3 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我接受你的道歉。
examples.english_sentence: I accept your apology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接受咗呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 sau6 zo2 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接受了这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He accepted the job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋接受唔到噉樣嘅安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zip3 sau6 m4 dou2 gam2 joeng2 ge3 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们接受不了这样的安排。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot accept such an arrangement.

english_meaning: Accept reality, come to terms with reality, face the facts
explanation_mandarin: 指承认并接受客观存在的现实情况，即使这些情况是不如意的。
explanation_english: To acknowledge and accept the reality of a situation, even if it is unpleasant or undesirable. It implies letting go of denial and adjusting to the actual circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要接受現實㗎啦，佢哋已經分手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 jin6 sat6 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 fan1 sau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也得接受现实了，他们已经分手了。
examples.english_sentence: You have to accept reality, they've already broken up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然好唔甘心，但係都要接受現實，我哋輸咗比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hou2 m4 gam1 sam1, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 jin6 sat6, ngo5 dei6 syu1 zo2 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然很不甘心，但是也得接受现实，我们输了比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Although I'm very unwilling, I still have to accept reality, we lost the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 接受現實啦，冇可能返到過去㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zip3 sau6 jin6 sat6 laa1, mou5 ho2 nang4 faan1 dou3 gwo3 heoi3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 接受现实吧，不可能回到过去了。
examples.english_sentence: Accept reality, it's impossible to go back to the past.

english_meaning: to connect; to get in touch with; to liaise; contact point; point of contact; (computing) interface
explanation_mandarin: 动词时，指联系，接洽；名词时，指联系人，联系点，或者技术上的接口。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to connect or liaise. As a noun, it refers to a contact person, a point of contact, or a technical interface (e.g., in computer science).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我哋同佢哋接口啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dei6 zip3 hau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以帮我们和他们联系一下？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help us get in touch with them?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司喺香港有個接口人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 jau5 go3 zip3 hau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司在香港有一个联络人。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has a contact person in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電腦嘅接口唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 nou5 ge3 zip3 hau2 m4 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个电脑的接口不匹配。
examples.english_sentence: This computer's interface doesn't match.

english_meaning: to kiss
explanation_mandarin: 嘴唇接触，表示亲爱、热情等感情。
explanation_english: To touch with the lips as a sign of love, affection, or greeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺海邊接吻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 hoi2 bin1 zip3 man5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在海边接吻。
examples.english_sentence: They are kissing at the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋錫錫接吻，真係好sweet呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sek3 sek3 zip3 man5, zan1 hai6 hou2 sweet aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们亲亲接吻，真是好甜蜜啊！
examples.english_sentence: They are kissing and kissing, so sweet!

english_meaning: down-to-earth, connected to the common people, relatable, authentic
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物或某人非常贴近实际生活，了解并能引起普通民众的共鸣。通常指内容、形式、行为等平易近人，不做作，不脱离群众。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being very down-to-earth and connected to the lives of ordinary people. It usually refers to content, forms, or behaviors that are approachable, genuine, and not detached from the masses. It implies authenticity and relatability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲好接地氣，講嘅都係我哋日常生活嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 hou2 zip3 dei6 hei3, gong2 ge3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 sang1 wu6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏很接地气，讲的都是我们日常生活的事情。
examples.english_sentence: This drama is very down-to-earth; it talks about things from our daily lives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好接地氣，成日同啲街坊吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zip3 dei6 hei3, seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 gaai1 fong1 cheui1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很接地气，经常和街坊邻居聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very down-to-earth person; he often chats with the neighbors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌好接地氣，所以咁多人鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 hou2 zip3 dei6 hei3, so2 ji5 gam3 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌很接地气，所以那么多人喜欢听。
examples.english_sentence: His songs are very down-to-earth, that's why so many people like to listen to them.

english_meaning: to receive a report; to be informed; to get a notification
explanation_mandarin: 收到报告或者通知。
explanation_english: To receive a report, information, or notification, often used in formal contexts like news reports or police statements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方接報，話旺角有打鬥事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zip3 bou3, waa6 wong6 gok3 jau5 daa2 dau3 si6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方接到报告说旺角有打架事件。
examples.english_sentence: The police received a report that there was a fight in Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防處接報後，立即派人到場處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 cyu3 zip3 bou3 hau6, lap1 zik1 paai3 jan4 dou3 coeng4 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防处接到报告后，立即派人到场处理。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the report, the Fire Services Department immediately sent people to the scene to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋接報有人喺公園暈倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zip3 bou3 jau5 jan4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 wan1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们接到报告说有人在公园晕倒了。
examples.english_sentence: We received a report that someone fainted in the park.

synonyms: 收到報告 (sau1 dou3 bou3 gou3)

english_meaning: to border on; to adjoin
explanation_mandarin: 指两国或两地边界相连。
explanation_english: To share a border with; to have a common boundary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港同中國大陸接壤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 tung4 zung1 gwok3 daai6 luk6 zip3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港和中国大陆接壤。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong borders mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個國家接壤，經常都有貿易往來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 zip3 joeng5, ging1 seong4 dou1 jau5 mau6 jik6 wong5 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个国家接壤，经常都有贸易往来。
examples.english_sentence: These two countries are adjacent and frequently engage in trade.

english_meaning: to receive guests; to entertain customers (often implying service industry, including prostitution)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是接待客人。但通常在某些语境下，带有性工作者接待客人的含义。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to receive guests'. However, it often carries the connotation of sex workers entertaining customers, especially in certain contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺夜總會接客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 je6 zung2 wui2 zip3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们在夜总会接客。
examples.english_sentence: They entertain customers at the nightclub. (implying prostitution)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅服務員好識得接客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 jyun4 hou2 sik1 dak1 zip3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的服务员很懂得接待客人。
examples.english_sentence: The staff at this hotel know how to receive guests well.

english_meaning: to receive (a guest); to admit (allow entrance); to entertain; reception
explanation_mandarin: 迎接招待，迎接并招待来访者。
explanation_english: To receive and entertain guests or visitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間酒店嘅服務好好，接待嘅人都好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 hou2, zip3 daai3 ge3 dou1 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们酒店的服务很好，接待的人都很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: The service in their hotel is very good, and the people who receive guests are very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司琴日接待咗一班嚟自美國嘅遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kam4 jat6 zip3 daai3 zo2 jat1 baan1 lai4 zi6 mei5 gwok3 ge3 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司昨天接待了一批来自美国的游客。
examples.english_sentence: Our company received a group of tourists from America yesterday.

english_meaning: Receptionist
explanation_mandarin: 负责接待来访者、接听电话、处理邮件等事务的人员。
explanation_english: A person employed to receive and assist visitors or clients in an office, hotel, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅接待員好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zip3 daai3 jyun4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的接待员很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: The receptionist of this company is very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打電話去問下接待員就知㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 din6 waa2 heoi3 man6 haa5 zip3 daai3 jyun4 zau6 zi1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打电话去问一下接待员就知道了。
examples.english_sentence: You'll know if you call and ask the receptionist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工係做接待員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hai6 zou6 zip3 daai3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作是做接待员。
examples.english_sentence: His job is to be a receptionist.

english_meaning: reception desk, reception area
explanation_mandarin: 负责接待来访者，处理问询等事务的场所或机构。
explanation_english: A place or area where visitors are received and inquiries are handled, often a desk or counter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺接待處登記咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 zip3 daai3 cyu3 dang1 gei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在接待处登记了。
examples.english_sentence: I registered at the reception desk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行到入面就會見到接待處㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 dou3 jap6 min6 zau6 wui5 gin3 dou2 zip3 daai3 cyu3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走到里面就会看到接待处了。
examples.english_sentence: If you walk inside, you will see the reception desk.

english_meaning: to support; to assist; to coordinate with; to give backup; to act as a contact (in espionage or illegal activities)
explanation_mandarin: 指在行动中配合、支援。
explanation_english: To support or assist someone, especially in an operation or planned activity; to coordinate with someone to provide backup or assistance. Can also refer to acting as a contact person, particularly in espionage or illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺外面接應你哋，你哋搞掂就出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ngoi6 min6 zip3 jing3 nei5 dei6, nei5 dei6 gaau2 dim6 zau6 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在外面接应你们，你们搞定了就出来。
examples.english_sentence: I'll be outside to back you up. Come out when you're done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋失手，有無人會嚟接應我哋㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 sat1 sau2, jau5 mou5 jan4 wui5 lai4 zip3 jing3 ngo5 dei6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们失手，有没有人会来接应我们啊？
examples.english_sentence: If we fail, is there anyone who will come to help us out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責喺碼頭接應走私貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu3 zaak3 hai2 maa5 tau4 zip3 jing3 zau2 si1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责在码头接应走私货。
examples.english_sentence: He's responsible for receiving the smuggled goods at the pier.

english_meaning: to take over; to take charge of; to succeed; to receive
explanation_mandarin: 接受并处理或负责某项工作、任务或权力。
explanation_english: To take over, take charge of, or succeed in handling a task, job, or power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會正式接手你嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 jing3 sik1 zip3 sau2 nei5 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会正式接手你的工作。
examples.english_sentence: I will officially take over your job tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，由佢個仔接手公司嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, jau4 keoi5 go3 zai2 zip3 sau2 gung1 si1 ge3 sang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，由他的儿子接手公司的生意。
examples.english_sentence: After his retirement, his son took over the company's business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個爛攤子邊個肯接手啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 laan6 taan1 zi2 bin1 go3 hang2 zip3 sau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个烂摊子谁肯接手啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who would be willing to take over this mess?

english_meaning: to take over; to assume control; to succeed to
explanation_mandarin: 接受並管理或控制某事物。通常指接替某人職位或管理權。
explanation_english: To take over and manage or control something. Usually refers to succeeding someone in a position or management authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，個仔就會接掌佢嘅生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, go3 zai2 zau6 wui5 zip3 zoeng2 keoi5 ge3 sang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，儿子就会接管他的生意。
examples.english_sentence: After he retires, his son will take over his business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接掌咗公司之後，進行咗好多改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 zoeng2 zo2 gung1 si1 zi1 hau6, gan2 hang4 zo2 hou2 do1 gai2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接管公司之后，进行了很多改革。
examples.english_sentence: After he took over the company, he implemented many reforms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新任總經理接掌公司大權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jam6 zung2 ging1 lei5 zip3 zoeng2 gung1 si1 daai6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新任总经理接管公司大权。
examples.english_sentence: The new general manager assumed control of the company.

english_meaning: to receive; to accept; to take over
explanation_mandarin: 接受，领受。也可以指接管，接收。
explanation_english: To receive, to accept something. It can also refer to taking over, inheriting, or gaining control of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋接收到佢哋嘅投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zip3 sau1 dou2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们接收到他们的投诉。
examples.english_sentence: We received their complaints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接收咗間公司嘅管理權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 sau1 zo2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接收了公司的管理权。
examples.english_sentence: He took over the management of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話接收唔到訊號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 zip3 sau1 m4 dou2 seon3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话接收不到信号。
examples.english_sentence: This phone can't receive a signal.

english_meaning: to take over a shift; to come on duty
explanation_mandarin: 指接替别人上班，完成该轮工作。
explanation_english: To take over someone's shift, completing the assigned work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋三點鐘接更，你準備好交更未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saam1 dim2 zung1 zip3 gang1, nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 gaau1 gang1 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们三点钟接班，你准备好交班了吗？
examples.english_sentence: We take over the shift at 3 o'clock, are you ready to hand over?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我要接更，所以唔可以同你哋出去玩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 jiu3 zip3 gang1, so2 ji5 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 dei6 cheot1 heoi3 waan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要接班，所以不可以和你们出去玩了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to take over the shift tonight, so I can't go out with you guys.

english_meaning: to replace; to succeed; to take over
explanation_mandarin: 代替别人，接替别人的工作或职位。
explanation_english: To replace someone, to take over their work or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月會接替李先生嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zip3 tai3 lei5 sin1 sang1 ge3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月会接替李先生的职位。
examples.english_sentence: He will take over Mr. Li's position next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我接替佢嚟睇住啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zip3 tai3 keoi5 lai4 tai2 zyu6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我接替他来看管这些东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm replacing him to look after these things.

english_meaning: grafting (plants); to graft
explanation_mandarin: 把一种植物的枝条或芽，接到另一种植物的茎干上，使结合在一起，成为一体生长。
explanation_english: The process of joining parts from two plants so that they grow as one. In Cantonese, it often refers to the literal act of grafting plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺好叻㗎，識得幫啲樹接枝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hou2 lek1 gaa3, sik1 dak1 bong1 di1 syu6 zip3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷很厉害，会帮树木嫁接。
examples.english_sentence: My grandpa is very good; he knows how to graft trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識接枝呀？我想學下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zip3 zi1 aa3? ngo5 soeng2 hok6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会嫁接？我想学一下。
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to graft? I want to learn.

english_meaning: to take over (a task); to receive the baton (in a relay race); to pass the torch
explanation_mandarin: 原本指接力赛跑中接棒的动作。引申为接替、继承某项工作或任务。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the action of receiving the baton in a relay race. It has been extended to mean taking over or succeeding in a job or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月就要退休喇，我會接棒做佢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 jiu3 teoi3 jau1 laa3, ngo5 wui5 zip3 paang5 zou6 keoi5 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月就要退休了，我会接替他做他的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's retiring next month, and I'll be taking over his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望下一代可以接棒，將呢啲傳統文化發揚光大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 haa6 jat1 daai6 ho2 ji5 zip3 paang5, zoeng1 ni1 di1 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 faat3 joeng4 gwong1 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望下一代可以接力，将这些传统文化发扬光大。
examples.english_sentence: Hope the next generation can take over and carry forward these traditional cultures.

english_meaning: to pick someone up at the airport; airport pickup
explanation_mandarin: 在机场迎接某人。
explanation_english: To meet and pick up someone arriving at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去機場接機呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zip3 gei1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去机场接机啊。
examples.english_sentence: I need to pick someone up at the airport tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以幫我接機呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zip3 gei1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我接机吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me pick someone up at the airport?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥今晚八點落機，我要去接機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 lok6 gei1, ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 zip3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥今晚八点下飞机，我要去接机。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother's flight arrives at eight tonight, I need to pick him up at the airport.

english_meaning: to negotiate; to get in touch with; to contact; to liaise with; to discuss terms with
explanation_mandarin: 指为了商议某事而进行接触和洽谈。
explanation_english: To contact and discuss with someone in order to negotiate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要同間公司嘅負責人接洽下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 fu3 ze2 jan4 zip3 hap6 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先和这家公司的负责人洽谈一下。
examples.english_sentence: We need to liaise with the person in charge of this company first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責接洽新嘅供應商。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 zip3 hap6 san1 ge3 gung1 jing3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责接洽新的供应商。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for contacting new suppliers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我地已經接洽咗幾間地產公司，睇下邊間最適合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zip3 hap6 zo2 gei2 gaan1 dei6 caan2 gung1 si1, tai2 haa5 bin1 gaan1 zeoi3 sik1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经洽谈了几家房地产公司，看看哪家最适合。
examples.english_sentence: We have already contacted several real estate companies to see which one is the most suitable.

english_meaning: to give financial assistance; to provide for; to relieve poverty
explanation_mandarin: 给予经济上的帮助；资助。
explanation_english: To provide financial support or assistance to someone in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企好窮，要靠親戚朋友接濟先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hou2 kung4, jiu3 kaau3 can1 cik1 pang4 jau5 zip3 zai3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家很穷，要靠亲戚朋友接济才行。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very poor and relies on financial assistance from relatives and friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺過身後，阿媽就靠我哋兄弟姐妹接濟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gwo3 san1 hau6, aa3 maa1 zau6 kaau3 ngo5 dei6 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui2 zip3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷去世后，妈妈就靠我们兄弟姐妹接济。
examples.english_sentence: After grandpa passed away, our mother relied on financial assistance from us siblings.

english_meaning: to take over a hot potato; to take over a difficult or problematic task/responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 比喻接手棘手的问题或责任，如同接住一根烫手的棍子，处理不好会烫到自己。
explanation_english: This idiom describes taking over a difficult or problematic task or responsibility. The metaphor is like receiving a hot stick - if you don't handle it carefully, you will get burned. It often implies that the person taking over the task may face criticism or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨尾先嚟走人，擺明係想我接火棒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 mei5 sin1 lai4 zau2 jan4, baai2 ming4 hai6 soeng2 ngo5 zip3 fo2 paang5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临走才离开，明显是想让我接烫手山芋啊。
examples.english_sentence: He only left at the last minute, clearly trying to pass the hot potato to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project咁多問題，邊個想接火棒呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project gam3 do1 man6 tai4, bin1 go3 soeng2 zip3 fo2 paang5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目这么多问题，谁想接烫手山芋啊？
examples.english_sentence: This project has so many problems, who wants to take on this hot potato?

english_meaning: to receive; to get
explanation_mandarin: 收到、接到（信件、通知、报告等）。
explanation_english: To receive, to get (letters, notifications, reports, etc.). It is a formal term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋琴日接獲大學嘅入學通知書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kam4 jat6 zip3 wok6 daai6 hok6 ge3 jap6 hok6 tung1 zi1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们昨天收到了大学的入学通知书。
examples.english_sentence: We received the university's admission letter yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方接獲市民嘅報案之後，立即展開調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zip3 wok6 si5 man4 ge3 bou3 on3 zi1 hau6, lap6 zik1 zin2 hoi1 diu6 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方接到市民的报案之后，立即展开调查。
examples.english_sentence: The police immediately launched an investigation after receiving the citizen's report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司接獲大量嘅投訴，反映服務質素下降。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zip3 wok6 daai6 loeng6 ge3 tau4 sou3, faan2 jing2 fuk6 mou6 zat1 so3 haa6 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司收到大量的投诉，反映服务质量下降。
examples.english_sentence: The company received a large number of complaints, reflecting a decline in service quality.

english_meaning: to succeed; to take over a position; successor
explanation_mandarin: 动词：接替别人的职位或工作。名词：接替职位的人。
explanation_english: Verb: To succeed someone in a position or job. Noun: The person who succeeds someone in a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係老細揀嘅接班人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lou5 sai3 gaan2 ge3 zip3 baan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是老板选的接班人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the successor chosen by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔終於接班，接手打理家族生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 zung1 jyu1 zip3 baan1, zip3 sau2 daa2 lei5 gaa1 zuk6 seng1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子终于接班，接手打理家族生意。
examples.english_sentence: The son finally took over, taking over the family business.

english_meaning: successor, heir, replacement
explanation_mandarin: 指继承或接替某人职位或事业的人。
explanation_english: A person who succeeds or replaces someone in a position or undertaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅接班人，好有潛力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 zip3 baan1 jan4, hou2 jau5 cim4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的接班人，很有潜力。
examples.english_sentence: He is the successor to the company and has a lot of potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔唔想做家族生意，咁就冇接班人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 m4 soeng2 zou6 gaa1 zuk6 seng1 ji3, gam2 zau6 mou5 zip3 baan1 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子不想做家族生意，这样就没有接班人了。
examples.english_sentence: The son doesn't want to do the family business, so there's no successor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搵個適合嘅接班人唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 wan2 go3 sik1 hap6 ge3 zip3 baan1 jan4 m4 jung4 yi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要找一个合适的接班人不容易。
examples.english_sentence: It is not easy to find a suitable successor.

english_meaning: to deliver a baby; midwifery
explanation_mandarin: 指帮助孕妇分娩，迎接新生命的到来。
explanation_english: Refers to assisting a pregnant woman in childbirth and welcoming the arrival of a new life; to act as a midwife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前喺鄉下幫人接生，好有經驗㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 bong1 jan4 zip3 sang1, hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前在乡下帮人接生，很有经验的。
examples.english_sentence: She used to help people deliver babies in the countryside, she is very experienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲醫院設備好完善，接生嘅過程都安全好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 ji1 jyun2 sai3 bei6 hou2 jyun4 sin6, zip3 sang1 ge3 gwo3 cing4 dou1 on1 cyun4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在医院的设备很完善，接生的过程也安全多了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, hospital equipment is very complete, and the process of delivering babies is much safer.

english_meaning: to follow, to continue, to catch
explanation_mandarin: 表示在时间、空间或动作上紧跟着前面的事物；继续。
explanation_english: Indicates that something closely follows the preceding thing in time, space, or action; to continue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講完之後，我哋接着討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 zip3 zoek6 dou2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说完之后，我们接着讨论。
examples.english_sentence: After he finished speaking, we continued the discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個波你接唔接得住啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bo1 nei5 zip3 m4 zip3 dak1 zyu6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个球你能接得住吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you catch this ball?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發完脾氣，接着就喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 jyun4 pei4 hei3, zip3 zoek6 zau6 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发完脾气，接着就哭。
examples.english_sentence: After he threw a tantrum, he started crying.

english_meaning: inoculation; vaccination
explanation_mandarin: 通过注射疫苗等方式，使人体产生对某种疾病的抵抗力。
explanation_english: To inoculate; to vaccinate. To introduce a vaccine into the body to produce immunity to a specific disease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日接種咗新冠疫苗未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 zip3 zung2 zo2 san1 gun1 jik6 miu4 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天接种新冠疫苗了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been vaccinated against COVID-19 today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府鼓勵市民接種疫苗，提高群體免疫力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gu2 lai6 si5 man4 zip3 zung2 jik6 miu4, tai4 gou1 kwan4 tai2 man5 jik6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府鼓励市民接种疫苗，提高群体免疫力。
examples.english_sentence: The government encourages citizens to get vaccinated to increase herd immunity.

english_meaning: to take over, to assume control
explanation_mandarin: 接收并管理。接手管理或控制。
explanation_english: To take over and manage something. To assume control or management of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀人收購咗，新嘅管理層會接管成間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 jan4 sau1 gau3 zo2, san1 ge3 gun2 lei5 cung4 wui2 zip3 gun2 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司被收购了，新的管理层会接管整个公司。
examples.english_sentence: The company was acquired, and the new management team will take over the whole company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細退休，個仔會接管佢盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 teoi3 jau1, go3 zai2 wui2 zip3 gun2 keoi5 pun4 seng1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板退休，他的儿子会接管他的生意。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is retiring, and his son will take over his business.

english_meaning: to accept, to adopt, to take in, to receive
explanation_mandarin: 接受别人的意见、观点、事物等。
explanation_english: To accept someone's opinion, viewpoint, or things; to adopt or take something in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要接納唔同嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zip3 naap6 m4 tung4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该接受不同的意见。
examples.english_sentence: We should accept different opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接納咗我嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 naap6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接受了我的建议。
examples.english_sentence: He accepted my suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好難接納新嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 naan4 zip3 naap6 san1 ge3 wong4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很难接纳新的员工。
examples.english_sentence: It's difficult for this company to accept new employees.

english_meaning: to transfer a call, to connect a phone line
explanation_mandarin: 指将电话转接到其他分机或连接电话线路。
explanation_english: Refers to transferring a phone call to another extension or connecting a telephone line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我接線去李先生度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 zip3 sin3 heoi3 lei5 sin1 saang1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我把电话转接到李先生那里。
examples.english_sentence: Please transfer the call to Mr. Li.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要搵人接線搞好啲網絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 jan4 zip3 sin3 gaau2 hou2 di1 mong5 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们需要找人来接线把网络弄好。
examples.english_sentence: They need to find someone to connect the cables to fix the network.

english_meaning: switchboard room; telephone exchange
explanation_mandarin: 指电话交换机所在的房间或场所。
explanation_english: Refers to a room or place where a telephone switchboard is located.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要檢查下接線室嘅防火系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gim2 caa4 haa5 zip3 sin3 sat1 ge3 fong2 fo2 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要检查一下交换机房的防火系统。
examples.english_sentence: We need to check the fire protection system in the switchboard room.

english_meaning: Telephone operator
explanation_mandarin: 指早期的电话交换机人工接线的服务员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who manually connects telephone calls at a switchboard in the early days of telephone communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲接線生好叻㗎，咩人嘅電話號碼都記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 zip3 sin3 saang1 hou2 lek1 gaa3, me1 jan4 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 dou1 gei3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的电话接线员很厉害的，什么人的电话号码都记得住。
examples.english_sentence: Telephone operators in the past were very good, they remembered everyone's phone number.

english_meaning: to continue, to go on, to proceed
explanation_mandarin: 继续，连接着进行。
explanation_english: To continue; to proceed with something after an interruption or pause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會接續討論呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zip3 zuk6 dou2 leon6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会继续讨论这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We will continue to discuss this issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議接續到聽日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui5 ji5 zip3 zuk6 dou3 ting1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议延续到明天。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting will continue until tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋接續做緊個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zip3 zuk6 zou6 gan2 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在继续做那个项目。
examples.english_sentence: They are continuing to work on that project.

english_meaning: to answer (the phone)
explanation_mandarin: 接听电话，听取对方说话。
explanation_english: To answer the phone and listen to the other party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔接聽電話，我咪打多幾次囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zip3 ting1 din6 waa2, ngo5 mai6 daa2 do1 gei2 ci3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不接电话，我就多打几次。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't answer the phone, I'll just call a few more times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開緊會，唔方便接聽電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 gan2 wui2, m4 fong1 bin6 zip3 ting1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在开会，不方便接听电话。
examples.english_sentence: He's in a meeting, so he can't answer the phone right now.

mandarin_meaning: 迎接，勾搭异性（多指男性搭讪女性）
english_meaning: 1. To pick up someone arriving by boat. 2. (Slang) To hit on, flirt with, or pick up someone (usually referring to men hitting on women).
explanation_mandarin: 1. 原义指迎接乘船而来的人。2. (俚语) 指男性主动搭讪、追求女性，试图建立恋爱关系。
explanation_english: 1. Literally means to pick up someone arriving by boat. 2. (Slang) Refers to a man actively hitting on, flirting with, or trying to pick up a woman with the intention of starting a romantic relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去碼頭接船啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 maa5 tau4 zip3 syun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去码头接船。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the pier to pick up someone arriving by boat tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧度接船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jau5 baa1 dou6 zip3 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在酒吧里搭讪女孩。
examples.english_sentence: He's always hitting on girls at the bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁心急接船啦，慢慢嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1 zip3 syun4 laa1, maan6 maan2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么着急着去搭讪，慢慢来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so eager to pick up girls, take it slow.

english_meaning: to continue; to follow; then; immediately after
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或顺序上紧跟着发生，或接在后面。
explanation_english: Indicates an event happening immediately after another in time or sequence; to follow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講完之後，接著就開始唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 zi1 hau6, zip3 zoek6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说完之后，接着就开始唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: After he finished speaking, he immediately started singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食完飯，接著去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6, zip3 zoek6 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃完饭，接着去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: After we finish eating, we'll go watch a movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗份工，接著搵過另一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, zip3 zoek6 wan2 gwo3 ling6 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞掉了工作，接着又找了另一份。
examples.english_sentence: He resigned from his job and then found another one.

english_meaning: to receive (a visitor); to grant an interview
explanation_mandarin: 会见，接受来访者。
explanation_english: To receive a visitor, to grant an audience or interview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日老細會接見個新嚟嘅經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lou5 sai3 wui5 zip3 gin3 go3 san1 lai4 ge3 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天老板会接见新来的经理。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will receive the new manager tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想請求行政長官接見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 cing2 kau4 hang4 zing3 zoeng2 gun1 zip3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想请求行政长官接见。
examples.english_sentence: They want to request an audience with the Chief Executive.

english_meaning: to contact; to touch; to be exposed to
explanation_mandarin: 指与人或事物发生联系或直接碰触。
explanation_english: To come into contact with; to touch; to be exposed to; to make contact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近接觸咗個新冠病人，要隔離觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zip3 zuk1 zo2 go3 san1 gun1 beng6 yan4, yiu3 gaak3 lei4 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近接触了一个新冠病人，需要隔离观察。
examples.english_sentence: He recently came into contact with a COVID patient and needs to be quarantined for observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔應該接觸太多電子產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 yau5 m4 ying1 goi1 zip3 zuk1 taai3 do1 din6 zi2 chan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友不应该接触太多电子产品。
examples.english_sentence: Children should not be exposed to too many electronic products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要接觸更多潛在客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 yiu3 zip3 zuk1 gang3 do1 cim4 zoi6 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要接触更多潜在客户。
examples.english_sentence: We need to contact more potential clients.

english_meaning: One after another; in quick succession; to come thick and fast
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或事件连续不断地发生。
explanation_english: Describes events or situations happening continuously and in rapid succession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從間公司出咗事之後，麻煩事就接踵而嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 chut1 zo2 si6 zi1 hau6, maa4 faan4 si6 zau6 zip3 zung2 ji4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司出了事之后，麻烦事就接连不断地来。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since the company had that incident, troubles have been coming one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試一完，慶祝嘅活動就接踵而來，真係好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 jat1 jyun4, hing3 zuk1 ge3 wut6 dung6 zau6 zip3 zung2 ji4 loi4, zan1 hai6 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试一结束，庆祝活动就接连不断地来，真是好忙。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the exams finished, the celebratory events came one after another, it's really busy.

mandarin_meaning: 接连不断地到来；一个接着一个地来
english_meaning: to come one after another; to arrive in quick succession; to follow on each other's heels
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或事物连续不断地发生或出现。
explanation_english: Describes things or events happening or appearing continuously and in quick succession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從間公司宣佈裁員之後，壞消息就接踵而至，搞到人心惶惶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 gaan1 gung1 si1 syun1 bou3 coi4 jyun4 zi1 hau6, waai6 siu2 sik1 zau6 zip3 zung2 ji4 zi3, gaau2 dou3 jan4 sam1 wong4 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从公司宣布裁员之后，坏消息就接踵而至，搞得人心惶惶。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since the company announced the layoffs, bad news has been coming one after another, making everyone uneasy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾好多party，節目接踵而至，忙到冇停手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 hou2 do1 paa1 ti1, zit3 muk6 zip3 zung2 ji4 zi3, mong4 dou3 mou5 ting4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底很多派对，节目接踵而至，忙得停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: There are many parties at the end of the year, with events following one after another, so busy that I can't stop.

mandarin_meaning: 接驳车; 迎送车辆; 赶时间搭乘顺风车
english_meaning: Shuttle bus; Connection vehicle; To catch a ride (often a quick or opportune one); To pick up someone by car; Connecting train/bus.
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指用于接驳的车辆，通常是巴士或小巴。动词：指乘坐接驳车；或是指开车去接某人；也指为了赶时间搭乘顺路的车。
explanation_english: As a noun, it refers to a shuttle bus or connecting vehicle, often a bus or minibus. As a verb, it means to take a shuttle bus, to pick someone up by car, or to catch a ride quickly, usually when running late or in a hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，求其接車走先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, kau4 kei4 zip3 ce1 zau2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，随便搭个车先走吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, I'll just catch a ride and go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有冇接車去機場呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 mou5 zip3 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有没有接驳车去机场啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is there a shuttle bus to the airport?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我陣間要去車站接車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 jiu3 heoi3 ce1 zaam6 zip3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一会儿要去车站接人。
examples.english_sentence: I need to pick someone up from the station later.

english_meaning: To connect; to integrate; to align with; to dovetail; to link up (with)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻使两者互相衔接，连接起来，使之协调一致。常用于政策、制度、标准等方面。
explanation_english: To connect or integrate, often referring to systems, policies, or standards aligning with each other. Implies a harmonization or compatibility between two things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅教育制度應該同國際接軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 jing1 goi1 tung4 gwok3 zai3 zip3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的教育制度应该和国际接轨。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's education system should align with international standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅運作方式要同國際標準接軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 wan6 zok3 fong1 sik1 jiu3 tung4 gwok3 zai3 biu1 zeon2 zip3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的运作方式要和国际标准接轨。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's operating procedures need to align with international standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新政策係為咗方便香港同內地嘅經濟接軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 hai6 wai6 zo2 fong1 bin6 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 noi6 dei6 ge3 ging1 zai3 zip3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项新政策是为了方便香港和内地的经济接轨。
examples.english_sentence: This new policy is to facilitate the economic integration of Hong Kong and the mainland.

english_meaning: to pick up and transport (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 用交通工具接人并运送他们到某个地方。
explanation_english: To pick someone up and transport them to a location using a vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要接載個客去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zip3 zoi3 go3 haak3 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去机场接送客人。
examples.english_sentence: I have to pick up a client and take them to the airport today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你接載我去火車站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 zip3 zoi3 ngo5 heoi3 fo2 ce1 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你接送我去火车站。
examples.english_sentence: Please pick me up and take me to the train station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司有車接載員工返工放工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 ce1 zip3 zoi3 waan4 gung1 faan1 gung1 fong3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有车接送员工上下班。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a car to pick up and drop off employees for work.

english_meaning: to approach; to get close to; near; similar
explanation_mandarin: 指靠近，靠近，相似。
explanation_english: Refers to approaching, getting near, or being similar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋住嘅地方接近地鐵站，好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 ge3 dei6 fong1 zip3 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6, hou2 fong1 bin6.

examples.english_sentence: The place we live in is close to the subway station, it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩隻顏色好接近，唔係好容易分得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 zek3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 zip3 gan6, m4 hai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 fan1 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种颜色很接近，不太容易分辨出来。
examples.english_sentence: These two colors are very similar, it's not easy to tell them apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅睇法同我接近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 tai2 faat3 tung4 ngo5 zip3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的看法和我接近。
examples.english_sentence: His point of view is close to mine.

english_meaning: to pick up and drop off; to shuttle
explanation_mandarin: 迎接并送往某地。
explanation_english: To pick someone up and take them to a destination; to shuttle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都要接送個仔返學放學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 zip3 sung3 go3 zai2 faan1 hok6 fong3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要接送儿子上学放学。
examples.english_sentence: I have to pick up and drop off my son from school every day.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以接送我去机场吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you pick me up and take me to the airport?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有車接送員工。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有车接送员工。
examples.english_sentence: The company provides a shuttle service for employees.

english_meaning: to connect; to get through (on the phone); to be put through
explanation_mandarin: 连接；使电话接通；得到连接。
explanation_english: To connect; to establish a connection, especially by telephone; to be put through to someone on the phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打咗好耐電話都接通唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 hou2 noi6 din6 waa2 dou1 zip3 tung1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打了很久电话都没接通。
examples.english_sentence: I've been calling for a long time but haven't been able to get through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我幫你接通佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zip3 tung1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你接通他。
examples.english_sentence: Let me put you through to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電話接通咗，但係冇人聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 waa2 zip3 tung1 zo2, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话接通了，但是没人接。
examples.english_sentence: The phone connected, but no one answered.

english_meaning: successively, one after another, continuously
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情连续不断地发生。
explanation_english: Indicates that things happen continuously and without interruption.

examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 zip3 lin4 lok6 zo2 gei2 coeng4 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天接连下了几场大雨。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, it rained heavily several times in succession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢接連考試合格，真係好叻。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司接連推出新產品，希望可以增加銷售額。

examples.english_sentence: The company has launched new products one after another, hoping to increase sales.

english_meaning: to answer the phone

explanation_english: To pick up the phone and start a conversation; to respond to a phone call.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 m4 dak1 haan4 zip3 din6 waa2, aan3 di1 fuk1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在没空接电话，晚点回复你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm busy answering the phone right now. I'll call you back later.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点接电话，可能是有紧急的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Answer the phone quickly, it might be an emergency.

english_meaning: to make contact (esp. secretly); to rendezvous; to connect; to have a secret meeting
explanation_mandarin: 指秘密地或约定好地进行联络或会面。
explanation_english: Refers to making contact or meeting, especially secretly or by prior arrangement.

examples.english_sentence: We'll make contact at the park tonight.

examples.english_sentence: Don't say so much on the phone, let's meet up and talk about it.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 dei6 hai6 mai1 jau5 bei3 mat6 zip3 tau4 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是不是有秘密接头啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are they having a secret rendezvous?

english_meaning: to connect; to transfer (transport); to link up
explanation_mandarin: 指将不同的交通工具或系统连接起来，使乘客可以顺利地从一种交通工具转移到另一种。
explanation_english: To connect or link up different modes of transportation or systems, allowing passengers to smoothly transfer from one mode to another.

examples.english_sentence: There are free shuttle buses at Hong Kong Airport to connect to different hotels.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在九龙塘站转乘东铁线。
examples.english_sentence: We need to transfer to the East Rail Line at Kowloon Tong station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新嘅渡輪服務提供接駁巴士，方便市民前往碼頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 ge3 dou6 leon4 fuk6 mou6 tai4 cung4 zip3 bok3 baa1 si2, fong1 bin6 si5 man4 cin1 wang5 maa5 tau2.

english_meaning: shuttle bus
explanation_mandarin: 指用于连接不同交通站点或线路的巴士，通常免费或低价。
explanation_english: A bus that connects different transportation points or lines, often provided free or at a low cost. A shuttle bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機場有免費嘅接駁巴去停車場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 coeng4 jau5 min5 fai3 ge3 zip3 bok3 baa1 heoi3 ting4 ce1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机场有免费的接驳巴士去停车场。
examples.english_sentence: There is a free shuttle bus from the airport to the parking lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以搭接駁巴去地鐵站。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以坐接驳巴士去地铁站。
examples.english_sentence: We can take the shuttle bus to the subway station.

english_meaning: Shuttle bus
explanation_mandarin: 一种为乘客提供短途运输服务的公共汽车，通常往返于交通枢纽（如机场、火车站）和停车场、酒店或其他特定地点之间。
explanation_english: A bus service providing short-distance transport, usually connecting transport hubs (such as airports, train stations) to car parks, hotels, or other specific locations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭接駁巴士去機場啦。

examples.english_sentence: Let's take the shuttle bus to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店有免費接駁巴士去地鐵站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 jau5 min5 fai3 zip3 bok3 baa1 si2 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店有免费的接驳巴士去地铁站。
examples.english_sentence: This hotel has a free shuttle bus to the subway station.

english_meaning: Chain game, continuation game
explanation_mandarin: 一种文字游戏，参加者轮流接续前一个人说的词语或句子，通常要求符合一定的规则，如押韵、词性一致等。
explanation_english: A type of word game where participants take turns continuing the previous person's word or sentence, usually following certain rules such as rhyming or consistent part of speech.

examples.english_sentence: During company meetings, they are always playing word chain games, which is very boring.

english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt; to boast
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粵語中，通常指炫耀、展示自己的優點或成就，帶有較為負面的意味，表示驕傲自滿，令人反感。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, it usually refers to showing off or flaunting one's advantages or achievements, often with a negative connotation, implying arrogance and causing dislike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日喺度掦佢架新跑車。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在炫耀他的新跑车。
examples.english_sentence: He shows off his new sports car every day.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么炫耀了，别人会不喜欢你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off so much, people will dislike you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到好成績就周圍掦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考到好成绩就到处炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He got good grades and showed off everywhere.

english_meaning: To control, to be obsessed with, -con (suffix indicating obsession)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指控制，但作为网络用语，常指对某事物有强烈的偏爱和迷恋，尤指对某种类型的人或事物有癖好。
explanation_english: Originally meaning 'to control', but as internet slang, it often refers to having a strong preference and obsession with something, especially a fetish or strong interest in a certain type of person or thing. As a suffix, it signifies the object of one's obsession.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个萝莉控。
examples.english_sentence: He is a Lolita complex.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢这种风格的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm obsessed with this style of clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好控住晒啲嘢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要控制所有的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't control everything.

english_meaning: to control, to regulate, control
explanation_mandarin: 掌握、支配、操纵，使其按一定方向发展或不超出一定范围。
explanation_english: To exercise restraint or direction over; dominate; command. To keep within limits; restrain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好難控制自己嘅情緒。

examples.english_sentence: The government is trying to control housing prices, but it doesn't seem to be working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要控制好自己嘅開支，唔好亂咁使錢。

examples.english_sentence: You need to control your expenses and don't spend money recklessly.

english_meaning: to accuse, to sue, to charge
explanation_mandarin: 指正式向法律机关提出诉讼，指控某人犯罪或违规。
explanation_english: To formally accuse someone of a crime or wrongdoing by filing a lawsuit or charge.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 kung3 gou3 zaa3 pin3.

examples.english_sentence: The lawyer advised me to sue the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為誹謗而俾人控吿。
