examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为诽谤而被控告。
examples.english_sentence: He was sued for defamation.

english_meaning: to accuse, to sue, to charge (in court)
explanation_mandarin: 指在法庭上正式指控某人犯了罪。
explanation_english: To formally accuse someone of a crime in a court of law; to bring a legal action against someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定控告間公司疏忽職守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 hung3 gou3 gaan1 gung1 si1 so1 fat1 zik1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定控告那家公司疏忽职守。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to sue the company for negligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人控告偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 hung3 gou3 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人控告偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of stealing.

mandarin_meaning: 掌控局面, 控制场面
english_meaning: to control the situation, to be in charge of the scene, to manage the flow
explanation_mandarin: 指在特定场合或情境中，有效地控制局面、掌握主动权，使事情按照预期的方向发展。
explanation_english: Refers to effectively controlling the situation, taking the initiative, and making things develop in the desired direction in a specific occasion or context. It implies having the ability to manage the flow of events and influence the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個會議度控場控得好好，所有人嘅注意力都喺佢身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 wui5 ji5 dou6 hung3 coeng4 hung3 dak1 ho2 ho2, so2 jau5 jan4 ge3 zyu2 yi3 lik6 dou1 hai2 keoi5 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在会议上掌控局面控制得很好，所有人的注意力都在他身上。
examples.english_sentence: He controlled the situation very well in the meeting, and everyone's attention was on him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個演唱會佢控場控到成班觀眾都好high。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 keoi5 hung3 coeng4 hung3 dou3 seng4 baan1 gun1 zung3 dou1 hou2 hai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会他控制场面，让所有的观众都很兴奋。
examples.english_sentence: He controlled the scene so well at the concert tonight that all the audience was very hyped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個辯論比賽佢控場能力好強，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 keoi5 hung3 coeng4 nang4 lik6 hou2 koeng4, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论比赛中掌控场面的能力很强，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong ability to control the scene in the debate competition and wins every time.

english_meaning: prosecution
explanation_mandarin: 法律用语，指在法庭上提出指控的一方。
explanation_english: Legal term referring to the party that brings charges in a court of law; the prosecution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 控方提出咗好多證據去證明被告有罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung3 fong1 tai4 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 zing3 geoi3 heoi3 zing3 ming4 bei6 gou3 jau5 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 控方提出了很多证据来证明被告有罪。
examples.english_sentence: The prosecution presented a lot of evidence to prove the defendant was guilty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 控方律師嘅論點好有力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung3 fong1 leot6 si1 ge3 leon6 dim2 hou2 jau5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 控方律师的论点很有力。
examples.english_sentence: The arguments of the prosecution lawyer were very powerful.

english_meaning: ball control; to control the ball (in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 在球类运动中控制球的能力或动作。
explanation_english: The ability or action of controlling the ball in ball sports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢控球技術好好，好難搶到佢嘅波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung3 kau4 gei6 seot6 hou2 hou2, hou2 naan4 cheung2 dou2 keoi5 ge3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的控球技术很好，很难抢到他的球。
examples.english_sentence: His ball control is very good; it's hard to steal the ball from him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波嘅關鍵係邊隊控球時間長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 cheung4 bo1 ge3 gwaan1 gin6 hai6 bin1 deui2 hung3 kau4 si4 gaan3 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛的关键是哪队控球时间长。
examples.english_sentence: The key to this game is which team has the most ball control time.

english_meaning: charge, accusation
explanation_mandarin: 法律用语，指控某人犯下的罪行或违法行为。
explanation_english: Legal term referring to the specific crime or offense that someone is accused of committing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面對幾項嚴重嘅控罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 deoi3 gei2 hong6 jim4 zung6 ge3 hung3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他面临几项严重的指控。
examples.english_sentence: He faces several serious charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方以盜竊罪提出控罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ji5 dou6 sit3 zeoi6 tai4 ceot1 hung3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方以盗窃罪名提出指控。
examples.english_sentence: The police filed a charge of theft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所有嘅控罪都唔成立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 jau5 ge3 hung3 zeoi6 dou1 m4 sing4 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的指控都不成立。
examples.english_sentence: All the charges are unfounded.

english_meaning: holding company, to hold shares (of a company)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过持有股份的方式来控制一个公司。作为名词时指控股公司，作为动词时指持有股份。
explanation_english: Refers to controlling a company by holding its shares. As a noun, it refers to a holding company; as a verb, it refers to holding shares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司係由一間控股公司控制嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 jau4 jat1 gaan1 hung2 gu2 gung1 si1 hung3 zai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司是由一家控股公司控制的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is controlled by a holding company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想控股嗰間新創企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 hung2 gu2 go2 gaan1 san1 cong3 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想控股那家新创企业。
examples.english_sentence: They want to hold shares in that startup.

english_meaning: Holding company
explanation_mandarin: 指通过持有其他公司的股份来控制这些公司的公司。
explanation_english: A company that controls other companies by owning their stock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間控股公司好有實力，控制住好多唔同嘅行業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hung3 gu2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 sat6 lik6, hung3 zai3 zyu6 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 hang4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家控股公司很有实力，控制着很多不同的行业。
examples.english_sentence: This holding company is very powerful and controls many different industries.

english_meaning: to accuse; to indict; accusation; indictment
explanation_mandarin: 指控告、控诉。动词时表示指控；名词时表示控告或指控的行为。
explanation_english: To accuse or indict someone, or the act of accusing. As a verb, it means to accuse; as a noun, it refers to the act of accusation or indictment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢控訴公司剝削員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung3 sou3 gung1 si1 bok1 seot3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他控诉公司剥削员工。
examples.english_sentence: He accused the company of exploiting its employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅控訴係冇根據嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hung3 sou3 hai6 mou5 gan1 geoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的控诉是没有根据的。
examples.english_sentence: Their accusations are groundless.

english_meaning: to push; to postpone; to decline; to promote (a product)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 用力向前或向外移动物体。2. 延遲，推迟。3. 拒绝，推辞。4. 推广，推销。
explanation_english: 1. To move something forward or outward with force. 2. To postpone, to put off. 3. To refuse, to decline. 4. To promote (a product).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我推唔郁佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi1 m4 juk1 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我推不动他。
examples.english_sentence: I can't push him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將個會議推遲到下個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 go3 wui5 ji5 teoi1 ci4 dou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把会议推迟到下个星期。
examples.english_sentence: We need to postpone the meeting until next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢推咗我個邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi1 zo2 ngo5 go3 yiu1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拒绝了我的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: He declined my invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想推呢隻新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 teoi1 ni1 zek3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想推广这个新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to promote this new product.

english_meaning: To make excuses, to procrastinate, to be reluctant to take on a task or responsibility, to hem and haw.
explanation_mandarin: 用各种理由推托，不肯承担责任或不愿意做某事。
explanation_english: To use various excuses to avoid taking on a responsibility or doing something, often implying a lack of willingness or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叫佢幫手搬嘢，佢就推三推四，話自己唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: giu3 keoi5 bong1 sau2 bun1 je5, keoi5 zau6 teoi1 saam1 teoi1 sei3, waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叫他帮忙搬东西，他就推三阻四，说自己没空。
examples.english_sentence: Asked him to help move things, but he just made excuses, saying he was busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好推三推四啦，呢個 project 真係好 urgent 架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi1 saam1 teoi1 sei3 laa1, ni1 go3 project zan1 hai6 hou2 urgent gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别推三阻四了，这个项目真的很紧急。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make excuses, this project is really urgent.

english_meaning: To expose to the press; to report to the media; to publicize a scandal or wrongdoing through the press
explanation_mandarin: 指将某事（通常是不光彩的事件或丑闻）公开给媒体，使其曝光。
explanation_english: Refers to exposing a matter (usually a disgraceful event or scandal) to the media, bringing it to public attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋唔道歉，我就推上報，等全香港人都知道佢哋嘅衰嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 m4 dou6 hip3, ngo5 zau6 teoi1 soeng5 bou3, dang2 cyun4 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 seoi1 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们不道歉，我就向报纸揭发，让全香港的人都知道他们的丑事！
examples.english_sentence: If they don't apologize, I'll expose them to the press so that everyone in Hong Kong knows their wrongdoings!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅黑幕太多啦，遲早有人會推上報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hak1 muk6 taai3 do1 laa3, ci4 zou2 jau5 jan4 wui5 teoi1 soeng5 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的黑幕太多了，迟早会有人揭发出来。
examples.english_sentence: There are too many shady secrets in this company, sooner or later someone will expose them to the press.

english_meaning: to recommend; recommendation
explanation_mandarin: 向他人介绍或推荐某事物、产品、服务等，使其受到重视或采纳。
explanation_english: To recommend something, such as a product, service, or person, to others; also, the act of recommending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我推介你去呢間餐廳試吓，佢哋嘅點心好好食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi1 gaai3 nei5 heoi3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 si3 haa5, keoi5 dei6 ge3 dim2 sam1 hou2 hou2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我推荐你去这家餐厅试试，他们家的点心很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I recommend you try this restaurant; their dim sum is very delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有個招聘會，佢叫我推介啲朋友去見工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 ziu1 ping3 wui2, keoi5 giu3 ngo5 teoi1 gaai3 di1 pang1 jau5 heoi3 gin3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有个招聘会，他叫我推荐一些朋友去面试。
examples.english_sentence: There's a job fair tomorrow, and he asked me to recommend some friends to go for an interview.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品好好用，我推介俾你試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 pin2 hou2 hou2 yung6, ngo5 teoi1 gaai3 bei2 nei5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品很好用，我推荐给你试试。
examples.english_sentence: This product is very useful; I recommend you give it a try.

mandarin_meaning: 推翻; 推到; 击倒; 推翻既定方案
english_meaning: to push over; to knock down; to overthrow; to overturn; to reject (a plan or idea)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是推倒某物。比喻义包括推翻、否决某个计划或方案。
explanation_english: Literally means to push something over. Figuratively, it can mean to overthrow, reject, or overturn a plan or idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想推倒呢個政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 teoi1 dou2 ni1 go3 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想推翻这个政府。
examples.english_sentence: They want to overthrow this government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個風好大，吹到啲樹都推倒晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 fung1 hou2 daai6, cheoi1 dou3 di1 syu6 dou1 teoi1 dou2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风很大，把树都吹倒了。
examples.english_sentence: The wind is very strong, it has blown all the trees over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔同意佢嘅提議，所以推倒咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 tung1 ji3 keoi5 ge3 tai4 ji5, so2 ji5 teoi1 dou2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不同意他的提议，所以否决了他。
examples.english_sentence: We didn't agree with his proposal, so we rejected it.

mandarin_meaning: 推倒重来 (tuī dǎo chóng lái)
english_meaning: to tear down and rebuild; to start over from scratch; to scrap and redo
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词短语 (dòng cí duǎn yǔ)
explanation_mandarin: 指把已经完成或进行中的事情完全废弃，重新开始。
explanation_english: Refers to completely abandoning a completed or ongoing task and starting over from the beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project 真係太差喇，不如推倒重來算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project zan1 hai6 taai3 caa1 laa3, bat1 jyu4 teoi1 dou2 cung4 loi4 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目实在太差了，不如推倒重来算了。
examples.english_sentence: This project is really bad, we might as well scrap it and start over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋之前嘅努力都白費，最後都要推倒重來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zi1 cin4 ge3 nu5 lik6 dou1 baak6 fai3, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 jiu3 teoi1 dou2 cung4 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们之前的努力都白费了，最后都要推倒重来。
examples.english_sentence: All our previous efforts were wasted, we have to start all over again in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔啱嘅話，我寧願推倒重來，都唔想錯落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 ngaam1 ge3 waa2, ngo5 ning4 jyun2 teoi1 dou2 cung4 loi4, dou1 m4 soeng2 co3 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不合适的话，我宁愿推倒重来，也不想错下去。
examples.english_sentence: If it's not right, I'd rather start over than keep making mistakes.

english_meaning: to launch, to release, to introduce, to put forward
explanation_mandarin: 把新的產品或政策等公佈、上市。
explanation_english: To launch a new product, policy, etc.; to release or introduce something new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司推出咗部新電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 bou6 san1 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司推出了一部新电话。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has launched a new phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出咗一啲新嘅環保政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 dik1 san1 ge3 waan4 bou2 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出了一些新的环保政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has launched some new environmental protection policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳推出咗個午市套餐，好抵食㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 go3 ng5 si5 tou3 caan1, hou2 dai2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅推出了午餐套餐，很划算的！
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has launched a lunch set menu, it's a good deal!

english_meaning: thrust, propulsion, pushing force
explanation_mandarin: 物理学名词，指推动物体前进的力。
explanation_english: A force that pushes an object forward; thrust, propulsion. Often used in physics and engineering contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火箭嘅推力好大，可以將佢送上太空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 zin3 ge3 teoi1 lik6 hou2 daai6, ho2 ji5 zoeng1 keoi5 sung3 soeng5 taai3 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火箭的推力很大，可以将它送上太空。
examples.english_sentence: The rocket's thrust is very strong and can send it into space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架車嘅引擎推力唔夠，爬唔到咁斜嘅山路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ge3 jing4 king4 teoi1 lik6 m4 gau3, paa4 m4 dou2 gam3 ce3 ge3 saan1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的引擎推力不够，爬不到这么陡的山路。
examples.english_sentence: This car's engine doesn't have enough thrust to climb such a steep mountain road.

english_meaning: to promote; to push forward; to advance; to propel
explanation_mandarin: 使事物向前发展或起作用。
explanation_english: To promote or advance something; to cause something to move forward or develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要推動經濟發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 teoi1 dung6 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要推动经济发展。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to promote economic development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要推動環保意識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 teoi1 dung6 waan4 bou2 ji3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要推动环保意识。
examples.english_sentence: We need to promote environmental awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢推動咗呢個項目嘅成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi1 dung6 zo2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推动了这个项目的成功。
examples.english_sentence: He promoted the success of this project.

english_meaning: driving force; impetus; motivation
explanation_mandarin: 促使事物发展、变化的力量或因素。
explanation_english: The force or factor that propels something to develop or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟發展嘅推動力嚟自創新科技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 ge3 teoi1 dung6 lik6 lai4 zi6 co3 san1 gao1 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济发展的推动力来自创新科技。
examples.english_sentence: The driving force of economic development comes from innovative technology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功嘅推動力係佢對事業嘅熱情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 ge3 teoi1 dung6 lik6 hai6 keoi5 deoi3 si6 jip6 ge3 jit6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功的推动力是他对事业的热情。
examples.english_sentence: The driving force behind his success is his passion for his career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 環保意識提高係社會進步嘅重要推動力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan4 bou2 ji3 sik1 tai4 gou1 hai6 se5 wui2 zeon3 bou6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 teoi1 dung6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 环保意识提高是社会进步的重要推动力。
examples.english_sentence: Increased environmental awareness is an important driving force for social progress.

english_meaning: to shirk (responsibility); to evade; to pass the buck; to push responsibility onto others
explanation_mandarin: 把责任推给别人。
explanation_english: To avoid responsibility by passing it on to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日推卸責任啦，自己做錯嘢就要認㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6 laa1, zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jiu3 jing6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是推卸责任，自己做错事就要承认。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always shirk responsibility, you should admit it when you do something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試圖推卸所有嘅罪責，但係最終都俾人揭穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 tou4 teoi1 se3 so2 jau5 ge3 zeoi6 zaak3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他试图推卸所有的罪责，但是最终还是被人揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to shirk all the blame, but he was eventually exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好推卸畀我呀，呢件事根本唔關我事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi1 se3 bei2 ngo5 aa3, ni1 gin6 si6 gan1 bun2 m4 gwaan1 ngo5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要推卸给我，这件事根本不关我的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push the responsibility on me, this matter has nothing to do with me.

english_meaning: to promote, to develop, to expand
explanation_mandarin: 指将某种事物或活动向更广阔的范围推广或发展。
explanation_english: To promote or develop something, spreading it to a wider scope or area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府積極推展環保政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zik1 gik1 teoi1 zin2 waan4 bou2 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府积极推广环保政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is actively promoting environmental protection policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司想推展業務去海外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 soeng2 teoi1 zin2 jip6 mou6 heoi3 hoi2 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司想把业务扩展到海外。
examples.english_sentence: Our company wants to expand our business overseas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校致力推展STEM教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 zik1 lik6 teoi1 zin2 STEM gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校致力于推广STEM教育。
examples.english_sentence: The school is dedicated to promoting STEM education.

english_meaning: to esteem; to praise highly; to hold in esteem; to revere
explanation_mandarin: 称赞和尊重；推重崇敬。
explanation_english: To highly praise and respect someone or something; to hold in high regard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好推崇佢阿爸嘅做人方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 teoi1 sung4 keoi5 aa3 baa1 ge3 zou6 jan4 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常推崇他父亲的处世方式。
examples.english_sentence: He highly esteems his father's way of conducting himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校好推崇學術自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 teoi1 sung4 hok6 seot6 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校非常推崇学术自由。
examples.english_sentence: This school highly values academic freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好推崇佢嘅音樂風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 teoi1 sung4 keoi5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 fong1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是很推崇他的音乐风格。
examples.english_sentence: I don't particularly admire his musical style.

english_meaning: to praise highly, to extol to the skies, to hold in high esteem
explanation_mandarin: 非常推崇，赞扬到极点。
explanation_english: To highly respect and praise something or someone; to extol to the highest degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對呢位科學家嘅貢獻推崇備至。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 wai2 fo1 hok6 gaa1 ge3 gung3 hiun3 teoi1 sung4 bei6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对这位科学家的贡献推崇备至。
examples.english_sentence: They hold this scientist's contribution in the highest esteem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部電影嘅評論對佢嘅演技推崇備至。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 din6 ying2 ge3 ping4 leon6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 yan2 gei6 teoi1 sung4 bei6 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影评论对他的演技推崇备至。
examples.english_sentence: The movie reviews highly praised his acting skills.

english_meaning: to put oneself in another's shoes; to empathize; to consider others' feelings as one's own
explanation_mandarin: 设身处地为别人着想。从自身体会出发，推想到别人的处境。
explanation_english: To consider others' feelings and circumstances based on one's own experiences and understanding; to show empathy and understanding towards others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人應該推己及人，唔好只係諗自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 ying1 goi1 teoi1 gei2 kap6 jan4, m4 hou2 zi2 hai6 nam2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人应该推己及人，不要只考虑自己。
examples.english_sentence: As a person, you should put yourself in other's shoes, don't just think of yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你推己及人咁諗，就會明白點解佢咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 nei5 teoi1 gei2 kap6 jan4 gam2 nam2, jau5 wui5 ming4 baak6 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你能设身处地地想，就会明白他为什么这么做。
examples.english_sentence: If you think about it empathetically, you will understand why he did that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為一個領導，要識得推己及人，先可以得到同事嘅支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 ling5 dou6, yiu3 sik1 dak1 teoi1 gei2 kap6 jan4, sin1 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 tung4 si6 ge3 zi1 chi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为一个领导，要懂得推己及人，才可以得到同事的支持。
examples.english_sentence: As a leader, you need to know how to empathize in order to get the support of your colleagues.

english_meaning: to promote, to popularize, to advocate
explanation_mandarin: 使事物、活动等普及，扩大范围，使更多人知道、了解和使用。
explanation_english: To promote or popularize something; to expand its reach and make it more widely known, understood, or used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年會大力推廣新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 wui5 daai6 lik6 teoi1 gwong2 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年会大力推广新产品。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will heavily promote the new product this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該推廣環保意識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 teoi1 gwong2 waan4 bou2 ji3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该推广环保意识。
examples.english_sentence: The government should promote environmental awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度推廣緊香港嘅旅遊業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 teoi1 gwong2 gan2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 leoi5 jau4 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在推广香港的旅游业。
examples.english_sentence: They are promoting Hong Kong's tourism industry.

english_meaning: to confide in somebody, to show one's heart and put one's guts on the table, to be open and honest
explanation_mandarin: 形容以真心待人，毫不隐瞒地表达自己的想法。
explanation_english: Describes treating someone with sincerity and expressing one's thoughts without reservation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋咁多年嘅朋友，我乜嘢都會同你推心置腹噉講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 pang4 jau5, ngo5 mat1 je5 dou1 wui5 tung4 nei5 teoi1 sam1 zi3 fuk1 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这么多年的朋友，我什么都会跟你推心置腹地说。
examples.english_sentence: We've been friends for so many years, I'll tell you everything openly and honestly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我推心置腹，乜秘密都肯同我分享。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 teoi1 sam1 zi3 fuk1, mat1 bei3 mat6 dou1 hang2 tung4 ngo5 fan1 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我很推心置腹，什么秘密都肯跟我分享。
examples.english_sentence: He confides in me a lot, willing to share all his secrets with me.

english_meaning: Tui Na (Chinese therapeutic massage)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中医的治疗方法，通过手法按摩人体穴位和经络，以达到舒筋活络、调理气血的目的。
explanation_english: Tui Na is a form of Chinese therapeutic massage, used to stimulate acupoints and meridians in the body to promote blood circulation, relax muscles and tendons, and regulate qi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我膊頭好攰，不如去按摩推拿下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bok3 tau4 hou2 gui6, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 on3 mo1 teoi1 naa4 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的肩膀很累，不如去按摩推拿一下。
examples.english_sentence: My shoulders are very tired, how about going for a massage and Tui Na?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間推拿舖嘅師傅手勢好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 teoi1 naa4 pou3 ge3 si1 fu2 sau2 sai3 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家推拿店的师傅手艺很好。
examples.english_sentence: The masseur at this Tui Na shop is very skilled.

english_meaning: to shirk (responsibility), to excuse oneself, to evade, to decline (an invitation)
explanation_mandarin: 用借口拒绝或回避承担责任、义务或邀请。
explanation_english: To avoid or refuse to accept responsibility, obligation, or an invitation by offering excuses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再推搪啦，幫手做埋佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 teoi1 tong4 laa1, bong1 sau2 zou6 maai4 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再推脱了，帮忙做完它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shirk anymore, just help finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次叫佢幫手，佢都推搪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 giu3 keoi5 bong1 sau2, keoi5 dou1 teoi1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次叫他帮忙，他都推辞。
examples.english_sentence: Every time he's asked to help, he always evades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好推搪責任呀，做錯嘢要認㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi1 tong4 zaak3 jam3 aa3, zou6 co3 je5 jiu3 jing6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要推卸责任啊，做错事要承认的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't evade responsibility, you have to admit when you've done something wrong.

english_meaning: to push and shove, to jostle, to bump into
explanation_mandarin: 用手或身体推挤碰撞。
explanation_english: To push and shove someone or something; to jostle or bump into things, often unintentionally or in a crowded situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好推撞呀，一個個嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi1 zong6 aa3, jat1 go3 go3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要推搡呀，一个一个来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push and shove, come one by one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅時候，觀眾不停咁推撞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6, gun1 zung3 bat1 ting4 gam2 teoi1 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的时候，观众不停地推搡。
examples.english_sentence: During the concert, the audience kept pushing and shoving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺地鐵站入面，啲人推撞得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 jap6 min6, di1 jan4 teoi1 zong6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在地铁站里面，人们推搡得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: In the subway station, people are pushing and shoving each other very intensely.

english_meaning: to deliberate; to consider carefully; to weigh; to polish (writing)
explanation_mandarin: 指反复琢磨，仔细斟酌字句。
explanation_english: To carefully consider and refine something, especially writing; to deliberate over the exact wording or details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇嘢寫得唔好，要好好推敲下先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 je5 se2 dak1 m4 hou2, jiu3 hou2 hou2 teoi1 haau1 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章写得不好，需要好好推敲一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This article is poorly written; it needs to be carefully considered and revised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間去推敲呢個計劃嘅細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 teoi1 haau1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间去推敲这个计划的细节。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time deliberating over the details of this plan.

english_meaning: to infer, to deduce, to conclude
explanation_mandarin: 根据已有的事实或证据，推论出结论。
explanation_english: To infer or deduce a conclusion based on existing facts or evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我推斷佢琴日冇返工，因為佢冇覆我嘅訊息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi1 dyun3 keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 mou5 fuk1 ngo5 ge3 seon3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我推断他昨天没上班，因为他没有回复我的信息。
examples.english_sentence: I infer that he didn't go to work yesterday because he didn't reply to my messages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過詳細嘅調查，我哋推斷到佢係犯人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 siu2 sai3 ge3 diu6 caa4, ngo5 dei6 teoi1 dyun3 dou3 keoi5 hai6 faan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过详细的调查，我们推断出他是犯人。
examples.english_sentence: After a detailed investigation, we deduced that he was the criminal.

english_meaning: massage (often with oil); euphemism for prostitution
explanation_mandarin: 本意是指按摩，使用精油或润滑油进行推拿。但在某些语境下，也可能作为性服务的委婉语。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to push oil' or massage with oil. It can refer to a regular massage. However, it is often used as a euphemism for prostitution involving massage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日去做咗個推油，舒服曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zou6 zo2 go3 teoi1 jau4, syu1 fuk6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天去做了一个按摩，舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: I went for a massage yesterday, it felt so much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想去泰國推油鬆一鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 heoi3 taai3 gwok3 teoi1 jau4 sung1 jat1 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想去泰国按摩放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to go to Thailand for a massage to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易信人哋講嘅嘢，小心佢哋係啲搞推油嘅場所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 yan4 dei6 gong2 ge3 ye5, siu2 sam1 keoi5 dei6 hai6 di1 gaau2 teoi1 jau4 ge3 coeng4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易相信别人说的话，小心他们是那些搞色情按摩的场所。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what people say so easily, be careful they might be talking about places that offer prostitution.

english_meaning: to add fuel to the fire; to push the boat out; to abet or instigate something undesirable
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从旁鼓动、助长事态的发展（多指向不好的方面）。
explanation_english: To push the waves and help the currents; to encourage or worsen a situation, often in a negative way; to add fuel to the fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本身都已經好嬲，你仲要喺度推波助瀾，咪盞激嬲佢囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 san1 dou1 ji5 ging1 hou2 nau1, nei5 zung6 jiu3 hai2 dou6 teoi1 bo1 zo6 laan4, mai1 zaan2 gik1 nau1 keoi5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来就很生气了，你还要在这里推波助澜，不是更惹他生气吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's already very angry, why are you adding fuel to the fire? You'll just make him even angrier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳媒嘅報導有時會推波助瀾，令到社會更加不安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 mui4 ge3 bou3 dou6 jau5 si4 wui2 teoi1 bo1 zo6 laan4, ling6 dou3 se5 wui2 gaang3 gaa1 bat1 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体的报道有时候会推波助澜，使得社会更加不安。
examples.english_sentence: The media's reports sometimes add fuel to the fire, making society even more uneasy.

synonyms: 火上加油 (fo2 soeng5 gaa1 jau4)
煽風點火 (sin3 fung1 dim2 fo2)

english_meaning: to speculate; to conjecture; to surmise; to guess
explanation_mandarin: 根据已知的情况，对未知的情况进行推断和猜测。
explanation_english: To make an educated guess based on available information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我推測佢聽日唔會返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi1 caak1 keoi5 ting1 jat6 m4 wui5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我推测他明天不会上班。
examples.english_sentence: I speculate that he won't be at work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係我嘅推測，唔一定啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 teoi1 caak1, m4 jat1 ding6 ngaam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是我的推测，不一定对。
examples.english_sentence: This is just my speculation, it might not be right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係識得推測，試下搵證據證明你嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 teoi1 caak1, si3 haa5 wan2 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只会推测，试着找证据证明你的看法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just speculate, try to find evidence to prove your point of view.

english_meaning: To shirk responsibility; to pass the buck; to make excuses
explanation_mandarin: 指逃避责任，将责任推给他人；找借口搪塞。
explanation_english: Refers to avoiding responsibility and passing it on to others; making excuses to evade responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日推牆啦，自己做錯嘢要認㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 teoi1 coeng4 laa1, zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 je5 jiu3 jing6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是推卸责任了，自己做错事要承认。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always shirk responsibility, you have to admit when you've done something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢就推牆，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 zau6 teoi1 coeng4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事就推卸责任，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always shirks responsibility when he does something wrong, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好推牆話係我嘅錯，明明係你冇講清楚！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teoi1 coeng4 waa6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3, ming4 ming4 hai6 nei5 mou5 gong2 cing1 chu2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别推卸责任说是我的错，明明是你没说清楚！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pass the buck and say it's my fault, it's clearly because you didn't explain it clearly!

english_meaning: reasoning; deduction; inference
explanation_mandarin: 根据已知的事实或证据，推断出未知的结论。
explanation_english: The process of drawing a conclusion from known facts or evidence; the act of reasoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻推理，成日都估中兇手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 teoi1 lei2, seng4 jat6 dou1 gu2 zung3 hung1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长推理，总是猜中凶手。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at reasoning; he always guesses the murderer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔嘅推理好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 teoi1 lei2 hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的推理非常精彩。
examples.english_sentence: The reasoning in this story is brilliant.

english_meaning: to calculate; to estimate; to infer; to deduce
explanation_mandarin: 根据已知的资料进行计算或推理，以估计或预测未来或未知的情况。
explanation_english: To calculate or deduce based on known information to estimate or predict future or unknown situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以根據現時嘅數據推算下個月嘅銷售額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 gan1 geoi3 hin6 si4 ge3 sou3 geoi3 teoi1 syun3 haa5 go3 jyut6 ge3 siu1 sau6 ngaak2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以根据现在的數據推算下个月的销售额。
examples.english_sentence: We can estimate next month's sales based on the current data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢推算今年經濟增長會放緩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi1 syun3 gam1 nin4 ging1 zai3 zang1 zoeng2 wui5 fong3 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推算今年经济增长会放缓。
examples.english_sentence: He estimated that economic growth would slow down this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生推算佢大概仲有三個月命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 teoi1 syun3 keoi5 daai6 koi3 zung6 jau5 saam1 go3 jyut6 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生推算他大概还有三个月生命。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor estimates he has about three months left to live.

english_meaning: to overthrow, to overturn, to refute, to subvert, to reject
explanation_mandarin: 颠覆，使原来的事物倒塌、无效；反驳，否定。
explanation_english: To overthrow a system, government, or idea; to refute or disprove something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想推翻個政府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 teoi1 faan1 go3 zing3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想推翻那个政府。
examples.english_sentence: They want to overthrow the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅論點俾人推翻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 leon6 dim2 bei2 jan4 teoi1 faan1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的论点被人推翻了。
examples.english_sentence: His argument was refuted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔同意，我要推翻你嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 tung1 ji3, ngo5 jiu3 teoi1 faan1 nei5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不同意，我要推翻你的决定。
examples.english_sentence: I disagree, I want to overturn your decision.

english_meaning: to promote it further; to generalize it; to apply it more widely; to extrapolate
explanation_mandarin: 把某种方法、经验或理论推广到更大的范围或更多的方面。
explanation_english: To extend a method, experience, or theory to a wider range or more aspects; to generalize or extrapolate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法喺呢間分公司做得幾好，我哋可以推而廣之，喺晒所有分公司度試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hai2 ni1 gaan1 fan1 gung1 si1 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 teoi1 ji4 gwong2 zi1, hai2 saai3 so2 jau5 fan1 gung1 si1 dou6 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法在这家分公司做得很好，我们可以推而广之，在所有分公司都试一下。
examples.english_sentence: This method works quite well in this branch office, we can generalize it and try it in all the branch offices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果成功咗，噉呢個經驗就可以推而廣之，幫到更加多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 sing4 gung1 zo2, daam2 ni1 go3 ging1 jim6 zau6 ho2 ji5 teoi1 ji4 gwong2 zi1, bong1 dou2 gang3 gaa1 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果成功了，那么这个经验就可以推而广之，帮助更多的人。
examples.english_sentence: If it's successful, then this experience can be extrapolated to help more people.

english_meaning: to nominate, to recommend, to elect
explanation_mandarin: 推荐并选举某人担任某个职位。
explanation_english: To recommend and elect someone to a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋推舉佢做班長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 teoi1 geoi2 keoi5 zou6 baan1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们推选他当班长。
examples.english_sentence: We nominate him to be the class monitor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事會一致推舉佢做新嘅主席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung2 si6 wui2 jat1 zi3 teoi1 geoi2 keoi5 zou6 san1 ge3 zyu2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事会一致推选他做新的主席。
examples.english_sentence: The board of directors unanimously elected him as the new chairman.

english_meaning: to pass the buck, to shirk responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 比喻推卸责任，将原本应该自己承担的责任推给别人。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to shirk responsibility; to push one's own responsibility onto someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日推莊啦，呢件事係你負責嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 teoi1 zong1 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 nei5 fu6 zaak3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是推卸责任，这件事是你负责的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pass the buck, you're responsible for this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢又想推莊俾同事，真係唔得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5 jau6 soeng2 teoi1 zong1 bei2 tung4 si6, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事又想把责任推给同事，真是不行。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake and wants to pass the buck to his colleague, it's really unacceptable.

english_meaning: to recommend; recommendation
explanation_mandarin: 介绍好的，希望别人接受。
explanation_english: To suggest someone or something as suitable for a particular purpose or job; to recommend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我推薦你睇呢套戲，好好睇㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teoi1 zin3 nei5 tai2 ni1 tou3 hei3, hou2 hou2 tai2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我推荐你看这部电影，很好看！
examples.english_sentence: I recommend you watch this movie, it's very good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋推薦我入呢間公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 teoi1 zin3 ngo5 jap6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们推荐我来这家公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: They recommended me to work in this company.

english_meaning: to implement, to carry out, to put into practice
explanation_mandarin: 实行，推動實施。
explanation_english: To put (a plan, policy, etc.) into practice; to implement; to carry out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃推行新嘅教育政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 teoi1 hang4 san1 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划推行新的教育政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to implement a new education policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司會推行一個新嘅銷售策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 wui5 teoi1 hang4 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 siu1 sau6 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司将会推行一个新的销售策略。
examples.english_sentence: Our company will implement a new sales strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 推行環保措施對保護地球好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi1 hang4 waan4 bou2 cou3 si1 deoi3 bou2 wu6 dei6 kau4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 推行环保措施对保护地球非常重要。
examples.english_sentence: Implementing environmental protection measures is very important for protecting the Earth.

english_meaning: inference, deduce, reasoning, deduction
explanation_mandarin: 根据已知的条件或事实，通过逻辑思维得出结论的过程或结果。
explanation_english: The process or result of deriving a conclusion from known facts or evidence through logical reasoning; an inference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以從呢啲證據推論到佢係兇手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 cung4 ni1 di1 zing3 geoi3 teoi1 leon6 dou3 keoi5 hai6 hung1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以从这些证据推论到他是凶手。
examples.english_sentence: We can infer from this evidence that he is the murderer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅推論好合理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 teoi1 leon6 hou2 ho2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的推论很合理。
examples.english_sentence: Your reasoning is very reasonable.

english_meaning: Push a cart; shopping cart; to push a vehicle that has broken down
explanation_mandarin: 本意指推动车辆，通常指购物车。也指推动坏掉的车。
explanation_english: Literally means to push a vehicle, usually referring to a shopping cart. It can also refer to pushing a broken-down vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去超市推車買嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 siu2 si5 teoi1 ce1 maai5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去超市推购物车买东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the supermarket to push a shopping cart and buy things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車壞咗，要推車先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 teoi1 ce1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车坏了，需要推车才行。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down, we need to push it.

english_meaning: to decline (an appointment, invitation etc.); to refuse
explanation_mandarin: 婉拒、拒绝接受。
explanation_english: To politely refuse or decline an offer, invitation, appointment, or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢推辭咗個宴會嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi1 ci4 zo2 go3 yin3 wui2 ge3 yiu1 ching2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推辞了宴会的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: He declined the invitation to the banquet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我今日好忙，要推辭你嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 mong4, jiu3 teoi1 ci4 nei5 ge3 yiu1 ching2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今天很忙，要推辞你的邀请。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm very busy today, I have to decline your invitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢推辭咗升職嘅機會，因為佢想多啲時間陪屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi1 ci4 zo2 sing1 jik1 ge3 gei1 wui6, yan1 wai6 keoi5 soeng2 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 pui4 uk1 kei2 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推辞了升职的机会，因为他想多点时间陪家人。
examples.english_sentence: He declined the promotion opportunity because he wanted to spend more time with his family.

english_meaning: to promote, to advance, to push forward
explanation_mandarin: 推动事物向前发展。
explanation_english: To push forward, promote, or advance a cause, plan, or project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該要推進環保政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 jiu3 teoi1 zeon3 waan4 bou2 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该要推进环保政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government should promote environmental protection policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要推進呢個項目嘅進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 teoi1 zeon3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要推进这个项目的进度。
examples.english_sentence: We need to advance the progress of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗經濟發展，政府決定推進基建工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2, zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 teoi1 zeon3 gei1 gin3 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了经济发展，政府决定推进基础设施建设工程。
examples.english_sentence: For economic development, the government decided to promote infrastructure construction projects.

english_meaning: to postpone, to defer, to put off
explanation_mandarin: 将原定的时间延后。
explanation_english: To delay or postpone something to a later time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議要推遲到下個禮拜先開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui5 ji5 jiu3 teoi1 ci4 dou3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 sin1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议要推迟到下个星期才开。
examples.english_sentence: The meeting will be postponed until next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為打風，所以啲航班推遲咗起飛時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 daa2 fung1, so2 ji5 di1 hong4 baan1 teoi1 ci4 zo2 hei2 fei1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为台风，所以一些航班推迟了起飞时间。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the typhoon, some flights have had their departure times delayed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅約會可能要推遲啦，我今日有啲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 joek3 wui2 ho2 nang4 jiu3 teoi1 ci4 laa1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的约会可能要推迟了，我今天有点不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Our appointment might have to be postponed, I'm feeling a bit unwell today.

english_meaning: to elect, to nominate, to choose by vote
explanation_mandarin: 通过推举或选举的方式选出。
explanation_english: To choose someone by nomination or election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要推選新嘅班長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 teoi1 syun2 san1 ge3 baan1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天需要推选新的班长。
examples.english_sentence: We need to elect a new class monitor today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋推選咗佢做主席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 teoi1 syun2 zo2 keoi5 zou6 zyu2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们推选了他做主席。
examples.english_sentence: They elected him as the chairman.

english_meaning: Coin pusher machine
explanation_mandarin: 一种投币游戏机，通过推动平台将硬币推出，玩家获得推出的硬币。
explanation_english: A coin pusher machine is a type of arcade game where coins are dropped into a machine in the hope that they will push other coins forward and off the edge, allowing the player to collect them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日去機鋪玩推銀機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gei1 pou3 waan2 teoi1 ngan4 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常去游戏厅玩推币机。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to the arcade to play coin pusher machines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間遊戲機中心執咗笠，啲推銀機都唔見晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 jau4 hei3 gei1 zung1 sam1 zap1 zo2 lap1, di1 teoi1 ngan4 gei1 dou1 m4 gin3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 游戏机中心倒闭了，那些推币机都不见了。
examples.english_sentence: The arcade went out of business, and all the coin pusher machines are gone.

english_meaning: to promote (a product); to market; to sell
explanation_mandarin: 推广销售商品或服务。
explanation_english: To actively promote and sell products or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司成日打電話嚟推銷保險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4 teoi1 siu1 bou2 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司总是打电话来推销保险。
examples.english_sentence: Their company always calls to promote insurance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭啲職員好落力推銷佢哋嘅產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 di1 zik1 jyun4 hou2 lok6 lik6 teoi1 siu1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的员工很努力推销他们的产品。
examples.english_sentence: The staff in this shop are working hard to promote their products.

english_meaning: salesperson, salesman, saleswoman
explanation_mandarin: 指从事推销工作的人员。
explanation_english: A person whose job is to sell products or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個好勤力嘅推銷員，成日都跑數跑到盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 kan4 lik6 ge3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4, seng4 jat6 dou1 paau2 sou3 paau2 dou3 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个很勤奋的推销员，总是努力完成销售目标。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very diligent salesperson, always working hard to meet his sales target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意啲推銷員成日打電話嚟煩住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 seng4 jat6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4 faan4 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢那些推销员总是打电话来烦我。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like those salespeople who always call to bother me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個推銷員好識氹人，講到隻錶好好咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4 hou2 sik1 tum2 yan4, gong2 dou3 zek3 biu1 hou2 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个推销员很会哄人，把那只手表说得很好。
examples.english_sentence: That salesperson is good at sweet-talking people, making that watch sound excellent.

english_meaning: Slot machine
explanation_mandarin: 一种赌博机器，通过投入硬币或代币，然后拉动杠杆或按下按钮来启动机器，期望获得奖金。通常指老虎机。
explanation_english: A gambling machine that is operated by inserting coins or tokens and then pulling a handle or pushing a button, hoping to win a prize. Commonly refers to a slot machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去賭場玩推錢機，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 dou2 coeng4 waan2 teoi1 cin2 gei1, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去赌场玩老虎机，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the casino to play slot machines and has lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好沉迷推錢機啊，好易輸身家㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cam4 mai4 teoi1 cin2 gei1 aa3, hou2 ji6 syu1 san1 ga1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要沉迷老虎机啊，很容易输掉全部家当的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't get addicted to slot machines, it's easy to lose all your wealth!

english_meaning: to weed through the old to bring forth the new; to innovate; to introduce new ideas on the basis of the old
explanation_mandarin: 去除旧的，创造新的。指对旧的事物进行批判地继承，并在继承的基础上加以创新。
explanation_english: To discard the old and bring forth the new; to get rid of the stale and bring forth the fresh. It refers to critically inheriting old things and innovating on the basis of inheritance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳推陳出新，成日都出啲新菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 teoi1 can4 ceot1 san1, seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 di1 san1 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅推陈出新，总是推出新的菜式。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant innovates constantly, always introducing new dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要令到傳統文化有活力，就要推陳出新，唔可以一成不變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 ling6 dou3 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 jau5 wut6 lik6, zau6 jiu3 teoi1 can4 ceot1 san1, m4 ho2 ji5 sing4 bat1 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要使传统文化有活力，就要推陈出新，不可以一成不变。
examples.english_sentence: To make traditional culture vibrant, we must innovate and not remain unchanged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅設計，年年都推陳出新，所以好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 cit3 gai3, nin4 nin4 dou1 teoi1 can4 ceot1 san1, so2 ji5 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的设计，年年都推陈出新，所以很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's designs innovate every year, so they are very popular.

english_meaning: To roll dice; to shirk responsibility; to pass the buck
explanation_mandarin: 1. 实际掷骰子。2. 比喻推卸责任。
explanation_english: 1. Literally, to roll dice. 2. Figuratively, to shirk responsibility or pass the buck to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日推骰啦，做錯嘢就認咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 teoi1 sik1 laa1, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jing6 zo2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是推卸责任了，做错了事就承认了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pass the buck, admit it if you made a mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗錢，就話係個骰仔唔好，根本就係推骰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 cin2, zau6 waa6 hai6 go3 sik1 zai2 m4 hou2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 teoi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了钱，就说是骰子不好，根本就是推卸责任。
examples.english_sentence: He lost money and blamed the dice, he's just shirking responsibility.

english_meaning: to cover; to close; to hide; to shut
explanation_mandarin: 用东西盖住或遮蔽；关闭（门窗等）；隐瞒或掩盖。
explanation_english: To cover something with something else; to close (a door or window); to conceal or hide something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掩住你把口！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim2 zyu6 nei5 baa2 hau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 闭上你的嘴！
examples.english_sentence: Shut your mouth!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掩住啲新聞真相啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jim2 zyu6 di1 san1 man4 zan1 soeng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要掩盖新闻真相了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cover up the truth of the news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 掩埋好啲垃圾先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jim2 maai4 hou2 di1 laap6 saap3 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 埋好垃圾再走。
examples.english_sentence: Bury the trash properly before leaving.

english_meaning: to deceive people; to pull the wool over someone's eyes; to cover up
explanation_mandarin: 指用假象来迷惑、欺骗人，使人弄不清真相。
explanation_english: To deceive people by covering up the truth with a false appearance; to hide something from public attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做只係想掩人耳目，實情係佢根本唔想解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 zi2 hai6 soeng2 jim2 jan4 ji5 muk6, sat6 cing4 hai6 keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 soeng2 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做只是想掩人耳目，实际上他根本不想解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: He's only doing this to deceive people, the truth is he doesn't want to solve the problem at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用好多花招去掩人耳目，唔想俾人發現佢哋嘅財政問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yung6 hou2 do1 faa1 ziu1 heoi3 jim2 jan4 ji5 muk6, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 coi4 zing3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司用了很多花招去掩人耳目，不想被人发现他们的财政问题。
examples.english_sentence: The company is using a lot of tricks to deceive people, not wanting people to discover their financial problems.

synonyms: 瞞天過海 (mun4 tin1 gwo3 hoi2)

english_meaning: hush money; bribe to keep someone silent
explanation_mandarin: 为了让某人保守秘密或不揭发不当行为而给予的钱财。
explanation_english: Money paid to someone to keep a secret or to prevent them from disclosing information about wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收咗老細嘅掩口費，所以乜都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 zo2 lou5 sai3 ge3 jim2 hau2 fai3, so2 ji5 mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收了老板的封口费，所以什么都不敢说。
examples.english_sentence: He received hush money from the boss, so he doesn't dare to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司為咗遮醜，俾咗好多掩口費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 ze1 cau2, bei2 zo2 hou2 do1 jim2 hau2 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司为了掩盖丑闻，给了很多封口费。
examples.english_sentence: That company paid a lot of hush money to cover up the scandal.

english_meaning: secretive, furtive, sneaky, doing things behind someone's back
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为不光明正大，偷偷摸摸的样子。指某人试图隐藏或掩盖某些事情，让人感到不坦率。
explanation_english: Describes someone's behavior as not being open and aboveboard, acting secretively or furtively. Refers to someone trying to hide or cover up something, giving the impression of dishonesty or lack of transparency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掩掩抰抰咁，唔知搞咩鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 yim2 yim2 jong2 jong2 gam2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是遮遮掩掩的，不知道在搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being so secretive, I wonder what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掩掩抰抰啦，有咩嘢咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yim2 yim2 jong2 jong2 laa1, jau5 mat1 je5 mai5 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要遮遮掩掩了，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so secretive, just say what you have to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鐘意佢做嘢掩掩抰抰，好似有嘢瞞住我哋咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 zou6 je5 yim2 yim2 jong2 jong2, hou2 ci5 jau5 je5 mun4 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢他做事遮遮掩掩，好像有什么瞒着我们似的。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like the way he does things so secretively, it's like he's hiding something from us.

english_meaning: Secretive, attempting to conceal something but doing it badly; trying to hide something in a clumsy manner, making it even more obvious.
explanation_mandarin: 形容试图掩盖或隐藏某事，但行为笨拙，反而更加暴露。
explanation_english: Describes someone trying to hide or conceal something but doing so in a clumsy way that makes it even more obvious. Implies a lack of skill in deception.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明偷食咗嘢，但係又掩掩揚揚咁，一睇就知佢講大話啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 tau1 sik6 zo2 ye5, daan6 hai6 jau6 yim2 yim2 yeung4 yeung4 gam2, jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明偷吃了东西，但是又遮遮掩掩的，一看就知道他在说谎。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly snuck some food, but he's being all secretive about it, you can tell right away he's lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁大鑊，唔好再掩掩揚揚啦，不如直接講清楚好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, m4 hou2 zoi3 yim2 yim2 yeung4 yeung4 laa1, bat1 jyu4 zik6 zip3 gong2 cing1 co2 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情这么严重，不要再遮遮掩掩了，不如直接说清楚更好。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so serious, don't be secretive anymore, it's better to just explain it clearly.

english_meaning: a smokescreen; a deceptive trick; sleight of hand; misdirection
explanation_mandarin: 指用某种手段迷惑、欺骗别人，使人看不到真相。
explanation_english: Refers to a method or trick used to deceive or mislead others, preventing them from seeing the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲掩眼法嚟呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 yung6 di1 jim2 ngaan5 faat3 lai4 aak1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常用一些障眼法来骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He often uses deceptive tricks to cheat people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個只係啲商家嘅掩眼法，唔好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 di1 seung1 gaa1 ge3 jim2 ngaan5 faat3, m4 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只是商家的一种障眼法，不要相信。
examples.english_sentence: This is just a smokescreen by the merchants, don't believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢做嘅嘢好勁，好多都係掩眼法嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 zou6 ge3 ye5 hou2 ging6, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 jim2 ngaan5 faat3 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为他做的事情很厉害，很多都是障眼法而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think what he does is impressive, a lot of it is just a smokescreen.

mandarin_meaning: 掩耳盗铃 (yǎn ěr dào líng)
english_meaning: To deceive oneself; to bury one's head in the sand; to delude oneself; to try to hide something from others while making it obvious to everyone else.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻自欺欺人，明明掩盖不住的事情偏要想法子掩盖。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes someone who deceives themselves by trying to hide something that is obvious to everyone else. It's about foolishly thinking you can hide something simply by ignoring it or preventing yourself from perceiving it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估淨係唔睇新聞就當件事冇發生過？簡直係掩耳盜鈴！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 zing6 hai6 m4 tai2 san1 man4 zau6 dong3 gin6 si6 mou5 faat3 sang1 gwo3? gaan2 zik6 hai6 jim2 ji5 dou6 ling4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为不看新闻就当这件事没发生过？简直是掩耳盗铃！
examples.english_sentence: Do you think that just by not watching the news, you can pretend it never happened? That's just burying your head in the sand!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明肥到著唔落條褲，但係日日都話自己瘦咗，根本就係掩耳盜鈴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 fei4 dou3 zoek3 m4 lok6 tiu4 fu3, daan6 hai6 jat1 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 sau3 zo2, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 jim2 ji5 dou6 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明胖得穿不下那条裤子，但是天天都说自己瘦了，根本就是掩耳盗铃。
examples.english_sentence: He's obviously too fat to fit in those pants, but he keeps saying he's lost weight; that's just deceiving himself.

synonyms: 自欺欺人 (zi6 hei1 hei1 jan4)
駝鳥政策 (to4 niu5 zing3 caak3)

english_meaning: to cover up; to conceal; to hide
explanation_mandarin: 遮盖，隐藏，使不暴露出来。
explanation_english: To cover up or conceal something; to prevent it from being discovered or revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想掩蓋真相，但係最後都俾人揭穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jim2 goi3 zan1 soeng3, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掩盖真相，但是最后还是被人揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to cover up the truth, but in the end, he was exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好試圖掩蓋你嘅錯誤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 si3 tou4 jim2 goi3 nei5 ge3 co3 ng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要试图掩盖你的错误。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to cover up your mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔可以掩蓋落去，一定要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ho2 ji5 jim2 goi3 lok6 heoi3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 caa4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不能掩盖下去，一定要调查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This matter cannot be covered up; it must be thoroughly investigated.

english_meaning: cover; shield; protect; provide cover fire
explanation_mandarin: 遮掩；保护；提供火力支援。
explanation_english: To cover, shield, or protect someone or something. It can also mean to provide covering fire, especially in a military or competitive context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我掩護你走先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jim2 wu6 nei5 zau2 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我掩护你先走！
examples.english_sentence: I'll cover you, you go first!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用啲假資料嚟掩護自己嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 di1 ga2 zi1 liu2 lai4 jim2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用一些假资料来掩盖自己的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: He used some false information to cover up his crimes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要有人掩護我哋過條街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 yau5 jan4 jim2 wu6 ngo5 dei6 gwo3 tiu4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要有人掩护我们过马路。
examples.english_sentence: We need someone to cover us while we cross the street.

english_meaning: to close the door; to shut the door
explanation_mandarin: 关闭门，合上门。
explanation_english: To close or shut a door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得出門口要掩門呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 jiu3 jim2 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得出门要关门啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to close the door when you leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太大力掩門，嘈醒咗BB。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 daai6 lik6 jim2 mun4, cou4 sing2 zo2 bi1 bi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太用力关门了，吵醒了宝宝。
examples.english_sentence: He slammed the door shut, waking up the baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫手掩埋道門啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 sau2 jim2 maai4 dou6 mun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦帮我关上这扇门吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me close this door.

english_meaning: to cover up, to conceal, to gloss over
explanation_mandarin: 遮盖事实真相，使人不了解实情。
explanation_english: To hide or conceal facts, truths, or feelings; to present something in a way that obscures the reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都掩飾自己嘅缺點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 jim2 sik1 zi6 gei2 ge3 kyut3 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是掩饰自己的缺点。
examples.english_sentence: He always covers up his shortcomings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使掩飾啦，我知你唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 jim2 sik1 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用掩饰了，我知道你不开心。
examples.english_sentence: There's no need to cover it up, I know you're not happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢試圖掩飾佢嘅驚慌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si3 tou4 jim2 sik1 keoi5 ge3 ging1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他试图掩饰他的惊慌。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to conceal his panic.

english_meaning: Shelter, Cover, Bunker
explanation_mandarin: 指可以遮蔽身体，防御子弹、炮火等攻击的构筑物。
explanation_english: A structure that provides protection from bullets, artillery fire, etc.; shelter or cover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搵個掩體避下啲雨啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 go3 jim2 tai2 bei6 haa5 di1 jyu5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找个掩体躲一下雨啊。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find some shelter to avoid the rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戰場上，士兵會搵掩體保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zin3 coeng4 soeng6, si6 bing1 wui5 wan2 jim2 tai2 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在战场上，士兵会找掩体保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: On the battlefield, soldiers will find cover to protect themselves.

english_meaning: to place; to handle; measure; step
explanation_mandarin: 安置、处理事务的方法。也可用作动词，表示安置或处理。
explanation_english: Refers to methods for placing or handling affairs. Can also be used as a verb, meaning to place or handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點樣措手好呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2 co3 sau2 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道该如何下手才好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to start (handling this).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該採取咩措拖嚟解決呢個問題？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 cai2 ceoi3 me1 co3 to1 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该采取什么措施来解决这个问题？
examples.english_sentence: What measures should the government take to solve this problem?

english_meaning: caught off guard; taken by surprise; unprepared
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情突然发生，来不及应付。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that happens suddenly, leaving one unprepared and unable to cope effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細突然間要我哋加班，搞到我哋措手不及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 dat6 jin4 gaan1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 baan1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 co3 sau2 bat1 gap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板突然要我们加班，搞得我们措手不及。
examples.english_sentence: The boss suddenly asked us to work overtime, which caught us completely off guard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次經濟衰退嚟得咁快，好多公司都措手不及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ging1 gai3 seoi1 teoi3 lai4 dak1 gam3 faai3, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 co3 sau2 bat1 gap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次经济衰退来得这么快，很多公司都措手不及。
examples.english_sentence: This economic recession came so quickly that many companies were caught unprepared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然求婚，我真係措手不及，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 kau4 fan1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 co3 sau2 bat1 gap6, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然求婚，我真是措手不及，不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly proposed, and I was really caught off guard, I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: measure, step, means
explanation_mandarin: 为解决问题或达到目的而采取的办法。
explanation_english: A course of action taken to achieve a particular end or solve a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出咗好多新嘅措施去幫助市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tui1 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 cok3 si1 heoi3 bong1 zo6 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出了很多新的措施去帮助市民。
examples.english_sentence: The government has introduced many new measures to help citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲措施可以有效咁降低空氣污染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cok3 si1 ho2 ji5 jau5 haau6 gam2 dai1 hung1 hei3 wu1 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些措施可以有效地降低空气污染。
examples.english_sentence: These measures can effectively reduce air pollution.

english_meaning: wording; choice of words; phrasing
explanation_mandarin: 选择和使用词语的方式。指说话或写作时选择和运用词语。
explanation_english: The way in which words are chosen and used, especially in speaking or writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢嘅措詞小心啲啦，唔好得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ge3 co3 ci4 siu2 sam1 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 dak1 zui6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话的措辞小心点吧，不要得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful with your wording, don't offend people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅措詞好客氣，聽落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 co3 ci4 hou2 hak1 hei3, teng1 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的措辞很客气，听起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: His wording is very polite, it sounds comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅措詞需要修改一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 co3 ci4 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 goi2 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的措辞需要修改一下。
examples.english_sentence: The wording of this report needs to be revised.

english_meaning: wording, choice of words, phraseology
explanation_mandarin: 选择并使用词语表达思想、情感的方式。
explanation_english: The way in which something is expressed; choice of words, phrasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅報告啲措辭好嚴謹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 bou3 gou3 di1 co3 ci4 hou2 yim4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告措辞很严谨。
examples.english_sentence: The wording in his report is very precise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢嘅時候要小心啲措辭，唔好得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 co3 ci4, m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话的时候要小心措辞，不要得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful with your wording when you speak, don't offend people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅回應嘅措辭非常巧妙，既婉拒咗邀請，又唔會令對方覺得尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wui4 ying3 ge3 co3 ci4 fei1 soeng4 ciu2 miu6, gei3 wun2 geoi5 zo2 o1 cing2, jau6 m4 wui5 ling6 deoi3 fong1 gok3 dak1 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的回应措辞非常巧妙，既婉拒了邀请，又不会让对方觉得尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: The wording of his response was very clever, both politely declining the invitation and not making the other person feel awkward.

english_meaning: to scoop up with both hands; to cup; to hold (liquid) in cupped hands
explanation_mandarin: 用双手捧取东西，多指液体。
explanation_english: To scoop up something with both hands, usually referring to liquids.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 捧一口水喝吧，润润喉咙。
examples.english_sentence: Scoop up a mouthful of water to drink and moisten your throat.

english_meaning: To grab someone's breasts; to grope breasts
explanation_mandarin: 指非礼行为，触摸女性的胸部。
explanation_english: Refers to an indecent act, touching a woman's breasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士上面掬奶，真係好變態。

examples.english_sentence: He groped someone's breasts on the bus, he's such a pervert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為細細個就可以亂咁掬奶，咁樣係犯法㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 ho2 ji5 lyun6 gam2 guk1 naai1, gam2 joeng2 hai6 faan6 faat3 gaa3.

english_meaning: to hold one's breath
explanation_mandarin: 屏住呼吸，暂时停止呼吸。
explanation_english: To hold one's breath; to temporarily stop breathing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋游水要掬氣㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau4 seoi2 jiu3 guk1 hei3 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们游泳要憋气的嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We need to hold our breath when swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好掬氣咁耐，會暈㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 guk1 hei3 gam3 noi6, wui5 wan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要憋气这么久，会晕的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hold your breath for so long, you'll get dizzy.

english_meaning: to add, to fill in (partially or as a supplement)
explanation_mandarin: 在不够的地方添补，补充。
explanation_english: To add to something that is lacking; to supplement or fill in a missing or insufficient part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我掭啲飯啦，未飽呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 tin3 di1 faan6 laa1, mei6 baau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我添点饭吧，还没饱呢。
examples.english_sentence: Please add some rice for me, I'm not full yet.
