examples.mandarin_sentence: 多喝点汤吧，我帮你添。
examples.english_sentence: Drink some more soup, let me add some for you.

english_meaning: to extort; to blackmail; to cheat; to rip off; to hold someone to ransom
explanation_mandarin: 指向人索取不合理的财物或利益；敲诈勒索。
explanation_english: To demand unreasonable money or benefits from someone; to extort; to blackmail; to cheat someone out of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想掯我錢，我點會俾佢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hang3 ngo5 cin2, ngo5 dim2 wui5 bei2 keoi5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想敲诈我的钱，我怎么会给他呢？
examples.english_sentence: He wants to extort money from me, how could I give it to him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢掯到你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 hang3 dou3 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他敲诈你！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him cheat you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳成日掯遊客，唔好幫襯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sing4 jat6 hang3 jau4 haak3, m4 hou2 bong1 can3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅经常敲诈游客，不要光顾了。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant often rips off tourists, don't patronize it.

english_meaning: to bully; to make things difficult for someone; to put someone in a difficult position; to embarrass someone
explanation_mandarin: 指故意找茬，使对方为难，让对方下不来台，感到难堪。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately finding fault with someone, making things difficult for them, putting them in an embarrassing situation, and making them feel awkward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日掯鼻佢啦，佢都好慘㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hang3 bei6 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hou2 caam2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是为难他了，他已经很惨了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always bully him, he's already miserable enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老細成日掯鼻啲新同事，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 hang3 bei6 di1 san1 tung4 si6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板总是为难那些新同事，真的很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: That boss always makes things difficult for the new colleagues, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登咁樣講嘢嚟掯鼻我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 dang3 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5 lai4 hang3 bei6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意这样说话来为难我。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately said things that way to embarrass me.

english_meaning: to break off, to split up (relationship, agreement, etc.), to part ways, to reject
explanation_mandarin: （口语）分开，解散。通常指人际关系、合作关系等破裂。
explanation_english: (Colloquial) To break up, to part ways. Usually refers to the breaking down of interpersonal relationships, partnerships, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個掰咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 baai1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个分手了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易同人掰面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 yi6 tung4 jan4 baai1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易和人翻脸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fall out with people so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司同佢哋掰咗，唔再合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 tung4 keoi5 dei6 baai1 zo2, m4 zoi3 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司和他们解约了，不再合作。
examples.english_sentence: Our company broke off the agreement with them and will no longer cooperate.

english_meaning: bye bye, goodbye
explanation_mandarin: 再见，表示告别。
explanation_english: Goodbye; an informal way of saying goodbye.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦，我走先啦，掰掰！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1, ngo5 zau2 sin1 laa1, baaai1 baaai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，我先走了，拜拜！
examples.english_sentence: Okay, I'll leave first, bye bye!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日見，掰掰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 gin3, baaai1 baaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天见，拜拜。
examples.english_sentence: See you tomorrow, bye bye.

english_meaning: pickpocket, thief
explanation_mandarin: 指偷偷摸摸地偷取他人财物的人，即小偷、扒手。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who stealthily steals other people's belongings; pickpocket, thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，呢度好多掱㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, ni1 dou6 hou2 do1 sau2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，这里有很多扒手！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, there are many pickpockets here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士上面畀人掱咗銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si6 soeng6 min6 bei2 jan4 sau2 zo2 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公交车上被人扒了钱包。
examples.english_sentence: His wallet was pickpocketed on the bus.

english_meaning: to pull, to tug, to pluck
explanation_mandarin: 用力拉、拽。通常指短促而迅速的拉动。
explanation_english: To pull or tug with force, usually referring to a quick, short pull.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掹我條辮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 maang1 ngo5 tiu4 bin1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拽我的辫子！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pull my braid!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掹咗一下條繩，想睇下斷咗未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maang1 zo2 jat1 haa5 tiu4 sing4, soeng2 tai2 haa5 tyun5 zo2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拽了一下绳子，想看看断了没有。
examples.english_sentence: He tugged at the rope to see if it was broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢掹咗幾條頭髮出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maang1 zo2 gei2 tiu4 tau4 faat3 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拔了几根头发出来。
examples.english_sentence: He plucked out a few hairs.

english_meaning: barely, just about enough, scraping by
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常勉强，刚刚好足够，几乎不足够。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where something is barely enough, just sufficient to meet a need, often implying a lack of comfort or ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月啲錢掹掹緊夠用咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 di1 cin2 mang1 mang1 gan2 gau3 yung6 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月那些钱只是勉强够用。
examples.english_sentence: The money this month is just barely enough to get by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋雖然細，但都掹掹緊住到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 seoi1 jin4 sai3, daan6 dou1 mang1 mang1 gan2 zyu6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子虽然小，但还是勉强可以住下。
examples.english_sentence: The house is small, but it's just barely liveable.

english_meaning: to boast, to brag, to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指夸大事实，吹牛，说大话。形容人喜欢炫耀，将事情说得比实际情况更好或更严重。
explanation_english: Refers to exaggerating facts, boasting, or talking big. It describes someone who likes to show off and make things sound better or more serious than they actually are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺度掹炮，話自己幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 maang1 paau3, waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 gam2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在这里吹牛，说自己多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He's always bragging here, saying how great he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢成日掹炮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 sing4 jat6 maang1 paau3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他说的话，他总是吹牛的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's always boasting.

english_meaning: to pull someone's ear
explanation_mandarin: 用手抓住耳朵并拉扯。
explanation_english: To grab someone's ear and pull it, often as a playful or disciplinary action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日俾阿媽掹耳仔，因為我唔聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 bei2 aa3 maa1 maang1 ji5 zai2, jan1 wai6 ngo5 m4 teng1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常被妈妈揪耳朵，因为我不听话。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom often pulled my ear because I was disobedient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再嘈啦，如果唔係我掹你耳仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 caau4 laa1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 ngo5 maang1 nei5 ji5 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再吵了，不然我就揪你耳朵了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop making noise, or I'll pull your ear!

mandarin_meaning: 抓住衣角; 依附; 依赖
english_meaning: To hold onto someone's shirt tail; to tag along; to follow closely for advantage; to rely on someone for support.
explanation_mandarin: 原意为抓住别人的衣角，引申为依靠别人，或者跟随别人以获得好处。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to hold onto someone's shirt tail. Figuratively, it means to rely on someone for support or to follow closely behind someone to gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掹衫尾，靠老細上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maang1 saam1 mei5, kaau3 lou5 sai3 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抓住领导的衣角，靠老板上位。
examples.english_sentence: He always tags along with the boss and relies on him to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日掹衫尾啦，自己諗吓辦法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 maang1 saam1 mei5 laa1, zi6 gei2 nam2 haa5 baan6 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是依靠别人，自己想办法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always rely on others, think of a solution yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲炒股票嘅人，成日都想掹分析員嘅衫尾，希望佢哋畀貼士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2啲 caau2 gu2 piu3 ge3 jan4, seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 maang1 fan1 sik1 jyun4 ge3 saam1 mei5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 bei2 tip1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些炒股票的人，总是想抓住分析员的衣角，希望他们给内幕消息。
examples.english_sentence: Those who speculate on stocks always want to cling to analysts, hoping they'll give them tips.

english_meaning: to deceive; to trick; to go back on one's word; to tease someone with false promises
explanation_mandarin: 用虚假的承诺或行动来哄骗、欺骗别人。通常指说话不算数，或者给人希望却最终不兑现。
explanation_english: To deceive or trick someone with false promises or actions. It usually refers to breaking one's word or giving someone hope but ultimately not delivering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掹貓尾，講嘅嘢都唔可以信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maang1 maau1 mei5, gong2 ge3嘢 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3.

examples.english_sentence: He always deceives people; you can't trust what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掹貓尾啦，應承咗人就要做到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 maang1 maau1 mei5 laa1, jing3 sing4 zo2 jan4 zau6 jiu3 zou6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要食言，答应了别人就要做到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go back on your word; if you promised someone, you have to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再掹貓尾喇，我唔會再信你㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 maang1 maau1 mei5 laa3, ngo5 m4 wui5 zoi3 seon3 nei5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再欺骗我了，我不会再相信你了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't deceive me again; I won't trust you anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 勉强赶上; 抓住机会
english_meaning: To barely make it; to scrape by; to seize an opportunity at the last minute; to jump on the bandwagon.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是抓住行驶中的车的边缘。引申为勉强赶上末班车，或者抓住最后的机会。也指能力不足却硬要参与，以求分一杯羹。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to grab the edge of a moving vehicle. Figuratively, it means to barely catch the last bus, or to seize a last-minute opportunity. It can also mean to try to participate even if you lack the skills, hoping to get a share of the benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試臨尾先嚟溫書，最後掹車邊合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lam4 mei5 sin1 lai4 wan1 syu1, zeoi3 hau6 maang1 ce1 bin1 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试最后才来复习，最后勉强及格。
examples.english_sentence: He only started studying at the last minute for the exam, and barely managed to pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project咁多人爭住做，我都想掹車邊分返少少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project gam3 do1 jan4 zaang1 zyu6 zou6, ngo5 dou1 soeng2 maang1 ce1 bin1 fan1 faan1 siu2 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很多人抢着做，我也想凑个热闹，分一点好处。
examples.english_sentence: So many people are competing for this project, I also want to jump on the bandwagon and get a small share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都唔識，但係都掹車邊入咗間大公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 dou1 maang1 ce1 bin1 jap6 zo2 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，但是也设法进入了一家大公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he still managed to scrape by and get a job at a big company.

english_meaning: to delete; to remove; to eliminate; to clear
explanation_mandarin: 从某个地方或列表中删除、移除某物。通常指通过物理操作或者数据操作将不需要的东西去除。
explanation_english: To delete, remove, or eliminate something from a place or list. It often refers to removing unwanted items through physical or data manipulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將啲廢物掹除曬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 fai3 mat6 mang1 ceoi4 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把垃圾全部清除掉。
examples.english_sentence: We need to remove all the trash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個檔案掹除咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 dong2 aan3 mang1 ceoi4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把文件删除了。
examples.english_sentence: He deleted the file.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦啲病毒要掹除清先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 di1 beng6 duk6 jiu3 mang1 ceoi4 cing1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑里的病毒必须清除干净才行。
examples.english_sentence: The viruses in the computer must be cleared thoroughly.

mandarin_meaning: 硬拉关系；牵强附会；作弊
english_meaning: To pull strings; to force a connection; to cheat (e.g., in exams)
explanation_mandarin: 指勉强地把不相关的事情联系起来，或者指通过不正当手段来达到目的，例如考试作弊。
explanation_english: Refers to forcing a connection between unrelated things or using improper means to achieve a goal, such as cheating on an exam. It also implies pulling strings to get something done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好掹雞啦，呢兩件事根本冇關係嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mang1 gai1 laa1, ni1 loeng5 gin6 si6 gaan1 bun2 mou5 gwaan1 hai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别牵强附会了，这两件事根本没有关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force a connection, these two things are not related at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試掹雞，俾老師捉到正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 mang1 gai1, bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou3 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊，被老师抓个正着。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated on the exam and was caught red-handed by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵人掹雞，先可以入到呢間公司做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 jan4 mang1 gai1, sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 dou3 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找人拉关系，才能进这家公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He pulled strings to get a job at this company.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常小气，一毛不拔，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money, even on small things. Literally, it means 'pulling chicken bean curd skin,' implying pulling apart something minimal to get the most out of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好掹雞豆皮，請佢食餐飯都唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mang1 gai1 dau6 pei1, cheng2 keoi5 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小气，请他吃顿饭都不肯。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy; he won't even let me treat him to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁掹雞豆皮啦，有錢使得就要使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 mang1 gai1 dau6 pei1 laa1, jau5 chin2 sai2 dak1 zeoi6 jiu3 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气啦，有钱该花的时候就要花。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy; if you have money, you should spend it when you need to.

mandarin_meaning: 拔鸡毛; 比喻从中取利，捞油水
english_meaning: To pluck a chicken; To skim profits (usually through underhanded means)
explanation_mandarin: 本意是拔鸡毛。比喻从中获取不正当的利益，通常指偷偷地或者用不光彩的手段。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Literally means to pluck chicken feathers. Figuratively, it means to extract unfair or illicit profits, often secretly or through dishonest means. Has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司度掹鷄，遲早俾人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 mang1 gai1, chi4 zou2 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在公司里捞油水，迟早会被人抓住。
examples.english_sentence: He's always skimming profits in the company; he'll get caught sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好多嘢都收貴曬，根本就係掹鷄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ho2 do1 ye5 dou1 sau1 gwai3 saai3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 mang1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很多东西都收费很贵，根本就是捞油水。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant charges exorbitant prices for everything; it's simply skimming profits.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好掹鷄豆皮，請食飯都唔捨得叫多個餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 mang1 gai1 dau6 pei4, cheng2 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 giu3 do1 go3 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是太抠门了，请客吃饭都不舍得多点一个菜。
examples.english_sentence: He is so stingy, he's not even willing to order an extra dish when treating people to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁掹鷄豆皮啦，難得出去玩一次，使多啲錢都唔緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 mang1 gai1 dau6 pei4 laa1, naan4 dak1 cheut1 heoi3 waan2 jat1 ci3, sai2 do1 di1 chin2 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么抠门了，难得出去玩一次，多花点钱也没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, it's rare to go out and have fun, it doesn't matter spending a bit more money.

english_meaning: to bump, to collide, to touch accidentally
explanation_mandarin: 指无意中碰到或撞到某物。
explanation_english: Refers to unintentionally bumping into or colliding with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你小心啲，唔好掽親啲嘢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 paang3 can1 di1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你小心一点，不要碰到东西了。
examples.english_sentence: Please be careful and don't bump into things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我行路嗰陣時唔小心掽到張枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 si4 m4 siu2 sam1 paang3 dou2 zoeng1 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我走路的时候不小心碰到了桌子。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally bumped into the table while walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車掽到隔離嗰部車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 paang3 dou2 gaak3 lei4 go2 bou6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车撞到了旁边的车。
examples.english_sentence: This car bumped into the car next to it.

english_meaning: to choose; to select; to pick
explanation_mandarin: 挑选，选取。
explanation_english: To choose, select, or pick something out from a group of items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想揀邊個呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 gaan2 bin1 go3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想选哪个？
examples.english_sentence: Which one do you want to choose?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳嘅嘢食好多選擇，唔知點揀好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 do1 syun2 zaak6, m4 zi1 dim2 gaan2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物有很多选择，不知道选哪个好。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has so many options, I don't know what to choose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揀最好嘅材料去整呢個蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaan2 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 coi4 liu2 heoi3 zing2 ni1 go3 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要选择最好的材料来做这个蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: We need to choose the best ingredients to make this cake.

mandarin_meaning: 剩下的，挑剩下的，剩余的
english_meaning: leftovers, what's left after others have chosen, the dregs
explanation_mandarin: 指被人挑剩下，质量或条件相对较差的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to things that are left over after others have chosen, usually implying they are of lower quality or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫俾人揀晒，得返啲揀剩尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 bei2 jan4 gaan2 saai3, dak1 faan1 di1 gaan2 sing6 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服都被人挑完了，只剩下一些挑剩下的。
examples.english_sentence: All the clothes have been picked over, only the leftovers are left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲咗去，淨係可以買啲揀剩尾嘅飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 zo2 heoi3, zing6 hai6 ho2 ji5 maai5 di1 gaan2 sing6 mei5 ge3 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迟去了，只能买到一些剩下的票。
examples.english_sentence: I went late, and could only buy the leftover tickets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係好受歡迎，所以通常都係揀剩尾嘅人同佢一組。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, so2 ji5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 gaan2 sing6 mei5 ge3 jan4 tung4 keoi5 jat1 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是很受欢迎，所以通常都是被挑剩下的人和他一组。
examples.english_sentence: He's not very popular, so he's usually grouped with the leftover people.

english_meaning: picky; choosy; fussy
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常挑剔，对选择对象要求很高，不容易满足。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very picky and has high standards when making choices, making them hard to satisfy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁揀卒啦，有得做咪做囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaan2 zeot1 laa1, jau5 dak1 zou6 mai1 zou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么挑剔了，有得做就做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, just do it if there's something to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀卒到呢，乜嘢都唔啱佢心水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zeot1 dou3 ni1, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 ngaam1 keoi5 sam1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太挑剔了，什么都不合他的心意。
examples.english_sentence: He's so picky, nothing suits his taste.

synonyms: 奄尖聲悶 (am1 zim1 seng1 mun6)

english_meaning: carefully selected; choice; best of the bunch
explanation_mandarin: 指挑选出来的最好的、最优质的。
explanation_english: Refers to something carefully selected and of the best quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅生果全部都係揀手貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 ge3 saang1 gwo2 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gaan2 sau2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店里的水果全部都是精选的。
examples.english_sentence: All the fruits in this shop are carefully selected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次買嘢都揀手嘅，唔會求其。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 maai5 je5 dou1 gaan2 sau2 ge3, m4 wui5 kau4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次买东西都会挑选最好的，不会随便。
examples.english_sentence: He always chooses the best when buying things; he's not casual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻錶係老闆嘅揀手珍藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 biu1 hai6 lou5 baan2 ge3 gaan2 sau2 zan1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块表是老板的精选珍藏。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is the boss's carefully selected treasure.

english_meaning: picky; choosy; to be selective; to nitpick
explanation_mandarin: 指過於挑剔，對選擇對象要求過高；也指選擇，挑選。
explanation_english: To be overly picky or choosy, having excessively high standards when making a selection; also, simply to choose or select.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好揀擇㗎，冇樣嘢啱佢心水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gaan2 zaak6 gaa3, mou5 joeng2 je5 ngaam1 keoi5 sam1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很挑剔的，没什么东西能让他满意。
examples.english_sentence: He's very picky, nothing satisfies him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁揀擇啦，有得食咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaan2 zaak6 laa1, jau5 dak1 sik6 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么挑剔了，有得吃就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, just be grateful that there's something to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揀擇對象唔可以太睇外表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan2 zaak6 deoi3 zoeng6 m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 tai2 ngoi6 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选择对象不可以太看重外表。
examples.english_sentence: When choosing a partner, you shouldn't focus too much on appearance.

english_meaning: to choose an apartment/flat; to select a unit in a building
explanation_mandarin: 挑选房屋，通常指在新建楼盘中选择具体的楼层和单元。
explanation_english: To choose an apartment, typically in a newly built residential building. It involves selecting the specific floor and unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要去揀樓，希望揀到間啱心水嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gaan2 lau2, hei1 mong6 gaan2 dou2 gaan1 aam1 sam1 seoi2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天要去选房，希望选到一间合心意的。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to choose an apartment tomorrow, hoping to select one that we like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發展商搞咗個揀樓儀式，好多人去排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 zin2 soeng1 gaau2 zo2 go3 gaan2 lau2 ji4 sik1, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开发商举办了一个选房仪式，很多人去排队。
examples.english_sentence: The developer held an apartment selection ceremony, and many people went to queue up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋排咗成日隊，都揀唔到好嘅樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai4 zo2 seng4 jat6 deoi2, dou1 gaan2 m4 dou2 hou2 ge3 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们排了一整天的队，都没选到好的房子。
examples.english_sentence: They queued up for the whole day but couldn't select a good apartment.

english_meaning: to pick out the best; to select the elite; to talent scout
explanation_mandarin: 从众多人或事物中挑选出最优秀的。多用于比喻选拔人才。
explanation_english: To select the best from a large group of people or things. Often used metaphorically to describe talent scouting or selecting the best candidates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司年年都去唔同嘅大學揀蟀，想搵啲有潛質嘅畢業生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 nin4 nin4 dou1 heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 daai6 hok6 gaan2 seot1, soeng2 wan2 di1 jau5 cim4 zat1 ge3 bat1 jip6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司每年都去不同的大学选拔人才，想找一些有潜力的毕业生。
examples.english_sentence: The company goes to different universities every year to scout for talent, looking for graduates with potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個選秀節目就係要幫娛樂圈揀蟀，發掘有天賦嘅新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 syun2 sau3 zit3 muk6 zau6 hai6 jiu3 bong1 jyu4 lok6 hyun1 gaan2 seot1, faat3 gwat6 jau5 tin1 fu3 ge3 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个选秀节目就是要帮娱乐圈选拔人才，发掘有天赋的新人。
examples.english_sentence: This talent show is to help the entertainment industry scout for talent and discover new faces with talent.

english_meaning: to choose, to select
explanation_mandarin: 挑选，选择。
explanation_english: To pick out, choose, or select from a number of possibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以揀選你鍾意嘅口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 gaan2 syun2 nei5 zung1 ji3 ge3 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以选择你喜欢的口味。
examples.english_sentence: You can choose your favorite flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揀選一間最好嘅餐廳去慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaan2 syun2 jat1 gaan1 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 caan1 teng1 heoi3 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要选择一家最好的餐厅去庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: We need to choose the best restaurant to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好揀選人，唔係個個都做得嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 gaan2 syun2 jan4, m4 hai6 go3 go3 dou1 zou6 dak1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很挑人，不是每个人都能做的来。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very selective, not everyone can do it.

english_meaning: to be picky about food, to be a fussy eater
explanation_mandarin: 形容人对食物非常挑剔，只吃自己喜欢的，不喜欢的就不吃。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very picky about food, only eating what they like and rejecting what they don't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁揀飲擇食，好難喺出邊食飯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 gaan2 jam2 zaak6 sik6, hou2 naan4 hai2 chut1 bin1 sik6 faan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么挑食，很难在外面吃饭的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so picky about food, it's difficult to eat out with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好揀飲擇食，乜嘢都唔肯食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 gaan2 jam2 zaak6 sik6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩很挑食，什么都不肯吃。
examples.english_sentence: That child is very picky about food and refuses to eat anything.

english_meaning: picky eater; discerning in food and drink; having refined taste in food and beverages
explanation_mandarin: 形容人对饮食非常讲究，喜欢挑剔选择，懂得品味美食和饮品。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very particular about food and drink, likes to be selective, and knows how to appreciate fine food and beverages. Implies a refined taste and a tendency to be picky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好揀飲識食㗎，間間餐廳都俾佢彈到一文不值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gaan2 jam2 sik1 sik6 gaa3, gaan1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 dou1 bei2 keoi5 taan4 dou3 jat1 man4 bat1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很挑剔，每家餐厅都被他批评得一无是处。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very picky eater, he criticizes every restaurant as being worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做飲食行業，要揀飲識食先得，唔係點知啲嘢好唔好食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jam2 sik1 hang4 jip6, jiu3 gaan2 jam2 sik1 sik6 sin1 dak1, m4 hai6 dim2 zi1 di1 je5 hou2 m4 hou2 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做餐饮行业，要懂得品尝才行，不然怎么知道东西好不好吃？
examples.english_sentence: To work in the food and beverage industry, you need to have a discerning palate, otherwise how would you know if something is delicious?

english_meaning: to tease, to mock, to ridicule
explanation_mandarin: 用言語或行動戲弄或嘲笑他人。
explanation_english: To tease or mock someone with words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日揄人啦，人哋會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 jyu4 jan4 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是嘲笑别人啦，人家会不高兴的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tease people, they'll be unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁騎呢，梗係俾人揄啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 ki1 le1, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 jyu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话那么古怪，当然会被人嘲笑啦。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks so strangely, of course, he'll be ridiculed.

english_meaning: to tease, to ridicule, to make fun of
explanation_mandarin: 用语言或行动来嘲弄、取笑对方。
explanation_english: To tease, ridicule, or make fun of someone, usually in a lighthearted or playful manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再揄褲佢啦，佢嬲㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 jyu4 fu3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 nau1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再嘲笑他了，他生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease him anymore, he's getting angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都揄褲我矮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jyu4 fu3 ngo5 ai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是嘲笑我矮。
examples.english_sentence: He always teases me for being short.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁認真啦，我淨係揄褲你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jing6 zan1 laa1, ngo5 zing6 hai6 jyu4 fu3 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么认真嘛，我只是在取笑你而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it so seriously, I'm just teasing you.

english_meaning: to estimate; to measure; to assess; to contemplate; to manage
explanation_mandarin: （书面语）估量，测量，管理。
explanation_english: (Formal) To estimate, measure, or manage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揆度下咁樣做嘅後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kwai4 dok6 haa5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 ge3 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得估量一下这样做的后果。
examples.english_sentence: We have to estimate the consequences of doing this.

english_meaning: to size up the situation; to assess the situation and act accordingly; to be pragmatic
explanation_mandarin: 观察时局，估计情势的发展趋势，从而决定行动方案。形容处事圆滑。
explanation_english: To carefully observe the current situation, assess the trends, and decide on a course of action accordingly. It describes someone who is adaptable and knows how to navigate complex situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識揆時度勢，所以喺公司撈得幾掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 kwai4 si4 dok6 sai3, so2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 lou1 dak1 gei2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会审时度势，所以在公司混得挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at sizing up the situation, so he's doing pretty well in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意要識得揆時度勢，先可以賺到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 jiu1 sik1 dak1 kwai4 si4 dok6 sai3, sin1 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意要懂得审时度势，才能赚到钱。
examples.english_sentence: You need to know how to size up the situation in business to make money.

english_meaning: Span (distance between thumb and little finger of outstretched hand)
explanation_mandarin: 用拇指和中指或拇指和小指量东西的长度。相当于“拃”。
explanation_english: The length of something measured from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the middle finger or little finger of an outstretched hand; a span.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵樹都有兩揇粗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ko1 syu6 dou1 jau5 loeng5 naam5 cou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵树都有两拃粗。
examples.english_sentence: This tree is about two spans thick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張檯有幾揇咁長呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 jau5 gei2 naam5 gam3 coeng4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张桌子有多长啊？
examples.english_sentence: How many spans long is this table?

english_meaning: to swing, to fling, to shake, to wave
explanation_mandarin: 用力向外或向下摆动；快速摇动。
explanation_english: To swing or fling something outwards or downwards with force; to shake or wave quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到揈晒啲文件落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 fing6 saai3 di1 man4 gin2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地把文件都甩到地上。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he flung all the documents on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度揈手，同我哋打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 fing6 sau2, tung4 ngo5 dei6 daa2 gei1 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里挥手，和我们打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: He was waving his hand there, greeting us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日揈嚟揈去，會整親人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 fing6 lai4 fing6 heoi3, wui5 zing2 can1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是甩来甩去，会碰到人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't swing it around all the time, you'll hit someone.

english_meaning: Loud and echoing sound; booming sound; deafening
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音很大，并且带有回音，震耳欲聋。通常用来形容音响设备播放的声音。
explanation_english: Describes a very loud and echoing sound, often used to describe the sound produced by audio equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部喇叭揈揈聲，嘈到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 laa3 baa1 fong6 fong6 seng1, cou4 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的喇叭声音震耳欲聋，吵死了。
examples.english_sentence: His speakers are booming, it's so loud it's annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房啲音響揈揈聲，搞到我頭都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 di1 yam1 hoeng2 fong6 fong6 seng1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里的音响声音太大了，搞得我头都痛了。
examples.english_sentence: The sound system in the room is so loud, it's giving me a headache.

english_meaning: To act high and mighty; to show off; to stand someone up; to flake
explanation_mandarin: 指故意摆出高人一等的姿态，或者无故爽约，放别人鸽子。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately acting superior or standing someone up without a good reason. Often implies a sense of arrogance or disregard for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢紅咗之後成日揈機，唔理啲舊朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung4 zo2 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 fing6 gei1, m4 lei5 di1 gau6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他红了之后总是耍大牌，不理那些老朋友。
examples.english_sentence: After he became famous, he always acts high and mighty and ignores his old friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再揈機啦，次次都遲到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 fing6 gei1 laa1, ci3 ci3 dou1 ci4 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再放鸽子了，每次都迟到！
examples.english_sentence: Stop flaking on me, you're always late!

english_meaning: To shake off, to get rid of, to ditch, to dump (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 用剧烈的动作把东西甩掉；摆脱某种关系或事物。
explanation_english: To shake something off with a violent movement; to get rid of something or someone, usually in a decisive way. It implies an action to forcibly remove something or end a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到揈甩我隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 fung2 lat1 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得甩开了我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he shook my hand off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我決定要揈甩佢，唔想再同佢一齊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 fung2 lat1 keoi5, m4 soeng2 zoi3 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我决定要甩掉他，不想再和他在一起了。
examples.english_sentence: I've decided to dump him. I don't want to be with him anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住咁容易就可以揈甩我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 gam3 yung4 yi6 zau6 ho2 ji5 fung2 lat1 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为这么容易就可以摆脱我们。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get rid of us so easily.

english_meaning: ecstasy (drug), MDMA
explanation_mandarin: 一种毒品，主要成分是亚甲基二氧甲基苯丙胺（MDMA），服用后会产生兴奋感，并伴随头部摇晃等现象。
explanation_english: Ecstasy, also known as MDMA, is a psychoactive drug primarily used for recreational purposes. It is known for producing feelings of euphoria and is often associated with raves and dance parties.  The term '揈頭丸' (fing6 tau4 jyun2) literally translates to 'head-shaking pill' due to the involuntary head movements sometimes exhibited by users.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好掂揈頭丸呀，會上癮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dim6 fing6 tau4 jyun2 aa3, wui5 soeng5 yan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碰摇头丸啊，会上瘾的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch ecstasy, it's addictive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察拉咗班賣揈頭丸嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2 baan1 maai6 fing6 tau4 jyun2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓了一群卖摇头丸的人。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested a group of people selling ecstasy.

english_meaning: rave; dance club where people shake their heads to electronic music (typically involving drug use)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种通常播放电子音乐的舞厅或派对，参与者会随着音乐摇头摆脑，有时也伴随着毒品的使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a rave or dance club, usually playing electronic music, where participants shake their heads and dance, often with drug use involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去揈頭場，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 fung4 tau4 coeng4, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去摇头舞厅，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to raves, I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔唔好成日去揈頭場，好易學壞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 saang1 zai2 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 heoi3 fung4 tau4 coeng4, hou2 ji6 hok6 waai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人不要总是去摇头舞厅，很容易学坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Young people shouldn't go to raves all the time, it's easy to go astray.

english_meaning: to knead; to rub; to massage
explanation_mandarin: 用手反复搓或按。
explanation_english: To rub or press repeatedly with the hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我揉返鬆條頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 jau4 faan1 sung1 tiu4 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我把脖子揉松。
examples.english_sentence: He is helping me to rub and loosen my neck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日揉麵粉整麵包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 jau4 min6 fan2 zing2 min6 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常揉面粉做面包。
examples.english_sentence: My mother often kneads flour to make bread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心整跌咗啲嘢落隻眼度，要揉一揉先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 dit3 zo2 di1 je5 lok6 zek3 ngaan5 dou6, jiu3 jau4 jat1 jau4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心弄了东西进眼睛里，要揉一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally got something in my eye, I need to rub it.

english_meaning: to integrate, to blend, to combine
explanation_mandarin: 把不同的事物混合在一起，使它们成为一个整体。
explanation_english: To blend or integrate different elements together to form a cohesive whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計揉合咗傳統同現代嘅元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 jau4 hap6 zo2 cyun4 tung2 tung4 hiun3 doi6 ge3 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计融合了传统和现代的元素。
examples.english_sentence: This design integrates traditional and modern elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將唔同嘅音樂風格揉合埋一齊，創造咗一種新嘅聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 m4 tung4 ge3 jam1 ngok6 fung1 gaak3 jau4 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4, cong3 zou6 zo2 jat1 zung2 san1 ge3 seng1 yam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将不同的音乐风格融合在一起，创造了一种新的声音。
examples.english_sentence: He blended different musical styles together, creating a new sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式揉合咗中西烹調技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 jau4 hap6 zo2 zung1 sai1 peng1 tiu4 gei2 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜肴融合了中西烹饪技巧。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's dishes integrate Chinese and Western cooking techniques.

english_meaning: to beat; to hit; to thrash
explanation_mandarin: 用拳头或武器打击。
explanation_english: To strike or hit someone, often repeatedly and forcefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔聽話，我就揍你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 teng1 waa6, ngo5 zau6 zau3 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不听话，我就打你！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen, I'll hit you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人揍咗一鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zau3 zo2 jat1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人打了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: He got beaten up.

english_meaning: to trace, to sketch, to depict, to describe
explanation_mandarin: 用线条画出或照着样子写或画，形容描写。
explanation_english: To trace, sketch, depict, or describe using lines; to portray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用幾隻字就描繪出呢個地方嘅美景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 gei2 jek3 zi6 jau6 miu4 wai2 chut1 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 mei5 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用几个字就描绘出了这个地方的美景。
examples.english_sentence: He depicted the beautiful scenery of this place with just a few words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫描得好仔細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 miu4 dak1 hou2 zi2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画描绘得很仔细。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is depicted very meticulously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺人哋嘅作品上面亂咁描。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 yan4 dei6 ge3 jok3 ban2 soeng6 min6 lyun6 gam2 miu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在别人的作品上面乱描。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trace randomly on other people's artwork.

english_meaning: to describe; to depict; description
explanation_mandarin: 用语言、文字等把事物的形象、情状表现出来。
explanation_english: To describe or depict something using language, writing, or other means, so as to present its image or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多筆墨去描寫呢個城市嘅風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 bat1 mak6 heoi3 miu4 se2 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了很多笔墨去描写这个城市的风景。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of ink to describe the scenery of this city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅作者好擅長描寫人物嘅內心世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jok3 je5 hou2 sin6 cheung4 miu4 se2 yan4 mat6 ge3 noi6 sam1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的作者很擅长描写人物的内心世界。
examples.english_sentence: The author of this book is very good at describing the inner world of characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅寫作功力唔夠，描寫唔到佢當時嘅心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 se2 jok3 gung1 lik6 m4 gau3, miu4 se2 m4 dou2 keoi5 dong1 si4 ge3 sam1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的写作能力不够，描写不到她当时的心情。
examples.english_sentence: My writing skills are not good enough to describe her mood at the time.

english_meaning: to depict, to describe, to portray
explanation_mandarin: 用语言、文字或图画等方式，对人或事物进行形象的描述。
explanation_english: To depict or describe someone or something using language, writing, drawing, or other means to create a vivid image.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用文字描繪咗一個好靚嘅日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 man4 zi6 miu4 wui2 zo2 yat1 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 yat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用文字描绘了一个很美的日落。
examples.english_sentence: He used words to depict a beautiful sunset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫描繪咗香港嘅舊時景象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 miu4 wui2 zo2 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 gau6 si4 ging2 seung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画描绘了香港的旧时景象。
examples.english_sentence: This painting portrays the old scenes of Hong Kong.

english_meaning: to describe; description
explanation_mandarin: 用语言或文字把事物、情景等具体地表现出来。
explanation_english: To give a detailed account of something; to represent or give an account of in words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以描述下個疑犯嘅樣貌啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 miu4 seot6 haa5 go3 ji4 faan6 ge3 joeng2 maau6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可不可以描述一下嫌疑犯的样貌？
examples.english_sentence: Could you describe the suspect's appearance?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅描述好生動，令我哋好似親身經歷一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 miu4 seot6 hou2 sang1 dung6, ling6 ngo5 dei6 hou2 ci5 can1 san1 ging1 lik6 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的描述很生动，让我们好像亲身经历一样。
examples.english_sentence: His description was so vivid, it felt like we were experiencing it ourselves.

english_meaning: Descriptivism
explanation_mandarin: 一种语言哲学理论，认为语言的意义在于它如何被实际使用，而非某种预设的规范或理想形式。强调描述而非规定语言的使用。
explanation_english: A philosophical approach to language that emphasizes describing how language is actually used, rather than prescribing how it should be used. It focuses on observation and recording of language usage rather than enforcing predetermined rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅語言學研究主要係基於描述主義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 hok6 jin4 gau3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 gei1 jyu1 miu4 seot6 zyu2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的语言学研究主要是基于描述主义。
examples.english_sentence: Their linguistic research is primarily based on descriptivism.

english_meaning: to lift; to carry; to raise; to mention; to bring up
explanation_mandarin: 向上拿东西；举起；提出；说起。
explanation_english: To lift or raise something; to carry; to bring up a topic in conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提起佢，我就嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 hei2 keoi5, ngo5 zau6 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一提起他，我就生气。
examples.english_sentence: When you mention him, I get angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提住呢个袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 zyu6 ni1 go3 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿着这个袋子。
examples.english_sentence: Carry this bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提议去食饭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ji5 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提议去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He suggested going to have a meal.

english_meaning: to submit, to hand in
explanation_mandarin: 递交；呈送。
explanation_english: To hand in, to present or submit something, usually documents, assignments, or applications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得聽日要提交份報告啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 ting1 jat6 jiu3 tai4 gaap3 fan6 bou3 gou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得明天要提交那份报告啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to submit that report tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱提交咗份申請表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 tai4 gaap3 zo2 fan6 san1 cheng2 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚提交了申请表。
examples.english_sentence: I just submitted the application form.

english_meaning: to provide; to offer; to supply
explanation_mandarin: 给予，供给。
explanation_english: To give or make available; to supply or furnish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳提供好多唔同嘅菜式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 tai4 gung1 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 coi3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅提供很多不同的菜式。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會提供經濟援助俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 tai4 gung1 ging1 zai3 yun4 zo6 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会提供经济援助给有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: The government will provide financial assistance to people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以提供啲意見俾你參考下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 tai4 gung1 di1 ji3 gin3 bei2 nei5 caam1 haau2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以提供一些意见给你参考一下。
examples.english_sentence: I can offer some advice for you to consider.

english_meaning: to advocate; to promote; to encourage; to propose
explanation_mandarin: 发起并主张；提议倡导。
explanation_english: To initiate and advocate; to propose and encourage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府提倡環保，鼓勵市民減少用塑膠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tai4 coeng3 waan4 bou2, gu2 lai6 si5 man4 g減siu2 yung6 suk1 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府提倡环保，鼓励市民减少使用塑料。
examples.english_sentence: The government is promoting environmental protection and encouraging citizens to reduce the use of plastics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司提倡彈性工作時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 tai4 coeng3 taan4 sing3 gung1 zok3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司提倡弹性工作时间。
examples.english_sentence: This company advocates flexible working hours.

english_meaning: to put forward, to propose, to raise (an issue), to suggest
explanation_mandarin: 表示提出意见、建议、计划、问题等。
explanation_english: To present or suggest an idea, plan, proposal, or question for consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提出咗一個好好嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提出了一个很好的建议。
examples.english_sentence: He put forward a very good suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該提出解決問題嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 tai4 ceot1 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该提出解决问题的方法。
examples.english_sentence: We should propose solutions to the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋提出咗好多疑問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tai4 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 ji2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们提出了很多疑问。
examples.english_sentence: They raised a lot of questions.

english_meaning: to do something in advance; ahead of schedule; to bring forward
explanation_mandarin: 在预定的时间之前做某事。
explanation_english: To do something before the scheduled or expected time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提前完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 cin4 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得提前完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We have to finish this project ahead of schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 航班提前咗兩個鐘起飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hong4 baan1 tai4 cin4 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 hei2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 航班提前了两个小时起飞。
examples.english_sentence: The flight took off two hours earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我提前預訂咗酒店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai4 cin4 jyu6 ding6 zo2 zau2 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我提前预订了酒店。
examples.english_sentence: I booked the hotel in advance.

english_meaning: to promote; to upgrade; to elevate; to improve
explanation_mandarin: 使位置、程度、质量等方面提高。
explanation_english: To raise something to a higher position, level, quality, or degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算提升佢做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 tai4 sing1 keoi5 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算提拔他做经理。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to promote him to manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提升產品嘅品質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 sing1 caan2 ban2 ge3 ban3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要提升产品的质量。
examples.english_sentence: We need to improve the quality of our products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個課程可以提升你嘅技能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 nei5 ge3 gei1 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个课程可以提升你的技能。
examples.english_sentence: This course can enhance your skills.

english_meaning: to mention, to refer to, to bring up
explanation_mandarin: 说到，提到。指在谈话或写作中提到某事或某人。
explanation_english: To mention, refer to, or bring up something or someone in conversation or writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先佢提及過呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 keoi5 tai4 gap6 gwo3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才他提到过这件事。
examples.english_sentence: He mentioned this matter just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺佢面前提及佢阿哥，佢哋關係唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 keoi5 min6 cin4 tai4 gap6 keoi5 aa3 go1, keoi5 dei6 gwaan1 hai6 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在他面前提起他哥哥，他们的关系不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mention his brother in front of him, their relationship isn't good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺報告入邊，佢無提及到任何嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 bin1, keoi5 mou4 tai4 gap6 dou3 jam6 ho4 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在报告里面，他没有提及到任何的问题。
examples.english_sentence: In the report, he didn't mention any problems.

english_meaning: to extract, to withdraw, to draw (from)
explanation_mandarin: 从某个来源或地方取出。
explanation_english: To take out or withdraw from a source or place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想提取啲現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tai4 qu2 di1 hin3 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想提取一些现金。
examples.english_sentence: I want to withdraw some cash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生提取咗佢嘅血液樣本嚟做測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 tai4 qu2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 hyut3 jik6 joeng2 bun2 lai4 zou6 cak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生提取了他的血液样本来进行测试。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor extracted a blood sample from him for testing.

english_meaning: nominate; nomination
explanation_mandarin: 推荐某人担任某个职位或获得某个奖项。
explanation_english: To formally suggest someone for a job, prize, or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋提名咗佢做主席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 tai4 ming4 zo2 keoi5 zou6 zyu2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们提名他做主席。
examples.english_sentence: They nominated him for chairman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉嘅提名程序好嚴謹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ge3 tai4 ming4 cing4 seoi5 hou2 jim4 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举的提名程序很严谨。
examples.english_sentence: The nomination process for this election is very rigorous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要搵人提名你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wan2 jan4 tai4 ming4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找人提名你。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find someone to nominate you.

english_meaning: to ask a question; to question
explanation_mandarin: 提出问题；询问。
explanation_english: To ask a question; to inquire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺堂上面提問咗一個好有趣嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tong4 soeng6 min6 tai4 man6 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在课堂上提出了一个很有趣的问题。
examples.english_sentence: He asked a very interesting question in class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲有冇嘢想提問啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 jau5 mou5 je5 soeng2 tai4 man6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还有什么想提问的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have anything else you want to ask?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師鼓勵學生多啲提問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gu2 lai6 hok6 sang1 do1 di1 tai4 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师鼓励学生多提问。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher encourages students to ask more questions.

english_meaning: to appear in court (for a preliminary hearing); court appearance; arraignment
explanation_mandarin: 指嫌疑犯被带到法庭接受初步审讯，以决定是否需要继续羁押或进行进一步审理。
explanation_english: To bring a suspect to court for a preliminary hearing or arraignment, usually to determine if the suspect should be remanded in custody or if further investigation/trial is required.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日要上庭提堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 soeng5 ting4 tai4 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天要上庭提审。
examples.english_sentence: He has to appear in court tomorrow for the preliminary hearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個疑犯今日已經提咗堂，法官決定唔俾佢保釋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji4 faan2 gam1 jat6 ji5 ging1 tai4 zo2 tong4, faat3 gun1 kyut3 ding6 m4 bei2 keoi5 bou2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个嫌疑犯今天已经被提审了，法官决定不让他保释。
examples.english_sentence: The suspect has already appeared in court today, and the judge decided not to grant him bail.

english_meaning: to prompt; to remind; to give a cue (esp. in acting or a performance); reminder; cue
explanation_mandarin: 在表演或行动中给予提示，避免出错或遗忘；提醒别人要做的事情。
explanation_english: To give a prompt or reminder, especially in a performance (like acting, singing, etc.) to help someone avoid mistakes or forgetting what to do or say. Also, more generally, to remind someone about something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唱歌嘅時候，有人喺側邊提場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1 ge3 si4 hau6, jau5 jan4 hai2 zak1 bin1 tai4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上唱歌的时候，有人在旁边提醒。
examples.english_sentence: When he was singing on stage, someone was giving him prompts from the side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該提場我聽日記得交功課啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 tai4 coeng4 ngo5 ting1 jat6 gei3 dak1 gaau1 gung1 fo3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦提醒我明天记得交作业啊。
examples.english_sentence: Please remind me to remember to submit my homework tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你提場，我差啲唔記得咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 tai4 coeng4, ngo5 caa1 di1 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你提醒，我差点忘了。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for the reminder, I almost forgot.

english_meaning: grape
explanation_mandarin: 指葡萄。在粤语中，“提子”是葡萄的常见说法。
explanation_english: Refers to grapes. In Cantonese, "tai zi" is a common term for grapes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食提子，尤其係青提子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 tai4 zi2, jau4 kei4 hai6 ceng1 tai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃葡萄，尤其是青葡萄。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat grapes, especially green grapes.

english_meaning: raisin
explanation_mandarin: 由葡萄晒干而成的果干。
explanation_english: Dried grapes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食提子乾呀，你呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 tai4 zi2 gon1 aa3, nei5 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃葡萄干，你呢？
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat raisins, what about you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個麵包入邊有好多提子乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 min6 baau1 jap6 bin6 jau5 hou2 do1 tai4 zi2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个面包里有很多葡萄干。
examples.english_sentence: There are lots of raisins in this bread.

english_meaning: with one's heart in one's mouth; on tenterhooks; with a fluttering heart
explanation_mandarin: 形容十分担心或害怕。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme worry or fear; to be very anxious and apprehensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日考完車牌筆試，等到今日都重未收到通知，真係提心吊膽啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 haau2 jyun4 ce1 paai4 bat1 si5, dang2 dou3 gam1 jat6 dou1 cung4 mei6 sau1 dou3 tung1 zi1, zan1 hai6 tai4 sam1 diu3 daam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天考完驾照笔试，等到今天都还没收到通知，真是提心吊胆啊！
examples.english_sentence: I finished the written driving test yesterday and haven't received any notification yet, I'm really on tenterhooks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人去咁遠嘅地方旅行，真係令人提心吊膽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 gam3 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1 leoi5 hang4, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tai4 sam1 diu3 daam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人去那么远的地方旅行，真让人提心吊胆。
examples.english_sentence: He's travelling to such a far-off place alone, it really makes people anxious.

english_meaning: to promote; to elevate (in position); to recommend
explanation_mandarin: 选拔提升（职位，等级等）。
explanation_english: To promote or elevate someone to a higher position or rank. To recommend someone for advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好欣賞我嘅能力，所以提拔我做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 yan1 soeng2 ngo5 ge3 nang4 lik6, so2 ji5 tai4 bat6 ngo5 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很欣赏我的能力，所以提拔我做经理。
examples.english_sentence: He really appreciates my ability, so he promoted me to manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆提拔咗佢，因為佢表現出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 tai4 bat6 zo2 keoi5, yan1 wai6 keoi5 biu2 hin3 seot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板提拔了他，因为他表现出色。
examples.english_sentence: The boss promoted him because of his outstanding performance.

english_meaning: to mentor, to give guidance and support, to help someone advance, to give a leg up
explanation_mandarin: 指帮助和引导某人，使其取得进步或成功。多用于职场或者人际关系中，表示上级对下级、前辈对后辈的帮助。
explanation_english: To mentor, support, and guide someone to help them advance or succeed, often in a professional or personal context. Commonly used to describe help from a senior to a junior, or a superior to a subordinate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿頭好肯提攜後輩，教咗我好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 tau4 hou2 hang2 tai4 kwai4 hau6 bei3, gaau3 zo2 ngo5 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 领导很愿意提拔后辈，教了我很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is very willing to mentor junior colleagues and has taught me a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁多年嚟嘅提攜，我先可以有今日嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 do1 nin4 lai4 ge3 tai4 kwai4, ngo5 sin1 ho2 ji5 jau5 gam1 jat6 ge3 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 感谢你这么多年来的提携，我才可以有今天的成就。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your guidance and support over the years; that's why I can have today's achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想搵個有經驗嘅人提攜下佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 wan2 go3 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jan4 tai4 kwai4 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想找个有经验的人提拔一下他。
examples.english_sentence: He really wants to find someone experienced to mentor him.

english_meaning: to bring forward; to advance; ahead of time; early
explanation_mandarin: 指时间上比原定的或预料的要早。
explanation_english: To do something earlier than originally planned or expected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提早出門口，費事塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 zou2 ceot1 mun4 hau2, fai3 si6 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要提前出门，免得堵车。
examples.english_sentence: We need to leave earlier to avoid traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提早咗成個鐘到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 zou2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他提前了一个小时到了。
examples.english_sentence: He arrived an hour early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以提早完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 tai4 zou2 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以提前完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We can finish this project ahead of schedule.

english_meaning: proposal; motion; bill
explanation_mandarin: 指在会议、组织等场合提出的建议或方案；提出建议或方案。
explanation_english: A proposal or motion put forward for consideration, typically in a formal setting such as a meeting or organization; to propose a suggestion or plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅銷售團隊提交咗一份新嘅提案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 siu1 sau6 teoi4 deoi2 tai4 gip1 zo2 jat1 fan6 san1 ge3 tai4 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的销售团队提交了一份新的提案。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's sales team submitted a new proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住喺聽日嘅會議度提案，建議改善員工福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 hai2 ting1 jat6 ge3 wui2 ji5 dou6 tai4 on3, gin3 ji5 gaai2 sin6 jyun4 gung1 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算在明天的会议上提案，建议改善员工福利。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to propose at tomorrow's meeting, suggesting improvements to employee benefits.

english_meaning: to withdraw money
explanation_mandarin: 从银行或自动取款机中取出钱。
explanation_english: To take money out of a bank account, usually from a bank or an ATM.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺櫃員機度提款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 dou6 tai4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在自动取款机取款了。
examples.english_sentence: I withdrew money from the ATM yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提款提咗成五千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 fun2 tai4 zo2 seng4 ng5 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他取款取了整整五千元。
examples.english_sentence: He withdrew as much as five thousand dollars.

english_meaning: ATM card, debit card
explanation_mandarin: 用于在自动取款机（ATM）上提取现金的银行卡。
explanation_english: A bank card used to withdraw cash from an automated teller machine (ATM).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我睇下呢張提款卡仲用唔用得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 ni1 zoeng1 tai4 fun2 kaat1 zung6 yung6 m4 yung6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我看看这张提款卡还能不能用。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me check if this ATM card is still usable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗帶提款卡，攞唔到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 tai4 fun2 kaat1, lo2 m4 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不记得带提款卡了，取不到钱。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my ATM card, so I can't withdraw money.

mandarin_meaning: 自动取款机 (zì dòng qǔ kuǎn jī)
english_meaning: ATM (Automated Teller Machine); Figuratively, a person who provides money constantly
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是自动取款机。 比喻经常提供金钱的人，尤指配偶或家人。
explanation_english: Literally means ATM (Automated Teller Machine). Figuratively, refers to a person who provides money constantly, especially a spouse or family member.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當咗佢老公係提款機，日日都問佢攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 zo2 keoi5 lou5 gung1 hai6 tai4 fun2 gei1, jat1 jat1 dou1 man6 keoi5 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她把她老公当成了提款机，每天都问他要钱。
examples.english_sentence: She treats her husband like an ATM, asking him for money every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將父母當提款機啊，自己都要努力賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 fu6 mou5 dong3 tai4 fun2 gei1 aa3, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nou5 lik6 zaan6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把父母当成提款机啊，自己也要努力赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat your parents like an ATM; you need to work hard and earn money yourself.

english_meaning: To give someone a hint; to coach; to help someone with information, often secretly; to tip someone off
explanation_mandarin: 指给他人提供帮助，提示或提供信息，尤其是在他们遇到困难或需要帮助时。有时也指暗中给他人通风报信。
explanation_english: Refers to providing help, hints, or information to someone, especially when they are facing difficulties or need assistance. Sometimes it also refers to secretly tipping someone off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣，可唔可以提水俾我呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 go2 zan6, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tai4 seoi2 bei2 ngo5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候，能不能给我提示一下啊？
examples.english_sentence: During the exam, can you give me some hints?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢提水俾我，話聽日會捉人，叫我小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai4 seoi2 bei2 ngo5, waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 zuk1 jan4, giu3 ngo5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给我通风报信，说明天会抓人，叫我小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He tipped me off that they'll be arresting people tomorrow, telling me to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿sir成日提水，我地先可以咁順利完成個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir4 sing4 jat6 tai4 seoi2, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 seon6 lei6 waan4 sing4 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师经常提示，我们才可以这么顺利完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher often gave us hints, that's how we were able to complete the project so smoothly.

english_meaning: to extract; to refine; to purify
explanation_mandarin: 提取精华，使精纯。
explanation_english: To extract or refine something, removing impurities and making it pure or concentrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要從經驗入面提煉出教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 ging1 gim6 jap6 min6 tai4 lin6 chut1 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要从经验中提炼出教训。
examples.english_sentence: We need to extract lessons from our experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司提煉石油。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 tai4 lin6 si4 yau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司提炼石油。
examples.english_sentence: This company refines petroleum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗幾年時間嚟提煉佢嘅寫作技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 gei2 nin4 si4 gaan3 lai4 tai4 lin6 keoi5 ge3 se2 jok3 gei2 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了几年时间来提炼他的写作技巧。
examples.english_sentence: He spent several years refining his writing skills.

english_meaning: violin
explanation_mandarin: 一种弦乐器，四根弦，用弓拉奏。
explanation_english: A stringed instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎，細細個就開始學提琴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hok6 tai4 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害，很小的时候就开始学小提琴。
examples.english_sentence: He is very talented, he started learning the violin when he was very young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個音樂廳晚晚都有提琴演奏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 yam1 ngok6 ting1 maan5 maan5 dou1 jau5 tai4 kam4 yin2 zau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个音乐厅每天晚上都有小提琴演奏。
examples.english_sentence: There's violin performance every night in that concert hall.

english_meaning: hint; clue; prompt; reminder; to remind; to prompt
explanation_mandarin: 指提醒、启发或暗示。
explanation_english: To give a hint, clue, reminder or prompt someone, indicating something indirectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗啲提示我，等我可以搵到份禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2啲 tai4 si6 ngo5, dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6.
