examples.english_sentence: You'd better not get involved in this matter, it's very complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都要插手，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 caap3 sau2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都要插手，真的很烦人。
examples.english_sentence: He meddles in everything, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: to interrupt, to butt in
explanation_mandarin: 打断别人的谈话，参与到别人的对话中。
explanation_english: To interrupt someone's conversation, to join in a conversation uninvited or inappropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日插把嘴啦，等我講埋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 caap3 baa2 zeoi2 laa1, dang2 ngo5 gong2 maai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是插嘴了，等我说完先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always butt in, let me finish speaking first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋講緊公司嘅嘢，你唔好插把嘴啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gong2 gan2 gung1 si1 ge3 je5, nei5 m4 hou2 caap3 baa2 zeoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在谈论公司的事情，你不要插嘴了。
examples.english_sentence: They are talking about company matters, don't interrupt.

english_meaning: to interrupt a broadcast, to cut in (on a broadcast), commercial break (in a broadcast)
explanation_mandarin: 在广播或电视节目中临时插入一段节目或广告。
explanation_english: To interrupt a broadcast with an announcement or commercial; a commercial break.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先睇電視嗰陣突然間插播咗段廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 tai2 din6 si6 go2 zan6 dat6 jin4 gaan1 caap3 bo3 zo2 dyun6 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才看电视的时候突然插播了一段广告。
examples.english_sentence: An advertisement suddenly cut in when I was watching TV just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋節目嘅贊助商想喺中間插播多一個廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zit3 muk6 ge3 zaan3 zo6 soeng1 soeng2 hai2 zung1 gaan1 caap3 bo3 do1 jat1 go3 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们节目的赞助商想在中间插播多一个广告。
examples.english_sentence: Our program's sponsor wants to insert one more advertisement in the middle.

english_meaning: To plant a flag; to claim territory; to establish a presence; to mark territory; to take over
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是插上旗子，引申为占领地盘，宣示主权，或是在某个领域取得优势。
explanation_english: Literally means to plant a flag. Figuratively, it means to claim territory, assert dominance, establish a presence, or gain an advantage in a particular area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺個市場度插咗旗，其他嘅商販都競爭唔過佢哋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 go3 si5 coeng4 dou6 caap3 zo2 kei4, kei4 taa1 ge3 soeng1 faan2 dou1 ging6 zang1 m4 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在市场上插了旗，其他的商贩都竞争不过他们了。
examples.english_sentence: They've planted their flag in the market, and the other vendors can't compete with them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想喺大陸市場插旗，所以派咗好多人上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 hai2 daai6 luk6 si5 coeng4 caap3 kei4, so2 ji5 paai3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想在中国大陆市场插旗，所以派了很多人上去。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to establish a presence in the Chinese mainland market, so they sent a lot of people there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就同佢表白，咪即係想插旗囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 tung4 keoi5 biu2 baak6, mai1 zik1 hai6 soeng2 caap3 kei4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就向她表白，不就是想占有她吗！
examples.english_sentence: You confessed to her so quickly, aren't you just trying to claim her as yours!

mandarin_meaning: 插曲; 小插曲; 意外事件
english_meaning: interlude; episode; incidental music; digression; (minor) hitch; unexpected episode
explanation_mandarin: 原指戏剧或电影中穿插的音乐段落，后来也指生活中突然发生的小事件或变故，通常是暂时性的。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a musical interlude in a drama or film. It can also refer to a minor event or unexpected incident that occurs in life, usually temporary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅旅程遇到咗啲小插曲，但係最終都順利完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 leoi5 cing4 jyu6 dou2 zo2 di1 siu2 caap3 kuk1, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 seon6 lei6 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的旅程遇到了一些小插曲，但是最终都顺利完成了。
examples.english_sentence: Our trip encountered some minor hitches, but it was eventually completed successfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅愛情故事雖然有啲插曲，但係最後都修成正果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 oi3 cing4 gu3 si6 seoi1 jin4 jau5 di1 caap3 kuk1, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 sau1 sing4 zeng3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爱情故事虽然有些插曲，但是最后都修成正果。
examples.english_sentence: Although there were some episodes in his love story, they finally ended up happily ever after.

mandarin_meaning: 假摔; 诈骗; 虚报
english_meaning: To dive; to feign a fall (especially in sports); to exaggerate or fabricate information for personal gain; to exaggerate costs or expenses; to scam; to fabricate.
explanation_mandarin: 原本指跳水运动，后来引申为在足球等运动中故意摔倒以骗取犯规。也用来指为了个人利益而夸大或捏造信息，虚报费用，或者进行诈骗行为。
explanation_english: Originally referring to diving in sports, it has been extended to mean deliberately falling in sports like football to deceive the referee into calling a foul. It can also refer to exaggerating or fabricating information for personal gain, inflating expenses, or engaging in fraudulent activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺禁區入面插水，想呃個十二碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam3 keoi1 jap6 min6 caap3 seoi2, soeng2 aak1 go3 sap6 ji6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在禁区内假摔，想骗个点球。
examples.english_sentence: He dived in the penalty area, trying to cheat for a penalty kick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司報銷嘅數目有啲古怪，好似有插水嘅成分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bou3 siu1 ge3 sou3 muk6 jau5 di1 gu2 gwaai3, hou2 ci5 jau5 caap3 seoi2 ge3 sing4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司报销的数目有些奇怪，好像有虚报的成分。
examples.english_sentence: The company's reimbursement amounts are a bit strange, it seems like there's some exaggeration involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再插水啦，冇人會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 caap3 seoi2 laa1, mou5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再假装了，没有人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep faking it, nobody will believe you.

english_meaning: Nodding the head like a diver plunging into water; vehemetly shaking the head (in disagreement or disapproval)
explanation_mandarin: 形容点头幅度很大，像跳水运动员跳水一样；或者形容摇头幅度很大，非常反对或不同意。
explanation_english: Describes nodding one's head vigorously and repeatedly, as if diving into water. Can also describe shaking one's head vehemently to express strong disagreement or disapproval. The image conjured is one of exaggerated and forceful movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽完個提議之後，即刻插水式頭搥，睇嚟佢好贊成喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jyun4 go3 tai4 ji5 zi1 hau6, zik1 haak1 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 chui4, tai2 lai4 keoi5 hou2 zaan3 sing4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听完这个提议之后，立刻像跳水一样点头，看来他很赞成啊。
examples.english_sentence: After listening to the suggestion, he immediately nodded his head like a diver plunging into water, it seems he's very supportive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我話請佢食飯，佢就插水式頭搥，驚死我唔記得咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 waa6 cheng2 keoi5 sik6 faan6, keoi5 zau6 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 chui4, geng1 sei2 ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我说请他吃饭，他就一个劲儿点头，好像很怕我忘记一样。
examples.english_sentence: When I said I'd treat him to a meal, he nodded his head enthusiastically, as if afraid I'd forget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問佢借錢，佢即刻插水式頭搥，擺明唔想借啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 keoi5 ze3 chin2, keoi5 zik1 haak1 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 chui4, baai2 ming4 m4 seung2 ze3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问他借钱，他立刻摇头，摆明不想借。
examples.english_sentence: When I asked him to lend me money, he immediately shook his head vehemently, clearly not wanting to lend it.

mandarin_meaning: 跳水式头球 / 比喻非常努力或孤注一掷的尝试
english_meaning: Diving header (literally); a desperate or all-out attempt; a last-ditch effort.
explanation_mandarin: 原指足球运动中，球员跳跃着以头撞球，像跳水一样。现在多比喻非常努力，不顾一切地尝试某事，甚至带有孤注一掷的意味。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a diving header in football (soccer), where a player leaps forward and heads the ball. Figuratively, it describes a desperate or all-out effort, a last-ditch attempt to achieve something, often implying a sense of recklessness or desperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗今次嘅考試，真係用咗插水式頭槌嘅精神去溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gam1 ci3 ge3 haau2 si5, zan1 hai6 yung6 zo2 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 ceoi4 ge3 zing1 san4 heoi3 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这次考试，他真的是用了跳水式头球的精神去复习。
examples.english_sentence: He really studied with the spirit of a diving header for this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司已經去到末路，唯有用插水式頭槌嘅方式去搏一搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 mut6 lou6, wai4 jau5 yung6 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 ceoi4 ge3 fong1 sik1 heoi3 bok3 jat1 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经走投无路，唯有用跳水式头球的方式去搏一搏。
examples.english_sentence: The company has reached the end of the road, and the only way is to take a gamble with a diving header approach.

english_meaning: Diving header; To dive (in football to feign a foul)
explanation_mandarin: 原指足球运动中一种头球的进攻方式，球员以俯冲姿势用头顶球。引申义指足球比赛中为了骗取犯规而故意摔倒的行为，也叫“假摔”。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a header in football where a player dives forward to head the ball.  In extended usage, it refers to a deliberate fall in football, designed to deceive the referee into awarding a foul. Also known as a 'dive'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺禁區裡面插水式頭鎚，想搏十二碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam3 keoi1 leoi5 min6 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 teoi4, soeng2 bok3 sap6 ji6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在禁区里假摔，想骗点球。
examples.english_sentence: He dived in the penalty area, trying to get a penalty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個前鋒用咗個插水式頭鎚，好彩冇受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cin4 fung1 yung6 zo2 go3 caap3 seoi2 sik1 tau4 teoi4, hou2 coi2 mou5 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个前锋用了一个俯冲式头球，幸好没有受伤。
examples.english_sentence: That striker used a diving header, luckily he wasn't injured.

english_meaning: to transfer to a class in the middle of a school year; to enroll mid-term
explanation_mandarin: 指学生在学期中途转入一个新班级学习。
explanation_english: To join a class or school in the middle of the term/year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人移民咗去加拿大，佢返嚟香港之後就插班入咗中學三年級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6, keoi5 faan1 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 zi1 hau6 zau6 caap3 baan1 jap6 zo2 zung1 hok6 saam1 nin4 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人移民去了加拿大，他回到香港之后就插班进入了中学三年级。
examples.english_sentence: His family immigrated to Canada, and after he returned to Hong Kong, he transferred to Year 9 in secondary school mid-term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔今年想插班入你間小學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 gam1 nin4 soeng2 caap3 baan1 jap6 nei5 gaan1 siu2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我儿子今年想插班进入你们小学。
examples.english_sentence: My son wants to transfer to your primary school this year.

english_meaning: transfer student
explanation_mandarin: 指中途转学进入某个班级的学生。
explanation_english: A student who joins a class or school after the academic year has already started.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今年嘅插班生，啱啱先嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 nin4 ge3 caap3 baan1 sang1, ngaam1 ngaam1 sin1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是今年的插班生，刚来。
examples.english_sentence: He's the transfer student this year, he just arrived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做插班生要快啲適應新嘅環境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 caap3 baan1 sang1 jiu3 faai3 di1 sik1 ying3 san1 ge3 waan4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做插班生要快点适应新的环境。
examples.english_sentence: As a transfer student, you need to adapt to the new environment quickly.

cantonese: 插田插到立夏，插唔插都罷
jyutping: caap3 tin4 caap3 dou3 lap6 haa6, caap3 m4 caap3 dou1 baa6
mandarin_meaning: 过了立夏才插秧，插与不插都无所谓了；比喻错过了最佳时机，做不做都无关紧要
english_meaning: Planting rice seedlings until the start of summer, it doesn't matter whether you plant or not; meaning missing the opportune moment, it doesn't matter whether you do it or not.
explanation_mandarin: 立夏是夏季的开始，过了立夏才插秧已经错过了最佳的种植时机，收成肯定会受到影响。因此，插不插已经意义不大。比喻错过最好的时机，再做这件事已经没有太大意义，结果也不会太好。
explanation_english: The start of summer (立夏) is the best time to plant rice seedlings. Planting after this period means missing the optimal time, and the harvest will be affected. Therefore, whether or not to plant anymore doesn't matter much. It's an idiom used to describe missing the opportune moment, and doing something afterwards won't make much of a difference, and the result won't be good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家先嚟準備考試，都插田插到立夏，插唔插都罷啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 zyun2 bei6 haau2 si3, dou1 caap3 tin4 caap3 dou3 lap6 haa6, caap3 m4 caap3 dou1 baa6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才来准备考试，都错过最佳时机了，考不考都无所谓了。
examples.english_sentence: You're only starting to prepare for the exam now; you've missed the opportune moment, so it doesn't matter whether you take it or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨咁耐都賣唔出，依家先至減價，真係插田插到立夏，插唔插都罷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 gam3 noi6 dou1 maai6 m4 ceot1, ji1 gaa1 sin1 zi3 gaam2 gaa3, zan1 hai6 caap3 tin4 caap3 dou3 lap6 haa6, caap3 m4 caap3 dou1 baa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货这么久都卖不出去，现在才降价，真是错过了时机，降不降价都无所谓了。
examples.english_sentence: These goods haven't been sold for so long, and you're only reducing the price now. You've really missed the opportune moment, it doesn't matter whether you reduce the price or not.

english_meaning: illustration
explanation_mandarin: 指为文字或故事配的图画，通常具有装饰或说明功能。
explanation_english: An illustration is a decoration, interpretation or visual explanation of a text, concept or process, designed for integration in published media, such as posters, flyers, magazines, books, teaching materials, animations, video games and films.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書嘅插畫畫得好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ge3 caap3 waa2 waa2 dak1 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的插画画得真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: The illustrations in this book are so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，好鍾意睇有好多插畫嘅兒童書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jau5 hou2 do1 caap3 waa2 ge3 ji4 tung4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，很喜欢看有很多插画的儿童书。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I loved reading children's books with lots of illustrations.

english_meaning: to crack jokes; to banter; to clown around; to interject humorous remarks
explanation_mandarin: 指在戏曲表演中穿插一些滑稽的动作、语言或小笑话，以活跃气氛，引人发笑。也比喻在其他场合用诙谐的言语或动作来逗乐。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of interjecting humorous actions, language, or short jokes into theatrical performances to liven up the atmosphere and make people laugh. It can also be used metaphorically to describe using humorous speech or actions to amuse people in other contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺開會嘅時候插科打諢，搞到大家都忍唔住笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 hoi1 wui2 ge3 si4 hau6 caap3 fo1 daa2 wan6, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jan2 m4 zyu6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在开会的时候插科打诨，搞得大家都忍不住笑。
examples.english_sentence: He often cracks jokes during meetings, making everyone unable to help but laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多插科打諢啦，我哋要認真傾下件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 caap3 fo1 daa2 wan6 laa1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jing6 zan1 king1 haa5 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么多插科打诨了，我们要认真谈一下这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't joke around so much, we need to seriously discuss this matter.

english_meaning: to transplant rice seedlings
explanation_mandarin: 将水稻秧苗从育苗地移植到稻田中。
explanation_english: The act of transplanting rice seedlings from a nursery bed to a paddy field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺以前成日都要落田插秧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 lok6 tin4 caap3 joeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷以前经常都要下田插秧。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather used to go down to the fields to transplant rice seedlings all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲農夫通常都用機器插秧，唔使人手插咁辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nung4 fu1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 jung6 gei1 hei3 caap3 joeng1, m4 sai2 jan4 sau2 caap3 gam3 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的农民通常都用机器插秧，不用人工插秧那么辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, farmers usually use machines to transplant rice seedlings, so they don't have to do it manually, which is hard work.

english_meaning: To be unable to escape even if one had wings; to be trapped with no way out; no escape
explanation_mandarin: 比喻陷入绝境，即使插上翅膀也难以飞走，形容处境非常困难，无法摆脱。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone is trapped and unable to escape, even if they were given wings. It implies a hopeless situation with no chance of breaking free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾班差人圍住，今次真係插翼難飛啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 baan1 caai1 jan4 wai4 zyu6, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 caap3 jik6 naan4 fei1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被警察包围了，这次真的是插翅难飞了。
examples.english_sentence: He's surrounded by the police; this time he really has no escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司欠債咁多，而家已經到咗插翼難飛嘅地步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 him3 zai3 gam3 do1, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 dou3 zo2 caap3 jik6 naan4 fei1 ge3 dei6 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司欠债那么多，现在已经到了插翅难飞的地步。
examples.english_sentence: The company has so much debt; it's now reached a point of no return.

english_meaning: Mechanical pencil
explanation_mandarin: 一种使用铅芯，需要按压或转动笔杆末端来推出铅芯的铅笔。
explanation_english: A type of pencil that uses lead refills and dispenses the lead by pressing or twisting the end of the pencil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用插芯筆寫字，唔使刨。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望可以在演艺界扬名立万。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to make a name for himself in the entertainment industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住自己嘅努力，終於喺商界揚名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6, zung1 jyu1 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 joeng4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠着自己的努力，终于在商界扬名。
examples.english_sentence: He finally became famous in the business world through his own efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個年輕嘅科學家因為佢嘅突破性研究而揚名國際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 nin4 hing1 ge3 fo1 hok6 gaa1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 ge3 dat6 po3 sing3 jin4 gau3 ji4 joeng4 ming4 gwok3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个年轻的科学家因为他的突破性研究而扬名国际。
examples.english_sentence: This young scientist gained international fame for his groundbreaking research.

english_meaning: to make a name for oneself; to achieve lasting fame and success
explanation_mandarin: 指创立功业，使名声流传后世。
explanation_english: To establish a name and reputation that will last for generations; to achieve great success and lasting fame through one's achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望可以喺呢個行業揚名立萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 joeng4 ming4 lap6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望可以在这个行业扬名立万。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to achieve lasting fame and success in this industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺電影界揚名立萬唔係一件容易嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 din6 ying2 gaai3 joeng4 ming4 lap6 maan6 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 yung4 yi6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要在电影界扬名立万不是一件容易的事。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to achieve lasting fame and success in the film industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅發明令佢喺科學界揚名立萬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 faat3 ming5 ling6 keoi5 hai2 fo1 hok6 gaai3 joeng4 ming4 lap6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的发明使他在科学界扬名立万。
examples.english_sentence: His invention helped him achieve lasting fame and success in the scientific community.

english_meaning: to show off one's power, to flaunt one's might, to achieve glory
explanation_mandarin: 显扬威风，使威名远扬。
explanation_english: To show off one's power and prestige, to make one's name and authority known far and wide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺運動比賽度攞咗冠軍，真係為學校揚威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wan6 dung6 bei2 coi3 dou6 lo2 zo2 gwun3 gwan1, zan1 hai6 wai4 hok6 haau6 joeng4 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在运动比赛中获得了冠军，真是为学校扬威。
examples.english_sentence: He won the championship in the sports competition, truly bringing glory to the school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港運動員喺奧運會揚威國際。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 wan6 dung6 jyun4 hai2 ou3 wan6 wui2 joeng4 wai1 gwok3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港运动员在奥运会上扬威国际。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong athletes showed their strength internationally at the Olympics.

english_meaning: To raise a hand; to wave
explanation_mandarin: 抬起手，通常是为了打招呼、示意或者表示赞同。
explanation_english: To raise one's hand, usually to greet someone, signal, or show approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揚手同佢講拜拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joeng4 sau2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 baai1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我挥手和她说了再见。
examples.english_sentence: I waved goodbye to her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揚手示意我哋埋去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 sau2 si3 ji3 ngo5 dei6 maai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他举手示意我们过去。
examples.english_sentence: He waved for us to come over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果同意，請揚手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 tung4 yi3, ching2 joeng4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果同意，请举手。
examples.english_sentence: If you agree, please raise your hand.

english_meaning: Triumphant, swaggering, puffed up with pride; showing off
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常得意，骄傲的样子，常常带有一种炫耀和自满的意味。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely triumphant and proud, often with a sense of showing off and being self-satisfied.  It implies a swaggering or puffed-up demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試攞到第一名，成日都揚揚貢咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, seng4 jat6 dou1 joeng4 joeng4 gung3 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试得了第一名，整天都得意洋洋的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam and has been swaggering around triumphantly all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁揚揚貢啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 joeng4 joeng4 gung3 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么得意洋洋的，低调一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so puffed up with pride, it's better to be low-key.

english_meaning: to declare; to proclaim; to announce; to make something known; to show off; to flaunt
explanation_mandarin: 公开宣称；张扬；扩大声势。
explanation_english: To publicly declare or announce something; to promote or make something known; to show off or flaunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揚聲自己幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 joeng4 seng1 zi6 gei2 gam3 le1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是声称自己有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He always boasts about how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁揚聲啦，低調啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 joeng4 seng1 laa1, dai1 diu6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么张扬，低调一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so ostentatious, it's better to be low-key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揚聲話要辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 seng1 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他声称要辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He announced that he was going to resign.

english_meaning: loudspeaker, speaker
explanation_mandarin: 一种将电信号转化为声音的设备，通常用于放大声音。
explanation_english: A device that converts electrical signals into sound, typically used to amplify sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部揚聲器啲聲好大聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 joeng4 sing1 hei3 di1 seng1 hou2 daai6 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台扬声器的声音很大。
examples.english_sentence: The sound from this speaker is very loud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要買個新嘅揚聲器嚟搞party。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 ge3 joeng4 sing1 hei3 lai4 gaau2 party.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要买一个新的扬声器来举办派对。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy a new speaker to have a party.

english_meaning: to declare, to threaten, to vow, to profess (often falsely or boastfully)
explanation_mandarin: 公开声称或宣扬，通常带有威胁或夸张的意味。
explanation_english: To publicly declare or proclaim, often with a threatening or exaggerated connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揚言要報仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 jin4 jiu3 bou3 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扬言要报仇。
examples.english_sentence: He vowed to take revenge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揚言會辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 jin4 wui5 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扬言要辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He declared that he would resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揚言要告間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng4 jin4 jiu3 gou3 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他扬言要起诉那家公司。
examples.english_sentence: He threatened to sue the company.

english_meaning: to strut away; to swagger off; to leave triumphantly
explanation_mandarin: 形容得意地离开，或者带着胜利者的姿态离去。
explanation_english: Describes leaving triumphantly, or leaving with the demeanor of a victor. Often implies arrogance or a feeling of superiority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽之後，揚長而去，好威風咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3 zi1 hau6, joeng4 coeng4 ji4 heoi3, hou2 wai1 fung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛之后，扬长而去，非常威风。
examples.english_sentence: After winning the competition, he strutted away triumphantly, looking very imposing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明鬧完老闆一餐之後，揚長而去，真係好有型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 naau6 jyun4 lou5 baan2 jat1 caan1 zi1 hau6, joeng4 coeng4 ji4 heoi3, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明骂了老板一顿之后，扬长而去，真是很帅气。
examples.english_sentence: After giving the boss a scolding, Ah Ming swaggered off, it was really cool.

english_meaning: to publicize; to make something known; to show off; to spread (news); to disclose
explanation_mandarin: 把事情、消息或秘密公开或广泛传播；炫耀、张扬自己的成就或能力。
explanation_english: To make something public, known, or widespread; to show off or flaunt one's achievements or abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有少少成就就揚開晒俾全世界知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 siu2 siu2 sing4 zau6 zau6 joeng4 hoi1 saai3 bei2 sai3 gaai3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一点成就就向全世界宣扬。
examples.english_sentence: He publicizes his minor achievements to the whole world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁揚開件事，唔係佢會好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 joeng4 hoi1 gin6 si6, m4 hai6 keoi5 wui5 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么宣扬这件事，不然他会很生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't publicize this matter so much, or he will be very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揚開呢件事，對佢唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 joeng4 hoi1 ni1 gin6 si6, deoi3 keoi5 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要宣扬这件事，对他不好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spread this matter, it's not good for him.

english_meaning: to exchange; to change; to switch; to convert
explanation_mandarin: 改变；替换。
explanation_english: To exchange something for something else; to change or replace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想換返啲港紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 faan1 di1 gong2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想换一些港币。
examples.english_sentence: I want to exchange for some Hong Kong dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦壞咗，要換過部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 gwo3 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电脑坏了，要换一部新的。
examples.english_sentence: My computer is broken, I need to replace it with a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗份新工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 fan6 san1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了一份新工作。
examples.english_sentence: He changed to a new job.

english_meaning: To put oneself in someone else's shoes; to think from another person's perspective; perspective-taking
explanation_mandarin: 从别人的角度思考问题，理解别人的感受和立场。
explanation_english: To consider a situation or problem from another person's point of view in order to understand their feelings, motives, and needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下換位思考，就明點解佢咁做喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 wun6 wai2 si1 haau1, zau6 ming4 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 gam2 zou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试着换位思考一下，就明白他为什么这么做了。
examples.english_sentence: If you try to put yourself in his shoes, you'll understand why he did that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺團隊合作入面，換位思考好重要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 tyun4 deoi2 hap6 zok3 jap6 min6, wun6 wai2 si1 haau1 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在团队合作中，换位思考很重要。
examples.english_sentence: In teamwork, it's very important to think from each other's perspectives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有時遇到問題，換位思考可以幫助你諗到新嘅解決方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 si4 jyu6 dou2 man6 tai4, wun6 wai2 si1 haau1 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 nam2 dou2 san1 ge3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候遇到问题，换位思考可以帮助你想到新的解决方案。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes when you encounter problems, thinking from another perspective can help you come up with new solutions.

synonyms: 設身處地 (sit3 san1 cyu2 dei6)
將心比心 (zoeng1 sam1 bei2 sam1)

english_meaning: to exchange for, to barter, to gain by exchanging
explanation_mandarin: 用某种事物交换得到另一种事物。
explanation_english: To obtain something by exchanging it for something else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用嗮啲積分嚟換取咗張戲飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 saai3 di1 jik1 fan1 lai4 wun6 ceoi2 zo2 zoeng1 hei3 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用完所有积分来换取了一张电影票。
examples.english_sentence: He used up all his points to exchange for a movie ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力讀書，先可以換取美好嘅將來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, sin1 ho2 yi5 wun6 ceoi2 mei5 hou2 ge3 jeung1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力读书，才可以换取美好的将来。
examples.english_sentence: We need to study hard in order to exchange for a bright future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用自由換取咗財富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zi6 yau4 wun6 ceoi2 zo2 choi4 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用自由换取了财富。
examples.english_sentence: He exchanged his freedom for wealth.

english_meaning: in other words; to put it another way
explanation_mandarin: 用不同的说法来表达相同的意思。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a rephrasing of a previous statement, clarifying its meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想再同你一齊，換句話說，佢想同你分手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, keoi5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 fan1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想再和你在一起了，换句话说，他想和你分手。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to be with you anymore; in other words, he wants to break up with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃失敗咗，換句話說，我哋要重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 sat1 baai6 zo2, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划失败了，换句话说，我们要重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: The plan failed; in other words, we have to start over.

english_meaning: In other words; that is to say; to put it another way
explanation_mandarin: 用另一种方式来表达相同的意思。
explanation_english: Used to rephrase something previously said in a different way, usually to make it clearer or simpler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想同你拍拖，換句話說，佢唔鍾意你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 paak3 to1, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想和你谈恋爱，换句话说，他不喜欢你。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to date you; in other words, he doesn't like you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠啦，換句話說，我失業啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 laap1 laa3, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, ngo5 sat1 jip6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，换句话说，我失业了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is closed down; in other words, I'm unemployed.

english_meaning: In other words; Put another way
explanation_mandarin: 表示用另一种方式来表达相同的意思，以便更容易理解。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a rephrasing of a statement to make it clearer or more emphatic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想返工，換句話説，佢想辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 faan1 gung1, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, keoi5 soeng2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想上班，换句话说，他想辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to go to work. In other words, he wants to quit his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冇晒錢喇，換句話説，我哋身無分文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mou5 saai3 cin2 laa3, wun6 geoi3 waa6 syut3, ngo5 dei6 san1 mou4 fan1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们没钱了，换句话说，我们身无分文。
examples.english_sentence: We've run out of money. In other words, we're broke.

synonyms: 簡單嚟講 (gaan2 daan1 lai4 gong2)

english_meaning: in other words; to put it another way
explanation_mandarin: 表示用另一种方式表达相同的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates expressing the same meaning in a different way; a phrase used to rephrase or clarify a previous statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢即係唔想做喇，換句話講，佢想辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zik1 hai6 m4 soeng2 zou6 laa3, wun6 geoi3 waa6 gong2, keoi5 soeng2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是不想做了，换句话说，他想辞职。
examples.english_sentence: He just doesn't want to do it anymore. In other words, he wants to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢件事冇興趣，換句話講，你唔使再同我講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 mou5 hing3 ceoi3, wun6 geoi3 waa6 gong2, nei5 m4 sai2 zoi3 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这件事没兴趣，换句话说，你不用再跟我说了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not interested in this. In other words, you don't need to tell me about it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇幫手，換句話講，佢袖手旁觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 bong1 sau2, wun6 geoi3 waa6 gong2, keoi5 sau1 sau2 pong4 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有帮忙，换句话说，他袖手旁观。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't help. In other words, he stood by and watched.

synonyms: 總而言之 (zung2 ji4 waan4 zi1)

english_meaning: change of season; to change seasons
explanation_mandarin: 指季节更替，或者因季节更替而更换衣物等。
explanation_english: Refers to the change of seasons, or the act of changing clothes, bedding, etc., due to the change of seasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換季喇，係時候執啲冬天衫出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 gwai3 laa3, hai6 si4 hau6 zap1 di1 dung1 tin1 saam1 ceot1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 换季了，是时候收拾一些冬天的衣服出来了。
examples.english_sentence: It's changing seasons, it's time to take out some winter clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我換季嘅時候，會將啲衫攞去洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wun6 gwai3 ge3 si4 hau6, wui5 zoeng1 di1 saam1 lo2 heoi3 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我换季的时候，会把衣服拿去洗。
examples.english_sentence: When the seasons change, I take the clothes to wash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近天氣咁反常，好似唔知換季未咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 gam3 faan2 soeng4, hou2 ci5 m4 zi1 wun6 gwai3 mei6 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近天气这么反常，好像不知道换季没换季似的。
examples.english_sentence: The weather has been so abnormal lately, it's like it doesn't know if the seasons have changed.

english_meaning: to change shift; to swap shifts
explanation_mandarin: 指工作人员之间交接班次，通常指完成一个班次的工作后，由另一位工作人员接替。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of handover between shifts of personnel, usually meaning that one worker completes their shift and is replaced by another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要換更，唔可以同你食飯喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 wun6 gang1, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要换班，不能和你吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to change shifts tomorrow, so I can't have dinner with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚唔該你幫我換更，我有急事要處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 wun6 gang1, ngo5 jau5 gap1 si6 jiu3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚麻烦你帮我换班，我有急事要处理。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please cover my shift tonight? I have an urgent matter to deal with.

english_meaning: to move to a bigger/better house; to upgrade one's house; to trade up in housing
explanation_mandarin: 指卖掉现在的房子，然后购买更大或更好的房子。通常是因为家庭成员增加、经济条件改善等原因。
explanation_english: Refers to selling one's current house and then buying a larger or better house. This is usually due to reasons such as an increase in family members or improved economic conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋儲咗咁耐錢，終於可以換樓喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cou5 zo2 gam3 noi6 cin2, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 wun6 lau2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们攒了这么久的钱，终于可以换房子了！
examples.english_sentence: We've saved money for so long, we can finally move to a bigger house!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港樓價咁貴，換樓真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 lau2 gaa3 gam3 gwai3, wun6 lau2 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港房价这么贵，换房子真不容易。
examples.english_sentence: House prices in Hong Kong are so expensive, moving to a bigger house is really not easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最近換咗樓，搬咗去個海景單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 gan6 wun6 zo2 lau2, bun1 zo2 heoi3 go3 hoi2 ging2 daan1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最近换了房子，搬去了一个海景房。
examples.english_sentence: They recently moved to a bigger house and moved to a sea view apartment.

english_meaning: New bottle, old wine; changing the form but not the substance; same stuff in a different package
explanation_mandarin: 比喻名称或形式虽然改变，实质却未变。
explanation_english: A metaphor for changing the form or presentation of something while the underlying content or substance remains the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋次次都係換湯不換葯，唔好咁快信佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ci3 ci3 dou1 hai6 wun6 tong1 bat1 wun6 joek6, m4 hou2 gam2 faai3 seon3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们每次都是换汤不换药，不要这么快相信他们。
examples.english_sentence: They always just change the packaging but the content remains the same, don't trust them so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新政策其實都係換湯不換葯啫，對我哋冇咩實際嘅幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 kei4 sat6 dou1 hai6 wun6 tong1 bat1 wun6 joek6 ze1, deoi3 ngo5 dei6 mou5 me1 sat6 zai3 ge3 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新政策其实还是换汤不换药而已，对我们没什么实际的帮助。
examples.english_sentence: This new policy is actually just the same old wine in a new bottle; it doesn't really help us.

english_meaning: new bottle, same wine; cosmetic changes only; same medicine, different broth
explanation_mandarin: 比喻名称或形式改变了，而实质没有变。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where superficial changes are made, but the underlying substance or core remains the same. Like changing the soup but still using the same ingredients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話要改革，但係換湯不換藥，根本冇分別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3, daan6 hai6 wun6 tong1 bat1 wun6 joek6, gan1 bun2 mou5 fan1 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说要改革，但是换汤不换药，根本没有区别。
examples.english_sentence: They said they wanted to reform, but it's just a new bottle with the same wine; there's fundamentally no difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳轉咗個名，但啲嘢食都係咁難食，真係換湯不換藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zyun2 zo2 go3 meng2, daan6 di1 je5 sik6 dou1 hai6 gam3 naan4 sik6, zan1 hai6 wun6 tong1 bat1 wun6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅换了个名字，但是食物还是一样难吃，真是换汤不换药。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant changed its name, but the food is still just as bad, it's really just a new bottle with the same wine.

synonyms: 粉飾太平 (fan2 sik1 taai3 ping4) - whitewashing peace (superficial change to give a false impression of stability)

english_meaning: Same old thing in a new bottle; New wine in old bottles; Cosmetic change only; Change the appearance but not the substance.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻名称或形式改变了，实质却未变。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where only superficial changes are made, while the underlying issue or problem remains the same. It's like changing the soup in a medicinal broth but using the same ingredients, resulting in the same effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日話要改革，但係換湯唔換藥，啲政策都係一樣咁差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 waa6 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3, daan6 hai6 wun6 tong1 m4 wun6 joek6, di1 jing3 caak3 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6 gam3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说要改革，但是换汤不换药，那些政策还是一样那么差。
examples.english_sentence: They always say they're reforming, but it's the same old thing in a new bottle. The policies are still just as bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳轉咗個名，但係換湯唔換藥，啲嘢食都係一樣咁難食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zyun2 zo2 go3 ming2, daan6 hai6 wun6 tong1 m4 wun6 joek6, di1 je5 sik6 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6 gam3 naan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅换了名字，但是换汤不换药，那些食物还是一样那么难吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant changed its name, but it's the same old thing in a new bottle. The food is still just as bad.

synonyms: 有名無實 (jau5 ming4 mou4 sat6)
金玉其外，敗絮其中 (gam1 juk6 kei4 ngoi6, baai6 seoi5 kei4 zung1)

english_meaning: New bottle, same wine; Changing the soup but not the ingredients; Same old thing with a new facade
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只改变外表形式，而内容实质不变。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where superficial changes are made, but the underlying substance or nature remains the same. It suggests that despite a change in appearance or presentation, the fundamental problem or issue is not addressed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聲稱要改革，但係睇落換湯唔換藥，啲政策都係一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng1 cheng1 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3, daan6 hai6 tai2 lok6 wun6 tong1 m4 wun6 joek6, di1 jing3 chaak3 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们声称要改革，但是看起来换汤不换药，政策还是一样。
examples.english_sentence: They claim to be implementing reforms, but it seems like new bottle, same wine; the policies are still the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司轉咗新嘅市場策略，但啲產品都冇變，咪又係換湯唔換藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun2 zo2 san1 ge3 si5 coeng4 chaak3 leuk6, daan6 di1 caan2 ban2 dou1 mou5 bin3, mai1 jau6 hai6 wun6 tong1 m4 wun6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司换了新的市场策略，但是产品都没变，还不是换汤不换药。
examples.english_sentence: The company changed its marketing strategy, but the products haven't changed; it's just new bottle, same wine.

synonyms: 徒有虚名 (tou2 jau5 heoi1 ming4)
舊調重彈 (gau6 diu6 cung4 taan4)

english_meaning: to change shifts; to change teams; to replace someone on shift; changeover
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或任务中，人员进行交替或替换，通常按时间段或任务段进行。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of personnel switching or replacing each other in a job or task, usually done according to time slots or task segments. It can also refer to a change in a team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日早啲換班，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zou2 di1 wun6 baan1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天早点换班，好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we change shifts earlier tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚要換班，你準備好未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 jiu3 wun6 baan1, nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚要换班了，你准备好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: We have to change shifts tonight, are you ready?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成隊換班，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 deoi2 wun6 baan1, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整个队伍换班，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: They changed the whole team and started over.

mandarin_meaning: 更换画面; 换对象; 喜新厌旧
english_meaning: Change the scene; change the picture; change partners (in a relationship); to be fickle; to ditch someone for someone else (romantically)
explanation_mandarin: 原意指更换电影或电视的画面。引申义指更换交往对象，含有喜新厌旧，见异思迁的意味。
explanation_english: Originally referring to changing the scene in a movie or on television. In extended usage, it means to change romantic partners, with the connotation of being fickle, changing one's mind easily, or dumping someone for someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔成日換畫，真係好花心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 sing4 jat6 wun6 waa2, zan1 hai6 hou2 faa1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个男人总是换女朋友，真是太花心了。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is always changing girlfriends; he's really a heartbreaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快換畫，唔係咁好掛？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 wun6 waa2, m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 gwaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就换了对象，不太好吧？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't it a bit soon to change partners like that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲電視劇成日換畫，好難追落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 din6 si6 kek6 sing4 jat6 wun6 waa2, hou2 naan4 zeoi1 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视剧总是更换演员，很难继续追下去。
examples.english_sentence: The TV series keeps changing actors, making it hard to keep up with.

english_meaning: to convert, to calculate
explanation_mandarin: 指将一种单位或形式转换为另一种单位或形式。
explanation_english: To convert from one unit or form to another, to calculate or reckon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將港幣換算成美金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gong2 bai6 wun6 syun3 sing4 mei5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把港币换算成美金。
examples.english_sentence: I want to convert Hong Kong dollars into US dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以幫我換算下幾多公斤？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 wun6 syun3 haa5 gei2 do1 gung1 gan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我换算一下是多少公斤吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me convert it to kilograms?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要換算返做實際嘅成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 syun3 faan1 zou6 sat6 zai3 ge3 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要换算回实际的成本。
examples.english_sentence: We need to convert it back to the actual cost.

english_meaning: to replace with fresh blood; to rejuvenate; to replace old personnel with new blood
explanation_mandarin: 比喻更换组织或团体中的旧人员，引入新鲜血液，以求改进或发展。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to replace old personnel within an organization or group with new blood, in order to improve or develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司想換血，所以請咗好多後生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 wun6 hyut3, so2 ji5 ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 hau6 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司想换血，所以请了很多年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to rejuvenate, so they hired a lot of young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊表現咁差，都係時候換血啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 biu2 hin3 gam3 caa1, dou1 hai6 si4 hau6 wun6 hyut3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队表现这么差，也是时候换血了。
examples.english_sentence: The team's performance is so bad, it's time to bring in some new blood.

english_meaning: to change clothes
explanation_mandarin: 更换衣服。从身上脱下旧衣服，穿上新的或不同的衣服。
explanation_english: To change clothes; to take off the clothes one is wearing and put on different or new clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋出街之前要換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceot1 gaai1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们出门之前要换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: We need to change clothes before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB 仔污糟咗要即刻換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 zai2 wu1 zou1 zo2 jiu3 zik1 hak1 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿脏了要立刻换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: If the baby gets dirty, you need to change their clothes immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我返到屋企第一件事就係換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 dai6 jat1 gin6 si6 zau6 hai6 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我回到家的第一件事就是换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The first thing I do when I get home is change my clothes.

english_meaning: in other words; that is to say
explanation_mandarin: 用不同的说法表达相同的意思。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a rephrasing or clarification of a previous statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想做呢份工，換言之，佢想辭職啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ni1 fan6 gung1, wun6 jin4 zi1, keoi5 soeng2 ci4 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想做这份工作，换句话说，他想辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to do this job. In other words, he wants to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋冇錢，換言之，去唔到旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mou5 cin2, wun6 jin4 zi1, heoi3 m4 dou2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们没钱，换句话说，去不了旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We have no money. That is to say, we can't go traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔合格，換言之，佢要重讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hap6 gaak3, wun6 jin4 zi1, keoi5 jiu3 cung4 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没及格，换句话说，他要重修。
examples.english_sentence: He failed. In other words, he has to retake the course.

english_meaning: to change to; to switch; to imagine if; if it were the other way around
explanation_mandarin: 动词：改变成另外一种情况。连词：表示假设，如果情况相反会怎样。
explanation_english: Verb: To change to another situation or condition. Conjunction: Indicates a hypothetical situation, what would happen if the situation were reversed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換轉我係你，我就唔會咁做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 zyun2 ngo5 hai6 nei5, ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 gam2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我是你，我就不会这么做了。
examples.english_sentence: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 換轉個角度諗，其實佢都幾慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wun6 zyun2 go3 gok3 dou6 lam2, kei4 sat6 keoi5 dou1 gei2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 换个角度想想，其实他也挺可怜的。
examples.english_sentence: Thinking from another perspective, he's actually quite pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你換轉諗下，如果你係佢，你會點做？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wun6 zyun2 lam2 haa5, jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 keoi5, nei5 wui5 dim2 zou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你换位思考一下，如果你是他，你会怎么做？
examples.english_sentence: Put yourself in his shoes, what would you do if you were him?

english_meaning: to change a battery, to recharge (figuratively: to revitalize, to recharge one's energy)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是更换电池。也常用于比喻恢复精力、充电。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to change a battery'. It is often used figuratively to mean to recharge one's energy, to revitalize, or to take a break and get refreshed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話冇電，我要換電先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6, ngo5 jiu3 wun6 din6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话没电了，我得先换电池。
examples.english_sentence: My phone is out of battery. I need to change the battery first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近好攰，要放個假去換電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 gui6, jiu3 fong3 go3 gaa3 heoi3 wun6 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近很累，要放个假去充充电。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very tired lately, I need to take a vacation to recharge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完運動之後，飲杯嘢換下電啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 zi1 hau6, yam2 bui1 ye5 wun6 haa5 din6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动完之后，喝点东西充充电吧。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising, have a drink to recharge.

english_meaning: to redeem, to exchange for and receive
explanation_mandarin: 用憑證（如收據、優惠券等）交換領取物品或服務。
explanation_english: To exchange a voucher, coupon, receipt, etc. for goods or services; to redeem and receive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我張coupon到期前要換領禮品呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 coupon dou3 kei5 cin4 jiu3 wun6 ling5 lai5 ban2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的优惠券到期前要兑换礼品呀。
examples.english_sentence: I need to redeem the gift before my coupon expires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺邊度可以換領飛機餐？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bin1 dou6 ho2 ji5 wun6 ling5 fei1 gei1 caan1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在哪里可以兑换飞机餐？
examples.english_sentence: Where can I redeem my airline meal?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你中咗獎，快啲去換領獎品啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung3 zo2 zoeng2, faai3 di1 heoi3 wun6 ling5 zoeng2 ban2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你中奖了，快点去兑换奖品吧！
examples.english_sentence: You won a prize, go redeem it quickly!

english_meaning: to change horses; to replace someone (usually in a competition or leadership position); substitution
explanation_mandarin: 比喻替换人，通常指替换领导人或参与竞赛的人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for replacing someone, usually referring to replacing a leader or someone participating in a competition. Literally means 'to change horses'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟佢哋打算換馬，搵個更有經驗嘅人嚟做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 keoi5 dei6 daa2 syun3 wun6 maa5, wan2 go3 gang3 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 jan4 lai4 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来他们打算换人，找一个更有经验的人来做经理。
examples.english_sentence: It seems they are planning to change horses and find someone with more experience to be the manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波打得唔好，教練決定換馬，派個後備球員上場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 daa2 dak1 m4 hou2, gaau3 lin6 kyut3 ding6 wun6 maa5, paai3 go3 hau6 bei2 kau4 yun4 soeng5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛打得不好，教练决定换人，派个后备球员上场。
examples.english_sentence: The team isn't playing well, so the coach decided to make a substitution and send a substitute player onto the field.

english_meaning: to cover; to hide; to conceal
explanation_mandarin: 用东西遮盖住，使不外露或不显露。
explanation_english: To cover something so it is not exposed or visible; to conceal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揜住你隻眼，唔好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: am2 zyu6 nei5 zek3 ngaan5, m4 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 捂住你的眼睛，别看。
examples.english_sentence: Cover your eyes, don't look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想揜住件事，唔想俾人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 am2 zyu6 gin6 si6, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掩盖这件事，不想让人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to cover up the matter, not wanting anyone to know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用塊布揜住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 faai3 bou3 am2 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用一块布盖住他。
examples.english_sentence: Cover him with a cloth.

english_meaning: to cover (with the hand); to conceal; to hide
explanation_mandarin: 用手或东西遮盖、掩盖。
explanation_english: To cover or conceal something with the hand or an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揞住個鼻，臭死我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: am2 zyu6 go3 bei6, cau3 sei2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 捂住鼻子，臭死我了！
examples.english_sentence: Cover your nose, it stinks so much!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揞住自己嘅秘密，唔想俾人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 am2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 bei3 mat6, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他隐瞒着自己的秘密，不想被人知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's hiding his secret, not wanting anyone to know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揞住隻眼，睇清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 am2 zyu6 zoek3 ngaan5, tai2 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要遮住眼睛，看清楚点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cover your eyes, look more clearly.

english_meaning: against one's conscience, to act against one's conscience, to do something with a guilty conscience
explanation_mandarin: 形容人违背自己的良知，做一些自己认为不道德或不应该做的事情。
explanation_english: Describes a person acting against their conscience, doing something they know is immoral or shouldn't be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗錢，揞住良心做埋啲傷天害理嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 cin2, am2 zyu6 loeng4 sam1 zou6 maai4 di1 soeng1 tin1 hoi6 lei5 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了钱，他昧着良心做了很多伤天害理的事情。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of money, he acted against his conscience and did many wicked and outrageous things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好揞住良心話冇見過佢啦，明明就係你帶佢走嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 am2 zyu6 loeng4 sam1 waa6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 laa1, ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 nei5 daai3 keoi5 zau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别昧着良心说没见过他，明明就是你带他走的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act against your conscience and say you haven't seen him, it was obviously you who took him away.

english_meaning: hush money
explanation_mandarin: 为了让人保守秘密而给予的钱财。
explanation_english: Money paid to someone to keep them silent about something, typically something discreditable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋俾咗好多揞口費佢，要佢唔好講出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 zo2 hou2 do1 am2 hau2 fai3 keoi5, jiu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 gong2 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们给了他很多封口费，要他不要说出去。
examples.english_sentence: They gave him a lot of hush money, asking him not to reveal it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為俾揞口費就解決到所有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 bei2 am2 hau2 fai3 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 so2 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为给封口费就能解决所有问题。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that you can solve all problems with hush money.

english_meaning: to take someone's pulse (in Chinese medicine); to probe, to feel out the situation
explanation_mandarin: 本义是中医诊断时通过摸脉搏来了解病人身体状况。引申义是指通过试探性的言行来摸清对方的想法或情况。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to the act of taking someone's pulse in traditional Chinese medicine to understand their health condition. Metaphorically, it means to probe or feel out someone's intentions or the situation through tentative words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生幫我揞脈，話我身體冇乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 bong1 ngo5 am2 mak6, waa6 ngo5 san1 tai2 mou5 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生帮我号脉，说我身体没什么问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor took my pulse and said there wasn't much wrong with my health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋試下揞下佢哋嘅脈，睇下佢哋對呢個計劃有咩意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 si3 haa5 am2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mak6, tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 me1 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们试着摸摸他们的脉，看看他们对这个计划有什么意见。
examples.english_sentence: Let's try to feel out their opinions to see what they think about this plan.

english_meaning: To pull out with force; to yank
explanation_mandarin: 用力拔出，通常指迅速或突然地拔出。
explanation_english: To pull out forcefully, often implying a quick or sudden action of extraction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力揠佢出嚟，會整爛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 aat3 keoi5 ceot1 lai4, wui5 zing2 laan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么用力地拔出来，会弄坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't yank it out so hard, you'll break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一嘢揠咗條草出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ge2 aat3 zo2 tiu4 cou2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子就拔出了那根草。
examples.english_sentence: He pulled out that piece of grass in one go.

english_meaning: to spoil things by excessive enthusiasm; to try to help shoots grow by pulling them up (idiom, from Mencius); to ruin things by excessive zeal
explanation_mandarin: 比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而把事情弄糟。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes spoiling things by excessive enthusiasm or trying to force growth, often resulting in a negative outcome. It refers to acting against the natural course of development, being too eager for success, and ultimately ruining things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好揠苗助長呀，俾啲耐性佢哋慢慢學啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 aat3 miu4 zo6 zoeng2 aa3, bei2 di1 noi6 sing3 keoi5 dei6 maan6 maan6 hok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要拔苗助长啊，给他们点耐心慢慢学吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't force the process, let them learn at their own pace with some patience.

english_meaning: to hold; to grip; to shake (hands)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或类似工具抓住。
explanation_english: To hold or grip something with your hand or a similar tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 握手禮係一種常見嘅禮儀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ak1 sau2 lai5 hai6 jat1 zung2 coeng4 gin3 ge3 lai5 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 握手礼是一种常见的礼仪。
examples.english_sentence: A handshake is a common form of etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好用力咁握住我隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 yung6 lik6 gam2 ak1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用力地握住我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He held my hand tightly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 握緊方向盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ak1 gan2 fong1 hoeng3 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 握紧方向盘。
examples.english_sentence: Grip the steering wheel tightly.

english_meaning: grip strength
explanation_mandarin: 手部握持的力量。
explanation_english: The strength of one's grip; the force one can exert with the hand while holding something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅握力好勁，可以單手拎起好重嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngak1 lik6 hou2 ging6, ho2 ji5 daan1 sau2 ling1 hei2 hou2 cung5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的握力很强，可以单手拿起很重的东西。
examples.english_sentence: His grip strength is very strong; he can lift very heavy things with one hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做運動可以增強握力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 zang1 koeng4 ngak1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做运动可以增强握力。
examples.english_sentence: Doing exercise can increase your grip strength.

english_meaning: to hold on tight, to grip firmly
explanation_mandarin: 牢牢地抓住；紧紧地握住。
explanation_english: To hold something tightly; to grip something firmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要握實扶手啊，唔好跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 ak1 sat6 fu4 sau2 aa3, m4 hou2 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要握紧扶手啊，不要摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: You need to hold on to the handrail tightly, don't fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到握實我隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 dou3 ak1 sat6 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕得紧紧握住我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he gripped my hand tightly.

english_meaning: to shake hands
explanation_mandarin: 指人们见面或告别时，互相用手握住对方的手表示问候、祝贺或友好。
explanation_english: To clasp another person's hand in one's own, as in greeting, agreement, or congratulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個握手言和，以後唔再鬧交喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ak1 sau2 jin4 wo4, ji5 hau6 m4 zoi3 naau6 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个握手言和，以后不再吵架了。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them shook hands and made peace, and they won't quarrel anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋握手成交啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ak1 sau2 sing4 gaau1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们握手成交了！
examples.english_sentence: We've agreed to the deal with a handshake!

english_meaning: opportunity; profitable position; a point of mutual benefit (literally: "handshake position")
explanation_mandarin: 比喻可以合作、获利或达成共识的机会或位置。 指双方可以握手言和，互惠互利的地方。也指有利可图的位置。
explanation_english: A metaphor for an opportunity or position where cooperation, profit, or consensus can be achieved. It refers to a place where two parties can come to an agreement and benefit each other. It can also refer to a profitable position or opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目對我哋嚟講係一個好好嘅握手位，大家都可以賺到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 ak1 sau2 wai2, daai6 ga1 dou1 ho2 ji5 zaan6 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目对我们来说是一个很好的机会，大家都可以赚到钱。
examples.english_sentence: This project is a great opportunity for us; everyone can make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傾生意嘅時候，最緊要搵到個握手位，先可以達成協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: king1 seng1 ji3 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 wan2 dou2 go3 ak1 sau2 wai2, sin1 ho2 ji5 daat6 sing4 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谈生意的时候，最重要的是找到一个双方都能接受的点，才能达成协议。
examples.english_sentence: When doing business, it's most important to find a point of mutual benefit in order to reach an agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個最後都搵到個握手位，解決咗個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 wan2 dou2 go3 ak1 sau2 wai2, gaai2 kyut3 zo2 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个最后都找到了一个双方都能接受的方案，解决了问题。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them eventually found a mutually acceptable solution and resolved the issue.

english_meaning: to shake hands and make peace; to reconcile
explanation_mandarin: 指双方通过握手的方式，结束争端，达成和解。
explanation_english: To shake hands and reconcile; to make peace by shaking hands, signifying the end of a dispute or conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拗咗咁耐，最後都係握手言和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 aau3 zo2 gam3 noi6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 ak1 sau2 jin4 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们争吵了这么久，最后还是握手言和了。
examples.english_sentence: They argued for so long, but in the end, they shook hands and made peace.

english_meaning: to put aside; to shelve; to jam; to get stuck; to detain
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情暂时放下，不做处理；或指物体被卡住，无法移动。
explanation_english: Refers to temporarily putting something aside and not dealing with it; or refers to an object being stuck and unable to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事俾佢哋揢埋咗一邊喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 bei2 keoi5 dei6 kek6 maai4 zo2 jat1 bin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事被他们搁置在一边了。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has been put aside by them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枝筆揢住咗，寫唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 bat1 kek6 zyu6 zo2, se2 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 笔卡住了，写不了东西。
examples.english_sentence: The pen is jammed, I can't write.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個計劃俾公司揢住咗，唔知幾時先可以實行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 gai3 waak6 bei2 gung1 si1 kek6 zyu6 zo2, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 ho2 ji5 sat6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的计划被公司搁置了，不知道什么时候才可以实行。
examples.english_sentence: My plan has been shelved by the company, I don't know when it can be implemented.

english_meaning: difficult to handle; troublesome; thorny; awkward
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情或问题难以处理、棘手。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or problem that is difficult to handle, troublesome, or thorny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢真係好揢手，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gok3 sau2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的很棘手，不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really difficult to handle, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個客投訴得好犀利，件事都幾揢手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 haak3 tau4 sou3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6, gin6 si4 dou1 gei2 gok3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客人投诉得很厉害，这件事也挺棘手的。
examples.english_sentence: The customer is complaining fiercely, the matter is quite troublesome.

english_meaning: to guess, to surmise, to speculate
explanation_mandarin: 猜测，揣测；估计，估量。
explanation_english: To guess, surmise, speculate, or estimate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揣佢應該唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceoi2 keoi5 jing1 goi1 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜他应该不会来。
examples.english_sentence: I guess he probably won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揣下佢嘅用意係乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ceoi2 haa5 keoi5 ge3 jung6 ji3 hai6 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你猜一下他的用意是什么？
examples.english_sentence: Can you guess what his intention is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揣唔到佢點解要咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceoi2 m4 dou2 keoi5 dim2 gai2 jiu3 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜不到他为什么这样做。
examples.english_sentence: I can't guess why he did that.

mandarin_meaning: 揣测; 猜测; 估计
english_meaning: to speculate; to surmise; to guess; to conjecture; to estimate
explanation_mandarin: 猜测，推测，估计（别人的想法，情况等）
explanation_english: To speculate, surmise, guess, or estimate (someone's thoughts, situation, etc.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揣度佢應該唔會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceoi2 dok6 keoi5 jing1 goi1 m4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我猜想他应该不会来。
examples.english_sentence: I guess he probably won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁揣度人哋嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 ceoi2 dok6 jan4 dei6 ge3 nam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便揣测别人的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speculate about other people's thoughts randomly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我揣度佢今次考試會考得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceoi2 dok6 keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 wui5 haau2 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我估计他这次考试会考得不错。
examples.english_sentence: I estimate that he will do well in this exam.

english_meaning: to speculate; to ponder; to figure out; to try to read (someone's mind)
explanation_mandarin: 猜测、推测别人的心思或意图；仔细琢磨、考虑。
explanation_english: To speculate or guess at someone's thoughts, feelings, or intentions; to carefully ponder or consider something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知佢諗緊乜，好難揣摩佢嘅心思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 gan2 mat1, hou2 naan4 ceoi2 mo2 keoi5 ge3 sam1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道他在想什么，很难揣摩他的心思。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what he's thinking; it's hard to figure out his thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揣摩老闆嘅意思，希望可以升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceoi2 mo2 lou5 baan2 ge3 ji3 si1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天揣摩老板的意思，希望可以升职。
examples.english_sentence: He spends all day trying to figure out what the boss wants, hoping to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個角色嘅性格好複雜，演員要好好揣摩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 ge3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jin2 jyun4 jiu3 hou2 hou2 ceoi2 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色的性格很复杂，演员要好好揣摩。
examples.english_sentence: This character's personality is very complex; the actor needs to ponder it carefully.

english_meaning: to speculate, to conjecture, to surmise
explanation_mandarin: 推测；猜测。
explanation_english: To try to understand or explain something by guessing, especially when you do not have all the facts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揣測人哋嘅諗法啦，直接問咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi2 caak1 jan4 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3 laa1, zik6 zip3 man6 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要揣测别人的想法了，直接问问就好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speculate about what other people are thinking, just ask them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想揣測佢嘅動機，實在太難估啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 ceoi2 caak1 keoi5 ge3 dung6 gei1, sat6 zoi6 taai3 naan4 gu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想揣测他的动机，实在太难猜了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to speculate about his motives, it's too hard to guess.

english_meaning: to squeeze; to press; to push; to jab
explanation_mandarin: 用手或手指用力按压。
explanation_english: To press something forcefully with a hand or finger; to squeeze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揤牙膏出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit1 ngaa4 gou1 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 挤牙膏出来。
examples.english_sentence: Squeeze the toothpaste out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揤咗個掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zit1 zo2 go3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他按了一下按钮。
examples.english_sentence: He pressed the button.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揤啲生果呀，爛晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zit1 di1 saang1 gwo2 aa3, laan6 saai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要挤压水果，会烂掉的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't squeeze the fruit, it will get rotten.

english_meaning: to pick up, to grab, to clutch
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具拿起或拾起。
explanation_english: To pick up or grab something with your hand or a tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揦住條繩，唔好鬆手啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: laa2 zyu6 tiu4 sing4, m4 hou2 sung1 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抓住绳子，不要松手啊！
examples.english_sentence: Grip the rope, don't let go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢執咗個銀包，唔知點處理好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zap1 zo2 go3 ngan4 baau1, m4 zi1 dim2 cyu2 lei5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他捡了个钱包，不知道怎么处理好。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up a wallet, and doesn't know how to deal with it.

english_meaning: To cling to, to hold onto tightly, to pester, to nag, to be clingy
explanation_mandarin: 形容紧紧抓住不放，或者指纠缠不休，喋喋不休地烦扰。
explanation_english: Describes holding onto something tightly, clinging to someone, or persistently bothering someone with nagging or pestering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揦住我問功課，煩死人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 laa2 zyu6 ngo5 man6 gung1 fo3, faan4 sei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是缠着我问功课，烦死人了。
examples.english_sentence: He always pesters me about homework, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好揦住佢唔放啦，佢有自己嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laa2 zyu6 keoi5 m4 fong3 laa1, keoi5 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再缠着他不放了，他有自己的生活。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cling to him anymore, he has his own life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路哥揦住佢媽媽隻手唔肯放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 go1 laa2 zyu6 keoi5 maa1 maa1 zek3 sau2 m4 hang2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩紧紧抓住他妈妈的手不肯放开。
examples.english_sentence: The child held onto his mother's hand tightly and refused to let go.

english_meaning: Clutching tightly, stingy, miserly
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常吝啬，紧紧抓住东西不放，不愿付出或给予。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy, clutching onto things tightly and unwilling to give or spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好揦住揦住，一蚊都唔捨得攞出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 laa2 zyu6 laa2 zyu6, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 lo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是太抠门了，一分钱都舍不得拿出来。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy, unwilling to take out even a single cent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁揦住揦住啦，請我飲杯嘢都唔肯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 laa2 zyu6 laa2 zyu6 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么小气嘛，请我喝杯东西都不肯？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, you won't even treat me to a drink?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揦住揦住舊嗰啲衫褲，唔肯掉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laa2 zyu6 laa2 zyu6 gau6 go2 di1 saam1 fu3, m4 hang2 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧抓着那些旧衣服裤子不放，不肯扔掉。
examples.english_sentence: He clutches tightly onto those old clothes and pants, unwilling to throw them away.

mandarin_meaning: 形容食物或药物的味道涩口、难以下咽；形容人小气吝啬，令人厌恶。
english_meaning: Describing food or medicine as astringent, unpleasant, and hard to swallow; describing a person as stingy, petty, and off-putting.
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物的味道让人感觉涩口，不好吃。也用来形容人吝啬，令人讨厌，不够大方。
explanation_english: Describes the taste of food as astringent and unpleasant. Also used to describe a person as stingy, annoying, and lacking generosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥咁揦口揦面，真係唔想飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 gam3 laa1 hau2 laa1 min6, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药味道这么涩，真不想喝。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine tastes so astringent, I really don't want to drink it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好揦口揦面，成日都計較埋啲濕碎嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 laa1 hau2 laa1 min6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gai3 gaau3 maai4 di1 sap1 seoi3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真够小气的，整天都在计较那些小事。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a stingy and petty person, always nitpicking over trivial matters.

mandarin_meaning: 一起拿走; 一起处理; 顺便; 包括
english_meaning: to take everything; to handle everything together; to include; to do something as a side job; all-in-one
explanation_mandarin: 表示将东西全部拿走，或者将事情全部一起处理，也可以表示顺便将某件事也做了。
explanation_english: Indicates taking everything, handling everything together, or doing something as a side job. It often implies efficiency and convenience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲嘢揦埋一齊拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 je5 laa2 maai4 jat1 cai4 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那些东西一起拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He took all those things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日晏晝要揦埋搞掂呢份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 aan3 zau3 jiu3 laa2 maai4 gaau2 dim6 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天下午要一起把这份报告完成。
examples.english_sentence: I need to finish this report together this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以揦埋幫我買埋啲嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 laa2 maai4 bong1 ngo5 maai5 maai4 di1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以顺便帮我买点东西吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please also help me buy some things?

english_meaning: to frown, to look sulky, to wear a long face
explanation_mandarin: 形容人面带愁容，显得不高兴或者不满意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is frowning or looking sulky, showing unhappiness or dissatisfaction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做咩揦埋口面啊？係咪有咩唔開心啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 me1 laa2 maai4 hau2 min6 aa3? hai6 mai6 jau5 me1 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么愁眉苦脸的？是不是有什么不开心的事情啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you looking so sulky? Is something making you unhappy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日揦埋口面啦，笑多啲咪開心啲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 laa2 maai4 hau2 min6 laa1, siu3 do1 di1 mai1 hoi1 sam1 di1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是愁眉苦脸的，多笑笑就会开心一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always wear a long face, smile more and you'll be happier.

mandarin_meaning: 惹祸上身; 自找麻烦
english_meaning: To bring trouble on oneself; to ask for trouble; to stick one's nose into something that doesn't concern you and suffer the consequences.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻没事找事，自找麻烦，引祸上身。形容一个人本来可以置身事外，却主动介入，结果给自己带来不必要的麻烦和困扰。
explanation_english: This idiom figuratively means to bring trouble upon oneself. It describes a situation where someone unnecessarily interferes or gets involved in something that doesn't concern them, leading to unwanted problems and difficulties. It suggests that the person could have avoided the situation, but their own actions caused it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知間公司財政有問題，重要主動接手，真係揦屎上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 gaan1 gung1 si1 coi4 zing3 jau5 man6 tai4, zung6 jiu3 zyu2 dung6 zip3 sau2, zan1 hai6 laa2 si2 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道公司财政有问题，还要主动接手，真是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He knew the company had financial problems, yet he took over the responsibility willingly. He's really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好理人哋啲家事啦，費事揦屎上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 jan4 dei6 di1 gaa1 si6 laa1, fai3 si6 laa2 si2 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要管别人家的事，免得惹祸上身。
examples.english_sentence: You better not interfere in other people's family affairs, lest you bring trouble upon yourself.

english_meaning: troublesome; thorny; difficult to handle; awkward
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情难以处理，令人感到棘手，不知如何下手。
explanation_english: Describes something difficult to handle or deal with, causing one to feel it is thorny or troublesome. It implies a sense of not knowing how to start or proceed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢真係好揦手，唔知點搞好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 laa2 sau2, m4 zi1 dim2 gaau2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事真的很棘手，不知道怎么处理好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is really troublesome; I don't know how to handle it well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課咁多嘢做，真係有啲揦手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 gam3 do1 je5 zou6, zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 laa2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份功课这么多东西要做，真的有点棘手。
examples.english_sentence: This homework has so much to do; it's really a bit troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好揦手，要慢慢諗先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 laa2 sau2, jiu3 maan6 maan2 nam2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很棘手，要慢慢想才行。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very difficult to handle; we need to think about it carefully.

english_meaning: flustered; unable to cope; overwhelmed; all fingers and thumbs
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事时慌张、笨拙，无法顺利完成。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is flustered, clumsy, and unable to cope with a task or situation effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次煮咁大餐飯，揦手唔成勢，搞到廚房一鑊泡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zyu2 gam3 daai6 caan1 faan6, laa2 sau2 m4 sing4 sai3, gaau2 dou3 cyu4 fong4 jat1 wok6 paau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次做这么大的一顿饭，手忙脚乱的，把厨房弄得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: It was his first time cooking such a big meal, he was so flustered that he made a mess of the kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考公開試嗰陣，我太緊張，揦手唔成勢，好多嘢都唔記得咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 gung1 hoi1 si3 go2 zan6, ngo5 taai3 gan2 zoeng1, laa2 sau2 m4 sing4 sai3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候，我太紧张了，手忙脚乱的，很多东西都忘记了。
examples.english_sentence: During the public exam, I was too nervous and overwhelmed, I forgot a lot of things.

english_meaning: Sloppy, messy, untidy, slovenly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不整洁，不干净。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as being unkempt, untidy, or dirty. It can also refer to someone who is careless or irresponsible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間房咁揦篩嘅，執執佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 fong2 gam3 laa2 sai1 ge3, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的房间这么邋遢，整理一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your room is so messy, tidy it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好揦篩，成日唔沖涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 laa2 sai1, seng4 jat6 m4 cung1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很邋遢，经常不洗澡。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very sloppy person, often doesn't take a shower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫到咁揦篩，點交俾人呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 gam3 laa2 sai1, dim2 gaau1 bei2 jan4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报告写得这么邋遢，怎么交给别人啊？
examples.english_sentence: The report is written so sloppily, how can we submit it to others?
