mandarin_meaning: 说话不客气；说话尖酸刻薄
english_meaning: to speak sarcastically; to be sharp-tongued; to have a biting tongue; to be hurtful with words
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话很不客气，带有讽刺或挖苦的意味，让人听了不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes speaking in a very impolite and sarcastic manner, often with a biting tone, making others feel uncomfortable. Implies the speaker's words are hurtful or unpleasant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁揦脷啦，佢都知錯㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 laa2 lei6 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么尖酸刻薄了，他/她都知道错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sharp-tongued, he/she already knows they've made a mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日唔知做乜咁揦脷，句句都帶刺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 zou6 mat1 gam3 laa2 lei6, geoi3 geoi3 dou1 daai3 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她今天不知道怎么这么说话尖酸刻薄，每句话都带着刺。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why he/she is being so sarcastic today, every sentence is laced with barbs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁揦脷，小心得罪人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 laa2 lei6, siu2 sam1 dak1 zeoi5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么说话尖酸刻薄，小心得罪人。
examples.english_sentence: If you're so sharp-tongued, be careful you don't offend people.

english_meaning: Sloppy, messy, untidy, careless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不認真，不整潔，馬虎，邋遢。可以形容人或事物。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not careful, not tidy, careless, or sloppy in their work or appearance. Can be used to describe people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個人咁揦西嘅，點解唔執拾下間房啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 jan4 gam3 laa2 sai1 ge3, dim2 gaai2 m4 zaap1 sap6 haa5 gaan1 fong2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个人这么邋遢，为什么不收拾一下房间呢？
examples.english_sentence: You are so sloppy, why don't you tidy up your room?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好揦西，成日都出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 laa2 sai1, seng4 jat6 dou1 cheut1 cho3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很马虎，经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: He is very careless in his work and makes mistakes all the time.

english_meaning: To pick up; to pull up; to buck up; to perk up
explanation_mandarin: 1. 拿起，捡起。2. 拉起，提起。3. 振作精神，打起精神。
explanation_english: 1. To pick up (something from the ground or a surface). 2. To pull up, lift up. 3. To buck up, to cheer up, to rally one's spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揦起地上面嘅垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laa2 hei2 dei6 soeng6 min6 ge3 laap1 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把地上的垃圾捡起来。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up the trash from the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到壞消息之後，佢即刻要揦起精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 waai6 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zik1 hak1 jiu3 laa2 hei2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到坏消息之后，他立刻要振作精神。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the bad news, he immediately needed to buck up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揦起條褲唔好跣低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laa2 hei2 tiu4 fu3 m4 hou2 sin6 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把裤子提起来，别滑下来。
examples.english_sentence: Pull up your pants so they don't slide down.

english_meaning: rubbish, trash, sloppy, messy, untidy, of poor quality
explanation_mandarin: 指物品或人邋遢、不整洁，质量差劲，或指行为不光彩。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone being messy, sloppy, untidy, of poor quality, or refers to dishonorable behavior. It carries a negative connotation, implying something is undesirable or substandard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間房咁揦鮓，執執佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 fong4 gam3 laa2 zaat3, zap1 zap1 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的房间这么邋遢，收拾一下吧！
examples.english_sentence: Your room is so messy, tidy it up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件嘢咁揦鮓，唔好買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 je5 gam3 laa2 zaat3, m4 hou2 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这东西这么垃圾，别买了。
examples.english_sentence: This thing is of such poor quality, don't buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好揦鮓㗎，你小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 laa2 zaat3 gaa3, nei5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很马虎，你小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He's very sloppy when he works, be careful.

english_meaning: terrible idea, awful plan, shoddy trick, bad move
explanation_mandarin: 指很差勁、不靠譜、甚至會帶來負面影響的主意或方法。通常帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to a very bad, unreliable idea or method that may even have negative consequences. Usually has a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗埋啲乜嘢揦鮓招啊？根本就唔work嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 maai4 di1 mat1 je5 laa1 zaat3 ziu1 aa3? gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 work ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想的都是些什么馊主意啊？根本就行不通的。
examples.english_sentence: What kind of terrible ideas are you coming up with? They won't work at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再出揦鮓招啦，次次都搞砸晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 laa1 zaat3 ziu1 laa1, ci3 ci3 dou1 gaau2 zaap3 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再出烂招数了，每次都搞砸了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop coming up with awful plans, you mess everything up every time!

mandarin_meaning: 粗制滥造的面条；敷衍了事的面条
english_meaning: Poorly made noodles; carelessly prepared noodles; a substandard effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容制作粗糙，质量很差的面条。引申为形容敷衍了事，随便应付。
explanation_english: Describes noodles that are poorly made and of low quality. By extension, it can describe something done carelessly or perfunctorily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗嘢簡直係揦鮓麪，啲麪又腍又冇味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 je5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 laa1 zaat3 min6, di1 min6 jau6 lam4 jau6 mou5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗东西简直是粗制滥造的面条，面条又软又没味道。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl is practically a plate of poorly-made noodles, the noodles are soggy and tasteless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課交揦鮓麪貨，求其交咗就算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gaau1 laa1 zaat3 min6 fo3, kau4 kei4 gaau1 zo2 zau6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的作业交得很敷衍，随便交了就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He handed in a shoddy piece of work, just submitting it to be done with it.

mandarin_meaning: 垃圾面, 马马虎虎的面条
english_meaning: Rubbish noodles; poorly made noodles; slapdash work
explanation_mandarin: 形容做得马马虎虎、质量很差的面条。也用来比喻做事敷衍了事，质量很差。
explanation_english: Describes noodles that are poorly made and of low quality. It can also be used metaphorically to describe something done carelessly and with poor quality; slapdash work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗麵真係揦鮓麵，啲麵又爛又冇味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 min6 zan1 hai6 laa2 zaa2 min6, di1 min6 jau6 laan6 jau6 mou5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗面真是垃圾面，面条又烂又没味道。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of noodles is really rubbish noodles; the noodles are soggy and tasteless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫到揦鮓麵咁，求其交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 laa2 zaa2 min6 gam2, kau4 kei4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这份报告写得像垃圾面一样，随便交差了事。
examples.english_sentence: His report was written like rubbish noodles; he just handed it in to get it over with.

synonyms: 是是但但 (si6 si6 daan6 daan6)

english_meaning: to rub, to graze, to touch lightly; to sponge off someone, to take advantage of; to flirt
explanation_mandarin: 用身体或物品轻轻接触或摩擦；占小便宜，揩油；（非正式）调情。
explanation_english: To rub or graze lightly; to take advantage of someone, especially financially or by getting free things; (informal) to flirt, often in a subtle or playful way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度揩油啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 haai1 jau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里占便宜！
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to take advantage here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路嘅時候，唔小心揩到人哋膊頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 ge3 si4 hau6, m4 siu2 sam1 haai1 dou2 jan4 dei6 bok3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路的时候，不小心碰到别人的肩膀。
examples.english_sentence: When he was walking, he accidentally brushed against someone's shoulder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意揩人哋嘅嘢嚟用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 haai1 jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 lai4 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢蹭别人的东西来用。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to sponge off other people's things.

english_meaning: To flirt, to try to pick someone up, to touch someone inappropriately, to skate around a topic (lit. to touch ice)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指触摸冰块，引申指试图与人建立亲密关系（多指带有性暗示或不怀好意的），或者在言语上试图引诱或挑逗，也指言语上回避话题，不直接回答问题。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to touch ice'. Figuratively, it refers to flirting, trying to pick someone up with ulterior motives, touching someone inappropriately, or skirting around a topic without directly addressing it. The connotation is generally negative, suggesting a lack of respect or honesty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧度揩冰，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 jiu1 baa1 dou6 haai1 bing1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在酒吧里搭讪，很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always flirting in bars, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔好意思直接答我問題，淨係識得揩冰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hou2 ji3 si1 zik6 zip3 daap3 ngo5 man6 tai4, zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 haai1 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不好意思直接回答我的问题，只会回避。
examples.english_sentence: He was embarrassed to answer my question directly, and only knew how to skirt around the topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個阿伯喺地鐵入面揩冰，俾人鬧到狗血淋頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 a3 baak3 hai2 dei6 tit3 jap6 min6 haai1 bing1, bei2 jan4 naau6 dou3 gau2 hyut3 lam4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老伯在地铁里揩油，被人骂得狗血淋头。
examples.english_sentence: That old man was touching someone inappropriately on the subway and got a severe scolding.

synonyms: 溝女 (gau1 neoi5) - for flirting specifically

mandarin_meaning: 沾染不好的东西; 惹麻烦; 倒霉
english_meaning: to get involved in trouble; to get screwed; to get into something bad; to be unlucky
explanation_mandarin: 指遇到倒霉的事情，或者沾染到不好的东西，导致陷入麻烦。也形容事情发展不利，遭遇困境。
explanation_english: Refers to encountering unlucky things, getting involved in bad things, leading to trouble. It also describes an unfavorable development of events and facing difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔合格，真係揩嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3, zan1 hai6 haai1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，真是倒霉了。
examples.english_sentence: I failed this exam, I'm really screwed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢衰咗咁多嘢，今次真係揩嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 zo2 gam3 do1 je5, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 haai1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，这次真的要倒霉了。
examples.english_sentence: He has done so many bad things, he's really going to get into trouble this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同啲壞人行埋，陣間揩嘢就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 di1 waai6 jan4 haang4 maai4, zan6 gaan1 haai1 je5 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要和坏人混在一起，到时候惹上麻烦就不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: You better not hang out with those bad guys, or you'll get into trouble.

english_meaning: To take advantage of; to do something together incidentally; to tack on; to piggyback; to sponge off of
explanation_mandarin: 指在做某事的同时，顺便做另一件事；或者指占别人的便宜。也指一起，一同。
explanation_english: To do something else incidentally while doing something else; to take advantage of someone or something; to sponge off of. Can also mean together, jointly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去食飯，不如你揩埋一齊去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 heoi3 sik6 faan6, bat1 jyu4 nei5 haai1 maai4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去吃饭，不如你顺便一起去吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to dinner tonight, why don't you come along with me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想揩埋啲免費嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 haai1 maai4 di1 min5 fai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占一些免费的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to get free stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以揩埋人哋嘅嘢，自己努力先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 haai1 maai4 jan4 dei6 ge3 je5, zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着可以占别人的便宜，自己努力才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can sponge off of others, you need to work hard yourself.

english_meaning: to freeload, to sponge off someone, to get a free ride, to take advantage, to profit unfairly
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用机会占便宜，或是不正当地获取利益。
explanation_english: Metaphorically means to take advantage of an opportunity to gain benefits or to unfairly obtain profits; to freeload or sponge off someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想揩油，真係乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 haai1 jau4, zan1 hai6 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占便宜，真令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to freeload, he's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日揩油，克扣員工工資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 haai1 jau4, hak1 kwan1 jung4 gung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板经常占便宜，克扣员工工资。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always tries to profit unfairly by deducting employees' wages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺我度揩油呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngo5 dou6 haai1 jau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想在我这里占便宜！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can sponge off me!

english_meaning: to take advantage of someone; to freeload; to sponge off someone
explanation_mandarin: 指占别人的便宜，从中获取好处。通常带贬义，指不劳而获或者利用他人获得利益。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of someone, especially to get benefits from them. It usually has a negative connotation, implying taking advantage of someone's kindness, generosity, or position without working for it or unfairly profiting from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想揩我哋公司嘅油水，真係好乞人憎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 haai1 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 jau4 seoi2, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占我们公司的便宜，真是很令人讨厌！
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to sponge off our company, it's really annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住揩我着數啊，我唔係咁容易俾人呃嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 haai1 ngo5 zoek3 sou3 aa3, ngo5 m4 hai6 gam3 jung4 ji6 bei2 jan4 aak1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想占我的便宜，我不是那么容易被骗的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of me, I'm not that easy to fool!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得揩人哋嘅資源，好快就上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 haai1 jan4 dei6 ge3 zi1 jyun4, hou2 faai3 zau6 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得利用别人的资源，很快就上位了。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to take advantage of other people's resources and rose to a high position quickly.

english_meaning: to scratch, to graze, to scuff, to damage by scratching
explanation_mandarin: 指物体表面因为摩擦而留下痕迹，造成损伤。
explanation_english: To damage the surface of an object by scratching or rubbing it against something else, leaving a mark or blemish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該小心啲，唔好揩花架車呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 haai1 faa1 gaa3 ce1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请小心点，不要把车刮花了。
examples.english_sentence: Please be careful, don't scratch the car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，唔小心揩花咗你部電話嘅mon啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, m4 siu2 sam1 haai1 faa1 zo2 nei5 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 mon1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，不小心把你的手机屏幕刮花了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I accidentally scratched your phone screen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我件衫揩花咗，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin6 saam1 haai1 faa1 zo2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的衣服被刮花了，不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: My clothes got scratched, I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to take advantage of, to freeload, to sponge off, to get something for nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指以不正当或不光明正大的方式占取小便宜，通常指在物质或金钱方面。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of someone or a situation in an unfair or sneaky way, usually to gain a small material or financial benefit. It implies getting something for free or at a greatly reduced price by exploiting a loophole or someone's kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日想住揩人草啦，自己俾翻錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai1 sing4 jat6 soeng2 zyu6 haai1 jan4 cou2 laa1, zi6 gei2 bei2 faan1 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别老想着占别人的便宜，自己付钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to take advantage of others, pay for yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度揩草，又唔幫手做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 haai1 cou2, jau6 m4 bong1 sau2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是占便宜，又不帮忙做事。
examples.english_sentence: He is always freeloading and doesn't help with the work.

english_meaning: To touch accidentally; to graze; to brush against; to get involved (in something bad)
explanation_mandarin: 指不小心碰到、擦到；也指沾染到不好的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to accidentally touching or grazing something. It can also mean getting involved or tainted by something bad, usually unintentionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心揩親佢件衫，整污糟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 haai1 can1 keoi5 gin6 saam1, zing2 wu1 zou1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心碰到他的衣服，弄脏了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally brushed against his shirt and got it dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好唔好揩親呢啲嘢，好易惹禍上身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 haai1 can1 ni1 di1 je5, hou2 ji6 j惹 wo6 soeng5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要沾染这些东西，很容易惹祸上身。
examples.english_sentence: You better not get involved with these things, it's easy to get yourself into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲太長，行路嗰陣成日揩親地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 taai3 coeng4, hang4 lou6 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 haai1 can1 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裤子太长，走路的时候老是碰到地面。
examples.english_sentence: The pants are too long, I keep brushing against the ground when I walk.

english_meaning: to skirt around; to touch lightly on; to be close to the edge; marginal
explanation_mandarin: 本意指擦到边，引申指接近某个目标或界限，但没有完全达到或超出。也形容非常接近某个状态或情形，但没有完全进入。
explanation_english: Literally means to brush against the edge. Figuratively, it means to be close to a target or boundary without fully reaching or exceeding it. It can also describe being very close to a certain state or situation without fully entering it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試差啲就肥佬，真係揩邊咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 caa1 di1 zau6 fei4 lou2, zan1 hai6 haai1 bin1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试差点不及格，真的只是擦边而已。
examples.english_sentence: He almost failed the exam, it was really just skirting the edge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅關係而家好揩邊，唔知將來會點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 haai1 bin1, m4 zi1 zoeng1 loi4 wui5 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在的关系很微妙，不知道将来会怎样。
examples.english_sentence: Our relationship is quite marginal now, I don't know what will happen in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都揩邊，唔敢直接講重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 haai1 bin1, m4 gam2 zik6 zip3 gong2 zung2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是绕弯子，不敢直接说重点。
examples.english_sentence: He always skirts around the issue when he speaks, not daring to directly address the main point.

english_meaning: To try to get an advantage; to freeload; to scrounge; to mooch; to sponge off someone.
explanation_mandarin: 指试图占他人便宜，不劳而获，或者利用某种关系、机会来获得好处。
explanation_english: Refers to trying to take advantage of others, getting something for nothing, or using some relationship or opportunity to gain benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想喺我度揩邊瓣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 hai2 ngo5 dou6 haai1 bin1 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想从我这里占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to sponge off me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺公司度揩邊瓣，要靠自己努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 haai1 bin1 baan6, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着在公司里捞好处，要靠自己努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about getting away with things at the company; you need to rely on your own efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想揩邊瓣，攞多啲油水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 haai1 bin1 baan6, lo2 do1 di1 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想捞点好处，多拿一些油水。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to scrounge around and get some extra benefits.

english_meaning: To freeload, to sponge, to take advantage (especially in a subtle or underhanded way), to get a free ride
explanation_mandarin: 指利用他人或环境提供的便利来获取好处，通常带有不劳而获或占小便宜的意味。
explanation_english: To take advantage of a situation or someone's generosity to get something for free or at a significantly reduced cost, often in a subtle or underhanded way. It implies getting a benefit without putting in equal effort or contribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺公司度揩鑊，乜嘢都唔做，淨係等出糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 haai1 wok6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 zou6, zing6 hai6 dang2 ceot1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在公司里占便宜，什么都不做，就等着发工资。
examples.english_sentence: He's always freeloading at the company, doing nothing and just waiting for payday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住揩人哋鑊啦，自己都要付出下㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 haai1 yan4 dei6 wok6 laa1, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 haa5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是想着占别人的便宜，自己也要付出一些啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about freeloading off others, you need to contribute something yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話請食飯，點知到埋單嗰陣就話唔記得帶銀包，想揩我鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ceng2 sik6 faan6, dim2 zi1 dou3 maai4 daan1 go2 zan6 zau6 waa6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1, soeng2 haai1 ngo5 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说请吃饭，谁知道结账的时候就说忘记带钱包，想占我便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would treat me to dinner, but when it came time to pay, he said he forgot his wallet and tried to freeload off me.

english_meaning: to grab, to seize, to clutch, to pull (e.g., someone's hair or clothes)
explanation_mandarin: 用手抓住或揪住（多指用力拉扯）
explanation_english: To grab, seize, or clutch, often with a pulling motion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到揪住佢條頭髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zau1 zyu6 keoi5 tiu4 tau4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地抓住了她的头发。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he grabbed her hair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揪住我件衫呀，會爛嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zau1 zyu6 ngo5 gin6 saam1 aa3, wui5 laan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要揪住我的衣服，会烂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't grab my shirt, it will rip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揪住我唔畀我走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau1 zyu6 ngo5 m4 bei2 ngo5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抓住我不让我走。
examples.english_sentence: He grabbed me and wouldn't let me leave.

english_meaning: to hit someone where it hurts; to exploit someone's weakness; to expose someone's past mistakes or wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 比喻抓住别人的弱点或过失进行攻击或威胁。
explanation_english: Figuratively, it means to seize upon someone's weaknesses or past mistakes to attack or threaten them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日揪人哋痛腳啦，做好自己先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 zau1 jan4 dei6 tung3 goek3 laa1, zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是抓住别人的痛处，先做好自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always exploit other people's weaknesses, focus on improving yourself first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉嗰陣，佢哋成日互相揪痛腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 go2 zan6, keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 wu6 seung1 zau1 tung3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举的时候，他们经常互相揭短。
examples.english_sentence: During the election, they often exposed each other's shortcomings.

english_meaning: to lift; to raise; to uncover; to reveal; to expose
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他工具把盖在上面的东西掀开，或者把覆盖着的东西揭露出来。
explanation_english: To lift something that is covering something else; to uncover or reveal something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揭開個蓋睇下入面有乜嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: kit3 hoi1 go3 goi3 tai2 haa5 jap6 min6 jau5 mat1 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把盖子打开看看里面有什么？
examples.english_sentence: Lift the lid and see what's inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揭發咗公司嘅貪污行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kit3 faat3 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 taam1 wu1 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭发了公司的贪污行为。
examples.english_sentence: He exposed the company's corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揭穿咗佢嘅謊言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kit3 cyun1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 fong1 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭穿了他的谎言。
examples.english_sentence: He uncovered his lies.

english_meaning: to rub salt in someone's wound; to bring up someone's past mistakes or embarrassing experiences; to reopen old wounds
explanation_mandarin: 揭：揭开，揭露。瘡疤：伤口愈合后留下的疤痕。比喻揭露别人的缺点或痛处，使人难堪。
explanation_english: "揭" means to uncover or reveal. "瘡疤" refers to a scar from a healed wound. The phrase means to bring up someone's past mistakes, embarrassing experiences, or painful memories, causing them distress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再揭人瘡疤啦，人哋都唔開心好耐㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 kit3 jan4 cong1 baa1 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1 hou2 noi6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再揭人伤疤了，人家都不开心很久了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rub salt in their wound anymore, they've been unhappy for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揭人瘡疤，所以冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kit3 jan4 cong1 baa1, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是揭人伤疤，所以没有什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always brings up people's past mistakes, so he doesn't have many friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係想揭人瘡疤，但係你真係要面對現實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 kit3 jan4 cong1 baa1, daan6 hai6 nei5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 min6 deoi3 hin6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是想揭人伤疤，但是你真的要面对现实。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mean to bring up painful memories, but you really need to face reality.

synonyms: 挑人痛處 (tiu1 jan4 tung3 cyu3)

english_meaning: the inside story; the full story; the whole truth; the real intention behind something
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的内幕、底细。比喻隐藏的真相或真正的意图。
explanation_english: Refers to the inside story, the whole truth, or the hidden details of something. It can also mean the real intention behind an action or statement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講咗咁耐都未肯揭尾故，實有嘢瞞住我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mei6 hang2 kit3 mei5 gu3, sat6 jau5 je5 mun4 zyu6 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说了这么久都不肯说出内幕，肯定有什么瞒着我们。
examples.english_sentence: He's been talking for so long but still hasn't revealed the whole story, he must be hiding something from us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我揭尾故畀你聽，其實佢咁做係為咗上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 kit3 mei5 gu3 bei2 nei5 teng1, kei4 sat6 keoi5 gam2 zou6 hai6 wai6 zo2 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我告诉你实情，其实他这样做是为了上位。
examples.english_sentence: Let me tell you the real story, actually he's doing this to climb up the ladder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我唔知你嘅揭尾故，你嗰套我睇穿晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 ge3 kit3 mei5 gu3, nei5 go2 tou3 ngo5 tai2 cyun1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为我不知道你的底细，你那套我全都看穿了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I don't know your hidden agenda, I've seen right through your tricks.

english_meaning: to unveil; to inaugurate; opening (ceremony)
explanation_mandarin: 揭开幕布，表示正式开始或启用。
explanation_english: To unveil or inaugurate something, often with a formal ceremony. It signifies the official opening or start of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係新博物館嘅揭幕典禮喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 san1 bok3 mat6 gun2 ge3 kit3 mok6 din2 lai5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是新博物馆的揭幕典礼了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the opening ceremony of the new museum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊去睇佢哋公司嘅新辦公室揭幕呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 san1 baan6 gung1 sat1 kit3 mok6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起去看他们公司的新办公室揭幕啊。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go together to see the opening of their company's new office.

english_meaning: to reveal; to announce; to unveil; to disclose
explanation_mandarin: 公布谜底、结果等。
explanation_english: To make something known publicly, especially something that has previously been kept secret or was not known for sure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽結果聽日就會揭曉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2 ting1 jat6 zau6 wui5 kit3 hiu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛结果明天就会揭晓了。
examples.english_sentence: The result of the competition will be announced tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋終於揭曉咗新產品嘅名稱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 kit3 hiu2 zo2 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 ming4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们终于揭晓了新产品的名称。
examples.english_sentence: They finally revealed the name of the new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都很期待邊個會攞到冠軍，好想快啲揭曉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 han2 kei4 doi6 bin1 go3 wui5 lo2 dou3 gun1 gwan3, hou2 soeng2 faai3 di1 kit3 hiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都非常期待谁会获得冠军，很想快点揭晓。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is looking forward to who will win the championship and eager for the announcement.

english_meaning: to expose; to uncover; to reveal; to denounce
explanation_mandarin: 揭露不为人知的事情，通常指坏事或秘密。
explanation_english: To expose something that is previously unknown, usually referring to wrongdoing or a secret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揭發咗公司嘅貪污醜聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kit3 faat3 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 taam1 wu1 chau2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭发了公司的贪污丑闻。
examples.english_sentence: He exposed the company's corruption scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者揭發咗呢單黑幕交易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 kit3 faat3 zo2 ni1 daan1 hak1 muk6 giao1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者揭发了这单黑幕交易。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter uncovered this shady deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揭發咗佢老闆嘅罪行，真係好勇敢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kit3 faat3 zo2 keoi5 lou5 baan2 ge3 zeoi6 hang4, zan1 hai6 hou2 yung5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭发了他老板的罪行，真的很勇敢。
examples.english_sentence: He exposed his boss's crimes, he's really brave.

english_meaning: to reveal the result, to announce the result, to unveil
explanation_mandarin: 原本指开奖，揭开盅盖以显示结果。现泛指揭晓、公布或公开谜底或结果。
explanation_english: Originally referred to opening a lottery draw, revealing the result by lifting the lid of the container. Now it generally refers to announcing, revealing, or publishing a mystery or result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽結果聽日就揭盅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 git3 gwo2 ting1 jat6 zau6 kit3 zung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛结果明天就揭晓了。
examples.english_sentence: The results of the competition will be revealed tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個謎底幾時揭盅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 mai4 dai2 gei2 si4 kit3 zung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个谜底什么时候揭晓？
examples.english_sentence: When will the answer to this riddle be revealed?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一直都冇揭盅佢嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 kit3 zung1 keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直都没有公布他们的计划。
examples.english_sentence: They haven't revealed their plans yet.

english_meaning: to expose; to unmask; to lay bare; to reveal (a lie, plot, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 揭露事情的真相，使原本隐藏的事实暴露出来；拆穿谎言、阴谋等。
explanation_english: To reveal the truth of a matter, exposing a previously hidden fact; to expose a lie, conspiracy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話俾我哋揭穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 kit3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说谎被我们揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: His lie was exposed by us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅陰謀最終都俾人揭穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam1 mau4 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 bei2 yan4 kit3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的阴谋最终被人揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: His plot was eventually exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想揭穿佢，費事佢冇面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seung2 kit3 cyun1 keoi5, fai3 si6 keoi5 mou5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想揭穿他，免得他没面子。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to expose him, in case he loses face.

english_meaning: to rise in revolt; to rebel; to launch an uprising (historical reference to a peasant rebellion)
explanation_mandarin: 指农民起义，比喻反抗统治者的暴政。源自陈胜、吴广起义时，用竹竿作为武器起兵反抗秦朝的统治。
explanation_english: Refers to a peasant uprising, used as a metaphor for resisting the tyranny of rulers. It originates from the Chen Sheng and Wu Guang uprising, where they used bamboo poles as weapons to rebel against the rule of the Qin Dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 民不聊生，逼到佢哋要揭竿起義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man4 bat1 liu4 sang1, bik1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 kit3 gon1 hei2 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 民不聊生，逼得他们要揭竿而起。
examples.english_sentence: The people are struggling to survive, forcing them to rise in revolt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政府繼續咁樣落去，好快就會有人揭竿起義㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 gai3 zuk6 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 jau5 jan4 kit3 gon1 hei2 ji6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府继续这样下去，很快就会有人揭竿而起。
examples.english_sentence: If the government continues like this, someone will soon rise up in revolt.

english_meaning: to uncover; to reveal; to expose; to open (a cover)
explanation_mandarin: 揭开，打开覆盖物，使显露出来。
explanation_english: To remove a cover from something; to reveal something previously hidden or concealed; to open something with a lid or covering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢慢慢咁揭開個煲蓋，睇下啲湯煲好未。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan6 maan2 gam2 kit3 hoi1 go3 bou1 goi3, tai2 haa5 di1 tong1 bou1 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慢慢地揭开锅盖，看看汤煲好了没有。
examples.english_sentence: He slowly uncovered the pot lid to see if the soup was ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者想揭開呢單案嘅真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 soeng2 kit3 hoi1 ni1 daan1 on3 ge3 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者想揭开这件案件的真相。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter wants to uncover the truth of this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快揭開個謎底，畀我哋估吓先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 kit3 hoi1 go3 mai4 dai2, bei2 ngo5 dei6 gu2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快揭开谜底，让我们猜一下先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't reveal the answer so quickly, let us guess first.

english_meaning: to expose, to reveal, to uncover
explanation_mandarin: 揭示、披露不为人知的事情（通常是不好的或秘密的事情）。
explanation_english: To expose or reveal something that was previously unknown or secret, often something negative or scandalous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揭露咗公司嘅醜聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kit3 lou6 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 chau2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他揭露了公司的丑闻。
examples.english_sentence: He exposed the company's scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者揭露咗政府嘅貪污行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 kit3 lou6 zo2 zing3 fu2 ge3 taam1 wu1 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者揭露了政府的贪污行为。
examples.english_sentence: The reporter revealed the government's corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書揭露咗好多歷史嘅真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 kit3 lou6 zo2 hou2 do1 lik6 si2 ge3 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书揭露了很多历史的真相。
examples.english_sentence: This book revealed a lot of historical truths.

english_meaning: to wave; to brandish; to wield; to spend lavishly; to squander
explanation_mandarin: 本义指挥动、摆动；引申指花费、挥霍。
explanation_english: The basic meaning is to wave or swing. It can also mean to spend lavishly or squander.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揮住手同我哋講拜拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fai1 zyu6 sau2 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2 baai1 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挥着手和我们说再见。
examples.english_sentence: He waved his hand to say goodbye to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得揮錢，一下子就洗晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 fai1 cin2, jat1 haa5 zi2 zau6 sai2晒啲cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会挥霍钱，一下子就把钱都花光了。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at squandering money, and he spent all the money in no time.

english_meaning: linger, not be able to shake off, unable to get rid of (thoughts, feelings, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某种想法、情绪或回忆一直萦绕在脑海中，无法摆脱。
explanation_english: Describes a thought, emotion, or memory that lingers in one's mind and cannot be easily dismissed or forgotten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從上次吵完交之後，佢嘅身影一直喺我腦海裏面揮之不去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 soeng6 ci3 caau2 jyun4 gaau1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 san1 jing2 jat1 zik6 hai2 ngo5 nou5 hoi2 leoi5 min6 fai1 zi1 bat1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从上次吵架之后，她的身影一直在我脑海里挥之不去。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since our last argument, her image has been lingering in my mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰首歌嘅旋律好入腦，聽完之後一直揮之不去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 sau2 go1 ge3 syun4 leot6 hou2 jap6 nou5, ting1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 jat1 zik6 fai1 zi1 bat1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那首歌的旋律很洗脑，听完之后一直挥之不去。
examples.english_sentence: That song's melody is so catchy; it's been stuck in my head since I heard it.

mandarin_meaning: 打败; 击败; 抛下; 丢下
english_meaning: to defeat; to beat; to abandon; to dump; to leave behind
explanation_mandarin: 指在竞争、比赛中打败对手，也指丢弃、抛弃某人或某物。
explanation_english: To defeat an opponent in a competition or game; also refers to abandoning or dumping someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽度揮低咗所有對手，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 dou6 fai1 dai1 zo2 so2 jau5 deoi3 sau2, lo2 zo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中打败了所有对手，获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He defeated all the opponents in the competition and won the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想拖累我，所以揮低咗我，自己走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 to1 leoi6 ngo5, so2 ji5 fai1 dai1 zo2 ngo5, zi6 gei2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想拖累我，所以抛下了我，自己走了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to burden me, so he abandoned me and left on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢事業成功咗，就揮低咗以前嘅朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si6 jip6 sing4 gung1 zo2, zau6 fai1 dai1 zo2 ji5 cin4 ge3 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他事业成功后，就抛弃了以前的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: After his career became successful, he abandoned his old friends.

english_meaning: to wave; to brandish; to wield
explanation_mandarin: 摇动；挥舞。
explanation_english: To move (something) back and forth or up and down; to wave or brandish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揮動住支旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fai1 dung6 zyu6 zi1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挥动着旗子。
examples.english_sentence: He is waving the flag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揮動雙手，向我哋打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fai1 dung6 soeng1 sau2, hoeng3 ngo5 dei6 daa2 ziu1 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挥动双手，向我们打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: He waved his hands to greet us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揮動住把劍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fai1 dung6 zyu6 baa2 gim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挥动着剑。
examples.english_sentence: He is wielding the sword.

english_meaning: to wave (one's hand)
explanation_mandarin: 摆动手臂示意，通常表示告别或打招呼。
explanation_english: To move one's hand back and forth, usually to say goodbye or to greet someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨走嘅時候，同我哋揮手道別。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 zau2 ge3 si4 hau6, tung4 ngo5 dei6 fai1 sau2 dou6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临走的时候，和我们挥手道别。
examples.english_sentence: He waved goodbye to us when he was leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺遠處見到佢，就即刻揮手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 jyun5 chu3 gin3 dou2 keoi5, zau6 zik1 hak1 fai1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在远处看到他，就立刻挥手。
examples.english_sentence: I saw him in the distance, so I waved immediately.

english_meaning: to punch, to swing a fist
explanation_mandarin: 挥动拳头，用拳头打。
explanation_english: To swing one's fist, to punch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到揮拳想打人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 fai1 kyun4 soeng2 daa2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得挥拳想打人。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he swung his fist, wanting to hit someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時衝動，揮拳打咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6, fai1 kyun4 daa2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时冲动，挥拳打了他。
examples.english_sentence: He acted impulsively and punched him.

english_meaning: Lunar New Year decorations (usually red banners with auspicious phrases)
explanation_mandarin: 农历新年时张贴的，写有吉祥话的红色纸条或横幅。
explanation_english: Lunar New Year decorations, typically red banners or paper strips with auspicious phrases written on them, intended to bring good luck and fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多人會喺屋企門口貼揮春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 wui5 hai2 uk1 kei2 mun4 hau2 tip3 fai1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人会在家门口贴春联。
examples.english_sentence: During Lunar New Year, many people will paste Lunar New Year decorations on their doorways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我哋買咗啲揮春，希望新一年好運啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 maa5 zo2 di1 fai1 ceon1, hei1 mong6 san1 jat1 nin4 hou2 wan6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我们买了一些春联，希望新的一年运气好一点。
examples.english_sentence: This year we bought some Lunar New Year decorations, hoping for better luck in the new year.

english_meaning: Spring Festival couplets paper
explanation_mandarin: 用于书写或印制挥春（春联）的纸张。
explanation_english: Paper used for writing or printing Fai Chun (Spring Festival couplets).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋會買啲揮春紙返屋企寫揮春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 maai5 di1 fai1 ceon1 zi2 faan1 uk1 kei2 se2 fai1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们会买一些春联纸回家写春联。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we buy some Spring Festival couplets paper to write couplets at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲揮春紙通常係紅色嘅，上面寫住啲吉祥嘅字句。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fai1 ceon1 zi2 tung1 soeng4 hai6 hung4 sik1 ge3, soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 di1 gat1 soeng4 ge3 zi6 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些春联纸通常是红色的，上面写着一些吉祥的字句。
examples.english_sentence: The Spring Festival couplets paper is usually red, with auspicious phrases written on it.

english_meaning: to wield freely; to do something with effortless ease; to handle with skill and ease; to be in one's element
explanation_mandarin: 形容画画、写字、做事等非常熟练、轻松，能充分发挥自己的才能。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very skilled and relaxed in painting, writing, doing things, etc., and can fully display their talents. It implies a sense of mastery and ease in execution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫畫畫得好揮灑自如，幾筆就畫咗幅靚畫出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 waa2 dak1 hou2 fai1 saa2 zi6 jyu4, gei2 bat1 zau6 waa2 zo2 fuk1 leng3 waa2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画画得很挥洒自如，几笔就画出了一幅漂亮的画。
examples.english_sentence: He paints with effortless ease; with just a few strokes, he creates a beautiful painting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對呢個項目好熟悉，做起嚟揮灑自如。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hou2 suk6 sik1, zou6 hei2 lai4 fai1 saa2 zi6 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对这个项目很熟悉，做起来挥洒自如。
examples.english_sentence: He's very familiar with this project, so he handles it with effortless ease.

synonyms: 得心應手 (dak1 sam1 jing3 sau2)
運用自如 (wan6 yung6 zi6 jyu4)

english_meaning: to volatilize; to evaporate
explanation_mandarin: 指液体表面分子逸散到空气中的过程。也比喻事物消失或分散。
explanation_english: To change from a liquid or solid to a gaseous state; to evaporate. Figuratively, to disappear or dissipate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒精好快揮發㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 ging1 hou2 faai3 fai1 faat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒精很快就会挥发的。
examples.english_sentence: Alcohol evaporates very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢唔用就好快揮發晒㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 m4 yung6 zau6 hou2 faai3 fai1 faat3 saai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱不用很快就会花光的。
examples.english_sentence: Money will quickly disappear if you don't use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲創意真係揮發得淋漓盡致。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 chong3 yi3 zan1 hai6 fai1 faat3 dak1 lam4 lei4 zeon6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的创意真是发挥得淋漓尽致。
examples.english_sentence: His creativity is truly brought into full play.

english_meaning: to wave; to brandish; to wield
explanation_mandarin: 挥动; 舞动。通常指挥动手臂或拿着某物挥动。
explanation_english: To wave or brandish something, typically by moving one's arms or holding an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢興奮咁揮舞住支旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hing3 fan5 gam2 fai1 mou5 zoek3 zi1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他兴奋地挥舞着旗子。
examples.english_sentence: He was waving the flag excitedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲示威者揮舞住標語，大聲叫口號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 si6 wai1 ze2 fai1 mou5 zoek3 biu1 jyu5, daai6 seng1 giu3 hau2 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威者挥舞着标语，大声喊着口号。
examples.english_sentence: The protesters were waving banners and shouting slogans loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上揮舞住雙手，帶動氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng5 fai1 mou5 zoek3 soeng1 sau2, daai3 dung6 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上挥舞着双手，带动气氛。
examples.english_sentence: He was waving his hands on the stage, stirring up the atmosphere.

english_meaning: to dispatch troops; to launch a military campaign; to advance (an army); to move (troops)
explanation_mandarin: 调动军队，发起军事行动。
explanation_english: To dispatch troops, launching a military campaign or military operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將軍一聲令下，軍隊就揮軍北上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeung1 gwan1 jat1 seng1 ling6 haa6, gwan1 deoi2 zau6 fai1 gwan1 bak1 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将军一声令下，军队就挥军北上。
examples.english_sentence: At the general's command, the army launched a military campaign to the north.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃下個月揮軍進攻市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 haa6 go3 jyut6 fai1 gwan1 zeon3 gung1 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划下个月挥军进攻市场。
examples.english_sentence: They are planning to launch a campaign to attack the market next month.

english_meaning: to spend money like dirt; to squander money
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱大手大脚，极其浪费。
explanation_english: Describes someone who spends money lavishly and wastefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一中咗六合彩，就開始揮金如土，買名牌、跑車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, zau6 hoi1 ci2 fai1 gam1 jyu4 tou2, maai5 ming4 paai2, paau2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一中了彩票，就开始挥金如土，买名牌、跑车。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he won the lottery, he started spending money like dirt, buying designer brands and sports cars.

english_meaning: to squander; to waste lavishly; to spend extravagantly
explanation_mandarin: 浪费钱财或物品。
explanation_english: To spend money or resources wastefully or extravagantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揮霍無度，好快就無晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fai1 fok3 mou4 dou6, hou2 faai3 zau6 mou4晒啲錢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是挥霍无度，很快就花光了所有的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always spends money lavishly, and will soon run out of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁揮霍啦，留返啲錢將來用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fai1 fok3 laa1, lau4 faan1啲錢 zoeng1 loi4 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么挥霍了，留点钱将来用。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wasteful, save some money for the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用幾年時間揮霍咗佢父母留俾佢嘅遺產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 gei2 nin4 si4 gaan3 fai1 fok3 zo2 keoi5 fu6 mou5 lau4 bei2 keoi5 ge3 wai4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用几年的时间挥霍了他父母留给他的遗产。
examples.english_sentence: He squandered the inheritance his parents left him in a few years.

english_meaning: to support; to aid; to assist; to cite; to quote
explanation_mandarin: 帮助，支持；引用
explanation_english: To provide help or support; to cite or quote a source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋需要你嘅援手啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 ge3 wun4 sau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们需要你的帮助啊。
examples.english_sentence: They need your help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺報告入面援引咗好多數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 wun4 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在报告中引用了很多数据。
examples.english_sentence: He cited a lot of data in the report.

english_meaning: compensated dating
explanation_mandarin: 一种非正式的性交易，通常指年轻女性（多为学生）接受经济援助，以换取陪伴或性服务。
explanation_english: An informal type of sexual transaction, usually referring to young women (often students) receiving financial assistance in exchange for companionship or sexual services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲新聞成日都講援交，好似好普遍噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 san1 man4 sing4 jat6 dou1 gong2 jyun4 gaau1, hou2 ci5 hou2 pou2 bin3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的新闻总是报道援助交际，好像很普遍的样子。
examples.english_sentence: The news nowadays is always reporting on compensated dating, as if it's very common.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就使咁多錢，唔通係做援交？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 sai2 gam3 do1 cin2, m4 tung1 hai6 zou6 jyun4 gaau1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么年轻就花这么多钱，难道是做援助交际？
examples.english_sentence: She spends so much money at such a young age, could she be doing compensated dating?

english_meaning: reinforcements; troops brought in to aid a besieged force
explanation_mandarin: 前来增援的军队；援救的兵力。
explanation_english: Troops sent to reinforce an army or a besieged location; reinforcements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋頂唔順啦，快啲叫援兵嚟啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ding2 m4 seon6 laa1, faai3 di1 giu3 wun4 bing1 lai4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们顶不住了，快点叫援兵来啊！
examples.english_sentence: We can't hold on anymore, quickly call for reinforcements!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有援兵到咗，我哋有希望啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 wun4 bing1 dou3 zo2, ngo5 dei6 jau5 hei1 mong6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有援兵到了，我们有希望了！
examples.english_sentence: Reinforcements have arrived, we have hope!

english_meaning: assistance, aid, support
explanation_mandarin: 帮助，支援；提供帮助的行为或事物。
explanation_english: To assist, aid, or support someone or something; the act of providing help or the assistance itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要國際社會嘅援助嚟重建家園。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gwok3 zai3 se5 wui2 ge3 jyun4 zo6 lai4 cung4 gin3 gaa1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要国际社会的援助来重建家园。
examples.english_sentence: We need assistance from the international community to rebuild our homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋向受災民眾提供緊急援助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoeng3 sau6 zoi1 man4 zung3 tai4 cung1 gan2 gap1 jyun4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们向受灾民众提供紧急援助。
examples.english_sentence: They provided emergency assistance to the disaster-stricken people.

english_meaning: help, assistance
explanation_mandarin: 提供帮助；援助之手。
explanation_english: To offer help; a helping hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋遇到困難，我哋應該伸出援手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 san1 cheut1 wun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们遇到困难，我们应该伸出援手。
examples.english_sentence: They are encountering difficulties, we should offer a helping hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好彩有你嘅援手，件事先至可以咁順利噉完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 choi2 jau5 nei5 ge3 wun4 sau2, gin6 si6 sin1 chi5 ho2 ji5 gam3 seon6 lei6 gam2 wun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好有你的帮助，事情才可以这么顺利地完成。
examples.english_sentence: Luckily with your help, the matter could be completed so smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果需要援手嘅話，隨時搵我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 seoi1 yiu3 wun4 sau2 ge3 waa6, cheui4 si4 wan2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果需要帮助的话，随时找我。
examples.english_sentence: If you need help, feel free to find me anytime.

english_meaning: to rescue, to aid, to assist (in an emergency)
explanation_mandarin: 提供援助以解救危难。
explanation_english: To provide assistance in order to rescue someone from danger or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋即刻去援救啲災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zik1 hak1 heoi3 wun4 gau3 di1 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们立刻去援救灾民。
examples.english_sentence: They immediately went to rescue the disaster victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員冒住生命危險去援救被困嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 mou6 zyu6 sang1 ming6 ngai4 him2 heoi3 wun4 gau3 bei6 kwan3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员冒着生命危险去援救被困的人。
examples.english_sentence: Firefighters risked their lives to rescue the trapped people.

english_meaning: reinforcements
explanation_mandarin: 增援的军队；援助的兵力。
explanation_english: Troops sent to reinforce an army or garrison; reinforcements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要援軍嚟幫手守住個陣地呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wun4 gwan1 lai4 bong1 sau2 jyu5 go3 zan6 dei6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要援军来帮忙守住这个阵地啊。
examples.english_sentence: We need reinforcements to help us defend this position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到風，聽日會有援軍到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 fung1, teng1 jat6 wui5 jau5 wun4 gwan1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到消息，听说明天会有援军到。
examples.english_sentence: I heard a rumor that reinforcements will arrive tomorrow.

english_meaning: frugal; thrifty; stingy; to save
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，揵通常指节俭，吝啬，节省。可以用作形容词或者动词。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "揵" usually refers to being frugal, thrifty, stingy, or saving. It can be used as an adjective or a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好揵家，乜都唔捨得買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gin6 gaa1, mat1 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很节俭，什么都不舍得买。
examples.english_sentence: He is very frugal; he is reluctant to buy anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要揵啲使錢，唔好咁大使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin6 di1 sai2 cin2, m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要节省点用钱，不要这么浪费。
examples.english_sentence: We need to save money, don't spend it so lavishly.

english_meaning: To perk up; to buck up; to cheer up; to be energetic
explanation_mandarin: 表示振作精神，变得更有活力。
explanation_english: To become more energetic and spirited; to cheer up and be more lively. Often used to encourage someone to improve their mood or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揵起啲啦，唔好咁灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kin4 hei2 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你振作一点吧，不要这么灰心。
examples.english_sentence: Cheer up a bit, don't be so discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試，快啲揵起精神溫書啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si3, faai3 di1 kin4 hei2 jing1 san4 wan1 syu1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要考试，快点提起精神复习吧！
examples.english_sentence: There's an exam tomorrow, quickly perk up and study!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到你咁冇精神，我都要揵起你至得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 nei5 gam3 mou5 jing1 san4, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 kin4 hei2 nei5 zi3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到你这么没精神，我都要让你振作起来。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing you so listless, I have to cheer you up.

english_meaning: to tease; to ridicule; to make fun of
explanation_mandarin: 用言语或行动取笑、戏弄别人。
explanation_english: To tease, ridicule, or make fun of someone using words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日揶人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 je4 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是戏弄别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tease people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意揶人哋矮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 je4 jan4 dei6 ai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢嘲笑别人矮。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to make fun of other people for being short.

mandarin_meaning: 揶揄, 嘲弄, 取笑
english_meaning: to tease, to ridicule, to mock
explanation_mandarin: 用语言或行动戏弄、嘲弄。
explanation_english: To tease, ridicule, or mock someone in a playful or sarcastic way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日揶揄佢啦，佢會唔開心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 je4 jyu4 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是揶揄他了，他会不开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always tease him, he'll be unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揶揄我嘅口音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 je4 jyu4 ngo5 ge3 hau2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是取笑我的口音。
examples.english_sentence: He always mocks my accent.

mandarin_meaning: 握, 驾驶, 控制, 管理
english_meaning: to hold, to grip, to drive (a vehicle), to manage, to be in charge of
explanation_mandarin: 1. 用手握住：揸住支笔 (握住笔)。2. 驾驶（车辆）：揸车 (开车)。3. 控制，管理：揸fit (管理；掌控大局， slang)。
explanation_english: 1. To hold, to grip, or to grasp with the hand. 2. To drive a vehicle. 3. To manage, control, or be in charge of something, often implying power or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揸住啲嘢實啲呀，唔好跌咗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaa1 zyu6 di1 je5 sat6 di1 aa3, m4 hou2 dit3 zo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把东西握紧点，不要掉下去了！
examples.english_sentence: Hold on to the things tighter, don't drop them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識揸車，你揸啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 zaa1 ce1, nei5 zaa1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂开车，你来开吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to drive, you drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司揸fit，乜都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zaa1 fit1, mat1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司掌握大权，什么都他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's in charge in the company, he calls all the shots.

english_meaning: Person in charge, leader (often in a gang or organization, but can also be used more generally)
explanation_mandarin: 在黑社会组织或公司中负责特定区域或事务的人，有时也指一般的负责人。
explanation_english: A person who is in charge of a specific area or matter, typically used to refer to a leader in a triad society, but can also be used more generally to refer to a leader or person in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢度嘅揸 fit 人，咩事都要問過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 dou6 ge3 zaa1 fit1 jan4, me1 si6 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这里的负责人，什么事都要问过他。
examples.english_sentence: He is the person in charge here, everything needs to be asked of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢以前係旺角嘅揸 fit 人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 wong6 gok3 ge3 zaa1 fit1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他以前是旺角的负责人/老大。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he used to be the person in charge in Mong Kok.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir想拉呢個社團嘅揸fit人.
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 soeng2 laai1 ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 ge3 zaa1 fit1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察想抓这个社团的负责人/老大.
examples.english_sentence: The police want to arrest the head of this triad.

mandarin_meaning: 掌权, 控制, 当家
english_meaning: to be in charge, to be the boss, to be in control, to be the leader (often in a gang setting)
explanation_mandarin: 在某个组织或群体中掌握权力，负责控制和管理。
explanation_english: To be in a position of authority and control within an organization or group, often used in the context of gangs or triads, but also applicable to other hierarchical structures. It implies being the one who makes decisions and holds the power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個社團度揸fit好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 dou6 zaa1 fit1 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个社团里掌权很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in charge of this triad for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁串，你以為你喺度揸fit呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 cyun3, nei5 ji5 wai4 nei5 hai2 dou6 zaa1 fit1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么嚣张，你以为你在这里当家作主吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so arrogant, do you think you are in charge here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊個揸fit呢間公司㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 go3 zaa1 fit1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谁是这家公司的负责人？
examples.english_sentence: Who is in charge of this company?

english_meaning: elevator operator, lift attendant
explanation_mandarin: 指操作电梯的人员。 在以前的香港，一些高级大厦或酒店会设有专门的电梯操作员，负责控制电梯和为乘客提供服务。
explanation_english: Refers to an elevator operator or lift attendant. In the past, some high-end buildings or hotels in Hong Kong employed dedicated elevator operators who were responsible for controlling the elevator and providing service to passengers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅酒店通常都有揸lift人幫你撳掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 zau2 dim3 tung1 soeng4 dou1 jau5 zaa1 lift1 jan4 bong1 nei5 gam2 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的酒店通常都有电梯操作员帮你按按钮。
examples.english_sentence: Hotels used to have elevator operators to help you press the buttons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好少見到揸lift人啦，通常都係自己撳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 zaa1 lift1 jan4 laa1, tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 zi6 gei2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少见到电梯操作员了，通常都是自己按。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, you rarely see elevator operators; usually, you press the buttons yourself.

english_meaning: to make decisions; to be in charge; to have one's own way
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握主导权，自己做决定，有话事权。
explanation_english: To be in charge of decision-making; to have the power to decide and control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅決策都係由佢揸主意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 caak3 dou1 hai6 jau4 keoi5 zaa1 zyu2 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的决策都是由他做主的。
examples.english_sentence: The decisions of this company are all made by him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有主見，鍾意自己揸主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 zyu2 gin3, zung1 ji3 zi6 gei2 zaa1 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有主见，喜欢自己做决定。
examples.english_sentence: He is very opinionated and likes to make his own decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你大個仔喇，應該學吓自己揸主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daai6 go3 zai2 laa3, ying1 goi1 hok6 haa5 zi6 gei2 zaa1 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你长大了，应该学着自己做决定了。
examples.english_sentence: You're grown up now, you should learn to make your own decisions.

mandarin_meaning: 拿着; 掌握; 拥有
english_meaning: To hold (in hand); to grasp; to be in control of; to possess; to be in possession of
explanation_mandarin: 表示用手拿着东西，或者表示掌握、控制某种事物或资源，也指拥有某种东西。
explanation_english: Indicates holding something with your hand, grasping or controlling something or a resource, or possessing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸住部手機，一路行一路睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 zyu6 bou6 sau2 gei1, jat1 lou6 haang4 jat1 lou6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着手机，一路走一路看。
examples.english_sentence: He was holding his mobile phone, walking and looking at it at the same time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋揸住公司嘅大部分股份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zaa1 zyu6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 bou6 fan6 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们掌握着公司的大部分股份。
examples.english_sentence: They hold the majority of the company's shares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揸住啲鎖匙未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaa1 zyu6 di1 so2 si4 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿着钥匙了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you holding the keys?

jyutping: zaa1 zyu6 gai1 mou4 dong3 ling6 zin3
english_meaning: To treat a feather as an imperial order; to make a big deal out of something trivial; to abuse one's limited authority.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把小事当成大事来处理，或拿着一点小的权力就滥用。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who exaggerates the importance of something trivial or abuses their limited authority as if it were a significant power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係一個普通職員，但成日揸住雞毛當令箭，乜都要管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 pou2 tung1 zik1 jyun4, daan6 seng4 jat6 zaa1 zyu6 gai1 mou4 dong3 ling6 zin3, mat1 dou1 jiu3 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是一个普通职员，但总是拿着鸡毛当令箭，什么都要管。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a regular employee, but he always treats a feather like an imperial order, wanting to control everything.

jyutping: zaa1 zyu6 gai1 mou4 dong3 ling6 zin3
english_meaning: To treat a feather as an imperial decree; to take something trivial as a serious order; to abuse one's power with minimal authority.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻拿着小权利当大权力使用，滥用职权。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who abuses their power and authority by treating a minor order or piece of information as a very important command. They overstep their bounds and use their limited authority in an excessive way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗做個小組長就揸住雞毛當令箭，乜都要管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 go3 siu2 zou2 zoeng2 zau6 zaa1 zyu6 gai1 mou4 dong3 ling6 zin3, mat1 dou1 jiu3 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升为小组长后就拿着鸡毛当令箭，什么都要管。
examples.english_sentence: After he was promoted to group leader, he treated a feather as an imperial decree, wanting to control everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好揸住雞毛當令箭，只係個實習生，唔使管咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zaa1 zyu6 gai1 mou4 dong3 ling6 zin3, zi2 hai6 go3 sat6 zaap6 sang1, m4 sai2 gun2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拿着鸡毛当令箭，只是个实习生，不用管那么多事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat a feather as an imperial decree; you're just an intern, you don't need to manage so many things.

english_meaning: To beg, to panhandle
explanation_mandarin: 指向他人乞讨钱财或食物。源于用手拿着容器（兜）向人乞讨。
explanation_english: To beg for money or food, typically by holding out a container (a 'dau' which means a type of container, traditionally a bowl) to receive alms. Literally means 'to hold a container'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業之後，逼住要揸兜過日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, bik1 zyu6 jiu3 zaa1 dau1 gwo3 jat1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业之后，被迫要乞讨度日。
examples.english_sentence: After losing his job, he was forced to beg to survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該隨便俾錢啲喺街邊揸兜嘅人，好容易助長佢哋唔工作嘅風氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 ceoi4 bin2 bei2 cin2 di1 hai2 gaai1 bin1 zaa1 dau1 ge3 jan4, hou2 jung4 ji6 zo6 zoeng2 keoi5 dei6 m4 gung1 zok3 ge3 fung1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该随便给钱那些在街边乞讨的人，很容易助长他们不工作的风气。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't give money to people begging on the street casually, it can easily encourage them not to work.

english_meaning: to take the lead; to be in charge; to be the one responsible
explanation_mandarin: 比喻承担主要责任，领导或主导某项事务。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to take on the main responsibility, lead, or be in charge of a particular matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project由你揸大旗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project jau4 nei5 zaa1 daai6 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目由你负责了。
examples.english_sentence: You are in charge of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司揸大旗好多年，經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zaa1 daai6 kei4 hou2 do1 nin4, ging1 gim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司领导了很多年，经验非常丰富。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in charge in the company for many years and is very experienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇人肯揸大旗，件事就冇人跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jan4 hang2 zaa1 daai6 kei4, gin6 si6 zau6 mou5 jan4 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有人肯负责，这件事就没有人跟进。
examples.english_sentence: No one is willing to take the lead, so no one is following up on this matter.

english_meaning: To drive recklessly; to take risks; to be bold and audacious (often used metaphorically, not just in driving).
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是驾驶大胆的车。 比喻指冒险行事，不顾后果。 通常带有贬义色彩，指人不谨慎。
explanation_english: Literally translates to "driving a bold/daring car". Figuratively, it means to take risks, act recklessly, or be audacious without considering the consequences. Often carries a negative connotation, implying imprudence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日揸大膽車，遲早出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zaa1 daai6 daam2 ce1, chi4 zou2 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是冒险行事，迟早要出事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always taking risks, sooner or later something bad will happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好揸大膽車啊，呢個投資風險好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zaa1 daai6 daam2 ce1 aa3, ni1 go3 tau4 zi1 fung1 him2 hou2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要冒险投资啊，这个投资风险很高。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take unnecessary risks, this investment is very high-risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸大膽車咁追個女仔，都唔知得唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 daai6 daam2 ce1 gam2 zeoi1 go3 neoi5 zai2, dou1 m4 zi1 dak1 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冒险追求那个女孩，也不知道行不行。
examples.english_sentence: He's taking a big risk pursuing that girl, I don't know if it'll work out.

english_meaning: to put on airs, to show off, to act important, to flaunt power
explanation_mandarin: 形容人故意摆出高人一等的姿态，以显示自己的权力或重要性。比喻一个人喜欢炫耀，装模作样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who deliberately puts on a superior attitude to show their power or importance. It's a metaphor for someone who likes to show off and act important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗做經理之後，日日揸大葵扇，好似自己好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat6 zaa1 daai6 kwai4 sin3, hou2 ci5 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升为经理之后，每天都摆架子，好像自己很厉害似的。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted to manager, he puts on airs every day, as if he's so capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁揸大葵扇啦，大家同事嚟嘅啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zaa1 daai6 kwai4 sin3 laa1, daai6 gaa1 tung4 si6 lai4 ge3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么摆架子了，大家都是同事而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on such airs, we're all just colleagues.

english_meaning: to grope breasts; to grab breasts; to fondle breasts
explanation_mandarin: 用手触摸或抓握女性的乳房，多含性骚扰或不尊重意味。
explanation_english: To touch or grab a woman's breasts, often with sexual harassment or disrespect implied. It is considered vulgar and highly offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士度俾人揸奶，真係好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 bei2 jan4 zaa1 naai5, zan1 hai6 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在巴士上被人摸奶，真的很生气。
examples.english_sentence: She was groped on the bus and was really angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便揸人哋嘅奶，咁樣好冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 zaa1 jan4 dei2 ge3 naai5, gam2 joeng2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便摸别人的奶，这样很不礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch other people's breasts casually, it's very impolite.

english_meaning: to be in charge, to take control, to run the show
explanation_mandarin: 表示掌握权力，负责管理，主导某个事务或团体。
explanation_english: To be in charge of something, to have authority over it, to be the person who is running the show or making the decisions. Often used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係呢間公司揸弗嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zaa1 fat1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是这家公司负责的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is the person in charge of this company now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話事，你揸弗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 si6, nei5 zaa1 fat1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说了算，你负责吧。
examples.english_sentence: You decide, you're in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想揸弗，太辛苦啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zaa1 fat1, taai3 san1 fu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想负责，太辛苦了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be in charge, it's too tiring.

mandarin_meaning: 负责人; 主事人; 话事人
english_meaning: Person in charge; decision-maker; boss; leader
explanation_mandarin: 指负责某项事务、团体或组织的领导者或主事人，拥有决策权和控制权。
explanation_english: Refers to the leader or person in charge of a certain affair, group, or organization, who has the power to make decisions and control things. It often implies a position of authority and responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢間公司嘅揸弗人，所有嘢都係佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zaa1 fat1 jan4, so2 jau5 je5 dou1 hai6 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这家公司的负责人，所有事情都是他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's the person in charge of this company, he makes all the decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都係呢個project嘅揸弗人，要自己諗辦法搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 hai6 ni1 go3 project ge3 zaa1 fat1 jan4, jiu3 zi6 gei2 nam2 baan6 faat3 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也是这个项目的负责人，要自己想办法搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: You are also in charge of this project, you need to find a way to handle it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社團入面係一個好有份量嘅揸弗人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 tyun4 jap6 min6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 fan6 leong6 ge3 zaa1 fat1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社团里是一个很有分量的负责人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very influential person in charge within the triad.

english_meaning: To shake hands; to hold hands; to be in control; to handle
explanation_mandarin: 可以指握手，也可以指掌握、控制，处理等。
explanation_english: Can refer to shaking hands, holding hands, being in control of something, or handling something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋見面嗰陣時，互相揸手打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gin3 min6 go2 zan6 si4, wu6 soeng1 zaa1 sau2 daa2 daa2 hiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们见面的时候，互相握手打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: When they met, they shook hands to greet each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目由佢揸手負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jau4 keoi5 zaa1 sau2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目由他负责。
examples.english_sentence: He is in charge of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拖手仔，揸手行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 to1 sau2 zai2, zaa1 sau2 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们牵着手，握着手逛街。
examples.english_sentence: They held hands and strolled down the street.

english_meaning: to be in control, to be in charge, to dominate, to take control of the situation
explanation_mandarin: 指掌握控制权，主导局势或事情的发展。
explanation_english: Refers to being in control of something, dominating a situation, or directing the development of an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想揸扒成件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zaa1 paa4 sing4 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掌控整个事情。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be in control of the whole thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢揸扒咗成個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 zaa1 paa4 zo2 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他掌控整个项目。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him take control of the entire project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司揸晒扒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zaa1 saai3 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司掌控一切。
examples.english_sentence: He is in complete control in the company.

mandarin_meaning: 掌握; 控制; 负责
english_meaning: to be in charge of; to control; to handle; to be responsible for; to take control of
explanation_mandarin: 负责处理某件事情或掌握某项事物。
explanation_english: To be in charge of or responsible for handling something, or to be in control of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project由你揸拿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project jau4 nei5 zaa1 naa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目由你负责。
examples.english_sentence: You are in charge of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識揸拿時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 zaa1 naa4 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会掌握时间。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at managing his time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想揸拿公司嘅大權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zaa1 naa4 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 kwun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想掌握公司的权力。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to take control of the company's power.

english_meaning: Quickly, immediately, at once, without delay
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或事情应立即进行，没有延误。强调快速行动。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or matter should be carried out immediately, without delay. Emphasizes quick action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揸揸林走啦，唔好阻住我做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaa1 zaa1 lam4 zau2 laa1, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你赶快走吧，不要妨碍我工作。
examples.english_sentence: Leave quickly, don't disturb me from working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 揸揸林搞掂佢，晏啲要交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa1 zaa1 lam4 gaau2 dim6 keoi5, aan3 di1 jiu3 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 赶快完成它，晚一点要交。
examples.english_sentence: Finish it quickly, it needs to be submitted later.

english_meaning: to set up a stall; to run a small business (usually a street stall)
explanation_mandarin: 指在街边或市场上摆摊售卖商品，从事小本生意。
explanation_english: Refers to setting up a stall on the street or in a market to sell goods and run a small business, typically a street stall or a small booth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廟街揸攤賣啲小飾物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 miu6 gaai1 zaa1 taan1 mai6 di1 siu2 sik1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在庙街摆摊卖一些小饰品。
examples.english_sentence: He sets up a stall in Temple Street selling some small ornaments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前阿爺都係喺街邊揸攤賣魚蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 aa3 je4 dou1 hai6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 zaa1 taan1 mai6 jyu4 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前爷爷也是在街边摆摊卖鱼蛋。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, grandpa also set up a stall on the street to sell fish balls.

mandarin_meaning: 结算账目, 核算账目
english_meaning: to check accounts, to audit, to settle accounts, to balance the books
explanation_mandarin: 指检查账目，核对账目，进行结算。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of checking accounts, verifying figures, and settling balances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每個禮拜都要揸數一次。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，好想自己揸舦，唔想俾人管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2, hou2 soeng2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 tai5, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，很想自己掌握主导权，不想被人管。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people really want to be in control themselves and don't want to be managed by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目一定要我哋揸舦，先可以保證成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 zaa1 tai5, sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 zing3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目一定要我们来掌控，才能保证成功。
examples.english_sentence: We must be in control of this project to guarantee success.

english_meaning: to be the banker (in gambling); to be in charge; to be the host; to be the organizer
explanation_mandarin: 在赌博中，指担任庄家。也引申为负责某事，主持局面，做主。
explanation_english: In gambling, it refers to being the banker. It also extends to meaning being responsible for something, being in charge, or being the host/organizer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚邊個揸莊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 bin1 go3 zaa1 zong1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚谁做庄啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who's the banker tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project由你揸莊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project jau4 nei5 zaa1 zong1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目由你负责了。
examples.english_sentence: You are in charge of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司揸莊好耐啦，咩都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zaa1 zong1 hou2 noi6 laa3, me1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司掌权很久了，什么都是他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in charge in the company for a long time, everything is up to him.

english_meaning: to drive (a car)
explanation_mandarin: 驾驶汽车。指操作方向盘和控制车辆行驶。
explanation_english: To drive a car. Refers to operating the steering wheel and controlling the movement of a vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要揸車返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zaa1 ce1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要开车上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to drive to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識揸車㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zaa1 ce1 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会不会开车啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know how to drive?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸車揸得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 zaa1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开车开得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He drives very fast.

english_meaning: To steer (a steering wheel); to drive (a vehicle)
explanation_mandarin: 握住方向盘进行驾驶。引申为开车。
explanation_english: To hold and steer the steering wheel of a vehicle; by extension, to drive a vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都揸軚返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zaa1 taai1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都开车上班。
examples.english_sentence: He drives to work every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你識唔識揸軚㗎？
