examples.english_sentence: Why don't we put this matter aside for now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架船搁浅咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 syun4 gok3 cin2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 船搁浅了。
examples.english_sentence: The ship has run aground.

english_meaning: to knock, to strike, to swindle, to extort
explanation_mandarin: 1. 敲打。2. 广东话口语，有敲竹杠，诈骗的意思。
explanation_english: 1. To knock or strike. 2. In Cantonese colloquial speech, it can mean to swindle or extort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搉詐我啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kok1 zaa3 ngo5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他诈骗了我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He swindled my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣搉人啦，好無良㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 kok1 jan4 laa1, hou2 mou4 loeng4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样敲诈别人了，很没良心的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't extort people like that, it's very unscrupulous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為可以搉我一筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 kok1 ngo5 jat1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为可以敲诈我一笔。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can swindle money from me.

english_meaning: to knead; to massage (with pressure)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具用力揉捏，使柔软或混合。
explanation_english: To knead, massage, or rub with pressure, often to soften or mix something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都搋麵粉整包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 caai2 min6 fan2 zeng2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是揉面粉做面包。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always kneads flour to make bread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我膊頭好攰，幫我搋下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bok3 tau4 hou2 gui6, bong1 ngo5 caai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我肩膀很累，帮我揉一下。
examples.english_sentence: My shoulders are tired, give me a massage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個師傅好大力搋我啲肌肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 si1 fu2 hou2 daai6 lik6 caai2 ngo5 di1 gei1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个师傅很用力地揉捏我的肌肉。
examples.english_sentence: That masseur kneaded my muscles very forcefully.

mandarin_meaning: 损, 贬低, 挖苦, 刻薄
english_meaning: To belittle, to mock, to make sarcastic remarks, to be mean with words, to damage slightly.
explanation_mandarin: （动词）用刻薄的话语嘲笑或贬低别人；（形容词）刻薄的，不善良的。
explanation_english: (Verb) To make sarcastic or belittling remarks towards someone. (Adjective) Sarcastic, mean, unkind in speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日損人啦，好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 syun2 jan4 laa1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是损人啦，很令人讨厌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always belittle people, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把口好損㗎，講嘢好難聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 hau2 hou2 syun2 gaa3, gong2 je5 hou2 naan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的嘴很损的，说话很难听。
examples.english_sentence: He's very sarcastic, he says very unpleasant things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車花咗，有啲損毀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 faa1 zo2, jau5 di1 syun2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车刮花了，有些损伤。
examples.english_sentence: This car is scratched and has some damage.

english_meaning: to harm others and bring no benefit to oneself; to cut off one's nose to spite one's face
explanation_mandarin: 损害别人对自己也没有好处。形容做了既害人又害己的蠢事。
explanation_english: Describes actions that harm others without benefiting oneself; actions that are ultimately self-defeating. It implies a foolish or spiteful act that hurts both the target and the perpetrator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做咪即係損人不利己囉，到頭來咪又係大家唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 syun2 jan4 bat1 lei6 gei2 lo1, dou3 tau4 lai4 mai1 jau6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是损人不利己吗，到头来还不是大家都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that is just harming others and yourself, in the end, everyone will be unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁幼稚啦，損人不利己嘅嘢唔好做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jau1 zi6 laa1, syun2 jan4 bat1 lei6 gei2 ge3 je5 m4 hou2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么幼稚了，损人不利己的事情不要做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so childish, don't do things that harm others and don't benefit you.

english_meaning: damage, injury, impairment
explanation_mandarin: 造成损害或受伤。可以指物理上的损坏，也可以指精神上的伤害。
explanation_english: To cause damage or injury. Can refer to physical damage or emotional/mental harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車撞到損傷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 zong6 dou3 syun2 soeng1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车撞坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The car got damaged in the crash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺意外度受到嚴重損傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji3 ngoi6 dou6 sau6 dou3 jyun4 zung6 syun2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在事故中受到了严重的损伤。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered serious injuries in the accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事對佢嘅名譽造成咗好大嘅損傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 ming4 jyu6 zaau6 sing4 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 syun2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事对他的名誉造成了很大的损害。
examples.english_sentence: This event caused great damage to his reputation.

english_meaning: to suffer losses in manpower and resources
explanation_mandarin: 比喻战争中士兵和将领都受到损失；也比喻做事情受到损失，没有达到预期的目的。
explanation_english: A military idiom meaning to suffer losses in both soldiers and generals. Metaphorically, it means to suffer losses and not achieve the desired result in an endeavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資失敗，真係損兵折將啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 baai6, zan1 hai6 syun2 bing1 zit3 zeong3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资失败，真是损兵折将啊。
examples.english_sentence: This investment failure is truly a loss of both soldiers and generals (a significant loss).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想偷雞唔成，仲要損兵折將，抵你死啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 tau1 gai1 m4 sing4, zung6 jiu3 syun2 bing1 zit3 zeong3, dai2 nei5 si2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想占便宜没成功，还损兵折将，活该你倒霉！
examples.english_sentence: You tried to take a shortcut and failed, and ended up suffering losses. Serves you right!

english_meaning: bad friend; friend who often plays practical jokes or teases
explanation_mandarin: 指经常出馊主意、捉弄人、开玩笑过度的朋友。
explanation_english: Refers to a friend who often gives bad advice, plays practical jokes, or teases excessively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你班損友成日教你啲衰嘢，你都唔聽我講！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baan1 syun2 jau5 seng4 jat6 gaau3 nei5 di1 seoi1 je5, nei5 dou1 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这群损友总是教你一些不好的东西，你都不听我的！
examples.english_sentence: Your group of bad friends always teaches you bad things, and you don't listen to me!

english_meaning: to damage; to break; to impair
explanation_mandarin: 指物体或事物受到破坏而失去原来的功能或状态。
explanation_english: To be damaged or broken, resulting in a loss of original function or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦跌咗落地，損壞咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, syun2 waai6 zo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑掉到地上，坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The computer fell to the ground and got damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部升降機損壞，暫停使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sing1 gong3 gei1 syun2 waai6, zaam6 ting4 si2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电梯损坏，暂停使用。
examples.english_sentence: This elevator is out of order and is temporarily suspended.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期暴露喺陽光下會損壞皮膚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 bou6 lou6 hai2 joeng4 gwong1 haa6 wui5 syun2 waai6 pei4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期暴露在阳光下会损伤皮肤。
examples.english_sentence: Prolonged exposure to sunlight can damage the skin.

english_meaning: loss, damage, to lose
explanation_mandarin: 指在经济上或物质上的减少或失去；亦可指失去机会或能力。
explanation_english: Refers to a decrease or loss in economic or material terms; can also refer to a loss of opportunity or ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資損失咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 syun2 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资损失了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment resulted in a big loss of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為遲到而損失咗一個重要嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 ci4 dou3 yi4 syun2 sat1 zo2 yat1 go3 zung6 yiu3 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为迟到而失去了一个重要的机会。
examples.english_sentence: He lost an important opportunity because he was late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次火災造成咗好大嘅損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 fo2 zoi1 zou6 sing4 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次火灾造成了很大的损失。
examples.english_sentence: This fire caused a great deal of damage.

english_meaning: damage, harm, injure, impair
explanation_mandarin: 造成破坏或伤害；对某事物造成负面的影响。
explanation_english: To cause damage or harm; to have a negative impact on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 吸煙對身體嘅損害好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kap1 jin1 deoi3 san1 tai2 ge3 syun2 hoi6 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吸烟对身体的损害很大。
examples.english_sentence: Smoking causes great damage to your health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉樣做會損害公司嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 wui5 syun2 hoi6 gung1 si1 ge3 seng1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做会损害公司的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this will damage the company's reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係已經受到損害，好難修復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 ji5 ging1 sau6 dou3 syun2 hoi6, hou2 naan4 sau1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系已经受到了损害，很难修复。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has already been damaged and is difficult to repair.

english_meaning: to suffer a loss; to lose money (in business or investment); to be short-handed (less common)
explanation_mandarin: 在经济上遭受损失，亏本。 也有人指人手不够，但较少使用。
explanation_english: To suffer a financial loss; to lose money (especially in business or investment). It can also (though less commonly) mean to be short-handed, lacking manpower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資損手，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 syun2 sau2, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资亏损了，赔了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment resulted in a loss; I lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市咁波動，好易損手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 gam3 bo1 dung6, hou2 ji6 syun2 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市这么波动，很容易亏损的。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market is so volatile, it's easy to lose money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為疫情而損手咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yan1 wai6 jik6 cing4 ji4 syun2 sau2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情，这家公司亏损了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost a lot of money due to the pandemic.

english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; to be prone to accidents and injuries; to be all thumbs
explanation_mandarin: 形容人动作笨拙，容易受伤或损坏东西。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy and awkward, prone to accidents, injuries, or breaking things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁損手爛腳，唔好俾佢掂啲易碎嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dim6 di1 ji6 seoi3 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么笨手笨脚的，不要让他碰那些易碎的东西了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so clumsy, don't let him touch fragile things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整親隻手，而家損手爛腳，乜都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 can1 zek3 sau2, ji4 gaa1 syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弄伤了手，现在笨手笨脚的，什么都做不了。
examples.english_sentence: I hurt my hand and now I'm all thumbs; I can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁損手爛腳啦，都跌爛咗三個碗㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 syun2 sau2 laan6 goek3 laa1, dou1 dit3 laan6 zo2 saam1 go3 wun2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨手笨脚的啦，都摔碎了三个碗了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you've already broken three bowls!

english_meaning: to damage, to ruin, to destroy, damage, destruction
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体受到破坏，失去原有的功能或价值。
explanation_english: To be damaged or destroyed, to suffer impairment. It can also refer to the state of being damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話跌落地面，損毀咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 dit3 lok6 dei6 min6, syun2 wai2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话掉在地上，损坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone fell on the ground and got damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風造成咗好多損毀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 zou6 sing4 zo2 hou2 do1 syun2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风造成了很多损坏。
examples.english_sentence: The typhoon caused a lot of damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫好耐歷史，但係保存得好好，冇乜損毀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hou2 noi6 lik6 si2, daan6 hai6 bou2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 hou2, mou5 mat1 syun2 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画历史悠久，但是保存得很好，没什么损坏。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has a long history, but it's well preserved and has little damage.

english_meaning: damaged, broken, worn out
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品受到损坏，失去原有的完整或功能。
explanation_english: Describes something that is damaged, broken, or worn out, losing its original integrity or functionality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話跌咗落地，螢幕損爛晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6, ying4 mok6 syun2 laan6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电话掉到地上，屏幕全损坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The phone fell on the ground, and the screen is completely damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫着咗好耐，已經損爛咗好多地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 zoek3 zo2 hou2 noi6, yi5 ging1 syun2 laan6 zo2 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服穿了很久，已经损坏了很多地方。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing has been worn for a long time, and it's damaged in many places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路年久失修，損爛得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 nin4 gau2 sat1 sau1, syun2 laan6 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路年久失修，损坏得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: This road hasn't been repaired for years and is severely damaged.

english_meaning: profit and loss statement, income statement
explanation_mandarin: 一种财务报表，显示公司在特定时期内的收入、支出和利润或亏损。
explanation_english: A financial statement that summarizes a company's revenues, costs, and expenses incurred during a specific period of time, resulting in a profit or loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅損益賬顯示今年盈利增加咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 syun2 yik1 zoeng3 hin2 si6 gam1 nin4 wing4 lei6 zeng1 gaa1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的损益表显示今年盈利增加了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's profit and loss statement shows that profits have increased significantly this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會計師負責準備每月嘅損益賬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 gai3 si1 fu3 zaak3 jun2 bei6 mui5 jyut6 ge3 syun2 yik1 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会计师负责准备每月的损益表。
examples.english_sentence: The accountant is responsible for preparing the monthly profit and loss statement.

english_meaning: loss; wastage; wear and tear; attrition
explanation_mandarin: 指在使用过程中逐渐减少或损失。
explanation_english: To decrease or lose gradually during use; depletion; wear and tear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器用咗好耐，損耗都幾嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 yung6 zo2 hou2 noi6, syun2 hou3 dou1 gei2 yim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器用了很久，损耗挺严重的。
examples.english_sentence: This machine has been used for a long time, and the wear and tear is quite severe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減低生產過程嘅損耗可以提升利潤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 dai1 sang1 caan2 gwo3 cing4 ge3 syun2 hou3 ho2 ji5 tai4 sing1 lei6 yeun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 降低生产过程中的损耗可以提升利润。
examples.english_sentence: Reducing wastage in the production process can increase profits.

english_meaning: to fight, to struggle, to strive for, to risk (something)
explanation_mandarin: 指努力争取，不顾一切地去拼。
explanation_english: Refers to striving hard and fighting without regard for anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份工，真係好搏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 bok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这份工作，真的很拼搏。
examples.english_sentence: He really works hard for this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搏埋呢鋪，希望可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bok3 maai4 ni1 pou1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冒险一搏，希望可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: He's taking a gamble in hopes of succeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁搏命啦，身體要緊呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bok3 ming6 laa1, san1 tai2 jiu3 gan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么拼命了，身体重要啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't work so hard, your health is important.

jyutping: bok3 jat1 bok3, daan1 ce1 bin3 mo1 to1
mandarin_meaning: 赌一把，自行车变摩托车 (赌一把，可能会有意外收获)
english_meaning: Take a chance, and your bicycle might become a motorcycle (Take a gamble, you might get a surprising reward)
explanation_mandarin: 意思是放手一搏，可能会有意外的收获。比喻通过冒险或尝试，有可能获得意想不到的成功或好处。其中“單車變摩托”是比喻从小到大、从弱到强的变化。
explanation_english: It means taking a chance or a gamble in the hope of achieving a significant reward or improvement. The phrase "bicycle transforming into a motorcycle" symbolizes a drastic upgrade or unexpected success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，不如搏一搏，單車變摩托，試下搞網上生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, bat1 jyu4 bok3 jat1 bok3, daan1 ce1 bin3 mo1 to1, si3 haa5 gaau2 mong5 soeng5 sing1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，不如赌一把，自行车变摩托车，试试做网上生意。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is not doing well, so why not take a chance, maybe our bicycle will become a motorcycle, let's try running an online business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要辭職去創業，真係搏一搏，單車變摩托喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1 heoi3 cong3 jip6, zan1 hai6 bok3 jat1 bok3, daan1 ce1 bin3 mo1 to1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要辞职去创业，真是赌一把，自行车变摩托车啊！
examples.english_sentence: He said he's quitting his job to start a business, that's really taking a chance, hoping his bicycle turns into a motorcycle!

english_meaning: To strive for promotion; to climb the ladder; to be ambitious and actively seek advancement
explanation_mandarin: 指为了获得更高的地位或职位而努力奋斗，甚至不惜使用手段。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of striving hard, sometimes unscrupulously, to gain a higher position or status in a career or social hierarchy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗搏上位，真係乜嘢都做得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bok3 soeng5 wai2, zan1 hai6 mat1 je5 dou1 zo6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了往上爬，他真的什么都做得出来。
examples.english_sentence: To get promoted, he's capable of anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁搏上位，遲早會惹人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 bok3 soeng5 wai2, ci4 zou2 wui5 je5 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么积极地往上爬，迟早会引起反感。
examples.english_sentence: His aggressive ambition to climb the ladder will eventually alienate people.

english_meaning: to act rashly; to mess around; to cause chaos; to make a mess of things
explanation_mandarin: 指不按常理出牌，不顾后果地胡乱行动，导致事情混乱或失败。
explanation_english: Refers to acting rashly and carelessly without considering the consequences, leading to chaos or failure. It implies a lack of planning and a disregard for proper procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搏亂啦，次次都搞衰晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 bok3 lyun6 laa1, ci3 ci3 dou1 gaau2 seoi1 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再瞎搞了，每次都把事情搞砸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around anymore, you always ruin everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，就走去搏亂，真係唔知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, zau6 zau2 heoi3 bok3 lyun6, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，就跑去瞎搞，真不知道他想怎么样。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he went to mess around, I really don't know what he's trying to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度搏亂呀，阿媽陣間返嚟鬧人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 bok3 lyun6 aa3, aa3 maa1 zan6 gaan1 faan1 lai4 naau6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里胡闹，妈妈一会儿回来会骂人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around here, Mom will be back later and scold us.

english_meaning: to play dumb; to feign ignorance; to act stupid
explanation_mandarin: 故意装作愚蠢或无知，以达到某种目的。
explanation_english: To deliberately act stupid or ignorant, often to avoid responsibility or gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同我搏傻啊，明明就係你整爛嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 ngo5 bok3 so4 aa3, ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 nei5 zing2 laan6 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别跟我装傻，明明就是你弄坏的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb with me, it was clearly you who broke it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前搏傻，扮乜都唔識咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 bok3 so4, baan6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在老板面前装傻，假装什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He often plays dumb in front of the boss, pretending he doesn't know anything.

mandarin_meaning: 为了出名而努力表现； 争上位
english_meaning: To try to stand out and gain attention; to strive for a better position (often implying using controversial or attention-grabbing methods); attention-seeking
explanation_mandarin: 指某人为了获得名气或更高的职位，通过各种方式（包括但不限于制造话题、炒作、夸张表现）来吸引大众的注意。
explanation_english: Refers to someone trying to gain fame or a better position by using various methods (including but not limited to creating controversy, hype, and exaggerated performances) to attract public attention. It often carries a negative connotation, implying that the person is doing it for the sake of fame rather than genuine talent or contribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交媒體搏出位，乜嘢都敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se5 giao1 mui4 tai2 bok3 ceot1 wai2, mat1 je5 dou1 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在社交媒体上博出位，什么都敢说。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to stand out on social media, he dares to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話佢為咗搏出位，乜嘢手段都用得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 wai6 zo2 bok3 ceot1 wai2, mat1 je5 sau2 dyun6 dou1 jung6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说他为了博出位，什么手段都使得出来。
examples.english_sentence: People say he'll use any means necessary to get attention.

mandarin_meaning: 拼尽全力; 竭尽全力
english_meaning: To give it your all; to go all out; to strive to the utmost; to push oneself to the limit.
explanation_mandarin: 指尽最大的努力，做到极限，毫不保留。通常形容在工作、学习或比赛中竭尽所能。
explanation_english: Refers to exerting maximum effort, reaching the limit, and holding nothing back. Usually describes giving your all in work, study, or competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我一定要搏到盡，攞個好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bok3 dou3 zeon6, lo2 go3 hou2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我一定要拼尽全力，取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: I must give it my all in this exam and get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏呢場比賽，我哋一定要搏到盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wing4 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bok3 dou3 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得这场比赛，我们一定要竭尽全力。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win this competition, we must go all out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗事業，搏到盡，搞到個人都瘦晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 si6 jip3, bok3 dou3 zeon6, gaau2 dou3 go3 jan4 dou1 sau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了事业，他拼尽了全力，搞得人都瘦了。
examples.english_sentence: He gave it his all for his career, and he lost so much weight.

english_meaning: to try to gain sympathy; to fish for sympathy; sympathy baiting
explanation_mandarin: 指通过某种方式，故意装可怜或夸大困难，以获得他人的同情和怜悯。
explanation_english: To deliberately try to gain sympathy from others, often by playing the victim or exaggerating difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都搏同情，想人哋幫佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 bok3 tung4 cing4, soeng2 jan4 dei6 bong1 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是博取同情，想让别人帮他做事。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to gain sympathy, hoping that others will do things for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搏同情啦，冇人會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 bok3 tung4 cing4 laa1, mou5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再博取同情了，没人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop trying to gain sympathy, no one will believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢嘅眼淚呃到，佢只係搏同情啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 ge3 ngaan5 leoi6 aak1 dou2, keoi5 zi2 hai6 bok3 tung4 cing4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被她的眼泪骗了，她只是在博取同情而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by her tears, she's just trying to gain sympathy.

english_meaning: to risk one's life; to work extremely hard; to go all out; to give it one's all
explanation_mandarin: 用尽全力，不顾一切地去做某事；形容非常努力或者冒着生命危险。
explanation_english: To risk one's life or work extremely hard to achieve something; to put in maximum effort, often disregarding personal safety or well-being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗養家，日頭返工，夜晚揸的士，真係搏命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 joeng5 gaa1, jat6 tau4 faan1 gung1, je6 maan5 zaa1 dik1 si2, zan1 hai6 bok3 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了养家，他白天上班，晚上开出租车，真是拼命。
examples.english_sentence: To support his family, he works during the day and drives a taxi at night. He's really working himself to the bone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工咁辛苦，唔係搏命都做唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2, m4 hai6 bok3 ming6 dou1 zou6 m4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作这么辛苦，不拼命做不来。
examples.english_sentence: This job is so tiring. You can't do it without working your butt off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗趕起單project，佢哋搏命OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gon2 hei2 daan1 project, keoi5 dei6 bok3 ming6 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赶上这个项目，他们拼命加班。
examples.english_sentence: To catch up with this project, they're working overtime like crazy.

mandarin_meaning: 冒险, 铤而走险, 碰运气
english_meaning: To take a risk, to gamble, to take a chance, to act boldly in a risky situation, daredevil behavior
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某个目的，不顾危险或困难，冒险尝试。通常带有碰运气或者赌一把的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to taking a risk or chance to achieve a goal, despite the danger or difficulty involved. Often carries the implication of taking a gamble or betting on luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗賺快錢，搏大膽買咗啲高風險嘅股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zaan6 faai3 cin2, bok3 daai6 daam2 maai5 zo2 di1 gou1 him2 hung2 ge3 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赚快钱，他冒险买了些高风险的股票。
examples.english_sentence: In order to make quick money, he took a risk and bought some high-risk stocks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次搏大膽試下，睇下可唔可以成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bok3 daai6 daam2 si3 haa5, tai2 haa5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次冒险试一下，看看是否可以成功。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a chance this time and see if we can succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住搏大膽，好多嘢都係要一步一步嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 bok3 daai6 daam2, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 jiu3 jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着冒险，很多事情都是要一步一步来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about taking risks; many things need to be done step by step.

english_meaning: to feign ignorance, to play dumb, to try to get away with something by pretending not to understand
explanation_mandarin: 指假装不知道，装糊涂，企图蒙混过关，逃避责任。
explanation_english: To pretend not to know something, to play dumb in order to avoid responsibility or get away with something. It implies an attempt to deceive by feigning ignorance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，想搏大霧唔認數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, soeng2 bok3 daai6 mou6 m4 jing6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错了事，想装糊涂不认账。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong and is trying to play dumb so he doesn't have to take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好想搏大霧，我哋知道晒你嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 soeng2 bok3 daai6 mou6, ngo5 dei6 zi1 dou3晒 nei5 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想装糊涂，我们都知道你的计划了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to play dumb, we know all about your plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搏大霧話唔記得交功課，點知老師唔信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bok3 daai6 mou6 waa6 m4 gei3 dak1 gaau1 gung1 fo3, dim2 zi1 lou5 si1 m4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他装糊涂说忘记交作业了，结果老师不相信。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended he forgot to hand in his homework, but the teacher didn't believe him.

synonyms: 詐傻扮懵 (zaa3 so4 baan6 mung2)

mandarin_meaning: 拼命取悦男性；卖弄风骚
english_meaning: To desperately try to please men; to be sexually provocative and attention-seeking (often in a negative way)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性为了获得男性关注、喜爱或利益，不择手段地取悦他们，通常带有负面含义，指责其行为过分卖弄风骚。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who desperately tries to please men, often through provocative behavior, in order to gain attention, affection, or benefits. It carries a negative connotation, often used to criticize someone for being overly flirtatious and manipulative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都着到咁性感，擺明就係搏屌啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zoek3 dou3 gam3 sing3 gam2, baai2 ming4 zau6 hai6 bok3 diu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都穿得这么性感，摆明就是为了勾引男人。
examples.english_sentence: She dresses so sexily every day; it's obvious that she's just trying to get attention from men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁搏屌啦，做返自己咪好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 bok3 diu2 laa1, zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 mai1 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么卖弄风骚了，做回自己不是很好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't try so hard to please men, isn't it better to just be yourself?

mandarin_meaning: 赌博, 碰运气, 博彩
english_meaning: Gambling, betting, lottery
explanation_mandarin: 指进行赌博活动，通常涉及金钱或财物的输赢，也泛指碰运气，希望通过某种行为获得意外的好处。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of gambling, usually involving the risk of losing money or possessions. It can also broadly refer to trying one's luck, hoping to gain unexpected benefits through a particular action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去澳門搏彩，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 Ou3 Mun4 bok3 coi2, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去澳门赌博，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to Macau to gamble and has lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買六合彩都係搏彩啫，唔好太認真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 luk6 hap6 coi2 dou1 hai6 bok3 coi2 ze1, m4 hou2 taai3 jing6 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买彩票也是碰运气而已，不要太认真。
examples.english_sentence: Buying the lottery is just gambling, don't take it too seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住搏彩，希望可以一夜致富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zyu6 bok3 coi2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 je6 zi3 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想着碰运气，希望可以一夜暴富。
examples.english_sentence: He's hoping to gamble and become rich overnight.

english_meaning: To take a chance; to try one's luck; to try to get away with something; to take advantage of someone's ignorance or unawareness; to freeload.
explanation_mandarin: 指利用别人不清楚状况或无防备时占便宜、蒙混过关。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of someone's lack of awareness or defenselessness, trying to get away with something, or freeloading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想搏懵，唔俾錢就想食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 bok3 mung2, m4 bei2 cin2 zau6 soeng2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想蒙混过关，不给钱就想吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to freeload, wanting to eat without paying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住搏懵，今次一定要交足功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 bok3 mung2, gam1 ci3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau2 zuk1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着蒙混过关，这次一定要交足功课。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about trying to get away with it; you must hand in complete homework this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為可以搏懵，點知俾人捉到正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 ho2 ji5 bok3 mung2, dim2 zi1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为可以蒙混过关，没想到被人当场抓住。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could get away with it, but he was caught red-handed.

english_meaning: terrible; awful; extremely bad; sucks
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情、情况或物品非常糟糕、差劲，令人失望。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that is terrible, awful, or extremely bad. It conveys a strong sense of disapproval and disappointment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試真係搏拉，乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 zan1 hai6 bok3 laai1, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试真是糟糕透了，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: This exam was absolutely terrible, I couldn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食搏拉到呢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 bok3 laai1 dou3 ne1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西难吃死了！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant sucks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日個波踢得好搏拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 go3 bo1 tek3 dak1 hou2 bok3 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天球踢得很烂。
examples.english_sentence: Today the soccer was played terribly.

english_meaning: combat, fighting, to fight
explanation_mandarin: 指徒手或使用简单武器进行的格斗、搏斗。
explanation_english: Refers to fighting or combat, usually involving hand-to-hand combat or using simple weapons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意睇搏擊比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 bok3 gik1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢看搏击比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes watching combat sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個開始學搏擊，所以好打得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 hoi1 chi2 hok6 bok3 gik1, so2 ji5 hou2 daa2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学习搏击，所以很能打。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning combat sports since he was young, so he is a good fighter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間健身室有搏擊課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gin3 san1 sat1 jau5 bok3 gik1 fo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家健身房有搏击课程。
examples.english_sentence: This gym offers combat sports classes.

english_meaning: to strive, to struggle, to work hard, to fight fiercely, to hustle (for work or money)
explanation_mandarin: 指努力拼搏，力求成功，通常带有竞争激烈的意味。在香港常用来形容努力工作赚钱。
explanation_english: Refers to striving and working hard for success, often with the implication of intense competition. In Hong Kong, it is commonly used to describe working hard to earn money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，要搏殺啲先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, jiu3 bok3 saat3 di1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，要努力拼搏一些才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good now, we need to work harder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都搏殺到好夜先返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 bok3 saat3 dou3 hou2 je6 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都努力工作到很晚才回家。
examples.english_sentence: He works hard every day and only goes home very late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗層樓，我哋要一齊搏殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 cang4 lau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 bok3 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了买房，我们得一起努力奋斗。
examples.english_sentence: To buy an apartment, we need to strive together.

mandarin_meaning: 故意表现不好，寻求被解雇
english_meaning: To deliberately perform poorly at work in order to get fired (and possibly collect severance pay or unemployment benefits).
explanation_mandarin: 指为了获取解雇赔偿或失业救济金，故意在工作中表现糟糕，以求被雇主解雇。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to intentionally performing poorly at work to get fired, usually in order to collect severance pay or unemployment benefits. It carries a negative connotation, implying laziness or opportunistic behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日返工都hea做，明顯係想搏炒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 faan1 gung1 dou1 hea1 zou6, ming4 hin2 hai6 soeng2 bok3 caau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天上班都偷懒，明显是想寻求被解雇。
examples.english_sentence: He slacks off every day at work, it's obvious that he wants to get fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁搏炒，會影響埋其他同事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 bok3 caau2, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 maai4 kei4 taa1 tung4 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样故意表现不好，会影响到其他同事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't deliberately perform poorly like that, it will affect your colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都諗住搏炒攞賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lam2 zyu6 bok3 caau2 lo2 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都想着故意被解雇来拿赔偿。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, many people are thinking of deliberately getting fired to get compensation.

english_meaning: to give it your all; to go all out; to put in maximum effort
explanation_mandarin: 尽最大的努力去做某事，不遗余力。
explanation_english: To exert maximum effort; to strive with all one's might; to go all out to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我會搏盡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 wui5 bok3 zeon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我会全力以赴的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to give it my all for this exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗贏比賽，我哋一定要搏盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wing4 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bok3 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了赢得比赛，我们一定要全力以赴。
examples.english_sentence: In order to win the competition, we must go all out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人做嘢好搏盡，所以升職都好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zou6 je5 hou2 bok3 zeon6, so2 ji5 sing1 zik1 dou1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很努力，所以升职很快。
examples.english_sentence: He works very hard, so he gets promoted quickly.

english_meaning: Go all out and have no regrets; give it your all and have no regrets; no regrets after giving your best effort
explanation_mandarin: 指尽自己最大的努力去做某事，即使结果不如意，也不会后悔。
explanation_english: It means to give your best effort in doing something, and even if the result is not satisfactory, you will have no regrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我已經搏盡無悔㗎啦，考成點都算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 ji5 ging1 bok3 zeon6 mou4 fui3 gaa3 laa1, haau2 sing4 dim2 dou1 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我已经全力以赴了，考成什么样都算了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already given it my all for this exam, whatever the result may be, I'll accept it.
