examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要自找麻烦了，明明没事都弄出事来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask for trouble. You managed to create problems where there were none.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸你唔好再撩佢，你搵嚟搞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 liu1 keoi5, nei5 wan2 lai4 gaau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝你不要再去惹他了，你是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to provoke him again, you are just asking for trouble.

synonyms: 自討苦吃 (zi6 tou2 fu2 hek3)

mandarin_meaning: 到处赚钱; 八方来财
english_meaning: To make money from all directions; to earn money from various sources.
explanation_mandarin: 指从各个地方、各个渠道赚钱。形容赚钱的方式很多，不局限于某个特定的行业或地点。
explanation_english: Refers to making money from all places and channels. It describes having many ways to earn money, not limited to a specific industry or location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，要搵四方錢至得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, jiu3 wan2 sei3 fong1 cin2 zi3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，要四处赚钱才行。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is not good now, we need to make money from all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎，乜都識搞，所以搵到好多四方錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, mat1 dou1 sik1 gaau2, so2 ji5 wan2 dou2 hou2 do1 sei3 fong1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能干，什么都会做，所以赚到很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable and knows how to do everything, so he earns a lot of money from various sources.

english_meaning: to look for a school; to find a school
explanation_mandarin: 寻找合适的学校，通常指为孩子寻找学校或自己寻找学习机构。
explanation_english: To search for a suitable school, usually for one's child or for oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋依家要開始幫個仔搵學校喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji1 gaa1 jiu3 hoi1 chi2 bong1 go3 zai2 wan2 hok6 haau6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在要开始帮儿子找学校了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to start looking for a school for our son now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗份工，想搵學校讀返個學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1, soeng2 wan2 hok6 haau6 duk6 faan1 go3 hok6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞掉了工作，想找学校读回一个学位。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job and wants to find a school to get a degree.

english_meaning: to look for a house/apartment
explanation_mandarin: 寻找住所，如房子或公寓。
explanation_english: To search for a place to live, such as a house or apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想搵屋搬出去住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 wan2 uk1 bun1 chut1 heoi3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想找房子搬出去住。
examples.english_sentence: We want to look for a place to move out and live.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近香港好難搵屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 naan4 wan2 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近在香港很难找到房子。
examples.english_sentence: It's really hard to find a place in Hong Kong these days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺網上搵屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 wan2 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在网上找房子。
examples.english_sentence: He looks for a house online every day.

english_meaning: to look for a job; to find work
explanation_mandarin: 寻找工作机会。
explanation_english: To seek employment; to actively search for job opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畢業之後就開始搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他毕业之后就开始找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He started looking for a job after graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好難搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 naan4 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很难找工作。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good right now, it's difficult to find work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫你留意下，睇吓有無啱你嘅工搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 nei5 lau4 yi3 haa5, tai2 haa5 yau5 mou5 aam1 nei5 ge3 gung1 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我帮你留意一下，看看有没有适合你的工作。
examples.english_sentence: I'll keep an eye out for you, and see if there are any jobs that are suitable for you.

english_meaning: to look for a job; to find work
explanation_mandarin: 寻找工作。
explanation_english: To seek or search for employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近失業，要開始搵工喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sat1 jip6, jiu3 hoi1 chi2 wan2 gung1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近失业了，要开始找工作了。
examples.english_sentence: I recently became unemployed, so I need to start looking for a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都上網搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 soeng5 mong5 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都上网找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He looks for a job online every day.

english_meaning: to make quick money, to get rich quick
explanation_mandarin: 指通过某种途径迅速赚取大量金钱。通常暗示这种途径风险较高，或者不正当。
explanation_english: Refers to earning a large sum of money quickly, often implying that the method involves high risk or may be illegitimate or unethical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住炒股票搵快錢，點知輸晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 caau2 gu2 piu3 wan2 faai3 cin2, dim2 zi1 syu1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想通过炒股赚快钱，没想到输光了。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could make quick money by speculating in stocks, but he ended up losing everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都想搵快錢，但係呢啲機會通常都好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 wan2 faai3 cin2, daan6 hai6 ni1 di1 gei1 wui2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都想赚快钱，但是这些机会通常都很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Many people want to make quick money, but these opportunities are usually very risky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住搵快錢，腳踏實地先至係正路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 wan2 faai3 cin2, goek3 daap6 sat6 dei6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zeng3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着赚快钱，脚踏实地才是正道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about making quick money; being down-to-earth is the right path.

english_meaning: to make quick money; to get rich quick
explanation_mandarin: 指通过某些途径在短时间内赚取大量金钱。
explanation_english: Refers to making a large amount of money in a short period, often through risky or speculative means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以靠炒股票搵快錢呀，風險好大㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 kaau3 caau2 gu2 piu3 wan2 faai3 cin2 aa3, fung1 him2 hou2 daai6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着靠炒股票来赚快钱，风险很大！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get rich quick by playing the stock market, the risks are very high!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住搵快錢，所以搞到一身蟻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 wan2 faai3 cin2, so2 ji5 gaau2 dou3 jat1 san1 ngai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着赚快钱，所以搞得一身麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to make quick money, which always gets him into trouble.

english_meaning: another day; some other day; sometime
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定的将来时间，意为“改天”、“以后再说”。通常用于婉拒或拖延做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates an indefinite future time, meaning 'another day', 'some other day', or 'sometime'. It is often used to politely decline or postpone doing something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如搵日一齊飲茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 wan2 jat6 jat1 cai4 jam2 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如改天一起喝茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we go for dim sum some other day?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搵日再傾啦，而家好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wan2 jat6 zoi3 king1 laa1, ji4 gaa1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们改天再聊吧，现在很忙。
examples.english_sentence: Let's talk another day, I'm very busy right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵日請你食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 jat6 cheng2 nei5 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 改天请你吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'll treat you to a meal some other day.

english_meaning: Another day, some day, one of these days
explanation_mandarin: 表示不确定的一天，通常用来表示将来某个时候，但没有具体时间。
explanation_english: Expresses an indefinite time in the future, often used to mean 'sometime in the future' without specifying a particular date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵日我請你飲茶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 jat6 ngo5 cing2 nei5 jam2 caa4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 改天我请你喝茶吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'll treat you to dim sum some day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，今晚唔得閒，搵日再約啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, gam1 maan1 m4 dak1 haan4, wan2 jat6 zoi3 joek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，今晚没空，改天再约吧。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm not free tonight. Let's arrange another day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事搵日先處理啦，而家冇時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 wan2 jat6 sin1 cyu2 lei5 laa1, ji4 gaa1 mou5 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事改天再处理吧，现在没时间。
examples.english_sentence: Let's deal with this another day, I don't have time now.

english_meaning: Barely making ends meet; living hand to mouth; unable to plan for the future due to financial insecurity.
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活非常困苦，今天赚的钱只能勉强维持今天的开销，无法为未来做任何计划。
explanation_english: Describes a very difficult financial situation where one's earnings are only sufficient for the present day, leaving no ability to save or plan for the future. It implies a precarious existence where one's income is uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，好多人都搵朝唔得晏，好難儲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 aan3, hou2 naan4 cou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，很多人都朝不保夕，很难存钱。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now, many people are barely making ends meet, and it's very difficult to save money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工唔穩定，搵朝唔得晏，成日都擔心冇飯開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 m4 wan2 ding6, wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 aan3, seng4 jat6 dou1 daam1 sam1 mou5 faan6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作不稳定，朝不保夕，总是担心没饭吃。
examples.english_sentence: His job is unstable, he's living hand to mouth, and he's always worried about not having enough to eat.

english_meaning: Barely making ends meet; living hand to mouth; struggling to survive financially.
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活非常贫困，早上找的钱不够晚上用，比喻生活极其艰难，没有保障。
explanation_english: Describes a very impoverished life where the money earned in the morning is not enough to cover expenses for the evening. It signifies a precarious existence with no financial security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲嘢咁貴，好多基層市民都係搵朝唔得晚，好慘㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, hou2 do1 gei1 cang4 si5 man4 dou1 hai6 wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 maan5, hou2 caam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在物价这么贵，很多基层市民都朝不保夕，很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: With things being so expensive nowadays, many grassroots citizens are barely making ends meet; it's really miserable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工唔穩定，成日都搵朝唔得晚，唔知幾時會俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 m4 wan2 ding6, seng4 jat6 dou1 wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 maan5, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 wui5 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作不稳定，总是朝不保夕，不知道什么时候会被炒鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: His job is unstable, he's constantly living hand to mouth, and doesn't know when he'll be fired.

english_meaning: To barely make ends meet; living from hand to mouth; unable to secure even the next day's sustenance
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活非常困苦，连第二天要吃什么都无法确定。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone is struggling to survive, unable to secure even the basic necessities for the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搵朝唔得晚，生活好艱難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 maan5, sang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们朝不保夕，生活很艰难。
examples.english_sentence: They barely make ends meet, and their lives are very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個經濟唔好嘅時候，好多人都搵朝唔得晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wan2 ziu1 m4 dak1 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个经济不好的时候，很多人都朝不保夕。
examples.english_sentence: In this bad economy, many people are living from hand to mouth.

english_meaning: to make money, to earn a living
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找赚钱的机会或途径。
explanation_english: Refers to finding opportunities or ways to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好難搵水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 naan4 wan2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很难赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good right now, it's hard to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都諗住點樣搵水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 wan2 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在想着怎么赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks about how to make money every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排冇乜嘢撈，搵水都冇乜路數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 mou5 mat1 je5 lou1, wan2 seoi2 dou1 mou5 mat1 lou6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近没什么活儿，赚钱也没有什么门路。
examples.english_sentence: There's not much work lately, and there are not many ways to earn money.

english_meaning: to earn real money; to make serious money; to earn a good living
explanation_mandarin: 指赚取实实在在的钱，通常指通过正当手段获得可观的收入。
explanation_english: Refers to earning real money, especially through legitimate means and in a substantial amount. Implies earning a good income and not just small change. '眞銀' (zan1 ngan4) literally means 'real silver', representing actual, valuable money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家轉咗份工，希望可以搵眞銀啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zyun2 zo2 fan6 gung1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 wan2 zan1 ngan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在换了一份工作，希望可以赚更多的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He changed jobs now, hoping to earn more real money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意都係想搵眞銀啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 dou1 hai6 soeng2 wan2 zan1 ngan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意都是想赚钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: Doing business is all about making real money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年興網上平台，好多人都諗住可以搵眞銀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 nin4 hing1 mong5 soeng6 ping4 toi4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 wan2 zan1 ngan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来流行网上平台，很多人都想着可以在网上平台赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, online platforms have become popular, and many people think they can earn real money from them.

english_meaning: to earn real money, to make serious money
explanation_mandarin: 搵是寻找、赚取的意思。真银是指真正的钱，不是小钱、不是虚假的收入，而是实实在在的、能带来财富的收入。
explanation_english: "搵" means to find or to earn. "真銀" refers to real money, not small change or insignificant earnings, but substantial income that can lead to wealth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日OT，都係為咗搵真銀啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 OT, dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 wan2 zan1 ngan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都加班，都是为了赚真钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: He works overtime every day, just to make some real money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業好難搵真銀㗎，不如考慮下轉工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 hou2 naan4 wan2 zan1 ngan4 gaa3, bat1 jyu4 hau2 leoi6 haa5 zyun2 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业很难赚到真钱，不如考虑一下换工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's difficult to make serious money in this industry, maybe you should consider switching jobs.

english_meaning: to make real money; to earn a significant amount of money; to strike it rich
explanation_mandarin: 指通过努力或机会，获得可观的收入，特别是相对于日常琐碎的收入而言。通常带有渴望财富增长或追求事业成功的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to earning a substantial amount of money, especially compared to ordinary income. It often implies a desire for wealth accumulation or the pursuit of career success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家日日 OT，都係為咗搵真銀啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jat1 jat1 OT, dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 wan2 zan1 ngan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在每天都加班，都是为了挣大钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's working overtime every day, all to make real money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港地，好多人都想搵真銀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dei6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 wan2 zan1 ngan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，很多人都想赚大钱。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, many people want to make a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行業好景嘅時候，真係好容易搵真銀嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 jip6 hou2 ging2 ge3 si4 hau6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 wan2 zan1 ngan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行业景气的时候，真的很容易赚大钱的。
examples.english_sentence: When this industry is booming, it's really easy to make a lot of money.

english_meaning: to seek advantages; to look for ways to benefit; to freeload
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找或利用机会来获取利益，通常指不费力气或付出较少而获得好处。
explanation_english: Refers to seeking or exploiting opportunities to gain benefits, often implying gaining advantages without much effort or minimal cost. It suggests looking for ways to get something for nothing or at a reduced price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣喺公司度搵着數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 wan2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎样在公司里占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to freeload at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住搵人着數，自己都要付出下㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 jan4 zoek3 sou3, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 haa5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着占别人便宜，自己也要付出一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about trying to freeload off of others, you have to put in some effort yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人成日話佢鍾意搵着數，不過我覺得佢都係識得慳錢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 zung1 ji3 wan2 zoek3 sou3, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dou1 hai6 sik1 dak1 haan1 cin2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们总是说他喜欢占便宜，不过我觉得他只是懂得省钱而已。
examples.english_sentence: People always say he likes to freeload, but I think he just knows how to save money.

english_meaning: To seek advantages, to look for opportunities to benefit (often implying taking advantage of others or a situation)
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找或抓住机会，以便获取利益或好处。通常带有贬义，暗示利用他人或情境来获得好处。
explanation_english: Refers to seeking or seizing opportunities to gain advantages or benefits. It often carries a negative connotation, implying taking advantage of others or a situation to gain something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住搵着數，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 wan2 zoek3 sou3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着占便宜，很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking of seeking advantages; it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住搵着數，做人老實啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 zoek3 sou3, zou6 jan4 lou5 sat6 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着占便宜，做人老实一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about seeking advantages, it's better to be honest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意喺公司入面搵着數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 wan2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢在公司里占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to seek advantages within the company.

synonyms: 貪小便宜 (taam1 siu2 bin6 ji4)

english_meaning: to want to find a hole to hide in; to feel extremely embarrassed and wish to disappear
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人感到非常尴尬、羞愧，恨不得找个地洞钻进去躲起来，避免面对窘境。
explanation_english: Describes someone feeling extremely embarrassed and ashamed, wishing to find a hole to hide in to avoid facing the awkward situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上唔記得歌詞，尷尬到想搵窿捐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 m4 gei3 dak1 go1 ci4, gaam3 gaai3 dou3 soeng2 wan2 lung1 gyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上忘记歌词，尴尬得想找个地洞钻进去。
examples.english_sentence: He forgot the lyrics on stage and was so embarrassed that he wanted to find a hole to hide in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再講喇，再講我就真係想搵窿捐㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3, zoi3 gong2 ngo5 zau6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 wan2 lung1 gyun1 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再说了，再说我就真的想找个地洞钻进去了！
examples.english_sentence: Stop talking about it, if you say anymore, I really want to find a hole to hide in!

english_meaning: To want to find a hole to crawl into; to be extremely embarrassed; to want the ground to swallow you up
explanation_mandarin: 形容感到极其尴尬、羞愧，恨不得立刻消失。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of extreme embarrassment or shame, to the point where one wishes to disappear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先我喺咁多人面前講錯嘢，真係想搵窿捐呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 ngo5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, zan1 hai6 soeng2 wan2 lung1 gyun1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才我在这么多人面前说错话，真想找个地缝钻进去！
examples.english_sentence: I misspoke in front of so many people just now, I really wanted to find a hole to crawl into!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試作弊俾老師捉到，梗係想搵窿捐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 zok3 bai6 bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2, gang2 hai6 soeng2 wan2 lung1 gyun1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试作弊被老师抓到，肯定想找个地缝钻进去。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught cheating on the exam by the teacher, he must want to find a hole to crawl into.

mandarin_meaning: 找门路, 找关系, 走后门
english_meaning: to find connections, to pull strings, to find a way through the back door, to find a loophole
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某个目的，通过不正当或非正式的渠道寻找关系、方法或途径。
explanation_english: To find connections, ways, or loopholes, often through informal or improper channels, in order to achieve a certain goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想入呢間公司，周圍搵窿路，睇吓有無人可以幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jap6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, zau1 wai4 wan2 lung1 lou6, tai2 haa5 jiu5 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想进这家公司，到处找门路，看看有没有人可以帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get into this company, so he's looking for connections everywhere to see if anyone can help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住搵窿路，應該靠自己嘅實力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 lung1 lou6, jing1 goi1 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 sat6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着走后门，应该靠自己的实力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about finding loopholes; you should rely on your own abilities.

english_meaning: to take advantage of someone; to cheat someone; to trick someone
explanation_mandarin: 指耍手段占别人便宜，欺骗别人，使别人吃亏。
explanation_english: To try to gain an advantage over someone, to cheat or trick them, often to make them suffer a loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住搵我笨呀！我識睇穿你嘅詭計㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 wan2 ngo5 ban6 aa3! ngo5 sik1 tai2 cyun1 nei5 ge3 gwai2 gai3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想占我便宜！ 我看得穿你的诡计！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of me! I can see through your tricks!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日搵笨，啲客都走晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 wan2 ban6, di1 haak3 dou1 zau2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司总是骗人，顾客都跑光了。
examples.english_sentence: That company always tries to cheat people, so all the customers have left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賣啲嘢咁貴，根本就係搵笨!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai6 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 wan2 ban6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卖的东西那么贵，根本就是骗人!
examples.english_sentence: He sells things so expensive, it's just a rip-off!

english_meaning: to rip someone off; to cheat; to take advantage of someone
explanation_mandarin: 指利用他人无知或疏忽而从中获取不正当利益，使人受骗吃亏。
explanation_english: To take advantage of someone, especially by cheating them or ripping them off. It implies exploiting someone's ignorance or naivete for personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為我唔識價錢就想搵我笨啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 sik1 gaa3 chin2 jau6 soeng2 wan2 ngo5 ban6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为我不懂价格就想占我便宜！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can rip me off just because you think I don't know the price!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日都搵客笨，所以冇人幫襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 wan2 hak3 ban6, so2 ji5 mou5 jan4 bong1 caan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司总是欺骗顾客，所以没人光顾。
examples.english_sentence: That company always rips off its customers, so no one goes there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人成日想搵人笨，冇朋友嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 seng4 jat6 soeng2 wan2 jan4 ban6, mou5 pang4 jau5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那个人总是想占别人便宜，没有朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to take advantage of people, that's why he has no friends.

synonyms: 揾食 (wan2 sik6) - in a negative context

english_meaning: to take advantage of someone; to rip someone off; to try to fool someone
explanation_mandarin: 指试图占别人便宜，欺骗他人，或者利用他人的无知从中获利。
explanation_english: Refers to attempting to take advantage of someone, deceiving them, or profiting from their ignorance. The *cat1* emphasizes the stupidity of the person being taken advantage of, and/or the rudeness/blatancy of the attempt to take advantage of them. It carries a slightly stronger negative connotation than just '搵笨'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住搵我笨柒呀，我唔係咁易呃嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 wan2 ngo5 ban6 cat1 aa3, ngo5 m4 hai6 gam3 ji6 aak1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想占我便宜，我没那么容易被骗的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about trying to rip me off, I'm not that easy to fool!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日都諗住搵客笨柒，啲嘢又貴又唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 wan2 haak3 ban6 cat1, di1 je5 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是想着坑顾客，东西又贵又不好。
examples.english_sentence: This company is always trying to rip off customers, the products are expensive and bad.

english_meaning: to find a way to make a living; to find a source of income; to hustle
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找维持生计的方法，多用于口语，带有一种为了生存而努力奋斗的意味。“米路”在这里指代生活所需的资源。
explanation_english: Refers to finding a way to make a living. It's often used colloquially and implies struggling and working hard for survival. "米路" (mai5 lou6) here metaphorically represents the resources needed for life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，好多人都喺度諗緊點樣搵米路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hai2 dou6 nim2 gan2 dim2 joeng2 wan2 mai5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，很多人都在想着怎么找生计。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad right now, many people are thinking about how to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗搵米路，咩工都肯做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 wan2 mai5 lou6, me1 gung1 dou1 hang2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了找生计，他什么工作都肯做。
examples.english_sentence: In order to make a living, he is willing to do any kind of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畢業之後，我都要開始諗吓點樣搵米路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 hoi1 chi2 nim2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 wan2 mai5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕业之后，我也要开始想想怎么找生计。
examples.english_sentence: After graduation, I need to start thinking about how to make a living.

english_meaning: to find a way to make a living, to look for ways to earn money, to find a means of sustenance
explanation_mandarin: 寻找谋生的方法或途径。比喻为了生存而努力寻找工作或机会。
explanation_english: To find a way or method to make a living. Figuratively, it refers to the effort to find work or opportunities in order to survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家經濟咁差，搵米路都好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ging1 gai3 gam3 caa1, wan2 mai5 lou6 dou1 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，找生计也很难。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now; it's difficult to find a way to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗份工之後，周圍去搵米路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1 zi1 hau6, zau1 wai4 heoi3 wan2 mai5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞职之后，到处去找生计。
examples.english_sentence: After quitting his job, he went everywhere looking for ways to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港生活，唔搵米路點得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sang1 wut6, m4 wan2 mai5 lou6 dim2 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港生活，不找生计怎么行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Living in Hong Kong, how can you survive without finding a way to make a living?

english_meaning: to look for a sucker; to scam someone
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找容易上当受骗的人，从而达到欺骗或占便宜的目的。多用于商业或恋爱关系中。
explanation_english: To look for someone gullible or naive to trick or take advantage of. Often used in a business or romantic context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明想搵老襯，賣啲假嘢俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 soeng2 wan2 lou5 can3, maai6 di1 gaa2 je5 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆明了想找冤大头，卖一些假货给你。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly wants to find a sucker and sell you some fake products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁容易信人，小心俾人搵老襯呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 wan2 lou5 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么容易相信人，小心被人当冤大头啊！
examples.english_sentence: You're so quick to trust people, be careful you don't get scammed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住搵老襯，做生意要老老實實先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 wan2 lou5 can3, zou6 saang1 ji3 jiu3 lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着找冤大头，做生意要老老实实才行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about trying to scam people, you have to be honest in business.

english_meaning: to find a sucker, to look for someone to take advantage of, to con someone
explanation_mandarin: 指寻找容易上当受骗的人，占其便宜。多用于负面场合，指欺骗或利用他人。
explanation_english: Refers to looking for someone who is easily deceived and taken advantage of. It is often used in negative situations, referring to cheating or exploiting others. '老襯' (lou5 can3) literally means 'old shirt', but in this context, it refers to a gullible or naive person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住點樣搵老襯，真係唔老實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 wan2 lou5 can3, zan1 hai6 m4 lou5 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天想着怎么找冤大头，真是不老实。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to find a sucker, he's really dishonest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司專搵老襯，賣啲又貴又唔好嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun1 wan2 lou5 can3, maai6 di1 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司专门找冤大头，卖又贵又不好东西。
examples.english_sentence: This company specializes in finding suckers, selling expensive and bad quality stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁易信人啊，小心俾人搵老襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 seon3 jan4 aa3, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 wan2 lou5 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么容易相信别人啊，小心被人当冤大头。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, be careful of being taken advantage of.

english_meaning: to find a partner (for an activity, often gambling or games); to find someone to join in
explanation_mandarin: 寻找一起参与活动的人，多指赌博或游戏等。
explanation_english: To find someone to join you in an activity, often implying gambling, games or a similar collaborative activity where multiple players are needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚想打麻雀，唔知搵唔搵到腳呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 soeng2 daa2 maa4 zoek3, m4 zi1 wan2 m4 wan2 dou2 goek3 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚想打麻将，不知道能不能找到人一起玩呢？
examples.english_sentence: I want to play Mahjong tonight, I wonder if I can find enough players.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋三個人差一個，不如搵個人嚟搵腳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 saam1 go3 jan4 caa1 jat1 go3, bat1 jyu4 wan2 go3 jan4 lei4 wan2 goek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们三个人还差一个，不如找个人来凑局吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're one person short, let's find someone to make a foursome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺街邊搵腳賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 gaai1 bin1 wan2 goek3 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在街边找人一起赌钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's always looking for partners to gamble with on the street.

english_meaning: to look for opportunities to gain an advantage; to seek a bargain; to try to get something for less or for free; to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 寻找机会占便宜，获得好处。指利用机会或关系，以较少的付出获取较多的利益。
explanation_english: To seek opportunities to gain an advantage, profit, or bargain. It implies using opportunities or relationships to obtain more benefits with less effort. Often carries a slightly negative connotation, suggesting a willingness to take advantage of situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣可以喺公司度搵著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 wan2 zoek6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎么样才能在公司里占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how he can gain an advantage in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺我度搵著數，我唔會俾你攞着數㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ngo5 dou6 wan2 zoek6 sou3, ngo5 m4 wui5 bei2 nei5 lo2 zoek6 sou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想在我这里占便宜，我不会让你占到便宜的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can take advantage of me; I won't let you get away with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意去啲清貨大減價度搵著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 di1 cing1 fo3 daai6 gaam2 gaa3 dou6 wan2 zoek6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢去清仓大减价的地方找便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to go to clearance sales to find bargains.

english_meaning: to try to gain an advantage; to look for benefits (often unfairly); to be opportunistic; to freeload
explanation_mandarin: 指想办法占别人的便宜，获取好处。
explanation_english: Refers to trying to take advantage of others to gain benefits or advantages, often in an unfair or opportunistic way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想搵人著數，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 wan2 jan4 zoek3 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占别人的便宜，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to take advantage of others, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以喺呢度搵著數，天下冇免費嘅午餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 dou6 wan2 zoek3 sou3, tin1 haa6 mou5 min5 fai3 ge3 ng5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着可以在这里占便宜，天下没有免费的午餐。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can freeload here, there's no such thing as a free lunch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人排隊都係想搵著數，攞多幾份禮物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 dou1 hai6 soeng2 wan2 zoek3 sou3, lo2 do1 gei2 fan6 lai5 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人排队都是想占便宜，多拿几份礼物。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are queuing up to try and get an advantage and get more gifts.

english_meaning: to make money; to earn a living
explanation_mandarin: 指通过工作或其他方式获取金钱。
explanation_english: Refers to obtaining money through work or other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好難搵銀㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 naan4 wan2 ngan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很难赚钱的。

examples.english_sentence: He wants to be the first to get the offer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搶先喺競爭對手前面推出新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 coeng2 sin1 hai2 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 cin4 min6 tui1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要抢先于竞争对手推出新产品。
examples.english_sentence: We need to launch the new product before our competitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想搶先發言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 coeng2 sin1 faat3 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想抢先发言。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to be the first to speak.

english_meaning: to be one step ahead; to take the lead; to get ahead of the game
explanation_mandarin: 比别人先做一步；领先一步。
explanation_english: To do something before others; to be ahead of the competition or others in a certain situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司搶先一步推出咗新產品，所以賺咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 coeng2 sin1 jat1 bou6 teoi1 ceot1 zo2 san1 caan2 ban2, so2 ji5 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司抢先一步推出了新产品，所以赚了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Their company launched the new product one step ahead, so they made a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想成功，就要搶先一步，諗到人哋諗唔到嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 sing4 gung1, zau6 jiu3 coeng2 sin1 jat1 bou6, nam2 dou3 jan4 dei6 nam2 m4 dou3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想成功，就要抢先一步，想到别人想不到的东西。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to succeed, you have to be one step ahead, thinking of things that others don't.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搶先一步攞到個合約，咁先可以保證公司嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 coeng2 sin1 jat1 bou6 lo2 dou2 go3 hap6 joek3, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 zing3 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要抢先一步拿到这个合约，这样才可以保证公司的发展。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be one step ahead in securing this contract, only then can we guarantee the company's development.

english_meaning: robbery, to rob
explanation_mandarin: 以暴力或威胁夺取他人财物。
explanation_english: To take property unlawfully from a person or place by force or threat of force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日喺銀行門口發生咗單搶劫案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 hai2 ngan4 hong4 mun4 hau2 faat3 sang1 zo2 daan1 coeng2 gip3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天在银行门口发生了一起抢劫案。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday there was a robbery at the entrance of the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打劫咗間便利店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 gip3 zo2 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抢劫了一家便利店。
examples.english_sentence: They robbed a convenience store.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搶劫我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 coeng2 gip3 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抢劫我啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't rob me!

english_meaning: Bun Scrambling (a traditional competition on Cheung Chau island during the Bun Festival)
explanation_mandarin: 香港长洲太平清醮（包山节）的一项传统活动。参与者攀爬覆盖着平安包的包山，抢夺包子。包子越多，象征着好运。
explanation_english: A traditional activity during the Cheung Chau Bun Festival in Hong Kong. Participants climb a bamboo tower covered in buns, trying to grab as many buns as possible. The more buns you grab, the more luck you're said to have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅搶包山比賽好激烈，個個都爭住爬上去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 coeng2 baau1 saan1 bei2 coi3 hou2 gik1 lit6, go3 go3 dou1 zaang1 zyu6 paa4 soeng5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的抢包山比赛非常激烈，每个人都争着爬上去。
examples.english_sentence: This year's Bun Scrambling competition was very intense, everyone was fighting to climb up.

mandarin_meaning: 顶嘴, 强词夺理, 争辩
english_meaning: To talk back, to argue, to interrupt (in conversation), to be argumentative, to try to get the last word
explanation_mandarin: 指别人说话时，插嘴打断或反驳，含有不尊重对方的意思。也指喜欢争辩，强词夺理。
explanation_english: Refers to interrupting or talking back while someone else is speaking, implying a lack of respect. It can also mean being argumentative and trying to get the last word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁搶口啦，等我講埋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 coeng2 hau2 laa1, dang2 ngo5 gong2 maai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么顶嘴了，等我说完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so argumentative, let me finish speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都搶口，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 coeng2 hau2, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是顶嘴，很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always talking back, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁搶口啦，尊重吓人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 coeng2 hau2 laa1, zyun1 zung6 haa5 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么爱争辩，尊重一下别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so argumentative, show some respect.

english_meaning: to snatch things, to rob, to grab things
explanation_mandarin: 指抢夺别人的物品或资源，带有强取豪夺的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to seizing or grabbing someone else's belongings or resources, often implying force or unfair means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搶嘢呀！要排隊先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 coeng2 je5 aa3! jiu3 paai4 deoi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抢东西！要排队先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't snatch things! You need to line up first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺便利店搶嘢，俾警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 coeng2 je5, bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在便利店抢东西，被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He robbed a convenience store and was arrested by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班人衝入去搶嘢，好恐怖啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 jan4 cung1 jap6 heoi3 coeng2 je5, hou2 hung2 bou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群人冲进去抢东西，好恐怖啊！
examples.english_sentence: That group of people rushed in to rob things, it's so scary!

english_meaning: to rob; to plunder; to seize; to snatch
explanation_mandarin: 以暴力手段夺取他人的财物。
explanation_english: To forcibly take possession of someone else's property, usually involving violence or force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搶奪咗銀行嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 coeng2 dyut6 zo2 ngan4 hong4 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抢夺了银行的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They robbed the bank of its money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個賊想搶奪婆婆嘅手袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 caak6 soeng2 coeng2 dyut6 po4 po2 ge3 sau2 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小偷想抢夺老奶奶的手提包。
examples.english_sentence: The thief wanted to snatch the old woman's handbag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以搶奪其他人嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 coeng2 dyut6 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以抢夺其他人的东西。
examples.english_sentence: You can't rob/snatch other people's things.

english_meaning: Ghost Festival Food Scramble; ritual food scrambling during the Ghost Festival (often involving climbing a greased pole to retrieve offerings)
explanation_mandarin: 一种在农历七月鬼节举行的传统民俗活动，目的是为了普渡孤魂野鬼。通常会在高台上设置许多祭品，让民众争抢，场面热闹且带有刺激性。抢孤活动通常带有一定的危险性。
explanation_english: A traditional folk activity held during the Ghost Festival (7th month of the lunar calendar). It involves setting up offerings on a high platform and having people scramble to grab them. The scene is usually lively and exciting, but can also be dangerous. It is performed to appease and provide for wandering spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅搶孤比賽好似話有好多人參加喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 coeng2 gu1 bi2 coi3 hou2 ci5 waa6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 caam1 gaa1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说今年的抢孤比赛有很多人参加。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that a lot of people are participating in this year's Ghost Festival food scramble competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講搶孤好危險㗎，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 coeng2 gu1 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说抢孤很危险，要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the Ghost Festival food scramble is very dangerous, you should be careful.

english_meaning: to poach customers, to compete for customers, customer grabbing
explanation_mandarin: 指商家或公司之间为了获得更多的顾客而采取各种竞争手段。
explanation_english: Refers to businesses or companies engaging in competitive tactics to acquire more customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲電訊公司搶客搶得好犀利呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 dik1 din6 seon3 gung1 si1 coeng2 haak3 coeng2 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的电信公司抢客户抢得很厉害啊。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the telecommunication companies are competing fiercely for customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間間銀行都出優惠嚟搶客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4 dou1 ceot1 jau1 wai2 lei4 coeng2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每家银行都推出优惠来抢客户。
examples.english_sentence: Every bank is offering promotions to grab customers.

english_meaning: To steal the scene, to upstage, to hog the limelight
explanation_mandarin: 在戏剧或表演中，指演员为了突出自己而过分表现，盖过其他演员的风头。也泛指在任何场合为了吸引注意而做出过分的举动。
explanation_english: In a play or performance, it refers to an actor overacting to highlight themselves, overshadowing other actors. It also refers to making excessive actions in any situation to attract attention and outshine others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想喺人哋嘅生日會度搶戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 hai2 jan4 dei6 ge3 saang1 jat6 wui2 dou6 coeng2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想在别人的生日会上抢风头。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to steal the show at other people's birthday parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搶戲啦，今日係阿婆生日，俾佢做主角啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 coeng2 hei3 laa1, gam1 jat6 hai6 aa3 po4 saang1 jat6, bei2 keoi5 zou6 zyu2 gok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要抢风头了，今天奶奶生日，让她做主角吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't steal the spotlight, it's grandma's birthday today, let her be the main character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢演技咁好，但係都唔需要搶戲去證明自己嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jin2 gei6 gam3 hou2, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 coeng2 hei3 heoi3 zing3 ming4 zi6 gei2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他演技那么好，但是也不需要抢戏去证明自己的。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a good actor, but he doesn't need to steal the scene to prove himself.

english_meaning: in demand; popular; sought-after
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品或人很受欢迎，很多人想要得到。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is very popular and sought after by many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對波鞋好搶手，一出就賣晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 hou2 coeng2 sau2, jat1 ceot1 zau6 maai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双运动鞋很抢手，一上市就卖光了。
examples.english_sentence: These sneakers are very popular and sold out as soon as they were released.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好搶手，好多公司都想請佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 coeng2 sau2, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 soeng2 ceng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很抢手，很多公司都想聘请他。
examples.english_sentence: He is in high demand; many companies want to hire him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會嘅飛好搶手，好難買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 fei1 hou2 coeng2 sau2, hou2 naan4 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票很抢手，很难买到。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets are in high demand and difficult to buy.

english_meaning: hot commodity, sought-after item, in high demand
explanation_mandarin: 形容物品非常受欢迎，供不应求。
explanation_english: Describes an item that is highly popular and in high demand, often exceeding supply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲演唱會飛真係搶手貨，一開賣就俾人搶晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 zan1 hai6 coeng2 sau2 fo3, jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 bei2 jan4 coeng2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些演唱会门票真是抢手货，一开卖就被抢光了。
examples.english_sentence: These concert tickets are really hot commodities; they were all snapped up as soon as they went on sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家樓市咁旺，啲新樓盤全部都係搶手貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 lau4 si5 gam3 wong6, di1 san1 lau4 pun4 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 coeng2 sau2 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在楼市这么火爆，那些新楼盘全部都是抢手货。
examples.english_sentence: The real estate market is so hot right now, all the new property developments are in high demand.

english_meaning: to loot; to plunder; looting; plundering
explanation_mandarin: 指用暴力抢夺、掠夺财物。
explanation_english: To forcibly seize or steal goods; to plunder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴徒喺條街度搶掠商店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 tou4 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 coeng2 loek6 soeng1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴徒在街上抢掠商店。
examples.english_sentence: The rioters were looting shops in the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭期間好多平民嘅財產都被人搶掠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zaang1 kei4 gaan1 hou2 do1 ping4 man4 ge3 coi4 saan2 dou1 bei2 jan4 coeng2 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争期间很多平民的财产都被人抢掠。
examples.english_sentence: During the war, many civilians' properties were looted.

english_meaning: to aggressively attack, to take the offensive, to push forward aggressively
explanation_mandarin: 指在比赛或竞争中，积极主动地进攻，争取主动权和优势。
explanation_english: Refers to actively and aggressively attacking in a competition or game, striving for the initiative and advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋上半場已經開始搶攻，想盡快攞到領先優勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng6 baan1 coeng4 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 coeng2 gung1, soeng2 zeon6 faai3 lo2 dou3 ling5 sin1 jau1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在上半场就已经开始抢攻，想尽快取得领先优势。
examples.english_sentence: They started attacking aggressively in the first half, wanting to take the lead as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司決定搶攻市場，推出咗好多新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 coeng2 gung1 si5 coeng4, tui1 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司决定抢攻市场，推出了很多新产品。
examples.english_sentence: This company decided to aggressively attack the market and launched many new products.

english_meaning: to rescue; to salvage; to save (life or property); emergency treatment
explanation_mandarin: 在紧急情况下，尽力救助生命或财物。
explanation_english: To make an all-out effort to rescue lives or property in an emergency situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生正喺度搶救個病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 zing3 hai2 dou6 coeng2 gau3 go3 beng6 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生正在抢救病人。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor is trying to save the patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火燭之後，消防員盡力搶救財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 zuk1 zi1 hau6, siu1 fong4 jyun4 zeon6 lik6 coeng2 gau3 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 火灾之后，消防员尽力抢救财物。
examples.english_sentence: After the fire, the firefighters did their best to salvage property.

english_meaning: Amphibious landing; to storm the beach; to establish a foothold (in a market, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指军事上的抢滩登陆，也比喻在商场或市场上迅速占领或夺取有利地位。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a military amphibious landing, it also metaphorically means to quickly occupy or seize a favorable position in the business world or market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間新公司想喺香港市場搶灘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 san1 gung1 si1 soeng2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 si5 coeng2 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家新公司想在香港市场抢滩。
examples.english_sentence: The new company wants to establish a foothold in the Hong Kong market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅團隊成功搶灘，成為業界嘅領頭羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 teoi1 deoi2 sing4 gung1 coeng2 taan1, sing4 wai4 gaaai3 jip6 ge3 ling5 tau4 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的团队成功抢滩，成为业界的领头羊。
examples.english_sentence: Their team successfully established a foothold and became a leader in the industry.

english_meaning: Easily angered; quick-tempered; to have a short fuse; easily irritable
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人脾氣暴躁，容易發脾氣，一點小事就容易生氣。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easily angered or irritated, and has a short temper; easily provoked to anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好搶火㗎，你講嘢小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 coeng2 fo2 gaa3, nei5 gong2 je5 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人脾气很暴躁，你说话小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very short temper, so be careful what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢，佢而家好搶火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 je5 keoi5, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 coeng2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他，他现在很容易生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him, he's very quick-tempered right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好怪佢，佢最近壓力大，所以咪搶火囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gwaai3 keoi5, keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 aat3 lik6 daai6, so2 ji5 mai1 coeng2 fo2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别怪他，他最近压力大，所以才这么容易生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame him, he's been under a lot of stress lately, that's why he's so easily angered.

english_meaning: eye-catching, striking, conspicuous, attention-grabbing
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常醒目，容易引起别人的注意。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very eye-catching and easily attracts attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着咗件紅色衫，好搶眼呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hung4 sik1 saam1, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一件红色的衣服，非常醒目！
examples.english_sentence: She wore a red dress today, it's very eye-catching!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告嘅設計好搶眼，一定會吸引好多人睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5, jat1 ding6 wui5 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 jan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个广告的设计很醒目，一定会吸引很多人看。
examples.english_sentence: The design of this advertisement is very eye-catching, it will definitely attract many people to watch.

english_meaning: to buzz in, to answer a question before others, to snatch an opportunity to answer
explanation_mandarin: 指在问答环节中，比其他人更快地回答问题，通常带有竞争的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to answering a question more quickly than others in a Q&A session, usually with a competitive implication. It describes the action of quickly pressing a buzzer or raising one's hand to be the first to answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺問答比賽入面，佢次次都搶答到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 man6 daap3 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 coeng2 daap3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在问答比赛里面，他每次都能抢答到。
examples.english_sentence: In the quiz competition, he always manages to buzz in and answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好想搶答，但係撳掣慢咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 soeng2 coeng2 daap3, daan6 hai6 gam6 zai3 maan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很想抢答，但是按按钮慢了。
examples.english_sentence: He really wanted to buzz in, but he pressed the button too slowly.

english_meaning: panic buying, to rush to purchase
explanation_mandarin: 指人们争先恐后地购买某种商品，通常是因为害怕涨价或供应短缺。
explanation_english: To rush to purchase something, usually due to fear of price increases or shortages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日開始封關喇，好多人去超市搶購食物同日用品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hoi1 ci2 fung1 gwaan1 laa3, hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 siu1 si5 coeng2 gau3 sik6 mat6 tung4 jat6 jung6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天开始封关了，很多人去超市抢购食物和日用品。
examples.english_sentence: The border will be closed tomorrow, so many people are rushing to the supermarket to buy food and daily necessities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會啲飛好搶手，一開賣就俾人搶購晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 di1 fei1 hou2 coeng2 sau2, jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 bei2 jan4 coeng2 gau3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票很抢手，一开卖就被抢购完了。
examples.english_sentence: Concert tickets are very popular and sold out as soon as they go on sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為疫情嘅關係，市民開始搶購口罩同酒精搓手液。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jik6 ching4 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, si5 man4 hoi1 ci2 coeng2 gau3 haau2 zaau3 tung4 zau2 ging1 co1 sau2 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为疫情的关系，市民开始抢购口罩和酒精洗手液。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the pandemic, citizens started to panic buy masks and hand sanitizers.

mandarin_meaning: 抢方向盘; 争夺控制权
english_meaning: To grab the steering wheel; to seize control; to usurp authority
explanation_mandarin: 原指行驶中抢夺方向盘的行为，引申为争夺控制权或权力。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the act of grabbing the steering wheel while driving. By extension, it means to seize control or power, often in a forceful or unexpected manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺公司入面成日搶軚，爭住做大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 sing4 jat6 coeng2 taai1, zaang1 zyu6 zou6 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在公司里经常争夺控制权，争着当老大。
examples.english_sentence: They are constantly vying for control in the company, competing to be the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁衝動，唔好隨便搶軚啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cung1 dung6, m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 coeng2 taai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么冲动，不要随便抢夺控制权啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, don't just try to seize control arbitrarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搶軚，但係最後都俾我阻止咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 coeng2 taai1, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 ngo5 zo2 zi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想抢夺控制权，但是最后还是被我阻止了。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to seize control, but I managed to stop him in the end.

synonyms: 爭權奪利 (zaang1 kyun4 dyut6 lei6)

english_meaning: to steal the spotlight, to hog attention
explanation_mandarin: 指在群体活动或照片中，通过某种方式吸引过多的注意，以至于掩盖了其他人的光芒。
explanation_english: To steal the spotlight or hog attention, often by being overly flamboyant or noticeable in a group setting, photo, or event, thus overshadowing others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺張合照度擺咗個咁誇張嘅甫士，好明顯係想搶鏡啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zoeng1 hap6 zo3 dou6 baai2 zo2 go3 gam3 kwaa1 zoeng1 ge3 pou2 si2, hou2 ming4 hin2 hai2 soeng2 coeng2 geng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在合照里摆了这么夸张的姿势，很明显是想抢风头。
examples.english_sentence: He struck such an exaggerated pose in the group photo, it's obvious he's trying to steal the spotlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住搶鏡啦，俾其他人都有啲表現嘅機會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 coeng2 geng3 laa1, bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 jau5 di1 biu2 hin3 ge3 gei1 wui2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着抢风头，给其他人也有一些表现的机会吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about stealing the spotlight, give other people a chance to shine too.

english_meaning: To jump the gun; To start prematurely; To rush into something
explanation_mandarin: 原指赛跑时提前起跑。引申为做事过早，操之过急，提前行动。
explanation_english: Originally refers to jumping the gun in a race. By extension, it means to act too early, to be overeager, or to take premature action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搶閘喺個市場推出新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 coeng2 zaap6 hai2 go3 si5 coeng4 tui1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们抢先在市场上推出了新产品。
examples.english_sentence: They jumped the gun and launched the new product in the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁搶閘住，等我講埋先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 coeng2 zaap6 zyu6, dang2 ngo5 gong2 maai4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么着急，等我说完再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be in such a rush, let me finish speaking first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢今次太搶閘，應該再準備多啲先好開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 gam1 ci3 taai3 coeng2 zaap6, jing1 goi1 zoi3 zyun2 bei6 do1 di1 sin1 hou2 hoi1 chi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他这次太着急了，应该再多准备一下再开始。
examples.english_sentence: I think he's rushing things this time. He should prepare more before starting.

english_meaning: to seize control, to usurp power, to be overbearing, to try to take the lead forcefully
explanation_mandarin: 比喻争夺控制权或领导地位，也形容一个人过于强势，喜欢强出头。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to seize control or leadership, or to describe someone who is too assertive and likes to take the lead forcefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想搶韁，其他人根本冇機會發表意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 coeng2 goeng1, kei4 taa1 jan4 gan1 bun2 mou5 gei1 wui2 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想抢夺控制权，其他人根本没有机会发表意见。
examples.english_sentence: He always wants to seize control, others don't even have a chance to express their opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁搶韁啦，畀其他人都有表現嘅機會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 coeng2 goeng1 laa1, bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 dou1 jau5 biu2 hin3 ge3 gei1 wui2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么强势，给其他人也有表现的机会吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so overbearing, give others a chance to show their abilities.

synonyms: 爭權奪利 (zaang1 kyun4 dyut6 lei6)

english_meaning: to apply (ointment, cream, etc.), to smear, to rub on
explanation_mandarin: 用某种东西涂抹在物体表面上。
explanation_english: To apply something, such as ointment or cream, onto a surface by rubbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搽啲藥膏落去啦，會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 di1 joek6 gou1 lok6 heoi3 laa1, wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 涂点药膏上去吧，会舒服点。
examples.english_sentence: Apply some ointment; it will feel better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搽咗好多防曬喺塊面度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa4 zo2 hou2 do1 fong4 saai3 hai2 faai3 min6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在脸上涂了很多防晒霜。
examples.english_sentence: She applied a lot of sunscreen on her face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搽咁多香水呀，太濃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caa4 gam3 do1 hoeng1 seoi2 aa3, taai3 nung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要涂那么多香水啊，太浓了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't apply so much perfume; it's too strong.

english_meaning: to pretend to be ignorant, to play dumb, to feign ignorance
explanation_mandarin: 比喻故意装作不知道，不明白，以此来回避问题或责任。 搽（caa4）是涂抹的意思，面懵膏（min6 mung1 gou1）可以理解为涂在脸上让人看起来傻傻的药膏。
explanation_english: It's a figurative expression meaning to deliberately pretend not to know something in order to avoid a problem or responsibility. '搽' (caa4) means to apply or spread. '面懵膏' (min6 mung1 gou1) can be understood as a cream applied to the face that makes one appear foolish or ignorant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明顯知道發生咩事，但係佢搽咗面懵膏，扮唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 hin2 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6, daan6 hai6 keoi5 caa4 zo2 min6 mung1 gou1, baan6 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明显知道发生了什么事，但他装糊涂，假装不知道。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knew what happened, but he played dumb and pretended not to know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搽咗面懵膏啦，件事關乎到你嘅利益㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caa4 zo2 min6 mung1 gou1 laa1, gin6 si6 gwaan1 wu1 dou3 nei5 ge3 lei6 jik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要装糊涂了，这件事关系到你的利益啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't play dumb, this matter concerns your interests.

english_meaning: to apply powder (cosmetics)
explanation_mandarin: 在脸上涂抹粉状化妆品，使皮肤看起来更白或更光滑。
explanation_english: To apply powder, usually face powder, as a cosmetic to make the skin appear lighter or smoother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出街之前一定會搽粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 gaai1 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 wui5 caa4 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她出门之前一定会涂粉。
examples.english_sentence: She always applies powder before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搽咁多粉啦，睇落好假噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caa4 gam3 do1 fan2 laa1, tai2 lok6 hou2 gaa2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要涂那么多粉了，看起来很假。
examples.english_sentence: Don't apply so much powder, it looks very fake.

english_meaning: Putting on makeup before hanging oneself; to put on a show for nothing; to waste effort on something pointless; futile effort to cover up a hopeless situation.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做毫无意义的举动，掩盖不了已经无法挽回的局面，白费力气。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where someone is putting on a facade or trying to improve their appearance when they are facing an unavoidable and negative outcome (hanging themselves). It signifies a pointless effort, doing something cosmetic when the underlying problem remains and is unfixable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家間公司都就嚟執笠啦，你仲喺度搞咩宣傳？咪搽脂粉吊頸囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gaan1 gung1 si1 dou1 zau6 lai4 zaap1 laap1 laa3, nei5 zung6 hai2 dou6 gaau2 me1 syun1 cyun4? mai6 caa4 zi1 fan2 diu3 geng2 lo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在公司都快倒闭了，你还在做什么宣传？这不是白费功夫吗！
examples.english_sentence: The company is about to go bankrupt, what are you still promoting? Isn't that just putting on makeup before hanging yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都欠咁多債，仲買咁多名牌衫，根本就係搽脂粉吊頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 him3 gam3 do1 zaai3, zung6 maai5 gam3 do1 ming4 paai4 saam1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 caa4 zi1 fan2 diu3 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都欠了这么多债，还买这么多名牌衣服，根本就是多此一举。
examples.english_sentence: You already owe so much debt, yet you're still buying so many designer clothes, that's just putting on makeup before hanging yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 浓妆艳抹，打扮得很妖艳
english_meaning: To be heavily made up, to wear excessive makeup; to be dressed in a gaudy or flamboyant manner; to paint the lily
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性打扮得花枝招展，浓妆艳抹，甚至有些俗气。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is heavily made up and dressed in a flamboyant or gaudy manner, sometimes with a vulgar or excessive appearance. It often implies a negative connotation suggesting the makeup is excessive and unnatural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日搽脂蕩粉咁，唔知去邊度蒲呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 caa4 zi1 dong6 fan2 gam2, m4 zi1 dou3 heoi3 bin1 dou6 pou1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得浓妆艳抹的，不知道去哪里玩呢？
examples.english_sentence: She's so heavily made up today, I wonder where she's going to hang out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時都唔搽脂蕩粉㗎，今日咁隆重，一定有特別嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 dou1 m4 caa4 zi1 dong6 fan2 gaa3, gam1 jat6 gam3 lung4 zung6, jat1 ding6 jau5 dak6 bit6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她平时都不化妆的，今天打扮得这么隆重，一定有什么特别的事情。
examples.english_sentence: She usually doesn't wear makeup, but she's so dolled up today, there must be something special happening.

english_meaning: to apply lipstick
explanation_mandarin: 用口红涂抹嘴唇。
explanation_english: To apply lipstick to the lips.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出門口之前一定要搽脣膏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 caa4 seon4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她出门前一定要涂口红。
examples.english_sentence: She must apply lipstick before going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下我今日嘅脣膏靚唔靚啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ngo5 gam1 jat6 ge3 seon4 gou1 leng3 m4 leng3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看一下我今天的口红漂亮吗？
examples.english_sentence: Look at my lipstick today, is it pretty?

english_meaning: to apply ointment, to apply cream
explanation_mandarin: 将药膏涂抹在皮肤上，以治疗或缓解症状。
explanation_english: To apply medicated ointment or cream to the skin, typically for treatment or relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我喺背脊度搽藥膏啦，我掂唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 hai2 bui3 zek3 dou6 caa4 joek6 gou1 laa1, ngo5 dim6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我往背上涂药膏吧，我够不着。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me apply ointment to my back, I can't reach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻蚊咬到我好痕，快啲搽藥膏止痕啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 man1 ngaau5 dou3 ngo5 hou2 han4, faai3 di1 caa4 joek6 gou1 zi2 han4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蚊子咬得我很痒，快点涂药膏止痒吧。
examples.english_sentence: The mosquito bite makes me very itchy, quickly apply ointment to stop the itching.

english_meaning: to spread (something) on bread
explanation_mandarin: 把食物涂抹在面包上。
explanation_english: To spread food on bread, such as butter, jam, or peanut butter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意朝朝搽花生醬喺麪包度食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ziu1 ziu1 caa4 faa1 sang1 zoeng2 hai2 min6 baau1 dou6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢每天早上在面包上涂花生酱吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like to spread peanut butter on bread and eat it every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搽牛油搽得好厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa4 ngau4 jau2 caa4 dak1 hou2 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他黄油涂得很厚。
examples.english_sentence: He spread the butter on very thickly.

english_meaning: to squeeze, to press, to extract (juice, oil etc.), to exploit, to fleece, to extort
explanation_mandarin: 用压力获取液体或利益。也指敲诈勒索。
explanation_english: To obtain liquid or benefit by applying pressure. Also refers to extortion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搾橙汁
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaa3 caang2 zap1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 榨橙汁
examples.english_sentence: to squeeze orange juice

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搾乾我啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zaa3 gon1 ngo5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想榨干我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to squeeze me dry of my money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個老闆成日搾員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 zaa3 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个老板总是剥削员工。
examples.english_sentence: This boss always exploits his employees.

english_meaning: to cover (with the hand); to muffle; to block
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他东西遮盖住。
explanation_english: To cover or block something with your hand or another object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥掩住對耳仔，唔聽人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 jim2 zyu6 deoi3 ji5 zai2, m4 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子捂住耳朵，不听人说话。
examples.english_sentence: The child covered his ears and didn't listen to what people were saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢凍到用手摀住個嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dung3 dou3 yung6 sau2 wu2 zyu6 go3 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他冷得用手捂住嘴巴。
examples.english_sentence: He was so cold that he covered his mouth with his hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到用手摀住自己個心口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 yung6 sau2 wu2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 go3 sam1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得用手捂住自己的胸口。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he covered his chest with his hand.

english_meaning: to lower (something), to reduce, to duck (down)
explanation_mandarin: 使位置、程度、数量等降低。
explanation_english: To make something lower in position, degree, quantity, etc. Can also refer to ducking down to avoid something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先突然間摀低咗，我問佢做乜，佢話避開個波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 tuth1 jin4 gaan1 wu2 dai1 zo2, ngo5 man6 keoi5 zou6 mat1, keoi5 waa6 bei6 hoi1 go3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才突然降低了头，我问他做什么，他说躲避球。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly ducked down just now, I asked him what he was doing, he said he was avoiding the ball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以將個價錢摀低啲呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 go3 gaa3 chin2 wu2 dai1 di1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把价格降低一些吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lower the price a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我地公司已經唔可以再摀低成本㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 wu2 dai1 sing4 bun2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我们公司已经不可以再降低成本了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, our company can no longer lower the costs.

english_meaning: to crouch down; to squat down; to duck down
explanation_mandarin: 降低身体高度，使自己处于更低的位置。
explanation_english: To lower one's body height, usually to avoid being seen or to pick something up from the ground. Can also mean to squat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你快啲摀低身，唔好畀人見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 faai3 di1 wu2 dai1 san1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 gin3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你快点蹲下，不要被人看到你。

english_meaning: to scratch, to claw
explanation_mandarin: 用指甲或其他尖锐物在物体表面轻轻摩擦或抓挠。
explanation_english: To scratch or claw with fingernails or other sharp objects.

examples.english_sentence: Could you please scratch my back for me?

english_meaning: to stir; to mix; to mess with; to fiddle with
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具把东西搅动；乱动，瞎弄。
explanation_english: To stir or mix something; to mess with something by touching or fiddling with it inappropriately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摎攪啲嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 di1 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱动那些东西！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with those things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日摎攪部電腦，搞到成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 bou6 din6 nou5, gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是乱动电脑，弄得总是坏。
examples.english_sentence: He's always fiddling with the computer, causing it to break all the time.

english_meaning: to pound; to ram; to thrust
explanation_mandarin: 用杵或类似的工具用力向下打，使物体受到冲击。
explanation_english: To pound, ram, or thrust something downwards with force using a pestle or similar tool, causing an impact on an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用個摏藥盅摏藥材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 go3 dung1 yeuk6 jung1 dung1 yeuk6 chai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用药臼捣药材。
examples.english_sentence: He pounds the medicinal herbs with a mortar and pestle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力摏啦，會整爛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 dung1 laa1, wui jeng2 laan6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么用力捣啦，会弄坏的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pound so hard, you'll break it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想摏啲蒜蓉整餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 dung1 di1 syun3 yung4 jeng2 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想捣一些蒜蓉做菜。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to pound some minced garlic to cook with.

english_meaning: to slap; to smack (across the face)
explanation_mandarin: 用手掌打对方的脸。
explanation_english: To hit someone on the face with an open hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢激嬲咗我，我忍唔住摑咗佢一巴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gik1 nau1 zo2 ngo5, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 gwaak3 zo2 keoi5 jat1 baa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他惹恼了我，我忍不住扇了他一巴掌。
examples.english_sentence: He annoyed me, I couldn't help but slap him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再嘈，我就摑你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 cou4, ngo5 zau6 gwaak3 nei5.

examples.english_sentence: If you make any more noise, I'll slap you.

synonyms: 掴頭 (gwaak3 tau4) - slap the head

english_meaning: to reject, to discard, to exclude, to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 丢弃，排除，放弃。
explanation_english: To reject, discard, exclude, or abandon something. It implies getting rid of something unwanted or unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摒棄舊嘅思想，接受新嘅觀念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bing3 hei3 gau6 ge3 si1 soeng2, zip3 sau6 san1 ge3 gun1 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抛弃旧的思想，接受新的观念。
examples.english_sentence: Discard old thoughts and accept new ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定摒除雜念，專心溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 bing3 ceoi4 zaap6 nim6, zyun1 sam1 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定排除杂念，专心复习。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to eliminate distractions and concentrate on studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該摒除歧視，互相尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 bing3 ceoi4 kei4 si6, wu6 seung1 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该消除歧视，互相尊重。
examples.english_sentence: We should eliminate discrimination and respect each other.

english_meaning: to abandon, to discard, to reject, to give up
explanation_mandarin: 指抛弃、放弃，通常指抛弃旧的、不好的事物或思想。
explanation_english: To abandon, discard, or reject something, often referring to old or undesirable things or ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該摒棄啲舊嘅諗法，接受新嘅事物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 bing3 hei3 di1 gau6 ge3 lam2 faat3, jip6 sau6 san1 ge3 si6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该抛弃旧的想法，接受新的事物。
examples.english_sentence: We should abandon old ideas and embrace new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摒棄咗以前嘅壞習慣，重新做人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bing3 hei3 zo2 yi5 cin4 ge3 waai6 zaap6 gwaan3, cung4 san1 zou6 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抛弃了以前的坏习惯，重新做人。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned his old bad habits and started anew.

english_meaning: eliminate, get rid of, remove
explanation_mandarin: 排除、除去不需要的或有害的事物。
explanation_english: To eliminate or remove unwanted or harmful things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要摒除一切雜念，專心讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bing3 ceoi4 jat1 cai3 zaap6 nim6, zyun1 sam1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要排除一切杂念，专心读书。
examples.english_sentence: We need to eliminate all distractions and focus on studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定摒除舊嘅制度，實行新嘅措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 bing3 ceoi4 gau6 ge3 zai3 dou6, sat6 hang4 san1 ge3 cou3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定排除旧的制度，实行新的措施。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to eliminate the old system and implement new measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想摒除負面情緒，積極面對生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bing3 ceoi4 fu6 min6 cing4 seoi5, zik1 gik1 min6 deoi3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想排除负面情绪，积极面对生活。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to eliminate negative emotions and face life positively.

english_meaning: to fall, to drop, to tumble
explanation_mandarin: 表示失去平衡而倒地，或使物体从高处掉落。
explanation_english: To lose balance and fall to the ground; or to cause something to fall from a height.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心摔咗落地，整親咗隻腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 seot1 zo2 lok6 dei6, zing2 can1 zo2 zek3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心摔倒在地，弄伤了脚。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally fell to the ground and hurt my foot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心將個電話摔咗落地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 go3 din6 waa6 seot1 zo2 lok6 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心把电话摔到了地上。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲行，唔好摔親啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1 haang4, m4 hou2 seot1 can1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点走，不要摔倒啊！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you walk, don't fall!

english_meaning: wrestling
explanation_mandarin: 一种体育运动，指双方徒手较量，设法将对方摔倒的活动。
explanation_english: A sport in which two opponents grapple and attempt to throw or force each other to the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時好鍾意睇電視嘅摔角比賽。

examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I loved watching wrestling matches on TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺度玩摔角，睇落幾開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 dou6 waan2 seot3 gok3, tai2 lok6 gei2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在那里玩摔跤，看起来挺开心的。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are wrestling, they look pretty happy.

english_meaning: to fall, to tumble, wrestling (less common)
explanation_mandarin: 跌倒，失去平衡而倒在地上。在粤语中，主要指跌倒。
explanation_english: To fall, to lose balance and fall to the ground. In Cantonese, it mainly refers to falling over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，喺條樓梯度摔跤。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，在楼梯上摔跤了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't careful while walking and fell on the stairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日喺公園度摔跤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 seot1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子经常在公园里摔跤。
examples.english_sentence: Kids often fall in the park.

examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the ground is wet, it's easy to fall.

synonyms: 仆街 (puk1 gaai1) - slang for fall badly, die in the street

english_meaning: to pick, to pluck, to select, to extract
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他工具从植物上取下果实、花朵等；选择，挑选；提取，摘录。
explanation_english: To pick or pluck fruit, flowers, etc. from a plant; to select or choose; to extract or excerpt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摘生果好開心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaak6 saang1 gwo2 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摘水果真开心啊！
examples.english_sentence: Picking fruit is so fun!

examples.english_sentence: I want to pick a flower for you.

english_meaning: to pick, to pluck, to select, to extract
explanation_mandarin: 采取、选取。从整体中挑选一部分。
explanation_english: To pick, pluck, select, or extract something from a larger entity or source.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faa1 jyun4 zaak3 ceoi2 zo2 di1 faa1.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wui5 zaak3 ceoi2 man4 zoeng1 ge3 zing1 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们会摘取文章的精华。
examples.english_sentence: They will extract the essence of the article.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要摘取經驗，唔好重蹈覆轍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaak3 ceoi2 ging1 jim6, m4 hou2 cung4 dou6 fuk1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要汲取经验，不要重蹈覆辙。
examples.english_sentence: We must learn from experience and not repeat the same mistakes.

english_meaning: to remove from a list, to disqualify, to delist
explanation_mandarin: 指从名单上移除某人的名字，通常表示取消其资格或地位。
explanation_english: To remove someone's name from a list, usually indicating disqualification or removal of status.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zok3 bai6 bei2 hok6 haau6 zaak6 zo2 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为作弊被学校除名了。
examples.english_sentence: He was expelled from school for cheating.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再不交作业，你就会被老师除名的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't hand in your homework again, you'll be delisted by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為犯咗規例，俾球隊摘名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 faan6 zo2 kwai1 lai6, bei2 kau4 deoi2 zaak6 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为违反了规定，被球队除名。
examples.english_sentence: He was delisted from the team for breaking the rules.

english_meaning: to quote, to excerpt, to cite
explanation_mandarin: 从文章或书籍中选取一部分内容进行引用。
explanation_english: To quote or excerpt from a text or book.
