examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 pin1 lun4 man4 zaak6 jan5 zo2 ho2 do1 hok6 seot6 man4 zoeng1 ge3 noi6 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在论文中摘引了很多学术文章的内容。
examples.english_sentence: He quoted a lot of content from academic articles in his thesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個報告摘引咗好多官方數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou3 gou3 zaak6 jan5 zo2 ho2 do1 gun1 fong1 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告摘录了很多官方数据。
examples.english_sentence: This report excerpted a lot of official data.

english_meaning: To take a cut; commission; to deduct a percentage
explanation_mandarin: 指从总额中抽取一定比例的金额作为提成或佣金。
explanation_english: To take a percentage of the total amount as a commission or cut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每個月摘數都唔少㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 go3 jyut6 zaak6 sou3 dou1 m4 siu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每个月提成都不少的。
examples.english_sentence: His commission every month is quite a lot.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wui5 zaak6 sou3 bei2 siu1 sau6 jyun4 ge3.

examples.english_sentence: The company will give the salesperson a commission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意幫老闆打工，因為好多都要畀佢摘數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 bong1 lou5 baan2 daa2 gung1, jan1 wai6 hou2 do1 dou1 jiu3 bei2 keoi5 zaak6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢给老板打工，因为很多都要给他抽成。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like working for a boss because he takes a cut from a lot of things.

english_meaning: excerpted from; taken from; quoted from
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某处选取出来。指从书刊、文章等中选取部分内容。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is selected or taken from a certain source, usually a book, article, or other written material.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段文字摘自佢本自傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 man4 zi6 zaak6 zi6 keoi5 bun2 zi6 zyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段文字摘自他的自传。
examples.english_sentence: This passage is excerpted from his autobiography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句說話摘自論語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa2 zaak6 zi6 leon4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话摘自《论语》。
examples.english_sentence: This saying is quoted from the Analects.

english_meaning: summary, abstract, synopsis
explanation_mandarin: 对文章或讲话的主要内容进行简要的概括。
explanation_english: A concise summary or abstract of a written or spoken work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寫咗個論文嘅摘要，你幫我睇下得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 se2 zo2 go3 leon6 man4 ge3 zaak6 jiu3, nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我写了一个论文的摘要，你帮我看看行不行？
examples.english_sentence: I wrote a summary of my thesis, can you help me check if it's okay?

english_meaning: to excerpt, to extract, to select excerpts
explanation_mandarin: 选取并抄录（文章、讲话等的）一部分。
explanation_english: To select and copy a portion of (a text, speech, etc.); to excerpt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要喺份報告入面摘錄啲重要數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 hai2 fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 zaak6 luk6 di1 zung6 jiu3 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要在报告中摘录一些重要数据。
examples.english_sentence: We need to extract some important data from the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摘錄咗本書最精彩嘅部分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaak6 luk6 zo2 bun2 syu1 zeoi3 zing1 coi2 ge3 bou6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摘录了这本书最精彩的部分。
examples.english_sentence: He excerpted the most exciting parts of the book.

english_meaning: to pinch; to tweak
explanation_mandarin: 用手指捏。
explanation_english: To pinch (with fingers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摙我塊面呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lin2 ngo5 faai3 min6 aa3!

examples.english_sentence: Don't pinch my face!

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是捏我的手。
examples.english_sentence: He always pinches my hand.

english_meaning: To put down; to drop; to leave behind; to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 把东西放到地上或较低的地方；比喻放下事务或抛弃。
explanation_english: To put something down onto the ground or a lower place; metaphorically, to put down a task or to abandon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太攰喇，將個袋摙低咗就瞓著咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 guih6 laa3, zoeng1 go3 doi2 lin2 dai1 zo2 zau6 fan3 zoek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太累了，把袋子放下就睡着了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so tired that he put down his bag and fell asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁麻煩，我諗住摙低唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 maa4 faan4, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 lin2 dai1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事太麻烦了，我想放下不管了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so troublesome, I'm thinking of abandoning it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁輕易摙低你嘅夢想啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 yi3 lin2 dai1 nei5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要轻易放弃你的梦想啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up on your dreams so easily!

english_meaning: to stage a car accident to extort money; to fake an accident for insurance fraud; car accident scamming
explanation_mandarin: 故意制造或利用假的交通事故来骗取赔偿金。
explanation_english: To deliberately stage or take advantage of a fake car accident to extort money or claim insurance fraudulently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺呢條路度摙車，你揸車要小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 ni1 tiu4 lou6 dou6 lin5 ce1, nei5 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在这条路上碰瓷，你开车要小心点啊。
examples.english_sentence: They often stage car accidents on this road, you need to be careful when driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講有啲人會專登摙車嚟搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 zyun1 deng3 lin5 ce1 lai4 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说有些人会故意碰瓷来赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that some people deliberately stage car accidents to make a living.

english_meaning: to throw; to fling; to toss; to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 表示用力投掷，或放弃、丢弃。
explanation_english: Indicates throwing forcefully or abandoning something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到將啲嘢摜晒落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zoeng1 di1 je5 gwaan3 saai3 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气得把东西都摔到地上了。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he threw everything on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔要呢啲垃圾，摜咗佢算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 jiu3 ni1 di1 laap1 saap3, gwaan3 zo2 keoi5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不要这些垃圾了，扔了算了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want this trash anymore, let's just throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便摜啲嘢落街，會整親人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 gwaan3 di1 je5 lok6 gaai1, wui2 zing2 can1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便把东西扔下楼，会伤到人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw things down the street casually, you'll hurt someone.

english_meaning: to take, to fetch, to grab, to obtain
explanation_mandarin: 指拿取、取得物品或东西。
explanation_english: To take, fetch, grab or obtain something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我摞啲嘢就走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo3 di1 je5 zau6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿点东西就走。
examples.english_sentence: I'll take some things and then leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去幫我摞本書嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 bong1 ngo5 lo3 bun2 syu1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去帮我拿本书来。
examples.english_sentence: Go and fetch a book for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋摞啲凳出嚟坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lo3 di1 dang3 chut1 lai4 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们拿些凳子出来坐吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take some chairs out to sit.

english_meaning: to put down; to set down; to leave behind
explanation_mandarin: 把东西从拿在手上或身上放下来。
explanation_english: To put something down from one's hands or body; to set something down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你摞低啲嘢先啦，我哋再慢慢傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lo3 dai1 di1 je5 sin1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 zoi3 maan6 maan6 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先放下一些东西吧，我们再慢慢聊。
examples.english_sentence: Put down some things first, and then we can chat slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摞低咗個袋喺張枱度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo3 dai1 zo2 go3 doi2 hai2 zoeng1 toi4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把袋子放在桌子上了。
examples.english_sentence: He put the bag down on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摞低希望呀，仲有機會㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lo3 dai1 hei1 mong6 aa3, zung6 jau5 gei1 wui2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要放弃希望啊，还有机会的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lose hope, there's still a chance.

english_meaning: to hug, to embrace, to grab
explanation_mandarin: 用手臂环绕；拥抱。
explanation_english: To put your arms around someone; to hug, to embrace. Can also mean to grab something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見到我就摟住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zau6 lau1 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到我就搂住我。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he saw me, he hugged me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摟住晒啲嘢，俾啲人睇下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lau1 zyu6 saai3 di1 je5, bei2 di1 jan4 tai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要霸占着所有的东西，给别人看看吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't grab all the things, let other people have a look.

mandarin_meaning: 亲热, 亲昵, 热情
english_meaning: Affectionate, overly familiar, touchy-feely
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常亲热、热情，甚至有点过分亲昵，喜欢动手动脚。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very affectionate, enthusiastic, or even overly familiar, and likes to touch or physically interact with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋第一次見面就已經摟口摟面，真係好熟咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 zau6 ji5 ging1 lau1 hau2 lau1 min6, zan1 hai6 hou2 suk6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们第一次见面就已经很亲热，好像很熟的样子。
examples.english_sentence: They were already being touchy-feely at their first meeting, like they were old friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好鍾意啲人摟口摟面嘅，覺得好唔自在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 di1 jan4 lau1 hau2 lau1 min6 ge3, gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 zi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太喜欢那些很亲热的人，觉得很不自在。
examples.english_sentence: I don't really like people who are too affectionate, it makes me feel uncomfortable.

english_meaning: To scold; to berate; to reprimand; to lambast
explanation_mandarin: 用严厉的言辞责备或斥责他人。
explanation_english: To scold or berate someone severely, often using harsh language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老細摟屌咗一鑊啊，慘啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 sai3 lau2 diu2 zo2 jat1 wok6 aa3, caam2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 被老板狠狠地骂了一顿，惨了！
examples.english_sentence: I got a good scolding from my boss, how terrible!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，梗係俾人摟屌㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, gang2 hai6 bei2 jan4 lau2 diu2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错事，当然会被人责骂的啦。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong, of course he'll be scolded.

mandarin_meaning: 故意穿着暴露的裙子，引人注目，带有贬义
english_meaning: Showy, attention-grabbing dress, usually worn with provocative or seductive intent (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性故意穿着暴露或设计浮夸的裙子，以吸引男性注意，通常带有负面评价，暗示其行为不够庄重。
explanation_english: Refers to a dress deliberately worn to be overly revealing or designed in a gaudy manner, with the intention of attracting male attention. Often carries a negative connotation, implying the wearer's behavior is not dignified or respectable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著埋啲咁嘅摟屌裙，明擺住想引人注意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 maai4 di1 gam2 ge3 lau1 diu2 kwan2, ming4 baai2 zyu6 soeng2 jan5 zyu3 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是穿一些这么暴露的裙子，明摆着想引起别人的注意啦。
examples.english_sentence: She always wears such showy dresses, it's obvious she wants to attract attention.

english_meaning: to quarrel; to fight; to scuffle
explanation_mandarin: 指发生口角或肢体冲突，通常带有比较粗俗的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a verbal dispute or physical altercation, often with a rather vulgar connotation. It can mean both a heated argument and a physical fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺街邊摟打，差啲搞到警察都嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 lau1 daa2, caa1 di1 gaau2 dou3 ging2 caat3 dou1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在街边打架，差点搞到警察都来了。
examples.english_sentence: They were fighting on the street, almost causing the police to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔好成日摟打啦，好醜怪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lau1 daa2 laa1, hou2 cau2 gwaai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们不要总是吵架，很丢脸的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't you guys always quarrel, it's very embarrassing.

english_meaning: to embrace, to hug
explanation_mandarin: 用手臂抱住对方，表示亲密或慰问。
explanation_english: To hold someone closely in one's arms, usually as a sign of affection or comfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺機場度摟抱，好唔捨得噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 gei1 coeng4 dou6 lau5 pou5, hou2 m4 se2 dak1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在机场拥抱，依依不舍的样子。
examples.english_sentence: They embraced at the airport, looking very reluctant to part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB扭計嗰陣，阿媽就會摟抱佢安撫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 nau2 gai3 go2 zan6, aa3 maa1 zau6 wui5 lau5 pou5 keoi5 on1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝闹脾气的时候，妈妈就会拥抱他来安抚。
examples.english_sentence: When the baby is fussy, the mother hugs him to soothe him.

english_meaning: To loaf around; to slack off; to do a half-assed job; to muddle through
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，得过且过，敷衍了事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious about their work, just going through the motions and doing a sloppy job; to slack off and avoid putting in real effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺度摟當啦，做嘢認真啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 lau1 dong3 laa1, zou6 je5 jing6 zan1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是在这里混日子，工作认真一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just loaf around here all the time, take your work more seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫得好摟當，完全冇用心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 lau1 dong3, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 jung6 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告很敷衍，完全没有用心。
examples.english_sentence: The report he wrote was very sloppy; he didn't put any effort into it at all.

cantonese: 摟蓑衣救火 - 惹火生身
jyutping: lau4 so1 ji1 gau3 fo2 -- je5 fo2 sang1 san1
english_meaning: To bring trouble upon oneself; to play with fire and get burned; to add fuel to the fire and get hurt.
explanation_mandarin: 用蓑衣去救火，结果只会让自己也着火。比喻采取不恰当的方法去解决问题，反而使自己遭受更大的损害。
explanation_english: Using a raincoat (made of straw) to put out a fire will only result in the raincoat catching fire and burning you. This idiom is used to describe situations where someone tries to solve a problem using inappropriate methods, which ultimately causes greater harm to themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撩佢啦，撩多陣咪摟蓑衣救火——惹火生身囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 liu1 keoi5 laa1, liu1 do1 zan6 mai1 lau4 so1 ji1 gau3 fo2 -- je5 fo2 sang1 san1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再招惹他了，再招惹一会儿就是引火烧身了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him anymore, provoking him any further would be like playing with fire and getting burned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 諗清楚先好做啊，如果唔係就摟蓑衣救火——惹火生身㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 hou2 zou6 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 lau4 so1 ji1 gau3 fo2 -- je5 fo2 sang1 san1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想清楚了再做啊，不然就是引火烧身了。
examples.english_sentence: Think it through before you do it, otherwise it will be like bringing trouble upon yourself.

synonyms: 搬石砸腳 (baan1 sek6 zaap3 goek3)
玩火自焚 (waan2 fo2 zi6 fan4)

english_meaning: To mistake someone for someone else; to misidentify someone.
explanation_mandarin: 指认错人，把一个人误认为是另一个人。
explanation_english: Refers to mistaking one person for another; to identify someone incorrectly. Often used when there is a resemblance or similar appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺街摟錯人皮，好尷尬呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 gaai1 lau1 co3 jan4 pei4, hou2 gaai3 gaai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在街上认错人了，好尴尬啊！
examples.english_sentence: I just mistook someone for someone else on the street, it was so embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個咁似樣，你摟錯人皮都唔出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 gam3 ci5 joeng2, nei5 lau1 co3 jan4 pei4 dou1 m4 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个长得这么像，你认错人也不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: They look so alike, it's not surprising that you mistook one for the other.

mandarin_meaning: 搪塞; 推卸; 敷衍
english_meaning: to fob off; to evade; to shirk; to put off
explanation_mandarin: 用借口来推托或敷衍。
explanation_english: To use excuses to evade responsibility or deal with something superficially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都摥我，唔肯幫我手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 tong3 ngo5, m4 hang2 bong1 ngo5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是搪塞我，不肯帮我忙。
examples.english_sentence: He always fobs me off and refuses to help me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摥住，有咩問題就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tong3 zyu6, jau5 me1 man6 tai4 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要敷衍了，有什么问题就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't evade the issue, just say what the problem is directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫佢做嘢，佢就摥話忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5, keoi5 zau6 tong3 waa6 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板让他做事，他就推托说忙。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked him to do something, and he evaded it by saying he was busy.

english_meaning: to fob off; to give a perfunctory or evasive reply; to brush off; to prevaricate
explanation_mandarin: 用不切实际的话应付、推托；敷衍了事。
explanation_english: To fob off someone with excuses or perfunctory answers; to avoid dealing with a question or request directly by giving an evasive or insincere response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日摥門啦，認真啲做嘢得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tong3 mun4 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是搪塞了，认真工作行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Stop fobbing me off all the time, can you please do your job properly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我問佢幾時還錢，佢淨係識得摥門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 man6 keoi5 gei2 si4 waan4 cin2, keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 tong3 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我问他什么时候还钱，他只会搪塞。
examples.english_sentence: I asked him when he would repay the money, and all he did was fob me off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府成日都係摥門，永遠唔會正面回應市民嘅訴求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zheng3 fu2 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 tong3 mun4, wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 zing3 min6 wui4 ying3 si5 man4 ge3 sou3 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府总是搪塞，永远不会正面回应市民的诉求。
examples.english_sentence: The government always fobs people off and never responds directly to the demands of the citizens.

english_meaning: to fob off, to brush off, to give the runaround, to evade
explanation_mandarin: 指用借口或敷衍的话来推托应付，不认真处理。
explanation_english: To fob someone off by giving excuses or avoiding the issue. To evade a question or responsibility by providing insincere answers or delaying tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係摥閘，我哋想知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tong3 zaap6, ngo5 dei6 soeng2 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是搪塞，我们想知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just fob us off, we want to know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日摥閘，啲嘢永遠都冇進展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tong3 zaap6, di1 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 mou5 zeon3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是搪塞，事情永远都没有进展。
examples.english_sentence: He always fobs people off, so things never progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫佢解釋，但係佢就摥閘話唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 keoi5 gaai2 sik1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zau6 tong3 zaap6 waa6 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫他解释，但是他就搪塞说不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked him to explain, but he fobbed him off by saying he wasn't clear.

english_meaning: to urge, to press, to destroy, to wreck
explanation_mandarin: 有催促，逼迫，破坏等意思。在香港口语中，也常用作比较口语化的表达，例如“摧你去洗澡啦！”表示催促你去做某事。
explanation_english: Means to urge, to press, to destroy. In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, it is also used as a more colloquial expression, such as "摧你去洗澡啦!" (ceoi1 nei5 heoi3 sai2 zo2 laa1!) meaning to urge you to do something, like 'go take a bath!'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽成日摧我去結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 ngo5 heoi3 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈整天催我去结婚。
examples.english_sentence: My mom is always urging me to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢不斷咁摧我交功課，煩死人喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bat1 dyun6 gam2 ceoi1 ngo5 gaau1 gung1 fo3, faan4 sei2 jan4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直催我交作业，烦死了！
examples.english_sentence: He keeps urging me to hand in my homework, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場風暴摧毀咗好多房屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 fung1 bou6 ceoi1 wai2 zo2 hou2 do1 fong4 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场风暴摧毁了很多房屋。
examples.english_sentence: The storm destroyed many houses.

english_meaning: to devastate; to wreck; to ruin; to ravage; to maltreat; to abuse; to torture
explanation_mandarin: 指用强力破坏或残害；多指精神或肉体上的伤害。
explanation_english: To devastate, ruin, or damage, often referring to physical or mental harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅健康俾病魔摧殘得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin6 hong1 bei2 beng6 mo1 ceoi1 caan4 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的健康被病魔摧残得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: His health has been severely ravaged by the illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭摧殘咗好多家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zaan3 ceoi1 caan4 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争摧残了很多家庭。
examples.english_sentence: War has devastated many families.

explanation_english: To rub back and forth with a hand or object; also refers to gently stroking with the hand.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便摸别人的肩膀啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just randomly touch people's shoulders.

examples.english_sentence: They are rubbing their fists and palms here, preparing to do something big.

english_meaning: to dawdle, to dilly-dally, to procrastinate, to waste time
explanation_mandarin: 指做事拖拖拉拉，慢慢吞吞，效率很低。
explanation_english: Refers to acting slowly, inefficiently, and wasting time; to dawdle or procrastinate.

examples.english_sentence: Can you not be so slow and inefficient when you work?

mandarin_meaning: 印度人；南亚人；（旧时）印度警察
english_meaning: Indian; South Asian; (Historically) Indian policeman
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对印度人或南亚人的称呼，有时含有贬义。也指旧时的印度警察。
explanation_english: A term, sometimes derogatory, used in the past to refer to people from India or South Asia. It also refers to Indian policemen in colonial times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲香港人成日叫印度警察做摩囉差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 seng4 jat6 giu3 jan3 dou6 ging2 caat3 zou6 mo1 lo1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的香港人总是叫印度警察做摩囉差。
examples.english_sentence: Hongkongers used to call Indian policemen 'Mo Lo Cha'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話我哋唔應該用「摩囉差」呢個詞，帶有歧視意味。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说我们不应该用“摩囉差”这个词，带有歧视意味。
examples.english_sentence: He said we shouldn't use the term 'Mo Lo Cha' as it has discriminatory connotations.

jyutping: mo1 lo1 caa1 waan2 jam1 ngok6
mandarin_meaning: 外行人装内行；不懂装懂
english_meaning: A layman pretending to be an expert, especially in music; someone who is clueless trying to act knowledgeable, playing music badly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不精通音乐，却装作很懂的样子。通常指技巧拙劣，演奏得不好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not proficient in music but pretends to be very knowledgeable. It usually implies poor skills and bad playing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴都未彈熟，就話自己係鋼琴大師，真係摩囉差玩音樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 dou1 mei6 taan4 suk6, zau6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 gong3 kam4 daai6 si1, zan1 hai6 mo1 lo1 caa1 waan2 jam1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他琴都没弹熟，就说自己是钢琴大师，真是外行人装内行。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't even mastered the piano, yet he claims to be a piano master. It's like a layman pretending to be an expert.

jyutping: mo1 lo1 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6
mandarin_meaning: 地位低下的人都有自己的地盘
english_meaning: Even the lowest of the low have their own territory or sphere of influence.
explanation_mandarin: “摩囉差”旧时指印度人，带有歧视色彩。这句话形容即使是最底层、最受歧视的人，也拥有属于自己的小小空间或权力范围。即使他们的地位低下，也有自己能控制或影响的领域。
explanation_english: "Mo Lo Chaa" is a derogatory term used in the past to refer to Indians. The idiom signifies that even the people at the very bottom of the social hierarchy possess their own territory or sphere of influence, however small it may be. Even if their status is low, they have an area they can control or affect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢係公司嘅清潔阿姨，但係喺個間茶水間度，佢話晒事，真係摩囉差都有殖民地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 cing1 git3 aa3 ji1, daan6 hai6 hai2 go3 gaan1 caa4 seoi2 gaan1 dou6, keoi5 waa6 saai3 si6, zan1 hai6 mo1 lo1 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然她是公司的清洁阿姨，但是在那个茶水间里，她说一不二，真是再底层的人也有自己的地盘。
examples.english_sentence: Although she is the cleaning lady of the company, she is the one in charge in the pantry. Even the lowest of the low have their own territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摩納哥嘅賭場好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mo1 naap6 gaa1 ge3 dou2 coeng4 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摩纳哥的赌场很有名。
examples.english_sentence: The casinos in Monaco are very famous.

mandarin_meaning: 印度人；印度裔；（旧时）对印度人的贬称
english_meaning: Indian (mostly derogatory, archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时香港对印度人的贬称，带歧视色彩。现在一般避免使用。
explanation_english: An old, mostly derogatory term for people of Indian descent, used in Hong Kong. It is considered offensive now and generally avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日叫印度人做「摩羅差」，好唔尊重人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 yan4 seng4 yat6 giu3 yan3 dou6 yan4 zou6 "mo1 lo4 caa1", hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 yan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们总是叫印度人“摩罗差”，很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: People used to call Indians 'mo1 lo4 caa1', which was very disrespectful.

jyutping: mo1 lo4 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6
mandarin_meaning: 印度阿三都有殖民地 (讽刺)
english_meaning: Even Indians had colonies (sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 讽刺那些自视甚高，觉得殖民地很光荣的人，实际上殖民历史并不光彩，甚至连印度人都曾是殖民者。
explanation_english: A sarcastic expression used to mock those who view the colonial era as glorious or something to be proud of. It implies that the history of colonialism is not something to celebrate, and even Indians (stereotypically referred to as "摩羅差", a derogatory term) were colonizers themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話以前香港好好，好似好懷念殖民地咁，真係「摩羅差都有殖民地」啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 hou2, hou2 ci5 hou2 waai4 nim6 zik6 man4 dei6 gam2, zan1 hai6 "mo1 lo4 caa1 dou1 jau5 zik6 man4 dei6" laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说以前的香港很好，好像很怀念殖民地一样，真是“印度阿三都有殖民地”了。
examples.english_sentence: He always says Hong Kong was so great in the past, as if he misses the colonial era. It's like saying "Even Indians had colonies."

english_meaning: Capricorn
explanation_mandarin: 黄道十二宫之一，相当于阳历12月22日至1月19日。
explanation_english: One of the twelve constellations of the zodiac, corresponding to approximately December 22nd to January 19th in the Gregorian calendar. (Capricorn)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係摩羯座嘅，所以比較務實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 mo1 git3 zo6 ge3, so2 ji5 bei2 gaau3 mou6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是摩羯座的，所以比较务实。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a Capricorn, so I'm quite practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信唔信摩羯座嘅人真係咁悶啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 m4 seon3 mo1 git3 zo6 ge3 jan4 zan1 hai6 gam3 mun6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信摩羯座的人真的这么闷吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you believe that Capricorns are really that boring?

english_meaning: Slow and sluggish; dilly-dallying; dawdling.
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作缓慢，拖拖拉拉，不干脆的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone being slow, sluggish, and dragging their feet; lacking decisiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度摩身摩勢啦，快啲搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 mo1 san1 mo1 sai3 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里慢吞吞的，快点把事情做完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dilly-dally here, finish the task quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都摩身摩勢，搞到我好鬼嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mo1 san1 mo1 sai3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gwai2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是慢吞吞的，搞得我很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so slow when he works, it makes me so angry.

english_meaning: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Mormonism)
explanation_mandarin: 指耶稣基督后期圣徒教会，又称摩门教。
explanation_english: Refers to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, also known as Mormonism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企信摩門敎，所以唔飲咖啡同茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 seon3 mo1 mun4 gaau3, so2 ji5 m4 yam2 gaa3 fe1 tung4 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家信奉摩门教，所以不喝咖啡和茶。
examples.english_sentence: Their family believes in Mormonism, so they don't drink coffee or tea.

english_meaning: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Mormonism)
explanation_mandarin: 指耶稣基督后期圣徒教会，通常被称为摩尔门教。
explanation_english: Refers to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, commonly known as Mormonism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人都係摩門教徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 dou1 hai6 mo1 mun4 gaau3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人都是摩尔门教徒。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family are Mormons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對摩門教嘅歷史好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 mo1 mun4 gaau3 ge3 lik6 si2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对摩尔门教的历史很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very interested in the history of Mormonism.

english_meaning: to stroke the crown of the head; to touch the top of the head
explanation_mandarin: 用手轻轻地抚摸头顶。
explanation_english: To gently stroke or touch the top of someone's head, typically as a sign of affection or blessing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摩頂安慰個喊緊嘅細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mo1 ding2 on1 wai3 go3 haam3 gan2 ge3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抚摸头顶安慰那个哭泣的孩子。
examples.english_sentence: He stroked the crown of the head to comfort the crying child.

english_meaning: to pick up, to gather, to cover
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中表示捡起、拾起，也指遮挡。具体含义根据语境而定。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it means to pick up, to gather, or to cover something. The specific meaning depends on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摭返起啲垃圾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 faan1 hei2 di1 laap1 saap3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把垃圾捡起来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Pick up the trash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用張報紙摭住個頭，費事曬親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 zoeng1 bou3 zi2 zek3 zyu6 go3 tau4, fai3 si5 saai3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用一张报纸遮住头，免得晒到。
examples.english_sentence: Use a newspaper to cover your head, so you don't get sunburned.

english_meaning: sincere, heartfelt, earnest
explanation_mandarin: 形容情感真诚、恳切。
explanation_english: Describes feelings that are genuine and heartfelt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅友誼好摯誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 jau5 ji5 hou2 zi3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的友谊非常真诚。
examples.english_sentence: The friendship between them is very sincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋向佢致以摯誠嘅問候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 keoi5 zi3 ji5 zi3 sing4 ge3 man6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们向他致以诚挚的问候。
examples.english_sentence: We extend our sincere greetings to him.

english_meaning: close friend, bosom friend, intimate friend
explanation_mandarin: 非常要好的朋友，知心朋友。
explanation_english: A very close friend; a bosom friend; an intimate friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅摯友，我哋識咗好耐喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi3 jau5, ngo5 dei6 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是我的挚友，我们认识很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is my close friend. We've known each other for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有一個摯友喺你身邊支持你，係一件好幸福嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jat1 go3 zi3 jau5 hai2 nei5 san1 bin1 zi1 ci4 nei5, hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 hang6 fuk1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有一个挚友在你身边支持你，是一件很幸福的事情。
examples.english_sentence: It's a great blessing to have a close friend supporting you.

english_meaning: Dearest love, beloved, cherished love
explanation_mandarin: 最深厚的爱，最爱的人或事物。
explanation_english: The deepest love; the person or thing that one loves most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅摯愛，我會永遠愛佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi3 oi3, ngo5 wui5 wing5 jyun5 oi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的挚爱，我会永远爱他。
examples.english_sentence: He is my dearest love, I will love him forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 音樂係佢嘅摯愛，佢每日都練琴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam1 ngok6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 zi3 oi3, keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 lin6 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 音乐是他的挚爱，他每天都练琴。
examples.english_sentence: Music is his dearest love, he practices the piano every day.

english_meaning: sincere, earnest, heartfelt
explanation_mandarin: 指真心实意，非常诚恳。
explanation_english: Refers to being genuine and sincere, very earnest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅合作係建基於彼此嘅摯誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hap6 jok3 hai6 gin3 gei1 jyu1 bei2 ci2 ge3 zi3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的合作是建立在彼此真诚的基础上的。
examples.english_sentence: Their cooperation is built on mutual sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對你嘅幫助係出於摯誠嘅心意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 nei5 ge3 bong1 zo6 hai6 ceot1 jyu1 zi3 sing4 ge3 sam1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对你的帮助是出于真诚的心意。
examples.english_sentence: Our help to you comes from a sincere intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要用摯誠嘅態度去面對每一個挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 yung6 zi3 sing4 ge3 taai3 dou6 heoi3 min6 deoi3 mui5 jat1 go3 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要用真诚的态度去面对每一个挑战。
examples.english_sentence: We need to face every challenge with a sincere attitude.

english_meaning: to pull; to tug; to drag
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具向某个方向用力拉动。
explanation_english: To pull or tug something in a certain direction, usually with hands or tools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摱住條繩，唔好放手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maan1 zyu6 tiu4 sing4, m4 hou2 fong3 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抓住绳子，不要放手啊！
examples.english_sentence: Hold onto the rope, don't let go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大力摱開咗道門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 lik6 maan1 hoi1 zo2 dou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用力拉开了门。
examples.english_sentence: He forcefully pulled the door open.

english_meaning: slowly; unhurriedly; deliberately slow
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作或速度非常缓慢，不着急的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the manner of doing something very slowly, without any rush or hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好摱摱緊啦，快啲搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 maan1 maan1 gan2 laa1, faai3 di1 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要慢吞吞的，快点搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow when you do things, finish it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆行路摱摱緊，要小心扶住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 haang4 lou6 maan1 maan1 gan2, jiu3 siu2 sam1 fu4 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶走路慢吞吞的，要小心扶着她。
examples.english_sentence: The grandma walks slowly, you need to carefully support her.

english_meaning: to hitch a ride (literally or figuratively); to freeload; to take advantage; to sponge off someone
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是抓住车边。比喻占别人便宜，利用别人的方便或关系来获得好处，带有不劳而获的意味。
explanation_english: Literally means to grab the side of a vehicle. Figuratively, it means to take advantage of someone else's convenience or connections to gain benefits without effort; to freeload or sponge off someone. It often implies a sense of opportunism and taking something for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都摱車邊，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 laan6 ce1 bin1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是占别人便宜，真让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to freeload, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住摱車邊入大學，要靠自己努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 laan6 ce1 bin1 jap6 daai6 hok6, jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着靠关系上大学，要靠自己努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about getting into university by taking advantage of connections, you need to rely on your own effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日摱我車邊，間唔中都要請返我食飯㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 laan6 ngo5 ce1 bin1, gaan1 m4 zung1 dou1 jiu3 ceng2 faan1 ngo5 sik6 faan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是占我的便宜，偶尔也要请我吃饭啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always sponge off me, you need to treat me to a meal once in a while.

english_meaning: To be unreasonable, to pick a fight for no reason, to be a troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 指无理取闹，故意找茬，让人觉得很烦。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is being unreasonable and deliberately causing trouble, making others feel annoyed. Often describes someone who enjoys picking fights or arguing for no good reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日摱雞啦，好煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 laan1 gai1 laa1, hou2 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是无理取闹了，很烦的。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being so unreasonable all the time, it's annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專登摱雞，想引起人哋注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 dang3 laan1 gai1, soeng2 hing2 hei2 jan4 dei6 zyu3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意找事，想引起别人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He is deliberately making trouble to get attention.

english_meaning: to nitpick; to find fault; to look for trouble; to find something to argue about; to pick on someone
explanation_mandarin: 指故意找别人的错处，吹毛求疵，没事找事。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately finding fault with others, being nitpicky, and looking for trouble where there is none. It implies a deliberate effort to find something wrong, even if it's trivial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日摱鷄啦，佢都做得好好㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 laan1 gai1 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是找茬了，他都做得很好啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always nitpick, he's already doing a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意摱鷄，成日投訴呢樣嗰樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 laan1 gai1, sing4 jat6 tau4 sou3 ni1 joeng2 go2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢找茬，总是抱怨这个那个。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to find fault, always complaining about this and that.

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常吝啬，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好摳，一毫子都唔捨得使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 kau1, jat1 hou4 zi2 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很抠门，一分钱都不舍得花。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy, he doesn't even want to spend a penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁摳啦，請我飲杯嘢都唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kau1 laa1, cheng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么抠门啦，请我喝杯东西都不肯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, you won't even buy me a drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁摳住啲錢啦，有需要就用啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 kau1 zyu6 di1 chin2 laa1, jau5 seoi1 jiu3 zau6 yung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么抠着那些钱了，有需要就用吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy with your money, use it if you need it.

english_meaning: to mess up; to rummage and make a mess; to tamper with
explanation_mandarin: 指用手随意翻动，把原本整齐的东西弄得杂乱无章。
explanation_english: To mess up something by rummaging through it or tampering with it in a disorganized way. It implies making a mess of something that was previously tidy or organized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再摳亂啲嘢啦，我啱啱執好㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 kau1 lyun6 di1 je5 laa1, ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zap1 hou2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再弄乱东西了，我刚刚才整理好的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess up the things again, I just tidied them up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路成日摳亂阿媽嘅化妝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 kau1 lyun6 aa3 maa1 ge3 faa3 zong1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩总是弄乱妈妈的化妆品。
examples.english_sentence: That child always messes up his mom's cosmetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摳亂人哋啲文件，好冇禮貌㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kau1 lyun6 jan4 dei6 di1 man4 gin2, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱翻别人的文件，很没礼貌的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't rummage through other people's documents, it's very impolite!

english_meaning: stingy; miserly; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常小气，舍不得花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very stingy and unwilling to spend money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好摳褲，一蚊都唔肯俾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 kau1 fu3, jat1 man1 dou1 m4 hang2 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小气，一分钱都不肯给。
examples.english_sentence: He is so stingy, he won't even give a penny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁摳褲啦，請我飲杯嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 kau1 fu3 laa1, ceng2 ngo5 jam2 bui1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气嘛，请我喝杯东西而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, just buy me a drink.

english_meaning: stingy; tight-fisted; miserly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常吝啬，一毛不拔。比喻非常小气，不肯花钱。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely stingy and unwilling to spend money. It implies a miserly attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好摳針，請佢食餐飯都好似要佢條命咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 kau1 zam1, ceng2 keoi5 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 hou2 ci5 jiu3 keoi5 tiu4 meng6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小气，请他吃顿饭都好像要了他的命一样。
examples.english_sentence: He is really stingy, treating him to a meal is like taking his life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁摳針啦，今次我請你飲杯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 kau1 zam1 laa1, gam1 ci3 ngo5 ceng2 nei5 yam2 bui1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么小气了，这次我请你喝一杯东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy, I'll treat you to a drink this time.

english_meaning: to tear, to rip, to pluck (feathers, leaves, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 用手快速地撕、扯、或拔除。
explanation_english: To tear, rip, or pluck something quickly with one's hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我摵爛咗張紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 laan6 zo2 zoeng1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把纸撕烂了。
examples.english_sentence: I tore the paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摵咗啲雞毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 zo2 di1 gai1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拔了一些鸡毛。
examples.english_sentence: He plucked some chicken feathers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力摵開佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 sik1 hoi1 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么用力地撕开它啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't tear it open with so much force!

english_meaning: to feign; to pretend; to put on airs; hypocritical; sanctimonious
explanation_mandarin: 指人故意装出正经或严肃的样子，并非真心实意，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a person deliberately putting on a serious or solemn appearance, not genuinely sincere. It carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度摵眉啦，你心諗緊乜嘢我知曬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sik1 mei4 laa1, nei5 sam1 nim2 gan2 mat1 je5 ngo5 zi1 saai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里装模作样了，你心里想什么我都知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend here, I know exactly what you're thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日摵眉摵眼，睇見都覺得假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 sik1 mei4 sik1 ngaan5, tai2 gin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人整天假正经，看着都觉得虚伪。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on airs, it feels so fake to look at him.

english_meaning: To suddenly get excited; to suddenly become enthusiastic about something; to suddenly become motivated
explanation_mandarin: 形容人突然对某件事产生兴趣或动力，变得很积极。
explanation_english: Describes someone who suddenly becomes interested or motivated in something, becoming very active and enthusiastic about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先仲話好攰，依家聽到話去食好嘢，即刻摵起條筋！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 zung1 waa6 hou2 gui6, ji1 gaa1 ting1 dou2 waa6 heoi3 sik6 hou2 je5, zik1 hak1 sek1 hei2 tiu4 gan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才还说很累，现在听到说去吃好吃的，立刻就来劲了！
examples.english_sentence: Just now you said you were tired, but now you hear we're going to eat something good, you suddenly got excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本身唔想做，但係見到有 bonus，佢即刻摵起條筋做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 san1 m4 soeng2 zou6, daan6 hai6 gin3 dou2 jau5 bonus, keoi5 zik1 hak1 sek1 hei2 tiu4 gan1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来不想做，但是看到有奖金，他立刻就来劲工作了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't want to do it at first, but when he saw there was a bonus, he suddenly got motivated to work.

english_meaning: to knead; to roll into a ball; to gather; to collect
explanation_mandarin: 用手把东西揉成团；聚集。
explanation_english: To knead or roll something into a ball using the hands; to gather or collect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摶緊啲麵粉準備整包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tyun4 gan2 di1 min6 fan2 jun2 bei6 zing2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她正在揉面粉准备做面包。
examples.english_sentence: She is kneading the flour to prepare for making bread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人摶埋一堆，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 tyun4 maai4 yat1 deoi1, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人聚集在一起，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: Those people are gathered together, I don't know what happened.

english_meaning: to rummage, to search through (messily), to turn upside down
explanation_mandarin: 指为了寻找某物而乱翻东西。通常指较为杂乱无章的翻找。
explanation_english: Refers to searching for something by rummaging through things, often in a disorganized manner. It implies a messy or disorderly search.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺個櫃桶度摷咗好耐，都搵唔到條鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 go3 gwai6 tung2 dou6 caau2 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 tiu4 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在抽屉里翻找了很久，都没找到钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: I rummaged through the drawer for a long time, but I couldn't find the key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摷我啲嘢啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 caau2 ngo5 di1 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱翻我的东西！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with my things!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個手袋度摷嚟摷去，都搵唔到佢部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 sau2 doi2 dou6 caau2 lei4 caau2 heoi3, dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 keoi5 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在手提包里翻来翻去，都找不到她的电话。
examples.english_sentence: She was rummaging around in her handbag, but couldn't find her phone.

mandarin_meaning: 触摸, 摸索, 偷窃
english_meaning: to touch, to feel, to grope, to steal, to play mahjong
explanation_mandarin: 用手接触或抚摸。也指偷窃（非正式用法）或打麻将。
explanation_english: To touch or feel with the hand. It can also refer to stealing (informal usage) or playing mahjong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂摸啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 mok1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱摸东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch the things randomly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去摸牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 mok1 paai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去打麻将。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to play mahjong tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摸咗我銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mok1 zo2 ngo5 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷了我的钱包。
examples.english_sentence: He stole my wallet.

english_meaning: to be unable to make head or tail of something, baffled, confused
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情令人费解，不知道是怎么回事。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is puzzling or difficult to understand; to not know what's going on; to be confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢講到一舊舊，真係摸不著頭腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gong2 dou3 jat1 gau6 gau6, zan1 hai6 mok1 bat1 zoek3 tau4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话含糊不清，真是摸不着头脑。
examples.english_sentence: He spoke so incoherently; I couldn't make head or tail of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得太複雜，睇完都摸不著頭腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 taai3 fuk1 zaap6, tai2 jyun4 dou1 mok1 bat1 zoek3 tau4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得太复杂了，看完都摸不着头脑。
examples.english_sentence: The report is written too complicated, I still couldn't understand after reading it.

mandarin_meaning: 摸清底细; 了解情况
english_meaning: to sound out; to get a feel for something; to ascertain the facts; to take a straw poll; to gauge the situation
explanation_mandarin: 指了解事情的详细情况，摸清底细，以便更好地开展工作或作出决策。
explanation_english: Refers to understanding the details of a matter, ascertaining the bottom line, in order to better carry out work or make decisions. It often implies a preliminary investigation or inquiry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要先摸底，了解下個客嘅需求先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 mok1 dai2, liu2 gaai2 haa5 go3 haak3 ge3 seoi1 kiu4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要先摸清底细，了解一下客户的需求。
examples.english_sentence: We need to sound out the situation first to understand the client's needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆叫我哋摸底，睇下有幾多同事想參加嗰個培訓課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 mok1 dai2, tai2 haa5 jau5 gei2 do1 tung4 si6 soeng2 caam1 gaa1 go2 go3 pui4 fun3 fo3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我们摸底，看看有多少同事想参加那个培训课程。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked us to take a straw poll to see how many colleagues want to attend that training course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方需要摸底，掌握更多犯罪集團嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 seoi1 jiu3 mok1 dai2, zaak1 wo6 geng3 do1 faan2 zeoi6 zaap6 tyun4 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方需要摸清底细，掌握更多犯罪集团的资料。
examples.english_sentence: The police need to get a feel for the situation and gather more information about the criminal syndicate.

english_meaning: To have a heart-to-heart talk (often over drinks); To talk deeply; To discuss matters intimately (over drinks)
explanation_mandarin: 指饮酒时，与人深入交谈，坦诚交流彼此的想法和感受。
explanation_english: Refers to having a deep and intimate conversation with someone, usually while drinking alcohol, to candidly exchange thoughts and feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋今晚出去摸杯底，傾下計？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 ceot1 heoi3 mok1 bui1 dai2, king1 haa5 gai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们今晚出去促膝长谈，聊聊天？
examples.english_sentence: How about we go out for a heart-to-heart tonight and have a chat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一路飲啤酒，一路摸杯底，好似好多嘢講噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 lou6 jam2 be1 zau2, jat1 lou6 mok1 bui1 dai2, hou2 ci5 hou2 do1 je5 gong2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩一边喝啤酒，一边促膝长谈，好像有很多话要说。
examples.english_sentence: They were drinking beer and having a heart-to-heart, as if they had a lot to talk about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日收工之後都去酒吧摸杯底，呻下工作上嘅苦況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 sau1 gung1 zi1 hau6 dou1 heoi3 zau2 baa1 mok1 bui1 dai2, san1 haa5 gung1 zok3 soeng6 ge3 fu2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常下班后都去酒吧深谈，抱怨一下工作上的苦恼。
examples.english_sentence: They often go to a bar for a heart-to-heart after work to complain about the hardships of their job.

english_meaning: to become familiar with, to get to know well, to master
explanation_mandarin: 指通过实践或接触，对某事物或技能非常熟悉并能够熟练掌握。
explanation_english: Refers to becoming very familiar with something or a skill through practice or contact, and being able to master it proficiently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要摸熟曬啲流程，先可以獨立處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 mok1 suk6 saai3 di1 lau4 cing4, sin1 ho2 ji5 duk6 laap6 cyu5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要完全熟悉这些流程，才能独立处理。
examples.english_sentence: You need to become completely familiar with these processes before you can handle them independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要摸熟香港嘅交通網絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 mok1 suk6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau1 tung1 mong5 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要熟悉香港的交通网络。
examples.english_sentence: We need to become familiar with Hong Kong's transportation network.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個程式要用多幾次先摸熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jiu3 yung6 do1 gei2 ci3 sin1 mok1 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个程序要多用几次才能熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: You need to use this program a few more times to become familiar with it.

mandarin_meaning: 麻将高手，牌技高超的人
english_meaning: Mahjong master, a person with exceptional mahjong skills
explanation_mandarin: 形容麻将技术非常高超的人，经常赢牌，被称为“摸王”。“摸”在麻将中指抽牌的动作。
explanation_english: Describes a person with exceptionally high mahjong skills who frequently wins. "摸 (mok1)" refers to the action of drawing a tile in mahjong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀真係好勁，啲人都叫佢做摸王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6, di1 jan4 dou1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mok1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将真的很厉害，大家都叫他摸王。
examples.english_sentence: He is really good at playing mahjong; everyone calls him Mahjong Master.

english_meaning: to fumble around blindly; to grope around without a clue; to do something without understanding or guidance
explanation_mandarin: 形容在黑暗中或不了解情况时，盲目地摸索、尝试。比喻做事没有方向，乱碰乱撞。
explanation_english: Describes groping or trying something blindly, either literally in the dark or figuratively without understanding or guidance. It implies a lack of direction and random, haphazard attempts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺黑麻麻嘅房入邊摸盲盲，搵緊支電筒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hak1 maa4 maa4 ge3 fong2 jap6 bin1 mok1 maang4 maang4, wan2 gan2 zi1 din6筒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在黑漆漆的房间里摸索着，找手电筒。
examples.english_sentence: He was fumbling around in the pitch-black room, looking for a flashlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢個新系統唔熟悉，成日摸盲盲，唔知點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 san1 hai6 tung2 m4 suk6 sik1, seng4 jat6 mok1 maang4 maang4, m4 zi1 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这个新系统不熟悉，总是盲目摸索，不知道怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not familiar with this new system, so I'm always just fumbling around and don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 彻底了解情况，弄清真相; 探底
english_meaning: to get to the bottom of something; to find out the truth; to investigate thoroughly; to reach rock bottom (metaphorically)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻深入了解情况，直至找出真相或解决问题。也指跌到谷底，情况非常糟糕。
explanation_english: Metaphorically means to thoroughly understand a situation, until finding out the truth or solving the problem. It can also mean to reach rock bottom, with the situation being very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要摸碟底，睇吓件事嘅真相係點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 mok1 dip6 dai2, tai2 haa5 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng2 hai6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要弄清楚事情的真相。
examples.english_sentence: We must get to the bottom of this and see what the truth of the matter is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢公司蝕到摸碟底，就嚟執笠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gung1 si1 sit8 dou3 mok1 dip6 dai2, zau6 lai4 zap1 laap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司亏损到了谷底，快要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: His company has lost so much money that it has reached rock bottom and is about to close down.

english_meaning: to grope; to fumble; to feel around; to explore; to feel out; to try to find one's way
explanation_mandarin: 用手触摸着寻找或试探。也比喻探索，寻找。
explanation_english: To feel around or explore with the hand. Also used metaphorically to mean exploring and searching for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺黑暗入面摸索住開燈掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hak1 am3 jap6 min6 mok1 sok3 zoek3 hoi1 dang1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在黑暗中摸索着开灯的开关。
examples.english_sentence: He was groping in the dark for the light switch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲喺度摸索緊點樣解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 hai2 dou6 mok1 sok3 gan2 dim2 joeng2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还在摸索如何解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We are still exploring how to solve this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱開始做生意，好多嘢都要自己摸索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 hoi1 chi2 zou6 saang1 yi3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 mok1 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚开始做生意，很多东西都要自己摸索。
examples.english_sentence: He just started a business and needs to figure out many things himself.

english_meaning: to inquire about; to investigate (esp. secretively); to seek information, often through indirect means; to be nosey
explanation_mandarin: 比喻暗中探听消息或调查情况。形容人喜欢打听别人的事情，或进行秘密的调查活动。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to secretly inquiring about news or investigating a situation. It describes someone who likes to inquire about other people's affairs or conduct secret investigations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都摸茶杯底，好八卦㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mok1 caa4 bui1 dai2, hou2 baat3 gwaa3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是到处打听消息，很八卦！
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to find out information from others, he's so nosy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日摸茶杯底啦，人哋嘅私事唔關你事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 mok1 caa4 bui1 dai2 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 si1 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是打听消息，别人的私事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be so nosy, other people's private matters are none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講公司入面有人摸茶杯底，想知邊個會升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jau5 jan4 mok1 caa4 bui1 dai2, soeng2 zi1 bin1 go3 wui5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说公司里有人在打听消息，想知道谁会升职。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that someone in the company is inquiring around, trying to find out who will get promoted.

english_meaning: to clam (collect clams)
explanation_mandarin: 指在海滩或泥滩上用手捡拾蚬子（一种贝类）。
explanation_english: To collect clams by hand, usually in mud flats or beaches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去流浮山摸蜆好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 lau4 fu4 saan1 mok1 hin2 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去流浮山捡蚬子好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go clamming in Lau Fau Shan tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人成日得閒就去海邊摸蜆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 sing4 jat6 dak1 haan4 zau6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 mok1 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人经常有空就去海边捡蚬子。
examples.english_sentence: His family often goes clamming at the seaside whenever they have free time.

english_meaning: Smuggled goods; contraband; black market goods
explanation_mandarin: 指未经海关检查或未缴纳关税而非法进口或出口的货物。
explanation_english: Refers to goods that are illegally imported or exported without customs inspection or payment of tariffs. Often associated with illegal trade and black markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都賣摸貨，小心俾人拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 maai6 mok1 fo3, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是卖走私货，小心被人抓。
examples.english_sentence: He's always selling smuggled goods, be careful of getting arrested.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲名牌嘢咁平，唔會係摸貨啩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ming4 paai4 je5 gam3 peng4, m4 wui5 hai6 mok1 fo3 gwaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些名牌东西这么便宜，不会是走私货吧？
examples.english_sentence: These branded goods are so cheap, could they be smuggled goods?

english_meaning: To touch someone inappropriately; to grope; to paw
explanation_mandarin: 指不正当地触摸别人的身体，带有性骚扰的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to touching someone's body inappropriately, often with a sexual connotation; to grope or paw at someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士度摸身摸勢，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 mok1 san1 mok1 sai3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在巴士上动手动脚的，真令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He was groping people on the bus, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好摸身摸勢啊！我報警㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 mok1 san1 mok1 sai3 aa3! ngo5 bou3 ging2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要动手动脚！我要报警的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't touch me inappropriately! I'll call the police!

mandarin_meaning: 闲聊；非正式地讨论事情
english_meaning: To chat casually over drinks; to discuss matters informally over drinks; to brainstorm over drinks
explanation_mandarin: 指一边喝酒，一边轻松地聊天或讨论事情。通常用于非正式的场合，目的是为了营造轻松的气氛，促进交流。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting or discussing matters casually while drinking, typically in an informal setting. The purpose is often to create a relaxed atmosphere and facilitate communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋今晚摸酒杯底傾下個project嘅 details啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 mok1 zau2 bui1 dai2 king1 haa5 go3 project ge3 details laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们今晚喝点酒，非正式地谈一下这个项目的细节吧。
examples.english_sentence: How about we chat over drinks tonight to discuss the project details informally?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日放工都摸酒杯底，吹水吹到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 fong3 gung1 dou1 mok1 zau2 bui1 dai2, cheui1 seui2 cheui1 dou3 hou2 je2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常下班后一起喝酒聊天，胡侃到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: We often chat over drinks after work, talking nonsense until late at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如摸酒杯底諗下啲新嘅 marketing strategies?
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 mok1 zau2 bui1 dai2 nam2 haa5 di1 san1 ge3 marketing strategies?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如喝点酒，一起想想新的营销策略？
examples.english_sentence: How about we brainstorm some new marketing strategies over drinks?

synonyms: 吹水 (cheui1 seui2) - to chat; to talk nonsense

english_meaning: to be turned away; to find the door locked; to be given the cold shoulder; to have your visit wasted
explanation_mandarin: 去某处拜访或办事，结果对方不在或无法完成，白跑一趟。
explanation_english: To go somewhere to visit or take care of something, only to find that the person is not there or the task cannot be completed, resulting in a wasted trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先去咗佢屋企，但係摸門釘，唔知佢去咗邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 heoi3 zo2 keoi5 uk1 kei5, daan6 hai6 mok1 mun4 ding1, m4 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才去了他家，但是吃了闭门羹，不知道他去哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: I went to his house earlier, but found the door locked. I don't know where he went.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日諗住去銀行搞啲嘢，點知摸門釘，原來今日星期日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 gaau2 di1 je5, dim2 zi1 mok1 mun4 ding1, jyun4 loi4 gam1 jat6 sing1 kei4 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天打算去银行办点事，没想到扑了个空，原来今天是星期日。
examples.english_sentence: I was planning to go to the bank to take care of some things today, but I found it closed. It turns out it's Sunday.

english_meaning: To reach the peak; to hit the highest point; to top out
explanation_mandarin: 比喻达到事物发展的最高点，例如股票价格、楼市价格等达到最高峰。
explanation_english: A metaphor for reaching the highest point of development in something, such as the peak of stock prices or property prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市已經摸頂，唔好再入市喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 ji5 ging1 mok1 ding2, m4 hou2 zoi3 jap6 si5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价已经到顶了，不要再入市了。
examples.english_sentence: The property market has already topped out, don't enter the market anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市已經摸頂，隨時會回落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 ji5 ging1 mok1 ding2, ceoi4 si4 wui5 wui4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市已经达到顶峰，随时会回调。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has reached its peak and may fall back at any time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻股票升到摸頂，我哋應該放手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 gu2 piu3 sing1 dou3 mok1 ding2, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 fong3 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支股票涨到顶峰了，我们应该放手了。
examples.english_sentence: This stock has risen to its peak, we should let go now.

english_meaning: To pat someone on the head; to touch someone's head endearingly or patronizingly (usually towards a child); to act in a condescending manner
explanation_mandarin: 用手轻轻地摸别人的头，通常是对小孩子表示喜爱或怜惜，有时也带有居高临下的态度。
explanation_english: To gently touch someone's head, usually to express affection or pity towards children, sometimes with a condescending attitude.  It can also refer to touching someone's hair or the top of their head in a playful or teasing manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日摸頭摸髻，我已經唔係細路仔啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 mok1 tau4 mok1 gai3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 m4 hai6 sai3 lou6 zai2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是摸我的头，我已经不是小孩子了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pat my head, I'm not a child anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個BB好得意，忍唔住摸頭摸髻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 bi1 bi1 hou2 dak1 ji3, jan2 m4 zyu6 mok1 tau4 mok1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那个婴儿很可爱，忍不住摸摸头。
examples.english_sentence: He saw that the baby was very cute and couldn't help but pat its head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日摸頭摸髻咁同我講嘢，好似覺得我好蠢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 mok1 tau4 mok1 gai3 gam2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5, hou2 ci5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 hou2 ceon2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是摸着我的头跟我说话，好像觉得我很笨似的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always talks to me while patting my head, as if he thinks I'm stupid.

english_meaning: to be sexually harassed (by touching); to be groped
explanation_mandarin: 指被他人触摸身体敏感部位，具有性骚扰意味。
explanation_english: Refers to being sexually harassed by someone touching one's private or sensitive body parts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士上面畀人摸黃，即刻報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6 bei2 jan4 mok1 wong4, zik1 hak1 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在公交车上被人摸黄，立刻报警。
examples.english_sentence: She was groped on the bus and immediately called the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢夜晚行路嘅時候畀人摸黃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 je5 maan5 haang4 lou6 ge3 si4 hau6 bei2 jan4 mok1 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她晚上走路的时候被人摸黄了。
examples.english_sentence: She said she was groped while walking at night.

english_meaning: to grope in the dark; to work in the dark; to do something without light
explanation_mandarin: 在黑暗中摸索；形容在没有灯光或光线不足的情况下行动或工作。
explanation_english: To grope around in the dark; to do something in the dark or with very little light. It often implies difficulty and uncertainty due to the lack of visibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停電嘅時候，我哋要摸黑煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 din6 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 mok1 hak1 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 停电的时候，我们要摸黑做饭。
examples.english_sentence: When there's a power outage, we have to cook in the dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摸黑行樓梯，差啲跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mok1 hak1 haang4 lau4 tai1, caa1 di1 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摸黑走楼梯，差点摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He was walking down the stairs in the dark and almost fell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好摸黑睇書，會傷眼㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mok1 hak1 tai2 syu1, wui5 soeng1 ngaan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要摸黑看书，会伤眼睛的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't read in the dark, it will hurt your eyes.

english_meaning: to copy; to imitate; to trace (a drawing or writing)
explanation_mandarin: 照着原样写或画; 模仿。
explanation_english: To copy or imitate something, usually writing or drawing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意摹帖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 mou4 tip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢临摹字帖。
examples.english_sentence: He likes copying calligraphy models very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係摹人哋嘅作品，要自己創作啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 mou4 yan4 dei6 ge3 zok3 pin2, jiu3 zi6 gei2 chong3 zok3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是模仿别人的作品，要自己创作啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just copy other people's works, you should create your own!

english_meaning: copy, replica, facsimile
explanation_mandarin: 指照原本复制出来的东西，例如书法、绘画的副本。
explanation_english: A copy or replica of an original, especially of a piece of writing, painting, or drawing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫係原作嘅摹本，但都好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hai6 jyun4 zok3 ge3 mou4 bun2, daan6 dou1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画是原作的摹本，但是也很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is a copy of the original, but it's still very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨摹咗好多名家嘅摹本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 mou4 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 gaa1 ge3 mou4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他临摹了很多名家的摹本。
examples.english_sentence: He copied many facsimiles of famous artists.

english_meaning: To close down, to shut down (a business), to fold, to give up
explanation_mandarin: 原本指摺叠东西，现在常用于指公司、商店等生意失败，倒闭，停止营业。
explanation_english: Originally meaning 'to fold', it now commonly refers to a business (company, shop, etc.) failing, closing down, or ceasing operations. It can also mean to give up on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳做咗幾個月就摺咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zou6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zau6 zip3 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅开了几个月就倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant closed down after only a few months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似想摺埋盤生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 soeng2 zip3 maai4 pun4 seng1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像想结束这盘生意。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like he wants to shut down this business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快摺埋，再試下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 zip3 maai4, zoi3 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快放弃，再试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly, try again.

english_meaning: folding stool/chair
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以折叠的凳子。在香港电影中常常作为临时武器使用，因此具有特殊的文化意涵。
explanation_english: A folding stool/chair. Often depicted as a makeshift weapon in Hong Kong movies, giving it a special cultural connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞起張摺凳就衝咗出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 hei2 zoeng1 zip3 dang3 zau6 cung1 zo2 chut1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿起一张折叠凳就冲了出去。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up a folding stool and rushed out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲摺凳好方便，唔用嗰陣可以摺埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zip3 dang3 hou2 fong1 bin6, m4 yung6 go2 zan6 ho2 ji5 zip3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些折叠凳很方便，不用的时候可以折叠起来。
examples.english_sentence: These folding stools are very convenient; you can fold them up when you're not using them.

english_meaning: folding knife, pocket knife
explanation_mandarin: 可以折叠起来的刀
explanation_english: A knife with a blade that folds into the handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢袋住把摺刀喺身，唔知想做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 doi6 zyu6 baa2 zip3 dou1 hai2 san1, m4 zi1 dou1 soeng2 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身上带着一把折叠刀，不知道想做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's carrying a folding knife, I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔應該玩摺刀，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 m4 ying1 goi1 waan2 zip3 dou1, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不应该玩折叠刀，很危险的。
examples.english_sentence: Children shouldn't play with folding knives, it's very dangerous.

english_meaning: Homebody friend, recluse friend, someone who prefers to stay at home and avoid social activities
explanation_mandarin: 指喜歡待在家裡，不愛出門社交的朋友。通常形容性格比較內向，不擅長或不喜歡與人交往。
explanation_english: Refers to a friend who prefers to stay at home and avoids social activities. It usually describes someone who is introverted and not good at or doesn't enjoy socializing with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好摺，成日都喺屋企打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zip3, seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很宅，整天都在家里打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: He's a real homebody; he's always at home playing video games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個摺友話今晚唔出嚟，要留喺屋企睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zip3 jau5 waa6 gam1 maan1 m4 ceot1 lai4, jiu3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的宅友说今晚不出来，要留在家里看电影。
examples.english_sentence: My reclusive friend said he's not coming out tonight; he wants to stay home and watch a movie.

mandarin_meaning: 收起来; 躲起来; 关闭
english_meaning: to fold up; to put away; to hide oneself; to close down (a business); to withdraw from society
explanation_mandarin: 1. 把东西收起来。2. 躲藏起来，不与人交往。3.（生意）关闭。
explanation_english: 1. To fold something up and put it away. 2. To hide oneself, withdraw from society and avoid contact with others. 3. To close down a business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完嘢要自己摺埋啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 je5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 zip3 maai4 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭要自己把东西收拾好。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, you need to clean up your own things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔開心，成日摺埋喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hoi1 sam1, seng4 jat6 zip3 maai4 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不开心，整天躲在家里。
examples.english_sentence: He's unhappy and hides himself at home all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭做唔住，最後摺埋咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 zou6 m4 zyu6, zeoi3 hau6 zip3 maai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺经营不下去，最后倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The shop couldn't keep operating and eventually closed down.

english_meaning: To do handicrafts, to make handmade items
explanation_mandarin: 指制作手工制品，例如折纸，剪纸，编织等。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of creating handmade items, such as origami, paper cutting, knitting, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日摺手工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sing4 jat6 zip3 sau2 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常做手工。
examples.english_sentence: I used to do handicrafts a lot when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友好鍾意喺學校摺手工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 hok6 haau6 zip3 sau2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友们很喜欢在学校做手工。
examples.english_sentence: Kids really like doing handicrafts at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摺手工好叻㗎，可以摺好多唔同嘅動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 sau2 gung1 hou2 lek1 gaa3, ho2 ji5 zip3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她做手工很厉害，可以折很多不同的动物。
examples.english_sentence: She's very good at handicrafts, she can fold many different animals.

english_meaning: to pull; to tug; to drag; to mess with (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指拉扯，拖拽。引申为胡乱摆弄，或者戏弄、招惹某人。
explanation_english: Literally means to pull or tug. By extension, it can mean to mess around with something, or to tease or provoke someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好摺拉啲電線啦，陣間整壞咗就麻煩喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zip3 laai1 di1 din6 sin3 laa1, zan6 gaan1 zing2 waai6 zo2 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要乱拉电线了，一会儿弄坏了就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with the wires, it'll be a problem if you break them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日鍾意摺拉人，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zung1 ji3 zip3 laai1 jan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢招惹别人，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to mess with people, it's really annoying.

english_meaning: flip a table; to violently protest or express extreme anger
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“折叠桌子”，比喻因愤怒或不满而采取极端行动，表示强烈抗议。
explanation_english: Literally means "to fold a table", metaphorically refers to flipping a table to express extreme anger, frustration, or disagreement, often leading to disruptive behavior. It signifies a violent outburst of emotion or protest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到摺枱啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 zip3 toi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他气得掀桌子了！
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he flipped the table!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好動不動就摺枱啦，冷靜啲先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dung6 bat1 dung6 zau6 zip3 toi2 laa1, laang5 zing6 di1 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要动不动就掀桌子，冷静一点先吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flip the table at every little thing, calm down first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋唔肯讓步，我就摺枱唔做喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 m4 hang2 joeng6 bou6, ngo5 zau6 zip3 toi2 m4 zou6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们不肯让步，我就掀桌子不做了！
examples.english_sentence: If they don't compromise, I'll just flip the table and quit!

mandarin_meaning: 关机; 结束通话; 失败; 不行
english_meaning: To switch off (a phone); to hang up (a phone); to fail; to give up; to be a no-go; to be impossible
explanation_mandarin: 原指关闭手机。引申为结束通话，比喻事情失败、结束，或表示事情不可能、无法实现。
explanation_english: Originally refers to switching off a mobile phone. By extension, it means to end a phone call, metaphorically representing failure, ending something, or indicating that something is impossible or unrealizable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，講完就摺機啦，唔好阻住我傾計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, gong2 jyun4 zau6 zip3 gei1 laa1, m4 hou2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，说完就挂机吧，别打扰我聊天。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, hang up after you're done talking, don't interrupt my chatting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，我諗住摺機算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, ngo5 lam2 zyu6 zip3 gei1 syun3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么难，我想干脆放弃算了。
examples.english_sentence: This exam is so difficult, I think I'll just give up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃根本就摺機，無可能成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 gan1 bun2 zau6 zip3 gei1, mou5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划根本就行不通，不可能成功。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is simply a no-go, it's impossible to succeed.

english_meaning: Flip the table; quit abruptly; stop doing something suddenly, often in anger or frustration
explanation_mandarin: 比喻因为不满或失败而突然放弃、停止或中断行动。通常带有生气或沮丧的情绪。
explanation_english: A metaphor for abruptly abandoning, stopping, or interrupting an action due to dissatisfaction or failure. It usually implies anger or frustration. It can also refer to literally flipping a table over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日改我嘅嘢，我真係想摺檯唔撈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 sing4 jat6 goi2 ngo5 ge3 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 zip3 toi2 m4 lou1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板老是改我的东西，我真想掀桌子不干了！
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always changing my work. I really want to quit and flip the table!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 輸咗咁多錢，佢嬲到摺檯走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, keoi5 nau1 dou3 zip3 toi2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 输了这么多钱，他气得掀桌子走了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost so much money that he got angry, flipped the table and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果談判唔順利，我哋可以摺檯唔傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 taam4 pun3 m4 seon6 lei6, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zip3 toi2 m4 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果谈判不顺利，我们可以放弃谈判。
examples.english_sentence: If the negotiation doesn't go well, we can break off the talks.

english_meaning: folding stool; folding chair
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以折叠起来的凳子，方便携带和存放。
explanation_english: A folding stool or chair; a type of stool or chair that can be folded for easy carrying and storage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我帶咗張摺櫈去公園坐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai3 zo2 zoeng1 zip3 dang3 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我带了一把折叠凳去公园坐。
examples.english_sentence: I brought a folding stool to sit on in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張摺櫈好輕，好容易拎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zip3 dang3 hou2 hing1, hou2 jung4 ji6 ling1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张折叠凳很轻，很容易拿。
examples.english_sentence: This folding stool is very light and easy to carry.

english_meaning: crease, fold mark
explanation_mandarin: 衣物或纸张折叠后留下的痕迹。
explanation_english: A mark left on fabric or paper after it has been folded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫擺喺櫃桶太耐，好多摺痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 baai2 hai2 gwai2 tung2 taai3 noi6, hou2 do1 zip3 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服放在抽屉里太久，有很多褶皱。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has been in the drawer for too long and has a lot of creases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張紙唔好摺，陣間會有摺痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 zi2 m4 hou2 zip3, zan6 gaan1 wui5 jau5 zip3 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要折这张纸，一会儿会有褶皱。
