examples.english_sentence: Don't fold this paper, it will have creases later.

english_meaning: to roll up one's sleeves
explanation_mandarin: 把袖子向上卷起。
explanation_english: To roll up the sleeves of a shirt or other garment, often in preparation for work or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摺袖，睇嚟準備大顯身手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zip3 zau6, tai2 lai4 jun2 bei6 daai6 hin2 san1 sau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他卷起袖子，看来准备大显身手了。
examples.english_sentence: He's rolling up his sleeves, looks like he's ready to show off his skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摺袖做嘢方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zip3 zau6 zou6 je5 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 卷起袖子工作方便一些。
examples.english_sentence: It's easier to work with your sleeves rolled up.

english_meaning: to close an umbrella; to fold an umbrella
explanation_mandarin: 把伞合起来。
explanation_english: To close or fold an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 停咗雨喇，快啲摺遮啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting4 zo2 jyu5 laa3, faai3 di1 zip3 ze1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雨停了，快点收伞吧。
examples.english_sentence: It stopped raining, close your umbrella quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺室內摺遮，唔係會唔老嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 sat1 noi6 zip3 ze1, m4 hai6 wui5 m4 lou5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在室内收伞，不然会老来不好的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't close the umbrella indoors, or it will bring bad luck when you're old.

english_meaning: folding door, bi-fold door; (slang) to close down, to shut down, to cease operations
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指可以折叠的门。2. （俚语）指公司倒闭、关门大吉，停止运作。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a door that can be folded. 2. (Slang) To close down a business, to shut down, to cease operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳裝修咗，換咗道摺門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zong1 sau1 zo2, wun6 zo2 dou6 zip3 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅装修了，换了一扇折叠门。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant was renovated and had a folding door installed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋公司就嚟摺門，爭人好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 zip3 mun4, zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们公司快要倒闭了，欠了很多人钱。
examples.english_sentence: I heard their company is about to close down, they owe a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果間舖蝕錢蝕得太犀利，都係摺門算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gaan1 pou3 sit6 cin2 sit6 dak1 taai3 sai1 lei6, dou1 hai6 zip3 mun4 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果店铺亏损太厉害，还是关门算了。
examples.english_sentence: If the shop is losing too much money, it's better to just close it down.

english_meaning: to mix, to blend, to adulterate
explanation_mandarin: 把不同物质混在一起。通常含有不纯或弄虚作假的意思。
explanation_english: To mix different substances together. Often implies impurity or adulteration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲奶粉摻咗雜質㗎，唔好俾小朋友飲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 naai5 fan2 caam3 zo2 zaap6 zat1 gaa3, m4 hou2 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 yam2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些奶粉掺了杂质，不要给小朋友喝啊。
examples.english_sentence: This milk powder has been adulterated with impurities, don't let the children drink it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋摻埋啲唔同嘅茶葉嚟賣，賺多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 caam3 maai4 di1 m4 tung4 ge3 caa4 jip6 lai4 maai6, zaan6 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把不同的茶叶混合起来卖，赚更多的钱。
examples.english_sentence: They mix different types of tea leaves together to sell and make more money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺啲咖啡度摻糖啊，我鍾意飲齋啡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 di1 gaa3 fe1 dou6 caam3 tong2 aa3, ngo5 zung1 ji3 yam2 zaai1 fe1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在咖啡里加糖，我喜欢喝黑咖啡。
examples.english_sentence: Don't add sugar to the coffee, I like to drink black coffee.

english_meaning: to play with... / to include... and play
explanation_mandarin: 指把某人或某事物加入到玩乐的活动中。表示一起玩耍或参与某项活动。
explanation_english: Refers to including someone or something in a playful activity. Indicates playing together or participating in an activity together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如摻埋佢玩啦，佢成日自己一個都好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 caam1 maai4 keoi5 waan2 laa1, keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 dou1 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如让他一起玩吧，他整天自己一个人也很闷。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we include him? He's been bored all day on his own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋玩board game，你想唔想摻埋一份玩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 waan2 board game, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 caam1 maai4 jat1 fan6 waan2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们玩桌游，你想不想加入一起玩啊？
examples.english_sentence: We're playing board games, do you want to join in?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋打邊爐，你得閒就摻埋嚟玩啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 daa2 bin1 lou4, nei5 dak1 haan4 zau6 caam1 maai4 lai4 waan2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们吃火锅，你有空就一起来玩吧！
examples.english_sentence: We're having hot pot tonight, come join us if you're free!

english_meaning: to knock, to strike, to hit
explanation_mandarin: 用硬物撞擊另一物體。在粵語中常用於形容撞到頭部。
explanation_english: To knock or strike something with a hard object. In Cantonese, it's often used to describe hitting one's head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心摼親個頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 hang1 can1 go3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心撞到了头。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally hit his head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我摼到隻腳指尾，好痛呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hang1 dou2 zek3 goek3 zi2 mei1, hou2 tung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我撞到小脚趾，好痛啊！
examples.english_sentence: I hit my little toe, it hurts!

english_meaning: to put down, to place, to shelve (a task or issue)
explanation_mandarin: 放置、放下；引申为搁置、放下某事不做。
explanation_english: To put down physically; by extension, to shelve, postpone, or abandon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撂低佢喺度先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 dai1 keoi5 hai2 dou6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把他放在那里吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put him down there for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事撂埋一邊先，遲啲再搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 lok6 maai4 jat1 bin1 sin1, ci4 di1 zoi3 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事先搁在一边，迟点再处理。
examples.english_sentence: Let's shelve this matter for now and deal with it later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁快就撂手唔做啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 zau6 lok6 sau2 m4 zou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么快就放弃不做啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 离开; 丢下; 撇弃; 闪人
english_meaning: to leave; to abandon; to ditch; to leave behind; to slip away; to dump (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 表示离开或抛弃某人或某物。含有快速离开、丢下不管的意思。
explanation_english: To leave or abandon someone or something, often with the implication of doing so quickly or without regard for consequences. It can also mean to dump someone in a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撇低曬啲嘢就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pit3 dai1 saai3 di1 je5 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的东西都丢下就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He left all his things behind and just left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易撇人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 yi6 pit3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么容易就抛弃别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to abandon people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔俾條女撇咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 bei2 tiu4 neoi2 pit3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男的被那个女的甩了。
examples.english_sentence: That guy got dumped by that girl.

english_meaning: to abandon; to leave behind; to ditch
explanation_mandarin: 指丢弃，留下某人或某物。
explanation_english: To abandon, leave behind, or ditch someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時嬲嬲哋，就撇低咗我喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 nau1 nau1 dei2, zau6 pit3 dai1 zo2 ngo5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时生气，就把我丢在那儿了。
examples.english_sentence: He got angry for a moment and left me there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁自私，撇低啲工作畀我做晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 zi6 si1, pit3 dai1 di1 gung1 zok3 bei2 ngo5 zou6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这么自私，把工作都丢给我做。
examples.english_sentence: You can't be so selfish, leaving all the work for me to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋撇低咗架車喺路邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 pit3 dai1 zo2 gaa3 ce1 hai2 lou6 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把车丢在路边了。
examples.english_sentence: They abandoned the car on the roadside.

english_meaning: To close a stall (usually temporarily); to leave one's post/station (often without permission); to skip work/duty
explanation_mandarin: 指暂时或永久地结束生意或工作，离开岗位。
explanation_english: Refers to closing a business or leaving a job/post, either temporarily or permanently. Often implies leaving without proper authorization or procedure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都撇檔去打麻雀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 pit3 dong3 heoi3 daa2 maa4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是擅离职守去打麻将。
examples.english_sentence: He always skips work to play mahjong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日生意唔好，不如早啲撇檔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 seng1 ji3 m4 hou2, bat1 jyu4 zou2 di1 pit3 dong3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天生意不好，不如早点收摊吧。
examples.english_sentence: Business is bad today, maybe we should close our stall earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細唔喺度，佢就諗住撇檔走咗去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 m4 hai2 dou6, keoi5 zau6 lam2 zyu6 pit3 dong3 zau2 zo2 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不在，他就想着擅离职守跑去喝茶了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss isn't here, so he's planning on skipping out to go for tea.

mandarin_meaning: 谎言; 不着边际的话
english_meaning: Lies; nonsense; fabrication; tall tale
explanation_mandarin: 指不真实、虚假的故事或谎言。也可指不着边际，没有根据的话。
explanation_english: Refers to untrue, false stories or lies. It can also refer to unfounded or nonsensical words.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲撇水片，無人信佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 di1 pit3 seoi2 pin3, mou4 jan4 seon3 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说谎，没人相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always tells lies, no one believes him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再講啲撇水片啦，我唔會信你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 pit3 seoi2 pin3 laa1, ngo5 m4 wui seon3 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再撒谎了，我不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell any more lies, I won't believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲都係撇水片嚟㗎，唔好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 dou1 hai6 pit3 seoi2 pin3 lai4 gaa3, m4 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的那些都是谎言，不要相信。
examples.english_sentence: What he said are all lies, don't believe them.

english_meaning: to wash one's hands of something, to clear oneself of suspicion, to disassociate oneself from something
explanation_mandarin: 指从某件事情或关系中完全脱身，力图证明自己与某事无关，以避免受到牵连或承担责任。
explanation_english: To completely extricate oneself from something, attempting to prove one's lack of involvement in order to avoid being implicated or taking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想撇清同單案嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 pit3 cing1 tung4 daan1 on3 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想撇清和这件案件的关系。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to wash his hands of any involvement in this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好想撇清責任喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 soeng2 pit3 cing1 zaak3 jam3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想推卸责任！
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to shirk your responsibility!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生咗咁大件事，佢想撇清都撇唔甩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 sang1 zo2 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6, keoi5 soeng2 pit3 cing1 dou1 pit3 m4 lat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生了这么大的事，他想撇清都撇不掉。
examples.english_sentence: With such a big incident happening, he can't wash his hands of it even if he wants to.

english_meaning: to ditch, to shake off, to get rid of, to leave behind
explanation_mandarin: 摆脱、丢下某人或某物。使自己从某种不 желаемая situation 中解脱出来。
explanation_english: To get rid of someone or something; to shake off or leave someone behind. To extricate oneself from an undesirable situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺旺角撇甩咗佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 wong6 gok3 pit3 lat1 zo2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在旺角甩掉他们了。
examples.english_sentence: I ditched them in Mong Kok yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想撇甩啲工作走去玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 pit3 lat1 di1 gung1 zok3 zau2 heoi3 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想摆脱那些工作去玩。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get rid of the work and go play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你點樣撇甩個煩人嘅客啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dim2 joeng2 pit3 lat1 go3 faan4 jan4 ge3 haak3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是怎么摆脱那个烦人的客人的啊？
examples.english_sentence: How did you shake off that annoying customer?

english_meaning: neat and tidy; free from encumbrance; decisive; forthright; clean-cut
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事或者处理事情干脆利落，不拖泥带水，或者形容一个人生活洒脱，不受约束。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is decisive and efficient in doing things, without dragging things out. It can also describe someone who lives freely and unconstrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好撇脫，唔會拖拖拉拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 pit3 tyut3, m4 wui5 to1 to1 laai1 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很干脆利落，不会拖拖拉拉。
examples.english_sentence: He is very efficient in his work and doesn't drag things out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好撇脫，鍾意就鍾意，唔鍾意就唔鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 pit3 tyut3, zung1 ji3 zau6 zung1 ji3, m4 zung1 ji3 zau6 m4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很干脆，喜欢就喜欢，不喜欢就不喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very forthright person, he likes it if he likes it, and he doesn't like it if he doesn't like it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想過啲撇脫啲嘅生活，所以辭咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gwo3 di1 pit3 tyut3 di1 ge3 sang1 wut6, so2 ji5 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想过一些更洒脱的生活，所以辞了工作。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to live a more unencumbered life, so he quit his job.

english_meaning: Carefree, uninhibited, decisive, clear-cut, free from worries, to shake off, to get rid of
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事干脆利落，不拖泥带水；或者形容人无忧无虑，洒脱自在。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is decisive and efficient in their actions, without being hesitant or indecisive. Can also describe someone who is carefree, uninhibited, and free from worries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好撇脫，做嘢唔會拖泥帶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 pit3 tyut3, zou6 je5 m4 wui5 to1 nai4 daai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很洒脱，做事不会拖泥带水。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very decisive person; he doesn't drag his feet when doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放低晒啲嘢，成個人都覺得撇脫晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 dai1晒 di1 je5, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 pit3 tyut3晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放下所有的事情，感觉整个人都变得轻松洒脱了。
examples.english_sentence: After putting everything down, I felt completely carefree.

english_meaning: decisive, straightforward, unencumbered, free and easy, not fussy
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事或处理事情时干净利落，不拖泥带水。也指性格洒脱，不拘小节。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is decisive and efficient in doing things, without being hesitant or dragging things out. It can also refer to a person's carefree and unconventional personality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好撇脱，唔會拖泥帶水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 pit3 tyut3, m4 wui5 to1 nai4 daai3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很干脆，不会拖泥带水。
examples.english_sentence: He's very decisive in his work; he doesn't drag things out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格好撇脱，唔會計較咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 hou2 pit3 tyut3, m4 wui5 gai3 gaau3 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很洒脱，不会计较那么多。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very carefree personality and doesn't fuss over trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你撇脱啲啦，唔好諗咁多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 pit3 tyut3 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 lam2 gam3 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干脆一点，不要想那么多。
examples.english_sentence: Be more decisive and don't overthink things.

english_meaning: to welsh on a debt; to refuse to pay a debt; to skip out on a bill
explanation_mandarin: 指拖欠或拒绝偿还债务，故意不还钱。
explanation_english: To default on a debt; to deliberately refuse to pay what is owed. It implies a deliberate intention to avoid payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日借錢唔還，專登撇賬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 ze3 cin2 m4 waan4, zyun1 dang3 pit3 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是借钱不还，故意赖账。
examples.english_sentence: He always borrows money and doesn't return it, deliberately welshing on his debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以撇賬，我一定會追你還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 pit3 zoeng3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zeoi1 nei5 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想赖账，我一定会追你还钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get away with welshing on the debt, I will definitely chase you for the money.

english_meaning: to set aside, to leave aside, to put aside, to disregard, to ignore
explanation_mandarin: 将某事暂且放下不考虑，或者忽略不计。
explanation_english: To set aside or leave aside something for the time being; to disregard or ignore something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撇開價錢唔講，呢個設計真係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pit3 hoi1 gaa3 cin2 m4 gong2, ni1 go3 sat3 gai3 zan1 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 撇开价格不说，这个设计真的很好。
examples.english_sentence: Putting the price aside, this design is really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該撇開成見，客觀噉睇待件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 pit3 hoi1 sing4 gin3, haak3 gun1 gam2 tai5 doi6 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该撇开成见，客观地看待这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We should set aside our prejudices and look at this matter objectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撇開唔開心嘅嘢，不如出去玩下輕鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pit3 hoi1 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 ye5, bat1 jyu4 cheut1 heui3 waan2 haa5 hing1 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 撇开不开心的事情，不如出去玩一下轻松一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let's put aside the unhappy things and go out to have fun and relax.

english_meaning: to exclude, to eliminate, to remove, to set aside
explanation_mandarin: 去除不需要或无关的事物。
explanation_english: To remove or eliminate something that is unnecessary or irrelevant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要撇除所有嘅雜音，集中精神做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 pit3 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 zaap6 jam1, zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要排除所有的噪音，集中精神工作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to eliminate all the background noise and focus on our work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撇除所有嘅意外因素，呢個計劃基本上係可行嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pit3 ceoi4 so2 jau5 ge3 ji3 ngoi6 jyun1 sou3, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gei1 bun2 soeng6 hai6 ho2 hang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 排除所有的意外因素，这个计划基本上是可行的。
examples.english_sentence: Excluding all unexpected factors, this plan is basically feasible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以撇除呢個可能性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 pit3 ceoi4 ni1 go3 ho2 nang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能排除这个可能性。
examples.english_sentence: You can't rule out this possibility.

mandarin_meaning: 获取, 获得, 混, 搅, 从事, 赚取
english_meaning: to scoop, to dredge up; to mix; to engage in (a profession); to earn (money); to get (information, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 本意是舀取、捞取。引申为混在一起；从事某种行业或活动；赚取（金钱）；获得（信息等）。
explanation_english: Originally meaning to scoop or dredge up. Extended meanings include to mix together; to engage in a certain profession or activity; to earn (money); to get (information, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺酒吧度撈世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jyu1 baa1 dou6 lou1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在酒吧里混日子。
examples.english_sentence: He's making a living in a bar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齐撈麵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 lou1 min6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起拌面吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's mix the noodles together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想撈油水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 lou1 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想捞点好处。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get some perks (benefit, profit) for himself.

english_meaning: to mix; to toss (ingredients)
explanation_mandarin: 将各种材料混合搅拌在一起。通常指食材，但也可用於比喻将不同事物混在一起。
explanation_english: To mix various ingredients together, usually food ingredients. Can also be used metaphorically to describe mixing different things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如撈鬆啲材料先，咁樣會均勻啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 lou1 sung1 di1 coi3 liu2 sin1, gam2 joeng6 wui5 gwan1 wan4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如先把材料拌匀，这样会更均匀一些。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we mix the ingredients first, that way it will be more even.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲唔關事嘅嘢撈鬆嚟講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 m4 gwaan1 si6 ge3 je5 lou1 sung1 lai4 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别把不相干的东西混在一起说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix irrelevant things together when you're talking.

english_meaning: to make a living; to make one's way in the world; to seek fortune
explanation_mandarin: 指为了生存而工作，四处奔波，也指到各地去闯荡，寻找机会。
explanation_english: Refers to working to make a living, running around, or going to different places to seek opportunities and make one's way in the world. It implies a sense of struggle and ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣就去咗外國撈世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 zau6 heoi3 zo2 ngoi6 gwok3 lou1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就去了外国闯荡。
examples.english_sentence: He went abroad to make a living when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家經濟唔好，好多人都出嚟撈世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 chut1 lai4 lou1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都出来谋生。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, so many people are trying to make a living.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想靠自己雙手喺香港撈世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 kaau3 zi6 gei2 soeng1 sau2 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 lou1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想靠自己的双手在香港谋生。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to make a living in Hong Kong relying on his own hands.

english_meaning: to mix up, to confuse, to muddle
explanation_mandarin: 把不同的东西混淆在一起，弄得难以分辨。
explanation_english: To mix things up, making them difficult to distinguish or understand. Can also mean to confuse someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲衫撈亂啊，唔係就唔知邊件係邊件㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 saam1 lou1 lyun6 aa3, m4 hai6 zau6 m4 zi1 dou1 bin1 gin6 hai6 bin1 gin6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把衣服混在一起，不然就不知道哪个是哪个了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix up the clothes, or you won't know which one is which.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢講到撈撈亂，我聽唔明啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gong2 dou3 lou1 lou1 lyun6, ngo5 teng1 m4 ming4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话说得乱七八糟的，我听不明白啊。
examples.english_sentence: You're speaking so jumbled up, I can't understand you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撈亂咗我哋嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou1 lyun6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把我们的名字搞混了。
examples.english_sentence: He mixed up our names.

english_meaning: Country bumpkin, out-of-towner, hick, a derogatory term for people from mainland China, perceived as unsophisticated or uncultured.
explanation_mandarin: 贬义词，指来自中国大陆，被认为不够时尚或者见识不够广的人。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used in Hong Kong to refer to people from mainland China, often implying they are unsophisticated, uncultured, or less knowledgeable about urban life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日笑我哋係撈仔，話我哋唔識嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 siu3 ngo5 dei6 hai6 lou1 zai2, waa6 ngo5 dei6 m4 sik1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是嘲笑我们是乡巴佬，说我们什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: They always laugh at us, calling us country bumpkins and saying we don't know anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣睇唔起人，唔係個個大陸嚟嘅都係撈仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 joeng2 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4, m4 hai6 go3 go3 daai6 luk6 lei4 ge3 dou1 hai6 lou1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样看不起人，不是每个从大陆来的人都是乡巴佬。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look down on people like that. Not everyone from mainland China is a hick.

english_meaning: Mainlander, person from mainland China (often with negative connotations)
explanation_mandarin: 指来自中国大陆的人，多含贬义，指他们不够文明或不了解香港的文化和习惯。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used by some Hong Kong people to refer to people from mainland China. It often implies that they are uncivilized, unsophisticated, or unfamiliar with Hong Kong culture and customs. It can be considered offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣叫佢哋，好唔尊重㗎，唔係個個撈佬都係咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 giu3 keoi5 dei6, hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 gaa3, m4 hai6 go3 go3 lou1 lou2 dou1 hai6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样叫他们，很不尊重，不是每个大陆人都是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call them that, it's very disrespectful. Not all mainlanders are like that.

english_meaning: to make a living through unconventional or shady means; to engage in illegal activities for profit; to work outside the law
explanation_mandarin: 指从事非正当的，通常是非法的活动来谋生。带有一定的贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to making a living through illegitimate, usually illegal, activities. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇做正經嘢，淨係撈偏，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zou6 zing3 ging1 je5, zing6 hai6 lou1 pin1, chi4 zou2 wui5 cheut1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不做正经事，只是走偏门，迟早会出事。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't do any legitimate work, he just engages in shady activities; sooner or later he'll get into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撈偏呀，坐監就唔抵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lou1 pin1 aa3, co5 gaam1 zau6 m4 dai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要走偏门啊，坐牢就不值得了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get involved in illegal activities, it's not worth going to jail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人窮，有啲會逼住撈偏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 yan4 kung4, yau5 di1 wui5 bik1 jyu6 lou1 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人穷，有些人会被迫走偏门。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people were poor, and some were forced to resort to illegal means.

synonyms: 做世界 (zou6 sai3 gaai3) - slang, context dependent

english_meaning: to engage in illicit or unconventional ways to make money, to make money through unorthodox means, to engage in shady dealings
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当或非常规的手段来赚钱。
explanation_english: Refers to making money through illegitimate, unconventional, or shady means, often involving risk or borderline illegal activities. It implies avoiding the normal or ethical ways of earning income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣曾經撈偏門，搞到一身蟻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 cang4 ging1 lou1 pin1 mun4, gaau2 dou3 jat1 san1 ngai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候曾经走偏门，搞得一身麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he engaged in shady dealings, which got him into a lot of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔，成日諗住一步登天，想撈偏門發達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zai2, seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 jat1 bou6 dang1 tin1, soeng2 lou1 pin1 mun4 faat3 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人，总是想着一步登天，想走偏门发财。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people always dream of getting rich overnight, wanting to make a fortune through unorthodox means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意最緊要穩穩陣陣，唔好諗住撈偏門，好易出事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 wan2 wan2 zan6 zan6, m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 lou1 pin1 mun4, hou2 ji6 ceot1 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意最重要的是稳扎稳打，不要想着走偏门，很容易出事的。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in business is to be steady and reliable, don't think about taking shortcuts, it's easy to get into trouble.

english_meaning: having a foreign accent; accented Cantonese; sounding foreign
explanation_mandarin: 指粤语带有外地的口音或说话方式，通常用来形容说粤语的人带有非广东地区的口音。
explanation_english: Refers to Cantonese spoken with a foreign accent or way of speaking, usually used to describe Cantonese speakers with a non-Guangdong accent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好撈味，一聽就知唔係香港人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 lou1 mei6, jat1 teng1 zau6 zi1 m4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话口音很重，一听就知道不是香港人。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese has a strong foreign accent; you can tell he's not a Hong Konger as soon as you hear him speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲廣東話雖然唔係好正，但係都聽得明，只係有啲撈味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gwong2 dung1 waa2 seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 hou2 zeng3, daan6 hai6 dou1 teng1 dak1 ming4, zi2 hai6 jau5 di1 lou1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的广东话虽然不是很标准，但是都能听懂，只是有点口音。
examples.english_sentence: His Cantonese isn't very standard, but it's understandable. It just has a bit of a foreign accent.

english_meaning: to slack off; to shirk work; to goof off
explanation_mandarin: 指工作時偷懶，不認真工作。
explanation_english: Refers to slacking off or shirking work duties; not working diligently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司撈哨，所以俾老細鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 lou1 siu3, so2 ji5 bei2 lou5 sai3 nau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在公司偷懶，所以被老闆罵。
examples.english_sentence: He always slacks off at work, so he gets scolded by the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撈哨啦，認真啲做嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 lou1 siu3 laa1, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再偷懶了，認真一點工作！
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off anymore, work more diligently!

english_meaning: incompatible; not getting along; unable to mix (well); not on the same wavelength
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人或事物之间无法协调、合作或相处融洽。表示彼此性格、观点、兴趣等方面存在较大差异，难以互相理解和融合。
explanation_english: Describes two people or things that are incompatible, unable to cooperate or get along well. It indicates that there are significant differences in personality, viewpoints, interests, etc., making it difficult to understand and integrate with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個性格差咁遠，根本撈唔埋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 caa1 gam3 jyun5, gan1 bun2 lou1 m4 maai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个性格差那么远，根本合不来。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are so different, they just can't get along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩隻顏色撈唔埋，擺埋一齊好核突。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 zek3 ngaan4 sik1 lou1 m4 maai4, baai2 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 wat6 dat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种颜色不搭，放在一起很难看。
examples.english_sentence: These two colors don't match; they look awful together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢嘅價值觀撈唔埋，所以好難做朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1 lou1 m4 maai4, so2 ji5 hou2 naan4 zou6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他的价值观不合，所以很难做朋友。
examples.english_sentence: His and my values are incompatible, so it's hard to be friends.

english_meaning: to be unable to make a living; to be incompetent; to fail
explanation_mandarin: 指某人在某行业或领域内无法生存，难以维持生计；也可指某人无法处理好某件事情，搞不定。
explanation_english: Refers to someone being unable to survive or make a living in a particular industry or field; can also refer to someone being unable to handle a situation or solve a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺香港撈唔掂，所以返咗大陸發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 lou1 m4 dim6, so2 ji5 faan1 zo2 daai6 luk6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香港混不下去了，所以回大陆发展了。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't make a living in Hong Kong, so he went back to the mainland to develop his career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份功課太難啦，我撈唔掂呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 taai3 naan4 laa1, ngo5 lou1 m4 dim6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份作业太难了，我搞不定啊！
examples.english_sentence: This homework is too difficult, I can't handle it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都搞成咁，睇嚟你都撈唔掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gaau2 sing4 gam2, tai2 lai4 nei5 dou1 lou1 m4 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都搞成这样了，看来你都搞不定了。
examples.english_sentence: You've made such a mess of it, it seems like you can't handle it.

mandarin_meaning: 混不起来; 无法成功; 没有出息
english_meaning: Unable to make a living; Unable to succeed; Unsuccessful; A failure
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人能力不足，无法在某个领域或社会上取得成功，生活困顿。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks the ability or resources to succeed in a particular field or in society in general, leading to a difficult or impoverished life. Often implies a lack of ability, opportunity, or a combination of both.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多年嘢都係撈唔起，真係幾慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 je5 dou1 hai6 lou1 m4 hei2, zan1 hai6 gei2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作了这么多年还是混不起来，真的很惨。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working for so many years but still can't make a decent living; it's really pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港而家後生仔撈唔起都好普遍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ji4 gaa1 hau6 saang1 zai2 lou1 m4 hei2 dou1 hou2 pou2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在在香港，年轻人混不起来是很普遍的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays in Hong Kong, it's very common for young people to not be able to make it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔努力啲，恐怕遲早都會撈唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 nu5 lik6 di1, hung2 paa3 ci4 zou2 dou1 wui5 lou1 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不更努力一些，恐怕迟早都会混不起来。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't work harder, I'm afraid he'll end up failing sooner or later.

synonyms: 冇符咒 (mou5 fu4 zau3) - (slang for 'no future')
唔掂 (m4 dim6) - (not good; won't work)

english_meaning: to get into trouble, to mess things up, something bad happening
explanation_mandarin: 指惹上麻烦事、遇到不好的事情，或者把事情搞砸了。
explanation_english: Refers to getting into trouble, encountering something bad, or messing things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再搞事啦，唔想撈嘢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 si6 laa1, m4 soeng2 lou1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再惹事了，不想惹麻烦啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause any more trouble, I don't want to get into any mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都撈嘢，真係攞嚟衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lou1 je5, zan1 hai6 lo2 lai4 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，真是自找倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets into trouble, he's just asking for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次大鑊啦，可能要撈嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daai6 wok6 laa1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 lou1 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次糟糕了，可能要出事了。
examples.english_sentence: This is bad news, we might get into trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 捞女 (lāo nǚ), 拜金女 (bài jīn nǚ)
english_meaning: Gold digger, a woman who seeks relationships primarily for financial gain
explanation_mandarin: 指那些主要为了金钱利益而与男性建立关系的女性。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who pursues relationships with men primarily for financial gain and material possessions. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就嫁個咁有錢嘅老嘢，擺明係撈女啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 gaa3 go3 gam3 jau5 cin2 ge3 lou5 je2, baai2 ming4 hai6 lou1 neoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么年轻就嫁给一个这么有钱的老头，明显就是拜金女。
examples.english_sentence: She's so young and married such a rich old man; it's obvious she's a gold digger.

mandarin_meaning: 外地来的年轻女孩，多含贬义
english_meaning: Derogatory term for a young woman from mainland China, often implying she is unsophisticated or trying to take advantage of opportunities in Hong Kong.
explanation_mandarin: 指来自中国内地的年轻女性，通常带有贬义，暗示其不够时尚、不谙世事，或者认为她们来香港是为了寻求更好的发展机会。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to describe young women who have come from mainland China to Hong Kong. It often carries negative connotations, implying they are unsophisticated, naive, or are motivated by a desire for financial or social advancement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅打扮，一睇就知係撈妹啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 daa2 bun2, jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 dou3 hai6 lou1 mui1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这样的打扮，一看就知道是内地来的。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at her outfit, you can tell she's from the mainland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日叫人撈妹啦，好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 giu3 jan4 lou1 mui1 laa1, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是叫别人“捞妹”了，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always call people 'lou mui', it's very rude.

english_meaning: Derogatory term for a woman from mainland China or a rural area; country bumpkin (female)
explanation_mandarin: 带有贬义色彩，指来自中国大陆或其他较落后地区的女性。在香港语境中常用于指代来自大陆的女性，暗示其土气、不够时尚等。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to refer to a woman from mainland China or other less developed regions. In the context of Hong Kong, it is often used to refer to women from the mainland, implying that they are unsophisticated, unfashionable, or from a rural background. It carries a negative connotation and can be offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話人哋係撈婆，真係好冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 jan4 dei6 hai6 lou4 po4, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说别人是乡下女人，真的很没礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: She always calls people 'mainland women,' it's really impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講啦，唔應該用『撈婆』嚟形容人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1, m4 jing1 goi1 yung6 'lou4 po4' lai4 jing4 yung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说啦，不应该用“乡下女人”来形容人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, we shouldn't use 'mainland woman' to describe people.

english_meaning: professional, someone who works in a specific field, a practitioner
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域工作的人，通常带有经验丰富、专业性强的含义。在某些语境下，也可能带有贬义，指那些钻营取巧、不择手段的从业者。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who works in a particular field, usually implying experience and professionalism. In some contexts, it can also have a negative connotation, referring to practitioners who are opportunistic and unscrupulous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好有名嘅律師撈家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 ming4 ge3 leot6 si1 lou1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有名的律师从业者。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous lawyer (professional).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信晒啲地產撈家，佢哋好多時都係想sell你嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 di1 dei6 caan2 lou1 gaa1, keoi5 dei6 hou2 do1 si4 dou1 hai6 soeng2 sell nei5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要完全相信那些房地产从业者，他们很多时候都只是想卖东西给你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely trust those real estate agents, they often just want to sell you something.

synonyms: 專業人士 (zyun1 jip6 jan4 si6)

english_meaning: To bottom out; to buy when the price is at its lowest; to fish out the bottom of a pot (literal)
explanation_mandarin: 捞取锅底的东西。 引申指在股价或资产价格跌到最低点时买入，期待反弹。也指事情发展到最坏的境地。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to scoop up the food at the bottom of a pot. Figuratively, it refers to buying stocks or assets when the price is at its lowest point, hoping for a rebound. It can also refer to a situation reaching its worst point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市跌到咁低，好多人都想撈底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 dit3 dou3 gam3 dai1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 lou1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市跌到这么低，很多人都想抄底。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market has fallen so low, many people want to buy at the bottom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司已經撈底，冇可能再差落去㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 lou1 dai2, mou5 ho2 nang4 zoi3 caa1 lok6 heoi3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司已经触底了，不可能再差下去了。
examples.english_sentence: This company has already bottomed out; it can't get any worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食埋啲餸就撈底㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 maai4 di1 sung3 zau6 lou1 dai2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃完这些菜就捞底了。（把锅底的也吃完了）
examples.english_sentence: We'll finish eating these dishes and then scoop out the bottom (of the pot).

english_meaning: Can get along well, compatible, able to mix well together
explanation_mandarin: 形容人与人之间能够相处融洽，关系和谐。也可以指不同事物能够很好地结合在一起。
explanation_english: Describes people who can get along well with each other and have a harmonious relationship. It can also refer to different things that can be combined well together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個好撈得埋，成日一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hou2 lou1 dak1 maai4, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个很合得来，经常一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: Those two get along very well and often play together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩隻顏色撈埋一齊都幾好睇嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 zek3 ngaan5 sik1 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4 dou1 gei2 hou2 tai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两种颜色混在一起挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: These two colors look pretty good when mixed together.

english_meaning: to be able to handle (a situation); to be successful; to be capable; to get by
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人有能力处理好某件事，或者在某个领域做得很好，很成功，能应付自如。
explanation_english: Refers to someone being capable of handling a situation well, or being successful in a certain field, and being able to cope with it easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意撈得掂，好快就發咗達。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 seng1 yi3 lou1 dak1 dim6, hou2 faai3 zau6 faat3 zo2 daat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意很成功，很快就发财了。
examples.english_sentence: He is successful in business and became rich very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好難做㗎，唔係個個都撈得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 naan4 zou6 gaa3, m4 hai6 go3 go3 dou1 lou1 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很难做，不是每个人都能胜任的。
examples.english_sentence: This job is difficult, not everyone can handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好醒目，去到邊都撈得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sing2 muk6, heoi3 dou3 bin1 dou1 lou1 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很机灵，去到哪里都能混得开。
examples.english_sentence: He is very smart and can get by anywhere.

english_meaning: to mess up, to confuse, to mix up, to muddle
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情弄亂，使之混淆不清。
explanation_english: Refers to making things messy or confusing, making them unclear and mixed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撈攪我啲嘢啦，我整理咗好耐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 lou1 gaau2 ngo5 di1 je5 laa1, ngo5 zing2 lei5 zo2 hou2 noi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再把我的东西搞乱了，我整理了很久的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess up my things again, I've been organizing them for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份文件嘅內容好撈攪，睇到我都唔知講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 man4 gin2 ge3 noi6 yung4 hou2 lou1 gaau2, tai2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件的内容很混乱，看得我都不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: The content of the document is very confusing, I don't even know what it's about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撈攪啲資料，搞到我哋要重新嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 lou1 gaau2 di1 zi1 liu2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cung4 san1 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是把资料搞乱，搞得我们要重新来过。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes up the data, making us have to start over.

english_meaning: Confused, muddled, to be unclear on something
explanation_mandarin: 形容思维混乱，搞不清楚状况。也指人迷糊、不清楚事情。
explanation_english: Describes a state of mental confusion, not understanding the situation. Also refers to someone being dazed, unclear about things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾佢問到我撈檬晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 keoi5 man6 dou3 ngo5 lou1 mung1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被他问得我糊涂了。
examples.english_sentence: He confused me with all his questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講乜嘢啊？我撈撈檬檬噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 mat1 je5 aa3? ngo5 lou1 lou1 mung1 mung1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在说什么啊？我有点糊涂。
examples.english_sentence: What are you talking about? I'm a bit confused.

mandarin_meaning: 捡剩下的好处; 捡残羹剩饭
english_meaning: to get the leftovers; to reap the benefits after others have already taken the best parts; to be late to the party
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在别人已经获得大部分利益之后，才得到剩余的利益。形容得到的好处比较少，而且时机已晚。
explanation_english: A metaphor for getting the remaining benefits after others have already obtained most of the profit. It describes getting fewer benefits and being late to take advantage of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭幾年樓市升得咁快，而家先至入市咪即係撈水尾囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 gei2 nin4 lau4 si5 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3, ji4 gaa1 sin1 zi3 jap6 si5 mai1 zik1 hai6 lou1 seoi2 mei5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前几年房价涨得那么快，现在才进入房地产市场不就是捡剩下的好处吗。
examples.english_sentence: The property market rose so quickly in the past few years. Entering the market now is just getting the leftovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲好位俾人揀晒，我入去都係撈水尾啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 hou2 wai2 bei2 jan4揀saai3, ngo5 jap6 heoi3 dou1 hai6 lou1 seoi2 mei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司的好职位都被人选光了，我进去也只是捡剩下的。
examples.english_sentence: All the good positions in that company have been taken. If I join, I'll just be getting the leftovers.

english_meaning: To scrape by; to mooch; to seek personal gain illegitimately (often through taking advantage of a position)
explanation_mandarin: 指不正当地获取利益，常指利用职务之便捞取好处。也可泛指勉强维持生计，混口饭吃。
explanation_english: Refers to obtaining benefits illegitimately, often through abusing one's position. Can also broadly mean to barely make a living, to scrape by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢間公司撈汁撈咗好耐，成日偷公司嘅嘢去賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 lou1 zap1 lou1 zo2 hou2 noi6, seng4 jat6 tau1 gung1 si1 ge3 je5 heoi3 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这家公司捞油水捞了很久，整天偷公司的东西去卖。
examples.english_sentence: He's been mooching off this company for a long time, constantly stealing company property to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，好多人都只係撈汁過日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zi2 hai6 lou1 zap1 gwo3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，很多人都只是混口饭吃过日子。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, many people are just scraping by day to day.

english_meaning: to skim profits, to make money illicitly (by abusing one's position)
explanation_mandarin: 指利用职权或机会，从中获取不正当的利益。
explanation_english: Refers to taking advantage of one's position or opportunity to obtain illicit profits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢個project度撈咗好多油水呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 go3 project dou6 lou1 zo2 hou2 do1 jau4 seoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这个项目里捞了很多油水啊！
examples.english_sentence: He skimmed a lot of profits from this project!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁積極，都唔知係咪想撈油水啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 zik1 gik1, dou1 m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 soeng2 lou1 jau4 seoi2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么积极，都不知道是不是想捞油水而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's so proactive at work, I wonder if he's just trying to make some illicit money.

english_meaning: To plagiarize, to mix up (different sources), to stitch together from various sources (often negatively, implying lack of originality or coherence)
explanation_mandarin: 指将不同来源的资料拼凑起来，尤其是指抄袭或没有原创性的行为。通常带贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of piecing together information from different sources, often implying plagiarism or a lack of originality. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告撈稿撈得好嚴重，好多嘢都係抄人哋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 lou1 gou2 lou1 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 hai6 caau1 yan4 dei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告抄袭得很严重，很多东西都是抄别人的。
examples.english_sentence: His report is heavily plagiarized; a lot of things are copied from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文撈稿撈到亂晒籠，睇唔明佢想講乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 lou1 gou2 lou1 dou3 lyun6 saai3 lung4, tai2 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 gong2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章拼凑得乱七八糟，看不懂他想说什么。
examples.english_sentence: This article is stitched together messily; I can't understand what he wants to say.

mandarin_meaning: 混在一起；搞混；关系密切
english_meaning: mixed up; intertwined; messed up; complicated; close relationship
explanation_mandarin: 原指搅拌混合在一起，引申为关系复杂、纠缠不清，或事情搞得一团糟。
explanation_english: Originally referred to mixing things together, it's extended to mean complicated relationships, intertwined, or a situation that is messed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅關係好撈絞，真係唔知點搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 lou1 gaau2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的关系很复杂，真不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: The relationships in this matter are very complicated, I really don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個撈絞咗好耐，大家都知佢哋有啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 lou1 gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 keoi5 dei6 jau5 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个混在一起很久了，大家都知道他们之间有些什么。
examples.english_sentence: Those two have been mixed up for a long time, everyone knows there's something between them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅電線全部撈絞晒，搞到我唔知點分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 din6 sin3 cyun4 bou6 lou1 gaau2 saai3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的电线全部缠在一起了，搞得我都不知道怎么分辨。

examples.english_sentence: He didn't want the party to be so quiet, so he invited a lot of friends to liven things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然公司蝕錢，但係都要撐場面，扮到好似冇事咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gung1 si1 sit3 cin2, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 caang3 coeng4 min6, baan3 dou3 hou2 ci5 mou5 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然公司亏钱，但是也要撑场面，装得好像没事一样。
examples.english_sentence: Even though the company is losing money, we still have to put on a show and pretend everything is fine.

english_meaning: To help out; to assist; to make up the numbers (often implying that the help is not particularly useful or effective)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某件事中帮忙，出力。有时带有贬义，指帮助不大，只是充人数。
explanation_english: Refers to helping out or assisting in something. Sometimes carries a negative connotation, implying that the help is not very effective or just to fill a quota.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咩都唔識，淨係喺度撐抬腳啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 me1 dou1 m4 sik1, zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 caang1 toi4 goek3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，只是在那儿凑个数而已。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, he's just there to make up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我都要返工，得閒先可以嚟幫你撐抬腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1, dak1 haan4 sin1 ho2 ji5 lai4 bong1 nei5 caang1 toi4 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我也要上班，只有空的时候才能来帮你一下。
examples.english_sentence: I also have to work, I can only come and help you out when I'm free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project，佢都算係撐抬腳，出咗少少力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project, keoi5 dou1 syun3 hai6 caang1 toi4 goek3, cheut1 zo2 siu2 siu2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目，他算是有帮忙，出了一点力。
examples.english_sentence: He helped out on this project, contributing a little bit.

mandarin_meaning: 约会吃饭; 单独赴约吃饭
english_meaning: To dine out with someone (usually implying a romantic date); To have a meal with someone at a restaurant.
explanation_mandarin: 本意指用东西支撑桌子脚，使桌子稳定。引申为两个人单独约会吃饭，尤其暗示有浪漫关系。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to prop up a table leg (to stabilize a wobbly table). Figuratively, it means to dine out with someone, usually implying a romantic encounter or date. It suggests spending quality time together over a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想同我女朋友出去撐枱腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 tung4 ngo5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 ceot1 heoi3 caang3 toi2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想和我女朋友出去约会吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I want to go out for a date with my girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日一齊撐枱腳，唔知係咪拍緊拖呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 caang3 toi2 goek3, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 paak3 gan2 to1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常一起出去吃饭，不知道是不是在谈恋爱呢？
examples.english_sentence: They often dine out together; I wonder if they are dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如聽晚出去撐枱腳，傾下偈？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 ting1 maan5 ceot1 heoi3 caang3 toi2 goek3, king1 haa5 gai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如明晚出去吃个饭，聊聊天？
examples.english_sentence: How about we go out for a meal tomorrow night and have a chat?

mandarin_meaning: 一起吃饭，尤其指情侣或朋友之间。
english_meaning: To dine together (often used to describe a date or a meal between friends). Literally: to prop up the table leg.
explanation_mandarin: 指两人或多人一起吃饭，特别指情侣或朋友一起约会吃饭。源于旧时饭桌不稳，需一人用脚撑住桌腿，另一人才能安心吃饭。现在引申为一起吃饭，互相陪伴。
explanation_english: To dine together, especially referring to a date or a meal between friends. The origin comes from the old days when tables were unstable, and one person needed to prop up the table leg with their foot so that the other person could eat in peace. Now it's extended to mean eating together and keeping each other company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚同男朋友出去撐檯腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 tung4 naam4 pang4 jau5 ceot1 heoi3 caang3 toi2 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚和男朋友出去吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going out for dinner with my boyfriend tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋得閒一齊撐檯腳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dak1 haan4 jat1 cai4 caang3 toi2 goek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有空一起吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have dinner together when we're free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去撐檯腳，好似拍緊拖咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 caang3 toi2 goek3, hou2 ci5 paak3 gan2 to1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常一起吃饭，好像在谈恋爱一样。
examples.english_sentence: They often dine together, it seems like they're dating.

english_meaning: To stuff you to death (with food); I hope you choke on it (said sarcastically or playfully)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“把你撑死”，可以指真的把人喂得很饱，但更多时候是带有一种讽刺或玩笑的语气，表示希望对方因为贪吃而难受，或者表示对对方行为的不满，希望对方受到惩罚。
explanation_english: Literally means "to stuff you to death". It can refer to actually feeding someone until they are very full, but more often it is used sarcastically or playfully. It can express the wish that someone suffers from overeating, or express dissatisfaction with someone's behavior, hoping they will be punished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁鬼鍾意食甜嘢，食多啲，撐死你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 gwai2 zung1 ji3 sik6 tim4 je5, sik6 do1 di1, caang3 sei2 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么喜欢吃甜食，多吃点，撑死你！
examples.english_sentence: You like sweet things so much, eat more, I hope you choke on it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咁多嘢食，你食唔食得曬㗎？到時撐死你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 gam3 do1 je5 sik6, nei5 sik6 m4 sik6 dak1 saai3 gaa3? dou3 si4 caang3 sei2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买这么多吃的，你吃得完吗？到时候撑死你啊！
examples.english_sentence: Buying so much food, can you finish it all? You'll get stuffed to death!

synonyms: 食滯你 (sik6 zai6 nei5) - cause indigestion; make you feel bloated

english_meaning: To stubbornly defend one's point of view; to insist on something even when wrong; to brazen it out.
explanation_mandarin: 指明明知道自己错了，或处于劣势，仍然强词夺理，不肯认输。形容强行支撑或掩盖错误。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone knows they are wrong or in a disadvantageous position, but stubbornly continues to argue and refuse to admit defeat.  It implies a forced attempt to support or cover up a mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都錯曬啦，仲喺度撐沙雞！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 co3 saai3 laa3, zung6 hai2 dou6 caang3 saa1 gai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都全错了，还在那里硬撑！
examples.english_sentence: You're completely wrong, and you're still trying to defend yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再撐沙雞喇，認咗佢咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 caang3 saa1 gai1 laa3, jing6 zo2 keoi5 mai6 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再硬撑了，承认了就算了。
examples.english_sentence: Stop trying to brazen it out, just admit it.

mandarin_meaning: 不讲理; 蛮横; 胡搅蛮缠
english_meaning: to act unreasonably; to be deliberately difficult; to be a pain in the neck; to be a troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 形容人无理取闹，故意刁难，使人感到烦恼。
explanation_english: Describes a person who acts unreasonably, deliberately makes things difficult, and causes annoyance to others. It implies someone is being a pain and causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度撐沙鷄，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 caang1 saa1 gai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在这里无理取闹，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being a pain in the neck here, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撐沙鷄啦，快啲解決件事佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 caang1 saa1 gai1 laa1, faai3 di1 gaai2 kyut3 gin6 si6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再无理取闹了，快点解决这件事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being difficult, just resolve this matter quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 争强好胜; 好出风头
english_meaning: to show off; to try to outshine others; to be competitive and boastful
explanation_mandarin: 指为了表现自己比别人优秀而过分炫耀或竞争。
explanation_english: Refers to excessively showing off or competing in order to make oneself appear superior to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都撐甲，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 caang3 gaap3, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢争强好胜，很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to show off, which is very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁撐甲啦，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 caang3 gaap3 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么好出风头，谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so boastful, it's better to be humble.

english_meaning: to support; to back up; to give backing to
explanation_mandarin: 提供支持，给予帮助或鼓励，通常指在某人遇到困难或受到攻击时给予支持。
explanation_english: To provide support, backing, or encouragement, especially when someone is facing difficulties or is being attacked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，我會撐腰㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, ngo5 wui5 caang3 jiu1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别害怕，我会支持你的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, I will back you up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有老闆撐腰，佢做嘢都大胆啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 lou5 baan2 caang3 jiu1, keoi5 zou6 je5 dou1 daai6 daam2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有老板支持，他做事都大胆一些。
examples.english_sentence: With the boss's support, he's bolder in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入邊有好多人撐腰，好難搞佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 bin1 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 caang3 jiu1, hou2 naan4 gaau2 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里有很多支持者，很难对付他。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of supporters in the company, so it's hard to deal with him.

english_meaning: To row a boat; To support (someone/something)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是划船。引申含义是支持，声援，帮助。
explanation_english: Literally means to row a boat. By extension, it means to support, back up, or help someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要撐艇支持香港嘅本土文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 caang3 teng5 zi1 chi4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 bun2 tou2 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要支持香港的本土文化。
examples.english_sentence: We need to support Hong Kong's local culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撐艇撐得好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caang3 teng5 caang3 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他划船划得很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He's rowing the boat with great effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快放棄，我一定撐艇你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 caang3 teng5 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快放弃，我一定会支持你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly, I will definitely support you.

mandarin_meaning: 私下交易；走私；非法交易
english_meaning: To engage in illegal or clandestine trading; to smuggle; to deal under the table.
explanation_mandarin: 指暗地里从事非法的交易活动，比如走私，或者私下买卖一些不应该买卖的东西。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in illegal or clandestine trading activities, such as smuggling or dealing in items that should not be traded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋成日喺邊境撐艇仔，賣啲未完稅嘅貨品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 bin1 ging2 caang1 ting5 zai2, maai6 di1 mei6 jyun4 seoi3 ge3 fo3 pan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们经常在边境走私，卖一些没有完税的货品。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they often engage in smuggling at the border, selling goods without paying taxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔為咗搵快錢，好多都冒險去撐艇仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 wai6 zo2 wan2 faai3 cin2, hou2 do1 dou1 mou6 him2 heoi3 caang1 ting5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的一些年轻人为了赚快钱，很多都冒险去做非法交易。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people take risks and engage in illegal trading to make quick money.

english_meaning: to support, to prop up, to hold up, to shoulder (responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 在物理上表示支撑物体使其不倒塌，或比喻承担责任，担当重任。
explanation_english: Physically, it means to support an object to prevent it from collapsing. Figuratively, it means to take responsibility and shoulder important tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人要撐起成頭家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 jiu3 caang1 hei2 seng4 tau4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人要支撑整个家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He has to support the whole family by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條柱可以撐起成棟樓嘅重量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 cyu5 ho2 ji5 caang1 hei2 seng4 dung6 lau2 ge3 zung6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这根柱子可以支撑整栋楼的重量。
examples.english_sentence: This pillar can support the weight of the entire building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 靠佢撐起場面，先至冇咁尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kaau3 keoi5 caang1 hei2 coeng4 min6, sin1 zi3 mou5 gam3 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 靠他撑场面，才没那么尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to him for holding the scene together, it wasn't so awkward.

english_meaning: to be stuffed (with food), to be too full
explanation_mandarin: 指吃得过饱，肚子很胀，感觉不舒服。
explanation_english: Refers to being overly full after eating, feeling bloated and uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先食咗好多嘢，而家撐飽晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, ji4 gaa1 caang3 baau2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才吃了很多东西，现在已经吃撑了。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a lot of food just now, I'm completely stuffed now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多啦，陣間撐飽就唔舒服㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 laa1, zan6 gaan1 caang3 baau2 zau6 m4 syu1 fuk6 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要吃那么多，一会儿吃撑了会不舒服的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so much, you'll feel uncomfortable if you're stuffed later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再夾餸畀我啦，我真係撐飽喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaap3 sung3 bei2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 caang3 baau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再夹菜给我了，我真的已经吃撑了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put any more food on my plate, I'm really full.

english_meaning: to row a dragon boat
explanation_mandarin: 指在龙舟节期间，人们一起划龙舟的活动。
explanation_english: To row a dragon boat, especially during the Dragon Boat Festival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 端午節我哋一家人去海邊撐龍舟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun1 ng5 zit3 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 caang1 lung4 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 端午节我们一家人去海边划龙舟。
examples.english_sentence: During the Dragon Boat Festival, my family went to the beach to row dragon boats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅龍舟比賽，我哋隊撐龍舟撐得好犀利呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 lung4 zau1 bei2 coi3, ngo5 dei6 deoi2 caang1 lung4 zau1 caang1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的龙舟比赛，我们队划龙舟划得很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: In this year's dragon boat race, our team rowed the dragon boat very powerfully!

mandarin_meaning: 支撑; 支持; 吃撑
english_meaning: To support; to prop up; to brace; to overeat; full (after eating)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 支撑，支撑着物体使其不倒塌。 2. 支持，在精神或行动上帮助。 3. 吃得过饱，感到胀。
explanation_english: 1. To support physically, to prop up something to prevent it from falling. 2. To support emotionally or through action. 3. To overeat to the point of discomfort; to be full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力咁撑起頭家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 caang1 hei2 tau4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地支撑着家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He's working very hard to support his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁撑我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 caang1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这么支持我。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for supporting me so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食到好撑呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 dou3 hou2 caang1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃得好撑啊！
examples.english_sentence: I'm so full!

english_meaning: Eat so much that you burst; Stuff yourself
explanation_mandarin: 指让对方吃很多东西，以至于撑到不舒服甚至出现健康问题。多带玩笑的意味，或者表达一种夸张的情感，例如热情款待，或者略带讽刺。
explanation_english: Refers to letting someone eat a lot, to the point where they feel uncomfortable or even have health problems. It often carries a playful meaning, or expresses an exaggerated emotion, such as warm hospitality or slight sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽煮咗咁多嘢食，今晚撐死你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 zyu2 zo2 gam3 do1 je5 sik6, gam1 maan1 caang3 sei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈做了这么多菜，今晚让你撑死。
examples.english_sentence: Mom cooked so much food, you'll be stuffed to death tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再食多啲啦，唔好客氣，撐死你都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 sik6 do1 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 hak3 hei3, caang3 sei2 nei5 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再多吃点吧，别客气，撑死你都没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Eat some more, don't be shy, I don't mind if you stuff yourself.

english_meaning: To show off, to try to act tough, to be cocky and aggressive (often in a boastful or provocative way)
explanation_mandarin: 指人喜欢逞强好胜，摆出很厉害的样子来吓唬人或挑衅。
explanation_english: Describes someone who likes to show off their strength or act tough, often to intimidate or provoke others. Implies an element of superficiality or bravado.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁撐沙雞啦，你都唔夠人打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 caang1 saa1 gai1 laa1, nei5 dou1 m4 gau3 jan4 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么逞强好胜了，你打不过人家。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so tough, you can't even beat them in a fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺班入面撐沙雞，好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 baan1 jap6 min6 caang1 saa1 gai1, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在班里逞强好胜，很让人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always showing off in class, it's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為自己好叻就撐沙雞，謙虛啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1 zau6 caang1 saa1 gai1, him1 heoi1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别以为自己很厉害就逞强好胜，谦虚一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so cocky just because you think you're good. Be humble.

english_meaning: To boast; to brag; to exaggerate; to show off
explanation_mandarin: 指吹嘘自己的能力、成就或财富，带有炫耀和夸大的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to boasting about one's abilities, achievements, or wealth, often with an implication of exaggeration and showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺度撑沙鷄，話自己幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 caang1 saa1 gai1, waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 gam3 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在那里吹牛，说自己有多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He boasts every day, saying how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日撑沙鷄啦，實際啲做好自己嘅嘢先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 caang1 saa1 gai1 laa1, sat6 zai3 di1 zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是吹牛了，实际地做好自己的事情再说。
examples.english_sentence: Stop boasting all the time, focus on doing your own things practically.

synonyms: 誇誇其談 (kwaa1 kwaa1 kei4 taam4)

english_meaning: to boast, to brag, to exaggerate, to bluff
explanation_mandarin: 指夸大事实，吹嘘自己的能力或成就，给人留下深刻印象。
explanation_english: To exaggerate or boast about one's abilities, achievements, or possessions in order to impress others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都撐甲，話自己幾叻幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 caang1 gaap3, waa6 zi6 gei2 lek1 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是吹牛，说自己多么多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He always brags about how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢撐甲，佢根本唔識做呢樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 caang1 gaap3, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 sik1 zou6 ni1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他吹牛，他根本不会做这件事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his boasting, he doesn't even know how to do this.

english_meaning: stuffed, full to the point of discomfort
explanation_mandarin: 指吃东西吃得非常饱，肚子胀胀的，甚至感到不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes the feeling of being extremely full after eating, to the point of feeling uncomfortable or bloated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先食自助餐，食到我撑飽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 sik6 zi6 zo6 caan1, sik6 dou3 ngo5 caang1 baau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才吃自助餐，我吃得撑死了！
examples.english_sentence: I ate so much at the buffet earlier, I'm stuffed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好食咁多啦，小心食到撑飽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sik6 gam3 do1 laa1, siu2 sam1 sik6 dou3 caang1 baau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要吃那么多啦，小心吃撑了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so much, be careful you don't get stuffed.

english_meaning: to scatter; to sprinkle; to let go; to release; to tell a lie; to act wildly
explanation_mandarin: 1. 散布，撒开。2. 释放，放开。3. 说谎。 4. 发泄，耍赖，胡闹。
explanation_english: 1. To scatter or sprinkle. 2. To release, let go, or free. 3. To tell a lie. 4. To vent, to act unreasonably, or to act wildly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撒咗好多鹽喺啲薯條上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saat3 zo2 hou2 do1 jim4 hai2 di1 syu4 tiu2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在薯条上面撒了很多盐。
examples.english_sentence: He sprinkled a lot of salt on the french fries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撒謊啦，我唔會信你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 saat3 hong1 laa1, ngo5 m4 wui5 seon3 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要撒谎了，我不会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lie, I won't believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路喺度撒野，好嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou6 hai2 dou6 saat3 je5, hou2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些小孩在那里撒野，很吵。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are acting wildly here, it's very noisy.

synonyms: 講大話 (gong2 daai6 waa6) - to lie

english_meaning: Satan, the Devil
explanation_mandarin: 基督教中的魔鬼，邪恶势力的代表。
explanation_english: Satan, the Devil, the embodiment of evil in Christian theology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簡直係撒但化身，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 saat3 daan6 faa3 san1, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他简直是撒旦的化身，整天搞破坏。
examples.english_sentence: He is practically the incarnation of Satan, always causing trouble.

english_meaning: to act like a spoiled child; to be coquettish; to throw a tantrum (affectionately); to act cute
explanation_mandarin: 为了获得别人的注意或喜爱，故意装出娇痴的样子。
explanation_english: To act in a spoiled, coy, or coquettish manner in order to gain attention or affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住男朋友撒嬌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 naam4 pang4 jau5 saat3 giu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是对着男朋友撒娇。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts coquettishly towards her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度撒嬌啦，快啲做功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 saat3 giu1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里撒娇了，快点做功课吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting like a spoiled brat here, do your homework quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知道撒嬌有用，所以咪成日咁做囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 dou3 saat3 giu1 jau5 jung6, so2 ji5 mai1 seng4 jat6 gam2 zou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她知道撒娇有用，所以才总是这样做。
examples.english_sentence: She knows that acting cute works, so she always does it.

english_meaning: to pass away, to breathe one's last, to die
explanation_mandarin: 指人去世。出自佛教用語，比喻放下塵世的一切，離開人世。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's death. Originates from Buddhist terminology, metaphorically meaning to let go of all worldly possessions and leave this world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日因病撒手人寰，屋企人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 jan1 beng6 saat3 sau2 jan4 waan4, uk1 kei5 jan4 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天因病去世，家里人都很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away yesterday due to illness, and his family is very sad.

english_meaning: to pass away, to depart from this world (idiom)
explanation_mandarin: 指人去世，离开人世。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to pass away, to die, to depart from the mortal world. It's a more formal or literary way to describe death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上個禮拜撒手塵寰，屋企人都好傷心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 saat3 sau2 can4 waan4, uk1 kei5 jan4 dou1 hou2 soeng1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上个星期去世了，家里人都很伤心。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away last week, and his family is very sad.

english_meaning: trump card, secret weapon, last resort
explanation_mandarin: 比喻关键时刻使用的制胜方法或手段。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a decisive method or means used at a crucial moment; a trump card or secret weapon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋嘅撒手鐧，唔到最後關頭唔用得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 saat3 sau2 gaan2, m4 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 gwaan1 tau4 m4 jung6 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们的杀手锏，不到最后关头不能用的。
examples.english_sentence: This is our trump card; we can't use it unless it's the last resort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個撒手鐧出嚟，一舉反敗為勝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 saat3 sau2 gaan2 chut1 lai4, jat1 geoi2 faan2 baai6 wai4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿出了杀手锏，一举反败为胜。
examples.english_sentence: He brought out his trump card and turned defeat into victory in one fell swoop.

english_meaning: Satan, devil
explanation_mandarin: 基督教、犹太教和伊斯兰教中指称邪恶势力的首领。
explanation_english: Satan, the chief evil spirit; the devil in Christianity, Judaism, and Islam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簡直係撒旦化身，專登搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 saat3 daan3 faa3 san1, zyun1 daang2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他简直是撒旦化身，故意捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: He is practically the embodiment of Satan, deliberately causing trouble.

english_meaning: to cast a net; to cast a wide net; to approach widely (dating)
explanation_mandarin: 原指渔民抛撒渔网捕鱼。比喻广泛地尝试或追求，尤指同时与多人交往，寻求爱情或机会。
explanation_english: Originally refers to fishermen casting nets to catch fish. Metaphorically, it means to cast a wide net or pursue widely, especially engaging with multiple people simultaneously in search of love or opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢周圍撒網，想搵個有錢嘅老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau1 wai4 saat3 mong5, soeng2 wan2 go3 jau5 cin2 ge3 lou5 po2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处撒网，想找个有钱的老婆。
examples.english_sentence: He's casting a wide net, hoping to find a rich wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撒網式咁樣求職，要針對性啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saat3 mong5 sik1 gam2 joeng2 kau4 zik1, jiu3 zaan3 deoi3 sing3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要撒网式地求职，要有针对性一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just apply for jobs in a scattershot way; be more targeted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為撒網就一定會成功，要睇吓你嘅餌有冇吸引力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 saat3 mong5 zau6 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1, jiu3 tai2 haa5 nei5 ge3 ji5 jau5 mou5 kap1 jan5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为撒网就一定会成功，要看看你的诱饵有没有吸引力啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that casting a wide net guarantees success; you need to see if your bait is attractive.

english_meaning: to lie; to tell a lie
explanation_mandarin: 说不真实的话；说谎。
explanation_english: To say something that is not true; to tell a lie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日撒謊啦，冇人會信你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 saat3 fong1 laa1, mou5 jan4 wui5 seon3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是撒谎了，没有人会相信你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always lie, no one will believe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話撒謊，畀人揭穿咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 saat3 fong1, bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说谎，被人揭穿了。
examples.english_sentence: He lied and was exposed.

english_meaning: to act shamelessly; to behave unreasonably; to try to get one's way by being obstinate; to play the rogue
explanation_mandarin: 指不讲道理，蛮不讲理地纠缠，企图达到个人目的。
explanation_english: Refers to acting unreasonably, arguing obstinately, and trying to achieve one's own goals through shameless behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再撒賴啦，俾返啲錢人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 saat3 laai6 laa1, bei2 faan1 di1 cin2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再耍赖了，把钱还给人家吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act shamelessly anymore, return the money to them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗波就開始撒賴，話人哋出貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 bo1 zau6 hoi1 ci2 saat3 laai6, waa6 jan4 dei6 ceot1 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了球就开始耍赖，说别人作弊。
examples.english_sentence: He started acting shamelessly after losing the game, saying that others were cheating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路扭計撒賴，搞到阿媽都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 nau2 gai2 saat3 laai6, gaau2 dou3 aa3 maa1 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩耍赖哭闹，搞得妈妈都不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The child is throwing a tantrum and acting shamelessly, making his mother unsure of what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 撒泼; 耍赖; 胡闹
english_meaning: to act wildly; to be unruly; to throw a tantrum; to create a scene
explanation_mandarin: 指行为粗鲁、放肆，不讲道理地吵闹或制造麻烦。
explanation_english: To act rudely, recklessly, and unreasonably, often by shouting, throwing a tantrum, or making trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度撒野呀，有咩事好好講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 saat3 je5 aa3, jau5 me1 si6 hou2 hou2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里撒野，有什么事好好说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act wildly here, let's talk things over calmly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔扭計，喺商場度撒野，真係好冇教養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 nau1 gai2, hai2 soeng1 coeng4 dou6 saat3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 gaau3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那小孩闹脾气，在商场里撒泼，真是没有教养。
examples.english_sentence: That child is throwing a tantrum and acting up in the shopping mall. It's really bad manners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒之後就開始撒野，周圍搞事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 saat3 je5, zau1 wai4 gaau2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒之后就开始胡闹，到处惹事。
examples.english_sentence: After he got drunk, he started acting wildly and causing trouble everywhere.

english_meaning: to scratch; to scrape; to tickle; to bother; to harass
explanation_mandarin: 用指甲或其他东西轻轻地抓或搔。
explanation_english: To scratch lightly with fingernails or something else; to tickle; to scrape something against a surface; to bother or harass someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撓我胳肋底呀，好痕㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 naau4 ngo5 gaak3 lak6 dai2 aa3, hou2 han4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要挠我的咯吱窝呀，很痒的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't tickle my armpits, it's very itchy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再喺度煩我，我撓你啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 hai2 dou6 faan4 ngo5, ngo5 naau4 nei5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再在这里烦我，我就挠你！
examples.english_sentence: If you bother me here again, I will scratch you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都撓頭，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 naau4 tau4, m4 zi1 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是挠头，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always scratches his head, I don't know what he is thinking.

english_meaning: annoying, irritating, bothersome, unwelcome
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事令人厌烦，不被欢迎。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is annoying, irritating, or unwelcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日喺度嘈嘈閉，真係好撓仁囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 caau4 caau4 bai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 naau6 jan4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整天在这里吵吵闹闹，真是很讨厌！
