examples.english_sentence: You're always making a lot of noise here, it's really annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁自私，真係撓仁到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 zi6 si1, zan1 hai6 naau6 jan4 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人这么自私，真是令人讨厌死了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so selfish, it's really annoying to death.

english_meaning: to tear, to rip
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具将东西扯开。
explanation_english: To pull apart or rip something with the hands or with a tool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撕爛張紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 laan6 zoeng1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 撕烂这张纸。
examples.english_sentence: Tear up this piece of paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撕爛本書呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 si1 laan6 bun2 syu1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要撕烂这本书啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tear the book!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗份嘢撕破臉皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai6 zo2 fan6 je5 si1 po3 lim5 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了那件事撕破了脸皮。
examples.english_sentence: Those two fell out completely over that matter.

english_meaning: heart-wrenching; gut-wrenching; excruciating
explanation_mandarin: 形容极度悲伤或痛苦，如同内心被撕裂一般。
explanation_english: Describes extreme sadness, grief, or pain, as if the heart is being torn apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢走咗嘅消息，佢老婆喊到撕心裂肺咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 zau2 zo2 ge3 siu1 sik1, keoi5 lou5 po4 haam3 dou3 si1 sam1 lit6 fai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他去世的消息，他的妻子哭得撕心裂肺。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his death, his wife cried heart-wrenchingly.

english_meaning: to tear up, to rip up, to destroy by tearing
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他方式把东西撕裂、毁坏。
explanation_english: To tear something up, to destroy it by tearing it into pieces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到撕毀咗封信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 si1 wai2 zo2 fung1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地撕毁了信。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he tore up the letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便撕毀文件呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 si1 wai2 man4 gin2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便撕毁文件啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just tear up documents randomly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生撕毀咗份試卷，表示抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 si1 wai2 zo2 fan6 si5 gyun2, biu2 si6 kong3 yi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们撕毁了试卷，表示抗议。
examples.english_sentence: The students tore up the exam papers to protest.

english_meaning: to tear up, to rip apart
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他工具将某物撕开。
explanation_english: To tear something up, usually with hands or a tool, breaking it into pieces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好嬲，將份文件撕爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nau1, zoeng1 fan6 man4 gin6 si1 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很生气，把文件撕烂了。
examples.english_sentence: He was very angry and tore up the document.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撕爛本書呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 si1 laan6 bun2 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要撕烂这本书啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't tear up the book!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗將份報紙撕爛晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 zoeng1 fan6 bou3 zi2 si1 laan6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 狗把报纸全撕烂了。
examples.english_sentence: The dog tore the newspaper to pieces.

english_meaning: to kill a hostage after a ransom demand has not been met; to renege on a deal by killing a hostage
explanation_mandarin: 指绑匪在收到赎金后仍然杀害人质的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of kidnappers killing the hostage after receiving the ransom, or killing the hostage when ransom demands are not met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔交贖金，佢哋會撕票㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 gaau1 suk6 gam1, keoi5 dei6 wui5 si1 piu3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不交赎金，他们会撕票的！
examples.english_sentence: If we don't pay the ransom, they will kill the hostage!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方盡力阻止綁匪撕票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zeon6 lik6 zo2 zi2 bong2 fei2 si1 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方尽力阻止绑匪撕票。
examples.english_sentence: The police are doing their best to prevent the kidnappers from killing the hostage.

english_meaning: to tear, to rip
explanation_mandarin: 用力扯开、撕破。
explanation_english: To tear something forcefully, to rip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心將張紙撕裂咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 si1 lit6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心把纸撕破了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally tore the paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場意外令到佢嘅肌肉撕裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 ji3 ngoi6 ling6 dou3 keoi5 ge3 gei1 yuk6 si1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场意外导致他的肌肉撕裂。
examples.english_sentence: The accident caused his muscle to tear.

english_meaning: to take (transportation); to put up; to build; to join; to match; to agree
explanation_mandarin: 乘坐（交通工具）；搭建；连接；配合；同意。
explanation_english: To take (a means of transportation); to put up (a structure); to connect or join; to match or pair; to agree or concur.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日撘飛機去日本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 daap3 fei1 gei1 heoi3 jat6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天坐飞机去日本。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking a plane to Japan tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一齊撘膊頭行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 cai4 daap3 bok3 tau4 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一起搭着肩膀逛街。
examples.english_sentence: They walked down the street with their arms around each other's shoulders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅衫同條褲好撘喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 saam1 tung4 tiu4 fu3 hou2 daap3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的衣服和裤子很配哦。
examples.english_sentence: Your shirt and pants match well.

english_meaning: to play with; to fondle; to mess with; (vulgar) to have sex; a term of emphasis (often used with negative connotations)
explanation_mandarin: 本义指用手搓捻，引申为玩弄、拨弄。在粤语中，也常用作语气助词，加强语气，多带有负面情绪或不耐烦的意味。口语中亦可以表示性交。
explanation_english: Literally means to twist with fingers. It is extended to mean to play with, to mess with. In Cantonese, it is also commonly used as an emphatic particle to strengthen the tone, often with negative emotions or impatience. In colloquial Cantonese, it can also refer to sexual intercourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撚煩啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lan2 faan4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要烦我了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友仔好撚串。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 lan2 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家伙非常嚣张。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is so arrogant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撚手小菜
examples.jyutping_sentence: lan2 sau2 siu2 coi3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿手小菜
examples.english_sentence: Signature dish (easy-to-handle dish)

english_meaning: to tease; to make fun of; to fool around with; to play with someone (in a manipulative way)
explanation_mandarin: 指以戏谑、玩笑的态度对待他人，或以花言巧语、手段来捉弄、耍弄他人。
explanation_english: Refers to treating someone in a teasing or joking manner, or using sweet talk and tricks to fool around with or manipulate them. It carries a slightly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撚化我啦，我知你呃緊我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nan2 faa3 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 aak1 gan2 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要捉弄我了，我知道你在骗我！
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease me. I know you are lying to me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔成日撚化啲女仔，好冇品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 seng4 jat6 nan2 faa3 di1 neoi5 zai2, hou2 mou5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男生总是耍弄那些女生，很没品。
examples.english_sentence: That guy always messes around with girls, it's so ungentlemanly.

english_meaning: As if; yeah right; no way; not likely; don't even think about it; utter nonsense
explanation_mandarin: 表示强烈的不相信、否定或者嘲讽的语气，带有一种不屑的意味。相当于普通话的“才”、“根本”、“才怪”。
explanation_english: Expresses strong disbelief, negation, or mockery, often with a disdainful tone. Equivalent to phrases like 'as if', 'no way', 'not likely', or 'utter nonsense'. It's often used sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢會請我食飯？撚就！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6? lan2 zau6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他会请我吃饭？才怪！
examples.english_sentence: You're saying he's going to treat me to a meal? As if!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己好勤力，撚就，日日瞓晏覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 kan4 lik6, lan2 zau6, jat1 jat1 fan3 aan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己很勤奋，才怪，天天睡午觉。
examples.english_sentence: He says he's very diligent. Yeah right, he takes a nap every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢會贏？撚就！我先唔信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 wing4? lan2 zau6! ngo5 sin1 m4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会赢？才怪！我才不信。
examples.english_sentence: He says he's going to win? No way! I don't believe it.

english_meaning: Asshole, idiot, dickhead
explanation_mandarin: 非常粗俗的粤语脏话，用来骂人愚蠢、讨厌或令人厌恶。通常表示强烈的负面情绪。
explanation_english: A very vulgar Cantonese profanity used to insult someone, calling them stupid, annoying, or despicable. It usually expresses strong negative emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁撚屌㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 lan2 diu2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在做什么这么蠢的事？
examples.english_sentence: What are you doing, you idiot?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條撚屌成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lan2 diu2 sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个混蛋整天搞破坏。
examples.english_sentence: That asshole is always causing trouble.

english_meaning: one's forte; one's specialty; skilled at; adept
explanation_mandarin: 指擅长、拿手的事情或技能。
explanation_english: Refers to something that one is skilled at, one's forte, or one's specialty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煮餸就係佢嘅撚手好戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 sung3 zau6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 nan2 sau2 hou2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做饭是她的拿手好戏。
examples.english_sentence: Cooking is her specialty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畫畫好撚手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 hou2 nan2 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他画画很拿手的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very skilled at painting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個唔係我嘅撚手嘢，你搵第二個幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 m4 hai6 ngo5 ge3 nan2 sau2 je5, nei5 wan2 dai6 ji6 go3 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这不是我擅长的，你找其他人帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: This is not my forte, find someone else to help you.

english_meaning: signature dish; speciality dish; a cook's best dish (usually a simple one)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人最擅长做的菜肴，通常指简单的家常菜。
explanation_english: Describes a dish that someone is particularly good at making, usually referring to a simple, home-style dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蒸水蛋係我嘅撚手小菜嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing1 seoi2 daan2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 nan2 sau2 siu2 coi3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蒸蛋是我的拿手小菜。
examples.english_sentence: Steamed egg is my signature dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話豉油皇炒麵係佢嘅撚手小菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 si6 jau4 wong4 caau2 min6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 nan2 sau2 siu2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说豉油皇炒面是他的拿手小菜。
examples.english_sentence: He said soy sauce fried noodles are his signature dish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚煮啲咩撚手小菜啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan1 zyu2 di1 me1 nan2 sau2 siu2 coi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚煮什么拿手小菜啊？
examples.english_sentence: What signature dishes are you cooking tonight?

english_meaning: Idiot, moron, fool (vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 一个粗俗的骂人词汇，形容人愚蠢、无能或令人讨厌。通常带有强烈的负面情绪。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese term used to insult someone, describing them as an idiot, a moron, or generally unpleasant. It carries strong negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條撚樣乜都唔識做㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lan2 joeng2 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个混蛋什么都不会做！
examples.english_sentence: That idiot doesn't know how to do anything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條撚樣真係激死我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 lan2 joeng2 zan1 hai6 gik1 sei2 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个混蛋真是气死我了！
examples.english_sentence: You idiot are really driving me crazy!

english_meaning: to toy with; to play with (someone); to mess around with; to take advantage of
explanation_mandarin: 用不正当的手段戏弄、玩弄别人，使其处于不利的境地。带有轻蔑和不尊重的意味。
explanation_english: To toy with someone, to mess with them, or to take advantage of them. It carries a connotation of contempt and disrespect. It often implies that the person being '撚狗' is being manipulated or treated unfairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撚狗啦，直接講你想點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nin2 gau2 laa1, zik6 zip3 gong2 nei5 soeng2 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别玩弄我了，直接说你想要什么吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop messing with me, just tell me what you want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撚狗，冇人信佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nin2 gau2, mou5 jan4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍弄人，没人相信他说的话。
examples.english_sentence: He always toys with people, no one believes what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日撚狗啲員工，搞到佢哋好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 nin2 gau2 di1 jyun4 gung1, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是玩弄员工，搞得他们很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always messes with the employees, which makes them very unhappy.

english_meaning: useless person; someone incompetent; a loser
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人能力低下，没什么用处。带贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is incompetent, useless, and of little value. It's derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁撚菜，點搞得掂呢件事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lan2 coi3, dim2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ni1 gin6 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么没用，怎么能搞定这件事呢？
examples.english_sentence: He's so useless, how can he possibly handle this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪搵佢喇，佢條友仔咁撚菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 wan2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 tiu4 yau2 zai2 gam3 lan2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别找他了，他那个人这么没用。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother looking for him, he's such a loser.

mandarin_meaning: 闲着没事做，玩弄小鸟；比喻无所事事，游手好闲
english_meaning: Literally: To fondle a bird; Figuratively: To do nothing, to idle around, to be a loafer
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是玩弄小鸟。在粤语中，引申为无所事事，闲着没事做。带有贬义色彩，形容人游手好闲，不务正业。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to fondle a bird. In Cantonese, it is used figuratively to describe someone who is idle, does nothing of substance, and wastes time. It carries a negative connotation, depicting someone as a loafer who doesn't work or engage in productive activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺屋企撚雀，唔搵嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 lan2 zoek3, m4 wan2 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在家闲着没事做，不找事情做。
examples.english_sentence: He's idling around at home every day, not looking for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日撚雀啦，搵份工做好過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lan2 zoek3 laa1, wan2 fan6 gung1 zou6 hou2 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是游手好闲了，找份工作做比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being so idle, it's better to find a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為讀完書就可以撚雀，搵到份好工先至係目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 duk6 jyun4 syu1 zau6 ho2 ji5 lan2 zoek3, wan2 dou2 fan6 hou2 gung1 sin1 zeoi3 hai6 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为读完书就可以无所事事，找到一份好工作才是目标。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that you can just laze around after finishing your studies. Finding a good job is the goal.

english_meaning: (derogatory) stupid, foolish, idiot, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，反应迟钝；也可用作名词，指愚笨的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is stupid, slow-witted; can also be used as a noun to refer to a stupid person. It's a derogatory term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁撚頭啦，講咗咁多次都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 nan2 tau4 laa1, gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨啦，说了这么多次都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, I've explained it so many times and you still don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好撚頭，乜嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 nan2 tau4, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是很笨，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stupid, he doesn't know how to do anything.

english_meaning: to prop up; to support; to brace; to hold up (physically)
explanation_mandarin: 用东西从下面托住；支撑。
explanation_english: To support something from below, to brace or hold up (physically). It implies providing physical support to prevent something from falling or collapsing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撜住張枱腳，費事佢鬆開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaang2 zyu6 zoeng1 toi1 goek3, fai3 si5 keoi5 sung1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 撑住桌子腿，免得它松开。
examples.english_sentence: Prop up the table leg, so it doesn't come loose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條木太重，我撜唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 muk6 taai3 cung5, ngo5 zaang2 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条木头太重了，我撑不起来。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of wood is too heavy, I can't hold it up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用手撜住個頭，好似好攰咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 sau2 zaang2 zyu6 go3 tau4, hou2 ci5 hou2 gui6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用手撑着头，好像很累的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He's propping his head up with his hand, looking very tired.

english_meaning: to bump into, to collide, to run into, to meet unexpectedly
explanation_mandarin: 碰撞；意外地碰到；不期而遇。
explanation_english: To collide with something; to bump into someone; to meet someone unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街撞到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 zong6 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上碰到他了。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into him on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞咗埋牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 zo2 maai4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞到墙了。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed into the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞板撞到應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 baan2 zong6 dou3 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他到处碰壁。
examples.english_sentence: He's running into obstacles everywhere.

english_meaning: To agree with someone, to see eye-to-eye, to be on the same wavelength
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人或多个人意见或想法一致，没有事先商量却得出了相同的结论。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two or more people have the same opinion or idea, arriving at the same conclusion without prior consultation or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋諗法撞晒匙，都係覺得呢個方案最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nam2 faat3 zong6 saai3 si4, dou1 hai6 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的想法一致，都觉得这个方案最好。
examples.english_sentence: We are on the same wavelength; we both think this is the best plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢撞匙撞到呢，佢一講我就知佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 zong6 si4 zong6 dou3 ne1, keoi5 jat1 gong2 ngo5 zau6 zi1 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他太有默契了，他一说我就知道他想做什么。
examples.english_sentence: We're so in sync; I know what he wants to do as soon as he speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋兩個嘅意見咁撞匙，一齊合作一定得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 ji3 gin3 gam3 zong6 si4, jat1 cai4 hap6 zok3 jat1 ding6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们两个的意见这么一致，一起合作肯定成功。
examples.english_sentence: Since your opinions are so aligned, you're sure to succeed if you work together.

synonyms: 一拍即合 (jat1 paak3 zik1 hap6)

english_meaning: to predict accurately, to make a prediction that comes true, to hit the nail on the head (in a prediction)
explanation_mandarin: 指偶然说出的话应验了，如同卦象一样灵验。
explanation_english: Refers to a statement made casually that unexpectedly comes true, as if it were a successful divination or prediction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隨口講句佢會遲到，點知真係俾我撞口卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceoi4 hau2 gong2 geoi3 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3, dim2 zi1 zan1 hai6 bei2 ngo5 zong6 hau2 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我随便说了一句他会迟到，没想到真的被我撞中了。
examples.english_sentence: I casually said he would be late, but I actually predicted it accurately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話聽日會落雨，結果又俾佢撞口卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5, git3 gwo2 jau6 bei2 keoi5 zong6 hau2 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说明天会下雨，结果又被他蒙对了。
examples.english_sentence: He said it would rain tomorrow, and he accurately predicted it again.

english_meaning: to bump into each other frequently; to meet often
explanation_mandarin: 形容经常在某个地方或某些场合遇到同一个人。
explanation_english: Describes frequently encountering the same person in a certain place or at certain occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺公司附近撞口撞面，真係好有緣份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 fu6 gan6 zong6 hau2 zong6 min6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jyun4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在公司附近碰面，真是有缘分。
examples.english_sentence: We often bump into each other near the office, it's really fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從搬咗嚟呢度住之後，我就成日同佢撞口撞面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 bun1 zo2 lai4 ni1 dou6 zyu6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 sing4 jat6 tung4 keoi5 zong6 hau2 zong6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从搬到这里住之后，我就经常和他碰面。
examples.english_sentence: Since I moved to live here, I often bump into him.

english_meaning: to coincide, to happen to meet, to bump into, by chance, accidentally
explanation_mandarin: 偶然遇到，正好赶上。 表示事情发生是巧合或偶然。
explanation_english: To meet by chance, to coincide, or to happen to be at the right place at the right time. It indicates that something happened as a coincidence or accidentally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺街撞啱咗個舊同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 zong6 ngaam1 zo2 go3 gau6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上碰巧遇到了一个老同学。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to bump into an old classmate on the street yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日撞啱老板心情好，所以先攞到假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zong6 ngaam1 lou5 baan2 sam1 cing4 hou2, so2 ji5 sin1 lo2 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天刚好碰到老板心情好，所以才能请到假。
examples.english_sentence: He happened to catch the boss in a good mood today, that's why he managed to get the leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撞啱打折，我買咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong6 ngaam1 daa2 zit3, ngo5 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正好赶上打折，我买了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to catch the sale, so I bought a lot of things.

english_meaning: to get lucky; to strike it lucky; to fluke; to get a lucky break
explanation_mandarin: 指运气好，偶然得到好处或成功。
explanation_english: Refers to being lucky, getting benefits or succeeding by chance or good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張六合彩，諗住撞下彩啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 luk6 hap6 coi2, lam2 zyu6 zong6 haa5 coi2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一张六合彩，想着碰碰运气而已。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a Mark Six ticket, just trying my luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試撞彩合格咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 zong6 coi2 hap6 gaak3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试碰运气合格了。
examples.english_sentence: He passed the exam this time by sheer luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住次次都撞彩，要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ci3 ci3 dou1 zong6 coi2, jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着每次都碰运气，要努力一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't expect to get lucky every time; you need to work harder.

english_meaning: to be lucky; to fluke; to have a lucky streak
explanation_mandarin: 指偶然运气好，碰巧成功。多用于游戏中或竞争场合。
explanation_english: Refers to having unexpected good luck or success, often by chance. Commonly used in games or competitive situations. Implies that the success is not necessarily due to skill but rather due to luck or a lucky streak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日買股票撞手神，賺咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 maai5 gu2 piu3 zong6 sau2 san4, zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天买股票运气好，赚了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He got lucky buying stocks yesterday and made a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日打麻雀撞手神，赢到笑!
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 daa2 maa4 zoek3 zong6 sau2 san4, wing4 dou3 siu3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天打麻将运气好，赢到笑!
examples.english_sentence: I'm having a lucky streak playing mahjong today, winning like crazy!

english_meaning: to strike; to collide; impact; collision
explanation_mandarin: 指猛烈地撞打或冲击。
explanation_english: To strike violently; to collide forcefully; impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞擊咗埋牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 gik1 zo2 maai4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车撞到了墙。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed into the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次撞擊好犀利，搞到佢受咗傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 zong6 gik1 hou2 sai1 lei6, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 sau6 zo2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次撞击非常厉害，导致他受伤了。
examples.english_sentence: That collision was very severe, causing him to get injured.

english_meaning: To hit a snag; to run into a problem; to meet with difficulties; to fail at something; to hit a wall
explanation_mandarin: 比喻遇到阻碍，事情进行不顺利。
explanation_english: A metaphor for encountering obstacles and things not going smoothly. It implies hitting an unexpected hurdle or encountering unforeseen difficulties, leading to failure or setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個計劃因為資金問題而撞板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 gai3 waak6 jan1 wai6 zi1 gam1 man6 tai4 ji4 zong6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划因为资金问题而碰壁了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan hit a snag due to funding issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想自己創業，但係撞咗唔少板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zi6 gei2 cong3 jip6, daan6 hai6 zong6 zo2 m4 siu2 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想自己创业，但是碰了不少壁。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to start his own business, but he ran into quite a few problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份新工作做得唔順利，成日撞板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 san1 gung1 zok3 zou6 dak1 m4 seon6 lei6, seng4 jat6 zong6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新工作做得不顺利，总是遇到困难。
examples.english_sentence: His new job is not going smoothly, and he's always running into problems.

jyutping: zong6 baan2 do1 gwo3 sik6 faan6
mandarin_meaning: 经常碰壁; 屡屡失败
english_meaning: To make mistakes more often than eating meals; to constantly run into problems; to be prone to errors; to fail repeatedly.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人经常遇到挫折，犯错的频率非常高，比吃饭还要频繁。比喻做事不顺利，屡次失败。
explanation_english: Describes a person who constantly encounters setbacks and makes mistakes very frequently, even more often than eating meals. It's a metaphor for doing things unsuccessfully and failing repeatedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢初初做生意，乜都唔識，撞板多過食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co1 co1 zou6 saang1 ji3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, zong6 baan2 do1 gwo3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚开始做生意，什么都不懂，经常碰壁。
examples.english_sentence: When he first started doing business, he didn't know anything, and he was constantly running into problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project好複雜，我哋撞板多過食飯都唔出奇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project hou2 fuk1 zaap6, ngo5 dei6 zong6 baan2 do1 gwo3 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 ceot1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很复杂，我们屡屡碰壁也不奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: This project is very complex, it wouldn't be surprising if we constantly run into problems.

mandarin_meaning: 碰运气, 瞎猫碰上死耗子
english_meaning: To try one's luck; to fluke; to hit upon something by chance; to be lucky; lucky break
explanation_mandarin: 指无意中或偶然地获得成功，带有一种侥幸的意味。类似“瞎猫碰上死耗子”的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to succeeding unintentionally or by chance, often implying luck. Similar to the English idiom 'fluke' or 'a lucky break'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試咁高分，都係撞棍啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 gou1 fan1, dou1 hai6 zong6 gwan3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考这么高分，都是碰运气罢了。
examples.english_sentence: He scored so high on this exam; it's all just luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識寫程式，但係今次竟然成功咗，可能係撞棍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 se2 cing4 sik1, daan6 hai6 gam1 ci3 ging2 jin4 sing4 gung1 zo2, ho2 nang4 hai6 zong6 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不懂写程序，但是这次竟然成功了，可能是碰巧了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to code, but I actually succeeded this time; it might just be a fluke.

english_meaning: to coincide; to run into (something); to happen to be (doing something); to hit the jackpot; to strike it lucky; to encounter; to be in time for
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事碰巧发生，正好赶上，或者意外地遇到了某人/某事。带有一定的偶然性和巧合性。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens by chance, is just in time, or unexpectedly encounters someone/something. It carries a sense of randomness and coincidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日撞正佢喺街市買餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zong6 zing3 keoi5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天正好在菜市场碰到她买菜。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to run into her buying groceries at the market today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞正老闆心情唔好，所以唔敢問加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 zing3 lou5 baan2 sam1 ching4 m4 hou2, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 man6 gaa1 yan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正好碰到老板心情不好，所以不敢问加薪。
examples.english_sentence: He happened to catch the boss in a bad mood, so he didn't dare to ask for a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我撞正打折，买咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zong6 zing3 daa2 zit3, maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我碰巧赶上打折，买了很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: I happened to catch the sale and bought a lot of things.

english_meaning: Beginner's luck; a lucky fluke; fluke; a blind pig finds an acorn.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻本来没有本事，却侥幸得到了成功。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes someone succeeding purely by chance or luck, often without skill or effort. Similar to 'beginner's luck'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時考試都唔溫書嘅，但今次竟然考得好好，真係撞死馬囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 haau2 si3 dou1 m4 wan1 syu1 ge3, daan6 gam1 ci3 ging2 jin4 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 zong6 sei2 maa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时考试都不复习的，但这次竟然考得很好，真是瞎猫碰上死耗子了。
examples.english_sentence: He usually doesn't study for exams, but he did really well this time. It's just beginner's luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我估唔到第一次買股票就賺錢，今次真係撞死馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu2 m4 dou2 dai6 jat1 ci3 maai5 gu2 piu3 zau6 zaan6 cin2, gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 zong6 sei2 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没想到第一次买股票就赚钱，这次真是瞎猫碰上死耗子。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect to make money on my first stock purchase; it's just a fluke.

english_meaning: Unlucky; ill-fated; having bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物运气不好，遭遇不幸。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as unlucky, experiencing misfortune. Literally: 'crashing/hitting a dead bird'. It implies bad luck or an unfortunate event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日撞死鳥咁，乜嘢都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zong6 sei2 niu5 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天倒霉透了，什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He's so unlucky today, nothing is going smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講，我哋唔想撞死鳥嘅事發生啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2, ngo5 dei6 m4 soeng2 zong6 sei2 niu5 ge3 si6 faat3 sang1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么说，我们不想倒霉的事情发生啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, we don't want unlucky things to happen!

synonyms: 黑過墨斗 (hak1 gwo3 mak6 dau2)

english_meaning: to get angry, to flare up (in anger)
explanation_mandarin: 指突然发怒，情绪激动。形容一个人容易发脾气。
explanation_english: Refers to suddenly getting angry or emotional. Describes someone who is easily angered or has a short temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都咁容易撞火嘅，你唔好咁介意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam3 jung4 ji6 zong6 fo2 ge3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaai3 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这么容易发脾气，你不要太在意了。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so quick to get angry, don't take it too personally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好搞搞震啦，佢好易撞火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 laa1, keoi5 hou2 ji6 zong6 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别捣乱了，他很容易生气的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around, he gets angry easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講嘢小心啲，唔好撞佢火頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 je5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zong6 keoi5 fo2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说话小心点，别惹他生气。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful what you say, don't make him angry.

english_meaning: to hit a wall; to run into a brick wall; to reach a dead end; to be stuck
explanation_mandarin: 比喻遇到阻碍，事情进行不下去。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to encounter obstacles or difficulties that prevent progress in a task or situation; to reach a point where no further advancement is possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做緊呢個project一路都好順利，點知而家撞牆，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 gan2 ni1 go3 project jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 seon6 lei6, dim2 zi1 ji4 gaa1 zong6 coeng4, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做这个项目一直都很顺利，谁知道现在碰壁了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: I've been doing this project very smoothly, but who knew I'd hit a wall now, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講道理好似撞牆咁，完全聽唔入耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 lei5 hou2 ci5 zong6 coeng4 gam2, jyun4 cyun4 ting1 m4 jap6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他讲道理就像碰壁一样，完全听不进去。
examples.english_sentence: Talking reason with him is like hitting a wall, he won't listen at all.

synonyms: 停滯不前 (ting4 zai6 bat1 cin4)

english_meaning: to pretend to be deaf; to feign ignorance; to turn a deaf ear
explanation_mandarin: 假装听不见。形容故意不理睬或回避问题。
explanation_english: To pretend to be deaf. It describes someone who intentionally ignores or avoids a problem or question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我講咗咁多次，你都係撞聾咁，唔聽我講！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, nei5 dou1 hai6 zong6 lung1 gam2, m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我说了这么多次，你都装聋作哑，不听我说！
examples.english_sentence: I've said it so many times, but you're still pretending to be deaf, not listening to me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撞聾啦，我哋講緊你份功課㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zong6 lung1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 gong2 gan2 nei5 fan6 gung1 fo3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别装聋作哑了，我们正在说你的功课呢！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be deaf, we're talking about your homework!

english_meaning: clashing colors, color blocking (fashion)
explanation_mandarin: 指颜色搭配上，将对比强烈的颜色组合在一起，形成视觉冲击。
explanation_english: Refers to the combination of strongly contrasting colors in a way that creates a striking visual effect. It can also refer to the unintentional matching of colors that might clash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着嘅衫好撞色，紅襯綠，好sharp呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 ge3 saam1 hou2 zong6 sik1, hung4 can3 luk6, hou2 sharp1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿的衣服很撞色，红配绿，很鲜艳啊！
examples.english_sentence: The clothes she's wearing today are very clashing, red with green, very vibrant!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年好興撞色嘅設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hou2 hing1 zong6 sik1 ge3 sat3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年很流行撞色的设计。
examples.english_sentence: Color-blocking designs are very popular this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁撞色啦，睇到眼都花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zong6 sik1 laa1, tai2 dou3 ngaan5 dou1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搭配得那么撞色，看得眼睛都花了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use such clashing colors, it's making my eyes hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 撞衫; 穿一样的衣服
english_meaning: To wear the same outfit as someone else; to have a wardrobe clash
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人或多个人穿了相同的衣服。
explanation_english: Refers to two or more people wearing the exact same outfit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日返工同同事撞咗衫，好尷尬呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 tung4 tung4 si6 zong6 zo2 saam1, hou2 gaam3 gaai3 a3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天上班和同事撞衫了，好尴尬啊！
examples.english_sentence: I wore the same outfit as my colleague to work today, it's so awkward!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最唔想嘅就係喺個party度同人撞衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 m4 soeng2 ge3 zau6 hai6 hai2 go3 party dou6 tung4 jan4 zong6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最不想的就是在派对上和别人撞衫。
examples.english_sentence: What I dislike the most is wearing the same outfit as someone else at a party.

english_meaning: to bump into, to run into, to encounter
explanation_mandarin: 意外地遇见某人或某事。
explanation_english: To encounter someone or something unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日我喺街撞見Mary。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 ngo5 hai2 gaai1 zong6 gin3 Mary.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天我在街上碰见了Mary。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into Mary on the street yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺戲院撞見佢同另一個女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hei3 jyun2 zong6 gin3 keoi5 tung4 ling6 jat1 go3 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在电影院碰见他和另一个女孩。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into him with another girl at the cinema.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想喺升降機度撞見佢，好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 hai2 sing1 gong3 gei1 dou6 zong6 gin3 keoi5, hou2 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想在电梯里碰到他，很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to bump into him in the elevator; it's so awkward.

english_meaning: To butt heads; to clash; to have a conflict; to be incompatible.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人与人之间意见不合，发生冲突或矛盾；也指事情进展不顺利，处处碰壁。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to a situation where people's opinions clash, leading to conflict or contradiction. It can also refer to a situation where progress is difficult and one encounters obstacles everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個性格唔夾，成日撞角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing3 gaak3 m4 gaap3, sing4 jat6 zong6 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个性格不合，经常发生冲突。
examples.english_sentence: We have incompatible personalities and often clash.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好固執，好容易同人撞角嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gu3 zap1, hou2 jung4 ji6 tung4 jan4 zong6 gok3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很固执，很容易和别人发生冲突的。
examples.english_sentence: He's very stubborn and easily clashes with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔聽佢講，實會同佢撞角㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 teng1 keoi5 gong2, sat1 wui tung4 keoi5 zong6 gok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不听他的话，肯定会和他发生冲突的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't listen to him, you'll definitely clash with him.

english_meaning: Car accident; crash; (figuratively) clash of ideas; repetition of ideas or approaches
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词, 动词 (名词, 动词)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是汽车相撞。引申义包括：1. 汽车发生事故。2. 比喻观点、方法等发生冲突或重复。
explanation_english: Literally means car crash. Figuratively, it means: 1. A car accident. 2. A clash or overlap of ideas, approaches, or schedules; repetition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日喺高速公路撞車，好彩冇人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 hai2 gou1 suk1 gung1 lou6 zong6 ce1, hou2 coi2 mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天在高速公路上撞车了，幸好没人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: There was a car accident on the highway yesterday. Luckily, no one was injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個嘅計劃撞車，要重新安排時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 gai3 waak6 zong6 ce1, jiu3 cung4 san1 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的两个计划撞车了，需要重新安排时间。
examples.english_sentence: Our two plans clashed, so we need to reschedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個諗法撞車，成日都嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 nam2 faat3 zong6 ce1, seng4 jat6 dou1 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个想法冲突，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Their ideas clash, so they often argue.

english_meaning: to be possessed by an evil spirit; to have a run-in with evil spirits
explanation_mandarin: 指人遇到邪灵或不干净的东西，导致精神或身体上出现异常状况。
explanation_english: Refers to encountering evil spirits or unclean entities, leading to abnormal mental or physical conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行山嗰陣時撞邪，返到屋企就發高燒，又講晒胡話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 si4 zong6 se4, faan1 dou3 uk1 kei5 zau6 faat3 gou1 siu1, jau6 gong2晒 wu4 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爬山的时候中邪了，回到家就发高烧，又说胡话。
examples.english_sentence: He encountered evil spirits while hiking, and when he got home, he had a high fever and was talking nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講呢間屋好猛鬼，成日有人撞邪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ni1 gaan1 uk1 hou2 maang5 gwai2, seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 zong6 se4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这间屋子很闹鬼，经常有人中邪。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that this house is haunted, and people often get possessed by evil spirits.

mandarin_meaning: 冲突；不合拍；意见不一致
english_meaning: to clash; to conflict; to be incompatible; to be out of sync; to have disagreements
explanation_mandarin: 比喻彼此意见、行为等不协调、不一致，发生冲突。
explanation_english: A metaphor used to describe situations where opinions, actions, or personalities are incompatible, leading to conflicts or disagreements. Can also refer to being out of sync or having conflicting schedules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個成日撞針，好難合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 zong6 zam1, hou2 naan4 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个人经常冲突，很难合作。
examples.english_sentence: The two of us clash all the time, it's difficult to work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅時間撞咗針，去唔到同一個活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 si4 gaan3 zong6 zo2 zam1, heoi3 m4 dou3 tung4 jat1 go3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的时间冲突了，去不了同一个活动。
examples.english_sentence: Their schedules clashed, so they couldn't go to the same event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同阿媽嘅諗法成日撞針，所以經常嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 aa3 maa1 ge3 lam2 faat3 sing4 jat6 zong6 zam1, so2 ji5 ging1 seong4 caau2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和妈妈的想法经常不一致，所以经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas often clash with his mother's, so they often argue.

english_meaning: to bump into; to run into (someone); to meet unexpectedly
explanation_mandarin: 意外相遇，碰见。
explanation_english: To encounter someone unexpectedly; to meet by chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先喺超級市場撞面碰到李老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 hai2 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 zong6 min6 pung3 dou2 lei5 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚才在超市碰到了李老师。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into Teacher Li at the supermarket just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到喺機場都撞面，真係好有緣份呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou3 hai2 gei1 coeng4 dou1 zong6 min6, zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jyun4 fan6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到在机场都能碰面，真是很有缘分啊！
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect to bump into you at the airport. What a coincidence!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 晏晝我喺條街度撞面碰到佢，佢好似唔認得我咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aan3 zau3 ngo5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 zong6 min6 pung3 dou2 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 jing6 dak1 ngo5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下午我在街上碰到了他，他好像不认识我了。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into him on the street this afternoon, and he didn't seem to recognize me.

english_meaning: To bump into each other (unexpectedly); To meet up; To have a meeting
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人意外地相遇，或事先约定见面。
explanation_english: Refers to two people meeting unexpectedly or having a pre-arranged meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日喺街撞頭撞到我個中學同學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 zong6 tau4 zong6 dou3 ngo5 go3 zung1 hok6 tung4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在街上碰巧遇到了我的中学同学。
examples.english_sentence: I bumped into my secondary school classmate on the street yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋聽日撞頭傾下個project？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zong6 tau4 king1 haa5 go3 project?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们明天碰头谈一下这个项目？
examples.english_sentence: How about we meet up tomorrow to discuss the project?

english_meaning: To see a ghost; What the heck?; Darn it!; Something spooky happened; Bizarre occurrence
explanation_mandarin: 本意是遇到鬼，引申为遇到奇怪、倒霉或令人不快的事情，也可作感叹词，表示惊讶、不满等情绪。
explanation_english: Literally means to encounter a ghost. Figuratively, it means to encounter something strange, unlucky, or unpleasant. It can also be used as an interjection to express surprise, dissatisfaction, or annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺條巷入面，撞鬼咁靜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 tiu4 hong2 jap6 min6, zong6 gwai2 gam3 zing6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在巷子里，安静得像见鬼一样。
examples.english_sentence: It was eerily quiet in the alley earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撞鬼！又停電啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zong6 gwai2! jau6 ting4 din6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 见鬼！又停电了？
examples.english_sentence: Darn it! The power's out again?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗銀包，撞鬼啦，去咗邊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 ngan4 baau1, zong6 gwai2 laa1, heoi3 zo2 bin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把钱包丢了，见鬼了，去哪儿了？
examples.english_sentence: I lost my wallet, what the heck! Where did it go?

english_meaning: to raise; to lift; to bring up (a topic)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指提起、抬起，有時也指提出（話題）。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial term meaning to raise, to lift up, or to bring up (a topic).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撟高手啦，幫我攞啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: giu2 gou1 sau2 laa1, bong1 ngo5 lo2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抬高手啊，帮我拿些东西。
examples.english_sentence: Raise your hand high, help me get some things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日撟住呢件事嚟講啦，好悶呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 giu2 zyu6 ni1 gin6 si6 lai4 gong2 laa1, hou2 mun6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是提起这件事来说了，很闷啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always bring up this topic, it's boring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如撟起啲輕鬆嘅話題傾下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 giu2 hei2 di1 hing1 sung1 ge3 waa6 tai4 king1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如提起一些轻松的话题聊聊吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we bring up some light topics to chat about?

english_meaning: to pull; to tug; to drag
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具拉扯。
explanation_english: To pull or tug something, usually with force or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撠住我件衫呀！會爛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zek1 zyu6 ngo5 gin6 saam1 aa1! wui5 laan6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要拽我的衣服！会破的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't pull my shirt! It will tear!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撠住條繩唔放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek1 zyu6 tiu4 sing2 m4 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拽着绳子不放手。
examples.english_sentence: He held onto the rope tightly and wouldn't let go.

english_meaning: To trip someone up; to obstruct; to hinder; to be a hindrance
explanation_mandarin: 本意是绊倒别人的脚，引申为阻碍、妨碍，使别人无法顺利进行。
explanation_english: Literally means to trip someone up. Figuratively, it means to obstruct, hinder, or impede someone's progress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度撠腳啦，阻住晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gik1 goek3 laa1, zo2 zyu6 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里碍事了，挡着路！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a hindrance here, you're blocking the way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撠腳，搞到我做嘢好唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gik1 goek3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 je5 hou2 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是阻碍我，搞得我工作很不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He's always hindering me, making my work very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撠腳呀，我趕時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gik1 goek3 aa3, ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要碍事，我赶时间。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get in the way, I'm in a hurry.

english_meaning: to withdraw; to retreat; to remove; to revoke; to cancel
explanation_mandarin: 表示退回，撤退；取消，撤销。
explanation_english: Indicates withdrawing, retreating; canceling, revoking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋撤退咗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cit3 teoi3 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们撤退了。
examples.english_sentence: They have retreated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆撤銷咗個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 cit3 siu1 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板取消了那个计划。
examples.english_sentence: The boss cancelled the plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要儘快撤離呢個地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 faai3 cit3 lei4 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尽快撤离这个地方。
examples.english_sentence: We need to evacuate this place as soon as possible.

english_meaning: evacuation of overseas citizens
explanation_mandarin: 指政府从国外将本国公民撤回本国。
explanation_english: Refers to the government evacuating its citizens from a foreign country back to the home country, usually due to war, natural disasters, or political instability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度打緊仗，政府安排咗撤僑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 daa2 gan2 zoeng3, zing3 fu2 on1 paai4 zo2 cit3 kiu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那里在打仗，政府安排了撤侨。
examples.english_sentence: There's a war going on there, the government has arranged for the evacuation of overseas citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果當地有危險，領事館會幫手安排撤僑嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 dong1 dei6 jau5 ngai4 him2, ling5 si3 gun2 wui5 bong1 sau2 on1 paai4 cit3 kiu4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果当地有危险，领事馆会帮忙安排撤侨的。
examples.english_sentence: If there is danger in the local area, the consulate will help arrange the evacuation of overseas citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望可以順利撤僑，唔好有人員傷亡啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 cit3 kiu4, m4 hou2 jau5 jan4 jyun4 soeng1 mong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望可以顺利撤侨，不要有人员伤亡。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully the evacuation of overseas citizens can be carried out smoothly, and there will be no casualties.

english_meaning: to withdraw troops, to retreat
explanation_mandarin: 军队从某地撤退。
explanation_english: To withdraw troops from a location; to retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敵軍頂唔順，終於決定撤兵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik6 gwan1 ding2 m4 seon6, zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 bing1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敌军顶不住了，终于决定撤兵了。
examples.english_sentence: The enemy troops couldn't hold on, and finally decided to withdraw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會有命令叫我哋撤兵返去基地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 jau5 ming6 ling6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 cit3 bing1 faan1 heoi3 gei1 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会有命令叫我们撤兵回到基地。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow there will be orders for us to withdraw and return to base.

english_meaning: withdraw, evacuate, pull out
explanation_mandarin: 指从某个地方或某个活动中撤退或离开。
explanation_english: To withdraw from a place, activity, or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於經濟唔景氣，佢哋決定撤出香港市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 ging1 zai3 m4 ging2 hei3, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 cit3 ceot1 hoeng1 gong2 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于经济不景气，他们决定撤出香港市场。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the economic downturn, they decided to withdraw from the Hong Kong market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到颱風警告之後，所有船隻都要撤出港口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 toi4 fung1 ging2 gou3 zi1 hau6, so2 jau5 syun4 zek3 dou1 jiu3 cit3 ceot1 gong2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到台风警告之后，所有船只都要撤出港口。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the typhoon warning, all ships must evacuate the harbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊已經開始撤出嗰個地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 cit3 ceot1 go2 go3 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队已经开始撤出那个地区。
examples.english_sentence: The troops have already begun to withdraw from that area.

english_meaning: to remove, to withdraw, to abolish, to cancel
explanation_mandarin: 移除，取消，撤销。指把原有的东西拿走或停止执行。
explanation_english: To remove something that was previously in place; to withdraw or cancel something, such as an order or an agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定撤去所有嘅指控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 cit3 heoi3 so2 jau5 ge3 zi2 gung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定撤销所有的指控。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to withdraw all the charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細命令我哋撤去所有嘅廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ming6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 cit3 heoi3 so2 jau5 ge3 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板命令我们撤销所有的广告。
examples.english_sentence: The boss ordered us to remove all the advertisements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布撤去所有嘅限制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 cit3 heoi3 so2 jau5 ge3 haan6 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布取消所有的限制。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced the removal of all restrictions.

english_meaning: withdraw, recall, retract
explanation_mandarin: 取消已经提出的要求、声明、提案等。
explanation_english: To withdraw or take back something that has been previously stated, requested, or proposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定撤回個建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 cit3 wui4 go3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定撤回那个建议。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to withdraw the suggestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府最終都撤回咗條爭議性嘅法案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zeoi3 chung1 dou1 cit3 wui4 zo2 tiu4 zaang1 yi5 sing3 ge3 faat3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府最终还是撤回了这条有争议的法案。
examples.english_sentence: The government eventually withdrew the controversial bill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我撤回啱啱講嘅嘢，我唔應該咁樣講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cit3 wui4 aam1 aam1 gong2 ge3 je5, ngo5 m4 jing1 goi1 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我撤回刚才说的话，我不应该那样说话。
examples.english_sentence: I retract what I just said; I shouldn't have said it that way.

english_meaning: to drop charges; to withdraw prosecution
explanation_mandarin: 指检方或原告放弃对某人的指控，停止起诉。
explanation_english: Refers to the prosecution or plaintiff abandoning charges against someone, ceasing prosecution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為證據唔夠，警方決定撤控。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 zing3 geoi3 m4 gau3, ging2 fong1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 hung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为证据不足，警方决定撤销控告。
examples.english_sentence: Because of insufficient evidence, the police decided to drop the charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後決定撤控，放咗佢走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 cit3 hung3, fong3 zo2 keoi5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后决定撤诉，放他走了。
examples.english_sentence: They finally decided to drop the charges and let him go.

english_meaning: to remove and replace, to replace
explanation_mandarin: 撤銷並更換。指免去某人的職務，並用其他人代替。
explanation_english: To remove someone from a position and replace them with someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢表現咁差，公司決定撤換佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 biu2 hin3 gam3 caa1, gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 wun6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他表现这么差，公司决定撤换他。
examples.english_sentence: He performed so badly that the company decided to replace him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為投訴太多，經理俾人撤換咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 tau4 sou3 taai3 do1, ging1 lei5 bei2 jan4 cit3 wun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为投诉太多，经理被人撤换了。
examples.english_sentence: Because of too many complaints, the manager was replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練因為戰術錯誤而被撤換。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 jan1 wai6 zin3 seot6 cu3 ng6 ji4 biu2 cit3 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练因为战术错误而被撤换。
examples.english_sentence: The coach was replaced due to tactical errors.

english_meaning: to revoke, to rescind, to repeal, to withdraw, to cancel
explanation_mandarin: 取消原来的决定、命令、协议等。
explanation_english: To officially cancel or withdraw something, such as a law, decision, or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定撤消嗰個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 siu1 go2 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定撤销那个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to cancel that project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官決定撤消控罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 siu1 hung3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官决定撤销控罪。
examples.english_sentence: The judge decided to drop the charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要求銀行撤消交易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu1 kiu4 ngan4 hong4 cit3 siu1 giao1 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要求银行撤销交易。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他再不改善表现，很快就会被人撤职。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't improve his performance, he will be removed from office soon.

english_meaning: withdraw investment, disinvest, divest
explanation_mandarin: 从某项投资项目中撤回资金。
explanation_english: To withdraw capital from an investment project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為政治風險太大，決定撤資。

examples.english_sentence: They decided to withdraw investment because the political risk is too high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為連年虧損，股東決定撤資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yan1 wai6 lin4 nin4 kwai1 syun2, gu2 dung1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为公司连年亏损，股东决定撤资。
examples.english_sentence: Due to years of losses, the shareholders decided to withdraw their investment from the company.

english_meaning: to withdraw; to evacuate; to pull out; to retreat
explanation_mandarin: 指从某个地方撤退或撤离。
explanation_english: Refers to withdrawing or evacuating from a place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋收到命令要即刻撤走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 dou3 ming6 ling6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 cit3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们收到命令要立刻撤离。
examples.english_sentence: They received orders to evacuate immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察封鎖咗現場，然後將啲人撤走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 fung1 so2 zo2 jin6 coeng4, jin4 hau6 zoeng1 di1 jan4 cit3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察封锁了现场，然后把人群疏散了。
examples.english_sentence: The police cordoned off the scene and then evacuated the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定將所有投資從嗰個項目度撤走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 so2 jau5 tau4 zi1 cung4 go2 go3 hong6 muk6 dou6 cit3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定将所有投资从那个项目撤走。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to withdraw all investment from that project.

english_meaning: withdraw troops, pull out
explanation_mandarin: 军队撤退，离开占领地区或作战地区。
explanation_english: To withdraw troops, to pull out of a occupied or combat area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋宣布咗會喺邊境撤軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 syun1 bou3 zo2 wui5 hai2 bin1 ging2 cit3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们宣布了将会从边境撤军。
examples.english_sentence: They announced that they would withdraw troops from the border.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺達成和平協議之後，各國就開始逐步撤軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daat6 sing4 wo4 ping4 hip3 ji5 zi1 hau6, gok3 gwok3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 zuk1 bou6 cit3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在达成和平协议之后，各国就开始逐步撤军。
examples.english_sentence: After reaching a peace agreement, the countries began to gradually withdraw their troops.

english_meaning: to withdraw, to retreat
explanation_mandarin: 指军队或人员离开作战或占据的阵地或区域。
explanation_english: To withdraw or retreat from a position, area, or engagement, typically referring to military or organized movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到指示，我哋要即刻撤退。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 zi2 si1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 cit3 teoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到指示，我们要立刻撤退。
examples.english_sentence: Having received instructions, we need to retreat immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到情況唔對路，佢哋就即刻撤退咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 cing4 fong3 m4 deoi3 lou6, keoi5 dei6 zau6 zik1 hak1 cit3 teoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到情况不对劲，他们就立刻撤退了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the situation wasn't right, they immediately retreated.

english_meaning: to revoke, to rescind, to cancel, to withdraw
explanation_mandarin: 取消原来的决定、命令、资格等。
explanation_english: To officially cancel or reverse a previous decision, order, qualification, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官決定撤銷控罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 siu1 hung3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官决定撤销控告。
examples.english_sentence: The judge decided to drop the charges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定撤銷佢嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 cit3 siu1 keoi5 ge3 zik1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定撤销他的职位。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to revoke his position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以隨便撤銷之前嘅承諾㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能随便撤销之前的承诺。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just withdraw your previous promise.

english_meaning: to evacuate, to withdraw, to move out
explanation_mandarin: 从危险或不适宜居住的地区撤退离开。
explanation_english: To withdraw from a dangerous or unsuitable area; to evacuate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府呼籲市民盡快撤離低窪地區。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fu1 jiu3 si5 man4 zeon6 faai3 cit3 lei4 dai1 wat1 dei6 keoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府呼吁市民尽快撤离低洼地区。
examples.english_sentence: The government is urging citizens to evacuate low-lying areas as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於火勢蔓延，我哋要緊急撤離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 fo2 sai3 maan6 jin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gan2 gap1 cit3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于火势蔓延，我们要紧急撤离。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the spreading fire, we need to evacuate immediately.

english_meaning: to move, to allocate, to stir, to push aside, to dial (a number)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他东西移动、拨弄。
explanation_english: To move something with your hand or another object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撥咗啲頭髮落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 but3 zo2 di1 tau4 faat3 lok6 lai4.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 拨出一些时间来做义工吧。
examples.english_sentence: Allocate some time to do volunteer work.

examples.english_sentence: He is dialing the phone.

english_meaning: to right wrongs, to restore order out of chaos, to turn things around
explanation_mandarin: 纠正混乱的局面，使事物恢复正常。
explanation_english: To correct a chaotic situation and restore things to their proper order; to reverse a wrong or mistaken policy and restore it to the correct path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多年嘅努力，我哋終於可以撥亂反正，將公司帶返上正軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 but6 lyun6 faan2 zing3, zoeng1 gung1 si1 daai3 faan1 soeng5 zing3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多年的努力，我们终于可以拨乱反正，将公司带回正轨。
examples.english_sentence: After so many years of hard work, we can finally right the wrongs and bring the company back on track.

examples.english_sentence: The government should quickly correct the chaos and resolve people's livelihood problems.

english_meaning: to make a phone call
explanation_mandarin: 指拨打电话，通常带有较为随意的语气。

explanation_mandarin: 指在繁忙中抽出空闲时间（多用于客套话，请求别人帮忙或出席活动等）。

english_meaning: to dial; to call (on the phone)

english_meaning: to allocate funds, to grant funds, appropriation
explanation_mandarin: 指从财政或机构中拨出款项用于特定的目的。

examples.english_sentence: Before we didn't have broadband, we had to use dial-up internet, it was very slow.

english_meaning: to dial (a phone number); to get through (on the phone)
explanation_mandarin: 指拨打电话号码并成功接通。
explanation_english: Refers to dialing a phone number and successfully connecting the call.

explanation_english: To move something aside or away, typically with a hand or tool, to reveal what is behind it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撥開啲頭髮，等我可以睇清楚佢嘅樣。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 拨开些树叶就看到路了。

english_meaning: to make a phone call
explanation_mandarin: 指拨打或拨通电话。
explanation_english: To dial a phone or make a phone call.

explanation_english: To pull forcefully; to argue aggressively or wrangle, often in a petty or trivial manner; to bicker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日為咗啲小事撦餐死。

examples.english_sentence: Don't pull the cat's tail here!

examples.english_sentence: Move the position
