examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆撫育咗三個仔女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 fu2 juk6 zo2 saam1 go3 zai2 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻抚养了三个子女。
examples.english_sentence: They (the couple) raised three children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撫育下一代係父母嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu2 juk6 haa6 jat1 daai6 hai6 fu6 mou5 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 抚养下一代是父母的责任。
examples.english_sentence: Raising the next generation is the parents' responsibility.

english_meaning: to raise, to rear, to bring up (children)
explanation_mandarin: 照顾和教育孩子成长。
explanation_english: To care for and educate a child as they grow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆撫養咗三個細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 fu2 joeng5 zo2 saam1 go3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻抚养了三个孩子。
examples.english_sentence: That couple raised three children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單親媽媽要撫養個仔，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 can1 maa1 maa1 jiu3 fu2 joeng5 go3 zai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 单亲妈妈要抚养儿子，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: It's really tough for a single mother to raise a son.

mandarin_meaning: 撬开; 挖掘; 挖走
english_meaning: to pry; to lever open; to dig up; to poach (someone's employee); to steal (someone's boyfriend/girlfriend)
explanation_mandarin: 用工具（如棍子、金属杆）强行打开或挖掘；也指挖走他人的人才或伴侣。
explanation_english: To pry open or dig up something using a tool (e.g., a stick, metal bar). It can also mean to poach talent from another company or to steal someone's boyfriend/girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想撬開個鎖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 kiu5 hoi1 go3 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想撬开那个锁。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to pry open the lock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人撬咗牆腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 kiu5 zo2 coeng4 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人挖了墙角。（他的另一半被别人抢走了）
examples.english_sentence: Someone stole his partner. (He got his partner stolen.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司撬咗我哋好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kiu5 zo2 ngo5 dei6 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司挖走了我们很多人。
examples.english_sentence: That company poached a lot of our people.

english_meaning: to steal someone else's partner/employee/customer, to poach, to undermine someone's relationship/business
explanation_mandarin: 比喻挖别人的墙脚，指引诱、争取别人的对象、人才或客户。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to undermine someone else's foundation by enticing away their partner, employee, or customer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想撬我牆角，好煩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 kiu3 ngo5 coeng4 gok3, hou2 faan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想挖我墙角，真烦人！
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to poach my staff, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以撬到佢女朋友啦，佢哋感情好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 kiu3 dou2 keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 laa1, keoi5 dei6 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想挖到他的女朋友了，他们感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about stealing his girlfriend, they have a very good relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司撬咗好多對手嘅客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kiu3 zo2 hou2 do1 deoi3 sau2 ge3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司挖了很多竞争对手的客户。
examples.english_sentence: This company poached a lot of customers from its competitors.

english_meaning: To poach customers; to solicit customers away from a competitor; to steal clients.
explanation_mandarin: 指从竞争对手那里抢走顾客，拉走顾客。
explanation_english: Refers to stealing customers away from a competitor, soliciting customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日喺人哋鋪頭門口撬客啦，咁樣唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 pou3 tau2 mun4 hau2 kiu3 haak3 laa1, gam2 joeng2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是在别人店门口拉客了，这样不好。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't always be poaching customers in front of other people's shops. It's not a good thing to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排生意唔好，好多人出嚟撬客，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 paai1 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 ceot1 lai4 kiu3 haak3, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1烈.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近生意不好，很多人出来拉客，竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: Business has been bad lately, many people are poaching customers, the competition is fierce.

english_meaning: to poach (someone's partner), to steal (someone's girlfriend/boyfriend), to undermine someone's relationship
explanation_mandarin: 比喻破坏别人的关系，尤其是指勾引或抢夺别人的伴侣。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to undermine or sabotage someone's relationship, especially by seducing or stealing their partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住撬我牆腳啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 kiu5 ngo5 coeng4 goek3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想挖我的墙脚！
examples.english_sentence: Don't you even think about poaching my partner!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撬人哋牆腳，冇乜朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kiu5 jan4 dei6 coeng4 goek3, mou5 mat1 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是挖别人的墙脚，没什么朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's always poaching other people's partners, so he doesn't have many friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，有人想撬你牆腳！
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, jau5 jan4 soeng2 kiu5 nei5 coeng4 goek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，有人想挖你的墙脚！
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, someone is trying to steal your partner!

english_meaning: To solicit votes; to poach votes; to swing votes
explanation_mandarin: 指在选举或投票中，通过各种手段积极争取选民的支持，甚至从对方阵营争取选票。
explanation_english: Refers to actively soliciting votes from voters in elections or voting, sometimes even trying to win votes from the opposing side. It often implies using persuasive or strategic tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗贏，唔停咁撬票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 jeng4, m4 ting4 gam2 kiu3 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了赢，不停地拉票。
examples.english_sentence: They are tirelessly soliciting votes in order to win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉好激烈，每個候選人都落力撬票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 hou2 gik1 lit6, mui5 go3 hau6 syun2 jan4 dou1 lok6 lik6 kiu3 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举很激烈，每个候选人都努力拉票。
examples.english_sentence: This election is very intense, every candidate is working hard to solicit votes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住點樣撬票嚟贏啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 kiu3 piu3 lai4 jeng4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算怎么拉票才能赢啊？
examples.english_sentence: How are you planning to solicit votes to win?

english_meaning: To expose someone's lie or trick; to blow someone's cover
explanation_mandarin: 比喻揭露别人的谎言或阴谋，使对方的计划无法继续进行。
explanation_english: A metaphor for exposing someone's lies or schemes, causing their plans to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話俾我撬咗馬腳，依家好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 ngo5 kiu3 zo2 maa5 goek3, ji1 gaa1 hou2 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的谎言被我拆穿了，现在很尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: I exposed his lie, and now he's very embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要撬佢哋嘅馬腳，唔可以俾佢哋陰謀得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 kiu3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 maa5 goek3, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 jam1 mau4 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要揭穿他们的阴谋，不能让他们得逞。
examples.english_sentence: We must expose their scheme and not allow them to succeed.

english_meaning: to broadcast; to sow; to spread; to scatter
explanation_mandarin: 指广播、播放、传播（声音、影像、消息等）
explanation_english: To broadcast (radio, television); to sow seeds; to spread, disseminate (information, ideas, etc.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台今晚會播呢套戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 gam1 maan1 wui5 bo3 ni1 tou3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视台今晚会播放这部电影。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station will broadcast this movie tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好周圍播謠言啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 bo3 jiu4 jin4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要到处散布谣言了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spread rumors everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度播種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 bo3 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里播种。
examples.english_sentence: He's sowing seeds there.

english_meaning: to broadcast; to air (a program)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过广播、电视等媒体播放节目。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of broadcasting a program through media such as radio or television.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚八點會播出個新劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 wui5 bo3 ceot1 go3 san1 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚八点会播出一部新剧。
examples.english_sentence: A new drama will be broadcast at 8 pm tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目喺星期日早上播出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 hai2 sing1 kei4 jat6 zou2 soeng6 bo3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目在星期日早上播出。
examples.english_sentence: This program is broadcast on Sunday mornings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅訪問會喺下個星期播出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fong2 man6 wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 bo3 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的采访会在下个星期播出。
examples.english_sentence: His interview will be broadcast next week.

english_meaning: to broadcast; to play (audio or video); to transmit
explanation_mandarin: 指通过无线电、电视等方式发出声音或图像；也指播放录音、录像等。
explanation_english: To transmit or broadcast audio or video; to play (a recording, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台今晚會播放一個好出名嘅電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 gam1 maan5 wui2 bo3 fong3 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 din6 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电视台今晚会播放一部很有名的电影。
examples.english_sentence: The television station will broadcast a very famous movie tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺電腦度播放緊一首歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 din6 nou5 dou6 bo3 fong3 gan2 jat1 sau2 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在电脑上播放一首歌。
examples.english_sentence: I am playing a song on the computer.

english_meaning: to broadcast, to screen, to show (a film)
explanation_mandarin: 播放影像或影片，通常指通过电视、电影院等媒介进行。
explanation_english: To broadcast or screen visual media, typically through television, cinemas, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚電視會播映一套新嘅電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 din6 si6 wui5 bo3 ying2 jat1 tou3 san1 ge3 din6 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚电视会播放一部新的电影。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight, the television will broadcast a new movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套紀錄片喺好多國家都播映過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 gei3 luk1 pin3 hai2 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 bo3 ying2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部纪录片在很多国家都播放过。
examples.english_sentence: This documentary has been screened in many countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好期待聽日嘅首映禮，到時會全球播映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 ting1 jat6 ge3 sau2 ying2 lai5, dou3 si4 wui5 cyun4 kau4 bo3 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很期待明天的首映礼，到时会全球播放。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really looking forward to tomorrow's premiere, which will be broadcast globally.

english_meaning: to sow seeds; to plant; (slang) to impregnate
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指撒播种子。 在粤语中，有时也用作俚语，指使女性怀孕。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to sow seeds or to plant. In Cantonese, it is sometimes used as slang to mean 'to impregnate'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個花園播種，想種啲花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 faa1 jyun2 bo3 zung2, soeng2 zung3 di1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在花园里播种，想种一些花。
examples.english_sentence: He's sowing seeds in the garden, wanting to plant some flowers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁播種呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 bo3 zung2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱播种啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just go around impregnating people!

english_meaning: broadcasting; to broadcast
explanation_mandarin: 指通过无线电或电视等方式传播声音和图像信息。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of transmitting audio and visual information through radio, television, or other means; broadcasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電台做播音員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 din6 toi4 zou6 bo3 jam1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电台做播音员。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a broadcaster at the radio station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目會喺今晚八點播音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 wui5 hai2 gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 bo3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目会在今晚八点广播。
examples.english_sentence: This program will be broadcast at 8 PM tonight.

english_meaning: radio station; broadcasting station
explanation_mandarin: 指进行广播的机构或场所。
explanation_english: Refers to an organization or place that broadcasts radio programs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間電台係香港最大嘅播音台之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 din6 toi4 hai6 Hoeng1 Gong2 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 bo3 jam1 toi4 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家电台是香港最大的广播电台之一。
examples.english_sentence: This radio station is one of the largest broadcasting stations in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個播音台做節目主持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 bo3 jam1 toi4 zou6 zit3 muk6 zyu2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在广播电台做节目主持人。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a program host at the radio station.

english_meaning: broadcaster, announcer
explanation_mandarin: 指在广播或电视等媒体中进行播音的人。
explanation_english: A person who broadcasts on radio or television.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢夢想係做個成功嘅播音員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 go3 sing4 gung1 ge3 bo3 jam1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一名成功的播音员。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a successful broadcaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個播音員把聲好甜美。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo3 jam1 jyun4 baa2 seng1 hou2 tim4 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个播音员的声音很甜美。
examples.english_sentence: That broadcaster's voice is very sweet.

english_meaning: broadcasting studio
explanation_mandarin: 进行广播节目的房间。
explanation_english: A room used for broadcasting radio or television programs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺播音室做緊直播節目呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 bo3 jam1 sat1 zou6 gan2 zik6 bo3 zit3 muk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在广播室做直播节目啊。
examples.english_sentence: They are doing a live broadcast program in the broadcasting studio.

mandarin_meaning: 扩音器; 大声公; 爱炫耀的人
english_meaning: megaphone; loudmouth; show-off
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指扩音器，喇叭。 2. 比喻爱炫耀，到处宣扬自己的人。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a megaphone or loudspeaker. 2. Figuratively refers to someone who loves to show off and boast about themselves everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人成日好似個播音筒咁，周圍同人講佢幾叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 hou2 ci5 go3 bo3 jam1 tung4 gam2, zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2 keoi5 gei2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人整天像个大喇叭一样，到处跟别人说他有多厉害。
examples.english_sentence: That person is always like a megaphone, telling everyone how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個播音筒嘅聲浪好大，搞到我聽唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo3 jam1 tung4 ge3 seng1 long6 hou2 daai6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ting1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那扩音器的声音很大，搞得我听不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The megaphone's volume is so loud that I can't hear clearly.

english_meaning: a pinch; a small amount (taken with fingertips); to pinch
explanation_mandarin: 用手指捏取少量东西的动作或数量。
explanation_english: The action of taking a small amount of something with one's fingertips; a small quantity pinched between the fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 加少少鹽咪得囉，唔使咁多，撮少少就夠㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 siu2 siu2 jim4 mai1 dak1 lo3, m4 sai2 gam3 do1, cyut3 siu2 siu2 zau6 gau3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加少量的盐就可以了，不用那么多，捏一点点就够了。
examples.english_sentence: Just add a little salt, you don't need that much. Just a pinch will do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撮咗啲茶葉出嚟沖茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyut3 zo2啲 caa4 jip6 ceot1 lai4 cung1 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他捏了一些茶叶出来泡茶。
examples.english_sentence: He pinched some tea leaves to make tea.

english_meaning: to matchmake; to bring together; to reconcile
explanation_mandarin: 促成男女婚事或促成双方合作。
explanation_english: To bring two people together, especially for marriage; to act as a matchmaker. Also, to bring two parties together to collaborate or reconcile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想撮合佢個仔同佢個同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 cyut3 hap6 keoi5 go3 zai2 tung4 keoi5 go3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想撮合他的儿子和他的同事。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to matchmake his son with his colleague.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你撮合我哋兩個，我哋先可以喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 cyut3 hap6 ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3, ngo5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你撮合我们俩，我们才能在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for matchmaking us, that's why we can be together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望可以撮合到佢哋傾掂數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 cyut3 hap6 dou3 keoi5 dei6 king1 dim6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望可以促成他们谈妥。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can bring them together to reach an agreement.

english_meaning: sketch; quick sketch; to sketch
explanation_mandarin: 指用简练的笔法快速地描绘出事物的大概轮廓或主要特征。 可以是动词，表示动作；也可以是名词，表示速写作品。
explanation_english: To sketch; to make a quick drawing, often focusing on capturing the essence or basic form of a subject. It can be used as a verb (to sketch) or a noun (the sketch).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗幾分鐘就撮寫咗幅風景畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 gei2 fan1 jung1 zau6 cyut3 se2 zo2 fuk1 fung1 ging2 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了几分钟就速写了一幅风景画。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 一进入面包店，面包的香味就扑鼻而来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as I entered the bakery, the smell of bread assailed my nostrils.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園啲花真係香到撲鼻，好舒服啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun4 di1 faa1 zan1 hai6 hoeng1 dou3 pok3 bei6, hou2 syu1 fuk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园里的花真的很香，香味扑鼻，很舒服啊。
examples.english_sentence: The flowers in this garden are so fragrant, the scent assails my nostrils, it's very comfortable.

english_meaning: to press; to push; to depress (a button or switch)
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或物体向下按压。
explanation_english: To press or push down with a finger or object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撳個掣就開到燈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam6 go3 zai3 zau6 hoi1 dou3 dang1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按一下按钮就可以开灯了。
examples.english_sentence: Press the button and the light will turn on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撳住我隻手唔畀我走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam6 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 m4 bei2 ngo5 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他按住我的手不让我走。
examples.english_sentence: He held down my hand to prevent me from leaving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好太大力撳部電腦，會整壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taai3 daai6 lik6 gam6 bou6 din6 nou5, wui2 zing2 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太用力按电脑，会弄坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't press the computer too hard, you'll break it.

english_meaning: to rob someone while holding them down; to exploit someone ruthlessly; to take advantage of someone in a vulnerable position
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是按住某人然后抢夺。引申为利用对方的弱势地位，趁机掠夺、榨取利益，手段非常不光彩。
explanation_english: Literally means to hold someone down and rob them. Figuratively, it means to exploit someone's vulnerability and take advantage of them for personal gain in a ruthless and unscrupulous manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲發展商成日都撳住嚟搶，啲小市民真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 faat3 zin2 soeng1 sing4 jat6 dou1 gam6 zyu6 lai4 coeng2, di1 siu2 si5 man4 zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些开发商总是趁人之危，小市民真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: These developers always exploit people ruthlessly; the ordinary citizens are really suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知我急住用錢，都仲要撳住嚟搶，簡直係無良。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 ngo5 gap1 zyu6 jung6 cin2, dou1 zung1 jiu3 gam6 zyu6 lai4 coeng2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 mou4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明知道我急着用钱，还要趁机敲诈，简直是没良心。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knew I needed money urgently, yet he still took advantage of me ruthlessly; he's simply heartless.

synonyms: 趁火打劫 (can3 fo2 daa2 gip3)

english_meaning: to hold (someone) down (by the head); to suppress; to keep (someone) under control; to keep (someone) down
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是按住别人的头。比喻压制、控制别人，使之无法发展或反抗。
explanation_english: Literally means to hold someone's head down. Figuratively, it means to suppress, control, or keep someone down, preventing them from developing or resisting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日撳住頭，唔俾我哋有機會發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 gam6 zyu6 tau4, m4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 jau5 gei1 wui2 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是压着我们，不给我们发展的机会。
examples.english_sentence: They are always suppressing us, not giving us the opportunity to develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住撳住頭就搞得掂我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 gam6 zyu6 tau4 zau6 gaau2 dak1 dim6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想着用压制的方法就能搞定我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can control me by suppressing me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直俾佢阿媽撳住頭，所以好冇自信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 bei2 keoi5 aa3 maa1 gam6 zyu6 tau4, so2 ji5 hou2 mou5 zi6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直被他妈妈压着，所以很没有自信。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been suppressed by his mother, so he has no confidence.

english_meaning: To stay put; to not make progress; to be stagnant
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物停留在原地，没有进展或改变。 比喻在原地做无用功，没有效果。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that remains in the same place without making any progress or change. It's a metaphor for putting in effort without achieving any results, like 'swimming on land'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係撳地游水，都冇用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 gam6 dei6 jau4 seoi2, dou1 mou5 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是原地踏步吗，没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is just like swimming on land; it's useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔改變策略，我哋咪變咗撳地游水？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 goi2 bin3 caak3 leuk6, ngo5 dei6 mai1 bin3 zo2 gam6 dei6 jau4 seoi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不改变策略，我们不就原地踏步了吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we don't change our strategy, won't we just be swimming on land (making no progress)?

english_meaning: to press a button; to push a button
explanation_mandarin: 用手指或其他工具按下按钮。
explanation_english: To press a button with a finger or other tool. Typically refers to activating a device or function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 撳掣就可以開電視喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam6 zai3 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 din6 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按一下按钮就可以打开电视了。
examples.english_sentence: You can turn on the TV by pressing the button.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁撳掣呀，會搞壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 zai3 aa3, wui5 gaau2 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱按按钮，会弄坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't press the buttons randomly, you'll break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撳掣叫咗 lift 上嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam6 zai3 giu3 zo2 lift soeng5 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他按了按钮叫电梯上来。
examples.english_sentence: He pressed the button to call the elevator up.

english_meaning: To operate a machine; to press buttons; to use an ATM
explanation_mandarin: 指操作机器，通常指操作自动柜员机（ATM）或按下机器的按钮。
explanation_english: Refers to operating a machine, usually an Automated Teller Machine (ATM) or pressing buttons on a machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日撳機撳咗五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 gam6 gei1 gam6 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天在ATM取了五百元。
examples.english_sentence: I withdrew five hundred dollars from the ATM yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你撳邊個掣可以開冷氣呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam6 bin1 go3 zai3 ho2 ji5 hoi1 laang5 hei3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你按哪个按钮可以开空调呀？
examples.english_sentence: Which button do you press to turn on the air conditioner?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掛住撳機，都唔理我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 gam6 gei1, dou1 m4 lei5 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天只顾着玩手机，都不理我。
examples.english_sentence: He's always busy using his phone and doesn't pay attention to me.

mandarin_meaning: 压下去; 压制; 否决
english_meaning: To suppress; to shelve; to veto; to pressure down; to put down; to override
explanation_mandarin: 比喻将某事压下去，使其不能发展或进行；否决提案。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means to suppress something, preventing it from developing or proceeding; to veto a proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想撳沉呢單新聞，唔想咁多人知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gam6 cam4 ni1 daan1 san1 man4, m4 soeng2 gam3 do1 jan4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想压下这则新闻，不想这么多人知道。
examples.english_sentence: They want to suppress this news story, they don't want so many people to know about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個提案俾佢哋撳沉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tai4 on3 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gam6 cam4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个提案被他们否决了。
examples.english_sentence: This proposal was vetoed by them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住可以撳沉我嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 gam6 cam4 ngo5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为你可以压制我的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can suppress my opinion.

english_meaning: click pen, retractable pen
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以通过按动笔杆尾部来伸出或缩回笔芯的圆珠笔。
explanation_english: A type of ballpoint pen where the tip is extended or retracted by pressing a button or clip, usually at the end of the pen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢枝撳芯筆好順滑，好好寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 ngam6 sam1 bat1 hou2 seon6 waat6, hou2 hou2 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支按动圆珠笔很顺滑，很好写。
examples.english_sentence: This click pen is very smooth and writes well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日唔記得撳返枝撳芯筆個芯入去，搞到袋裡面污糟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 ngam6 faan1 zi1 ngam6 sam1 bat1 go3 sam1 jap6 heoi3, gaau2 dou3 doi2 lei5 min6 wu1 zou1晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是忘记把按动圆珠笔的笔芯按回去，弄得口袋里面脏兮兮的。
examples.english_sentence: I always forget to retract the tip of the click pen, making my pocket all dirty.

english_meaning: to veto, to block, to shelve, to table (a proposal)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻否决、搁置或阻止某项提议或计划。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, to veto, block, or shelve a proposal or plan. Implies preventing something from moving forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個提案俾佢撳釘咗，冇得再傾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tai4 on3 bei2 keoi5 gam6 ding3 zo2, mou5 dak1 zoi3 king1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个提案被他否决了，没法再谈了。
examples.english_sentence: This proposal was vetoed by him, there's no point in discussing it further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我驚佢撳釘我嘅計劃，所以唔敢同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 keoi5 gam6 ding3 ngo5 ge3 gai3 waak6, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我怕他会否决我的计划，所以不敢和他讲。
examples.english_sentence: I'm afraid he'll veto my plan, so I don't dare tell him.

english_meaning: to withdraw money (from an ATM); to press for money
explanation_mandarin: 从自动提款机(ATM)提取现金；也指催促别人给钱。
explanation_english: To withdraw cash from an ATM (Automated Teller Machine). It can also mean to press someone for money, especially if they owe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏晝要去銀行撳錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 zau3 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong2 gam6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午要去银行取钱。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the bank to withdraw money this afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都唔夠錢使，要問屋企人撳錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gau3 cin2 sai2, jiu3 man6 uk1 kei2 jan4 gam6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是不够钱用，要问家人要钱。
examples.english_sentence: I never have enough money, I have to ask my family for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢欠我好多錢，我要撳佢錢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him3 ngo5 hou2 do1 cin2, ngo5 jiu3 gam6 keoi5 cin2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠我很多钱，我得催他给钱。
examples.english_sentence: He owes me a lot of money, I need to press him for the money.

english_meaning: to press a bell; to ring a bell
explanation_mandarin: 按压钟的按钮以发出声音。
explanation_english: To press the button of a bell to make it ring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺門口撳鐘，但係冇人應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 mun4 hau2 ngam6 zung1, daan6 hai6 mou5 jan4 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在门口按铃，但是没有人应答。
examples.english_sentence: He rang the doorbell, but no one answered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺醫院撳鐘，會騷擾到病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ji1 yun2 ngam6 zung1, wui5 sou1 jiu2 dou3 beng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在医院按铃，会骚扰到病人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ring the bell in the hospital, it will disturb the patients.

english_meaning: To press the doorbell; To push or rush (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是按小铃。 比喻催促别人快点行动，或催促事情尽快完成。
explanation_english: Literally means to press a small bell. Figuratively, it means to urge someone to hurry up or to push for a quick completion of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日撳鐘仔啦，我趕緊做緊㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gam2 zung1 zai2 laa1, ngo5 gon2 gan2 zou6 gan2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是催促我，我正在赶着做呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep rushing me, I'm hurrying up to get it done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔交功課，我就要撳鐘仔㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, ngo5 zau6 jiu3 gam2 zung1 zai2 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不交作业，我就要催你交了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't hand in your homework, I'm going to have to push you to do it.

english_meaning: to waste time; to procrastinate; to delay
explanation_mandarin: 指无所事事地浪费时间，拖延工作或任务。多形容不认真对待事情，拖延时间。
explanation_english: Refers to wasting time idly, procrastinating on work or tasks. It often describes someone who doesn't take things seriously and delays things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再撳鐳啦，快啲做完啲功課佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gam6 leoi4 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 di1 gung1 fo3 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再浪费时间了，快点做完作业吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop wasting time, hurry up and finish your homework!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撳鐳，所以啲嘢永遠都做唔完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gam6 leoi4, so2 ji5 di1 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 zou6 m4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是浪费时间，所以事情永远都做不完。
examples.english_sentence: He always wastes time, so he never finishes anything.

english_meaning: impatient; unable to restrain oneself; unable to keep a secret
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人性子急，沉不住气，容易泄露秘密或做出冲动的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is impatient, unable to restrain themselves, and prone to blurting out secrets or acting impulsively. The term originates from the sound a partridge makes when disturbed and suddenly flies away, suggesting a sudden and uncontrolled action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁撳鷓鴣啦，等我講埋佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ze3 gu1 laa1, dang2 ngo5 gong2 maai4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么着急，等我说完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impatient, let me finish talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好撳鷓鴣，有咩秘密都守唔住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gam3 ze3 gu1, jau5 me1 bei3 mat6 dou1 sau2 m4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很急躁，有什么秘密都守不住。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very impatient person, he can't keep any secrets.

english_meaning: to press the elevator button, to call the elevator
explanation_mandarin: 指按下电梯按钮，召唤电梯。
explanation_english: Refers to pressing the elevator button to call the elevator.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我撳𨋢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 gam6 lip1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦帮我按一下电梯。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me press the elevator button.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都唔撳𨋢就走咗去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 gam6 lip1 zau6 zau2 zo2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是没按电梯就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He always leaves without pressing the elevator button.

mandarin_meaning: 摔，跌倒，失败；批评，指责；抛弃，分手
english_meaning: to fall; to stumble; to fail; to criticize; to dump (a boyfriend/girlfriend)
explanation_mandarin: 表示跌倒、摔倒；也指事情失败、落空；引申指批评、指责；还可指男女朋友分手。
explanation_english: Indicates falling or stumbling; also refers to failure or falling through of an event; by extension, it can mean to criticize or blame; it can also refer to a breakup between boyfriend and girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，撻親咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, taat3 can1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: He wasn't careful while walking and stumbled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾條女撻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 tiu4 neoi2 taat3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被女朋友甩了。
examples.english_sentence: He got dumped by his girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日撻人啦，顧下人哋感受啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 taat3 jan4 laa1, gu3 haa5 jan4 dei6 gam2 sau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是批评别人了，顾及一下别人的感受吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop criticizing people all the time, consider other people's feelings.

mandarin_meaning: 失误; 搞砸; 失败
english_meaning: to fail; to screw up; to misfire; to choke
explanation_mandarin: 原指打桌球时击球失误，导致没有击中目标球。引申为做事情失败，搞砸，或者在关键时刻掉链子。
explanation_english: Originally refers to miscuing in billiards/pool, resulting in missing the target ball.  By extension, it means to fail at something, to screw up, or to choke at a crucial moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我撻Q咗，乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 taat3 kiu1 zo2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我搞砸了，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: I screwed up the exam this time, I couldn't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺比賽嘅最後關頭撻Q咗，攞唔到冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bei2 coi3 ge3 zeoi3 hau6 gwaan1 tau4 taat3 kiu1 zo2, lo2 m4 dou2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛的最后关头失败了，没拿到冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He choked at the last moment of the competition and didn't win the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張，如果撻Q咗都唔緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, jyu4 gwo2 taat3 kiu1 zo2 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么紧张，如果失败了也没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, it doesn't matter if you screw up.

english_meaning: to finalize, to confirm, to settle (a matter)
explanation_mandarin: 指最终决定或确认某事，使之确定下来。
explanation_english: To finalize or confirm something, making it definite or settled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經撻定咗下個禮拜開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 taat3 ding6 zo2 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经确定了下个星期开会。
examples.english_sentence: We have already finalized the meeting for next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話要撻定呢個計劃先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 taat3 ding6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说要先敲定这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said he wants to finalize this plan first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋撻定咗去邊度旅行未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 taat3 ding6 zo2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们确定好去哪里旅行了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have we finalized where to travel to yet?

english_meaning: To default on a debt; to welch on a payment; to renege on a deal; to stiff someone; to flake
explanation_mandarin: 指欠债不还，拖欠账款或赖账的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of not repaying a debt, delaying payment, or defaulting on a financial obligation. It implies a breach of trust or agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撻數，冇人敢借錢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 taat3 sou3, mou5 jan4 gam2 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是赖账，没人敢借钱给他。
examples.english_sentence: He always defaults on his debts, so nobody dares to lend him money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好撻數啊，講好嘅數目要找清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taat3 sou3 aa3, gong2 hou2 ge3 sou3 muk6 jiu3 zaau2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要赖账啊，说好的数目要算清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't welch on the deal, you have to settle the agreed amount clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔信佢會撻數嘅，佢一向都好準時還錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 wui5 taat3 sou3 ge3, keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4 waan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不相信他会赖账的，他一直都按时还钱。
examples.english_sentence: I don't believe he would default; he always pays back money on time.

english_meaning: To drop names, to use someone's name to intimidate or gain advantage
explanation_mandarin: 指利用某人的名声或地位来威胁他人，或为自己谋取利益。
explanation_english: To invoke someone's name or position, usually of a person with authority or influence, to intimidate others or gain an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日撻朵喇，自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 taat3 doe2 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是报上名号，自己搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always drop names, just handle it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日撻朵，話自己識得好多老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 taat3 doe2, waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 dak1 hou2 do1 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是报上名号，说自己认识很多老板。
examples.english_sentence: He always drops names, saying he knows a lot of bosses.

english_meaning: to fall to one's death; to be killed by falling; to die from a fall
explanation_mandarin: 指从高处跌落而死亡。
explanation_english: Refers to dying from falling from a high place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爬上棵樹，點知唔小心撻死咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paa4 soeng5 go1 syu6, dim2 zi1 m4 siu2 sam1 taat3 sei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爬上树，结果不小心摔死了。
examples.english_sentence: He climbed the tree, but accidentally fell to his death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺啲危險嘅地方行嚟行去，好易會撻死㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 di1 ngai4 him2 ge3 dei6 fong1 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, hou2 ji6 wui5 taat3 sei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在危险的地方走来走去，很容易摔死的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk around in dangerous places, you could easily fall to your death.

english_meaning: Slippers; flip-flops
explanation_mandarin: 一种轻便的鞋子，通常在室内或休闲场合穿着。
explanation_english: A type of light footwear that is typically worn indoors or in casual settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺屋企鍾意著撻沙，舒服啲嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 zung1 ji3 zoek3 taat3 saa1, syu1 fuk6 di1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在家里喜欢穿拖鞋，舒服一点嘛。
examples.english_sentence: I like wearing slippers at home, it's more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好著住撻沙周街走啦，好肉酸㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 zyu6 taat3 saa1 zau1 gaai1 zau2 laa1, hou2 juk6 saan1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要穿着拖鞋在街上到处走啊，很丢脸的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't walk around the street in slippers, it's embarrassing!

english_meaning: busybody, meddler, someone who is always moving around and interfering
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人喜欢到处走动，管别人的事情，多带贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who likes to move around a lot and interfere in other people's business, often with a negative connotation. Similar to a flatfish (撻沙) which lies flat on the seabed and moves around a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度撻沙魚，乜嘢都要問一餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 taat3 saa1 jyu2, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 jat1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天到处打听，什么都要问一遍。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being a busybody, asking about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做咁多撻沙魚啦，人哋嘅嘢由得佢哋自己搞掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 gam3 do1 taat3 saa1 jyu2 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 jau4 dak1 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别管那么多闲事了，别人的事情让他们自己解决吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop being such a busybody, let them sort out their own things.

english_meaning: To make a fool of oneself; to embarrass oneself; to lose face; to make a blunder
explanation_mandarin: 指在公众场合或重要场合表现失误，做出令人尴尬的事情，导致自己或他人丢脸。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake or blunder in public or an important occasion, causing embarrassment to oneself or others; to lose face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日喺台上唱歌，唱到走晒音，真係撻晒生魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 go1, coeng3 dou3 zau2 saai3 jam1, zan1 hai6 taat3 saai3 saang1 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在台上唱歌，唱得完全跑调了，真是丢尽了脸。
examples.english_sentence: He sang out of tune on stage yesterday, it was really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺咁多人面前講錯嘢，唔係嘅話好易撻生魚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5, m4 hai6 ge3 waa2 hou2 ji6 taat3 saang1 yu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这么多人面前说错话，不然很容易出丑的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say the wrong thing in front of so many people, or you'll easily embarrass yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 耍赖; 不讲理; 蛮不讲理
english_meaning: To be unreasonable; to be difficult; to be a pain; to act like a rogue; to be a troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 指人蛮横无理，故意找麻烦，不讲道理。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is unreasonable, deliberately causing trouble, and not listening to reason. It often implies a stubborn and troublesome attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁撻皮啦，好無？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 taat3 pei4 laa1, hou2 mou4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么耍赖好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unreasonable, okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺度撻皮，真係好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 dou6 taat3 pei4, zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在那里耍赖，真的很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He's being a pain every day, it's so annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個客仔撻皮唔肯俾錢，我哋都唔知點算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 haak3 zai2 taat3 pei4 m4 hang2 bei2 cin2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个顾客耍赖不肯付钱，我们都不知道怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: That customer is being unreasonable and refusing to pay, we don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 启动; 发动; 点燃
english_meaning: to start (an engine); to ignite; to be triggered (emotionally); to click (with someone romantically)
explanation_mandarin: 1. （指发动机）启动，发动。2. 点燃。3. （比喻）情绪被激发。4. （比喻）对某人产生好感或兴趣，开始交往。
explanation_english: 1. To start (an engine, vehicle, etc.). 2. To ignite or light something (e.g., a fire). 3. (Figurative) To be triggered or to have one's emotions stirred up. 4. (Slang, Figurative) To click with someone romantically; to develop a crush or romantic interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撻唔着，唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 taat3 m4 zoek3, m4 zi1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车启动不了，不知道怎么回事。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't start, I don't know what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰句嘢即刻撻着咗我把火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 geoi3 je5 zik1 hak1 taat3 zoek3 zo2 ngo5 baa2 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的这句话立刻点燃了我的怒火。
examples.english_sentence: What he said immediately triggered my anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢好似有啲撻着，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 taat3 zoek3, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好像对他有点意思，不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: I think I'm starting to have a crush on him, I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to ignite; to start (usually refers to a vehicle); to click; to feel a spark (of connection, romance)
explanation_mandarin: 原指用火点燃东西，多指启动车辆引擎。引申义指人与人之间产生火花，感觉来电。
explanation_english: Originally refers to igniting something with fire, often referring to starting a vehicle engine. The extended meaning refers to a spark between people, a feeling of connection or chemistry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撻唔著，唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 taat3 m4 zoek6, m4 zi1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车打不着火，不知道怎么回事。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't start, I don't know what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋第一次見面就撻著咗，好似認識咗好耐咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 zau6 taat3 zoek6 zo2, hou2 ci5 jing6 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们第一次见面就来电了，好像认识了很久一样。
examples.english_sentence: We clicked the first time we met, like we'd known each other for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋傾咗幾句就撻著咗，睇嚟好有機會發展落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 king1 zo2 gei2 geoi3 zau6 taat3 zoek6 zo2, tai2 lai4 hou2 jau5 gei1 wui2 faat3 zin2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们聊了几句就来电了，看来很有机会发展下去。
examples.english_sentence: They clicked after a few words, seems like there's a good chance they'll develop a relationship.

english_meaning: to forfeit a deposit; to break a contract and lose the deposit; to renege on a deal, losing the deposit paid
explanation_mandarin: 指买方或预订方违背合同或协议，放弃之前支付的定金或押金。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of a buyer or a party making a reservation breaking a contract or agreement, forfeiting the deposit or down payment previously paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗間樓花，但係因為層樓跌價，所以佢寧願撻訂都唔要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gaan1 lau4 faa1, daan6 hai6 jan1 wai6 cang4 lau4 dit3 gaa3, so2 ji5 keoi5 ning4 jyun2 taat3 deng3 dou1 m4 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一套期房，但是因为房价下跌，所以他宁愿损失定金也不要了。
examples.english_sentence: He bought an apartment off-plan, but because the price dropped, he would rather forfeit the deposit than take it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你如果撻訂，筆錢就無曬㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jyu4 gwo2 taat3 deng3, bat1 cin2 zau6 mou5 saai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你违约，这笔钱就都没了。
examples.english_sentence: If you forfeit the deposit, all the money will be gone.

english_meaning: to start a car (engine)
explanation_mandarin: 指启动汽车的发动机。撻：启动，突然启动。車：汽车。
explanation_english: Refers to starting a car's engine. 撻 (taat3): to start, to suddenly start. 車 (ce1): car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，快啲撻車走啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, faai3 di1 taat3 ce1 zau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，快点启动车走吧！
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, start the car quickly and let's go!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撻唔着，唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 taat3 m4 zoek6, m4 zi1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子启动不了，不知道怎么回事。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't start, I don't know what's wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撻車好順，一撻就着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taat3 ce1 hou2 seon6, jat1 taat3 zau6 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他启动车很顺利，一启动就着。
examples.english_sentence: He starts the car very smoothly, it starts right away.

english_meaning: to start, to begin, to initiate, to launch (an activity or project)
explanation_mandarin: 指开始做某件事，通常是开始一项新的活动、项目或计划。也可以引申为事情的开端。
explanation_english: Refers to starting or beginning something, usually a new activity, project, or plan. It can also refer to the beginning of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日撻頭搞個新嘅活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 taat3 tau4 gaau2 go3 san1 ge3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天开始搞一个新的活动。
examples.english_sentence: We will start a new activity tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project 幾時撻頭啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project gei2 si4 taat3 tau4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目什么时候开始？
examples.english_sentence: When does this project start?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋撻頭做生意喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 taat3 tau4 zou6 saang1 ji3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开始做生意了。
examples.english_sentence: They started doing business.

english_meaning: to bump; to collide; to ram; to confront; to challenge
explanation_mandarin: 指猛烈地碰撞，也指顶撞，对抗。
explanation_english: Refers to a violent collision or impact. It can also mean to confront, challenge, or contradict someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋架車撼埋咗一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa3 che1 haam6 maai4 zo2 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的车撞到一起了。
examples.english_sentence: Their cars collided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同佢撼頭啊，佢好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 haam6 tau4 aa3, keoi5 hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别和他顶撞，他很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't confront him, he's very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢哋撼，人哋好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 haam6, yan4 dei6 hou2 do1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和他们硬碰硬，他们人很多。
examples.english_sentence: Don't confront them head-on, there are many of them.

english_meaning: to shake, to rock, to convulse, to disturb, to affect profoundly
explanation_mandarin: 使…动摇；使…受到影响。
explanation_english: To cause something to shake or be disturbed; to affect something profoundly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事撼動咗佢嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ham6 dung6 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事撼动了他的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: This event shook his values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟衰退撼動咗整個金融市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 seoi1 teoi3 ham6 dung6 zo2 zing2 go3 gam1 yung4 si5 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济衰退撼动了整个金融市场。
examples.english_sentence: The economic recession shook the entire financial market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講撼動咗在場嘅每一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin2 gong2 ham6 dung6 zo2 zoi6 cheung4 ge3 mui5 jat1 go3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲撼动了在场的每一个人。
examples.english_sentence: His speech moved everyone present.

english_meaning: to bang one's head against the wall (literally); to be extremely frustrated and regretful; to be at one's wits' end
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是用头撞墙。比喻非常懊恼、后悔，或者走投无路，不知如何是好。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to bang one's head against the wall. Figuratively, it describes a state of extreme frustration, regret, or feeling at a dead end, not knowing what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔合格，佢覺得好後悔，好似想撼頭埋牆咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 hau6 fui3, hou2 ci5 soeng2 haam6 tau4 maai4 coeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试没及格，他觉得很后悔，好像想撞墙一样。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and felt so regretful, it was like he wanted to bang his head against the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份project deadline就到，但係仲未開始做，真係想撼頭埋牆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 project deadline zau6 dou3, daan6 hai6 zung6 mei6 hoi1 ci2 zou6, zan1 hai6 soeng2 haam6 tau4 maai4 coeng4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的项目截止日期就要到了，但是还没开始做，真的想撞墙！
examples.english_sentence: The deadline for my project is approaching, but I haven't even started working on it yet, I really want to bang my head against the wall!

english_meaning: to scratch; to claw; to grab (and pull)
explanation_mandarin: 用指甲或尖锐的东西在物体表面划过或抓取。
explanation_english: To scratch or claw with nails or sharp objects, or to grab and pull something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再撾塊面啦，再撾就損㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 waa1 faai3 min6 laa1, zoi3 waa1 zau6 syun2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再抓脸了，再抓就破了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scratch your face anymore, or it will get damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到係咁撾牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 hai6 gam2 waa1 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气到一直在抓墙。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he kept clawing at the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓撾咗我一嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 waa1 zo2 ngo5 jat1 neoe5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫抓了我一下。
examples.english_sentence: The cat scratched me.

english_meaning: to pick up; to gather; to collect
explanation_mandarin: 从地上或其他地方拾取东西。
explanation_english: To pick something up from the ground or another place; to gather or collect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺地下撿到個銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dei6 haa2 gim2 dou2 go3 ngan2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在地上捡到一个钱包。
examples.english_sentence: I picked up a wallet from the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去沙灘撿貝殼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 saa1 taan1 gim2 bui3 hok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去沙滩捡贝壳。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the beach to collect seashells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好周圍撿嘢食，好污糟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 gim2 je5 sik6, hou2 wu1 zou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要到处捡东西吃，很脏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pick up food to eat everywhere, it's very dirty.

english_meaning: to pick up; to collect; to gather
explanation_mandarin: 用手或工具从地上或某个地方拿起来。指拾取掉落或散落的物品。
explanation_english: To pick up from the ground or a place using hands or tools; to collect dropped or scattered items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺沙灘度撿拾貝殼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 gim2 sap6 bui3 hok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在沙滩上捡贝壳。
examples.english_sentence: We are picking up seashells on the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條街度撿拾咗個銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 gim2 sap6 zo2 go3 ngan2 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上捡到了一个钱包。
examples.english_sentence: He picked up a wallet on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清潔工會定時撿拾垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 git3 gung1 wui5 ding6 si4 gim2 sap6 laap1 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清洁工会定时捡拾垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: Cleaners will regularly pick up litter.

english_meaning: to hug, to embrace, to crowd
explanation_mandarin: 抱；聚集，挤。
explanation_english: To hug or embrace; to crowd or gather together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個擁埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jung2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人拥抱在一起。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them hugged each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擁埋嚟，逼死人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung2 maai4 lai4, bik1 sei2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要挤过来，要挤死人了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't crowd around, you're going to crush someone.

english_meaning: to maintain an army to build up one's own power; to possess military strength and use it for personal gain; to use military power to further one's own interests
explanation_mandarin: 拥有军队，凭借武力，以巩固和扩张自己的势力。
explanation_english: To possess an army and use military force to consolidate and expand one's own power and influence. It typically refers to situations where a military leader uses their armed forces for personal gain or to challenge central authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時軍閥擁兵自重，搞到成個國家亂晒籠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2陣時 gwan1 fat3 jung2 bing1 zi6 zung6, gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 gwok3 gaa1 lyun6晒lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时军阀拥兵自重，搞得整个国家一片混乱。
examples.english_sentence: At that time, the warlords maintained armies for their own benefit, causing chaos throughout the entire country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司啲部門主管個個都擁兵自重，咁公司就好難有效率咁運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 di1 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2 go3 go3 dou1 jung2 bing1 zi6 zung6, gam2 gung1 si1 hau2 nan4 jau5 haau6 leot2 gam2 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司的部门主管个个都拥兵自重，那么公司就很难有效率地运作。
examples.english_sentence: If every department head in the company maintains their own power base, it will be difficult for the company to operate efficiently.

english_meaning: to embrace and kiss, to kiss passionately
explanation_mandarin: 指拥抱和亲吻，表达爱意的一种方式。
explanation_english: To embrace and kiss, expressing affection or passion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺月光下擁吻，浪漫到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 jyut6 gwong1 haa6 jung2 man5, long6 maan6 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在月光下拥吻，浪漫极了。
examples.english_sentence: They embraced and kissed under the moonlight, it was incredibly romantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會完咗，佢擁吻住女朋友嚟慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yin2 cheung3 wui2 yun4 zo2, keoi5 jung2 man5 zyu6 neoi5 pang4 jau5 lai4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会结束后，他拥吻着女朋友来庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: After the concert ended, he embraced and kissed his girlfriend to celebrate.

english_meaning: to support, to endorse, to acclaim, to rally around
explanation_mandarin: 推举并拥护；拥护爱戴。
explanation_english: To support and endorse someone, especially a leader or a cause. To rally around someone or something with enthusiasm and loyalty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民好擁戴佢做特首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 hou2 jung2 daai3 keoi5 zou6 dak6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民很拥戴他当特首。
examples.english_sentence: The citizens strongly support him to be the Chief Executive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家一致擁戴佢做主席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 ga1 jat1 zai3 jung2 daai3 keoi5 zou6 zyu2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一致拥戴他当主席。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone unanimously supports him to be the chairman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊贏咗，球迷們擁戴佢哋嘅領隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 wing4 zo2, kau4 mei5 mun4 jung2 daai3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ling5 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队赢了，球迷们拥戴他们的领队。
examples.english_sentence: The team won, and the fans acclaimed their manager.

english_meaning: to embrace; to hug
explanation_mandarin: 用双臂抱住（人或物）。
explanation_english: To hold (someone or something) closely in one's arms; to hug.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好耐冇見，一見面就擁抱咗一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 jung2 pou5 zo2 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很久没见面了，一见面就拥抱了一下。
examples.english_sentence: They haven't seen each other for a long time, and they hugged when they met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢需要一個擁抱嚟安慰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 jung2 pou5 lai4 on1 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她需要一个拥抱来安慰。
examples.english_sentence: She needs a hug for comfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋擁抱新科技，希望可以改善生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jung2 pou5 san1 fo1 gei6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gai2 sin6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们拥抱新技术，希望可以改善生活。
examples.english_sentence: We embrace new technology, hoping to improve our lives.

english_meaning: crowded, congested, packed
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或物密集，非常拥挤。
explanation_english: Describing a place or situation where people or things are packed together, very crowded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日地鐵真係好擁擠呀，迫到我差啲上唔到車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 dei6 tit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jung2 zai1 aa3, bik1 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 soeng5 m4 dou2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天地铁真的很拥挤，挤得我差点上不了车。
examples.english_sentence: The subway was really crowded yesterday; I almost couldn't get on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣，花車巡遊條街逼到擁擠不堪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6, faa1 ce1 seon4 jau4 tiu4 gaai1 bik1 dou3 jung2 zai1 bat1 ham1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，花车巡游那条街挤得拥挤不堪。
examples.english_sentence: During the Chinese New Year, the street where the float parade takes place is extremely crowded.

english_meaning: to possess, to have, to own
explanation_mandarin: 表示占有或具有某种事物或能力。
explanation_english: To possess something; to have something; to own something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擁有好多樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing1 jau5 hou2 do1 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拥有很多房子。
examples.english_sentence: He owns a lot of apartments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司擁有好多專利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 wing1 jau5 hou2 do1 zyun1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司拥有很多专利。
examples.english_sentence: This company owns a lot of patents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擁有做呢件事嘅能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wing1 jau5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拥有做这件事的能力。
examples.english_sentence: You have the ability to do this.

english_meaning: to support and establish (a ruler); to enthrone; to back; to advocate
explanation_mandarin: 拥护并拥戴某人为领袖或君主。
explanation_english: To support and establish someone as a leader or monarch; to enthrone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋擁立咗佢做新嘅領袖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung2 lap6 zo2 keoi5 zou6 san1 ge3 ling5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们拥立他为新的领袖。
examples.english_sentence: They enthroned him as the new leader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個國家嘅人民都擁立佢做皇帝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 yan4 man4 dou1 jung2 lap6 keoi5 zou6 wong4 dai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个国家的人民都拥立他为皇帝。
examples.english_sentence: The people of the whole country enthroned him as emperor.

english_meaning: to support, to endorse, to uphold
explanation_mandarin: 支持，拥戴，维护。
explanation_english: To support enthusiastically; to endorse or uphold a person, cause, or belief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要擁護黨嘅領導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jung2 wu6 dong2 ge3 ling5 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拥护党的领导。
examples.english_sentence: We must support the leadership of the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多市民都擁護政府嘅新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 si5 man4 dou1 jung2 wu6 zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多市民都拥护政府的新政策。
examples.english_sentence: Many citizens support the government's new policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都擁護自由民主嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 jung2 wu6 zi6 jau4 man4 zyu2 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都拥护自由民主的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: He has always upheld the values of freedom and democracy.

mandarin_meaning: 拥趸, 支持者, 铁杆粉丝
english_meaning: ardent supporter, loyal fan, die-hard follower
explanation_mandarin: 指狂热的、坚定的支持者或粉丝。通常用于形容对某个明星、品牌、团体或理念的忠实拥护。
explanation_english: Refers to a fervent and steadfast supporter or fan. Often used to describe someone's loyal allegiance to a celebrity, brand, group, or ideology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係張學友嘅擁躉，每場演唱會都一定去睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zoeng1 hok6 jau5 ge3 jung2 dan2, mui5 coeng4 jin2 coeng3 wui2 dou1 jat1 ding6 heoi3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是张学友的拥趸，每场演唱会都一定去看。
examples.english_sentence: He is a loyal fan of Jacky Cheung and goes to every concert without fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅擁躉都係啲老街坊，幫襯咗幾十年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 jung2 dan2 dou1 hai6 di1 lou5 gaai1 fong1, bong1 can3 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的拥趸都是些老街坊，光顾了几十年。
examples.english_sentence: The ardent supporters of this restaurant are all old neighborhood residents who have been patronizing it for decades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蘋果公司有好多擁躉，佢哋對蘋果產品非常忠誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 gwo2 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 jung2 dan2, keoi5 dei6 deoi3 ping4 gwo2 caan2 ban2 fei1 soeng4 zung1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 苹果公司有很多拥趸，他们对苹果产品非常忠诚。
examples.english_sentence: Apple Inc. has many loyal fans who are very loyal to Apple products.

english_meaning: to grind; to pound; to beat; to bump into
explanation_mandarin: 用研磨工具碾碎或捣碎东西；也指碰撞或搅拌。
explanation_english: To grind or pound something into a powder or paste using a grinding tool; also refers to bumping into or stirring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋整緊擂茶啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zing2 gan2 leoi4 caa4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在做擂茶。
examples.english_sentence: We are making Lei Cha (ground tea).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心擂到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 leoi4 dou2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心撞到我了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally bumped into me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 擂台上面嘅拳手好打得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi4 toi4 soeng6 min6 ge3 kyun4 sau2 hou2 daa2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 擂台上的拳击手很能打。
examples.english_sentence: The boxers on the ring are very capable fighters.

english_meaning: to knock down; to defeat; to subdue
explanation_mandarin: 用武力或技巧使对方倒下或失败；使对方失去抵抗能力。
explanation_english: To knock someone down physically or metaphorically; to defeat or subdue someone using force or skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好打得㗎，好難擂低佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 daa2 dak1 gaa3, hou2 naan4 leoi4 dai1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能打，很难打倒他。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at fighting; it's hard to knock him down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋隊波好勁，成日都擂低對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 hou2 ging6, seng4 jat6 dou1 leoi4 dai1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们队很厉害，总是打败对手。
examples.english_sentence: Their team is very strong, they always defeat their opponents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好難，但我一定要擂低佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4, daan6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 leoi4 dai1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题很难，但是我一定要解决它（打倒它）。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is very difficult, but I must overcome it (defeat it).

english_meaning: boxing ring; martial arts stage; arena
explanation_mandarin: 旧时比武用的高台。现指进行比赛或辩论的场所。
explanation_english: A raised platform traditionally used for martial arts competitions. Now refers to a place for competitions or debates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺擂台上比武。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 leoi4 toi4 soeng5 bei2 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在擂台上比武。
examples.english_sentence: They are competing in martial arts on the arena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個辯論比賽好似一個擂台咁，個個都想贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 leoi4 toi4 gam2, go3 go3 dou1 soeng2 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个辩论比赛就像一个擂台，每个人都想赢。
examples.english_sentence: This debate competition is like an arena, everyone wants to win.

english_meaning: Blockhead, idiot, fool
explanation_mandarin: 比喻头脑迟钝，反应慢的人。擂槌是舂米用的工具，笨重且没有思想，因此用它来形容愚笨的人。
explanation_english: Metaphor for someone who is slow-witted and slow to react. 'Leoi4 ceoi4' is a pestle used for pounding rice. It's heavy and has no independent thought, hence its use to describe a foolish person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係擂槌嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 leoi4 ceoi4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不明白，真是个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: You don't even understand this, you're such an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人啦，雖然佢係有啲擂槌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gong2 jan4 laa1, seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hai6 jau5 di1 leoi4 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人啦，虽然他是有一些笨。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk about people like that, even though he is a bit of a blockhead.

english_meaning: Glutinous rice balls rolled in crushed peanuts and sugar
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统的中式甜点。将煮熟的汤圆（糯米团子）捞出后，在混合了花生碎、芝麻、糖等配料的粉末中滚动，使其表面沾满这些粉末。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese dessert. Boiled glutinous rice balls are rolled in a mixture of crushed peanuts, sesame seeds, sugar, and other ingredients, creating a coating of flavored powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭嘅擂沙湯丸好出名㗎，好多人排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 leoi4 saa1 tong1 jyun2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店的擂沙汤圆很有名，很多人排队买。
examples.english_sentence: The glutinous rice balls rolled in crushed peanuts from that shop are very famous; many people line up to buy them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我最鍾意食阿嫲整嘅擂沙湯丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2, ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 aa3 maa4 zing2 ge3 leoi4 saa1 tong1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我最喜欢吃奶奶做的擂沙汤圆。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child, I loved eating the glutinous rice balls rolled in crushed peanuts that my grandma made.

english_meaning: Glutinous rice balls rolled in peanut powder (a type of sweet dessert)
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统的中式甜点，以糯米粉制成的汤圆煮熟后，裹上炒熟并磨碎的花生粉或芝麻粉。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese dessert made of glutinous rice balls that are cooked and then rolled in roasted and ground peanut or sesame powder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食擂沙湯圓，夠晒香口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 leoi4 saa1 tong1 jyun2, gau3 saai3 hoeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃擂沙汤圆，非常香。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating glutinous rice balls rolled in peanut powder the most, it's very fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭嘅擂沙湯圓好出名，好多人排隊買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou1 tau4 ge3 leoi4 saa1 tong1 jyun2 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店的擂沙汤圆很有名，很多人排队买。
examples.english_sentence: The glutinous rice balls rolled in peanut powder from that shop are very famous, many people line up to buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 搅拌棒；没头脑的人；迟钝的人
english_meaning: Mixing stick; A person who is slow-witted; A dullard
explanation_mandarin: 原指搅拌米浆的棍子。 比喻反应迟钝，没有主见，容易被人摆布的人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a stick used for mixing rice paste. It is a metaphor for someone who is slow-witted, lacks initiative, and is easily manipulated by others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似碌擂漿棍咁，乜都唔識諗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 luk1 leoi4 zoeng1 gwan3 gam2, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 nam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人好像一根搅浆棍一样，什么都不会思考。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a mixing stick, he can't think for himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做一條擂漿棍，要有自己嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jat1 tiu4 leoi4 zoeng1 gwan3, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做一个搅浆棍，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a dullard, have your own opinions.

english_meaning: to kidnap, to seize, to capture by force, to abduct
explanation_mandarin: 用武力劫持或抢夺。
explanation_english: To seize or capture someone or something by force; to abduct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋擄走咗個細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lou5 zou2 zo2 go3 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们绑架了那个小孩。
examples.english_sentence: They kidnapped that child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班賊擄走咗佢哋嘅財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 caak6 lou5 zou2 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那帮贼掠走了他们的财物。
examples.english_sentence: The gang robbed them of their possessions.

english_meaning: to plunder, to loot, to pillage
explanation_mandarin: 指用武力夺取财物；抢劫。
explanation_english: To seize goods by force; to plunder, loot, or pillage, often involving violence or coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班賊佬入村擄掠村民嘅財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 caak6 lou2 jap6 cyun1 lou5 loek6 cyun1 man4 ge3 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那伙强盗进村掠夺村民的财物。
examples.english_sentence: The gang of bandits entered the village and plundered the villagers' belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭期間，好多城市都受到擄掠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zang1 kei4 gaan1, hou2 do1 sing4 si5 dou1 sau6 dou3 lou5 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争期间，很多城市都受到了掠夺。
examples.english_sentence: During the war, many cities were subjected to plunder.

english_meaning: skilled in, good at, adept at
explanation_mandarin: 指在某方面很有能力、很熟练。
explanation_english: To be skilled or proficient in something; to be good at.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好擅長唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sin6 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔擅長同人哋交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sin6 coeng4 tung4 jan4 dei6 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不擅长和别人交流。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not good at communicating with other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明擅長捉棋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 sin6 coeng4 zuk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明擅长下棋。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is good at playing chess.

english_meaning: to be good at, to be adept at, to excel in
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某一方面有特长或技巧。
explanation_english: To be skilled or proficient in a particular area; to have expertise or a knack for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好擅於唱歌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sin6 jyu1 cheung3 go1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很擅长唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好擅於同人溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 sin6 jyu1 tung4 jan4 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太擅长与人沟通。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not very good at communicating with people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擅於解決複雜嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin6 jyu1 gaai2 kyut3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擅长解决复杂的问题。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at solving complex problems.

english_meaning: without permission; without authorization; arbitrarily; on one's own
explanation_mandarin: 指没有得到允许或授权，就自行做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something without permission or authorization, independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擅自攞咗我啲嘢用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin6 zi6 lo2 zo2 ngo5 di1 je5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擅自拿了我的东西用。
examples.english_sentence: He took my things and used them without permission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以擅自改動個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 sin6 zi6 goi2 dung6 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不可以擅自改动这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: You can't arbitrarily change the plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點解佢擅自離開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 sin6 zi6 lei4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道为什么他擅自离开了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why he left without permission.

english_meaning: to be good at; to be expert in; to be skilled in
explanation_mandarin: 指在某方面具有特长或技能，非常擅长于做某事。
explanation_english: To be proficient or skilled in a particular area; to excel at something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擅長唱歌，成日參加歌唱比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin6 coeng4 cheung3 go1, seng4 jat6 chaam1 gaa1 go1 cheung3 bei2 choi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擅长唱歌，经常参加歌唱比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at singing and often participates in singing competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明電腦好叻，佢擅長寫程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 din6 nou5 hou2 lek1, keoi5 sin6 coeng4 se2 ching4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明电脑很厉害，他擅长写程序。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is good with computers. He is skilled in programming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔擅長煮飯，但係擅長洗碗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sin6 coeng4 jyu2 faan6, daan6 hai6 sin6 coeng4 sai2 wun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不擅长做饭，但是擅长洗碗。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not good at cooking, but I'm good at washing dishes.

english_meaning: to trespass, to intrude without permission
explanation_mandarin: 未经允许，擅自进入。
explanation_english: To enter a place without permission; to trespass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擅闖人哋嘅地方呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sin6 cong2 jan4 dei6 ge3 dei6 fong1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要擅自闯入别人的地方啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't trespass on other people's property!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擅闖咗禁區，俾警察拉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin6 cong2 zo2 gam3 keoi1, bei2 ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他擅自闯入了禁区，被警察抓了。
examples.english_sentence: He trespassed into a restricted area and was arrested by the police.

english_meaning: to desert one's post; to abandon one's duty; dereliction of duty
explanation_mandarin: 没有经过允许，擅自离开自己的工作岗位。
explanation_english: To leave one's post without permission; to abandon one's duty or workplace without authorization. Often implies a failure to fulfill one's responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返工時間走咗去打機，根本就係擅離職守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 gung1 si4 gaan3 zau2 zo2 heoi3 daa2 gei1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 saan3 lei4 zik1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上班时间跑去打游戏，根本就是擅离职守。
examples.english_sentence: He went to play video games during working hours, which is essentially desertion of duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你擅離職守，公司會懲罰你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 saan3 lei4 zik1 sau2, gung1 si1 wui5 cing4 fat6 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你擅离职守，公司会惩罚你的。
examples.english_sentence: If you abandon your post, the company will punish you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍人擅離職守係好嚴重嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 jan4 saan3 lei4 zik1 sau2 hai6 hou2 jim4 zung6 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军人擅离职守是很严重的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: Desertion of duty is a very serious crime for soldiers.

english_meaning: to choose, to select
explanation_mandarin: 挑选；选择
explanation_english: To choose; to select; to pick out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擇邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaak6 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你选哪个？
examples.english_sentence: Which one do you choose?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀咗擇日結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zo2 zaak6 jat6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他选择了吉日结婚。
examples.english_sentence: He chose an auspicious day to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得擇衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 zaak6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会选衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at choosing clothes.

english_meaning: picky; choosy; fastidious; to be selective about who to employ or make use of; to be selective in general
explanation_mandarin: 形容人挑剔，对事物或人选来选去，不轻易决定。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is picky and choosy, being selective about things or people, and not easily making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁擇使啦，有工做咪算好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 zaak6 sai2 laa1, jau5 gung1 zou6 mai1 syun3 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么挑剔了，有工作做就算不错了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, having a job is good enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擇使到暈，成日嫌三嫌四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaak6 sai2 dou3 wan4, seng4 jat6 him4 saam1 him4 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挑剔得要命，整天嫌这嫌那。
examples.english_sentence: He's extremely picky, always complaining about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，唔好咁擇使，有得揀咪揀囉，無得揀咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, m4 hou2 gam3 zaak6 sai2, jau5 dak1 gaan2 mai1 gaan2 lo1, mou5 dak1 gaan2 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，不要这么挑剔，如果能选择就选，不能选择就算了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, don't be so picky, if you can choose, then choose, if you can't, then just let it be.

english_meaning: to choose a spouse; to select a mate
explanation_mandarin: 选择结婚对象，寻找伴侣。
explanation_english: To choose a marriage partner; to select a spouse or mate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋擇偶條件好高㗎，一定要有樓有車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zaak6 ngau5 tiu4 gin2 hou2 gou1 gaa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 lau2 jau5 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的择偶条件很高，一定要有房有车。
examples.english_sentence: Their criteria for choosing a spouse are very high; they must have an apartment and a car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲年輕人擇偶都好注重性格夾唔夾嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 nin4 hing1 jan4 zaak6 ngau5 dou1 hou2 zyu3 zung6 sing3 gaak3 gaap3 m4 gaap3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人在选择配偶时都很注重性格是否合得来。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people pay a lot of attention to whether their personalities match when choosing a spouse.

english_meaning: Criteria for choosing a spouse; mate selection criteria
explanation_mandarin: 选择配偶时所设定的标准或要求。
explanation_english: The criteria or requirements that one sets when choosing a spouse or life partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅擇偶條件好高㗎，一定要有車有樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zaak6 ngau5 tiu4 gin2 hou2 gou1 gaa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jau5 ce1 jau5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的择偶条件很高，一定要有车有房。
examples.english_sentence: His criteria for choosing a spouse are very high; he insists on having a car and a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲後生仔女擇偶條件都唔同咗，唔再淨係睇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 neoi5 zaak6 ngau5 tiu4 gin2 dou1 m4 tung4 zo2, m4 zoi3 zing6 hai6 tai2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人的择偶条件都不一样了，不再只是看钱。
examples.english_sentence: Young people's criteria for choosing a spouse are different now; they don't just look at money anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅擇偶條件係乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 zaak6 ngau5 tiu4 gin2 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的择偶条件是什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are your criteria for choosing a spouse?
