english_meaning: To be careful; to be cautious; to take care of (something); to be mindful of (something)
explanation_mandarin: 指小心谨慎地对待某事物，避免损坏或引起不必要的麻烦。也可指珍惜爱护。
explanation_english: Refers to treating something with care and caution to avoid damage or unnecessary trouble. It can also mean to cherish and protect something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 擏住啲，呢個花樽好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging6 zyu6 di1, ni1 go3 faa1 zyun1 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，这个花瓶很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, this vase is very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦擏住用，唔好成日打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 ging6 zyu6 yung6, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑要小心使用，不要总是玩游戏。
examples.english_sentence: Use the computer carefully, don't play games all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擏住自己身體啊，唔好咁操勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ging6 zyu6 zi6 gei2 san1 tai2 aa3, m4 hou2 gam3 cou1 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要注意自己的身体啊，不要这么操劳。
examples.english_sentence: You need to take care of your body, don't overwork yourself.

english_meaning: to cherish; to treasure; to handle with care; to be careful with
explanation_mandarin: 小心爱护，珍惜。
explanation_english: To handle something with care and affection; to treasure or cherish something; to be careful with something delicate or valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲古董好襟撈㗎，要擏惜啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gu2 dung2 hou2 kam1 lou1 gaa3, jiu3 ging6 sik1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些古董很耐用，但也要爱惜一点。
examples.english_sentence: These antiques are durable, but you still need to handle them with care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好擏惜佢部相機，驚整花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ging6 sik1 keoi5 bou6 soeng3 gei1, geng1 zing2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常爱惜他的相机，怕弄花。
examples.english_sentence: He cherishes his camera very much, afraid of scratching it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好擏惜呢個仔，乜嘢都俾最好嘅佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ging6 sik1 ni1 go3 zai2, mat1 je5 dou1 bei2 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们非常疼爱这个儿子，什么都给他最好的。
examples.english_sentence: They cherish this son so much, they give him the best of everything.

english_meaning: overly cautious; careful to a fault; gingerly
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事非常小心，顾虑太多，行动受到限制，显得不自然。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly cautious and apprehensive, leading to restricted and unnatural movements. Often used to describe someone who is afraid of making mistakes or causing damage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁擏手擏腳嘅，呢啲嘢唔易爛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 ging6 sau2 ging6 goek3 ge3, ni1 di1 je5 m4 ji6 laan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用这么小心翼翼的，这些东西不容易坏的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so overly cautious, these things aren't easily broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都擏手擏腳，好似怕蝕底咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 ging6 sau2 ging6 goek3, hou2 ci5 paa3 sit6 dai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是小心翼翼的，好像怕吃亏一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts so gingerly when doing things, as if he's afraid of losing out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁擏手擏腳啦，大膽啲試下啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ging6 sau2 ging6 goek3 laa1, daai6 daam2 di1 si3 haa5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么小心翼翼啦，大胆地试一下吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so overly cautious, try it boldly!

mandarin_meaning: 爱惜, 珍惜, 呵护
english_meaning: To cherish, to treasure, to take good care of, to be careful with
explanation_mandarin: 指小心地爱护、珍惜，不希望物品受到损坏或他人受到伤害。
explanation_english: Refers to carefully cherishing and valuing something or someone, wanting to protect it from damage or harm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車佢好擏錫㗎，從來唔俾人掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 keoi5 hou2 ging6 sek3 gaa3, cung4 loi4 m4 bei2 jan4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车他很爱惜，从来不让人碰。
examples.english_sentence: He treasures this car a lot, he never lets anyone touch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友要擏錫啲書本，唔好亂畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jiu3 ging6 sek3 di1 syu1 bun2, m4 hou2 lyun6 waak2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友要爱惜书本，不要乱画。
examples.english_sentence: Children should cherish their books and not scribble on them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擏錫自己身體啊，唔好成日捱夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ging6 sek3 zi6 gei2 san1 tai2 aa3, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 ngaai4 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要爱惜自己的身体啊，不要总是熬夜。
examples.english_sentence: You should take care of your body, don't always stay up late.

english_meaning: to seize, to capture, to catch
explanation_mandarin: 抓住，捉住。
explanation_english: To seize, capture, or catch something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋已經將個賊擒住咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 go3 caak6 kam4 zyu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们已经把贼抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: They have already captured the thief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir話要將佢哋一網擒晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: a3 sir2 waa6 jiu3 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 jat1 mong5 kam4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警官说要将他们一网打尽。
examples.english_sentence: The police officer said they would capture them all in one fell swoop.

english_meaning: climbing up and down repeatedly; going up and down constantly; running around busily; busy as a bee
explanation_mandarin: 形容不断地、频繁地上下移动。也形容为了某个目的而忙碌奔波。
explanation_english: Describes the action of moving up and down repeatedly and frequently. It can also describe someone being busy and running around for a purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份報告，擒上擒落走勻成間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3, kam4 soeng5 kam4 lok6 zau2 wan4 sing4 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这份报告，他跑遍了整个公司。
examples.english_sentence: For this report, he ran all over the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆行樓梯擒上擒落，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 haang4 lau4 tai1 kam4 soeng5 kam4 lok6, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶爬楼梯上上下下，真是很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma climbing the stairs up and down is really tiring.

english_meaning: to seduce a man; to hook a man; to catch a guy; to get a boyfriend (often implying a deliberate or calculated effort)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性通过各种手段吸引男性，使其成为自己的伴侣或对象。通常带有主动和策略性的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman attracting a man through various means, aiming to make him her partner or target. It usually carries a sense of proactiveness and strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識擒佬㗎，次次都得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 kam4 lou2 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很会钓男人的，每次都成功。
examples.english_sentence: She's very good at seducing men, she always succeeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁明顯擒佬啦，畀人睇到會笑你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ming4 hin2 kam4 lou2 laa1, bei2 jan4 tai2 dou3 wui5 siu3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么明显地勾引男人了，被人看到会笑你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so obvious about trying to hook a guy, people will laugh at you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多時間去擒個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 kam4 go3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她花了很多时间去勾引那个医生。
examples.english_sentence: She spent a lot of time trying to catch that doctor.

english_meaning: to climb up and down; to scramble around; to move restlessly
explanation_mandarin: 指不断地爬上爬下或者到处乱动，没有安稳的时候。
explanation_english: Refers to constantly climbing up and down, or moving around restlessly without settling down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻馬騮擒嚟擒去，好鬼得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maa5 lau1 kam4 lai4 kam4 heoi3, hou2 gwai2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只猴子爬来爬去，非常可爱。
examples.english_sentence: That monkey is scrambling around, it's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔擒嚟擒去，真係唔定性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 kam4 lai4 kam4 heoi3, zan1 hai6 m4 ding6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子爬来爬去，真是不安分。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are climbing all over the place, they're really restless.

english_meaning: In a hurry, flustered, anxious, hasty
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常匆忙，慌张，急躁的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very rushed, flustered, anxious, or hasty in their actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擒擒青咁做咩呀？慢慢嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kam4 kam4 ceng1 gam2 zou6 me1 aa3? maan6 maan2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么慌慌张张地做什么？慢慢来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you doing things so hastily? Take your time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擒擒青，諗清楚先決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kam4 kam4 ceng1, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要慌慌张张的，想清楚再决定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rush things, think clearly before making a decision.

english_meaning: to climb; to clamber; to scramble
explanation_mandarin: 指手脚并用向上攀登。
explanation_english: Refers to climbing upwards using both hands and feet; to clamber or scramble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我成日都擒爬啲樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 kam4 paa4 di1 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常爬树。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often climbed trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲馬騮好鍾意喺啲山上面擒爬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 maa1 lau1 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 di1 saan1 soeng6 min6 kam4 paa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猴子很喜欢在山上攀爬。
examples.english_sentence: Monkeys love to climb on the mountains.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擒爬上個棚架，整盞燈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 paa4 soeng5 go3 paang4 gaa2, zing2 zaan2 dang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爬上脚手架，修理灯。
examples.english_sentence: He climbed up the scaffolding to fix the light.

english_meaning: to capture, to seize, to arrest
explanation_mandarin: 指捉住并捕获，通常指捉拿犯人或动物。
explanation_english: To capture or seize, usually referring to capturing criminals or animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方成功擒獲咗嗰兩個賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 sing4 gung1 kam4 wok6 zo2 go2 leong5 go3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方成功抓获了那两个贼。
examples.english_sentence: The police successfully captured those two thieves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用陷阱擒獲咗隻野豬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 haam6 jip6 kam4 wok6 zo2 zek3 je5 zyu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用陷阱抓获了一只野猪。
examples.english_sentence: They captured a wild boar with a trap.

english_meaning: To catch bandits, first catch the chief; Get to the root of the problem; Deal with the leader first.
explanation_mandarin: 抓住盗贼，首先要抓住他们的首领。比喻解决问题要抓住关键。
explanation_english: This idiom means that to catch bandits, you should first catch their chief. Figuratively, it means to get to the heart of the problem or deal with the leader of the opposing side first in order to effectively resolve the issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，擒賊先擒王，揾到個幕後黑手先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, kam4 caak6 sin1 kam4 wong4, wan2 dou3 go3 muk6 hau6 hak1 sau2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，擒贼先擒王，找到幕后黑手才行。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we must get to the root of it; we need to find the mastermind behind it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得擒賊先擒王，直接同老闆傾會快啲解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 kam4 caak6 sin1 kam4 wong4, zik6 zip3 tung4 lou5 baan2 king1 wui2 faai3 di1 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得擒贼先擒王，直接和老板谈会更快解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: I think we should go straight to the boss; that's the quickest way to resolve the issue.

english_meaning: rushed; hastily; carelessly done
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事匆忙，没有仔细考虑或准备就绪。也指因时间紧迫而草率行事。
explanation_english: Describes doing things hastily and without careful consideration or preparation. It also refers to acting rashly due to time constraints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擒青做完份功課，好多錯漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 ceng1 zou6 jyun4 fan6 gung1 fo3, hou2 do1 co3 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他匆忙做完作业，有很多错误。
examples.english_sentence: He rushed through his homework and made many mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擒青決定，諗清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kam4 ceng1 kyut3 ding6, nam2 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要匆忙做决定，想清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make a hasty decision, think it through first.

english_meaning: To sexually harass, to flirt inappropriately, to grope
explanation_mandarin: 指以不恰当的方式调戏或侵犯他人，多指性骚扰行为。
explanation_english: Refers to inappropriate flirting or harassment of others, often referring to sexual harassment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再擒騎佢，我就報警㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 kam4 ke4 keoi5, ngo5 zau6 bou3 ging2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再性骚扰她，我就报警了！
examples.english_sentence: If you sexually harass her again, I'll call the police!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺巴士上面俾人擒騎，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6 bei2 jan4 kam4 ke4, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在巴士上被人性骚扰，真的很可怜。
examples.english_sentence: She was sexually harassed on the bus, it's really terrible.

english_meaning: To be opportunistic; to try to get the best of both worlds; to try to gain advantages from people of different statuses
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在不同层级的人之间寻求利益，既想在高层获得好处，又想在低层占便宜，形容投机取巧的行为。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who tries to gain advantages from people of different social standings. They attempt to climb high to get benefits from superiors and simultaneously try to take advantage of inferiors, highlighting opportunistic behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擒高搲低，所以冇乜人鍾意同佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 kam4 gou1 waa2 dai1, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 je5 jan4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是高攀低就，所以没什么人喜欢和他一起工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is always trying to get the best of both worlds, so not many people like to work with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住擒高搲低就可以成功，靠自己努力先係真道理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 kam4 gou1 waa2 dai1 zau6 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1, kaau3 zi6 gei2 nou5 lik6 sin1 hai6 zan1 dou6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着高攀低就就能成功，靠自己努力才是真理。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can succeed by being opportunistic; relying on your own efforts is the real way.

english_meaning: Climbing up and down repeatedly; moving around a lot; being very busy and active.
explanation_mandarin: 形容忙碌，不停地爬上爬下或到处奔波。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very busy, constantly climbing up and down or moving around a lot, often implying a sense of tireless activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗份工擒高擒低，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 kam4 gou1 kam4 dai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了这份工作到处奔波，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He's been running around for this job, it's really tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋嘅時候，我哋擒高擒低，搞到全身都痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 kam4 gou1 kam4 dai1, gaau2 dou3 cyun4 san1 dou1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的时候，我们爬上爬下，弄得全身都痛。
examples.english_sentence: When we were moving house, we were climbing up and down, and our whole bodies were aching.

english_meaning: to carry (on a shoulder pole); to bear, to take on, to shoulder (responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 用肩膀挑东西；承担责任。
explanation_english: To carry something using a shoulder pole; to bear or take on a responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一齊擔起呢個責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 daam1 hei2 ni1 go3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一起承担这个责任。
examples.english_sentence: We have to shoulder this responsibility together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擔住兩桶水上樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daam1 zyu6 loeng5 tung2 seoi2 soeng5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他挑着两桶水上楼。
examples.english_sentence: He is carrying two buckets of water upstairs (using a shoulder pole).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大壓力，唔需要咩都自己擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 aat3 lik6, m4 seoi1 jiu3 me1 dou1 zi6 gei2 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要有这么大的压力，不需要什么都自己承担。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stressed, you don't need to shoulder everything by yourself.

english_meaning: to hold a post; to assume the office of
explanation_mandarin: 担当某种职务或工作。
explanation_english: To take on a role or responsibility; to hold a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擔任咗公司嘅市場部經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daam1 yam4 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 si5 coeng4 bou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他担任了公司的市场部经理。
examples.english_sentence: He has taken on the role of marketing manager in the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將會擔任下屆學生會會長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jeung1 wui5 daam1 yam4 haa6 gaai3 hok6 sang1 wui2 wui2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将担任下届学生会会长。
examples.english_sentence: He will take on the position of president of the next student union.

english_meaning: to guarantee, to vouch for; guarantee
explanation_mandarin: 作为保证人；保证
explanation_english: To guarantee or vouch for someone or something; a guarantee or assurance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我擔保佢一定會準時到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daam1 bou2 keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 zeon2 si4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我担保他一定会准时到。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee that he will arrive on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以攞一份擔保書俾銀行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 lo2 jat1 fan6 daam1 bou2 syu1 bei2 ngan4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以拿一份担保书给银行。
examples.english_sentence: You can take a letter of guarantee to the bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我擔保呢件嘢嘅品質冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daam1 bou2 ni1 gin6 je5 ge3 ban2 zat1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我担保这件东西的品质没有问题。
examples.english_sentence: I guarantee that there are no problems with the quality of this item.

english_meaning: Carry a small stool; (figuratively) listen attentively and respectfully (often with the implication of gossiping or eavesdropping)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是搬一个小凳子。引申义是形容很认真、很恭敬地倾听，通常带有一种八卦或偷听的意味。
explanation_english: Literally means 'carry a small stool'. Figuratively, it describes listening attentively and respectfully, often with an implication of being gossipy or eavesdropping. It conveys the image of someone bringing a stool to sit and listen to something interesting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你哋咪喺度講人哋壞話啦，陣間有人擔凳仔嚟聽就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, nei5 dei6 mai5 hai2 dou6 gong2 yan4 dei6 waai6 waa6 laa1, zan6 gaan1 yau5 yan4 daam1 dang3 zai2 lai4 ting1 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你们别在这里说人坏话了，一会儿有人搬小板凳来听就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't talk bad about people here, it wouldn't be good if someone comes to listen with a stool.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到有嘢聽就即刻擔凳仔，真係好八卦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 jat1 ting3 dou2 yau5 je5 ting1 zau6 zik1 hak1 daam1 dang3 zai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 baat3 gwaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到有东西听就立刻搬小板凳，真是很八卦。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he hears there's something to listen to, he immediately brings a stool, he's really gossipy.

english_meaning: to take on a major responsibility; to be the main person in charge; to carry the flag
explanation_mandarin: 比喻承担重要的任务，成为主要负责人或领导者。 大旗：古代战争中指挥作战的大旗。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking on a significant responsibility and becoming the main person in charge or the leader. '大旗' (daai6 kei4) refers to the large flag used for commanding battles in ancient warfare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project咁大，得佢一個可以擔大旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project gam3 daai6, dak1 keoi5 jat1 go3 ho2 ji5 daam1 daai6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目这么大，只有他一个人可以挑大梁。
examples.english_sentence: This project is so big, only he can take on the major responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經驗豐富，公司有咩困難都係佢擔大旗搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 gim6 fung1 fu3, gung1 si1 jau5 me1 kwan3 naan4 dou1 hai6 keoi5 daam1 daai6 kei4 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经验丰富，公司有什么困难都是他挑大梁解决。
examples.english_sentence: He is very experienced, he is always the one to take charge and solve any problems the company has.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家冇人肯擔大旗，點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 mou5 jan4 hang2 daam1 daai6 kei4, dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在没有人肯承担重任，怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: Now nobody is willing to take on the responsibility, what do we do?

english_meaning: To look around aimlessly; to be inattentive; to be distracted and unfocused; gawking around.
explanation_mandarin: 形容心不在焉，到处张望，不专心做事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is distracted, looking around aimlessly, and not concentrating on what they are doing. Often implies a lack of focus or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁擔天望地啦，專心啲呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6嘢 m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 tin1 mong6 dei6 laa1, zyun1 sam1 di1 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你工作的时候不要总是东张西望，专心一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so inattentive when you're working, concentrate!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擔天望地，唔知諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daam1 tin1 mong6 dei6, m4 zi1 nam2 ging2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是东张西望，不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always looking around aimlessly, I don't know what he's thinking.

english_meaning: burden; responsibility; load
explanation_mandarin: 指需要承担的责任、负担，或实际的重物。
explanation_english: Refers to the burden, responsibility, or actual physical load that needs to be carried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅擔子好重，又要返工又要照顧屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daam1 zi2 hou2 cung5, jau6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 jau6 jiu3 ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的担子很重，既要上班又要照顾家庭。
examples.english_sentence: His burden is very heavy, he has to work and take care of his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾咁多擔子佢孭啦，佢會頂唔順㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 gam3 do1 daam1 zi2 keoi5 me1 laa1, keoi5 wui2 ding2 m4 seon6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他承担这么多负担了，他会受不了的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give him so much burden to carry, he won't be able to handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一齊分擔呢個擔子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 fan1 daam1 ni1 go3 daam1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要一起分担这个责任。
examples.english_sentence: We have to share this responsibility together.

mandarin_meaning: 老实本分；非常老实；老实到极点
english_meaning: Extremely honest; so honest they wouldn't even steal feces; scrupulously honest; beyond reproach.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常老实，即使给他机会偷东西（哪怕是不值钱的屎），他也不会这样做。表达了这个人诚实到了极点。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is exceptionally honest, to the point that they wouldn't even steal feces, even if they had the chance. It's a hyperbolic expression emphasizing extreme honesty and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係擔屎唔偷食㗎，你俾啲錢佢保管絕對放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daam1 si2 m4 tau1 sik6 gaa3, nei5 bei2 di1 cin2 keoi5 bou2 gun2 zyut6 deoi3 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个非常老实的人，你把钱交给他保管绝对放心。
examples.english_sentence: He's really honest, you can absolutely trust him with your money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明就係擔屎唔偷食嘅人，所以大家都好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 zau6 hai6 daam1 si2 m4 tau1 sik6 ge3 jan4, so2 ji5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明就是个老实本分的人，所以大家都非常信任他。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is an extremely honest person, so everyone trusts him very much.

jyutping: daam1 si2 dou1 m4 tau1 sik6
mandarin_meaning: 形容人非常老实，即使机会摆在眼前也不会占小便宜
english_meaning: So honest/upright that one wouldn't even steal feces to eat (even if carrying it); extremely honest and trustworthy; impeccably honest even given the opportunity to cheat.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常诚实守信，即使是面对唾手可得的蝇头小利也不会动心。通常用来赞扬一个人品行端正，值得信赖。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is incredibly honest and trustworthy, to the point that they wouldn't even consider taking advantage of a situation, even if it were an insignificant benefit. It is used to praise someone's integrity and reliability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人真係擔屎都唔偷食，絕對可以信賴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 daam1 si2 dou1 m4 tau1 sik6, zyut6 deoi3 ho2 ji5 seon3 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人真是个老实人，绝对可以信赖。
examples.english_sentence: This person is so honest, you can absolutely trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擔心，佢擔屎都唔偷食，唔會呃你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daam1 sam1, keoi5 daam1 si2 dou1 m4 tau1 sik6, m4 wui5 ngaak1 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别担心，他非常老实，不会骗你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, he's incredibly honest; he wouldn't cheat you.

synonyms: 老實可靠 (lou5 sat6 ho2 kaau3)
君子坦蕩蕩 (gwan1 zi2 taan2 dong6 dong6)

english_meaning: To take responsibility; to bear; to shoulder (a burden or task)
explanation_mandarin: 指承担责任、任务或负担。
explanation_english: Refers to taking responsibility, tasks, or burdens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我一定會擔帶落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 daam1 daai3 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我一定会承担下来的。
examples.english_sentence: I will definitely take responsibility for this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好乜都俾晒佢擔帶，你都要幫手分擔下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mat1 dou1 bei2 saai3 keoi5 daam1 daai3, nei5 dou1 jiu3 bong1 sau2 fan1 daam1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要什么都让他承担，你也要帮忙分担一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him bear everything. You should also help to share the burden.

english_meaning: To carry a funeral banner
explanation_mandarin: 在葬礼中，家属手持写有死者姓名的旗帜，引领送葬队伍。
explanation_english: To carry a funeral banner (幡) in a funeral procession. The banner usually bears the surname and other information about the deceased and is carried by a family member at the front of the procession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企人過身，個仔要擔幡帶孝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 jan4 gwo3 san1, go3 zai2 jiu3 daam1 faan1 daai3 haau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家里人去世了，儿子要举幡戴孝。
examples.english_sentence: A member of their family passed away, and the son has to carry the funeral banner and wear mourning clothes.

english_meaning: To conduct Taoist rituals for the deceased; to perform funeral rites
explanation_mandarin: 源于传统丧葬习俗。 “擔幡” 指丧礼中由孝子拿着引路的幡。“買水” 指购买水来为死者清洗身体。现在通常用来形容为去世的人做法事，超度亡灵。
explanation_english: Derived from traditional funeral customs. "擔幡" (daam1 faan1) refers to the filial son holding a guiding banner in the funeral procession. "買水" (maai5 seoi2) refers to buying water to cleanse the body of the deceased. Now, it's generally used to describe performing Taoist rituals for the deceased to help their spirit pass on to the afterlife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆過咗身，佢哋請咗道士返嚟擔幡買水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 dei6 cheng2 zo2 dou6 si6 faan1 lai4 daam1 faan1 maai5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶去世了，他们请了道士回来做法事。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma passed away, so they hired Taoist priests to perform funeral rites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想為死咗嘅仔擔幡買水，希望佢可以安息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wai6 sei2 zo2 ge3 zai2 daam1 faan1 maai5 seoi2, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 on1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想为死去的儿子做法事，希望他可以安息。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to conduct Taoist rituals for his deceased son, hoping he can rest in peace.

english_meaning: to worry; to be anxious
explanation_mandarin: 对可能发生的危险或不如意的事情感到忧虑不安。
explanation_english: To feel worried or anxious about a potential danger or undesirable event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好擔心聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很担心明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very worried that it will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁擔心啦，船到橋頭自然直。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa1, syun4 dou3 kiu4 tau4 zi6 jin4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么担心了，船到桥头自然直。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much, things will work out in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好擔心我嘅身體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 daam1 sam1 ngo5 ge3 san1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很担心我的身体。
examples.english_sentence: My mom is very worried about my health.

english_meaning: to worry; to be concerned
explanation_mandarin: 对某事或某人感到不安和顾虑。
explanation_english: To feel anxious or apprehensive about something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好擔憂佢嘅健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 daam1 jau1 keoi5 ge3 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很担心他的健康。
examples.english_sentence: I am very worried about his health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔憂，我會搞掂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 jau1, ngo5 wui5 gaau2 dim6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我会搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I'll take care of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日擔憂我哋唔夠衫着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 daam1 jau1 ngo5 dei6 m4 gau3 saam1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是担心我们穿的衣服不够。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always worries that we don't have enough clothes to wear.

english_meaning: to bear, to shoulder, to take responsibility for, to support (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 承受责任，承担义务；支持，照顾。
explanation_english: To bear responsibility, to shoulder obligations; to support or take care of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔緊要，有咩事我擔戴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gan2 jiu3, jau5 me1 si6 ngo5 daam1 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没关系，有什么事我承担。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay, I'll take responsibility if anything happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人擔戴成頭家，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 daam1 daai3 sing4 tau4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人承担整个家庭的责任，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He is shouldering the responsibility for the whole family all alone, it's really tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你咁多年嘅擔戴，我先可以咁順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam3 do1 nin4 ge3 daam1 daai3, ngo5 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你这么多年来的支持，我才可以这么顺利。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your support over the years, that's why I could be so successful.

english_meaning: to undertake, to bear, to shoulder (responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 承担责任或义务。
explanation_english: To undertake or bear a responsibility or obligation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我擔承今次嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daam1 sing4 gam1 ci3 ge3 zaak3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我承担这次的责任。
examples.english_sentence: I will bear the responsibility for this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔願意擔承風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 jyun4 yi3 daam1 sing4 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不愿承担风险。
examples.english_sentence: He is unwilling to take on the risk.

english_meaning: carrying pole; shoulder pole
explanation_mandarin: 一种扁平的木制工具，用来挑东西，通常两端挂着篮子或物品。
explanation_english: A carrying pole, typically made of wood, used to carry items by suspending them from both ends, often with baskets or other containers attached.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲農民成日用擔挑擔嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 nung4 man4 seng4 jat6 yung6 daam1 tiu1 daam1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的农民经常用扁担挑东西。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, farmers often used carrying poles to carry things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用擔挑擔住兩桶水，行咗好遠嘅路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 daam1 tiu1 daam1 zyu6 loeng5 tung2 seoi2, haang4 zo2 hou2 jyun5 ge3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用扁担挑着两桶水，走了很远的路。
examples.english_sentence: He carried two buckets of water with a carrying pole and walked a long distance.

mandarin_meaning: 笨手笨脚，手脚慢，做事不俐落
english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; slow and inefficient
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事笨拙，动作缓慢，效率不高。也指处理事情不果断。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, slow, and inefficient in their actions. It can also refer to someone who is indecisive in handling matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好咁擔擔抬抬啦，快啲搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 daam1 toi2 toi2 laa1, faai3啲 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事不要这么笨手笨脚的，快点把它搞定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy in your work, get it done quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人擔擔抬抬，成日都唔記得嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 daam1 daam1 toi2 toi2, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人做事笨手笨脚的，总是忘记事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is clumsy and forgetful.

synonyms: 論論盡盡 (leon6 leon6 zeon6 zeon6)

english_meaning: Dan Dan noodles
explanation_mandarin: 一种四川风味的面食，特点是面条细滑，佐以麻酱、辣椒油等调料。
explanation_english: A type of Sichuan noodle dish, known for its thin noodles and flavorful sauce made with sesame paste, chili oil, and other seasonings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好想食碗擔擔麪啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 soeng2 sik6 wun2 daam3 daam2 min6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很想吃一碗担担面啊！
examples.english_sentence: I really want to eat a bowl of Dan Dan noodles today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅擔擔麪做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 daam3 daam2 min6 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的担担面做得非常地道。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant makes very authentic Dan Dan noodles.

english_meaning: Dan Dan noodles
explanation_mandarin: 一种四川风味的面条，特点是麻辣味浓。
explanation_english: A Sichuan-style noodle dish characterized by its spicy and savory flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日晏晝想食碗擔擔麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 aan3 zau3 soeng2 sik6 wun2 daam1 daam1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天中午想吃一碗担担面。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a bowl of Dan Dan noodles for lunch today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅擔擔麵做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 daam1 daam1 min6 zou6 dak1 hou2 zeng3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的担担面做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: The Dan Dan noodles at this restaurant are very authentic.

english_meaning: stretcher; litter
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于抬运伤病员的工具，通常由两根长木棍和中间的布面或金属架组成。
explanation_english: A stretcher; a litter. A framework or canvas on poles for carrying a sick, injured, or dead person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺意外入面受咗傷，要用擔架抬走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji3 ngoi6 jap6 min6 sau6 zo2 soeng1, jiu3 yung6 daam1 gaa2 taai2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在事故中受伤了，需要用担架抬走。
examples.english_sentence: He was injured in the accident and had to be carried away on a stretcher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫護人員即刻攞咗擔架過嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 wu6 yan4 yun4 jik1 hak1 lo2 zo2 daam1 gaa2 gwo3 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医护人员立刻拿了担架过来。
examples.english_sentence: The medical staff immediately brought a stretcher over.

english_meaning: Camp bed, cot, stretcher bed
explanation_mandarin: 一种简易的床，通常用帆布或其他坚固的材料绷在框架上，可以折叠或拆卸，便于携带。常用于野外、军队或紧急情况。
explanation_english: A simple bed, usually made of canvas or other sturdy material stretched across a frame, that can be folded or dismantled for easy carrying. Often used in the field, by the military, or in emergency situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺災區瞓緊擔架床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zoi1 keoi1 fan3 gan2 daam1 gaa2 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在灾区睡行军床。
examples.english_sentence: They are sleeping on camp beds in the disaster area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日喺屋企張擔架床上面跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 zoeng1 daam1 gaa2 cong4 soeng6 min6 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常在家里的行军床上跳。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often jumped on the camp bed at home.

english_meaning: stretcher
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于运送伤病员的简易床具，通常由帆布或其他耐用材料制成，固定在两个或多个把手上，方便抬运。
explanation_english: A type of simple bed or frame used for transporting sick or injured people; typically made of canvas or other durable material stretched over a frame with handles for carrying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺意外度受傷，要用擔架牀送去醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji3 ngoi6 dou6 sau6 soeng1, jiu3 yung6 daam1 gaa2 cong4 sung3 heoi3 ji1 yun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在意外中受伤了，要用担架床送到医院。
examples.english_sentence: He was injured in the accident and had to be taken to the hospital on a stretcher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救護員用擔架牀將傷者抬上救護車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 wu6 jyun4 yung6 daam1 gaa2 cong4 zoeng1 soeng1 ze2 toi4 soeng5 gau3 wu6 che1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救护员用担架床将伤者抬上救护车。
examples.english_sentence: The paramedics carried the injured person onto the ambulance using a stretcher.

english_meaning: To hold a ladder; to support; to back someone up; to provide assistance; to act as a yes-man.
explanation_mandarin: 本义是扶着梯子，引申为在言语或行动上支持别人，使别人能达到目的。有时带有贬义，指盲目支持，不分是非。
explanation_english: Literally means to hold a ladder. Figuratively, it means to support someone verbally or in action to help them achieve their goal. Sometimes it carries a negative connotation, referring to blindly supporting someone, regardless of right or wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講乜你都擔梯，咁樣唔係咁好囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 mat1 nei5 dou1 daam1 tai1, gam2 joeng2 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说什么你都捧场，这样不太好吧。
examples.english_sentence: You support everything he says; that's not a good way to do things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要你擔梯，幫我喺老闆面前講幾句好說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 daam1 tai1, bong1 ngo5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 gong2 gei2 geoi3 hou2 syut3 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要你帮我搭梯子，在老板面前帮我说几句好话。
examples.english_sentence: I need you to back me up and say some good things about me in front of the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係識得擔梯，要有自己嘅諗法啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 daam1 tai1, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只会捧场，要有自己的想法啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just be a yes-man; you need to have your own opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 担任主角，担当主要角色
english_meaning: To play the leading role, to take the lead, to be the main performer
explanation_mandarin: 原意指戏曲表演中担当正角（主角），引申为在任何场合或活动中担任主要或最重要的角色。
explanation_english: Originally referred to playing the leading role in opera performances. It has been extended to mean taking on the main or most important role in any situation or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次部戲擔正做男主角呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bou6 hei3 daam1 zeng3 zou6 naam4 zyu2 gok3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次的电影担任男主角啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's playing the leading role in this movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project由你擔正啦，加油！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project jau4 nei5 daam1 zeng3 laa1, gaa1 jau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划由你负责，加油！
examples.english_sentence: You're leading this project this time, good luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，開始擔正處理好多重要嘅事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, hoi1 ci2 daam1 zeng3 cyu2 lei5 hou2 do1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，开始担任处理很多重要的事务。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he started to take the lead in handling many important matters.

english_meaning: futile effort; a Sisyphean task; pouring water into a sieve
explanation_mandarin: 比喻白费力气，劳而无功。如同用沙子去填海一样，根本不可能完成。
explanation_english: Describes a futile effort, a task that is impossible to accomplish. It's like trying to fill the ocean with sand, which is a completely pointless endeavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係擔沙塞海囉，根本冇用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 daam1 saa1 sak1 hoi2 lo1, gan1 bun2 mou5 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是徒劳无功吗，根本没用的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is just a futile effort; it's completely useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明知唔得都仲要做，根本係擔沙塞海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 zi1 m4 dak1 dou1 cung4 jiu3 zou6, gan1 bun2 hai6 daam1 saa1 sak1 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明知道不行还要做，根本是白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing it won't work and still doing it, it's completely futile.

english_meaning: Trying to fill the sea with sand; a futile attempt; a waste of effort.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻白费力气，毫无作用。指做根本不可能成功的事情。
explanation_english: Metaphorically describes an effort that is completely futile and leads to no positive result. It refers to doing something that is inherently impossible to succeed at.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再咁樣做都係擔沙塡海啫，唔會有用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gam2 joeng2 zou6 dou1 hai6 daam1 saa1 tin4 hoi2 ze1, m4 wui5 jau5 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再这样做也是徒劳无功，不会有用的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep doing it this way, it's just like trying to fill the sea with sand, it won't be useful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想靠佢自己一個人解決呢個問題，根本就係擔沙塡海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 kaau3 keoi5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 daam1 saa1 tin4 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想靠他自己一个人解决这个问题，根本就是徒劳无功。
examples.english_sentence: Trying to rely on him alone to solve this problem is simply a futile attempt.

english_meaning: carrying sand to fill the sea; a futile effort; a waste of time and energy
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做徒劳无功的事情，白白浪费精力。
explanation_english: A metaphor for doing something futile and wasting effort in vain, like carrying sand to fill the sea. It describes an action that has no chance of success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係擔沙填海囉，根本冇可能成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 daam1 saa1 tin4 hoi2 lo1, gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是白费力气吗，根本不可能成功的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is just a futile effort; there's no way it'll succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不斷咁投訴但係又唔行動，咪等於擔沙填海囉，問題都唔會解決到嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 dyun6 gam2 tau4 sou3 daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 hang4 dung6, mai1 dang2 jyu1 daam1 saa1 tin4 hoi2 lo1, man6 tai4 dou1 m4 wui5 gaai2 kyut3 dou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不停地投诉但是又不行动，不就等于白费力气吗，问题也不会解决的。
examples.english_sentence: Constantly complaining but not taking action is like carrying sand to fill the sea; the problem won't be solved.

english_meaning: to take on, to bear, to shoulder (responsibility); to assume (a role)
explanation_mandarin: 承担责任或角色。
explanation_english: To take on a responsibility or role; to bear or shoulder a burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有責任感，肯擔當重任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam3 gam2, hang2 daam1 dong1 zung6 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有责任感，愿意承担重任。
examples.english_sentence: He is very responsible and willing to take on important tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目好重要，一定要搵個靠得住嘅人嚟擔當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 hou2 zung6 jiu3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 wan2 go3 kaau3 dak1 zyu6 ge3 jan4 lai4 daam1 dong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很重要，一定要找个靠得住的人来承担。
examples.english_sentence: This project is very important, we must find a reliable person to take it on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥喺屋企擔當起照顧細佬妹嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 hai2 uk1 kei2 daam1 dong1 hei2 ziu3 gu3 sai3 lou2 mui2 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥在家里承担起照顾弟弟妹妹的责任。
examples.english_sentence: The older brother takes on the responsibility of taking care of his younger siblings at home.

english_meaning: carrying pole, shoulder pole
explanation_mandarin: 一种用来挑东西的工具，通常用竹或木制成。
explanation_english: A carrying pole or shoulder pole, typically made of bamboo or wood, used for carrying loads balanced on each end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日用擔竿挑住兩籮嘢去賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 yung6 daam1 gon1 tiu1 zyu6 loeng5 lo4 je5 heoi3 mai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人经常用扁担挑着两筐东西去卖。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people often used a carrying pole to carry two baskets of goods to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條頸俾條擔竿磨到紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 geng2 bei2 tiu4 daam1 gon1 mo4 dou3 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脖子被扁担磨得通红。
examples.english_sentence: His neck was rubbed red by the carrying pole.

jyutping: daam1 gon1 jaa5 cang4 zou6 gwo3 seon2
mandarin_meaning: 谁没年轻过，谁没风光过
english_meaning: Everyone has had their prime; everyone has been young and successful before.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻每个人都曾经年轻过，辉煌过，即使现在可能不如以前。
explanation_english: This idiom means that everyone has experienced their youth and success. It acknowledges that people's circumstances change over time, and even if someone is no longer at their peak, they once were. It suggests a sense of empathy and understanding of life's cycles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家撈得唔好，但係擔竿也曾做過筍，當年佢都好威㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 lou1 dak1 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 daam1 gon1 jaa5 cang4 zou6 gwo3 seon2, dong1 nin4 keoi5 dou1 hou2 wai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在混得不好，但是谁没年轻过，谁没风光过，当年他也很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He's not doing so well now, but everyone has had their prime, he used to be very impressive back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小佢呀，擔竿也曾做過筍，佢以前係個大老闆嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5 aa3, daam1 gon1 jaa5 cang4 zou6 gwo3 seon2, keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 go3 daai6 laau5 baan2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，谁没年轻过，谁没风光过，他以前是个大老板来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, everyone has had their prime, he used to be a big boss.

english_meaning: to take the lead role; to play the key part; to be in charge
explanation_mandarin: 主要指在戏剧、电影、节目等演出中担任主角或主要负责人。
explanation_english: Refers to taking the lead role or being the main person in charge, especially in plays, movies, programs, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次喺套戲入面擔綱男主角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 daam1 gong1 naam4 zyu2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次在这部电影里担任男主角。
examples.english_sentence: He's playing the leading male role in this movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嘅演唱會由邊個擔綱演出啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2 jau4 bin1 go3 daam1 gong1 jin2 ceot1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的演唱会由谁负责演出啊？
examples.english_sentence: Who is in charge of the performance at tonight's concert?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擔綱呢個項目嘅策劃，壓力都幾大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daam1 gong1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 caak3 waak6, aat3 lik6 dou1 gei2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责这个项目的策划，压力也挺大的。
examples.english_sentence: He's responsible for planning this project, so the pressure is quite high.

english_meaning: To support the family; to be the breadwinner
explanation_mandarin: 指承担起家庭的经济责任，成为家庭的主要经济来源。
explanation_english: Refers to taking on the financial responsibility of the family, becoming the primary source of income and support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸過咗身之後，佢就逼住要擔起頭家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 baa1 gwo3 zo2 san1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 bik1 zyu6 jiu3 daam1 hei2 tau4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸去世后，他就被迫要撑起家庭。
examples.english_sentence: After his father passed away, he was forced to support the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生就出嚟做嘢，為咗擔起頭家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 zau6 ceot1 lai4 zou6 je5, wai6 zo2 daam1 hei2 tau4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就出来工作，为了撑起家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He started working at a young age to support the family.

mandarin_meaning: 徒劳无功; 白费力气
english_meaning: Futile effort; pouring water into a sieve; a fruitless task
explanation_mandarin: 比喻白费力气，劳而无功。 把雪搬去填井，雪很快就会融化，井永远也填不满，所以是白费力气。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a futile effort, where one's efforts are in vain. Carrying snow to fill a well, the snow will quickly melt and the well will never be filled, therefore it is a pointless exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係擔雪塡井，晒氣囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 daam1 syut3 tin4 zeng2, saai3 hei3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是徒劳无功，浪费力气吗？
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way is just a futile effort and a waste of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 再諗都係擔雪塡井㗎啦，呢個project根本冇可能成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoi3 lam2 dou1 hai6 daam1 syut3 tin4 zeng2 gaa3 laa1, ni1 go3 project gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再想也是徒劳无功的，这个项目根本不可能成功。
examples.english_sentence: Thinking about it again is just a futile effort; this project is fundamentally impossible to succeed.

english_meaning: Futile effort; Sisyphusian task; pouring water into a sieve; trying to fill a well with snow.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做徒劳无功的事情，白白浪费力气。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a futile effort, like trying to fill a well with snow. It signifies doing something that is inherently impossible or pointless, resulting in wasted effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係擔雪填井，冇用㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 daam1 syut3 tin4 zeng2, mou5 yung6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是徒劳无功吗，没有用的。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is just a futile effort, it's useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日日都OT，但係啲問題都解決唔到，咪好似擔雪填井咁囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 jat6 dou1 OT, daan6 hai6 di1 man6 tai4 dou1 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2, mai1 hou2 ci5 daam1 syut3 tin4 zeng2 gam2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每天都加班，但是问题都解决不了，不就像徒劳无功一样吗。
examples.english_sentence: We're working overtime every day, but the problems aren't being solved. It's just like a futile effort.

synonyms: 緣木求魚 (jyun4 muk6 kau4 jyu4)
徒勞無功 (tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1)

english_meaning: to feel anxious and fearful; to be in constant fear
explanation_mandarin: 形容内心总是感到担忧和害怕，处于恐惧之中。
explanation_english: Describes a state of constant worry and fear, being in a state of terror and anxiety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從上次俾賊仔入屋之後，佢晚晚都擔驚受怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 soeng6 ci3 bei2 caak6 zai2 jap6 uk1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 maan5 maan5 dou1 daam1 ging1 sau6 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从上次被小偷入室后，她每天晚上都担惊受怕。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since the last time a thief broke into the house, she has been anxious and fearful every night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一路行，一路擔驚受怕，驚俾人發現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 lou6 haang4, jat1 lou6 daam1 ging1 sau6 paa3, ging1 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一路走，一路担惊受怕，害怕被人发现。
examples.english_sentence: We walked along, constantly worried about being discovered.

english_meaning: to boast; to brag; to exaggerate one's worth or ability; to inflate one's value
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人过分夸大自己的能力、价值或成就。
explanation_english: Describes a person who excessively exaggerates their abilities, value, or achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺人哋面前擔高頭，話自己幾咁叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 daam1 gou1 tau4, waa6 zi6 gei2 gei2 gam3 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在别人面前自抬身价，说自己多么厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He always boasts in front of others, saying how capable he is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日擔高頭，謙虛啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 daam1 gou1 tau4, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是自抬身价，谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't always boast; being more humble is better.

synonyms: 抬高自己 (toi4 gou1 zi6 gei2)

english_meaning: to throw away, to discard, to abandon
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，表示扔掉、抛弃的意思，也指抛弃感情或关系。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquialism meaning to throw away, discard, or abandon. It can also refer to abandoning a relationship or feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我擗咗佢送嘅嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pek3 zo2 keoi5 sung3 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把他送的东西扔掉了。
examples.english_sentence: I threw away the things he gave me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁輕易就擗低佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 zau6 pek3 dai1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么轻易就抛弃她。
examples.english_sentence: Don't abandon her so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅責任擗晒俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 zaak3 jam3 pek3 saai3 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的责任都推给了我。
examples.english_sentence: He threw all the responsibilities on me.

mandarin_meaning: 拍马屁, 吹捧, 奉承
english_meaning: to brown-nose, to flatter, to suck up to someone
explanation_mandarin: 指用夸张的言辞奉承、讨好别人，以求得对方的欢心或好处。
explanation_english: To flatter or fawn over someone, often using exaggerated praise, in order to gain their favor or benefit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前擗炮，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 pik1 paau3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在老板面前拍马屁，想升职呗。
examples.english_sentence: He's constantly brown-nosing the boss, trying to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁擗炮啦，我都知你講緊大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 pik1 paau3 laa1, ngo5 dou1 zi1 nei5 gong2 geng2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么吹捧了，我知道你在说谎。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flatter me so much, I know you're lying.

english_meaning: to split open, to break apart (with force, often with hands or arms)
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他方法把东西分开。
explanation_english: To split something open or break it apart, often using hands or arms to apply force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 擘大個口
examples.jyutping_sentence: maak3 daai6 go3 hau2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 张大嘴巴
examples.english_sentence: Open your mouth wide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我擘唔開呢個合桃呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maak3 m4 hoi1 ni1 go3 hap6 tou4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我掰不开这个核桃啊。
examples.english_sentence: I can't crack this walnut open.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力擘開本書呀，會爛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 maak3 hoi1 bun2 syu1 aa3, wui5 laan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么用力地把书掰开啊，会烂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't split the book open with so much force, it will tear.

english_meaning: To have one's mouth slightly open (often implying naivete, gullibility, or being easily surprised)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人略微张着嘴巴，有时带有傻气、容易受骗的意思。
explanation_english: Describes someone with their mouth slightly open, often implying a sense of naivete, gullibility, or being easily surprised. It can also suggest a simple or foolish demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日擘口仔噉，人哋呃你都唔知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 mak1 hau2 zai2 gam2, jan4 dei6 aak1 nei5 dou1 m4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是那样张着小嘴，别人骗你都不知道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always look so naive with your mouth open like that, you won't even realize if someone's tricking you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽完個故仔，擘口仔噉望住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 jyun4 go3 gu3 zai2, mak1 hau2 zai2 gam2 mong6 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听完故事，张着小嘴看着我。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the story, he looked at me with his mouth slightly open.

jyutping: maak6 daai6 go3 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1
english_meaning: All mouth and no trousers; all talk and no action; a big mouth with nothing inside; a hollow mouth
explanation_mandarin: 形容人只会说大话，却没有实际行动；或形容人夸夸其谈，肚子里却没有什么真才实学。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is all talk and no action, or who boasts a lot but lacks substance or skills. It implies emptiness and ineffectualness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己好叻，到做嘢嘅時候就乜都唔識，真係擘大個口得個窿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, dou3 zou6 je5 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 maak6 daai6 go3 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天说自己很厉害，到真正做事的时候却什么都不会，真是光说不做。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's so capable, but when it comes to doing the work, he doesn't know anything. He's all mouth and no trousers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢呀，佢擘大個口得個窿，講就天下無敵，做就無能為力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 maak6 daai6 go3 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1, gong2 zau6 tin1 haa6 mou4 dik1, zou6 zau6 mou4 nang4 wai4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他只会说空话，说起来天下无敌，做起来却无能为力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he's all mouth and no trousers. He talks a big game, but when it comes to doing anything, he's useless.

english_meaning: to open one's mouth wide
explanation_mandarin: 指张开很大的嘴巴。
explanation_english: Refers to opening one's mouth very wide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我擘大口，睇吓喉嚨有冇發炎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 mak6 daai6 hau2, tai2 haa5 hau4 lung4 jau5 mou5 faat3 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我张大嘴巴，看看喉咙有没有发炎。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to open my mouth wide to see if my throat was inflamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息之後，擘大口得滯，講唔出嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, mak6 daai6 hau2 dak1 zai6, gong2 m4 chut1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个消息之后，惊讶得张大了嘴巴，说不出话来。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he was so surprised that he opened his mouth wide and couldn't say anything.

jyutping: maak3 daai6 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1
mandarin_meaning: 张大嘴巴只剩下一个洞; 白费力气
english_meaning: To open your mouth wide and only get a hole; All effort for nothing; No gain whatsoever.
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费很多精力，最终却一无所获，毫无成果。 比喻白费力气，毫无意义。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a lot of effort is spent, but ultimately nothing is gained. It implies that the effort was wasted and meaningless. The phrase highlights a lack of return despite significant input.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢溫咗成晚書，點知第二日考試乜都唔記得，真係擘大口得個窿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan1 zo2 seng4 maan5 syu1, dim2 zi1 dai6 ji6 jat6 haau2 si5 mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1, zan1 hai6 maak3 daai6 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他温习了一整晚的书，没想到第二天考试什么都不记得了，真是白费力气。
examples.english_sentence: He studied all night, but he couldn't remember anything on the exam the next day. It was all effort for nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咗咁耐，最後都係失敗，咪即係擘大口得個窿囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6, mai1 zik1 hai6 maak3 daai6 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞了这么久，最后还是失败了，不就是白费力气嘛。
examples.english_sentence: After all this effort, it still failed in the end. It's just been all for nothing.

synonyms: 徒勞無功 (tou4 lou4 mou4 gung1)

mandarin_meaning: 睁大眼睛尿裤子；装傻；不知所措
english_meaning: To wet one's pants with one's eyes wide open; to be caught red-handed and be completely flustered and helpless; to feign ignorance when caught in the act.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“睁大眼睛尿裤子”，比喻人在惊慌失措或被当场抓住现行时，显得非常窘迫、不知所措的样子。 也可引申为装傻、明知故犯。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to wet one's pants with eyes wide open'. It describes someone being caught red-handed or being in a state of panic, feeling extremely embarrassed and helpless. It can also imply feigning ignorance or deliberately committing a wrong act knowing the consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾老細捉到佢上班時間睇波，佢真係擘大眼瀨尿，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 lou5 sai3 zuk1 dou2 keoi5 soeng5 baan1 si4 gaan3 tai2 bo1, keoi5 zan1 hai6 mak1 daai6 ngaan5 laai6 niu6, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板发现他上班时间看球赛，他真是吓得不知所措，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: The boss caught him watching a football game during work hours. He was completely flustered and didn't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明知係佢偷咗嘢，但係佢就擘大眼瀨尿，死都唔認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi1 hai6 keoi5 tau1 zo2 je5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zau6 mak1 daai6 ngaan5 laai6 niu6, sei2 dou1 m4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明知道是他偷的东西，但他却装傻，死也不承认。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly knew he stole the item, but he feigned ignorance and refused to admit it, no matter what.

synonyms: 手足無措 (sau2 zuk1 mou4 co3)

jyutping: mak1 daai6 ngaan5 gong2 daai6 waa6
english_meaning: to lie through one's teeth; to tell a blatant lie
explanation_mandarin: 指非常明显地说谎，明知是假的却装作是真的来说。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who is telling a very obvious lie, knowing it's false but pretending it's true. It implies a boldness or shamelessness in lying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擘大眼講大話，話自己冇去過，但明明就係佢喺現場！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mak1 daai6 ngaan5 gong2 daai6 waa6, waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 heoi3 gwo3, daan6 ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 keoi5 hai2 jin6 coeng4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睁着眼睛说瞎话，说自己没去过，但明明就是他在现场！
examples.english_sentence: He's lying through his teeth, saying he wasn't there, but he was clearly at the scene!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，佢成日擘大眼講大話嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 seng4 jat6 mak1 daai6 ngaan5 gong2 daai6 waa6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他啊，他总是睁眼说瞎话的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he always lies through his teeth.

english_meaning: to split open; to tear apart; to spread apart; to open wide
explanation_mandarin: 用手或其他方式把东西从中间分开；张开（手、腿等）。
explanation_english: To split something open, often with force or using your hands; to tear apart; to spread something open (like arms or legs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個麵包擘開兩份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 min6 baau1 maak3 hoi1 loeng5 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把面包掰成两半。
examples.english_sentence: He tore the bread in half.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擘開啲隻腳，等我容易啲幫你拉筋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maak3 hoi1 di1 zek3 goek3, dang2 ngo5 jung4 ji6 di1 bong1 nei5 laai1 gan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把脚张开一点，让我更容易帮你拉筋。
examples.english_sentence: Spread your legs a little wider so it's easier for me to help you stretch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擘開雙手，表示無辜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maak3 hoi1 soeng1 sau2, biu2 si6 mou4 gu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他张开双手，表示无辜。
examples.english_sentence: He spread his hands to indicate innocence.

english_meaning: to open one's eyes (literally: to open the eye boogers)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把眼屎拨开，睁开眼睛。 通常用来比喻刚刚睡醒，或者从不了解情况到开始了解。
explanation_english: Literally means to pry open one's eyes (after sleeping), referring to removing eye boogers. Figuratively, it can also mean to wake up to reality or to become aware of something after being ignorant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早擘開眼屎就返工，真係好攰啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 maak3 hoi1 ngaan5 si2 zau6 faan1 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上刚睁开眼睛就要上班，真是很累啊！
examples.english_sentence: Having to go to work right after opening my eyes in the morning, it's really tiring!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都擘開眼屎睇清楚啲啦，唔好再俾佢呃啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 maak3 hoi1 ngaan5 si2 tai2 cing1 co2 di1 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 bei2 keoi5 aak1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要睁开眼睛看清楚一点啊，不要再被他骗了。
examples.english_sentence: You should open your eyes and see clearly, don't be deceived by him again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人呃咗咁多次都唔擘開眼屎，真係抵佢死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 maak3 hoi1 ngaan5 si2, zan1 hai6 dai2 keoi5 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了这么多次都不醒悟，真是活该。
examples.english_sentence: He has been deceived so many times and still doesn't wake up to reality, he deserves it.

english_meaning: to fall out; to break up (a relationship); to have a falling out; to become estranged
explanation_mandarin: 形容原本关系亲密的人因为矛盾而决裂，不再往来。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where people who were originally close have a falling out due to conflict and no longer associate with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個因為錢銀問題擘咗面，而家已經無偈傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 yan1 wai4 cin2 ngan2 man6 tai4 mak6 zo2 min6, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 mou5 gai2 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个因为钱的问题翻脸了，现在已经无法沟通。
examples.english_sentence: They fell out over money matters and now they can't even talk to each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想同你擘面，大家都係朋友，有咩事好好傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 nei5 mak6 min6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 pang4 jau5, jau5 me1 si6 hou2 hou2 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想和你翻脸，大家都是朋友，有什么事好好商量。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to fall out with you. We're all friends. Let's talk things over.

english_meaning: to push; to shove; to jostle
explanation_mandarin: 用手或身体用力推。多指在拥挤的情况下。
explanation_english: To push forcefully with the hand or body, often in a crowded situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 迫巴士嗰陣要小心啲，唔好擙親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bik1 baa1 si2 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 ngou3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 挤巴士的时候要小心点，不要推到别人。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when squeezing onto the bus, don't shove other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擙開啲人，衝咗入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngou3 hoi1 di1 jan4, cung1 zo2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他推开人群，冲了进去。
examples.english_sentence: He pushed through the crowd and rushed in.

english_meaning: according to, based on, to occupy, to seize
explanation_mandarin: 动词：占据；介词：依据，根据。
explanation_english: Verb: to occupy, seize; Preposition: according to, based on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據我所知，佢哋已經結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 ngo5 so2 zi1, keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据我所知，他们已经结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: According to what I know, they are already married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方曾經俾人據為己有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 cang4 ging1 bei2 jan4 geoi3 wai4 gei2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方曾经被人据为己有。
examples.english_sentence: This place was once seized and occupied by someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據報導，聽日會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 bou3 dou6, ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据报道，明天会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: According to reports, it will rain tomorrow.

english_meaning: according to reports; it is reported that
explanation_mandarin: 表示消息来源，通常用于新闻报道中，说明某事是通过报道得知的。
explanation_english: Indicates the source of information, usually used in news reports to state that something is known through reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據報，尋日港島區有示威活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 bou3, cam4 jat6 gong2 dou2 keoi1 jau5 si6 wai1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据报道，昨天港岛区有示威活动。
examples.english_sentence: According to reports, there were protests in the Hong Kong Island area yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據報，嗰間公司就嚟執笠啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 bou3, go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 zap1 laap1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据报道，那家公司快要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: It is reported that that company is about to go bankrupt.

english_meaning: it is reported; it is said that; according to reports
explanation_mandarin: 根据听到的或看到的消息，表示所说的情况是听来的或看到的。
explanation_english: Indicates that the information is based on hearsay or reports. Used to introduce a piece of information that has been obtained from an outside source, rather than directly observed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據悉，聽日會落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 sik1, ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据悉，明天会下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: It is reported that it will rain heavily tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據悉，佢哋已經分咗手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 sik1, keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 fan1 zo2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据悉，他们已经分手了。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that they have already broken up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 據悉，政府計劃喺嗰度起新嘅醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: geoi3 sik1, zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hai2 go2 dou6 hei2 san1 ge3 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据悉，政府计划在那里建新的医院。
examples.english_sentence: According to reports, the government plans to build a new hospital there.

english_meaning: to take possession of something; to appropriate; to usurp
explanation_mandarin: 把别人的东西或权力非法地占为自己的。
explanation_english: To take something that belongs to others and claim it as one's own, often through illegitimate or illegal means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將公司嘅專利技術據為己有，俾人告咗上法庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 zyun1 lei6 gei6 seot6 geoi3 wai4 gei2 jau5, bei2 jan4 gou3 zo2 soeng5 faat3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把公司的专利技术据为己有，被人告上了法庭。
examples.english_sentence: He appropriated the company's patented technology as his own, and was sued in court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以將人哋嘅功勞據為己有㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 jan4 dei6 ge3 gung1 lou4 geoi3 wai4 gei2 jau5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能把别人的功劳据为己有啊！
examples.english_sentence: You can't take credit for someone else's accomplishments!

english_meaning: to take possession of; to appropriate; to seize as one's own; to take for oneself
explanation_mandarin: 把别人的东西或功劳等，当作自己的。
explanation_english: To take something that belongs to someone else, or someone else's credit, and claim it as one's own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將人哋嘅研究成果據爲己有，真係好唔道德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 jan4 dei6 ge3 jin4 gau3 sing4 gwo2 geoi3 wai4 gei2 jau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 dou6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把别人的研究成果据为己有，真的很不道德。
examples.english_sentence: He appropriated someone else's research findings, it's really immoral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣據爲己有，份功勞係大家一齊努力嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 geoi3 wai4 gei2 jau5, fan6 gung1 lou4 hai6 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nu5 lik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样据为己有，这份功劳是大家一起努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to take all the credit, the achievement is the result of everyone's hard work.

english_meaning: to argue strongly on the basis of reason; to contend strongly according to reason
explanation_mandarin: 根据道理，尽力争取。
explanation_english: To argue strongly for something based on reason and principles; to make a strong case using logic and evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得公司唔公平，所以決定據理力爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 gung1 si1 m4 gung1 ping4, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 geoi3 lei5 lik6 zaang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得公司不公平，所以决定据理力争。
examples.english_sentence: He felt the company was unfair, so he decided to argue strongly based on reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要據理力爭，唔可以俾佢哋咁樣欺負我哋。

mandarin_meaning: 比喻不负责任，推卸责任
english_meaning: To shirk responsibility; to pass the buck; to be irresponsible (literally: to blow one's snot onto someone else's thigh)
explanation_mandarin: 这是一个粤语俗语，形容一个人把自己的责任或麻烦推给别人，非常不负责任。 “擤” 是擤鼻涕的意思，“邊髀” 是指大腿。 想象一下，把鼻涕擤到别人的大腿上，既恶心又不礼貌，比喻把不好的东西或责任推给别人。
explanation_english: This is a Cantonese idiom that describes someone who shirks responsibility and passes it on to others.  "擤" (sing3) means to blow one's nose. "邊髀" (bin1 bei2) means the thigh. The image of blowing one's snot onto someone else's thigh is used to illustrate the act of passing on something unpleasant or undesirable, like responsibility.
