examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi2 soeng6 min6 zyu2 dung6 tung4 jan4 paan1 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派对上主动和人攀谈。
examples.english_sentence: He actively struck up conversations with people at the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識佢，所以唔敢同佢攀談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 keoi5, so2 ji5 m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 paan1 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不认识他，所以不敢和他攀谈。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know him, so I don't dare to strike up a conversation with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得點樣同陌生人攀談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 dim2 joeng2 tung4 mak6 sang1 jan4 paan1 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得怎样和陌生人攀谈。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at striking up conversations with strangers.

english_meaning: to curry favour with; to latch onto; to cling to for support; to ingratiate oneself with someone of high status; to be a hanger-on
explanation_mandarin: 指依靠或依附于权势或地位较高的人，以获取利益或提高自身地位。带有贬义。
explanation_english: To rely on or attach oneself to someone with power or higher status in order to gain benefits or improve one's own position. It often carries a negative connotation, suggesting opportunism or subservience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想攀附啲有錢人，希望可以少奮鬥幾年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 paan1 fu6 di1 jau5 cin2 jan4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 siu2 fan5 dau3 gei2 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想攀附那些有钱人，希望可以少奋斗几年。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to curry favour with rich people, hoping to struggle less for a few years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住攀附權貴，最緊要靠自己嘅努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 paan1 fu6 kuen4 gwai3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nu5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着攀附权贵，最重要的是靠自己的努力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about currying favour with the powerful and wealthy, the most important thing is to rely on your own efforts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠住攀附老闆先至升到咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zyu6 paan1 fu6 lou5 baan2 sin1 zai3 sing1 dou3 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是靠攀附老板才升得这么快的。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted so quickly by ingratiating himself with the boss.

english_meaning: to snatch; to grab; to pluck
explanation_mandarin: 用手快速地拿取、抓取。
explanation_english: To quickly take or grab something with one's hand; to snatch or pluck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攊咗我嘅銀包就走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lip1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 ngan4 baau1 zau6 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抢了我的钱包就走了。
examples.english_sentence: He snatched my wallet and left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆喺街市攊咗幾條菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 hai2 gaai1 si5 lip1 zo2 gei2 tiu4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶在菜市场拿了几根菜。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady plucked a few stalks of vegetables at the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁心急攊啲嘢食，排隊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sam1 gap1 lip1 di1 je5 sik6, paai4 deoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么着急抢食物，排队吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so anxious to grab the food, line up!

english_meaning: to swipe; to pilfer; to snatch away; to take something quickly and stealthily
explanation_mandarin: 指趁人不注意时偷偷地拿走东西。
explanation_english: Refers to taking something stealthily when people are not paying attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁人唔注意，攊走咗我銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 jan4 m4 zyu2 yi3, lek1 zau2 zo2 ngo5 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁人不注意，顺手牵羊把我的钱包拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He swiped my wallet when no one was looking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁擺啲嘢喺枱面，好易俾人攊走㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 baai2 di1 je5 hai2 toi2 min6, hou2 ji6 bei2 jan4 lek1 zau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱放东西在桌子上，很容易被人顺手牵羊拿走的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave your things lying around on the table, it's easy for someone to swipe them.

english_meaning: to defecate (as in a child accidentally), to leave behind, to lag behind, to lose out
explanation_mandarin: 指小孩不小心拉屎，也指遗漏、落下东西，或落在后面。
explanation_english: Refers to a child accidentally defecating. It can also mean to leave something behind, to omit something, or to fall behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔喺度攋屎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 dou6 laai6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩在这里拉屎了。
examples.english_sentence: That kid defecated here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好攋低我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 laai6 dai1 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要落下我呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave me behind!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想考試攋班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 haau2 si5 laai6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想考试落后于班级。
examples.english_sentence: Don't want to fall behind in class during the exam.

english_meaning: to leave behind; to leave something behind; to be left behind
explanation_mandarin: 指将某物遗留在某处；指被遗留在某处。
explanation_english: Refers to leaving something behind at a certain place; also refers to being left behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日返工攋低咗個銀包喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 laai6 dai1 zo2 go3 ngan4 baau1 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天上班把钱包落在家裡了。
examples.english_sentence: I left my wallet at home today when I went to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車開走咗，攋低咗佢喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hoi1 zau2 zo2, laai6 dai1 zo2 keoi5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车开走了，把他落在了这里。
examples.english_sentence: The car drove off, leaving him behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好攋低我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 laai6 dai1 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要丢下我呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave me behind!

english_meaning: To mess up, to screw up, to blunder, to fail
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情搞砸，犯錯誤，造成不好的後果。
explanation_english: Refers to messing up a task, making a mistake, or causing undesirable consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我攋咗嘢，好多嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 laai6 zo2 je5, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我搞砸了，很多东西都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up on the exam this time; I didn't know how to do many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再攋嘢啦，唔係老闆會炒你魷魚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 laai6 je5 laa1, m4 hai6 lou5 baan2 wui5 caau2 nei5 jau4 jyu4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再搞砸了，不然老板会炒你鱿鱼的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess up again, or the boss will fire you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都攋嘢，搞到大家都好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 laai6 je5, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是搞砸事情，搞得大家都头疼。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes things up, causing everyone a headache.

english_meaning: all; altogether; total; to gather together
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部或所有；亦可表示加起来。
explanation_english: Indicates all or the totality of something; can also mean to add up, or to gather together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢攏埋都唔夠買部車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 lung5 maai4 dou1 m4 gau3 maai5 bou6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有的钱加起来都不够买一辆车。
examples.english_sentence: All the money added together isn't enough to buy a car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攏共借咗幾多錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lung5 gung6 ze3 zo2 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一共借了多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much money did he borrow altogether?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋攏都支持你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lung5 dou1 zi1 chi4 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们都支持你的。
examples.english_sentence: We all support you.

english_meaning: to block, to obstruct, to intercept, to hinder
explanation_mandarin: 阻止别人前进或做事。
explanation_english: To stop someone from moving forward or doing something; to block or obstruct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想走，但係我哋攔住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zau2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 laan4 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想走，但是我们拦住了他。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to leave, but we stopped him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度攔路！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 laan4 lou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里挡路！
examples.english_sentence: Don't block the way here!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察攔低咗架車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 laan4 dai1 zo2 gaa3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察拦下了那辆车。
examples.english_sentence: The police stopped the car.

english_meaning: to intercept, to block, to stop
explanation_mandarin: 阻止某人或某物通过或继续前进。
explanation_english: To obstruct or prevent someone or something from passing or continuing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺路口攔截疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 lou6 hau2 laan4 zit6 ji4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在路口拦截嫌疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police intercepted the suspect at the intersection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想攔截我嘅電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 laan4 zit6 ngo5 ge3 din6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想拦截我的电子邮件。
examples.english_sentence: They want to intercept my email.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個守門員成功攔截咗個波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sau2 mun4 jyun4 sing4 gung1 laan4 zit6 zo2 go3 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 守门员成功地拦截了球。
examples.english_sentence: The goalkeeper successfully intercepted the ball.

english_meaning: to obstruct, to block the way, to intercept
explanation_mandarin: 阻止或阻碍别人的去路或行动。
explanation_english: To block someone's path or action; to intercept.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條路中間攔河，唔畀我哋過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 lou6 zung1 gaan3 laan4 ho4, m4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在路中间拦路，不让我们过去。
examples.english_sentence: He blocked the way in the middle of the road, not allowing us to pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察攔河截查可疑車輛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 laan4 ho4 zit6 caa4 ho2 yi4 ce1 loeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察拦路截查可疑车辆。
examples.english_sentence: The police intercepted suspicious vehicles by blocking the road.

english_meaning: around the waist; midsection; halfway
explanation_mandarin: 从中间拦住；腰部的位置。
explanation_english: To block or intercept something in the middle; around the waist area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺馬路中間攔腰捉住個賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 maa5 lou6 zung1 gaan1 laan4 jiu1 zuk1 zyu6 go3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在马路中间拦腰抓住了那个贼。
examples.english_sentence: He grabbed the thief around the waist in the middle of the road.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條樹俾颱風吹到攔腰折斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 syu6 bei2 toi4 fung1 cheui1 dou3 laan4 jiu1 zit3 dyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那棵树被台风吹得拦腰折断。
examples.english_sentence: The tree was broken in half by the typhoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一見到我就攔腰抱住我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zau6 laan4 jiu1 pou5 zyu6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一见到我就拦腰抱住我。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he saw me, he hugged me around the waist.

english_meaning: to push; to jostle; to disturb; to harass
explanation_mandarin: 指推挤、拥挤、骚扰的行为。在粤语中，常用于形容拥挤或忙乱的场面。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of pushing, jostling, or disturbing. In Cantonese, it is often used to describe a crowded or chaotic scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日搭地鐵真係好攘呀，迫到死死吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 daap3 dei6 tit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 joeng5 aa3, bik1 dou3 sei2 sei2 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天坐地铁真的很拥挤啊，挤得要死了。
examples.english_sentence: The MTR was so crowded today, I was squeezed to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁攘啦，排隊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 joeng5 laa1, paai4 deoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么拥挤，排队吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't push so much, line up.

english_meaning: to support (with one's hand); to assist (someone unsteady); to mix; to blend; to adulterate
explanation_mandarin: 用手扶助，多指扶助行动不便的人。 也指混合、掺杂。
explanation_english: To support or assist someone, usually with one's hand, often referring to helping someone who is unsteady or has difficulty walking. Can also mean to mix or blend, sometimes implying adulteration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你扶我起身啦，我隻腳好痛呀，要人攙扶先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fu4 ngo5 hei2 san1 laa1, ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3 aa3, jiu3 jan4 caam1 fu4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你扶我起来吧，我的脚很痛，需要人搀扶才行。
examples.english_sentence: Help me up, my foot hurts a lot. I need someone to support me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲咖啡溝咗啲水，所以味道淡咗好多，唔夠濃，明顯係有人落咗手腳， 攙雜咗嘢落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gaa3 fe1 gau1 zo2 di1 seoi2, so2 ji5 mei6 dou6 daam6 zo2 hou2 do1, m4 gau3 nung4, ming4 hin2 hai6 jau5 jan4 lok6 zo2 sau2 goek3, caam1 zaap6 zo2 je5 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些咖啡掺了些水，所以味道淡了很多，不够浓，明显是有人做了手脚，掺杂了东西进去。
examples.english_sentence: This coffee has been mixed with some water, so the taste is much weaker and not strong enough. It's obvious someone's tampered with it and mixed something in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆行路唔穩，要人攙住佢行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po2 haang4 lou6 m4 wan2, jiu3 jan4 caam1 zyu6 keoi5 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶走路不稳，需要人搀扶着她走。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is unsteady when walking, she needs someone to support her.

english_meaning: to help; to support (with one's hand); to assist (someone unsteady)
explanation_mandarin: 用手扶助；帮助行走不稳的人。
explanation_english: To support someone, especially when they are unsteady, by holding their arm or hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 婆婆行路唔穩陣，你要攙扶佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: po4 po2 haang4 lou6 m4 wan2 zan6, nei5 jiu3 caam1 fu4 keoi5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶走路不稳，你要搀扶她啊。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is unsteady when walking, you need to help her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒，要人攙扶先企得穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zau2, jiu3 jan4 caam1 fu4 sin1 kei5 dak1 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了，要人搀扶才能站稳。
examples.english_sentence: He's drunk and needs someone to support him to stand steadily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到老人家, 我哋應該主動上前攙扶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 lou5 jan4 gaa1, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 zyu2 dung6 soeng5 cin4 caam1 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到老年人，我们应该主动上前搀扶。
examples.english_sentence: When we see elderly people, we should proactively offer assistance.

english_meaning: to mix; to adulterate; to blend; to mingle; to intermingle
explanation_mandarin: 指将不同的东西混合在一起，有时含有掺假或降低品质的意味。
explanation_english: To mix different things together, sometimes implying adulteration or reduction in quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲奶粉好似攙雜咗其他嘢，唔係咁純。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 naai5 fan2 hou2 ci5 caam1 zaap6 zo2 kei4 taa1 je5, m4 hai6 gam3 seon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些奶粉好像掺杂了其他东西，不是很纯。
examples.english_sentence: This milk powder seems to be mixed with other things, it's not so pure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅音樂風格攙雜咗好多唔同嘅元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 fung1 gaak3 caam1 zaap6 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的音乐风格掺杂了很多不同的元素。
examples.english_sentence: His musical style blends many different elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺啲水泥入邊攙雜太多水，會影響強度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 di1 seoi2 nai4 jap6 bin1 caam1 zaap6 taai3 do1 seoi2, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 koeng4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在水泥里掺杂太多水，会影响强度。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mix too much water into the cement, it will affect its strength.

english_meaning: to carry, to bring along
explanation_mandarin: 拿着或带着东西。
explanation_english: To carry or bring something along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攜住行李去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kwai4 zyu6 hang4 lei5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们携带行李去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They are carrying luggage to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得攜帶身份證去投票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 kwai4 daai3 san1 fan2 zing3 heoi3 tau4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得携带身份证去投票。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your ID card to vote.

english_meaning: to carry; to bring; to take along
explanation_mandarin: 携带物品；随身带着。
explanation_english: To carry something, often things one owns or uses; to take something with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得攜帶身份證啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 kwai4 daai3 san1 fan6 zing3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得携带身份证啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your ID card!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，搭飛機唔可以攜帶超過一百毫升嘅液體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, daap3 fei1 gei1 m4 ho2 ji5 kwai4 daai3 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 baak3 hou4 sing1 ge3 jik6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，搭飞机不可以携带超过一百毫升的液体。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, you can't carry more than 100ml of liquid on the plane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日攜帶咗個飯盒返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 kwai4 daai3 zo2 go3 faan6 hap6 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天带了饭盒上班。
examples.english_sentence: He brought a lunchbox to work today.

english_meaning: hand in hand; to join hands; to cooperate
explanation_mandarin: 手牵着手；比喻共同合作。
explanation_english: Literally, to hold hands. Figuratively, it means to cooperate or work together towards a common goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要攜手合作，先可以完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kwai4 sau2 hap6 jok3, sin1 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要携手合作，才可以完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to cooperate to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攜手走過咗好多困難嘅日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kwai4 sau2 zau2 gwo3 zo2 hou2 do1 kwan3 naan4 ge3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们携手走过了很多困难的日子。
examples.english_sentence: They went through many difficult days hand in hand.

english_meaning: to bring one's family along; accompanied by family
explanation_mandarin: 携带家属、眷属。指带着配偶、子女等家人一同前往。
explanation_english: To bring one's family along; to be accompanied by one's spouse and/or children. Often used in formal situations or announcements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下個月去歐洲旅行，會攜眷同行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4, wui5 kwai4 gyun3 tung4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下个月去欧洲旅行，会携带家眷一同前往。
examples.english_sentence: They are going to Europe next month and will be bringing their family along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司周年晚宴，歡迎同事攜眷出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3, faan1 jing4 tung4 si6 kwai4 gyun3 cheut1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司周年晚宴，欢迎同事携带家眷出席。
examples.english_sentence: The company's anniversary dinner welcomes colleagues to bring their families along.

mandarin_meaning: 塞进; 插入; 拍摄; 照相
english_meaning: to tuck in; to insert; to photograph; to take a photo; to absorb; to ingest
explanation_mandarin: 1. 将某物塞入或插入到狭窄的空间中。2. 拍摄，照相。 3. 吸收；摄入。
explanation_english: 1. To tuck something into a narrow space; to insert. 2. To photograph; to take a picture. 3. To absorb; to ingest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將條褲攝入對靴度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 tiu4 fu3 sip3 jap6 deoi3 hoe1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把裤子塞进靴子里。
examples.english_sentence: Tuck the pants into the boots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋不如攝張合照啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bat1 jyu4 sip3 zoeng1 hap6 ziu3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不如拍张合照吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we take a group photo?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攝取咗好多營養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sip3 ceoi2 zo2 hou2 do1 wing4 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摄取了很多营养。
examples.english_sentence: He ingested a lot of nutrients.

english_meaning: To squeeze into a space; to cut in (line); to fill a gap; to find a spot; to insert oneself (into a situation)
explanation_mandarin: 原本意思是挤入狭小的空间，引申为寻找机会，插入空隙，或强行加入某个群体或活动中。
explanation_english: Originally meaning to squeeze into a small space, it is extended to mean finding an opportunity, filling a gap, or forcefully joining a group or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嚟到，佢即刻攝位泊咗入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 lai4 dou3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 sip3 wai2 paak3 zo2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车来了，他立刻插空停了进去。
examples.english_sentence: The car arrived, and he immediately squeezed into the parking space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識攝位，所以喺公司升得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 sip3 wai2, so2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会见缝插针，所以在公司升职很快。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at seizing opportunities, so he gets promoted quickly at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好攝人哋隊呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sip3 yan4 dei6 deoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要插别人的队呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't cut in line!

english_meaning: to absorb, to intake (nutrition, information etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 吸收或摄入（营养、信息等）。
explanation_english: To absorb or take in (nutrition, information, etc.). Commonly used in the context of nutrition, knowledge, or information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要攝取足夠嘅維他命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sip3 ceoi2 zuk1 gau3 ge3 wai4 taa1 ming5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要摄取足够的维生素。
examples.english_sentence: We need to absorb enough vitamins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攝取咗好多新知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sip3 ceoi2 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们摄取了很多新知识。
examples.english_sentence: They have absorbed a lot of new knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 植物通過光合作用攝取能量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 mat6 tung1 gwo3 gwong1 hap6 zok3 yung6 sip3 ceoi2 nang4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 植物通过光合作用摄取能量。
examples.english_sentence: Plants absorb energy through photosynthesis.

english_meaning: To appease Tai Sui (the Grand Duke Jupiter, a deity believed to govern the fortunes of the year); to ward off bad luck in a year conflicting with Tai Sui according to Chinese astrology
explanation_mandarin: 根据中国传统信仰，每一年都有一个当值的太岁。如果你的生肖和当年的太岁相冲，就需要“摄太岁”，即到庙宇祭拜太岁，以求消灾解难，保佑平安。
explanation_english: According to traditional Chinese belief, each year is governed by a Tai Sui (Grand Duke Jupiter). If your Chinese zodiac sign clashes with the Tai Sui of the year, it is believed that you need to 'sip taai seoi', which means to go to a temple to worship Tai Sui in order to avoid misfortune and pray for peace and safety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我犯太歲，所以要搵日去攝太歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 faan6 taai3 seoi3, so2 ji5 jiu3 wan2 jat6 heoi3 sip3 taai3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我犯太岁，所以要找一天去安太岁。
examples.english_sentence: This year my zodiac sign clashes with Tai Sui, so I need to find a day to go and appease Tai Sui.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆每年都去黃大仙攝太歲，求個心安理得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 mui5 nin4 dou1 heoi3 wong4 daai6 sin1 sip3 taai3 seoi3, kau4 go3 sam1 on1 lei5 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶每年都去黄大仙安太岁，求个心安理得。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma goes to Wong Tai Sin Temple every year to appease Tai Sui, seeking peace of mind.

english_meaning: photography
explanation_mandarin: 指使用照相机等器材拍摄照片的行为或技术。
explanation_english: The art or practice of taking and processing photographs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意攝影㗎，得閒會周圍影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sip3 ying2 gaa3, dak1 haan4 wui5 zau1 wai4 ying2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢摄影，有空会到处拍照。
examples.english_sentence: I really like photography and take photos everywhere when I have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個專業攝影師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 zyun1 jip6 sip3 ying2 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位专业的摄影师。
examples.english_sentence: He is a professional photographer.

english_meaning: photographer
explanation_mandarin: 指以摄影为职业或爱好的人，负责拍摄照片或影片。
explanation_english: A person who takes photographs, especially as a profession or hobby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅攝影師，啲相影得好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 sek3 ying2 si1, di1 soeng2 ying2 dak1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有名的摄影师，照片拍得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous photographer, and his photos are beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想請個攝影師嚟幫我哋影結婚相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ceng2 go3 sek3 ying2 si1 lai4 bong1 ngo5 dei6 ying2 git3 fan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想请一位摄影师来帮我们拍结婚照。
examples.english_sentence: I want to hire a photographer to take our wedding photos.

english_meaning: regent; regency
explanation_mandarin: 指君主年幼或不能执政时，代替君主处理国事的职位或行为。
explanation_english: A regent is a person appointed to administer a country because the monarch is a minor, is absent, or is incapacitated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺皇帝重細嘅時候做攝政王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wong4 dai3 zung6 sai3 ge3 si4 hau6 zou6 sip3 zing3 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在皇帝还小的时候当摄政王。
examples.english_sentence: He was the regent when the emperor was still young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段時間係皇后攝政時期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 hai6 wong4 hau6 sip3 zing3 si4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段时间是皇后摄政时期。
examples.english_sentence: This period is the regency of the Empress.

english_meaning: To squeeze in time; to make time; to fit something into one's schedule
explanation_mandarin: 指在忙碌的日程中，尽力抽出时间来做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to making an effort to find time to do something within a busy schedule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好忙，要攝時間去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 mong4, jiu3 sip3 si4 gaan3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很忙，要挤时间去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very busy today, I need to squeeze in time to see the doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都要返工，但係佢都會攝時間同個仔玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 wui5 sip3 si4 gaan3 tung4 go3 zai2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都要上班，但是他还是会抽时间和儿子玩。
examples.english_sentence: He has to work every day, but he still makes time to play with his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攝時間覆你email啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sip3 si4 gaan3 fuk1 nei5 email laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我挤时间回复你的邮件。
examples.english_sentence: I will squeeze in time to reply to your email.

english_meaning: Celsius; centigrade
explanation_mandarin: 表示温度的计量单位，冰点定为0度，沸点定为100度。
explanation_english: A unit of temperature on the Celsius scale, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅氣溫係三十度攝氏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 hei3 wan1 hai6 saam1 sap6 dou6 sip3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天气温是三十摄氏度。
examples.english_sentence: Today's temperature is thirty degrees Celsius.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲水要煲到一百度攝氏先會滾㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 seoi2 jiu3 bou1 dou3 jat1 baak3 dou6 sip3 si6 sin1 wui5 gwan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 烧水要烧到一百摄氏度才会开的。
examples.english_sentence: Water needs to be heated to 100 degrees Celsius to boil.

english_meaning: to try to get in through the back door; to try to get in by any means possible, often unethical; to pull strings; to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人为了达到目的，不择手段地寻找机会，甚至通过不正当的途径。
explanation_english: Describes someone who uses any means possible, even unethical ones, to achieve their goals by exploiting opportunities or using back channels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想攝灶罅上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 sip3 zou3 laa3 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想钻空子往上爬。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to get ahead by pulling strings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住攝灶罅入大學，認真讀書先係正途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 sip3 zou3 laa3 jap6 daai6 hok6, jing6 zan1 duk6 syu1 sin1 hai6 zing3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着走后门进大学，认真读书才是正道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about trying to get into university through the back door, studying hard is the right way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意佢嘅為人，成日諗住攝灶罅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 ge3 wai4 jan4, sing4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 sip3 zou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢他这个人，总是想着钻空子。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like him, he's always looking for ways to get ahead by any means.

english_meaning: To fill the gap between teeth; to nibble; to have a small snack; barely enough to satisfy hunger.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是填塞牙缝，引申为吃少量食物，只能稍微满足饥饿感。比喻食物很少，不够吃。
explanation_english: Literally means to fill the gap between teeth. Figuratively, it refers to eating a small amount of food, barely enough to satisfy hunger. It implies that the food is not substantial enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先食咗少少嘢攝牙罅啫，晏啲再食過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 sik6 zo2 siu2 siu2 je5 sip3 ngaa4 laa3 ze1, aan3 di1 zoi3 sik6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才吃了一点东西，只是塞塞牙缝，晚点再吃。
examples.english_sentence: I just had a little something to nibble on earlier, I'll eat again later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲餅乾淨係夠攝牙罅，唔夠飽嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 beng2 gon1 zing6 hai6 gau3 sip3 ngaa4 laa3, m4 gau3 baau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些饼干只够塞牙缝，不够饱的。
examples.english_sentence: These biscuits are just enough to nibble on, not enough to fill you up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀嗰啲錢淨係夠攝牙罅，根本唔夠用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 go2 di1 cin2 zing6 hai6 gau3 sip3 ngaa4 laa3, gan1 bun2 m4 gau3 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给的那些钱只够塞牙缝，根本不够用。
examples.english_sentence: The money he gave is only enough to tide us over, it's not enough to use at all.

english_meaning: to curry favour; to suck up to; to brown-nose; to flatter
explanation_mandarin: 用奉承或讨好的手段去博取别人的好感。
explanation_english: To curry favour with someone, usually a superior, through flattery and subservience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺老細面前攝石，想升職啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 sip3 sek6, soeng2 sing1 zik1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在老板面前巴结，想升职罢了。
examples.english_sentence: He's sucking up to the boss every day, just wants a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣攝石啦，大家都知你諗咩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 sip3 sek6 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 lam2 me1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这样巴结了，大家都知道你在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to curry favour like that, everyone knows what you're thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 托关系的人; 找关系的人
english_meaning: Someone who uses connections or influence; A person who pulls strings; A well-connected person
explanation_mandarin: 指那些为了达到目的而通过关系、人脉来运作的人。通常带有一定的贬义，暗示这个人不是靠自身实力，而是靠关系。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who uses connections, relationships, or influence to achieve their goals. It often carries a slightly negative connotation, implying that the person is not relying on their own abilities but rather on their connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個出名嘅攝石人，乜嘢都搵人幫手搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 cheut1 ming4 ge3 sip3 sek6 jan4, mat1 je5 dou1 wan2 jan4 bong1 sau2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个出了名的托关系的人，什么都找人帮忙搞定。
examples.english_sentence: He is a notorious person who uses connections; he gets others to help him with everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢唔好成日諗住搵攝石人，自己努力先係最重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 jyu6 wan2 sip3 sek6 jan4, zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 sin1 hai6 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作不要总是想着找关系，自己努力才是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: When working, don't always think about using connections; your own effort is the most important thing.

english_meaning: to film and produce; filming and production
explanation_mandarin: 指用摄影机或其他摄像设备进行拍摄和制作电影、电视节目、广告等。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of filming and producing movies, television programs, commercials, etc., using a camera or other video recording equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲喺香港攝製。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai2 Hoeng1 Gong2 sip3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是在香港拍摄制作的。
examples.english_sentence: This movie was filmed and produced in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司專門攝製廣告片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 sip3 zai3 gwong2 gou3 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司专门拍摄制作广告片。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in filming and producing commercials.

english_meaning: to catch a cold; to get chilled; to be affected by cold (weather/wind)
explanation_mandarin: 指身体受寒，导致不适，通常指着凉感冒。
explanation_english: Refers to the body being exposed to cold, leading to discomfort, usually indicating catching a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁少衫，小心攝親呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 siu2 saam1, siu2 sam1 sip3 can1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你穿这么少衣服，小心着凉啊！
examples.english_sentence: You are wearing so little, be careful not to catch a cold!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚瞓覺冇閂窗，搞到我攝親喉嚨痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 ngaam1 fan3 gaau3 mou5 saan1 coeng1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sip3 can1 hau4 lung4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚睡觉没关窗，搞得我着凉喉咙痛。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't close the window last night while sleeping, which resulted in me catching a cold and having a sore throat.

english_meaning: to record video; video recording; filming
explanation_mandarin: 使用摄像机或录像设备记录影像。
explanation_english: To record video using a camera or video recording equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攝錄緊婚禮嘅過程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sip3 luk6 gan2 fan1 lai5 ge3 gwo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在录制婚礼的过程。
examples.english_sentence: They are recording the wedding process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請唔好喺戲院入面攝錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ching2 m4 hou2 hai2 hei3 yun2 yap6 min6 sip3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请不要在电影院里面录像。
examples.english_sentence: Please do not record video inside the cinema.

english_meaning: Camcorder, video camera
explanation_mandarin: 指用于拍摄视频的电子设备。
explanation_english: An electronic device used for recording video.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部新嘅攝錄機，想拍多啲屋企人嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 ge3 sip3 luk6 gei1, soeng2 paak3 do1 di1 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一部新的摄像机，想多拍一些家人的生活。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new camcorder and want to record more of my family's life.

mandarin_meaning: 碰运气，侥幸，瞎猫碰上死耗子
english_meaning: To get lucky, to fluke, to stumble upon something by chance, beginners luck
explanation_mandarin: 指意外地碰上好运，或技术不高明却侥幸成功。比喻运气好。
explanation_english: Refers to unexpectedly encountering good luck, or succeeding by chance despite lacking skill. It is a metaphor for being lucky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，純粹攝鐵啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, seon4 seoi6 sip3 tit3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，纯粹是碰运气罢了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, it's purely a fluke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考得咁好，我估都係攝鐵嘅機會大啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 dak1 gam3 hou2, ngo5 gu2 dou1 hai6 sip3 tit3 ge3 gei1 wui2 daai6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考得这么好，我估计多数是碰运气的成分大一些。
examples.english_sentence: I did so well on the exam this time, I guess there's a high chance it was just luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你贏咗一次就代表你勁，可能只係攝鐵咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 wing4 zo2 jat1 ci3 zau6 daai6 biu2 nei5 ging6, ho2 nang4 zi2 hai6 sip3 tit3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你赢了一次就代表你厉害，可能只是运气好而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that winning once means you're good, it might just be luck.

english_meaning: to charge (electrically)
explanation_mandarin: 指给电池或电子设备充电，使其恢复电力。
explanation_english: To charge a battery or electronic device, restoring its power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部手機冇電喇，要攝電先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 mou5 din6 laa3, jiu3 sip3 din6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手机没电了，要先充电。
examples.english_sentence: My phone is out of battery, I need to charge it first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得臨瞓前幫部平板電腦攝電啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 lam4 fan3 cin4 bong1 bou6 ping4 baan2 din6 nou5 sip3 din6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得睡觉前帮平板电脑充电啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to charge the tablet before you go to sleep.

english_meaning: Show-off; Someone who tries too hard to be trendy or fashionable, often with comical or embarrassing results; Someone who is clumsy or careless.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人穿着打扮或行为举止过于追求潮流，但效果往往适得其反，显得滑稽可笑。也指冒失鬼，做事不小心。
explanation_english: Describes someone whose appearance or behavior is trying too hard to be trendy or fashionable, often with the opposite effect, appearing comical or embarrassing. It can also refer to someone who is clumsy or careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪做啲咁嘅嘢啦，好似個攝青鬼咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 zou6 di1 gam2 ge3 je5 laa1, hou2 ci5 go3 sip3 ceng1 gwai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做那些事了，像个爱出风头的人似的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do those things, you look like a show-off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日學人着啲奇奇怪怪嘅衫，真係成個攝青鬼噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hok6 jan4 zoek3 di1 kei4 kei4 gwaai3 gwaai3 ge3 saam1, zan1 hai6 seng4 go3 sip3 ceng1 gwai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是学别人穿一些奇奇怪怪的衣服，真是像个爱出风头的人。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to copy others by wearing strange clothes, he really looks like a show-off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁唔小心，真係攝青鬼咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 m4 siu2 sam1, zan1 hai6 sip3 ceng1 gwai2 gam2 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么不小心，真是个冒失鬼的样子。
examples.english_sentence: You are so careless, you are really clumsy.

synonyms: 老泥妹 (when referring to outdated fashion sense)

english_meaning: to sleep soundly (without worries); to be carefree; to have no concerns
explanation_mandarin: 指没有忧虑，睡得很安稳。比喻没有顾虑，放心。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the state of sleeping soundly without worries. It implies being carefree and having no concerns, often suggesting a situation where one is confident and not anxious about potential problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試考完啦，依家可以攝高枕頭瞓覺啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 haau2 jyun4 laa3, ji1 gaa1 ho2 ji5 sip3 gou1 zam2 tau4 fan3 gaau3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试考完了，现在可以高枕无忧睡觉了！
examples.english_sentence: The exams are over, now I can sleep soundly without any worries!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搞掂晒啲嘢，咪可以攝高枕頭囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaau2 dim6晒啲嘢，mai6 ho2 ji5 sip3 gou1 zam2 tau4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有事情都搞定了，才可以高枕无忧。
examples.english_sentence: He has taken care of everything, so he can rest easy.

english_meaning: to take; to get; to fetch; to bring; to use
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中表示“拿”、“取”、“得到”、“使用”等意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, it means 'to take', 'to get', 'to fetch', 'to use', etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞啲嘢走先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 di1 je5 zau2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先把东西拿走。
examples.english_sentence: Take the things away first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞咗獎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 zo2 zoeng2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我得奖了！
examples.english_sentence: I won an award!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞嚟睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 lei4 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿来看一下。
examples.english_sentence: Let me have a look.

english_meaning: to reserve a seat; to get a place; to stake out a position
explanation_mandarin: 意思是提前占据位置，多指在餐厅、电影院等地方预先占座位。也引申为争取机会或优势。
explanation_english: Means to reserve or occupy a seat in advance, often referring to reserving seats in restaurants, cinemas, etc. It can also be extended to mean seizing an opportunity or gaining an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋早啲去酒樓攞位啦，驚遲咗冇位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 heoi3 zau2 lau4 lo2 wai2 laa1, geng1 chi4 zo2 mou5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们早点去酒楼占位子吧，怕晚了没座位。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the restaurant early to reserve a seat, I'm afraid there won't be any seats if we're late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識攞位，所以升得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 lo2 wai2, so2 ji5 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会争取机会，所以升迁很快。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to seize opportunities, so he gets promoted very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲演唱會嘅飛好搶手，要一早排隊攞位先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 yin2 cheung3 wui2 ge3 fei1 hou2 cheung2 sau2, yiu3 yat1 zou2 paai4 deoi2 lo2 wai2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票很抢手，要一大早排队占位子才行。
examples.english_sentence: Concert tickets are in high demand, you have to queue up early to get a place.

english_meaning: to take advantage of; to get something on the cheap; to freeload; to profit unfairly
explanation_mandarin: 指利用机会或手段，获取不正当的利益或好处。
explanation_english: To take advantage of a situation or someone, often unfairly, to gain a benefit or profit. It implies that the person is trying to get something without proper payment or effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日都想攞人哋便宜，唔好咁貪心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 lo2 jan4 dei6 bin6 yi4, m4 hou2 gam3 taam1 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是想占别人的便宜，不要那么贪心啦。
examples.english_sentence: You always want to take advantage of others, don't be so greedy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好孤寒，成日都諗住攞便宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gu1 hon4, seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 lo2 bin6 yi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很吝啬，总是想着占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He is very stingy and always thinks about taking advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次特價，咪益佢，等佢攞唔到便宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 dak6 gaa3, mai5 jik1 keoi5, dang2 keoi5 lo2 m4 dou2 bin6 yi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次特价，别让他得利，让他占不到便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This time it's a special price, don't let him benefit, let him not be able to get a cheap deal.

english_meaning: to take leave; to take a holiday; to request time off
explanation_mandarin: 向公司或学校申请休假。
explanation_english: To apply for and obtain leave from work or school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想攞幾日假去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 lo2 gei2 jat6 gaa3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想请几天假去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a few days off to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，所以要攞假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, so2 ji5 jiu3 lo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生病了，所以要请假。
examples.english_sentence: He's sick, so he needs to take leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日攞唔攞假呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ting1 jat6 lo2 m4 lo2 gaa3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天请假吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you taking leave tomorrow?

english_meaning: To throw (something) away to be used for land reclamation; to get rid of something completely useless.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻把某样东西扔到海里填海，形容某样东西毫无用处，只能丢弃。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to throw something into the sea for land reclamation, implying that the object is utterly useless and fit only to be discarded. It emphasizes complete worthlessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊電腦攞去塡海算啦，都壞晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 din6 nou5 lo2 heoi3 tin4 hoi2 syun3 laa1, dou1 waai6晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧电脑扔到海里填海算了，都坏掉了。
examples.english_sentence: These old computers are so broken, we might as well just throw them into the sea for land reclamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫到一塌糊塗，簡直攞去塡海都嫌阻地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dou3 jat1 taap3 wu4 tu4, gaan2 zik6 lo2 heoi3 tin4 hoi2 dou1 him4 zo2 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告一塌糊涂，简直扔到海里填海都嫌占地方。
examples.english_sentence: His report is such a mess, it's so bad it's a waste of space even to throw it into the sea for land reclamation.

english_meaning: Throw it to the sea (for land reclamation); useless; good for nothing; to get rid of something worthless
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拿去填海，指东西毫无用处，只能拿去填海造地；引申为丢弃，处理掉没用的东西。 也用来形容某人或某事毫无价值。
explanation_english: Literally means to take something to the sea for land reclamation. It implies that something is completely useless and only suitable for land reclamation. By extension, it means to discard or get rid of something worthless. It can also be used to describe someone or something as worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊電腦都冇用㗎啦，攞去填海算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau6 din6 nou5 dou1 mou5 yung6 gaa3 laa3, lo2 heoi3 tin4 hoi2 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑都没用了，把它丢掉算了。
examples.english_sentence: This old computer is useless, let's just get rid of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份proposal咁差，攞去填海都嫌阻地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 proposal gam3 chaa1, lo2 heoi3 tin4 hoi2 dou1 him4 zo2 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的提案那么差，丢到海里都嫌碍地方。
examples.english_sentence: His proposal is so bad, even throwing it into the sea would be a waste of space.

mandarin_meaning: 逞口舌之快；说大话；吹牛
english_meaning: To boast; to brag; to talk big; to show off with words
explanation_mandarin: 指用言语夸大自己的能力或成就，以此来炫耀或抬高自己。
explanation_english: Refers to exaggerating one's abilities or achievements through speech to show off or elevate oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日攞口響啦，做啲嘢出嚟先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 sing4 jat6 lo2 hau2 hoeng2 laa1, zou6 di1 je5 chut1 lai4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是说大话，先做点成绩出来。
examples.english_sentence: Stop bragging all the time, produce some results first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最叻就係攞口響，但係做嘢就唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 lek1 zau6 hai6 lo2 hau2 hoeng2, daan6 hai6 zou6 je5 zau6 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最擅长的就是吹牛，但是做事就不行。
examples.english_sentence: He is best at bragging, but he's not good at getting things done.

english_meaning: life-threatening; to kill; to be extremely difficult; to drive someone crazy; killing (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情非常严重，会让人受不了；也指夺取性命。
explanation_english: Describes something extremely serious or unbearable; can also refer to taking someone's life (literally or figuratively, as in 'driving someone crazy').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project做到攞命啊，日日都要OT！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project zou6 dou3 lo2 ming6 aa3, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目做到要命啊，每天都要加班！
examples.english_sentence: This project is killing me, I have to work overtime every day!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日熱到攞命，好似焗桑拿咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jit6 dou3 lo2 ming6, hou2 ci5 guk6 song1 naa4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天热得要命，好像蒸桑拿一样。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot today, it's like being in a sauna.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌聲好似攞命咁難聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 sing1 hou2 ci5 lo2 ming6 gam2 naan4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌声难听得要命。
examples.english_sentence: His singing is terribly awful.

english_meaning: asking for it; bringing it upon oneself; inviting trouble; well deserved (negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦、自作自受。通常带有负面评价，表示某人因自己的行为而导致不好的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to bringing trouble upon oneself or reaping what one sows. It usually has a negative connotation, indicating that someone has brought about a bad result due to their own actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔聽我講，而家衰咗咪攞嚟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ting1 ngo5 gong2, ji4 gaa1 seoi1 zo2 mai1 lo2 lai4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不听我的话，现在失败了不是活该吗？
examples.english_sentence: You didn't listen to me, so now that you've failed, you're asking for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，俾人鬧咪攞嚟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, bei2 jan4 naau6 mai1 lo2 lai4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天惹是生非，被人骂不是自找的吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's always causing trouble, so getting scolded is what he deserves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明叫你唔好掂，你又唔聽，電親咪攞嚟囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 dim6, nei5 jau6 m4 ting1, din6 can1 mai1 lo2 lai4 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明叫你不要碰，你又不听，触电了不是活该吗？
examples.english_sentence: I clearly told you not to touch it, but you didn't listen, so getting shocked is what you deserve!

english_meaning: to ask for trouble; to bring it on oneself; to be asking for it
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦，原本可以避免的事情，却因为自己的行为而导致了不好的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to bringing trouble upon oneself; doing something that leads to an undesirable outcome which could have been avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明知佢脾氣唔好，仲要撩佢，咪攞嚟做囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 zi1 keoi5 pei4 hei3 m4 hou2, zung6 jiu3 liu1 keoi5, mai1 lo2 lai4 zou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明知道他脾气不好，还要招惹他，这不是自找麻烦吗。
examples.english_sentence: You knew he has a bad temper, but you still provoked him. You're just asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔熟路就唔好自己揸車去啦，攞嚟做㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 suk6 lou6 zau6 m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 ce1 heoi3 laa1, lo2 lai4 zou6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不熟悉路就不要自己开车去啦，不是自找麻烦吗？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't know the way, don't drive there yourself. Are you asking for trouble?

synonyms: 自討苦吃 (zi6 tou2 fu2 hek3)

mandarin_meaning: 自找麻烦; 没事找事
english_meaning: to ask for trouble; to invite problems; to create unnecessary problems; to stir up trouble
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦，原本没事，自己故意制造问题或招惹麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to inviting trouble or creating problems for oneself. It implies that there was no problem initially, but someone deliberately created or attracted it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣做呀，攞嚟搞㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 zou6 aa3, lo2 lai4 gaau2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要这样做，那是自找麻烦！
examples.english_sentence: You better not do that, you're asking for trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明冇嘢，你又走去撩佢，真係攞嚟搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 mou5 je5, nei5 jau6 zau2 heoi3 liu1 keoi5, zan1 hai6 lo2 lai4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明没事，你又跑去惹他，真是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: There was nothing wrong, but you went to provoke him, that's really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理佢哋啦，佢哋鍾意攞嚟搞㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 dei6 laa1, keoi5 dei6 zung1 ji3 lo2 lai4 gaau2 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别理他们了，他们喜欢自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with them, they like to stir up trouble.

english_meaning: to make a fool of oneself; to become a laughingstock; to invite ridicule
explanation_mandarin: 指做了一些愚蠢的事情，结果被人嘲笑。通常带有自作自受，活该的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something foolish or stupid, resulting in being ridiculed by others. It often carries the implication of 'deserving it' or 'bringing it upon oneself'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁蠢嘅計仔都信，真係攞嚟笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ceon2 ge3 gai3 zai2 dou1 seon3, zan1 hai6 lo2 lai4 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么愚蠢的计策都相信，真是自取其辱。
examples.english_sentence: You actually believed such a stupid plan, you're really making a fool of yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上跌親，咪即係攞嚟笑囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng2 dit3 can1, mai1 zik1 hai6 lo2 lai4 siu3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上摔倒了，那不就是贻笑大方吗？
examples.english_sentence: He fell on stage, so he's become a laughingstock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔識做就唔好扮識，唔係咪攞嚟笑囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sik1 zou6 zau6 m4 hou2 baan6 sik1, m4 hai6 mai1 lo2 lai4 siu3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不会做就不要装懂，不然就是自取其辱。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't know how to do it, don't pretend you do, or you'll just make a fool of yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自找麻烦, 自讨苦吃
english_meaning: to ask for trouble, to bring trouble upon oneself, to invite disaster
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人明明知道事情会带来不好的结果，却仍然去做，相当于自找麻烦，自讨苦吃。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone knowingly does something that will lead to negative consequences, essentially inviting trouble or disaster upon themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明知佢性格係咁，仲要去惹佢，真係攞嚟衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 zi1 keoi5 sing3 gaak3 hai6 gam2, zung6 jiu3 heoi3 re2 keoi5, zan1 hai6 lo2 lei4 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明知道他的性格是这样，还要去惹他，真是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: You know his personality is like that, and you still go and provoke him, you're really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明考試前唔溫書，到時唔合格就攞嚟衰啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 haau2 si5 cin4 m4 wan1 syu1, dou3 si4 m4 hap1 gaak3 zau6 lo2 lei4 seoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明考试前不复习，到时候不及格就是自找麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Clearly not studying before the exam, if you fail then you're bringing it on yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自找麻煩 / 找茬儿 / 故意提起
english_meaning: To bring it up deliberately (often to cause trouble); to ask for it; to bring something upon oneself
explanation_mandarin: 故意提起不愉快的事情或問題，常帶有責備或不滿的語氣，暗示自找麻煩。
explanation_english: To deliberately bring up an unpleasant topic or problem, often with a tone of blame or dissatisfaction, implying that someone is asking for trouble or bringing something upon themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再提件事啦，攞嚟講咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4 gin6 si6 laa1, lo2 lei4 gong2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再提这件事了，是故意找茬吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't bring up this matter again, are you asking for it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經唔想理佢，佢仲要走嚟挑釁我，真係攞嚟講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 m4 soeng2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zung6 jiu3 zau2 lei4 tiu1 san3 ngo5, zan1 hai6 lo2 lei4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经不想理他了，他还要来挑衅我，真是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: I already didn't want to bother with him, but he still came to provoke me, he's really asking for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明知老闆心情唔好，你仲走去問佢加人工，擺明攞嚟講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 zi1 lou5 baan2 sam1 ching4 m4 hou2, nei5 zung6 zau2 heoi3 man6 keoi5 gaa1 yan4 gung1, baai2 ming4 lo2 lei4 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明知道老板心情不好，你还跑去问他加薪，摆明是自找麻烦啊。
examples.english_sentence: You clearly knew the boss was in a bad mood, and you still went to ask him for a raise, you're obviously asking for it.

english_meaning: to ask for trouble, to bring suffering upon oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦，自寻烦恼，明明知道后果不好，却还要去做。
explanation_english: Refers to bringing trouble upon oneself. Knowing the consequences are bad, but still choosing to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明知佢份人係咁，仲要同佢合作，真係攞嚟賤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 zi1 keoi5 fan6 jan4 hai6 gam2, zung6 jiu3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3, zan1 hai6 lo2 lei4 zin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明知道他就是那样的人，还要和他合作，真是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: You know he's that kind of person, yet you still want to cooperate with him, you're really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明考試前唔溫書，考唔到好成績咪攞嚟賤囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 haau2 si5 cin4 m4 wan1 syu1, haau2 m4 dou2 hou2 sing1 zik1 mai1 lo2 lei4 zin6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明考试前不复习，考不到好成绩就是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: Clearly you didn't study before the exam, not getting good grades is just asking for trouble.

english_meaning: to ask for trouble; to make things difficult for oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指自找麻烦，给自己增加不必要的负担和痛苦。
explanation_english: Refers to bringing trouble upon oneself, creating unnecessary burdens and suffering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明唔識整，仲要幫人整電腦，真係攞嚟辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 m4 sik1 zeng2, cung4 jiu3 bong1 jan4 zeng2 din6 nou5, zan1 hai6 lo2 lai4 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明不会修，还要帮别人修电脑，真是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: You clearly don't know how to fix it, yet you still try to fix other people's computers. You're just asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放工咁攰，仲要煮咁多餸，簡直係攞嚟辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gung1 gam3 gui6, cung4 jiu3 zyu2 gam3 do1 sung3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 lo2 lai4 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下班这么累，还要做这么多菜，简直是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: After being so tired from work, and still cooking so many dishes, it's simply making things difficult for yourself.

english_meaning: to win an award; to be awarded a prize
explanation_mandarin: 获得奖项。指在比赛、竞赛或其他评选中获得优胜，得到奖励。
explanation_english: To win an award or prize, usually in a competition or contest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年攞咗最佳男主角奬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 lo2 zo2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年获得了最佳男主角奖。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Best Actor award this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋努力啲，今年一定攞奬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 nu5 lik6 di1, gam1 nin4 jat1 ding6 lo2 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们更努力一点，今年一定能获奖。
examples.english_sentence: If we work harder, we will definitely win an award this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅發明攞咗國際大奬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 faat3 ming5 lo2 zo2 gwok3 zai3 daai6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的发明获得了国际大奖。
examples.english_sentence: His invention won an international award.

mandarin_meaning: 占便宜, 捡便宜, 捞好处
english_meaning: to take advantage at the last minute, to get the last laugh, to profit from someone else's work at the end
explanation_mandarin: 在事情快要结束的时候，占到便宜或获得好处。通常指别人付出了努力，而自己最后却得到好处。
explanation_english: To profit from a situation, especially at the very end, often after others have done the hard work. It implies taking advantage of a situation to gain benefits without contributing significantly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度攞尾彩，乜都唔做，到最後就拎晒 credit。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 lo2 mei5 coi2, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6, dou3 zeoi3 hau6 zau6 ling1 saai3 credit.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想占便宜，什么都不做，到最后就把所有的功劳都拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to take advantage at the last minute, does nothing, and then takes all the credit at the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢攞尾彩啊，呢個 project 我哋做咗咁耐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 lo2 mei5 coi2 aa3, ni1 go3 project ngo5 dei6 zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别让他占便宜了，这个项目我们做了这么久了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him take advantage, we've been working on this project for so long.

english_meaning: to try to impress, to show off, to seek applause/approval
explanation_mandarin: 指为了得到别人的赞赏或喝彩而故意做出某种行为或展示某种才能。带有炫耀和讨好的意味。
explanation_english: To deliberately do something or showcase a talent in order to gain praise or applause from others. It carries a connotation of showing off and trying to please.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前攞彩，想升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 lo2 coi2, soeng2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前表现自己，想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always trying to impress the boss, hoping for a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺我面前攞彩啦，我知你好叻㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 lo2 coi2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 hou2 lek1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在我面前炫耀了，我知道你很厉害了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to show off in front of me, I know you're very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣攞彩，好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 lo2 coi2, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那样炫耀，很令人讨厌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't show off like that, it's very annoying.

english_meaning: to seek a good omen; to do something for good luck
explanation_mandarin: 为了获得好运或者好的兆头而做某事。
explanation_english: To do something in order to seek good luck or a favorable omen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年我哋要食啲有寓意嘅嘢，攞意頭嘛！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sik6 di1 jau5 jyu6 ji3 ge3 je5, lo2 ji3 tau4 maa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年我们要吃一些有寓意的东西，图个好彩头嘛！
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, we need to eat things with symbolic meaning, to seek good luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開工第一日，買個菠蘿包攞意頭，希望盤生意紅皮赤壯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 gung1 dai6 jat1 jat6, maai5 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 lo2 ji3 tau4, hei1 mong6 pun4 sang1 ji3 hung4 pei4 cek3 zong3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开工第一天，买个菠萝包讨个彩头，希望生意兴隆。
examples.english_sentence: On the first day of work, I'll buy a pineapple bun to bring good luck, hoping the business will be prosperous.

english_meaning: To take a handbag
explanation_mandarin: 拿取或拿起手提包。是一个非常直接的动作描述。
explanation_english: To take, pick up, or get a handbag. It's a straightforward description of the action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出街之前要攞手袋先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 chut1 gaai1 zi1 cin4 jiu3 lo2 sau2 doi2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我出门之前要先拿手提包。
examples.english_sentence: I need to take my handbag before I go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度攞手袋，準備走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 lo2 sau2 doi2, zeon2 bei6 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在拿手提包，准备走了。
examples.english_sentence: She is taking her handbag, getting ready to leave.

mandarin_meaning: 搞定; 摆平; 解决
english_meaning: to settle; to sort out; to handle; to get it done; to resolve
explanation_mandarin: 指把事情处理妥当，解决问题。
explanation_english: Refers to handling things properly, resolving problems, and getting things sorted out or settled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我一定會幫你攞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 bong1 nei5 lo2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我一定会帮你搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: I will definitely help you sort this out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，我一定攞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ngo5 jat1 ding6 lo2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，我一定能解决它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will definitely handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project 老闆叫我一定要攞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lo2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我一定要把那个项目搞定。
examples.english_sentence: The boss told me I must complete that project successfully.

mandarin_meaning: 搜集资料, 获取信息
english_meaning: to gather information, to collect data, to research
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某种目的而搜集资料或信息。
explanation_english: To gather information or collect data for a specific purpose; to research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要做個報告，要攞多啲料先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou6 go3 bou3 gou3, jiu3 lo2 do1 di1 liu2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要写一个报告，要多收集一些资料才行。
examples.english_sentence: We need to write a report, we need to gather more information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度攞料，唔知做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 lo2 liu2, m4 zi1 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在收集资料，不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always gathering information, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者為咗寫新聞，要四圍攞料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 wai6 zo2 se2 san1 man2, jiu3 sei3 wai4 lo2 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者为了写新闻，要四处搜集资料。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters need to gather information from all around to write the news.

english_meaning: to hog the limelight, to steal the show, to take all the credit
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或一件事出尽风头，把所有的注意力都吸引过去，或者把所有的功劳都占为己有。
explanation_english: Refers to someone or something that hogs the limelight, attracts all the attention, or takes all the credit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺個presentation度攞晒彩，講到好似所有嘢都係佢做咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 go3 presentation dou6 lo2 saai3 coi2, gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 so2 jau5 je5 dou1 hai6 keoi5 zou6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在演示中出尽风头，说的好像所有事情都是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: He stole the show in the presentation, making it sound like he did everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住攞晒彩，要畀啲機會其他人表現下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 lo2 saai3 coi2, jiu3 bei2 di1 gei1 wui2 kei4 taa1 jan4 biu2 hin6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着出尽风头，要给一些机会其他人表现一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about hogging the limelight, give others a chance to shine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞晒彩之後，大家都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 saai3 coi2 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出尽风头之后，大家都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: After he hogged the limelight, everyone disliked him.

mandarin_meaning: 找麻烦，做样子，装模作样
english_meaning: to make trouble, to show off, to make a scene, to do something for appearances
explanation_mandarin: 指故意制造麻烦，或为了达到某种目的而做表面功夫，装模作样。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately creating trouble, or doing something for appearances to achieve a certain goal; to put on an act, to show off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度攞景啦，快啲做嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 lo2 ging2 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里找麻烦了，快点工作吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't make trouble here, get to work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前攞景，想升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 lo2 ging2, soeng2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在老板面前做样子，想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He often tries to show off in front of the boss, hoping to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好攞景啦，我知你唔係真心想幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lo2 ging2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 soeng2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要装模作样了，我知道你不是真心想帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Stop putting on an act, I know you don't really want to help.

english_meaning: Are you trying to mess things up or help?
explanation_mandarin: 指某人的行为让人难以判断是故意捣乱还是真心帮忙，通常带有贬义或嘲讽的意味。
explanation_english: This idiom questions whether someone's actions are deliberately causing trouble or genuinely trying to help. It often carries a negative or sarcastic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日喺度搞搞震，攞景定贈興呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, lo2 ging2 ding6 zang6 hing1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是在这里捣乱，你是添乱还是帮忙啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're always messing around here. Are you trying to make things worse or are you actually helping?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢又唔識，但係又衝出嚟畀意見，真係唔知佢攞景定贈興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 cung1 chut1 lai4 bei2 ji3 gin3, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 lo2 ging2 ding6 zang6 hing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他又不了解情况，却冲出来给意见，真不知道他是添乱还是帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't even know what's going on, but he's rushing to give his opinion. I really don't know if he's making things worse or helping.

english_meaning: to reserve a table; to take a table (at a restaurant)
explanation_mandarin: 在餐厅或茶楼等地方，提前占有或拿取一张桌子。
explanation_english: To reserve or take a table in a restaurant, tea house, etc., often before ordering or when it's busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋早啲去攞枱，唔係陣間冇位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 heoi3 lo2 toi2, m4 hai6 zan6 gaan1 mou5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们早点去占座，不然一会儿就没位置了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go reserve a table earlier, otherwise there won't be any seats later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆自己攞咗張枱，坐低睇報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 zi6 gei2 lo2 zo2 zoeng1 toi2, co5 dai1 tai2 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶自己拿了一张桌子，坐下看报纸。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady took a table for herself and sat down to read the newspaper.

english_meaning: to have official permission; to be officially sanctioned; to have a license to do something
explanation_mandarin: 指得到正式的许可或者批准，可以光明正大地做某事。
explanation_english: Refers to obtaining official permission or approval, allowing one to do something openly and legitimately. It implies a formal authorization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攞咗正牌可以喺條街度賣嘢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 lo2 zo2 zeng3 paai4 ho2 ji5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 maai6 je5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们获得了正式许可可以在这条街上卖东西了。
examples.english_sentence: They have got official permission to sell things on this street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家佢攞正牌遲到，因為佢嘅上司批准咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 keoi5 lo2 zeng3 paai4 ci4 dou3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 ge3 soeng5 si1 pui1 zhun2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在他可以光明正大地迟到，因为他的上司批准了。
examples.english_sentence: Now he has the official license to be late because his boss approved it.

english_meaning: to win an award, to be awarded
explanation_mandarin: 获得奖励，得到奖项。
explanation_english: To receive an award; to be the recipient of an award.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年攞咗最佳男主角獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 lo2 zo2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年获得了最佳男主角奖。
examples.english_sentence: He won the Best Actor award this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋努力啲，下次一定可以攞獎嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 nou5 lik6 di1, haa6 ci3 jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 lo2 zoeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们努力一点，下次一定可以得奖的。
examples.english_sentence: If we work harder, we can definitely win an award next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗攞獎，真係好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 lo2 zoeng2, zan1 hai6 hou2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了得奖，他真的很努力。
examples.english_sentence: He is working really hard to win an award.

english_meaning: to take photos (usually referring to posed or formal photos)
explanation_mandarin: 指拍摄照片，多指摆好姿势的正规拍照。
explanation_english: To take photos, usually referring to posed or formal photography, as opposed to candid snapshots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日去主題樂園攞相啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zyu2 tai4 lok6 jyun2 lo2 soeng3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天去主题公园拍照吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the theme park to take photos today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，好多人都會去花市攞相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 heoi3 faa1 si5 lo2 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，很多人都会去花市拍照。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many people go to the flower market to take photos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嘅時候，用咗好多錢攞相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ge3 si4 hau6, yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 lo2 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚的时候，花了很多钱拍照。
examples.english_sentence: They spent a lot of money taking photos when they got married.

english_meaning: To gain an advantage, to profit at someone else's expense, to be opportunistic
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不公平或不正当的手段，从他人或事物中获取利益或优势。
explanation_english: Refers to gaining an advantage, benefit, or profit, often through unfair or opportunistic means, sometimes at the expense of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣攞着數，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 lo2 zoek3 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎么占便宜，真是很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always thinking about how to gain an advantage; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁貪心，唔好諗住淨係攞着數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 taam1 sam1, m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 zing6 hai6 lo2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么贪心，不要只想占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so greedy, don't only think about gaining an advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意唔可以淨係諗住攞着數，長遠嘅合作先至重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 seng1 ji3 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 lo2 zoek3 sou3, coeng4 jyun5 ge3 hap6 zok3 sin1 zi3 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意不可以只想着占便宜，长期的合作才重要。
examples.english_sentence: In business, you can't just think about gaining advantages; long-term collaboration is more important.

english_meaning: to pluck up courage, to embolden oneself, to psych oneself up
explanation_mandarin: 鼓起勇气，使自己更有胆量。
explanation_english: To pluck up courage, to embolden oneself, often involving doing something risky or scary after hesitation. It implies building up the courage to do something one is afraid of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞咗好耐膽，先敢去同佢表白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 zo2 hou2 noi6 daam2, sin1 gam2 heoi3 tung4 keoi5 biu2 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我鼓了好久的勇气，才敢去向他表白。
examples.english_sentence: I plucked up courage for a long time before daring to confess my feelings to him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知我驚，咪鼓勵我攞膽試下囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 ngo5 geng1, mai1 gu2 lai6 ngo5 lo2 daam2 si3 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道我害怕，就鼓励我壮着胆子试试看。
examples.english_sentence: He knew I was scared, so he encouraged me to pluck up courage and give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你攞啲膽出嚟啦，唔好咁懦弱啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lo2 di1 daam2 chut1 lei4 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 no6 joek6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿出点勇气来吧，别这么懦弱了！
examples.english_sentence: Show some courage, don't be so weak!

english_meaning: to ask for trouble; to make a rod for one's own back; to go out of one's way to make life difficult
explanation_mandarin: 指自己找麻烦，本来可以避免痛苦，却偏偏要去做。
explanation_english: To deliberately create problems or difficulties for oneself; to go out of one's way to make things harder than they need to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明唔識整電腦，仲要自己拆開佢，咪就係攞苦嚟辛囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 m4 sik1 zing2 din6 nou5, zung6 jiu3 zi6 gei2 caak3 hoi1 keoi5, mai1 zau6 hai6 lo2 fu2 lai4 san1 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明不懂修电脑，还要自己拆开它，不就是自讨苦吃吗！
examples.english_sentence: You clearly don't know how to fix computers, yet you disassembled it yourself. Isn't that just asking for trouble?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明可以搭的士，你又要行咁遠路返屋企，真係攞苦嚟辛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 ho2 ji5 daap3 dik1 si2, nei5 jau6 jiu3 haang4 gam3 jyun5 lou6 faan1 uk1 kei2, zan1 hai6 lo2 fu2 lai4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明可以打出租车，你又要走那么远的路回家，真是自讨苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: You could have taken a taxi, but you chose to walk such a long way home. You're really just asking for trouble.

english_meaning: to take advantage, to get a bargain, to look for (unfair) advantages
explanation_mandarin: 指利用机会或手段获取不正当的利益，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: To take advantage of a situation or someone, often in an opportunistic or even slightly dishonest way. It implies seeking gains that may not be entirely fair or deserved. Can also mean getting a good deal or bargain, but often carries the implication of shrewdness and potential exploitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住點樣攞著數嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 lo2 zoek6 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着怎样占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He is always thinking about how to take advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住攞著數，做人要光明正大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 lo2 zoek6 sou3, zou6 jan4 jiu3 gwong1 ming4 zing3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着占便宜，做人要光明正大。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about taking advantage, be honest and upright.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭做緊大減價，快啲去攞著數啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3, faai3 di1 heoi3 lo2 zoek6 sou3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店正在做大减价，快点去占便宜吧！
examples.english_sentence: This shop is having a big sale, hurry up and go grab a bargain!

english_meaning: to get medicine, to collect medicine
explanation_mandarin: 指去医院、药房等地方领取医生开的药物。
explanation_english: To get or collect medicine, usually from a hospital or pharmacy after seeing a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去醫院攞藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ji1 yun2 lo2 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去医院拿药。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go to the hospital to get medicine today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你攞咗藥未啊？記得食啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lo2 zo2 joek6 mei6 aa3? gei3 dak1 sik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你拿药了吗？记得吃药啊！
examples.english_sentence: Have you collected your medicine yet? Remember to take it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞藥嘅時候，記得問清楚醫生點樣食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 joek6 ge3 si4 hau2, gei3 dak1 man6 cing1 co2 yi1 sang1 dim2 joeng2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿药的时候，记得问清楚医生怎么吃。
examples.english_sentence: When collecting the medicine, remember to ask the doctor clearly how to take it.

english_meaning: to take away, to remove, to carry off
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物从某地拿走，带离。
explanation_english: To take something away from a place; to remove it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞走咗本書喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 zau2 zo2 bun2 syu1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经把书拿走了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already taken the book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞走晒啲嘢，咩都冇留低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zau2 saai3 di1 je5, me1 dou1 mou5 lau4 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的东西都拿走了，什么也没留下。
examples.english_sentence: He took everything away, leaving nothing behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我攞走啲垃圾啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 lo2 zau2 di1 laap6 saap3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以帮我把这些垃圾拿走吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me take the trash away?

mandarin_meaning: 改变方向; 改变策略; 转舵
english_meaning: To change direction; to change strategy; to steer (a ship or car)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“握住方向盘”。引申意思是指改变方向，改变策略或做法。常用于形容人或组织改变立场或政策。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to hold the steering wheel'. Figuratively, it means to change direction, strategy, or approach. Often used to describe a person or organization changing their stance or policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見情況唔對路，即刻攞軚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 ching4 fong3 m4 deoi3 lou6, jik1 hak1 lo2 taai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到情况不对，立刻改变了策略。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the situation was not right, he immediately changed his strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅政策經常攞軚，搞到我哋好難適應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jing1 chak3 ging1 seung4 lo2 taai5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 naan4 sik1 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的政策经常变动，搞得我们很难适应。
examples.english_sentence: The company's policies change frequently, making it difficult for us to adapt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前反對呢個提案，但係而家又攞軚支持，真係估佢唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 chin4 faan2 deoi3 ni1 go3 tai4 on3, daan6 hai6 ji4 ga1 jau6 lo2 taai5 zhi1 chi4, zhan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前反对这个提案，但是现在又转变立场支持，真是出乎意料。
examples.english_sentence: He previously opposed this proposal, but now he's changed his mind and supports it. It's really unexpected.

english_meaning: to withdraw money; to take money; to get money
explanation_mandarin: 指从银行、自动取款机等地方取出钱，或者直接拿取某处的钱。
explanation_english: Refers to withdrawing money from a bank, ATM, or taking money from somewhere directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去銀行攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去银行取钱。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the bank to withdraw money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去自動櫃員機攞錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zi6 dung6 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 lo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去自动柜员机取钱。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the ATM to withdraw money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆攞錢出嚟派俾員工做花紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 lo2 cin2 chut1 lai4 paai3 bei2 wun4 gung1 zou6 faa1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板拿钱出来分给员工做花红。
examples.english_sentence: The boss took out money to distribute to employees as bonuses.

english_meaning: to look in the mirror
explanation_mandarin: 观察自己的形象，通常使用镜子。
explanation_english: To observe one's own appearance, usually using a mirror.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都要攞鏡，睇下自己嘅樣靚唔靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 lo2 geng3, tai2 haa5 zi6 gei2 ge3 joeng2 leng3 m4 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都要照镜子，看看自己的样子漂亮不漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He looks in the mirror every day to see if he looks pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你攞鏡睇下，個妝係咪花咗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lo2 geng3 tai2 haa5, go3 zong1 hai6 mai1 faa1 zo2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你照照镜子看看，妆是不是花了？
examples.english_sentence: Look in the mirror and see if your makeup is smudged.

mandarin_meaning: 积攒, 凑集, 聚集
english_meaning: to save up, to accumulate, to gather, to assemble
