examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 dou3 fung1 mei6 aa3? teng1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 git3 fan1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有听到风声？听说他们要结婚了！
examples.english_sentence: Have you heard? I heard they're getting married!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收到風，聽日老細會突擊檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou3 fung1, teng1 jat6 lou5 sai3 wui5 dat6 gik1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收到风声，明天老板会突击检查。
examples.english_sentence: We heard that the boss will be making a surprise inspection tomorrow.

english_meaning: harvest; reap; collect; to profit at someone's expense
explanation_mandarin: 原指收割农作物。引申义指获取利益，有时带有贬义，指通过不正当手段或利用他人获取好处。
explanation_english: Originally refers to harvesting crops.  By extension, it means to gain profit or benefits. Sometimes it carries a negative connotation, implying obtaining benefits through unfair means or by exploiting others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲發展商收割晒啲農田，起樓賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 faat3 zin2 soeng1 sau1 got3晒 di1 nung4 tin4, hei2 lau2 mai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些开发商把农田都收割了，盖楼卖。
examples.english_sentence: The developers harvested all the farmland and built apartments to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺股市度收割咗一大筆錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gu2 si5 dou6 sau1 got3 zo2 jat1 daai6 bat1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在股市里收获了一大笔钱。
examples.english_sentence: He reaped a large sum of money in the stock market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司不斷咁收割員工嘅福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bat1 dyun6 gam2 sau1 got3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司不断地剥削员工的福利。
examples.english_sentence: The company is constantly cutting back on employee benefits (exploiting them).

english_meaning: to collect; to receive; to charge (fees)
explanation_mandarin: 指收集，接收，或收取费用。
explanation_english: Refers to collecting, receiving, or charging fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行會收取手續費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaan4 hong4 wui5 sau1 ceoi2 sau2 zuk1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行会收取手续费。
examples.english_sentence: The bank will charge a handling fee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋會收取入場費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wui5 sau1 ceoi2 jap6 coeng4 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们会收取入场费。
examples.english_sentence: They will charge an entrance fee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司收取好高嘅服務費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sau1 ceoi2 hou2 gou1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司收取很高的服务费。
examples.english_sentence: This company charges a very high service fee.

english_meaning: to accept; to receive (usually illicitly or improperly)
explanation_mandarin: 接受，通常指接受贿赂或其他不正当利益。
explanation_english: To accept or receive something, typically implying the acceptance of bribes or other illicit benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為收受利益而被捕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 sau1 sau6 lei6 yik1 yi4 bei6 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为收受利益而被捕。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for accepting bribes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以收受任何形式嘅賄賂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 yi5 sau1 sau6 yam6 ho4 hang4 sik1 ge3 wai2 lo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以接受任何形式的贿赂。
examples.english_sentence: You must not accept any form of bribery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廉政公署調查佢收受非法利益嘅案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lim4 jing3 gung1 syu5 diu6 ca4 keoi5 sau1 sau6 fei1 faat3 lei6 yik1 ge3 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廉政公署调查他收受非法利益的案件。
examples.english_sentence: The Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) is investigating his case of accepting illegal benefits.

english_meaning: Shut up; Stop talking; Hold your tongue
explanation_mandarin: 停止说话；闭嘴。
explanation_english: To stop talking; to shut up; to hold one's tongue. It carries a negative connotation, implying that the speaker should not be saying what they are saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再講落去就抵鬧喇，快啲收口啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 dai2 naau6 laa3, faai3 di1 sau1 hau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再说下去就活该被骂了，快点闭嘴吧！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep talking like that, you deserve to be scolded. Shut up now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，收口啦！咁多人喺度，唔好講呢啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sau1 hau2 laa1! gam3 do1 jan4 hai2 dou6, m4 hou2 gong2 ni1 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，别说了！这么多人在这里，不要说这些东西了。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, shut up! There are so many people here, don't say things like that.

synonyms: 唔好出聲 (m4 hou2 cheut1 seng1)

english_meaning: Stop it, quit, give up, shut up (often used dismissively)
explanation_mandarin: 表示停止、放弃正在进行的活动或说话，带有不耐烦或轻蔑的语气。
explanation_english: To stop an action or cease talking, often used with impatience or dismissiveness. Can also mean 'give it a rest' or 'shut up'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，收咧啦！你都講咗成個鐘，我都唔想聽喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sau1 le1 laa1! nei5 dou1 gong2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 teng1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，住手吧！你都讲了一个小时了，我都不想听了。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, stop it! You've been talking for an hour, I don't want to listen anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，收咧啦，唔好再拗落去喇，冇意思嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, sau1 le1 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 aau3 lok6 heoi3 laa3, mou5 ji3 si1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，别争了，不要再争下去了，没意义的。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, give it up, don't argue anymore, it's pointless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要考試喇，你哋收咧啦，唔好再打機喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 si3 laa3, nei5 dei6 sau1 le1 laa3, m4 hou2 zoi3 daa2 gei1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要考试了，你们别玩了，不要再打游戏了。
examples.english_sentence: We have exams tomorrow, you guys stop it, don't play games anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 算了, 得了, 停止吧
english_meaning: Stop it! That's enough! Give it a rest!
explanation_mandarin: 表示不耐烦或不满， 叫别人停止做某事或停止说话。
explanation_english: Expresses impatience or disapproval.  Used to tell someone to stop doing something or stop talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收啦！你講咗成個鐘都係講緊同一件事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 laa1! nei5 gong2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou1 hai6 gong2 gan2 tung4 jat1 gin6 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 得了！你讲了一个小时都是在讲同一件事！
examples.english_sentence: Stop it! You've been talking about the same thing for an hour!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收啦，唔好再嘈啦，我想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 cou4 laa1, ngo5 soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，别再吵了，我想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: That's enough, stop being so noisy, I want to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收啦，知你叻仔啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 laa1, zi1 nei5 lek1 zai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了好了，知道你厉害啦！
examples.english_sentence: Alright, alright, we know you're great!

english_meaning: Shut up
explanation_mandarin: 闭嘴，停止说话。带有强烈的不满或生气的情绪。
explanation_english: Shut up, be quiet. It implies a strong feeling of dissatisfaction or anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再講啲咁嘅嘢，我叫你收嗲呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 gong2 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, ngo5 giu3 nei5 sau1 de2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再说这种话，我就叫你闭嘴！
examples.english_sentence: If you say something like that again, I'll tell you to shut up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大佬，收嗲啦，嘈到我瞓唔著！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lou2, sau1 de2 laa1, caau4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大哥，闭嘴吧，吵得我睡不着！
examples.english_sentence: Dude, shut up, you're too noisy and I can't sleep!

english_meaning: to pack up, to tidy up, to clear away; (slang) to get screwed over, to get the short end of the stick
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思为收拾东西，整理物品。口语中也有“倒霉，吃亏”的意思，表示某人遭遇了不好的事情或被占了便宜。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to pack things up or tidy up. In colloquial Cantonese, it also has the meaning of 'to get screwed over,' 'to get the short end of the stick,' indicating that someone has encountered something bad or been taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收嘢走啦，就嚟閂門啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 je5 zau2 laa1, zau6 lei4 saan1 mun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收拾东西走了，快要关门了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's pack up and go, it's almost closing time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我真係收晒嘢，俾佢呃咗咁多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau1 saai3 je5, bei2 keoi5 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我真的倒大霉了，被他骗了这么多钱。
examples.english_sentence: I really got screwed over this time, he cheated me out of so much money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾人收你嘢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 sau1 nei5 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，不要被人占便宜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't let people take advantage of you.

synonyms: 畀人搵笨 (bei2 jan4 wan2 ban6)

english_meaning: to retract an order; to withdraw a decree; to rescind an order
explanation_mandarin: 指取消或收回已经发布的命令或决定。
explanation_english: Refers to canceling or retracting an order or decision that has already been issued.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細聽咗我嘅解釋之後，收回成命，冇炒我魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 ting3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 gaai2 sik1 zi1 hau6, sau1 wui4 sing4 ming6, mou5 caau2 ngo5 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板听了我的解释之后，收回成命，没有炒我鱿鱼。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing my explanation, the boss retracted the order and didn't fire me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺公眾壓力之下，被迫收回成命，取消咗個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 gung1 zung3 aat3 lik6 zi1 haa6, bei1 bik1 sau1 wui4 sing4 ming6, qu2 siu1 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在公众压力之下，被迫收回成命，取消了那个计划。
examples.english_sentence: Under public pressure, the government was forced to retract the order and cancel the plan.

english_meaning: to hide, to conceal, to put away and hide
explanation_mandarin: 指将某物藏起来，不让人轻易找到。
explanation_english: Refers to hiding something away so that it is not easily found.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日收埋啲零食，唔俾我哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 maai4 di1 ling4 sik6, m4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是把零食藏起来，不给我们吃。
examples.english_sentence: He always hides the snacks and doesn't let us eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好收埋啲真相，同我講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sau1 maai4 di1 zan1 seong2, tung4 ngo5 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隐瞒真相，跟我说清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hide the truth, tell me clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心將你份禮物收埋咗，真係唔好意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zoeng1 nei5 fan6 lai5 mat6 sau1 maai4 zo2, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心把你的礼物藏起来了，真是不好意思。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally hid your gift, I'm really sorry.

mandarin_meaning: 收到消息; 获取信息
english_meaning: to receive information; to get the news; to be informed
explanation_mandarin: 表示收到消息或获取信息，类似于“收到消息”、“获得信息”的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates receiving or obtaining information, similar to 'receive information' or 'get the news'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱收報，聽日會打風啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 sau1 bou3, ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚刚收到消息，明天会刮台风啊！
examples.english_sentence: We just received news that there will be a typhoon tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收報話公司要裁員，所以好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 bou3 waa6 gung1 si1 jiu3 coi4 jyun4, so2 ji5 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得到消息说公司要裁员，所以很担心。
examples.english_sentence: He received information that the company is going to lay off employees, so he is very worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信晒收報嘅嘢，要自己fact check 下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 sau1 bou3 ge3 je5, jiu3 zi6 gei2 fact check haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要完全相信收到的信息，要自己核实一下。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely trust the information you receive, you need to fact-check it yourself.

english_meaning: to end; to wind up; to finish; ending; outcome
explanation_mandarin: 结束、完结、收尾。可以指事情的最终结果或结束的方式。
explanation_english: To end, conclude, or wind up. It can refer to the final result of a matter or the way in which it ends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事噉樣收場，大家都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam2 joeng2 sau1 coeng4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这样收场，大家都感到不开心。
examples.english_sentence: This matter ended like this, everyone is unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋最後分手收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 fan1 sau2 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们最后以分手收场。
examples.english_sentence: They ended up breaking up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞到唔愉快收場啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 m4 jyu4 faai3 sau1 coeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要搞得结局不愉快。
examples.english_sentence: Let's not end this on an unpleasant note.

english_meaning: to work late, to have a late shift
explanation_mandarin: 指工作到很晚，或者上晚班。
explanation_english: Refers to working until late at night or having a late work shift.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要收夜，冇得同你食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 sau1 je2, mou5 dak1 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要熬夜，没法和你吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to work late today, so I can't have dinner with you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋份工成日都要收夜，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan6 gung1 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 sau1 je2, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的工作经常要上晚班，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Their job requires them to work late all the time, it's very tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚收夜，搞到而家都仲未瞓醒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 sau1 je2, gaau2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung1 mei6 fan3 seng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚熬夜，到现在都还没睡醒。
examples.english_sentence: I worked late last night, and I still haven't woken up properly.

english_meaning: to raise enough money; to gather enough support (usually financial); to have collected enough resources
explanation_mandarin: 指募集到足够的资金或资源，以支持某个项目或活动。
explanation_english: Refers to collecting enough funds or resources to support a project or activity. It often implies that the goal has been reached in terms of fundraising or resource gathering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺下個月之前收夠籌，先可以搞到個慈善晚宴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 zi1 cin4 sau1 gau3 cau4, sin1 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dou2 go3 ci4 sin6 maan5 jin3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们必须在下个月之前募集到足够的资金，才能举办慈善晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: We need to raise enough money before next month to be able to organize the charity gala.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司上市前，都要收夠籌先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng5 si5 cin4, dou1 jiu3 sau1 gau3 cau4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司上市之前，必须先募集到足够的资金。
examples.english_sentence: Before a company can go public, it must raise enough capital.

mandarin_meaning: 停止哺乳; 停止供應
english_meaning: To stop breastfeeding; To stop providing (support, benefits, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指停止给婴儿喂母乳。引申义可以指停止提供某种资源、支持或好处。
explanation_english: Literally means to stop breastfeeding an infant. By extension, it can refer to stopping the provision of certain resources, support, or benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔歲半，我已經收奶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 seoi3 bun3, ngo5 ji5 ging1 sau1 naai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子一岁半，我已经断奶了。
examples.english_sentence: My son is one and a half years old, I've already stopped breastfeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司蝕錢蝕到咁，梗係要收奶啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sit8 cin2 sit8 dou3 gam2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 sau1 naai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司亏钱亏成这样，肯定要停止提供福利了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is losing so much money, of course they have to cut benefits.

english_meaning: to shelter, to take in, to provide accommodation, to give refuge to
explanation_mandarin: 接收並容納。通常指接收無家可歸者、難民或其他需要幫助的人。
explanation_english: To take in and provide shelter or accommodation, often referring to homeless people, refugees, or others in need of assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該收容更多難民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 sau1 yung4 gang3 do1 naan4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该收容更多难民。
examples.english_sentence: The government should take in more refugees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間教會收容咗好多露宿者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gaau3 wui2 sau1 yung4 zo2 hou2 do1 lou6 suk1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家教会收留了很多露宿者。
examples.english_sentence: This church has taken in many homeless people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋收容咗隻流浪貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sau1 yung4 zo2 zek3 lau4 long6 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们收留了一只流浪猫。
examples.english_sentence: We took in a stray cat.

english_meaning: shelter, refuge
explanation_mandarin: 提供临时住所或保护的地方，通常是为无家可归者、流浪动物或受灾人群设立的。
explanation_english: A place that provides temporary housing or protection, typically for homeless people, stray animals, or disaster victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多流浪狗都喺收容所等緊人領養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 lau4 long6 gau2 dou1 hai2 sau1 jung4 so2 dang2 gan2 jan4 ling5 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多流浪狗都在收容所等着人领养。
examples.english_sentence: Many stray dogs are waiting for adoption at the shelter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地震之後，好多災民暫時住喺收容所。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 zan3 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 zoi1 man4 zaam6 si4 zyu6 hai2 sau1 jung4 so2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地震之后，很多灾民暂时住在收容所。
examples.english_sentence: After the earthquake, many victims are temporarily living in the shelter.

english_meaning: to finish; to end; to conclude; to wind up; to tidy up; final stage
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的最后阶段，完成或结束某件事。也指整理、收拾。
explanation_english: Refers to the final stage of something, completing or ending something. Can also mean to tidy up or pack up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日要做埋收尾啲嘢先走得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 maai4 sau1 mei5 di1 je5 sin1 zau2 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天要把结尾的那些事情做完才能走。
examples.english_sentence: You have to finish the remaining tasks before you can leave today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得走之前收尾啊，唔好搞到咁亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 zau2 zi1 cin4 sau1 mei5 aa3, m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 gam3 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得走之前收拾一下，不要弄得这么乱。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to tidy up before you leave, don't make it so messy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project就嚟收尾㗎啦，大家加把勁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project zau6 lai4 sau1 mei5 gaa3 laa1, daai6 gaa1 gaa1 baa2 ging6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目快要收尾了，大家加把劲！
examples.english_sentence: This project is almost finished, let's all put in some extra effort!

english_meaning: to collect a corpse, to collect/deal with the aftermath of a disaster (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指收拾尸体。比喻收拾残局，处理糟糕的局面，通常指为某人的过失或失败承担责任。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to collect a corpse. Figuratively, it means to clean up a mess, to deal with a bad situation, often referring to taking responsibility for someone else's mistake or failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次衰咗，要佢自己收屍喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 seoi1 zo2, jiu3 keoi5 zi6 gei2 sau1 si1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次失败了，要他自己收拾残局了。
examples.english_sentence: This time he failed, he has to clean up the mess himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你闖咁大禍，要我幫你收屍咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cong2 gam3 daai6 wo6, jiu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 sau1 si1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你闯了这么大的祸，要我帮你收拾残局吗？
examples.english_sentence: You caused such a big disaster, do you want me to clean up the mess for you?

english_meaning: to retire (from a profession or activity); to quit; to hang up one's boots
explanation_mandarin: 原指结束在山上的活动。比喻结束某种职业或活动，不再从事。
explanation_english: Originally referred to ending activities in the mountains. Metaphorically, it means to retire from a profession or activity, no longer engaging in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾十年戲，終於都收山喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 hei3, zung1 jyu1 dou1 sau1 saan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了几十年戏，终于都退休了。
examples.english_sentence: He has been acting for decades and has finally retired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話今次係佢最後一次比賽，之後就會收山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gam1 ci3 hai6 keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 ci3 bei2 coi3, zi1 hau6 zau6 wui5 sau1 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这次是他最后一次比赛，之后就会退休。
examples.english_sentence: He said this is his last competition, and he will retire afterwards.

mandarin_meaning: 停止, 结束 (行动或活动); 金盆洗手
english_meaning: To stop (an action or activity); to retire (from a profession or undertaking); to give up a life of crime; to hang up one's boots
explanation_mandarin: 比喻停止某項活動，通常是指比較高風險或複雜的活動。也指退出江湖，不再從事犯罪活動。
explanation_english: A metaphor for stopping an activity, usually a high-risk or complex one. It can also refer to retiring from a life of crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撈偏咁耐，都係時候收山腳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou1 pin1 gam3 noi6, dou1 hai6 si4 hau6 sau1 saan1 goek3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做偏门这么久了，也是时候收手了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working in the underworld for so long, it's about time he retires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋個 project 終於都收山腳喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 go3 project zung1 jyu1 dou1 sau1 saan1 goek3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的项目终于都结束了！
examples.english_sentence: Our project has finally come to an end!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話做完呢單就收山腳，唔再做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zou6 jyun4 ni1 daan1 zau6 sau1 saan1 goek3, m4 zoi3 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说做完这单就不做了，要收手了。
examples.english_sentence: He said that after finishing this job, he'll retire and won't do it anymore.

english_meaning: to finish work, to get off work, to pack up
explanation_mandarin: 结束工作，停止工作，下班。
explanation_english: To finish work, to stop working, to get off work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日六點收工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 luk6 dim2 sau1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天六点下班。
examples.english_sentence: We finish work at 6 o'clock today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，收工未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sau1 gung1 mei6 a3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，下班了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, have you finished work yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日唔使咁早返工，可以晏啲收工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 gam3 zou2 faan1 gung1, ho2 ji5 aan3 di1 sau1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天不用那么早去上班，可以晚一点下班。
examples.english_sentence: We don't need to go to work so early tomorrow, we can finish work later.

english_meaning: market close, to close the market (trading)
explanation_mandarin: 股市交易结束，停止交易的时间；股市收盘价。
explanation_english: The end of trading on the stock market; the closing price of a stock market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日收市點數係幾多呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sau1 si5 dim2 sou3 hai6 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天收盘的点数是多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's the closing index for today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 三點半就收市啦，快啲決定買唔買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saam1 dim2 bun3 zau6 sau1 si5 laa1, faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 maai5 m4 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 三点半就收盘了，快点决定买不买吧。
examples.english_sentence: The market closes at 3:30, hurry up and decide whether to buy or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日收市前要搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 sau1 si5 cin4 jiu3 gaau2 dim6 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天收盘前要搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: We need to get it done before the market closes tomorrow.

english_meaning: Acceptable; passable; okay; alright; successful; effective; works
explanation_mandarin: 表示可以，行得通，可以接受，或者事情成功、有效。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is acceptable, works, is passable, or that something is successful or effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法收得喎，不如試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 sau1 dak1 wo3, bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法可行啊，不如试试。
examples.english_sentence: This method works, let's give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅建議都收得嘅，可以考慮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 gin3 ji5 dou1 sau1 dak1 ge3, ho2 ji5 haam1 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的建议都可以的，可以考虑。
examples.english_sentence: Your suggestions are all acceptable, we can consider them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦整返好，而家收得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 zing2 faan1 hou2, ji4 gaa1 sau1 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑修好了，现在可以用了。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is fixed, now it works.

english_meaning: to recover (lost territory); to recapture; to retrieve
explanation_mandarin: 重新夺回失去的领土、阵地或东西。
explanation_english: To recover or recapture something that was lost, especially territory or a position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一定要收復失地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 sau1 fuk6 sat1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要收复失地。
examples.english_sentence: We must recover the lost territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成功收復咗個山頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 gung1 sau1 fuk6 zo2 go3 saan1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成功收复了那个山头。
examples.english_sentence: They successfully recaptured that hilltop.

mandarin_meaning: 收心养性 (shōu xīn yǎng xìng)
english_meaning: To settle down and cultivate one's character; to calm down and mend one's ways; to focus on self-improvement
explanation_mandarin: 指收敛心思，培养性情。 多指经历一些事情后，不再浮躁，开始沉稳地修身养性。
explanation_english: Refers to calming one's mind and cultivating one's character. It often implies that after experiencing certain events, one becomes less impulsive and begins to focus on self-cultivation and improving one's moral character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前成日蒲頭蒲勢，但係失戀之後就收心養性，開始讀書喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 seng4 jat6 pou4 tau4 pou4 sai3, daan6 hai6 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 zau6 sau1 sam1 joeng5 sing3, hoi1 chi2 duk6 syu1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前总是到处玩乐，但是失恋之后就收心养性，开始读书了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to always go out and party, but after his heartbreak, he settled down and started studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 退休之後，佢就返鄉下收心養性，種下花草，過啲悠閒嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teoi3休zi1 hau6, keoi5 zau6 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 sau1 sam1 joeng5 sing3, zung3 haa5 faa1 cou2, gwo3 di1 jau4 haan4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 退休之后，他就回老家收心养性，种些花草，过一些悠闲的生活。
examples.english_sentence: After retiring, he returned to his hometown to settle down and cultivate himself, planting flowers and plants and living a leisurely life.

english_meaning: to collect interest (on a loan or investment)
explanation_mandarin: 收取贷款或投资的利息。
explanation_english: To collect interest payments, typically from loans or investments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠收息都可以過世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 sau1 sik1 dou1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠收利息都可以度过一生。
examples.english_sentence: He can live his whole life just by collecting interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲銀行存款收息好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 ngan4 hong4 cyun4款 sau1 sik1 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在银行存款的利息很低。
examples.english_sentence: The interest rates on bank deposits are very low these days.

english_meaning: harvest, crop
explanation_mandarin: 指农作物成熟后被收割，也比喻其他方面的成果。
explanation_english: Refers to the harvesting of mature crops, or figuratively, the results of other endeavors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年啲菜收成好好呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 di1 coi3 sau1 sing4 ho2 ho2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的蔬菜收成很好啊！
examples.english_sentence: The vegetable harvest is great this year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋努力咗咁耐，終於有收成啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nou5 lik6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 jau5 sau1 sing4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们努力了这么久，终于有收获了。
examples.english_sentence: They've worked hard for so long, finally they're reaping the rewards.

english_meaning: to stop; to quit; to cease; to lay off (doing something)
explanation_mandarin: 停止正在做的事情；不再继续。
explanation_english: To stop doing something; to cease or quit an activity, especially one that is considered undesirable or problematic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再賭落去會輸晒㗎，快啲收手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 dou2 lok6 heoi3 wui5 syu1 saai3 gaa3, faai3 di1 sau1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再赌下去会输光的，快点住手吧！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep gambling, you'll lose everything. Stop now!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸你最好收手，唔好再搞落去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 zeoi3 hou2 sau1 sau2, m4 hou2 zoi3 gaau2 lok6 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝你最好住手，不要再搞下去了。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you to stop, don't get involved any further.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁多壞事，遲早都要收手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam3 do1 waai6 si6, ci4 zou2 dou1 jiu3 sau1 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了这么多坏事，迟早都要收手的。
examples.english_sentence: He's done so many bad things, sooner or later he will have to stop.

english_meaning: detain, take into custody
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或相关机构将嫌疑人拘留，等待进一步调查或审判。
explanation_english: To detain someone in custody pending further investigation or trial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為涉嫌詐騙俾警察收押咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sip3 jim4 zaa3 pin3 bei2 ging2 chaat3 sau1 aap3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为涉嫌诈骗被警察拘留了。
examples.english_sentence: He was detained by the police for suspected fraud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官決定將疑犯收押候審。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gun1 kyut3 ding6 jeung1 ji4 faan2 sau1 aap3 hau6 sam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官决定将嫌疑人拘留候审。
examples.english_sentence: The judge decided to remand the suspect in custody pending trial.

english_meaning: to tidy up, to pack, to punish
explanation_mandarin: 整理、收拾东西；惩罚。
explanation_english: To tidy up; to pack; to punish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要收拾行李準備去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau1 sap6 hang4 lei5 zeon2 bei6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要收拾行李准备去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pack our luggage and get ready for the trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽話，阿媽話要收拾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 waa6, aa3 maa1 waa6 jiu3 sau1 sap6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听话，妈妈说要收拾他。
examples.english_sentence: He's not being obedient, Mom said she's going to punish him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收拾乾淨啲張枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 sap6 gon1 zing6 di1 zoeng1 toi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把桌子收拾干净一点。
examples.english_sentence: Tidy up the table a bit more.

english_meaning: to stop; to brake; to call it a day; to wrap things up
explanation_mandarin: 原指刹车，停止机器运转。引申为停止行动、结束某事。
explanation_english: Originally referring to braking or stopping a machine. It now figuratively means to stop an action or bring something to an end; to wrap things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都咁晏啦，不如收掣返屋企啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 gam3 aan3 laa3, bat1 jyu4 sau1 cai3 faan1 uk1 geoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都这么晚了，不如结束回家吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so late, why don't we call it a day and go home?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁嘅態度，我即刻收掣唔再講落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 keoi5 gam3 ge3 taai3 dou6, ngo5 zik1 hak1 sau1 cai3 m4 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这样的态度，我立刻停止不再说下去了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his attitude, I immediately stopped and didn't continue speaking.

english_meaning: receipt
explanation_mandarin: 购物或接受服务后，商家开具的凭证，证明已收到款项。
explanation_english: A written acknowledgment that something has been received, typically a sum of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾張收據我得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以给我一张收据吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I have a receipt, please?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗張收據，唔知點報銷好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3, m4 zi1 dim2 bou3 siu1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把收据弄丢了，不知道怎么报销好。
examples.english_sentence: I lost the receipt and I don't know how to claim reimbursement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得拎返張收據，方便你之後退貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 ling1 faan1 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3, fong1 bin6 nei5 zi1 hau6 teoi3 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得拿回收据，方便你之后退货。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to take the receipt so you can return the goods later.

english_meaning: income and expenditure; revenue and expenses
explanation_mandarin: 收入和支出的总称。
explanation_english: The total of income and expenditure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要保持收支平衡先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 bou2 chi4 sau1 zi1 ping4 hang4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要先保持收支平衡才可以。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to maintain a balance of income and expenditure first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要檢討下個個月嘅收支情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gim2 tou2 haa5 go3 go3 jyut6 ge3 sau1 zi1 ching4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要检讨每个月的收支情况。
examples.english_sentence: We need to review the income and expenditure situation each month.

english_meaning: balance of income and expenditure; break-even
explanation_mandarin: 收入和支出相等，没有盈余也没有亏损的状态。
explanation_english: A situation where income and expenditure are equal, resulting in neither a profit nor a loss; break-even point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要達到收支平衡，我哋要諗辦法增加收入或者減少開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 daat6 dou3 sau1 zi1 ping4 hang4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 zeng1 gaa1 sau1 jap6 waak6 ze2 gaam2 siu2 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要达到收支平衡，我们要想办法增加收入或者减少开支。
examples.english_sentence: To achieve a balance of income and expenditure, we need to find ways to increase income or reduce expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今年嘅目標係做到收支平衡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 zou6 dou3 sau1 zi1 ping4 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司今年的目标是做到收支平衡。
examples.english_sentence: The company's goal this year is to break even.

mandarin_meaning: 偷偷地藏起来; 收藏; 积攒
english_meaning: To hide away secretively; to hoard; to accumulate stealthily
explanation_mandarin: 形容偷偷地、小心翼翼地把东西藏起来或积累起来。也指人比较内向，不轻易表达自己的想法。
explanation_english: Describes secretly and carefully hiding or accumulating things. It can also refer to someone who is introverted and doesn't easily express their thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日收收埋埋啲零食，唔俾人食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4 di1 ling4 sik6, m4 bei2 jan4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是偷偷地藏着零食，不给别人吃。
examples.english_sentence: He always hides away his snacks and doesn't let others eat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好收收埋埋，乜嘢都唔肯講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 hang2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很内向，什么都不肯说。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very introverted and unwilling to say anything.

english_meaning: To hide something away; to be secretive; to keep things to oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指把东西藏起来，不让人知道；形容人不坦率，把想法或东西藏在心里。
explanation_english: Describes the act of hiding something away, not letting others know; also used to describe someone who is not forthright and keeps their thoughts or possessions to themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日收收埋埋，都唔知諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4, dou1 m4 zi1 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是藏着掖着，都不知道在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always secretive, I don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好收收埋埋啲錢啦，攞啲出嚟請我食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4 di1 cin2 laa1, lo2 di1 chut1 lai4 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要藏着掖着那些钱了，拿一些出来请我吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't hide your money away, take some out to treat me to a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩事唔好收收埋埋，講出嚟大家一齊諗辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 si6 m4 hou2 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4, gong2 chut1 lai4 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 nam2 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么事不要藏着掖着，说出来大家一起想办法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep things to yourself when something's wrong, tell us so we can think of a solution together.

english_meaning: careless and perfunctory; sloppy; to do something superficially; to get it over with quickly
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真，草率了事。也可以用作动词，表示敷衍了事。
explanation_english: Describes doing something carelessly, perfunctorily, or sloppily. It can also be used as a verb, meaning to do something superficially and quickly just to get it over with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁收收散啦，做好啲佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sau1 sau1 saan3 laa1, zou6 hou2 di1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么草率，把它做好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sloppy, do it properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都收收散，所以啲客唔鍾意搵佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 sau1 sau1 saan3, so2 ji5 di1 haak3 m4 zung1 ji3 wan2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作总是很敷衍，所以客户不喜欢找他。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things sloppily, so clients don't like to look for him.

english_meaning: well-behaved, docile, obedient
explanation_mandarin: 形容人很听话，很乖巧，顺从。
explanation_english: Describes someone as very obedient, docile, and well-behaved. Often used to imply a sense of being overly compliant or even slightly subservient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個小朋友真係好收收柄柄，大人叫佢哋做咩就做咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau1 sau1 beng3 beng3, daai6 jan4 giu3 keoi5 dei6 zou6 me1 zau6 zou6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个小朋友真的很乖，大人叫他们做什么就做什么。
examples.english_sentence: Those two kids are really well-behaved; they do whatever the adults tell them to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁收收柄柄啦，有啲自己嘅諗法好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sau1 sau1 beng3 beng3 laa1, jau5 di1 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么服服帖帖的，有一些自己的想法比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so docile; it's better to have some of your own ideas.

mandarin_meaning: 运用自如；收敛和放开都能随心所欲
english_meaning: to have complete control; to be able to control something with ease; to rein in and unleash at will
explanation_mandarin: 指能够自由控制，随意运用。可以指能力、情绪、态度等方面。
explanation_english: Describes the ability to control something freely and use it at will. Can refer to abilities, emotions, attitudes, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技已經去到收放自如嘅境界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 ji5 ging1 heoi3 dou3 sau1 fong3 zi6 jyu4 ge3 ging2 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技已经达到收放自如的境界。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills have reached a state of complete control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺工作上面收放自如，效率好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6 min6 sau1 fong3 zi6 jyu4, haau2 leot2 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工作上收放自如，效率很高。
examples.english_sentence: He is able to control himself well at work, making him very efficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要學識控制自己嘅情緒，做到收放自如。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hok6 sik1 hung3 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 cing4 seoi5, zou6 dou3 sau1 fong3 zi6 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要学会控制自己的情绪，做到收放自如。
examples.english_sentence: You need to learn to control your emotions and be able to rein them in and unleash them at will.

english_meaning: to be effective, to have effect, to produce results
explanation_mandarin: 指产生效果，达到预期的目标。
explanation_english: Refers to producing the desired effect or achieving the expected goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種療法對佢嚟講冇乜收效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 liu4 faat3 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 mou5 mat1 sau1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种疗法对他来说没什么效果。
examples.english_sentence: This treatment doesn't seem to be effective for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅新政策都幾收效，失業率降低咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3 dou1 gei2 sau1 haau6, sat1 jip6 leot2 gong3 dai1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的新政策还挺有效果的，失业率降低了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The government's new policies are quite effective, and the unemployment rate has decreased a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我試過好多方法減肥都唔收效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 si3 gwo3 hou2 do1 fong1 faat3 gaam2 fei4 dou1 m4 sau1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我试过很多方法减肥都没什么效果。
examples.english_sentence: I've tried many ways to lose weight, but none of them have worked.

english_meaning: to collect debts; to dun for payment
explanation_mandarin: 指向欠债人追讨债务的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of collecting debts from debtors. Often associated with debt collection agencies or individuals who collect debts on behalf of others, sometimes implying aggressive tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專門幫人收數，所以好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 sau1 sou3, so2 ji5 hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门帮人收账，所以很凶的。
examples.english_sentence: He specializes in collecting debts for people, so he's very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你爭人錢唔還，小心俾人收數呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zaang1 jan4 cin2 m4 waan4, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 sau1 sou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你欠人钱不还，小心被人收账啊！
examples.english_sentence: If you don't pay back the money you owe, be careful you might get people chasing you for it!

english_meaning: debt collector
explanation_mandarin: 指专门负责追讨债务的人，有时带有贬义，暗示其追债手段可能不太正当。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who specializes in collecting debts. It sometimes carries a negative connotation, implying that their debt collection methods may not be entirely legitimate or ethical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爭人好多錢，日日俾收數佬追。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2, jat1 jat1 bei2 sau1 sou3 lou2 zeoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠别人很多钱，每天都被讨债人追债。
examples.english_sentence: He owes people a lot of money and is being chased by debt collectors every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好借錢俾佢啦，到時要搵收數佬先追得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5 laa1, dou3 si4 jiu3 wan2 sau1 sou3 lou2 sin1 zeoi1 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别借钱给他了，到时候要找讨债人才能追回来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lend him money, or you'll have to hire a debt collector to get it back.

english_meaning: debt collection agency
explanation_mandarin: 专门从事追讨债务的公司。
explanation_english: A company that specializes in collecting debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爭人好多錢，可能收數公司會搵上門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang1 jan4 hou2 do1 cin2, ho2 nang4 sau1 sou3 gung1 si1 wui5 wan2 soeng5 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠别人很多钱，可能讨债公司会上门找他。
examples.english_sentence: He owes people a lot of money, so debt collectors might come knocking on his door.

english_meaning: to restrain oneself, to be modest, to converge (mathematics)
explanation_mandarin: 约束自己的行为或言语，使其变得谨慎或不张扬；在数学中指收敛。
explanation_english: To restrain one's behavior or speech to be more cautious or low-key; in mathematics, to converge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都大個仔啦，要收斂啲喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 daai6 go3 zai2 laa1, jiu3 sau1 lim5 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都长大了，要收敛一点了！
examples.english_sentence: You're all grown up now, you need to restrain yourself a bit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前好囂張，但係俾人教訓咗之後就收斂咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hou2 hiu1 zoeng1, daan6 hai6 bei2 jan4 gaau3 fan3 zo2 zi1 hau6 zau6 sau1 lim5 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前很嚣张，但是被教训了之后就收敛了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be very arrogant, but after being taught a lesson, he has become much more restrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個數列收斂到零。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 lit6 sau1 lim5 dou3 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数列收敛到零。
examples.english_sentence: This sequence converges to zero.

english_meaning: to subdue, to conquer, to tame, to win over, to bring to one's side
explanation_mandarin: 以力量或手段使对方屈服，顺从。
explanation_english: To subdue or conquer someone or something, bringing them under control or winning them over to one's side. It can imply using force, skill, or persuasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多時間先收服到個客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 si4 gaan3 sin1 sau1 fuk6 dou2 go3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多时间才说服了那位顾客。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of time before he managed to win over that customer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻野獸好難收服㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 ye5 sau3 ho2 naan4 sau1 fuk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只野兽很难驯服的。
examples.english_sentence: This beast is very difficult to tame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想用武力收服其他嘅國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 yung6 mou5 lik6 sau1 fuk6 kei4 taa1 ge3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想用武力征服其他的国家。
examples.english_sentence: They want to conquer other countries by force.

english_meaning: to clear the table
explanation_mandarin: 清理饭桌，将餐具、食物残渣等从桌子上移走。
explanation_english: To clear the table after a meal, removing dishes, leftovers, and other items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯記得收枱啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 gei3 dak1 sau1 toi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭记得收拾桌子啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to clear the table after you finish eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，幫我收埋啲枱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, bong1 ngo5 sau1 maai4 di1 toi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你，帮我把桌子收拾一下。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could you please clear the table for me?

synonyms: 清理枱面 (cing1 lei5 toi2 min6)

english_meaning: receipt
explanation_mandarin: 收到物品或钱款后，写给对方的凭证。
explanation_english: A written acknowledgement that something has been received, typically money or goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你俾咗錢記得攞返張收條啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 zo2 cin2 gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 sau1 tiu4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你付了钱记得拿回一张收据啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to get a receipt after you've paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張收條唔見咗，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 sau1 tiu4 m4 gin3 zo2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收据不见了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: I lost the receipt, I don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to take possession of a newly built apartment/house; handover of property
explanation_mandarin: 指购买新建成的房屋后，办理手续正式接收房屋。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of formally taking possession of a newly built apartment or house after completing the necessary procedures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月就收樓啦，好期待啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 sau1 lau2 laa1, hou2 kei5 daai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月就要收房了，好期待啊！
examples.english_sentence: We're taking possession of our new apartment next month, I'm so excited!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收樓嗰日，請晒啲親戚朋友嚟慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 lau2 go2 jat6, ceng2 saai3 di1 can1 cik1 pang4 jau5 lai4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收房那天，请了所有的亲戚朋友来庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: He invited all his relatives and friends to celebrate the day he took possession of his new apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收樓前要驗清楚啲嘢，唔好有漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 lau2 cin4 jiu3 jim6 cing1 co2 di1 je5, m4 hou2 jau5 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收房前要仔细检查清楚，不要有遗漏。
examples.english_sentence: You need to check everything carefully before taking possession of the apartment, don't miss anything.

english_meaning: to close up shop; to pack up; to call it a day (business); to shut down (an operation)
explanation_mandarin: 指结束营业，收拾东西。也可以引申为结束某项活动或计划。
explanation_english: Refers to closing up shop and packing things away after business hours. It can also be extended to mean ending an activity or project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日生意唔好，早啲收檔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, zou2 di1 sau1 dong3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天生意不好，早点收摊吧。
examples.english_sentence: Business isn't good today, let's close up shop earlier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咗咁耐，不如收檔去飲杯嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6, bat1 jyu4 sau1 dong3 heoi3 jam2 bui1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做了这么久，不如收工去喝一杯东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've been working for so long, how about calling it a day and going for a drink?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳執咗笠，即係收檔唔做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zap1 zo2 lap1, zik1 hai6 sau1 dong3 m4 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅倒闭了，就是收摊不做了。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant went bankrupt, meaning it's closed down and no longer doing business.

english_meaning: to restrain oneself; to be more moderate; to be more reserved; to curb (one's behavior); to become less excessive; to tone down
explanation_mandarin: 约束自己的行为，变得更谨慎、克制。
explanation_english: To restrain oneself, become more cautious and restrained in one's behavior; to become less excessive in behavior or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從結咗婚之後就收歛咗好多，冇以前咁癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 git3 zo2 fan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 sau1 lim5 zo2 hou2 do1, mou5 ji5 cin4 gam3 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自从结婚之后就收敛了很多，没有以前那么疯了。
examples.english_sentence: He has restrained himself a lot since getting married; he's not as crazy as he used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收歛啲啦！咁大聲講嘢，唔怕俾人聽到咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 lim5 di1 laa1! gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2嘢, m4 paa3 bei2 jan4 teng1 dou2 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你收敛点吧！这么大声说话，不怕别人听到吗？
examples.english_sentence: Tone it down a bit! Speaking so loudly, aren't you afraid others will hear you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗屋企，唯有收歛脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 uk1 kei2, wai4 jau5 sau1 lim5 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了家庭，他只能收敛脾气。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his family, he had no choice but to curb his temper.

english_meaning: to take back; to reclaim; to bring under control; to nationalize
explanation_mandarin: 把原本属于私人或集体的财产或权力收回，归于政府或某个特定机构。
explanation_english: To take back property or power that originally belonged to private individuals or collectives and transfer it to the government or a specific institution; to reclaim; to nationalize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司俾政府收歸咗，以後就唔係私人嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 zing3 fu2 sau1 gwai1 zo2, ji5 hau6 zau6 m4 hai6 si1 jan4 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司被政府收归了，以后就不是私人的了。
examples.english_sentence: The company was nationalized by the government and is no longer privately owned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想將所有嘅土地收歸國有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 tou2 dei6 sau1 gwai1 gwok3 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想把所有的土地收归国有。
examples.english_sentence: They want to nationalize all the land.

english_meaning: to nationalize, to bring under state ownership
explanation_mandarin: 指将私有财产、企业或资源等收归国家所有。
explanation_english: To transfer private property, enterprises, or resources into state ownership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司因為財政問題，最後都俾政府收歸國有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jan1 wai6 coi4 zing3 man6 tai4, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 bei2 zing3 fu2 sau1 gwai1 gwok3 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司因为财政问题，最后都被政府收归国有了。
examples.english_sentence: Due to financial problems, the company was eventually nationalized by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲重要嘅戰略資源，有啲國家會選擇收歸國有嚟保障國家安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 zin3 loek6 zi1 jyun4, jau5 di1 gwok3 gaa1 wui5 syun2 zaak6 sau1 gwai1 gwok3 jau5 lai4 bou2 zoeng3 gwok3 gaa1 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些重要的战略资源，有些国家会选择收归国有来保障国家安全。
examples.english_sentence: Some countries choose to nationalize important strategic resources to ensure national security.

mandarin_meaning: 回收资金；停止支出；紧缩银根
english_meaning: To withdraw funds; to cut back on spending; to tighten credit
explanation_mandarin: 原本指黑社会停止非法活动，转而回收资金。现在也指公司或个人减少开支，保存资金；银行减少贷款，收紧银根。
explanation_english: Originally referring to triads ceasing illegal activities and withdrawing funds. Now it also refers to companies or individuals reducing expenses and conserving funds; or banks reducing lending and tightening credit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，公司要收水喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, gung1 si1 jiu3 sau1 seoi2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，公司要减少开支了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, the company needs to cut back on spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 銀行最近收水收得好緊，好難借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngan4 hong4 zeoi3 gan6 sau1 seoi2 sau1 dak1 hou2 gan2, hou2 naan4 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 银行最近收紧银根，很难借钱。
examples.english_sentence: The bank has been tightening credit lately, it's difficult to borrow money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之前撈偏嘅，而家話要收水唔撈喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 cin4 lou1 pin1 ge3, ji4 gaa1 waa6 jiu3 sau1 seoi2 m4 lou1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之前是做偏门的，现在说要收手不做了。
examples.english_sentence: They used to be involved in illegal activities, but now they say they want to quit and withdraw.

english_meaning: to slow down, to reduce speed; to stop, to quit (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“收起油”，引申为减速，降低速度。在俚语中也指停止做某事，收手，放弃。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to take back the oil', referring to reducing speed. In slang, it also means to stop doing something, to quit, to give up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面塞車，收油啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 sak1 ce1, sau1 jau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面堵车，减速吧！
examples.english_sentence: There's a traffic jam ahead, slow down!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事咁危險，你都係收油好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 ngai4 him2, nei5 dou1 hai6 sau1 jau4 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么危险，你还是收手比较好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so dangerous, you better quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頂唔順啦，真係要收油先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ding2 m4 seon6 laa3, zan1 hai6 jiu3 sau1 jau4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我顶不住了，真的要放弃才行。
examples.english_sentence: I can't take it anymore, I really need to quit.

english_meaning: to calm down, to simmer down, to cool off
explanation_mandarin: 平息怒气，使情绪冷静下来。
explanation_english: To calm down, to reduce one's anger, to simmer down and become less agitated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收下火先啦，唔好咁嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 haa5 fo2 sin1 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你先消消气吧，不要这么生气。
examples.english_sentence: Calm down first, don't be so angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講咗咁耐，佢終於收火喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sau1 fo2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说了这么久，他终于消气了。
examples.english_sentence: After talking for so long, he finally calmed down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲杯涼茶收下火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 bui1 leung4 caa4 sau1 haa5 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝杯凉茶降降火。
examples.english_sentence: Drink a cup of herbal tea to cool down.

english_meaning: Cool down (literally and figuratively); let things calm down; let a heated situation subside
explanation_mandarin: 比喻使激动的情绪或事物平静下来；降温。
explanation_english: Literally means to cool down the 'hot head'. Figuratively means to allow a situation to calm down, or for someone to cool off their anger or excitement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先鬧得咁僵，依家都係收熱頭先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 naau6 dak1 gam3 goeng1, ji1 gaa1 dou1 hai6 sau1 jit6 tau4 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才闹得这么僵，现在还是先降降温吧。
examples.english_sentence: Things got so tense just now, let's just let things cool down for now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再講啦，等佢收下熱頭先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa1, dang2 keoi5 sau1 haa5 jit6 tau4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别再说了，等他冷静一下再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say anymore, let him cool down first.

mandarin_meaning: 收工; 停止营业; 结束营业
english_meaning: To close shop; to shut down (business); to stop working (especially at the end of the year or after a long period)
explanation_mandarin: 指结束一年的工作或结束一项业务，有暂时或永久停止的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of a year's work or the closing of a business, implying a temporary or permanent cessation of operations. Often used when referring to closing down for Chinese New Year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司聽日就收爐喇，可以放新年假喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ting1 jat6 zau6 sau1 lou4 laa3, ho2 ji5 fong3 san1 nin4 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司明天就收工了，可以放新年假了！
examples.english_sentence: Our company is closing shop tomorrow; we can start our Chinese New Year holiday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳做埋今日就收爐，聽日開始裝修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 zou6 maai4 gam1 jat6 zau6 sau1 lou4, ting1 jat6 hoi1 chi2 zong1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅做到今天就结束营业，明天开始装修。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant will close shop after today, and renovations will begin tomorrow.

english_meaning: To collect bad debts, to recover uncollectible accounts
explanation_mandarin: 指收取已经很难收回的债务。烂数：指很难或者无法收回的债务。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of collecting debts that are difficult or unlikely to be recovered. '爛數' (laan6 sou3) means bad debts, accounts that are difficult or impossible to collect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間收數公司好出名，專門收爛數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 sau1 sou3 gung1 si1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, zyun1 mun4 sau1 laan6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家收账公司很有名，专门收坏账。
examples.english_sentence: This debt collection company is very famous, specializing in collecting bad debts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲爛數真係好難收㗎，好多時都收唔返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 laan6 sou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 sau1 gaa3, hou2 do1 si4 hau6 dou1 sau1 m4 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些坏账真的很难收回来，很多时候都收不回来。
examples.english_sentence: Those bad debts are really hard to collect; a lot of the time, you can't get them back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工作係幫銀行收爛數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 hai6 bong1 ngan4 hong4 sau1 laan6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作是帮银行收坏账。
examples.english_sentence: His job is to collect bad debts for the bank.

english_meaning: to collect evidence; to take photos (often covertly, for surveillance); to gather information (negative connotation)
explanation_mandarin: 原指警察或其他执法人员收集证据。现在也指暗中收集别人的信息，通常带有负面含义，例如跟踪、偷拍。
explanation_english: Originally, it referred to police or other law enforcement personnel collecting evidence. Now, it also refers to secretly gathering information about others, usually with a negative connotation, such as stalking or taking photos without permission. Often implies surveillance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我屋企樓下收片，唔知想做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 uk1 kei2 lau4 haa6 sau1 pin3, m4 zi1 soeng2 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在我家楼下收集情报/拍照，不知道想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always taking pictures/collecting information downstairs from my house, I don't know what he's trying to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁緊張啦，我又唔係收片，只係睇吓你嘅情況啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 laa1, ngo5 jau6 m4 hai6 sau1 pin3, zi2 hai6 tai2 haa5 nei5 ge3 cing4 fong3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么紧张，我又不是在搜集你的资料/监视你，只是看看你的情况而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, I'm not collecting information on you/spying on you, I'm just checking up on you.

english_meaning: to enroll students, student recruitment
explanation_mandarin: 招收学生。指学校或教育机构为了扩充学生来源而进行的活动。
explanation_english: To recruit or enroll students. Refers to the activities undertaken by schools or educational institutions to expand their student intake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校今年收生收得好好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 gam1 nin4 sau1 sang1 sau1 dak1 hou2 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校今年招生招得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This school has had a very good student recruitment year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間補習社收生手法好進取㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 bou2 zaap6 se5 sau1 sang1 sau2 faat3 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的补习社招生手法非常积极。
examples.english_sentence: Their tutoring center has a very aggressive student recruitment strategy.

english_meaning: to take in; to offer shelter; to give refuge
explanation_mandarin: 容留；提供住所和食物等。
explanation_english: To provide accommodation and sustenance; to take someone in and offer them shelter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇屋企，我收留咗佢幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 uk1 kei5, ngo5 sau1 lau4 zo2 keoi5 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有家，我收留了他几天。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't have a home, so I took him in for a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇地方住，你可以嚟我度，我收留你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 dei6 fong1 zyu6, nei5 ho2 ji5 lai4 ngo5 dou6, ngo5 sau1 lau4 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有地方住，你可以来我这里，我收留你。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't have a place to live, you can come to my place, I'll take you in.

english_meaning: Admit a patient (to a hospital); To take on a case
explanation_mandarin: （医生）接收病人住院治疗；（律师）接收案件。
explanation_english: To admit a patient to a hospital for treatment; To take on a legal case (by a lawyer). It implies that someone is taking responsibility for handling the case or caring for the patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個醫生琴日收咗三個症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ji1 sang1 kam4 jat6 sau1 zo2 saam1 go3 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位医生昨天收了三个病人。
examples.english_sentence: That doctor admitted three patients yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢咁麻煩，你都肯收症？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 gam3 maa4 faan4, nei5 dou1 hang2 sau1 zing3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么麻烦，你都肯接手？
examples.english_sentence: This case is so troublesome, are you still willing to take it on?

english_meaning: to receive and dispatch; to handle incoming and outgoing mail/documents; to collect and distribute
explanation_mandarin: 接收和发送（邮件、文件等）。
explanation_english: To receive and dispatch, referring to handling incoming and outgoing mail, documents, or other items. It implies both receiving and distributing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責收發公司嘅信件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 sau1 faat3 gung1 si1 ge3 seon3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责收发公司的信件。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for receiving and dispatching the company's mail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門專門收發文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 zyun1 mun4 sau1 faat3 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门专门收发文件。
examples.english_sentence: This department specializes in receiving and dispatching documents.

english_meaning: Shut up; Get lost; Cut it out; Knock it off
explanation_mandarin: 表示让对方停止说话或行动，带有强烈的不满或愤怒情绪。
explanation_english: A rude and forceful expression used to tell someone to be quiet or to stop what they are doing. It carries a strong sense of annoyance or anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收皮啦！再嘈我就打你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 pei4 laa1! zoi3 cou4 ngo5 zau6 daa2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你闭嘴吧！再吵我就打你。
examples.english_sentence: Shut up! If you make any more noise, I'll hit you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞成咁嘅樣，你都係收皮算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 sing4 gam2 ge3 joeng2, nei5 dou1 hai6 sau1 pei4 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞成这个样子，你还是滚开算了。
examples.english_sentence: Since things have turned out like this, you should just get lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收皮啦，唔好再講啲廢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 pei4 laa1, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 fai3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别说了，别再讲废话了。
examples.english_sentence: Cut it out, stop talking nonsense.

english_meaning: profit, gain, benefit, yield, proceeds
explanation_mandarin: 获得的利益或好处。
explanation_english: The profit, gain, benefit, or yield obtained from an investment or activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個投資嘅收益好高㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tau4 zi1 ge3 sau1 yik1 hou2 gou1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个投资的收益很高。
examples.english_sentence: The profit from this investment is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年嘅收益比上年多咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ge3 sau1 yik1 bei2 soeng6 nin4 do1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年的收益比去年多了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's profits this year are much higher than last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅努力終於得到收益喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nou5 lik6 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 sau1 yik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的努力终于得到了收益了。
examples.english_sentence: His efforts finally paid off.

english_meaning: yield rate, rate of return
explanation_mandarin: 投资收益与投资成本的比率，通常以百分比表示。
explanation_english: The ratio of investment income to investment cost, usually expressed as a percentage. It indicates the return on an investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻債券嘅收益率幾高㗎，你可以考慮吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 zaai3 gyun3 ge3 sau1 jik1 leot6 gei2 gou1 gaa3, nei5 ho2 ji5 hau2 leoi6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个债券的收益率很高，你可以考虑一下。
examples.english_sentence: The yield rate of this bond is quite high, you can consider it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投資房地產嘅收益率通常都比較穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 zi1 fong4 dei6產 ge3 sau1 jik1 leot6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 bei2 gaau3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投资房地产的收益率通常都比较稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The yield rate of investing in real estate is usually relatively stable.

english_meaning: to be imprisoned, to be jailed, to go to prison
explanation_mandarin: 指被逮捕并关进监狱。
explanation_english: Refers to being arrested and put in jail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗法，俾人收咗監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 faat3, bei2 jan4 sau1 zo2 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了法，被人关进监狱了。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the law and was imprisoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果再唔守規矩，遲早都要收監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 m4 sau2 kwai1 geoi2, ci4 zou2 dou1 jiu3 sau1 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果再不遵守规矩，迟早都要进监狱。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't follow the rules, you'll end up in jail sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收監之後，成個人都變晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 gaam1 zi1 hau6, sing4 go3 jan4 dou1 bin3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他入狱之后，整个人都变了。
examples.english_sentence: After he was imprisoned, he changed completely.

english_meaning: to watch (television programs); to view
explanation_mandarin: 观看电视节目。指接收信号并观看。
explanation_english: To watch television programs; to receive and view a broadcast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚想收看咩電視節目呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan1 soeng2 sau1 hon3 me1 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚想看什么电视节目啊？
examples.english_sentence: What TV program do you want to watch tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我日日都會收看新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 wui5 sau1 hon3 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都会看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: I watch the news every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得收看今晚八點嘅首播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 sau1 hon3 gam1 maan1 baat3 dim2 ge3 sau2 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得收看今晚八点的首播。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to watch the premiere tonight at 8 o'clock.

english_meaning: to watch (TV, video, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 观看电视节目、视频等。
explanation_english: To watch TV programs, videos, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你琴日有冇收睇世界盃決賽呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 kam4 jat6 jau5 mou5 sau1 tai2 sai3 gaai3 bui1 kyut3 coi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你昨天有没有收看世界杯决赛呀？
examples.english_sentence: Did you watch the World Cup final yesterday?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得今晚八點半收睇我哋嘅節目啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 gam1 maan5 baat3 dim2 bun3 sau1 tai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zit3 muk6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得今晚八点半收看我们的节目啊！
examples.english_sentence: Remember to watch our program at 8:30 tonight!

english_meaning: to end; to conclude; to tidy up the situation; to deal with the aftermath; to fix things
explanation_mandarin: 指事情发展到最后阶段，需要进行处理、结束或收拾局面。也可指承担责任，解决问题。
explanation_english: Refers to the final stage of a situation where it needs to be handled, concluded, or cleaned up. It can also mean taking responsibility and solving problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞出咁大件事，睇下你點收科！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 chut1 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6, tai2 haa5 nei5 dim2 sau1 fo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞出这么大的事，看你怎样收拾局面！
examples.english_sentence: You've created such a big mess, let's see how you clean it up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 單嘢咁複雜，唔知點收科好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daan1 je5 gam3 fuk1 zaap6, m4 zi1 dim2 sau1 fo1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这事这么复杂，不知道怎么收场好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so complicated, I don't know how to end it well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯認錯，我幫佢收科囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 ying6 cho3, ngo5 bong1 keoi5 sau1 fo1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯认错，我帮他收拾局面吧。
examples.english_sentence: He refuses to admit his mistake, I'll help him clean up the mess.

english_meaning: to collect rent
explanation_mandarin: 收取房租。通常指房东向租客收取房屋的租金。
explanation_english: To collect rent. Usually refers to the landlord collecting rent from the tenant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯每個月初都嚟收租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 bak3 mui5 go3 jyut6 co1 dou1 lai4 sau1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 伯伯每个月初都来收房租。
examples.english_sentence: The uncle comes to collect rent at the beginning of every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠收租過活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 sau1 zou1 gwo3 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠收房租生活。
examples.english_sentence: He lives off rent collection.

english_meaning: harvest, gain, result, achievement
explanation_mandarin: 名词：指秋季收割的农作物；比喻获得的成果或知识。动词：指收取农作物；比喻取得成果或知识。
explanation_english: Noun: The harvest of crops in autumn; metaphorically refers to gains, results, or knowledge obtained. Verb: To harvest crops; metaphorically, to achieve results or gain knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅稻米收穫好好呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 dou6 mai5 sau1 wok6 hou2 hou2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的稻米收成很好啊！
examples.english_sentence: The rice harvest is very good this year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁耐嘅努力，我哋終於有收穫喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 noi6 ge3 nou5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 sau1 wok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么久的努力，我们终于有收获了。
examples.english_sentence: After so much effort, we finally have achieved something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次交流活動，我哋都獲益良多，收穫豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 gaau1 lau4 wut6 dung6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 wok6 jik1 loeng4 do1, sau1 wok6 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次交流活动，我们都受益良多，收获丰富。
examples.english_sentence: We all benefited a lot from this exchange activity, with rich gains.

english_meaning: to put away; to pack; to collect; to receive; to store; storage; accommodation
explanation_mandarin: 收拾整理物品，使之存放有序；收集，容纳。
explanation_english: To tidy up and arrange items for orderly storage; to collect or contain things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學吓點樣收納啲嘢，唔係間屋好亂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 sau1 naap6 di1 je5, m4 hai6 gaan1 uk1 hou2 lyun6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学一下怎样收纳东西，不然房子会很乱的。
examples.english_sentence: We need to learn how to put things away, otherwise the house will be very messy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個櫃好啱用嚟收納啲衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwai6 hou2 ngaam1 yung6 lai4 sau1 naap6 di1 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个柜子很适合用来收纳衣服。
examples.english_sentence: This cabinet is very suitable for storing clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅收納技巧真係好勁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau1 naap6 gei2 haau2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的收纳技巧真的很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: His storage skills are really amazing!

english_meaning: menopause; to stop menstruating
explanation_mandarin: 指女性停止月经，进入更年期。也可以用来骂人，形容人言行举止不合时宜，跟不上时代。
explanation_english: Refers to the cessation of menstruation in women, marking the onset of menopause. It can also be used as an insult, describing someone's words and actions as outdated or out of touch with the times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢五十五歲就收咗經啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ng5 sap6 ng5 seoi3 zau6 sau1 zo2 ging1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她五十五岁就绝经了。
examples.english_sentence: She reached menopause at the age of fifty-five.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都收咗經㗎啦，仲着到咁後生！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 sau1 zo2 ging1 gaa3 laa1, zung6 zoek3 dou3 gam3 hau6 saang1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都绝经了，还穿得那么年轻！
examples.english_sentence: You're already past menopause, why are you dressing so young!

english_meaning: to tighten, to clamp down, to restrict, to become stricter
explanation_mandarin: 使松弛的、宽大的变得紧密或严格。
explanation_english: To make something looser or wider become tighter or stricter. Can refer to physical tightening or tightening of rules and policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府收緊咗入境政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sau1 gan2 zo2 jap6 ging2 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府收紧了入境政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has tightened immigration policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條褲太鬆啦，要收緊啲先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 fu3 taai3 sung1 laa1, jiu3 sau1 gan2 di1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的裤子太松了，需要收紧一些才行。
examples.english_sentence: Your pants are too loose, you need to tighten them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話要收緊我啲零用錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 jiu3 sau1 gan2 ngo5 di1 ling4 yung6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说要减少我的零用钱。
examples.english_sentence: My mom said she's going to reduce my allowance.

english_meaning: to hang up (the phone)
explanation_mandarin: 结束通话，挂断电话的意思。
explanation_english: To end a phone call; to hang up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該晒，我收線先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3, ngo5 sau1 sin3 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你，我先挂断电话了。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you very much, I'll hang up now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到收咗我線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 sau1 zo2 ngo5 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生气地挂了我的电话。
examples.english_sentence: He was so angry that he hung up on me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂？喂？點解佢突然收線嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2? wai2? dim2 gaai2 keoi5 dat6 jin4 sau1 sin3 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂？喂？为什么他突然挂断了电话？
examples.english_sentence: Hello? Hello? Why did he suddenly hang up?

english_meaning: to incorporate; to enlist; to absorb; to bring into an organization
explanation_mandarin: 指将分散的力量或人员纳入统一的编制或组织中。
explanation_english: To incorporate scattered forces or personnel into a unified structure or organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司想收編啲小型初創企業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 soeng2 sau1 pin1 di1 siu2 hing1 co1 cong3 kei5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司想收编一些小型初创企业。
examples.english_sentence: Their company wants to incorporate some small startup businesses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃係想收編所有嘅義工，令到資源運用得更加有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 soeng2 sau1 pin1 so2 jau5 ge3 ji6 gung1, ling6 dou3 zi1 jyun4 wan6 yung6 dak1 gang3 gaa1 jau5 haau6 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划是想收编所有的义工，使得资源运用得更加有效率。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is to incorporate all the volunteers, making resource utilization more efficient.

english_meaning: to contract; to shrink; to reduce; contraction; shrinkage
explanation_mandarin: 指物体体积或范围变小，或者减少规模。
explanation_english: Refers to the reduction in size or scope of an object, or a decrease in scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，公司要收縮規模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, gung1 si1 jiu3 sau1 suk1 kwai1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，公司要收缩规模。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the poor economy, the company needs to downsize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣凍嘅時候，啲嘢會收縮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 dung3 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 je5 wui5 sau1 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气冷的时候，东西会收缩。
examples.english_sentence: Things will contract when the weather is cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到人多就忍唔住收縮埋一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 do1 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 sau1 suk1 maai4 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到人多就忍不住缩到一边。
examples.english_sentence: He couldn't help but shrink to one side when he saw a crowd.

english_meaning: Shut up; be quiet; silence
explanation_mandarin: 停止说话，保持安静。
explanation_english: To stop talking, to be quiet. Often used as an impolite command.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你收聲啦！嘈到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sau1 seng1 laa1! cou4 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你闭嘴吧！吵得我做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: Shut up! You're making so much noise that I can't work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢咁衰，你收聲唔好理佢咪算囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 seoi1, nei5 sau1 seng1 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 mai1 syun3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的这么过分，你闭嘴别理他就行了。
examples.english_sentence: He's saying such awful things, just shut up and ignore him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，收聲呀！聽下人哋講嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sau1 seng1 aa3! teng1 haa5 yan4 dei6 gong2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，安静点！听听别人说话。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, be quiet! Listen to what other people are saying.

english_meaning: to listen to (the radio); to listen in
explanation_mandarin: 指收听广播节目。
explanation_english: To listen to a radio program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺揸車嘅時候收聽電台節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 zaa1 ce1 ge3 si4 hau6 sau1 ting1 din6 toi4 zit3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在开车的时候收听电台节目。
examples.english_sentence: I like to listen to the radio programs when I'm driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚有冇收聽新聞啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 jau5 mou5 sau1 ting1 san1 man4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚有没有收听新闻啊？
examples.english_sentence: Did you listen to the news tonight?

english_meaning: to hold in your stomach; to suck in your gut
explanation_mandarin: 指有意地将腹部肌肉收紧，使肚子看起来较小。
explanation_english: Refers to intentionally tightening your stomach muscles to make your stomach appear smaller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影相嘅時候記得收肚呀，唔係會顯肥㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ying2 seung2 ge3 si4 hau6 gei3 dak1 sau1 tou5 aa3, m4 hai6 wui5 hin2 fei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍照的时候记得收腹呀，不然会显得胖的。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to hold in your stomach when taking photos, or you'll look fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙咁窄，要收肚先着得落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 gam3 zaak3, yiu3 sau1 tou5 sin1 zoek3 dak1 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子这么紧，要收腹才能穿得下。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is so tight, I need to hold in my stomach to fit into it.

english_meaning: to collect; to store up; collection
explanation_mandarin: 指收集、保存有价值的东西；也指收集来的东西。
explanation_english: To collect and preserve valuable items; also refers to the items collected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意收藏古董錶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 sau1 cong4 gu2 dung2 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢收藏古董表。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to collect antique watches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館有好多珍貴嘅收藏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 jau5 hou2 do1 zan1 gwai3 ge3 sau1 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家博物馆有很多珍贵的收藏品。
examples.english_sentence: This museum has many precious collections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要將啲相收藏好，唔好畀啲塵整污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 soeng2 sau1 cong4 hou2, m4 hou2 bei2 di1 can4 zing2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要把这些照片收藏好，不要让灰尘弄脏。
examples.english_sentence: I need to store these photos carefully, so that dust doesn't get them dirty.

english_meaning: collectible; collection item
explanation_mandarin: 值得收藏的物品，通常因其稀有、独特或具有历史价值。
explanation_english: An item that is worth collecting because of its rarity, uniqueness, historical significance, or other valued attributes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館有好多珍貴嘅收藏品。
