examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 jau5 hou2 do1 zan1 gwai3 ge3 sau1 cong4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家博物馆有很多珍贵的收藏品。
examples.english_sentence: This museum has many precious collectibles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅嗜好係收集古董收藏品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 si3 hou3 hai6 sau1 zaap6 gu2 dung2 sau1 cong4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的爱好是收集古董收藏品。
examples.english_sentence: My hobby is collecting antique collectibles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢花咗好多錢喺啲藝術收藏品上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 hai2 di1 ngai6 seot4 sau1 cong4 ban2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了很多钱在一些艺术收藏品上面。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of money on some art collectibles.

english_meaning: to stop; to cease; to quit; to back down; to give up (esp. after losing money or facing difficulty)
explanation_mandarin: 停止做某事，通常指停止进行会亏本或有困难的事情。
explanation_english: To stop doing something, usually referring to stopping an activity that is losing money or is facing difficulties. It implies cutting one's losses and withdrawing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 炒股輸咗咁多錢，都係收虧算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caau2 gu2 syu1 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, dou1 hai6 sau1 kwai1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炒股输了这么多钱，还是收手算了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Having lost so much money investing in stocks, it's better to just quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個生意蝕本蝕得咁犀利，不如收虧啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 seng1 ji3 sit6 bun2 sit6 dak1 gam3 sai1 lei6, bat1 jyu4 sau1 kwai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个生意亏本亏得这么厉害，不如停止了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This business is losing so much money, we might as well quit it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見情況唔對路，即刻收虧走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 cing4 kwong3 m4 deoi3 lou6, zik1 haak1 sau1 kwai1 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见情况不对劲，立刻收手走人。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the situation was unfavorable, he immediately backed down and left.

english_meaning: to stop; to quit; to withdraw (from an activity, especially illegal ones)
explanation_mandarin: 指停止进行某项活动，尤其是不正当或非法的活动。有收敛，不再继续的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to stopping an activity, especially an improper or illegal one. It implies ceasing and not continuing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差唔多夠皮喇，都係時候收行水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 m4 do1 gau3 pei4 laa3, dou1 hai6 si4 hau6 sau1 hang4 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 差不多够了，也是时候收手了。
examples.english_sentence: It's almost enough, it's time to stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撈偏門咁耐，都想收行水，搵份正經嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou1 pin1 mun4 gam3 noi6, dou1 soeng2 sau1 hang4 seoi2, wan2 fan6 zeng3 ging1 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做偏门生意这么久，也想收手，找一份正经的工作做。
examples.english_sentence: He has been involved in illegal business for so long, he also wants to quit and find a proper job.

english_meaning: to take in clothes (from the washing line/dryer); to bring in laundry
explanation_mandarin: 把晾晒的衣服收回来。
explanation_english: To collect clothes that have been drying outside or in a dryer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落狗屎喇，快啲收衫啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 gau2 si2 laa3, faai3 di1 sau1 saam1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下大雨了，快点收衣服吧！
examples.english_sentence: It's pouring rain, quickly bring in the clothes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好天，曬完衫記得收衫啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 tin1, saai3 jyun4 saam1 gei3 dak1 sau1 saam1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气很好，晒完衣服记得收衣服啊。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is good today. Remember to bring the clothes in after they're dried.

english_meaning: to take bribes, to receive kickbacks
explanation_mandarin: 指利用职权接受不正当的利益或好处。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: To receive illegitimate benefits or advantages by abusing one's power or position. Usually carries a negative connotation and implies corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁耐，一定收唔少規啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 noi6, jat1 ding6 sau1 m4 siu2 kwai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么久，肯定收了不少好处。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working for so long, he must have received a lot of kickbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以收規啊，依家查得好嚴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 sau1 kwai1 aa3, ji1 gaa1 caa4 dak1 hou2 jim4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着可以收受贿赂，现在查得很严。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about taking bribes, the investigation is very strict now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人就係鍾意收規，真係唔要面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 zau6 hai6 zung1 ji3 sau1 kwai1, zan1 hai6 m4 jiu3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人就是喜欢收受贿赂，真不要脸。
examples.english_sentence: Some people just love taking bribes, they are shameless.

english_meaning: viewership; television ratings
explanation_mandarin: 指电视节目的观众人数或观众比例，是衡量节目受欢迎程度的重要指标。
explanation_english: Refers to the number of viewers or the proportion of viewers watching a television program. It's an important indicator of a program's popularity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇嘅收視好好喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 ge3 sau1 si6 hou2 hou2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧的收视率很好啊。
examples.english_sentence: The viewership for this drama is really good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗提高收視，電視台諗咗好多辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 tai4 gou1 sau1 si6, din6 si6 toi4 nam2 zo2 hou2 do1 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了提高收视率，电视台想了很多办法。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station has come up with many ways to increase viewership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚嘅世界盃決賽收視破咗紀錄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 ge3 sai3 gaai3 bui1 kyut3 coi3 sau1 si6 po3 zo2 gei2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的世界杯决赛收视率打破了纪录。
examples.english_sentence: Last night's World Cup final viewership broke records.

english_meaning: TV ratings, viewership rating
explanation_mandarin: 指电视节目的观众收看比例，是衡量节目受欢迎程度的指标。
explanation_english: The percentage of households with TV sets that are tuned to a particular program. It is an indicator of the program's popularity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目嘅收視率一路都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ge3 sau1 si6 leut6 jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目的收视率一直都很高。
examples.english_sentence: The TV ratings of this program have always been very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果收視率唔夠高，電視台就會cut節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 sau1 si6 leut6 m4 gau3 gou1, din6 si6 toi4 zau6 wui5 cut3 zit3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果收视率不够高，电视台就会取消节目。
examples.english_sentence: If the TV ratings aren't high enough, the TV station will cancel the program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好關注呢套劇嘅收視率會唔會上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3 ni1 tou3 kek6 ge3 sau1 si6 leut6 wui5 m4 wui5 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很关注这部剧的收视率会不会上升。
examples.english_sentence: They are very concerned about whether the ratings of this drama will increase.

english_meaning: To accept (goods, results); to be satisfied with; to pass quality control
explanation_mandarin: 原本指收到货物并确认质量合格。引申为对某事的结果感到满意，或通过了某种考核、检验。
explanation_english: Originally refers to receiving goods and confirming their quality. By extension, it means to be satisfied with the result of something, or to have passed some kind of assessment or inspection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢批貨品質素唔錯，可以收貨啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat1 fo3 ban2 chat1 m4 co3, ho2 ji5 sau1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这批货的质量不错，可以验收了。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this batch of goods is good, we can accept it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫得幾好，老細都收貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 gei2 hou2, lou5 sai3 dou1 sau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告不错，老板也接受了。
examples.english_sentence: His report is well written, the boss is also satisfied with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表演麻麻哋，觀眾都唔收貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 maa4 maa2 dei2, gun1 zung3 dou1 m4 sau1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表演一般般，观众都不满意。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was so-so, the audience wasn't satisfied.

english_meaning: to bribe, to buy over, to win over
explanation_mandarin: 用金钱或利益等手段，使人为自己所用或替自己做事。
explanation_english: To bribe or win over someone with money or other benefits to make them work for you or do something for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想收買啲官員，等佢可以起樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sau1 maai5 di1 gun1 jyun4, dang2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 hei2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想收买那些官员，好让他可以盖楼。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to bribe those officials so that he can build the building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你可以用錢收買我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 cin2 sau1 maai5 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你可以用钱收买我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can bribe me with money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用禮物收買人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 lai5 mat6 sau1 maai5 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用礼物收买人心。
examples.english_sentence: They use gifts to win people's hearts.

mandarin_meaning: 草菅人命, 视人命如草芥
english_meaning: To take human life cheaply; to treat human life with contempt; to be reckless about human life; to undervalue human life; human life is cheap.
explanation_mandarin: 指轻视人命，随意夺取他人的生命，视生命如草芥。
explanation_english: Refers to disregarding human life and taking other people's lives arbitrarily, treating life as insignificant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間黑廠咁樣做嘢，根本就係收買人命！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hak1 cong2 gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 sau1 maai5 jan4 ming6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家黑工厂这样工作，简直就是草菅人命！
examples.english_sentence: The way this illegal factory operates is just taking human life cheaply!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣揸車，根本就係收買人命！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zaa1 ce1, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 sau1 maai5 jan4 ming6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样开车，简直就是在草菅人命！
examples.english_sentence: Driving like that is basically treating human life with contempt!

english_meaning: to win people's hearts, to curry favour with, to ingratiate oneself with
explanation_mandarin: 通过给予好处或者做出承诺等方式，来博取人们的好感和支持。
explanation_english: To win people's hearts by offering benefits, promises, or showing favouritism in order to gain their support and loyalty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日送啲小禮物俾同事，想收買人心啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sung3 di1 siu2 lai5 mat6 bei2 tung4 si6, soeng2 sau1 maai5 jan4 sam1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是送一些小礼物给同事，就是想笼络人心。
examples.english_sentence: He always gives small gifts to his colleagues, just trying to win them over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為派糖就可以收買人心，最緊要係真誠對待人哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 paai3 tong2 zau6 ho2 ji5 sau1 maai5 jan4 sam1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zan1 sing4 deoi3 doi6 jan4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为发糖就可以笼络人心，最重要的是真诚待人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that giving out sweets can win people's hearts, the most important thing is to treat people with sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出好多福利政策，有人話佢哋想收買人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 tui1 ceot1 hou2 do1 fuk1 lei6 zing3 caak3, jau5 jan4 waa6 keoi5 dei6 soeng2 sau1 maai5 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出了很多福利政策，有人说他们想笼络人心。
examples.english_sentence: The government introduced many welfare policies, and some people say they want to win people's hearts.

synonyms: 籠絡人心 (lung5 lok3 jan4 sam1)

english_meaning: ragpicker, junk collector, scrap dealer
explanation_mandarin: 指专门收购旧货、废品的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who specializes in buying old items, recyclable materials, and junk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆成日執啲紙皮俾收買佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 zap1 di1 zi2 pe4 bei2 sau1 maai5 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶经常捡一些纸皮给收废品的。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma often collects cardboard and gives it to the junk collector.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲收買佬會攞住個喇叭周圍叫收嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 sau1 maai5 lou2 wui5 lo2 zyu6 go3 laa3 baa1 zau1 wai4 giu3 sau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前收废品的人会拿着喇叭到处叫收东西。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, junk collectors would carry a loudspeaker and shout around collecting things.

english_meaning: charge a fee; collect fees; toll; admission
explanation_mandarin: 收取费用。指提供服务或产品后，向顾客索要相应的报酬。
explanation_english: To charge a fee for a service or product provided; to collect fees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間健身室收費幾貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gin3 san1 sat1 sau1 fai3 gei2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家健身房收费挺贵的。
examples.english_sentence: This gym charges quite a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入去個公園要收費㗎，你知唔知啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 heoi3 go3 gung1 jyun2 jiu3 sau1 fai3 gaa3, nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 进入那个公园是要收费的，你知道吗？
examples.english_sentence: You have to pay to enter that park, do you know?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家好多網站都開始收費睇片啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 mong5 zaam6 dou1 hoi1 chi2 sau1 fai3 tai2 pin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多网站都开始收费看视频了。
examples.english_sentence: Many websites are now starting to charge for watching videos.

english_meaning: acquisition, to acquire, to buy out
explanation_mandarin: 指一家公司通过购买另一家公司的股份或资产来控制该公司。
explanation_english: The act of one company acquiring control of another company by purchasing its shares or assets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司畀大集團收購咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 daai6 zaap6 tyun4 sau1 gau3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司被一个大集团收购了。
examples.english_sentence: That company was acquired by a large corporation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃收購競爭對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 sau1 gau3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划收购竞争对手。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to acquire their competitor.

english_meaning: to lose weight, to slim down, to get in shape
explanation_mandarin: 通过运动或节食等方式使身体变得苗条。
explanation_english: To lose weight or slim down through exercise, diet, or other methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下定決心要收身，夏天嘅時候可以著靚啲嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 ding6 kyut3 sam1 jiu3 sau1 san1, haa6 tin1 ge3 si4 hau6 ho2 ji5 zoek3 leng3 di1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下定决心要减肥，夏天的时候可以穿漂亮一点的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I'm determined to lose weight so I can wear nicer clothes in the summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好努力收身，日日都去gym做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 nou5 lik6 sau1 san1, jat1 jat1 dou1 heoi3 gym zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近很努力减肥，每天都去健身房运动。
examples.english_sentence: She's been working hard to lose weight recently, going to the gym to exercise every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生完BB之後，好多媽媽都要花時間收身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 jyun4 bi1 bi1 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 maa1 maa1 dou1 jiu3 faa1 si4 gaan3 sau1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生完宝宝之后，很多妈妈都要花时间瘦身。
examples.english_sentence: After giving birth, many mothers need to spend time getting back in shape.

english_meaning: cashier
explanation_mandarin: 指在商店、餐馆等场所负责收款的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is responsible for receiving payments in places such as shops and restaurants.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 maai4 daan1, sau1 ngan2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我结账，收银台在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Please give me the bill. Where's the cashier?

examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这家餐厅的收银人手不太够。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant is short-staffed at the cashier today.

english_meaning: cash register; cashier's counter
explanation_mandarin: 商店或餐厅等场所用来收取顾客款项的柜台或机器。
explanation_english: A counter or machine in a shop or restaurant used for receiving payments from customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去收銀台俾錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 sau1 ngan4 toi4 bei2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去收银台付钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Go to the cash register to pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條隊好長，排到收銀台出面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 deoi2 hou2 coeng4, paai4 dou3 sau1 ngan4 toi4 ceot1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队伍很长，排到收银台外面了。
examples.english_sentence: The queue is very long, it's lined up outside the cashier's counter.

english_meaning: Cashier, teller
explanation_mandarin: 负责收取款项，处理现金或信用卡交易的员工。
explanation_english: An employee responsible for receiving payments and handling cash or credit card transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個收銀員服務態度好好啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sau1 ngan4 jyun4 fuk6 mou6 taai3 dou6 hou2 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个收银员服务态度很好啊。
examples.english_sentence: That cashier has a very good service attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你喺邊度做收銀員啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 zou6 sau1 ngan4 jyun4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你在哪里做收银员啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where do you work as a cashier?

english_meaning: cash register, till
explanation_mandarin: 用于收款和记录销售信息的机器。
explanation_english: A machine used for recording sales transactions and collecting money from customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 埋單，去收銀機俾錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai4 daan1, heoi3 sau1 ngan4 gei1 bei2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结账，去收银机付钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Pay the bill at the cash register.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部收銀機壞咗，用唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau1 ngan4 gei1 waai6 zo2, yung6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收银机坏了，不能用了。
examples.english_sentence: The cash register is broken and can't be used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收銀機入面冇曬散紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 ngan4 gei1 yap6 min6 mou5 saai3 saan2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收银机里没有零钱了。
examples.english_sentence: There's no more change in the cash register.

english_meaning: Cash register, Cashier's counter
explanation_mandarin: 商店或机构中用于收款和存放现金的柜台。
explanation_english: A counter in a shop or establishment where payments are made and cash is kept; a cash register.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去收銀櫃俾錢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 sau1 ngan2 gwai6 bei2 cin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去收银台付钱吧。
examples.english_sentence: Go to the cash register to pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收銀櫃嗰邊排晒隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 ngan2 gwai6 go2 bin1 paai4 saai3 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收银台那边排满了队。
examples.english_sentence: The queues at the cash registers are very long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺收銀櫃做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 sau1 ngan2 gwai6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在收银台工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works at the cash register.

english_meaning: to include, to record, to admit, to enlist
explanation_mandarin: 指将某物（如声音、影像、信息）收集并记录下来。也指接纳、吸收。
explanation_english: To include something in a collection, record or list; to admit or enlist someone.  It often refers to recording audio, video, or information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻碟收錄咗佢好多經典歌曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 dip2 sau1 luk6 zo2 keoi5 hou2 do1 ging1 din2 go1 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张专辑收录了他的很多经典歌曲。
examples.english_sentence: This album includes many of his classic songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅新歌都會收錄喺下隻碟度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 go1 dou1 wui5 sau1 luk6 hai2 haa6 zek3 dip2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新歌都会收录在下一张专辑里。
examples.english_sentence: His new songs will be included on the next album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定收錄佢入隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 sau1 luk6 keoi5 jap6 deoi2.

examples.english_sentence: The company decided to enlist him into the team.

english_meaning: To receive money; to collect money; to take money; to get paid
explanation_mandarin: 获得钱财；收取钱款。
explanation_english: To receive money as payment for a service or product; to collect money due; to be paid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫人補習收錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 jan4 bou2 sik6 sau1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮人补习是收钱的。
examples.english_sentence: He gets paid for tutoring people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋專登嚟收錢，可能係收保護費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun1 dang1 lai4 sau1 cin2, ho2 nang4 hai6 sau1 bou2 wu6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们专门来收钱，可能是收保护费。
examples.english_sentence: They came specifically to collect money, maybe it's protection money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做完嘢，應該收返你應得嘅錢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做完事，应该收回你应得的钱。
examples.english_sentence: You should get paid the money you deserve after you've finished the work.

english_meaning: to collect; to gather
explanation_mandarin: 聚集在一起；把零散的东西集中起来。
explanation_english: To gather together; to bring scattered things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意收集郵票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sau1 zaap6 jau4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢收集邮票。
examples.english_sentence: I like collecting stamps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋收集咗好多資料去寫報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 zaap6 zo2 hou2 do1 zi1 liu2 heoi3 se2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们收集了很多资料来写报告。
examples.english_sentence: They collected a lot of information to write the report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府收集市民嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 sau1 zaap6 si5 man4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府收集市民的意见。
examples.english_sentence: The government is collecting opinions from citizens.

english_meaning: to rein in; to pull back the reins; to stop; to control
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是拉紧缰绳，使马停下来。比喻约束、控制某种行为或趋势，使其停止或减缓。
explanation_english: Literally means to pull the reins to stop a horse. Figuratively, it means to restrain or control a certain behavior or trend, causing it to stop or slow down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都使咗咁多錢，係時候要收韁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 sai2 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, hai6 si4 hau6 jiu3 sau1 goeng1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已经花了这么多钱，是时候要控制一下了。
examples.english_sentence: You've spent so much money, it's time to rein it in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆見公司蝕錢，即刻收韁，唔再擴張業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gin3 gung1 si1 sit6 cin2, zik1 haak1 sau1 goeng1, m4 zoi3 kwong3 zoeng1 ye6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板看到公司亏钱，立刻停止扩张业务。
examples.english_sentence: The boss, seeing that the company was losing money, immediately stopped expanding the business.

english_meaning: to record sound; sound recording
explanation_mandarin: 指录制声音的过程或结果。
explanation_english: Refers to the process or result of recording sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋要喺呢度收音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 ni1 dou6 sau1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们要在这里录音。
examples.english_sentence: Today we are recording sound here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段收音嘅質素好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 sau1 jam1 ge3 zat1 so3 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段录音的质量很差。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of this sound recording is very poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部機嘅收音功能好強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gei1 ge3 sau1 jam1 gung1 nang4 hou2 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器的录音功能很强。
examples.english_sentence: This machine's sound recording function is very strong.

english_meaning: radio
explanation_mandarin: 一种接收无线电广播的电子设备。
explanation_english: An electronic device that receives radio broadcasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時成日聽收音機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 teng1 sau1 jam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常听收音机。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often listened to the radio.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好少聽收音機喇，多數都用手機聽歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 siu2 teng1 sau1 jam1 gei1 laa3, do1 sou3 dou1 yung6 sau2 gei1 teng1 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人很少听收音机了，多数都用手机听歌。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people rarely listen to the radio, most of them use their phones to listen to music.

english_meaning: Calm down a bit; Take it easy; Ease up; Behave yourself a little better.
explanation_mandarin: 表示劝告、警告别人稍微收敛一些，不要太过分，好自为之。
explanation_english: An expression used to advise or warn someone to calm down a little, not to go too far, or to behave a bit better. It implies that the person's behavior is becoming unacceptable or excessive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再嘈落去，我就报警㗎啦，收順啲啦你！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 cou4 lok6 heoi3, ngo5 zau6 bou3 ging2 gaa3 laa1, sau1 seon6 di1 laa1 nei5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再吵下去，我就报警了，安静点吧你！
examples.english_sentence: If you keep arguing, I'll call the police, calm down a bit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢饮醉咗就乱嚟，你收順啲啦，费事出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zeoi3 zo2 zau6 lyun6 lai4, nei5 sau1 seon6 di1 laa1, fai3 si6 chut1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉了就乱来，你收敛点吧，免得出事。
examples.english_sentence: He acts recklessly when he's drunk, so take it easy, so there are no problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，收順啲啦，公众场合嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, sau1 seon6 di1 laa1, gung1 zung3 coeng4 hap6 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，安静点，这是公共场合！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, calm down a bit, this is a public place!

english_meaning: to gather information; to scout for news; to find out what's happening; to get the lay of the land; to check things out
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中或秘密地打听消息，收集信息，以便了解情况或做出决策。
explanation_english: Refers to secretly or discreetly gathering information and scouting for news to understand a situation or make decisions. It implies a deliberate effort to find out what is happening, often unofficially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要收下風，睇下老闆有咩新嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau1 haa5 fung1, tai2 haa5 lou5 baan2 jau5 me1 san1 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要打听一下，看看老板有什么新的计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to gather some information to see what new plans the boss has.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日收風，所以對公司嘅大小事都好清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sau1 fung1, so2 ji5 deoi3 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 siu2 si6 dou1 hou2 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常打听消息，所以对公司的大大小小的事情都很清楚。
examples.english_sentence: He often gathers information, so he is very clear about the big and small matters of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你去收吓風，睇吓邊個會升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 heoi3 sau1 haa5 fung1, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 wui5 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你去打听一下，看看谁会升职。
examples.english_sentence: Go and gather some information to see who will get promoted.

english_meaning: to adopt (a child)
explanation_mandarin: 领养他人子女，使其成为自己的子女。
explanation_english: To legally take a child of other parents to raise as one's own child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋冇仔女，所以決定收養一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 mou5 zai2 neoi5, so2 ji5 kyut3 ding6 sau1 joeng5 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们没有子女，所以决定收养一个。
examples.english_sentence: They don't have children, so they decided to adopt one.

english_meaning: to finish; to stop; to call it a day; to wrap things up
explanation_mandarin: 原意是指停止赛马，现在常用来表示结束某项工作或活动。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the end of a horse race, where the horses are brought back, it now commonly means to finish a task, activity, or work for the day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日做到呢度啦，收馬先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zou6 dou3 ni1 dou6 laa1, sau1 maa5 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天就做到这里吧，先收工！
examples.english_sentence: Let's stop here for today, let's wrap things up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都差唔多時間收馬，不如我哋早啲食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 caa1 m4 do1 si4 gaan3 sau1 maa5, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也差不多是收工的时间了，不如我们早点吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: It's almost time to finish up, how about we have dinner earlier?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project終於收馬，可以放鬆下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project zung1 jyu1 sau1 maa5, ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目终于结束了，可以放松一下了。
examples.english_sentence: The project is finally done, we can relax now.

english_meaning: to calm someone who is frightened; to perform a ritual to soothe a person who is easily frightened, especially children
explanation_mandarin: 一种民间仪式，用来安抚容易受到惊吓的人，特别是小孩。
explanation_english: A folk ritual performed to calm someone who is easily frightened, especially children. It is believed that the person's spirit (魂魄) has been disturbed and needs to be called back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話 BB 成日喊，要帶佢去收驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 BB sing4 jat6 haam3, jiu3 daai3 keoi5 heoi3 sau1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说宝宝总是哭，要带他去收惊。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma says the baby cries all the time and needs to be taken to have a calming ritual performed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日俾阿媽帶去收驚，因為我好容易撞邪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 sing4 jat6 bei2 aa3 maa1 daai3 heoi3 sau1 ging1, yan1 wai6 ngo5 hou2 jung4 ji6 zong6 se4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常被妈妈带去收惊，因为我很容易撞邪。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mom often took me to have a calming ritual performed because I was easily affected by spirits.

english_meaning: To recruit followers; to take in new members (typically younger or less experienced); to recruit minions
explanation_mandarin: 收服或招揽年纪较轻、资历较浅的人作为手下或成员。
explanation_english: To recruit or take in younger or less experienced people as subordinates or members. Often implies a hierarchical relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺條街度收𡃁，想做大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 sau1 leng1, soeng2 zou6 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在街上招募小弟，想当老大。
examples.english_sentence: He's recruiting followers on the street, trying to become a big boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁收𡃁，小心俾差人拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 sau1 leng1, siu2 sam1 bei2 caai1 jan4 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱招募小弟，小心被警察抓。
examples.english_sentence: Don't recruit followers randomly, be careful or the police will arrest you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司不斷收𡃁，擴大勢力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 bat1 dyun6 sau1 leng1, kwong3 daai6 sai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司不断招揽新人，扩大势力。
examples.english_sentence: This company is constantly recruiting new members to expand its power.

mandarin_meaning: 治理，修治; 行为; 所
english_meaning: to govern, to manage; behavior; that which
explanation_mandarin: 文言字，常用於人名或古文之中。有治理、修治、行为、地方等意思。
explanation_english: A literary word, often used in names or classical Chinese. It means to govern, to manage, behavior, place, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名有個「攸」字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ming2 jau5 go3 "jau4" zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的名字里有个“攸”字。
examples.english_sentence: His name has the character "攸".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「攸」喺現代廣東話唔常用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: “jau4” hai2 jin6 doi6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 m4 soeng4 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “攸”在现代广东话里不常用。
examples.english_sentence: The character "攸" is not commonly used in modern Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 更改, 修改, 改变
english_meaning: to change, to alter, to correct, to revise, to reform
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的样子，使适应新的情况或需要。
explanation_english: To alter or modify something; to change its form or character to fit a new situation or need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想改呢份功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想修改这份作业。
examples.english_sentence: I want to correct this homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢改咗個髮型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 goi2 zo2 go3 faat3 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她改变了发型。
examples.english_sentence: He/She changed his/her hairstyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約要改一改先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 jiu3 goi2 jat1 goi2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同要修改一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This contract needs to be revised before it's okay.

english_meaning: to change the rules, to amend regulations
explanation_mandarin: 更改或修订规则、条例。
explanation_english: To change or amend rules, regulations, or laws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司又改例喇，以後遲到要扣人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jau6 goi2 lai6 laa3, ji5 hau6 ci4 dou3 jiu3 kau3 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司又改规则了，以后迟到要扣工资。
examples.english_sentence: The company has changed the rules again. Being late will result in a salary deduction from now on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府改例之後，啲政策都唔同曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 goi2 lai6 zi1 hau6, di1 zing3 caak3 dou1 m4 tung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府修改规则之后，那些政策都完全不同了。
examples.english_sentence: After the government changed the regulations, the policies are completely different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋改例唔俾帶食物入場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 goi2 lai6 m4 bei2 daai3 sik6 mat6 jap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们修改规则不允许携带食物入场。
examples.english_sentence: They changed the rules, forbidding bringing food into the venue.

english_meaning: to reform a system; to restructure; to change the system
explanation_mandarin: 改变原有的制度或体制。
explanation_english: To change or reform the existing system or structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備改制，希望可以改善效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 goi2 zai3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 gai2 sin6 haau2 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司准备改革制度，希望可以改善效率。
examples.english_sentence: The company is preparing to reform the system, hoping to improve efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話要改制，但係啲細節都未公佈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jiu3 goi2 zai3, daan6 hai6 di1 sai3 zit3 dou1 mei6 gung1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说要改革制度，但是细节都还没有公布。
examples.english_sentence: They said they're going to reform the system, but the details haven't been announced yet.

english_meaning: to modify; to alter; to change; modification; alteration
explanation_mandarin: 改变或修改事物，使之与原先有所不同。
explanation_english: To make changes or modifications to something, making it different from its original state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約需要改動一啲條款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 seoi1 jiu3 goi2 dung6 yat1 di1 tiu4 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同需要改动一些条款。
examples.english_sentence: This contract needs to have some clauses modified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要對個設計圖做一啲改動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deoi3 go3 sat3 gai3 tou4 zou6 yat1 di1 goi2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要对设计图做一些改动。
examples.english_sentence: We need to make some changes to the design drawing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過改動之後，個系統好用咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 goi2 dung6 zi1 hau6, go3 hai6 tung2 hou2 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过改动之后，这个系统好用了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After the modification, the system is much more user-friendly.

english_meaning: to change one's tune; to retract one's words; to eat one's words
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的说法；改变口气。
explanation_english: To change what one said before; to change one's tone of voice; to retract a statement or promise, often because of pressure or changed circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先仲鬧緊我，點知老闆一嚟，佢即刻改口讚我叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 zung2 naau6 ging2 ngo5, dim2 zi1 lou5 baan2 jat1 lai4, keoi5 zik1 hak1 goi2 hau2 zaan3 ngo5 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚才还在骂我，谁知道老板一来，他立刻改口夸我能干。
examples.english_sentence: He was just scolding me, but as soon as the boss arrived, he immediately changed his tune and praised me for being capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都已經應承咗人哋，而家想改口都唔得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 ji5 ging1 jing1 sing4 zo2 jan4 dei6, ji4 gaa1 soeng2 goi2 hau2 dou1 m4 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都已经答应人家了，现在想改口都不行了。
examples.english_sentence: You've already promised them, you can't retract your words now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一開始唔肯幫手，後尾見到有著數，即刻改口話願意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 chi2 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2, hau6 mei5 gin3 dou2 jau5 zoek3 sou3, zik1 hak1 goi2 hau2 waa6 jyun4 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一开始不肯帮忙，后来看到有好处，立刻改口说愿意。
examples.english_sentence: He initially refused to help, but later when he saw there was a benefit, he immediately changed his tune and said he was willing.

english_meaning: to change one's name; to rename
explanation_mandarin: 更改名字。可以是人名，也可以是其他事物的名称。
explanation_english: To change a name. This can refer to a person's name or the name of anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個果陣改過名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 gwo2 zan6 goi2 gwo3 ming2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候改过名字。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his name when he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳執咗笠，依家改名重新開張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 zap1 zo2 lap1, ji1 gaa1 goi2 ming2 cung4 san1 hoi1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅倒闭了，现在改名重新开张。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant went out of business, and now it's reopening under a new name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你使唔使改名轉運啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai2 m4 sai2 goi2 ming2 zyun2 wan6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要改名字来转运吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you need to change your name to change your luck?

english_meaning: to change one's name and surname; to assume a false identity
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的姓名，隐瞒身份。
explanation_english: To change one's name and surname, usually to hide one's identity or avoid being recognized. It implies a desire to sever ties with the past and start anew under a different guise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗避債，焗住要改名換姓走佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bei6 zaai3, guk6 zyu6 jiu3 goi2 ming4 wun6 sing3 zau2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为了躲债，不得不改名换姓逃跑。
examples.english_sentence: To avoid debt, he had no choice but to change his name and run away.

english_meaning: to improve, to ameliorate, improvement
explanation_mandarin: 使情况变得更好。
explanation_english: To make something better; to improve the quality or condition of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改善下公司嘅服務質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaai2 sin6 haa5 gung1 si1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 zat1 so3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要改善一下公司的服务质量。
examples.english_sentence: We need to improve the service quality of our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想改善下佢嘅英文水平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaai2 sin6 haa5 keoi5 ge3 jing1 man4 seoi2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想提高一下他的英语水平。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to improve his English level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生活環境改善咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 wut6 waan4 ging2 gaai2 sin6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生活环境改善了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The living environment has improved a lot.

english_meaning: to edit a picture, to photoshop (a picture)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过图像处理软件对图片进行修改、编辑或篡改。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of modifying, editing, or manipulating a picture using image processing software.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將張相改圖改到認唔出佢本人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zoeng1 soeng2 goi2 tou4 goi2 dou3 ying6 m4 chut1 keoi5 bun2 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把这张照片改图改到认不出他本人了。
examples.english_sentence: He photoshopped the picture so much that he is unrecognizable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日改圖啦，真實啲好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 goi2 tou4 laa1, zan1 sat6 di1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是改图啦，真实一些好一些。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't always photoshop pictures, being more authentic is better.

english_meaning: another day; some other time; later
explanation_mandarin: 表示推迟到将来某一天，但具体时间未定。
explanation_english: Indicates postponing something to an unspecified day in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，我今日真係唔得閒，改天再同你食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 haan4, goi2 tin1 zoi3 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今天真的很忙，改天再和你吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm really busy today. Let's have dinner some other time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次唔得閒去旅行，改天先去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 m4 dak1 haan4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, goi2 tin1 sin1 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次没空去旅行，改天再去吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have time to travel this time. Let's go another day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有機會，改天一齊去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 gei1 wui6, goi2 tin1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有机会，改天一起去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: If we have the chance, let's go for dim sum some other time.

english_meaning: to remarry (of a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指女子在丈夫去世或离婚后再次结婚。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman remarrying after her husband has passed away or after a divorce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老公走咗之後，佢都冇諗過改嫁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 gung1 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 dou1 mou5 lam2 gwo3 goi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她丈夫去世后，她都没想过改嫁。
examples.english_sentence: After her husband passed away, she never considered remarrying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺以前嘅社會，女人改嫁會受到好多歧視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji5 cin4 ge3 se5 wui2, neoi5 jan2 goi2 gaa3 wui5 sau6 dou3 ho2 do1 kei4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在以前的社会，女人改嫁会受到很多歧视。
examples.english_sentence: In the old society, women faced a lot of discrimination when they remarried.

english_meaning: to rewrite, to revise, to modify, to adapt
explanation_mandarin: 重新书写；修改；改变原有的内容。
explanation_english: To rewrite; to revise; to modify or change the original content of something written or created.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告寫得唔好，要改寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 m4 hou2, jiu3 goi2 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得不好，需要改写。
examples.english_sentence: This report is not well written, it needs to be rewritten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔嘅結局可以改寫得更加浪漫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 ge3 git3 guk6 ho2 ji5 goi2 se2 dak1 gang3 gaa1 long6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事的结局可以改写得更加浪漫。
examples.english_sentence: The ending of this story can be rewritten to be more romantic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將首歌嘅歌詞改寫咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 sau2 go1 ge3 go1 ci4 goi2 se2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她把这首歌的歌词改写了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She rewrote the lyrics of the song.

english_meaning: to rebuild; to reconstruct; to renovate; to remodel
explanation_mandarin: 重新建造或改造建筑物。
explanation_english: To rebuild, reconstruct, renovate, or remodel a building or structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃改建呢間舊工廠做寫字樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 goi2 gin3 ni1 gaan1 gau6 gung1 chong2 zou6 se2 zi6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划改建这家旧工厂做办公室。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to renovate this old factory into an office building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋諗住改建間屋，整大啲個廚房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lam2 zyu6 goi2 gin3 gaan1 uk1, zing2 daai6 di1 go3 chu4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算改建房子，把厨房弄大一点。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to renovate the house and make the kitchen bigger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路太窄，需要改建擴闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 taai3 zaak3, seoi1 jiu3 goi2 gin3 kwok3 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路太窄，需要改建扩宽。
examples.english_sentence: This road is too narrow and needs to be rebuilt and widened.

english_meaning: to change direction or method, to adopt a new approach
explanation_mandarin: 比喻改变原来的方向、做法或主张。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to change one's course, to adopt a new approach, or to change one's ways. It implies a shift in direction or strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋見個計劃唔掂，決定改弦易轍，用另一種方法試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gin3 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 dim1, kyut3 ding6 goi2 jin4 jik6 cit3, yung6 ling6 jat1 zung2 fong1 faat3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们见这个计划不行，决定改变方向，用另一种方法试试。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that the plan wasn't working, they decided to change direction and try a different approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得依家嘅方法唔啱，不如改弦易轍，睇下會唔會好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 ji1 gaa1 ge3 fong1 faat3 m4 ngaam1, bat1 jyu4 goi2 jin4 jik6 cit3, tai2 haa5 wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得现在的方法不对，不如改变方向，看看会不会好一点。
examples.english_sentence: If you think the current method isn't right, why not change direction and see if it's better?

english_meaning: to change, to replace, to substitute
explanation_mandarin: 替换，更换。 把原来的东西换成另外的东西。
explanation_english: To change, replace, or substitute one thing for another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想改換個髮型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 wun6 go3 faat3 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想换个发型。
examples.english_sentence: I want to change my hairstyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳改換咗餐牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 goi2 wun6 zo2 caan1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅更换了菜单。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has changed its menu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改換一下策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 wun6 jat1 haa5 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要改变一下策略。
examples.english_sentence: We need to change our strategy.

english_meaning: to revise an article, to edit a document
explanation_mandarin: 修改文章，修改文件。指对文章或文件进行修改润色，使其更完善。
explanation_english: To revise an article or edit a document. Refers to modifying and polishing an article or document to make it more complete and perfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告有啲地方要改文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 jiu3 goi2 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有些地方需要修改。
examples.english_sentence: There are some parts of this report that need to be revised.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我改文，改到好順暢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 goi2 man2, goi2 dou3 hou2 seon6 cheung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮我修改文章，改得很流畅。
examples.english_sentence: He helped me revise the article and made it very smooth.

english_meaning: dynastic change, regime change, change of dynasty
explanation_mandarin: 指一个朝代被另一个朝代取代，通常涉及政治制度的根本变革。
explanation_english: Refers to the replacement of one dynasty or regime by another, often involving fundamental changes in the political system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史上唔少國家都經歷過改朝換代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 soeng6 m4 siu2 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 ging1 lik6 gwo3 goi2 ciu4 wun6 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史上不少国家都经历过改朝换代。
examples.english_sentence: Many countries in history have experienced dynastic changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每次改朝換代都帶嚟唔同程度嘅社會動盪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 ci3 goi2 ciu4 wun6 doi6 dou1 daai3 lei4 m4 tung4 cing4 dou6 ge3 se5 wui2 dung6 dong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每次改朝换代都带来不同程度的社会动荡。
examples.english_sentence: Every dynastic change brings social unrest of varying degrees.

english_meaning: to reschedule; to postpone
explanation_mandarin: 更改原定的日期；延期。
explanation_english: To change the original date; to postpone or reschedule an event or appointment to a later date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改期開會呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 kei4 hoi1 wui2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要改期开会啊。
examples.english_sentence: We need to reschedule the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為打風，演唱會要改期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 daa2 fung1, yin2 cheung3 wui2 jiu3 goi2 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为台风，演唱会要改期。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the typhoon, the concert needs to be rescheduled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我唔得閒，可唔可以改期？
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 goi2 kei4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我没空，可不可以改期？
examples.english_sentence: If I'm not free, can we reschedule?

english_meaning: to correct; to rectify; to amend
explanation_mandarin: 纠正错误，使之正确。
explanation_english: To correct an error; to make something right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你寫錯字喇，要改正返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 se2 co3 zi6 laa3, jiu3 go2 zing3 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你写错字了，要改正。
examples.english_sentence: You wrote the word wrong, you need to correct it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有啲錯漏，我要改正下先交俾老闆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 di1 co3 lau6, ngo5 jiu3 go2 zing3 haa5 sin1 gaau1 bei2 lou5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有些错误，我要改正一下再交给老板。
examples.english_sentence: There are some errors in this report, I need to correct them before submitting it to the boss.

english_meaning: to change to, to alter to, to convert to
explanation_mandarin: 将原来的改变成另一种形式或状态。
explanation_english: To change something to another form or state. To alter or convert something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定將個計劃改為下個月先開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 go3 gai3 waak6 goi2 wai4 haa6 go3 jyut6 sin1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定将这个计划改为下个月才开始。
examples.english_sentence: We've decided to change the plan to start next month instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將部車改為電動車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 bou6 ce1 goi2 wai4 din6 dung6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把车改为电动车。
examples.english_sentence: He converted the car into an electric car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為天氣唔好，我哋將戶外活動改為室內活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 m4 hou2, ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 wu6 ngoi6 wut6 dung6 goi2 wai4 sat1 noi6 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为天气不好，我们把户外活动改为室内活动。
examples.english_sentence: Because the weather is bad, we changed the outdoor activities to indoor activities.

english_meaning: to change to; to convert to; to alter to; to be changed to
explanation_mandarin: 改变成为；转换成。
explanation_english: To change into something; to convert to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋決定將個會議改爲線上進行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 go3 wui6 ji5 goi2 wai4 sin3 soeng6 gan2 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们决定把会议改为在线进行。
examples.english_sentence: We decided to change the meeting to be conducted online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原本計劃去旅行，但係因為疫情，所以改爲留喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 bun2 gai3 waak6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4, daan6 hai6 yan1 wai6 jik6 cing4, so2 ji5 goi2 wai4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原本计划去旅行，但是因为疫情，所以改为留在家里。
examples.english_sentence: Originally planned to travel, but due to the pandemic, it was changed to staying at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告要改爲用英文寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 goi2 wai4 yung6 ying1 man2 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告要改为用英文写。
examples.english_sentence: This report needs to be changed to be written in English.

english_meaning: to switch to, to use instead, to adopt, to change to (using something else)
explanation_mandarin: 改变原先使用的，开始使用新的事物。
explanation_english: To change from the original thing used to a new one; to start using something new instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部舊電腦壞咗，我要改用新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, ngo5 jiu3 goi2 yung6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧电脑坏了，我要改用新的。
examples.english_sentence: The old computer is broken, I need to switch to a new one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議我改用另一種藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 ngo5 goi2 yung6 ling6 jat1 zung2 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议我改用另一种药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested I switch to another type of medication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司決定改用環保物料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 goi2 yung6 waan4 bou2 mat6 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定改用环保材料。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to switch to using environmentally friendly materials.

mandarin_meaning: 修改账本; 篡改记录
english_meaning: To alter records, to doctor the books, to falsify accounts
explanation_mandarin: 指通过不正当手段修改账本或者记录，通常是为了掩盖错误或者欺骗他人。
explanation_english: Refers to altering records or accounts, usually with dishonest intentions to cover up mistakes or deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司俾人發現改簿，啲數唔啱數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 goi2 bou2, di1 sou3 m4 ngaam1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司被人发现篡改账本，账目不对。
examples.english_sentence: Their company was found to be doctoring the books, and the accounts didn't add up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住改簿就可以呃到人，始終會俾人發現嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 goi2 bou2 zau6 ho2 ji5 aak1 dou3 jan4, ci2 zung1 wui5 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想通过篡改账本就可以骗到人，迟早会被人发现的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can deceive people by falsifying records, it will eventually be discovered.

english_meaning: reorganization, restructuring
explanation_mandarin: 重新组织机构或队伍。
explanation_english: To reorganize or restructure an organization, company, or team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司要改組，好多人都擔心會俾人炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jiu3 goi2 zou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 daam1 sam1 wui5 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要改组，很多人都担心会被解雇。
examples.english_sentence: The company is going to be reorganized, and many people are worried about being fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過改組之後，公司嘅效率提高咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 goi2 zou2 zi1 hau6, gung1 si1 ge3 haau2 leot2 tai4 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过改组之后，公司的效率提高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After the reorganization, the company's efficiency has improved a lot.

english_meaning: to adapt; to rearrange; to rewrite
explanation_mandarin: 将文学作品、电影、戏剧等进行修改或改编，使其适合新的表达形式或观众。
explanation_english: To adapt or rearrange a literary work, film, play, etc., to make it suitable for a new form of expression or audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲係由一本好出名嘅小說改編而成嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 jau4 jat1 bun2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 siu2 syut3 goi2 bin1 ji4 sing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影是由一本很出名的小说改编而成的。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is adapted from a very famous novel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將首歌改編咗做爵士樂版本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 sau2 go1 goi2 bin1 zo2 zou6 zoek3 si6 ngok6 bun2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把那首歌改编成了爵士乐版本。
examples.english_sentence: They adapted that song into a jazz version.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個劇本係改編自真人真事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 kek6 bun2 hai6 goi2 bin1 zi6 zan1 jan4 zan1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剧本是改编自真人真事。
examples.english_sentence: The screenplay is adapted from real events and real people.

english_meaning: to improve, to ameliorate, to reform
explanation_mandarin: 通过改进来提高质量或性能。
explanation_english: To improve the quality or performance of something through changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改良下個產品嘅設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 loeng4 haa5 go3 caan2 ban2 ge3 sat3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要改良一下那个产品的设计。
examples.english_sentence: We need to improve the design of that product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過改良之後，佢嘅耕作方法更加有效率。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 goi2 loeng4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 gaang1 zok3 fong1 faat3 gang3 gaa1 jau5 haau6 leot2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过改良之后，他的耕作方法更加有效率。
examples.english_sentence: After improvement, his farming method is more efficient.

english_meaning: to change profession/trade/career
explanation_mandarin: 改变职业，转做其他行业。
explanation_english: To change one's profession, trade, or career; to switch to a different line of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得做嘢壓力太大，所以諗住改行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zou6 je5 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6, so2 ji5 lam2 zyu6 goi2 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得工作压力太大，所以想改行。
examples.english_sentence: He feels the work pressure is too high, so he's thinking of changing careers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都被迫改行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 bei1 bik1 goi2 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都被迫改行。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, many people are forced to change careers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我讀咗咁多年醫，唔想改行做其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 duk6 zo2 gam3 do1 nin4 ji1, m4 soeng2 goi2 hong4 zou6 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我读了这么多年医，不想改行做其他事情。
examples.english_sentence: I've studied medicine for so many years, I don't want to change to another career.

english_meaning: to modify; to refit; to customize; modification
explanation_mandarin: 改变原有的装置或形状，使之适应新的需要。
explanation_english: To modify or refit something, especially equipment or a vehicle, to better suit a particular purpose or need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢部車改裝得好型啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou6 ce1 goi2 zong1 dak1 hou2 ying4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车改装得很帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: His car is so cool with the modifications!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改裝間屋，等佢住得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 yiu3 goi2 zong1 gaan1 uk1, dang2 keoi5 zyu6 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要改装这间屋子，让他住得舒服一点。
examples.english_sentence: We need to renovate the house so he can live more comfortably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦改裝過，所以行得快好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 goi2 zong1 gwo3, so2 ji5 haang4 dak1 faai3 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑改装过，所以运行快了很多。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been upgraded, so it runs much faster.

english_meaning: to change one's view; to improve one's opinion; to take on a new aspect
explanation_mandarin: 改变原有的看法或印象，变得更好。
explanation_english: To change one's original view or impression, usually for the better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最初我覺得佢好寸，但係接觸多咗之後，對佢嘅印象就改觀咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 co1 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 cyun3, daan6 hai6 zip3 cuk1 do1 zo2 zi1 hau6, deoi3 keoi5 ge3 jan3 soeng6 zau6 goi2 gun1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最初我觉得他很傲慢，但是接触多了之后，对他的印象就改观了。
examples.english_sentence: At first, I thought he was very arrogant, but after getting to know him better, my impression of him changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部新電影嘅口碑好好，令到好多原本唔想睇嘅人都對佢改觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 san1 din6 ying2 ge3 hau2 bei6 hou2 hou2, ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 jyun4 bun2 m4 soeng2 tai2 ge3 jan4 dou1 deoi3 keoi5 goi2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部新电影的口碑很好，使得很多原本不想看的人都对它改观了。
examples.english_sentence: This new movie has very good word-of-mouth, causing many people who didn't want to see it originally to change their minds about it.

english_meaning: Parody lyrics, to change the lyrics (of a song)
explanation_mandarin: 改编歌曲的歌词，通常是为了幽默或讽刺。
explanation_english: To change the lyrics of a song, usually for humor or satire; to write parody lyrics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意改詞，成日將啲流行歌改成搞笑版本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 goi2 ci4, seng4 jat6 zoeng1 di1 lau4 hang4 go1 goi2 sing4 gaau2 siu3 baan2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢改歌词，经常把流行的歌改成搞笑的版本。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes to parody lyrics, always changing popular songs into funny versions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我哋啱啱改詞改得太投入，嘈親你哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 goi2 ci4 goi2 dak1 taai3 tau4 jap6, cou4 can1 nei5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我们刚才改歌词改得太投入，吵到你们了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, we were too engrossed in writing parody lyrics and disturbed you.

english_meaning: to change; to alter; to transform
explanation_mandarin: 使发生变化；改换。
explanation_english: To make something different; to alter or transform something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法改變咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 goi2 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法改变了很多。
examples.english_sentence: His way of thinking has changed a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以改變過去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 goi2 bin3 gwo3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能改变过去。
examples.english_sentence: You cannot change the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 世界不停噉改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 gaai3 bat1 ting4 gam2 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 世界不停地改变。
examples.english_sentence: The world is constantly changing.

english_meaning: to change direction; to change strategy; to alter course
explanation_mandarin: 比喻改变原来的方向、方法或策略。
explanation_english: A metaphor for changing one's original direction, methods, or strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅計劃失敗咗，可能要改轅易轍先得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 sat1 baai6 zo2, ho2 nang4 jiu3 goi2 jyun4 jik6 cit3 sin1 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划失败了，可能需要改变策略才行了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan failed, we might need to change our strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司見到市場反應唔好，決定改轅易轍，推出新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gin3 dou2 si5 coeng4 faan2 jing3 m4 hou2, kyut3 ding6 goi2 jyun4 jik6 cit3, tui1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司看到市场反应不好，决定改变策略，推出新产品。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the market's negative response, the company decided to change its strategy and launch a new product.

mandarin_meaning: 改变主意, 改变方向
english_meaning: to change one's mind, to change direction, to change course
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的想法或做法。
explanation_english: To change one's original intention, plan, or course of action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢本來諗住移民，但係而家改轉咗，唔走喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bun2 lai4 nam2 zyu6 ji4 man4, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 goi2 zyun2 zo2, m4 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他本来打算移民，但是现在改变主意了，不走了。
examples.english_sentence: He originally planned to immigrate, but now he's changed his mind and isn't going.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事已經決定咗，唔可以隨便改轉㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zo2, m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 goi2 zyun2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情已经决定了，不可以随便改变的。
examples.english_sentence: The matter has already been decided, you can't just change it arbitrarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到個市況咁差，佢決定改轉投資策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 go3 si5 fong3 gam3 caa1, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 goi2 zyun2 tau4 zi1 cak1 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到市场情况这么差，他决定改变投资策略。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how bad the market situation is, he decided to change his investment strategy.

english_meaning: to transform, to remould, to reform, to restructure, to renovate
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的样子或性质，使适应新的情况或需要。
explanation_english: To change something's original appearance or nature to adapt it to a new situation or need. To transform or remold something, often with the aim of improving it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想改造間舊屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gaai2 zou6 gaan1 gau6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想改造那间旧房子。
examples.english_sentence: They want to renovate that old house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想改造自己嘅性格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaai2 zou6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing3 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想改造自己的性格。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to reform his character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市不斷被改造緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 bat1 dyun6 bei6 gaai2 zou6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个城市不断地被改造着。
examples.english_sentence: This city is constantly being transformed.

english_meaning: to improve; to make better; improvement
explanation_mandarin: 使原有的基础上变得更好；改善。
explanation_english: To make something better than it was before; to improve or upgrade.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要不斷改進服務質素，先可以吸引更多顧客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bat1 dyun6 goi2 zeon3 fuk6 mou6 zat1 so3, sin1 ho2 ji5 kap1 yan5 gang3 do1 gu3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要不断改进服务质量，才可以吸引更多顾客。
examples.english_sentence: We need to constantly improve the quality of our service in order to attract more customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個設計仲有好多改進嘅空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 gai3 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 goi2 zeon3 ge3 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个设计还有很多改进的空间。
examples.english_sentence: This design still has a lot of room for improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過今次嘅經驗，希望下次可以有所改進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam1 ci3 ge3 ging1 jim6, hei1 mong6 haa6 ci3 ho2 ji5 jau5 so2 goi2 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这次的经验，希望下次可以有所改进。
examples.english_sentence: After this experience, I hope that we can make some improvements next time.

english_meaning: To correct one's mistakes; to repent; to turn over a new leaf
explanation_mandarin: 指改正过去的错误，重新做人。
explanation_english: To correct past mistakes and start anew; to repent and change one's ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢知錯喇，決定改過自身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 co3 laa3, kyut3 ding6 gaai2 gwo3 zi6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他知道错了，决定改过自新。
examples.english_sentence: He knows he was wrong and has decided to turn over a new leaf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir俾多次機會佢，希望佢可以改過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir1 bei2 do1 ci3 gei1 wui6 keoi5, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 gaai2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师再给他一次机会，希望他可以改正错误。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher is giving him another chance, hoping he can correct his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 犯咗錯唔緊要，最緊要係肯改過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan6 zo2 co3 m4 gan2 jiu3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hang2 gaai2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 犯了错不要紧，最重要的是肯改正。
examples.english_sentence: It doesn't matter if you make mistakes, the most important thing is to be willing to correct them.

english_meaning: to turn over a new leaf, to mend one's ways
explanation_mandarin: 改正过去的错误，重新做人。
explanation_english: To correct one's past mistakes and start afresh, to reform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐完監之後，決定改過自新，搵份正經嘢做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zo6 jyun4 gaam1 zi1 hau6, kyut3 ding6 goi2 gwo3 zi6 san1, wan2 fan6 zing3 ging1 je5 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐完牢之后，决定改过自新，找一份正经工作做。
examples.english_sentence: After serving his time in prison, he decided to turn over a new leaf and find an honest job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢以前做錯好多嘢，但係如果佢真心想改過自新，我哋應該俾個機會佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 co3 ho2 do1 je5, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zan1 sam1 soeng2 goi2 gwo3 zi6 san1, ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 bei2 go3 gei1 wui2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他以前做错了很多事，但是如果他真心想要改过自新，我们应该给他一个机会。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has done many wrong things in the past, if he sincerely wants to mend his ways, we should give him a chance.

english_meaning: to change route; to reroute; to detour
explanation_mandarin: 改变原来的路线。
explanation_english: To change the original route; to detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面撞車，要改道行先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 zong6 ce1, jiu3 goi2 dou6 hang4 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面发生车祸，要改道才能走了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a car accident ahead, we have to take a detour to proceed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路整緊，巴士要改道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 zing2 gan2, baa1 si2 jiu3 goi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路正在维修，巴士需要改道。
examples.english_sentence: The road is under construction, the bus has to take a detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為遊行嘅關係，好多巴士都要改道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 jau4 hang4 ge3 gwaan1 hai6, hou2 do1 baa1 si2 dou1 jiu3 goi2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为游行的关系，很多巴士都要改道。
examples.english_sentence: Due to the parade, many buses need to reroute.

english_meaning: re-election, to re-elect, to hold a new election
explanation_mandarin: 重新选举，改变原有的选举结果。
explanation_english: To hold a new election, typically to replace existing representatives or officers due to resignation, term expiration, or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢犯咗嚴重嘅錯誤，所以我哋要改選佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yan1 wai6 keoi5 faan6 zo2 yim4 zung6 ge3 co3 ng6, so2 yi5 ngo5 dei6 yiu3 goi2 syun2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他犯了严重的错误，所以我们要改选他。
examples.english_sentence: Because he made a serious mistake, we need to re-elect and replace him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅學生會要改選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 hok6 saang1 wui2 yiu3 goi2 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的学生会要改选。
examples.english_sentence: The student union will hold a re-election this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定提早改選董事會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 tai4 zou2 goi2 syun2 dung2 si6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定提早改选董事会。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to hold an early re-election of the board of directors.

english_meaning: to turn over a new leaf, to abandon evil and return to good, to repent and reform
explanation_mandarin: 指抛弃邪恶，回到正道上来。形容坏人决心做好人。
explanation_english: Refers to abandoning wickedness and returning to the right path. Describes a bad person's determination to become good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係黑社會嘅，但係而家佢改邪歸正，做返個好人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 hak1 se5 wui2 ge3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 keoi5 goi2 ce4 gwai1 zing3, zou6 faan1 go3 hou2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是黑社会的，但是现在他改邪归正，重新做人了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be in the triad, but now he has turned over a new leaf and is a good person again.

english_meaning: correction tape
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于修正书写错误的文具。
explanation_english: A type of stationery used to correct writing mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 借枝改錯帶嚟用下唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze3 zi1 goi2 co3 daai2 lai4 yung6 haa5 m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请借我用一下修正带。
examples.english_sentence: Please lend me the correction tape for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份功課錯字太多，要用改錯帶改返好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 fo3 co3 zi6 taai3 do1, jiu3 yung6 goi2 co3 daai2 goi2 faan1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作业里错字太多了，要用修正带改好。
examples.english_sentence: There are too many typos in the homework, I need to use correction tape to fix it.

english_meaning: reform; to reform
explanation_mandarin: 改变旧的制度、方法等，使适合新的情况和需要。
explanation_english: To make changes to something in order to improve it; to reorganize a system, organization, etc. to make it more efficient or better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司需要改革先至可以生存落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 sang1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司需要改革才可以生存下去。
examples.english_sentence: This company needs reform in order to survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布咗一系列嘅經濟改革措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 zo2 jat1 hei6 lit6 ge3 ging1 zai3 gaai2 gaak3 cu3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布了一系列的经济改革措施。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced a series of economic reform measures.

english_meaning: to undergo a complete makeover; to change completely; to revamp; to put on a new face
explanation_mandarin: 比喻只在表面形式上有所改变，实质上没有改变。
explanation_english: Metaphorically refers to making superficial changes without changing the fundamental nature of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間餐廳改頭換面之後，生意好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 caan1 teng1 goi2 tau4 wun6 min6 zi1 hau6, saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的餐厅改头换面之后，生意好了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After the restaurant had a complete makeover, the business became much better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃只係改頭換面，骨子裏都係一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zi2 hai6 goi2 tau4 wun6 min6, gwat1 zi2 leoi5 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划只是改头换面，骨子里还是一样。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is just a makeover, the core remains the same.

mandarin_meaning: 攻击, 进攻, 攻读
english_meaning: to attack, to assault, to study intensively, to major in
explanation_mandarin: 指进攻，攻击。也指集中精力学习或研究。
explanation_english: Refers to attacking or assaulting. It also means to concentrate on studying or researching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋準備攻入敵方陣地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun2 bei6 gung1 jap6 dik6 fong1 zan6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们准备攻入敌方阵地。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing to attack the enemy's position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大學嗰陣攻讀工程系。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 hok6 go2 zan6 gung1 duk6 gung1 cing4 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大学的时候攻读工程系。
examples.english_sentence: I majored in engineering when I was in university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要全力攻克呢個難題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cyun4 lik6 gung1 hak1 ni1 go3 naan4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要全力攻克这个难题。
examples.english_sentence: We must do our best to overcome this difficulty.

english_meaning: to capture, to occupy, to seize
explanation_mandarin: 以武力夺取、占领。
explanation_english: To seize or occupy a place by force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用咗幾日就攻佔咗成個城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 zo2 gei2 jat6 zau6 gung1 zim3 zo2 sing4 go3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用了几天就攻占了整个城市。
examples.english_sentence: They captured the whole city in a few days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好受歡迎，好多時都要排隊先攻佔到個位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4, hou2 do1 si4 dou1 jiu3 paai4 deoi2 sin1 gung1 zim3 dou2 go3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很受欢迎，很多时候都要排队才能占到座位。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is very popular, you often have to queue to get a seat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想攻佔市場嘅大部分份額。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 gung1 zim3 si5 coeng4 ge3 daai6 bui6 fan6 aak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想攻占市场的大部分份额。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to capture a large share of the market.

english_meaning: to strike when unprepared; to catch someone off guard
explanation_mandarin: 乘对方没有防备的时候进攻。
explanation_english: To attack someone or something when they are not prepared or expecting it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要攻其不備，先可以贏到呢場比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gung1 kei4 bat1 bei6, sin1 ho2 ji5 wing4 dou3 ni1 coeng4 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要攻其不备，才能赢得这场比赛。
examples.english_sentence: We need to catch them off guard to win this match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日攻其不備，搞到人哋唔知點應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gung1 kei4 bat1 bei6, gaau2 dou3 jan4 dei6 m4 zi1 dim2 ying3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是攻其不备，搞得别人不知道怎么应付。
examples.english_sentence: He always attacks when people least expect it, making it difficult for them to cope.

english_meaning: offensive; onslaught; attack; initiative
explanation_mandarin: 指进攻的态势或行动。
explanation_english: Refers to an offensive posture or action; an attack or initiative taken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波我哋要採取主動嘅攻勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 coi2 ceoi2 zyu2 dung6 ge3 gung1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛我们要采取主动的攻势。
examples.english_sentence: We need to take the initiative and go on the offensive in this game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發動咗一輪凌厲嘅攻勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 dung6 zo2 jat1 leon4 ling4 lai6 ge3 gung1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们发起了一轮猛烈的攻势。
examples.english_sentence: They launched a fierce offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅言語攻勢好強勁，令人難以招架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin4 jyu5 gung1 sai3 hou2 koeng4 ging6, ling6 jan4 naan4 ji5 ziu1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的语言攻势很强劲，令人难以招架。
examples.english_sentence: His verbal offensive is so strong that it's hard to parry.

english_meaning: to capture cities and seize territory; to conquer and expand one's territory aggressively
explanation_mandarin: 原指攻打城市，掠夺土地。形容侵略扩张，争夺地盘。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to attacking cities and seizing territory. It describes aggressive expansion and competition for territory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司為咗擴大市場佔有率，不斷咁攻城掠地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wai4 zo2 kwok3 daai6 si5 coeng4 zim3 jau5 leot6, bat1 dyun6 gam2 gung1 sing4 loek6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司为了扩大市场占有率，不断地攻城略地。
examples.english_sentence: This company is constantly capturing new market share in order to expand its market share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地產發展商積極喺新界攻城掠地，起好多新樓盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 caan2 faat3 zin2 soeng1 gik1 gik1 hai2 san1 gaai3 gung1 sing4 loek6 dei6, hei2 hou2 do1 san1 lau4 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房地产开发商积极在新界攻城略地，建造很多新楼盘。
examples.english_sentence: Real estate developers are actively conquering territory in the New Territories, building many new residential developments.

english_meaning: to tackle a difficult problem; to overcome a challenge; to assault and take (a fortified position)
explanation_mandarin: 指集中力量克服困难或难关。也指强攻并占领。
explanation_english: Refers to concentrating efforts to overcome difficulties or challenges. It can also refer to assaulting and capturing a fortified position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要一齊攻堅，先可以完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 gung1 gin1, sin1 ho2 ji5 waan4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要一起攻克难关，才能完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to tackle the difficult problems together in order to complete this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攻堅咗好耐，終於搵到解決方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 gin1 zo2 hou2 noi6, zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou3 gaai2 kyut3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们攻克难关很久，终于找到了解决方案。
examples.english_sentence: They tackled the problem for a long time, and finally found a solution.

english_meaning: balanced offense and defense; good at both offense and defense; having both offensive and defensive capabilities
explanation_mandarin: 既善于进攻，又善于防守。形容能力全面。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is good at both offense and defense, possessing well-rounded abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波攻守兼備，好難對付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 gung1 sau2 gim1 bei6, hou2 naan4 deoi3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球攻守兼备，很难对付。
examples.english_sentence: He's very hard to deal with when playing football because he has a good balance of offense and defense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品設計攻守兼備，功能又多又安全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 sat3 gai3 gung1 sau2 gim1 bei6, gung1 nang4 jau6 do1 jau6 on1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品设计攻守兼备，功能多又安全。
examples.english_sentence: This product design is both offensive and defensive, with numerous functions and high security.

english_meaning: to attack, to assault, to invade
explanation_mandarin: 指用武力进攻、打击。
explanation_english: To attack using military force; to assault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃攻打敵軍嘅城堡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 gung1 daa2 dik6 gwan1 ge3 sing4 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划攻打敌军的城堡。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to attack the enemy's castle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該用暴力去攻打其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ying1 goi1 yung6 bou6 lik6 heoi3 gung1 daa2 kei4 taa1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该用暴力去攻击其他人。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't use violence to attack other people.

english_meaning: To play mahjong
explanation_mandarin: 指玩麻将。 "四方城"指的是麻将牌局，因四人围坐打牌，故称。
explanation_english: Refers to playing mahjong. "四方城" (sei3 fong1 sing4) literally means "four-sided city," referring to the mahjong game because four people sit around the table to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚得閒冇？一齊攻打四方城吖？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 dak1 haan4 mou5? jat1 cai4 gung1 daa2 sei3 fong1 sing4 aa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有空吗？一起打麻将吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tonight? Shall we play mahjong together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都攻打四方城，乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jat1 dou1 gung1 daa2 sei3 fong1 sing4, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在打麻将，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He plays mahjong every day and does nothing else.

english_meaning: to attack; assault; to accuse; to criticize
explanation_mandarin: 采取军事行动打击敌人；指责或批评。
explanation_english: To launch a military attack; to accuse or criticize someone verbally or in writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋攻擊我哋嘅網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 gik1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们攻击了我们的网站。
