examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 kyut3 ding6 fong3 sau2, m4 zoi3 tau4 zi1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最终还是决定放手，不再投资这家公司。
examples.english_sentence: In the end, he decided to let go and no longer invest in this company.

english_meaning: to give it one's all, to go all out, to stake everything on a single throw
explanation_mandarin: 指尽最大的努力去尝试，即使有失败的风险也要全力以赴。
explanation_english: To give it your best shot; to risk everything on a single attempt. It implies taking a chance when the outcome is uncertain, but putting in maximum effort to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 橫掂都冇其他辦法，不如放手一搏啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waang4 dim6 dou1 mou5 kei4 taa1 baan6 faat3, bat1 jyu4 fong3 sau2 jat1 bok3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 反正也没有其他办法，不如放手一搏吧！
examples.english_sentence: Anyway, there are no other options, so let's just give it our best shot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定放手一搏，用曬所有嘅積蓄去創業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 fong3 sau2 jat1 bok3, yung6 saai3 so2 yau5 ge3 zik1 suk1 heoi3 chong3 yip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定放手一搏，用尽所有的积蓄去创业。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to go all out, using all his savings to start a business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道機會唔大，但係我都想放手一搏試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 gei1 wui2 m4 daai6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 dou1 soeng2 fong3 sau2 jat1 bok3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道机会不大，但是我也想放手一搏试一下。
examples.english_sentence: I know the chance isn't great, but I still want to give it my best shot and try.

english_meaning: to lend money, to give out loans (usually at high interest rates)
explanation_mandarin: 指借出金钱，通常伴随较高的利息。多用于非正规的借贷活动。
explanation_english: To lend money, usually with high interest rates. Often refers to informal lending practices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專門放數畀啲賭仔，賺好多錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 mun4 fong3 sou3 bei2 di1 dou2 zai2, zaan6 ho2 do1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门放贷给那些赌徒，赚很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He specializes in lending money to gamblers and makes a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好搵佢哋放數，利息高到嚇死人㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 wan2 keoi5 dei6 fong3 sou3, lei6 sik1 gou1 dou3 haak3 sei2 jan4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要找他们放贷，利息高得吓死人！
examples.english_sentence: Definitely don't go to them for loans, the interest rates are scarily high!

english_meaning: to leak information; to reveal secrets; to drop a bomb (of information)
explanation_mandarin: 指泄露、透露或公开秘密或内部消息。
explanation_english: Refers to leaking, revealing, or disclosing secrets or inside information, often to the media or public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放料畀記者，想搞臭間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 liu2 bei2 gei3 ze2, soeng2 gaau2 cau3 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向记者爆料，想搞臭这家公司。
examples.english_sentence: He leaked information to the reporters, wanting to ruin the company's reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂放料，小心俾人告㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 fong3 liu2, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 gou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱爆料，小心被人告哦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't leak information recklessly, be careful you might get sued!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日會有猛料放，記得留意新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 wui5 jau5 maang5 liu2 fong3, gei3 dak1 lau4 yi3 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天会有劲爆新闻发布，记得留意新闻。
examples.english_sentence: There will be some big news leaked tomorrow, remember to pay attention to the news.

english_meaning: to show (a film); to screen; to project
explanation_mandarin: 播放电影或其他影像。
explanation_english: To show a film or other visual media to an audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日戲院會放映一套新嘅戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hei3 yun2 wui5 fong3 ying2 jat1 tou3 san1 ge3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天电影院会放映一部新电影。
examples.english_sentence: The cinema will be showing a new movie tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校今晚放映紀錄片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 gam1 maan1 fong3 ying2 gei2 luk6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校今晚放映纪录片。
examples.english_sentence: This school will be screening a documentary tonight.

english_meaning: to clear up (weather)
explanation_mandarin: 指天气由阴雨转为晴朗。
explanation_english: To describe the weather changing from cloudy or rainy to sunny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先都落緊大雨，依家就放晴喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 dou1 lok6 ging2 daai6 jyu5, ji1 gaa1 zau6 fong3 cing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才还在下大雨，现在就转晴了。
examples.english_sentence: It was raining heavily just now, and now it's cleared up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望聽日會放晴啦，我想去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 wui5 fong3 cing4 laa1, ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望明天会转晴，我想去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: I hope it will clear up tomorrow, I want to go hiking.

english_meaning: to abandon, to give up, to renounce
explanation_mandarin: 停止做某事，不再坚持。
explanation_english: To give up; to stop trying to do something; to renounce a claim or right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放棄咗佢嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hei3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放弃了他的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: He gave up his dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好咁快放棄啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 fong3 hei3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要这么快放弃啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so quickly!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為太難，佢最後都放棄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 taai3 naan4, keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 fong3 hei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为太难了，他最后还是放弃了。
examples.english_sentence: Because it was too difficult, he eventually gave up.

english_meaning: to announce the list of successful candidates; to release examination results
explanation_mandarin: 指公布考试成绩，通常指公开张贴或以其他方式发布通过考试的名单。
explanation_english: Refers to the announcement of examination results, usually by publicly posting or otherwise releasing the list of successful candidates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就放榜啦，我好緊張啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 fong3 bong2 laa1, ngo5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要发榜了，我很紧张啊。
examples.english_sentence: The results will be announced tomorrow, I'm so nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到入大學，放榜嗰日開心到飛起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou3 jap6 daai6 hok6, fong3 bong2 go2 jat6 hoi1 sam1 dou3 fei1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了大学，放榜那天高兴得飞起来。
examples.english_sentence: He got into university, he was so happy on the day the results were released that he was over the moon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年放榜嘅時間好似遲咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 fong3 bong2 ge3 si4 gaan3 hou2 ci5 ci4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年发榜的时间好像晚了。
examples.english_sentence: It seems like the results are being released later this year.

english_meaning: to delegate power, to decentralize, to give authority
explanation_mandarin: 将权力下放，让下属或较低层级的人员拥有决策权和责任。
explanation_english: To delegate authority or power to subordinates or lower levels in an organization, allowing them to make decisions and take responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細決定放權俾我哋部門自己做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 kyut3 ding6 fong3 kyun4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 bou6 mun4 zi6 gei2 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板决定放权给我们部门自己做决定。
examples.english_sentence: The boss decided to delegate the decision-making power to our department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要成功，就要識得放權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 sing4 gung1, zau6 jiu3 sik1 dak1 fong3 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要成功，就要懂得放权。
examples.english_sentence: For a company to succeed, it needs to know how to delegate authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯放權，乜嘢都要自己管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 fong3 kyun4, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 zi6 gei2 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯放权，什么都要自己管。
examples.english_sentence: He is unwilling to delegate and wants to control everything himself.

mandarin_meaning: 放水; 故意放松要求; 泄露信息
english_meaning: To ease up; to relax requirements; to deliberately let someone win or succeed; to leak information; to go easy on someone
explanation_mandarin: 在某种情况下，故意降低标准、放松要求或让对方占便宜。也指泄露信息。
explanation_english: To deliberately lower standards, relax requirements, or allow someone to gain an advantage in a certain situation. It can also refer to leaking information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考車個陣，阿sir好似有啲放水咁喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 ce1 go3 zan6, aa3 sir1 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 fong3 seoi2 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试开车的时候，老师好像有点放水。
examples.english_sentence: During the driving test, the instructor seemed to be going easy on me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好放水俾佢贏呀，要盡力比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fong3 seoi2 bei2 keoi5 wing4 aa3, jiu3 zeon6 lik6 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要放水让他赢，要尽力比赛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him win by going easy on him; give it your best in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該唔好放水，老老實實咁講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 m4 hou2 fong3 seoi2, lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6 gam2 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请不要放松要求，请老老实实地讲吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't sugarcoat it, just be honest and tell me straight.

english_meaning: to go abroad (usually for studies or work); to go overseas
explanation_mandarin: 指到国外去，多指出国留学或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to going abroad, often for studying or working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仔女大個咗之後，都想放洋讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zai2 neoi5 daai6 go3 zo2 zi1 hau6, dou1 soeng2 fong3 joeng4 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的孩子们长大后，都想出国留学。
examples.english_sentence: After his children grew up, they all wanted to study abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多香港嘅後生仔都鍾意放洋去外國體驗生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 Hoeng1 Gong2 ge3 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 fong3 joeng4 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 tai2 jim6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多香港的年轻人喜欢到国外去体验生活。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many young people in Hong Kong like to go abroad to experience life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣放洋去英國做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 fong3 joeng4 heoi3 jing1 gwok3 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候出国去英国工作。
examples.english_sentence: He went abroad to the UK to work when he was young.

english_meaning: to set fire to, to commit arson
explanation_mandarin: 点燃物品，制造火灾。
explanation_english: To ignite something, causing a fire; to commit arson.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑係因為佢失業所以放火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 sat1 jip6 so2 ji5 fong3 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被怀疑是因为失业而放火。
examples.english_sentence: He is suspected of committing arson because he lost his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以喺森林放火㗎，好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 sam1 lam4 fong3 fo2 gaa3, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能在森林里放火，很危险的！
examples.english_sentence: You can't set fire in the forest, it's very dangerous!

mandarin_meaning: 作弊; 偷懒; 混日子
english_meaning: to cheat (in exams); to slack off; to coast through (life/work)
explanation_mandarin: 在学业或工作中不努力，敷衍了事，混日子。 也指考试作弊。
explanation_english: To not work hard in studies or work, to be perfunctory, and to coast through life. It can also refer to cheating in exams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好放牛啊，考試就嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fong3 ngau4 aa3, haau2 si5 zau6 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要偷懒啊，考试就要来了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't slack off, the exam is coming soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放牛，所以成績好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fong3 ngau4, so2 ji5 sing4 jik1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天偷懒，所以成绩很差。
examples.english_sentence: He slacks off all the time, so his grades are very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為放牛就冇人知，紙包唔住火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 fong3 ngau4 zau6 mou5 jan4 zi1, zi2 baau1 m4 zyu6 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为偷懒就没人知道，纸包不住火。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that no one will know if you slack off, the truth will come out eventually.

english_meaning: to graze (livestock), to pasture
explanation_mandarin: 指放养牲畜，让其在野外吃草。
explanation_english: To graze livestock; to allow animals to feed in a pasture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺喺山上面放牧啲牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6 fong3 muk6 di1 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷在山上放牧牛。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa is grazing the cattle on the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋靠放牧羊嚟維持生計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kaau3 fong3 muk6 joeng4 lai4 wai4 ci4 sang1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们靠放牧羊来维持生计。
examples.english_sentence: They rely on grazing sheep for their livelihood.

mandarin_meaning: 放出狗；比喻放出爪牙，去咬人
english_meaning: To unleash a dog; metaphorically, to unleash one's henchmen or hirelings to attack or harass someone.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是放出狗。在口语中，常用来比喻指使手下或受雇的人去攻击、骚扰或威胁他人。
explanation_english: Literally means to release a dog. In colloquial use, it is often used metaphorically to refer to instructing subordinates or hired individuals to attack, harass, or threaten others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都放狗咬人，冇人敢惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fong3 gau2 ngaau5 jan4, mou5 jan4 gam2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是指使手下攻击别人，没人敢惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He always unleashes his henchmen to attack others; no one dares to offend him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲黑社會成日放狗收數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hak1 se6 wui2 seng4 jat6 fong3 gau2 sau1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些黑社会经常派人去收债。
examples.english_sentence: The triads often send their men to collect debts.

english_meaning: to release a captured animal (back to its natural environment, especially as a Buddhist act of compassion); to set free
explanation_mandarin: 把捕获的动物放回自然环境，通常是佛教徒出于慈悲心的行为。
explanation_english: To release a captured animal back into its natural habitat. This is often done as an act of compassion, especially by Buddhists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去海邊放生啲魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 fong3 saang1 di1 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常去海边放生一些鱼。
examples.english_sentence: They often go to the beach to release some fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放生係一種積功德嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 saang1 hai6 jat1 zung2 zik1 gung1 dak1 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放生是一种积累功德的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Releasing animals is a deed that accumulates merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁放生外來物種，會破壞生態平衡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 fong3 saang1 ngoi6 loi4 mat6 zung2, wui5 po3 waai6 sang1 taai3 ping4 hang4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随意放生外来物种，会破坏生态平衡的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly release foreign species; it will disrupt the ecological balance.

english_meaning: to flirt, to give off flirting vibes
explanation_mandarin: 指用眼神、言语或动作等来吸引对方，表达好感或进行调情。
explanation_english: Refers to using eye contact, words, or actions to attract someone, express affection, or flirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住啲男仔放生電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 di1 naam4 zai2 fong3 sang1 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是对着男生放电。
examples.english_sentence: She's always flirting with boys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂咁放生電，小心人哋誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 fong3 sang1 din6, siu2 sam1 yan4 dei6 ng6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要乱放电，小心别人误会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just flirt randomly, be careful people misunderstand.

english_meaning: to stand someone up, to not show up for an appointment without informing the other party
explanation_mandarin: 指约定好的事情，一方没有出现，也没有提前通知对方，使对方空等。
explanation_english: To stand someone up; to not show up for a prearranged appointment without prior notice, leaving the other person waiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日約咗佢睇戲，點知佢放我白鴿，嬲死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 joek3 zo2 keoi5 tai2 hei3, dim2 zi1 keoi5 fong3 ngo5 baak6 gap3, nau1 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天约了他看电影，结果他放我鸽子，气死我了。
examples.english_sentence: I arranged to watch a movie with him yesterday, but he stood me up. I'm furious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都放人白鴿，真係好冇信用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fong3 jan4 baak6 gap3, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 seon3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是放别人鸽子，真的很没信用。
examples.english_sentence: He always stands people up; he's really unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放我白鴿呀，我會喺嗰度等㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 ngo5 baak6 gap3 aa3, ngo5 wui5 hai2 go2 dou6 dang2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要放我鸽子啊，我会在那里等的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand me up, I'll be waiting there.

english_meaning: to be released from prison
explanation_mandarin: 指从监狱释放出来，恢复自由。
explanation_english: Refers to being released from prison, regaining freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐咗十年監，聽日就放監喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 zo2 sap6 nin4 gaam1, ting1 jat6 zau6 fong3 gaam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐了十年牢，明天就要出狱了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in prison for ten years and will be released tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話呢件事好似放監咁開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 ci5 fong3 gaam1 gam2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这件事就像出狱一样开心。
examples.english_sentence: He said this matter is as happy as being released from prison.

english_meaning: to put (a property) on the market for sale
explanation_mandarin: 指将房产放到市场上出售。通常指通过房地产中介或自行发布信息，让有意购买的人知道并进行交易。
explanation_english: To put a property on the market for sale. Typically involves listing it with a real estate agent or advertising it privately so that potential buyers are aware and can make offers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打算將間屋放盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 syun3 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 fong3 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打算把房子放盘出售。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to put their house on the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近樓市唔好，放盤都未必賣得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 lau4 si5 m4 hou2, fong3 pun4 dou1 mei6 bit1 maai6 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近房市不好，放盘了也未必卖得出去。
examples.english_sentence: The property market isn't good recently; even if you put it on the market, you might not be able to sell it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋諗緊應該自己放盤定係搵地產經紀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nam2 gan2 jing1 goi1 zi6 gei2 fong3 pun4 ding6 hai6 wan2 dei6 caan2 ging1 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在考虑应该自己放盘还是找房地产经纪。
examples.english_sentence: We are considering whether we should put the property on the market ourselves or find a real estate agent.

mandarin_meaning: 放下相机; 收起相机
english_meaning: To put down the camera; To stop taking photos
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是放下相机。引申意义是不再拍照，停止拍照的行为。
explanation_english: Literally means to put down the camera. By extension, it means to stop taking photos, to cease the act of taking pictures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋影咗好多相喇，不如放相機食啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying2 zo2 hou2 do1 soeng3, bat1 jyu4 fong3 soeng3 gei1 sik6 di1 ye5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们拍了很多照片了，不如放下相机吃点东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've taken a lot of photos already, why don't we put down the camera and have something to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係掛住影相啦，放相機欣賞下啲風景啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gwaa3 zyu6 ying2 soeng3 laa1, fong3 soeng3 gei1 yan1 soeng2 haa5 di1 fung1 ging2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只顾着拍照，放下相机欣赏一下风景吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just focus on taking photos, put down the camera and appreciate the scenery.

english_meaning: to rent out (property)
explanation_mandarin: 将房产或其他物业出租给他人。
explanation_english: To rent out property (e.g., an apartment, house, or shop) to another party for a fee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間屋放租咗出去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 fong3 zou1 zo2 chut1 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的房子已经出租出去了。
examples.english_sentence: We've rented out our house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲樓咁貴，好多人都會買樓放租。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 lau2 gam3 gwai3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 maai5 lau2 fong3 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在房价这么贵，很多人都会买房出租。
examples.english_sentence: Now that apartments are so expensive, many people will buy apartments to rent out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將間鋪頭放租，自己就退休去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jeung1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 fong3 zou1, zi6 gei2 jau6 teoi3 jau1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把店铺出租，自己就退休去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: He rented out his shop and retired to travel.

english_meaning: to empty one's mind, to space out, to blank out, to zone out
explanation_mandarin: 指头脑一片空白，什么也不想，或者故意不去思考。
explanation_english: To empty one's mind, to consciously try to not think about anything, to space out or zone out. It can also refer to forgetting something completely, like having a mental blank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意行山嘅時候放空下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6 fong3 hung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢爬山的时候放空一下。
examples.english_sentence: I like to space out a bit when I'm hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣我一時放空咗，咩都諗唔起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 go2 zan6 ngo5 jat1 si4 fong3 hung1 zo2, me1 dou1 nam2 m4 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候我一时放空了，什么都想不起来。
examples.english_sentence: I had a complete blank during the exam; I couldn't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日放空啦，做嘢專心啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 fong3 hung1 laa1, zou6 je5 zyun1 sam1 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要整天放空了，工作专心点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't zone out all the time; focus on your work!

english_meaning: to fly a kite
explanation_mandarin: 指放飞用纸或其它轻型材料制作，借空气动力升空的玩具。
explanation_english: To fly a kite, a toy made of paper or other light material that is flown in the air using the wind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣咁好，我哋去公園放紙鷂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 fong3 zi2 jiu2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气这么好，我们去公园放风筝吧。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so nice today, let's go fly a kite in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我成日同阿爸阿媽一齊去沙灘放紙鷂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 aa3 baa1 aa3 maa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 saa1 taan1 fong3 zi2 jiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我常常和爸爸妈妈一起去沙滩放风筝。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often went to the beach with my parents to fly kites.

english_meaning: to slow down; to decelerate; to ease up
explanation_mandarin: 速度或节奏变慢。
explanation_english: To decrease in speed or pace; to decelerate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟增長放緩咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 zang1 zoeng2 fong3 wun6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济增长放缓了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Economic growth has slowed down a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你行慢啲啦，放緩腳步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 maan6 di1 laa1, fong3 wun6 goek3 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你走慢点吧，放慢脚步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Walk slower, slow down your pace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅速度放緩咗好多，等我可以聽得清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 suk1 dou6 fong3 wun6 zo2 hou2 do1, dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 teng1 dak1 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的速度放慢了很多，我可以听得清楚些。
examples.english_sentence: He slowed down his speaking speed a lot so that I could hear more clearly.

english_meaning: to indulge, to pamper, to spoil; to be permissive, to let oneself go
explanation_mandarin: 指纵容、放任，不加约束。
explanation_english: To indulge, pamper, or spoil someone or something. It can also mean to be permissive or to let oneself go, often in a negative way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁放縱個仔，佢會變壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fong3 zung3 go3 zai2, keoi5 wui5 bin3 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么放纵你的儿子，他会变坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spoil your son so much, he will become bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放縱自己食咗好多甜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 zung3 zi6 gei2 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 tim4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放纵自己吃了好多甜的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He indulged himself and ate a lot of sweets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以放縱罪犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 zung3 zeoi6 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不可以放纵罪犯。
examples.english_sentence: Criminals cannot be indulged.

english_meaning: to place, to put, to lay, to set
explanation_mandarin: 将物品放在某个地方。
explanation_english: To put something in a particular place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好隨便放置啲嘢喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 fong3 zi3 di1 je5 hai2 dei6 haa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要随便把东西放在地上。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just put things on the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲行李放置喺邊度好呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hang4 lei5 fong3 zi3 hai2 bin1 dou6 hou2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行李放在哪里好呢？
examples.english_sentence: Where is a good place to put the luggage?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將呢份文件放置喺你嘅桌面上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 ni1 fan6 man4 gin2 fong3 zi3 hai2 nei5 ge3 zoek3 min6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把这份文件放在你的桌面上。
examples.english_sentence: Put this document on your desktop.

mandarin_meaning: 放置不管，放任不管，置之不理
english_meaning: To neglect, to leave something unattended, to abandon;  (Hong Kong slang) to intentionally ignore someone to provoke them or make them react.
explanation_mandarin: 源自英文 'play'，意指一种心态或行为。在粤语中，'放置play' 指的是故意不理会某人或某事，使之产生反应或达到某种目的。也指放任不管，置之不理。
explanation_english: Derived from the English word 'play', referring to a mindset or behavior. In Cantonese, '放置play' refers to intentionally ignoring someone or something in order to provoke a reaction or achieve a specific goal. It can also mean to neglect or abandon something entirely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放置play我，真係好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fong3 zi3 phei1 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是故意不理我，真的很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He always intentionally ignores me, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放置play啲功課呀，唔係會肥佬㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 zi3 phei1 di1 gung1 fo3 aa3, m4 hai6 wui5 fei4 lou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要放任不管你的作业啊，不然会不及格的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't neglect your homework, or you'll fail.

mandarin_meaning: 透露风声; 泄露消息
english_meaning: to leak information; to let slip a secret; to give a hint
explanation_mandarin: 指故意或不小心地透露消息、内幕、机密等信息。
explanation_english: To intentionally or unintentionally reveal information, insider stories, or secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放聲氣話公司就嚟裁員喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 seng1 hei3 waa6 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 caai4 jyun4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他透露消息说公司快要裁员了。
examples.english_sentence: He let slip that the company is going to lay off staff soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好周圍放聲氣呀，呢件事仲係機密嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 fong3 seng1 hei3 aa3, ni1 gin6 si6 zung6 hai6 gei1 mat6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要到处泄露消息，这件事还是机密的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leak the information everywhere, this matter is still confidential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係放咗少少聲氣啫，唔諗到佢反應咁大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 fong3 zo2 siu2 siu2 seng1 hei3 ze1, m4 nam2 dou3 keoi5 faan2 jing3 gam3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是透露了一点点消息而已，没想到他反应这么大。
examples.english_sentence: I only let out a small hint, I didn't expect him to react so strongly.

english_meaning: unrestrained, presumptuous, impudent, audacious, to act wildly
explanation_mandarin: 行为不加约束，不受礼法限制；也指过于随便，不尊重人。
explanation_english: Describing behavior that is unrestrained and not bound by rules or etiquette; also refers to being too casual or disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁放肆呀，呢度唔係你屋企！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 fong3 si3 aa3, ni1 dou6 m4 hai6 nei5 uk1 kei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么放肆，这里不是你家！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unrestrained, this isn't your home!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒之後就開始放肆噉跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zau2 zi1 hau6 zau6 hoi1 chi2 fong3 si3 gam2 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒之后就开始放肆地跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: After he got drunk, he started dancing wildly.

english_meaning: to be bold; to be daring; to take courage; to feel free to (do something)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有胆量，敢于去做某事，不畏惧。
explanation_english: To be bold or daring; to not be afraid to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放膽試吓啦，唔使驚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 daam2 si3 haa5 laa1, m4 sai2 geng1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你大胆尝试一下吧，不用害怕的。
examples.english_sentence: Be bold and try it, you don't need to be afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放膽講你嘅諗法出嚟啦，唔好怕醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 daam2 gong2 nei5 ge3 lam2 faat3 chut1 lai4 laa1, m4 hou2 paa3 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大胆地说出你的想法吧，不要害羞。
examples.english_sentence: Feel free to speak out your thoughts, don't be shy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鼓勵我放膽去追自己嘅夢想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu2 lai6 ngo5 fong3 daam2 heoi3 zeoi1 zi6 gei2 ge3 mung6 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他鼓励我大胆地去追求自己的梦想。
examples.english_sentence: He encouraged me to boldly pursue my dreams.

english_meaning: to put down; to place down
explanation_mandarin: 把东西从高处或手中放到较低的位置或地面上。
explanation_english: To put something down from a higher position or from one's hand to a lower position or the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手好攰，放落嚟抖吓先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 hou2 gui6, fong3 lok6 lai4 dau2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手很累，放下来休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: My hand is very tired, let me put it down and rest for a while.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，放落地下嗰陣唔好整爛呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, fong3 lok6 dei6 haa2 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 zing2 laan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心一点，放到地上的时候不要弄坏了。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't break it when you put it down on the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輕輕噉將個BB放落張床度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hing1 hing1 gam2 zoeng1 go3 BB fong3 lok6 zoeng1 cong4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他轻轻地将婴儿放到床上。
examples.english_sentence: He gently put the baby down on the bed.

english_meaning: To keep someone guessing; to string someone along; to tease; to hold back information deliberately; to play coy
explanation_mandarin: 指故意隐瞒信息，让人猜不透，捉摸不定，通常带有一些调侃或戏弄的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately withholding information to keep someone guessing or uncertain, often with a playful or teasing intention. It implies holding back information strategically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好再放葫蘆啦，快啲話俾我知發生咩事啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 fong3 wu4 lou4 laa1, faai3 di1 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你别再卖关子了，快点告诉我发生什么事了！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, stop stringing me along, just tell me what happened!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放葫蘆，唔肯直接講答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fong3 wu4 lou4, m4 hang2 zik6 zip3 gong2 daap3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是卖关子，不愿意直接说答案。
examples.english_sentence: He's always keeping people guessing, unwilling to give a straight answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好放葫蘆，我真係好想知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fong3 wu4 lou4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng2 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别卖关子了，我真的很想知道！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play coy, I really want to know!

english_meaning: dissolute, licentious, debauched, wild, unrestrained
explanation_mandarin: 形容行为不检点，生活随便。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is immoral, dissolute, unrestrained, or leading a loose life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好放蕩，成日飲酒溝女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 fong3 dong6, seng4 jat6 jam2 zau2 gau1 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很放荡，整天喝酒泡妞。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very dissolute person, always drinking and chasing girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁放蕩啦，對自己好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fong3 dong6 laa1, deoi3 zi6 gei2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么放荡了，对自己好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unrestrained, be good to yourself.

english_meaning: to release a tiger back to the mountain (idiom); to let the tiger return to the mountain; to let the enemy escape to a safe haven; to let the grass grow back and risk trouble in the future
explanation_mandarin: 比喻放走敌人，留下后患。
explanation_english: This idiom means to release an enemy, leaving behind future troubles and potential dangers. It refers to letting a dangerous person or situation go unchecked, allowing it to potentially cause problems later on. It is analogous to releasing a tiger back into its natural habitat where it can freely roam and pose a threat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔將佢繩之於法，咁咪即係放虎歸山囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 zoeng1 keoi5 sing4 zi1 jyu1 faat3, gam2 mai1 zik1 hai6 fong3 fu2 gwai1 saan1 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不把他绳之以法，那不就是放虎归山吗？
examples.english_sentence: If we don't bring him to justice, isn't that just letting the tiger return to the mountain?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個騙徒呃咗咁多人嘅錢，如果你哋放咗佢，咪即係放虎歸山呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 pin3 tou4 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 jan4 ge3 cin2, jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dei6 fong3 zo2 keoi5, mai1 zik1 hai6 fong3 fu2 gwai1 saan1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个骗子骗了这么多人的钱，如果你们放了他，不就是放虎归山吗？
examples.english_sentence: That swindler cheated so many people out of their money, if you let him go, wouldn't that be letting the tiger return to the mountain?

synonyms: 養虎遺患 (joeng5 fu2 wai4 waan6)

mandarin_meaning: 释放蚊子；比喻故意让人难堪或受到损失
english_meaning: To release mosquitoes; (figuratively) to set someone up to fail, to throw someone under the bus, to deliberately cause trouble for someone.
explanation_mandarin: 本意是释放蚊子。引申义是比喻设计陷害他人，使他人陷入困境或者承受损失。多指有意为之。
explanation_english: Literally means to release mosquitoes. Figuratively, it means to set someone up to fail, betray someone, or deliberately cause trouble for someone, often with malicious intent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺明放蚊，專登俾啲錯嘅資料我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ming4 fong3 man1, zyun1 dang3 bei2 di1 co3 ge3 zi1 liu2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明显是故意陷害我，专门给我一些错误的信息。
examples.english_sentence: He's clearly setting me up, deliberately giving me wrong information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放蚊啦，大家同事嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 man1 laa1, daai6 gaa1 tung4 si6 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要陷害别人了，大家都是同事嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw someone under the bus, we're all colleagues.

synonyms: 插贓嫁禍 (caap3 zong1 gaa3 wo6)

english_meaning: undercover operation; to go undercover
explanation_mandarin: 指警方派遣便衣警察乔装成普通市民，秘密收集犯罪证据的行为。通常是为了打击一些难以直接取证的犯罪活动，如毒品交易、卖淫等。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of police officers dispatching plainclothes officers disguised as ordinary citizens to secretly collect evidence of crimes. This is usually done to combat criminal activities that are difficult to obtain direct evidence for, such as drug trafficking and prostitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方派咗啲人放蛇，捉啲賣翻版嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 paai3 zo2 di1 jan4 fong3 se4, zuk1 di1 maai6 faan1 baan2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方派了一些人去卧底，抓那些卖盗版的人。
examples.english_sentence: The police sent some people undercover to catch those selling pirated goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢喺酒吧放蛇，查緊有無人賣毒品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai2 jau5 baa1 fong3 se4, caa4 gan2 jau5 mou5 jan4 maai6 duk6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他在酒吧卧底，调查有没有人卖毒品。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he's going undercover in the bar, investigating if anyone is selling drugs.

english_meaning: to flake, to stand someone up, to ditch someone
explanation_mandarin: 指约好之后，却没有出现，失约。
explanation_english: To break a promise or appointment; to stand someone up; to not show up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日放我蟹，冇嚟到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 fong3 ngo5 haai5, mou5 lai4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天放我鸽子，没有来。
examples.english_sentence: He flaked on me yesterday, he didn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放我蟹呀，我好期待㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 ngo5 haai5 aa3, ngo5 hou2 kei5 doi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要放我鸽子啊，我很期待的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flake on me, I'm really looking forward to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日放人蟹，咁樣唔得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 fong3 jan4 haai5, gam2 joeng2 m4 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是放别人鸽子，这样是不行的。
examples.english_sentence: You always stand people up, that's not right.

mandarin_meaning: 割肉放血 (gē ròu fàng xuè) / 倾囊而出 (qīng náng ér chū) / 大出血 (dà chū xiě)
english_meaning: Bleeding; bloodletting; to bleed (metaphorically, of financial loss); to be fleeced; to lose a lot of money.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 (dòng cí) / 名词 (míng cí)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指实际上的放血，现在多用来形容经济上的重大损失，像被割肉一样。比喻付出巨大的代价或者花费大量的金钱。也可能指股市或商业上的严重亏损。
explanation_english: Literally refers to bloodletting. Metaphorically, it describes a significant financial loss, as if being cut. It implies paying a huge price or spending a large amount of money. It can also refer to serious losses in the stock market or business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投資真係放血，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 zan1 hai6 fong3 hyut3, sit8 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资真是大出血，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: This investment was really bleeding me dry, I lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗層樓，我哋要放血好多年先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 cang4 lau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fong3 hyut3 hou2 do1 nin4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了这套房子，我们要勒紧裤腰带很多年才行。
examples.english_sentence: To afford this apartment, we have to bleed for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾間黑店放血，買咗啲又貴又唔好嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 gaan1 hak1 dim3 fong3 hyut3, maai5 zo2啲 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被黑店宰了一刀，买了些又贵又不好的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He was fleeced by a shady shop and bought expensive and bad-quality things.

english_meaning: to allow to pass; to release; to clear (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 允许通过；释放；放行
explanation_english: To allow someone to pass through, release someone, or clear them to proceed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關放行咗佢啲行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 fong3 haang4 zo2 keoi5 di1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关放行了他的行李。
examples.english_sentence: Customs released his luggage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人放行咗示威者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan4 fong3 haang4 zo2 si6 wai1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察放行了示威者。
examples.english_sentence: The police let the protesters pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆終於放行我嘅辭職申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zung1 jyu1 fong3 haang4 ngo5 ge3 ci4 zik1 san1 cheng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板终于批准了我的辞职申请。
examples.english_sentence: The boss finally approved my resignation application.

jyutping: fong3 zyu1 sei3 hoi2 gaai1 zeon2
english_meaning: Universally applicable; true everywhere
explanation_mandarin: 形容某种道理或原则具有普遍性，适用于任何地方和任何情况。
explanation_english: Describes a principle or truth that is universally applicable, working in all places and situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 誠實嘅原則，放諸四海皆準㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 sat6 ge3 jyun2 zak1, fong3 zyu1 sei3 hoi2 gaai1 zeon2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 诚实的原则是四海皆准的。
examples.english_sentence: The principle of honesty is universally applicable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尊重他人呢個道理，放諸四海皆準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyun1 cung4 taa1 jan4 ne1 go3 dou6 lei5, fong3 zyu1 sei3 hoi2 gaai1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尊重他人的道理是四海皆准的。
examples.english_sentence: The principle of respecting others is universally applicable.

english_meaning: To vent negativity; to release negative energy; to express negative feelings
explanation_mandarin: 指倾诉或发泄负面情绪，例如抱怨、不满、悲伤等。是一种社交行为，常见于网络用语。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of expressing or venting negative emotions, such as complaining, dissatisfaction, sadness, etc. It is a social behavior commonly used in online language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日喺社交媒體放負啦，人都會覺得你好煩嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 giao1 mui4 tai2 fong3 fu6 laa1, jan4 dou1 wui5 gok3 dak1 nei5 hou2 faan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是在社交媒体上释放负能量，人们会觉得你很烦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always vent negativity on social media, people will find you annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日放負，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 fong3 fu6, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近总是释放负能量，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He's been venting negativity a lot lately, I wonder what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放負唔係解決問題嘅方法，不如諗下點樣積極面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 fu6 m4 hai6 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 ge3 fong1 faat3, bat1 jyu4 nam2 haa5 dim2 joeng6 zik1 gik1 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 释放负能量不是解决问题的方法，不如想想怎么样积极面对。
examples.english_sentence: Venting negativity isn't a way to solve problems, why not think about how to face them positively.

english_meaning: to lend money at exorbitant interest rates; to be a loan shark
explanation_mandarin: 指以极高的利率借钱给他人，从中牟取暴利。是一种非法的金融行为。
explanation_english: Refers to lending money to others at extremely high interest rates, making huge profits from it. It is an illegal financial activity; to be a loan shark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放貴利，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 fong3 gwai3 lei6, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是放高利贷，迟早会出事。
examples.english_sentence: He's always lending money at exorbitant interest rates; sooner or later, he'll get into trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好問佢借錢，佢係放貴利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 man6 keoi5 ze3 cin2, keoi5 hai6 fong3 gwai3 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要问他借钱，他是放高利贷的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't borrow money from him, he's a loan shark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放貴利係犯法嘅，唔好以身試法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gwai3 lei6 hai6 faan6 faat3 ge3, m4 hou2 ji5 san1 si3 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放高利贷是犯法的，不要以身试法。
examples.english_sentence: Lending money at exorbitant interest rates is illegal; don't try to test the law.

english_meaning: to let go; to release; to let escape
explanation_mandarin: 让…逃走；释放。
explanation_english: To allow someone or something to escape; to release something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬放走咗個賊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caai1 lou2 fong3 zau2 zo2 go3 caak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察把贼放走了。
examples.english_sentence: The police let the thief escape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該放走任何機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 fong3 zau2 jam6 ho4 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该放走任何机会。
examples.english_sentence: We shouldn't let any opportunities pass us by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細放走咗佢，因為佢認錯咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 fong3 zau2 zo2 keoi5, jan1 wai6 keoi5 jing6 co3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板放走了他，因为他认错了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss let him go because he admitted his mistake.

mandarin_meaning: 放松警惕；卸下防备；软弱无力
english_meaning: to relax one's guard; to let one's defenses down; to become weak and powerless (literally, 'to soften hands and feet')
explanation_mandarin: 指放下戒心，不再保持警惕；也指因恐惧等原因导致手脚无力，失去反抗能力。
explanation_english: Refers to lowering one's guard and ceasing to be vigilant; can also refer to feeling weak and powerless due to fear, etc., losing the ability to resist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講咗幾句好聽嘅說話，你就放軟手腳，信晒佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 zo2 gei2 geoi3 hou2 teng1 ge3 syut3 waa6, nei5 zau6 fong3 jyun5 sau2 goek3, seon3 saai3 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说了几句好听的话，你就放松警惕，完全相信他了？
examples.english_sentence: He just said a few nice things, and you let your guard down and believed everything he said?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嚇到我放軟手腳，郁都郁唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 dou3 ngo5 fong3 jyun5 sau2 goek3, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吓得我手脚发软，动都动不了。
examples.english_sentence: I was so scared that my legs turned to jelly and I couldn't even move.

english_meaning: banish; exile; expulsion
explanation_mandarin: 将某人驱逐出境或逐出其居住地。
explanation_english: To send someone away from a country or place as an official punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為犯咗法，俾人放逐咗出國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 faan6 zo2 faat3, bei2 jan4 fong3 zuk6 zo2 ceot1 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为犯了法，被人放逐出国了。
examples.english_sentence: He was banished from the country because he broke the law.

english_meaning: to let off, to forgive, to spare, to let go
explanation_mandarin: 饶恕、不追究、不惩罚。也指错过机会。
explanation_english: To let someone off, to forgive, to spare someone punishment, or to miss an opportunity. Can also mean to let something go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，今次放過你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, gam1 ci3 fong3 gwo3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，这次放过你。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, I'll let you off this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放過呢個機會呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 gwo3 ni1 go3 gei1 wui2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要错过这个机会啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't miss this opportunity!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢求情，法官決定放過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kau4 cing4, faat3 gun1 kyut3 ding6 fong3 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他求情，法官决定放过他。
examples.english_sentence: He pleaded for mercy, and the judge decided to let him off.

jyutping: fong3 coeng4 sin3 diu3 daai6 jyu2
english_meaning: To use a long line to catch a big fish; to invest effort for a long-term gain; to bide one's time
explanation_mandarin: 比喻用长远的计划或手段来获取更大的利益。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to using a long-term strategy or investing effort over time to achieve a greater reward later. It implies patience and strategic planning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家對你咁好，都係放長線釣大魚啫，你想清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 deoi3 nei5 gam3 hou2, dou1 hai6 fong3 coeng4 sin3 diu3 daai6 jyu2 ze1, nei5 soeng2 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在对你这么好，都是放长线钓大鱼而已，你想清楚点。
examples.english_sentence: He's being so nice to you now, it's just a long-term investment to get a bigger reward later, think carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀咁多資源你，都係放長線釣大魚，希望你可以幫公司賺更多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 gam3 do1 zi1 jyun4 nei5, dou1 hai6 fong3 coeng4 sin3 diu3 daai6 jyu2, hei1 mong6 nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 gung1 si1 zaan6 gang3 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给你这么多资源，都是放长线钓大鱼，希望你可以帮公司赚更多钱。
examples.english_sentence: The company is giving you so many resources, it's a long-term investment, hoping you can help the company earn more money.

english_meaning: wait and see; keep a close watch
explanation_mandarin: 比喻密切注意事态发展，等待最终结果。
explanation_english: To wait and see; to keep a close watch on developments, expecting a certain outcome (often negative). It implies that one will be observing carefully to see what happens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢一定會成功，我哋放長雙眼睇佢點樣收科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1, ngo5 dei6 fong3 coeng4 soeng1 ngaan5 tai2 keoi5 dim2 joeng6 sau1 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他一定会成功，我们拭目以待看他怎么收场。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would definitely succeed, we'll wait and see how he cleans up the mess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話呢個計劃會成功，我放長雙眼睇吓佢會唔會失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wui5 sing4 gung1, ngo5 fong3 coeng4 soeng1 ngaan5 tai2 haa5 keoi5 wui5 m4 wui5 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说这个计划会成功，我拭目以待看看它是否会失败。
examples.english_sentence: You said this plan will succeed, I'll wait and see if it fails.

english_meaning: Public display of affection (PDA), to show off affection
explanation_mandarin: 形容情侣之间公开展示亲密行为，使其他人感到刺眼。
explanation_english: Describes couples publicly displaying affection (PDA), often to an extent that makes others feel uncomfortable or envious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺 Facebook 放閃，真係好閃呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 Facebook fong3 sim2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sim2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是整天在 Facebook 上秀恩爱，真让人受不了!
examples.english_sentence: They are always showing off their affection on Facebook, it's so annoying!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔使放閃啦，知你哋好恩愛㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 sai2 fong3 sim2 laa1, zi1 nei5 dei6 hou2 yan1 oi3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们不用秀恩爱了，知道你们很恩爱啦。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to show off your affection, we know you love each other.

mandarin_meaning: 放开; 释放; 开放
english_meaning: to release; to let go; to loosen; to free; to open up; to be open-minded
explanation_mandarin: （1）放掉，松开。（2）释放，解除束缚。（3）开放，不拘束。（4）指想开，不放在心上。
explanation_english: (1) To release, to let go, to loosen one's grip. (2) To set free, to release from constraint. (3) To be open, not restrained. (4) To let go of something mentally; to not dwell on something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放開我啦，我好唔舒服啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 hoi1 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放开我吧，我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: Let go of me, I'm very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放開咗之前嘅唔開心，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 hoi1 zo2 zi1 cin4 ge3 m4 hoi1 sam1, cung4 san1 hoi1 chi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放开了之前的不开心，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: He let go of the unhappiness from before and started over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要放開啲，唔好咁執着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 fong3 hoi1 di1, m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要开朗一点，不要这么执着。
examples.english_sentence: One should be more open-minded in life, don't be so fixated.

english_meaning: To flirt, to turn on the charm, to exude charisma (often sexually), to radiate energy
explanation_mandarin: 指人散发出魅力，引人注意，通常带有性吸引力的意味；也指释放精力，消耗体力。
explanation_english: Refers to someone exuding charm or charisma, attracting attention, often with sexual undertones; can also refer to releasing energy or expending physical effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對住男仔放電，好鬼姣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 naam4 zai2 fong3 din6, hou2 gwai2 haau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是对着男孩子放电，很骚。
examples.english_sentence: She's always flirting with boys, she's such a tease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 踢完波之後，成個人好似放晒電咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tek3 jyun4 bo1 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 fong3 saai3 din6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 踢完球之后，整个人好像放完电一样。
examples.english_sentence: After playing football, I feel like I've completely run out of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚喺party度猛咁放電，唔知釣到仔未呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 ngaan1 hai2 party dou6 maang5 gam2 fong3 din6, m4 zi1 diu3 dou2 zai2 mei6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她昨晚在派对上猛放电，不知道钓到男人没有？
examples.english_sentence: She was really flirting a lot at the party last night, I wonder if she managed to pick up a guy?

english_meaning: All-you-can-eat (AYCE)
explanation_mandarin: 一种餐饮方式，顾客支付固定费用后，可以在规定时间内无限量地享用提供的食物。
explanation_english: A dining style where customers pay a fixed price and can eat unlimited amounts of food within a specified time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食放題，你想唔想去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 fong3 tai4, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃自助餐，你想去吗？
examples.english_sentence: We're going for all-you-can-eat tonight, do you want to come?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間日式餐廳嘅放題好出名㗎，啲刺身好新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jat6 sik1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fong3 tai4 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3, di1 ci3 san1 hou2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家日式餐厅的自助餐很有名，刺身很新鲜。
examples.english_sentence: This Japanese restaurant's all-you-can-eat is very famous, the sashimi is very fresh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食放題最緊要係唔好浪費食物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 fong3 tai4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 m4 hou2 long6 fai3 sik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃自助餐最重要的是不要浪费食物。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing when eating at an all-you-can-eat is not to waste food.

mandarin_meaning: 通风报信; 放松; 遛弯
english_meaning: To inform secretly; to tip off; to loosen up; to take a walk; to let someone out to stretch their legs (from confinement).
explanation_mandarin: 1. （秘密）通知、走漏消息。2. 监狱等地方让犯人出来透透气。3. 比喻让人放松一下、透透气。
explanation_english: 1. To secretly inform or leak information, especially to alert someone of impending danger or opportunity. 2. To let prisoners out of their cells for a short period to get some fresh air and exercise. 3. Figuratively, to allow someone to relax or take a break from a stressful situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我放風俾你知，老細聽日會嚟巡視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fong3 fung1 bei2 nei5 zi1, lou5 sai3 ting1 jat6 wui5 lai4 seon4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我给你通风报信，老板明天会来视察。
examples.english_sentence: I'm tipping you off, the boss will be coming for inspection tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿Sir，我想放風抖下氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 sir3, ngo5 soeng2 fong3 fung1 dau2 haa5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警官，我想出去放松一下，透透气。
examples.english_sentence: Officer, I want to go out for a bit to relax and get some fresh air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日困喺屋企，應該俾佢哋去公園放風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 kwan3 hai2 uk1 kei2, jing1 goi1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 fong3 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们整天被困在家里，应该让他们去公园放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: They are confined at home all day, they should be allowed to go to the park to loosen up.

mandarin_meaning: 暗箭伤人; 背後放冷箭
english_meaning: To stab in the back; To launch a hidden attack; To secretly criticize or undermine someone.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻暗中攻击或陷害别人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for secretly attacking or framing someone. It implies a covert and malicious action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺背後放飛劍啦，有咩就當面講清楚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 bui3 hau6 fong3 fei1 gim3 laa1, jau5 me1 zau6 dong1 min6 gong2 cing1 co2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在背后放冷箭了，有什么就当面说清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stab people in the back, please. If you have something to say, say it to their face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放飛劍，好陰險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fong3 fei1 gim3, hou2 jam1 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常放冷箭，很阴险的。
examples.english_sentence: He often stabs people in the back; he's very treacherous.

synonyms: 背後搞小動作 (bui3 hau6 gaau2 siu2 dung6 zok3)

english_meaning: to not show up, to stand someone up, to flake, to break a promise
explanation_mandarin: 指约好之后没有赴约，爽约了别人。就像放出的飞机一样，没有回来。
explanation_english: It refers to failing to show up for a pre-arranged appointment or meeting. The image is like releasing an airplane that never returns, symbolizing a broken promise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日放飛機，唔好咁信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 fong3 fei1 gei1, m4 hou2 gam3 seon3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是爽约，别太相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He always flakes, don't trust him too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好放我飛機呀，我等你好耐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fong3 ngo5 fei1 gei1 aa3, ngo5 dang2 nei5 hou2 noi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别爽约啊，我等你很久了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand me up, I've been waiting for you for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日佢放咗我飛機，我好嬲呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 keoi5 fong3 zo2 ngo5 fei1 gei1, ngo5 hou2 nau1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天他爽约了，我很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He stood me up yesterday, I'm very angry.

english_meaning: To be oneself completely; to let go and be free; to indulge oneself.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人完全释放自己，不受约束，做自己想做的事情，通常带有一定程度的放纵或任性。
explanation_english: Refers to a person completely freeing themselves, without restraint, doing what they want to do. Usually carries a connotation of indulgence or wilfulness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試，我決定放飛自我，去旅行放鬆下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 fong3 fei1 zi6 ngo5, heoi3 leoi5 hang4 fong3 sung1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试后，我决定放飞自我，去旅行放松一下。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, I decided to let loose and be myself, going on a trip to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放飛自我，日日都飲酒玩樂，唔理屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 fei1 zi6 ngo5, jat1 jat1 dou1 yam2 zau2 waan2 lok6, m4 lei5 uk1 kei2 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放飞自我，每天都喝酒玩乐，不理家人。
examples.english_sentence: He's letting himself go, drinking and having fun every day, ignoring his family.

mandarin_meaning: 吃饭; 下班吃饭; 休息吃饭
english_meaning: lunch break; time for lunch; to have lunch
explanation_mandarin: 指工作或学习期间，休息并吃饭的时间。也指开始吃饭这个动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the time for a lunch break during work or study. It also refers to the action of starting to eat lunch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先老細話一點放飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 lou5 sai3 waa6 jat1 dim2 fong3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才老板说一点钟午休。
examples.english_sentence: The boss just said the lunch break is at 1 o'clock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放飯喇！一齊去食嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 faan6 laa3! jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 午休了！一起去吃饭吧！
examples.english_sentence: It's lunch break! Let's go eat together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋幾點放飯㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 gei2 dim2 fong3 faan6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们几点午休？
examples.english_sentence: What time is your lunch break?

english_meaning: free-range (animal husbandry); to let something/someone develop freely; to raise without much intervention
explanation_mandarin: 指牲畜在野外自由生长，也比喻对孩子或事物采取放任自流的态度，不做过多干涉。
explanation_english: Literally refers to raising livestock in the wild freely. Figuratively, it means adopting a laissez-faire attitude towards children or things, without much intervention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲父母興放養式教育，等啲細路仔自己探索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 fu6 mou5 hing3 fong3 joeng5 sik1 gaau3 juk6, dang2 di1 sai3 lou2 zai2 zi6 gi2 taam3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的父母流行放养式教育，让孩子们自己探索。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, parents are into free-range parenting, letting kids explore on their own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸阿媽成日放養佢，搞到佢乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa1 aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 fong3 joeng5 keoi5, gaau2 dou3 keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸妈总是放任他，搞得他什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: His parents always let him do whatever he wants, and as a result, he knows nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅雞全部都係放養，所以啲蛋特別好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 gai1 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 fong3 joeng5, so2 ji5 di1 daan2 dak6 bit1 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的鸡全部都是散养的，所以鸡蛋特别好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The chickens here are all free-range, so the eggs are especially delicious.

english_meaning: to be wise after the event, to offer advice or criticism after the fact
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情过后才发表意见或采取行动，已经于事无补，类似“事后诸葛亮”。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to offering advice, criticism, or solutions after an event has already occurred, making it pointless or ineffective. It's similar to being a 'Monday morning quarterback' or 'wise after the event'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家先嚟講應該點做，咪即係放馬後炮囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 gong2 ying1 goi1 dim2 zou6, mai1 zik1 hai6 fong3 maa5 hau6 paau3 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在才来说应该怎么做，不就是事后诸葛亮吗！
examples.english_sentence: You're only telling us what we should have done now? That's just being wise after the event!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好放馬後炮啦，事情都已經發生咗，不如諗吓點樣解決佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fong3 maa5 hau6 paau3 laa1, si6 ching4 dou1 ji5 ging1 faat3 sang1 zo2, bat1 jyu4 lam2 haa5 dim2 yeung2 gaai2 kyut3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要事后诸葛亮了，事情都已经发生了，不如想想怎么解决它。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be wise after the event. The situation has already happened, let's focus on how to solve it.

synonyms: 事後孔明 (si6 hau6 hung2 ming4)

english_meaning: Bring it on; Come at me; Do your worst
explanation_mandarin: 表示不畏惧对方的挑战或威胁，充满自信地让对方来尝试。
explanation_english: An expression of confidence and defiance, challenging someone to attempt something difficult or to make a threat. It implies the speaker is not intimidated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住嚇我呀？放馬過嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 zeoi2 hak1 ngo5 aa3? fong3 maa5 gwo3 lai4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为吓唬我吗？放马过来吧！
examples.english_sentence: You think you can scare me? Bring it on!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔怕你，有咩招數放馬過嚟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 paa3 nei5, jau5 me1 ziu1 sou3 fong3 maa5 gwo3 lai4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不怕你，有什么招数尽管使出来！
examples.english_sentence: I'm not afraid of you, bring on whatever tricks you have!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得自己好叻？放馬過嚟試下囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1? fong3 maa5 gwo3 lai4 si3 haa5 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得自己很厉害？放马过来试试看吧！
examples.english_sentence: You think you're so great? Bring it on and try!

synonyms: 嚟抽水呀 (lai4 cau1 seoi2 aa1)

english_meaning: to relax, to loosen
explanation_mandarin: 使身心得到舒缓，不再紧张。
explanation_english: To relax, to loosen up, to relieve tension in body and mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁緊張，放鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, fong3 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么紧张，放松一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so nervous, relax a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽下音樂，放鬆心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 haa5 jam1 ngok6, fong3 sung1 sam1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听听音乐，放松心情。
examples.english_sentence: Listen to some music and relax your mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放鬆咗膊頭，感覺舒服好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 sung1 zo2 bok3 tau4, gam2 gok3 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他放松了肩膀，感觉舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: He relaxed his shoulders and felt much more comfortable.

english_meaning: politics, government
explanation_mandarin: 指国家或社会事务的管理和治理活动。
explanation_english: Refers to the activities related to the management and governance of a country or society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對政治好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zing3 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对政治很有兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in politics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要推出新嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 teoi1 ceot1 san1 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要推出新的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is going to launch new policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞政治唔係咁容易嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 zing3 zi6 m4 hai6 gam3 jung4 ji6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞政治不是那么容易的。
examples.english_sentence: Getting involved in politics is not that easy.

english_meaning: political affairs, state affairs, politics
explanation_mandarin: 指与政治有关的事务，如政府运作、政策制定等。
explanation_english: Refers to matters related to politics, such as government operations, policy-making, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對政事好有興趣，成日睇新聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zing3 si6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, seng4 jat6 tai2 san1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对政治事务很有兴趣，经常看新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in political affairs and watches the news often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家嘅政事好腐敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zing3 si6 hou2 fu6 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家的政治事务很腐败。
examples.english_sentence: The political affairs of this country are very corrupt.

english_meaning: government decree; administrative order
explanation_mandarin: 政府頒布的命令或法令。
explanation_english: A decree or order issued by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府發佈咗好多新嘅政令。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 faat3 bou3 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 zing3 ling6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府发布了很多新的政令。
examples.english_sentence: The government has issued many new government decrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲政令影響到好多市民嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zing3 ling6 ying2 hoeng2 dou3 hou2 do1 si5 man4 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些政令影响到很多市民的生活。
examples.english_sentence: These government decrees affect the lives of many citizens.

english_meaning: political system; form of government
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或地区的政治制度和组织形式。
explanation_english: Refers to the political system and organizational structure of a country or region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅政制需要改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 zai3 seoi1 jiu3 gaai2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的政治制度需要改革。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's political system needs reform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔同國家有唔同嘅政制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 zing3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不同的国家有不同的政治制度。
examples.english_sentence: Different countries have different political systems.

english_meaning: government affairs; political affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或政治方面的事务。
explanation_english: Refers to matters relating to government or politics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好忙，日日都要處理政務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 mong4, jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 cyu5 lei5 zing3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很忙，每天都要处理政务。
examples.english_sentence: He is very busy, he has to deal with government affairs every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門主要負責本地嘅政務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 bun2 dei6 ge3 zing3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门主要负责本地的政务。
examples.english_sentence: This department is mainly responsible for local government affairs.

english_meaning: Administrative Officer (AO)
explanation_mandarin: 香港政府中，通过政务主任职系招聘的公务员，主要负责政策制定和行政管理。
explanation_english: In the Hong Kong Government, an Administrative Officer (AO) is a civil servant recruited through the Administrative Officer Grade. They are primarily responsible for policy formulation and administration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考到政務官，前途一片光明呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 dou2 zing3 mou6 gun1, cin4 tou4 jat1 pin3 gwong1 ming4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了政务官，前途一片光明啊！
examples.english_sentence: He passed the Administrative Officer exam, his future is bright!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多大學生都想入政府做政務官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 daai6 hok6 sang1 dou1 soeng2 jap6 zing3 fu2 zou6 zing3 mou6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多大学生都想进政府做政务官。
examples.english_sentence: Many university students want to join the government and become Administrative Officers.

mandarin_meaning: 政治协商会议 (zhèngzhì xiéshāng huìyì)
english_meaning: Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC)
explanation_mandarin: 中国人民政治协商会议的简称，是中国共产党领导的统一战线组织，是中国共产党同各民主党派、无党派人士、各人民团体进行政治协商、民主监督和参政议政的重要机构。
explanation_english: Abbreviation for the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), a political advisory body in China. It's a united front organization led by the Communist Party of China, and an important institution for political consultation, democratic supervision, and participation in the deliberation and administration of state affairs by the Communist Party of China, various democratic parties, people without party affiliation, and various people's organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係省嘅政協委員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 saang2 ge3 zing3 hip3 wai2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是省政协委员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a member of the Provincial CPPCC.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港富豪都係政協嘅成員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 fu3 hou4 dou1 hai6 zing3 hip3 ge3 sing4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港富豪都是政协的成员。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong tycoons are members of the CPPCC.

english_meaning: political circles, the political arena, the world of politics
explanation_mandarin: 指政治界，从事政治活动的圈子。
explanation_english: Refers to the world of politics, the circles of people involved in political activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺政壇打滾咗好多年，經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zing3 taan4 daa2 gwan2 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4, ging1 gim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在政坛摸爬滚打了好多年，经验很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in the political arena for many years and has a lot of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅選舉，政壇一定會出現大變動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 syun2 geoi2, zing3 taan4 jat1 ding6 wui5 ceot1 hin1 daai6 bin3 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的选举，政坛一定会发生大变动。
examples.english_sentence: The political arena is bound to see major changes in this election.

english_meaning: politician (often with negative connotations)
explanation_mandarin: 指以政治为职业，并且往往为了个人或党派利益而钻营的人。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is professionally involved in politics, often with a negative connotation implying that they are more concerned with personal or partisan gain than with serving the public good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得開空頭支票，真係一個政客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 hoi1 hung1 tau4 zi1 piao3, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 zing3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会开空头支票，真是一个政客。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to make empty promises, he's really a politician.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得啲政客成日講大話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 di1 zing3 haak3 seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得那些政客总是说谎。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that politicians always lie.

english_meaning: political situation, political landscape
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或地区的政治形势和发展趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to the political situation and trends in a country or region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近嘅政局都幾唔穩定。

english_meaning: political reform

explanation_english: Refers to the reform of political systems and institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅政改一直都係社會關注嘅焦點。

english_meaning: Separation of church and state
explanation_mandarin: 政治和宗教分离的原则，避免宗教干涉政治，也避免政治干涉宗教。
explanation_english: The principle that government and religious institutions should be kept separate, avoiding religious interference in government and government interference in religion.

english_meaning: Theocracy; unification of church and state

explanation_english: A form of government in which a religious institution or religious leaders hold supreme power in the state; religious laws become state laws.

english_meaning: Separation of church and state

explanation_english: The principle that the state and the church should be separate and not interfere in each other's affairs.

english_meaning: Theocracy; union of church and state

english_meaning: regime; political power

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人為咗逃避政治迫害，會尋求政治庇護。
