examples.jyutping_sentence: yau5 si4 m4 ho2 yi5 taai3 jau5 zing3 zi6 git3 pik1, yiu3 sik1 dak1 to2 hip3 sin1 ho2 yi5 zou6 sing4 di1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有时候不能太有政治洁癖，要懂得妥协才可以做成一些事情。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes you can't be too politically pure; you have to know how to compromise to get things done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為有政治潔癖，所以唔肯加入任何政黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 jau5 zing3 zi6 git3 pik1, so2 ji5 m4 hang2 gaap3 yap6 yam6 ho4 zeng3 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为有政治洁癖，所以不肯加入任何政党。
examples.english_sentence: Because of his political purity, he refuses to join any political party.

synonyms: 理想主義 (lei5 soeng2 zyu2 ji6)

english_meaning: political prisoner
explanation_mandarin: 因其政治信仰或行动而被监禁的人。
explanation_english: A person imprisoned for their political beliefs or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為參與民主運動俾人拉咗，依家變成咗政治犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai4 caam1 jyu5 man4 zyu2 wan6 dung6 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, ji1 gaa1 bin3 sing4 zo2 zing3 zi6 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为参与民主运动被抓了，现在变成了政治犯。
examples.english_sentence: He was arrested for participating in the democracy movement and is now a political prisoner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 國際社會關注唔少國家嘅政治犯處境。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwok3 zai3 se5 wui2 gwaan1 zyu3 m4 siu2 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zing3 zi6 faan2 cyu2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 国际社会关注很多国家的政治犯处境。
examples.english_sentence: The international community is concerned about the situation of political prisoners in many countries.

english_meaning: Political persecution
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或政治团体对不同政治观点或信仰的人进行压制、歧视或伤害。
explanation_english: The suppression, discrimination, or harm inflicted on individuals or groups by a government or political organization due to their differing political views or beliefs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己受到政治迫害，所以要離開香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 sau6 dou3 zing3 zi6 bik1 hoi6, so2 ji5 jiu3 lei4 hoi1 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己受到了政治迫害，所以要离开香港。
examples.english_sentence: He said he was politically persecuted, so he had to leave Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人認為佢哋只係想抹黑個政府，話有政治迫害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 jing6 wai4 keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 soeng2 mut3 hak1 go3 zing3 fu2, waa6 jau5 zing3 zi6 bik1 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人认为他们只是想抹黑政府，说有政治迫害。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think they are just trying to smear the government by claiming political persecution.

english_meaning: Political Department, Political Section
explanation_mandarin: 指机构或组织的政治部门，通常负责政治宣传、思想教育、情报搜集等方面的工作。在香港语境下，特指香港政府以前的一个部门，专门负责政治情报和安全。
explanation_english: Refers to a political department or section within an organization, typically responsible for political propaganda, ideological education, intelligence gathering, etc. In the Hong Kong context, it specifically refers to a former department of the Hong Kong government responsible for political intelligence and security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前香港政府嘅政治部好神秘㗎，好多人都唔知佢哋做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 zi6 bou6 hou2 san1 bei3 gaa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 m4 zi1 gei2 deoi2 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前香港政府的政治部很神秘的，很多人都不知道他们做什么。
examples.english_sentence: The former Hong Kong government's Political Department was very mysterious. Many people didn't know what they did.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲舊電影成日講政治部查案嘅故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gau6 din6 jing2 sing4 jat6 gong2 zing3 zi6 bou6 caa4 on3 ge3 gu3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一些老电影经常讲政治部查案的故事。
examples.english_sentence: Some old movies often tell stories about the Political Department investigating cases.

english_meaning: political circles, political arena, politics
explanation_mandarin: 指从事政治活动或与政治有关的人士、团体或领域。
explanation_english: Refers to people, groups, or areas engaged in political activities or related to politics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住投身政界，為市民服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 tau4 san1 zing3 gaai3, wai6 si5 man4 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打算投身政界，为市民服务。
examples.english_sentence: He plans to enter politics and serve the citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政界嘅嘢好複雜㗎，唔係咁容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 gaai3 ge3 je5 hou2 fuk1 zaap6 gaa3, m4 hai6 gam2 jung4 ji6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政治圈的事情很复杂的，不是那么容易明白。
examples.english_sentence: The things in political circles are very complicated; it's not that easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多商界人士都同政界關係密切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 seung1 gaai3 jan4 si6 dou1 tung4 zing3 gaai3 gwaan1 hai6 mat6 chit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多商界人士都与政界关系密切。
examples.english_sentence: Many business people have close relationships with political circles.

english_meaning: policy
explanation_mandarin: 指国家、政党或其他团体为达到一定目的而制定的行动方针和具体办法。
explanation_english: A course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, party, business, or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府最近出咗好多新政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zeoi3 gan6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 zaak3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府最近出台了很多新政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has recently introduced many new policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個政策對市民有咩影響？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaak3 caak3 deoi3 si5 man4 jau5 me1 jing2 hoeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个政策对市民有什么影响？
examples.english_sentence: What impact does this policy have on citizens?

english_meaning: political platform; manifesto
explanation_mandarin: 指政党或政治人物提出的施政方针和政策主张。
explanation_english: A political platform or manifesto outlines a political party's or politician's policies and proposals for governing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個候選人都應該清晰咁講出佢嘅政綱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 hau6 syun2 yan4 dou1 ying1 goi1 ching1 sik1 gam2 gong2 chut1 keoi5 ge3 zing3 gong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个候选人都应该清晰地讲出他的政纲。
examples.english_sentence: Every candidate should clearly state their political platform.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民需要仔細研究唔同政黨嘅政綱先決定投邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 seoi1 yiu3 zai2 sai3 ngin4 gau3 m4 tung4 zing3 dong2 ge3 zing3 gong1 sin1 kyut3 ding6 tau4 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民需要仔细研究不同政党的政纲才能决定投给谁。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens need to carefully study the political platforms of different political parties before deciding who to vote for.

english_meaning: political achievements; track record; performance record
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或官员在任期间取得的成就，例如经济发展、社会福利、基础设施建设等方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the achievements made by a government or official during their term in office, such as economic development, social welfare, and infrastructure construction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢任內嘅政績都幾唔錯，經濟發展得幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam6 noi6 ge3 zing3 zik1 dou1 gei2 m4 co3, ging1 gai3 faat3 zin2 dak1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在任期间的政绩还不错，经济发展得很好。
examples.english_sentence: His performance record during his term was quite good; the economy developed very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民最關心嘅都係政府嘅政績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 zeoi3 gwaan1 sam1 ge3 dou1 hai6 zing3 fu2 ge3 zing3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民最关心的都是政府的政绩。
examples.english_sentence: What the citizens are most concerned about is the government's performance record.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要評價一個官員，就要睇佢嘅政績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 ping3 gaa3 jat1 go3 gun1 jyun4, zau6 jiu3 tai2 keoi5 ge3 zing3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要评价一个官员，就要看他的政绩。
examples.english_sentence: To evaluate an official, you have to look at their performance record.

mandarin_meaning: 政界要人; 重要政治人物
english_meaning: political figure; prominent politician; important political personage
explanation_mandarin: 指在政治界具有重要地位和影响力的人物。
explanation_english: Refers to individuals who hold important positions and wield significant influence in the political arena.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚嘅宴會好多政要都有出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 ge3 jin3 wui2 hou2 do1 zing3 jiu3 dou1 jau5 ceot1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚的宴会上很多政界要人都出席了。
examples.english_sentence: Many political figures attended the banquet last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想成為一個政要，貢獻社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 zing3 jiu3, gung3 hiun3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想成为一个政界要人，贡献社会。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to become a political figure and contribute to society.

english_meaning: political views; political opinions
explanation_mandarin: 指个人或团体对政治问题的看法和主张。
explanation_english: Refers to the views and stances of an individual or group on political issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅政見好唔同，成日嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zing3 gin3 hou2 m4 tung4, sing4 jat6 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的政治观点很不同，经常吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Our political views are very different, and we argue all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因为政見唔同就闹人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 zing3 gin3 m4 tung4 zau6 naau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为政治观点不同就骂人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold people just because they have different political views.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅政見係偏向保守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing3 gin3 hai6 pin1 hoeng3 bou2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的政治观点是偏向保守。
examples.english_sentence: His political views are more inclined towards conservatism.

english_meaning: political commentary; political criticism; political analysis
explanation_mandarin: 针对政治事件、政策或人物发表的评论或分析。
explanation_english: Commentary or analysis on political events, policies, or figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺報紙寫政評，講啲政府嘅唔啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 bou3 zi2 se2 zing3 ping3, gong2 di1 zing3 fu2 ge3 m4 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在报纸上写政治评论，说政府的不足之处。
examples.english_sentence: He often writes political commentary in the newspaper, pointing out the government's shortcomings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇政評寫得好深入，分析得好透徹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 zing3 ping3 se2 dak1 hou2 sam1 jap6, fan1 sik1 dak1 hou2 tau3 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇政治评论写得很深入，分析得很透彻。
examples.english_sentence: This political commentary is written in great depth, with thorough analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇梁啟智嘅政評，佢嘅觀點好獨到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 loeng4 kai2 zi3 ge3 zing3 ping3, keoi5 ge3 gun1 dim2 hou2 duk6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢看梁启智的政治评论，他的观点很独特。
examples.english_sentence: I really enjoy reading Liang Qizhi's political commentary, his views are very unique.

english_meaning: political commentary, political discussion, political argument
explanation_mandarin: 对政治事件或政治观点进行评论或议论。
explanation_english: Commentary or discussion on political events or viewpoints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲政論節目好多都好主觀嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 zing3 leon6 zit3 muk6 hou2 do1 dou1 hou2 zyu2 gun1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的政治评论节目很多都很主观的。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many political commentary shows are very subjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意睇啲政論節目，覺得太嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tai2 di1 zing3 leon6 zit3 muk6, gok3 dak1 taai3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢看政治评论节目，觉得太吵。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like watching political commentary shows, I think they're too noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺報紙寫政論文章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bou3 zi2 se2 zing3 leon6 man4 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在报纸上写政治评论文章。
examples.english_sentence: He writes political commentary articles in the newspaper.

english_meaning: coup d'état, coup
explanation_mandarin: 指通过非法或暴力手段夺取政权的行为。
explanation_english: An illegal and overt seizure of a state by the military or other elites within the state apparatus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講琴晚發生咗政變，唔知真定假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 kam4 maan1 faat3 sang1 zo2 zing3 bin3, m4 zi1 zan1 ding6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说昨晚发生了政变，不知道是真的还是假的。
examples.english_sentence: I heard there was a coup d'état last night, I don't know if it's true or not.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個國家經歷過幾次政變，政治都唔穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gwok3 gaa1 ging1 lik6 gwo3 gei2 ci3 zing3 bin3, zing3 zi6 dou1 m4 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个国家经历过几次政变，政治都不稳定。
examples.english_sentence: That country has experienced several coups, and its politics are unstable.

mandarin_meaning: 政通人和 (zhèng tōng rén hé)
english_meaning: Government is effective and the people live in harmony; smooth government and harmonious people.
explanation_mandarin: 指政治清明，上下沟通，人民和睦相处。形容国家安定团结。
explanation_english: Describes a state where the government is efficient and just, communication between officials and the people is smooth, and the people live together in peace and harmony. It represents a stable and united country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果個政府做得好，經濟又搞得掂，咁就政通人和啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 go3 zing3 fu2 zou6 dak1 hou2, ging1 zai3 jau6 gaau2 dak1 dim6, gam2 zau6 zing3 tung1 jan4 wo4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府做得好，经济又能搞好，那就是政通人和了。
examples.english_sentence: If the government does a good job and the economy is well-managed, then it's a case of smooth government and harmonious people.

english_meaning: political system; form of government
explanation_mandarin: 指国家的政治制度和组织形式。
explanation_english: Refers to the political system and organizational structure of a country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每個國家嘅政體都唔同，反映咗佢哋獨特嘅歷史同文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zing3 tai2 dou1 m4 tung4, faan2 ying2 zo2 keoi5 dei6 duk6 dak6 ge3 lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每个国家的政体都不同，反映了他们独特的历史和文化。
examples.english_sentence: Each country has a different political system, reflecting its unique history and culture.

english_meaning: political party
explanation_mandarin: 指为了实现一定的政治纲领，由具有相同或相似政治理念的人组成的政治组织。
explanation_english: A political organization that unites people with shared political aims and opinions, and that seeks to influence public policy by getting its candidates elected to public office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多唔同嘅政黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zing3 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多不同的政党。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many different political parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想加入嗰個政黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 gaa1 jap6 go2 go3 zing3 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想加入那个政党。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to join that political party.

english_meaning: reason, cause; accident; death (of a person)
explanation_mandarin: 作为名词，表示原因、缘故；也指事故。作为动词，表示死亡（敬语，用于人）。
explanation_english: As a noun, it means reason, cause, or accident. As a verb, it means to die (a respectful term used for people).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咩故啊？點解會咁樣㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: me1 gu3 aa3? dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 joeng2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 什么原因啊？为什么会这样呢？
examples.english_sentence: What's the reason? Why did it happen like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢過咗身，佢屋企人話佢尋日走咗，即係話佢尋日去咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 waa6 keoi5 cam4 jat6 zau2 zo2, zik1 hai6 waa6 keoi5 cam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去世了，他的家人说他昨天走了，也就是他昨天去世了。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away. His family said he left yesterday, meaning he died yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出咗交通意外，可能有啲故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 zo2 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngoi6, ho2 nang4 jau5 di1 gu3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生了交通事故，可能有些故事/问题。
examples.english_sentence: There was a traffic accident, there might be some issues/problems.

english_meaning: story; tale; narrative
explanation_mandarin: 用作叙述一系列真实或虚构的事件的文学作品，通常旨在娱乐或教育听众或读者。
explanation_english: A narrative, either true or fictitious, designed to interest, amuse, or instruct the hearer or reader; a tale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日聽阿嫲講故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 ting1 aa3 maa4 gong2 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常听奶奶讲故事。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often listened to my grandma telling stories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔好感人，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hou2 gam2 jan4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事很感人，看到我眼眶湿润。
examples.english_sentence: This story is very touching; it made my eyes teary.

english_meaning: old friend; old acquaintance
explanation_mandarin: 指相识已久的朋友，老朋友。
explanation_english: Refers to a friend or acquaintance of long standing; an old friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅故人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gu3 jan4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的老朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is an old friend of mine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐冇見，估唔到喺呢度遇到故人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, gu2 m4 dou3 hai2 ni1 dou6 jyu6 dou2 gu3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好久不见了，没想到在这里遇到老朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Long time no see. I didn't expect to meet an old friend here.

english_meaning: story, tale
explanation_mandarin: 指叙述事件经过或人物事迹的文章或口述内容。
explanation_english: A narrative or account of connected events; a tale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日要阿媽講故仔我聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau2 seng4 jat6 jiu3 a3 maa1 gong2 gu3 zai2 ngo5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常要妈妈讲故事给我听。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I always asked my mom to tell me stories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔好感人，我睇到喊咗出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 hou2 gam2 jan4, ngo5 tai2 dou3 haam3 zo2 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事很感人，我看到哭了出来。
examples.english_sentence: This story is very touching; I cried when I watched it.

english_meaning: to feign; to pretend; to affect; to put on an act
explanation_mandarin: 故意装出某种样子或行为，掩饰真实情况。
explanation_english: To deliberately pretend to be something one is not, or to feign a particular emotion or condition, often to conceal one's true feelings or intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢故作鎮定，但係我睇得出佢好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu3 zok3 zan3 ding6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故作镇定，但是我看得出他很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended to be calm, but I could tell he was very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢故作唔知發生咩事，其實佢咩都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu3 zok3 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6, kei4 sat6 keoi5 me1 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意装作不知道发生什么事，其实他什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He pretended not to know what was happening, but he actually knew everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好故作堅強啦，想喊就喊出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gu3 zok3 gin1 koeng5 laa1, soeng2 haam3 zau6 haam3 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要故作坚强了，想哭就哭出来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be strong, if you want to cry, just cry.

english_meaning: to put on an act of profoundness; to pretend to be profound
explanation_mandarin: 故意装出高深莫测的样子。
explanation_english: To deliberately act in a way that makes oneself appear profound or mysterious, often to impress others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都故作高深，冇人知佢諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gu3 zok3 gou1 sam1, mou5 jan4 zi1 keoi5 nam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是故作高深，没人知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an act of profoundness; no one knows what he is thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度故作高深啦，有咩咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 gu3 zok3 gou1 sam1 laa1, jau5 me1 mai1 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里故弄玄虚了，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to be profound here, just say what you have to say directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都故作高深，好似好叻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gu3 zok3 gou1 sam1, hou2 ci5 hou2 lek1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是故作高深，好像很厉害的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks in a way that pretends to be profound, as if he's very capable.

english_meaning: old friend; old acquaintance
explanation_mandarin: 指相识已久的朋友，通常带有怀旧或者惋惜的意味。
explanation_english: An old friend; a friend of long standing. Often implies a sense of nostalgia or regret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街度撞到個故友，真係好耐冇見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 zong6 dou2 go3 gu3 jau5, zan1 hai6 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街上遇到了一个老朋友，真是好久没见了。
examples.english_sentence: I ran into an old friend on the street; it's been such a long time.

english_meaning: The Forbidden City; Palace Museum
explanation_mandarin: 指北京的故宫，也称紫禁城，是明清两代的皇宫。
explanation_english: Refers to the Forbidden City in Beijing, also known as the Palace Museum, which served as the imperial palace during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去北京參觀故宮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 bak1 ging1 caam1 gun1 gu3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去北京参观故宫。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to visit the Forbidden City in Beijing tomorrow.

english_meaning: former residence; old residence
explanation_mandarin: 指已经去世的人或已经离开的人曾经居住过的地方。
explanation_english: A former residence, particularly one associated with a deceased or departed person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間就係李小龍嘅故居喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau6 hai6 lei5 siu2 lung4 ge3 gu3 geoi1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间就是李小龙的故居了。
examples.english_sentence: This is Bruce Lee's former residence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定將呢間古老嘅故居改造成博物館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 ni1 gaan1 gu2 lou5 ge3 gu3 geoi1 goi2 zuk6 sing4 bok3 mat6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定将这间古老的故居改造成博物馆。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to transform this old residence into a museum.

english_meaning: to mystify, to make something unnecessarily mysterious, to create an air of mystery, to deliberately obfuscate
explanation_mandarin: 故意把事情弄得很神秘，讓人摸不著頭腦，實際上並沒有什麼真本事或真正的原因。
explanation_english: To deliberately make something appear mysterious and complicated, often to impress others or to hide a lack of real substance or knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都故弄玄虛，聽唔明佢想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gu3 nung6 jyun4 heoi1, teng1 m4 ming4 keoi5 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是故弄玄虚，听不明白他想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks in a mysterious way, making it hard to understand what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好故弄玄虛啦，有咩就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gu3 nung6 jyun4 heoi1 laa1, jau5 me1 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别故弄玄虚了，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so mysterious, just say what you have to say directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲廣告成日都故弄玄虛，令人唔知佢哋賣緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 gwong2 gou3 seng4 jat6 dou1 gu3 nung6 jyun4 heoi1, ling6 jan4 m4 zi1 keoi5 dei6 maai6 ging2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的广告总是故弄玄虚，让人不知道他们在卖什么。
examples.english_sentence: This company's advertisements are always deliberately mysterious, making it difficult to understand what they are selling.

english_meaning: deliberately, intentionally, on purpose
explanation_mandarin: 有意識地做某事，並非偶然或無意。
explanation_english: Doing something consciously and intentionally, not accidentally or unintentionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢故意唔聽電話嘅，唔係收唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu3 ji3 m4 ting1 din6 waa2 ge3, m4 hai6 sau1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是故意不接电话的，不是没收到。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately didn't answer the phone, he did receive it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁故意搞搞震啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gu3 ji3 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么故意搞破坏了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't deliberately cause trouble like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係故意遲到㗎，塞車呀嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3 ci4 dou3 gaa3, sak1 ce1 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是故意迟到的，堵车嘛。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't deliberately arrive late, there was traffic jam.

mandarin_meaning: 旧病复发; 老毛病又犯了
english_meaning: To relapse into former bad habits; to revert to old ways; a relapse
explanation_mandarin: 指恢复到原来的老样子，多指坏习惯或旧病复发。
explanation_english: Refers to reverting to a previous state, often referring to the recurrence of bad habits or a chronic illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戒咗煙冇幾耐又故態復萌，開始食返煙喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai3 zo2 yin1 mou5 gei2 noi6 jau6 gu3 taai3 fuk1 mang4, hoi1 chi2 sik6 faan1 yin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戒烟没多久又旧病复发，开始抽烟了。
examples.english_sentence: He quit smoking not long ago, but he relapsed and started smoking again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗職之後，又故態復萌，成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 tung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 jik1 zi1 hau6, jau6 gu3 taai3 fuk1 mang4, seng4 jat6 chi4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职之后，又开始故态复萌，总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Since he got promoted, he's relapsed and is always late.

english_meaning: deliberately; intentionally; on purpose
explanation_mandarin: 表示有意识地去做某事，带有主观意愿。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something consciously, with subjective intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢故手整爛我部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu3 sau2 zing2 laan6 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他故意弄坏了我的手机。
examples.english_sentence: He deliberately broke my phone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好故手扭曲我嘅意思啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gu3 sau2 nau2 kuk1 ngo5 ge3 ji3 si1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要故意扭曲我的意思啦！
examples.english_sentence: Don't deliberately twist my meaning!

english_meaning: to repeat an old trick; to resort to the same old tactics; to pull the same old stunt
explanation_mandarin: 再次使用以前用过的、无效或令人厌恶的手段或方法。
explanation_english: To use a previously employed, often ineffective or undesirable, trick or method again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次都係故技重施，呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 hai6 gu3 gei6 cung4 si1, aak1 yan4 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次都故技重施，骗人钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always resorts to the same old trick to cheat people out of their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住故技重施可以瞞天過海啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 gu3 gei6 cung4 si1 ho2 ji5 maan4 tin1 gwo3 hoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为故技重施可以蒙混过关啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can get away with it by pulling the same old trick.

english_meaning: therefore, hence, so
explanation_mandarin: 表示因果关系，相当于“因此”、“所以”。
explanation_english: Expressing a cause-and-effect relationship, equivalent to "therefore," "hence," or "so."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日冇溫書，故此考試唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 mou5 wan1 syu1, gu3 ci2 haau2 si5 m4 gok3 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没有复习，因此考试没及格。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't study yesterday, therefore he failed the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，故此好多人都去咗沙灘游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam3 jit6, gu3 ci2 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 heoi3 zo2 saa1 taan1 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么热，所以很多人都去了沙滩游泳。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so hot, therefore many people have gone to the beach to swim.

english_meaning: to be complacent and stick to old ways; to be self-satisfied and refuse to make progress; to rest on one's laurels
explanation_mandarin: 形容安于现状，不求进步。比喻因循守旧，不接受新事物。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is content with the status quo and doesn't seek progress. It's a metaphor for being conservative, sticking to old ways, and not accepting new things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋故步自封，就好快會俾人淘汰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 gu3 bou6 zi6 fung1, zau6 hou2 faai3 wui5 bei2 jan4 tau4 taai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们固步自封，很快就会被淘汰。
examples.english_sentence: If we are complacent and stick to old ways, we will be eliminated very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅管理層故步自封，唔肯接受新嘅科技。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 cang4 gu3 bou6 zi6 fung1, m4 hang2 zip3 sau6 san1 ge3 fo1 gei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的管理层固步自封，不肯接受新的科技。
examples.english_sentence: The company's management is complacent and refuses to accept new technologies.

english_meaning: old papers; a pile of old books and documents; outdated knowledge or ideas
explanation_mandarin: 指大量的旧书、旧文件等。也比喻陈旧的、过时的知识或理论。
explanation_english: Refers to a large pile of old books, documents, etc. Also used metaphorically to describe outdated knowledge or theories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淨係識喺故紙堆入面搵答案，唔識變通嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 hai2 gu3 zi2 deoi1 jap6 min6 wan2 daap3 aan3, m4 sik1 bin3 tung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是只知道在旧书堆里找答案，不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to find answers in old books; he doesn't know how to be flexible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲報告全部都係故紙堆，冇參考價值㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 bou3 gou3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gu3 zi2 deoi1, mou5 caam1 kaau2 gaa3 zik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些报告全部都是废纸堆，没有参考价值。
examples.english_sentence: These reports are all just old papers, they have no reference value.

english_meaning: used clothes; old clothes
explanation_mandarin: 指别人穿过的，已经旧的衣服。
explanation_english: Refers to clothes that have been worn by others and are old.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲故衣攞去非洲捐俾啲窮人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gu3 ji1 lo2 heoi3 fei1 zau1 gyun1 bei2 di1 kung4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧衣服拿去非洲捐给穷人。
examples.english_sentence: These used clothes are taken to Africa to donate to the poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔介意着故衣，最緊要乾淨衛生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gaai3 ji3 zoek3 gu3 ji1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 gon1 zing6 wai6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不介意穿旧衣服，最重要的是干净卫生。
examples.english_sentence: I don't mind wearing used clothes, as long as they are clean and hygienic.

english_meaning: second-hand clothing shop, thrift store
explanation_mandarin: 售卖二手衣物的商店。
explanation_english: A shop that sells second-hand clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都去故衣舖度尋寶，睇下有冇啲特別嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 gu3 yi1 pou3 dou6 cam4 bou2, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 di1 dak6 bit3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去二手服装店寻宝，看看有没有特别的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the thrift store to hunt for treasure and see if there's anything special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲故衣舖都幾乾淨企理㗎，唔似以前咁污糟邋遢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gu3 yi1 pou3 dou1 gei2 gon1 zing6 kei5 lei5 gaa3, m4 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 wu1 zou1 laat6 taat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的二手服装店都挺干净整洁的，不像以前那么脏乱。
examples.english_sentence: These days, second-hand clothing shops are quite clean and tidy, unlike how dirty and messy they used to be.

english_meaning: hometown; native place
explanation_mandarin: 出生或长期居住的地方，带有怀旧情感。
explanation_english: The place where one was born or has lived for a long time, often with a sense of nostalgia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好掛住我嘅故鄉啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5 ge3 gu3 hoeng1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想念我的故乡啊。
examples.english_sentence: I miss my hometown so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢離開咗故鄉好多年啦，一直都冇返去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 zo2 gu3 hoeng1 hou2 do1 nin4 laa1, jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 faan1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他离开故乡很多年了，一直都没有回去。
examples.english_sentence: He left his hometown many years ago and hasn't returned since.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然喺香港住咗好耐，但係我永遠都唔會忘記我嘅故鄉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 mong4 gei3 ngo5 ge3 gu3 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然在香港住了很久，但是我永远都不会忘记我的故乡。
examples.english_sentence: Although I've lived in Hong Kong for a long time, I'll never forget my hometown.

english_meaning: malfunction, breakdown, fault, failure
explanation_mandarin: 指机器、设备等发生问题，不能正常运转或使用。
explanation_english: Refers to a problem occurring with a machine, equipment, etc., causing it to not function or be used normally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦又故障，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 jau6 gu3 zoeng3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑又出故障了，搞得我做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: The computer malfunctioned again, making me unable to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺高速公路上面故障，真係好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 gou1 suk1 gung1 lou6 soeng6 min6 gu3 zoeng3, zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车在高速公路上发生故障，真是很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down on the highway, which is really troublesome.

english_meaning: to imitate; to emulate; to follow; effect; result
explanation_mandarin: 模仿，学习；效果，作用。
explanation_english: To imitate or emulate; the result or effect of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好效人哋衰嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 haau6 jan4 dei6 seoi1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要模仿别人不好的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't imitate other people's bad habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法唔太效喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 taai3 haau6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法不太有效啊。
examples.english_sentence: This method isn't very effective.

english_meaning: to serve for; to work for; effectiveness; efficacy
explanation_mandarin: （动词）为某人或某事尽力；（名词）指产生的效果、效用。
explanation_english: (verb) To serve or work for someone or something; (noun) effectiveness, efficacy, power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺間大公司效力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 haau6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在那家大公司工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's now working for that big company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥嘅效力好強。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 haau6 lik6 hou2 koeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药的效力很强。
examples.english_sentence: The effectiveness of this medicine is very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法嘅效力仲有待驗證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 ge3 haau6 lik6 zung6 jau5 doi6 jim6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法的效力还有待验证。
examples.english_sentence: The effectiveness of this method still needs to be verified.

english_meaning: to serve; to offer one's services; to assist
explanation_mandarin: 为他人出力服务。
explanation_english: To serve or assist others; to offer one's services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩我可以幫手效勞嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 haau6 lou4 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么我可以帮忙效劳的吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is there anything I can help you with?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使客氣，好樂意為你效勞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, hou2 lok6 ji3 wai6 nei5 haau6 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用客气，很乐意为您效劳。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be polite, I'm happy to be of service.

mandarin_meaning: 效仿坏的榜样; 学样
english_meaning: to imitate a bad example; to follow suit (in a negative way); to emulate wrongly
explanation_mandarin: 指模仿坏的榜样或行为，多含贬义。
explanation_english: To imitate a bad example or behavior, usually with negative connotations. It implies copying something undesirable or harmful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好效尤佢哋嘅坏习惯啦，对你冇好处㗎。

english_meaning: to pledge allegiance; to be loyal (to); to swear fealty

examples.english_sentence: They swore an oath of allegiance to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government.

examples.english_sentence: The effect of this policy is very obvious.

english_meaning: effect; result; outcome

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥嘅效果好好，食咗幾日就冇事喇。

examples.english_sentence: We need to see the effect after exercising to know.

english_meaning: to emulate, to imitate, to follow the example of
explanation_mandarin: 学习并模仿别人的做法或行为。
explanation_english: To learn from and imitate someone else's methods or behaviour; to follow someone's example.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該效法佢嘅勤力精神。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他效仿名人的穿着风格。
examples.english_sentence: He imitates the clothing style of celebrities.

english_meaning: efficiency, productivity
explanation_mandarin: 指单位时间内完成的工作量或取得的成果与所消耗的资源之间的比例。
explanation_english: The rate at which something is done or produced relative to the resources consumed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提高工作效率可以幫你慳返好多時間。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 提高工作效率可以帮你节省很多时间。
examples.english_sentence: Improving work efficiency can save you a lot of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅效率好低，好多嘢都拖好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 haau6 leot2 hou2 dai1, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 to1 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的效率很低，很多事情都拖很久。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盡量提高生產效率。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尽量提高生产效率。
examples.english_sentence: We should try our best to improve production efficiency.

english_meaning: effect; effectiveness; utility; function; use
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所产生的效果、作用或用途。
explanation_english: Refers to the effect, function, or use produced by something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻藥嘅效用好顯著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 joek6 ge3 haau6 jung6 hou2 hin2 zoek3.

examples.english_sentence: The effect of this medicine is very significant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法嘅效用有幾大，仲需要進一步研究。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种方法的效用有多大，还需要进一步研究。
examples.english_sentence: How effective this method is needs further research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢強調產品嘅效用同安全性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 koeng4 diu6 caan2 ban2 ge3 haau6 jung6 tung4 on1 cyun4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他强调产品的效用和安全性。
examples.english_sentence: He emphasized the effectiveness and safety of the product.

mandarin_meaning: 效益, 效果, 效用
english_meaning: benefit, effectiveness, efficiency, results, effect
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所产生的有益效果、利益或价值。
explanation_english: Refers to the beneficial effect, profit, or value produced by something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新政策可以提高公司嘅效益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 gung1 si1 ge3 haau6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项新政策可以提高公司的效益。
examples.english_sentence: This new policy can improve the company's efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要考慮點樣增加投資嘅效益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haau1 leoi6 dim2 yeung2 zang1 ga1 tau4 zi1 ge3 haau6 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要考虑怎样增加投资的效益。
examples.english_sentence: We need to consider how to increase the return on investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅效益好高，值得投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 haau6 jik1 hou2 gou1, zik6 dak1 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的效益很高，值得投资。
examples.english_sentence: This project is highly profitable and worth investing in.

english_meaning: effectiveness, efficiency, performance
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所发挥的功能和效率。
explanation_english: Refers to the function and efficiency of something; the ability to produce a desired or intended result.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦嘅效能好高，處理圖像好快。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提高公司嘅運作效能。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种新药的效能还有待验证。
examples.english_sentence: The effectiveness of this new drug still needs to be verified.

english_meaning: to narrate, to relate, to discuss, to chat
explanation_mandarin: 讲述，叙述，多用于正式场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To narrate, relate, or discuss, often used in formal settings or written language.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他洋洋洒洒地叙述了整件事情的经过。
examples.english_sentence: He described the whole incident in great detail.

english_meaning: narration, narrative, recount a story
explanation_mandarin: 讲述事情的经过；叙述事情的经过的文章或形式。
explanation_english: To recount or narrate a story or event; the act of narrating, or a written/spoken account of events in sequence.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 ge3 seoi5 si6 fong1 sik1 hou2 dak6 bit1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的叙事方式很特别。
examples.english_sentence: The narration style of this movie is very unique.

examples.english_sentence: The narrative technique of this article is so-so, not attractive enough.

explanation_english: To reminisce about the past; to catch up with old friends or acquaintances, often involving sharing memories and stories.

examples.english_sentence: When returning to my hometown for the Lunar New Year, of course, I need to catch up with relatives and friends.

english_meaning: narrate, recount, describe
explanation_mandarin: 用口头或书面的形式详细地讲述事情的经过或情况。

explanation_mandarin: 指教导、教授知识或技能，也可指使唤、吩咐。
explanation_english: To teach, instruct, or impart knowledge or skills. It can also mean to tell or ask someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我敎你點樣用呢部機啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 yeung2 yung6 ni1 bou6 gei1 laa1.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师教我们读书。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher teaches us to study.

english_meaning: religious leader; leader; cult leader; often used sarcastically or humorously to refer to someone overly enthusiastic or influential in a specific area.

explanation_english: Originally refers to the leader of a religion. Now often used jokingly or sarcastically to refer to someone who has great influence or is overly enthusiastic in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺攝影界就好似個敎主咁，好多人都跟佢。

examples.english_sentence: You can pick up your transcript at the academic affairs office.

jyutping: gaau3 sik1 tou4 dai6 mou5 si1 fu2

english_meaning: Teach the apprentice, starve the master; the apprentice surpasses the master, often leaving the master behind.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻徒弟学成后超越师傅，师傅反而会被抛弃或显得不如徒弟。也指教会了徒弟，自己就没有价值了，甚至会被取代。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe a situation where an apprentice, after being taught by a master, surpasses the master in skill and knowledge, sometimes leaving the master behind or making the master look inadequate. It also implies that once the apprentice is skilled, the master becomes irrelevant or is even replaced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，真係敎識徒弟冇師傅，而家佢叻過我，自己開檔喇。

examples.english_sentence: Sigh, it's really teaching the apprentice and starving the master. Now he's better than me and has opened his own business.

english_meaning: Teach a disciple, and you have no master; to teach a disciple is to lose a master. / The student surpasses the teacher.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻徒弟学成后，能力超过师父，甚至不再尊重师父。多含贬义，指忘恩负义。
explanation_english: An idiom that describes a situation where the student surpasses the teacher in skill and knowledge, sometimes implying that the student no longer respects or needs the teacher. Often carries a negative connotation, suggesting ingratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家叻咗咁多，完全唔記得當初係邊個教佢，真係「敎識徒弟冇師父」！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 lek1 zo2 gam3 do1, jyun4 cyun4 m4 gei3 dak1 dong1 co1 hai6 bin1 go3 gaau3 keoi5, zan1 hai6 "gaau3 sik1 tou4 dai2 mou5 si1 fu2"!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在这么厉害，完全不记得当初是谁教他的，真是“教会徒弟，饿死师傅”！
examples.english_sentence: He's so skilled now and completely forgot who taught him in the beginning, it's really a case of 'teach a disciple, and you have no master'!

english_meaning: to give directions; to show the way; to offer advice; to guide
explanation_mandarin: 提供方向，指引路径或提供建议。
explanation_english: To provide directions, guide someone on a path, or offer advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識去果度，你可唔可以敎下路啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 heoi3 gwo2 dou6, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaau3 haa5 lou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不认识去那里，你可以不可以指点一下路啊？
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to get there, can you give me directions?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢方面好有經驗，問下佢，佢會敎你路嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 fong1 min6 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6, man6 haa5 keoi5, keoi5 wui5 gaau3 nei5 lou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这方面很有经验，问问他，他会给你建议的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very experienced in this area, ask him, he will give you advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫幫手敎下路，我真係唔識搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 bong1 sau2 gaau3 haa5 lou6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 sik1 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦帮帮忙指点一下，我真的不知道怎么弄。
examples.english_sentence: Please help and give me some advice, I really don't know how to do it.

english_meaning: Hong Kong Institute of Education (HKIEd) / Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK) (abbreviation)
explanation_mandarin: “敎院”是“香港教育学院”或其后续更名“香港教育大学”的简称。香港教育学院后来升格为大学，并改名为香港教育大学。口语中仍常使用“敎院”来指代该大学。
explanation_english: "敎院" (gaau3 jyun2*) is the abbreviation for "Hong Kong Institute of Education (HKIEd)" or its later name "Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK)". The Hong Kong Institute of Education was later upgraded to a university and renamed the Education University of Hong Kong. However, people often still use "敎院" to refer to the university in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊敎院，想做老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gan2 gaau3 jyun2, soeng2 zou6 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香港教育大学读书，想当老师。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying at the Education University of Hong Kong and wants to become a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個表妹舊年由敎院畢業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 biu2 mui6 gau6 nin4 jau4 gaau3 jyun2 bat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的表妹去年从香港教育大学毕业了。
examples.english_sentence: My cousin graduated from the Education University of Hong Kong last year.

english_meaning: quick; agile; sensitive; clever; sharp
explanation_mandarin: 指反应快，感觉灵敏，或做事动作迅速。
explanation_english: Refers to being quick, having sensitive senses, or being swift in action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好敏捷，做嘢好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 man5 git3, zou6 je5 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很敏捷，做事很快。
examples.english_sentence: He is very agile and works very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對藥物好敏感，食錯嘢好易出疹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 joek6 mat6 hou2 man5 gam2, sik6 co3 je5 hou2 ji6 ceot1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对药物很敏感，吃错东西很容易出疹子。
examples.english_sentence: He is very sensitive to medication; he easily gets a rash if he eats something wrong.

english_meaning: sensitive
explanation_mandarin: 容易受到外界刺激而产生反应的；感觉敏锐的。
explanation_english: Easily affected by external stimuli; highly perceptive; sensitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲皮膚好敏感，用啲化妝品要好小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 pei4 fu1 hou2 man5 gam2, yung6 di1 faa3 zong1 ban2 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的皮肤很敏感，用化妆品要很小心。
examples.english_sentence: My skin is very sensitive, I need to be very careful when using cosmetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好敏感，講嘢要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 man5 gam2, gong2 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她这个人很敏感，说话要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a very sensitive person, you need to be careful when speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近啲新聞都好敏感，好多嘢都唔講得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 di1 san1 man2 dou1 hou2 man5 gam2, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 gong2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近的新闻都很敏感，很多东西都不能说。
examples.english_sentence: The news has been very sensitive lately, there are many things that can't be said.

english_meaning: agile; nimble; quick; prompt
explanation_mandarin: 动作迅速灵活；反应灵敏。
explanation_english: Quick and nimble in movement or thought; responsive and alert.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身手敏捷，好快就爬上咗棵樹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 sau2 man5 git6, hou2 faai3 zau6 paa4 soeng5 zo2 fo2 syu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身手敏捷，很快就爬上了一棵树。
examples.english_sentence: He is agile and quickly climbed up a tree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個足球員嘅反應好敏捷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zuk1 kau4 jyun4 ge3 faan2 jing3 hou2 man5 git6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个足球运动员的反应很敏捷。
examples.english_sentence: This football player's reaction is very quick.

english_meaning: acute, sharp, keen, perceptive
explanation_mandarin: 指感觉灵敏，观察力强。
explanation_english: Describes being sensitive and having a strong sense of observation; perceptive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅觀察力好敏銳，好快就睇穿咗件事嘅真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gun1 caat3 lik6 hou2 man5 jeoi6, hou2 faai3 zau6 tai2 cyun1 zo2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的观察力很敏锐，很快就看穿了事情的真相。
examples.english_sentence: His observation skills are very sharp, he quickly saw through the truth of the matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個記者好敏銳，問嘅問題都好尖銳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei2 ze2 hou2 man5 jeoi6, man6 ge3 man6 tai4 dou1 hou2 zim1 jeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个记者很敏锐，问的问题都很尖锐。
examples.english_sentence: This reporter is very perceptive, and the questions asked are sharp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對味道嘅感覺好敏銳喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 mei6 dou6 ge3 gam2 gok3 hou2 man5 jeoi6 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对味道的感觉很敏锐啊！
examples.english_sentence: Your sense of taste is very acute!

english_meaning: Sharp; keen; acute; perceptive
explanation_mandarin: 形容感觉灵敏，判断准确。
explanation_english: Describing someone who is sharp, keen, and able to perceive things accurately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅觀察力好敏銳，好快就睇穿咗件事嘅真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gun1 caat3 lik6 hou2 man5 jeoi6, hou2 faai3 zau6 tai2 cyun1 zo2 gin6 si6 ge3 zan1 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的观察力很敏锐，很快就看穿了事情的真相。
examples.english_sentence: His observation skills are very sharp, he quickly saw through the truth of the matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對時裝潮流好敏銳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 si4 zong1 ciu4 lau4 hou2 man5 jeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对时尚潮流很敏锐。
examples.english_sentence: He is very perceptive about fashion trends.

english_meaning: Sharp, keen, acute, perceptive
explanation_mandarin: 指感觉灵敏，眼光锐利。
explanation_english: Refers to being sensitive, sharp-sighted, or perceptive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅觀察力好敏鋭，一睇就知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gun1 caat3 lik6 hou2 man5 jeoi6, jat1 tai2 zau6 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的观察力很敏锐，一看就知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: His observation skills are very sharp; he knows what happened at a glance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個記者嘅政治觸覺非常敏鋭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei3 ze2 ge3 zing3 zi6 zuk1 gok3 fei1 soeng4 man5 jeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个记者的政治触觉非常敏锐。
examples.english_sentence: This reporter has a very keen political sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對市場變化非常敏鋭，所以好快就做出正確嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 si5 coeng4 bin3 faa3 fei1 soeng4 man5 jeoi6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 zou6 ceot1 zing3 kok3 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对市场变化非常敏锐，所以很快就做出了正确的决定。
examples.english_sentence: He is very perceptive to market changes, so he quickly made the correct decision.

english_meaning: to save, to rescue, to help, to deliver
explanation_mandarin: 从危险或困境中解脱出来，使人或物避免遭受损害或死亡。
explanation_english: To save, rescue, or deliver someone or something from danger or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救命呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 ming6 aa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救命啊！
examples.english_sentence: Help! Save my life!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員救咗好多人出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 gau3 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员救出了很多人出来。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters rescued many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要救地球！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gau3 dei6 kau4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要拯救地球！
examples.english_sentence: We need to save the Earth!

english_meaning: Savior, Messiah
explanation_mandarin: 拯救世人的主。比喻能够解除困难、带来希望的人。
explanation_english: One who saves the world; a savior; a messiah. Figuratively, someone who can solve difficulties and bring hope.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住有人會做你嘅救世主啊，自己搞掂佢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nam2 zyu6 jau5 jan4 wui5 zou6 nei5 ge3 gau3 sai3 zyu2 aa3, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想着会有人做你的救世主，自己解决吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't expect someone to be your savior, solve it yourself!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日覺得自己係救世主咁款，咩都要管。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hai6 gau3 sai3 zyu2 gam2 kwan2, me1 dou1 jiu3 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是觉得自己是救世主一样，什么都要管。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks he's some kind of savior, meddling in everything.

english_meaning: The Salvation Army
explanation_mandarin: 基督教慈善组织，致力于帮助穷人和有需要的人。
explanation_english: A Christian charitable organization committed to helping the poor and needy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺街邊見到救世軍嘅人籌款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 gin3 dou2 gau3 sai3 gwan1 ge3 jan4 cau4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常在街边看到救世军的人筹款。
examples.english_sentence: They often see people from the Salvation Army fundraising on the streets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救世軍嘅服務範圍好廣，包括派飯、提供庇護同埋職業培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 sai3 gwan1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 faan6 wai4 hou2 gwong2, baau1 kwut3 paai3 faan6, tai4 gung1 bei3 huk1 tung4 mai4 zik1 jip6 pui4 fun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救世军的服务范围很广，包括派饭、提供庇护和职业培训。
examples.english_sentence: The Salvation Army's services are wide-ranging, including distributing meals, providing shelter, and offering vocational training.

english_meaning: Savior; rescuer; one who saves or helps
explanation_mandarin: 指能够拯救别人于危难中的人或事物，通常带有感激或敬佩的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or thing that can save others from danger or difficulty, often with a sense of gratitude or admiration. It can be used literally or figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係我嘅救主啊，如果唔係你，我唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gau3 zyu2 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 nei5, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是我的救星啊，如果不是你，我都不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: You are really my savior! If it weren't for you, I wouldn't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，好彩有佢幫手整返好，佢簡直係我嘅救主。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, hou2 coi2 jau5 keoi5 bong1 sau2 zing2 faan1 hou2, keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gau3 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，幸好有他帮忙修好，他简直是我的救星。
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke down. Luckily, he helped fix it. He's practically my savior.

english_meaning: to save the nation from extinction; national salvation
explanation_mandarin: 拯救國家，使其免於滅亡。
explanation_english: To save the nation from extinction, often used in the context of a crisis or threat to national survival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺嗰個危急嘅關頭，好多人都諗住救亡圖存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 go2 go3 ngai4 gap1 ge3 gwaan1 tau4, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 nam2 zyu6 gau3 mong4 tou4 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在那个危急的关头，很多人都想着救亡图存。
examples.english_sentence: At that critical moment, many people were thinking of saving the nation and seeking survival.

english_meaning: first aid; to give first aid
explanation_mandarin: 指在意外或疾病发生时，给予伤者或病人及时的初步处理和照顾。
explanation_english: To give first aid; the act of providing immediate medical assistance to an injured or ill person before professional medical help arrives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋即刻幫個傷者救傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zik1 hak1 bong1 go3 soeng1 ze2 gau3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们立刻帮伤者急救。
examples.english_sentence: They immediately gave first aid to the injured person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 識得基本救傷知識好緊要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 dak1 gei1 bun2 gau3 soeng1 zi1 sik1 hou2 gan2 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 懂得基本的急救知识非常重要。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing basic first aid knowledge is very important.

english_meaning: ambulance
explanation_mandarin: 运送伤病员的车辆。
explanation_english: A vehicle equipped for taking sick or injured people to and from hospital, especially in emergencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋即刻call咗架救傷車嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zik1 hak1 call zo2 gaa3 gau3 soeng1 ce1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们立刻叫了一辆救护车来。
examples.english_sentence: They immediately called an ambulance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到警笛聲，知道有救傷車經過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 ging2 dik6 seng1, zi1 dou3 jau5 gau3 soeng1 ce1 ging1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到警笛声，知道有救护车经过。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the siren, I knew an ambulance was passing by.

english_meaning: Reinforcements; Savior; Someone who comes to the rescue
explanation_mandarin: 指前来救援的军队或人员；比喻在困难时出现，能够提供帮助的人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to reinforcement troops or personnel; figuratively, someone or something that appears in times of difficulty and can provide assistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次冇佢哋嚟做救兵，我哋實死梗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 mou5 keoi5 dei6 lai4 zou6 gau3 bing1, ngo5 dei6 sat6 si2 gang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次如果没有他们来当救兵，我们肯定完蛋。
examples.english_sentence: If they hadn't come to the rescue this time, we would definitely be finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵咗個電腦高手嚟做救兵，幫佢搞掂晒啲電腦問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 zo2 go3 din6 nou5 gou1 sau2 lai4 zou6 gau3 bing1, bong1 keoi5 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 din6 nou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他找了个电脑高手来当救兵，帮他解决了所有的电脑问题。
examples.english_sentence: He found a computer expert to come to the rescue and solve all his computer problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿哥係佢嘅救兵，有乜事都靠佢阿哥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 go1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 gau3 bing1, jau5 mat1 si6 dou1 kaau3 keoi5 aa3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他哥哥是他的救星，有什么事都靠他哥哥。
examples.english_sentence: His brother is his savior; he relies on his brother for everything.

english_meaning: to rescue, to save
explanation_mandarin: 将某人或某物从危险或困境中解救出来。
explanation_english: To rescue someone or something from danger or a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員成功救出所有被困嘅居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 sing4 gung1 gau3 ceot1 so2 jau5 bei6 kwan3 ge3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员成功救出了所有被困的居民。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters successfully rescued all the trapped residents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋合力救出咗嗰隻跌咗落水嘅小貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hap6 lik6 gau3 ceot1 zo2 go2 zek3 dit3 zo2 lok6 seoi2 ge3 siu2 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们合力救出了那只掉进水里的小猫。
examples.english_sentence: They worked together to rescue the kitten that had fallen into the water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方救出咗一批被綁架嘅人質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 gau3 ceot1 zo2 jat1 pai1 bei6 bong2 gaa3 ge3 jan4 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方救出了一批被绑架的人质。
examples.english_sentence: The police rescued a group of kidnapped hostages.

english_meaning: to help and rescue; to aid
explanation_mandarin: 帮助和救援。通常用于紧急情况或需要帮助的情况。
explanation_english: To provide help and rescue. Usually used in emergency situations or when help is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋俾山泥埋咗，好彩消防員及時救助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 saan1 nei4 maai4 zo2, hou2 coi3消fung2 jyun4 kap6 si4 gau3 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被泥石流掩埋了，幸好消防员及时救助。
examples.english_sentence: They were buried by the landslide, luckily the firefighters provided timely help and rescue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會提供緊急救助俾災民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 tai4 cung1 gan2 gap1 gau3 zo6 bei2 zoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会提供紧急救助给灾民。
examples.english_sentence: The government will provide emergency aid to disaster victims.

english_meaning: Help! Save me!
explanation_mandarin: 呼救，请求帮助；救助生命。
explanation_english: To cry for help; to ask for rescue; to save someone's life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救命呀！有人搶嘢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 ming6 aa3! jau5 jan4 coeng2 je5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救命啊！有人抢东西啊！

examples.english_sentence: He's drowning, quickly save him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢科好難讀，救命呀，考試點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 hou2 naan4 duk6, gau3 ming6 aa3, haau2 si3 dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这门课很难学，救命啊，考试怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: This course is very difficult, help me! What am I going to do about the exam?

english_meaning: Lifeline bell; emergency bell
explanation_mandarin: 指在紧急情况下可以求救的铃铛或装置，通常用于老人院、医院等需要紧急救援的场所。
explanation_english: Refers to a bell or device that can be used to call for help in an emergency. It's usually used in places like nursing homes or hospitals where emergency assistance is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間老人院每張床邊都有個救命鐘，方便阿婆有事嗰陣可以即刻撳鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 lou5 jan5 jyun2 mui5 zoeng1 cong4 bin1 dou1 jau5 go3 gau3 ming6 zung1, fong1 bin6 aa3 po4 jau5 si6 go2 zan6 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 gam2 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家养老院每张床边都有一个救命铃，方便老奶奶有事的时候可以立刻按铃。
examples.english_sentence: Each bed in that nursing home has a lifeline bell so the old ladies can press it immediately if something happens.

english_meaning: to save the country; to save the nation
explanation_mandarin: 拯救国家，使国家免于危难。
explanation_english: To save the country; to rescue the nation from danger or collapse. Often used in a historical or political context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅一生都奉獻俾救國事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jat1 sang1 dou1 fung6 hin3 bei2 gau3 gwok3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一生都奉献给了救国事业。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his whole life to the cause of saving the country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時好多人都想投身救國運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 tau4 san1 gau3 gwok3 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时很多人都想投身救国运动。
examples.english_sentence: At that time, many people wanted to devote themselves to the national salvation movement.

english_meaning: to rescue the market, market intervention, bail out the market
explanation_mandarin: 指政府或相关机构采取措施，防止股市或经济出现崩盘或严重下滑的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the actions taken by the government or relevant institutions to prevent a stock market or economy from crashing or experiencing a severe downturn. It often involves injecting capital or implementing policies to stabilize the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府出咗好多招嚟救市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 ziu1 lai4 gau3 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府出了很多招来救市。
examples.english_sentence: The government has implemented many measures to rescue the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市跌到咁，睇嚟都要有人救市先得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 dit3 dou3 gam3, tai2 lai4 dou1 jiu3 jau5 jan4 gau3 si5 sin1 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市跌成这样，看来也需要有人救市才行了。
examples.english_sentence: The property market has fallen so much, it seems like someone needs to bail it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果股市再跌，恐怕冇人救市都唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gu2 si5 zoi3 dit3, hung2 paa3 mou5 jan4 gau3 si5 dou1 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果股市再跌，恐怕没人救市都不行。
examples.english_sentence: If the stock market falls further, I'm afraid it won't work even with a bailout.

english_meaning: to meet an urgent need; to provide emergency relief
explanation_mandarin: 指应对紧急情况，解决燃眉之急。
explanation_english: To provide urgent assistance or relief in an emergency; to meet an immediate need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇錢交租，我唯有救急幫佢一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 cin2 gaau1 zou1, ngo5 wai4 jau5 gau3 gap1 bong1 keoi5 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没钱交房租，我只好救急帮他一次。
examples.english_sentence: He has no money to pay the rent, so I have to help him out in this emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲錢係留嚟救急用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cin2 hai6 lau4 lai4 gau3 gap1 yung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些钱是留着救急用的。
examples.english_sentence: This money is kept for emergency use.

english_meaning: To relieve danger and support those in distress; to help those in urgent need
explanation_mandarin: 指帮助处在危急困境中的人，解救他们的危难。
explanation_english: To help people who are in urgent need and distress, relieving them from their difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁好人，成日都救急扶危嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hou2 jan4, seng4 jat6 dou1 gau3 gap1 fu4 ngai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个好人，总是救急扶危。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a good person, always helping those in urgent need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做慈善就係要救急扶危，幫助啲有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 ci4 sin6 zau6 hai6 jiu3 gau3 gap1 fu4 ngai4, bong1 zo6 di1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做慈善就是要救急扶危，帮助那些有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: Doing charity is about relieving danger and supporting those in distress, helping those in need.

english_meaning: rescue; salvage
explanation_mandarin: 解救，援助，使脱离危险境地。
explanation_english: To rescue; to salvage; to provide assistance to someone in a dangerous or distressed situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員趕去現場救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 gon2 heoi3 hin2 coeng4 gau3 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员赶去现场救援。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters rushed to the scene to carry out rescue operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成功救援咗被困喺山上面嘅行山人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 gung1 gau3 wun4 zo2 bei6 kwan3 hai2 saan1 soeng6 min6 ge3 haang4 saan1 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成功救援了被困在山上的人士。
examples.english_sentence: They successfully rescued the hikers who were trapped on the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望救援隊可以搵返啲失蹤嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gau3 wun4 deoi2 ho2 ji5 wan2 faan1 di1 sat1 zung1 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望救援队可以找回失踪的人。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, the rescue team can find the missing people.

english_meaning: savior, rescuer
explanation_mandarin: 比喻拯救人民或使摆脱困境的人或事物。
explanation_english: A person or thing that saves people from danger or helps them overcome a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簡直係我嘅救星，如果唔係佢幫手，我唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zik6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gau3 sing1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5 bong1 sau2, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他简直是我的救星，如果不是他帮忙，我不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: He is simply my savior. If he hadn't helped, I wouldn't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新政策對我哋公司嚟講，簡直係救星嚟㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 zing3 caak3 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 lai4 gong2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 gau3 sing1 lai4 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个新政策对我们公司来说，简直是救星啊！
examples.english_sentence: This new policy is simply a savior for our company!

english_meaning: to treat (medically); to rescue and treat
explanation_mandarin: 用医疗手段进行抢救和治疗。
explanation_english: To provide medical treatment to rescue and heal someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生盡力救治病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 zeon6 lik6 gau3 zi6 beng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生尽力救治病人。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor tried his best to treat the patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾車撞親，好彩送院救治得及時。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 che1 zong6 chan1, hou2 choi2 sung3 jyun2 gau3 zi6 dak1 gap6 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被车撞了，幸好送院救治及时。
examples.english_sentence: He was hit by a car, luckily he was sent to the hospital for treatment in time.

english_meaning: to rescue; to save (a life); to revive; to bring back to life
explanation_mandarin: 使失去知觉或濒临死亡的人或事物恢复生机。
explanation_english: To restore someone unconscious or near death to life; to revive someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生好叻啊，竟然可以救活佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 hou2 lek1 aa3, ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 gau3 wut6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生很厉害啊，竟然可以救活他。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor is so skilled, he could actually save him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌落水，好彩有人救活佢咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 lok6 seoi2, hou2 coi2 jau5 jan4 gau3 wut6 keoi5 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掉进水里，幸好有人救活了他。
examples.english_sentence: He fell into the water, luckily someone saved him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盡力去救活呢間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 lik6 heoi3 gau3 wut6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尽力去救活这家公司。
examples.english_sentence: We must do our best to save this company.

english_meaning: to relieve (disaster etc); to help the needy; relief (aid)
explanation_mandarin: 动词：给予援助，帮助受灾或生活困难的人。名词：给予的援助或帮助。
explanation_english: Verb: to provide aid or assistance to those affected by disaster or living in poverty. Noun: the aid or assistance given.
