examples.english_sentence: The exam requires writing a piece of prose on the topic of Hong Kong's history.

mandarin_meaning: 闲逛; 游荡; 无所事事
english_meaning: To stroll around idly; to loaf around; to wander aimlessly; to hang out doing nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指没有明确目的地或目的，到处闲逛或游荡。 多指无所事事，打发时间。
explanation_english: Refers to wandering or strolling around without a specific destination or purpose. It often implies being idle and killing time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假咪掛住喺屋企瞓覺啦，出去散下春啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 mai1 gwaa3 zyu6 hai2 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3 laa1, cheut1 heui3 saan3 haa5 cheun1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假别总是在家睡觉，出去散散步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just sleep at home during the holidays, go out for a stroll.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺街度散春，唔知做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 gaai1 dou6 saan3 cheun1, m4 zi1 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都在街上闲逛，不知道在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always loafing around on the street, I don't know what he's doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班後生仔冇嘢做，咪喺公園散春囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 hau6 saang1 zai2 mou5 je5 zou6, mai1 hai2 gung1 yun2 saan3 cheun1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些年轻人没事做，就在公园闲逛吧。
examples.english_sentence: Those young people have nothing to do, so they just hang out in the park.

english_meaning: All gone; all dispersed; completely scattered; used up
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部都已经消失、分散、用完的状态。
explanation_english: Indicates a state where everything is gone, dispersed, used up, or scattered completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲錢俾佢賭散晒啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cin2 bei2 keoi5 dou2 saan3 saai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱都被他赌光了！
examples.english_sentence: All the money has been gambled away by him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人一聽到有事就散晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 jat1 ting1 dou2 jau5 si6 zau6 saan3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人一听到有事就都散开了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as those people heard something was wrong, they all dispersed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨俾人搶散晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 bei2 jan4 coeng2 saan3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 货物被人抢光了。
examples.english_sentence: All the goods were snatched up.

english_meaning: Finishing work signal; signal to end work; time to go home from work
explanation_mandarin: 过去旧式工厂或作坊，会在收工的时候敲锣，通知工人下班。散更鑼就是指收工的锣声。比喻收工时间，或者可以离开工作岗位。
explanation_english: In old factories or workshops, a gong would be struck to signal the end of the workday. '散更鑼' refers to this gong sound, symbolizing the end of work and the time to leave the workplace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日準時五點半打散更鑼，唔好遲到啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zeon2 si4 ng5 dim2 bun3 daa2 saan3 gaang1 lo4, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天准时五点半敲收工号，不要迟到啊！
examples.english_sentence: The finishing gong will sound precisely at 5:30 tomorrow, don't be late!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好眼瞓啊，幾時先有散更鑼打？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 ngaan5 feon3 aa3, gei2 si4 sin1 jau5 saan3 gaang1 lo4 daa2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好困啊，什么时候才能收工？
examples.english_sentence: I'm so sleepy, when will it be time to go home from work?

english_meaning: Adjourn a meeting; Meeting dismissed
explanation_mandarin: 结束会议，宣布会议结束。
explanation_english: To end or dismiss a meeting; to adjourn the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好喇，時間差唔多，我哋散會啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa3, si4 gaan3 caa1 m4 do1, ngo5 dei6 saan3 wui2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了，时间差不多了，我们散会吧。
examples.english_sentence: Alright, time is almost up, let's adjourn the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 主席宣佈散會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 zik6 syun1 bou3 saan3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 主席宣布散会。
examples.english_sentence: The chairman announced the adjournment of the meeting.

english_meaning: to break up (romantic relationship, team, etc.), to disband, to end (a project)
explanation_mandarin: 指团体、组织或关系解散、结束。 常用于情侣分手，或团队、项目解散。
explanation_english: Refers to the dissolution or ending of a group, organization, or relationship. Often used to describe the breakup of a romantic relationship, or the disbanding of a team or project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗五年拖，最後都係散檔收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 ng5 nin4 to1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 saan3 dong3 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈了五年恋爱，最后还是分手了。
examples.english_sentence: They dated for five years, but in the end, they broke up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個project做完，我哋個team都散檔㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 project zou6 jyun4, ngo5 dei6 go3 team dou1 saan3 dong3 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 项目做完了，我们的团队也解散了。
examples.english_sentence: The project is finished, so our team has disbanded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司經營唔掂，聽日就要散檔啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 jing4 m4 dim6, ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 saan3 dong3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司经营不善，明天就要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The company is poorly managed and will close down tomorrow.

english_meaning: to take a walk; to stroll
explanation_mandarin: 为了休闲放松而漫步。
explanation_english: To walk leisurely for relaxation and enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食完飯去海邊散步啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 saan3 bou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃完饭去海边散步吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a walk by the seaside after dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每日都會喺公園散步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 saan3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都会在公园散步。
examples.english_sentence: He takes a walk in the park every day.

english_meaning: To disperse, to break up (a gathering); to finish work and leave; to leak information, to warn others about imminent danger
explanation_mandarin: 原指人群解散、分散。现在也指工作结束，下班离开。在黑社会语境中，也指泄露消息，警告他人，让他们离开以避免危险。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a crowd dispersing or breaking up. It now also refers to finishing work and leaving (going off work). In a triad context, it also means leaking information to warn others, allowing them to leave to avoid danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，聽日考試，今晚早啲散水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, ting1 jat6 haau2 si5, gam1 maan5 zou2 di1 saan3 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，明天考试，今晚早点结束吧。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, there's an exam tomorrow, let's break up early tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話今日要OT，唔知幾時先散水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 OT, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 saan3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说今天要加班，不知道什么时候才能下班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we need to work overtime today, I don't know when we can finish work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬嚟緊，快啲散水啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 lai4 gan2, faai3 di1 saan3 seoi2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察要来了，快点散了吧！
examples.english_sentence: The cops are coming, disperse quickly!

english_meaning: Farewell treats/cake; treats given by someone leaving a job to their colleagues
explanation_mandarin: 指员工离职时，为了感谢同事的帮助和合作，而请大家吃的点心或饼干等食物。
explanation_english: Refers to the treats, usually cakes, pastries or biscuits, given by an employee who is leaving a job to their colleagues as a token of appreciation for their help and cooperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日最後一日返工，所以今日派散水餅俾我哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 jat6 faan1 gung1, so2 ji5 gam1 jat6 paai3 saan3 seoi2 beng2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天最后一天上班，所以今天发离职饼给我们吃。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is his last day at work, so he's giving out farewell treats for us to eat today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年走咗好多人，日日都有散水餅食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 zau2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4, jat1 jat6 dou1 jau5 saan3 seoi2 beng2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年走了很多人，每天都有离职饼吃。
examples.english_sentence: So many people have left this year, there are farewell treats to eat every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遞咗信喇，諗住買啲咩散水餅好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 zo2 seon3 laa3, nam2 zyu2 maai5 di1 me1 saan3 seoi2 beng2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经递交了辞职信了，在想买些什么离职饼好。
examples.english_sentence: I've already handed in my resignation letter, thinking about what kind of farewell treats I should buy.

english_meaning: loose sand; a divided or disorganized group; lacking cohesion
explanation_mandarin: 比喻组织涣散，没有凝聚力，像一盘散沙一样。
explanation_english: Metaphor for a group or organization that is disorganized, lacking cohesion, and easily scattered, like loose sand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家呢個團隊好似一盤散沙咁，做咩都做唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ni1 go3 teoi1 deoi2 hou2 ci5 jat1 pun4 saan3 saa1 gam2, zou6 me1 dou1 zou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的这个团队就像一盘散沙，做什么都做不好。
examples.english_sentence: This team is like loose sand, they can't do anything well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔團結，就會變成散沙，俾人擊破。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 tyun4 git3, zau6 wui bin3 sing4 saan3 saa1, bei2 jan4 gik1 po3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不团结，就会变成一盘散沙，被人击破。
examples.english_sentence: If we are not united, we will become loose sand and be defeated.

english_meaning: lax, undisciplined, lacking focus, disorganized
explanation_mandarin: 形容组织、团队、气氛等松散，缺乏凝聚力；也可以形容人精神状态松懈。
explanation_english: Describes a group, team, or atmosphere as being loose, lacking cohesion; can also describe a person's mental state as relaxed and unfocused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲同事做嘢散渙渙噉，搞到成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 tung4 si6 zou6 je5 saan3 wun6 wun6 gam2, gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近同事们工作很散漫，导致经常出错。
examples.english_sentence: The colleagues have been very lax in their work recently, leading to frequent mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅管理好散渙，所以好多員工都想走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 hou2 saan3 wun6, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 gung1 jyun4 dou1 soeng2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的管理很涣散，所以很多员工都想离开。
examples.english_sentence: The management of this company is very disorganized, so many employees want to leave.

english_meaning: lax; sloppy; undisciplined; careless
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事不认真、不集中，纪律性差。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is not serious, not focused, and lacks discipline in their work or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好散漫，成日都遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 saan3 maan6, seng4 jat6 dou1 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很散漫，总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He's very lax in his work and is always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁散漫啦，快啲做晒啲功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 saan3 maan6 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 saai3 di1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么散漫了，快点做完功课。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sloppy, finish your homework quickly.

english_meaning: to dissipate heat; to cool down; heat dissipation
explanation_mandarin: 使热量散发出去，降低温度。
explanation_english: To dissipate heat, reducing temperature; cooling down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦用咗好耐，要散熱先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 yung6 zo2 hou2 noi6, yiu3 saan3 jit6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑用了很久，要散热才可以。
examples.english_sentence: This computer has been used for a long time, it needs to cool down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動完之後，最好飲啲嘢散熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 yun4 zi1 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 yam2 di1 ye5 saan3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动完之后，最好喝点东西散热。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising, it's best to drink something to cool down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個散熱器嘅效果好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saan3 jit6 hei3 ge3 haau6 gwo2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个散热器的效果很好。
examples.english_sentence: The effect of this heat sink is very good.

english_meaning: to emit, to radiate, to give off, to distribute
explanation_mandarin: 指发出、散布某种东西（光、热、气味等）。 也可指分发、散布。
explanation_english: To emit or radiate something (light, heat, smell, etc.). Can also refer to distributing or giving out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢朵花散發出好香嘅香味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 do2 faa1 saan3 faat3 chut1 hou2 hoeng1 ge3 hoeng1 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这朵花散发出很香的味道。
examples.english_sentence: This flower emits a very fragrant scent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢散發住自信嘅氣場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saan3 faat3 zyu6 zi6 seon3 ge3 hei3 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他散发着自信的气场。
examples.english_sentence: He exudes an aura of confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司喺街度散發傳單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hai2 gaai1 dou6 saan3 faat3 cyun4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司在街上散发传单。
examples.english_sentence: The company is distributing leaflets on the street.

english_meaning: short-term rent; to sublet a room
explanation_mandarin: 指短期租赁房屋或者将房屋的一部分分租出去。
explanation_english: Refers to renting a house for a short period or subletting a part of a house to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近樓市唔好，好多人都將自己間屋散租出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 lau4 si5 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 gaan1 uk1 saan3 zou1 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近楼市不好，很多人都把自己的房子短租出去。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, the property market hasn't been good, so many people are short-term renting out their apartments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢散租咗間房俾個學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saan3 zou1 zo2 gaan1 fong2 bei2 go3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把一间房分租给了一个学生。
examples.english_sentence: He sublet a room to a student.

english_meaning: small change, loose change
explanation_mandarin: 指小额的硬币或纸币，用于日常消费。
explanation_english: Refers to small denominations of coins or banknotes, used for daily transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我得返散紙，唔知夠唔夠俾錢呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 dak1 faan1 saan3 zi2, m4 zi1 gau3 m4 gau3 bei2 cin2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我只有零钱了，不知道够不够付钱呢？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I only have loose change left, I wonder if it's enough to pay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲散紙擺晒入個錢罌度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 saan3 zi2 baai2 saai3 jap6 go3 cin2 aang1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把零钱都放进存钱罐里了。
examples.english_sentence: He put all the loose change into the piggy bank.

english_meaning: small change bag; loose change; small denominations of money
explanation_mandarin: 装零钱的袋子；也指代零钱本身，多指小面额的钞票和硬币。
explanation_english: A bag or container for holding loose change; also refers to the loose change itself, typically small denomination notes and coins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，比個散紙包我換啲紙幣得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, bei2 go3 saan3 zi2 baau1 ngo5 wun6 di1 zi2 bai6 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问，可以把我的零钱袋换成一些纸币吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could I exchange my bag of loose change for some banknotes?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我袋入面好多散紙包，重到死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 doi2 jap6 min6 hou2 do1 saan3 zi2 baau1, cung5 dou3 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的口袋里有很多零钱，重死了。
examples.english_sentence: I have a lot of loose change in my pocket, it's so heavy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭巴士最好準備定散紙包，方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 baa1 si2 zeoi3 hou2 zeon2 bei6 ding6 saan3 zi2 baau1, fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐公共汽车最好准备好零钱，方便一些。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to prepare some loose change when taking the bus, it's more convenient.

english_meaning: to scatter, to be scattered; scattered, dispersed
explanation_mandarin: 指分散、落下；形容分散、散乱的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to scattering, falling; also used to describe a scattered or dispersed state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲葉喺地下散落得到處都係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jip6 hai2 dei6 haa2 saan3 lok6 dak1 dou3 chu3 dou1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叶子在地上散落得到处都是。
examples.english_sentence: The leaves are scattered all over the ground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅行李散落咗喺機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang4 lei5 saan3 lok6 zo2 hai2 gei1 cheung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的行李散落在机场了。
examples.english_sentence: Their luggage was scattered at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲玩具散落喺個房度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 wun2 geoi6 saan3 lok6 hai2 go3 fong2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩具散落在房间里。
examples.english_sentence: The toys are scattered in the room.

english_meaning: loose packaging; unpackaged; bulk
explanation_mandarin: 指没有包装或包装简陋的商品；也可形容人行为散漫，不拘小节。
explanation_english: Refers to goods without packaging or with simple packaging; can also describe someone who is casual, uninhibited, and doesn't pay attention to details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買啲散裝嘅糖，平啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 di1 saan2 zong1 ge3 tong2, peng4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买些散装的糖，便宜点。
examples.english_sentence: Let's buy some unpackaged candies, they are cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好散裝，成日唔記得帶嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 saan2 zong1, seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很散漫，经常忘记带东西。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very casual person and often forgets to bring things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲藥係散裝嘅，冇盒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 joek6 hai6 saan2 zong1 ge3, mou5 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些药是散装的，没有盒子。
examples.english_sentence: These medicines are unpackaged, there is no box.

english_meaning: To sell off stock (often at a discounted price); clearance sale
explanation_mandarin: 指商家为了清理库存，以较低的价格出售商品。
explanation_english: Refers to a merchant selling goods at a lower price in order to clear inventory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間舖頭執笠，依家散貨大平賣呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zap1 lap1, ji1 gaa1 saan3 fo3 daai6 peng4 maai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们那家店要倒闭了，现在清仓大甩卖！
examples.english_sentence: Their shop is closing down, so they're having a big clearance sale!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年尾啦，好多公司都散貨減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 mei5 laa1, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 saan3 fo3 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年底了，很多公司都在打折清货。
examples.english_sentence: It's the end of the year, many companies are having clearance sales with price reductions.

english_meaning: to buy in small quantities; to buy retail
explanation_mandarin: 指购买零散的商品，而非批量购买。
explanation_english: To buy items individually or in small quantities, rather than in bulk or wholesale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係散買幾粒糖食下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 saan3 maai5 gei2 lap1 tong2 sik6 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是零买几颗糖吃吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just buying a few candies to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間超級市場可以散買雞蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 ho2 ji5 saan3 maai5 gai1 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家超市可以零买鸡蛋。
examples.english_sentence: You can buy eggs individually at this supermarket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋通常都係散買生果，費事食唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 saan3 maai5 sang1 gwo2, fai3 si6 sik6 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们通常都零买水果，免得吃不完。
examples.english_sentence: We usually buy fruit in small quantities, so we don't end up wasting it.

english_meaning: to sell retail, to sell in small quantities, to sell piecemeal
explanation_mandarin: 以小份或单件的方式出售商品。
explanation_english: To sell goods in individual units or small quantities; to sell retail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲糖可以散賣㗎，你想要幾多呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 tong2 ho2 ji5 saan3 maai6 gaa3, nei5 soeng2 jiu3 gei2 do1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些糖可以零卖的，你想要多少啊？
examples.english_sentence: These candies can be sold individually, how many do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間舖頭主要係做批發，但都有散賣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 pou3 tau4 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 zou6 pai1 faat3, daan6 dou1 jau5 saan3 maai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的店铺主要是做批发，但也有零售的。
examples.english_sentence: Their shop mainly does wholesale, but they also do retail.

english_meaning: loose change, small change
explanation_mandarin: 指小额的硬币或纸币。
explanation_english: Refers to small denomination coins or banknotes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇散銀，得唔得八達通啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 saan3 ngan2, dak1 m4 dak1 baat3 daat6 tung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有零钱，可以用八达通吗？
examples.english_sentence: I don't have any loose change, can I use my Octopus card?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我畀散銀得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 bei2 saan3 ngan2 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我可以付零钱吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, can I pay with loose change?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你袋入面好多散銀喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 doi2 jip6 mui5 gin2 hou2 do1 saan3 ngan2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你口袋里好多零钱啊。
examples.english_sentence: You have a lot of loose change in your pocket.

english_meaning: to disperse; to scatter; to spread out; to break up (a crowd)
explanation_mandarin: 指人群、队伍等分散离开；或事物向四处散布。
explanation_english: Refers to a crowd, team, etc. dispersing and leaving; or things scattering in all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差佬嚟緊，大家散開啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 lou2 lai4 gan2, daai6 gaa1 saan3 hoi1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察来了，大家散开啊！
examples.english_sentence: The police are coming, everyone disperse!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會之後，大家散開做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 zi1 hau6, daai6 gaa1 saan3 hoi1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开会之后，大家散开工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: After the meeting, everyone disperse and get to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲傳聞散開得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 cyun4 man4 saan3 hoi1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谣言散播得很快。
examples.english_sentence: The rumors spread quickly.

english_meaning: to relieve a cold; to clear one's head; to relax and have fun; to unwind
explanation_mandarin: 本意指驱散风寒，治疗感冒。引申义指出去放松，消遣娱乐，减轻压力。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to dispelling wind-cold and treating a cold. By extension, it means to go out and relax, have fun, and relieve stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排壓力咁大，不如我哋去散散風啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai2 aat3 lik6 gam3 daai6, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 saan3 saan3 fung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近压力这么大，不如我们去散散心吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've been under so much stress lately, why don't we go out and relax?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲碗薑茶可以散風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 wun2 goeng1 caa4 ho2 ji5 saan3 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝碗姜茶可以祛风寒。
examples.english_sentence: Drinking a bowl of ginger tea can relieve a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試之後，成班同學去咗沙灘散風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si3 zi1 hau6, seng4 baan1 tung4 hok6 heoi3 zo2 saa1 taan1 saan3 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试之后，全班同学去了沙滩散心。
examples.english_sentence: After the exam, the whole class went to the beach to unwind.

english_meaning: Loose; scattered; not closely knit; disorganized
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物结构松散，不紧密。
explanation_english: Describes something that is loose, scattered, and not tightly organized or structured. Can also refer to a person who is disorganized or scatterbrained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人散颼颼嘅，成日唔記得嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 saan3 sau1 sau1 ge3, seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很散漫，经常忘记事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very disorganized person and often forgets things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司管理散颼颼，好多嘢都冇系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 saan3 sau1 sau1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 mou5 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司管理松散，很多事情都没有系统性。
examples.english_sentence: The management of this company is disorganized; many things lack a system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲頭髮散颼颼咁，梳返好佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tau4 faat3 saan3 sau1 sau1 gam2, so1 faan1 hou2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 头发这么散乱，梳整齐吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your hair is so loose, comb it properly.

english_meaning: à la carte; ordering individual dishes
explanation_mandarin: 指不包含在套餐内的，单独点的菜品。
explanation_english: Refers to ordering individual dishes from a menu, as opposed to a set meal or fixed-price menu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日食散餐，唔要套餐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 sik6 saan3 caan1, m4 jiu3 tou3 caan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天吃单点菜，不要套餐了。
examples.english_sentence: We'll order à la carte today, not the set meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅散餐都幾好食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 saan3 caan1 dou1 gei2 hou2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的单点菜都挺好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: The à la carte dishes at this restaurant are quite delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 恳切; 诚恳; 敦促
english_meaning: sincere; earnest; to urge; to press
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度真诚、恳切，或指催促、敦促。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude that is sincere and earnest, or refers to urging or pressing someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好敦厚㗎，唔會呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 deon1 hau5 gaa3, m4 wui5 aak1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很恳切，不会骗人。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very sincerely and wouldn't deceive anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要敦促政府解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deon1 cuk1 zing3 fu2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要敦促政府解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to urge the government to solve this problem.

english_meaning: urge, press, exhort
explanation_mandarin: 恳切地催促。
explanation_english: To urge earnestly; to press; to exhort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經敦促佢盡快提交報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 deon1 cuk1 keoi5 zeon6 faai3 tai4 gaau2 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经敦促他尽快提交报告。
examples.english_sentence: We have already urged him to submit the report as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該敦促發展商提供更多可負擔房屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 deon1 cuk1 faat3 zin2 soeng1 tig4 gung1 gang3 do1 ho2 fu6 daam1 fong4 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该敦促发展商提供更多可负担房屋。
examples.english_sentence: The government should urge developers to provide more affordable housing.

english_meaning: sexual intercourse, to have sexual relations
explanation_mandarin: 委婉说法，指夫妻之间的性行为。
explanation_english: A euphemism for sexual intercourse, referring to sexual relations between a married couple. It carries a traditional and sometimes conservative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋新婚燕爾，日日都敦倫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 san1 fan1 yin3 ji5, jat1 jat1 dou1 deon1 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们新婚燕尔，每天都性交。
examples.english_sentence: They are newlyweds, having sexual relations every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老一輩嘅人講嘢好含蓄，通常會用「敦倫」嚟代替「性交」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jat1 bui3 ge3 jan4 gong2 waa2 hou2 ham4 suk1, tung1 soeng4 wui5 yung6 "deon1 leon4" lai4 dai6 tai3 "sing3 gaau1".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老一辈的人说话很含蓄，通常会用“敦伦”来代替“性交”。
examples.english_sentence: The older generation is very discreet when speaking, and they often use "敦倫" instead of "性交".

english_meaning: honest and sincere; simple and honest; thick and heavy (often used to describe a person's personality as being honest and reliable)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人忠厚老实，待人诚恳。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is honest, sincere, and treats others with sincerity. It suggests a person of good character and integrity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好敦厚，唔會呃人嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 deon1 hau5, m4 wui5 aak1 jan4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很敦厚，不会骗人的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very honest and sincere person and wouldn't deceive anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺係個敦厚嘅老人家，成日幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 hai6 go3 deon1 hau5 ge3 lou5 jan4 gaa1, seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷是个敦厚的老人家，经常帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather is a kind and sincere old man who often helps others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅文字好敦厚，讀落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 man4 zi6 hou2 deon1 hau5, duk6 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的文字很朴实，读起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: His writing style is very simple and sincere, and it's comfortable to read.

english_meaning: to urge payment, to press for payment, to chase up money
explanation_mandarin: 催促别人按时或提前付款。
explanation_english: To urge someone to pay on time or ahead of schedule; to press for payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條數拖咗好耐喇，我哋要敦款先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sou3 to1 zo2 hou2 noi6 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deon1 fun2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔账拖了很久了，我们得催款才行。
examples.english_sentence: This bill has been outstanding for a long time, we need to chase up the payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日拖數，銀行都唔敢借錢俾佢，依家日日都俾人敦款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 to1 sou3, ngan4 hong4 dou1 m4 gam2 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5, ji1 gaa1 jat6 jat6 dou1 bei2 jan4 deon1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拖欠账款，银行都不敢借钱给他，现在每天都被人催款。
examples.english_sentence: He always defaults on payments, so the bank doesn't dare to lend him money. Now he's being chased for payment every day.

english_meaning: Dunhuang (a city in Gansu province, China; known for its Mogao Caves)
explanation_mandarin: 中国甘肃省的一个城市，以莫高窟而闻名。
explanation_english: A city in Gansu province, China, famous for the Mogao Caves (also known as the Thousand Buddha Grottoes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去敦煌睇下莫高窟呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 deon1 wong4 tai2 haa5 mok6 gou1 kut1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去敦煌看看莫高窟啊。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to go to Dunhuang to see the Mogao Caves.

english_meaning: sincerely invite; earnestly request
explanation_mandarin: 恭敬地请求或邀请。
explanation_english: To sincerely request or invite someone, usually with a formal tone and showing respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司敦請咗李教授嚟做顧問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 deon1 cing2 zo2 lei5 gau3 sau6 lai4 zou6 gu3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司恳请了李教授来做顾问。
examples.english_sentence: Our company sincerely invited Professor Li to be a consultant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要敦請佢嚟主持今晚嘅晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deon1 cing2 keoi5 lai4 zyu2 ci4 gam1 maan1 ge3 maan5 jin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想邀请他来主持今晚的晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: We would like to earnestly invite him to host tonight's dinner.

english_meaning: to relax, to loosen, to relieve (stress/tension)
explanation_mandarin: 使紧张的状态得到缓解，变得轻松。
explanation_english: To relax, loosen, or relieve a tense or stressed state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假咪就係想抖下，敨下囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 mai1 zau6 hai6 soeng2 dau2 haa5, tau2 haa5 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假不就是想休息一下，放松一下吗？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't the point of a holiday to rest and relax?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都唔駛咁緊張嘅，敨鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 ge3, tau2 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都不用那么紧张的，放松点啦。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so nervous, just relax a bit.

english_meaning: to take a deep breath (usually after a stressful situation); to breathe a sigh of relief
explanation_mandarin: 深呼吸，通常指在紧张或困难情况结束后，感到放松而深呼吸。
explanation_english: To take a deep breath, usually after a stressful or difficult situation, indicating relief and relaxation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完試喇，終於可以敨大氣啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 si5 laa3, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 tau2 daai6 hei3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完试了，终于可以松口气了！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is over, I can finally breathe a sigh of relief!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂曬啲嘢，我都要抖抖氣，敨大氣先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6晒啲嘢，ngo5 dou1 jiu3 dau2 dau2 hei3, tau2 daai6 hei3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把所有的事情都搞定了，我也要休息一下，先松口气才行。
examples.english_sentence: I've finished everything, I need to rest and take a breather, I need to breathe a sigh of relief first.

mandarin_meaning: 尊敬; 敬佩; 敬酒; 献
english_meaning: to respect; to admire; to offer politely; to present; to dedicate; to toast
explanation_mandarin: 表示尊敬、敬佩；献给；饮酒时举杯表示敬意。
explanation_english: To show respect or admiration; to offer something respectfully; to toast (someone with a drink).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好敬佩佢嘅毅力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ging3 pui3 keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常敬佩他的毅力。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire his perseverance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等我敬你一杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 ngo5 ging3 nei5 jat1 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我敬你一杯。
examples.english_sentence: Let me toast you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好敬老人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ging3 lou5 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尊敬老人。
examples.english_sentence: He respects old people very much.

english_meaning: to admire, to revere
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬仰慕。
explanation_english: To respect and admire deeply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好敬仰佢嘅成就。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ging3 joeng5 keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很敬仰他的成就。
examples.english_sentence: I really admire his achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好值得我哋敬仰嘅科學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 ging3 joeng5 ge3 fo1 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很值得我们敬仰的科学家。
examples.english_sentence: He is a scientist who is very worthy of our admiration.

english_meaning: to admire, to esteem, to respect
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬佩服。
explanation_english: To admire and respect someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅毅力真係令人敬佩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ngai6 lik6 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 ging3 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的毅力真令人敬佩。
examples.english_sentence: His perseverance is truly admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好敬佩佢哋為社會所做嘅貢獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ging3 pui3 keoi5 dei6 wai6 se5 wui2 so2 zou6 ge3 gung3 hiến3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很敬佩他们为社会所做的贡献。
examples.english_sentence: I greatly admire their contributions to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成就實在令人敬佩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau1 sat6 zoi6 ling6 jan4 ging3 pui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成就是实在令人敬佩的。
examples.english_sentence: His achievements are truly admirable.

english_meaning: Dear Sir/Madam/To Whom It May Concern
explanation_mandarin: 用于正式书信或公函的开头，表示对收信人的尊敬。
explanation_english: A formal salutation used at the beginning of a letter or email, typically in official correspondence, indicating respect for the recipient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬啓者，我寫呢封信係想投訴你哋嘅服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 kai2 ze2, ngo5 se2 ni1 fung1 seon3 hai6 soeng2 tau4 sou3 nei5 dei6 ge3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尊敬的先生/女士，我写这封信是想投诉你们的服务。
examples.english_sentence: Dear Sir/Madam, I am writing this letter to complain about your service.

english_meaning: To Whom It May Concern
explanation_mandarin: 用于正式信函或通知的开头，表示对收信人的尊敬。
explanation_english: Used as a salutation in formal letters or notices, indicating respect for the recipient(s). It's a standard way to address an unspecified recipient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬啟者，我謹代表公司邀請您參加我哋嘅週年晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 kai2 ze2, ngo5 gan2 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 yiu1 cing2 nin4 caam1 ga1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敬启者，我谨代表公司邀请您参加我们的周年晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: To Whom It May Concern, I am writing on behalf of the company to invite you to our annual gala dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬啟者：有關查詢申請，請參考附件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 kai2 ze2: jau5 gwaan1 caa4 seon1 san1 cheng2, cheng2 caam1 kaau2 fu6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敬启者：关于查询申请，请参考附件。
examples.english_sentence: To Whom It May Concern: Regarding the inquiry application, please refer to the attachment.

english_meaning: Dear Sir/Madam, To Whom It May Concern
explanation_mandarin: 公文书信中常用的称谓语，用于不知收信人姓名时。
explanation_english: A formal salutation commonly used in official documents and letters when the recipient's name is unknown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬啟者，我係想查詢下你哋公司嘅招聘詳情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 kai2 ze2, ngo5 hai6 soeng2 caa4 seon1 haa5 nei5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 ziu1 ping3 coeng4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 尊敬的读者，我想咨询一下贵公司的招聘详情。
examples.english_sentence: Dear Sir/Madam, I would like to inquire about the recruitment details of your company.

english_meaning: respect, reverence, deference
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬的意念或表示尊敬的言语行动。
explanation_english: A feeling of deep admiration or respect for someone or something; a sign of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對佢嘅成就表示敬意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 sing4 zau6 biu2 si6 ging3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对他的成就表示敬意。
examples.english_sentence: They showed respect for his achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該對長輩表示敬意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 deoi3 zoeng2 bui3 biu2 si6 ging3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该对长辈表示敬意。
examples.english_sentence: We should show respect to our elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講充滿對歷史嘅敬意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 cung1 mun5 deoi3 lik6 si2 ge3 ging3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲充满了对历史的敬意。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was full of respect for history.

english_meaning: respect and love; esteem
explanation_mandarin: 既尊敬又喜爱。
explanation_english: To both respect and love someone; to hold someone in high regard and affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好敬愛我哋嘅老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 ging3 oi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很敬爱我们的老师。
examples.english_sentence: We deeply respect and love our teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好敬愛佢哋嘅父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 ging3 oi3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很敬爱他们的父母。
examples.english_sentence: They deeply respect and love their parents.

english_meaning: to worship, to adore
explanation_mandarin: 指用恭敬的心情和行动来表达对神或者其他被崇拜对象的尊敬和爱戴。
explanation_english: To show reverence and adoration for a deity or other object of worship through acts and expressions of devotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每個禮拜日都會去教堂敬拜上帝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 jat6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 gaau1 tong4 ging3 baai3 soeng5 dei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每个星期日都会去教堂敬拜上帝。
examples.english_sentence: We go to church to worship God every Sunday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意聽福音音樂，覺得可以藉住音樂敬拜神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 fuk1 jam1 jam1 ngok6, gok3 dak1 ho2 ji5 jik6 zyu6 jam1 ngok6 ging3 baai3 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢听福音音乐，觉得可以通过音乐敬拜神。
examples.english_sentence: He likes listening to gospel music and feels he can worship God through it.

english_meaning: dedicated to one's work; conscientious; professional
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人对工作认真负责，尽心尽力。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is serious and responsible towards their work, and puts in their best effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好敬業，成日都OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ging3 jip6, seng4 jat6 dou1 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很敬业，经常加班。
examples.english_sentence: He's very dedicated to his work, and always works overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個敬業嘅員工，會為公司帶來好多益處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 ging3 jip6 ge3 jyun4 gung1, wui5 wai6 gung1 si1 daai3 loi4 hou2 do1 jik1 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个敬业的员工会为公司带来很多益处。
examples.english_sentence: A dedicated employee will bring many benefits to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生最緊要係要有敬業樂業嘅精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 jiu3 jau5 ging3 jip6 lok6 jip6 ge3 jing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生最重要的是要有敬业乐业的精神。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing for a doctor is to have a spirit of dedication and enjoyment in their work.

english_meaning: Dedication to one's work and finding joy in it; dedication and enjoyment in work
explanation_mandarin: 指对自己的工作非常投入，并且乐在其中。形容对工作认真负责，并能从中获得乐趣。
explanation_english: Refers to being deeply involved in one's work and enjoying it. It describes someone who is responsible and conscientious in their work and finds pleasure in it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢真係好敬業樂業，日日都充滿活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 zan1 hai6 hou2 ging3 jip6 lok6 jip6, jat1 jat1 dou1 cung1 mun5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作真是非常敬业乐业，每天都充满活力。
examples.english_sentence: He is really dedicated to his work and enjoys it, full of energy every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要搵到一份自己敬業樂業嘅工真係唔容易。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 wan2 dou2 jat1 fan6 zi6 gei2 ging3 jip6 lok6 jip6 ge3 gung1 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 yi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要找到一份自己敬业乐业的工作真是不容易。
examples.english_sentence: It's really not easy to find a job that you're dedicated to and enjoy.

synonyms: 全心投入 (cyun4 sam1 tau4 jap6)
盡心盡力 (zeon6 sam1 zeon6 lik6)

english_meaning: Dedicated to one's work and enjoying harmony with others; dedicated to work and sociable; professional and sociable
explanation_mandarin: 出自《礼记·大学》。形容对工作尽心尽力，并乐于与周围的人相处，保持和谐的人际关系。
explanation_english: An idiom originating from 'The Great Learning' in the 'Book of Rites'. It describes someone who is dedicated and diligent in their work, and also enjoys being with others, maintaining harmonious interpersonal relationships. It emphasizes professionalism and sociability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好敬業樂羣，同事們都好鍾意同佢合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 ging3 jip6 lok6 kwan4, tung4 si6 mun4 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很敬业乐群，同事们都很喜欢和他合作。
examples.english_sentence: He is very dedicated to his work and enjoys interacting with his colleagues, so they all like working with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想喺公司升職，除咗要有能力之外，都要識得敬業樂羣先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 hai2 gung1 si1 sing1 zik1, ceoi4 zo2 jiu3 jau5 nang4 lik6 zi1 ngoi6, dou1 jiu3 sik1 dak1 ging3 jip6 lok6 kwan4 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想在公司升职，除了要有能力之外，还要懂得敬业乐群才行。
examples.english_sentence: If you want a promotion in the company, besides having the ability, you also need to know how to be dedicated to your work and get along well with others.

english_meaning: Dedication to work and harmonious social interaction.
explanation_mandarin: 指既热爱自己的工作，又乐于与大家相处。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is dedicated to their work and enjoys interacting harmoniously with others in a group or community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好敬業樂群，所以好受同事歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ging3 jip6 lok6 kwan4, so2 ji5 hou2 sau6 tung4 si6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作既敬业又乐群，所以很受同事欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He is both dedicated to his work and enjoys harmonious interaction with others, so he is very popular among his colleagues.

english_meaning: awe; reverence; to stand in awe of; to revere
explanation_mandarin: 既尊敬又畏惧。表示对某人或某事物非常尊重，同时又怀有畏惧的心情。
explanation_english: To have a feeling of reverence, respect, and awe for someone or something; to hold in high esteem and with a sense of fear or respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該對大自然抱有敬畏之心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin1 pou5 jau5 ging3 wai3 zi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该对大自然抱有敬畏之心。
examples.english_sentence: We should have a sense of awe and respect for nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅老師好敬畏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 lou5 si1 hou2 ging3 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她对他的老师很敬畏。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has great reverence for his/her teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對咁樣嘅成就，我哋唔可以冇敬畏之心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gam2 joeng2 ge3 sing4 zau6, ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 mou5 ging3 wai3 zi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对这样的成就，我们不可以没有敬畏之心。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with such achievements, we cannot lack a sense of awe.

english_meaning: salute; to salute
explanation_mandarin: 一种表示尊敬的礼节，通常通过举手或鞠躬等方式进行。
explanation_english: A gesture of respect, usually performed by raising the hand or bowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個長官就即刻敬禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 zoeng2 gun1 zau6 zik1 hak1 ging3 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他见到长官就立刻敬礼。
examples.english_sentence: He saluted immediately when he saw the officer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍人應該識得點樣敬禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 yan4 ying1 goi1 sik1 dak1 dim2 yeung2 ging3 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军人应该知道怎样敬礼。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers should know how to salute.

english_meaning: to respect the elderly; respect for the aged
explanation_mandarin: 尊重和尊敬年长的人。
explanation_english: To respect and honor the elderly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該要敬老，扶老攜幼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 jiu3 ging3 lou5, fu4 lou5 kwai4 yau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尊敬老人，扶老携幼。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect the elderly and take care of the young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港政府鼓勵市民敬老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zing3 fu2 gu2 lai6 si5 man4 ging3 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港政府鼓励市民尊敬老人。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong government encourages citizens to respect the elderly.

english_meaning: to keep a respectful distance from; to steer clear of
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事物表面上尊敬，实际上不愿接近。比喻既尊重又保持距离，不愿靠近或接触。
explanation_english: To keep someone or something at a distance while maintaining a respectful attitude. It implies a combination of respect and a desire to avoid close contact or involvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁古怪，啲同事都淨係會敬而遠之咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 gu2 gwaai3, di1 tung4 si6 dou1 zing6 hai6 wui5 ging3 ji4 jyun5 zi1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很古怪，同事们都只是敬而远之而已。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an eccentric person that his colleagues just keep a respectful distance from him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於啲成日喺度講是非嘅人，最好都係敬而遠之。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 di1 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 gong2 si6 fei1 ge3 jan4, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 ging3 ji4 jyun5 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于那些总是说人是非的人，最好还是敬而远之。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to keep a respectful distance from people who are always gossiping.

english_meaning: honorifics; polite language
explanation_mandarin: 表示尊敬的语言形式。通常用于对长辈、上级或客人说话时。
explanation_english: Honorifics; polite language used to show respect, typically when speaking to elders, superiors, or guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司同老細講嘢要用敬語㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2 je5 jiu3 yung6 ging3 jyu5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司和老板说话要用敬语。
examples.english_sentence: You need to use honorifics when talking to your boss at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有禮貌，成日都用敬語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 ging3 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很有礼貌，总是用敬语。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very politely, always using honorifics.

english_meaning: Please (respectfully); Kindly request
explanation_mandarin: 客气地请求或邀请。
explanation_english: A polite and respectful way to request or invite someone to do something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請各位準時出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 gok3 wai2 zeon2 si4 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敬请各位准时出席。
examples.english_sentence: Please (respectfully) request everyone to attend on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請留意本公司嘅最新消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 lau4 yi3 bun2 gung1 si1 ge3 zeoi3 san1 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敬请留意本公司的最新消息。
examples.english_sentence: Kindly pay attention to our company's latest news.

english_meaning: Please forgive me / Please excuse me
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种礼貌的请求原谅的方式，语气较为正式和客气。
explanation_english: A polite and formal way of asking for forgiveness or excusing oneself. It indicates respect and politeness in seeking pardon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到咗，敬請原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2, ging3 cing2 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迟到了，请原谅。
examples.english_sentence: I'm late, please forgive me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我有冒犯嘅地方，敬請原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 jau5 mou6 faan6 ge3 dei6 fong1, ging3 cing2 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我有冒犯的地方，请原谅。
examples.english_sentence: If I have offended you in any way, please forgive me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為系統故障，導致服務暫停，敬請原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 hai6 tung2 gu3 zoeng3, dou6 zi3 fuk6 mou6 zaam6 ting4, ging3 cing2 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由于系统故障，导致服务暂停，请原谅。
examples.english_sentence: Due to a system failure resulting in service suspension, please accept our apologies.

english_meaning: Please pay attention; please take note
explanation_mandarin: 客套用语，用于提醒对方注意某事。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used to remind or request someone to pay attention to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請留意我哋嘅最新優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 lau4 ji3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zeoi3 san1 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请注意我们的最新优惠。
examples.english_sentence: Please pay attention to our latest offers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請留意月台嘅廣播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 lau4 ji3 jyut6 toi4 ge3 gwong2 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请注意站台的广播。
examples.english_sentence: Please pay attention to the platform announcements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬請留意個人財物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 cing2 lau4 ji3 go3 jan4 coi4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请注意个人财物。
examples.english_sentence: Please mind your belongings.

english_meaning: To decline politely; to beg to be excused; to express polite refusal.
explanation_mandarin: 客气地表示能力不够或不愿承担某项任务。
explanation_english: A polite way of refusing a task or offer, implying a lack of ability or unwillingness to undertake it. It is often used when the speaker feels they are not suited for the role or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細叫我做Project嘅Lead，我敬謝不敏啦，我經驗唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 giu3 ngo5 zou6 Project ge3 Lead, ngo5 ging3 ze6 bat1 man5 laa1, ngo5 ging1 gim6 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板叫我做这个项目的负责人，我恕不接受了，我经验不足。
examples.english_sentence: The boss asked me to be the Project Lead, but I politely declined, as I don't have enough experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想推我上去做經理，但係我覺得自己未夠班，所以敬謝不敏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 teoi1 ngo5 soeng5 heoi3 zou6 ging1 lei5, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 mei6 gau3 baan1, so2 ji5 ging3 ze6 bat1 man5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想推我上去当经理，但是我感觉自己还不够格，所以婉言谢绝了。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to promote me to manager, but I felt I wasn't qualified enough, so I politely declined.

english_meaning: Congratulations
explanation_mandarin: 恭敬地祝贺。用于正式场合的祝贺。
explanation_english: To respectfully congratulate. Used in formal occasions for congratulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司敬賀你升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ging3 ho6 nei5 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司恭贺你升职。
examples.english_sentence: Our company congratulates you on your promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敬賀新禧，祝你新年快樂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging3 ho6 san1 hei1, zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 faai3 lok6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭贺新禧，祝你新年快乐！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year! Wishing you a happy new year!

english_meaning: to propose a toast; to offer a drink as a gesture of respect or goodwill
explanation_mandarin: 在宴席上，向他人举杯表示敬意或祝贺。
explanation_english: To offer a toast to someone at a banquet or gathering as a sign of respect, goodwill, or congratulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋要敬酒多謝你哋嘅幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ging3 zau2 do1 ze6 nei5 dei6 ge3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们要敬酒感谢你们的帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight, we want to propose a toast to thank you all for your help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成晚都喺度敬酒，好忙咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 maan5 dou1 hai2 dou6 ging3 zau2, hou2 mong4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整个晚上都在敬酒，很忙的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He was proposing toasts all night, looking very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我唔識飲酒，唔可以敬酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 m4 sik1 yam2 zau2, m4 ho2 ji5 ging3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我不喝酒，不可以敬酒。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, I don't drink alcohol, I can't propose a toast.

jyutping: ging3 zau2 m4 jam2 jam2 fat6 zau2
english_meaning: If you don't accept a toast willingly, you'll be forced to drink a penalty drink.
explanation_mandarin: 原本的意思是：别人敬你酒，如果不喝，就要罚酒。引申意义：不接受好意，后果自负；不识抬举，会受到惩罚。
explanation_english: Literally means: If someone offers you a toast and you refuse, you'll be penalized and forced to drink. The extended meaning: If you don't accept a good intention, you'll have to bear the consequences; not appreciating goodwill will result in punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你大佬敬你酒，你唔飲？小心敬酒唔飲飲罰酒啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dai6 lou2 ging3 nei5 zau2, nei5 m4 jam2? siu2 sam1 ging3 zau2 m4 jam2 jam2 fat6 zau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你大哥敬你酒，你不喝？小心不敬酒就罚酒啊！
examples.english_sentence: Your big brother is offering you a toast, are you not drinking? Be careful, if you don't accept a toast willingly, you'll be forced to drink a penalty drink!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次機會咁好，你都唔把握，到時後悔就敬酒唔飲飲罰酒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gei1 wui2 gam3 hou2, nei5 dou1 m4 baa2 ak1, dou3 si4 hau6 fui3 zau6 ging3 zau2 m4 jam2 jam2 fat6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次机会这么好，你都不把握，到时候后悔就自食其果了。
examples.english_sentence: This opportunity is so good, and you don't seize it. If you regret it later, you'll have to bear the consequences yourself.

english_meaning: to respect, to esteem, to revere
explanation_mandarin: 尊重和重视；表示对人或事物的敬佩和重视。
explanation_english: To respect and value; to show admiration and importance to a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好敬重佢嘅專業精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 ging3 zung6 keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常敬佩他的专业精神。
examples.english_sentence: I really respect his professionalism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學識同人品都好值得人敬重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 sik1 tung4 jan4 ban2 dou1 hou2 zik6 dak1 jan4 ging3 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学识和人品都非常值得人尊敬。
examples.english_sentence: His knowledge and character are both very worthy of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要得到人哋嘅敬重，首先要做好自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 dak1 dou3 jan4 dei6 ge3 ging3 zung6, sau2 sin1 jiu3 zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要得到别人的尊敬，首先要做好自己。
examples.english_sentence: To earn the respect of others, you must first do well yourself.

english_meaning: Humbly stating that one is sitting at the last seat; I humbly take the lowest seat.
explanation_mandarin: 表示谦虚，自谦坐在最末的位置以陪衬在座的其他人。多用于宴会、会议等场合。
explanation_english: A humble way of saying that one is sitting in the lowest seat, usually to show respect for others present. Commonly used in banquets, meetings, or other formal occasions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚可以敬陪末座，同大家學嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ho2 ji5 ging3 pui4 mut6 zo6, tung4 daai6 gaa1 hok6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我可以敬陪末座，和大家学习。
examples.english_sentence: I am honored to be here and take the last seat tonight, and learn from everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔敢當，我淨係敬陪末座啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gam2 dong3, ngo5 zing6 hai6 ging3 pui4 mut6 zo6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不敢当，我只是敬陪末座而已。
examples.english_sentence: You flatter me, I'm just humbly taking the last seat.

english_meaning: to knock, to strike, to extort, to fleece
explanation_mandarin: 1. 敲打；叩击。2. 比喻利用不正当手段获取钱财或利益，例如敲诈勒索。
explanation_english: 1. To knock, strike, or beat. 2. (Figurative) To extort money or benefits through illegitimate means; to fleece or blackmail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敲門先啦，咁冇禮貌嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau1 mun4 sin1 laa1, gam3 mou5 lai5 maau6 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先敲门吧，这么没礼貌的？
examples.english_sentence: Knock on the door first, how impolite!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都想敲我啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 haau1 ngo5 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想敲诈我的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to extort money from me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢咁貴，根本就係敲客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 gam3 gwai3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 haau1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的东西那么贵，根本就是宰客。
examples.english_sentence: The food in that restaurant is so expensive, they are basically ripping off customers.

english_meaning: to finalize, to settle, to nail down
explanation_mandarin: 最终确定，做出最终决定。
explanation_english: To finalize, confirm, or settle on something after discussion or consideration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經敲定咗下個月去日本旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 haau1 ding6 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经敲定了下个月去日本旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We have already finalized our trip to Japan next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋仲未敲定婚禮嘅日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung6 mei6 haau1 ding6 fan1 lai5 ge3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们还没有敲定婚礼的日子。
examples.english_sentence: They haven't finalized the date of the wedding yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋今晚敲定聽日做咩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 haau1 ding6 ting1 jat6 zou6 me1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们今晚敲定明天做什么吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we finalize what to do tomorrow tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 敲打; 提醒; 警告
english_meaning: To tap; to beat (lightly); to hint; to warn; to give someone a subtle warning; to sound someone out
explanation_mandarin: 用含蓄的方式提醒或警告某人，使其有所警觉或改进。
explanation_english: To subtly remind or warn someone to be more alert or to improve; to give a gentle nudge or hint in the right direction. It can also mean to test someone's reaction by dropping hints or sounding them out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日敲打我哋，叫我哋做嘢快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 haau1 daa2 ngo5 dei6, giu3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 je5 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是敲打我们，叫我们做事快点。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always subtly reminds us to work faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係敲打下你，唔係想鬧你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 haau1 daa2 haa5 nei5, m4 hai6 soeng2 naau6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是提醒一下你，不是想骂你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just giving you a gentle reminder, I don't want to scold you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好隱晦，好似想敲打我咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jan2 wai3, hou2 ci5 soeng2 haau1 daa2 ngo5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话很隐晦，好像想提醒我似的。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very vaguely, as if he's trying to hint at something.

english_meaning: to strike; to beat; to knock
explanation_mandarin: 用硬物撞击某物。
explanation_english: To strike something with a hard object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢敲擊個鼓，發出好大嘅聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau1 gik1 go3 gu2, faat3 ceot1 hou2 daai6 ge3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他敲击鼓，发出很大的声音。
examples.english_sentence: He struck the drum, making a loud noise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到有人敲擊門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou2 jau5 jan4 haau1 gik1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到有人敲门。
examples.english_sentence: I heard someone knocking on the door.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再敲擊張枱啦，好嘈呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 haau1 gik1 zoeng1 toi2 laa1, hou2 cou4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再敲桌子了，很吵啊！
examples.english_sentence: Stop hitting the table, it's very noisy!

english_meaning: Percussion music
explanation_mandarin: 以打击乐器为主的音乐类型。
explanation_english: A type of music that primarily features percussion instruments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣學過敲擊樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hok6 gwo3 haau1 gik1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候学过打击乐。
examples.english_sentence: I learned percussion music when I was a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場音樂會有好多敲擊樂嘅演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 jam1 ngok6 wui2 jau5 hou2 do1 haau1 gik1 ngok6 ge3 jin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场音乐会有很多打击乐的演出。
examples.english_sentence: There are many percussion performances in this concert.

english_meaning: to overcharge, to rip someone off, to inflate prices (opportunistically)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻利用机会，抬高物价或索取不合理的费用，从中获取暴利。
explanation_english: To exploit an opportunity to overcharge someone, inflate prices, or demand unreasonable fees for personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳擺明敲竹槓，啲嘢食又貴又唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 baai2 ming4 haau1 zuk1 gong3, di1 je5 sik6 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅摆明了要敲竹杠，东西又贵又不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant is clearly ripping people off; the food is expensive and doesn't taste good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢趁住我哋趕時間，想敲竹槓，收貴我哋好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 can3 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 gon2 si4 gaan3, soeng2 haau1 zuk1 gong3, sau1 gwai3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他趁我们赶时间，想敲竹杠，多收了我们很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to rip us off while we were in a hurry and charged us a lot of extra money.

english_meaning: To stab someone in the back; to plot against someone behind their back; to trip someone up
explanation_mandarin: 比喻暗中使坏，在背后算计别人，使别人倒霉。
explanation_english: A metaphor for secretly harming or plotting against someone behind their back, causing them misfortune. It suggests a treacherous and underhanded action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日諗住敲人哋腳骨啦，做好自己先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 haau1 jan4 dei6 goek3 gwat1 laa1, zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要整天想着背后算计别人，先做好自己吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about stabbing people in the back, just do your own thing first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升職都係靠敲老細腳骨啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zik1 dou1 hai6 kaau3 haau1 lou5 sai3 goek3 gwat1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职都是靠背后算计老板罢了。
examples.english_sentence: He only got promoted by stabbing the boss in the back.

english_meaning: to blackmail, to extort
explanation_mandarin: 指用威胁、恐吓等手段勒索财物。
explanation_english: To obtain something from someone through coercion, threats, or intimidation; to extort or blackmail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋敲詐咗佢好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haau1 zaa3 zo2 keoi5 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们敲诈了他很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: They extorted a lot of money from him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢哋敲詐到你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 haau1 zaa3 dou3 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他们敲诈到你啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't let them blackmail you!

mandarin_meaning: 旁敲侧击； 从旁协助
english_meaning: to drum up support from the sidelines; to assist someone indirectly; to support from the periphery
explanation_mandarin: 比喻从旁协助、间接支持。通常指不直接参与主要活动，而是通过其他方式给予帮助或暗示。
explanation_english: A metaphor for assisting or supporting indirectly. It usually refers to helping or hinting through other means instead of directly participating in the main activity. It can also mean drumming up support for someone from the sidelines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度淨係識敲邊鼓，乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 zing6 hai6 sik1 haau1 bin1 gu2, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这里只会旁敲侧击，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to offer indirect support here, doing nothing himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要出聲支持佢，唔可以淨係喺度敲邊鼓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 chut1 seng1 zi1 chi4 keoi5, m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 hai2 dou6 haau1 bin1 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要出声支持他，不可以只是在这里旁敲侧击。
examples.english_sentence: We need to voice our support for him, we can't just drum up support from the sidelines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆唔鍾意啲人淨係敲邊鼓，佢想大家直接表達意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 zung1 ji3 di1 yan4 zing6 hai6 haau1 bin1 gu2, keoi5 soeng2 daai6 gaa1 zik6 zip3 biu2 daat6 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板不喜欢人们只是旁敲侧击，他想大家直接表达意见。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't like people who just offer indirect support; he wants everyone to express their opinions directly.

english_meaning: to beat drums and gongs; to make a big fanfare; to make a lot of noise in celebration; to publicize widely
explanation_mandarin: 形容大张旗鼓地宣传、庆祝。
explanation_english: Describes making a big show or fanfare, often to publicize something or celebrate an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋敲鑼打鼓咁慶祝，唔知發生咩事呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haau1 lo4 daa2 gu2 gam2 hing3 zuk1, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们敲锣打鼓地庆祝，不知道发生了什么事呢？
examples.english_sentence: They are celebrating with drums and gongs. I wonder what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司賺咗好多錢，所以敲鑼打鼓咁宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, so2 ji5 haau1 lo4 daa2 gu2 gam2 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司赚了很多钱，所以敲锣打鼓地宣传。
examples.english_sentence: The company made a lot of money, so they are publicizing it with a big fanfare.

english_meaning: to knock on a door
explanation_mandarin: 用手或硬物撞击门，发出声音，以引起注意。
explanation_english: To knock on a door, usually with your hand or a hard object, to make a sound and attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我敲門敲咗好耐，都冇人應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau1 mun4 haau1 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 mou5 jan4 ying3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我敲门敲了很久，都没有人回应。
examples.english_sentence: I knocked on the door for a long time, but no one answered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你入去之前記得敲門呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jap6 heoi3 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 haau1 mun4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你进去之前记得敲门啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to knock on the door before you go in.

english_meaning: stepping stone; a means to an end; something used to gain entry or advantage
explanation_mandarin: 比喻借以达到目的的初步手段。最初指的是敲门的砖头，用完就可以扔掉。现在多用来形容为了达到更高目标而暂时利用的手段或工具。
explanation_english: A stepping stone; something used as a temporary means to achieve a greater end. Originally referring to a brick used to knock on a door which could then be discarded, it now often describes a temporary means or tool used to achieve a higher goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個實習只係我嘅敲門磚，等我將來搵到更好嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat6 zaap6 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 haau1 mun4 zyun1, dang2 ngo5 zoeng1 loi4 wan2 dou2 gang3 hou2 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个实习只是我的敲门砖，为了我将来找到更好的工作。
examples.english_sentence: This internship is just a stepping stone for me to find a better job in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大學學位好多時都係搵好工嘅敲門磚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hok6 hok6 wai2 hou2 do1 si4 dou1 hai6 wan2 hou2 gung1 ge3 haau1 mun4 zyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大学学位很多时候都是找好工作的敲门砖。
examples.english_sentence: A university degree is often a stepping stone to finding a good job.

english_meaning: to do, to make, to fix, to prepare, to get
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作，有做、制作、修理等多种含义。在口语中应用广泛。
explanation_english: A versatile verb meaning 'to do', 'to make', 'to fix', 'to prepare', 'to get' something. It's a very common word in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整多碗飯啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 do1 wun2 faan6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再盛一碗饭吧！
examples.english_sentence: Get another bowl of rice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我整緊啲嘢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing2 gan2 di1 je5 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在做一些吃的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm making some food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我整好部電腦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 zing2 hou2 bou6 din6 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 帮我修好这台电脑。
examples.english_sentence: Help me fix this computer.

english_meaning: While doing something (little by little, gradually, unintentionally)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在做某件事情的过程中，不知不觉地、逐渐地或无意中产生了某种结果或状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that during the process of doing something, a certain result or state arises unconsciously, gradually, or unintentionally. It implies a gradual process or an unexpected outcome from repeated small actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我整下整下就學識咗游水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing2 haa5 zing2 haa5 zau6 hok6 sik1 zo2 jau4 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我弄着弄着就学会游泳了。
examples.english_sentence: I learned to swim while just doing it little by little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦整下整下又壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 zing2 haa5 zing2 haa5 jau6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑弄着弄着又坏了。
examples.english_sentence: The computer broke again while I was just using it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫整下整下就洗晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 zing2 haa5 zing2 haa5 zau6 sai2 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服洗着洗着就洗完了。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes got washed while just washing them.

english_meaning: to renovate, to repair, to overhaul
explanation_mandarin: 修理，修缮；使之恢复原状或达到更好状态。
explanation_english: To repair or renovate something; to restore something to its original state or improve its condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋太舊，要整修吓先住得人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 taai3 gau6, jiu3 zing2 sau1 haa5 sin1 zyu6 dak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子太旧了，要整修一下才能住人。
examples.english_sentence: The house is too old, it needs to be renovated before it's habitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車撞爛咗，拎去車房整修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 zong6 laan6 zo2, ling1 heoi3 ce1 fong2 zing2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞坏了，拿去车房修理。
examples.english_sentence: The car was crashed, take it to the garage for repairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃整修呢條舊街，令佢煥然一新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 zing2 sau1 ni1 tiu4 gau6 gaai1, ling6 keoi5 waan6 jin4 jat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划整修这条老街，让它焕然一新。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to renovate this old street and give it a new look.

english_meaning: entire; whole; complete; all
explanation_mandarin: 表示全部，整个的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates the entire or whole quantity/extent of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我整個禮拜都好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing2 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我整个星期都很忙。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very busy the whole week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食咗成整個蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 zo2 sing4 zing2 go3 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃了整个蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: I ate the whole cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整個世界都變晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 go3 sai3 gaai3 dou1 bin3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个世界都变了。
examples.english_sentence: The whole world has changed.

english_meaning: to injure; to hurt; to get injured
explanation_mandarin: 使受伤；受到伤害
explanation_english: To cause injury; to become injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波整傷咗隻腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 zing2 soeng1 zo2 zek3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球弄伤了脚。
examples.english_sentence: He injured his foot playing football.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你整傷咗佢，要同佢道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing2 soeng1 zo2 keoi5, jiu3 tung4 keoi5 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你弄伤了他，要向他道歉。
examples.english_sentence: You hurt him; you need to apologize to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好整傷自己呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zing2 soeng1 zi6 gei2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心一点，别弄伤自己呀。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, don't hurt yourself.

english_meaning: to cause; to bring about; to end up (with); to get to the point of
explanation_mandarin: 表示由于某种行为或情况的发生，最终导致某种结果。通常是不太好的结果。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain action or situation has occurred, ultimately leading to a particular result. Often implies a negative or undesirable outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你再唔做嘢，好快整到冇嘢食㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoi3 m4 zou6 je5, hou2 faai3 zing2 dou3 mou5 je5 sik6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你再不工作，很快就会弄到没东西吃的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't work, you'll soon end up with nothing to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日唔瞓覺，整到個人好冇精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 m4 fan3 gaau3, zing2 dou3 go3 jan4 hou2 mou5 zing1 san4.
