examples.cantonese_sentence: 你整理好啲文件未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing2 lei5 hou2 di1 man4 gin2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整理好那些文件了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you sorted out those documents yet?

english_meaning: to rectify, to purge, to clean up, to rectify (a situation), to consolidate
explanation_mandarin: 指整顿纪律，清除坏分子，使之纯洁巩固。
explanation_english: To rectify, purge, or clean up. To consolidate a group or organization by removing undesirable elements or correcting problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司最近整肅咗一批員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 zing2 suk1 zo2 jat1 bat1 jyun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司最近整顿了一批员工。
examples.english_sentence: Their company recently purged a batch of employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次事件之後，政府決定要整肅警隊嘅風紀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 si6 gin2 zi1 hau6, zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 zing2 suk1 ging2 deoi6 ge3 fung1 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次事件之后，政府决定要整顿警队的风纪。
examples.english_sentence: After this incident, the government decided to rectify the discipline within the police force.

english_meaning: to put on an act; to make a fuss; to exaggerate; to show off
explanation_mandarin: 指为了吸引别人注意，故意装腔作势，做表面功夫，或者小题大做。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately putting on an act or making a fuss, often to attract attention or impress others. It can also mean exaggerating or making a big deal out of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都整色整水，想吸引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing2 sik1 zing2 seoi2, soeng2 kap1 jan5 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装模作样，想吸引别人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He always puts on an act, trying to attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使整色整水啦，有咩就直接講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 zing2 sik1 zing2 seoi2 laa1, jau5 me1 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用装模作样了，有什么就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: No need to put on an act, just say what you want.

english_meaning: to put on an act; to feign; to pretend; to create a false impression; to play-act
explanation_mandarin: 形容人故意做作，装模作样，给人留下不真实的印象。
explanation_english: Describes someone deliberately putting on an act, feigning, or pretending to create a false impression. It implies insincerity or artificiality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前整色水，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 zing2 sik1 seoi2, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前装模作样，想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always putting on an act in front of the boss, hoping to get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再整色水啦，我知你根本唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 zing2 sik1 seoi2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 gan1 bun2 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别再装模作样了，我知道你根本不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: Stop pretending, I know you don't like him at all.

english_meaning: To cook dishes; To fix (someone); To set someone up; To plot against
explanation_mandarin: 1. 做菜，准备饭菜。 2. 整治，陷害，暗算。可以指耍手段对付某人。
explanation_english: 1. To cook, to prepare food. 2. To fix someone, to plot against them, to set them up. It implies using underhanded methods to deal with someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我整幾味菜畀你哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zing2 gei2 mei6 coi3 bei2 nei5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我做几道菜给你们吃。
examples.english_sentence: I'll cook a few dishes for you guys to eat tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你小心啲，佢想整菜你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1, keoi5 soeng2 zing2 coi3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小心点，他想陷害你。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, he's trying to set you up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁做，唔係我整菜你啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, m4 hai6 ngo5 zing2 coi3 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样做，不然我就要整治你了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that, or I'll fix you!

english_meaning: to make a cake; to bake a cake
explanation_mandarin: 制作蛋糕。一般指准备食材、混合、烘烤等过程。
explanation_english: To make a cake; to bake a cake. It generally refers to the process of preparing ingredients, mixing, baking, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日想整蛋糕慶祝你生日呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 soeng2 zing2 daan6 gou1 hing3 zuk1 nei5 saang1 jat6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天想做蛋糕庆祝你的生日。
examples.english_sentence: I want to make a cake tomorrow to celebrate your birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整蛋糕整得好靚㗎，好有天份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 daan6 gou1 zing2 dak1 hou2 leng3 gaa3, hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她做蛋糕做得非常漂亮，很有天赋。
examples.english_sentence: She makes cakes very beautifully, she has a lot of talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 不如我哋一齊整蛋糕啦，一定好好玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zing2 daan6 gou1 laa1, jat1 ding6 hou2 hou2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不如我们一起做蛋糕吧，肯定很好玩。
examples.english_sentence: How about we make a cake together? It will definitely be fun.

english_meaning: to prank, to play tricks on, to make a fool of
explanation_mandarin: 捉弄人，使人难堪或受骗。 通常带有开玩笑的意味，但程度可轻可重。
explanation_english: To play a trick on someone, to prank them, or to make them look foolish. It usually implies a playful intention, but the severity can vary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日整蠱人，好乞人憎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing2 gu2 jan4, hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是捉弄人，很令人讨厌的。
examples.english_sentence: He always pranks people; he's very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好整蠱我啦，我趕時間啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing2 gu2 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别捉弄我了，我赶时间啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't prank me, I'm in a hurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 愚人節就係用嚟整蠱人㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 jan4 zit3 zau6 hai6 yung6 lai4 zing2 gu2 jan4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 愚人节就是用来捉弄人的嘛。
examples.english_sentence: April Fool's Day is for pranking people.

english_meaning: To play pranks; to act mischievously; to cause trouble playfully; to be eccentric
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做一些古怪或让人感到惊讶的事情，通常带有一些恶作剧的意味，目的是为了引人发笑或制造乐趣。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately doing strange or surprising things, often with a mischievous intent, with the aim of making people laugh or creating fun. It implies playful troublemaking or eccentricity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路成日喺度整蠱作怪，搞到我頭都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 zing2 gu2 zok3 gwaai3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些孩子整天在这里恶作剧，搞得我头都疼了。
examples.english_sentence: These kids are always playing pranks here, giving me a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鍾意整蠱作怪，成日諗埋晒啲古靈精怪嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 zung1 ji3 zing2 gu2 zok3 gwaai3, sing4 jat6 nam2 maai4 saai3 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很喜欢搞怪，总是想一些稀奇古怪的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to act mischievously, always thinking of weird and wonderful things.

english_meaning: To play pranks, to act weird or eccentric, to make mischief, to be deliberately annoying
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做出古怪或令人讨厌的行为来捉弄别人或引起注意。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately acting in a strange or annoying way to prank others or attract attention. It implies a playful but potentially disruptive behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日整蠱做怪啦，做啲正經嘢得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zing2 gu2 zou6 gwaai3 laa1, zou6 di1 zing3 ging1 je5 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别老是搞怪，做点正经事行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting weird all the time, can't you do something serious?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班細路仔最鍾意喺萬聖節整蠱做怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 hai2 maan6 sing3 zit3 zing2 gu2 zou6 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群小孩子最喜欢在万圣节搞怪。
examples.english_sentence: That group of kids love playing pranks on Halloween.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都整蠱做怪，想引起人哋注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zing2 gu2 zou6 gwaai3, soeng2 ging2 hei2 jan4 dei6 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是搞怪，想引起别人注意。
examples.english_sentence: He is always acting weird to get people's attention.

english_meaning: to play tricks, to act strange, to be mischievous
explanation_mandarin: 指故意做出古怪、奇异的举动或装扮，以取乐或引起注意。带有一定的贬义，指行为不庄重、不正经。
explanation_english: Refers to deliberately making strange and bizarre actions or dressing up to amuse oneself or attract attention. It has a slightly derogatory connotation, referring to behavior that is not dignified or serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日整蠱弄怪啦，正經啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zing2 gu2 nung6 gwaai3 laa1, zing3 ging1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是装神弄鬼的，正经一点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always act so strange, can't you be more serious?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意整蠱弄怪，搞到大家都唔知佢諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 zing2 gu2 nung6 gwaai3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 ging2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢装神弄鬼，搞得大家都不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to play tricks, making everyone not know what he is thinking.

english_meaning: to be fully equipped and ready to go; all set and ready to set off
explanation_mandarin: 整理好行装，等待出发。形容准备充分，随时可以行动。
explanation_english: To have everything packed and ready to go. Describes being fully prepared and ready to act at any moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經整裝待發，準備去旅行啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 ging1 zing2 zong1 doi6 faat3, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 leoi5 haang4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经整装待发，准备去旅行了！
examples.english_sentence: We are all set and ready to go, ready for our trip!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就考試喇，我哋要整裝待發，迎接挑戰！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 haau2 si5 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing2 zong1 doi6 faat3, jing4 zip3 tiu1 zin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要考试了，我们要整装待发，迎接挑战！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, we need to be fully prepared and ready to face the challenge!

english_meaning: to get injured; to hurt oneself
explanation_mandarin: 指不小心弄伤了自己或别人。
explanation_english: Refers to accidentally injuring oneself or someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔小心整親隻手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 can1 zek3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心把手弄伤了。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally hurt his hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢小心啲，唔好整親自己呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 zing2 can1 zi6 gei2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你工作小心点，不要弄伤自己啊。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful while working, don't hurt yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我煮飯嘅時候整親隻手指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu2 faan6 ge3 si4 hau6 zing2 can1 zek3 sau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做饭的时候把手指弄伤了。
examples.english_sentence: I injured my finger while cooking.

english_meaning: to get rid of, to remove, to eliminate, to kick out
explanation_mandarin: 指通过某种手段使人或物离开某个地方或失去某种地位。带有一定的主动性和意图性。
explanation_english: Refers to removing someone or something from a place or position through some means. It implies a degree of intentionality and agency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好唔鍾意阿明，想整走佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 m4 zung1 ji3 aa3 ming4, soeng2 zing2 zau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很不喜欢阿明，想把他弄走。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like Ah Ming and wants to get rid of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢哋再嘈，我會整走佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 zoi3 cou4, ngo5 wui5 zing2 zau2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他们再吵闹，我会把他们弄走。
examples.english_sentence: If they keep making noise, I'll get rid of them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆決定要整走啲舊電腦，換新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 zing2 zau2 di1 gau6 din6 nou5, wun6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板决定要处理掉旧电脑，换新的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss decided to get rid of the old computers and replace them with new ones.

english_meaning: divisible, to divide evenly
explanation_mandarin: 数学术语，指一个数能够被另一个数完全除尽，没有余数。
explanation_english: A mathematical term referring to a number being perfectly divisible by another number, leaving no remainder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 六可以俾二整除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: luk6 ho2 ji5 bei2 ji6 zing2 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 六可以被二整除。
examples.english_sentence: Six is divisible by two.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個數可以俾三整除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 ho2 ji5 bei2 saam1 zing2 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数可以被三整除。
examples.english_sentence: This number is divisible by three.

mandarin_meaning: 整理; 整治; 整頓
english_meaning: to rectify; to consolidate; to reorganize; to crack down (on); to straighten out; to tidy up
explanation_mandarin: 整理，使有秩序；整饬，使健全。
explanation_english: To put in order; to rectify or consolidate; to reorganize or tidy up something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要整頓一下內部管理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 zing2 deon6 jat1 haa5 noi6 bou6 gun2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要整顿一下内部管理。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to tidy up its internal management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定整頓交通秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 zing2 deon6 giao1 tung1 dit6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定整顿交通秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to rectify the traffic order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要整頓好晒啲嘢先可以放工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing2 deon6 hou2 saai3 di1 je5 sin1 ho2 ji5 fong3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把所有东西都整理好才能下班。
examples.english_sentence: We need to tidy up all the things before we can leave work.

english_meaning: to cook and eat; to prepare and eat food; to fix something to eat
explanation_mandarin: 指准备食物并食用。通常包含自己动手烹饪的意思，而非仅仅是吃饭。
explanation_english: Refers to preparing food and eating it. Usually implies cooking something yourself rather than simply eating a meal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚整食好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 zing2 sik6 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚自己做饭吃好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we cook something tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都整食俾我哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing2 sik6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是做饭给我们吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always cooks for us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自己整食，健康啲㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 自己做饭吃，更健康。
examples.english_sentence: Cooking your own food is healthier.

english_meaning: To make a cake; to bake a cake; to cook up something (usually in a negative sense, meaning to scheme or conspire)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是做饼，制作蛋糕。引申义为策划、搞鬼，通常带有负面含义，指密谋、串通。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to make a cake or bake a cake. Figuratively, it can mean to cook up something, scheme, or conspire, usually with negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋整餅仔，請你食啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 zing2 beng2 zai2, ceng2 nei5 sik6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们做小蛋糕，请你吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: We're making small cakes tomorrow, and we'll treat you to some!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋係咪又喺度整餅啊？小心俾人捉到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 hai6 mai1 jau6 hai2 dou6 zing2 beng2 aa3? siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们是不是又在搞鬼啊？小心被人抓住！
examples.english_sentence: Are you guys scheming again? Be careful you don't get caught!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋整餅想屈我，我一定唔會俾佢哋得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zing2 beng2 soeng2 wat1 ngo5, ngo5 jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 bei2 keoi5 dei6 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想陷害我，我一定不会让他们得逞。
examples.english_sentence: They are plotting to frame me, I definitely won't let them succeed.

english_meaning: to cook dishes
explanation_mandarin: 指烹饪，制作菜肴。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of cooking and preparing dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋自己整餸食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 zing2 sung3 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们自己做菜吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's cook our own dishes tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你整餸好叻㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing2 sung3 hou2 lek1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做菜很厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: You are very good at cooking!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽日日都要整餸畀我哋食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zing2 sung3 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈每天都要做菜给我们吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom has to cook dishes for us every day.

english_meaning: whole, entirety, overall
explanation_mandarin: 指全部，整体，整个方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the whole, the entirety, the overall aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇成個項目嘅整體表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeng2 tai2 biu2 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要看整个项目的整体表现。
examples.english_sentence: We need to look at the overall performance of the entire project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整體嚟講，佢哋嘅團隊合作都幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng2 tai2 lai4 gong2, keoi5 dei6 ge3 tyun4 doi2 hap6 jok3 dou1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整体来说，他们的团队合作挺好的。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, their teamwork is pretty good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅整體形象唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zeng2 tai2 hing6 zoeng6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的整体形象不错。
examples.english_sentence: The overall image of this company is not bad.

english_meaning: overall, generally speaking, in general
explanation_mandarin: 表示从整体上、大体上来说的意思，用于总结或概括。
explanation_english: Used to express an overall or general viewpoint; indicates a summary or generalization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整體嚟講，呢間餐廳嘅食物都幾好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng2 tai2 lei4 gong2, ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 dou1 gei2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总的来说，这家餐厅的食物都挺好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, the food at this restaurant is quite delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整體嚟講，今年嘅經濟都唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng2 tai2 lei4 gong2, gam1 nin4 ge3 ging1 zai3 dou1 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总的来说，今年的经济都不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: Generally speaking, the economy this year hasn't been very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整體嚟講，呢部電影都值得睇嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeng2 tai2 lei4 gong2, ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 dou1 zik6 dak1 tai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总的来说，这部电影都值得看的。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, this movie is worth watching.

synonyms: 總括嚟講 (zung2 kwok3 lei4 gong2)

english_meaning: to play tricks; to play pranks; to cause trouble deliberately; mischievous
explanation_mandarin: 故意制造麻烦；搞恶作剧；搞鬼。
explanation_english: To deliberately cause trouble; to play a prank; to be mischievous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再整鬼喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zing2 gwai2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再捣鬼了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't play tricks anymore!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都鍾意整鬼人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zung1 ji3 zing2 gwai2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢捉弄人。
examples.english_sentence: He always likes to play pranks on people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好整鬼部電腦啊，壞咗就麻煩啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing2 gwai2 bou6 din6 nou5 aa3, waai6 zo2 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱动电脑，坏了就麻烦了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with the computer, it'll be troublesome if it breaks!

english_meaning: to act strangely; to play tricks; to act up; to make a fuss; to be weird; to be mischievous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为古怪，喜欢搞怪，装模作样，故意引人注意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts strangely, likes to play tricks, is pretentious, or deliberately tries to attract attention. It often implies a mischievous or bothersome quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再整鬼整怪啦，阻住晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 zing2 gwai2 zing2 gwaai3 laa1, zo2 zyu6 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再装神弄鬼了，碍事！
examples.english_sentence: Stop acting so strangely, you're in the way!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都整鬼整怪，唔知想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zing2 gwai2 zing2 gwaai3, m4 zi1 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是装神弄鬼，不知道想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting up, I don't know what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔整鬼整怪好正常嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 zing2 gwai2 zing2 gwaai3 hou2 zing3 soeng4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子装神弄鬼很正常的。
examples.english_sentence: It's normal for children to act mischievous.

mandarin_meaning: 装神弄鬼; 搞花样; 耍花招
english_meaning: To play tricks; to act suspiciously; to behave in a weird or eccentric way; to make a fuss or a spectacle.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做出一些奇怪、可疑或不正常的行为，让人觉得是在耍花招或者装模作样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is behaving strangely, suspiciously, or abnormally, making others suspect they are playing tricks or putting on an act. It can also imply someone is making a big fuss over something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好整鬼整馬啦，有咩就直接講啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing2 gwai2 zing2 maa5 laa1, jau5 me1 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要装神弄鬼了，有什么就直接说吧！
examples.english_sentence: Stop playing tricks and just tell me what's going on!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前整鬼整馬，想攞好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 zing2 gwai2 zing2 maa5, soeng2 lo2 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在老板面前耍花招，想捞好处。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to get on the boss's good side by acting suspiciously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度整鬼整馬，搞到咁大陣仗做咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zing2 gwai2 zing2 maa5, gaau2 dou3 gam3 daai6 zan6 zoeng6 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里搞花样，弄得这么兴师动众干什么呀？
examples.english_sentence: Don't make such a big fuss; why are you making such a spectacle?

english_meaning: neat, tidy, in order, orderly
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物有秩序，不凌乱。
explanation_english: Describes something that is in order, not messy or chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房執到好整齊喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 zap1 dou3 hou2 zing2 cai4 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间收拾得很整齐啊。
examples.english_sentence: The room is tidied up very neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲文件要擺整齊啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 man4 gin2 jiu3 baai2 zing2 cai4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 文件要摆放得整齐一些。
examples.english_sentence: The documents need to be arranged more neatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隊伍排得好整齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi6 ng5 paai4 dak1 hou2 zing2 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队伍排列得很整齐。
examples.english_sentence: The team is lined up very neatly.

english_meaning: enemy; opponent; rival
explanation_mandarin: 指与自己作对或竞争的人或势力。
explanation_english: A person or force that is hostile or opposed to someone; an opponent or rival.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋嘅主要敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们的主要敌人。
examples.english_sentence: He is our main enemy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將佢哋當敵人，佢哋只係競爭對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 dong3 dik6 jan4, keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把他们当作敌人，他们只是竞争对手。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat them as enemies, they are just competitors.

english_meaning: enemy; foe
explanation_mandarin: 指敌对的一方，与自己有冲突或对抗的人或团体。
explanation_english: A person or group of people who are opposed to or hostile towards someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係我哋嘅敵人，我哋一定要打敗佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 dik6 jan4, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daa2 baai6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是我们的敌人，我们一定要打败他们。
examples.english_sentence: They are our enemies, we must defeat them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商場上，競爭對手就係你嘅敵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 coeng4 soeng6, ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 zau6 hai6 nei5 ge3 dik6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商场上，竞争对手就是你的敌人。
examples.english_sentence: In the business world, your competitors are your enemies.

english_meaning: hostile; antagonistic; enemy
explanation_mandarin: 指双方处于不友好的状态，互相仇视或对抗。
explanation_english: Describes a state of hostility or antagonism between two or more parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個自從上次鬧交之後，就一直都好敵對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zi6 cung4 soeng6 ci3 naau6 gaau1 zi1 hau6, zau6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 dik6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个自从上次吵架之后，就一直都很敌对。
examples.english_sentence: Those two have been very hostile to each other ever since their last fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個國家嘅關係變得越嚟越敵對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 bin3 dak1 yut6 lai4 yut6 dik6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个国家的关系变得越来越敌对。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the two countries is becoming increasingly hostile.

english_meaning: hostility, animosity, antagonism
explanation_mandarin: 敌对的情绪或意图。
explanation_english: A feeling of antagonism or hostility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我充滿敵意，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 cung1 mun5 dik6 ji3, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我很充满敌意，不知道为什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's full of hostility towards me, I don't know why.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我感覺到佢哋之間嘅敵意好強烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam2 gok3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 dik6 ji3 hou2 koeng4 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我感觉到他们之间的敌意很强烈。
examples.english_sentence: I felt the hostility between them was very strong.

english_meaning: enemy and ourselves; us versus them; friend or foe
explanation_mandarin: 敌方和我方。指对立的双方。
explanation_english: Enemy and ourselves; the opposing sides in a conflict or situation; the concept of 'us versus them'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將所有意見唔同嘅人睇成敵我，嘗試理解下佢哋嘅諗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ji3 gin3 m4 tung4 ge3 jan4 tai2 sing4 dik6 ngo5, si3 soeng4 lei5 gaai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 lam2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把所有意见不同的人看成敌人，尝试理解他们的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat everyone who disagrees with you as an enemy; try to understand their perspective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戰爭嘅時候，分清楚敵我非常重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zin3 zang1 ge3 si4 hau6, fan1 cing1 co2 dik6 ngo5 fei1 soeng4 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在战争的时候，分清楚敌我非常重要。
examples.english_sentence: In times of war, it's crucial to distinguish between friend and foe.

english_meaning: opponent, rival, adversary
explanation_mandarin: 指竞争或斗争中的对方。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or group one is competing or fighting against.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我最勁嘅敵手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 ging6 ge3 dik6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我最强的对手。
examples.english_sentence: He is my strongest opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場波嘅敵手好難應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 bo1 ge3 dik6 sau2 hou2 naan4 jing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛的对手很难对付。
examples.english_sentence: The opponents in this game are difficult to handle.

english_meaning: to be hostile towards; to view as an enemy; to antagonize
explanation_mandarin: 把某人或某事物看作敌人，并抱有敌对情绪。
explanation_english: To regard someone or something as an enemy and harbor hostile feelings towards them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一直都敵視我，覺得我搶咗佢哋嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 zik6 dou1 dik6 si6 ngo5, gok3 dak1 ngo5 coeng2 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直敌视我，觉得我抢了他们的机会。
examples.english_sentence: They have always been hostile towards me, thinking I stole their opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好敵視唔同文化嘅人，應該互相尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dik6 si6 m4 tung4 man1 faa3 ge3 jan4, jing1 goi1 wu6 seung1 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要敌视不同文化的人，应该互相尊重。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be hostile towards people of different cultures; we should respect each other.

english_meaning: enemy troops; opposing forces
explanation_mandarin: 指与我方作战的军队。
explanation_english: Refers to the military force that is fighting against one's own side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敵軍嚟緊喇，大家準備好作戰！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dik6 gwan1 lei4 gan2 laa3, daai6 gaa1 zeon2 bei6 hou2 zok3 zin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 敌军来了，大家准备好作战！
examples.english_sentence: The enemy troops are coming, everyone prepare for battle!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成功擊退咗敵軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 gung1 gik1 teoi3 zo2 dik6 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们成功击退了敌军。
examples.english_sentence: We successfully repelled the enemy troops.

english_meaning: to apply (ointment, plaster, etc.); to spread; to put on (mask); perfunctory; to go through the motions
explanation_mandarin: 1. 涂抹：把东西铺开或粘附在物体上。2. 敷衍：做事不认真，不负责任。
explanation_english: 1. To apply: to spread or stick something on an object. 2. Perfunctory: doing things without sincerity or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 敷藥啦，咁樣會好快啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu1 joek6 laa1, gam2 joeng2 wui5 hou2 faai3 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 涂点药吧，这样会好快一点的。
examples.english_sentence: Apply some medicine, it will heal faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得敷衍我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 fu1 jin2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只会敷衍我。
examples.english_sentence: He only knows how to be perfunctory with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁敷皮啦，做嘢認真啲得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 fu1 pei4 laa1, zou6 je5 jing6 zan1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么敷衍了，工作认真点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so perfunctory, can you be more serious at work?

english_meaning: dressing (medical)
explanation_mandarin: 用于伤口的覆盖物，有保护、吸收、止血等作用。
explanation_english: Medical dressing, used to cover wounds for protection, absorption, hemostasis, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢換咗啲敷料，個傷口冇咁痛喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wun6 zo2 di1 fu1 liu2, go3 soeng1 hau2 mou5 gam3 tung3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了些敷料，伤口没那么痛了。
examples.english_sentence: He changed the dressing, and the wound doesn't hurt as much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我哋每日都要幫佢換敷料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 wun6 fu1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生让我们每天都要帮他换敷料。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told us to change his dressing every day.

english_meaning: to apply medicine (topically)
explanation_mandarin: 将药物敷在伤口或患处。
explanation_english: To apply medicine to a wound or affected area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我敷葯吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 fu1 joek6 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请帮我敷药。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me apply the medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親之後，要即刻敷葯止血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 zi1 hau6, jiu3 zik1 hak1 fu1 joek6 zi2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒之后，要立刻敷药止血。
examples.english_sentence: After falling, you should immediately apply medicine to stop the bleeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫我每日敷葯兩次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 giu3 ngo5 mui5 jat6 fu1 joek6 loeng5 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫我每天敷药两次。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to apply the medicine twice a day.

english_meaning: to apply medicine (topically)
explanation_mandarin: 将药物涂抹或敷在伤口、患处上。
explanation_english: To apply medicine topically, typically to a wound or affected area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌親要即刻敷藥，唔係好易發炎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 can1 jiu3 zik1 hak1 fu1 joek6, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 faat3 jim4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摔倒了要立刻敷药，不然很容易发炎的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to apply medicine immediately after falling, otherwise it can easily get infected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓嘅傷口好深，要每日幫佢敷藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 ge3 soeng1 hau2 hou2 sam1, jiu3 mui5 jat6 bong1 keoi5 fu1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 猫的伤口很深，要每天帮它敷药。
examples.english_sentence: The cat's wound is very deep, you need to apply medicine to it every day.

english_meaning: to be perfunctory, to go through the motions, to do a sloppy job, to treat carelessly, to skimp on
explanation_mandarin: 做事不认真，马虎了事。敷衍也可以指为了应付而随便应付。
explanation_english: To do something carelessly or perfunctorily; to go through the motions without genuine effort or sincerity; to respond insincerely or carelessly to a request or question.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好敷衍，成日都出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢hou2 fu1 jin2, seng4 jat6 dou1 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很敷衍，总是出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's very perfunctory in his work and makes mistakes all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁敷衍我啦，講真話得唔得啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fu1 jin2 ngo5 laa1, gong2 zan1 waa6 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么敷衍我了，说真话行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't fob me off like that, can't you just tell me the truth?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好敷衍啲功課，要認真啲做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 fu1 jin2 di1 gung1 fo3, jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要敷衍作业，要认真一点做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do your homework perfunctorily, you need to do it more seriously.

english_meaning: to perform one's duty in a perfunctory manner; to go through the motions; to shirk responsibility; to be slapdash
explanation_mandarin: 做事不认真，只是表面应付，以搪塞责任。
explanation_english: To perform a task carelessly or superficially in order to avoid responsibility or get it done quickly without putting in effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告寫得好敷衍塞責，根本冇認真做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 fu1 hin2 sak1 zaak3, gan1 bun2 mou5 jing6 zan1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的报告非常敷衍塞责，根本没有认真做。
examples.english_sentence: His report was written in a very perfunctory manner; he didn't do it seriously at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係想住敷衍塞責，要做得好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 soeng2 zyu6 fu1 hin2 sak1 zaak3, jiu3 zou6 dak1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只想敷衍了事，要做得好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just think about doing it perfunctorily, you need to do it better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你敷衍塞責，到時出咗事，你就要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 fu1 hin2 sak1 zaak3, dou3 si4 ceot1 zo2 si6, nei5 zau6 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你敷衍了事，到时候出了事，你就要负责。
examples.english_sentence: If you shirk your responsibility, you will be responsible if something goes wrong.

synonyms: 馬馬虎虎 (maa5 maa5 fu1 fu2)

english_meaning: to count; to calculate; number; fate; to enumerate; to blame; to scold
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示计算数量；作为名词，表示数字、数量，也指命运。 在粤语中也常用于指责，抱怨，相当于“责怪”或“埋怨”。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to count or calculate. As a noun, it refers to a number, quantity, or fate. In Cantonese, it is also commonly used to mean to blame or scold someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我數吓啲錢夠唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 sou3 haa5 di1 cin2 gau3 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我数一下钱够不够。
examples.english_sentence: Help me count the money to see if it's enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日數我啦，我都盡力㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sou3 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 dou1 zeon6 lik6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是责怪我了，我已经尽力了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always blame me, I've already done my best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事唔可以就咁就算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 m4 ho2 ji5 zau6 gam2 zau6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事不可以就这么算了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter cannot be simply let go.

english_meaning: One of the best, second to none, outstanding, top-notch
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常优秀，在同类事物中排名靠前。
explanation_english: Describes something that is outstanding and ranks among the best in its category.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我哋公司係數一數二嘅programmer嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 sou2 jat1 sou2 ji6 ge3 programmer lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在我们公司是数一数二的程序员。
examples.english_sentence: He is one of the best programmers in our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心喺香港都算係數一數二㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 syun3 hai6 sou2 jat1 sou2 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心在香港也算是数一数二的。
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum at this restaurant is considered one of the best in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅歌喉喺樂壇都係數一數二，好少人可以同佢相比。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 go1 hau4 hai2 ngok6 taan4 dou1 hai6 sou2 jat1 sou2 ji6, hou2 siu2 jan4 ho2 ji5 tung4 keoi5 soeng1 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌喉在乐坛也是数一数二的，很少人可以和他相比。
examples.english_sentence: His singing voice is one of the best in the music scene, very few people can compare to him.

english_meaning: Count to three; In three counts; Give a three-count
explanation_mandarin: 表示在很短的时间内完成某事，或者给对方一个很短的时间限制。通常带有警告或威胁的意味，表示如果对方在数完三声之后仍然不配合，就会采取行动。
explanation_english: Indicates a very short timeframe to complete something, or gives the other party a very short time limit. It usually carries a warning or threatening tone, implying that action will be taken if the other party does not cooperate after counting to three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我數三聲，你再唔走，我就報警㗎喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sou3 saam1 seng1, nei5 zoi3 m4 zau2, ngo5 zau6 bou3 ging2 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我数三声，你再不走，我就报警了！
examples.english_sentence: I'll count to three, and if you don't leave, I'll call the police!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我數三聲，你哋就要企起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sou3 saam1 seng1, nei5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 kei5 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我数三声，你们就要站起来。
examples.english_sentence: I'll count to three, and you all have to stand up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話數三聲之內要交齊啲文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 sou3 saam1 seng1 zi1 noi6 jiu3 gaau1 cai4 di1 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说三声之内要交齐所有的文件。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said all the documents must be submitted within a three-count.

mandarin_meaning: 数不胜数, 多得数不清
english_meaning: countless, innumerable, too numerous to count
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，无法数清楚。
explanation_english: Describes a quantity that is too large to be counted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天上面嘅星星數之不盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 soeng6 min6 ge3 sing1 sing1 sou3 zi1 bat1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天上的星星数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: The stars in the sky are countless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅美食數之不盡，你試過幾多款？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 mei5 sik6 sou3 zi1 bat1 zeon6, nei5 si3 gwo3 gei2 do1 fun2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的美食数不胜数，你尝过多少种？
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's delicacies are innumerable, how many kinds have you tried?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擁有嘅財產數之不盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung2 jau1 ge3 coi4 saan2 sou3 zi1 bat1 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拥有的财产数不胜数。
examples.english_sentence: The property he owns is countless.

english_meaning: Numbered in...
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，以某种数量为单位计算。相当于“以…计”。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that a number is counted in units of a certain quantity; numbered in...

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅人口數以百萬計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jan4 hau2 sou3 ji5 baak3 maan6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的人口数以百万计。
examples.english_sentence: The population of Hong Kong is numbered in the millions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅損失數以億計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 syun2 sat1 sou3 ji5 jik1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的损失数以亿计。
examples.english_sentence: The losses of this company are numbered in the hundreds of millions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下載咗呢個App嘅人數數以萬計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 zai2 zo2 ni1 go3 App ge3 jan4 sou3 sou3 ji5 maan6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下载这个App的人数以万计。
examples.english_sentence: The number of people who have downloaded this App is in the tens of thousands.

english_meaning: Accountant; bean counter
explanation_mandarin: 指负责计算账目的人，通常指会计。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is responsible for calculating accounts, usually an accountant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司請咗個新嘅數佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 sou3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司请了一个新的会计。
examples.english_sentence: Our company hired a new accountant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做數佬好多年，經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 sou3 lou2 hou2 do1 nin4, ging1 gim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他当会计很多年了，经验很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: He has been an accountant for many years and has a lot of experience.

english_meaning: numerical value, value
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量的大小，一般指用数字表示的量。
explanation_english: A numerical quantity assigned or computed, usually representing a measurement or observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個圖表顯示咗唔同年份嘅銷售額數值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tou4 biu2 hin2 si6 zo2 m4 tung4 nin4 fan2 ge3 siu1 sau6 ngaak2 sou3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个图表显示了不同年份的销售额数值。
examples.english_sentence: This chart shows the sales figures (numerical values) for different years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用電腦程式嚟分析數據嘅數值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yung6 din6 nou5 cing4 sik1 lai4 fan1 sik1 sou3 geoi3 ge3 sou3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用电脑程序来分析数据的数值。
examples.english_sentence: They use computer programs to analyze the numerical values of the data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個實驗嘅結果有好多關鍵數值要留意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 ge3 git3 gwo2 jau5 hou2 do1 gwaan1 gin6 sou3 zik6 jiu3 lau4 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个实验的结果有很多关键数值需要留意。
examples.english_sentence: There are many key numerical values to pay attention to in the results of this experiment.

english_meaning: to forget one's origins; to be ungrateful to one's ancestors; to forget the source of one's blessings
explanation_mandarin: 比喻忘本；也比喻对本来的事物不了解。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to forget one's roots or origins; to be ungrateful to one's ancestors or those who came before and made things possible. It can also imply a lack of understanding of the origin or history of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家發咗達就唔記得以前點樣捱世界，真係數典忘祖！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 faat3 zo2 daat6 zau6 m4 gei3 dak1 ji5 cin4 dim2 joeng2 ngaai4 sai3 gaai3, zan1 hai6 sou2 din2 mong4 zou2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在发达了就忘记以前是怎么打拼的，真是数典忘祖！
examples.english_sentence: Now that you've become successful, you've forgotten how you struggled in the past, you're really forgetting your roots!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將啲傳統習俗全部廢除晒，根本就係數典忘祖嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 cyun4 tung2 zaap6 suk6 cyun4 bou6 fai3 ceoi4 saai3, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 sou2 din2 mong4 zou2 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把所有的传统习俗都废除了，根本就是数典忘祖的行为。
examples.english_sentence: They abolished all the traditional customs, it's basically an act of forgetting their origins.

mandarin_meaning: 算术能力; 精打细算
english_meaning: Arithmetic ability; good at calculating; shrewdness in business; being calculative.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指计算能力或对金钱、利益方面的精明程度。可以是中性的描述计算能力，也可以是负面的，指一个人很会算计，过于看重利益。
explanation_english: Generally refers to the ability to calculate, or the level of shrewdness in money and profit matters. It can be a neutral description of calculation ability, or a negative description of a person who is very calculating and overly concerned with profits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢數口好精，做生意一定掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 hau2 hou2 zing1, zou6 seng1 ji3 jat1 ding6 dim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的算术能力很强，做生意肯定成功。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at calculating, he will definitely succeed in business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁數口啦，大家朋友嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sou3 hau2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 pang4 jau5 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么斤斤计较了，大家是朋友嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so calculating, we are friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆數口唔好，成日俾人呃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sou3 hau2 m4 hou2, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 aak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶算术不好，总是被人骗。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is not good at calculating, she is always being cheated.

english_meaning: number, figure
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量的符号或用于计数的单位。
explanation_english: A symbol or word used to represent a quantity or to count.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你電話號碼嘅數字係咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 ge3 sou3 zi6 hai6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的电话号码的数字是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What are the numbers in your phone number?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個數字太大，我記唔住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 taai3 daai6, ngo5 gei3 m4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个数字太大了，我记不住。
examples.english_sentence: This number is too big, I can't remember it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢數學好好，對數字好敏感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 hok6 hou2 hou2, deoi3 sou3 zi6 hou2 man5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他数学很好，对数字很敏感。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at math and is very sensitive to numbers.

english_meaning: Data analytics
explanation_mandarin: 指用大量数据进行分析，从而得出结论或做出决策的方法，常用于体育赛事中分析球员或球队的表现。
explanation_english: Refers to the method of using a large amount of data for analysis to draw conclusions or make decisions. It is often used in sports to analyze the performance of players or teams.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅足球隊好興用數字球分析球員嘅表現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 zuk1 kau4 deoi2 hou2 hing3 yung6 sou3 zi6 kau4 fan1 sik1 kau4 yun4 ge3 biu2 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的足球队很流行用数据分析来分析球员的表现。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, football teams are very popular in using data analytics to analyze players' performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 數字球唔單止可以用喺運動度，商業決策都可以用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 zi6 kau4 m4 daan1 zi2 ho2 ji5 yung6 hai2 wan6 dung6 dou6, soeng1 jip6 kyut3 caak3 dou1 ho2 ji5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 数据分析不仅仅可以用在运动上，商业决策也可以用。
examples.english_sentence: Data analytics can be used not only in sports, but also in business decisions.

english_meaning: Mathematics
explanation_mandarin: 研究数量、结构、空间以及变化等概念的学科。
explanation_english: The abstract science of number, quantity, and space. Mathematics may be studied in its own right (pure mathematics), or as it is applied to other disciplines such as physics and engineering (applied mathematics).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意數學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sou3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢数学。
examples.english_sentence: I liked mathematics a lot when I was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢數學成績好好，將來想做工程師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 hok6 sing4绩績 hou2 hou2, zeong1 loi4 soeng2 zou6 gung1 cing4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的数学成绩很好，将来想当工程师。
examples.english_sentence: His mathematics results are very good, and he wants to be an engineer in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數學題好難，我唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 hou2 naan4, ngo5 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道数学题很难，我不会做。
examples.english_sentence: This mathematics problem is very difficult, I don't know how to do it.

english_meaning: To be last; to be at the bottom; to come in last place
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个竞争或排序中排在最后一位。 通常带有负面含义，表示表现不如其他人。
explanation_english: To be ranked at the very bottom or in last place in a competition or ranking. It usually carries a negative connotation, indicating underperformance compared to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我數尾，真係好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 sou3 mei5, zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考了最后一名，真是不开心。
examples.english_sentence: I came in last place in this exam, I'm really unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都數尾，所以冇乜自信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sou3 mei5, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 zi6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是垫底，所以没什么自信。
examples.english_sentence: He is always at the bottom, so he doesn't have much confidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，到時就數尾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6, dou3 si4 zau6 sou3 mei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，到时候就垫底了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, we'll be in last place.

english_meaning: data
explanation_mandarin: 指可以被收集、存储、处理和分析的数字或信息。
explanation_english: Refers to numerical or informational units that can be collected, stored, processed, and analyzed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告嘅數據顯示經濟有上升嘅趨勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sou3 geoi3 hin2 si6 ging1 zai3 jau5 soeng5 sing1 ge3 ceoi1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告的数据显示经济有上升的趋势。
examples.english_sentence: The data in this report shows an upward trend in the economy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要更多數據去支持呢個理論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 sou3 geoi3 heoi3 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 lei5 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更多数据来支持这个理论。
examples.english_sentence: We need more data to support this theory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大數據分析可以幫助我哋了解顧客嘅喜好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 sou3 geoi3 fan1 sik1 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 ngo5 dei6 liu5 gaai2 guk1 haak3 ge3 hei2 hou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大数据分析可以帮助我们了解顾客的喜好。
examples.english_sentence: Big data analysis can help us understand customers' preferences.

english_meaning: Data center
explanation_mandarin: 指一个专门用于容纳计算机系统及其相关组件（如电信和存储系统）的环境控制设备（如冗余电源或备用发电机、环境控制系统（如空调、灭火系统）和安全设备）的设施。
explanation_english: A facility used to house computer systems and associated components, such as telecommunications and storage systems. It generally includes redundant or backup power supplies, redundant data communications connections, environmental controls (e.g., air conditioning, fire suppression) and security devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司起咗個新嘅數據中心，用嚟儲存所有客戶嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hei2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 sou3 geoi3 zung1 sam1, yung6 lai4 cyu5 cyun4 so2 jau5 haak3 wu6 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司建了一个新的数据中心，用来存储所有客户的资料。
examples.english_sentence: Our company built a new data center to store all customer data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 數據中心嘅保安好嚴密，閒雜人等唔可以入去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 geoi3 zung1 sam1 ge3 bou2 on1 hou2 yim4 mat6, haan4 zaap6 yan4 dang2 m4 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 数据中心的保安非常严密，闲杂人等不可以进去的。
examples.english_sentence: The security of the data center is very strict, unauthorized personnel are not allowed to enter.

english_meaning: Database
explanation_mandarin: 储存和组织数据的电子系统。
explanation_english: A structured set of data held in a computer, especially one that is accessible in various ways.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅數據庫好大，要時間先搵到想要嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 sou3 geoi3 fu3 hou2 daai6, jiu3 si4 gaan3 sin1 wan2 dou2 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的数据量很大，需要时间才能找到想要的资料。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's database is huge, it takes time to find the information we need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你需要學點樣管理數據庫先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hok6 dim2 yeung2 gun2 lei5 sou3 geoi3 fu3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要学习如何管理数据库才行。
examples.english_sentence: You need to learn how to manage a database.

english_meaning: modem
explanation_mandarin: 一种将计算机的数字信号转换为模拟信号，以便通过电话线传输，或将接收到的模拟信号转换回数字信号的设备。
explanation_english: A device that converts digital signals from a computer to analog signals for transmission over telephone lines, or converts received analog signals back to digital signals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前上網要用數據機，而家直接用寬頻方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 soeng5 mong5 jiu3 yung6 sou3 geoi3 gei1, ji4 gaa1 zik6 zip3 yung6 fun1 pin4 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.

mandarin_meaning: 清点碗碟；形容斤斤计较、小气

jyutping: sou3 waan4 sou3 lou6 waan4 lou6
mandarin_meaning: 账归账，路归路; 各不相干
english_meaning: What's done is done; Let bygones be bygones; Money matters are money matters, personal matters are personal matters.
explanation_mandarin: 意思是账目和情义要分清楚，互不相干。处理事情时，公私分明，避免混淆。
explanation_english: This idiom means that financial and personal matters should be kept separate and not mixed up. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining clear boundaries between business and personal relationships to avoid conflicts and ensure fairness. It's similar to saying "business is business" or "don't mix business with pleasure."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋係老友，但係數還數路還路，欠你嘅錢我會還嘅。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我们是老朋友，但是账归账路归路，欠你的钱我会还的。
examples.english_sentence: Although we are old friends, what's done is done. I'll pay you back the money I owe you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆講到明，數還數路還路，唔會因為我係佢親戚就鬆手㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说得很清楚，账归账路归路，不会因为我是他的亲戚就放水的。
examples.english_sentence: The boss made it clear, money matters are money matters. He won't be lenient just because I'm his relative.

english_meaning: What's owed is owed, what's due is due; Business is business; To keep things separate and distinct; Each issue should be dealt with separately.
explanation_mandarin: 形容处理事情要公私分明，互不干涉。 该算账的要算账，该怎样还是怎样。指即使关系亲密，涉及利益时也要分清楚。
explanation_english: This idiom means to separate different matters and deal with them independently and fairly. It emphasizes that even if there is a personal relationship, financial or other matters should be handled strictly according to the rules, and one matter shouldn't influence another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係好朋友，但係講到錢銀，數還數，路還路，一定要清清楚楚。

explanation_english: Describes a person, usually a woman, as being gentle, kind, and in good health; gentle and peaceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個女仔好文康，好得人鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi5 zai2 hou2 man1 hong1, hou2 dak1 jan4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的女儿很温柔体贴，很讨人喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: Her daughter is very gentle and kind, and very likable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢將來可以搵到個文康嘅老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 go3 man1 hong1 ge3 lou5 po2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望他将来可以找到一个温柔体贴的妻子。
examples.english_sentence: I hope he can find a gentle and kind wife in the future.

english_meaning: rich in both literary talent and emotional expression; eloquent and touching
explanation_mandarin: 形容文章或作品的文采和感情都很丰富，具有感染力。
explanation_english: Describes a piece of writing or work of art that is rich in both literary talent and emotional expression, making it deeply moving and impactful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢篇演講稿寫得文情並茂，聽眾聽得好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pin1 jin2 gong2 gou2 se2 dak1 man4 cing4 bing6 mau6, ting1 zung3 ting1 dak1 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲稿写得文情并茂，听众听得非常感动。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was so eloquently and touchingly written that the audience was deeply moved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影文情並茂咁描寫咗一段刻骨銘心嘅愛情故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 man4 cing4 bing6 mau6 gam2 miu4 se2 zo2 jat1 dyun6 hak1 gu2 ming4 sam1 ge3 oi3 ching4 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影文情并茂地描写了一段刻骨铭心的爱情故事。
examples.english_sentence: This movie eloquently and touchingly portrays a deeply unforgettable love story.

english_meaning: diploma, certificate
explanation_mandarin: 指由学校或其他机构授予的证明完成特定学习课程的证书。
explanation_english: A document certifying completion of a course of study or training, such as a diploma or certificate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個大學文憑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 daai6 hok6 man4 pang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到了大学文凭。
examples.english_sentence: He got a university diploma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有張文憑，搵工都容易啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zoeng1 man4 pang4, wan2 gung1 dou1 jung4 ji6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有张文凭，找工作也容易些。
examples.english_sentence: Having a diploma makes it easier to find a job.

english_meaning: Diploma teacher (referring to a teacher with a teaching diploma, often implying a lower level of qualification compared to a degree-holding teacher)
explanation_mandarin: 指持有文凭的教师。 在香港，通常暗示其学历不如持有学士学位的教师。
explanation_english: Refers to a teacher who holds a teaching diploma. In Hong Kong context, it often carries the connotation of having a lower level of qualification compared to teachers holding a bachelor's degree or higher. It might imply less experience or expertise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前好多學校都請文憑教師，但係而家大部分都請學位教師喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hou2 do1 hok6 haau6 dou1 ceng2 man1 ping3 gaau3 si1, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 ceng2 hok6 wai2 gaau3 si1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前很多学校都聘请文凭教师，但是现在大部分都聘请学位教师了。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many schools hired diploma teachers, but now most of them hire degree-holding teachers.

english_meaning: Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination (HKDSE)
explanation_mandarin: 香港中学文凭考试，简称文凭试，是香港中学生取得中学毕业资格的公开考试。
explanation_english: The Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education Examination (HKDSE), a qualification offered upon completion of a six-year secondary education. It is the main university entrance examination in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅文憑試好難啊，好多人都話啲題目好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 man4 ping3 si5 hou2 naan4 aa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 di1 tai4 muk6 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的中学文凭考试很难啊，很多人都说题目很深奥。
examples.english_sentence: This year's HKDSE is very difficult, many people say the questions are very profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗考好文憑試，日日溫書溫到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haau2 hou2 man4 ping3 si5, jat1 jat6 wan1 syu1 wan1 dou3 hou2 je6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了考好中学文凭考试，他每天学习到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: In order to do well in the HKDSE, he studies very late every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考完文憑試之後，佢打算去外國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 jyun4 man4 ping3 si5 zi1 hau6, keoi5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考完中学文凭考试之后，他打算去外国读书。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing the HKDSE, he plans to study abroad.

english_meaning: Accomplished in both civil administration and military prowess; possessing both literary and martial virtues.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人在文化和军事方面都非常出色。文：指文化，文学，治国理政等；武：指军事，武力，战争等。德：指道德，品德。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is outstanding in both civil and military aspects. 文 (man4) refers to culture, literature, governance, etc.; 武 (mou5) refers to military affairs, martial arts, warfare, etc.; 德 (dak1) refers to morality and virtue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係文成武德，識得搞經濟又識得帶兵打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 man4 sing4 mou5 dak1, sik1 dak1 gaau2 ging1 zai3 jau6 sik1 dak1 daai3 bing1 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是文治武功，既会搞经济又会带兵打仗。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly accomplished in both civil administration and military prowess, knowing how to manage the economy and lead troops in battle.

english_meaning: drama with primarily dialogue and acting, not action scenes; dialogue-heavy scene; character-driven scene
explanation_mandarin: 指以对话和表演为主，动作场面较少的戏剧或电影场景。强调演员的演技和情感表达。
explanation_english: Refers to a drama or film scene that primarily focuses on dialogue and acting rather than action. It emphasizes the actors' performance and emotional expression. It can also generally refer to parts of a drama that focus on the dialogue and emotional relationships between characters, rather than on action or special effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場戲都係文戲嚟啫，冇乜動作場面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 hei3 dou1 hai6 man1 hei3 lai4 ze1, mou5 mat1 dung6 zok3 coeng4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场戏都是文戏而已，没什么动作场面。
examples.english_sentence: This scene is just dialogue-driven, there aren't many action scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演技喺文戲入面先至可以完全發揮出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gei6 hai2 man1 hei3 jap6 min6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 faat3 fai1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演技在文戏里面才可以完全发挥出来。
examples.english_sentence: His acting skills can only be fully displayed in drama scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意睇文戲多啲，覺得可以睇到演員嘅內心世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 man1 hei3 do1 di1, gok3 dak1 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 jin2 jyun4 ge3 noi6 sam1 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢看文戏多一点，觉得可以看到演员的内心世界。
examples.english_sentence: I prefer to watch drama scenes more, I feel like I can see the actors' inner world.

english_meaning: The Four Treasures of the Study (writing brush, ink stick, paper, and inkstone)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国传统的书法和绘画工具：笔、墨、纸、砚。
explanation_english: Refers to the traditional Chinese writing and painting tools: writing brush, ink stick, paper, and inkstone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企嘅書房擺滿咗文房四寶，睇得出佢哋對傳統文化好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 syu1 fong4 baai2 mun5 zo2 man4 fong4 sei3 bou2, tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 dei6 deoi3 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家里的书房摆满了文房四宝，看得出他们对传统文化很有兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: Their study is filled with the Four Treasures of the Study, showing that they are very interested in traditional culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家好少人用文房四寶寫字，通常都係用電腦打字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 jan4 yung6 man4 fong4 sei3 bou2 se2 zi6, tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 yung6 din6 nou5 daa2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少人用文房四宝写字，通常都是用电脑打字。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, few people use the Four Treasures of the Study to write; usually they use computers to type.

english_meaning: plagiarist, copycat, one who steals literary works
explanation_mandarin: 指抄袭他人文章、作品的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who plagiarizes the writings or works of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做文抄公，啲功課都係抄人哋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 man4 caau1 gung1, di1 gung1 fo3 dou1 hai6 caau1 jan4 dei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是当抄袭者，作业都是抄别人的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always a plagiarist, his homework is all copied from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做文抄公啊，自己諗吓好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 man4 caau1 gung1 aa3, zi6 gei2 lam2 haa5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要当抄袭者啊，自己想想比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a plagiarist, it's better to think for yourself.

english_meaning: Wenchang (God of literature and scholarly success)
explanation_mandarin: 文昌帝君，道教和民间信仰中的掌管文运功名的神祇。也指与之相关的庙宇或方位。
explanation_english: Wenchang refers to the God of literature and scholarly success in Taoism and folk religion. It can also refer to temples dedicated to Wenchang or a direction associated with good fortune in studies and career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽叫我拜文昌，希望我考試順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 giu3 ngo5 baai3 man4 cheung1, hei1 mong6 ngo5 haau2 si3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈叫我拜文昌帝君，希望我考试顺利。
examples.english_sentence: My mom told me to pray to Wenchang, hoping my exams will go smoothly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 風水先生話書房擺喺文昌位最好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fung1 seoi2 sin1 saang1 waa6 syu1 fong2 baai2 hai2 man4 cheung1 wai2 zeoi3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 风水先生说书房摆在文昌位最好。
examples.english_sentence: The Feng Shui master said it's best to place the study room in the Wenchang position.

english_meaning: civilization; culture; civilized; cultured
explanation_mandarin: 指人类社会发展到较高阶段的状态，包括物质文明和精神文明；也指具有较高文化素养和行为规范。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of human society having developed to a relatively high stage, including material civilization and spiritual civilization; also refers to having high cultural accomplishments and behavioral standards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個高度文明嘅城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 gou1 dou6 man4 ming4 ge3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个高度文明的城市。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a highly civilized city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提倡文明禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 coeng3 man4 ming4 lai5 mau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要提倡文明礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: We should promote civility and courtesy.

english_meaning: document; paperwork; official correspondence
explanation_mandarin: 指正式的文件、公文、书面材料等。
explanation_english: Refers to formal documents, official papers, written materials, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責處理公司嘅所有文書工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 chu5 lei5 gung1 si1 ge3 so2 jau5 man4 syu1 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责处理公司的所有文件工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's responsible for handling all the company's paperwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份文書需要老闆簽名先有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 man4 syu1 seoi1 jiu3 lou5 baan2 chim1 meng2 sin1 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件需要老板签名才有效。
examples.english_sentence: This document needs the boss's signature to be valid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將啲文書整理好未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jeung1 di1 man4 syu1 zing2 lei5 hou2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把那些文件整理好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you organized those documents yet?

english_meaning: body double (for acting scenes, not stunts); stand-in for dialogue scenes
explanation_mandarin: 在电影或电视剧拍摄中，演员因故无法亲自拍摄文戏（非动作戏，如对白、情感戏等）时，代替演员出镜的人。
explanation_english: In film or television production, a person who replaces an actor in non-action scenes (such as dialogue or emotional scenes) when the actor is unable to film them themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拍呢套戲好多都係用文替嘅，因為佢唔識講廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paak3 ni1 tou3 hei3 ho2 do1 dou1 hai6 yung6 man4 tai3 ge3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拍这部戏很多场景都用了文戏替身，因为他不会说广东话。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of body doubles for the dialogue scenes in this movie because he can't speak Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做文替都唔容易㗎，要記熟晒啲對白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 man4 tai3 dou1 m4 jung4 yi6 gaa3, jiu3 gei3 suk6 saai3 di1 deoi3 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当文戏替身也不容易，需要记住所有的台词。
examples.english_sentence: Being a body double isn't easy; you have to memorize all the lines.

english_meaning: text, text document
explanation_mandarin: 指书面材料的内容，例如文章、报告、信件等。
explanation_english: Refers to the content of written material, such as articles, reports, letters, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文本寫得幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 bun2 se2 dak1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文本写得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This text is written very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要分析下呢個文本嘅內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fan1 sik1 haa5 ni1 go3 man4 bun2 ge3 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要分析一下这个文本的内容。
examples.english_sentence: We need to analyze the content of this text.

english_meaning: document, file
explanation_mandarin: 指记录信息的文件，可以是纸质的，也可以是电子的。
explanation_english: Refers to a document that records information, which can be paper or electronic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文檔好重要，你唔好搞唔見啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 dong2 hou2 zung6 jiu3, nei5 m4 hou2 gaau2 m4 gin3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文档很重要，你不要弄丢了。
examples.english_sentence: This document is very important, don't lose it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要將呢啲資料整理成一份文檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 zoeng1 ni1 di1 zi1 liu2 zing2 lei5 sing4 jat1 fan6 man4 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要将这些资料整理成一份文档。
examples.english_sentence: I need to organize these materials into a document.

mandarin_meaning: 文武全才; 多才多艺; 万事通
english_meaning: Jack-of-all-trades; all-rounder; multi-talented
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人文才武略兼备，或指一个人多才多艺，什么都会一点。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is skilled in both literary and martial arts, or refers to someone who is multi-talented and knows a little bit about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係文武吧，咩都識啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 man1 mou5 baa1, me1 dou1 sik1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个文武全才，什么都会一点。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a jack-of-all-trades, he knows a little bit about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明文武吧，又識彈琴又識畫畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 man1 mou5 baa1, jau6 sik1 taan4 kam4 jau6 sik1 waak6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明真是多才多艺，又会弹琴又会画画。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is really multi-talented, he can play the piano and paint.

english_meaning: skilled in both literary and military arts; accomplished in both intellectual and physical pursuits
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人既有文才又有武艺，文武兼备，才能出众。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is proficient in both literary and martial arts, possessing both intellectual and physical abilities, and outstanding talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就開始學功夫同埋書法，真係文武雙全呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 gung1 fu1 tung4 maai4 syu1 faat3, zan1 hai6 man4 mou5 soeng1 cyun4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学功夫和书法，真是文武双全啊！
examples.english_sentence: He started learning kung fu and calligraphy since he was young, truly skilled in both literary and martial arts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成為一個好嘅領導，除咗要識管理，都要有啲魄力，最好就係文武雙全啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 ling5 dou6, ceoi4 zo2 jiu3 sik1 gun2 lei5, dou1 jiu3 jau5 di1 paak3 lik6, zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 man4 mou5 soeng1 cyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成为一个好的领导，除了要懂得管理，还要有些魄力，最好就是文武双全了。
examples.english_sentence: To be a good leader, you need to know how to manage and also have some courage and boldness; it's best to be skilled in both literary and military arts.

english_meaning: grammar
explanation_mandarin: 语言中词汇的构成和变化的规则，以及用词造句的规则。
explanation_english: The system of rules governing the structure and arrangement of words and phrases in a language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你文法咁差，點寫好篇文呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man1 faat3 gam3 caa1, dim2 se2 hou2 pin1 man4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的语法这么差，怎么写好文章啊？
examples.english_sentence: Your grammar is so bad, how can you write a good essay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書教你點樣學好英文文法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 gaau3 nei5 dim2 yeung2 hok6 hou2 ying1 man2 man1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书教你怎样学好英语语法。
examples.english_sentence: This book teaches you how to learn English grammar well.

english_meaning: Grammar school
explanation_mandarin: 指主要教授拉丁语、希腊语和其他经典学科的学校，通常是中学。
explanation_english: A grammar school is a type of secondary school which selects students on the basis of academic ability, typically focusing on the study of classics (Latin and Greek) and other academic subjects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前喺英國讀文法學校，所以英文底子好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai2 ying1 gwok3 duk6 man1 faat3 hok6 haau6, so2 ji5 ying1 man2 dai2 zi2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前在英国读文法学校，所以英文底子很好。
examples.english_sentence: He used to study in a grammar school in the UK, so his English foundation is very solid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港冇文法學校，但係以前都有類似嘅制度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 mou5 man1 faat3 hok6 haau6, daan6 hai6 ji5 cin4 dou1 jau5 leoi5 si6 ge3 zai3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港没有文法学校，但是以前也有类似的制度。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong doesn't have grammar schools, but there used to be a similar system before.

english_meaning: low heat; simmer
explanation_mandarin: 烹饪时使用的火力小的火候。
explanation_english: Low heat, used in cooking, typically for simmering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用文火煲湯先至好飲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 man1 fo2 bou1 tong1 sin1 zai3 hou2 jam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用小火炖汤才好喝。
examples.english_sentence: Simmering soup over low heat is what makes it taste good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餸要用文火慢慢炆先會入味。

jyutping: man1 mou4 dai6 jat1, mou5 mou4 dai6 ji6

explanation_english: This idiom means that in literary and artistic pursuits, standards are subjective, making it difficult to determine an absolute best. However, in martial arts competitions, victory is paramount, and only the winner can be considered the best. It emphasizes the subjective nature of art versus the objective nature of combat.

examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 je5 ni1 di1 je5, man1 mou4 dai6 jat1, mou5 mou4 dai6 ji6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 zi6 gei2 zung1 ji3.

english_meaning: cultural relic; historical relic; antique

english_meaning: literature; documents

explanation_english: Documents or written works that have historical or scholarly significance; literature.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 写论文的时候，一定要参考一些相关的文献。
examples.english_sentence: When writing a thesis, you must refer to some relevant literature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文獻記錄咗當時嘅社會情況。

english_meaning: illiterate

explanation_english: A person who is unable to read and write; illiterate.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 科技发展得这么快，就算不是文盲，不学习新东西也很快过时。
examples.english_sentence: With technology developing so quickly, even if you're not illiterate, you'll quickly become outdated if you don't learn new things.

english_meaning: arts (subject); humanities
explanation_mandarin: 指人文科学，如文学、历史、哲学等。
explanation_english: Refers to the humanities, such as literature, history, philosophy, etc.

english_meaning: manuscript; draft; text
explanation_mandarin: 书面稿件；待发表或未发表的文章。

english_meaning: article, essay, writing
explanation_mandarin: 指具有完整主题和结构的文字作品，通常用于表达观点、叙述事件或进行论证。
explanation_english: A piece of writing with a complete theme and structure, usually used to express opinions, narrate events, or make arguments.

examples.english_sentence: This time, the exam requires writing an argumentative essay.

english_meaning: writing style, literary talent
explanation_mandarin: 指文章的写作风格和技巧。
explanation_english: Refers to the style and skill of writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇嘢嘅文筆好流暢，讀起嚟好舒服。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章的文笔很流畅，读起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The writing style of this article is very smooth, and it's comfortable to read.

english_meaning: bookish; pedantic; overly refined in speech or writing; stilted
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或文章咬文嚼字，过于讲究辞藻和典故，显得不自然、不流畅。
explanation_english: Describing speech or writing that is overly refined and filled with literary allusions and elaborate diction, making it sound unnatural and stilted. It implies a preoccupation with style over substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日都文縐縐，好似背書咁。

english_meaning: art and literature; artistic; literary
explanation_mandarin: 指艺术和文学方面的事物，或形容某人具有艺术气质。
explanation_english: Refers to things related to art and literature, or describes someone who has an artistic temperament.

examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people find Classical Chinese difficult to learn.

english_meaning: pedantic, bookish, affectedly erudite, overly refined in speech
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话或行事过于咬文嚼字，卖弄学问，给人一种不自然，不坦率的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone who speaks or acts in a pedantic, overly formal, and bookish manner, often with the intention of showing off their knowledge, resulting in an unnatural and insincere impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁文謅謅啦，講啲人聽得明嘅嘢啦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人文质彬彬，很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very refined and cultured person, very polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅舉止文質彬彬，令人覺得佢好有教養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 geoi2 zi2 man4 zat1 ban1 ban1, ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 jau5 gaau3 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的举止文质彬彬，让人觉得他很有教养。
examples.english_sentence: His manner is refined, making people think that he is very well-educated.

english_meaning: connections, contacts, channels, way (of doing things), influence
explanation_mandarin: 指办事的关系、渠道、门路。通常指通过人际关系或者不正当的手段来达到目的。
explanation_english: Refers to connections, contacts, channels, or ways of getting things done, often implying the use of personal relationships or sometimes less than legitimate means to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港做生意，冇啲文路真係好難搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 saang1 ji3, mou5 di1 man6 lou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港做生意，没有一些门路真的很难办。
examples.english_sentence: Doing business in Hong Kong is really difficult without some connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠晒佢老豆嘅文路先入到呢間公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 saai3 keoi5 lou5 dau2 ge3 man6 lou6 sin1 jap6 dou2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全靠他父亲的关系才能进入这家公司。
examples.english_sentence: He got into this company entirely because of his father's connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇文路，搵唔到好嘅醫生幫我睇病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 man6 lou6, wan2 m4 dou2 hou2 ge3 ji1 sang1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我没有关系，找不到好的医生帮我治病。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have the connections to find a good doctor to treat my illness.

english_meaning: to gloss over one's faults; to cover up mistakes
explanation_mandarin: 用虚假的言辞来掩盖自己的错误或缺点。
explanation_english: To conceal one's faults or errors by using deceptive language or justifications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日文過飾非，唔肯認自己嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 man4 gwo3 sik1 fei1, m4 hang2 jing6 zi6 gei2 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是文过饰非，不肯承认自己的错误。
examples.english_sentence: He always glosses over his faults and refuses to admit his mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅領導文過飾非，將公司嘅問題隱瞞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 ling5 dou6 man4 gwo3 sik1 fei1, zoeng1 gung1 si1 ge3 man6 tai4 yan2 mun4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的领导文过饰非，将公司的问题隐瞒了。
examples.english_sentence: The company's leader covered up the company's problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意佢咁樣，文過飾非，唔夠坦誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5 gam2 joeng2, man4 gwo3 sik1 fei1, m4 gau3 taan2 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢他这样，文过饰非，不够坦诚。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like him acting this way, covering up his mistakes, he's not honest enough.

english_meaning: literary talent; elegant writing style
explanation_mandarin: 指写作方面的才华，文辞华丽。
explanation_english: Refers to literary talent, especially when reflected in elegant and refined writing style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫嘅文章好有文采，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 ge3 man4 zoeng1 hou2 jau5 man4 coi2, hou2 kap1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写的文章很有文采，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: His writing is very elegant and captivating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位作家嘅文采真係一流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 zok3 gaa1 ge3 man4 coi2 zan1 hai6 jat1 lau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位作家的文采真是一流。
examples.english_sentence: This writer's literary talent is truly first-class.

english_meaning: Pickpocket; Thief (specifically a petty thief, often operating in a group)
explanation_mandarin: 指小偷，扒手，通常指团伙作案的小偷。
explanation_english: Refers to a pickpocket or thief, particularly one who operates as part of a small gang. It suggests a certain level of artistry or skill in the theft, though often of a petty nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講呢頭好多文雀㗎，小心啲你啲嘢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ni1 tau4 hou2 do1 man1 zoek3 gaa3, siu2 sam1 di1 nei5 di1 je5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这里有很多扒手，小心你的东西啊。
examples.english_sentence: I heard there are a lot of pickpockets around here, be careful with your belongings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班文雀喺度搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 baan1 man1 zoek3 hai2 dou6 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一伙小偷在这里谋生。
examples.english_sentence: They're a gang of pickpockets making a living here.

english_meaning: refined, elegant, cultured, graceful
explanation_mandarin: 指人的言谈举止、行为等表现出一种高雅、有文化修养的风格。
