examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係斷咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 dyun6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系断了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship broke down.

english_meaning: Drop the idea; give up on that plan; forget about it.
explanation_mandarin: 表示放弃某个念头或计划，不再尝试。
explanation_english: Indicates to give up on an idea, plan, or possibility; to not attempt something anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你斷咗攞獎嘅計啦，人哋勁過你好多喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dyun6 zo2 lo2 zoeng2 ge3 gai3 laa1, jan4 dei6 ging6 gwo3 nei5 hou2 do1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你死了拿奖这条心吧，人家比你厉害很多呢。
examples.english_sentence: You should drop the idea of winning the award; the others are much better than you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔鍾意你，你斷咗追佢嘅計啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 nei5, nei5 dyun6 zo2 zeoi1 keoi5 ge3 gai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她都不喜欢你，你死了追她的这条心吧。
examples.english_sentence: She doesn't even like you; you should give up on chasing her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我勸你斷咗靠佢嘅計啦，佢根本唔會幫你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hyun3 nei5 dyun6 zo2 kaau3 keoi5 ge3 gai3 laa1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 bong1 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我劝你死了靠他的这条心吧，他根本不会帮你的。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you to forget about relying on him; he definitely won't help you.

english_meaning: to break off diplomatic relations; to cut off relations (with someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指国家之间断绝外交关系，或个人之间断绝来往。
explanation_english: Refers to a country breaking off diplomatic relations with another country, or individuals cutting off contact with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為啲錢銀瓜葛斷咗交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 yan1 wai6 di1 cin2 ngan2 gwaa1 got3 dyun6 zo2 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为一些金钱纠纷断交了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke off relations because of some money disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰兩個國家斷咗交，短期內都唔會有任何貿易來往喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 dyun6 zo2 gaau1, dyun2 kei4 noi6 dou1 m4 wui5 jau5 jam6 ho4 mau6 jik6 loi4 wong5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那两个国家断交了，短期内都不会有任何贸易往来了。
examples.english_sentence: Those two countries have broken off diplomatic relations, and there will be no trade between them in the short term.

mandarin_meaning: 片面历史；截断历史；以朝代为断限的历史
english_meaning: incomplete history; fragmented history; history limited to a single dynasty
explanation_mandarin: 指只描述某个朝代或时期的历史，缺少对整体历史脉络的连贯性理解。也用来比喻对事物发展缺乏完整认识，只了解部分片面信息。
explanation_english: Refers to a history that focuses solely on a specific dynasty or period, lacking a coherent understanding of the overall historical context. It can also be used metaphorically to describe a lack of complete understanding of the development of something, only knowing partial and fragmented information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係睇過唐朝嘅歷史，對成個中國歷史嚟講，可以話係睇咗啲斷代史噉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 tai2 gwo3 tong4 ciu4 ge3 lik6 si2, deoi3 sing4 go3 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 lai4 gong2, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 tai2 zo2 di1 dyun6 doi6 si2 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只看过唐朝的历史，对于整个中国历史来说，可以说是看了些片面历史。
examples.english_sentence: He has only read about the history of the Tang Dynasty. When it comes to the entire Chinese history, you could say he has only read a fragmented history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以淨係睇到呢單嘢嘅表面，要了解返成件事嘅背景，如果唔係就會好似睇斷代史噉，唔夠全面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 tai2 dou2 ni1 daan1 je5 ge3 biu2 min6, jiu3 liu2 gaai2 faan1 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 bui3 ging2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 wui5 hou2 ci5 tai2 dyun6 doi6 si2 gam2, m4 gau3 cyun4 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能只看到这件事的表面，要了解整件事的背景，不然就会像看片面历史一样，不够全面。
examples.english_sentence: You can't just look at the surface of this matter; you need to understand the whole background of the situation, otherwise it'll be like reading a fragmented history, not comprehensive enough.

english_meaning: to guess wildly; to speculate; to make assumptions
explanation_mandarin: 没有根据地胡乱猜测。
explanation_english: To make a wild guess or assumption without any solid evidence or basis. Often used to express disapproval of someone's speculation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好斷估啦，根本就唔係咁嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 dyun3 gu2 laa1, gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 hai6 gam2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要瞎猜了，根本就不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just make wild guesses, it's not like that at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好斷估我會點做，你根本唔了解我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dyun3 gu2 ngo5 wui5 dim2 zou6, nei5 gan1 bun2 m4 liu2 gaai2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要猜测我会怎么做，你根本不了解我。
examples.english_sentence: Don't assume what I would do, you don't understand me at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日斷估啲嘢，所以成日錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dyun3 gu2 di1 je5, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡乱猜测，所以总是错。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes wild guesses, so he's always wrong.

english_meaning: to stop providing; to stop making payments (e.g., mortgage payments)
explanation_mandarin: 停止提供资金或物质，通常指停止支付按揭贷款。
explanation_english: To cease providing funds or materials, usually referring to stopping mortgage payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓價跌咁多，好多人驚斷供啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 gaa3 dit3 gam3 do1, hou2 do1 jan4 geng1 dyun3 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房价跌了这么多，很多人担心断供啊。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices have fallen so much, a lot of people are worried about defaulting on their mortgage payments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，佢哋差啲斷供層樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, keoi5 dei6 caa1 di1 dyun3 gung1 cang4 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，他们差点断供了那套房子。
examples.english_sentence: Because of the poor economy, they almost defaulted on their mortgage for that apartment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果失業，就好容易斷供。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 sat1 jip6, zau6 hou2 yung4 yi6 dyun3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果失业，就很容易断供。
examples.english_sentence: If you lose your job, it's very easy to default on your mortgage.

english_meaning: To sever ties with one's relatives; to become estranged from one's family; to be alone and isolated due to one's actions or character.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因为某种原因，例如性格古怪、行为极端，导致与亲属关系疏远甚至断绝。
explanation_english: Describes a person who, due to certain reasons, such as eccentric character or extreme behavior, becomes estranged from or completely severs ties with their relatives. Often implies a negative connotation, suggesting the person's own fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁衰格，遲早斷六親㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 seoi1 gaak3, ci4 zou2 dyun6 luk6 can1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人品行这么差，迟早会和亲戚断绝关系的。
examples.english_sentence: His character is so awful; sooner or later, he will sever ties with his relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到斷六親，老婆都走埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 dyun6 luk6 can1, lou5 po4 dou1 zau2 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌到众叛亲离，连老婆都跑了。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled so much that he became estranged from his relatives, even his wife left him.

english_meaning: to wean (a baby)
explanation_mandarin: 指停止给婴儿哺乳。
explanation_english: To stop breastfeeding or giving milk to a baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經幫個仔斷咗奶喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 bong1 go3 zai2 dyun6 zo2 naai5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经帮儿子断奶了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already weaned our son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打算幾時幫個女斷奶啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 syun3 gei2 si4 bong1 go3 neoi5 dyun6 naai5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算什么时候帮女儿断奶啊？
examples.english_sentence: When are you planning to wean your daughter?

english_meaning: to conclude; to determine; to decide; to judge
explanation_mandarin: 确定地判断；判定。
explanation_english: To make a definite judgment or conclusion about something; to determine or decide something with certainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我斷定佢一定會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dyun3 ding6 keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我断定他一定会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sure he will succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生斷定佢患咗感冒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 dyun3 ding6 keoi5 waan6 zo2 gam2 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生断定他得了感冒。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor determined that he had caught a cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以咁快斷定邊個啱邊個錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 faai3 dyun3 ding6 bin1 go3 aam1 bin1 go3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能这么快断定谁对谁错。
examples.english_sentence: I can't quickly decide who is right and who is wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 收尾；结束；停止；不再继续
english_meaning: to stop; to end; to finish; to not continue (doing something); to cut off the tail (literal meaning, but rarely used as such)
explanation_mandarin: 原意是切断动物的尾巴。引申义是停止，结束，不再继续某种行为或活动。通常指中途停止或放弃。
explanation_english: Originally refers to cutting off an animal's tail. The extended meaning is to stop, end, or not continue a certain behavior or activity. It usually refers to stopping or giving up halfway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事都咁耐啦，都係斷尾算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dou1 gam3 noi6 laa1, dou1 hai6 dyun3 mei5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事都这么久了，还是结束算了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has been going on for so long, let's just end it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要減肥，但係食咗一日就斷尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, daan6 hai6 sik6 zo2 jat1 jat6 zau6 dyun3 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要减肥，但是吃了一天就停止了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to lose weight, but he stopped after just one day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程中途斷尾，損失好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 zung1 tou4 dyun3 mei5, syun2 sat1 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程中途停止，损失很大。
examples.english_sentence: This project was stopped midway, resulting in a great loss.

english_meaning: fault line; discontinuity; gap; generation gap
explanation_mandarin: 地质学上的断层；比喻事物发展或传承中出现的中断或缺失；也指代代之间的代沟。
explanation_english: Geological fault line; metaphorically refers to a break or gap in the development or inheritance of something; also refers to the generation gap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港電影業出現咗嚴重嘅人才斷層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 din6 jing2 jip6 ceot1 jin6 zo2 jim4 zung6 ge3 jan4 coi4 dyun6 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港电影业出现了严重的人才断层。
examples.english_sentence: There is a serious talent gap in the Hong Kong film industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩代人之間嘅價值觀斷層好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 doi6 jan4 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1 dyun6 cang4 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两代人之间的价值观断层很大。
examples.english_sentence: The generation gap in values between the two generations is very large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次地震形成咗一個好明顯嘅地殼斷層。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 dei6 zan3 jing4 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 ming4 hin2 ge3 dei6 hok3 dyun6 cang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次地震形成了一个很明显的地壳断层。
examples.english_sentence: This earthquake formed a very obvious crustal fault.

english_meaning: out of stock; sold out; completely sold out; very popular and hard to get
explanation_mandarin: 指商品因为非常受欢迎而全部售完，供不应求，导致市场出现空缺。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where a product is so popular that it is completely sold out, resulting in a shortage in the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款口罩好好賣，成日都斷市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 kwan2 hau2 zaau3 hou2 hou2 maai6, sing4 jat6 dou1 dyun6 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款口罩卖得很好，经常都脱销。
examples.english_sentence: These masks sell very well and are often out of stock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會啲飛一開賣就斷市，真係好難買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 di1 fei1 jat1 hoi1 maai6 zau6 dyun6 si5, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会的票一开售就脱销了，真的很难买到。
examples.english_sentence: The concert tickets were sold out as soon as they went on sale, it's really hard to get them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部最新款嘅iPhone一出就斷市，好多人都買唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 zeoi3 san1 kwan2 ge3 iPhone jat1 ceot1 zau6 dyun6 si5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 maai5 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最新款的iPhone一上市就脱销，很多人都买不到。
examples.english_sentence: The newest iPhone model sold out as soon as it was released, and many people couldn't buy it.

english_meaning: to interrupt; to cut short; to abort; to terminate abruptly
explanation_mandarin: 中途停止或打断某个动作或过程。
explanation_english: To stop or interrupt an action or process midway; to terminate abruptly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好斷打人哋講嘢啦，好唔禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dyun6 daa2 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 laa1, hou2 m4 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要打断别人说话，很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't interrupt people when they are talking, it's very impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個程式行到一半斷打咗，唔知咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cing4 sik1 haang4 dou3 jat1 bun3 dyun6 daa2 zo2, m4 zi1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 程序运行到一半中断了，不知道什么原因。
examples.english_sentence: The program was aborted halfway through, I don't know why.

english_meaning: Simian crease (a single crease across the palm); supposedly indicative of a strong-willed personality or a difficult life.
explanation_mandarin: 指手掌上只有一条横贯掌心的纹路，而非正常人的三条。在传统观念中，断掌的人性格固执，命运多舛，但也有说法是代表事业心强。
explanation_english: Refers to a single crease running across the palm of the hand, instead of the usual three. Traditionally, people with simian creases are thought to be stubborn and have difficult lives, but some believe it signifies a strong work ethic and career success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻手係斷掌，聽講會好固執㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 sau2 hai6 dyun3 zoeng2, teng1 gong2 wui5 hou2 gu3 zap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手是断掌，听说会很固执。
examples.english_sentence: He has a simian crease. I heard people with it are very stubborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話斷掌嘅女人好惡，但我唔信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 dyun3 zoeng2 ge3 neoi5 jan2 hou2 ok3, daan6 ngo5 m4 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说断掌的女人很凶，但我才不信。
examples.english_sentence: People say women with simian creases are mean, but I don't believe it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺話斷掌嘅人事業會做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 waa6 dyun3 zoeng2 ge3 jan4 si6 jip6 wui5 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷说断掌的人事业会做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather said people with simian creases will have successful careers.

english_meaning: To malfunction, break down suddenly; to have a sudden problem; to be out of order; to have a hiccup.
explanation_mandarin: 指机器、设备、电子产品等突然出现故障，无法正常工作。也指突然出现问题或状况，导致无法顺利进行。
explanation_english: Refers to a sudden malfunction or breakdown of machinery, equipment, or electronic products. It can also refer to a sudden problem or situation that disrupts the smooth progress of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦成日斷搶，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sing4 jat6 dyun3 coeng2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑经常出问题，导致我没法工作。
examples.english_sentence: This computer malfunctions all the time, making it impossible for me to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架車喺半路斷搶，搞到我哋遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 ce1 hai2 bun3 lou6 dyun3 coeng2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的车在半路上出问题了，导致我们迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: His car broke down halfway, causing us to be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知點解，佢部電話突然間斷搶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 dim2 gai2, keoi5 bou6 din6 waa2 dat6 jin4 gaan1 dyun3 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道为什么，他的电话突然间就出问题了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why, but his phone suddenly malfunctioned.

english_meaning: To have no descendants; to die without issue; to have no one to carry on the family line.
explanation_mandarin: 指没有后代，绝嗣。
explanation_english: Refers to having no descendants, to die without issue, or to have the family line cut off. The imagery comes from a carrying pole (担挑) breaking, symbolizing the inability to carry on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就走咗，真係斷擔挑呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 dyun3 daam3 tiu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就去世了，真是绝后了！
examples.english_sentence: He passed away so young, it's truly tragic that he has no descendants!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇仔女，咪即係斷擔挑囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 mou5 zai2 neoi5, mai1 zik1 hai6 dyun3 daam3 tiu1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有子女，不就是绝后了吗。
examples.english_sentence: If there are no children, then it means there's no one to carry on the family line.

english_meaning: Definitely, certainly
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常肯定和确定的语气，类似于“一定”、“肯定”。
explanation_english: Expresses a strong sense of certainty and definiteness, similar to "definitely" or "certainly". It emphasizes that something will undoubtedly happen or is undoubtedly true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚斷斷落雨㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 dyun6 dyun6 lok6 jyu5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚肯定会下雨的。
examples.english_sentence: It's definitely going to rain tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，斷斷考到好成績啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, dyun6 dyun6 haau2 dou2 hou2 sing1 jik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，肯定能考到好成绩的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so smart; you'll definitely get good grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢斷斷會幫你手㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dyun6 dyun6 wui5 bong1 nei5 sau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他肯定会帮你忙的。
examples.english_sentence: He will definitely help you.

english_meaning: intermittently; off and on; sporadically
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物时断时续，不连贯。
explanation_english: Describes something that is intermittent, sporadic, or not continuous; occurring in fits and starts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚我斷斷續續咁聽到有啲怪聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 ngaan5 ngo5 dyun6 dyun6 zuk6 zuk6 gam2 ting1 dou2 jau5 di1 gwaai3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天晚上我断断续续地听到一些奇怪的声音。
examples.english_sentence: Last night, I heard some strange noises intermittently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗好耐，斷斷續續咁睇醫生，都冇乜起色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, dyun6 dyun6 zuk6 zuk6 gam2 tai2 yi1 sang1, dou1 mou5 mat1 hei2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了很久，断断续续地看医生，都没有什么好转。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sick for a long time, seeing the doctor off and on, but there's been little improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅談話斷斷續續，因為電話訊號唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 taam4 waa2 dyun6 dyun6 zuk6 zuk6, yan1 wai6 din6 waa2 seon3 hou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的谈话断断续续，因为电话信号不好。
examples.english_sentence: Our conversation was intermittent because the phone signal was bad.

mandarin_meaning: 残缺不全的东西；不中用的人或物
english_meaning: A broken piece of worm; useless person or thing; someone who is not capable or competent.
explanation_mandarin: “禾蟲”是一种水生环节动物，是一种美味的食材。 “斷橛禾蟲”指被切断的禾蟲，残缺不全，因此比喻没有用处的人或物。 比喻人能力不足，不可靠，没有用。
explanation_english: "Wo4 cung4" (禾蟲) is an aquatic segmented worm and is a delicacy. "Dyun6 kyut3 wo4 cung4" (斷橛禾蟲) refers to a cut-off piece of worm, incomplete and therefore useless. It is used metaphorically to describe a person or thing that is useless or incompetent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪諗住靠佢呀，條友斷橛禾蟲嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 lam2 zyu6 kaau3 keoi5 aa3, tiu4 jau2 dyun6 kyut3 wo4 cung4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想指望他，那个人是个废物。
examples.english_sentence: Don't even think about relying on him, that guy is completely useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機用到斷橛禾蟲咁，都唔知整唔整得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 jung6 dou3 dyun6 kyut3 wo4 cung4 gam2, dou1 m4 zi1 zing2 m4 zing2 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器坏得不成样子，都不知道能不能修好。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is so broken, I don't even know if it can be fixed.

english_meaning: caught red-handed; caught in the act
explanation_mandarin: 指某人正在做坏事或不应该做的事情时，被当场抓住。
explanation_english: Refers to someone being caught red-handed, or caught in the act of doing something wrong or something they shouldn't be doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷嘢俾差人斷正咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 je5 bei2 caai1 yan4 dyun3 zing3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他偷东西被警察当场抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught red-handed stealing by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺課室瞓覺俾老師斷正咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 fo3 sat1 fan3 gaau3 bei2 lou5 si1 dyun3 zing3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在教室睡觉被老师抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: I was caught sleeping in class by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到三更半夜，點知佢阿媽突然返嚟，斷正咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 saam1 gaang1 bun3 je6, dim2 zi1 keoi5 aa3 maa1 dat6 jin4 faan1 lei4, dyun3 zing3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他玩游戏玩到半夜三更，结果他妈妈突然回来，被抓现行了。
examples.english_sentence: He was playing games until the middle of the night, but then his mom suddenly came back and caught him in the act.

synonyms: 捉黃腳雞 (zuk1 wong4 goek3 gai1)

english_meaning: to die, to breathe one's last, to pass away
explanation_mandarin: 指停止呼吸，死亡。
explanation_english: To stop breathing; to die; to breathe one's last.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺醫院斷咗氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ji1 yun2 dyun6 zo2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在医院断气了。
examples.english_sentence: He died in the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個病人就嚟斷氣喇，快啲叫醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 beng6 yan2 zau6 lai4 dyun6 hei3 laa3, faai3 di1 giu3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病人快要断气了，快点叫医生。
examples.english_sentence: The patient is about to die, call the doctor quickly.

english_meaning: water supply cut off; water outage
explanation_mandarin: 指停止供水。
explanation_english: Refers to the cessation of water supply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日成個區都斷水，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 seng4 go3 keoi1 dou1 dyun6 seoi2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天整个区都停水了，不知道搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: The water supply was cut off in the whole district yesterday. I don't know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企斷水，沖唔到涼呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 dyun6 seoi2, cung1 m4 dou2 loeng4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家停水了，不能洗澡啊。
examples.english_sentence: Our water supply is cut off, so we can't take a shower.

english_meaning: cut off water and food supplies; to be in a desperate situation due to lack of supplies
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏食物和饮用水，形容处境非常艰难、困苦。
explanation_english: Describes a situation of extreme hardship and difficulty due to the lack of food and water supplies. It implies being in a very desperate and vulnerable state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾日嘅風災，好多村落都斷水斷糧，情況好危急呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 jat6 ge3 fung1 zoi1, hou2 do1 cyun1 lok6 dou1 dyun6 seoi2 dyun6 loeng4, cing4 fong3 hou2 ngai4 gap1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几天的风灾，很多村庄都断水断粮，情况很危急啊！
examples.english_sentence: After several days of the typhoon, many villages are cut off from water and food supplies, the situation is very critical!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋再唔諗辦法，我哋就會斷水斷糧㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 zoi3 m4 lam2 baan6 faat3, ngo5 dei6 zau6 wui5 dyun6 seoi2 dyun6 loeng4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们再不想法子，我们就要断水断粮了。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't think of a solution soon, we will be cut off from water and food.

english_meaning: cut off water and electricity; disconnection of water and electricity supply
explanation_mandarin: 指停止供应自来水和电力，通常是因为欠费或其他原因导致的服务中断。
explanation_english: Refers to the cessation of the supply of water and electricity, usually due to unpaid bills or other reasons leading to service interruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為交唔起租，俾業主斷水斷電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 gaau1 m4 hei2 zou1, bei2 jip6 zyu2 dyun6 seoi2 dyun6 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为交不起房租，被房东断水断电。
examples.english_sentence: They were cut off from water and electricity by the landlord because they couldn't afford the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風嚟嘅時候，好多村屋都會斷水斷電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 lei4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 cyun1 uk1 dou1 wui5 dyun6 seoi2 dyun6 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风来的时候，很多村屋都会断水断电。
examples.english_sentence: During typhoons, many village houses experience water and electricity cuts.

english_meaning: cut off water and electricity supply
explanation_mandarin: 停止供应自来水和电力。
explanation_english: To cut off the supply of water and electricity, often due to unpaid bills or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為交唔起租，俾業主斷水電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 gaau1 m4 hei2 zo1, bei2 yip6 zyu2 dyun6 seoi2 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为交不起租，被业主停了水电。
examples.english_sentence: They had their water and electricity cut off by the landlord because they couldn't afford the rent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔交電費，電力公司會斷水電㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 m4 gaau1 din6 fai3, din6 lik6 gung1 si1 wui5 dyun6 seoi2 din6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不交电费，电力公司会停水停电的。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't pay your electricity bill, the power company will cut off the water and electricity.

english_meaning: resolutely; absolutely; definitely
explanation_mandarin: 表示坚决、决断地。
explanation_english: Expressing firmness and decisiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢斷然拒絕咗我哋嘅提議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dyun6 jin4 keoi5 gyut6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tai4 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他断然拒绝了我们的提议。
examples.english_sentence: He resolutely rejected our proposal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋斷然唔可以咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dyun6 jin4 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们断然不能这么做。
examples.english_sentence: We absolutely cannot do that.

english_meaning: Blackout (due to excessive alcohol consumption); memory loss
explanation_mandarin: 指因饮酒过量或其他原因导致的短暂性记忆缺失，无法回忆起一段时间内发生的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to temporary memory loss, usually due to excessive alcohol consumption or other causes, where one cannot recall events during a specific period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋晚飲到斷片，乜都唔記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 maan1 jam2 dou3 dyun6 pin3, mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚喝到断片，什么都不记得了。
examples.english_sentence: I drank so much last night that I blacked out and don't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日飲酒飲到斷片，真係唔係辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jam2 zau2 jam2 dou3 dyun6 pin3, zan1 hai6 m4 hai6 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常喝酒喝到断片，真不是办法。
examples.english_sentence: He often drinks until he blacks out; it's really not a good thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我飲咗幾杯就開始斷片喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jam2 zo2 gei2 bui1 zau6 hoi1 chi2 dyun6 pin3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喝了几杯就开始断片了。
examples.english_sentence: I started blacking out after drinking a few glasses.

english_meaning: to break an addiction; to kick a habit; withdrawal (from addiction)
explanation_mandarin: 指戒除对某种事物（如毒品、酒精、赌博等）的依赖或嗜好，通常伴随戒断反应。
explanation_english: Refers to breaking free from an addiction or habit (such as drugs, alcohol, gambling, etc.), usually accompanied by withdrawal symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要斷癮好困難㗎，因為佢已經上癮好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu3 dyun3 jan5 hou2 kwan3 naan4 gaa3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 ji5 ging1 soeng5 jan5 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戒瘾很困难，因为他已经上瘾很久了。
examples.english_sentence: It's very difficult for him to kick the habit because he has been addicted for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢去戒毒所斷癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 keoi5 heoi3 gaai3 duk6 so2 dyun3 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议他去戒毒所戒毒。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested he go to a rehabilitation center to break his drug addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 斷癮期間，佢嘅情緒好唔穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dyun3 jan5 kei4 gaan1, keoi5 ge3 ching4 seoi5 hou2 m4 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在戒瘾期间，他的情绪很不稳定。
examples.english_sentence: During the withdrawal period, his emotions are very unstable.

english_meaning: Out of stock (in certain sizes); Discontinued size(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指商品某个或某些尺码的库存已经售完，不再有货。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where certain size(s) of a product are out of stock and no longer available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好多碼都斷碼喇，得返細碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 do1 maa5 dou1 dyun3 maa5 laa3, dak1 faan1 sai3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很多尺码都断码了，只剩下小码。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is out of stock in many sizes, only small size is left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪做緊清貨，所以有啲款會斷碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 zou6 gan2 cing1 fo3, so2 ji5 jau5 di1 fun2 wui5 dyun3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店正在清仓，所以有些款式会断码。
examples.english_sentence: This store is having a clearance sale, so some styles are out of stock in certain sizes.

english_meaning: to quote out of context; to take something out of context
explanation_mandarin: 截取文章或言论的一部分，而不顾及整体内容和语境，故意歪曲原意。
explanation_english: To quote something out of context; to present a part of a statement in a way that distorts its meaning. It refers to deliberately misinterpreting someone's words or writings by quoting them selectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢斷章取義，想抹黑我嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dyun3 zoeng1 ceoi2 ji6, soeng2 mut3 hak1 ngo5 ge3 seng1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他断章取义，想抹黑我的声誉。
examples.english_sentence: He's quoting me out of context to tarnish my reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好斷章取義呀，要睇返成篇嘢先知佢真正嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dyun3 zoeng1 ceoi2 ji6 aa3, jiu3 tai2 faan1 seng4 pin1 je5 sin1 zi1 keoi5 zan1 zeng3 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要断章取义啊，要看回整篇文章才知道它真正的意思。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take it out of context, you need to read the whole article to understand its real meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者經常斷章取義啲政治人物嘅說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 ging1 seong4 dyun3 zoeng1 ceoi2 ji6 di1 zing3 zi6 yan4 mat6 ge3 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者经常断章取义政治人物的话。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters often quote politicians out of context.

mandarin_meaning: 残缺不全的书籍或文献片段
english_meaning: fragmentary documents; incomplete records; scraps of writing
explanation_mandarin: 指残缺不全的书籍、文献或文字片段。 形容事物不完整，难以拼凑出完整的信息。
explanation_english: Refers to incomplete books, documents, or fragments of writing. Describes something that is incomplete and difficult to piece together to form a complete picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺舊屋嘅閣樓搵到啲斷簡殘章，唔知係咪祖先留低嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gau6 uk1 ge3 gok3 lau4 wan2 dou2 di1 dyun3 gaan2 caan4 zoeng1, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 zou2 sin1 lau4 dai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在老房子的阁楼里找到一些残缺不全的文字，不知道是不是祖先留下的。
examples.english_sentence: I found some fragmentary documents in the attic of the old house; I don't know if they were left by our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個案件嘅資料好零碎，全部都係斷簡殘章，好難查落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 on3 gin2 ge3 zi1 liu2 hou2 ling4 seoi3, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 dyun3 gaan2 caan4 zoeng1, hou2 naan4 caa4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个案件的资料非常零碎，全都是残缺不全的记录，很难继续调查下去。
examples.english_sentence: The information for this case is very fragmented, all just incomplete records, making it difficult to continue the investigation.

english_meaning: to lose one's livelihood; to cut off one's source of income
explanation_mandarin: 指失去了谋生的手段，没有了收入来源。
explanation_english: Refers to losing one's means of making a living, having no source of income anymore. Literally, 'cut off the rice road'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果間公司執咗笠，我就斷米路喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 zo2 lap1, ngo5 zau6 dyun6 mai5 lou6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这家公司倒闭了，我就断了生计了。
examples.english_sentence: If this company closes down, I'll lose my livelihood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒咗老細魷魚，咪就係斷米路囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 zo2 lou5 sai3 jau4 jyu2, mai1 zau6 hai6 dyun6 mai5 lou6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他炒了老板的鱿鱼，不就是断了生计吗？
examples.english_sentence: He quit on his boss, doesn't that mean he's lost his livelihood?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情搞到好多人斷米路，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 dyun6 mai5 lou6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情导致很多人断了生计，真是可怜。
examples.english_sentence: The pandemic has caused many people to lose their livelihood, it's really pitiful.

english_meaning: to sever; to break off; to discontinue; to cut off (relations, supplies, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 切断，断开，停止来往。
explanation_english: To cut off; to break off; to sever; to discontinue relationships, supplies, or connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經斷絕關係啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 dyun6 zyut6 gwaan1 hai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经断绝关系了。
examples.english_sentence: We've already broken off our relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同屋企人斷絕聯絡好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 dyun6 zyut6 lyun4 lok3 hou2 noi6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和家人断绝联系很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He has lost contact with his family for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定斷絕所有同嗰個國家嘅貿易關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 dyun6 zyut6 so2 jau5 tung4 go2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 mau6 yik6 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定断绝所有和那个国家的贸易关系。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to cut off all trade relations with that country.

english_meaning: Internet outage, to lose internet connection, to be disconnected from the internet
explanation_mandarin: 指网络连接中断，无法上网。
explanation_english: Refers to the interruption of internet connection, making it impossible to access the internet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日屋企突然間斷網，搞到我做唔到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 uk1 kei2 dat6 jin4 gaan1 dyun3 mong5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 zou6 m4 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天家里突然断网了，搞得我做不了事。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday the internet suddenly went out at home, which made me unable to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間cafe成日斷網，真係好麻煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 cafe seng4 jat6 dyun3 mong5, zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家咖啡厅总是断网，真麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: This cafe always has internet outages, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果考試嗰陣斷網就好弊啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haau2 si3 go2 zan6 dyun3 mong5 zau6 hou2 bai6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果在考试的时候断网就糟糕了！
examples.english_sentence: If the internet goes out during the exam, that would be terrible!

english_meaning: disconnected; out of touch; not making sense; losing it; blanking out
explanation_mandarin: 原指电线断开，引申为失去联系，精神状态不佳，思维中断等。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a broken wire, it's extended to mean disconnected, out of touch, not making sense, or losing one's mind/blanking out. It can describe someone who is not thinking clearly or is acting irrationally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好似斷咗線咁，唔知佢up乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 ci5 dyun3 zo2 sin3 gam2, m4 zi1 keoi5 ap1 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话好像断了线一样，不知道他在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: What he's saying is like he's lost it, I don't know what he's talking about.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日唔覆我message，好似斷咗線咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 m4 fuk1 ngo5 message, hou2 ci5 dyun3 zo2 sin3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是不回我信息，好像断了线一样。
examples.english_sentence: He never replies to my messages, it's like we're disconnected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗嘢諗到斷曬線，唔知點做好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 je5 lam2 dou3 dyun3 saai3 sin3, m4 zi1 dim2 zou6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想事情想得断线了，不知道该怎么做。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so stressed thinking about things that I'm losing it and don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 断线; 失去联系; 关系断绝
english_meaning: To lose contact; to sever ties; to cut off communication; literally 'break the rope'
explanation_mandarin: 原指船只断缆，引申为失去联系，断绝关系。多用于人际关系或恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a ship breaking its mooring rope, it is extended to mean losing contact, severing ties, or ending a relationship. Mostly used for interpersonal relationships or romantic relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢已經斷咗纜好耐啦，冇再聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ji5 ging1 dyun3 zo2 laam6 hou2 noi6 laa3, mou5 zoi3 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他已经断了联系很久了，没有再联系。
examples.english_sentence: I've lost contact with him for a long time, we don't communicate anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍拖唔夠一年就斷纜，真係估唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 m4 gau3 jat1 nin4 zau6 dyun3 laam6, zan1 hai6 gu2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈恋爱不到一年就分手了，真是想不到。
examples.english_sentence: They broke up in less than a year of dating, I really didn't expect that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢移民之後，我哋就斷纜喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 ji4 man4 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 dyun3 laam6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他移民之后，我们就断了联系了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he immigrated, we've lost contact.

english_meaning: homosexuality, gay (usually referring to male homosexuality)
explanation_mandarin: 指男性之间的同性恋行为或关系。
explanation_english: Refers to homosexual acts or relationships between men. It's a slightly dated and sometimes considered a sensitive term. More neutral terms like '同志' are preferred.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人對斷背嘅接受程度高咗好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 deoi3 dyun3 bui3 ge3 zip3 sau6 cing4 dou6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在人们对同性恋的接受程度高了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people are much more accepting of homosexuality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係斷背㗎，大家都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 dyun3 bui3 gaa3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是同性恋，大家都知道。
examples.english_sentence: They are gay, everyone knows.

english_meaning: heartbroken, deeply saddened, gut-wrenching
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常悲伤，悲痛欲绝，好像肠子都断了一样。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme sorrow or grief, as if one's intestines are breaking. It conveys a feeling of intense heartbreak and emotional pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢走咗嘅消息，我真係斷腸咁痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 zau2 zo2 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 dyun3 coeng2 gam2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他去世的消息，我真是断肠般地痛。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his passing, I felt a gut-wrenching pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失戀嘅感覺真係令人斷腸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 lyun2 ge3 gam2 gok3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 dyun3 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失恋的感觉真令人断肠。
examples.english_sentence: The feeling of heartbreak is truly gut-wrenching.

english_meaning: Gelsemium elegans (a highly poisonous plant, literally "gut-severing grass")
explanation_mandarin: 一种剧毒植物，学名钩吻，误食会导致腹痛、抽搐等症状，严重者可致死。因其毒性之烈，故有“断肠”之说。
explanation_english: Gelsemium elegans, a highly poisonous plant. Ingestion can cause abdominal pain, convulsions, and even death in severe cases. It's called "gut-severing grass" due to its extreme toxicity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢唔小心食咗啲斷腸草，差啲冇命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 sik6 zo2啲 dyun6 coeng4 cou2, caa1 di1 mou5 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他不小心吃了一些断肠草，差点没命了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he accidentally ate some Gelsemium elegans and almost died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嘅時候要小心，唔好亂咁食啲唔認得嘅植物，可能係斷腸草㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 sik6啲 m4 ying6 dak1 ge3植mat6, ho2 nang4 hai6 dyun6 coeng4 cou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的时候要小心，不要乱吃不认识的植物，有可能是断肠草。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when hiking and don't eat unfamiliar plants indiscriminately, it could be Gelsemium elegans.

mandarin_meaning: 取消连庄; 中断连庄
english_meaning: To break the bank; to break the dealer's streak (in gambling); to discontinue a winning streak
explanation_mandarin: 原本指赌博时，庄家连续赢的局面被打破，失去庄家的位置。后来也用来比喻某人在某事上连续取得成功，但最终失败或停止。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to breaking the dealer's winning streak and losing the dealer position in gambling. Later, it's also used to describe someone's continuous success in something, but ultimately failing or stopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚喺賭場度斷咗莊，輸咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 maan1 hai2 dou2 coeng4 dou6 dyun3 zo2 zong1, syu1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚在赌场断了庄，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He broke the bank at the casino last night and lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前考試次次都攞第一，但係今次失手，斷咗莊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 haau2 si5 ci3 ci3 dou1 lo2 dai6 jat1, daan6 hai6 gam1 ci3 sat1 sau2, dyun3 zo2 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前每次考试都拿第一，但是这次失手，中断了连庄。
examples.english_sentence: He always got first place in exams before, but this time he messed up and broke his winning streak.

english_meaning: fracture; break; rupture
explanation_mandarin: 指物体断开裂开；亦可指关系破裂。
explanation_english: To break or fracture; can also refer to the breakdown of a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩索斷裂咗，搞到我差啲跌親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing4 sok3 dyun6 lit6 zo2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 caa1 di1 dit3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 绳子断裂了，害得我差点摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: The rope broke, causing me to almost fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係因為誤會而斷裂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 yan1 wai6 ng6 wui6 ji4 dyun6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系因为误会而破裂。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship broke down due to a misunderstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅屏幕斷裂咗，要攞去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 ping4 muk6 dyun6 lit6 zo2, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机的屏幕断裂了，需要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: The screen of this phone is cracked, it needs to be repaired.

english_meaning: to assert; to declare; to make a definite statement
explanation_mandarin: 明确肯定地说；下定论。
explanation_english: To state something definitely and firmly; to make a categorical assertion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔會咁快斷言佢哋一定會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 wui5 gam3 faai3 dyun3 jin4 keoi5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不会这么快断言他们一定会成功。
examples.english_sentence: I wouldn't be so quick to assert that they will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢斷言呢件事一定唔關佢事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dyun3 jin4 ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 ding6 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他断言这件事一定与他无关。
examples.english_sentence: He declared that this matter had nothing to do with him.

english_meaning: to forfeit, to ruin, to lose (something valuable), to send to one's doom
explanation_mandarin: 原本指送死，现在多指因某种原因而失去、毁掉（美好的事物、前途等）。
explanation_english: Originally meant to send someone to their death, but now it often refers to losing or ruining (something valuable, one's future, etc.) due to some reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣落去，遲早斷送埋自己嘅前途。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 yeung2 lok6 heui3, chi4 zou2 dyun3 sung3 maai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 chin4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样下去，迟早会断送了自己的前途。
examples.english_sentence: If things continue like this, sooner or later you'll ruin your own future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好沉迷賭博，唔係就好易斷送一生㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 cham4 mai4 dou2 bok3, m4 hai6 jau6 hou2 yi6 dyun3 sung3 yat1 sang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要沉迷赌博，不然很容易断送一生的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be addicted to gambling, or you'll easily ruin your whole life.

english_meaning: Power outage, power cut, blackout
explanation_mandarin: 电力供应中断，停止供电。
explanation_english: To have a power outage; a situation where the electricity supply is interrupted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日打風，成個區都斷電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 daa2 fung1, seng4 go3 keoi1 dou1 dyun6 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天刮台风，整个区都停电了。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday there was a typhoon, and the whole district had a power outage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 突然間斷電，我部電腦啲嘢都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dat6 jin4 gaan1 dyun6 din6, ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 di1 je5 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 突然停电，我电脑里的东西都没了。
examples.english_sentence: There was a sudden power outage, and all the data on my computer was lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋斷電，乜都做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 dyun6 din6, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里停电，什么都做不了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a power outage at home, so I can't do anything.

english_meaning: Guillotine
explanation_mandarin: 古代用来处决犯人的刑具，一种通过刀片迅速落下斩首的机器。
explanation_english: A device used for execution by decapitation, consisting of a heavy blade that is dropped between two vertical guides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺法國大革命嗰陣用斷頭台斬咗好多人嘅頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 faat3 gwok3 daai6 gaak3 ming6 go2 zan6 yung6 dyun6 tau4 toi4 zaam2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在法国大革命的时候用断头台砍了很多人的头。
examples.english_sentence: They used the guillotine to behead many people during the French Revolution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到好似我哋公司係斷頭台咁，做錯少少嘢就炒魷魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 dyun6 tau4 toi4 gam2, zou6 co3 siu2 siu2 je5 zau6 caau2 yau4 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说的好像我们公司是断头台一样，做错一点点事就被解雇。
examples.english_sentence: It's like our company is a guillotine, if you make a small mistake, you're fired.

english_meaning: guillotine, execution ground
explanation_mandarin: 一种古代的刑具，用于斩首。 也可引申为比喻让人身败名裂的处境。
explanation_english: A guillotine, an instrument of execution by beheading. Can also be used metaphorically to describe a situation that leads to downfall or ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業好似行緊斷頭臺咁，岌岌可危。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 hou2 ci5 haang4 gan2 dyun6 tau4 toi4 gam2, ngap1 ngap1 ho2 ngai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业好像走在断头台上一样，岌岌可危。
examples.english_sentence: His career is like walking on a guillotine; it's in a precarious situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司裁員嘅傳聞搞到人心惶惶，個個都好似等上斷頭臺咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 ge3 cyun4 man4 gaau2 dou3 jan4 sam1 fong4 fong4, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 ci5 dang2 soeng5 dyun6 tau4 toi4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司裁员的传闻搞得人心惶惶，每个人都好像在等待上断头台一样。
examples.english_sentence: The rumors of layoffs in this company have caused panic; everyone feels like they are waiting to go to the guillotine.

english_meaning: fasting, to fast
explanation_mandarin: 停止進食，尤指為了健康或宗教原因。
explanation_english: To abstain from eating food, especially for health or religious reasons; fasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議佢斷食一日，等腸胃休息下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 yi5 keoi5 dyun3 sik6 jat1 jat6, dang2 cheung2 wai2 yau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生建议他禁食一天，让肠胃休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested he fast for one day to let his stomach rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人為咗減肥會間歇性斷食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 wai6 zo2 gaam2 fei4 wui gaan3 hit3 sing3 dyun3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人为了减肥会间歇性断食。
examples.english_sentence: Some people will do intermittent fasting to lose weight.

english_meaning: ecstatic; entranced; heartbroken; grief-stricken; soul-destroying
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常迷恋，心神不定，也可以形容伤心到极点，好像灵魂都要离开身体一样。
explanation_english: Describes being deeply infatuated or entranced, to the point of distraction. It can also describe being extremely heartbroken, as if the soul is leaving the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣靚到斷魂呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 leng3 dou3 dyun3 wan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她长得太漂亮了，简直让人销魂！
examples.english_sentence: She is so beautiful that she is captivating!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失戀嘅時候真係覺得斷魂咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 lyun2 ge3 si4 hau6 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 dyun3 wan4 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失恋的时候真的觉得伤心欲绝。
examples.english_sentence: When you are heartbroken, you really feel like you're dying inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢走咗嘅消息，我真係斷曬魂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 keoi5 zau2 zo2 ge3 siu1 sik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 dyun3 saai3 wan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他去世的消息，我真的伤心极了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing the news of his passing, I was truly heartbroken.

english_meaning: direction; side; square; just (now); newly
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词; 形容词; 副词
explanation_mandarin: 指方向、方面；形容正或方形；表示刚刚或新近。
explanation_english: Refers to a direction or aspect; describes something square or upright; indicates recently or just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 邊方方便啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin1 fong1 fong1 bin6 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪边方便一些？
examples.english_sentence: Which side is more convenient?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個盒係四方形嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap2 hai6 sei3 fong1 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个盒子是正方形的。
examples.english_sentence: This box is square.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我方先至知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fong1 sin1 zi3 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚知道。
examples.english_sentence: I just found out.

english_meaning: Abbot (of a Buddhist monastery); also used colloquially as a term of address for someone in a position of authority (often in a joking or sarcastic way)
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛寺的住持，主持僧团事务的和尚。现在有时也用来戏称或讽刺掌握权力的人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the abbot of a Buddhist monastery, the monk who is in charge of the monastic community. Now, it is sometimes used jokingly or sarcastically to refer to people who hold power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你估你係方丈呀？乜都你話事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gu2 nei5 hai6 fong1 zoeng6 aa3? mat1 dou1 nei5 waa6 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为你是住持啊？什么都你说了算！
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you're the abbot? You get to decide everything!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅老細好似方丈咁，永遠都聽唔入人哋嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 lou5 sai3 hou2 ci5 fong1 zoeng6 gam2, wing5 jyun5 dou1 teng1 m4 jap6 yan4 dei6 ge3 yi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的老板好像住持一样，永远都听不进别人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: The company boss is like an abbot; he never listens to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: direction; position; orientation
explanation_mandarin: 方向；位置；朝向
explanation_english: Direction; position; orientation; the direction one is facing or moving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔識睇地圖，搞唔清個方位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 sik1 tai2 dei6 tou4, gaau2 m4 cing1 go3 fong1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不认识看地图，搞不清楚方向。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to read a map, I can't figure out the direction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅方位好好，坐北向南。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 fong1 wai2 hou2 hou2, zo6 bak1 hoeng3 naam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子的方位很好，坐北朝南。
examples.english_sentence: The orientation of this house is very good, facing south and sitting north.

english_meaning: convenient; convenient time; to help out; to use the toilet
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词, 动词, 名词
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：便利，顺手。动词：使便利，帮助。名词：机会，方便的时候；指上厕所。
explanation_english: Adjective: convenient, handy. Verb: to make convenient, to help out. Noun: opportunity, convenient time; to use the toilet (euphemism).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個時間我唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 ngo5 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个时间我不方便。
examples.english_sentence: This time is not convenient for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我個方便啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 go3 fong1 bin6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可不可以帮我个忙啊？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me out?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去方便一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 fong1 bin6 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去方便一下。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the toilet.

synonyms: 幫手 (bong1 sau2) (when meaning 'to help out')

english_meaning: sandwich bread, sliced bread, toast bread
explanation_mandarin: 指切片面包，通常用于制作三明治或烤面包。
explanation_english: Refers to sliced bread, typically used for making sandwiches or toast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買兩塊方包做三文治。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 faai3 fong1 baau1 zou6 saam1 man4 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买两片吐司做三明治。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy two slices of sandwich bread to make a sandwich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 早餐我通常食方包烘底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou2 caan1 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 sik6 fong1 baau1 hung3 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早餐我通常吃烤吐司。
examples.english_sentence: I usually eat toasted bread for breakfast.

english_meaning: direction; orientation
explanation_mandarin: 指事物所朝向的方位或发展趋势。

explanation_english: Refers to the direction and method for handling matters; a guiding principle or policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司今年嘅發展方針係開拓新市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 ge3 faat3 zin2 fong1 zan1 hai6 hoi1 tok3 san1 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司今年的发展方针是开拓新市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company's development policy this year is to explore new markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅教育方針需要檢討。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 gaau3 yuk6 fong1 zan1 seoi1 jiu3 gim2 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的教育方针需要检讨。
examples.english_sentence: The government's education policy needs review.

english_meaning: aspect; side; facet; respect
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的一方面或一个方面。
explanation_english: Refers to one aspect or a certain side of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺工作方面，佢表現得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 zok3 fong1 min6, keoi5 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在工作方面，他表现得很好。
examples.english_sentence: In terms of work, he performs very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對呢方面嘅知識唔多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fong1 min6 ge3 zi1 sik1 m4 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对这方面的知识不多。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much knowledge in this aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 安全方面要多加注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on1 cyun4 fong1 min6 jiu3 do1 ga1 zyu3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 安全方面要注意。
examples.english_sentence: We need to pay more attention to the safety aspect.

english_meaning: at, in, on, to, from, than
explanation_mandarin: 表示处所、时间、方向、对象、范围、原因等。
explanation_english: Indicates location, time, direction, object, scope, reason, etc. Generally functions as a preposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在香港。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢於上個月離開咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyu1 soeng6 go3 jyut6 lei4 hoi1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他于上个月离开了。
examples.english_sentence: He left last month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺呢間學校讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这间学校读书。
examples.english_sentence: I study at this school.

english_meaning: of no help; useless; to no avail
explanation_mandarin: 指对事情没有任何帮助或作用。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is of no help or effect to a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家先嚟幫手，都於事無濟㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 bong1 sau2, dou1 jyu1 si6 mou4 zai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在才来帮忙，都无济于事了。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use you coming to help now, it's already too late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講咁多都於事無濟，不如直接啲做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 gam3 do1 dou1 jyu1 si6 mou4 zai3, bat1 jyu4 zik6 zip3 di1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说那么多也没用，不如直接做。
examples.english_sentence: Talking so much is useless, we might as well just do it directly.

english_meaning: of no help; of no avail; to no avail; to no purpose; to be of no help
explanation_mandarin: 对事情没有帮助。指做了也白做，起不到任何作用。
explanation_english: To be of no help or use; to be ineffectual. Describes an action that is futile and does not improve a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家先嚟道歉都於事無補㗎啦，佢已經決定咗辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 dou6 hip3 dou1 jyu1 si6 mou4 bou2 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zo2 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在才来道歉也无济于事了，她已经决定辞职了。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use apologizing now, she has already decided to resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講咁多都於事無補，最緊要係行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 gam3 do1 dou1 jyu1 si6 mou4 bou2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说这么多也没用，最重要的是行动。
examples.english_sentence: Saying so much is of no use, the most important thing is to take action.

english_meaning: to be unable to bear to; to not have the heart to
explanation_mandarin: 内心不忍心做某事，通常指因为同情或不愿伤害对方。
explanation_english: To feel unwilling or unable to do something because of compassion or a reluctance to cause harm to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁慘，我於心不忍唔幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 gam3 caam2, ngo5 jyu1 sam1 bat1 jan2 m4 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么惨，我不忍心不帮助他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so miserable, I couldn't bear not to help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我於心不忍將佢炒魷魚，但係佢嘅表現實在太差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jyu1 sam1 bat1 jan2 zoeng1 keoi5 caau2 jau4 jyu2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ge3 biu2 hin3 sat6 zoi6 taai3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不忍心解雇他，但是他的表现实在太差。
examples.english_sentence: I couldn't bear to fire him, but his performance was just too bad.

english_meaning: How can one bear to do something?
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事感到不忍心，难以狠下心肠去做。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of being unable to bring oneself to do something because it is too cruel or against one's conscience. It indicates a strong reluctance to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇住啲細路咁慘，我於心何忍唔幫手？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 zyu6 di1 sai3 lou2 gam3 caam2, ngo5 jyu1 sam1 ho4 jan2 m4 bong1 sau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看着这些孩子这么可怜，我怎么忍心不帮忙呢？
examples.english_sentence: Seeing these children in such a miserable state, how can I bear not to help?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都病到咁樣，你仲要佢返工，於心何忍呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 beng6 dou3 gam2 joeng2, nei5 zung6 jiu3 keoi5 faan1 gung1, jyu1 sam1 ho4 jan2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都病成这样了，你还要他回去工作，你忍心吗？
examples.english_sentence: He's already so sick, how can you bear to make him go back to work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻狗咁乖，點解你會於心何忍棄養佢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gau2 gam3 gwaai1, dim2 gaai2 nei5 wui5 jyu1 sam1 ho4 jan2 hei3 joeng5 keoi5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只狗这么乖，为什么你忍心抛弃它？
examples.english_sentence: The dog is so obedient, why would you bear to abandon it?

english_meaning: to have a guilty conscience; to feel ashamed
explanation_mandarin: 心里感到惭愧和不安，因为做了错事或者没有尽到责任。
explanation_english: To feel ashamed and uneasy due to having done something wrong or failing to fulfill one's responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我呃咗佢咁多錢，真係於心有愧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aak1 zo2 keoi5 gam3 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 jyu1 sam1 jau5 kwai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我骗了他这么多钱，真是问心有愧。
examples.english_sentence: I cheated him out of so much money, I really feel guilty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我應承咗幫佢手，但係最後都冇做到，於心有愧啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing3 sing4 zo2 bong1 keoi5 sau2, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mou5 zou6 dou2, jyu1 sam1 jau5 kwai5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我答应了帮他，但是最后都没做到，感觉很惭愧。
examples.english_sentence: I promised to help him, but in the end I didn't do it. I feel ashamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇好好照顧父母，我成日都於心有愧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 hou2 hou2 ziu3 gu3 fu6 mou5, ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jyu1 sam1 jau5 kwai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没有好好照顾父母，我总是感到内疚。
examples.english_sentence: I always feel guilty for not taking good care of my parents.

english_meaning: therefore, hence, consequently, thereupon
explanation_mandarin: 表示后一个动作或情况是前一个动作或情况的结果。
explanation_english: Indicates that the subsequent action or situation is the result of the previous action or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發燒，於是睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 siu1, jyu1 si6 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发烧了，于是去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He had a fever, therefore he went to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔夠錢，於是冇買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gau3 cin2, jyu1 si6 mou5 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我钱不够，所以没买到。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't have enough money, so I didn't buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落大雨，於是取消咗個活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 daai6 jyu5, jyu1 si6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 go3 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下了大雨，于是取消了活动。
examples.english_sentence: It rained heavily, therefore the activity was cancelled.

english_meaning: therefore, hence, consequently
explanation_mandarin: 表示承接关系，相当于“于是”、“因此”。文言色彩较浓。
explanation_english: A conjunction indicating a consequential relationship; equivalent to 'therefore' or 'hence'. It has a somewhat formal and literary tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日病咗，於是乎今日就冇返工啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 beng6 zo2, jyu1 si6 fu4 gam1 jat6 zau6 mou5 faan1 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天病了，于是乎今天就没有上班了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick yesterday, therefore he didn't go to work today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢努力讀書，於是乎考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, jyu1 si6 fu4 haau2 dou2 hou2 sing1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他努力读书，于是乎考到了好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: He studied hard, therefore he got good grades.

english_meaning: May your wish be fulfilled; be satisfied with what one has.
explanation_mandarin: 表示愿望能够实现，就已经很满足了。侧重于对现状的知足和对未来的期望。
explanation_english: Expresses contentment when a wish is fulfilled. It emphasizes satisfaction with the current situation and expectation for the future, implying that achieving the desired outcome is enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係想佢身體健康，咁就於願足矣喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 keoi5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, gam2 zau6 jyu1 jyun6 zuk1 ji5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只希望他身体健康，这样就心满意足了。
examples.english_sentence: I only wish for him to be healthy, and that will be enough to make me happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽攞到獎已經好好，攞唔到都於願足矣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou2 zoeng2 ji5 ging1 hou2 hou2, lo2 m4 dou2 dou1 jyu1 jyun6 zuk1 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛拿到奖已经很好，没拿到也心满意足了。
examples.english_sentence: Getting an award in this competition is already great. If I don't get one, I'll still be satisfied.

english_meaning: to give; to bestow; to grant; to carry out; to implement
explanation_mandarin: 给予，施舍；实行，施行。
explanation_english: To give, bestow; to implement, carry out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 施肥都唔係咁施嘅！
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 fei4 dou1 m4 hai6 gam2 si1 ge3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 施肥也不是这样施的！
examples.english_sentence: That's not how you fertilize!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢施捨啲錢俾個乞丐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si1 se2 di1 cin2 bei2 go3 hat1 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他施舍一些钱给乞丐。
examples.english_sentence: He gave some money to the beggar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會施政去改善民生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 si1 zing3 heoi3 gai2 sin6 man4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府会施政去改善民生。
examples.english_sentence: The government will implement policies to improve people's livelihood.

mandarin_meaning: 施主， 捐赠人， 善人
english_meaning: Benefactor, donor, generous person (often used by monks/nuns)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教用语，和尚或尼姑称呼向寺庙捐赠财物的人，也泛指行善的人。
explanation_english: A term used in Buddhism, referring to a person who donates money or goods to a temple, or generally a person who does good deeds. Often used by monks or nuns when addressing laypeople.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 施主，唔該你捐啲錢畀我哋起廟呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 zyu2, m4 goi1 nei5 gyun1 di1 cin2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 hei2 miu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 施主，请您捐一些钱给我们建庙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Benefactor, please donate some money to us to build the temple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位施主好有善心，經常捐錢幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 si1 zyu2 hou2 jau5 sin6 sam1, ging1 seung4 gyun1 cin2 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位施主很有善心，经常捐钱帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: This benefactor is very kind and often donates money to help people in need.

english_meaning: to give, to bestow, to grant
explanation_mandarin: 给予，施舍。通常指给予帮助或恩惠。
explanation_english: To give, bestow, or grant something, usually referring to providing help or a favour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有愛心，成日施予啲嘢俾有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1, seng4 jat6 si1 jyu5 di1 je5 bei2 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有爱心，经常施舍东西给有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He is very kind and often gives things to people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該盡力施予援手，幫助有困難嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zeon6 lik6 si1 jyu5 wun4 sau2, bong1 zo6 jau5 kwan3 naan4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尽力伸出援手，帮助有困难的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should try our best to offer a helping hand and help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府施予咗好多資源去幫助失業人士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 si1 jyu5 zo2 hou2 do1 zi1 jyun4 heoi3 bong1 zo6 sat1 jip6 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府给予了很多资源去帮助失业人士。
examples.english_sentence: The government has allocated a lot of resources to help the unemployed.

english_meaning: to bestow; to confer; to administer; to apply
explanation_mandarin: 给予，施加。通常用于比较正式的场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To bestow, confer, administer or apply something, often in a formal or written context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院施以急救，但都救唔返佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 si1 ji5 gap1 gau3, daan6 dou1 gau3 m4 faan1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院进行了急救，但还是没能救回他。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital administered first aid, but they couldn't save him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方決定施以嚴懲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 kyut3 ding6 si1 ji5 jim4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方决定施以严厉的惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: The police decided to administer severe punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生會施以局部麻醉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 wui5 si1 ji5 guk6 bou6 maa4 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生会施以局部麻醉。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor will administer local anaesthesia.

english_meaning: to perform surgery; to operate (on)
explanation_mandarin: 进行外科手术；开刀。通常指医生对病人进行手术。
explanation_english: To perform a surgical operation; to operate (on someone). Usually refers to a doctor performing surgery on a patient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢要施刀先得，唔係嘅話會好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 si1 dou1 sin1 dak1, m4 hai6 ge3 waa6 wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他需要动手术才行，不然的话会很危险。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he needs to have surgery, otherwise it will be very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽日就要施刀，希望佢一切順利啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 jat6 zau6 jiu3 si1 dou1, hei1 mong6 keoi5 yat1 chai3 seon6 lei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明天就要动手术了，希望他一切顺利。
examples.english_sentence: He is going to have surgery tomorrow. I hope everything goes well for him.

english_meaning: to exert, to impose, to apply
explanation_mandarin: 指把某种力量或影响加在某人或某事物上。
explanation_english: To exert a force, influence, or pressure on someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋施加壓力俾我，要我接受呢份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 si1 gaa1 aat3 lik6 bei2 ngo5, jiu3 ngo5 zip3 sau6 ni1 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对我施加压力，要我接受这份工作。
examples.english_sentence: They are putting pressure on me to accept this job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府施加咗新嘅稅務政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 si1 gaa1 zo2 san1 ge3 seoi3 mou6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府施加了新的税务政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has imposed a new tax policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好施加咁多負能量俾自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 si1 gaa1 gam3 do1 fu6 nang4 loeng6 bei2 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要给自己施加那么多负能量了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put so much negative energy on yourself.

english_meaning: to exert pressure; to put pressure on
explanation_mandarin: 通过各种手段对某人或某事施加影响力，使其做出某种行为或改变。
explanation_english: To exert influence or pressure on someone or something to make them act in a certain way or change.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆施壓要我哋OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 si1 aat3 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板施压要我们加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is putting pressure on us to work overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好對佢施壓，佢已經好大壓力㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 deoi3 keoi5 si1 aat3, keoi5 ji5 ging1 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要对他施加压力，他已经压力很大了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put pressure on him, he's already under a lot of stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鐘意人哋對我施壓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 jan4 dei6 deoi3 ngo5 si1 aat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢别人对我施加压力。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like it when people put pressure on me.

english_meaning: to use, to put to use, to give full play to; to display (one's skill)
explanation_mandarin: 运用，发挥（技能、本领等）。
explanation_english: To use, exercise, or display one's skills, abilities, or talents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於可以施展佢嘅功夫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 si1 zin2 keoi5 ge3 gung1 fu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于可以施展他的功夫了。
examples.english_sentence: He can finally display his Kung Fu skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想施展佢嘅魅力嚟贏得比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 si1 zin2 keoi5 ge3 mei6 lik6 lai4 wing4 dak1 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想施展他的魅力来赢得比赛。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to use his charm to win the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾啲時間我施展我嘅計劃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 si4 gaan3 ngo5 si1 zin2 ngo5 ge3 gai3 waak6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一些时间施展我的计划。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some time to put my plan into action.

english_meaning: to construct; to build; construction
explanation_mandarin: 指进行工程建设。
explanation_english: Refers to carrying out construction work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面條路施工緊，要兜路行啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 tiu4 lou6 si1 gung1 gan2, jiu3 dau1 lou6 haang4 aa3.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟大廈施工咗好耐都未起好。
